brenton_translation: And Laban said to Jacob, Surely thou shalt not serve me for nothing, because thou art my brother; tell me what thy reward is to be.

fresh_translation: Now Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger Rachel.
brenton_translation: Now Laban had two daughters, the name of the elder was Lea, and the name of the younger, Rachel.

fresh_translation: And Leah's eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and exceedingly lovely in appearance.
brenton_translation: And the eyes of Lea were weak. But Rachel was beautiful in appearance, and exceedingly fair in countenance.

fresh_translation: And Jacob loved Rachel and said, I will serve you seven years for Rachel your younger daughter.
brenton_translation: And Jacob loved Rachel, and said, I will serve thee seven years for thy younger daughter Rachel.

fresh_translation: And Laban said to him, It is better for me to give her to you than for me to give her to another man. Dwell with me.
brenton_translation: And Laban said to him, It is better that I should give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man; dwell with me.

fresh_translation: And Jacob served for Rachel seven years, and they were in his sight like a few days because he loved her.
brenton_translation: And Jacob served for Rachel seven years, and they were before him as a few days, by reason of his loving her.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said to Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled so that I may go in to her.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.

fresh_translation: And Laban gathered all the men of the place and made a wedding feast.
brenton_translation: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a marriage-feast.

fresh_translation: And it happened at evening that he took Leah his daughter and brought her to Jacob, and Jacob went in to her.
brenton_translation: And it was even, and he took his daughter Lea, and brought her in to Jacob, and Jacob went in to her.

fresh_translation: And Laban gave to Leah his daughter Zilpah his servant-girl as servant-girl for her.
brenton_translation: And Laban gave to his daughter Lea, Zelpha his handmaid, as a handmaid for her.

fresh_translation: And it happened in the morning, and look, it was Leah. And Jacob said to Laban, What is this you did to me? Was it not for Rachel that I served with you? And why did you trick me?
brenton_translation: And it was morning, and behold it was Lea; and Jacob said to Laban, What is this that thou hast done to me? did I not serve thee for Rachel? and wherefore hast thou deceived me?

fresh_translation: And Laban answered, It is not done this way in our place, to give the younger before the elder.
brenton_translation: And Laban answered, It is not done thus in our country, to give the younger before the elder.

fresh_translation: So fulfill this one's sevens, and I will give you that one too in exchange for the work that you work with me, still another seven years.
brenton_translation: Fulfil then her sevens, and I will give to thee her also in return for thy labour, which thou labourest with me, yet seven other years.

fresh_translation: And Jacob did so and fulfilled this one's sevens, and Laban gave him Rachel his daughter to him as wife.
brenton_translation: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her sevens; and Laban gave him his daughter Rachel to wife.

fresh_translation: And Laban gave to his daughter Rachel Bilhah his servant-girl as servant-girl for her.
brenton_translation: And Laban gave to his daughter his handmaid Balla, for a handmaid to her.

fresh_translation: And he went in to Rachel, and he loved Rachel more than Leah, and he served him another seven years.
brenton_translation: And he went in to Rachel; and he loved Rachel more than Lea; and he served him seven other years.

fresh_translation: And when the Lord God saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
brenton_translation: And when the Lord God saw that Lea was hated, he opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.

fresh_translation: And Leah conceived and bore a son to Jacob, and she called his name Reuben, saying, Because the Lord saw my humiliation and gave me a son. So now my husband will love me.
brenton_translation: And Lea conceived and bore a son to Jacob; and she called his name, Ruben; saying, Because the Lord has looked on my humiliation, and has given me a son, now then my husband will love me.

fresh_translation: And she conceived again and bore a second son to Jacob and said, Because the Lord heard that I am hated, he gave me this one also. And she called his name Simeon.
brenton_translation: And she conceived again, and bore a second son to Jacob; and she said, Because the Lord has heard that I am hated, he has given to me this one also; and she called his name, Simeon.

fresh_translation: And she conceived yet again and bore a son and said, At this time now my husband will be with me, for I have borne him three sons. Therefore she called his name Levi.
brenton_translation: And she conceived yet again, and bore a son, and said, In the present time my husband will be with me, for I have born him three sons; therefore she called his name, Levi.

fresh_translation: And conceiving yet again she bore a son and said, Now this time I will give thanks to the Lord. Therefore she called his name Judah. And she stopped bearing.
brenton_translation: And having conceived yet again, she bore a son, and said, Now yet again this time will I give thanks to the Lord; therefore she called his name, Juda; and ceased bearing.

fresh_translation: And Rachel, seeing that she bore no children to Jacob, became jealous of her sister and said to Jacob, Give me children, but if not, I will die.
brenton_translation: And Rachel having perceived that she bore Jacob no children, was jealous of her sister; and said to Jacob, Give me children; and if not, I shall die.

fresh_translation: And Jacob, angered at Rachel, said to her, Am I in the place of God, who deprived you of fruit of the womb?
brenton_translation: And Jacob was angry with Rachel, and said to her, Am I in the place of God, who has deprived thee of the fruit of the womb?

fresh_translation: And Rachel said to Jacob, Look, my servant-girl Bilhah. Go in to her, and she will bear upon my knees, and I too will have children through her.
brenton_translation: And Rachel said to Jacob, Behold my handmaid Balla, go in to her, and she shall bear upon my knees, and I also shall have children by her.

fresh_translation: And she gave him Bilhah her servant-girl as wife for him, and Jacob went in to her.
brenton_translation: And she gave him Balla her maid, for a wife to him; and Jacob went in to her.

fresh_translation: And Bilhah, Rachel's servant-girl, conceived and bore a son to Jacob.
brenton_translation: And Balla, Rachel's maid, conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

fresh_translation: And Rachel said, God judged for me and heard my voice and gave me a son. Therefore she called his name Dan.
brenton_translation: And Rachel said, God has given judgment for me, and hearkened to my voice, and has given me a son; therefore she called his name, Dan.

fresh_translation: And Bilhah, Rachel's servant-girl, conceived again and bore a second son to Jacob.
brenton_translation: And Balla, Rachel's maid, conceived yet again, and bore a second son to Jacob.

fresh_translation: And Rachel said, God joined in my struggle, and I struggled with my sister and prevailed. And she called his name Naphtali.
brenton_translation: And Rachel said, God has helped me, and I contended with my sister and prevailed; and she called his name, Nephthalim.

fresh_translation: And Leah saw that she had stopped bearing, and she took Zilpah her servant-girl and gave her to Jacob as wife. And he went in to her.
brenton_translation: And Lea saw that she ceased from bearing, and she took Zelpha her maid, and gave her to Jacob for a wife; and he went in to her.

fresh_translation: And Zilpah, Leah's servant-girl, conceived and bore a son to Jacob.
brenton_translation: And Zelpha the maid of Lea conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

fresh_translation: And Leah said, In luck. And she called his name Gad.
brenton_translation: And Lea said, It is happily: and she called his name, Gad.

fresh_translation: And Zilpah, Leah's servant-girl, conceived again and bore a second son to Jacob.
brenton_translation: And Zelpha the maid of Lea conceived yet again, and bore Jacob a second son.

fresh_translation: And Leah said, Blessed am I, because the women will pronounce me blessed. And she called his name Asher.
brenton_translation: And Lea said, I am blessed, for the women will pronounce me blessed; and she called his name, Aser.

fresh_translation: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest and found mandrake apples in the field and brought them to Leah his mother. And Rachel said to Leah her sister, Give me some of your son's mandrakes.
brenton_translation: And Ruben went in the day of barley-harvest, and found apples of mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother Lea; and Rachel said to Lea her sister, Give me of thy son's mandrakes.

fresh_translation: And Leah said, Is it not enough for you that you took my husband? Will you now take my son's mandrakes too? And Rachel said, Not so. Let him sleep with you tonight in exchange for your son's mandrakes.
brenton_translation: And Lea said, Is it not enough for thee that thou hast taken my husband, wilt thou also take my son's mandrakes? And Rachel said, Not so: let him lie with thee to-night for thy son's mandrakes.

fresh_translation: And Jacob came in from the field at evening, and Leah went out to meet him and said, You will come in to me today, for I hired you with my son's mandrakes. And he slept with her that night.
brenton_translation: And Jacob came in out of the field at even; and Lea went forth to meet him, and said, Thou shalt come in to me this day, for I have hired thee for my son's mandrakes; and he lay with her that night.

fresh_translation: And God heard Leah, and conceiving she bore a fifth son to Jacob.
brenton_translation: And God hearkened to Lea, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

fresh_translation: And Leah said, God gave me my wages, because I gave my servant-girl to my husband. And she called his name Issachar, which means wages.
brenton_translation: And Lea said, God has given me my reward, because I gave my maid to my husband; and she called his name Issachar, which is, Reward.

fresh_translation: And Leah conceived again and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
brenton_translation: And Lea conceived again, and bore Jacob a sixth son.

fresh_translation: And Leah said, God has gifted me with a good gift at this time. My husband will choose me, for I have borne him six sons. And she called his name Zebulun.
brenton_translation: And Lea said, God has given me a good gift in this time; my husband will choose me, for I have born him six sons: and she called his name, Zabulon.

fresh_translation: And after this she bore a daughter and called her name Dinah.
brenton_translation: And after this she bore a daughter; and she called her name, Dina.

fresh_translation: And God remembered Rachel, and God heard her and opened her womb,
brenton_translation: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and he opened her womb.

fresh_translation: and conceiving she bore a son to Jacob. And Rachel said, God took away my reproach.
brenton_translation: And she conceived, and bore Jacob a son; and Rachel said, God has taken away my reproach.

fresh_translation: And she called his name Joseph, saying, Let God add another son to me.
brenton_translation: And she called his name Joseph, saying, Let God add to me another son.

fresh_translation: And it happened when Rachel bore Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, Send me away, so that I may depart to my place and to my land.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Rachel had born Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, Send me away, that I may go to my place and to my land.

fresh_translation: Restore my wives and my children, for whom I have served you, so that I may depart, for you know the service with which I have served you.
brenton_translation: Restore my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, that I may depart, for thou knowest the service wherewith I have served thee.

fresh_translation: And Laban said to him, If I found favor before you, I would practice augury, for God blessed me at your coming in.
brenton_translation: And Laban said to him, If I have found grace in thy sight, I would augur well, for the Lord has blessed me at thy coming in.

fresh_translation: Set your wages with me, and I will give them.
brenton_translation: Appoint me thy wages, and I will give them.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said, You know what things I have served you in and how much livestock of yours was with me,
brenton_translation: And Jacob said, Thou knowest in what things I have served thee, and how many cattle of thine are with me.

fresh_translation: for what you had before me was little, and it increased into a multitude, and the Lord God blessed you at my foot. Now then, when shall I too make a house for myself?
brenton_translation: For it was little thou hadst before my time, and it is increased to a multitude, and the Lord God has blessed thee since my coming; now then, when shall I set up also my own house?

fresh_translation: And Laban said to him, What shall I give you? And Jacob said to him, You shall give me nothing. If you do this thing for me, I will again shepherd your sheep and keep them.
brenton_translation: And Laban said to him, What shall I give thee? and Jacob said to him, Thou shalt not give me anything; if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again tend thy flocks and keep them.

fresh_translation: Let all your sheep pass by today, and separate from there every gray sheep among the lambs and every white-marked and speckled one among the goats. This shall be my wages.
brenton_translation: Let all thy sheep pass by to-day, and separate thence every grey sheep among the rams, and every one that is speckled and spotted among the goats—this shall be my reward.

fresh_translation: And my righteousness will answer for me on the next day, because my wages are before you. Everything that is not speckled and white-marked among the goats and gray among the lambs will be considered stolen with me.
brenton_translation: And my righteousness shall answer for me on the morrow, for it is my reward before thee: whatever shall not be spotted and speckled among the goats, and grey among the rams, shall be stolen with me.

fresh_translation: And Laban said to him, Let it be according to your word.
brenton_translation: And Laban said to him, Let it be according to thy word.

fresh_translation: And he separated on that day the speckled and white-marked he-goats and all the speckled and white-marked she-goats and everything gray among the lambs and everything white among them, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
brenton_translation: And he separated in that day the spotted and speckled he-goats, and all the spotted and speckled she-goats, and all that was grey among the rams, and every one that was white among them, and he gave them into the hand of his sons.

fresh_translation: And he set a journey of three days between them and Jacob. And Jacob was shepherding the remaining sheep of Laban.
brenton_translation: And he set a distance of a three days' journey between them and Jacob. And Jacob tended the cattle of Laban that were left behind.

fresh_translation: And Jacob took for himself a green storax rod and walnut and plane-tree, and Jacob peeled white peelings on them, stripping away the green. And the white that he peeled showed variegated on the rods.
brenton_translation: And Jacob took to himself green rods of storax tree and walnut and plane-tree; and Jacob peeled in them white stripes; and as he drew off the green, the white stripe which he had made appeared alternate on the rods.

fresh_translation: And he set the rods that he peeled in the troughs of the watering places, so that when the sheep came to drink before the rods, when they came to drink, they might conceive by the rods.
brenton_translation: And he laid the rods which he had peeled, in the hollows of the watering-troughs, that whensoever the cattle should come to drink, as they should have come to drink before the rods, the cattle might conceive at the rods.

fresh_translation: And the sheep were conceiving by the rods, and the sheep bore white-marked and variegated and ash-speckled young.
brenton_translation: So the cattle conceived at the rods, and the cattle brought forth young speckled, and streaked and spotted with ash-coloured spots.

fresh_translation: And Jacob separated the lambs and set before the sheep a white-marked ram and every variegated one among the lambs. And he separated flocks for himself by themselves and did not mix them into Laban's sheep.
brenton_translation: And Jacob separated the lambs, and set before the sheep a speckled ram, and every variegated one among the lambs, and he separated flocks for himself alone, and did not mingle them with the sheep of Laban.

fresh_translation: And it happened at the time when the sheep that were taking in seed conceived, Jacob set the rods before the sheep in the troughs, so that they might conceive in relation to the rods.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the time wherein the cattle became pregnant, conceiving in the belly, Jacob put the rods before the cattle in the troughs, that they might conceive by the rods.

fresh_translation: But whenever the sheep were giving birth, he did not set them there. So the unmarked were Laban's, but the marked were Jacob's.
brenton_translation: But he did not put them in indiscriminately whenever the cattle happened to bring forth, but the unmarked ones were Laban's, and the marked ones Jacob's.

fresh_translation: And the man grew very, very rich, and he had many flocks and cattle and male servants and female servants and camels and donkeys.
brenton_translation: And the man became very rich, and he had many cattle, and oxen, and servants, and maid-servants, and camels, and asses.

fresh_translation: And Jacob heard the words of Laban's sons saying, Jacob has taken all that belonged to our father, and from what belonged to our father he made all this glory.
brenton_translation: And Jacob heard the words of the sons of Laban, saying, Jacob has taken all that was our father's, and of our father's property has he gotten all this glory.

fresh_translation: And Jacob saw Laban's face, and look, it was not toward him as yesterday and the third day.
brenton_translation: And Jacob saw the countenance of Laban, and behold it was not toward him as before.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Jacob, Return to the land of your father and to your family line, and I will be with you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Jacob, Return to the land of thy father, and to thy family, and I will be with thee.

fresh_translation: And Jacob sent and called Leah and Rachel into the plain where the flocks were.
brenton_translation: And Jacob sent and called Lea and Rachel to the plain where the flocks were.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, I see your father's face, that it is not toward me as yesterday and the third day, but the God of my father was with me.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, I see the face of your father, that it is not toward me as before, but the God of my father was with me.

fresh_translation: And you yourselves know that with all my strength I served your father.
brenton_translation: And ye too know that with all my might I have served your father.

fresh_translation: But your father cheated me and changed my wages for the ten lambs, yet God did not let him harm me.
brenton_translation: But your father deceived me, and changed my wages for the ten lambs, yet God gave him not power to hurt me.

fresh_translation: If he said this, The variegated shall be your wages, then all the sheep would bear variegated. But if he said, The white ones shall be your wages, then all the sheep would bear white.
brenton_translation: If he should say thus, The speckled shall be thy reward, then all the cattle would bear speckled; and if he should say, The white shall be thy reward, then would all the cattle bear white.

fresh_translation: So God took away all your father's livestock and gave them to me.
brenton_translation: So God has taken away all the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

fresh_translation: And it happened when the sheep were conceiving and taking seed in the belly, I saw with my eyes in sleep, and look, the he-goats and rams mounting the sheep and the goats were white-marked and variegated and ash-speckled.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the cattle conceived and were with young, that I beheld with mine eyes in sleep, and behold the he-goats and the rams leaping on the sheep and the she-goats, speckled and variegated and spotted with ash-coloured spots.

fresh_translation: And the angel of God said to me in sleep, Jacob. And I said, What is it?
brenton_translation: And the angel of God said to me in a dream, Jacob; and I said, What is it?

fresh_translation: And he said, Lift up your eyes and see the he-goats and the rams mounting the sheep and the goats, white-marked and variegated and ash-speckled, for I have seen what things Laban does to you.
brenton_translation: And he said, Look up with thine eyes, and behold the he-goats and the rams leaping on the sheep and the she-goats, speckled and variegated and spotted with ash-coloured spots; for I have seen all things that Laban does to thee.

fresh_translation: I am the God who appeared to you in the place of God, where you anointed a pillar to me and vowed a vow to me there. So now rise and go out from this land and go to the land of your birth, and I will be with you.
brenton_translation: I am God that appeared to thee in the place of God, where thou anointedst a pillar to me, and vowedst to me there a vow; now then arise and depart out of this land, depart into the land of thy nativity, and I will be with thee.

fresh_translation: And Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, Is there still a portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
brenton_translation: And Rachel and Lea answered and said to him, Have we yet a part or inheritance in the house of our father?

fresh_translation: Are we not counted by him as foreigners? For he sold us and by eating ate up our silver.
brenton_translation: Are we not considered strangers by him? for he has sold us, and quite devoured our money.

fresh_translation: All the wealth and the glory that God took away from our father shall be ours and our children's. So now whatever God said to you, do.
brenton_translation: All the wealth and the glory which God has taken from our father, it shall be our's and our children's; now then do whatsoever God has said to thee.

fresh_translation: And Jacob rose and took his wives and his children on the camels.
brenton_translation: And Jacob arose and took his wives and his children up on the camels;

fresh_translation: And he led away all that belonged to him and all his baggage, which he acquired in Mesopotamia, all that was his, to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: and he took away all his possessions and all his store, which he had gotten in Mesopotamia, and all that belonged to him, to depart to Isaac his father in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and Rachel stole her father's idols.
brenton_translation: And Laban went to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole her father's images.

fresh_translation: And Jacob hid the matter from Laban the Syrian by not reporting to him that he was running away.
brenton_translation: And Jacob hid the matter from Laban the Syrian, so as not to tell him that he ran away.

fresh_translation: And he fled, he and all that was his, and crossed the river and set out for the mountain of Gilead.
brenton_translation: And he departed himself and all that belonged to him, and passed over the river, and went into the mountain Galaad.

fresh_translation: And on the third day it was reported to Laban the Syrian that Jacob had fled,
brenton_translation: But it was told Laban the Syrian on the third day, that Jacob was fled.

fresh_translation: and taking his brothers with him, he pursued after him a journey of seven days and overtook him at the mountain of Gilead.
brenton_translation: And having taken his brethren with him, he pursued after him seven days' journey, and overtook him on Mount Galaad.

fresh_translation: And God came to Laban the Syrian in sleep by night and said to him, Watch yourself, lest you speak evil things with Jacob.
brenton_translation: And God came to Laban the Syrian in sleep by night, and said to him, Take heed to thyself that thou speak not at any time to Jacob evil things.

fresh_translation: And Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban stationed his brothers at the mountain of Gilead.
brenton_translation: And Laban overtook Jacob; and Jacob pitched his tent in the mountain; and Laban stationed his brothers in the mount Galaad.

fresh_translation: And Laban said to Jacob, What did you do? Why did you run away in secret and carry me off by theft and lead away my daughters like captives of the sword?
brenton_translation: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done? wherefore didst thou run away secretly, and pillage me, and lead away my daughters as captives taken with the sword?

fresh_translation: And if you had reported it to me, I would have sent you away with gladness and with songs and with tambourines and with lyre,
brenton_translation: Whereas if thou hadst told me, I would have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, and timbrels, and harp.

fresh_translation: and I was not counted worthy to kiss my children and my daughters. But now you acted foolishly.
brenton_translation: And I was not counted worthy to embrace my children and my daughters; now then thou hast wrought foolishly.

fresh_translation: And now my hand has power to harm you, but the God of your father said to me yesterday, saying, Watch yourself, lest you speak evil things with Jacob.
brenton_translation: And now my hand has power to hurt thee; but the God of thy father spoke to me yesterday, saying, Take heed to thyself that thou speak not evil words to Jacob.

fresh_translation: So now go on, for with desire you desired to go to your father's house. Why did you steal my gods?
brenton_translation: Now then go on thy way, for thou hast earnestly desired to depart to the house of thy father; wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

fresh_translation: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid, for I said, Perhaps you would take your daughters away from me and all that is mine.
brenton_translation: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid; for I said, Lest at any time thou shouldest take away thy daughters from me, and all my possessions.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said, With whomever you find your gods, he shall not live before our brothers. Recognize what of yours is with me and take it. But Jacob did not know that Rachel his wife had stolen them.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said, With whomsoever thou shalt find thy gods, he shall not live in the presence of our brethren; take notice of what I have of thy property, and take it; and he observed nothing with him, but Jacob knew not that his wife Rachel had stolen them.

fresh_translation: And going in, Laban searched Leah's house and did not find them. And he went out from Leah's house and searched Jacob's house and the house of the two servant-girls and did not find them. Then he entered Rachel's house too.
brenton_translation: And Laban went in and searched in the house of Lea, and found them not; and he went out of the house of Lea, and searched in the house of Jacob, and in the house of the two maid-servants, and found them not; and he went also into the house of Rachel.

fresh_translation: Now Rachel had taken the idols and thrown them among the camel packs and sat on them.
brenton_translation: And Rachel took the idols, and cast them among the camels' packs, and sat upon them.

fresh_translation: And she said to her father, Do not take it heavily, lord. I cannot rise before you, because the custom of women is upon me. And Laban searched through the whole house and did not find the idols.
brenton_translation: And she said to her father, Be not indignant, Sir; I cannot rise up before thee, for it is with me according to the manner of women. Laban searched in all the house, and found not the images.

fresh_translation: And Jacob grew angry and fought with Laban. And Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my wrongdoing and what is my sin, that you pursued after me?
brenton_translation: And Jacob was angry, and strove with Laban; and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my injustice, and what my sin, that thou hast pursued after me,

fresh_translation: And because you searched all the furnishings of my house, what did you find from all the furnishings of your house? Set it here before your brothers and my brothers, and let them judge between the two of us.
brenton_translation: and that thou hast searched all the furniture of my house? what hast thou found of all the furniture of thine house? set it here between thy relations and my relations, and let them decide between us two.

fresh_translation: These twenty years I have been with you. Your sheep and your goats did not miscarry, and I did not eat the rams of your sheep.
brenton_translation: These twenty years have I been with thee; thy sheep, and thy she-goats have not failed in bearing; I devoured not the rams of thy cattle.

fresh_translation: What was torn by beasts I did not bring to you. I was making good from myself the thefts of day and the thefts of night.
brenton_translation: That which was taken of beasts I brought not to thee; I made good of myself the thefts of the day, and the thefts of the night.

fresh_translation: By day I was being burned together by the heat and by the frost of night, and my sleep departed from my eyes.
brenton_translation: I was parched with heat by day, and chilled with frost by night, and my sleep departed from my eyes.

fresh_translation: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters and six years among your sheep, and you tricked my wages by ten lambs.
brenton_translation: These twenty years have I been in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years among thy sheep, and thou didst falsely rate my wages for ten lambs.

fresh_translation: If the God of my father Abraham and the Fear of Isaac had not been mine, now you would have sent me away empty. God saw my humiliation and the labor of my hands and rebuked you yesterday.
brenton_translation: Unless I had the God of my father Abraam, and the fear of Isaac, now thou wouldest have sent me away empty; God saw my humiliation, and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesterday.

fresh_translation: But Laban answered and said to Jacob, The daughters are my daughters, and the sons my sons, and the livestock my livestock, and all that you see is mine and my daughters'. What shall I do to these today or to their children whom they bore?
brenton_translation: And Laban answered and said to Jacob, The daughters are my daughters, and the sons my sons, and the cattle are my cattle, and all things which thou seest are mine, and the property of my daughters; what shall I do to them to-day, or their children which they bore?

fresh_translation: So now come, let us make a covenant, both I and you, and it shall be for a witness between me and you. And he said to him, Look, no one is with us. Look, God is witness between me and you.
brenton_translation: Now then come, let me make a covenant, both I and thou, and it shall be for a witness between me and thee; and he said to him, Behold, there is no one with us; behold, God is witness between me and thee.

fresh_translation: And Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.
brenton_translation: And Jacob having taken a stone, set it up for a pillar.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said to his brothers, Gather stones. And they gathered stones and made a heap, and they ate there on the heap.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to his brethren, Gather stones; and they gathered stones and made a heap, and ate there upon the heap; and Laban said to him, This heap witnesses between me and thee to-day.

fresh_translation: And Laban said to him, This heap bears witness between me and you today.
brenton_translation: And Laban called it, the Heap of Testimony; and Jacob called it, the Witness Heap.

fresh_translation: And Laban called it Heap of Witness, but Jacob called it Witness Heap. And Laban said to Jacob, Look, this heap and this pillar that I set between me and you, this heap bears witness and this pillar bears witness. Therefore its name was called, Heap bears witness.
brenton_translation: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and the pillar, which I have set between me and thee; this heap witnesses, and this pillar witnesses; therefore its name was called, the Heap witnesses.

fresh_translation: And Watchpost, which he said, May God look between me and you, because we will be separated from one another.
brenton_translation: And the vision of which he said—Let God look to it between me and thee, because we are about to depart from each other,—

fresh_translation: If you humble my daughters, if you take wives in addition to my daughters, see, no one is with us seeing. God is witness between me and you.
brenton_translation: If thou shalt humble my daughters, if thou shouldest take wives in addition to my daughters, see, there is no one with us looking on. God is witness between me and thee.

fresh_translation: For if I should not cross over to you, and you should not cross over to me beyond this heap and this pillar for evil,
brenton_translation: For if I should not cross over unto thee, neither shouldest thou cross over to me, for mischief beyond this heap and this pillar.

fresh_translation: the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor will judge between us.
brenton_translation: The God of Abraam and the God of Nachor judge between us; and Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.

fresh_translation: And Jacob swore by the Fear of Isaac his father and offered a sacrifice in the mountain and called his brothers, and they ate and drank and slept in the mountain.
brenton_translation: And he offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his brethren, and they ate and drank, and slept in the mountain.

fresh_translation: And Jacob went on his own way. And lifting up his eyes, he saw a camp of God encamped, and the angels of God met him.
brenton_translation: And Laban rose up in the morning, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them; and Laban having turned back, departed to his place.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said when he saw them, This is God's camp. And he called the name of that place Camps.
brenton_translation: And Jacob departed for his journey; and having looked up, he saw the host of God encamped; and the angels of God met him.

fresh_translation: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother in the land of Seir, in the country of Edom.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said, when he saw them, This is the Camp of God; and he called the name of that place, Encampments.

fresh_translation: And he charged them, saying, Thus you will say to my lord Esau, Thus says your servant Jacob: I sojourned with Laban and lingered until now,
brenton_translation: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother to the land of Seir, to the country of Edom.

fresh_translation: and there came to me oxen and donkeys and sheep and male servants and female servants, and I sent to report to my lord Esau, so that your servant may find favor before you.
brenton_translation: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye say to my lord Esau: Thus saith thy servant Jacob; I have sojourned with Laban and tarried until now.

fresh_translation: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to your brother Esau, and look, he is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.
brenton_translation: And there were born to me oxen, and asses, and sheep, and men-servants and women-servants; and I sent to tell my lord Esau, that thy servant might find grace in thy sight.

fresh_translation: And Jacob feared greatly and was perplexed. And he divided the people with him and the cattle and the camels and the sheep into two camps,
brenton_translation: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and lo! he comes to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

fresh_translation: and Jacob said, If Esau comes to one camp and cuts it down, the second camp will be for safety.
brenton_translation: And Jacob was greatly terrified, and was perplexed; and he divided the people that was with him, and the cows, and the camels, and the sheep, into two camps.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said, God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, Lord, you are the one who said to me, Run back to the land of your birth and I will do you good,
brenton_translation: And Jacob said, If Esau should come to one camp, and smite it, the other camp shall be in safety.

fresh_translation: Let there be to me a sufficiency of all the righteousness and all the truth that you wrought with your servant, for with this staff I crossed this Jordan, and now I have become two camps.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said, God of my father Abraam, and God of my father Isaac, O Lord, thou art he that said to me, Depart quickly to the land of thy birth, and I will do thee good.

fresh_translation: Deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau, because I am afraid of him, lest he come and strike me, mother upon children.
brenton_translation: Let there be to me a sufficiency of all the justice and all the truth which thou hast wrought with thy servant; for with this my staff I passed over this Jordan, and now I am become two camps.

fresh_translation: And you said, I will do you good and make your seed like the sand of the sea, which will not be numbered because of the multitude.
brenton_translation: Deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau, for I am afraid of him, lest haply he should come and smite me, and the mother upon the children.

fresh_translation: And he slept there that night and took from what he was carrying gifts and sent them to Esau his brother,
brenton_translation: But thou saidst, I will do thee good, and will make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which shall not be numbered for multitude.

fresh_translation: two hundred she-goats, twenty he-goats, two hundred sheep, twenty rams,
brenton_translation: And he slept there that night, and took of the gifts which he carried with him, and sent out to Esau his brother,

fresh_translation: thirty milk camels and their young, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty donkeys, and ten foals.
brenton_translation: two hundred she-goats, twenty he-goats, two hundred sheep, twenty rams,

fresh_translation: And he gave them to his servants, herd by itself. And he said to his servants, Go on before me, and put a gap between herd and herd.
brenton_translation: milch camels, and their foals, thirty, forty kine, ten bulls, twenty asses, and ten colts.

fresh_translation: And he charged the first, saying, If Esau my brother meets you and asks you, saying, Whose are you and where are you going and whose are these going before you,
brenton_translation: And he gave them to his servants each drove apart; and he said to his servants, Go on before me, and put a space between drove and drove.

fresh_translation: you will say, They belong to your servant Jacob. He sent gifts to my lord Esau, and look, he himself is behind us.
brenton_translation: And he charged the first, saying, If Esau my brother meet thee, and he ask thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither wouldest thou go, and whose are these possessions advancing before thee?

fresh_translation: And he charged the first and the second and the third and all those going before behind these herds, saying, According to this word speak to Esau when you find him,
brenton_translation: Thou shalt say, Thy servant Jacob's; he hath sent gifts to my lord Esau, and lo! he is behind us.

fresh_translation: and you will say, Look, your servant Jacob is coming behind us. For he said, I will propitiate his face with the gifts going before him, and after this I will see his face. For perhaps he will accept my face.
brenton_translation: And he charged the first and the second and the third, and all that went before him after these flocks, saying, Thus shall ye speak to Esau when ye find him;

fresh_translation: And the gifts went on before him, but he himself slept that night in the camp.
brenton_translation: and ye shall say, Behold thy servant Jacob comes after us. For he said, I will propitiate his countenance with the gifts going before his presence, and afterwards I will behold his face, for peradventure he will accept me.

fresh_translation: And rising in that night, he took his two wives and his two servant-girls and his eleven children and crossed the ford of Jabbok.
brenton_translation: So the presents went on before him, but he himself lodged that night in the camp.

fresh_translation: And he took them and crossed the torrent and brought over all that was his.
brenton_translation: And he rose up in that night, and took his two wives and his two servant-maids, and his eleven children, and crossed over the ford of Jaboch.

fresh_translation: And Jacob was left behind alone, and a man wrestled with him until morning.
brenton_translation: And he took them, and passed over the torrent, and brought over all his possessions.

fresh_translation: And he saw that he could not prevail against him, and he touched the broad part of his thigh, and the broad part of Jacob's thigh went numb while he wrestled with him.
brenton_translation: And Jacob was left alone; and a man wrestled with him till the morning.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Send me away, for dawn has come up. But he said, I will certainly not send you away unless you bless me.
brenton_translation: And he saw that he prevailed not against him; and he touched the broad part of his thigh, and the broad part of Jacob's thigh was benumbed in his wrestling with him.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, What is your name? And he said, Jacob.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Let me go, for the day has dawned; but he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name, because you were strong with God, and with men you will be powerful.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, What is thy name? and he answered, Jacob.

fresh_translation: And Jacob asked and said, Tell me your name. And he said, Why is this that you ask my name? And he blessed him there.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Thy name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name; for thou hast prevailed with God, and shalt be mighty with men.

fresh_translation: And Jacob called the name of that place Form of God, for I saw God face to face, and my life was saved.
brenton_translation: And Jacob asked and said, Tell me thy name; and he said, Wherefore dost thou ask after my name? and he blessed him there.

fresh_translation: And the sun rose on him when he passed the Form of God, and he was limping on his thigh.
brenton_translation: And Jacob called the name of that place, the Face of God; for, said he, I have seen God face to face, and my life was preserved.

fresh_translation: Because of this the sons of Israel shall never eat the sinew that went numb, which is on the broad part of the thigh, until this day, because he touched the broad part of Jacob's thigh, the sinew that went numb.
brenton_translation: And the sun rose upon him, when he passed the Face of God; and he halted upon his thigh.

fresh_translation: Because of this the sons of Israel shall never eat the sinew that went numb, which is on the broad part of the thigh, until this day, because he touched the broad part of Jacob's thigh, the sinew and it went numb.
brenton_translation: Therefore the children of Israel will by no means eat of the sinew which was benumbed, which is on the broad part of the thigh, until this day, because the angel touched the broad part of the thigh of Jacob—even the sinew which was benumbed.

fresh_translation: And Jacob, lifting up his eyes, saw, and look, Esau his brother was coming and four hundred men with him. And Jacob divided the children among Leah and Rachel and the two servant-girls.
brenton_translation: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and beheld, and lo! Esau his brother coming, and four hundred men with him; and Jacob divided the children to Lea and to Rachel, and the two handmaidens.

fresh_translation: And he placed the two servant-girls and their sons first, and Leah and her children behind, and Rachel and Joseph last.
brenton_translation: And he put the two handmaidens and their children with the first, and Lea and her children behind, and Rachel and Joseph last.

fresh_translation: But he himself went before them and bowed to the ground seven times until he drew near to his brother.
brenton_translation: But he advanced himself before them, and did reverence to the ground seven times, until he drew near to his brother.

fresh_translation: And Esau ran to meet him and embraced him and fell on his neck and kissed him, and both wept.
brenton_translation: And Esau ran on to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him; and they both wept.

fresh_translation: And Esau lifted up his eyes and saw the women and the children and said, What are these to you? And he said, The children to whom God showed mercy to your servant.
brenton_translation: And Esau looked up and saw the women and the children, and said, What are these to thee? And he said, The children with which God has mercifully blessed thy servant.

fresh_translation: And the servant-girls and their children came near and bowed,
brenton_translation: And the maid-servants and their children drew near and did reverence.

fresh_translation: and Leah and her children came near and bowed. And after these Rachel and Joseph came near and bowed.
brenton_translation: And Lea and her children drew near and did reverence; and after this drew near Rachel and Joseph, and did reverence.

fresh_translation: And he said, What are all these camps to you that I met? And he said, So that your servant may find favor before you, lord.
brenton_translation: And he said, What are these things to thee, all these companies that I have met? And he said, That thy servant might find grace in thy sight, my lord.

fresh_translation: And Esau said, I have much, brother. Let what is yours remain yours.
brenton_translation: And Esau said, I have much, my brother; keep thine own.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said, If I found favor before you, receive the gifts by my hands, because for this reason I saw your face as one might see God's face, and you were well pleased with me.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said, If I have found grace in thy sight, receive the gifts through my hands; therefore have I seen thy face, as if any one should see the face of God, and thou shalt be well-pleased with me.

fresh_translation: Take my blessings that I brought to you, because God showed mercy to me and because I have everything. And he pressed him, and he took them.
brenton_translation: Receive my blessings, which I have brought thee, because God has had mercy on me, and I have all things; and he constrained him, and he took them.

fresh_translation: And he said, Let us set out and go straight on.
brenton_translation: And he said, Let us depart, and proceed right onward.

fresh_translation: But he said to him, My lord knows that the children are more delicate, and the sheep and the cattle with young are on me. So if I drive them hard one day, all the livestock will die.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, My lord knows, that the children are very tender, and the flocks and the herds with me are with young; if then I shall drive them hard one day, all the cattle will die.

fresh_translation: Let my lord go on before his servant, and I will strengthen myself on the road at the leisure of the journey before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord in Seir.
brenton_translation: Let my lord go on before his servant, and I shall have strength on the road according to the ease of the journey before me, and according to the strength of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.

fresh_translation: And Esau said, I will leave with you some of the people with me. But he said, Why this? It is enough that I found favor before you, lord.
brenton_translation: And Esau said, I will leave with thee some of the people who are with me. And he said, Why so? it is enough that I have found favour before thee, my lord.

fresh_translation: And Esau turned back on that day on his way to Seir.
brenton_translation: And Esau returned on that day on his journey to Seir.

fresh_translation: And Jacob set out to Tents, and there he made houses for himself, and for his livestock he made tents. Therefore he called the name of that place, Tents.
brenton_translation: And Jacob departs to his tents; and he made for himself there habitations, and for his cattle he made booths; therefore he called the name of that place, Booths.

fresh_translation: And Jacob came to Salem, city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he returned from Mesopotamia of Syria, and he encamped in front of the city.
brenton_translation: And Jacob came to Salem, a city of Secima, which is in the land of Chanaan, when he departed out of Mesopotamia of Syria, and took up a position in front of the city.

fresh_translation: And he bought the portion of the field where he set his tent there from Hamor father of Shechem for one hundred lambs.
brenton_translation: And he bought the portion of the field, where he pitched his tent, of Emmor the father of Sychem, for a hundred lambs.

fresh_translation: And he set up an altar there and called on the God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he set up there an altar, and called on the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Dinah, daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to observe the daughters of the inhabitants.
brenton_translation: And Dina, the daughter of Lea, whom she bore to Jacob, went forth to observe the daughters of the inhabitants.

fresh_translation: And Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, ruler of the land, saw her, and taking her, he lay with her and humbled her.
brenton_translation: And Sychem the son of Emmor the Evite, the ruler of the land, saw her, and took her and lay with her, and humbled her.

fresh_translation: And he was attached in soul to Dinah daughter of Jacob, and he loved the virgin and spoke to the heart of the virgin.
brenton_translation: And he was attached to the soul of Dina the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and he spoke kindly to the damsel.

fresh_translation: And Shechem said to Hamor his father, saying, Take this girl for me as wife.
brenton_translation: Sychem spoke to Emmor his father, saying, Take for me this damsel to wife.

fresh_translation: And Jacob heard that the son of Hamor had defiled Dinah his daughter. But his sons were with his livestock in the plain. And Jacob kept silent until they came.
brenton_translation: And Jacob heard that the son of Emmor had defiled Dina his daughter (now his sons were with his cattle in the plain). And Jacob was silent until they came.

fresh_translation: And Hamor father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.
brenton_translation: And Emmor the father of Sychem went forth to Jacob, to speak to him.

fresh_translation: And Jacob's sons came from the plain. And when they heard, the men were cut to the heart, and it was very grievous to them, because he had done a shameful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob's daughter, and so it will not be.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jacob came from the plain; and when they heard, the men were deeply pained, and it was very grievous to them, because the man wrought folly in Israel, having lain with the daughter of Jacob, and so it must not be.

fresh_translation: And Hamor spoke to them, saying, My son Shechem chose your daughter in his soul. So give her to him as wife,
brenton_translation: And Emmor spoke to them, saying, Sychem my son has chosen in his heart your daughter; give her therefore to him for a wife,

fresh_translation: and intermarry with us. Give your daughters to us and take our daughters for your sons.
brenton_translation: and intermarry with us. Give us your daughters, and take our daughters for your sons.

fresh_translation: And dwell among us, and look, the land is broad before you. Dwell and trade on it and gain possessions in it.
brenton_translation: And dwell in the midst of us; and, behold, the land is spacious before you, dwell in it, and trade, and get possessions in it.

fresh_translation: And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, May I find favor before you, and whatever you say, we will give.
brenton_translation: And Sychem said to her father and to her brothers, I would find grace before you, and we will give whatever ye shall name.

fresh_translation: Greatly increase the dowry, and I will give according to whatever you say to me. Only give me this girl as wife.
brenton_translation: Multiply your demand of dowry very much, and I will give accordingly as ye shall say to me, only ye shall give me this damsel for a wife.

fresh_translation: And Jacob's sons answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit and spoke to them, because they had defiled Dinah their sister,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jacob answered to Sychem and Emmor his father craftily, and spoke to them, because they had defiled Dina their sister.

fresh_translation: and Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, said to them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to a man who has foreskin, for it is a reproach to us.
brenton_translation: And Symeon and Levi, the brothers of Dina, said to them, We shall not be able to do this thing, to give our sister to a man who is uncircumcised, for it is a reproach to us.

fresh_translation: Only in this will we become like you and dwell among you: if you too become as we are in every male of yours being circumcised.
brenton_translation: Only on these terms will we conform to you, and dwell among you, if ye also will be as we are, in that every male of you be circumcised.

fresh_translation: And we will give our daughters to you, and from your daughters we will take wives for ourselves, and we will dwell with you and become like one race.
brenton_translation: And we will give our daughters to you, and we will take of your daughters for wives to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will be as one race.

fresh_translation: But if you do not listen to us to be circumcised, taking our daughter, we will depart.
brenton_translation: But if ye will not hearken to us to be circumcised, we will take our daughter and depart.

fresh_translation: And the words were pleasing before Hamor and before Shechem son of Hamor.
brenton_translation: And the words pleased Emmor, and Sychem the son of Emmor.

fresh_translation: And the young man did not delay to do this thing, for he was attached to Jacob's daughter. And he was the most honored of all in his father's house.
brenton_translation: And the young man delayed not to do this thing, for he was much attached to Jacob's daughter, and he was the most honourable of all in his father's house.

fresh_translation: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city and spoke to the men of their city, saying,
brenton_translation: And Emmor and Sychem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke to the men of their city, saying,

fresh_translation: These men are peaceable with us. Let them dwell on the land and trade it, and look, the land is broad before them. We will take their daughters as wives for ourselves, and we will give our daughters to them.
brenton_translation: These men are peaceable, let them dwell with us upon the land, and let them trade in it, and behold the land is extensive before them; we will take their daughters to us for wives, and we will give them our daughters.

fresh_translation: Only in this will the men become like us to dwell with us, so as to be one people, in every male of us being circumcised, just as they also are circumcised.
brenton_translation: Only on these terms will the men conform to us to dwell with us so as to be one people, if every male of us be circumcised, as they also are circumcised.

fresh_translation: And will not their livestock and their four-footed animals and their possessions be ours? Only in this let us become like them, and they will dwell with us.
brenton_translation: And shall not their cattle and their herds, and their possessions, be ours? only in this let us conform to them, and they will dwell with us.

fresh_translation: And all who traded through the gate of their city listened to Hamor and Shechem his son, and every male was circumcised in the flesh of their foreskin.
brenton_translation: And all that went in at the gate of their city hearkened to Emmor and Sychem his son, and they were circumcised in the flesh of their foreskin every male.

fresh_translation: And it happened on the third day, when they were in pain, the two sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, each took his sword and entered the city securely and killed every male.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were in pain, the two sons of Jacob, Symeon and Levi, Dina's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city securely, and slew every male.

fresh_translation: And they killed Hamor and Shechem his son by the mouth of the sword, and they took Dinah from Shechem's house and went out.
brenton_translation: And they slew Emmor and Sychem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dina out of the house of Sychem, and went forth.

fresh_translation: And Jacob's sons entered upon the wounded and plundered the city in which they had defiled Dinah their sister,
brenton_translation: But the sons of Jacob came upon the wounded, and ravaged the city wherein they had defiled Dina their sister.

fresh_translation: and they took their sheep and their cattle and their donkeys, whatever was in the city and whatever was in the field.
brenton_translation: And their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses they took, and all things whatsoever were in the city, and whatsoever were in the plain.

fresh_translation: And they took captive all their persons and all their baggage and their wives, and they plundered whatever was in the city and whatever was in the houses.
brenton_translation: And they took captive all the persons of them, and all their store, and their wives, and plundered both whatever things there were in the city, and whatever things there were in the houses.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, You made me hateful, so that I am evil to all the inhabitants of the land, both among the Canaanites and among the Perizzites. And I am few in number, and gathering against me they will cut me down, and I and my house will be destroyed.
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to Symeon and Levi, Ye have made me hateful so that I should be evil to all the inhabitants of the land, both among the Chananites and the Pherezites, and I am few in number; they will gather themselves against me and cut me in pieces, and I shall be utterly destroyed, and my house.

fresh_translation: But they said, Shall they treat our sister like a prostitute?
brenton_translation: And they said, Nay, but shall they treat our sister as an harlot?

fresh_translation: And God said to Jacob, Rise, go up to the place Bethel and dwell there, and make there an altar to the God who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.
brenton_translation: And God said to Jacob, Arise, go up to the place, Bæthel, and dwell there; and make there an altar to the God that appeared to thee, when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

fresh_translation: And Jacob said to his house and to all with him, Take away the foreign gods from your midst and purify yourselves and change your garments,
brenton_translation: And Jacob said to his house, and to all that were with him, Remove the strange gods that are with you from the midst of you, and purify yourselves, and change your clothes.

fresh_translation: and rising, let us go up to Bethel and let us make there an altar to the God who heard me in the day of distress, who was with me and preserved me on the road on which I traveled.
brenton_translation: And let us rise and go up to Bæthel, and let us there make an altar to God who hearkened to me in the day of calamity, who was with me, and preserved me throughout in the journey, by which I went.

fresh_translation: And they gave Jacob the foreign gods that were in their hands and the earrings in their ears, and Jacob hid them under the terebinth in Shechem, and he destroyed them until this day.
brenton_translation: And they gave to Jacob the strange gods, which were in their hands, and the ear-rings which were in their ears, and Jacob hid them under the turpentine tree which is in Secima, and destroyed them to this day.

fresh_translation: And Israel set out from Shechem, and a fear of God came on the cities around them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: So Israel departed from Secima, and the fear of God was upon the cities round about them, and they did not pursue after the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, which is Bethel, he and all the people with him.
brenton_translation: And Jacob came to Luza, which is in the land of Chanaan, which is Bæthel, he and all the people that were with him.

fresh_translation: And he built there an altar and called the name of the place Bethel, for there God appeared to him when he fled from the face of Esau his brother.
brenton_translation: And he built there an altar, and called the name of the place Bæthel; for there God appeared to him, when he fled from the face of his brother Esau.

fresh_translation: And Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died and was buried below Bethel under the oak, and Jacob called its name Oak of Mourning.
brenton_translation: And Deborrha, Rebecca's nurse, died, and was buried below Bæthel under the oak; and Jacob called its name, The Oak of Mourning.

fresh_translation: And God appeared to Jacob again in Luz, when he came from Mesopotamia of Syria, and God blessed him.
brenton_translation: And God appeared to Jacob once more in Luza, when he came out of Mesopotamia of Syria, and God blessed him.

fresh_translation: And God said to him, Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name. And he called his name Israel.
brenton_translation: And God said to him, Thy name shall not be called Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name; and he called his name Israel.

fresh_translation: And God said to him, I am your God. Increase and multiply. Nations and gatherings of nations will come from you, and kings will come out from your loins.
brenton_translation: And God said to him, I am thy God; increase and multiply; for nations and gatherings of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins.

fresh_translation: And the land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I have given it to you. It shall be yours, and to your seed after you I will give this land.
brenton_translation: And the land which I gave to Abraam and Isaac, I have given it to thee; and it shall come to pass that I will give this land also to thy seed after thee.

fresh_translation: And God went up from him from the place where he spoke with him.
brenton_translation: And God went up from him from the place where he spoke with him.

fresh_translation: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where God spoke with him, a stone pillar, and he poured a libation on it and poured oil on it.
brenton_translation: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where God spoke with him, even a pillar of stone; and offered a libation upon it, and poured oil upon it.

fresh_translation: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him there, Bethel.
brenton_translation: And Jacob called the name of the place in which God spoke with him, Bæthel.

fresh_translation: And Jacob, setting out from Bethel, pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder. And it happened when he drew near a little way to come to Ephrathah, Rachel gave birth, and she was in hard labor in the birth.
brenton_translation: [And Jacob removed from Bæthel, and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Gader,] and it came to pass when he drew nigh to Chabratha, to enter into Ephratha, Rachel travailed; and in her travail she was in hard labour.

fresh_translation: And it happened in her hard labor, the midwife said to her, Take courage, for this son also is yours.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in her hard labour, that the midwife said to her, Be of good courage, for thou shalt also have this son.

fresh_translation: And it happened when her life was departing, for she was dying, she called his name Son of my pain. But his father called his name Benjamin.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in her giving up the ghost (for she was dying), that she called his name, The son of my pain; but his father called his name Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And Rachel died and was buried on the road of the racecourse of Ephrathah (this is Bethlehem).
brenton_translation: So Rachel died, and was buried in the way of the course of Ephratha, this is Bethleem.

fresh_translation: And Jacob set up a pillar over her tomb. This is the pillar over Rachel's tomb until this day.
brenton_translation: And Jacob set up a pillar on her tomb; this is the pillar on the tomb of Rachel, until this day.

fresh_translation: Now Jacob's sons were twelve.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Israel dwelt in that land, that Ruben went and lay with Balla, the concubine of his father Jacob; and Israel heard, and the thing appeared grievous before him.

fresh_translation: Sons of Leah: firstborn of Jacob, Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun.
brenton_translation: The sons of Lea, the first-born of Jacob; Ruben, Symeon, Levi, Judas, Issachar, Zabulon.

fresh_translation: And sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Rachel; Joseph and Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And sons of Bilhah, Rachel's servant-girl: Dan and Naphtali.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Balla, the hand-maid of Rachel; Dan and Nephthalim.

fresh_translation: And sons of Zilpah, Leah's servant-girl: Gad and Asher. These are Jacob's sons, who came to him in Mesopotamia of Syria.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Zelpha, the hand-maid of Lea; Gad and Aser. These are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Mesopotamia of Syria.

fresh_translation: And Jacob came to Isaac his father at Mamre, to the city of the plain (this is Hebron) in the land of Canaan, where Abraham and Isaac had sojourned.
brenton_translation: And Jacob came to Isaac his father to Mambre, to a city of the plain; this is Chebron in the land of Chanaan, where Abraam and Isaac sojourned.

fresh_translation: And the days of Isaac that he lived became one hundred eighty years,
brenton_translation: And the days of Isaac which he lived were an hundred and eighty years.

fresh_translation: and failing, Isaac died and was added to his people, old and full of days. And Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.
brenton_translation: And Isaac gave up the ghost and died, and was laid to his family, old and full of days; and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.

fresh_translation: And these are the generations of Esau (he is Edom):
brenton_translation: And these are the generations of Esau; this is Edom.

fresh_translation: And Esau took wives for himself from the daughters of the Canaanites: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah daughter of Anah son of Zibeon the Hivite,
brenton_translation: And Esau took to himself wives of the daughters of the Chananites; Ada, the daughter of Ælom the Chettite; and Olibema, daughter of Ana the son of Sebegon, the Evite;

fresh_translation: and Basemath daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebajoth.
brenton_translation: and Basemath, daughter of Ismael, sister of Nabaioth.

fresh_translation: And Adah bore Eliphaz to him, and Basemath bore Reuel,
brenton_translation: And Ada bore to him Eliphas; and Basemath bore Raguel.

fresh_translation: and Aholibamah bore Jeush and Jaalam and Kore. These are Esau's sons who came to him in the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: And Olibema bore Jeus, and Jeglom, and Core; these are the sons of Esau, which were born to him in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and all the persons of his house and all his possessions and all his livestock and everything he acquired and everything he gained in the land of Canaan, and Esau went from the land of Canaan away from the face of Jacob his brother.
brenton_translation: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and all his possessions, and all his cattle, and all that he had got, and all things whatsoever he had acquired in the land of Chanaan; and Esau went forth from the land of Chanaan, from the face of his brother Jacob.

fresh_translation: For their possessions were too many to dwell together, and the land of their sojourning was not able to carry them because of the abundance of their possessions.
brenton_translation: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together; and the land of their sojourning could not bear them, because of the abundance of their possessions.

fresh_translation: And Esau dwelt in Mount Seir (Esau, he is Edom).
brenton_translation: And Esau dwelt in mount Seir; Esau, he is Edom.

fresh_translation: And these are the generations of Esau father of Edom in Mount Seir,
brenton_translation: And these are the generations of Esau, the father of Edom in the mount Seir.

fresh_translation: and these are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz son of Adah, wife of Esau, and Reuel son of Basemath, wife of Esau.
brenton_translation: And these are the names of the sons of Esau. Eliphas, the son of Ada, the wife of Esau; and Raguel, the son of Basemath, wife of Esau.

fresh_translation: And Eliphaz' sons were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Eliphas were Thæman, Omar, Sophar, Gothom, and Kenez.

fresh_translation: And Timnah was a concubine of Eliphaz, Esau's son, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These are the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.
brenton_translation: And Thamna was a concubine of Eliphaz, the son of Esau; and she bore Amalec to Eliphas. These are the sons of Ada, the wife of Esau.

fresh_translation: And these are Reuel's sons: Nahath, Zerah, Some, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Raguel; Nachoth, Zare, Some, and Moze. These were the sons of Basemath, wife of Esau.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Aholibamah, daughter of Anah son of Zibeon, wife of Esau. And she bore Jeush and Jaalam and Kore to Esau.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Olibema, the daughter of Ana, the son of Sebegon, the wife of Esau; and she bore to Esau, Jeus, and Jeglom, and Core.

fresh_translation: These are the chiefs, sons of Esau. Sons of Eliphaz, Esau's firstborn: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
brenton_translation: These are the chiefs of the son of Esau, even the sons of Eliphas, the first-born of Esau; chief Thæman, chief Omar, chief Sophar, chief Kenez,

fresh_translation: chief Kore, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.
brenton_translation: chief Core, chief Gothom, chief Amalec. These are the chiefs of Eliphas, in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Ada.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Reuel, son of Esau: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Some, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Raguel, the son of Esau; chief Nachoth, chief Zare, chief Some, chief Moze. These are the chiefs of Raguel, in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, wife of Esau.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Aholibamah, wife of Esau: chief Jeush, chief Jaalam, chief Kore. These are the chiefs of Aholibamah daughter of Anah, wife of Esau.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Olibema, wife of Esau; chief Jeus, chief Jeglom, chief Core. These are the chiefs of Olibema, daughter of Ana, wife of Esau.

fresh_translation: These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs. These are the sons of Edom.
brenton_translation: These are the sons of Esau, and these are the chiefs; these are the sons of Edom.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Seir, the Chorrhite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, Sobal, Sebegon, Ana,

fresh_translation: and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan. These are the chiefs of the Horite, sons of Seir in the land of Edom.
brenton_translation: and Deson, and Asar, and Rison. These are the chiefs of the Chorrhite, the son of Seir, in the land of Edom.

fresh_translation: And Lotan's sons became Horites and Heman, and Lotan's sister was Timnah.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Lotan were Chorrhi and Hæman; and the sister of Lotan, Thamna.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath and Ebal and Shepho and Onam.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Sobal; Golam, and Manachath, and Gæbel, and Sophar, and Omar.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Zibeon: Ajah and Anah. This is Anah, who found mules in the wilderness, when he tended the beasts of burden of Zibeon his father.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Sebegon; Aïe, and Ana; this is the Ana who found Jamin in the wilderness, when he tended the beasts of his father Sebegon.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah daughter of Anah.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Ana; Deson—and Olibema was daughter of Ana.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Haran.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Deson; Amada, and Asban, and Ithran, and Charrhan.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Ezer: Balaam and Zoukam and Joukam.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Asar; Balaam, and Zucam, and Jucam.

fresh_translation: And these are the sons of Dishan: Hos and Aran.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Rison; Hos, and Aran.

fresh_translation: And these are the chiefs of Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
brenton_translation: And these are the chiefs of Chorri; chief Lotan, chief Sobal, chief Sebegon, chief Ana,

fresh_translation: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan. These are the chiefs of Horites in their chiefships in the land of Edom.
brenton_translation: chief Deson, chief Asar, chief Rison. These are the chiefs of Chorri, in their principalities in the land of Edom.

fresh_translation: And these are the kings who reigned in Edom before a king reigned in Israel.
brenton_translation: And these are the kings which reigned in Edom, before a king reigned in Israel.

fresh_translation: And Balac son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
brenton_translation: And Balac, son of Beor, reigned in Edom; and the name of his city was Dennaba.

fresh_translation: And Balac died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Balac died; and Jobab, son of Zara, from Bosorrha reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Jobab died, and Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Jobab died; and Asom, from the land of the Thæmanites, reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who cut down Midian in the plain of Moab, reigned in his place, and the name of his city was Gittaim.
brenton_translation: And Asom died; and Adad son of Barad, who cut off Madiam in the plain of Moab, ruled in his stead; and the name of his city was Getthaim.

fresh_translation: And Hadad died, and Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Adad died; and Samada of Massecca reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Samlah died, and Saul from Rehoboth by the river reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Samada died; and Saul of Rhoöboth by the river reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Saul died; and Ballenon the son of Achobor reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, and Hadar son of Matred reigned in his place, and the name of his city was Peor, and the name of his wife was Mehetabel, daughter of Matred son of Mezahab.
brenton_translation: And Ballenon the son of Achobor died; and Arad the son of Barad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Phogor; and the name of his wife was Metebeel, daughter of Matraith, son of Maizoöb.

fresh_translation: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau in their tribes according to their place, in their lands and in their nations: chief Timnah, chief Alvah, chief Jether,
brenton_translation: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau, in their tribes, according to their place, in their countries, and in their nations; chief Thamna, chief Gola, chief Jether,

fresh_translation: chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
brenton_translation: chief Olibema, chief Helas, chief Phinon,

fresh_translation: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
brenton_translation: chief Kenez, chief Thæman, chief Mazar,

fresh_translation: chief Magdiel, chief Zaphoin. These are the chiefs of Edom in the places built up in the land of their possession. This is Esau, father of Edom.
brenton_translation: chief Magediel, chief Zaphoin. These are the chiefs of Edom in their dwelling-places, in the land of their possession; this is Esau, the father of Edom.

fresh_translation: Now Jacob lived in the land where his father had sojourned, in the land of Canaan.
brenton_translation: And Jacob dwelt in the land where his father sojourned, in the land of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And these are the generations of Jacob. Joseph was seventeen years old, shepherding his father's sheep with his brothers, being young, with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah, the wives of his father. And Joseph brought a bad report to Israel their father.
