fresh_translation: And they placed it on four incorruptible posts overlaid with gold, and their capitals gold, and their four bases silver.
brenton_translation: And they put it on four posts of incorruptible wood overlaid with gold; and their chapiters were gold, and their four sockets were silver.

fresh_translation: And they made the curtain of the door of the tent of testimony of blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen, woven work with cherubim.
brenton_translation: And they made the veil of the door of the tabernacle of witness of blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined, woven work with cherubs,

fresh_translation: And its five posts and rings, and they overlaid their capitals and clasps with gold, and their five bases were bronze.
brenton_translation: and their posts five, and the rings; and they gilded their chapiters and their clasps with gold, and they had five sockets of brass.

fresh_translation: And they made the court. Toward the south wind were hangings of the court of woven fine linen, one hundred by one hundred.
brenton_translation: And they made the court toward the south; the curtains of the court of fine linen twined, a hundred cubits every way,

fresh_translation: And their pillars twenty and their bases twenty.
brenton_translation: and their posts twenty, and their sockets twenty;

fresh_translation: And on the side toward the north, one hundred by one hundred, and their pillars twenty and their bases twenty.
brenton_translation: and on the north side a hundred every way, and on the south side a hundred every way, and their posts twenty and their sockets twenty.

fresh_translation: And on the side toward the sea, curtains of fifty cubits, their pillars ten and their bases ten.
brenton_translation: And on the west side curtains of fifty cubits, their posts ten and their sockets ten.

fresh_translation: And on the side toward the east, fifty cubits.
brenton_translation: And on the east side curtains of fifty cubits of fifteen cubits behind,

fresh_translation: Hangings fifteen cubits at the back, and their pillars three and their bases three.
brenton_translation: and their pillars three, and their sockets three.

fresh_translation: And on the second back, on this side and that, by the gate of the court, hangings fifteen cubits, and their pillars three and their bases three.
brenton_translation: And at the second back on this side and on that by the gate of the court, curtains of fifteen cubits, their pillars three and their sockets three;

fresh_translation: All the hangings of the court were of woven fine linen.
brenton_translation: all the curtains of the tabernacle of fine linen twined.

fresh_translation: And the bases of their pillars were bronze, and their hooks silver, and their capitals silver-covered, and all the pillars of the court were silver-covered.
brenton_translation: And the sockets of their pillars of brass, and their hooks of silver, and their chapiters overlaid with silver, and all the posts of the court overlaid with silver:

fresh_translation: And the curtain of the gate of the court, embroidered work, of blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen, was twenty cubits long, and its height and breadth five cubits, equal to the hangings of the court.
brenton_translation: and the veil of the gate of the court, the work of an embroiderer of blue, and purple, and spun scarlet, and fine linen twined; the length of twenty cubits, and the height and the breadth of five cubits, made equal to the curtains of the court;

fresh_translation: And their pillars four and their bases four bronze, and their hooks silver, and their capitals silver-covered.
brenton_translation: and their pillars four, and their sockets four of brass, and their hooks of silver, and their chapiters overlaid with silver.

fresh_translation: They also were silver-covered, and all the pegs of the court all around were bronze.
brenton_translation: And all the pins of the court round about of brass, and they were overlaid with silver.

fresh_translation: And this was the ordering of the tent of testimony, as it was arranged by Moses for the service of the Levites through Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
brenton_translation: And this was the construction of the tabernacle of witness, accordingly as it was appointed to Moses; so that the public service should belong to the Levites, through Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

fresh_translation: And Bezalel son of Uri, of the tribe of Judah, made as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And Beseleel the son of Urias of the tribe of Juda, did as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, was there, chief craftsman in woven works and embroidery and variegated weaving with scarlet and fine linen.
brenton_translation: And Eliab the son of Achisamach of the tribe of Dan was there, who was chief artificer in the woven works and needle-works and embroideries, in weaving with the scarlet and fine linen.

fresh_translation: And Bezalel made the ark,
brenton_translation: And Beseleel made the ark,

fresh_translation: and overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside.
brenton_translation: and overlaid it with pure gold within and without;

fresh_translation: And he cast for it four gold rings, two on one side and two on the second side,
brenton_translation: and he cast for it four golden rings, two on the one side, and two on the other,

fresh_translation: broad enough for the poles, so that they might carry it by them.
brenton_translation: wide enough for the staves, so that men should bear the ark with them.

fresh_translation: And he made the propitiatory above the ark of pure gold,
brenton_translation: And he made the propitiatory over the ark of pure gold,

fresh_translation: and the two gold cherubim,
brenton_translation: and the two cherubs of gold;

fresh_translation: one cherub on one end of the propitiatory and one cherub on the second end of the propitiatory,
brenton_translation: one cherub on the one end of the propitiatory, and another cherub on the other end of the propitiatory,

fresh_translation: overshadowing the propitiatory with their wings.
brenton_translation: overshadowing the propitiatory with their wings.

fresh_translation: And he made the presentation table of pure gold,
brenton_translation: And he made the set table of pure gold,

fresh_translation: and cast for it four rings, two on one side and two on the second side, broad enough so that it might be lifted with the poles in them.
brenton_translation: and cast for it four rings: two on the one side and two on the other side, broad, so that men should lift it with the staves in them.

fresh_translation: And he made the poles of the ark and of the table and overlaid them with gold.
brenton_translation: And he made the staves of the ark and of the table, and gilded them with gold.

fresh_translation: And he made the utensils of the table, both the dishes and the censers and the cups and the bowls in which he would pour offerings, of gold.
brenton_translation: And he made the furniture of the table, both the dishes, and the censers, and the cups, and the bowls with which he should offer drink-offerings, of gold.

fresh_translation: And he made the lampstand that gives light, of solid gold, the shaft
brenton_translation: And he made the candlestick which gives light, of gold;

fresh_translation: and the branches from both sides of it,
brenton_translation: the stem solid, and the branches from both its sides;

fresh_translation: and buds springing out from its branches, three on this side and three on that, matching one another.
brenton_translation: and blossoms proceeding from its branches, three on this side, and three on the other, made equal to each other.

fresh_translation: And as for the lamps that are at the ends, nut-like cups came from them, and sockets from them, so that the lamps might rest on them; and the seventh socket, at the top of the lampstand, at the summit above, was wholly solid gold.
brenton_translation: And as to their lamps, which are on the ends, knops proceeded from them; and sockets proceeding from them, that the lamps might be upon them; and the seventh socket, on the top of the candlestick, on the summit above, entirely of solid gold.

fresh_translation: And on the lampstand were seven gold lamps, and its snuffers gold, and their trays gold.
brenton_translation: And on the candlestick seven golden lamps, and its snuffers gold, and its funnels gold.

fresh_translation: He silver-covered the posts and cast gold rings for each post and overlaid the bars with gold. He overlaid the posts of the curtain with gold and made gold hooks.
brenton_translation: He overlaid the posts with silver, and cast for each post golden rings, and gilded the bars with gold; and he gilded the posts of the veil with gold, and made the hooks of gold.

fresh_translation: He also made the rings of the tent gold, and the rings of the court, and rings for drawing out the upper covering, bronze.
brenton_translation: He made also the rings of the tabernacle of gold; and the rings of the court, and the rings for drawing out the veil above of brass.

fresh_translation: He cast the silver capitals of the tent and the bronze capitals of the door of the tent and the gate of the court, and he made silver hooks for the posts and silver-covered them on the posts.
brenton_translation: He cast the silver chapiters of the tabernacle, and the brazen chapiters of the door of the tabernacle, and the gate of the court; and he made silver hooks for the posts, he overlaid them with silver on the posts.

fresh_translation: He made the pegs of the tent and the pegs of the court, bronze.
brenton_translation: He made the pins of the tabernacle and the pins of the court of brass.

fresh_translation: He made the bronze altar from the bronze fire-pans that belonged to the men who stirred up revolt with the company of Korah.
brenton_translation: He made the brazen altar of the brazen censers, which belonged to the men engaged in sedition with the gathering of Core.

fresh_translation: He made all the utensils of the altar and its fire-pan and the base and the bowls and the bronze flesh-hooks.
brenton_translation: He made all the vessels of the altar and its grate, and its base, and its bowls, and the brazen flesh-hooks.

fresh_translation: He made for the altar a surrounding frame of net-work beneath its fire-pan underneath it as far as its middle, and he fixed to it four bronze rings on the four sides of the frame of the altar, wide enough for the bars, so that the altar might be carried by them.
brenton_translation: He made an appendage for the altar of network under the grate, beneath it as far as the middle of it; and he fastened to it four brazen rings on the four parts of the appendage of the altar, wide enough for the bars, so as to bear the altar with them.

fresh_translation: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure compounded incense, work of a perfumer.
brenton_translation: He made the holy anointing oil and the composition of the incense, the pure work of the perfumer.

fresh_translation: He made the bronze laver and its bronze base from the mirrors of the women who fasted, who fasted by the doors of the tent of testimony on the day it was set up.
brenton_translation: He made the brazen laver, and the brazen base of it of the mirrors of the women that fasted, who fasted by the doors of the tabernacle of witness, in the day in which he set it up.

fresh_translation: And he made the laver so that Moses and Aaron and his sons might wash their hands and feet from it. Whenever they entered the tent of testimony or approached the altar to minister, they washed from it, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And he made the laver, that at it Moses and Aaron and his sons might wash their hands and their feet: when they went into the tabernacle of witness, or whensoever they should advance to the altar to do service, they washed at it, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: All the gold that was worked for the works, for all the labor of the holy things, was gold from the contribution, twenty-nine talents and seven hundred twenty shekels by the holy shekel.
brenton_translation: All the gold that was employed for the works according to all the fabrication of the holy things, was of the gold of the offerings, twenty-nine talents, and seven hundred and twenty shekels according to the holy shekel.

fresh_translation: And the silver contribution from the men counted in the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels,
brenton_translation: And the offering of silver from the men that were numbered of the congregation a hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels, one drachm apiece, even the half shekel, according to the holy shekel.

fresh_translation: one drachma per head, half the shekel by the holy shekel, for everyone passing through the visitation, from twenty years and above, six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
brenton_translation: Every one that passed the survey from twenty years old and upwards to the number of six hundred thousand, and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

fresh_translation: And the one hundred talents of silver became the casting of the one hundred capitals of the tent and the capitals of the curtain, one hundred capitals for the one hundred talents, a talent per capital.
brenton_translation: And the hundred talents of silver went to the casting of the hundred chapiters of the tabernacle, and to the chapiters of the veil;

fresh_translation: And the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels they made into hooks for the posts, and he overlaid their capitals and adorned them.
brenton_translation: a hundred chapiters to the hundred talents, a talent to a chapiter.

fresh_translation: And the bronze of the contribution was seventy talents and one thousand five hundred shekels.
brenton_translation: And the thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels he formed into hooks for the pillars, and he gilt their chapiters and adorned them.

fresh_translation: And from it he made the bases of the door of the tent of testimony,
brenton_translation: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and a thousand five hundred shekels;

fresh_translation: and the bases of the court all around and the bases of the gate of the court and the pegs of the tent and the pegs of the court all around,
brenton_translation: and they made of it the bases of the door of the tabernacle of witness,

fresh_translation: and the bronze frame of the altar and all the utensils of the altar and all the instruments of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: and the bases of the court round about, and the bases of the gate of the court, and the pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court round about;

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses; so they did.
brenton_translation: and the brazen appendage of the altar, and all the vessels of the altar, and all the instruments of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And from the gold that remained of the contribution they made vessels to minister with before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.

fresh_translation: And the remaining blue and purple and scarlet they made into ministering garments for Aaron, so that he might minister with them in the holy place.
brenton_translation: And of the gold that remained of the offering they made vessels to minister with before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they brought the garments to Moses, and the tent and its utensils and its bases and its bars and the posts,
brenton_translation: And the blue that was left, and the purple, and the scarlet they made into garments of ministry for Aaron, so that he should minister with them in the sanctuary;

fresh_translation: and the ark of the covenant and its carrying-poles,
brenton_translation: and they brought the garments to Moses, and the tabernacle, and its furniture, its bases and its bars and the posts;

fresh_translation: and the altar and all its utensils and the anointing oil and the compounded incense,
brenton_translation: and the ark of the covenant, and its bearers, and the altar and all its furniture.

fresh_translation: and the pure lampstand and its lamps, lamps for burning, and the oil of light,
brenton_translation: And they made the anointing oil, and the incense of composition, and the pure candlestick,

fresh_translation: and the presentation table and all its utensils and the loaves laid out,
brenton_translation: and its lamps, lamps for burning, and oil for the light,

fresh_translation: and the holy garments that belong to Aaron and the garments of his sons for the priesthood,
brenton_translation: and the table of shewbread, and all its furniture, and the shewbread upon it,

fresh_translation: and the hangings of the court and the posts and the curtain of the door of the tent and of the gate of the court and all the utensils of the tent and all its instruments,
brenton_translation: and the garments of the sanctuary which belong to Aaron, and the garments of his sons, for the priestly ministry;

fresh_translation: and the red-dyed rams' skins and the blue skin coverings and the coverings for the remaining things,
brenton_translation: and the curtains of the court, and the posts, and the veil of the door of the tabernacle, and the gate of the court,

fresh_translation: and the pegs and all the instruments for the works of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: and all the vessels of the tabernacle and all its instruments: and the skins, even rams' skins dyed red, and the blue coverings, and the coverings of the other things, and the pins, and all the instruments for the works of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: As the Lord commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel made all the equipment.
brenton_translation: Whatsoever things the Lord appointed Moses, so did the children of Israel make all the furniture.

fresh_translation: And Moses saw all the works, and they had done them just as the Lord commanded Moses. So they made them, and Moses blessed them.
brenton_translation: And Moses saw all the works; and they had done them all as the Lord commanded Moses, so had they made them; and Moses blessed them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: "On one day, the new moon of the first month, you shall set up the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: On the first day of the first month, at the new moon, thou shalt set up the tabernacle of witness,

fresh_translation: And you shall place the ark of testimony and cover the ark with the curtain.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt place in it the ark of the testimony, and shalt cover the ark with the veil,

fresh_translation: And you shall bring in the table and arrange its arrangement, and you shall bring in the lampstand and place its lamps.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt bring in the table and shalt set forth that which is to be set forth on it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick and place its lamps on it.

fresh_translation: And you shall place the gold altar for incense before the ark, and you shall place the curtain-screen on the door of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt place the golden altar, to burn incense before the ark; and thou shalt put a covering of a veil on the door of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And you shall place the altar of offerings by the doors of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put the altar of burnt-offerings by the doors of the tabernacle of witness,

fresh_translation: And you shall set the tent around it and sanctify all that belongs to it all around.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt set up the tabernacle round about, and thou shalt hallow all that belongs to it round about.

fresh_translation: And you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tent and all that is in it, and you shall sanctify it and all its utensils, and it shall be holy.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and shalt anoint the tabernacle, and all things in it; and shalt sanctify it, and all its furniture, and it shall be holy.

fresh_translation: And you shall anoint the altar of offerings and all its utensils, and you shall sanctify the altar, and the altar shall be Holy of Holies.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt anoint the altar of burnt-offerings, and all its furniture; and thou shalt hallow the altar, and the altar shall be most holy.

fresh_translation: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the doors of the tent of testimony and wash them with water.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons to the doors of the tabernacle of witness, and thou shalt wash them with water.

fresh_translation: And you shall clothe Aaron with the holy garments and anoint him and sanctify him, and he shall serve as priest to me.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt put on Aaron the holy garments, and thou shalt anoint him, and thou shalt sanctify him, and he shall minister to me as priest.

fresh_translation: And you shall bring his sons and clothe them with tunics.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt bring up his sons, and shalt put garments on them.

fresh_translation: And you shall anoint them just as you anointed their father, and they shall serve as priests to me. And it shall be for them an anointing of priesthood forever throughout their generations."
brenton_translation: And thou shalt anoint them as thou didst anoint their father, and they shall minister to me as priests; and it shall be that they shall have an everlasting anointing of priesthood, throughout their generations.

fresh_translation: And Moses did all that the Lord commanded him; so he did.
brenton_translation: And Moses did all things whatsoever the Lord commanded him, so did he.

fresh_translation: And it came about in the first month, in the second year after they went out from Egypt, at the new moon, that the tent was set up.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the first month, in the second year after their going forth out of Egypt, at the new moon, that the tabernacle was set up.

fresh_translation: And Moses set up the tent and put on the capitals and inserted the bars and set up the posts.
brenton_translation: And Moses set up the tabernacle, and put on the chapiters, and put the bars into their places, and set up the posts.

fresh_translation: And he stretched out the curtains over the tent and put the covering of the tent above it, as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And he stretched out the curtains over the tabernacle, and put the veil of the tabernacle on it above as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And taking the testimonies, he put them into the ark and placed the poles beside the ark.
brenton_translation: And he took the testimonies, and put them into the ark; and he put the staves by the sides of the ark.

fresh_translation: And he brought the ark into the tent and put on the curtain-covering and covered the ark of testimony, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and put on it the covering of the veil, and covered the ark of the testimony, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And he placed the table in the tent of testimony on the north side of the tent, outside the curtain of the tent.
brenton_translation: And he put the table in the tabernacle of witness, on the north side without the veil of the tabernacle.

fresh_translation: And he set upon it the loaves of presentation before the Lord, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And he put on it the shewbread before the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And he placed the lampstand in the tent of testimony on the south side of the tent.
brenton_translation: And he put the candlestick into the tabernacle of witness, on the side of the tabernacle toward the south.

fresh_translation: And he placed its lamps before the Lord, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And he put on it its lamps before the Lord, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And he placed the golden altar in the tent of testimony opposite the curtain.
brenton_translation: And he put the golden altar in the tabernacle of witness before the veil;

fresh_translation: And he burned on it the compounded incense, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: and he burnt on it incense of composition, as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And he placed the altar of offerings by the doors of the tent.
brenton_translation: And he put the altar of the burnt-offerings by the doors of the tabernacle.

fresh_translation: And he set up the court around the tent and the altar, and Moses finished all the works.
brenton_translation: And he set up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar; and Moses accomplished all the works.

fresh_translation: And the cloud covered the tent of testimony, and the tent was filled with the glory of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the cloud covered the tabernacle of witness, and the tabernacle was filled with the glory of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of testimony, because the cloud overshadowed it, and the tent was filled with the glory of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Moses was not able to enter into the tabernacle of testimony, because the cloud overshadowed it, and the tabernacle was filled with the glory of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And whenever the cloud went up from the tent, the sons of Israel set out with all their baggage.
brenton_translation: And when the cloud went up from the tabernacle, the children of Israel prepared to depart with their baggage.

fresh_translation: But if the cloud did not go up, they did not set out until the day the cloud went up.
brenton_translation: And if the cloud went not up, they did not prepare to depart, till the day when the cloud went up.

fresh_translation: For the cloud was upon the tent by day, and fire upon it by night, before all Israel in all their journeys.
brenton_translation: For a cloud was on the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night before all Israel, in all their journeyings.

fresh_translation: And the Lord called Moses and spoke to him from the tent of testimony, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord called Moses again and spoke to him out of the tabernacle of witness, saying, Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, If a person from among you brings gifts to the Lord, you shall bring your gifts from the livestock, from the cattle and from the sheep.
brenton_translation: If any man of you shall bring gifts to the Lord, ye shall bring your gifts of the cattle and of the oxen and of the sheep.

fresh_translation: If his gift is a whole burnt offering from the cattle, he shall bring a male without blemish to the entrance of the tent of testimony. He shall bring it as accepted before the Lord.
brenton_translation: If his gift be a whole-burnt-offering, he shall bring an unblemished male of the herd to the door of the tabernacle of witness, he shall bring it as acceptable before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the offering. It shall be accepted for him, to make atonement for him.
brenton_translation: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt-offering as a thing acceptable for him, to make atonement for him.

fresh_translation: And they shall slaughter the calf before the Lord, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall bring the blood and pour the blood around on the altar, the one at the entrance of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And they shall slay the calf before the Lord; and the sons of Aaron the priests shall bring the blood, and they shall pour the blood round about on the altar, which is at the doors of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And after flaying the whole burnt offering, they shall divide it by limbs.
brenton_translation: And having flayed the whole burnt-offering, they shall divide it by its limbs.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall place fire on the altar and pile wood upon the fire.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Aaron the priests shall put fire on the altar, and shall pile wood on the fire.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pile the divided pieces and the head and the fat upon the wood on the fire that is on the altar.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Aaron the priests shall pile up the divided parts, and the head, and the fat on the wood on the fire, the wood which is on the altar.

fresh_translation: And they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water, and the priests shall place everything upon the altar. It is an offering, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the entrails and the feet they shall wash in water, and the priests shall put all on the altar: it is a burnt-offering, a sacrifice, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if his gift to the Lord is from the sheep, from the lambs or from the young goats, for a whole burnt offering, he shall bring it, a male without blemish, and he shall lay his hand on its head.
brenton_translation: And if his gift be of the sheep to the Lord, or of the lambs, or of the kids for whole-burnt-offerings, he shall bring it a male without blemish.

fresh_translation: And they shall slaughter it on the side of the altar toward the north before the Lord, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour its blood around on the altar.
brenton_translation: And he shall lay his hand on its head; and they shall kill it by the side of the altar, toward the north before the Lord, and the sons of Aaron the priests shall pour its blood on the altar round about.

fresh_translation: And they shall divide it by limbs, with the head and the fat, and the priests shall pile them on the wood on the fire on the altar.
brenton_translation: And they shall divide it by its limbs, and its head and its fat, and the priests shall pile them up on the wood which is on the fire, on the altar.

fresh_translation: And they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water, and the priest shall bring everything and place it upon the altar. It is an offering, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water, and the priest shall bring all the parts and put them on the altar: it is a burnt-offering, a sacrifice, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if he brings from the birds an offering as a gift to the Lord, he shall bring his gift from the turtledoves or from the pigeons.
brenton_translation: And if he bring his gift, a burnt-offering to the Lord, of birds, then shall he bring his gift of doves or pigeons.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall bring it to the altar and wring off its head and place it on the altar, and he shall drain out the blood against the base of the altar.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall bring it to the altar, and shall wring off its head; and the priest shall put it on the altar, and shall wring out the blood at the bottom of the altar.

fresh_translation: And he shall remove the crop with its feathers and throw it beside the altar on the east, to the place of ashes.
brenton_translation: And he shall take away the crop with the feathers, and shall cast it forth by the altar toward the east to the place of the ashes.

fresh_translation: And he shall split it open by the wings and shall not divide it, and the priest shall place it on the altar, on the wood on the fire. It is an offering, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he shall break it off from the wings and shall not separate it, and the priest shall put it on the altar on the wood which is on the fire: it is a burnt-offering, a sacrifice, a sweet-smelling savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if a person brings a sacrifice as a gift to the Lord, his gift shall be fine flour, and he shall pour oil upon it and place frankincense upon it. It is a sacrifice.
brenton_translation: And if a soul bring a gift, a sacrifice to the Lord, his gift shall be fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and shall put frankincense on it: it is a sacrifice.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests, and taking from it a full handful of the fine flour with the oil and all its frankincense, the priest shall place its memorial portion on the altar, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring it to the priests the sons of Aaron: and having taken from it a handful of the fine flour with the oil, and all its frankincense, then the priest shall put the memorial of it on the altar: it is a sacrifice, an odour of sweet savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And what remains from the sacrifice shall belong to Aaron and his sons, a holy of holies from the sacrifices of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the remainder of the sacrifice shall be for Aaron and his sons, a most holy portion from the sacrifices of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if he brings as a gift a sacrifice baked in an oven, as a gift to the Lord, it shall be unleavened loaves of fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
brenton_translation: And if he bring as a gift a sacrifice baked from the oven, a gift to the Lord of fine flour, he shall bring unleavened bread kneaded with oil, and unleavened cakes anointed with oil.

fresh_translation: And if your gift is a sacrifice from a griddle, it shall be fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened.
brenton_translation: And if thy gift be a sacrifice from a pan, it is fine flour mingled with oil, unleavened offerings.

fresh_translation: And you shall crumble them into pieces and pour oil upon them. It is a sacrifice to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt break them into fragments and pour oil upon them: it is a sacrifice to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if your gift is a sacrifice from a hearth-pan, it shall be made from fine flour with oil.
brenton_translation: And if thy gift be a sacrifice from the hearth, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring to the Lord the sacrifice that he makes from these, and he shall bring it to the priest and bring it near to the altar.
brenton_translation: And he shall offer the sacrifice which he shall make of these to the Lord, and shall bring it to the priest.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall remove from the sacrifice its memorial portion and place it on the altar, an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall approach the altar, and shall take away from the sacrifice a memorial of it, and the priest shall place it on the altar: a burnt offering, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And what remains from the sacrifice shall belong to Aaron and his sons, a holy of holies from the offerings of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And that which is left of the sacrifice shall be for Aaron and his sons, most holy from the burnt-offerings of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Every sacrifice that you bring to the Lord you shall not make leavened, for no leaven and no honey shall you bring from it as an offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Ye shall not leaven any sacrifice which ye shall bring to the Lord; for as to any leaven, or any honey, ye shall not bring of it to offer a gift to the Lord.

fresh_translation: You shall bring them to the Lord as a gift of firstfruits, but upon the altar they shall not be offered up as an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Ye shall bring them in the way of fruits to the Lord, but they shall not be offered on the altar for a sweet-smelling savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And every gift of your sacrifice shall be salted with salt. You shall not let the salt of the covenant of the Lord cease from your sacrifices. On every gift of yours you shall bring salt to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And every gift of your sacrifice shall be seasoned with salt; omit not the salt of the covenant of the Lord from your sacrifices: on every gift of yours ye shall offer salt to the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And if you bring a sacrifice of first produce to the Lord, you shall bring fresh roasted grain, crushed from the tender growth, for the sacrifice of first produce.
brenton_translation: And if thou wouldest offer a sacrifice of first-fruits to the Lord, it shall be new grains ground and roasted for the Lord; so shalt thou bring the sacrifice of the first-fruits.

fresh_translation: And you shall pour oil upon it and place frankincense upon it. It is a sacrifice.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt pour oil upon it, and shalt put frankincense on it: it is a sacrifice.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall offer up its memorial portion from the crushed grain with the oil and all its frankincense. It is an offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall offer the memorial of it taken from the grains with the oil, and all its frankincense: it is a burnt-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if his gift to the Lord is a sacrifice of salvation, if he brings it from the cattle, whether male or female, he shall bring it without blemish before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And if his gift to the Lord be a peace-offering, if he should bring it of the oxen, whether it be male or whether it be female, he shall bring it unblemished before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he shall lay his hands on the head of the gift and slaughter it beside the doors of the tent of testimony, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour the blood around on the altar of whole burnt offerings.
brenton_translation: And he shall lay his hands on the head of the gift, and shall slay it before the Lord, by the doors of the tabernacle of witness. And the priests the sons of Aaron shall pour the blood on the altar of burnt-offerings round about.

fresh_translation: And from the sacrifice of salvation they shall bring an offering to the Lord: the fat that covers the belly and all the fat that is on the belly,
brenton_translation: And they shall bring of the peace-offering a burnt-sacrifice to the Lord, the fat covering the belly, and all the fat on the belly.

fresh_translation: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that on the thighs, and he shall remove the lobe above the liver with the kidneys.
brenton_translation: And the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them; he shall take away that which is on the thighs, and the caul above the liver together with the kidneys.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall offer them on the altar upon the whole burnt offerings, upon the wood on the fire on the altar, an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the priests the sons of Aaron shall offer them on the altar on the burnt-offering, on the wood which is on the fire upon the altar: it is a burnt-offering, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if his gift from the sheep is a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord, male or female, he shall bring it without blemish.
brenton_translation: And if his gift be of the sheep, a peace-offering to the Lord, male or female, he shall bring it unblemished.

fresh_translation: If he brings a lamb as his gift, he shall bring it before the Lord.
brenton_translation: If he bring a lamb for his gift, he shall bring it before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he shall lay his hands on the head of his gift and slaughter it beside the doors of the tent of testimony, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour the blood around on the altar.
brenton_translation: And he shall lay his hands on the head of his offering, and shall slay it by the doors of the tabernacle of witness; and the priests the sons of Aaron shall pour out the blood on the altar round about.

fresh_translation: And from the sacrifice of salvation he shall bring an offering to God: the fat and the unblemished hind-part, he shall remove it with the lower back, and the fat of the belly,
brenton_translation: And he shall bring of the peace-offering a burnt-sacrifice to the Lord: the fat and the hinder part unblemished he shall take away with the loins, and having taken away all the fat that covers the belly, and all the fat that is on the belly,

fresh_translation: and both kidneys and the fat on them, that on the thighs, and removing the lobe above the liver with the kidneys,
brenton_translation: and both the kidneys and the fat that is upon them, and that which is on the thighs, and the caul which is on the liver with the kidneys,

fresh_translation: the priest shall offer it on the altar, an aroma of sweet fragrance, an offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: the priest shall offer these on the altar: it is a sacrifice of sweet savour, a burnt-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if his gift is from the goats, then he shall bring it before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And if his offering be of the goats, then shall he bring it before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he shall lay his hands on its head, and they shall slaughter it before the Lord beside the doors of the tent of testimony, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour its blood around on the altar.
brenton_translation: And he shall lay his hands on its head; and they shall slay it before the Lord by the doors of the tabernacle of witness; and the priests the sons of Aaron shall pour out the blood on the altar round about.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring from it an offering to the Lord: the fat that covers the belly and all the fat that is on the belly,
brenton_translation: And he shall offer of it a burnt-offering to the Lord, even the fat that covers the belly, and all the fat that is on the belly.

fresh_translation: and both kidneys and all the fat that is on them, that on the thighs, and he shall remove the lobe of the liver with the kidneys.
brenton_translation: And both the kidneys, and all the fat that is upon them, that which is upon the thighs, and the caul of the liver with the kidneys, shall he take away.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall offer it on the altar, an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord. All the fat belongs to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall offer it upon the altar: it is a burnt-offering, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord. All the fat belongs to the Lord.

fresh_translation: It is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings. You shall eat no fat and no blood.
brenton_translation: It is a perpetual statute throughout your generations, in all your habitations; ye shall eat no fat and no blood.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, If a person sins unintentionally before the Lord in any of the commands of the Lord about things that ought not to be done, and does one of them,
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin unwillingly before the Lord, in any of the commandments of the Lord concerning things which he ought not to do, and shall do some of them;

fresh_translation: if the anointed high priest sins so as to make the people sin, then he shall bring for his sin that he sinned a calf from the cattle, without blemish, to the Lord for his sin.
brenton_translation: if the anointed priest sin so as to cause the people to sin, then shall he bring for his sin, which he has sinned, an unblemished calf of the herd to the Lord for his sin.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring the calf to the entrance of the tent of testimony before the Lord, and he shall lay his hand on the head of the calf before the Lord and slaughter the calf before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring the calf to the door of the tabernacle of witness before the Lord, and he shall put his hand on the head of the calf before the Lord, and shall slay the calf in the presence of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the anointed priest whose hands have been consecrated shall take some of the blood of the calf and bring it into the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And the anointed priest who has been consecrated having received of the blood of the calf, shall then bring it into the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the Lord, before the holy curtain.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall dip his finger into the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the Lord, over against the holy veil.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall place some of the blood of the calf on the horns of the altar of the blended incense that is before the Lord, which is in the tent of testimony, and he shall pour out all the blood of the calf at the base of the altar of whole burnt offerings, which is by the doors of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall put of the blood of the calf on the horns of the altar of the compound incense which is before the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of witness; and all the blood of the calf shall he pour out by the foot of the altar of whole-burnt-offerings, which is by the doors of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And he shall remove from it all the fat of the calf for sin: the fat that covers the inward parts and all the fat that is on the inward parts,
brenton_translation: And all the fat of the calf of the sin-offering shall he take off from it; the fat that covers the inwards, and all the fat that is on the inwards,

fresh_translation: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that on the thighs, and he shall remove the lobe above the liver with the kidneys,
brenton_translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, that which is on the thighs, and the caul that is on the liver with the kidneys, them shall he take away,

fresh_translation: just as it is removed from the calf of the sacrifice of salvation. And the priest shall offer it on the altar of offering.
brenton_translation: as he takes it away from the calf of the sacrifice of peace-offering, so shall the priest offer it on the altar of burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And the skin of the calf and all its flesh, with the head and the extremities and the belly and the dung,
brenton_translation: And they shall take the skin of the calf, and all his flesh with the head and the extremities and the belly and the dung,

fresh_translation: they shall carry out the whole calf outside the camp to a clean place, where they pour out the ashes, and they shall burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.
brenton_translation: and they shall carry out the whole calf out of the camp into a clean place, where they pour out the ashes, and they shall consume it there on wood with fire: it shall be burnt on the ashes poured out.

fresh_translation: And if the whole assembly of Israel unintentionally fails to notice, and the matter escapes the eyes of the assembly, and they do one of all the commands of the Lord that must not be done, and become guilty,
brenton_translation: And if the whole congregation of Israel trespass ignorantly, and a thing should escape the notice of the congregation, and they should do one thing forbidden of any of the commands of the Lord, which ought not to be done, and should transgress:

fresh_translation: and the sin that they sinned in it becomes known to them, then the assembly shall bring a calf from the cattle, without blemish, for sin, and they shall bring it to the doors of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: and the sin wherein they have sinned should become known to them, then shall the congregation bring an unblemished calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and they shall bring it to the doors of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And the elders of the assembly shall lay their hands on the head of the calf before the Lord, and they shall slaughter the calf before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the calf before the Lord, and they shall slay the calf before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the calf into the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And the anointed priest shall bring in of the blood of the calf into the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood of the calf and sprinkle it seven times before the Lord, in front of the holy curtain.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall dip his finger into some of the blood of the calf, and shall sprinkle it seven times before the Lord, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall place some of the blood on the horns of the altar of the blended incense, which is before the Lord, which is in the tent of testimony, and he shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar of offerings, the one by the door of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of the incense of composition, which is before the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of witness; and he shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of whole-burnt-offerings, which is by the door of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: And he shall remove all the fat from it and offer it on the altar.
brenton_translation: And he shall take away all the fat from it, and shall offer it up on the altar.

fresh_translation: And he shall do to the calf just as he did to the calf for sin; so shall it be done. And the priest shall make atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
brenton_translation: And he shall do to the calf as he did to the calf of the sin-offering, so shall it be done; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and the trespass shall be forgiven them.

fresh_translation: And they shall carry out the whole calf outside the camp and burn the calf as they burned the earlier calf. It is the sin-offering of the assembly.
brenton_translation: And they shall carry forth the calf whole without the camp, and they shall burn the calf as they burnt the former calf: it is the sin-offering of the congregation.

fresh_translation: And if a ruler sins and does one of all the commands of the Lord their God that must not be done, unintentionally, and sins and becomes guilty,
brenton_translation: And if a ruler sin, and break one of all the commands of the Lord his God, doing the thing which ought not to be done, unwillingly, and shall sin and trespass,

fresh_translation: and the sin that he sinned becomes known to him, then he shall bring his gift, a he-goat from the goats, a male without blemish.
brenton_translation: and his trespass wherein he has sinned, be known to him,—then shall he offer for his gift a kid of the goats, a male without blemish.

fresh_translation: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the he-goat, and they shall slaughter it in the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offerings before the Lord. It is a sin-offering.
brenton_translation: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the kid, and they shall kill it in the place where they kill the victims for whole-burnt-offerings before the Lord; it is a sin-offering.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall place some of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger on the horns of the altar of whole burnt offerings, and he shall pour out all its blood at the base of the altar of whole burnt offerings.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall put some of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger on the horns of the altar of whole-burnt-offering; and he shall pour out all its blood by the bottom of the altar of whole-burnt-offerings.

fresh_translation: And he shall offer all its fat on the altar, just like the fat of the sacrifice of salvation. And the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
brenton_translation: And he shall offer up all his fat on the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

fresh_translation: And if one person from the people of the land sins unintentionally by doing one of all the commands of the Lord that must not be done, and becomes guilty,
brenton_translation: And if a soul of the people of the land should sin unwillingly, in doing a thing contrary to any of the commandments of the Lord, which ought not to be done, and shall transgress,

fresh_translation: and the sin that he sinned becomes known to him, then he shall bring a female goat from the goats, without blemish, for the sin that he sinned.
brenton_translation: and his sin should be known to him, wherein he has sinned, then shall he bring a kid of the goats, a female without blemish shall he bring for his sin, which he has sinned.

fresh_translation: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his sin-offering, and they shall slaughter the female goat of the sin-offering in the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offerings.
brenton_translation: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his sin-offering, and they shall slay the kid of the sin-offering in the place where they slay the victims for whole-burnt-offerings.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and place it on the horns of the altar of whole burnt offerings, and he shall pour out all its blood at the base of the altar.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall take of its blood with his finger, and shall put it on the horns of the altar of whole-burnt-offerings; and all its blood he shall pour forth by the foot of the altar.

fresh_translation: And he shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the sacrifice of salvation, and the priest shall offer it on the altar as an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord. And the priest shall make atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
brenton_translation: And he shall take away all the fat, as the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace-offering, and the priest shall offer it on the altar for a smell of sweet savour to the Lord; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and his sin shall be forgiven him.

fresh_translation: And if he brings a sheep as his gift for sin, he shall bring a female without blemish.
brenton_translation: And if he should offer a lamb for his sin-offering, he shall offer it a female without blemish.

fresh_translation: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin-offering, and they shall slaughter it in the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offerings.
brenton_translation: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin-offering, and they shall kill it in the place where they kill the victims for whole-burnt-offerings.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger and place it on the horns of the altar of whole burnt offering, and he shall pour out all its blood at the base of the altar of whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger, and shall put it on the horns of the altar of whole-burnt-offerings, and he shall pour out all its blood by the bottom of the altar of whole-burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And he shall remove all its fat, just as the fat of a sheep is removed from the sacrifice of salvation, and the priest shall place it on the altar, on the Lord's whole burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin that he sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
brenton_translation: And he shall take away all his fat, as the fat of the lamb of the sacrifice of peace-offering is taken away, and the priest shall put it on the altar for a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord; and the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which he sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

fresh_translation: And if a person sins and hears a sworn charge, and he is a witness or has seen or knows, if he does not report it, he shall bear the sin.
brenton_translation: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and he is a witness or has seen or been conscious, if he do not report it, he shall bear his iniquity.

fresh_translation: Or if a person touches any unclean thing, whether the carcass of an unclean wild beast, or carcasses of unclean abominations, or carcasses of unclean cattle,
brenton_translation: That soul which shall touch any unclean thing, or carcase, or that which is unclean being taken of beasts, or the dead bodies of abominable reptiles which are unclean, or carcases of unclean cattle,

fresh_translation: or touches human uncleanness, any uncleanness by which, when touching it, he would be defiled, and it escapes him, but afterward he knows and becomes guilty,
brenton_translation: or should touch the uncleanness of a man, of whatever kind, which he may touch and be defiled by, and it should have escaped him, but afterwards he should know,—then he shall have transgressed.

fresh_translation: or if a person swears, rashly speaking with the lips, to do evil or to do good, according to whatever a man may utter with an oath, and it escapes him before his eyes, and later he knows and sins in one of these things,
brenton_translation: That unrighteous soul, which determines with his lips to do evil or to do good according to whatsoever a man may determine with an oath, and it shall have escaped his notice, and he shall afterwards know it, and so he should sin in some one of these things:—

fresh_translation: then he shall confess the sin in which he has sinned.
brenton_translation: then shall he declare his sin in the things wherein he has sinned by that sin.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring to the Lord for what he became guilty in, for the sin that he sinned, a female from the sheep, a ewe lamb or a female goat, for sin, and the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring for his transgressions against the Lord, for his sin which he has sinned, a ewe lamb of the flock, or a kid of the goats, for a sin-offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he has sinned, and his sin shall be forgiven him.

fresh_translation: And if his hand is not strong enough for a sheep, he shall bring for his sin that he sinned two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the Lord, one for sin and one for a whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: And if he cannot afford a sheep, he shall bring for his sin which he has sinned, two turtle-doves or two young pigeons to the Lord; one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring them to the priest, and the priest shall bring the one for sin first, and the priest shall pinch off its head from the neck, but shall not divide it.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring them to the priest, and the priest shall bring the sin-offering first; and the priest shall pinch off the head from the neck, and shall not divide the body.

fresh_translation: And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the one for sin on the wall of the altar, and the rest of the blood he shall drain out at the base of the altar, for it is a sin-offering.
brenton_translation: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin-offering on the side of the altar, but the rest of the blood he shall drop at the foot of the altar, for it is a sin-offering.

fresh_translation: And he shall make the second one a whole burnt offering, as is proper, and the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin that he sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
brenton_translation: And he shall make the second a whole-burnt-offering, as it is fit; and the priest shall make atonement for his sin which he has sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

fresh_translation: And if his hand cannot find a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his gift for the sin that he sinned a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for sin. He shall not pour oil on it, nor place frankincense on it, because it is a sin-offering.
brenton_translation: And if he cannot afford a pair of turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, then shall he bring as his gift for his sin, the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin-offering; he shall not pour oil upon it, nor shall he put frankincense upon it, because it is a sin-offering.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest, taking from it a full handful, its memorial portion, shall place it on the altar of whole burnt offerings to the Lord. It is a sin-offering.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring it to the priest; and the priest having taken a handful of it, shall lay the memorial of it on the altar of whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord; it is a sin-offering.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin that he sinned in one of these things, and it shall be forgiven him. And what remains shall belong to the priest, like the sacrifice of fine flour.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin, which he has sinned in one of these things, and it shall be forgiven him; and that which is left shall be the priest's, as an offering of fine flour.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: If a person is overtaken by forgetfulness and sins unintentionally in the holy things of the Lord, then he shall bring for his trespass to the Lord a ram without blemish from the sheep, valued in silver shekels by the sanctuary shekel, for the thing in which he trespassed.
brenton_translation: The soul which shall be really unconscious, and shall sin unwillingly in any of the holy things of the Lord, shall even bring to the Lord for his transgression, a ram of the flock without blemish, valued according to shekels of silver according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for his transgression wherein he transgressed.

fresh_translation: And what he sinned from the holy things he shall repay, and he shall add a fifth to it and give it to the priest. And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of trespass, and it shall be forgiven him.
brenton_translation: And he shall make compensation for that wherein he has sinned in the holy things; and he shall add the fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of transgression, and his sin shall be forgiven him.

fresh_translation: And if a person sins and does one of all the commands of the Lord that must not be done, and he does not know it, yet becomes guilty and bears the sin,
brenton_translation: And the soul which shall sin, and do one thing against any of the commandments of the Lord, which it is not right to do, and has not known it, and shall have transgressed, and shall have contracted guilt,

fresh_translation: then he shall bring a ram without blemish from the sheep, valued in silver, for trespass to the priest. And the priest shall make atonement for him for his ignorance that he committed in ignorance, and he did not know it, and it shall be forgiven him.
brenton_translation: he shall even bring a ram without blemish from the flock, valued at a price of silver for his transgression to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for his trespass of ignorance, wherein he ignorantly trespassed, and he knew it not; and it shall be forgiven him.

fresh_translation: For by guilt he has been guilty before the Lord.
brenton_translation: For he has surely been guilty of transgression before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: If a person sins and deliberately overlooks the commands of the Lord and lies about matters concerning his neighbor, in a deposit or in a partnership or in a robbery, or has wronged his neighbor in something,
brenton_translation: The soul which shall have sinned, and wilfully overlooked the commandments of the Lord, and shall have dealt falsely in the affairs of his neighbour in the matter of a deposit, or concerning fellowship, or concerning plunder, or has in anything wronged his neighbour,

fresh_translation: or has found something lost and lies about it and swears unjustly concerning any one of all the things that a person may do so as to sin in them,
brenton_translation: or has found that which was lost, and shall have lied concerning it, and shall have sworn unjustly concerning any one of all the things, whatsoever a man may do, so as to sin hereby;

fresh_translation: then it shall be, whenever he sins and becomes guilty, that he shall restore the plunder that he seized, or the wrong that he committed, or the deposit entrusted to him, or the lost thing that he found,
brenton_translation: it shall come to pass, whensoever he shall have sinned, and transgressed, that he shall restore the plunder which he has seized, or redress the injury which he has committed, or restore the deposit which was entrusted to him, or the lost article which he has found

fresh_translation: from any matter about which he swore unjustly, he shall repay its principal and add a fifth to it. He shall give it to the one to whom it belongs on the day he is convicted.
brenton_translation: of any kind, about which he swore unjustly, he shall even restore it in full; and he shall add to it a fifth part besides; he shall restore it to him whose it is in the day in which he happens to be convicted.

fresh_translation: And for his trespass he shall bring to the Lord a ram from the sheep, without blemish, valued for the matter in which he trespassed.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring to the Lord for his trespass, a ram of the flock, without blemish, of value to the amount of the thing in which he trespassed.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord, and it shall be forgiven him for any one of all the things that he did and trespassed in.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord, and he shall be forgiven for any one of all the things which he did and trespassed in it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Charge Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the whole burnt offering: this is the whole burnt offering on its burning upon the altar all night until morning, and the fire of the altar shall burn on it; it shall not be extinguished.
brenton_translation: Charge Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of whole-burnt-offering; this is the whole-burnt-offering in its burning on the altar all the night till the morning; and the fire of the altar shall burn on it, it shall not be put out.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall put on a linen tunic, and he shall put linen undergarments around his body, and he shall remove the ashes that the fire consumed from the whole burnt offering on the altar, and he shall place them beside the altar.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall put on the linen tunic, and he shall put the linen drawers on his body; and shall take away that which has been thoroughly burnt, which the fire shall have consumed, even the whole-burnt-offering from the altar, and he shall put it near the altar.

fresh_translation: And he shall take off his garment and put on another garment, and he shall carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.
brenton_translation: And he shall put off his robe, and put on another robe, and he shall take forth the offering that has been burnt without the camp into a clean place.

fresh_translation: And the fire on the altar shall burn upon it and shall not be extinguished, and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning and stack the whole burnt offering upon it, and he shall place on it the fat of the sacrifice of salvation.
brenton_translation: And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, and shall not be extinguished; and the priest shall burn on it wood every morning, and shall heap on it the whole-burnt-offering, and shall lay on it the fat of the peace-offering.

fresh_translation: And fire shall burn continually on the altar; it shall not be extinguished.
brenton_translation: And the fire shall always burn on the altar; it shall not be extinguished.

fresh_translation: This is the law of the sacrifice that the sons of Aaron shall bring before the Lord, before the altar.
brenton_translation: This is the law of the sacrifice, which the sons of Aaron shall bring near before the Lord, before the altar.

fresh_translation: And he shall take from it with his handful from the fine flour of the sacrifice with its oil and all the frankincense that is on the sacrifice, and he shall offer on the altar an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance, its memorial to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he shall take from it a handful of the fine flour of the sacrifice with its oil, and with all its frankincense, which are upon the sacrifice; and he shall offer up on the altar a burnt-offering as a sweet-smelling savour, a memorial of it to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Aaron and his sons shall eat what is left of it. It shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place; they shall eat it in the court of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And Aaron and his sons shall eat that which is left of it: it shall be eaten without leaven in a holy place, they shall eat it in the court of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: It shall not be baked leavened. I have given it to them as a portion from the Lord's offerings. It is holy of holies, like that for sin and like that for trespass.
brenton_translation: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as a portion to them of the burnt-offerings of the Lord: it is most holy, as the offering for sin, and as the offering for trespass.

fresh_translation: Every male among the priests shall eat it. It is an everlasting statute throughout your generations from the Lord's offerings. Everyone who touches them shall be sanctified.
brenton_translation: Every male of the priests shall eat it: it is a perpetual ordinance throughout your generations of the burnt-offerings of the Lord; whosoever shall touch them shall be hallowed.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: This is the gift of Aaron and of his sons that they shall bring to the Lord on the day when he anoints him: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a continual sacrifice, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.
brenton_translation: This is the gift of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the Lord in the day in which thou shalt anoint him; the tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sacrifice continually, the half of it in the morning, and the half of it in the evening.

fresh_translation: It shall be made on a griddle with oil. He shall bring it well mixed, a sacrifice rolled out in pieces, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: It shall be made with oil in a frying-pan; he shall offer it kneaded and in rolls, an offering of fragments, an offering of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

fresh_translation: The anointed priest in his place from among his sons shall make it. It is an everlasting statute. It shall all be completely offered.
brenton_translation: The anointed priest who is in his place, one of his sons, shall offer it: it is a perpetual statute, it shall all be consumed.

fresh_translation: And every sacrifice of a priest shall be wholly burned and shall not be eaten.
brenton_translation: And every sacrifice of a priest shall be thoroughly burnt, and shall not be eaten.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the thing for sin: in the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offering, they shall slaughter the things for sin before the Lord. It is holy of holies.
brenton_translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin-offering;—in the place where they slay the whole-burnt-offering, they shall slay the sin-offerings before the Lord: they are most holy.

fresh_translation: The priest who offers it shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: The priest that offers it shall eat it: in a holy place it shall be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: Everyone touching its flesh shall be sanctified, and whatever garment is sprinkled with some of its blood, you shall wash what was sprinkled on it in a holy place.
brenton_translation: Every one that touches the flesh of it shall be holy, and on whosesoever garment any of its blood shall have been sprinkled, whosoever shall have it sprinkled, shall be washed in the holy place.

fresh_translation: And the earthen vessel in which it was boiled shall be broken. And if it was boiled in a bronze vessel, he shall scour it and rinse it with water.
brenton_translation: And the earthen vessel, in whichsoever it shall have been sodden, shall be broken; and if it shall have been sodden in a brazen vessel, he shall scour it and wash it with water.

fresh_translation: Every male among the priests shall eat it. It is holy of holies to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Every male among the priests shall eat it: it is most holy to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And every thing for sin, from whose blood some is brought into the tent of testimony to make atonement in the holy place, shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire.
brenton_translation: And no offerings for sin, of whose blood there shall be brought any into the tabernacle of witness to make atonement in the holy place, shall be eaten: they shall be burned with fire.

fresh_translation: And this is the law of the ram for trespass. It is holy of holies.
brenton_translation: And this is the law of the ram for the trespass-offering; it is most holy.

fresh_translation: In the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offering, they shall slaughter the ram of trespass before the Lord, and he shall pour the blood around on the altar.
brenton_translation: In the place where they slay the whole-burnt-offering, they shall slay the ram of the trespass-offering before the Lord, and he shall pour out the blood at the bottom of the altar round about.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring from it all its fat, and the loin, and all the fat that covers the inward parts and all the fat that is on the inward parts,
brenton_translation: And he shall offer all the fat from it; and the loins, and all the fat that covers the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

fresh_translation: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that on the thighs, and he shall remove the lobe above the liver with the kidneys.
brenton_translation: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, that which is upon the thighs, and the caul upon the liver with the kidneys, he shall take them away.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall offer them on the altar, an offering to the Lord. It is for trespass.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall offer them on the altar a burnt-offering to the Lord; it is for trespass.

fresh_translation: Every male among the priests shall eat them. They shall eat them in a holy place. It is holy of holies.
brenton_translation: Every male of the priests shall eat them, in the holy place they shall eat them: they are most holy.

fresh_translation: As the thing for sin, so also the thing for trespass. There is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with it, it shall belong to him.
brenton_translation: As the sin-offering, so also is the trespass-offering. There is one law of them; the priest who shall make atonement with it, his it shall be.

fresh_translation: And the priest who offers a person's whole burnt offering, the skin of the whole burnt offering that he offers shall belong to him.
brenton_translation: And as for the priest who offers a man's whole-burnt-offering, the skin of the whole-burnt-offering which he offers, shall be his.

fresh_translation: And every sacrifice that is prepared in the oven, and everything that is prepared on the hearth-pan or on the griddle, shall belong to the priest who offers it.
brenton_translation: And every sacrifice which shall be prepared in the oven, and every one which shall be prepared on the hearth, or on a frying-pan, it is the property of the priest that offers it; it shall be his.

fresh_translation: And every sacrifice mixed with oil and not mixed with oil shall belong equally to all the sons of Aaron.
brenton_translation: And every sacrifice made up with oil, or not made up with oil, shall belong to the sons of Aaron, an equal portion to each.

fresh_translation: This is the law of the sacrifice of salvation that they shall bring to the Lord.
brenton_translation: This is the law of the sacrifice of peace-offering, which they shall bring to the Lord.

fresh_translation: If he brings it for praise, then on the sacrifice of praise he shall bring loaves from fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and fine flour well mixed with oil.
brenton_translation: If a man should offer it for praise, then shall he bring, for the sacrifice of praise, loaves of fine flour made up with oil, and unleavened cakes anointed with oil, and fine flour kneaded with oil.

fresh_translation: With leavened loaves he shall bring his gifts with the sacrifice of praise of salvation.
brenton_translation: With leavened bread he shall offer his gifts, with the peace-offering of praise.

fresh_translation: And he shall bring one from all his gifts as a contribution to the Lord. It shall belong to the priest who pours out the blood of the sacrifice of salvation.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring one of all his gifts, a separate offering to the Lord: it shall belong to the priest who pours forth the blood of the peace-offering.

fresh_translation: And the flesh of the sacrifice of praise of salvation shall belong to him, and it shall be eaten on the day it is offered. They shall not leave any of it until morning.
brenton_translation: And the flesh of the sacrifice of the peace-offering of praise shall be his, and it shall be eaten in the day in which it is offered: they shall not leave of it till the morning.

fresh_translation: And if his gift is a vow or a voluntary offering, on the day when he offers his sacrifice it shall be eaten, and on the next day,
