brenton_translation: Only he shall not approach the veil, and he shall not draw nigh to the altar, because he has a blemish; and he shall not profane the sanctuary of his God, for I am the Lord that sanctifies them.

fresh_translation: And Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons and to all the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to Aaron and his sons, and let them attend carefully to the holy things of the sons of Israel, and they shall not profane my holy name in what they consecrate to me. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, and let them take heed concerning the holy things of the children of Israel, so they shall not profane my holy name in any of the things which they consecrate to me: I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: Say to them: Throughout your generations any man from all your seed who approaches the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate to the Lord, while his uncleanness is upon him, that person shall be destroyed from before me. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Say to them, Every man throughout your generations, whoever of all your seed shall approach to the holy things, whatsoever the children of Israel shall consecrate to the Lord, while his uncleanness is upon him, that soul shall be cut off from me: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And any man from the seed of Aaron the priest, if he has skin-disease or a discharge, shall not eat the holy things until he is cleansed. And if one touches any uncleanness of a dead person, or a man from whom a flow of seed goes out,
brenton_translation: And the man of the seed of Aaron the priest, if he should have leprosy or issue of the reins, shall not eat of the holy things, until he be cleansed; and he that touches any uncleanness of a dead body, or the man whose seed of copulation shall have gone out from him,

fresh_translation: or whoever touches any unclean creeping thing that would make him unclean, or a human by whom he would become unclean according to all his uncleanness,
brenton_translation: or whosoever shall touch any unclean reptile, which will defile him, or who shall touch a man, whereby he shall defile him according to all his uncleanness:

fresh_translation: a person who touches these shall be unclean until evening and shall not eat from the holy things unless he washes his body in water.
brenton_translation: whatsoever soul shall touch them shall be unclean until evening; he shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his body in water,

fresh_translation: And when the sun goes down, he shall be clean, and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because that is his bread.
brenton_translation: and the sun go down, and then he shall be clean; and then shall he eat of all the holy things, for they are his bread.

fresh_translation: What dies of itself or is torn by beasts he shall not eat, to be defiled by them. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: He shall not eat that which dies of itself, or is taken of beasts, so that he should be polluted by them: I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they shall keep my ordinances, so that they may not bear sin because of them and die because of them if they profane them. I am the Lord God who sanctifies them.
brenton_translation: And they shall keep my ordinances, that they do not bear iniquity because of them, and die because of them, if they shall profane them: I am the Lord God that sanctifies them.

fresh_translation: And no foreigner shall eat holy things. A resident of a priest or a hired servant shall not eat holy things.
brenton_translation: And no stranger shall eat the holy things: one that sojourns with a priest, or a hireling, shall not eat the holy things.

fresh_translation: But if a priest acquires a person as property with silver, that one shall eat of his bread, and those born in his house, they too shall eat of his bread.
brenton_translation: But if a priest should have a soul purchased for money, he shall eat of his bread; and they that are born in his house, they also shall eat of his bread.

fresh_translation: And if a priest's daughter belongs to a foreign man, she shall not eat of the firstfruits of the holy things.
brenton_translation: And if the daughter of a priest should marry a stranger, she shall not eat of the offerings of the sanctuary.

fresh_translation: But if a priest's daughter becomes a widow or cast out, and there is no seed for her, and she returns to her father's house as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's bread. But no foreigner shall eat from them.
brenton_translation: And if the daughter of a priest should be a widow, or put away, and have no seed, she shall return to her father's house, as in her youth: she shall eat of her father's bread, but no stranger shall eat of it.

fresh_translation: And if a man eats holy things by ignorance, he shall add a fifth part to it and give the holy thing to the priest.
brenton_translation: And the man who shall ignorantly eat holy things, shall add the fifth part to it, and give the holy thing to the priest.

fresh_translation: And they shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel, which they set apart for the Lord,
brenton_translation: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the Lord.

fresh_translation: and bring upon themselves guilt of trespass when they eat their holy things, because I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
brenton_translation: So should they bring upon themselves the iniquity of trespass in their eating their holy things: for I am the Lord that sanctifies them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the congregation of Israel, and you shall say to them: Any man from the sons of Israel or from the sons of the newcomers attached to them in Israel who brings his gifts according to all their vows or according to all their freewill choices, whatever they may bring to God as a whole burnt offering,
brenton_translation: Speak to Aaron and his sons, and to all the congregation of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Any man of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that abide among them in Israel, who shall offer his gifts according to all their confession and according to all their choice, whatsoever they may bring to the Lord for whole-burnt-offerings—

fresh_translation: for acceptance for you, shall bring an unblemished male from the cattle and from the sheep and from the goats.
brenton_translation: your free-will-offerings shall be males without blemish of the herds, or of the sheep, or of the goats.

fresh_translation: Whatever has a blemish in it you shall not bring to the Lord, because it shall not be acceptable for you.
brenton_translation: They shall not bring to the Lord anything that has a blemish in it, for it shall not be acceptable for you.

fresh_translation: And if a man brings a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord, fulfilling a vow or as a freewill choice or in your festivals, it shall be unblemished for acceptance, from the cattle or from the sheep. No blemish shall be in it.
brenton_translation: And whatsoever man shall offer a peace-offering to the Lord, discharging a vow, or in the way of free-will-offering, or an offering in your feasts, of the herds or of the sheep, it shall be without blemish for acceptance: there shall be no blemish in it.

fresh_translation: A blind or crushed or cut-tongued animal, or one with warts or with mange or with ringworm, these you shall not bring to the Lord, and from them you shall not place an offering upon the altar to the Lord.
brenton_translation: One that is blind, or broken, or has its tongue cut out, or is troubled with warts, or has a malignant ulcer, or tetters, they shall not offer these to the Lord; neither shall ye offer any of them for a burnt-offering on the altar of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And a calf or sheep cut in ear or short in tail, you shall make them as slaughter-offerings for yourself, but for your vow it shall not be accepted.
brenton_translation: And a calf or a sheep with the ears cut off, or that has lost its tail, thou shalt slay them for thyself; but they shall not be accepted for thy vow.

fresh_translation: One bruised or crushed or cut out or torn away you shall not bring to the Lord, and in your land you shall not do so.
brenton_translation: That which has broken testicles, or is crushed or gelt or mutilated,—thou shalt not offer them to the Lord, neither shall ye sacrifice them upon your land.

fresh_translation: And from the hand of a foreigner you shall not bring gifts to your God from any of these, because ruin is in them; blemish is in them; these shall not be accepted for you.
brenton_translation: Neither shall ye offer the gifts of your God of all these things by the hand of a stranger, because there is corruption in them, a blemish in them: these shall not be accepted for you.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: A calf or sheep or goat, whenever it is born, shall be seven days under its mother, but on the eighth day and beyond it shall be accepted as a gift, an offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: As for a calf, or a sheep, or a goat, whenever it is born, then shall it be seven days under its mother; and on the eighth day and after they shall be accepted for sacrifices, a burnt-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And a calf or sheep, her and her young you shall not slaughter in one day.
brenton_translation: And a bullock and a ewe, it and its young, thou shalt not kill in one day.

fresh_translation: And if you sacrifice to the Lord a sacrifice, a vow of rejoicing, you shall sacrifice it for acceptance for you.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest offer a sacrifice, a vow of rejoicing to the Lord, ye shall offer it so as to be accepted for you.

fresh_translation: It shall be eaten on that same day; you shall not leave any of the meat from it until morning. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: In that same day it shall be eaten; ye shall not leave of the flesh till the morrow: I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you shall keep my commands and do them.
brenton_translation: And ye shall keep my commandments and do them.

fresh_translation: And you shall not profane my holy name, and I shall be sanctified in the midst of the sons of Israel. I am the Lord who sanctifies you,
brenton_translation: And ye shall not profane the name of the Holy One, and I will be sanctified in the midst of the children of Israel. I am the Lord that sanctifies you,

fresh_translation: who brought you out from the land of Egypt so as to be your God. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: These are the feasts of the Lord, which you shall call holy convocations; these are my feasts.
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say unto them, The feasts of the Lord which ye shall call holy assemblies, these are my feasts.

fresh_translation: Six days you shall do works, and on the seventh day there shall be Sabbaths, rest, a holy convocation to the Lord. You shall do no work. It is Sabbath to the Lord in every dwelling of yours.
brenton_translation: Six days shalt thou do works, but on the seventh day is the sabbath; a rest, a holy convocation to the Lord: thou shalt not do any work, it is a sabbath to the Lord in all your dwellings.

fresh_translation: These are the feasts of the Lord, holy convocations, which you shall call in their times.
brenton_translation: These are the feasts to the Lord, holy convocations, which ye shall call in their seasons.

fresh_translation: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the evenings, is Passover to the Lord.
brenton_translation: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the evening times is the Lord's passover.

fresh_translation: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast of Unleavened Bread to the Lord. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
brenton_translation: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast of unleavened bread to the Lord; seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread.

fresh_translation: And the first day shall be a holy convocation for you. You shall do no servile work.
brenton_translation: And the first day shall be a holy convocation to you: ye shall do no servile work.

fresh_translation: And you shall bring whole burnt offerings to the Lord seven days, and the seventh day shall be a holy convocation for you. You shall do no servile work.
brenton_translation: And ye shall offer whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord seven days; and the seventh day shall be a holy convocation to you: ye shall do no servile work.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: When you enter the land that I give you and reap its harvest, you shall bring a sheaf, the firstfruits of your harvest, to the priest.
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, When ye shall enter into the land which I give you, and reap the harvest of it, then shall ye bring a sheaf, the first-fruits of your harvest, to the priest;

fresh_translation: And he shall lift the sheaf before the Lord, acceptable for you. On the day after the first day the priest shall lift it.
brenton_translation: and he shall lift up the sheaf before the Lord, to be accepted for you. On the morrow of the first day the priest shall lift it up.

fresh_translation: And on the day when you bring the sheaf, you shall prepare an unblemished yearling lamb as a whole burnt offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And ye shall offer on the day on which ye bring the sheaf, a lamb without blemish of a year old for a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And its sacrifice shall be two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering to the Lord, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord, and its libation shall be a fourth of a hin of wine.
brenton_translation: And its meat-offering two tenth portions of fine flour mingled with oil: it is a sacrifice to the Lord, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord, and its drink-offering the fourth part of a hin of wine.

fresh_translation: And bread and parched grain and fresh kernels you shall not eat until this very day, until you bring the gifts to your God. It is a perpetual statute throughout your generations in every dwelling of yours.
brenton_translation: And ye shall not eat bread, or the new parched corn, until this same day, until ye offer the sacrifices to your God: it is a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

fresh_translation: And you shall count for yourselves from the day after the Sabbaths, from the day when you bring the sheaf of the raised offering, seven full weeks.
brenton_translation: And ye shall number to yourselves from the day after the sabbath, from the day on which ye shall offer the sheaf of the heave-offering, seven full weeks:

fresh_translation: Until the day after the last week you shall count fifty days, and you shall bring a new sacrifice to the Lord.
brenton_translation: until the morrow after the last week ye shall number fifty days, and shall bring a new meat-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: From your dwellings you shall bring loaves as a raised offering, two loaves from two tenths of fine flour. They shall be baked leavened, firstfruits to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Ye shall bring from your dwelling loaves, as a heave-offering, two loaves: they shall be of two tenth portions of fine flour, they shall be baked with leaven of the first-fruits to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you shall bring with the loaves seven unblemished yearling lambs and one calf from the cattle and two unblemished rams. They shall be a whole burnt offering to the Lord, and their sacrifices and their libations, an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And ye shall bring with the loaves seven unblemished lambs of a year old, and one calf of the herd, and two rams without blemish, and they shall be a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord: and their meat-offerings and their drink-offerings shall be a sacrifice, a smell of sweet savour to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they shall offer one kid from the goats for sin, and two yearling lambs as a sacrifice of salvation with the loaves of firstfruits.
brenton_translation: And they shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin-offering, and two lambs of a year old for a peace-offering, with the loaves of the first-fruits.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall place them with the loaves of firstfruits as a raised offering before the Lord with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the Lord for the priest who offers them; they shall be his.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall place them with the loaves of the first-fruits an offering before the Lord with the two lambs, they shall be holy to the Lord; they shall belong to the priest that brings them.

fresh_translation: And you shall proclaim this day; it shall be a holy convocation for you. You shall do no servile work in it. It is a perpetual statute throughout your generations in every dwelling of yours.
brenton_translation: And ye shall call this day a convocation: it shall be holy to you; ye shall do no servile work on it: it is a perpetual ordinance throughout your generations in all your habitations.

fresh_translation: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not finish off the remainder of your field when you reap, and the fallen gleanings of your harvest you shall not gather. For the poor and for the newcomer you shall leave them. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And when ye shall reap the harvest of your land, ye shall not fully reap the remainder of the harvest of your field when thou reapest, and thou shalt not gather that which falls from thy reaping; thou shalt leave it for the poor and the stranger: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a rest, a memorial of trumpets, a holy convocation.
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have a rest, a memorial of trumpets: it shall be to you a holy convocation.

fresh_translation: You shall do no servile work, and you shall bring a whole burnt offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall offer a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: And on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall humble your lives, and you shall bring a whole burnt offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month is a day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation to you; and ye shall humble your souls, and offer a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: You shall do no work on this very day, because it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Ye shall do no work on this self-same day: for this is a day of atonement for you, to make atonement for you before the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: Every person who is not humbled on this very day shall be destroyed from her people.
brenton_translation: Every soul that shall not be humbled in that day, shall be cut off from among its people.

fresh_translation: And every person who does work on this very day, that person shall perish from her people.
brenton_translation: And every soul which shall do work on that day, that soul shall be destroyed from among its people.

fresh_translation: You shall do no work. It is a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
brenton_translation: Ye shall do no manner of work: it is a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your habitations.

fresh_translation: It shall be a Sabbath of Sabbaths for you, and you shall humble your lives. From the ninth day of the month, from evening to evening, you shall sabbatize your Sabbaths.
brenton_translation: It shall be a holy sabbath to you; and ye shall humble your souls, from the ninth day of the month: from evening to evening ye shall keep your sabbaths.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of Booths for seven days to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month, there shall be a feast of tabernacles seven days to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no servile work.
brenton_translation: And on the first day shall be a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

fresh_translation: Seven days you shall bring whole burnt offerings to the Lord, and the eighth day shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall bring whole burnt offerings to the Lord. It is a conclusion. You shall do no servile work.
brenton_translation: Seven days shall ye offer whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord, and the eighth-day shall be a holy convocation to you; and ye shall offer whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord: it is a time of release, ye shall do no servile work.

fresh_translation: These are the feasts of the Lord, which you shall call holy convocations, so as to bring offerings to the Lord, whole burnt offerings and their sacrifices and their libations, each day as required for the day,
brenton_translation: These are the feasts to the Lord, which ye shall call holy convocations, to offer burnt-offerings to the Lord, whole-burnt-offerings and their meat-offerings, and their drink-offerings, that for each day on its day:

fresh_translation: apart from the Sabbaths of the Lord and apart from your gifts and apart from all your vows and apart from all your freewill offerings that you give to the Lord.
brenton_translation: besides the sabbaths of the Lord, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides your free-will-offerings, which ye shall give to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month, whenever you finish the produce of the land, you shall keep feast to the Lord seven days. On the first day there shall be rest, and on the eighth day there shall be rest.
brenton_translation: And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month, when ye shall have completely gathered in the fruits of the earth, ye shall keep a feast to the Lord seven days; on the first day there shall be a rest, and on the eighth day a rest.

fresh_translation: And on the first day you shall take splendid fruit of trees and branches of palms and boughs of leafy tree and willows and branches of chaste tree from the torrent, to rejoice before the Lord your God seven days.
brenton_translation: And on the first day ye shall take goodly fruit of trees, and branches of palm trees, and thick boughs of trees, and willows, and branches of osiers from the brook, to rejoice before the Lord your God seven days in the year.

fresh_translation: It is a perpetual statute throughout your generations. In the seventh month you shall keep feast to it.
brenton_translation: It is a perpetual statute for your generations: in the seventh month ye shall keep it.

fresh_translation: You shall dwell in booths seven days. Every native-born person in Israel shall dwell in booths,
brenton_translation: Seven days ye shall dwell in tabernacles: every native in Israel shall dwell in tents,

fresh_translation: so that your generations may see that in booths I settled the sons of Israel when I brought them out from the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: that your posterity may see, that I made the children of Israel to dwell in tents, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And Moses spoke the feasts of the Lord to the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Moses recounted the feasts of the Lord to the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Command the sons of Israel, and let them take for me clear beaten olive oil for light, to burn a lamp continually.
brenton_translation: Charge the children of Israel, and let them take for thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to burn a lamp continually,

fresh_translation: Outside the curtain in the tent of testimony, Aaron and his sons shall burn it from evening until morning before the Lord continually, a perpetual statute throughout your generations.
brenton_translation: outside the veil in the tabernacle of witness; and Aaron and his sons shall burn it from evening until morning before the Lord continually, a perpetual statute throughout your generations.

fresh_translation: On the pure lampstand you shall burn the lamps before the Lord until morning.
brenton_translation: Ye shall burn the lamps on the pure lamp-stand before the Lord till the morrow.

fresh_translation: And you shall take fine flour and make from it twelve loaves. Each loaf shall be of two tenths.
brenton_translation: And ye shall take fine flour, and make of it twelve loaves; each loaf shall be of two tenth parts.

fresh_translation: And you shall place them in two arrangements, six loaves in one arrangement, on the pure table before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And ye shall put them in two rows, each row containing six loaves, on the pure table before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you shall place on the arrangement pure frankincense and salt, and they shall be for the loaves as a memorial, set before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And ye shall put on each row pure frankincense and salt; and these things shall be for loaves for a memorial, set forth before the Lord.

fresh_translation: On the day of the Sabbaths it shall be set out before the Lord continually, from the sons of Israel as an everlasting covenant.
brenton_translation: On the sabbath-day they shall be set forth before the Lord continually before the children of Israel, for an everlasting covenant.

fresh_translation: And it shall belong to Aaron and to his sons, and they shall eat them in a holy place, because this is holy of holies for him from the things sacrificed to the Lord, a perpetual statute.
brenton_translation: And they shall be for Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat them in the holy place: for this is their most holy portion of the offerings made to the Lord, a perpetual statute.

fresh_translation: And there came out a son of an Israelite woman, and he was the son of an Egyptian, among the sons of Israel, and the one from the Israelite woman and the Israelite man fought in the camp.
brenton_translation: And there went forth a son of an Israelitish woman, and he was son of an Egyptian man among the sons of Israel; and they fought in the camp, the son of the Israelitish woman, and a man who was an Israelite.

fresh_translation: And the son of the Israelite woman, having named the Name, cursed, and they brought him to Moses. And his mother's name was Shelomith, daughter of Dibri, from the tribe of Dan.
brenton_translation: And the son of the Israelitish woman named THE NAME and cursed; and they brought him to Moses: and his mother's name was Salomith, daughter of Dabri of the tribe of Dan.

fresh_translation: And they put him into custody, to judge him by the command of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they put him in ward, to judge him by the command of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Bring out the one who cursed outside the camp, and let all who heard place their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
brenton_translation: Bring forth him that cursed outside the camp, and all who heard shall lay their hands upon his head, and all the congregation shall stone him.

fresh_translation: And speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: A man who curses God shall bear sin.
brenton_translation: And speak to the sons of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Whosoever shall curse God shall bear his sin.

fresh_translation: And the one naming the name of the Lord, let him surely be put to death; with stones let all the congregation stone him. Whether newcomer or native-born, when he names the name of the Lord, let him die.
brenton_translation: And he that names the name of the Lord, let him die the death: let all the congregation of Israel stone him with stones; whether he be a stranger or a native, let him die for naming the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And a man who strikes a human life, and it dies, let him surely be put to death.
brenton_translation: And whosoever shall smite a man and he die, let him die the death.

fresh_translation: And whoever strikes an animal and it dies, let him pay life for life.
brenton_translation: And whosoever shall smite a beast, and it shall die, let him render life for life.

fresh_translation: And if anyone gives a blemish to his neighbor, as he did, so it shall be done back to him:
brenton_translation: And whosoever shall inflict a blemish on his neighbour, as he has done to him, so shall it be done to himself in return;

fresh_translation: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. According as he gave a blemish to a person, so shall it be given to him.
brenton_translation: bruise for bruise, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as any one may inflict a blemish on a man, so shall it be rendered to him.

fresh_translation: Whoever strikes a person and he dies, let him surely be put to death.
brenton_translation: Whosoever shall smite a man, and he shall die, let him die the death.

fresh_translation: One righteous judgment shall be for the newcomer and for the native-born, because I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: There shall be one judgment for the stranger and the native, for I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and they brought out the one who cursed outside the camp and stoned him with stones. And the sons of Israel did just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and they brought him that had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones: and the children of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the mount Sina, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: When you enter the land that I give you, the land that I give you shall rest, Sabbaths to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Whensoever ye shall have entered into the land, which I give to you, then the land shall rest which I give to you, for its sabbaths to the Lord.

fresh_translation: Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard and gather its fruit.
brenton_translation: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vine, and gather in its fruit.

fresh_translation: But in the seventh year there shall be Sabbaths of rest for the land, Sabbaths to the Lord. Your field you shall not sow, and your vineyard you shall not prune.
brenton_translation: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath, it shall be a rest to the land, a sabbath to the Lord: thou shalt not sow thy field, and thou shalt not prune thy vine.

fresh_translation: And the spontaneous growths of your field you shall not reap, and the grapes of your consecrated growth you shall not gather. It shall be a year of rest for the land.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not gather the spontaneous produce of thy field, and thou shalt not gather fully the grapes of thy dedication: it shall be a year of rest to the land.

fresh_translation: And the Sabbaths of the land shall be food for you and for your servant and for your maidservant and for your hired worker and for the resident staying with you,
brenton_translation: And the sabbaths of the land shall be food for thee, and for thy man-servant, and for thy maid-servant, and thy hireling, and the stranger that abides with thee.

fresh_translation: and for your cattle and for the wild animals in your land. All its produce shall be for eating.
brenton_translation: And for thy cattle, and for the wild beasts that are in thy land, shall every fruit of it be for food.

fresh_translation: And you shall count for yourself seven rests of years, seven years seven times, and you shall have seven weeks of years, forty-nine years.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt reckon to thyself seven sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and they shall be to thee seven weeks of years, nine and forty years.

fresh_translation: And you shall proclaim a trumpet's sound through all your land in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month. On the day of atonement you shall proclaim with trumpet through all your land.
brenton_translation: In the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall make a proclamation with the sound of a trumpet in all your land; on the day of atonement ye shall make a proclamation with a trumpet in all your land.

fresh_translation: And you shall sanctify the fiftieth year, and you shall proclaim release upon the land to all dwelling in it. This year shall be for you a signal of release, and each shall go out to his possession, and each shall return to his homeland.
brenton_translation: And ye shall sanctify the year, the fiftieth year, and ye shall proclaim a release upon the land to all that inhabit it; it shall be given a year of release, a jubilee for you; and each one shall depart to his possession, and ye shall go each to his family.

fresh_translation: This fiftieth year shall be for you a signal of release. You shall not sow, nor reap its spontaneous growths, nor gather its consecrated produce.
brenton_translation: This is a jubilee of release, the year shall be to you the fiftieth year: ye shall not sow, nor reap the produce that comes of itself from the land, neither shall ye gather its dedicated fruits.

fresh_translation: Because it is a signal of release, it shall be holy to you. From the fields you shall eat its produce.
brenton_translation: For it is a jubilee of release; it shall be holy to you, ye shall eat its fruits off the fields.

fresh_translation: In this year of its signal of release each shall return to his possession.
brenton_translation: In the year of the release even the jubilee of it, shall each one return to his possession.

fresh_translation: And if you make a sale to your neighbor, or acquire from your neighbor, let no one oppress his neighbor.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest sell a possession to thy neighbour, or if thou shouldest buy of thy neighbour, let not a man oppress his neighbour.

fresh_translation: According to the number of years after the signal you shall acquire from your neighbor; according to the number of crop-years he shall sell to you.
brenton_translation: According to the number of years after the jubilee shalt thou buy of thy neighbour, according to the number of years of the fruits shall he sell to thee.

fresh_translation: According as the years are many, you shall increase its purchase, and according as the years are few, you shall lessen its purchase, because according to the number of its crops he sells to you.
brenton_translation: According as there may be a greater number of years he shall increase the value of his possession, and according as there may be a less number of years he shall lessen the value of his possession; for according to the number of his crops, so shall he sell to thee.

fresh_translation: Let no one oppress his neighbor, and you shall fear the Lord your God. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Let not a man oppress his neighbour, and thou shalt fear the Lord thy God: I am the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And you shall do all my ordinances and all my judgments, and keep them and do them, and you shall dwell confidently on the land.
brenton_translation: And ye shall keep all my ordinances, and all my judgments; and do ye observe them, and ye shall keep them, and dwell securely in the land.

fresh_translation: And the land shall give its produce, and you shall eat to fullness and dwell confidently on it.
brenton_translation: And the land shall yield her increase, and ye shall eat to fulness, and shall dwell securely in it.

fresh_translation: And if you say, What shall we eat in this seventh year, if we do not sow nor gather our produce?
brenton_translation: And if ye should say, What shall we eat in this seventh year, if we do not sow nor gather in our fruits?

fresh_translation: Then I will send my blessing to you in the sixth year, and it shall make its produce for three years.
brenton_translation: Then will I send my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and the land shall produce its fruits for three years.

fresh_translation: And you shall sow in the eighth year and eat from the old produce until the ninth year; until its produce comes in, you shall eat old stores of old things.
brenton_translation: And ye shall sow in the eighth year, and eat old fruits till the ninth year: until its fruit come, ye shall eat old fruits of the old.

fresh_translation: And the land shall not be sold into permanence, because the land is mine. For you are newcomers and residents before me.
brenton_translation: And the land shall not be sold for a permanence; for the land is mine, because ye are strangers and sojourners before me.

fresh_translation: And through all the land of your possession you shall give redemption for the land.
brenton_translation: And in every land of your possession, ye shall allow ransoms for the land.

fresh_translation: And if your brother beside you becomes poor and sells from his possession, and his near kinsman comes, the one nearest to him, he shall redeem the sale of his brother.
brenton_translation: And if thy brother who is with thee be poor, and should have sold part of his possession, and his kinsman who is nigh to him come, then he shall redeem the possession which his brother has sold.

fresh_translation: And if he has no kinsman, but his hand prospers and sufficient redemption is found for him,
brenton_translation: And if one have no near kinsman, and he prosper with his hand, and he find sufficient money, even his ransom;

fresh_translation: then he shall calculate the years of his sale and pay back the surplus to the man to whom he sold himself, and he shall return to his possession.
brenton_translation: then shall he calculate the years of his sale, and he shall give what is due to the man to whom he sold it, and he shall return to his possession.

fresh_translation: But if his hand does not prosper enough to repay him, then the sale shall remain with the one who acquired it until the year of release, and he shall go out in the release and return to his possession.
brenton_translation: But if his hand have not prospered sufficiently, so as that he should restore the money to him, then he that bought the possessions shall have them till the sixth year of the release; and it shall go out in the release, and the owner shall return to his possession.

fresh_translation: And if anyone sells a dwelling house in a walled city, its redemption shall continue until a full year of days is completed; its redemption shall last a full year.
brenton_translation: And if any one should sell an inhabited house in a walled city, then there shall be the ransom of it, until the time is fulfilled: its time of ransom shall be a full year.

fresh_translation: But if it is not redeemed until a whole year is completed for it, then the house in the city that has a wall shall be confirmed permanently to the one who acquired it, throughout his generations. It shall not go out in the release.
brenton_translation: And if it be not ransomed until there be completed of its time a full year, the house which is in the walled city shall be surely confirmed to him that bought it, throughout his generations; and it shall not go out in the release.

fresh_translation: But the houses in villages that have no wall around them shall be counted with the field of the land. They shall always be redeemable, and in the release they shall go out.
brenton_translation: But the houses in the villages which have not a wall round about them, shall be reckoned as the fields of the country: they shall always be redeemable, and they shall go out in the release.

fresh_translation: And the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities of their possession, shall always be redeemable for the Levites.
brenton_translation: And the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities in their possession, shall be always redeemable to the Levites.

fresh_translation: And whoever redeems from the Levites, then the sale of houses of the city of their possession shall go out in the release, because the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession in the midst of the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And if any one shall redeem a house of the Levites, then shall their sale of the houses of their possession go out in the release; because the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession in the midst of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the fields set apart for their cities shall not be sold, because this is their everlasting possession.
brenton_translation: And the lands set apart for their cities shall not be sold, because this is their perpetual possession.

fresh_translation: And if your brother becomes poor and grows weak in his hands beside you, you shall take hold of him as of a newcomer and a resident, and your brother shall live with you.
brenton_translation: And if thy brother who is with thee become poor, and he fail in resources with thee, thou shalt help him as a stranger and a sojourner, and thy brother shall live with thee.

fresh_translation: You shall not take interest from him, nor increase, and you shall fear your God. I am the Lord, and your brother shall live with you.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not receive from him interest, nor increase: and thou shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord: and thy brother shall live with thee.

fresh_translation: Your silver you shall not give to him at interest, and your food you shall not give to him for increase.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not lend thy money to him at interest, and thou shalt not lend thy meat to him to be returned with increase.

fresh_translation: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, so as to be your God.
brenton_translation: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Chanaan, so as to be your God.

fresh_translation: And if your brother beside you is humbled and is sold to you, he shall not serve you with a servant's service.
brenton_translation: And if thy brother by thee be lowered, and be sold to thee, he shall not serve thee with the servitude of a slave.

fresh_translation: He shall be with you as a hired worker or a resident. He shall work beside you until the year of release,
brenton_translation: He shall be with thee as a hireling or a sojourner, he shall work for thee till the year of release:

fresh_translation: and he shall go out in the release, he and his children with him, and he shall return to his family; to his paternal possession he shall run back.
brenton_translation: and he shall go out in the release, and his children with him; and he shall go to his family, he shall hasten back to his patrimony.

fresh_translation: Because these are my domestics, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold in a servant's sale.
brenton_translation: Because these are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; such an one shall not be sold as a common servant.

fresh_translation: You shall not stretch him hard in toil, and you shall fear the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not oppress him with labour, and shalt fear the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And slave and slave-girl, as many as may come to you from the nations that are around you, from them you shall acquire male slave and female slave.
brenton_translation: And whatever number of men-servants and maid-servants thou shalt have, thou shalt purchase male and female servants from the nations that are round about thee.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of the residents who are among you, from these you shall acquire, and from their families, as many as may be born in your land, and they shall be for you as a possession.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of the sojourners that are among you, of these ye shall buy and of their relations, all that shall be in your lands; let them be to you for a possession.

fresh_translation: And you shall distribute them to your children after you, and they shall be for you as permanent holdings forever. But among your brothers, the sons of Israel, no one shall stretch his brother hard in toils.
brenton_translation: And ye shall distribute them to your children after you, and they shall be to you permanent possessions for ever: but of your brethren the children of Israel, one shall not oppress his brother in labours.

fresh_translation: And if the hand of the newcomer or the resident beside you prospers, and your brother grows poor and is sold to the newcomer or resident beside you, to one born from newcomer stock,
brenton_translation: And if a stranger or sojourner with thee wax rich, and thy brother in distress be sold to the stranger or the sojourner that is with thee, or to a proselyte by extraction;

fresh_translation: after he has been sold, redemption shall be for him; one of his brothers shall redeem him.
brenton_translation: after he is sold to him there shall be redemption for him, one of his brethren shall redeem him.

fresh_translation: His father's brother or the son of his father's brother shall redeem him, or one from his own flesh, from his tribe, shall redeem him. But if he prospers in his hands, he may redeem himself.
brenton_translation: A brother of his father, or son of his father's brother shall redeem him; or let one of his near kin of his tribe redeem him, and if he should be rich and redeem himself,

fresh_translation: And he shall calculate with the one who acquired him from the year that he sold himself to him until the year of release, and the silver of his sale shall be according to a hired worker's wage, year by year it shall be with him.
brenton_translation: then shall he calculate with his purchaser from the year that he sold himself to him until the year of release: and the money of his purchase shall be as that of a hireling, he shall be with him from year to year.

fresh_translation: And if many years remain, according to these he shall pay his redemption from the silver of his sale.
brenton_translation: And if any have a greater number of years than enough, according to these he shall pay his ransom out of his purchase-money.

fresh_translation: And if only a few years remain until the year of release, then he shall calculate for him according to his years, and he shall pay his redemption.
brenton_translation: And if but a little time be left of the years to the year of release, then shall he reckon to him according to his years, and shall pay his ransom

fresh_translation: He shall be with him as a hired worker year by year. You shall not stretch him hard in toil before you.
brenton_translation: as a hireling; he shall be with him from year to year; thou shalt not oppress him with labour before thee.

fresh_translation: But if he is not redeemed by these means, he shall go out in the year of release, he and his children with him.
brenton_translation: And if he do not pay his ransom accordingly, he shall go out in the year of his release, he and his children with him.

fresh_translation: Because the sons of Israel are mine as domestics. They are my servants, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: For the children of Israel are my servants: they are my attendants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: Do not make for yourselves idols made by hand, nor carved images, nor set up a pillar for yourselves, nor place a watching stone in your land to bow down to it, because I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: I am the Lord your God: ye shall not make to yourselves gods made with hands, or graven; neither shall ye rear up a pillar for yourselves, neither shall ye set up a stone for an object in your land to worship it: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: Keep my Sabbaths, and stand in awe before my holy things. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuaries: I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: If you walk in my ordinances and keep my commands and do them,
brenton_translation: If ye will walk in my ordinances, and keep my commandments, and do them,

fresh_translation: then I will give you rain in its season, and the land will give its produce, and the trees of the plains will yield their fruit.
brenton_translation: then will I give you the rain in its season, and the land shall produce its fruits, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

fresh_translation: And threshing will overtake vintage for you, and vintage will overtake sowing, and you will eat your bread to fullness and dwell in safety on your land.
brenton_translation: And your threshing time shall overtake the vintage, and your vintage shall overtake your seed time; and ye shall eat your bread to the full; and ye shall dwell safely upon your land, and war shall not go through your land.

fresh_translation: And war will not pass through your land, and I will give peace in your land, and you will sleep, and there will be none to frighten you, and I will destroy harmful wild beasts from your land.
brenton_translation: And I will give peace in your land, and ye shall sleep, and none shall make you afraid; and I will destroy the evil beasts out of your land,

fresh_translation: And you will pursue your enemies, and they will fall before you by slaughter.
brenton_translation: and ye shall pursue your enemies, and they shall fall before you with slaughter.

fresh_translation: And five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue myriads, and your enemies will fall before you by sword.
brenton_translation: And five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase tens of thousands; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

fresh_translation: And I will look upon you and increase you and multiply you, and I will establish my covenant with you.
brenton_translation: And I will look upon you, and increase you, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

fresh_translation: And you will eat old stores, even very old stores, and you will clear out the old before the new.
brenton_translation: And ye shall eat that which is old and very old, and bring forth the old to make way for the new.

fresh_translation: And I will set my covenant among you, and my soul will not abhor you.
brenton_translation: And I will set my tabernacle among you, and my soul shall not abhor you;

fresh_translation: And I will walk among you and will be your God, and you will be my people.
brenton_translation: and I will walk among you, and be your God, and ye shall be my people.

fresh_translation: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt when you were slaves, and I shattered the bonds of your yoke and led you with boldness.
brenton_translation: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, where ye were slaves; and I broke the band of your yoke, and brought you forth openly.

fresh_translation: But if you do not listen to me and do not do these ordinances,
brenton_translation: But if ye will not hearken to me, nor obey these my ordinances,

fresh_translation: but disobey them, and your soul loathes my judgments, so that you do not do all my commands, so as to break my covenant,
brenton_translation: but disobey them, and your soul should loathe my judgments, so that ye should not keep all my commands, so as to break my covenant,

fresh_translation: then I also will do this to you: I will bring upon you distress, scab, and jaundice, wasting your eyes and consuming your life, and you will sow your seed for nothing, and your adversaries will eat it.
brenton_translation: then will I do thus to you: I will even bring upon you perplexity and the itch, and the fever that causes your eyes to waste away, and disease that consumes your life; and ye shall sow your seeds in vain, and your enemies shall eat them.

fresh_translation: And I will set my face against you, and you will fall before your enemies, and those who hate you will pursue you, and you will flee though none pursues you.
brenton_translation: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall fall before your enemies, and they that hate you shall pursue you; and ye shall flee, no one pursuing you.

fresh_translation: And if even after this you do not listen to me, I will continue to discipline you sevenfold for your sins.
brenton_translation: And if ye still refuse to hearken to me, then will I chasten you yet more even seven times for your sins.

fresh_translation: And I will shatter the arrogance of your pride, and I will make your sky iron and your land like bronze.
brenton_translation: And I will break down the haughtiness of your pride; and I will make your heaven iron, and your earth as it were brass.

fresh_translation: And your strength will be spent in vain, and your land will not give its seed, and the tree of your field will not give its fruit.
brenton_translation: And your strength shall be in vain; and your land shall not yield its seed, and the tree of your field shall not yield its fruit.

fresh_translation: And if after this you go at odds with me and are unwilling to listen to me, I will add blows to you sevenfold according to your sins.
brenton_translation: And if after this ye should walk perversely, and not be willing to obey me, I will further bring upon you seven plagues according to your sins.

fresh_translation: And I will send against you the wild beasts of the land, and they will devour you and destroy your cattle and make you few, and your roads will be desolate.
brenton_translation: And I will send upon you the wild beasts of the land, and they shall devour you, and shall consume your cattle: and I will make you few in number, and your ways shall be desolate.

fresh_translation: And if by these things you are not disciplined, but go at odds with me,
brenton_translation: And if hereupon ye are not corrected, but walk perversely towards me,

fresh_translation: then I also will go with you in anger at odds, and I myself will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
brenton_translation: I also will walk with you with a perverse spirit, and I also will smite you seven times for your sins.

fresh_translation: And I will bring upon you a sword avenging covenant justice, and you will flee into your cities, and I will send death among you, and you will be handed over into enemies' hands.
brenton_translation: And I will bring upon you a sword avenging the cause of my covenant, and ye shall flee for refuge to your cities; and I will send out death against you, and ye shall be delivered into the hands of your enemies.

fresh_translation: When I afflict you with the scarcity of breads, ten women will bake your breads in one oven and give back your breads by weight, and you will eat and not be filled.
brenton_translation: When I afflict you with famine of bread, then ten women shall bake your loaves in one oven, and they shall render your loaves by weight; and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

fresh_translation: But if after these things you do not listen to me and go with me at odds,
brenton_translation: And if hereupon ye will not obey me, but walk perversely towards me,

fresh_translation: then I myself will go with you in wrath at odds and discipline you sevenfold according to your sins.
brenton_translation: then will I walk with you with a froward mind, and I will chasten you sevenfold according to your sins.

fresh_translation: And you will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.
brenton_translation: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

fresh_translation: And I will lay waste your pillars and destroy your wooden idols, and I will place your carcasses upon the carcasses of your idols, and my soul will loathe you.
brenton_translation: And I will render your pillars desolate, and will utterly destroy your wooden images made with hands; and I will lay your carcases on the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall loathe you.

fresh_translation: And I will make your cities desolate and lay waste your holy places, and I will not smell the fragrance of your sacrifices.
brenton_translation: And I will lay your cities waste, and I will make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell the savour of your sacrifices.

fresh_translation: And I myself will lay waste the land, and your enemies who dwell in it will wonder at it.
brenton_translation: And I will lay your land desolate, and your enemies who dwell in it shall wonder at it.

fresh_translation: And I will scatter you among the nations, and the sword coming after you will consume you, and your land will be desolate and your cities desolate.
brenton_translation: And I will scatter you among the nations, and the sword shall come upon you and consume you; and your land shall be desolate, and your cities shall be desolate.

fresh_translation: Then the land will welcome its Sabbaths all the days of its desolation, while you are in the land of your enemies; then the land will keep Sabbath and welcome its Sabbaths.
brenton_translation: Then the land shall enjoy its sabbaths all the days of its desolation.

fresh_translation: All the days of its desolation it will keep Sabbath, what it did not keep Sabbath in your Sabbaths when you were dwelling on it.
brenton_translation: And ye shall be in the land of your enemies; then the land shall keep its sabbaths, and the land shall enjoy its sabbaths all the days of its desolation: it shall keep sabbaths which it kept not among your sabbaths, when ye dwelt in it.

fresh_translation: And to those left of you I will bring fear into their heart in the land of their enemies, and the sound of a driven leaf will pursue them, and they will flee as fleeing from war and will fall with none pursuing.
brenton_translation: And to those who are left of you I will bring bondage into their heart in the land of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them, and they shall flee as fleeing from war, and shall fall when none pursues them.

fresh_translation: And brother will disregard brother, as in war, though none chases, and you will not be able to stand against your enemies.
brenton_translation: And brother shall disregard brother as in war, when none pursues; and ye shall not be able to withstand your enemies.

fresh_translation: And you will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will devour you.
brenton_translation: And ye shall perish among the Gentiles, and the land of your enemies shall devour you.

fresh_translation: And those left of you will waste away for their sins in the land of their enemies; they also will melt away for the sins of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And those who are left of you shall perish, because of their sins, and because of the sins of their fathers: in the land of their enemies shall they consume away.

fresh_translation: And they will confess their sins and the sins of their fathers, that they transgressed and overlooked me and went at odds with me.
brenton_translation: And they shall confess their sins, and the sins of their fathers, that they have transgressed and neglected me, and that they have walked perversely before me,

fresh_translation: And I also went with them in anger at odds and destroyed them in the land of their enemies. Then their uncircumcised heart will be ashamed, and then they will accept their sins.
brenton_translation: and I walked with them with a perverse mind; and I will destroy them in the land of their enemies: then shall their uncircumcised heart be ashamed, and then shall they acquiesce in the punishment of their sins.

fresh_translation: And I will remember the covenant of Jacob, and the covenant of Isaac, and the covenant of Abraham I will remember, and I will remember the land.
brenton_translation: And I will remember the covenant of Jacob, and the covenant of Isaac, and the covenant of Abraam will I remember.

fresh_translation: And the land will be left by them; then it will welcome its Sabbaths while made desolate because of them, and they will accept their lawless deeds, because they overlooked my judgments and their soul loathed my ordinances.
brenton_translation: And I will remember the land, and the land shall be left of them; then the land shall enjoy her sabbaths, when it is deserted through them: and they shall accept the punishment of their iniquities, because they neglected my judgments, and in their soul loathed my ordinances.

fresh_translation: Yet not even while they are in the land of their enemies have I overlooked them or loathed them so as to destroy them, so as to break my covenant with them, because I am the Lord their God.
brenton_translation: And yet not even thus, while they were in the land of their enemies, did I overlook them, nor did I loathe them so as to consume them, to break my covenant made with them; for I am the Lord their God.

fresh_translation: And I will remember for them the earlier covenant, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of a house of slavery, before the nations, to be their God. I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will remember their former covenant, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage before the nations, to be their God; I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: These are the judgments and the ordinances and the law that the Lord gave between himself and the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai by Moses' hand.
brenton_translation: These are my judgments and my ordinances, and the law which the Lord gave between himself and the children of Israel, in the mount Sina, by the hand of Moses.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: Whoever vows a vow, setting the valuation of his life to the Lord,
brenton_translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Whosoever shall vow a vow as the valuation of his soul for the Lord,

fresh_translation: the valuation of the male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty silver didrachms by the holy standard.
brenton_translation: the valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be—his valuation shall be fifty didrachms of silver by the standard of the sanctuary.

fresh_translation: And the valuation of the female shall be thirty didrachms.
brenton_translation: And the valuation of a female shall be thirty didrachms.

fresh_translation: And if from five years old to twenty years old, the valuation of the male shall be twenty didrachms, and of the female ten didrachms.
brenton_translation: And if it be from five years old to twenty, the valuation of a male shall be twenty didrachms, and of a female ten didrachms.

fresh_translation: And from a month old to five years old, the valuation of the male shall be five silver didrachms, and of the female three didrachms.
brenton_translation: And from a month old to five years old, the valuation of a male shall be five didrachms, and of a female, three didrachms of silver.

fresh_translation: And if from sixty years old and upward, if male, the valuation shall be fifteen silver didrachms, and if female, ten didrachms.
brenton_translation: And if from sixty years old and upward, if it be a male, his valuation shall be fifteen didrachms of silver, and if a female, ten didrachms.

fresh_translation: And if he is too poor for the valuation, he shall stand before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according as the hand of the one who vowed is able, the priest shall value him.
brenton_translation: And if the man be too poor for the valuation, he shall stand before the priest; and the priest shall value him: according to what the man who has vowed can afford, the priest shall value him.

fresh_translation: And if it is from the cattle that people bring from them as a gift to the Lord, whatever someone gives from these to the Lord shall be holy.
brenton_translation: And if it be from the cattle that are offered as a gift to the Lord, whoever shall offer one of these to the Lord, it shall be holy.

fresh_translation: He shall not exchange it, good for bad or bad for good. But if in exchanging he does exchange animal for animal, both it and its exchange shall be holy.
brenton_translation: He shall not change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good; and if he do at all change it, a beast for a beast, it and the substitute shall be holy.

fresh_translation: And if it is any unclean animal, from which they do not bring a gift to the Lord, he shall set the animal before the priest.
brenton_translation: And if it be any unclean beast, of which none are offered as a gift to the Lord, he shall set the beast before the priest.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall value it between good and bad, and as the priest values it, so it shall stand.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall make a valuation between the good and the bad, and accordingly as the priest shall value it, so shall it stand.

fresh_translation: But if in redeeming he redeems it, he shall add the fifth part to its valuation.
brenton_translation: And if the worshipper will at all redeem it, he shall add the fifth part to its value.

fresh_translation: And if a person sanctifies his house as holy to the Lord, the priest shall value it between good and bad; as the priest values it, so it shall stand.
brenton_translation: And whatsoever man shall consecrate his house as holy to the Lord, the priest shall make a valuation of it between the good and the bad: as the priest shall value it, so shall it stand.

fresh_translation: And if the one who sanctified it redeems his house, he shall add to it the fifth part of the silver of its valuation, and it shall be his.
brenton_translation: And if he that has sanctified it should redeem his house, he shall add to it the fifth part of the money of the valuation, and it shall be his.

fresh_translation: And if a person sanctifies to the Lord part of the field of his possession, its valuation shall be according to its seed: a homer of barley seed, fifty silver didrachms.
brenton_translation: And if a man should hallow to the Lord a part of the field of his possession, then the valuation shall be according to its seed, fifty didrachms of silver for a homer of barley.

fresh_translation: And if he sanctifies his field from the year of release, it shall stand according to its valuation.
brenton_translation: And if he should sanctify his field from the year of release, it shall stand according to his valuation.

fresh_translation: But if he sanctifies his field later, after the release, the priest shall reckon the silver for him according to the years remaining until the year of release, and it shall be deducted from its valuation.
brenton_translation: And if he should sanctify his field in the latter time after the release, the priest shall reckon to him the money for the remaining years, until the next year of release, and it shall be deducted as an equivalent from his full valuation.

fresh_translation: And if the one who sanctified it redeems the field, he shall add the fifth part of the silver to its valuation, and it shall be his.
brenton_translation: And if he that sanctified the field would redeem it, he shall add to its value the fifth part of the money, and it shall be his.

fresh_translation: But if he does not redeem the field, and the field is sold to another person, he may no longer redeem it.
brenton_translation: And if he do not redeem the field, but should sell the field to another man, he shall not after redeem it.

fresh_translation: But when the field goes out in the release, it shall be holy to the Lord, like land set apart. It shall belong to the priest as a possession.
brenton_translation: But the field shall be holy to the Lord after the release, as separated land; the priest shall have possession of it.

fresh_translation: And if he sanctifies to the Lord part of a field he bought, which is not from the field of his possession,
brenton_translation: And if he should consecrate to the Lord of a field which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

fresh_translation: the priest shall reckon for him the full amount of the valuation until the year of release, and he shall give the valuation on that day, holy to the Lord.
brenton_translation: the priest shall reckon to him the full valuation from the year of release, and he shall pay the valuation in that day as holy to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And in the year of release the field shall be returned to the person from whom he bought it, to the one whose possession the land was.
brenton_translation: And in the year of release the land shall be restored to the man of whom the other bought it, whose the possession of the land was.

fresh_translation: And every valuation shall be by holy weights; twenty obols shall be the didrachm.
brenton_translation: And every valuation shall be by holy weights: the didrachm shall be twenty oboli.

fresh_translation: But every firstborn that is born among your cattle shall belong to the Lord, and no one shall sanctify it, whether calf or sheep; it belongs to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And every first-born which shall be produced among thy cattle shall be the Lord's, and no man shall sanctify it: whether calf or sheep, it is the Lord's.

fresh_translation: And if it is from the unclean four-footed animals, he shall redeem it according to its valuation and add the fifth part to it, and it shall be his. But if it is not redeemed, it shall be sold according to its valuation.
brenton_translation: But if he should redeem an unclean beast, according to its valuation, then he shall add the fifth part to it, and it shall be his; and if he redeem it not, it shall be sold according to its valuation.

fresh_translation: But every devoted thing that a person devotes to the Lord, from all that belongs to him, from human to beast and from the field of his possession, shall not be sold and shall not be redeemed. Every devoted thing is holy of holies to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And every dedicated thing which a man shall dedicate to the Lord of all that he has, whether man or beast, or of the field of his possession, he shall not sell it, nor redeem it: every devoted thing shall be most holy to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And every devoted thing that is devoted from humans shall not be redeemed, but shall surely be put to death.
brenton_translation: And whatever shall be dedicated of men, shall not be ransomed, but shall be surely put to death.

fresh_translation: And every tithe of the land, from the seed of the land and from the fruit of the trees, belongs to the Lord; it is holy to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Every tithe of the land, both of the seed of the land, and of the fruit of trees, is the Lord's, holy to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if a person redeems his tithe in redeeming, he shall add the fifth part to it, and it shall be his.
brenton_translation: And if a man should at all redeem his tithe, he shall add the fifth part to it, and it shall be his.

fresh_translation: And every tithe of cattle and sheep, everything that passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And every tithe of oxen, and of sheep, and whatsoever may come in numbering under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the Lord.

fresh_translation: He shall not inspect whether it is good or bad, and he shall not exchange it. But if in exchanging he does exchange it, both it and its exchange shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not change a good for a bad, or a bad for a good; and if thou shouldest at all change it, its equivalent also shall be holy, it shall not be redeemed.

fresh_translation: These are the commands that the Lord commanded Moses for the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai.
brenton_translation: These are the commandments which the Lord commanded Moses for the sons of Israel in mount Sina.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of testimony, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sina, in the tabernacle of witness, on the first day of the second month, in the second year of their departure from the land of Egypt, saying,

fresh_translation: Take the headcount of the whole congregation of the sons of Israel by their families, by the houses of their fathers, by the number of their names, by their heads, every male,
brenton_translation: Take the sum of all the congregation of Israel according to their kindreds, according to the houses of their fathers' families, according to their number by their names, according to their heads: every male

fresh_translation: from twenty years old and upward, every one going out in force in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them with their strength.
brenton_translation: from twenty years old and upwards, every one that goes forth in the forces of Israel, take account of them with their strength; thou and Aaron take account of them.

fresh_translation: And with you there shall be one man from each tribe; they shall be chiefs by the houses of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And with you there shall be each one of the rulers according to the tribe of each: they shall be according to the houses of their families.

fresh_translation: And these are the names of the men who shall stand with you: from Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
brenton_translation: And these are the names of the men who shall be present with you; of the tribe of Ruben, Elisur the son of Sediur.

fresh_translation: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
brenton_translation: Of Symeon, Salamiel the son of Surisadai.

fresh_translation: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
brenton_translation: Of Juda, Naasson the son of Aminadab.

fresh_translation: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
brenton_translation: Of Issachar, Nathanael the son of Sogar.

fresh_translation: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;
brenton_translation: Of Zabulon, Eliab the son of Chælon.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Joseph, of Ephraim, Elisama the son of Emiud: of Manasses, Gamaliel the son of Phadasur.

fresh_translation: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
brenton_translation: Of Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gadeoni.

fresh_translation: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
brenton_translation: Of Dan, Achiezer the son of Amisadai.

fresh_translation: from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;
brenton_translation: Of Aser, Phagaiel the son of Echran.

fresh_translation: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Reuel;
brenton_translation: Of Gad, Elisaph the son of Raguel.

fresh_translation: from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.
brenton_translation: Of Nephthali, Achire the son of Ænan.

fresh_translation: These were the called ones of the congregation, chiefs of the tribes of their fathers, commanders of thousands in Israel.
brenton_translation: These were famous men of the congregation, heads of the tribes according to their families: these are heads of thousands in Israel.

fresh_translation: And Moses and Aaron took these men, the ones called by name,
brenton_translation: And Moses and Aaron took these men who were called by name.

fresh_translation: and they assembled the whole congregation on the first day of the second month in the second year, and they enrolled themselves by their generations, by their fathers, by the number of their names, from twenty years old and upward, every male by their heads.
brenton_translation: And they assembled all the congregation on the first day of the month in the second year; and they registered them after their lineage, after their families, after the number of their names, from twenty years old and upwards, every male according to their number:

fresh_translation: As the Lord commanded Moses, so they were counted in the wilderness of Sinai.
brenton_translation: as the Lord commanded Moses, so they were numbered in the wilderness of Sina.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Reuben, Israel's firstborn, by their families, by their clans, by the houses of their fathers, by the number of their names, by their headcount, every male from twenty years old and upward, every one going out in force,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ruben the first-born of Israel according to their kindreds, according to their divisions, according to the houses of their families, according to the number of their names, according to their heads, were—all males from twenty years old and upward, every one that went out with the host—

fresh_translation: those counted from the tribe of Reuben: forty-six thousand five hundred.
brenton_translation: the numbering of them of the tribe of Ruben, was forty-six thousand and four hundred.

fresh_translation: As for the sons of Simeon, by their families, by their clans, by the houses of their fathers, by the number of their names, by their headcount, every male from twenty years old and upward, every one going out in force,
brenton_translation: For the children of Symeon according to their kindreds, according to their divisions, according to the houses of their families, according to the number of their names, according to their polls, all males from twenty years old and upward, every one that goes out with the host,
