brenton_translation: If thou shouldest build a new house, then shalt thou make a parapet to thy house; so thou shalt not bring blood-guiltiness upon thy house, if one should in any wise fall from it.

fresh_translation: You shall not sow your vineyard with diversity, lest the produce and the seed that you sow with the produce of your vineyard be made holy.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with diverse seed, lest the fruit be devoted, and whatsoever seed thou mayest sow, with the fruit of thy vineyard.

fresh_translation: You shall not plow with calf and donkey together.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not plough with an ox and an ass together.

fresh_translation: You shall not wear mixed fabric, wool and linen together.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not wear a mingled garment, woollen and linen together.

fresh_translation: You shall make twisted threads for yourself on the four corners of your cloaks with which you clothe yourself.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt make fringes on the four borders of thy garments, with which soever thou mayest be clothed.

fresh_translation: And if a man takes a wife and lives with her and then hates her,
brenton_translation: And if any one should take a wife, and dwell with her, and hate her,

fresh_translation: and places pretextual words against her and brings an evil name upon her and says, I took this woman, and after going in to her I did not find her virginity,
brenton_translation: and attach to her reproachful words, and bring against her an evil name, and say, I took this woman, and when I came to her I found not her tokens of virginity:

fresh_translation: then, taking the tokens of the girl's virginity, the father of the girl and the mother shall bring them out to the elders at the gate,
brenton_translation: then the father and the mother of the damsel shall take and bring out the damsel's tokens of virginity to the elders of the city to the gate.

fresh_translation: and the father of the girl shall say to the elders, I gave this daughter of mine to this man as a wife, and, having hated her,
brenton_translation: And the father of the damsel shall say to the elders, I gave this my daughter to this man for a wife;

fresh_translation: he now places pretextual words against her, saying, I did not find virginity for your daughter. And these are the girl's virginity. And they shall spread out the garment before the elders of the city.
brenton_translation: and now he has hated her, and attaches reproachful words to her, saying, I have not found tokens of virginity with thy daughter; and these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity. And they shall unfold the garment before the elders of the city.

fresh_translation: And the elders of that city shall take that man and discipline him,
brenton_translation: And the elders of that city shall take that man, and shall chastise him,

fresh_translation: and they shall fine him one hundred shekels and give them to the father of the young woman, because he brought an evil name upon a virgin of Israel, and she shall be his wife. He shall not be able to send her away all his time.
brenton_translation: and shall fine him a hundred shekels, and shall give them to the father of the damsel, because he has brought forth an evil name against a virgin of Israel; and she shall be his wife: he shall never be able to put her away.

fresh_translation: But if this matter truly happened and virginity was not found for the young woman,
brenton_translation: But if this report be true, and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel;

fresh_translation: then they shall bring the young woman out to the doors of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones, and she shall die, because she did folly among the sons of Israel, prostituting herself in her father's house. And you shall destroy the evil one from among you.
brenton_translation: then shall they bring out the damsel to the doors of her father's house, and shall stone her with stones, and she shall die; because she has wrought folly among the children of Israel, to defile the house of her father by whoring: so thou shalt remove the evil one from among you.

fresh_translation: And if a man is found lying with a woman living with a husband, you shall kill them both, the man lying with the woman and the woman, and you shall destroy the evil one from Israel.
brenton_translation: And if a man be found lying with a woman married to a man, ye shall kill them both, the man that lay with the woman, and the woman: so shalt thou remove the wicked one out of Israel.

fresh_translation: And if there is a virgin girl betrothed to a man, and a man finding her in the city lies with her,
brenton_translation: And if there be a young damsel espoused to a man, and a man should have found her in the city and have lain with her;

fresh_translation: you shall bring them both out to the gate of their city, and they shall be stoned with stones and die, the young woman because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he humbled his neighbor's wife. And you shall destroy the evil one from among you.
brenton_translation: ye shall bring them both out to the gate of their city, and they shall be stoned with stones, and they shall die; the damsel, because she cried not in the city; and the man, because he humbled his neighbour's spouse: so shalt thou remove the evil one from yourselves.

fresh_translation: But if a man finds the betrothed girl in the field and, forcing her, lies with her, you shall kill only the man lying with her.
brenton_translation: But if a man find in the field a damsel that is betrothed, and he should force her and lie with her, ye shall slay the man that lay with her only.

fresh_translation: And to the young woman you shall do nothing. The young woman has no sin worthy of death, because as when a man rises against his neighbor and murders his life, so is this matter,
brenton_translation: And the damsel has not committed a sin worthy of death; as if a man should rise up against his neighbour, and slay him, so is this thing;

fresh_translation: because he found her in the field. The betrothed young woman cried out, and there was no one to help her.
brenton_translation: because he found her in the field; the betrothed damsel cried, and there was none to help her.

fresh_translation: And if a man finds the virgin girl who is not betrothed and, forcing her, lies with her and they are found,
brenton_translation: And if any one should find a young virgin who has not been betrothed, and should force her and lie with her, and be found,

fresh_translation: then the man lying with her shall give the father of the young woman fifty silver didrachmas, and she shall be his wife, because he humbled her. He shall not be able to send her away all his time.
brenton_translation: the man who lay with her shall give to the father of the damsel fifty silver didrachms, and she shall be his wife, because he has humbled her; he shall never be able to put her away.

fresh_translation: A man shall not take his father's wife, and he shall not uncover his father's covering.
brenton_translation: A man shall not take his father's wife, and shall not uncover his father's skirt.

fresh_translation: One crushed in the testicles and one cut off shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord.
brenton_translation: He that is fractured or mutilated in his private parts shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord.

fresh_translation: One from a prostitute shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord.
brenton_translation: One born of a harlot shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord.

fresh_translation: An Ammonite and a Moabite shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord, and even to the tenth generation he shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord, even forever,
brenton_translation: The Ammanite and Moabite shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord, even until the tenth generation he shall not enter into the assembly of the Lord, even for ever:

fresh_translation: because they did not meet you with bread and water on the road when you came out from Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam son of Beor from Mesopotamia to curse you.
brenton_translation: because they met you not with bread and water by the way, when ye went out of Egypt; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Mesopotamia to curse thee.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God was not willing to listen to Balaam, and the Lord your God turned the curses into blessing, because the Lord your God loved you.
brenton_translation: But the Lord thy God would not hearken to Balaam; and the Lord thy God changed the curses into blessings, because the Lord thy God loved thee.

fresh_translation: You shall not greet them with peace, nor seek what benefits them, all your days forever.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not speak peaceably or profitably to them all thy days for ever.

fresh_translation: You shall not abhor an Edomite, because he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you became a resident in his land.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite, because he is thy brother; thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian, because thou wast a stranger in his land.

fresh_translation: If sons are born to them, the third generation shall enter into the assembly of the Lord.
brenton_translation: If sons be born to them, in the third generation they shall enter into the assembly of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if you go out to encamp against your enemies, you shall keep yourself from every evil word.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest go forth to engage with thine enemies, then thou shalt keep thee from every wicked thing.

fresh_translation: And if there is in you a man who is not clean from his night-flow, then he shall go outside the camp and shall not enter into the camp.
brenton_translation: If there should be in thee a man who is not clean by reason of his issue by night, then he shall go forth out of the camp, and he shall not enter into the camp.

fresh_translation: And it shall be toward evening, he shall wash his body with water, and when the sun has set he shall enter into the camp.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass toward evening he shall wash his body with water, and when the sun has gone down, he shall go into the camp.

fresh_translation: And a place shall be for you outside the camp, and you shall go out there,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt have a place outside of the camp, and thou shalt go out thither,

fresh_translation: and a peg shall be for you on your belt, and it shall be, when you sit outside, then you shall dig with it and, turning back, you shall cover your indecency with it.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt have a trowel on thy girdle; and it shall come to pass when thou wouldest relieve thyself abroad, that thou shalt dig with it, and shalt bring back the earth and cover thy nuisance.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord your God walks about in your camp to deliver you and hand over your enemy before your face, and your camp shall be holy, and indecency of a matter shall not be seen in you, and he shall turn away from you.
brenton_translation: Because the Lord thy God walks in thy camp to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemy before thy face; and thy camp shall be holy, and there shall not appear in thee a disgraceful thing, and so he shall turn away from thee.

fresh_translation: You shall not hand over a servant to his master who has been added to you from his master.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not deliver a servant to his master, who coming from his master attaches himself to thee.

fresh_translation: With you he shall dwell, among you he shall dwell, in every place that pleases him. You shall not afflict him.
brenton_translation: He shall dwell with thee, he shall dwell among you where he shall please; thou shalt not afflict him.

fresh_translation: There shall not be a prostitute from the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be one prostituting himself from the sons of Israel. There shall not be a consecrated woman from the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be a consecrated man from the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: There shall not be a harlot of the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be a fornicator of the sons of Israel; there shall not be an idolatress of the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be an initiated person of the sons of Israel.

fresh_translation: You shall not bring the wages of a prostitute nor the price of a dog into the house of the Lord your God for any vow, because both are an abomination to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a harlot, nor the price of a dog into the house of the Lord thy God, for any vow; because even both are an abomination to the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: You shall not lend at interest to your brother, interest of silver and interest of food and interest of anything that you lend.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not lend to thy brother on usury of silver, or usury of meat, or usury of any thing which thou mayest lend out.

fresh_translation: To the foreigner you shall lend at interest, but to your brother you shall not lend at interest, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all your works on the land into which you are entering there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: Thou mayest lend on usury to a stranger, but to thy brother thou shalt not lend on usury; that the Lord thy God may bless thee in all thy works upon the land, into which thou art entering to inherit it.

fresh_translation: And if you vow a vow to the Lord your God, you shall not delay paying it, because in requiring the Lord your God will require it from you, and there will be sin in you.
brenton_translation: And if thou wilt vow a vow to the Lord thy God, thou shalt not delay to pay it; for the Lord thy God will surely require it of thee, and otherwise it shall be sin in thee.

fresh_translation: And if you do not wish to vow, there is no sin in you.
brenton_translation: But if thou shouldest be unwilling to vow, it is not sin in thee.

fresh_translation: What goes out through your lips you shall keep and do, in the way you vowed to the Lord your God, the gift that you spoke with your mouth.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt observe the words that proceed from between thy lips; and as thou hast vowed a gift to the Lord God, so shalt thou do that which thou hast spoken with thy mouth.

fresh_translation: And if you enter into your neighbor's standing grain, then you may gather ears with your hands, but you shall certainly not put a sickle to your neighbor's standing grain.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest go into the corn field of thy neighbour, then thou mayest gather the ears with thy hands; but thou shalt not put the sickle to thy neighbour's corn.

fresh_translation: And if you enter into your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat grapes as much as your soul desires to be filled, but you shall not put any into a vessel.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest go into the vineyard of thy neighbour, thou shalt eat grapes sufficient to satisfy thy desire; but thou mayest not put them into a vessel.

fresh_translation: And if a man takes a wife and lives with her, and it happens that she does not find favor before him because he found in her a shameful matter, then he shall write for her a document of divorce and give it into her hands and send her out from his house.
brenton_translation: And if any one should take a wife, and should dwell with her, then it shall come to pass if she should not have found favour before him, because he has found some unbecoming thing in her, that he shall write for her a bill of divorcement, and give it into her hands, and he shall send her away out of his house.

fresh_translation: And after going out she becomes another man's wife,
brenton_translation: And if she should go away and be married to another man;

fresh_translation: and the later man hates her and writes for her a document of divorce and gives it into her hands and sends her out from his house, or the later man dies who took her to himself as a wife,
brenton_translation: and the last husband should hate her, and write for her a bill of divorcement; and should give it into her hands, and send her away out of his house, and the last husband should die, who took her to himself for a wife;

fresh_translation: then the former man who sent her away shall not be able, after turning back, to take her to himself as a wife after she has been defiled, because it is an abomination before the Lord your God, and you shall not defile the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: the former husband who sent her away shall not be able to return and take her to himself for a wife, after she has been defiled; because it is an abomination before the Lord thy God, and ye shall not defile the land, which the Lord thy God gives thee to inherit.

fresh_translation: And if a man has recently taken a wife, he shall not go out to war, and no matter shall be laid upon him. He shall be innocent in his house one year, and he shall cheer his wife whom he took.
brenton_translation: And if any one should have recently taken a wife, he shall not go out to war, neither shall any thing be laid upon him; he shall be free in his house; for one year he shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.

fresh_translation: You shall not take a mill or upper millstone as a pledge, because this one takes life as a pledge.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not take for a pledge the under millstone, nor the upper millstone; for he who does so takes life for a pledge.

fresh_translation: And if a man is caught stealing a life from his brothers, from the sons of Israel, and after oppressing him he sells him, that thief shall die, and you shall destroy the evil one from among you.
brenton_translation: And if a man should be caught stealing one of his brethren of the children of Israel, and having overcome him he should sell him, that thief shall die; so shalt thou remove that evil one from yourselves.

fresh_translation: Watch yourself in the matter of leprosy, to keep very carefully to do according to all the law that the Levitical priests report to you. In the way I commanded you, keep to do.
brenton_translation: Take heed to thyself in regard of the plague of leprosy: thou shalt take great heed to do according to all the law, which the priests the Levites shall report to you; take heed to do, as I have charged you.

fresh_translation: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam on the road when you came out from Egypt.
brenton_translation: Remember all that the Lord thy God did to Mariam in the way, when ye were going out of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And if some debt is in your neighbor, any debt whatever, you shall not enter into his house to take the pledge as a pledge.
brenton_translation: If thy neighbour owe thee a debt, any debt whatsoever, thou shalt not go into his house to take his pledge:

fresh_translation: You shall stand outside, and the man in whom your loan is shall bring the pledge out to you.
brenton_translation: thou shalt stand without, and the man who is in thy debt shall bring the pledge out to thee.

fresh_translation: And if the man is poor, you shall not sleep in his pledge.
brenton_translation: And if the man be poor, thou shalt not sleep with his pledge.

fresh_translation: Returning, you shall return his pledge around the setting of the sun, and he shall sleep in his garment and bless you, and it shall be righteousness for you before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt surely restore his pledge at sunset, and he shall sleep in his garment, and he shall bless thee; and it shall be mercy to thee before the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: You shall not do injustice to the wages of the poor and needy, whether from your brothers or from the proselytes in your cities.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not unjustly withhold the wages of the poor and needy of thy brethren, or of the strangers who are in thy cities.

fresh_translation: On the same day you shall give his wages. The sun shall not set on it, because he is poor and has his hope in it, and he shall not cry out against you to the Lord, and it will be sin in you.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt pay him his wages the same day, the sun shall not go down upon it, because he is poor and he trusts in it; and he shall cry against thee to the Lord, and it shall be sin in thee.

fresh_translation: Fathers shall not die for children, and sons shall not die for fathers. Each one shall die in his own sin.
brenton_translation: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, and the sons shall not be put to death for the fathers; every one shall be put to death for his own sin.

fresh_translation: You shall not turn aside the judgment of a proselyte and orphan and widow, and you shall not take a widow's garment as a pledge.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of the stranger and the fatherless, and widow; thou shalt not take the widow's garment for a pledge.

fresh_translation: And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you from there. Because of this I command you to do this word.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the Lord thy God redeemed thee from thence; therefore I charge thee to do this thing.

fresh_translation: And if you reap a harvest in your field and forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not turn back to take it. It shall be for the poor and the proselyte and the orphan and the widow, so that the Lord your God may bless you in all the works of your hands.
brenton_translation: And when thou shalt have reaped corn in thy field, and shalt have forgotten a sheaf in thy field, thou shalt not return to take it; it shall be for the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow, that the Lord thy God may bless thee in all the works of thy hands.

fresh_translation: And if you gather your olives, you shall not go back to gather what is behind you. It shall be for the proselyte and the orphan and the widow. And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt. Because of this I command you to do this word.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest gather thine olives, thou shalt not return to collect the remainder; it shall be for the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, and thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt; therefore I command thee to do this thing.

fresh_translation: And if you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean what is behind you. It shall be for the proselyte and the orphan and the widow.
brenton_translation: And whensoever thou shalt gather the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean what thou hast left; it shall be for the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow:

fresh_translation: And you shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt. Because of this I command you to do this word.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt; therefore I command thee to do this thing.

fresh_translation: And if there is a dispute between men and they come to judgment and they judge and justify the righteous and condemn the ungodly,
brenton_translation: And if there should be a dispute between men, and they should come forward to judgment, and the judges judge, and justify the righteous, and condemn the wicked:

fresh_translation: then it shall be, if the ungodly one is worthy of blows, you shall make him sit before the judges, and they shall whip him before them according to his ungodliness, by number.
brenton_translation: then it shall come to pass, if the unrighteous should be worthy of stripes, thou shalt lay him down before the judges, and they shall scourge him before them according to his iniquity.

fresh_translation: Forty they shall whip him. They shall not add more. But if they add to whip him beyond these blows, more blows, then your brother will be disgraced before you.
brenton_translation: And they shall scourge him with forty stripes in number, they shall not inflict more; for if thou shouldest scourge him with more stripes beyond these stripes, thy brother will be disgraced before thee.

fresh_translation: You shall not muzzle an ox threshing.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treads out the corn.

fresh_translation: And if brothers dwell together and one of them dies and has no seed, the wife of the dead one shall not be outside to a man not near. The brother of her husband shall go in to her and take her to himself as a wife and dwell with her.
brenton_translation: And if brethren should live together, and one of them should die, and should not have seed, the wife of the deceased shall not marry out of the family to a man not related: her husband's brother shall go in to her, and shall take her to himself for a wife, and shall dwell with her.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, the child whom she bears shall be established in the name of the one who died, and his name shall not be blotted out from Israel.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass that the child which she shall bear, shall be named by the name of the deceased, and his name shall not be blotted out of Israel.

fresh_translation: And if the man does not wish to take his brother's wife, then the woman shall go up to the gate, to the elders, and say, My husband's brother does not wish to raise up his brother's name in Israel. My husband's brother did not want to take me.
brenton_translation: And if the man should not be willing to take his brother's wife, then shall the woman go up to the gate to the elders, and she shall say, My husband's brother will not raise up the name of his brother in Israel, my husband's brother has refused.

fresh_translation: And the elders of his city shall call him and speak to him, and if he stands and says, I do not wish to take her,
brenton_translation: And the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him; and if he stand and say, I will not take her:

fresh_translation: then the wife of his brother, coming near before the elders, shall remove his sandal, the one on his foot, and spit into his face, and answering she shall say, Thus they shall do to the man who will not build up his brother's house.
brenton_translation: then his brother's wife shall come forward before the elders, and shall loose one shoe from off his foot, and shall spit in his face, and shall answer and say, Thus shall they do to the man who will not build his brother's house in Israel.

fresh_translation: And his name shall be called in Israel, House of the one whose sandal was removed.
brenton_translation: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him that has had his shoe loosed.

fresh_translation: And if men fight together, a man with his brother, and the wife of one comes near to rescue her husband from the hand of the one striking him, and, stretching out her hand, seizes his testicles,
brenton_translation: And if men should strive together, a man with his brother, and the wife of one of them should advance to rescue her husband out of the hand of him that smites him, and she should stretch forth her hand, and take hold of his private parts;

fresh_translation: you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall not spare her.
brenton_translation: thou shalt cut off her hand; thine eye shall not spare her.

fresh_translation: There shall not be in your purse a weight and a weight, great or small.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.

fresh_translation: There shall not be in your house a measure and a measure, great or small.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures, a great and a small.

fresh_translation: A true and righteous weight shall be for you, and a true and righteous measure shall be for you, so that you may be long-lived on the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt have a true and just weight, and a true and just measure, that thou mayest live long upon the land which the Lord thy God gives thee for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: Because everyone doing these things, everyone doing injustice, is an abomination to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: For every one that does this is an abomination to the Lord thy God, even every one that does injustice.

fresh_translation: Remember what Amalek did to you on the road when you came out from Egypt,
brenton_translation: Remember what things Amalec did to thee by the way, when thou wentest forth out of the land of Egypt:

fresh_translation: how he opposed you on the road and cut down your stragglers, those laboring behind you, while you were hungry and weary, and he did not fear God.
brenton_translation: how he withstood thee in the way, and harassed thy rear, even those that were weary behind thee, and thou didst hunger and wast weary; and he did not fear God.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when the Lord your God gives you rest from all your enemies around you in the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance to inherit, you shall wipe out the name of Amalek from under heaven. You shall certainly not forget.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass whenever the Lord thy God shall have given thee rest from all thine enemies round about thee, in the land which the Lord thy God gives thee to inherit, thou shalt blot out the name of Amalec from under heaven, and shalt not forget to do it.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, if you enter into the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance and inherit it and dwell on it,
brenton_translation: And it shall be when thou shalt have entered into the land, which the Lord thy God gives thee to inherit it, and thou shalt have inherited it, and thou shalt have dwelt upon it,

fresh_translation: then you shall take from the firstfruits of the fruits of your land that the Lord your God gives you and put them into a basket and go to the place that the Lord your God chooses for his name to be called there.
brenton_translation: that thou shalt take of the first of the fruits of thy land, which the Lord thy God gives thee, and thou shalt put them into a basket, and thou shalt go to the place which the Lord thy God shall choose to have his name called there.

fresh_translation: And you shall come to the priest who may be in those days and say to him, I declare today to the Lord my God that I have entered into the land that the Lord swore to our fathers to give us.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt come to the priest who shall be in those days, and thou shalt say to him, I testify this day to the Lord my God, that I am come into the land which the Lord sware to our fathers to give to us.

fresh_translation: And the priest shall take the basket from your hands and set it before the altar of the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hands, and shall set it before the altar of the Lord thy God:

fresh_translation: And answering you shall say before the Lord your God, My father abandoned Syria and went down into Egypt and lived there as a stranger, few in number, and there he became a nation great and many and large.
brenton_translation: and he shall answer and say before the Lord thy God, My father abandoned Syria, and went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with a small number, and became there a mighty nation and a great multitude.

fresh_translation: And the Egyptians afflicted us and humbled us and laid hard works on us.
brenton_translation: And the Egyptians afflicted us, and humbled us, and imposed hard tasks on us:

fresh_translation: And we cried out to the Lord, the God of our fathers, and the Lord heard our voice and saw our humiliation and our labor and our affliction.
brenton_translation: and we cried to the Lord our God, and the Lord heard our voice, and saw our humiliation, and our labour, and our affliction.

fresh_translation: And the Lord brought us out from Egypt, he himself, with great strength and with mighty hand and with his high arm and with great visions and with signs and wonders.
brenton_translation: And the Lord brought us out of Egypt himself with his great strength, and his mighty hand, and his high arm, and with great visions, and with signs, and with wonders.

fresh_translation: And he brought us into this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
brenton_translation: And he brought us into this place, and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

fresh_translation: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the produce of the land that you gave me, Lord, a land flowing with milk and honey. And you shall leave them there before the Lord your God and worship there before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruits of the land, which thou gavest me, O Lord, a land flowing with milk and honey: and thou shalt leave it before the Lord thy God, and thou shalt worship before the Lord thy God;

fresh_translation: And you shall rejoice in all the good things that the Lord your God gave you and your house, you and the Levite and the proselyte in you.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt rejoice in all the good things, which the Lord thy God has given thee, thou and thy family, and the Levite, and the stranger that is within thee.

fresh_translation: And if you finish tithing all the tithe of your produce in the third year, the second tithe, you shall give it to the Levite and the proselyte and the orphan and the widow, and they shall eat in your cities and be filled.
brenton_translation: And when thou shalt have completed all the tithings of thy fruits in the third year, thou shalt give the second tenth to the Levite, and stranger, and fatherless, and widow; and they shall eat it in thy cities, and be merry.

fresh_translation: And you shall say before the Lord your God, I have cleansed the holy things out of my house, and I have given them to the Levite and the proselyte and the orphan and the widow, according to all the commands that you commanded me. I did not transgress your command and I did not forget.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say before the Lord thy God, I have fully collected the holy things out of my house, and I have given them to the Levite, and the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow, according to all the commands which thou didst command me: I did not transgress thy command, and I did not forget it.

fresh_translation: And I did not eat from them in my grief, nor did I take from them for uncleanness, nor did I give from them to the dead. I obeyed the voice of the Lord my God. I did as you commanded me.
brenton_translation: And in my distress I did not eat of them, I have not gathered of them for an unclean purpose, I have not given of them to the dead; I have hearkened to the voice of the Lord our God, I have done as thou hast commanded me.

fresh_translation: Look down from your holy house, from heaven, and bless your people Israel and the land that you gave them, just as you swore to our fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
brenton_translation: Look down from thy holy house, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given them, as thou didst swear to our fathers, to give to us a land flowing with milk and honey.

fresh_translation: On this day the Lord your God commanded you to do all these ordinances and judgments, and you shall keep and do them from your whole heart and from your whole soul.
brenton_translation: On this day the Lord thy God charged thee to keep all the ordinances and judgments; and ye shall observe and do them, with all your heart, and with all your soul.

fresh_translation: You chose God today to be your God and to walk in his ways and keep his ordinances and his judgments and obey his voice,
brenton_translation: Thou hast chosen God this day to be thy God, and to walk in all his ways, and to observe his ordinances and judgments, and to hearken to his voice.

fresh_translation: and the Lord chose you today to become for him a people of special possession, just as he said to you, to keep all his commands,
brenton_translation: And the Lord has chosen thee this day that thou shouldest be to him a peculiar people, as he said, to keep his commands;

fresh_translation: and for you to be above all the nations, as he made you, named and boasting and glorious, for you to be a holy people to the Lord your God, just as he spoke.
brenton_translation: and that thou shouldest be above all nations, as he has made thee renowned, and a boast, and glorious, that thou shouldest be a holy people to the Lord thy God, as he has spoken.

fresh_translation: And Moses and the elders of Israel commanded, saying, Keep all these commands that I command you today.
brenton_translation: And Moses and the elders of Israel commanded, saying, Keep all these commands, all that I command you this day.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the Lord your God gives you, you shall set up for yourself great stones and whitewash them with lime,
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in the day when ye shall cross over Jordan into the land which the Lord thy God gives thee, that thou shalt set up for thyself great stones, and shalt plaster them with plaster.

fresh_translation: and write on the stones all the words of this law as you cross the Jordan, when you enter into the land that the Lord God of your fathers gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, in the way the Lord God of your fathers spoke to you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt write on these stones all the words of this law, as soon as ye have crossed Jordan, when ye are entered into the land, which the Lord God of thy fathers gives thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, according as the Lord God of thy fathers said to thee.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when you cross the Jordan, you shall set up these stones that I command you today on Mount Ebal, and you shall whitewash them with lime.
brenton_translation: And it shall be as soon as ye are gone over Jordan, ye shall set up these stones, which I command thee this day, on mount Gæbal, and thou shalt plaster them with plaster.

fresh_translation: And you shall build there an altar to the Lord your God, an altar of stones. You shall not put iron on them.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt build there an altar to the Lord thy God, an altar of stones; thou shalt not lift up iron upon it.

fresh_translation: With whole stones you shall build the altar to the Lord your God, and you shall offer whole burnt offerings on it to the Lord your God,
brenton_translation: Of whole stones shalt thou build an altar to the Lord thy God, and thou shalt offer upon it whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: and you shall sacrifice there a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord your God, and you shall eat and be filled and rejoice before the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt there offer a peace-offering; and thou shalt eat and be filled, and rejoice before the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And you shall write on the stones all this law very clearly.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt write upon the stones all this law very plainly.

fresh_translation: And Moses and the priests, the Levites, spoke to all Israel, saying, Keep silence and hear, Israel. On this day you have become a people to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And Moses and the priests the Levites spoke to all Israel, saying, Be silent and hear, O Israel; this day thou art become a people to the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And you shall listen to the voice of the Lord your God and do all his commands and his ordinances that I command you today.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and shalt do all his commands, and his ordinances, as many as I command thee this day.

fresh_translation: And Moses commanded the people on that day, saying,
brenton_translation: And Moses charged the people on that day, saying,

fresh_translation: These shall stand to bless the people on Mount Gerizim after you cross the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
brenton_translation: These shall stand to bless the people on mount Garizin having gone over Jordan; Symeon, Levi, Judas, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And these shall stand for the curse on Mount Ebal: Reuben, Gad, and Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
brenton_translation: And these shall stand for cursing on mount Gæbal; Ruben, Gad, and Aser, Zabulon, Dan, and Nephthali.

fresh_translation: And answering, the Levites shall say to all Israel with a loud voice,
brenton_translation: And the Levites shall answer and say to all Israel with a loud voice,

fresh_translation: Cursed is the man who makes a carved or molten image, an abomination to the Lord, work of a craftsman's hands, and places it in hiding. And all the people, answering, shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is the man whosoever shall make a graven or molten image, an abomination to the Lord, the work of the hands of craftsmen, and shall put it in a secret place: and all the people shall answer and say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is the one dishonoring his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is the man that dishonours his father or his mother: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is the one moving his neighbor's boundaries. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is he that removes his neighbour's landmarks: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is the one leading the blind astray on the road. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is he that makes the blind to wander in the way: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is whoever turns aside the judgment of the proselyte and the orphan and the widow. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is every one that shall pervert the judgment of the stranger, and orphan, and widow: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is the one lying with his father's wife, because he uncovered his father's covering. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is he that lies with his father's wife, because he has uncovered his father's skirt: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is the one lying with any beast. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is he that lies with any beast: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is the one lying with his sister from his father or from his mother. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is he that lies with his sister by his father or his mother: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is the one lying with his mother-in-law. And all the people shall say, Let it be. Cursed is the one lying with his wife's sister. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is he that lies with his daughter-in-law: and all the people shall say, So be it. Cursed is he that lies with his wife's sister: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is the one striking his neighbor deceitfully. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is he that smites his neighbour secretly: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is whoever takes gifts to strike the life of innocent blood. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is he whosoever shall have taken a bribe to slay an innocent man: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: Cursed is every man who does not remain in all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Let it be.
brenton_translation: Cursed is every man that continues not in all the words of this law to do them: and all the people shall say, So be it.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when you cross the Jordan into the land that the Lord your God gives you, if indeed you listen to the voice of the Lord your God, keeping and doing all his commands that I command you today, then the Lord your God will set you above all the nations of the earth.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, if thou wilt indeed hear the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and do all these commands, which I charge thee this day, that the Lord thy God shall set thee on high above all the nations of the earth;

fresh_translation: And all these blessings shall come upon you and find you, if indeed you hear the voice of the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: and all these blessings shall come upon thee, and shall find thee. If thou wilt indeed hear the voice of the Lord thy God,

fresh_translation: Blessed are you in the city, and blessed are you in the field.
brenton_translation: blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.

fresh_translation: Blessed are the offspring of your womb and the produce of your land, the herds of your cattle and the flocks of your sheep.
brenton_translation: Blessed shall be the offspring of thy body, and the fruits of thy land, and the herds of thy oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep.

fresh_translation: Blessed are your storehouses and your reserves.
brenton_translation: Blessed shall be thy barns, and thy stores.

fresh_translation: Blessed are you in your coming in, and blessed are you in your going out.
brenton_translation: Blessed shalt thou be in thy coming in, and blessed shalt thou be in thy going out.

fresh_translation: The Lord your God will give your enemies who rise against you broken before your face. By one way they shall come out against you, and by seven ways they shall flee from before your face.
brenton_translation: The Lord deliver thine enemies that withstand thee utterly broken before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and they shall flee seven ways from before thee.

fresh_translation: May the Lord send upon you blessing in your storehouses and in everything to which you put your hand, on the land that the Lord your God gives you.
brenton_translation: The Lord send upon thee his blessing in thy barns, and on all on which thou shalt put thine hand, in the land which the Lord thy God gives thee.

fresh_translation: May the Lord raise you up for himself as a holy people, in the way he swore to your fathers, if you listen to the voice of the Lord your God and walk in his ways.
brenton_translation: The Lord raise thee up for himself a holy people, as he sware to thy fathers; if thou wilt hear the voice of the Lord thy God, and walk in all his ways.

fresh_translation: And all the nations of the earth shall see that the name of the Lord has been called upon you, and they shall fear you.
brenton_translation: And all the nations of the earth shall see thee, that the name of the Lord is called upon thee, and they shall stand in awe of thee.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God will multiply you for good, in the offspring of your womb and in the produce of your land and in the offspring of your cattle, on the land that the Lord swore to your fathers to give you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord thy God shall multiply thee for good in the offspring of thy body, and in the offspring of thy cattle, and in the fruits of thy land, on thy land which the Lord sware to thy fathers to give to thee.

fresh_translation: May the Lord open for you his good treasury, the heaven, to give rain to your land in its season and bless all the works of your hands. And you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow, and you shall rule many nations, but they shall not rule you.
brenton_translation: May the Lord open to thee his good treasure, the heaven, to give rain to thy land in season: may he bless all the works of thy hands: so shalt thou lend to many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt rule over many nations, but they shall not rule over thee.

fresh_translation: May the Lord your God set you as head and not as tail, and you shall then be above and not below, if you hear the commands of the Lord your God that I command you today, to keep and do,
brenton_translation: The Lord thy God make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt then be above and thou shalt not be below, if thou wilt hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, in all things that I charge thee this day to observe.

fresh_translation: and do not transgress any of the words that I command you today, right or left, going after other gods to serve them.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not turn aside from any of the commandments, which I charge thee this day, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, if you do not listen to the voice of the Lord your God, keeping and doing all his commands that I command you today, then all these curses shall come upon you and overtake you.
brenton_translation: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe all his commandments, as many as I charge thee this day, then all these curses shall come on thee, and overtake thee.

fresh_translation: Cursed are you in the city, and cursed are you in the field.
brenton_translation: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.

fresh_translation: Cursed are your storehouses and your reserves.
brenton_translation: Cursed shall be thy barns and thy stores.

fresh_translation: Cursed are the offspring of your womb and the produce of your land, the herds of your cattle and the flocks of your sheep.
brenton_translation: Cursed shall be the offspring of thy body, and the fruits of thy land, the herds of thine oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep.

fresh_translation: Cursed are you in your going out, and cursed are you in your coming in.
brenton_translation: Cursed shalt thou be in thy coming in, and cursed shalt thou be in thy going out.

fresh_translation: May the Lord send to you want and withering and consumption in everything to which you put your hand, whatever you may do, until he utterly destroys you and until he quickly perishes you, because of your evil practices, because you abandoned me.
brenton_translation: The Lord send upon thee want, and famine, and consumption on all things on which thou shalt put thy hand, until he shall have utterly destroyed thee, and until he shall have consumed thee quickly because of thine evil devices, because thou hast forsaken me.

fresh_translation: May the Lord make death cling to you until it consumes you from the land into which you are entering there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: The Lord cause the pestilence to cleave to thee, until he shall have consumed thee off the land into which thou goest to inherit it.

fresh_translation: May the Lord strike you with distress and fever and chill and irritation and killing and blight and mildew, and they shall pursue you until they destroy you.
brenton_translation: The Lord smite thee with distress, and fever, and cold, and inflammation, and blighting, and paleness, and they shall pursue thee until they have destroyed thee.

fresh_translation: And the heaven over your head shall be bronze for you, and the earth under you iron.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt have over thine head a sky of brass, and the earth under thee shall be iron.

fresh_translation: May the Lord give the rain to your land as dust and dirt. From heaven it shall come down upon you until it grinds you away and until it destroys you.
brenton_translation: The Lord thy God make the rain of thy land dust; and dust shall come down from heaven, until it shall have destroyed thee, and until it shall have quickly consumed thee.

fresh_translation: May the Lord give you defeat before your enemies. By one way you shall go out against them, and by seven ways you shall flee from before them, and you shall be a dispersion in all the kingdoms of the earth.
brenton_translation: The Lord give thee up for slaughter before thine enemies: thou shalt go out against them one way, and flee from their face seven ways; and thou shalt be a dispersion in all the kingdoms of the earth.

fresh_translation: And your dead shall be food for the birds of heaven and for the beasts of the earth, and there shall be no one to frighten them away.
brenton_translation: And your dead men shall be food to the birds of the sky, and to the beasts of the earth; and there shall be none to scare them away.

fresh_translation: May the Lord strike you with the Egyptian boil on the buttocks, and with wild itch and scab, so that you cannot be healed.
brenton_translation: The Lord smite thee with the botch of Egypt in the seat, and with a malignant scab, and itch, so that thou canst not be healed.

fresh_translation: May the Lord strike you with madness and blindness and astonishment of mind,
brenton_translation: The Lord smite thee with insanity, and blindness, and astonishment of mind.

fresh_translation: and you shall be groping at midday as the blind gropes in darkness, and your ways shall not prosper, and you shall then be wronged and plundered all the days, and there shall not be one helping you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt grope at mid-day, as a blind man would grope in the darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways; and then thou shalt be unjustly treated, and plundered continually, and there shall be no helper.

fresh_translation: You shall take a wife, and another man shall have her. You shall build a house, and you shall not dwell in it. You shall plant a vineyard, and you shall not harvest it.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt take a wife, and another man shall have her; thou shalt build a house, and thou shalt not dwell in it; thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes of it.

fresh_translation: Your calf slaughtered before you, and you shall not eat from it; your donkey snatched from you, and it shall not be returned to you; your sheep given to your enemies, and there shall not be one helping you.
brenton_translation: Thy calf shall be slain before thee, and thou shalt not eat of it; thine ass shall be violently taken away from thee, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given to thine enemies, and thou shalt have no helper.

fresh_translation: Your sons and your daughters given to another nation, and your eyes shall look, failing for them, and your hand shall have no strength.
brenton_translation: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given to another nation, and thine eyes wasting away shall look for them: thine hand shall have no strength.

fresh_translation: A nation that you do not know shall eat the produce of your land and all your labors, and you shall be wronged and broken all the days,
brenton_translation: A nation which thou knowest not shall eat the produce of thy land, and all thy labours; and thou shalt be injured and crushed always.

fresh_translation: and you shall be maddened by the sights of your eyes that you see.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt be distracted, because of the sights of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

fresh_translation: May the Lord strike you with an evil boil on the knees and on the shins, so that you cannot be healed from the sole of your foot to your crown.
brenton_translation: The Lord smite thee with an evil sore, on the knees and the legs, so that thou shalt not be able to be healed from the sole of thy foot to the crown of thy head.

fresh_translation: May the Lord lead you and your rulers whom you set over yourself away to a nation that you and your fathers do not know, and you shall serve there other gods, wood and stones.
brenton_translation: The Lord carry away thee and thy princes, whom thou shalt set over thee, to a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers know; and thou shalt there serve other gods, wood and stone.

fresh_translation: And you shall be there as a riddle and a parable and a tale among all the nations into which the Lord leads you there.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt be there for a wonder, and a parable, and a tale, among all the nations, to which the Lord thy God shall carry thee away.

fresh_translation: You shall carry much seed out into the field and bring in little, because the locust shall eat it.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt carry forth much seed into the field, and thou shalt bring in little, because the locust shall devour it.

fresh_translation: You shall plant and work vineyards, but you shall not drink wine nor rejoice from it, because the worm shall consume them.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt plant a vineyard, and dress it, and shalt not drink the wine, neither shalt thou delight thyself with it, because the worm shall devour it.

fresh_translation: You shall have olive trees in all your borders, but you shall not anoint with oil, because your olive tree shall drop its fruit.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt have olive trees in all thy borders, and thou shalt not anoint thee with oil, because thine olive shall utterly cast its fruit.

fresh_translation: You shall beget sons and daughters, and they shall not be yours, because they shall go away into captivity.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, and they shall not be thine, for they shall depart into captivity.

fresh_translation: Blight shall consume all your trees and the produce of your land.
brenton_translation: All thy trees and the fruits of thy land shall the blight consume.

fresh_translation: The proselyte who is in you shall go up over you higher and higher, but you shall go down lower and lower.
brenton_translation: The stranger that is within thee shall get up very high, and thou shalt come down very low.

fresh_translation: He shall lend to you, but you shall not lend to him. He shall be head, but you shall be tail.
brenton_translation: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.

fresh_translation: And all these curses shall come upon you and pursue you and overtake you until they utterly destroy you and until they perish you, because you did not listen to the voice of the Lord your God, to keep his commands and his ordinances that he commanded you.
brenton_translation: And all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and shall overtake thee, until he shall have consumed thee, and until he shall have destroyed thee; because thou didst not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commands, and his ordinances which he has commanded thee.

fresh_translation: And they shall be in you as signs and wonders and in your seed forever,
brenton_translation: And these things shall be signs in thee, and wonders among thy seed for ever;

fresh_translation: because you did not serve the Lord your God with gladness and good heart, because of the abundance of everything.
brenton_translation: because thou didst not serve the Lord thy God with gladness and a good heart, because of the abundance of all things.

fresh_translation: And you shall serve your enemies whom the Lord will send upon you, in hunger and in thirst and in nakedness and in lack of everything, and he shall put an iron collar on your neck until he utterly destroys you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt serve thine enemies, which the Lord will send forth against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in the want of all things; and thou shalt wear upon thy neck a yoke of iron until he shall have destroyed thee.

fresh_translation: The Lord will bring upon you a nation from far away, from the end of the earth, like the rush of an eagle, a nation whose voice you do not understand,
brenton_translation: The Lord shall bring upon thee a nation from the extremity of the earth, like the swift flying of an eagle, a nation whose voice thou shalt not understand;

fresh_translation: a nation shameless in face, which shall not marvel at the face of an elder, and the young it shall not pity,
brenton_translation: a nation bold in countenance, which shall not respect the person of the aged and shall not pity the young.

fresh_translation: and it shall eat the offspring of your cattle and the produce of your land, so as not to leave for you grain, wine, oil, the herds of your cattle and the flocks of your sheep, until it destroys you.
brenton_translation: And it shall eat up the young of thy cattle, and the fruits of thy land, so as not to leave to thee corn, wine, oil, the herds of thine oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep, until it shall have destroyed thee;

fresh_translation: And it shall grind you down in all your cities until your high and fortified walls are torn down, those in which you have trusted, in all your land, and it shall afflict you in all your cities that the Lord your God gave you.
brenton_translation: and have utterly crushed thee in thy cities, until the high and strong walls be destroyed, in which thou trustest, in all thy land; and it shall afflict thee in thy cities, which he has given to thee.

fresh_translation: And you shall eat the offspring of your womb, the flesh of your sons and your daughters that the Lord your God gave you, in your distress and in the affliction with which your enemy afflicts you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thy body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, all that he has given thee, in thy straitness and thy affliction, with which thine enemy shall afflict thee.

fresh_translation: The delicate one in you and the very tender shall begrudge with his eye his brother and the wife in his bosom and the children left over whom he leaves,
brenton_translation: He that is tender and very delicate within thee shall look with an evil eye upon his brother, and the wife in his bosom, and the children that are left, which may have been left to him;

fresh_translation: so as to give to one of them from the flesh of his children whom he ate, because nothing was left to him in your distress and in the affliction with which your enemies afflicted you in all your cities.
brenton_translation: so as not to give to one of them of the flesh of his children, whom he shall eat, because of his having nothing left him in thy straitness, and in thy affliction, with which thine enemies shall afflict thee in all thy cities.

fresh_translation: And the delicate woman among you and the very tender, whose foot never tried to step on the ground because of delicacy and tenderness, shall begrudge with her eye her husband in her bosom and her son and her daughter,
brenton_translation: And she that is tender and delicate among you, whose foot has not assayed to go upon the earth for delicacy and tenderness, shall look with an evil eye on her husband in her bosom, and her son and her daughter,

fresh_translation: and her afterbirth that came out through her thighs and the child that she bears, for she shall eat them because of the lack of everything, secretly, in your distress and in the affliction with which your enemy afflicts you in all your cities.
brenton_translation: and her offspring that comes out between her feet, and the child which she shall bear; for she shall eat them because of the want of all things, secretly in thy straitness, and in thy affliction, with which thine enemy shall afflict thee in thy cities.

fresh_translation: If you do not listen so as to do all the words of this law written in this book, to fear this honored and wondrous name, the Lord your God,
brenton_translation: If thou wilt not hearken to do all the words of this law, which have been written in this book, to fear this glorious and wonderful name, the Lord thy God;

fresh_translation: then the Lord will make your blows and the blows of your seed extraordinary, great and wondrous blows, and evil and lasting diseases.
brenton_translation: then the Lord shall magnify thy plagues, and the plagues of thy seed, great and wonderful plagues, and evil and abiding diseases.

fresh_translation: And he will turn back upon you every evil pain of Egypt that you feared before them, and they shall cling in you.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring upon thee all the evil pain of Egypt, of which thou wast afraid, and they shall cleave to thee.

fresh_translation: And every sickness and every blow not written in the book of this law, the Lord will bring upon you until he utterly destroys you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall bring upon thee every sickness, and every plague that is not written, and every one that is written in the book of this law, until he shall have destroyed thee.

fresh_translation: And you shall be left few in number, although you were like the stars of heaven in multitude, because you did not listen to the voice of the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of the sky in multitude; because thou didst not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, in the way the Lord rejoiced over you to do good to you and multiply you, so the Lord will rejoice over you to utterly destroy you, and you shall be plucked from the land into which you are entering there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass that as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you; and ye shall be quickly removed from the land, into which ye go to inherit it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God will scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth, and there you shall serve other gods, wood and stones, that neither you nor your fathers trusted.
brenton_translation: And the Lord thy God shall scatter thee among all nations, from one end of the earth to the other; and thou shalt there serve other gods, wood and stone, which thou hast not known, nor thy fathers.

fresh_translation: But even among those nations he will not give you rest, nor shall there be standing for the sole of your foot, and the Lord will give you there a despairing heart and failing eyes and a melting soul.
brenton_translation: Moreover among those nations he will not give thee quiet, neither by any means shall the sole of thy foot have rest; and the Lord shall give thee there another and a misgiving heart, and failing eyes, and a wasting soul.

fresh_translation: And your life shall be hanging before your eyes, and you shall fear by day and by night, and you shall not trust your life.
brenton_translation: And thy life shall be in suspense before thine eyes; and thou shalt be afraid by day and by night, and thou shalt have no assurance of thy life.

fresh_translation: In the morning you shall say, How might evening come? And in the evening you shall say, How might morning come? from the fear of your heart that you fear and from the sights of your eyes that you see.
brenton_translation: In the morning thou shalt say, Would it were evening! and in the evening thou shalt say, Would it were morning! for the fear of thine heart with which thou shalt fear, and for the sights of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will bring you back to Egypt in ships and on the road about which I said, You shall not add to see it again. And there you shall be sold to your enemies as male servants and female servants, and there shall not be one buying.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall bring thee back to Egypt in ships, by the way of which I said, Thou shalt not see it again; and ye shall be sold there to your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and none shall buy you.

fresh_translation: These are the words of the covenant that the Lord commanded Moses to establish with the sons of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant that he covenanted with them in Horeb.
And Moses called all the sons of Israel and said to them, You have seen all that the Lord did in the land of Egypt before you, to Pharaoh and to his servants and to all his land,
brenton_translation: These are the words of the covenant, which the Lord commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant which he made with them in Choreb.

fresh_translation: the great trials that your eyes saw, those signs and those great wonders.
brenton_translation: And Moses called all the sons of Israel and said to them, Ye have seen all things that the Lord did in the land of Egypt before you to Pharao and his servants, and all his land;

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God did not give you a heart to know and eyes to see and ears to hear until this day.
brenton_translation: the great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great wonders.

fresh_translation: And he led you forty years in the wilderness. Your garments did not grow old, and your sandals did not wear out from your feet.
brenton_translation: Yet the Lord God has not given you a heart to know, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, until this day.

fresh_translation: Bread you did not eat, and wine and strong drink you did not drink, so that you might know that this one is the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And he led you forty years in the wilderness; your garments did not grow old, and your sandals were not worn away off your feet.

fresh_translation: And you came to this place, and Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to meet us in war, and we struck them,
brenton_translation: Ye did not eat bread, ye did not drink wine or strong drink, that ye might know that I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: and we took their land and gave it as an inheritance to Reuben and to Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh.
brenton_translation: And ye came as far as this place; and there came forth Seon king of Esebon, and Og king of Basan, to meet us in war.

fresh_translation: And keep to do all the words of this covenant, so that you may understand everything that you do.
brenton_translation: And we smote them and took their land, and I gave it for an inheritance to Ruben and Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasse.

fresh_translation: You all stand today before the Lord your God, your tribal leaders and your elders and your judges and your scribes, every man of Israel,
brenton_translation: And ye shall take heed to do all the words of this covenant, that ye may understand all things that ye shall do.

fresh_translation: your women and your children and the proselyte in the midst of your camp, from your woodcutter to your water carrier,
brenton_translation: Ye all stand to-day before the Lord your God, the heads of your tribes, and your elders, and your judges, and your officers, every man of Israel,

fresh_translation: to pass into the covenant of the Lord your God and into his curses, whatever the Lord your God covenants with you today,
brenton_translation: your wives, and your children, and the stranger who is in the midst of your camp, from your hewer of wood even to your drawer of water,

fresh_translation: so that he may establish you for himself as a people and he himself will be your God, in the way he said to you and in the way he swore to your fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob.
brenton_translation: that thou shouldest enter into the covenant of the Lord thy God and into his oaths, as many as the Lord thy God appoints thee this day;

fresh_translation: And not with you alone do I covenant this covenant and this curse,
brenton_translation: that he may appoint thee to himself for a people, and he shall be thy God, as he said to thee, and as he sware to thy fathers, Abraam, and Isaac, and Jacob.

fresh_translation: but also with those here with us today before the Lord your God and with those not here with us today,
brenton_translation: And I do not appoint to you alone this covenant and this oath;

fresh_translation: because you know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt and passed through the midst of the nations through which you passed,
brenton_translation: but to those also who are here with you to-day before the Lord your God, and to those who are not here with you to-day.

fresh_translation: and you saw their abominations and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, that are among them.
brenton_translation: For ye know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt, how we came through the midst of the nations through whom ye came.

fresh_translation: Lest there is among you a man or woman or clan or tribe whose mind has turned aside from the Lord your God to go serve the gods of those nations, lest there is among you a root springing up in gall and bitterness,
brenton_translation: And ye beheld their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which are among them.

fresh_translation: and it shall be, if he hears the words of this curse and congratulates himself in his heart, saying, Holy things shall be mine, because in the wandering of my heart I will walk, so that the sinner may not destroy the sinless,
brenton_translation: Lest there be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart has turned aside from the Lord your God, having gone to serve the gods of these nations; lest there be in you a root springing up with gall and bitterness.

fresh_translation: God will certainly not be willing to be propitiated toward him, but then the wrath of the Lord and his jealousy will burn in that man, and all the curses of this covenant written in the book of this law will cling to him, and the Lord will wipe out his name from under heaven.
brenton_translation: And it shall be if one shall hear the words of this curse, and shall flatter himself in his heart, saying, Let good happen to me, for I will walk in the error of my heart, lest the sinner destroy the guiltless with him:

fresh_translation: And the Lord will set him apart for evil from all the sons of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in the book of this law.
brenton_translation: God shall by no means be willing to pardon him, but then the wrath of the Lord and his jealousy shall flame out against that man; and all the curses of this covenant shall attach themselves to him, which are written in this book, and the Lord shall blot out his name from under heaven.

fresh_translation: And another generation will say, your sons who rise up after you, and the foreigner who may come from a far land, and they shall see the blows of that land and the diseases that the Lord sent on it,
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall separate that man for evil of all the children of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in the book of this law.

fresh_translation: sulfur and salt, burned up, all its land. It shall not be sown, nor spring up, nor shall any green thing come up on it, just as Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim were overthrown, which the Lord overthrew in wrath and anger.
brenton_translation: And another generation shall say—even your sons who shall rise up after you, and the stranger who shall come from a land afar off, and shall see the plagues of that land and their diseases, which the Lord has sent upon it,

fresh_translation: And all the nations will say, Why did the Lord do thus to this land? What is this great wrath of anger?
brenton_translation: brimstone and burning salt, (the whole land shall not be sown, neither shall any green thing spring, nor rise upon it, as Sodom and Gomorrha were overthrown, Adama and Seboim, which the Lord overthrew in his wrath and anger:)—

fresh_translation: And they will say, Because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers that he covenanted with their fathers when he brought them out from the land of Egypt,
brenton_translation: and all the nations shall say, Why has the Lord done thus to this land? what is this great fierceness of anger?

fresh_translation: and, going, they served other gods and bowed to them, whom they did not know, and he had not allotted them.
brenton_translation: And men shall say, Because they forsook the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers, the things which he appointed to their fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt:

fresh_translation: And the Lord was angered in wrath against that land, to bring upon it all the curses written in the book of this law,
brenton_translation: and they went and served other gods, which they knew not, neither did he assign them to them.

fresh_translation: and the Lord removed them from their land in wrath and anger and exceedingly great provocation and cast them into another land, as now.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was exceedingly angry with that land to bring upon it according to all the curses which are written in the book of this law.

fresh_translation: The hidden things belong to the Lord our God, but the revealed things belong to us and to our children forever, to do all the words of this law.
brenton_translation: And the Lord removed them from their land in anger, and wrath, and very great indignation, and cast them out into another land as at present.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when all these words come upon you, the blessing and the curse that I set before your face, and you receive them into your heart among all the nations where the Lord scattered you there,
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when all these things shall have come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thy face, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, wherein the Lord shall have scattered thee,

fresh_translation: and you turn back to the Lord your God and obey his voice according to everything that I command you today, from your whole heart and from your whole soul,
brenton_translation: and shalt return to the Lord thy God, and shalt hearken to his voice, according to all things which I charge thee this day, with all thy heart, and with all thy soul;

fresh_translation: then the Lord will heal your sins and have mercy on you, and again the Lord will gather you from all the nations into which the Lord scattered you there.
brenton_translation: then the Lord shall heal thine iniquities, and shall pity thee, and shall again gather thee out from all the nations, among which the Lord has scattered thee.

fresh_translation: If your dispersion is from one end of heaven to the other end of heaven, from there the Lord your God will gather you, and from there the Lord your God will take you.
brenton_translation: If thy dispersion be from one end of heaven to the other, thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and thence will the Lord thy God take thee.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God will bring you into the land that your fathers inherited, and you shall inherit it, and he will do good for you and make you more numerous than your fathers.
brenton_translation: And the Lord thy God shall bring thee in from thence into the land which thy fathers have inherited, and thou shalt inherit it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will purify your heart and the heart of your seed, to love the Lord your God from your whole heart and from your whole soul, so that you may live.
