brenton_translation: And the Lord shall purge thy heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God will put these curses on your enemies and on those hating you who persecuted you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord thy God will put these curses upon thine enemies, and upon those that hate thee, who have persecuted thee.

fresh_translation: And you shall turn back and obey the voice of the Lord your God and do his commands that I command you today.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt return and hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and shall keep his commands, all that I charge thee this day.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God will make you abound in every work of your hands, in the offspring of your womb and in the produce of your land and in the offspring of your cattle, because the Lord your God will return to rejoice over you for good, in the way he rejoiced over your fathers,
brenton_translation: And the Lord thy God shall bless thee in every work of thine hands, in the offspring of thy body, and in the offspring of thy cattle, and in the fruits of thy land, because the Lord thy God will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:

fresh_translation: if you obey the voice of the Lord your God, to keep and do all his commands and his ordinances and his judgments written in the book of this law, if you turn back to the Lord your God from your whole heart and from your whole soul.
brenton_translation: if thou wilt hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments, and his ordinances, and his judgments written in the book of this law, if thou turn to the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

fresh_translation: Because this command that I command you today is not excessively hard, nor is it far from you.
brenton_translation: For this command which I give thee this day is not grievous, neither is it far from thee.

fresh_translation: It is not in heaven above, saying, Who will go up for us into heaven and take it for us, and after hearing it we will do it?
brenton_translation: It is not in heaven above, as if there were one saying, Who shall go up for us into heaven, and shall take it for us, and we will hear and do it?

fresh_translation: Nor is it beyond the sea, saying, Who will cross over for us to the far side of the sea and take it for us and make it heard to us, and we will do it?
brenton_translation: Neither is it beyond the sea, saying, Who will go over for us to the other side of the sea, and take it for us, and make it audible to us, and we will do it?

fresh_translation: The word is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart and in your hands to do it.
brenton_translation: The word is very near thee, in thy mouth, and in thine heart, and in thine hands to do it.

fresh_translation: Behold, I have set before your face today life and death, good and evil.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have set before thee this day life and death, good and evil.

fresh_translation: If you obey the commands of the Lord your God that I command you today, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his ordinances and his judgments, then you shall live and be many, and the Lord your God will bless you in all the land into which you are entering there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: If thou wilt hearken to the commands of the Lord thy God, which I command thee this day, to love the Lord thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his ordinances, and his judgments; then ye shall live, and shall be many in number, and the Lord thy God shall bless thee in all the land into which thou goest to inherit it.

fresh_translation: And if your heart turns away and you do not listen, and being led astray you bow to other gods and serve them,
brenton_translation: But if thy heart change, and thou wilt not hearken, and thou shalt go astray and worship other gods, and serve them,

fresh_translation: I declare to you today that with destruction you shall perish, and you shall certainly not be long-lived on the land that the Lord your God gives you, into which you are crossing the Jordan there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: I declare to you this day, that ye shall utterly perish, and ye shall by no means live long upon the land, into which ye go over Jordan to inherit it.

fresh_translation: I call heaven and earth to witness to you today. I have set before your face life and death, blessing and curse. Choose life so that you and your seed may live,
brenton_translation: I call both heaven and earth to witness this day against you, I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse: choose thou life, that thou and thy seed may live;

fresh_translation: loving the Lord your God, obeying his voice, and holding fast to him, because this is your life and the length of your days, for you to dwell on the land that the Lord swore to your fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, to give to them.
brenton_translation: to love the Lord thy God, to hearken to his voice, and cleave to him; for this is thy life, and the length of thy days, that thou shouldest dwell upon the land, which the Lord sware to thy fathers, Abraam, and Isaac, and Jacob, to give to them.

fresh_translation: And Moses finished speaking all these words to all the sons of Israel,
brenton_translation: And Moses finished speaking all these words to all the children of Israel;

fresh_translation: and said to them, I am one hundred and twenty years old today. I will not be able any longer to go in and come out, and the Lord said to me, You shall not cross this Jordan.
brenton_translation: and said to them, I am this day a hundred and twenty years old; I shall not be able any longer to come in or go out; and the Lord said to me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

fresh_translation: The Lord your God, the one going before your face, he will utterly destroy these nations from before your face, and you will inherit them, and Joshua, the one going before your face, will do so, just as the Lord spoke.
brenton_translation: The Lord thy God who goes before thee, he shall destroy these nations before thee, and thou shalt inherit them: and it shall be Joshua that goes before thy face, as the Lord has spoken.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will do to them just as he did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, and to their land, in the way he utterly destroyed them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord thy God shall do to them as he did to Seon and Og the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond Jordan, and to their land, as he destroyed them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord handed them over to you, and you shall do to them just as I commanded you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord has delivered them to you; and ye shall do to them, as I charged you.

fresh_translation: Be courageous and strong. Do not fear, nor be cowardly, nor terrified before their face, because the Lord your God, the one going before with you, will certainly not leave you nor forsake you.
brenton_translation: Be courageous and strong, fear not, neither be cowardly, neither be afraid before them; for it is the Lord your God that advances with you in the midst of you, neither will he by any means forsake thee, nor desert thee.

fresh_translation: And Moses called Joshua and said to him before all Israel, Be courageous and strong, because you will enter before this people into the land that the Lord swore to our fathers to give to them, and you will distribute it to them as an inheritance.
brenton_translation: And Moses called Joshua, and said to him before all Israel, Be courageous and strong; for thou shalt go in before this people into the land which the Lord sware to your fathers to give to them, and thou shalt give it to them for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: And the Lord, the one going together with you, will not leave you nor forsake you. Do not fear, nor be cowardly.
brenton_translation: And the Lord that goes with thee shall not forsake thee nor abandon thee; fear not, neither be afraid.

fresh_translation: And Moses wrote the words of this law in a book and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, those carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and to the elders of the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Moses wrote the words of this law in a book, and gave it to the priests the sons of Levi who bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and to the elders of the sons of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Moses commanded them on that day, saying, After seven years, at the time of the year of release, at the feast of tabernacle-making,
brenton_translation: And Moses charged them in that day, saying, After seven years, in the time of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

fresh_translation: when all Israel comes to appear before the Lord your God in the place that the Lord chooses, you shall read this law before all Israel in their ears.
brenton_translation: when all Israel come together to appear before the Lord your God, in the place which the Lord shall choose, ye shall read this law before all Israel in their ears,

fresh_translation: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the children and the proselyte in your cities, so that they may hear and so that they may learn to fear the Lord your God, and they will listen so as to do all the words of this law.
brenton_translation: having assembled the people, the men, and the women, and the children, and the stranger that is in your cities, that they may hear, and that they may learn to fear the Lord your God; and they shall hearken to do all the words of this law.

fresh_translation: And their sons, who do not know, shall hear and learn to fear the Lord your God all the days that they live on the land into which you are crossing the Jordan there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: And their sons who have not known shall hear, and shall learn to fear the Lord thy God all the days that they live upon the land, into which ye go over Jordan to inherit it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Behold, the days of your death have drawn near. Call Joshua, and stand by the doors of the tent of testimony, and I will command him. And Moses and Joshua went into the tent of testimony and stood by the doors of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Behold, the days of thy death are at hand; call Joshua, and stand ye by the doors of the tabernacle of testimony, and I will give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went to the tabernacle of testimony, and stood by the doors of the tabernacle of testimony.

fresh_translation: And the Lord came down in a cloud and stood by the doors of the tent of testimony, and the pillar of cloud stood by the doors of the tent.
brenton_translation: And the Lord descended in a cloud, and stood by the doors of the tabernacle of testimony; and the pillar of the cloud stood by the doors of the tabernacle of testimony.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Behold, you sleep with your fathers, and this people, rising up, will prostitute itself after the foreign gods of the land into which it enters there, and they will abandon me and scatter my covenant that I covenanted with them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, and this people will arise and go a whoring after the strange gods of the land, into which they are entering: and they will forsake me, and break my covenant, which I made with them.

fresh_translation: And I will be angered in wrath against them in that day and abandon them and turn my face away from them, and he shall be for eating, and many evils and afflictions shall find him, and he shall say in that day, Because the Lord my God is not in me, these evils found me.
brenton_translation: And I will be very angry with them in that day, and I will leave them and turn my face away from them, and they shall be devoured; and many evils and afflictions shall come upon them; and they shall say in that day, Because the Lord my God is not with me, these evils have come upon me.

fresh_translation: And I, hiding, will hide my face from them in that day because of all the evils that they did, because they turned to foreign gods.
brenton_translation: And I will surely turn away my face from them in that day, because of all their evil doings which they have done, because they turned aside after strange gods.

fresh_translation: And now write the words of this song, and teach it to the sons of Israel and put it into their mouth, so that this song may become for me a witness among the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And now write the words of this song, and teach it to the children of Israel, and ye shall put it into their mouth, that this song may witness for me among the children of Israel to their face.

fresh_translation: For I will bring them into the good land that I swore to their fathers to give to them, a land flowing with milk and honey, and they shall eat and be filled and be satisfied, and they shall turn to foreign gods and serve them and provoke me and scatter my covenant.
brenton_translation: For I will bring them into the good land, which I sware to their fathers, to give to them a land flowing with milk and honey: and they shall eat and be filled and satisfy themselves; then will they turn aside after other gods, and serve them, and they will provoke me, and break my covenant.

fresh_translation: And this song shall stand against them as a witness. It shall certainly not be forgotten from their mouth and from the mouth of their seed, because I know their wickedness, what they do here today before I bring them into the good land that I swore to their fathers.
brenton_translation: And this song shall stand up to witness against them; for they shall not forget it out of their mouth, or out of the mouth of their seed; for I know their wickedness, what they are doing here this day, before I have brought them into the good land, which I sware to their fathers.

fresh_translation: And Moses wrote this song on that day and taught it to the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Moses wrote this song in that day, and taught it to the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Moses commanded Joshua and said to him, Be courageous and strong, because you will bring the sons of Israel into the land that the Lord swore to them, and he himself will be with you.
brenton_translation: And he charged Joshua, and said, Be courageous and strong, for thou shalt bring the sons of Israel into the land, which the Lord sware to them, and he shall be with thee.

fresh_translation: And when Moses finished writing all the words of this law into a book, until the end,
brenton_translation: And when Moses finished writing all the words of this law in a book, even to the end,

fresh_translation: then he commanded the Levites, those carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,
brenton_translation: then he charged the Levites who bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,

fresh_translation: Take the book of this law and place it at the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and it shall be there among you as a witness.
brenton_translation: Take the book of this law, and ye shall put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God; and it shall be there among you for a testimony.

fresh_translation: Because I know your provocation and your stiff neck. For while I am still living with you today, you were embittering the things toward God. How much more after my death?
brenton_translation: For I know thy provocation, and thy stiff neck; for yet during my life with you at this day, ye have been provoking in your conduct toward God: how shall ye not also be so after my death?

fresh_translation: Assemble to me your tribal leaders and your elders and your judges and your scribes, so that I may speak all these words in their ears and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
brenton_translation: Gather together to me the heads of your tribes, and your elders, and your judges, and your officers, that I may speak in their ears all these words; and I call both heaven and earth to witness against them.

fresh_translation: For I know that after the end of my life you will break the law lawlessly and turn aside from the way that I commanded you, and evils will meet you at the end of the days, because you will do evil before the Lord, provoking him in the works of your hands.
brenton_translation: For I know that after my death ye will utterly transgress, and turn aside out of the way which I have commanded you; and evils shall come upon you in the latter days, because ye will do evil before the Lord, to provoke him to anger by the works of your hands.

fresh_translation: And Moses spoke in the ears of the whole assembly of Israel the words of this song until the end.
brenton_translation: And Moses spoke all the words of this song even to the end, in the ears of the whole assembly.

fresh_translation: Pay attention, O heaven, and I will speak, and let the earth hear words from my mouth.
brenton_translation: Attend, O heaven, and I will speak; and let the earth hear the words out of my mouth.

fresh_translation: Let my utterance be awaited like rain, and let my words come down like dew, like a storm on fresh grass and like snowfall on grass.
brenton_translation: Let my speech be looked for as the rain, and my words come down as dew, as the shower upon the herbage, and as snow upon the grass.

fresh_translation: Because I called on the name of the Lord, give greatness to our God.
brenton_translation: For I have called on the name of the Lord: assign ye greatness to our God.

fresh_translation: God, his works are true, and all his ways are judgments, faithful God, and there is no injustice, righteous and holy is the Lord.
brenton_translation: As for God, his works are true, and all his ways are judgment: God is faithful, and there is no unrighteousness in him; just and holy is the Lord.

fresh_translation: They sinned, not to him; blameworthy children, a crooked and twisted generation.
brenton_translation: They have sinned, not pleasing him; spotted children, a froward and perverse generation.

fresh_translation: Do you repay the Lord like this, foolish people and not wise? Is not this one your father? He acquired you and made you and created you.
brenton_translation: Do ye thus recompense the Lord? is the people thus foolish and unwise? did not he himself thy father purchase thee, and make thee, and form thee?

fresh_translation: Remember the days of old; understand the years of generation after generation. Ask your father, and he will report to you, your elders, and they will tell you.
brenton_translation: Remember the days of old, consider the years for past ages: ask thy father, and he shall relate to thee, thine elders, and they shall tell thee.

fresh_translation: When the Most High divided nations, when he scattered sons of Adam, he set the boundaries of the nations according to the number of the angels of God.
brenton_translation: When the Most High divided the nations, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the nations according to the number of the angels of God.

fresh_translation: And the Lord's portion became his people, Jacob, the measuring line of his inheritance, Israel.
brenton_translation: And his people Jacob became the portion of the Lord, Israel was the line of his inheritance.

fresh_translation: He provided for him in a wilderness land, in thirst of heat, in a waterless place. He encircled him and disciplined him and guarded him as the pupil of an eye.
brenton_translation: He maintained him in the wilderness, in burning thirst and a dry land: he led him about and instructed him, and kept him as the apple of an eye.

fresh_translation: Like an eagle sheltering its nest and longing over its young, spreading its wings, it received them and took them up on its back.
brenton_translation: As an eagle would watch over his brood, and yearns over his young, receives them having spread his wings, and takes them up on his back:

fresh_translation: The Lord alone led them, and there was no foreign god with them.
brenton_translation: the Lord alone led them, there was no strange god with them.

fresh_translation: He brought them up on the strength of the land; he fed them with the produce of fields. They sucked honey out of a rock and oil out of solid rock,
brenton_translation: He brought them up on the strength of the land; he fed them with the fruits of the fields; they sucked honey out of the rock, and oil out of the solid rock.

fresh_translation: butter of cattle and milk of sheep, with the fat of lambs and rams, sons of bulls and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat, and they drank the blood of grapes, wine.
brenton_translation: Butter of cows, and milk of sheep, with the fat of lambs and rams, of calves and kids, with fat of kidneys of wheat; and he drank wine, the blood of the grape.

fresh_translation: And Jacob ate and was filled, and the beloved kicked. He grew fat, he became thick, he broadened out, and he abandoned God who made him and withdrew from God his savior.
brenton_translation: So Jacob ate and was filled, and the beloved one kicked; he grew fat, he became thick and broad: then he forsook the God that made him, and departed from God his Saviour.

fresh_translation: They provoked me with strange things; in their abominations they embittered me.
brenton_translation: They provoked me to anger with strange gods; with their abominations they bitterly angered me.

fresh_translation: They sacrificed to demons and not to God, to gods they did not know, new recent ones have come whom their fathers did not know.
brenton_translation: They sacrificed to devils, and not to God; to gods whom they knew not: new and fresh gods came in, whom their fathers knew not.

fresh_translation: You abandoned God who begot you, and you forgot God who nourished you.
brenton_translation: Thou hast forsaken God that begot thee, and forgotten God who feeds thee.

fresh_translation: And the Lord saw and was jealous and was provoked through the anger of his sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And the Lord saw, and was jealous; and was provoked by the anger of his sons and daughters,

fresh_translation: And he said, I will turn my face away from them and show what will be for them at the end, because it is a generation turned aside, sons in whom there is no faithfulness.
brenton_translation: and said, I will turn away my face from them, and will show what shall happen to them in the last days; for it is a perverse generation, sons in whom is no faith.

fresh_translation: They made me jealous over what is not God; they provoked me in their idols. And I will make them jealous over what is not a nation; over a nation without understanding I will provoke them.
brenton_translation: They have provoked me to jealousy with that which is not God, they have exasperated me with their idols; and I will provoke them to jealousy with them that are no nation, I will anger them with a nation void of understanding.

fresh_translation: Because a fire has been kindled from my wrath; it shall burn to Hades below, it shall consume the earth and its produce and set on fire the foundations of mountains.
brenton_translation: For a fire has been kindled out of my wrath, it shall burn to hell below; it shall devour the land, and the fruits of it; it shall set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

fresh_translation: I will gather evils upon them; I will spend my arrows on them.
brenton_translation: I will gather evils upon them, and will fight with my weapons against them.

fresh_translation: Melted with hunger and consumed by birds and incurable convulsion, I will send on them teeth of beasts with the wrath of those crawling on the ground.
brenton_translation: They shall be consumed with hunger and the devouring of birds, and there shall be irremediable destruction: I will send forth against them the teeth of wild beasts, with the rage of serpents creeping on the ground.

fresh_translation: Outside the sword shall make them childless, and from the storerooms fear, young man with virgin, suckling with gray old man.
brenton_translation: Without, the sword shall bereave them of children, and terror shall issue out of the secret chambers; the young man shall perish with the virgin, the suckling with him who has grown old.

fresh_translation: I said, I will scatter them and stop their remembrance from among men,
brenton_translation: I said, I will scatter them, and I will cause their memorial to cease from among men.

fresh_translation: if not because of the wrath of enemies, lest they become long-lasting and lest the adversaries combine against them and say, Our high hand, and not the Lord, did all these things.
brenton_translation: Were it not for the wrath of the enemy, lest they should live long, lest their enemies should combine against them; lest they should say, Our own high arm, and not the Lord, has done all these things.

fresh_translation: Because they are a nation ruined of counsel, and there is no understanding in them.
brenton_translation: It is a nation that has lost counsel, neither is there understanding in them.

fresh_translation: They were not wise to understand these things; let them receive them for the coming time.
brenton_translation: They had not sense to understand: let them reserve these things against the time to come.

fresh_translation: How will one pursue a thousand, and two put ten thousands to flight, unless God sold them over and the Lord handed them over?
brenton_translation: How should one pursue a thousand, and two rout tens of thousands, if God had not sold them, and the Lord delivered them up?

fresh_translation: Because their gods are not like our God, but our enemies are foolish.
brenton_translation: For their gods are not as our God, but our enemies are void of understanding.

fresh_translation: For their vine is from the vine of Sodom, and their branch from Gomorrah. Their grape is a grape of gall, a cluster of bitterness for them.
brenton_translation: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and their vine-branch of Gomorrha: their grape is a grape of gall, their cluster is one of bitterness.

fresh_translation: The fury of dragons is their wine, and the incurable fury of asps.
brenton_translation: Their wine is the rage of serpents, and the incurable rage of asps.

fresh_translation: Are not these things gathered with me and sealed in my treasuries?
brenton_translation: Lo! are not these things stored up by me, and sealed among my treasures?

fresh_translation: In the day of vengeance I will repay, in the time when their foot slips, because the day of their destruction is near and the prepared things are at hand for you.
brenton_translation: In the day of vengeance I will recompense, whensoever their foot shall be tripped up; for the day of their destruction is near to them, and the judgments at hand are close upon you.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord will judge his people and be comforted over his servants, for he saw them weakened and worn out in confinement and abandoned.
brenton_translation: For the Lord shall judge his people, and shall be comforted over his servants; for he saw that they were utterly weakened, and failed in the hostile invasion, and were become feeble:

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, Where are their gods on whom they trusted,
brenton_translation: and the Lord said, Where are their gods on whom they trusted?

fresh_translation: whose sacrifice fat you were eating and drinking the wine of their libations? Let them rise and help you and become your shelters.
brenton_translation: the fat of whose sacrifices ye ate, and ye drank the wine of their drink-offerings? let them arise and help you, and be your protectors.

fresh_translation: See, see that I am, and there is no god besides me. I kill and make alive, I strike and I will heal, and there is none who delivers from my hands.
brenton_translation: Behold, behold that I am he, and there is no god beside me: I kill, and I will make to live: I will smite, and I will heal; and there is none who shall deliver out of my hands.

fresh_translation: Because I will lift my hand to heaven, and I swear by my right hand and say, I live forever.
brenton_translation: For I will lift up my hand to heaven, and swear by my right hand, and I will say, I live for ever.

fresh_translation: Because I sharpen my sword like lightning, and my hand will hold judgment, and I will repay justice to my enemies, and I will repay those hating me.
brenton_translation: For I will sharpen my sword like lightning, and my hand shall take hold of judgment; and I will render judgment to my enemies, and will recompense them that hate me.

fresh_translation: I will make my arrows drunk from blood, and my sword shall consume flesh from the blood of the wounded and the captivity, from the head of the rulers of enemies.
brenton_translation: I will make my weapons drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh, it shall glut itself with the blood of the wounded, and from the captivity of the heads of their enemies that rule over them.

fresh_translation: Rejoice, O heavens, together with him, and let all sons of God worship him. Rejoice, O nations, with his people, and let all angels of God strengthen themselves in him, because he avenges the blood of his sons and will exact vengeance and repay justice to enemies, and to those hating him he will repay, and the Lord will cleanse the land of his people.
brenton_translation: Rejoice, ye heavens, with him, and let all the angels of God worship him; rejoice ye Gentiles, with his people, and let all the sons of God strengthen themselves in him; for he will avenge the blood of his sons, and he will render vengeance, and recompense justice to his enemies, and will reward them that hate him; and the Lord shall purge the land of his people.

fresh_translation: And Moses wrote this song on that day and taught it to the sons of Israel, and Moses came in and spoke all the words of this law into the ears of the people, he and Joshua son of Nun.
brenton_translation: And Moses wrote this song in that day, and taught it to the children of Israel; and Moses went in and spoke all the words of this law in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Naue.

fresh_translation: And Moses finished speaking to all Israel,
brenton_translation: And Moses finished speaking to all Israel.

fresh_translation: and said to them, Pay attention with your heart to all these words that I call to witness among you today, which you shall command your sons to keep and do, all the words of this law.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Take heed with your heart to all these words, which I testify to you this day, which ye shall command your sons, to observe and do all the words of this law.

fresh_translation: Because this is not an empty word for you, because this is your life, and because of this word you shall be long-lived on the land into which you are crossing the Jordan there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: For this is no vain word to you; for it is your life, and because of this word ye shall live long upon the land, into which ye go over Jordan to inherit it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses on that day, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses in this day, saying,

fresh_translation: Go up onto this mountain of Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab facing Jericho, and see the land of Canaan that I give to the sons of Israel as a possession.
brenton_translation: Go up to the mount Abarim, this mountain Nabau which is in the land of Moab over against Jericho, and behold the land of Chanaan, which I give to the sons of Israel:

fresh_translation: And die on the mountain to which you go up there, and be added to your people, in the way Aaron your brother died on Mount Or and was added to his people,
brenton_translation: and die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be added to thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Or, and was added to his people.

fresh_translation: because you disobeyed my word among the sons of Israel at the water of contradiction, Kadesh, in the wilderness of Sin, because you did not sanctify me among the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: Because ye disobeyed my word among the children of Israel, at the waters of strife of Cades in the wilderness of Sin; because ye sanctified me not among the sons of Israel.

fresh_translation: Because you shall see the land before you, but you shall not enter there.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt see the land before thee, but thou shalt not enter into it.

fresh_translation: And this is the blessing with which Moses, the man of God, blessed the sons of Israel before his death.
brenton_translation: And this is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

fresh_translation: And he said, The Lord comes from Sinai and appeared from Seir to us and hurried from Mount Paran with the myriads of Kadesh; from his right hand angels were with him.
brenton_translation: And he said, The Lord is come from Sina, and has appeared from Seir to us, and has hasted out of the mount of Pharan, with the ten thousands of Cades; on his right hand were his angels with him.

fresh_translation: And he spared his people, and all the sanctified ones are under your hands, and these are under you, and he received from his words.
brenton_translation: And he spared his people, and all his sanctified ones are under thy hands; and they are under thee; and he received of his words

fresh_translation: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance to the assemblies of Jacob.
brenton_translation: the law which Moses charged us, an inheritance to the assemblies of Jacob.

fresh_translation: And there shall be a ruler in the beloved, when leaders of peoples are gathered together with the tribes of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he shall be prince with the beloved one, when the princes of the people are gathered together with the tribes of Israel.

fresh_translation: Let Reuben live and not die, and let him be many in number.
brenton_translation: Let Ruben live, and not die; and let him be many in number.

fresh_translation: And this to Judah: Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and let him enter into his people. His hands shall judge for him, and you shall be a helper against his enemies.
brenton_translation: And this is the blessing of Juda; Hear, Lord, the voice of Juda, and do thou visit his people: his hands shall contend for him, and thou shalt be a help from his enemies.

fresh_translation: And to Levi he said, Give Levi his disclosures and his truth to the holy man whom they tested in testing, they reviled him at the water of contradiction,
brenton_translation: And to Levi he said, Give to Levi his manifestations, and his truth to the holy man, whom they tempted in the temptation; they reviled him at the water of strife.

fresh_translation: the one saying to father and mother, I have not seen you, and he did not acknowledge his brothers and disowned his sons. He kept your words and preserved your covenant.
brenton_translation: Who says to his father and mother, I have not seen thee; and he knew not his brethren, and he refused to know his sons: he kept thine oracles, and observed thy covenant.

fresh_translation: They shall declare your ordinances to Jacob and your law to Israel. They shall place incense in your anger, always upon your altar.
brenton_translation: They shall declare thine ordinances to Jacob, and thy law to Israel: they shall place incense in the time of thy wrath continually upon thine altar.

fresh_translation: Bless, Lord, his strength, and receive the works of his hands. Strike down the loins of the enemies who rise against him, and let those hating him not rise.
brenton_translation: Bless, Lord, his strength, and accept the works of his hands; break the loins of his enemies that have risen up against him, and let not them that hate him rise up.

fresh_translation: And to Benjamin he said, Beloved by the Lord, he shall dwell trusting, and God overshadows him all the days, and he rested between his shoulders.
brenton_translation: And to Benjamin he said, The beloved of the Lord shall dwell in confidence, and God overshadows him always, and he rested between his shoulders.

fresh_translation: And to Joseph he said, His land is from the blessings of the Lord, from seasons of heaven and dew and from the springs of depths below,
brenton_translation: And to Joseph he said, His land is of the blessing of the Lord, of the seasons of sky and dew, and of the deeps of wells below,

fresh_translation: and from the seasons of the produce of the sun's courses and from the meetings of the months,
brenton_translation: and of the fruits of the changes of the sun in season, and of the produce of the months,

fresh_translation: and from the peak of ancient mountains and from the peak of everlasting hills,
brenton_translation: from the top of the ancient mountains, and from the top of the everlasting hills,

fresh_translation: and from the seasons of the earth's fullness and the acceptable things to the one who appeared in the bush. Let them come on the head of Joseph and on the crown of the one glorified among brothers.
brenton_translation: and of the fulness of the land in season: and let the things pleasing to him that dwelt in the bush come on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of him who was glorified above his brethren.

fresh_translation: The beauty of a firstborn bull is his. The horns of a unicorn are his horns; with them he shall horn nations together to the end of the earth. These are the myriads of Ephraim, and these are the thousands of Manasseh.
brenton_translation: His beauty is as the firstling of his bull, his horns are the horns of a unicorn; with them he shall thrust the nations at once, even from the end of the earth: these are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and these are the thousands of Manasse.

fresh_translation: And to Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in your departure, and Issachar in his tents.
brenton_translation: And to Zabulon he said, Rejoice, Zabulon, in thy going out, and Issachar in his tents.

fresh_translation: They shall utterly destroy nations, and there you shall call them, and they shall sacrifice a sacrifice of righteousness, because the wealth of the sea shall suckle you and the trade of those dwelling on the coast.
brenton_translation: They shall utterly destroy the nations, and ye shall call men there, and there offer the sacrifice of righteousness; for the wealth of the sea shall suckle thee, and so shall the marts of them that dwell by the sea-coast.

fresh_translation: And to Gad he said, Blessed is the one enlarging Gad. He rested like a lion, crushing arm and ruler.
brenton_translation: And to Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlarges Gad: as a lion he rested, having broken the arm and the ruler.

fresh_translation: And he saw his first portion, because there land of leaders was apportioned, gathered together with the leaders of peoples. The Lord did righteousness and his judgment with Israel.
brenton_translation: And he saw his first-fruits, that there the land of the princes gathered with the chiefs of the people was divided; the Lord wrought righteousness, and his judgment with Israel.

fresh_translation: And to Dan he said, Dan is a lion's cub and shall leap out from Bashan.
brenton_translation: And to Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp, and shall leap out of Basan.

fresh_translation: And to Naphtali he said, Naphtali, fullness of acceptable things, and let him be filled with blessing from the Lord. He shall inherit sea and south.
brenton_translation: And to Nephthali he said, Nephthali has the fulness of good things; and let him be filled with blessing from the Lord: he shall inherit the west and the south.

fresh_translation: And to Asher he said, Blessed from children is Asher, and he shall be acceptable to his brothers. He shall dip his foot in oil.
brenton_translation: And to Aser he said, Aser is blessed with children; and he shall be acceptable to his brethren: he shall dip his foot in oil.

fresh_translation: His sandal shall be iron and bronze, and as your days, your strength.
brenton_translation: His sandal shall be iron and brass; as thy days, so shall be thy strength.

fresh_translation: There is none like the God of the beloved, riding on heaven as your helper and the magnificent one of the firmament.
brenton_translation: There is not any such as the God of the beloved; he who rides upon the heaven is thy helper, and the magnificent One of the firmament.

fresh_translation: The shelter of the God of old, and underneath the strength of everlasting arms, and he will cast out the enemy from before your face, saying, Perish.
brenton_translation: And the rule of God shall protect thee, and that under the strength of the everlasting arms; and he shall cast forth the enemy from before thy face, saying, Perish.

fresh_translation: And Israel shall dwell trusting, alone upon the land of Jacob, on grain and wine, and his heaven cloudy with dew.
brenton_translation: And Israel shall dwell in confidence alone on the land of Jacob, with corn and wine; and the sky shall be misty with dew upon thee.

fresh_translation: Blessed are you, Israel. Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord? Your helper shields, and your sword boasts, and your enemies shall lie to you, and you shall step on their neck.
brenton_translation: Blessed art thou, O Israel; who is like to thee, O people saved by the Lord? thy helper shall hold his shield over thee, and his sword is thy boast; and thine enemies shall speak falsely to thee, and thou shalt tread upon their neck.

fresh_translation: And Moses went up from Araboth of Moab onto Mount Nebo, onto the top of Pisgah, which is opposite Jericho, and the Lord showed him all the land of Gilead as far as Dan,
brenton_translation: And Moses went up from Araboth Moab to the mount of Nabau, to the top of Phasga, which is before Jericho; and the Lord shewed him all the mount of Galaad to Dan, and all the land of Nephthali,

fresh_translation: and all the land of Naphtali and all the land of Ephraim and Manasseh and all the land of Judah as far as the western sea,
brenton_translation: and all the land of Ephraim and Manasse, and all the land of Juda to the farthest sea;

fresh_translation: and the wilderness and the regions of Jericho, the city of palms, as far as Zoar.
brenton_translation: and the wilderness, and the country round about Jericho, the city of palm-trees, to Segor.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, This is the land that I swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, saying, To your seed I will give it. I have shown it to your eyes, but you shall not enter there.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Moses, This is the land of which I sware to Abraam, and Isaac, and Jacob, saying, To your seed will I give it: and I have shewed it to thine eyes, but thou shalt not go in thither.

fresh_translation: And Moses, servant of the Lord, died in the land of Moab by the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: So Moses the servant of the Lord died in the land of Moab by the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they buried him in Gai in the land of Moab, near the house of Peor, and no one knows his burial until this day.
brenton_translation: And they buried him in Gai near the house of Phogor; and no one has seen his sepulchre to this day.

fresh_translation: And Moses was one hundred and twenty years old when he died. His eyes were not dimmed, nor had his vigor failed.
brenton_translation: And Moses was a hundred and twenty years old at his death; his eyes were not dimmed, nor were his natural powers destroyed.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel mourned Moses in Araboth of Moab on the Jordan opposite Jericho thirty days, and the days of mourning for the weeping of Moses were completed.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in Araboth of Moab at Jordan near Jericho thirty days; and the days of the sad mourning for Moses were completed.

fresh_translation: And Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of understanding, because Moses laid his hands on him, and the sons of Israel listened to him and did just as the Lord commanded Moses.
brenton_translation: And Joshua the son of Naue was filled with the spirit of knowledge, for Moses had laid his hands upon him; and the children of Israel hearkened to him; and they did as the Lord commanded Moses.

fresh_translation: And no prophet rose again in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
brenton_translation: And there rose up no more a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,

fresh_translation: in all the signs and wonders for which the Lord sent him to do them in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh and to his servants and to all his land,
brenton_translation: in all the signs and wonders, which the Lord sent him to work in Egypt on Pharao, and his servants, and all his land;

fresh_translation: the great wonders and the mighty hand that Moses did before all Israel.
brenton_translation: the great wonders, and the mighty hand which Moses displayed before all Israel.

fresh_translation: And it happened after the death of Moses, the Lord said to Joshua son of Nun, minister of Moses, saying,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the death of Moses, that the Lord spoke to Joshua the son of Naue, the minister of Moses, saying,

fresh_translation: Moses my servant has died. Now therefore, rising up, cross this Jordan, you and all this people, into the land that I give to them.
brenton_translation: Moses my servant is dead; now then arise, go over Jordan, thou and all this people, into the land, which I give them.

fresh_translation: Every place on which you step with the track of your feet, I will give it to you, in the way I told Moses.
brenton_translation: Every spot on which ye shall tread I will give it you, as I said to Moses.

fresh_translation: From the wilderness and Anti-Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, and as far as the western sea from the setting of the sun, shall be your boundaries.
brenton_translation: The wilderness and Antilibanus, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, and as far as the extremity of the sea; your coasts shall be from the setting of the sun.

fresh_translation: No person shall stand before you all the days of your life, and as I was with Moses, so I will also be with you, and I will not forsake you nor overlook you.
brenton_translation: Not a man shall stand against you all the days of thy life; and as I was with Moses, so will I also be with thee, and I will not fail thee, or neglect thee.

fresh_translation: Be strong and act like a man, because you shall apportion to this people the land that I swore to your fathers to give to them.
brenton_translation: Be strong and quit thyself like a man, for thou shalt divide the land to this people, which I sware to give to your fathers.

fresh_translation: Be strong, therefore, and act like a man, keeping and doing as Moses my servant commanded you. Do not turn away from them to the right or to the left, so that you may understand in everything you do.
brenton_translation: Be strong, therefore, and quit thyself like a man, to observe and do as Moses my servant commanded thee; and thou shalt not turn therefrom to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest be wise in whatsoever thou mayest do.

fresh_translation: And the book of this law shall not depart from your mouth, and you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you may understand to do all the things written. Then you shall prosper and prosper your ways, and then you shall understand.
brenton_translation: And the book of this law shall not depart out of thy mouth, and thou shalt meditate in it day and night, that thou mayest know how to do all the things that are written in it; then shalt thou prosper, and make thy ways prosperous, and then shalt thou be wise.

fresh_translation: Behold, I have commanded you: be strong and act like a man. Do not be cowardly, nor fear, because the Lord your God is with you in everything you may do.
brenton_translation: Lo! I have commanded thee; be strong and courageous, be not cowardly nor fearful, for the Lord thy God is with thee in all places whither thou goest.

fresh_translation: And Joshua commanded the scribes of the people, saying,
brenton_translation: And Joshua commanded the scribes of the people, saying,

fresh_translation: Go through the midst of the camp of the people and command the people, saying, Prepare provisions, because in yet three days you cross this Jordan, entering to possess the land that the Lord God of your fathers gives you.
brenton_translation: Go into the midst of the camp of the people, and command the people, saying, Prepare provisions; for yet three days and ye shall go over this Jordan, entering in to take possession of the land, which the Lord God of your fathers gives to you.

fresh_translation: And to Reuben and to Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh Joshua said,
brenton_translation: And to Ruben, and to Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasse, Joshua said,

fresh_translation: Remember the word that Moses, servant of the Lord, commanded you, saying, The Lord your God has given you rest and given you this land.
brenton_translation: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, The Lord your God has caused you to rest, and has given you this land.

fresh_translation: Let your wives and your children and your cattle dwell in the land that he gave you, but you shall cross over well-armed before your brothers, every strong one, and you shall fight alongside them,
brenton_translation: Let your wives and your children and your cattle dwell in the land, which he has given you; and ye shall go over well armed before your brethren, every one of you who is strong; and ye shall fight on their side;

fresh_translation: until the Lord your God gives your brothers rest just as also to you, and they also inherit the land that the Lord our God gives them. And you shall go away, each one to his inheritance that Moses gave you beyond the Jordan from the sunrise.
brenton_translation: until the Lord your God shall have given your brethren rest, as also to you, and they also shall have inherited the land, which the Lord your God gives them; then ye shall depart each one to his inheritance, which Moses gave you beyond Jordan eastward.

fresh_translation: And answering Joshua they said, Everything that you command us we will do, and into every place where you send us we will go.
brenton_translation: And they answered Joshua and said, We will do all things which thou commandest us, and we will go to every place whither thou shalt send us.

fresh_translation: According to everything that we listened to from Moses, we will listen to you. Only let the Lord our God be with you in the way he was with Moses.
brenton_translation: Whereinsoever we hearkened to Moses we will hearken to thee; only let the Lord our God be with thee, as he was with Moses.

fresh_translation: And the man whoever disobeys you and whoever does not listen to your words in whatever you command him, let him die. But be strong and act like a man.
brenton_translation: And whosoever shall disobey thee, and whosoever shall not hearken to thy words as thou shalt command him, let him die; but be thou strong and courageous.

fresh_translation: And Joshua son of Nun sent from Shittim two young men to spy, saying, Go up and see the land and Jericho. And going, the two young men entered into Jericho and entered into the house of a prostitute woman whose name was Rahab, and they lodged there.
brenton_translation: And Joshua the son of Naue sent out of Sattin two young men to spy the land, saying, Go up and view the land and Jericho: and the two young men went and entered into Jericho; and they entered into the house of a harlot, whose name was Raab, and lodged there.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to the king of Jericho, saying, Men from the sons of Israel have entered here to spy out the land.
brenton_translation: And it was reported to the king of Jericho, saying, Men of the sons of Israel have come in hither to spy the land.

fresh_translation: And the king of Jericho sent and said to Rahab, Bring out the men who entered into your house in the night, because they have come to spy out the land.
brenton_translation: And the king of Jericho sent and spoke to Raab, saying, Bring out the men that entered into thine house this night; for they are come to spy out the land.

fresh_translation: And the woman, taking the men, hid them and said, The men did come to me,
brenton_translation: And the woman took the two men and hid them; and she spoke to the messengers, saying, The men came in to me,

fresh_translation: but when the gate was being shut in the dark, the men went out. I do not know where they have gone. Pursue after them, if you will overtake them.
brenton_translation: but when the gate was shut in the evening, the men went out; I know not whither they are gone: follow after them, if ye may overtake them.

fresh_translation: But she had brought them up to the roof and hid them in the flax stalks stacked for her on the roof.
brenton_translation: But she had brought them up upon the house, and hid them in the flax-stalks that were spread by her on the house.

fresh_translation: And the men pursued after them on the road by the Jordan to the crossings, and the gate was shut. And it happened, as those pursuing after them had gone out,
brenton_translation: And the men followed after them in the way to Jordan to the fords; and the gate was shut.

fresh_translation: that before the men lay down, she came up to the roof toward them
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the men who pursued after them were gone forth, and before the spies had lain down to sleep, that she came up to them on the top of the house;

fresh_translation: and said to them, I know that the Lord has given you the land, for your fear has fallen on us,
brenton_translation: and she said to them, I know that the Lord has given you the land; for the fear of you has fallen upon us.

fresh_translation: for we heard that the Lord God dried up the Red Sea from before your face when you came out from Egypt, and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
brenton_translation: For we have heard that the Lord God dried up the Red Sea before you, when ye came out of the land of Egypt, and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond Jordan, to Seon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

fresh_translation: And hearing, our heart was astonished, and spirit no longer stood in any of us before your face, because the Lord your God is God in heaven above and on the earth below.
brenton_translation: And when we heard it we were amazed in our heart, and there was no longer any spirit in any of us because of you, for the Lord your God is God in heaven above, and on the earth beneath.

fresh_translation: And now swear to me by the Lord God that as I do mercy to you, so you also will do mercy with the house of my father,
brenton_translation: And now swear to me by the Lord God; since I deal mercifully with you, so do ye also deal mercifully with the house of my father:

fresh_translation: and you will keep alive the house of my father and my mother and my brothers and all my house and everything that belongs to them, and you will rescue my life from death.
brenton_translation: and save alive the house of my father, my mother, and my brethren, and all my house, and all that they have, and ye shall rescue my soul from death.

fresh_translation: And the men said to her, Our life for yours unto death. And she said, Whenever the Lord delivers the city to you, you shall do mercy and truth with me.
brenton_translation: And the men said to her, Our life for yours even to death: and she said, When the Lord shall have delivered the city to you, ye shall deal mercifully and truly with me.

fresh_translation: And she let them down through the window.
brenton_translation: And she let them down by the window;

fresh_translation: And she said to them, Go away into the hill country, lest those pursuing meet you, and hide yourselves there three days until those pursuing turn back from behind you, and after these things go away on your road.
brenton_translation: and she said to them, Depart into the hill-country, lest the pursuers meet you, and ye shall be hidden there three days until your pursuers return from after you, and afterwards ye shall depart on your way.

fresh_translation: And the men said to her, We are guiltless from this oath of yours.
brenton_translation: And the men said to her, We are clear of this thy oath.

fresh_translation: Behold, when we enter into the city, this scarlet cord sign you shall bind in the window through which you brought us down through it, and your father and your mother and your brothers and all your father's house you shall gather to yourself into your house.
brenton_translation: Behold, we shall enter into a part of the city, and thou shalt set a sign; thou shalt bind this scarlet cord in the window, by which thou hast let us down, and thou shalt bring in to thyself, into thy house, thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all the family of thy father.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, everyone who may go out the door of your house outside shall be liable to himself, but we are guiltless of this oath of yours, and whoever may be with you in the house, we will be liable.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass that whosoever shall go outside the door of thy house, his guilt shall be upon him, and we shall be quit of this thine oath; and we will be responsible for all that shall be found with thee in thy house.

fresh_translation: And if anyone wrongs us or reveals these words of ours, we will be guiltless of this oath of yours.
brenton_translation: But if any one should injure us, or betray these our matters, we shall be quit of this thine oath.

fresh_translation: And she said to them, According to your word, so let it be. And she sent them away.
brenton_translation: And she said to them, Let it be according to your word; and she sent them out, and they departed.

fresh_translation: And they went away and came to the hill country and remained there three days, and the pursuers searched all the roads and did not find them.
brenton_translation: And they came to the hill-country, and remained there three days; and the pursuers searched all the roads, and found them not.

fresh_translation: And the two young men returned and came down from the mountain and crossed over to Joshua son of Nun and told him all the things that happened to them.
brenton_translation: And the two young men returned, and came down out of the mountain; and they went over to Joshua the son of Naue, and told him all things that had happened to them.

fresh_translation: And they said to Joshua, The Lord has delivered all the land into our hands, and every inhabitant of that land has cowered from before us.
brenton_translation: And they said to Joshua, The Lord has delivered all the land into our power, and all the inhabitants of that land tremble because of us.

fresh_translation: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and they set out from Shittim and came as far as the Jordan, and they lodged there before crossing.
brenton_translation: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and departed from Sattin; and they came as far as Jordan, and lodged there before they crossed over.

fresh_translation: And it happened after three days that the scribes went through the camp,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after three days, that the scribes went through the camp;

fresh_translation: and they commanded the people, saying, Whenever you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord our God and our priests and the Levites carrying it, depart from your places and go behind it,
brenton_translation: and they charged the people, saying, When ye shall see the ark of the covenant of the Lord our God, and our priests and the Levites bearing it, ye shall depart from your places, and ye shall go after it.

fresh_translation: but let there be distance between you and it, about two thousand cubits. You shall stand; do not come near it, so that you may understand the road on which you go, because you have not gone on this road before yesterday or the third day.
brenton_translation: But let there be a distance between you and it; ye shall stand as much as two thousand cubits from it. Do not draw nigh to it, that ye may know the way which ye are to go; for ye have not gone the way before.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to the people, Purify yourselves for tomorrow, because tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to the people, Sanctify yourselves against to-morrow, for to-morrow the Lord will do wonders among you.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to the priests, Lift up the ark of the covenant of the Lord and go before the people. And the priests lifted up the ark of the covenant of the Lord and went before the people.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to the priests, Take up the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and go before the people: and the priests took up the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and went before the people.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, On this day I begin to exalt you before all the sons of Israel, so that they may know that just as I was with Moses, so I will also be with you.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, This day do I begin to exalt thee before all the children of Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so will I also be with thee.

fresh_translation: And now command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant, saying, When you enter upon the edge of the water of the Jordan, stand in the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And now charge the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, As soon as ye shall enter on a part of the water of Jordan, then ye shall stand in Jordan.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, Come near here and hear the word of the Lord our God.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to the children of Israel, Come hither, and hearken to the word of the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and destroying he will destroy from before our face the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Amorite and the Gergesite and the Jebusite.
brenton_translation: Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and will utterly destroy from before our face the Chananite, and the Chettite and Pherezite, and the Evite, and the Amorite, and the Gergesite, and the Jebusite.

fresh_translation: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth crosses the Jordan.
brenton_translation: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over Jordan.

fresh_translation: Choose for yourselves twelve men from the sons of Israel, one from each tribe.
brenton_translation: Choose for yourselves twelve men of the sons of Israel, one of each tribe.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth come to rest in the water of the Jordan, the water of the Jordan will fail, and the water coming down will stand.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, when the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord of the whole earth rest in the water of Jordan, the water of Jordan below shall fail, and the water coming down from above shall stop.

fresh_translation: And the people set out from their tents to cross the Jordan, and the priests were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord before the people.
brenton_translation: And the people removed from their tents to cross over Jordan, and the priests bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord before the people.

fresh_translation: And when the priests carrying the ark of the covenant went into the Jordan, and the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord were dipped on the edge of the water of the Jordan, now the Jordan was full along all its bank, like the days of wheat harvest,
brenton_translation: And when the priests that bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord entered upon Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord were dipped in part of the water of Jordan; (now Jordan overflowed all its banks about the time of wheat harvest:)

fresh_translation: then the waters coming down from above stood, a mass standing exceedingly far away, as far as the region of Kirjathjearim, but the waters going down went down into the Arabah sea, the Salt Sea, until the end they failed, and the people stood opposite Jericho.
brenton_translation: then the waters that came down from above stopped; there stood one solid heap very far off, as far as the region of Kariathiarim, and the lower part came down to the sea of Araba, the salt sea, till it completely failed; and the people stood opposite Jericho.

fresh_translation: And the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood on dry ground in the midst of the Jordan, and all the sons of Israel were crossing on dry ground until all the people finished crossing the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And the priests that bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood on dry land in the midst of Jordan; and all the children of Israel went through on dry land, until all the people had completely gone over Jordan.

fresh_translation: And when all the people finished crossing the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua, saying,
brenton_translation: And when the people had completely passed over Jordan, the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,

fresh_translation: Take men from the people, one from each tribe,
brenton_translation: Take men from the people, one of each tribe,

fresh_translation: and command them, saying, Take up from the midst of the Jordan twelve ready stones, and, carrying them with you, place them in your camp, where you may camp there tonight.
brenton_translation: and charge them; and ye shall take out of the midst of Jordan twelve fit stones, and having carried them across together with yourselves, place them in your camp, where ye shall encamp for the night.

fresh_translation: And Joshua called twelve honored men from the sons of Israel, one from each tribe,
brenton_translation: And Joshua having called twelve men of distinction among the children of Israel, one of each tribe,

fresh_translation: and said to them, Come before me before the Lord into the midst of the Jordan, and, taking from there, let each lift a stone on his shoulders according to the number of the twelve tribes of Israel,
brenton_translation: said to them, Advance before me in the presence of the Lord into the midst of Jordan, and each having taken up a stone from thence, let him carry it on his shoulders, according to the number of the twelve tribes of Israel:

fresh_translation: so that these may exist for you as a sign lying there forever, so that when your son asks you tomorrow, saying, What are these stones to you?
brenton_translation: that these may be to you continually for an appointed sign, that when thy son asks thee in future, saying, What are these stones to us?

fresh_translation: then you shall explain to your son, saying that the river Jordan failed from before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth as it crossed it, and these stones shall be for you as a memorial to the sons of Israel forever.
brenton_translation: then thou mayest explain to thy son, saying, The river Jordan was dried up from before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of the whole earth, when it passed it: and these stones shall be for a memorial for you for the children of Israel for ever.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel did thus just as the Lord commanded Joshua, and taking twelve stones from the midst of the Jordan, just as the Lord ordered Joshua at the completion of the crossing of the sons of Israel, they carried them with themselves into the camp and laid them there.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel did so, as the Lord commanded Joshua; and they took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, (as the Lord commanded Joshua, when the children of Israel had completely passed over,) and carried these stones with them into the camp, and laid them down there.

fresh_translation: And Joshua set up another twelve stones in that Jordan itself, in the place that came to be under the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and they are there until this day.
brenton_translation: And Joshua set also other twelve stones in Jordan itself, in the place that was under the feet of the priests that bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord; and there they are to this day.

fresh_translation: And the priests carrying the ark of the covenant had been standing in the Jordan until Joshua finished everything that the Lord commanded to report to the people, and the people hurried and crossed.
brenton_translation: And the priests that bore the ark of the covenant stood in Jordan, until Joshua had finished all that the Lord commanded him to report to the people; and the people hasted and passed over.

fresh_translation: And it happened, when all the people finished crossing, the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the stones crossed before them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when all the people had passed over, that the ark of the covenant of the Lord passed over, and the stones before them.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over prepared before the sons of Israel, just as Moses commanded them.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses commanded them.

fresh_translation: Forty thousand well-armed for battle crossed before the Lord for war, toward the city Jericho.
brenton_translation: Forty thousand armed for battle went over before the Lord to war, to the city of Jericho.

fresh_translation: On that day the Lord magnified Joshua before all the race of Israel, and they feared him as they feared Moses for as long as he lived.
brenton_translation: In that day the Lord magnified Joshua before all the people of Israel; and they feared him, as they did Moses, as long as he lived.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,

fresh_translation: Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the testimony of the Lord to come up out of the Jordan.
brenton_translation: Charge the priests that bear the ark of the covenant of the testimony of the Lord, to go up out of Jordan.

fresh_translation: And Joshua commanded the priests, saying, Come up out of the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And Joshua charged the priests, saying, Go up out of Jordan.

fresh_translation: And it happened, when the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord came up out of the Jordan and set their feet on the land, the water of the Jordan rushed down to its place and went as yesterday and the third day along all the bank.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord were gone up out of Jordan, and set their feet upon the land, that the water of Jordan returned impetuously to its place, and went as before over all its banks.

fresh_translation: And the people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth of the first month, and the sons of Israel encamped in Gilgal at the part toward the sunrise from Jericho.
brenton_translation: And the people went up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month; and the children of Israel encamped in Galgala in the region eastward from Jericho.

fresh_translation: And Joshua set up these twelve stones that he took from the Jordan in Gilgal,
brenton_translation: And Joshua set these twelve stones which he took out of Jordan, in Galgala,

fresh_translation: saying, Whenever your sons ask you, saying, What are these stones?
brenton_translation: saying, When your sons ask you, saying, What are these stones?

fresh_translation: you shall report to your sons that Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground,
brenton_translation: Tell your sons, that Israel went over this Jordan on dry land,

fresh_translation: when the Lord our God dried up the water of the Jordan from before them until they crossed, just as the Lord our God did to the Red Sea, which the Lord our God dried up before us until we passed over,
brenton_translation: when the Lord our God had dried up the water of Jordan from before them, until they had passed over; as the Lord our God did to the Red Sea, which the Lord our God dried up from before us, until we passed over.

fresh_translation: so that all the nations of the earth may know that the power of the Lord is strong, and so that you may revere the Lord your God at all times.
brenton_translation: That all the nations of the earth might know, that the power of the Lord is mighty, and that ye might worship the Lord our God in every work.

fresh_translation: And it happened, when the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan and the kings of Phoenicia by the sea heard that the Lord God dried up the river Jordan from before the sons of Israel while they crossed it, then their minds melted and they were astonished, and there was no understanding in them at all from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the kings of the Amorites who were beyond Jordan heard, and the kings of Phœnicia by the sea, that the Lord God had dried up the river Jordan from before the children of Israel when they passed over, that their hearts failed, and they were terror-stricken, and there was no sense in them because of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And at that time the Lord said to Joshua, Make for yourself stone knives from sheer rock, and sit down and circumcise the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And about this time the Lord said to Joshua, Make thee stone knives of sharp stone, and sit down and circumcise the children of Israel the second time.

fresh_translation: And Joshua made sharp stone knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at the place called Hill of Foreskins.
brenton_translation: And Joshua made sharp knives of stone, and circumcised the children of Israel at the place called the “Hill of Foreskins.”

fresh_translation: And this is the way Joshua purified the sons of Israel, as many as had once come to be on the road, and as many as had once been uncircumcised among those who came out from Egypt.
brenton_translation: And this is the way in which Joshua purified the children of Israel; as many as were born in the way, and as many as were uncircumcised of them that came out of Egypt,

fresh_translation: All these Joshua circumcised.
brenton_translation: all these Joshua circumcised; for forty and two years Israel wandered in the wilderness of Mabdaris—

fresh_translation: For forty-two years Israel had turned about in the wilderness of Madbaritis; therefore most of them were uncircumcised, the fighting men who had come out from the land of Egypt, who disobeyed the commands of God, to whom the Lord also determined that they should not see the land that he swore to their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
brenton_translation: Wherefore most of the fighting men that came out of the land of Egypt, were uncircumcised, who disobeyed the commands of God; concerning whom also he determined that they should not see the land, which the Lord sware to give to their fathers, even a land flowing with milk and honey.

fresh_translation: And in place of these he set up their sons, whom Joshua circumcised because they had become uncircumcised on the road.
brenton_translation: And in their place he raised up their sons, whom Joshua circumcised, because they were uncircumcised, having been born by the way.

fresh_translation: And after they were circumcised, they had rest there, sitting in the camp until they were healed.
brenton_translation: And when they had been circumcised they rested continuing there in the camp till they were healed.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua son of Nun, On this day I have removed the reproach of Egypt from you. And he called the name of that place Gilgal.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Joshua the son of Naue, On this day have I removed the reproach of Egypt from you: and he called the name of that place Galgala.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month, from evening, west of Jericho, beyond the Jordan, in the plain.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, to the westward of Jericho on the opposite side of the Jordan in the plain.

fresh_translation: And they ate from the grain of the land, unleavened bread and new grain, on this very day.
brenton_translation: And they ate of the grain of the earth unleavened and new corn.

fresh_translation: The manna failed after they had eaten from the grain of the land, and there was no longer manna for the sons of Israel, but they harvested the land of the Phoenicians in that year.
brenton_translation: In this day the manna failed, after they had eaten of the corn of the land, and the children of Israel no longer had manna; and they took the fruits of the land of the Phœnicians in that year.

fresh_translation: And it happened, as Joshua was in Jericho, that lifting his eyes he saw a man standing before him, and his sword was drawn in his hand. And coming near, Joshua said to him, Are you one of ours or of our adversaries?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Joshua was in Jericho, that he looked up with his eyes and saw a man standing before him, and there was a drawn sword in his hand; and Joshua drew near and said to him, Art thou for us or on the side of our enemies?

fresh_translation: And he said to him, I am commander-in-chief of the Lord's force; now I have arrived. And Joshua fell on his face to the ground and said to him, Master, what do you command your servant?
brenton_translation: And he said to him, I am now come, the chief captain of the host of the Lord. And Joshua fell on his face upon the earth, and said to him, Lord, what commandest thou thy servant?

fresh_translation: And the commander-in-chief of the Lord says to Joshua, Loose the sandal from your feet, because the place on which you stand is holy.
brenton_translation: And the captain of the Lord's host said to Joshua, Loose thy shoe off thy feet, for the place whereon thou now standest is holy.

fresh_translation: And Jericho was shut up and fortified, and no one went out from it, nor entered into it.
brenton_translation: Now Jericho was closely shut up and besieged, and none went out of it, and none came in.
