brenton_translation: that ye go not in among these nations that are left; and the names of their gods shall not be named among you, neither shall ye serve them, neither shall ye bow down to them.

fresh_translation: But to the Lord your God you shall cling, just as you have done until this day.
brenton_translation: But ye shall cleave to the Lord our God, as ye have done until this day.

fresh_translation: And the Lord destroyed from before you great and strong nations, and no one stood against you until this day.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall destroy them before you, even great and strong nations; and no one has stood before us until this day.

fresh_translation: One of you chased a thousand, because the Lord your God was fighting for you, just as he said to you.
brenton_translation: One of you has chased a thousand, for the Lord our God, he fought for you, as he said to you.

fresh_translation: And take great care to love the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And take ye great heed to love the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: For if you turn back and attach yourselves to these nations left over with you and make marriages with them and mingle with them and they with you,
brenton_translation: For if ye shall turn aside and attach yourselves to these nations that are left with you, and make marriages with them, and become mingled with them and they with you,

fresh_translation: know that the Lord will certainly not continue to destroy these nations from before you, and they shall become snares for you and scandals and nails in your heels and darts in your eyes until you perish from this good land that the Lord your God gave you.
brenton_translation: know that the Lord will no more destroy these nations from before you; and they will be to you snares and stumbling-blocks, and nails in your heels, and darts in your eyes, until ye be destroyed from off this good land, which the Lord your God has given you.

fresh_translation: And behold, I am departing on the way, just as all on the earth, and you shall know in your heart and in your soul that not one word has failed from all the words that the Lord your God spoke concerning all that belongs to you; none of them has fallen away.
brenton_translation: But I hasten to go the way of death, as all that are upon the earth also do: and know ye in your heart and in your soul, that not one word has fallen to the ground of all the words which the Lord our God has spoken respecting all that concerns us; there has not one of them failed.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, just as all the good words that the Lord spoke to you have come upon you, so the Lord your God will bring upon you all the evil words until he destroys you from this good land that the Lord gave you.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, that as all the good things are come upon us which the Lord spoke concerning you, so the Lord God will bring upon you all the evil things, until he shall have destroyed you from off this good land, which the Lord has given you,

fresh_translation: when you transgress the covenant of the Lord your God that he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them.
brenton_translation: when ye transgress the covenant of the Lord our God, which he has charged us, and go and serve other gods, and bow down to them.

fresh_translation: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shiloh and called together their elders and their scribes and their judges, and he set them before God.
brenton_translation: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Selo, and convoked their elders, and their officers, and their judges, and set them before God.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to all the people, Thus says the Lord God of Israel: From the beginning your fathers lived beyond the river, Terah the father of Abraham and the father of Nahor, and they served other gods.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to all the people, Thus says the Lord God of Israel, Your fathers at first sojourned beyond the river, even Thara, the father of Abraam and the father of Nachor; and they served other gods.

fresh_translation: And I took your father Abraham from beyond the river and led him through all the land, and I multiplied his seed and gave him Isaac.
brenton_translation: And I took your father Abraam from the other side of the river, and I guided him through all the land, and I multiplied his seed;

fresh_translation: And to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau, and to Esau I gave Mount Seir for his inheritance, and Jacob and his sons went down into Egypt and became there a great and numerous and strong nation.
brenton_translation: and I gave to him Isaac, and to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau mount Seir for him to inherit: and Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt, and became there a great and populous and mighty nation: and the Egyptians afflicted them.

fresh_translation: And the Egyptians afflicted them, and the Lord struck Egypt with the things he did among them, and after these things he brought you out.
brenton_translation: And I smote Egypt with the wonders that I wrought among them.

fresh_translation: Out of Egypt you came, and you entered the Red Sea, and the Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and horses to the Red Sea.
brenton_translation: And afterwards God brought out our fathers from Egypt, and ye entered into the Red Sea; and the Egyptians pursued after our fathers with chariots and horses into the Red Sea.

fresh_translation: And we cried out to the Lord, and he put cloud and gloom between us and between the Egyptians, and he brought the sea upon them and covered them, and your eyes saw what the Lord did in the land of Egypt, and you were in the wilderness many days.
brenton_translation: And we cried aloud to the Lord; and he put a cloud and darkness between us and the Egyptians, and he brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen all that the Lord did in the land of Egypt; and ye were in the wilderness many days.

fresh_translation: And he brought you into the land of the Amorites who dwell beyond the Jordan, and they arrayed themselves against you, and the Lord gave them into your hands, and you inherited their land and destroyed them from before you.
brenton_translation: And he brought us into the land of the Amorites that dwelt beyond Jordan, and the Lord delivered them into our hands; and ye inherited their land, and utterly destroyed them from before you.

fresh_translation: And Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, rose up and made war against Israel, and he sent and called Balaam to curse you.
brenton_translation: And Balac, king of Moab, son of Sepphor, rose up, and made war against Israel, and sent and called Balaam to curse us.

fresh_translation: And the Lord your God was not willing to destroy you, and with blessing he blessed you and delivered you from their hands and gave them over.
brenton_translation: But the Lord thy God would not destroy thee; and he greatly blessed us, and rescued us out of their hands, and delivered them to us.

fresh_translation: And you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho, and those dwelling in Jericho fought against you: the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite and the Hittite and the Girgashite, and the Lord gave them into your hands.
brenton_translation: And ye crossed over Jordan, and came to Jericho; and the inhabitants of Jericho fought against us, the Amorite, and the Chananite, and the Pherezite, and the Evite, and the Jebusite, and the Chettite, and the Gergesite, and the Lord delivered them into our hands.

fresh_translation: And he sent ahead of you the hornet, and it drove them out from before you, twelve kings of the Amorites, not by your sword nor by your bow.
brenton_translation: And he sent forth the hornet before you; and he drove them out from before you, even twelve kings of the Amorites, not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

fresh_translation: And he gave you a land on which you did not labor, and cities that you did not build, and you settled in them, and you eat vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.
brenton_translation: And he gave you a land on which ye did not labour, and cities which ye did not build, and ye were settled in them; and ye eat of vineyards and oliveyards which ye did not plant.

fresh_translation: And now fear the Lord and serve him in uprightness and in righteousness, and remove the foreign gods that your fathers served beyond the river and in Egypt, and serve the Lord.
brenton_translation: And now fear the Lord, and serve him in righteousness and justice; and remove the strange gods, which our fathers served beyond the river, and in Egypt; and serve the Lord.

fresh_translation: But if it does not please you to serve the Lord, choose for yourselves today whom you will serve, whether the gods of your fathers beyond the river or the gods of the Amorites among whom you dwell on their land. But I and my house will serve the Lord, because he is holy.
brenton_translation: But if it seem not good to you to serve the Lord, choose to yourselves this day whom ye will serve, whether the gods of your fathers that were on the other side of the river, or the gods of the Amorites, among whom ye dwell upon their land: but I and my house will serve the Lord, for he is holy.

fresh_translation: And the people answered and said, May it never be for us to forsake the Lord so as to serve other gods.
brenton_translation: And the people answered and said, Far be it from us to forsake the Lord, so as to serve other gods.

fresh_translation: The Lord our God, he is God; he brought up us and our fathers out of Egypt and preserved us in all the way in which we went and among all the nations through whom we passed.
brenton_translation: The Lord our God, he is God; he brought up us and our fathers from Egypt, and kept us in all the way wherein we walked, and among all the nations through whom we passed.

fresh_translation: And the Lord drove out the Amorite and all the nations dwelling in the land from before us. Therefore we also will serve the Lord, for he is our God.
brenton_translation: And the Lord cast out the Amorite, and all the nations that inhabited the land from before us: yea, we will serve the Lord, for he is our God.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to the people, You will not be able to serve the Lord, because he is a holy and jealous God; he will not forgive your sins and your lawless deeds.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to the people, Indeed ye will not be able to serve the Lord, for God is holy; and he being jealous will not forgive your sins and your transgressions.

fresh_translation: Whenever you forsake the Lord and serve other gods, then coming upon you he will mistreat you and consume you in return for the good things he did for you.
brenton_translation: Whensoever ye shall forsake the Lord and serve other gods, then he shall come upon you and afflict you, and consume you, because he has done you good.

fresh_translation: And the people said to Joshua, No, but we will serve the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the people said to Joshua, Nay, but we will serve the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you chose the Lord, to serve him.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves, that ye have chosen the Lord to serve him.

fresh_translation: And now remove the foreign gods among you and direct your heart toward the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And now take away the strange gods that are among you, and set your heart right toward the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the people said to Joshua, We will serve the Lord and we will listen to his voice.
brenton_translation: And the people said to Joshua, We will serve the Lord, and we will hearken to his voice.

fresh_translation: And Joshua made a covenant with the people on that day and gave them law and judgment in Shiloh before the tent of the God of Israel.
brenton_translation: So Joshua made a covenant with the people on that day, and gave them a law and an ordinance in Selo before the tabernacle of the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and Joshua took a great stone and set it up under the terebinth before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he wrote these words in the book of the laws of God: and Joshua took a great stone, and set it up under the oak before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Joshua said to the people, Behold, this stone shall be among you as a witness, because it has heard all that was spoken to it by the Lord, whatever he spoke to us today, and it shall be among you as a witness at the last days, whenever you lie against the Lord my God.
brenton_translation: And Joshua said to the people, Behold, this stone shall be among you for a witness, for it has heard all the words that have been spoken to it by the Lord; for he has spoken to you this day; and this stone shall be among you for a witness in the last days, whenever ye shall deal falsely with the Lord my God.

fresh_translation: And Joshua sent the people away, and each went to his own place.
brenton_translation: And Joshua dismissed the people, and they went every man to his place.

fresh_translation: And Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who lengthened time after Joshua and who saw all the works of the Lord that he did for Israel.
brenton_translation: And Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that lived as long as Joshua, and all that knew all the works of the Lord which he wrought for Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after these things that Joshua son of Nun, servant of the Lord, died at one hundred ten years.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after these things that Joshua the son of Naue the servant of the Lord died, at the age of a hundred and ten years.

fresh_translation: And they buried him at the borders of his inheritance in Thamnathasachara in the hill-country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash. There they put with him into the tomb in which they buried him the stone knives with which he circumcised the sons of Israel in Gilgal when he brought them out of Egypt, just as the Lord commanded them, and there they are until this day.
brenton_translation: And they buried him by the borders of his inheritance in Thamnasarach in the mount of Ephraim, northward of the mount of Galaad:

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel brought up the bones of Joseph out of Egypt, and they buried them in Shechem, in the portion of the field that Jacob acquired from the Amorites dwelling in Shechem for a hundred lambs, and he gave it to Joseph as a portion.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel brought up the bones of Joseph out of Egypt, and buried them in Sicima, in the portion of the land which Jacob bought of the Amorites who dwelt in Sicima for a hundred ewe-lambs; and he gave it to Joseph for a portion.

fresh_translation: And after these things Eleazar son of Aaron the high priest died, and they buried him in Gabaath of Phinehas his son, which he gave him in the hill-country of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass afterwards that Eleazar the high-priest the son of Aaron died, and was buried in Gabaar of Phinees his son, which he gave him in mount Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after the death of Joshua that the sons of Israel inquired of the Lord, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanite, leading to fight against him?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the death of Joshua, that the children of Israel enquired of the Lord, saying, Who shall go up for us first against the Chananites, to fight against them?

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, Judah shall go up. See, I have given the land into his hand.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, Judas shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

fresh_translation: And Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come up with me in my lot and let us fight against the Canaanite, and I also will go with you in your lot. And Simeon went with him.
brenton_translation: And Judas said to his brother Symeon, Come up with me into my lot, and let us array ourselves against the Chananites, and I also will go with thee into thy lot: and Symeon went with him.

fresh_translation: And Judah went up, and the Lord gave the Canaanite and the Perizzite into his hand, and he struck them at Bezek, ten thousand men.
brenton_translation: And Judas went up; and the Lord delivered the Chananite and the Pherezite into their hands, and they smote them in Bezek to the number of ten thousand men.

fresh_translation: And they found Adonibezek at Bezek and fought against him, and they struck the Canaanite and the Perizzite.
brenton_translation: And they overtook Adonibezek in Bezek, and fought against him; and they smote the Chananite and the Pherezite.

fresh_translation: And Adonibezek fled, and they pursued after him and took him and cut off the tips of his hands and his feet.
brenton_translation: And Adonibezek fled, and they pursued after him, and took him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

fresh_translation: And Adonibezek said, Seventy kings with the tips of their hands and feet cut off used to gather what was under my table. As I did, so God repaid me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
brenton_translation: And Adonibezek said, Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their food under my table: as I therefore have done, so God has recompensed me: and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Judah fought against Jerusalem and took it, and they struck it with the edge of the sword and burned the city with fire.
brenton_translation: And the children of Judas fought against Jerusalem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and they burnt the city with fire.

fresh_translation: And after this the sons of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanite dwelling in the hill-country and the south and the plain.
brenton_translation: And afterwards the children of Judas went down to fight with the Chananite dwelling in the hill country, and the south, and the plain country.

fresh_translation: And Judah went against the Canaanite dwelling in Hebron, and Hebron came out opposite them; the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba. And he struck Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai, offspring of Anak.
brenton_translation: And Judas went to the Chananite who dwelt in Chebron; and Chebron came out against him; [and the name of Chebron before was Cariatharbocsepher:] and they smote Sessi, and Achiman, and Tholmi, children of Enac.

fresh_translation: And from there they went against those dwelling in Debir, and the name of Debir before was the City of Letters.
brenton_translation: And they went up thence to the inhabitants of Dabir; but the name of Dabir was before Cariathsepher, the city of Letters.

fresh_translation: And Caleb said, Whoever strikes the City of Letters and takes it first, I will give him my daughter Achsah as wife.
brenton_translation: And Chaleb said, Whosoever shall smite the city of Letters, and shall first take it, I will give to him Ascha my daughter to wife.

fresh_translation: And Othniel son of Kenaz, younger brother of Caleb, took it first, and he gave him his daughter Achsah as wife.
brenton_translation: And Gothoniel the younger son of Kenez the brother of Chaleb took it; and Chaleb gave him his daughter Ascha to wife.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when she went in, she urged him to ask from her father for the field, and she groaned upon the pack animal and cried out from the pack animal, You gave me into a south land. And Caleb said to her, What is wrong with you?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as she went in, that Gothoniel urged her to ask a field of her father; and she murmured and cried from off her ass, Thou hast sent me forth into a south land: and Chaleb said to her, What is thy request?

fresh_translation: And Achsah said to him, Give me a blessing, because you gave me into a south land, and you shall give me a redemption of water. And Caleb gave her according to her heart, the redemption of the heights and the redemption of the low places.
brenton_translation: And Ascha said to him, Give me, I pray thee, a blessing, for thou hast sent me forth into a south land, and thou shalt give me the ransom of water: and Chaleb gave her according to her heart the ransom of the upper springs and the ransom of the low springs.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Hobab the Kenite, father-in-law of Moses, went up from the City of Palms with the sons of Judah into the wilderness that is in the south at the descent of Arad, and he went and dwelt with the people.
brenton_translation: And the children of Jothor the Kenite the father-in-law of Moses went up from the city of palm-trees with the children of Judas, to the wilderness that is in the south of Juda, which is at the descent of Arad, and they dwelt with the people.

fresh_translation: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanite dwelling at Zephath and devoted it to destruction and utterly destroyed it, and they called the name of the city Extermination.
brenton_translation: And Judas went with Symeon his brother, and smote the Chananite that inhabited Sepheth, and they utterly destroyed them; and they called the name of the city Anathema.

fresh_translation: And Judah did not inherit Gaza and its boundary, and Ashkelon and its boundary, and Ekron and its boundary, and Ashdod and its pasturelands.
brenton_translation: But Judas did not inherit Gaza nor her coasts, nor Ascalon nor her coasts, nor Accaron nor her coasts, nor Azotus nor the lands around it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was with Judah, and he inherited the hill-country, because he was not able to inherit those dwelling in the valley, because Rechab had deployed it.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was with Judas, and he inherited the mountain; for they were not able to destroy the inhabitants of the valley, for Rechab prevented them.

fresh_translation: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, just as Moses spoke, and he inherited from there the three cities and removed from there the three sons of Anak.
brenton_translation: And they gave Chebron to Chaleb, as Moses said; and thence he inherited the three cities of the children of Enac.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Benjamin did not remove the Jebusite dwelling in Jerusalem, and the Jebusite dwelt with the sons of Benjamin until this day.
brenton_translation: But the children of Benjamin did not take the inheritance of the Jebusite who dwelt in Jerusalem; and the Jebusite dwelt with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem until this day.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Joseph also went up to Bethel, and Judah was with them.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Joseph, they also went up to Bæthel; and the Lord was with them.

fresh_translation: And the house of Israel encamped against Bethel; the name of the city before was Luz.
brenton_translation: And they encamped and surveyed Bæthel: and the name of the city before was Luza.

fresh_translation: And the watchers saw a man coming out of the city and took him and said to him, Show us the entrance of the city, and we will deal mercifully with you.
brenton_translation: And the spies looked, and behold, a man went out of the city, and they took him; and they said to him, Shew us the way into the city, and we will deal mercifully with thee.

fresh_translation: And he showed them the entrance of the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword, but the man and all his kin they sent away.
brenton_translation: And he shewed them the way into the city; and they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and his family.

fresh_translation: And the man went into the land of the Hittites and built there a city and called its name Luz. This is its name until this day.
brenton_translation: And the man went into the land of Chettin, and built there a city, and called the name of it Luza; this is its name until this day.

fresh_translation: And Manasseh did not inherit Bethshan, which is a city of Scythians, nor its daughters, nor its pasturelands, nor Ekthanaad and its daughters, nor those dwelling in Dor and its daughters, and those dwelling in Balaam and its daughters, and those dwelling in Megiddo and its daughters, nor those dwelling in Jeblaam nor its daughters. And the Canaanite began to dwell in this land.
brenton_translation: And Manasse did not drive out the inhabitants of Bæthsan, which is a city of Scythians, nor her towns, nor her suburbs; nor Thanac, nor her towns; nor the inhabitants of Dor, nor her towns; nor the inhabitant of Balac, nor her suburbs, nor her towns; nor the inhabitants of Magedo, nor her suburbs, nor her towns; nor the inhabitants of Jeblaam, nor her suburbs, nor her towns; and the Chananite began to dwell in this land.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Israel grew strong, it made the Canaanite subject to tribute, but in removing, it did not remove him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Israel was strong, that he made the Chananite tributary, but did not utterly drive them out.

fresh_translation: And Ephraim did not remove the Canaanite dwelling in Gezer, and the Canaanite dwelt in its midst in Gezer and became subject to tribute.
brenton_translation: And Ephraim did not drive out the Chananite that dwelt in Gazer; and the Chananite dwelt in the midst of him in Gazer, and became tributary.

fresh_translation: And Zebulun did not remove those dwelling in Kidron and those dwelling in Enaala, and the Canaanite dwelt in its midst and became subject to tribute.
brenton_translation: And Zabulon did not drive out the inhabitants of Kedron, nor the inhabitants of Domana: and the Chananite dwelt in the midst of them, and became tributary to them.

fresh_translation: And Asher did not remove those dwelling in Acco, and they became tributary to him, and those dwelling in Dor and those dwelling in Sidon and those dwelling in Ahlab and Achzib and Helbah and Aphek and Rehob.
brenton_translation: And Aser did not drive out the inhabitants of Accho, and that people became tributary to him, nor the inhabitants of Dor, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor the inhabitants of Dalaph, nor Aschazi, nor Chebda, nor Nai, nor Ereo.

fresh_translation: And Asher dwelt in the midst of the Canaanite dwelling in the land, because he was not able to remove him.
brenton_translation: And Aser dwelt in the midst of the Chananite who inhabited the land, for he could not drive him out.

fresh_translation: And Naphtali did not remove those dwelling in Beth-shemesh nor those dwelling in Bethanath, and Israel dwelt in the midst of the Canaanite dwelling in the land, but those dwelling in Beth-shemesh and Bethanath became subject to tribute for them.
brenton_translation: And Nephthali did not drive out the inhabitants of Bæthsamys, nor the inhabitants of Bæthanach; and Nephthali dwelt in the midst of the Chananite who inhabited the land: but the inhabitants of Bethsamys and of Bætheneth became tributary to them.

fresh_translation: And the Amorite pressed the sons of Dan into the mountain, because he did not allow him to go down into the valley.
brenton_translation: And the Amorite drove out the children of Dan into the mountain, for they did not suffer them to come down into the valley.

fresh_translation: And the Amorite began to dwell in the mountain of Myrsinon, where the bears and the foxes are, and the hand of the house of Joseph weighed heavily on the Amorite, and he became subject to tribute.
brenton_translation: And the Amorite began to dwell in the mountain of shells, in which are bears, and foxes, in Myrsinon, and in Thalabin; and the hand of the house of Joseph was heavy upon the Amorite, and he became tributary to them.

fresh_translation: And the boundary of the Amorite, the Edomite, was above Akrabbim, from the rock and upward.
brenton_translation: And the border of the Amorite was from the going up of Acrabin, from the rock and upwards.

fresh_translation: And an angel of the Lord went up from Gilgal to the place of Weeping and to Bethel and to the house of Israel and said to them, The Lord brought you up out of Egypt and brought you into the land that he swore to your fathers to give you, and he said to you, I will never scatter my covenant with you forever.
brenton_translation: And an angel of the Lord went up from Galgal to the place of weeping, and to Bæthel, and to the house of Israel, and said to them, Thus says the Lord, I brought you up out of Egypt, and I brought you into the land which I sware to your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant that I have made with you.

fresh_translation: And you shall not make a covenant with those dwelling in this land, and you shall certainly not bow down to their gods, but you shall shatter their carved images and dig down their altars. And you did not listen to my voice when you did these things.
brenton_translation: And ye shall make no covenant with them that dwell in this land, neither shall ye worship their gods; but ye shall destroy their graven images, ye shall pull down their altars: but ye hearkened not to my voice, for ye did these things.

fresh_translation: And I said, I will not continue to move away the people that I said I would destroy from before you, and they shall be for you in constriction, and their gods shall be for you as a snare.
brenton_translation: And I said, I will not drive them out from before you, but they shall be for a distress to you, and their gods shall be to you for an offence.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, as the angel of the Lord spoke these words to all Israel, the people raised their voice and wept.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the angel of the Lord spoke these words to all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

fresh_translation: Because of this the name of that place was called Weeping, and there they sacrificed to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they named the name of that place Weepings; and they sacrificed there to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Joshua sent the people away, and the sons of Israel went, each to his house and to his inheritance, to inherit the land.
brenton_translation: And Joshua dismissed the people, and they went every man to his inheritance, to inherit the land.

fresh_translation: And the people served the Lord all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who lived long after Joshua, who knew all the great work of the Lord that he did for Israel.
brenton_translation: And the people served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that lived many days with Joshua, as many as knew all the great work of the Lord, what things he had wrought in Israel.

fresh_translation: And Joshua son of Nun, servant of the Lord, died, being one hundred ten years old.
brenton_translation: And Joshua the son of Naue, the servant of the Lord, died, a hundred and ten years old.

fresh_translation: And they buried him in the boundary of his inheritance in Timnathheres in the hill-country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
brenton_translation: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance, in Thamnathares, in mount Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaas.

fresh_translation: And that whole generation was added to their fathers, and another generation arose after them, those who did not know the Lord and the work that he did for Israel.
brenton_translation: And all that generation were laid to their fathers: and another generation rose up after them, who knew not the Lord, nor yet the work which he wrought in Israel.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel did evil before the Lord and served the Baals.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel wrought evil before the Lord, and served Baalim.

fresh_translation: And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they went after other gods from the gods of the peoples around them and bowed down to them, and they provoked the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and walked after other gods, of the gods of the nations round about them; and they worshipped them.

fresh_translation: And they forsook the Lord and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
brenton_translation: And they provoked the Lord, and forsook him, and served Baal and the Astartes.

fresh_translation: And the Lord burned with anger against Israel and gave them into the hand of plunderers, and they plundered them, and he sold them into the hand of their enemies all around, and they were not able to stand before their enemies.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Israel; and he gave them into the hands of the spoilers, and they spoiled them; and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, and they could not any longer resist their enemies,

fresh_translation: In all the ways in which they prostituted themselves, the hand of the Lord was against them for harm, just as the Lord spoke and just as the Lord swore, and he pressed them very hard.
brenton_translation: among whomsoever they went; and the hand of the Lord was against them for evil, as the Lord spoke, and as the Lord sware to them; and he greatly afflicted them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord raised up judges for them, and they saved them from the hand of those plundering them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord raised up judges, and the Lord saved them out of the hands of them that spoiled them: and yet they hearkened not to the judges,

fresh_translation: Yet even to their judges they did not listen, because they prostituted themselves after other gods and bowed down to them and provoked the Lord, and they quickly turned aside from the way in which their fathers walked, to listen to the commandments of the Lord. They did not do so.
brenton_translation: for they went a whoring after other gods, and worshipped them; and they turned quickly out of the way in which their fathers walked to hearken to the words of the Lord; they did not so.

fresh_translation: And when the Lord raised up judges for them, the Lord was with the judge and saved them from the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge, because the Lord was moved by their groaning from before those besieging them and mistreating them.
brenton_translation: And because the Lord raised them up judges, so the Lord was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for the Lord was moved at their groaning by reason of them that besieged them and afflicted them.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when the judge died, they turned back and again corrupted themselves beyond their fathers, going after other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They did not cast off their practices, and they did not depart from their hard way.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the judge died, that they went back, and again corrupted themselves worse than their fathers to go after other gods to serve them and to worship them: they abandoned not their devices nor their stubborn ways.

fresh_translation: And the Lord burned with anger against Israel and said, Because this nation forsook my covenant that I commanded their fathers and did not listen to my voice,
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Israel, and said, Forasmuch as this nation has forsaken my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not hearkened to my voice,

fresh_translation: I also will not continue to remove a man from before them from the nations that Joshua left and allowed to remain,
brenton_translation: therefore I will not any more cast out a man of the nations from before their face, which Joshua the son of Naue left in the land. And the Lord left them,

fresh_translation: in order to test Israel by them, whether they will keep the way of the Lord to walk in it, just as their fathers kept it, or not.
brenton_translation: to prove Israel with them, whether they would keep the way of the Lord, to walk in it, as their fathers kept it, or no.

fresh_translation: And the Lord left these nations so as not to remove them quickly, and he did not give them into the hand of Joshua.
brenton_translation: So the Lord will leave these nations, so as not to cast them out suddenly; and he delivered them not into the hand of Joshua.

fresh_translation: And these are the nations Joshua left to test Israel by them, all who had not known all the wars of Canaan,
brenton_translation: And these are the nations which the Lord left to prove Israel with them, all that had not known the wars of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: only for the generations of the sons of Israel, to teach them war, only those before them had not known them:
brenton_translation: Only for the sake of the generations of Israel, to teach them war, only the men before them knew them not.

fresh_translation: the five satrapies of the foreigners and all the Canaanite and the Sidonian and the Hivite dwelling on Lebanon from Mount Baalhermon to Zobah.
brenton_translation: The five lordships of the Phylistines, and every Chananite, and the Sidonian, and the Evite who dwelt in Libanus from the mount of Aermon to Laboemath.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in order to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the commandments of the Lord that he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
brenton_translation: And this was done in order to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would obey the commands of the Lord, which he charged their fathers by the hand of Moses.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel dwelt in the midst of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite,
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel dwelt in the midst of the Chananite, and the Chettite, and the Amorite, and the Pherezite, and the Evite, and the Jebusite.

fresh_translation: and they took their daughters for themselves as wives and gave their daughters to their sons and served their gods.
brenton_translation: And they took their daughters for wives to themselves, and they gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel did evil before the Lord and forgot the Lord their God and served the Baals and the groves.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and forgot the Lord their God, and served Baalim and the groves.

fresh_translation: And the Lord burned with anger against Israel and sold them into the hands of Chushan-rishathaim king of Syrian Mesopotamia, and they served him eight years.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Israel, and sold them into the hand of Chusarsathaim king of Syria of the rivers: and the children of Israel served Chusarsathaim eight years.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord, and the Lord raised up a savior for Israel and saved them, Othniel son of Kenaz, younger brother of Caleb, and he listened to him.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord; and the Lord raised up a saviour to Israel, and he saved them, Gothoniel the son of Kenez, the brother of Chaleb younger than himself.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel and went out to war, and the Lord gave Chushan-rishathaim king of Syria into his hand, and his hand grew strong over Chushan-rishathaim.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war against Chusarsathaim: and the Lord delivered into his hand Chusarsathaim king of Syria of the rivers, and his hand prevailed against Chusarsathaim.

fresh_translation: And the land was at rest fifty years, and Othniel son of Kenaz died.
brenton_translation: And the land was quiet forty years; and Gothoniel the son of Kenez died.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel again added to do evil before the Lord, and the Lord strengthened Eglon king of Moab against Israel because they had done evil before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel continued to do evil before the Lord: and the Lord strengthened Eglom king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he brought to himself all the sons of Ammon and Amalek, and he went and struck Israel and inherited the City of Palms.
brenton_translation: And he gathered to himself all the children of Ammon and Amalec, and went and smote Israel, and took possession of the city of Palm-trees.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel served Eglon king of Moab eighteen years.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel served Eglom the king of Moab eighteen years.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord, and the Lord raised up for them a savior, Ehud son of Gera, a Benjamite, an ambidextrous man. And the sons of Israel sent gifts by his hand to Eglon king of Moab.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord; and he raised up to them a saviour, Aod the son of Gera a son of Jemeni, a man who used both hands alike: and the children of Israel sent gifts by his hand to Eglom king of Moab.

fresh_translation: And Ehud made for himself a double-edged sword a span in length and girded it under his cloak on his right thigh.
brenton_translation: And Aod made himself a dagger of two edges, of a span long, and he girded it under his cloak upon his right thigh.

fresh_translation: And he brought the gifts to Eglon king of Moab, and Eglon was a very imposing man.
brenton_translation: And he went, and brought the presents to Eglom king of Moab, and Eglom was a very handsome man.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when Ehud finished presenting the gifts, he sent away those carrying the gifts.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Aod had made an end of offering his gifts, that he dismissed those that brought the gifts.

fresh_translation: And Eglon turned back from the carved images near Gilgal, and Ehud said, I have a secret word for you, O king. And Eglon said, Silence, everyone out from my presence. And all those standing by him went out from him.
brenton_translation: And he himself returned from the quarries that are by Galgal; and Aod said, I have a secret errand to thee, O king! and Eglom said to him, Be silent: and he sent away from his presence all who waited upon him.

fresh_translation: And Ehud went in to him, and he was sitting alone in his summer upper room. And Ehud said, I have a word of God for you, O king. And Eglon rose from the throne near him.
brenton_translation: And Aod went in to him; and he sat in his own upper summer chamber quite alone; and Aod said, I have a message from God to thee, O king: and Eglom rose up from his throne near him.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, as he rose up, Ehud stretched out his left hand and took the sword from his right thigh and drove it into the belly of Eglon.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as he arose, that Aod stretched forth his left hand, and took the dagger off his right thigh, and plunged it into his belly;

fresh_translation: And indeed he drove in the hilt behind the blade, and the fat closed over the blade, because he did not pull the sword out of his belly.
brenton_translation: and drove in also the haft after the blade, and the fat closed in upon the blade, for he drew not out the dagger from his belly.

fresh_translation: And Ehud went out into the vestibule and shut the doors of the upper room upon him and locked them.
brenton_translation: And Aod went out to the porch, and passed out by the appointed guards, and shut the doors of the chamber upon him, and locked them.

fresh_translation: And he went out, and his servants came in and saw, and behold, the doors of the upper room were shut. And they said, Perhaps he is relieving himself in the private room of the bedchamber.
brenton_translation: And he went out: and Eglom's servants came, and saw, and behold, the doors of the upper chamber were locked; and they said, Does he not uncover his feet in the summer-chamber?

fresh_translation: And they waited until they were ashamed, and behold, there was no one opening the doors of the upper room. And they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen dead upon the ground.
brenton_translation: And they waited till they were ashamed, and, behold, there was no one that opened the doors of the upper chamber; and they took the key, and opened them; and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And Ehud escaped while they were in confusion, and there was no one paying him heed, and he himself passed by the carved images and escaped to Seirath.
brenton_translation: And Aod escaped while they were in a tumult, and no one paid attention to him; and he passed the quarries, and escaped to Setirotha.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when he arrived, he sounded a horn in the hill-country of Ephraim, and the sons of Israel went down with him, and he was before them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Aod came into the land of Israel, that he blew the horn in mount Ephraim, and the children of Israel came down with him from the mountain, and he was before them.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Come down after me, because the Lord God has given your enemies, Moab, into your hands. And they came down after him and seized the crossings of the Jordan of Moab and did not allow a man to cross over.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Come down after me, for the Lord God has delivered our enemies, even Moab, into our hand; and they went down after him, and seized on the fords of Jordan before Moab, and he did not suffer a man to pass over.

fresh_translation: And they struck Moab at that time, about ten thousand men, every fighting man among them and every man of strength, and not a man escaped.
brenton_translation: And they smote Moab on that day about ten thousand men, every lusty person and every mighty man; and not a man escaped.

fresh_translation: And Moab was put to shame on that day under the hand of Israel, and the land was at rest eighty years. And Ehud judged them until he died.
brenton_translation: So Moab was humbled in that day under the hand of Israel, and the land had rest eighty years; and Aod judged them till he died.

fresh_translation: And after him arose Shamgar son of Anath, and he struck the foreigners, six hundred men, apart from the calves of the cattle, and he too saved Israel.
brenton_translation: And after him rose up Samegar the son of Dinach, and smote the Philistines to the number of six hundred men with a ploughshare such as is drawn by oxen; and he too delivered Israel.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel again added to do evil before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel continued to do evil against the Lord; and Aod was dead.

fresh_translation: And the Lord sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor, and the commander of his force was Sisera, and he dwelt in Harosheth of the nations.
brenton_translation: And the Lord sold the children of Israel into the hand of Jabin king of Chanaan, who ruled in Asor; and the chief of his host was Sisara, and he dwelt in Arisoth of the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord, because he had nine hundred iron chariots, and he oppressed Israel with force for twenty years.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord, because he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed Israel twenty years.

fresh_translation: And Deborah, a woman prophet, wife of Lapidoth, she was judging Israel at that time.
brenton_translation: And Debbora, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth,—she judged Israel at that time.

fresh_translation: And she sat under the palm of Deborah between Ramah and between Bethel in the hill-country of Ephraim, and the sons of Israel went up to her there for judgment.
brenton_translation: And she sat under the palm-tree of Debbora between Rama and Bæthel in mount Ephraim; and the children of Israel went up to her for judgment.

fresh_translation: And Deborah sent and called Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh of Naphtali and said to him, Has not the Lord God of Israel commanded you? And you shall depart to Mount Tabor and take with yourself ten thousand men from the sons of Naphtali and from the sons of Zebulun.
brenton_translation: And Debbora sent and called Barac the son of Abineem out of Cades Nephthali, and she said to him, Has not the Lord God of Israel commanded thee? and thou shalt depart to mount Thabor, and shalt take with thyself ten thousand men of the sons of Nephthali and of the sons of Zabulon.

fresh_translation: And I will draw to you, to the torrent Kishon, Sisera the commander of Jabin's force and his chariots and his multitude, and I will give him into your hand.
brenton_translation: And I will bring to thee to the torrent of Kison Sisara the captain of the host of Jabin, and his chariots, and his multitude, and I will deliver them into thine hands.

fresh_translation: And Barak said to her, If you go with me, I will go, and if you do not go with me, I will not go, because I do not know the day in which the Lord prospers the angel with me.
brenton_translation: And Barac said to her, If thou wilt go with me, I will go; and if thou wilt not go, I will not go; for I know not the day on which the Lord prospers his messenger with me.

fresh_translation: And Deborah said to him, Going, I will go with you. Only know that the advantage shall not be yours on the way by which you are going, because into a woman's hand the Lord will give Sisera. And Deborah rose and went with Barak to Kedesh.
brenton_translation: And she said, I will surely go with thee; but know that thy honour shall not attend on the expedition on which thou goest, for the Lord shall sell Sisara into the hands of a woman: and Debbora arose, and went with Barac out of Cades.

fresh_translation: And Barak summoned Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh, and ten thousand men went up at his feet, and Deborah went up with him.
brenton_translation: And Barac called Zabulon and Nephthali out of Cades, and there went up at his feet ten thousand men, and Debbora went up with him.

fresh_translation: And those near the Kenite had separated from the sons of Hobab, son-in-law of Moses, and he pitched his tent by the oak of those resting, which is near Kedesh.
brenton_translation: And Chaber the Kenite had removed from Caina, from the sons of Jobab the father-in-law of Moses, and pitched his tent by the oak of the covetous ones, which is near Kedes.

fresh_translation: And they reported to Sisera that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.
brenton_translation: And it was told Sisara that Barac the son of Abineem was gone up to mount Thabor.

fresh_translation: And Sisera called together all his chariots, because he had nine hundred iron chariots, and all the people with him, from Harosheth of the nations to the torrent Kishon.
brenton_translation: And Sisara summoned all his chariots, nine hundred chariots of iron and all the people with him, from Arisoth of the Gentiles to the brook of Kison.

fresh_translation: And Deborah said to Barak, Rise up, because this is the day in which the Lord has given Sisera into your hand. Look, the Lord will go out before you. And Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
brenton_translation: And Debbora said to Barac, Rise up, for this is the day on which the Lord has delivered Sisara into thy hand, for the Lord shall go forth before thee: and Barac went down from mount Thabor, and ten thousand men after him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord threw Sisera and all his chariots and all his camp into confusion by the edge of the sword before Barak, and Sisera came down from his chariot and fled on his feet.
brenton_translation: And the Lord discomfited Sisara, and all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barac: and Sisara descended from off his chariot, and fled on his feet.

fresh_translation: And Barak pursued after the chariots and after the camp as far as the oak grove of the nations, and all the camp of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword; not even one was left.
brenton_translation: And Barac pursued after the chariots and after the army, into Arisoth of the Gentiles; and the whole army of Sisara fell by the edge of the sword, there was not one left.

fresh_translation: And Sisera withdrew on his feet to the tent of Jael, wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was peace between Jabin king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
brenton_translation: And Sisara fled on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Chaber the Kenite his friend: for there was peace between Jabin king of Asor and the house of Chaber the Kenite.

fresh_translation: And Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, Turn aside, my lord, turn aside to me, do not fear. And he turned aside to her into the tent, and she covered him with her cloak.
brenton_translation: And Jael went out to meet Sisara, and said to him, Turn aside, my lord, turn aside to me, fear not: and he turned aside to her into the tent; and she covered him with a mantle.

fresh_translation: And Sisera said to her, Give me to drink a little water, because I thirsted. And she opened the skin of milk and gave him drink and covered his face.
brenton_translation: And Sisara said to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink, for I am thirsty: and she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him to drink, and covered him.

fresh_translation: And he said to her, Stand at the door of the tent, and it shall be, if someone comes to you and asks you and says to you, Is there a man here? you shall say, There is not. And she covered him with her cloak.
brenton_translation: And Sisara said to her, Stand now by the door of the tent, and it shall come to pass if any man come to thee, and ask of thee, and say, Is there any man here? then thou shalt say, There is not.

fresh_translation: And Jael wife of Heber took the tent peg and put the hammer in her hand and came in to him quietly and drove the peg into his jaw and it went through into the ground. And he writhed between her knees and breathed out and died.
brenton_translation: And Jael the wife of Chaber took a pin of the tent, and took a hammer in her hand, and went secretly to him, and fastened the pin in his temple, and it went through to the earth, and he fainted away, and darkness fell upon him and he died.

fresh_translation: And behold, Barak was pursuing Sisera, and Jael went out to meet him and said to him, Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek. And he went in to her, and behold, Sisera had fallen dead, and the peg was in his jaw.
brenton_translation: And, behold, Barac was pursuing Sisara: and Jael went out to meet him, and she said to him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest: and he went in to her; and, behold, Sisara was fallen dead, and the pin was in his temple.

fresh_translation: And God humbled Jabin king of Canaan on that day before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: So God routed Jabin king of Chanaan in that day before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the hand of the sons of Israel went on, going and hardening against Jabin king of Canaan, until they destroyed him.
brenton_translation: And the hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin king of Chanaan, until they utterly destroyed Jabin king of Chanaan.

fresh_translation: And Deborah sang, and Barak son of Abinoam, on that day, and said,
brenton_translation: And Debbora and Barac son of Abineem sang in that day, saying,

fresh_translation: When leaders began in Israel, in the willing offering of the people, bless the Lord.
brenton_translation: A revelation was made in Israel when the people were made willing: Praise ye the Lord.

fresh_translation: Hear, kings; give ear, satraps. I will sing to the Lord; I will make melody to the God of Israel.
brenton_translation: Hear, ye kings, and hearken, rulers: I will sing, it is I who will sing to the Lord, it is I, I will sing a psalm to the Lord the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: Lord, in your going out from Seir, in your marching from the field of Edom, the earth shook, and heaven was shaken, and the clouds dripped water.
brenton_translation: O Lord, in thy going forth on Seir, when thou wentest forth out of the land of Edom, the earth quaked and the heaven dropped dews, and the clouds dropped water.

fresh_translation: Mountains were shaken from before the Lord, this Sinai, from before the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: The mountains were shaken before the face of the Lord Eloi, this Sina before the face of the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, kings ceased, and ways went on twisted roads.
brenton_translation: In the days of Samegar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, they deserted the ways, and went in by-ways; they went in crooked paths.

fresh_translation: Rule ceased in Israel, it ceased until Deborah arose, because a mother arose in Israel.
brenton_translation: The mighty men in Israel failed, they failed until Debbora arose, until she arose a mother in Israel.

fresh_translation: They chose new gods, like barley bread. A shield, if I should see, or spear among forty thousand?
brenton_translation: They chose new gods; then the cities of rulers fought; there was not a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel.

fresh_translation: My heart is toward the appointed ones of Israel, the mighty ones of the people. Bless the Lord.
brenton_translation: My heart inclines to the orders given in Israel; ye that are willing among the people, bless the Lord.

fresh_translation: You who ride on the beasts of burden, you who sit on carpets,
brenton_translation: Ye that mount a she-ass at noon-day, ye that sit on the judgment-seat, and walk by the roads of them that sit in judgment by the way; declare

fresh_translation: sound forth the voice of those striking up among rejoicing ones. There they will give righteousness to the Lord; the righteous ones were strengthened in Israel. Then the people of the Lord went down to his cities.
brenton_translation: ye that are delivered from the noise of disturbers among the drawers of water; there shall they relate righteous acts: O Lord, increase righteous acts in Israel: then the people of the Lord went down to the cities.

fresh_translation: Awake, awake, Deborah. Awaken myriads with the people. Awake, awake, speak with song. Strengthening one, rise up, Barak, and strengthen, Deborah, Barak. Take captive your captivity, son of Abinoam.
brenton_translation: Awake, awake, Debbora; awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barac, and lead thy captivity captive, son of Abineem.

fresh_translation: Then his strength was magnified. Lord, humble for me my stronger ones.
brenton_translation: Then went down the remnant to the strong, the people of the Lord went down for him among the mighty ones from me.

fresh_translation: The people of Ephraim punished them in the valley. Benjamin, your brother, among your peoples. From me, Machir came down, searching out, and from Zebulun the Lord fought for me among mighty ones, from there with the scepter of strengthening leadership.
brenton_translation: Ephraim rooted them out in Amalec, behind thee was Benjamin among thy people: the inhabitants of Machir came down with me searching out the enemy, and from Zabulon came they that draw with the scribe's pen of record.

fresh_translation: In Issachar with Deborah he sent his footmen into the valley. Why do you dwell between the lips? He stretched out at his feet. In the divisions of Reuben were great searchings of heart.
brenton_translation: And princes in Issachar were with Debbora and Barac, thus she sent Barac on his feet in the valleys into the portions of Ruben; great pangs reached to the heart.

fresh_translation: Why do you sit among the sheepfolds, to hear the whistlings of those stirring up to pass through? In the matters of Reuben were great searchings of heart.
brenton_translation: Why did they sit between the sheep-folds to hear the bleating of flocks for the divisions of Ruben? there were great searchings of heart.

fresh_translation: Gilead camped beyond the Jordan, and Dan, why does he dwell among ships? Asher settled by the seashore and camped by his inlets.
brenton_translation: Galaad is on the other side of Jordan where he pitched his tents; and why does Dan remain in ships? Aser sat down on the sea-coasts, and he will tabernacle at his ports.

fresh_translation: Zebulun, a people that reproached its soul to death, and Naphtali on the heights of the field.
brenton_translation: The people Zabulon exposed their soul to death, and Nephthali came to the high places of their land.

fresh_translation: Kings came and arrayed themselves, then the kings of Canaan fought at Thennach by the water of Megiddo. They took no gain of silver.
brenton_translation: Kings set themselves in array, then the kings of Chanaan fought in Thanaach at the water of Mageddo; they took no gift of money.

fresh_translation: From heaven stars fought; from their order they fought with Sisera.
brenton_translation: The stars from heaven set themselves in array, they set themselves to fight with Sisara out of their paths.

fresh_translation: The torrent Kishon swept them away, torrent of former days, torrent Kishon. My soul, you shall trample the mighty.
brenton_translation: The brook of Kison swept them away, the ancient brook, the brook Kison: my mighty soul will trample him down.

fresh_translation: Then the heels of the horse were cut off by the prancings of his mighty ones.
brenton_translation: When the hoofs of the horse were entangled, his mighty ones earnestly hasted

fresh_translation: Curse Meroz, said the angel of the Lord; curse its inhabitants with a curse, because they did not come to the help of the Lord. The Lord is our helper, mighty in warriors.
brenton_translation: to curse Meroz: Curse ye it, said the angel of the Lord; cursed is every one that dwells in it, because they came not to the help of the Lord, to his help among the mighty.

fresh_translation: Blessed among women be Jael, wife of Heber the Kenite; among women in the tent let her be blessed.
brenton_translation: Blessed among women be Jael wife of Chaber the Kenite; let her be blessed above women in tents.

fresh_translation: He asked water of her, and she gave him milk. In a bowl of the mighty she brought him butter.
brenton_translation: He asked for water, she gave him milk in a dish; she brought butter of princes.

fresh_translation: Her left hand she stretched to the peg, and her right hand to the work of laborers, and she struck Sisera, she shattered his head and crushed and pierced through his jaw.
brenton_translation: She stretched forth her left hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workman's hammer, and she smote Sisara with it, she nailed through his head and smote him; she nailed through his temples.

fresh_translation: Between her feet, bending down, he fell; he slept between her feet. Where he bent down, there he fell, exhausted.
brenton_translation: He rolled down between her feet; he fell and lay between her feet; he bowed and fell: where he bowed, there he fell dead.

fresh_translation: Through the window the mother of Sisera leaned out, looking through the lattice at those returning with Sisera. Why has his chariot delayed to come? Why have the tracks of his chariots tarried?
brenton_translation: The mother of Sisara looked down through the window out of the loophole, saying, Why was his chariot ashamed? why did the wheels of his chariots tarry?

fresh_translation: The wise women of her princesses answered her, and she answered in her own words,
brenton_translation: Her wise ladies answered her, and she returned answers to herself, saying,

fresh_translation: Will they not find him dividing spoil, making friends for friends? A spoil of dyed cloths for the head of a mighty man, spoil of dyed cloths of variegated embroidery, dyed embroidered things around his neck, spoil.
brenton_translation: Will they not find him dividing the spoil? he will surely be gracious to every man: there are spoils of dyed garments for Sisara, spoils of various dyed garments, dyed embroidered garments, they are the spoils for his neck.

fresh_translation: So let all your enemies perish, O Lord, but those loving him are as the rising of the sun in his might. And the land was at rest forty years.
brenton_translation: Thus let all thine enemies perish, O Lord: and they that love him shall be as the going forth of the sun in his strength.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel did evil before the Lord, and the Lord gave them into the hand of Midian seven years.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and the Lord gave them into the hand of Madiam seven years.

fresh_translation: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel, and the sons of Israel made for themselves, because of Midian, hideouts in the mountains and caves and strongholds.
brenton_translation: And the hand of Madiam prevailed against Israel: and the children of Israel made for themselves because of Madiam the caves in the mountains, and the dens, and the holes in the rocks.

fresh_translation: And it happened when a man of Israel sowed, Midian and Amalek and the sons of the east would come up against him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the children of Israel sowed, that Madiam and Amalec went up, and the children of the east went up together with them.

fresh_translation: And they would encamp against them and destroy the produce of the land as far as Gaza, and they would leave no sustenance of life in Israel, and no sheep and no calf and no donkey.
brenton_translation: And they encamped against them, and destroyed their fruits until they came to Gaza; and they left not the support of life in the land of Israel, not even ox or ass among the herds.

fresh_translation: For they and their cattle came up, and they carried their tents and came like locusts for multitude, and there was no number for them or for their camels, and they came into the land of Israel to ruin it.
brenton_translation: For they and their stock came up, and their tents were with them, as the locust in multitude, and there was no number to them and their camels; and they came to the land of Israel, and laid it waste.

fresh_translation: And Israel became very poor before Midian, and the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of Madiam.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord because of Midian,
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord because of Madiam.

fresh_translation: that the Lord sent a man, a prophet, to the sons of Israel and said to them, Thus says the Lord God of Israel: I am the one who brought you up out of Egypt and brought you out of the house of slavery.
brenton_translation: And the Lord sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, Thus says the Lord God of Israel, I am he that brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and I brought you up out of the house of your bondage.

fresh_translation: And I delivered you from the hand of Egypt and from the hand of all oppressing you, and I drove them out from before you and gave you their land.
brenton_translation: And I delivered you out of the hand of Egypt, and out of the hand of all that afflicted you, and I cast them out before you; and I gave you their land.

fresh_translation: And I said to you, I am the Lord your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorite among whom you dwell in their land, and you did not listen to my voice.
brenton_translation: And I said to you, I am the Lord your God: ye shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell; but ye hearkened not to my voice.

fresh_translation: And an angel of the Lord came and sat under the oak that was in Ephrathah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, and Gideon his son was beating out wheat in a winepress to escape from before Midian.
brenton_translation: And an angel of the Lord came, and sat down under the fir tree, which was in Ephratha in the land of Joas father of Esdri; and Gedeon his son was threshing wheat in a wine-press in order to escape from the face of Madiam.

fresh_translation: And an angel of the Lord appeared to him and said to him, The Lord is with you, mighty in strength.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord appeared to him and said to him, The Lord is with thee, thou mighty in strength.

fresh_translation: And Gideon said to him, In me, my lord? And if the Lord is with us, why have all these evils found us, and where are all his wonders that our fathers recounted to us, saying, Did not the Lord bring us up out of Egypt? But now he has cast us off and given us into the hand of Midian.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon said to him, Be gracious with me, my Lord: but if the Lord is with us, why have these evils found us? and where are all his miracles, which our fathers have related to us, saying, Did not the Lord bring us up out of Egypt? and now he has cast us out, and given us into the hand of Madiam.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord looked upon him and said to him, Go in your strength, and you shall save Israel. See, I have sent you.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord turned to him, and said, Go in this thy strength, and thou shalt save Israel out of the hand of Madiam: behold, I have sent thee.

fresh_translation: And Gideon said to him, In me, my lord? By what shall I save Israel? Behold, my thousand is the humblest in Manasseh, and I am small in my father's house.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon said to him, Be gracious with me, my Lord: whereby shall I save Israel? behold, my thousand is weakened in Manasse, and I am the least in my father's house.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to him, The Lord will be with you, and you will strike Midian as one man.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to him, The Lord shall be with thee, and thou shalt smite Madiam as one man.

fresh_translation: And Gideon said to him, If I found favor in your eyes, then do for me a sign that you are the one speaking with me.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon said to him, If now I have found mercy in thine eyes, and thou wilt do this day for me all that thou hast spoken of with me,

fresh_translation: Do not move from here until I come to you and bring out my sacrifice and set it before you. And he said, I am; I will stay until you return.
brenton_translation: depart not hence until I come to thee, and I will bring forth an offering and offer it before thee: and he said, I will remain until thou return.

fresh_translation: And Gideon went in and made a kid of the goats and unleavened loaves from an ephah of flour, and he put the meat in the basket and poured the broth into the pot, and he brought them out to him under the oak and bowed down.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon went in, and prepared a kid of the goats, and an ephah of fine flour unleavened; and he put the flesh in the basket, and poured the broth into the pot, and brought them forth to him under the turpentine tree, and drew nigh.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to him, Take the meat and the unleavened loaves and lay them on that rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
brenton_translation: And the angel of God said to him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and put them on that rock, and pour out the broth close by: and he did so.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord stretched out the tip of the staff in his hand and touched the meat and the unleavened loaves, and fire sprang up from the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened loaves, and the angel of the Lord departed from his sight.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord stretched out the end of the rod that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened bread; and fire came up out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened bread, and the angel of the Lord vanished from his sight.

fresh_translation: And Gideon saw that he was an angel of the Lord and said, Ah, Lord, Lord, because I saw the angel of the Lord face to face.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon saw that he was an angel of the Lord; and Gedeon said, Ah, ah, Lord my God! for I have seen the angel of the Lord face to face.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to him, Peace to you. Do not fear; you shall not die.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to him, Peace be to thee, fear not, thou shalt not die.

fresh_translation: And Gideon built there an altar to the Lord and called it Peace of the Lord. Until this day it still stands in Ephrathah of the father of Ezri.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon built there an altar to the Lord, and called it The peace of the Lord, until this day, as it is still in Ephratha of the father of Esdri.

fresh_translation: And it came to be that night that the Lord said to him, Take your father's fatted calf, the seven-year-old bull, and pull down the altar of Baal that belongs to your father, and cut down the grove upon it.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in that night, that the Lord said to him, Take the young bullock which thy father has, even the second bullock of seven years old, and thou shalt destroy the altar of Baal which thy father has, and the grove which is by it thou shalt destroy.

fresh_translation: And you shall build an altar to the Lord your God, who appeared to you, on the top of this stronghold mountain in the arrangement, and you shall take the bull and offer a whole burnt offering with the wood of the grove that you cut down.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt build an altar to the Lord thy God on the top of this Maozi in the ordering it, and thou shalt take the second bullock, and shalt offer up whole-burnt-offerings with the wood of the grove, which thou shalt destroy.

fresh_translation: And Gideon took ten and three men from among his servants and did as the Lord spoke to him. And it came to be, because he feared his father's house and the men of the city, not to do it by day, he did it by night.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon took ten men of his servants, and did as the Lord spoke to him: and it came to pass, as he feared the house of his father and the men of the city if he should do it by day, that he did it by night.

fresh_translation: And the men of the city rose early in the morning, and behold, the altar of Baal had been dug down and the grove upon it had been cut down, and the fatted bull had been offered as a whole burnt offering on the altar that had been built.
brenton_translation: And the men of the city rose up early in the morning; and behold, the altar of Baal had been demolished, and the grove by it had been destroyed; and they saw the second bullock, which Gedeon offered on the altar that had been built.

fresh_translation: And each man said to his neighbor, Who did this thing? And they searched and inquired and said, Gideon son of Joash did this thing.
brenton_translation: And a man said to his neighbour, Who has done this thing? and they enquired and searched, and learnt that Gedeon the son of Joas had done this thing.

fresh_translation: And the men of the city said to Joash, Bring out your son and let him die, because he dug down the altar of Baal and because he cut down the grove upon it.
brenton_translation: And the men of the city said to Joas, Bring out thy son, and let him die, because he has destroyed the altar of Baal, and because he has destroyed the grove that is by it.

fresh_translation: And Joash said to the men standing against him, Will you now judge on behalf of Baal, or will you save him? Whoever pleads his case shall die by morning. If he is a god, let him avenge himself, because his altar was dug down.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon the son of Joas said to all the men who rose up against him, Do ye now plead for Baal, or will ye save him? whoever will plead for him, let him be slain this morning: if he be a god let him plead for himself, because one has thrown down his altar.

fresh_translation: And on that day he called him Tribunal of Baal, because he dug down his altar.
brenton_translation: And he called it in that day Jerobaal, saying, Let Baal plead thereby, because his altar has been thrown down.

fresh_translation: And all Midian and Amalek and the sons of the east gathered together, and they crossed over and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.
brenton_translation: And all Madiam, and Amalek, and the sons of the east gathered themselves together, and encamped in the valley of Jezrael.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of God clothed Gideon, and he sounded the horn, and Abiezer cried out after him.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon Gedeon, and he blew with the horn, and Abiezer came to help after him.

fresh_translation: And he sent messengers through all Manasseh, and it also cried out after him, and he sent messengers in Asher and in Zebulun and in Naphtali, and they went up to meet him.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon sent messengers into all Manasse, and into Aser, and into Zabulon, and into Nephthali; and he went up to meet them.

fresh_translation: And Gideon said to God, If you are saving Israel by my hand, just as you said,
brenton_translation: And Gedeon said to God, If thou wilt save Israel by my hand, as thou hast said,

fresh_translation: behold, I lay the fleece of wool on the threshing floor, and if dew comes upon the fleece alone and drought upon all the land, then I will know that you are saving Israel by my hand, just as you said.
brenton_translation: behold, I put the fleece of wool in the threshing-floor: if there be dew on the fleece only, and drought on all the ground, I shall know that thou wilt save Israel by my hand, as thou hast said.

fresh_translation: And it happened so, and Gideon rose early the next day and squeezed the fleece, and the dew ran out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
brenton_translation: And it was so: and he rose up early in the morning, and wrung the fleece, and dew dropped from the fleece, a bowl full of water.

fresh_translation: And Gideon said to God, Let not your anger burn in me, and let me speak once more. Let me test once more with the fleece. Let there be drought upon the fleece alone, but upon all the land let there be dew.
brenton_translation: And Gedeon said to God, Let not, I pray thee, thine anger be kindled with me, and I will speak yet once; I will even yet make one trial more with the fleece: let now the drought be upon the fleece only, and let there be dew on all the ground.

fresh_translation: And God did so in that night, and there was drought upon the fleece alone, but upon all the land there was dew.
brenton_translation: And God did so in that night; and there was drought on the fleece only, and on all the ground there was dew.
