fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel removed the Baals and the groves of Ashtaroth and served the Lord alone.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel took away Baalim and the groves of Astaroth, and served the Lord only.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray concerning you to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Massephath, and I will pray for you to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they gathered to Mizpah and drew water and poured it out before the Lord upon the ground and fasted on that day and said, We sinned before the Lord. And Samuel was judging the sons of Israel in Mizpah.
brenton_translation: And they were gathered together to Massephath, and they drew water, and poured it out upon the earth before the Lord. And they fasted on that day, and said, We have sinned before the Lord. And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Massephath.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners heard that all the sons of Israel had gathered to Mizpah, and the satraps of the foreigners went up against Israel. And the sons of Israel heard and feared from before the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines heard that all the children of Israel were gathered together to Massephath: and the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel: and the children of Israel heard, and they feared before the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel said to Samuel, Do not be silent away from us from crying to the Lord your God, and he will save us from the hand of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry to the Lord thy God for us, and he shall save us out of the hand of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And Samuel took one suckling lamb and offered it up whole with all the people to the Lord, and Samuel cried out to the Lord concerning Israel, and the Lord listened to him.
brenton_translation: And Samuel took a sucking lamb, and offered it up as a whole-burnt-offering with all the people to the Lord: and Samuel cried to the Lord for Israel, and the Lord heard him.

fresh_translation: And Samuel was offering up the whole burnt offering, and the foreigners drew near for battle against Israel, and the Lord thundered with a great voice on that day against the foreigners and confused them, and they stumbled before Israel.
brenton_translation: And Samuel was offering the whole-burnt-offering; and the Philistines drew near to war against Israel; and the Lord thundered with a mighty sound in that day upon the Philistines, and they were confounded and overthrown before Israel.

fresh_translation: And the men of Israel went out from Mizpah and pursued the foreigners and struck them as far as below Baithchor.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel went forth out of Massephath, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them to the parts under Bæthchor.

fresh_translation: And Samuel took one stone and set it between Mizpah and between the old place and called its name Ebenezer, Stone of the Helper, and said, Until here the Lord has helped us.
brenton_translation: And Samuel took a stone, and set it up between Massephath and the old city; and he called the name of it Abenezer, stone of the helper; and he said, Hitherto has the Lord helped us.

fresh_translation: And the Lord humbled the foreigners, and they no longer continued to come into the border of Israel, and the hand of the Lord was upon the foreigners all the days of Samuel.
brenton_translation: So the Lord humbled the Philistines, and they did not any more come into the border of Israel; and the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

fresh_translation: And the cities that the foreigners took from the sons of Israel were given back, and they restored them to Israel from Ashkelon to Azob, and the border of Israel they removed from the hand of the foreigners. And there was peace between Israel and between the Amorite.
brenton_translation: And the cities which the Philistines took from the children of Israel were restored; and they restored them to Israel from Ascalon to Azob: and they took the coast of Israel out of the hand of the Philistines; and there was peace between Israel and the Amorite.

fresh_translation: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
brenton_translation: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

fresh_translation: And he went year by year and made circuit of Bethel and Gilgal and Mizpah and judged Israel in all these consecrated places.
brenton_translation: And he went year by year, and went round Bæthel, and Galgala, and Massephath; and he judged Israel in all these consecrated places.

fresh_translation: And his return was to Ramathaim-Zophim, because there was his house, and there he judged Israel, and he built there an altar to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And his return was to Armathaim, because there was his house; and there he judged Israel, and built there an altar to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Samuel grew old that he appointed his sons as judges for Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.

fresh_translation: And these are the names of his sons: firstborn Joel, and the name of the second Abijah, judges in Beersheba.
brenton_translation: And these are the names of his sons; Joel the first-born, and the name of the second Abia, judges in Bersabee.

fresh_translation: And his sons did not walk in his way, and they turned aside after gain and were taking gifts and turning aside judgments.
brenton_translation: And his sons did not walk in his way; and they turned aside after gain, and took gifts, and perverted judgments.

fresh_translation: And the men of Israel gathered together and came to Ramathaim-Zophim to Samuel.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel gather themselves together, and come to Armathaim to Samuel,

fresh_translation: And they said to him, Behold, you have grown old, and your sons do not walk in your way, and now appoint over us a king to judge us, as also the rest of the nations have.
brenton_translation: and they said to him, Behold, thou art grown old, and thy sons walk not in thy way; and now set over us a king to judge us, as also the other nations have.

fresh_translation: And the word was evil in the eyes of Samuel as they said, Give us a king to judge us, and Samuel prayed to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the thing was evil in the eyes of Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us: and Samuel prayed to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Samuel, Hear the voice of the people according to whatever they say to you, because they have not despised you, but me they have despised, from reigning over them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Samuel, Hear the voice of the people, in whatever they shall say to thee; for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me from reigning over them.

fresh_translation: According to all the deeds that they did to me from the day I brought them up out of Egypt until this day, and they forsook me and served other gods, so they also are doing to you.
brenton_translation: According to all their doings which they have done to me, from the day that I brought them out of Egypt until this day, even as they have deserted me, and served other gods, so they do also to thee.

fresh_translation: And now hear their voice; only in protesting protest to them and declare to them the right of the king who will reign over them.
brenton_translation: And now hearken to their voice; only thou shalt solemnly testify to them, and thou shalt describe to them the manner of the king who shall reign over them.

fresh_translation: And Samuel spoke every word of the Lord to the people asking from him a king.
brenton_translation: And Samuel spoke every word of the Lord to the people who asked of him a king.

fresh_translation: And he said, This will be the right of the king who will reign over you: he will take your sons and place them in his chariots and among his horsemen and as runners before his chariots,
brenton_translation: And he said, This shall be the manner of the king that shall rule over you: he shall take your sons, and put them in his chariots, and among his horsemen, and running before his chariots,

fresh_translation: and to appoint them for himself commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds and to reap his harvest and gather his vintage and make his implements of war and the implements of his chariots.
brenton_translation: and his manner shall be to make them to himself captains of hundreds and captains of thousands; and to reap his harvest, and gather his vintage, and prepare his instruments of war, and the implements of his chariots.

fresh_translation: And your daughters he will take as perfumers and cooks and bakers.
brenton_translation: And he will take your daughters to be perfumers, and cooks, and bakers.

fresh_translation: And your fields and your vineyards and your good olive groves he will take and give to his servants.
brenton_translation: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your good oliveyards, and give them to his servants.

fresh_translation: And your seeds and your vineyards he will tithe and give to his eunuchs and to his servants.
brenton_translation: And he will take the tithe of your seeds and your vineyards, and give it to his eunuchs, and to his servants.

fresh_translation: And your male servants and your female servants and your good cattle and your donkeys he will take and tithe for his works.
brenton_translation: And he will take your servants, and your handmaids, and your good herds and your asses, and will take the tenth of them for his works.

fresh_translation: And your flocks he will tithe, and you will be his servants.
brenton_translation: And he will tithe your flocks; and ye shall be his servants.

fresh_translation: And you will cry out in that day because of your king whom you chose for yourselves, and the Lord will not listen to you in those days, because you chose a king for yourselves.
brenton_translation: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king whom ye have chosen to yourselves, and the Lord shall not hear you in those days, because ye have chosen to yourselves a king.

fresh_translation: And the people was not willing to hear Samuel, and they said to him, No, but a king shall be over us.
brenton_translation: But the people would not hearken to Samuel; and they said to him, Nay, but there shall be a king over us.

fresh_translation: And we also will be like all the nations, and our king will judge us and go out before us and fight our war.
brenton_translation: And we also will be like all the nations; and our king shall judge us, and shall go out before us, and fight our battles.

fresh_translation: And Samuel heard all the words of the people and spoke them into the ears of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and spoke them in the ears of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Samuel, Hear their voice and make a king reign over them. And Samuel said to the men of Israel, Let each man run back to his city.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Samuel, Hearken to their voice, and appoint them a king. And Samuel said to the men of Israel, Let each man depart to his city.

fresh_translation: And there was a man from the sons of Benjamin, and his name was Kish, son of Abiel, son of Zeror, son of Bechorath, son of Aphek, son of a Benjamite man, a mighty man.
brenton_translation: And there was a man of the sons of Benjamin, and his name was Kis, the son of Abiel, the son of Jared, the son of Bachir, the son of Aphec, the son of a Benjamite, a man of might.

fresh_translation: And he had a son, and his name was Saul, a well-grown good man, and there was not among the sons of Israel a better man than he; from his shoulders and above he was taller than all the people.
brenton_translation: And this man had a son, and his name was Saul, of great stature, a goodly man; and there was not among the sons of Israel a goodlier than he, high above all the people from his shoulders and upward.

fresh_translation: And the donkeys of Kish, father of Saul, were lost, and Kish said to Saul his son, Take with yourself one of the young men, rise, and go seek the donkeys.
brenton_translation: And the asses of Kis the father of Saul were lost; and Kis said to Saul his son, Take with thee one of the young men, and arise ye, and go and seek the asses.

fresh_translation: And they passed through the hill-country of Ephraim, and they passed through the land of Salcah and did not find them, and they passed through the land of Shaalim and it was not there, and they passed through the land of Jakim and did not find them.
brenton_translation: And they went through mount Ephraim, and they went through the land of Selcha, and found them not: and they passed through the land of Segalim, and they were not there: and they passed through the land of Jamin, and found them not.

fresh_translation: When they came into Zuph, Saul said to his young man who was with him, Come, let us turn back, lest my father leave off about the donkeys and be anxious about us.
brenton_translation: And when they came to Siph, then Saul said to his young man that was with him, Come and let us return, lest my father leave the asses, and take care for us.

fresh_translation: And the young man said to him, Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and the man is honored; everything whatever he may speak, when it comes, it will stand. And now let us go there, so he may report to us the road on which we have gone.
brenton_translation: And the young man said to him, Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and the man is of high repute; all that he shall speak will surely come to pass: now then let us go, that he may tell us our way on which we have set out.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to his young man who was with him, And behold, we will go, but what shall we bring to the man of God? Because the breads have failed from our vessels, and there is no more with us to carry in to the man of God. What have we with us?
brenton_translation: And Saul said to his young man that was with him, Lo, then, we will go; but what shall we bring the man of God? for the loaves are spent out of our vessels, and we have nothing more with us that belongs to us to bring to the man of God.

fresh_translation: And the young man answered Saul again and said, Behold, a quarter-shekel of silver has been found in my hand, and I will give it to the man of God, and he will tell us our road.
brenton_translation: And the young man answered Saul again, and said, Behold, there is found in my hand a fourth part of a shekel of silver; and thou shalt give it to the man of God, and he shall tell us our way.

fresh_translation: Formerly in Israel each one used to say these things when going to inquire of God: Come, let us go to the seer, because the people formerly called the prophet the seer.
brenton_translation: Now beforetime in Israel every one in going to enquire of God said, Come and let us go to the seer; for the people beforetime called the prophet, the seer.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to his young man, Good word. Come, let us go. And they went into the city where the man of God was there.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to his servant, Well said, come and let us go: and they went to the city where the man of God was.

fresh_translation: As they were going up the ascent of the city, they found young girls who had come out to draw water, and they say to them, Is the seer here?
brenton_translation: As they went up the ascent to the city, they find damsels come out to draw water, and they say to them, Is the seer here?

fresh_translation: And the girls answered them and say to them, He is; behold, before your face now. For today he has come into the city, because there is a sacrifice today for the people at the high place.
brenton_translation: And the virgins answered them, and they say to them, He is: behold, he is before you: now he is coming to the city, because of the day, for to-day there is a sacrifice for the people in Bama.

fresh_translation: As soon as you enter the city, so you will find him in the city before he goes up to the high place to eat. Because the people certainly will not eat until he enters, because he blesses the sacrifice, and after these things the guests eat. And now go up, because today you will find him.
brenton_translation: As soon as ye shall enter into the city, so shall ye find him in the city, before he goes up to Bama to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes in, for he blesses the sacrifice, and afterwards the guests eat; now then go up, for ye shall find him because of the holiday.

fresh_translation: And they go up to the city. As they were entering into the middle of the city, behold, Samuel came out to meet them, to go up to the high place.
brenton_translation: And they go up to the city; and as they were entering into the midst of the city, behold, Samuel came out to meet them, to go up to Bama.

fresh_translation: And the Lord had uncovered the ear of Samuel one day before Saul came to him, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord uncovered the ear of Samuel one day before Saul came to him, saying,

fresh_translation: About this time tomorrow I will send to you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you will anoint him as a ruler over my people Israel, and he will save my people from the hand of foreigners, because I have looked upon the humiliation of my people, because their cry has come to me.
brenton_translation: At this time to-morrow I will send to thee a man out of the land of Benjamin, and thou shalt anoint him to be ruler over my people Israel, and he shall save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon the humiliation of my people, for their cry is come unto me.

fresh_translation: And Samuel saw Saul, and the Lord answered him, Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you; this one will rule among my people.
brenton_translation: And Samuel looked upon Saul, and the Lord answered him, Behold the man of whom I spoke to thee, This one shall rule over my people.

fresh_translation: And Saul came near to Samuel in the middle of the city and said, Tell me now, where is the house of the seer?
brenton_translation: And Saul drew near to Samuel into the midst of the city, and said, Tell me now which is the house of the seer?

fresh_translation: And Samuel answered Saul and said, I am he. Go up before me to the high place and eat with me today, and I will send you away in the morning, and all the things in your heart I will report to you.
brenton_translation: And Samuel answered Saul, and said, I am he: go up before me to Bama, and eat with me to-day, and I will send thee away in the morning, and I will tell thee all that is in thine heart.

fresh_translation: And concerning your donkeys that were lost three days ago today, do not set your heart on them, because they have been found. And for whom are the beautiful things of Israel? Are they not for you and for your father’s house?
brenton_translation: And concerning thine asses that have been lost now these three days, care not for them, for they are found. And to whom does the excellency of Israel belong? does it not to thee and to thy father's house?

fresh_translation: And Saul answered and said, Am I not son of a Benjamite man, from the least scepter of a tribe of Israel, and my tribe the least from the whole scepter of Benjamin? And why have you spoken to me according to this word?
brenton_translation: And Saul answered and said, Am not I the son of a Benjamite, the least tribe of the people of Israel? and of the least family of the whole tribe of Benjamin? and why hast thou spoken to me according to this word?

fresh_translation: And Samuel took Saul and his young man and brought them into the guest room and set for them a place among the first of those who had been called, about seventy men.
brenton_translation: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them to the inn, and set them there a place among the chief of those that were called, about seventy men.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to the cook, Give me the portion that I gave to you, which I said to you to set beside you.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to the cook, Give me the portion which I gave thee, which I told thee to set by thee.

fresh_translation: And the cook lifted up the haunch and set it before Saul, and Samuel said to Saul, Behold, what has been left over; set it before you and eat, because it has been kept for you for this appointed witness beside the others. And Saul ate with Samuel on that day.
brenton_translation: Now the cook had boiled the shoulder, and he set it before Saul; and Samuel said to Saul, Behold that which is left: set it before thee, and eat; for it is set thee for a testimony in preference to the others; take of it: and Saul ate with Samuel on that day.

fresh_translation: And he came down from the high place into the city, and they spread a bed for Saul on the roof.
brenton_translation: And he went down from Bama into the city; and they prepared a lodging for Saul on the roof, and he lay down.

fresh_translation: And he slept. And it came to be, as dawn was rising, Samuel called Saul on the roof, saying, Rise, and I will send you away. And Saul rose, and both he and Samuel went out.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the morning dawned, that Samuel called Saul on the roof, saying, Rise up, and I will dismiss thee. And Saul arose, and he and Samuel went out.

fresh_translation: As they were going down to the outskirts of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Tell the young man, and let him pass on before us. But you stand like today, and hear the word of God.
brenton_translation: As they went down to a part of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Speak to the young man, and let him pass on before us; and do thou stand as to-day, and hearken to the word of God.

fresh_translation: And Samuel took the flask of oil and poured it on his head and kissed him and said to him, Has not the Lord anointed you as a ruler over his people, over Israel? And you will rule among the people of the Lord, and you will save him from the hand of his enemies round about. And this is the sign to you that the Lord has anointed you over his inheritance as a ruler.
brenton_translation: And Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it on his head, and kissed him, and said to him, Has not the Lord anointed thee for a ruler over his people, over Israel? and thou shalt rule among the people of the Lord, and thou shalt save them out of the hand of their enemies; and this shall be the sign to thee that the Lord has anointed thee for a ruler over his inheritance.

fresh_translation: When you depart from me today, you will find two men by the tombs of Rachel in the border of Benjamin, speaking great things, and they will say to you, The donkeys that you went to seek have been found, and behold, your father has shaken off the matter of the donkeys and is anxious about you, saying, What shall I do concerning my son?
brenton_translation: As soon as thou shalt have departed this day from me, thou shalt find two men by the burial-place of Rachel on the mount of Benjamin, exulting greatly; and they shall say to thee, The asses are found which ye went to seek; and, behold, thy father has given up the matter of the asses, and he is anxious for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?

fresh_translation: And you will pass on from there and beyond, and you will come as far as the oak of Tabor, and you will find there three men going up to God at Bethel, one carrying three kids, one carrying three vessels of breads, and one carrying a skin of wine.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt depart thence, and shalt go beyond that as far as the oak of Thabor, and thou shalt find there three men going up to God to Bæthel, one bearing three kids, and another bearing three vessels of bread, and another bearing a bottle of wine.

fresh_translation: And they will ask you the things of peace, and they will give you two firstfruits of breads, and you will take them from their hand.
brenton_translation: And they shall ask thee how thou doest, and shall give thee two presents of bread, and thou shalt receive them of their hand.

fresh_translation: And after these things you will enter the hill of God, where the station of the foreigners is, there at Zuph the foreigner. And it will be when you enter there into the city, you will meet a chorus of prophets coming down from the high place, and before them harp and tambourine and flute and lyre, and they prophesying.
brenton_translation: And afterward thou shalt go to the hill of God, where is the encampment of the Philistines; there is Nasib the Philistine: and it shall come to pass when ye shall have entered into the city, that thou shalt meet a band of prophets coming down from the Bama; and before them will be lutes, and a drum, and a pipe, and a harp, and they shall prophesy.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord will rush upon you, and you will prophesy with them, and you will be turned into another man.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord shall come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.

fresh_translation: And it will be when these signs come upon you, do everything whatever your hand finds, because God is with you.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when these signs shall come upon thee,—then do thou whatsoever thy hand shall find, because God is with thee.

fresh_translation: And you will go down before me to Gilgal, and behold, I am coming down to you to offer up whole burnt offerings and sacrifices of peace. Seven days you will wait until my coming to you, and I will make known to you what you shall do.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt go down in front of Galgal, and behold, I come down to thee to offer a whole-burnt-offering and peace-offerings: seven days shalt thou wait until I shall come to thee, and I will make known to thee what thou shalt do.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when he turned his shoulder to depart from Samuel, God turned for him another heart, and all these signs came on that day.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he turned his back to depart from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all these signs came to pass in that day.

fresh_translation: And he comes from there to the hill, and behold, a chorus of prophets came opposite him, and the Spirit of God leapt upon him, and he prophesied in their midst.
brenton_translation: And he comes thence to the hill, and behold a band of prophets opposite to him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied in the midst of them.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, all who knew him yesterday and the third day saw, and behold, he was in the midst of the prophets, and each person said to his neighbor, What is this that has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among prophets?
brenton_translation: And all that had known him before came, and saw, and, behold, he was in the midst of the prophets: and the people said every one to his neighbour, What is this that has happened to the son of Kis? is Saul also among the prophets?

fresh_translation: And one of them answered and said, And who is his father? Because of this it became a proverb, Is Saul also among prophets?
brenton_translation: And one of them answered and said, And who is his father? and therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?

fresh_translation: And he finished prophesying and comes to the hill.
brenton_translation: And he ceased prophesying, and comes to the hill.

fresh_translation: And his kinsman said to him and to his young man, Where did you go? And they said, To seek the donkeys, and we saw that they are not there, and we entered to Samuel.
brenton_translation: And his kinsman said to him and to his servant, Whither went ye? and they said, To seek the asses; and we saw that they were lost, and we went in to Samuel.

fresh_translation: And the kinsman said to Saul, Tell me now, what did Samuel say to you?
brenton_translation: And his kinsman said to Saul, Tell me, I pray thee, What did Samuel say to thee?

fresh_translation: And Saul said to his kinsman, He plainly told me that the donkeys have been found. But the word of the kingship he did not tell him.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to his kinsman, He verily told me that the asses were found. But the matter of the kingdom he told him not.

fresh_translation: And Samuel summoned all the people to the Lord at Mizpah,
brenton_translation: And Samuel summoned all the people before the Lord to Massephath.

fresh_translation: and he said to the sons of Israel, Thus says the Lord God of Israel, saying, I brought up the sons of Israel from Egypt, and I delivered you from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt and from all the kingdoms afflicting you.
brenton_translation: And he said to the children of Israel, Thus has the Lord God of Israel spoken, saying, I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, and I rescued you out of the hand of Pharao king of Egypt, and out of all the kingdoms that afflicted you.

fresh_translation: And you today have counted as nothing your God, who himself is your savior from all your evils and afflictions, and you said, No, but you will appoint a king over us. And now stand before the Lord by your scepters and by your tribes.
brenton_translation: And ye have this day rejected God, who is himself your Deliverer out of all your evils and afflictions; and ye said, Nay, but thou shalt set a king over us: and now stand before the Lord according to your tribes, and according to your families.

fresh_translation: And Samuel brought near all the scepters of Israel, and the scepter of Benjamin was taken by lot.
brenton_translation: And Samuel brought nigh all the tribes of Israel, and the tribe of Benjamin is taken by lot.

fresh_translation: And he brings near the scepter of Benjamin by tribes, and the tribe of Matrites is taken by lot. And they bring near the tribe of Matrites by men, and Saul son of Kish was taken by lot. And they sought him, and he was not found.
brenton_translation: And he brings near the tribe of Benjamin by families, and the family of Mattari is taken by lot: and they bring near the family of Mattari, man by man, and Saul the son of Kis is taken; and he sought him, but he was not found.

fresh_translation: And Samuel inquired yet again of the Lord whether the man comes here. And the Lord said, Behold, he is hidden among the baggage.
brenton_translation: And Samuel asked yet again of the Lord, Will the man come hither? and the Lord said, Behold, he is hid among the stuff.

fresh_translation: And they ran and take him from there, and he stood in the midst of the people, and he was taller than all the people from the shoulder and upward.
brenton_translation: And he ran and took him thence, and he set him in the midst of the people; and he was higher than all the people by his shoulders and upwards.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to all the people, Have you seen whom the Lord has chosen for himself, that there is none like him among all of you? And all the people knew and said, Long live the king.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to all the people, Have ye seen whom the Lord has chosen to himself, that there is none like to him among you all? And all the people took notice, and said, Let the king live!

fresh_translation: And Samuel told the people the righteous judgment of the king, and he wrote it in a scroll and set it before the Lord. And Samuel sent away all the people, and each went to his place.
brenton_translation: And Samuel told to the people the manner of the king, and wrote it in a book, and set it before the Lord: and Samuel sent away all the people, and each went to his place.

fresh_translation: And Saul went to his house at Gibeah, and sons of powers whose hearts God had touched went with Saul.
brenton_translation: And Saul departed to his house to Gabaa; and there went with Saul mighty men whose hearts God had touched.

fresh_translation: And pestilent sons said, How will this one save us? And they dishonored him and did not bring him gifts.
brenton_translation: But evil men said, Who is this man that shall save us? and they despised him, and brought him no gifts.

fresh_translation: And it came to be as after a month, Nahash the Ammonite went up and camped against Jabesh Gilead, and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash the Ammonite, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass about a month after this, that Naas the Ammanite went up, and encamped against Jabis Galaad: and all the men of Jabis said to Naas the Ammanite, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.

fresh_translation: And Nahash the Ammonite said to them, On this condition I will make a covenant with you: that I gouge out every right eye of yours, and I will set reproach on Israel.
brenton_translation: And Naas the Ammanite said to them, On these terms will I make a covenant with you, that I should put out all your right eyes, and I will lay a reproach upon Israel.

fresh_translation: And the men of Jabesh say to him, Leave us for seven days, and we will send messengers into every border of Israel. And if there is no one saving us, we will come out to you.
brenton_translation: And the men of Jabis say to him, Allow us seven days, and we will send messengers into all the coasts of Israel: if there should be no one to deliver us, we will come out to you.

fresh_translation: And the messengers come to Gibeah to Saul and speak the words into the ears of the people, and all the people lifted up their voice and wept.
brenton_translation: And the messengers came to Gabaa to Saul, and they speak the words into the ears of the people; and all the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

fresh_translation: And behold, Saul came after the morning from the field, and Saul said, Why is the people weeping? And they recount to him the words of the sons of Jabesh.
brenton_translation: And, behold, Saul came after the early morning out of the field: and Saul said, Why does the people weep? and they tell him the words of the men of Jabis.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord leapt upon Saul as he heard these words, and his anger was greatly kindled against them.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon Saul when he heard these words, and his anger was greatly kindled against them.

fresh_translation: And he took two oxen and cut them in pieces and sent them through every border of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, Whoever is not coming out after Saul and after Samuel, thus they will do to his oxen. And the astonishment of the Lord came upon the people of Israel, and they cried out like one man.
brenton_translation: And he took two cows, and cut them in pieces, and sent them into all the coasts of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, Whoso comes not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall they do to his oxen: and a transport from the Lord came upon the people of Israel, and they came out to battle as one man.

fresh_translation: And he musters them at Bezek on the high place, every man of Israel six hundred thousand, and men of Judah seventy thousand.
brenton_translation: And he reviews them at Bezec in Bama, every man of Israel six hundred thousand, and the men of Juda seventy thousand.

fresh_translation: And he said to the messengers who came, Thus you will say to the men of Jabesh, Tomorrow salvation is for you, when the sun grows warm. And the messengers came into the city and report to the men of Jabesh, and they rejoiced.
brenton_translation: And he said to the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say to the men of Jabis, To-morrow ye shall have deliverance when the sun is hot; and the messengers came to the city, and told the men of Jabis, and they rejoiced.

fresh_translation: And the men of Jabesh said to Nahash the Ammonite, Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you may do to us what is good in your sight.
brenton_translation: And the men of Jabis said to Naas the Ammanite, To-morrow we will come forth to you, and ye shall do to us what seems good in your sight.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the next day that Saul set the people in three heads, and they entered the middle of the camp in the morning watch and were striking the sons of Ammon until the day grew warm. And the ones left were scattered, and not two among them were left together.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Saul divided the people into three companies, and they go into the midst of the camp in the morning watch, and they smote the children of Ammon until the day was hot; and it came to pass that those who were left were scattered, and there were not left among them two together.

fresh_translation: And the people said to Samuel, Who is the one who said, Shall Saul not reign over us? Hand over the men, and we will put them to death.
brenton_translation: And the people said to Samuel, Who has said that Saul shall not reign over us? Give up the men, and we will put them to death.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, No one will be put to death on this day, because today the Lord has worked salvation in Israel.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, No man shall die this day, for to-day the Lord has wrought deliverance in Israel.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to the people, saying, Let us go to Gilgal, and let us renew the kingship there.
brenton_translation: And Samuel spoke to the people, saying, Let us go to Galgala, and there renew the kingdom.

fresh_translation: And all the people went to Gilgal, and Samuel anointed Saul there as king before the Lord in Gilgal, and he sacrificed there sacrifices, even peaceful ones, before the Lord. And Samuel and all Israel rejoiced there very greatly.
brenton_translation: And all the people went to Galgala, and Samuel anointed Saul there to be king before the Lord in Galgala, and there he offered meat-offerings and peace-offerings before the Lord: and Samuel and all Israel rejoiced exceedingly.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to every man of Israel, Behold, I have listened to your voice in everything whatever you said to me, and I made a king reign over you.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened to your voice in all things that ye have said to me, and I have set a king over you.

fresh_translation: And now behold, the king goes before you, and I have grown old and will sit, and behold, my sons are among you, and behold, I have gone before you from my youth until this day.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, the king goes before you; and I am grown old and shall rest; and, behold, my sons are among you; and, behold, I have gone about before you from my youth to this day.

fresh_translation: Behold me. Answer against me before the Lord and before his anointed. Whose calf have I taken, or whose donkey have I taken, or whom of you have I oppressed, or whom have I crushed, or from whose hand have I taken a propitiation, even sandals? Answer against me, and I will restore it to you.
brenton_translation: Behold, here am I, answer against me before the Lord and before his anointed: whose calf have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom of you have I oppressed? or whom have I been violent with? or from whose hand have I taken a bribe, even to a sandal? bear witness against me, and I will make restitution to you.

fresh_translation: And they said to Samuel, You have not wronged us, and you have not oppressed us, and you have not crushed us, and you have not taken anything from the hand of anyone.
brenton_translation: And they said to Samuel, Thou hast not injured us, and thou hast not oppressed us; and thou hast not afflicted us, and thou hast not taken anything from any one's hand.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to the people, The Lord is witness among you, and his anointed is witness today in this day, that you have not found anything in my hand. And they said, Witness.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to the people, The Lord is witness among you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found anything in my hand: and they said, He is witness.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to the people, saying, The Lord is witness, the one who made Moses and Aaron, the one who brought our fathers up from Egypt.
brenton_translation: And Samuel spoke to the people, saying, The Lord who appointed Moses and Aaron is witness, who brought our fathers up out of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And now stand, and I will judge you before the Lord, and I will recount to you all the righteousness of the Lord, what things he did among you and among your fathers.
brenton_translation: And now stand still, and I will judge you before the Lord; and I will relate to you all the righteousness of the Lord, the things which he has wrought among you and your fathers.

fresh_translation: When Jacob and his sons entered into Egypt, and Egypt humbled them, our fathers cried out to the Lord, and the Lord sent Moses and Aaron and brought our fathers out of Egypt and settled them in this place.
brenton_translation: When Jacob and his sons went into Egypt, and Egypt humbled them, then our fathers cried to the Lord, and the Lord sent Moses and Aaron; and they brought our fathers out of Egypt, and he made them to dwell in this place.

fresh_translation: And they forgot the Lord their God, and he sold them into the hands of Sisera, commander of the army of Iabin king of Hazor, and into the hands of foreigners, and into the hands of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.
brenton_translation: And they forgot the Lord their God, and he sold them into the hands of Sisara captain of the host of Jabis king of Asor, and into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the king of Moab; and he fought with them.

fresh_translation: And they cried out to the Lord and said, We have sinned, because we abandoned the Lord and served the Baals and the groves, and now deliver us from the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.
brenton_translation: And they cried to the Lord, and said, We have sinned, for we have forsaken the Lord, and have served Baalim and the groves: and now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.

fresh_translation: And the Lord sent Jerubbaal and Barak and Jephthah and Samuel, and he delivered you from the hand of your enemies round about, and you lived trusting.
brenton_translation: And he sent Jerobaal, and Barac, and Jephthae, and Samuel, and rescued us out of the hand of our enemies round about, and ye dwelt in security.

fresh_translation: And you saw that Nahash king of the sons of Ammon came against you, and you said, No, but a king will reign over us, though the Lord your God is your king.
brenton_translation: And ye saw that Naas king of the children of Ammon came against you, and ye said, Nay, none but a king shall reign over us; whereas the Lord our God is our king.

fresh_translation: And now behold the king whom you chose, and behold, the Lord has given a king over you.
brenton_translation: And now behold the king whom ye have chosen; and behold, the Lord has set a king over you.

fresh_translation: If you fear the Lord and serve him and hear his voice and do not rebel against the mouth of the Lord, then both you and the king who reigns over you will be going after the Lord.
brenton_translation: If ye should fear the Lord, and serve him, and hearken to his voice, and not resist the mouth of the Lord, and ye and your king that reigns over you should follow the Lord, well.

fresh_translation: But if you do not hear the voice of the Lord and you rebel against the mouth of the Lord, then the hand of the Lord will be upon you and upon your king.
brenton_translation: But if ye should not hearken to the voice of the Lord, and ye should resist the mouth of the Lord, then shall the hand of the Lord be upon you and upon your king.

fresh_translation: And now stand and see this great thing, which the Lord will do before your eyes.
brenton_translation: And now stand still, and see this great thing, which the Lord will do before your eyes.

fresh_translation: Is it not wheat harvest today? I will call upon the Lord, and he will give voices and rain, and know and see that your evil is great, which you did before the Lord, asking a king for yourselves.
brenton_translation: Is it not wheat-harvest to-day? I will call upon the Lord, and he shall send thunder and rain; and know ye and see, that your wickedness is great which ye have wrought before the Lord, having asked for yourselves a king.

fresh_translation: And Samuel called upon the Lord, and the Lord gave voices and rain on that day, and all the people greatly feared the Lord and Samuel.
brenton_translation: And Samuel called upon the Lord, and the Lord sent thunders and rain in that day; and all the people feared greatly the Lord and Samuel.

fresh_translation: And all the people said to Samuel, Pray concerning your servants to the Lord your God, and let us not die, because we have added to all our sins this evil, asking a king for ourselves.
brenton_translation: And all the people said to Samuel, Pray for thy servants to the Lord thy God, and let us not die; for we have added to all our sins this iniquity, in asking for us a king.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to the people, Do not fear. You have done all this evil; only do not turn aside from behind the Lord, and serve the Lord with your whole heart.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to the people, Fear not: ye have indeed wrought all this iniquity; only turn not from following the Lord, and serve the Lord with all your heart.

fresh_translation: And do not turn aside after the things that are not, which will accomplish nothing and will not deliver, because they are nothing.
brenton_translation: And turn not aside after the gods that are nothing, who will do nothing, and will not deliver you, because they are nothing.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord will not thrust away his people, on account of his great name, because the Lord was pleased to take you to himself for a people.
brenton_translation: For the Lord will not cast off his people for his great name's sake, because the Lord graciously took you to himself for a people.

fresh_translation: And as for me, far be it from me to sin against the Lord by ceasing to pray concerning you, and I will serve the Lord and show you the good and straight way.
brenton_translation: And far be it from me to sin against the Lord in ceasing to pray for you: but I will serve the Lord, and shew you the good and the right way.

fresh_translation: Only fear the Lord and serve him in truth and with your whole heart, because you have seen what things he magnified with you.
brenton_translation: Only fear the Lord, and serve him in truth and with all your heart, for ye see what great things he has wrought with you.

fresh_translation: But if you do evil in doing evil, both you and your king will be swept away.
brenton_translation: But if ye continue to do evil, then shall ye and your king be consumed.

fresh_translation: And Saul chose for himself three thousand men from the men of Israel, and two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and on the hill of Bethel, and one thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin, and the rest of the people he sent away, each to his tent.
brenton_translation: And Saul chooses for himself three thousand men of the men of Israel: and there were with Saul two thousand who were in Machmas, and in mount Bæthel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gabaa of Benjamin: and he sent the rest of the people every man to his tent.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan struck the foreign garrison on the hill, and the foreigners heard, and Saul blew the trumpet through all the land, saying, The slaves have revolted.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan smote Nasib the Philistine that dwelt in the hill; and the Philistines hear of it, and Saul sounds the trumpet through all the land, saying, The servants have despised us.

fresh_translation: And all Israel heard those saying, Saul has struck the foreign garrison, and Israel has become odious among the foreigners. And the people cried out after Saul in Gilgal.
brenton_translation: And all Israel heard say, Saul has smitten Nasib the Philistine; now Israel had been put to shame before the Philistines; and the children of Israel went up after Saul in Galgala.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners gather for war against Israel, and they come up against Israel with thirty thousand chariots and six thousand horsemen and people like the sand beside the sea in multitude. And they come up and camp in Michmash, opposite Bethhoron toward the south.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines gather together to war with Israel; and then come up against Israel thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand by the seashore for multitude: and they come up, and encamp in Machmas, opposite Bæthoron southward.

fresh_translation: And each man of Israel saw that he was in a narrow place, that no one could come near him, and the people hid in the caves and in the folds and in the rocks and in the pits and in the cisterns.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait so that they could not draw nigh, and the people hid themselves in caves, and sheepfolds, and rocks, and ditches, and pits.

fresh_translation: And the ones crossing over crossed the Jordan into the land of Gad and Gilead. And Saul was still in Gilgal, and all the people stood outside themselves after him.
brenton_translation: And they that went over went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Galaad: and Saul was yet in Galgala, and all the people followed after him in amazement.

fresh_translation: And he waited seven days for the testimony, as Samuel said, and Samuel did not arrive in Gilgal, and his people were scattered from him.
brenton_translation: And he continued seven days for the appointed testimony, as Samuel told him, and Samuel came not to Galgala, and his people were dispersed from him.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, Bring near, so I may offer whole burnt offerings and peace offerings. And he offered the whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, Bring hither victims, that I may offer whole-burnt-offerings and peace-offerings: and he offered the whole-burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, as he finished offering the whole burnt offering, Samuel arrives, and Saul went out to meet him, to bless him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he had finished offering the whole-burnt-offering, that Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to meet him, and to bless him.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said, What have you done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and you did not come as you ordered in the testimony of the days, and the foreigners were gathered in Michmash,
brenton_translation: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? and Saul said, Because I saw how the people were scattered from me, and thou wast not present as thou purposedst according to the set time of the days, and the Philistines were gathered to Machmas.

fresh_translation: I said, Now the foreigners will come down against me to Gilgal, and I have not entreated the face of the Lord. And I forced myself and offered the whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: Then I said, Now will the Philistines come down to me to Galgala, and I have not sought the face of the Lord: so I forced myself and offered the whole-burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to Saul, It has been made foolish for you, because you did not keep the commandment that the Lord commanded you. For now the Lord would have prepared your kingdom over Israel forever.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly; for thou hast not kept my command, which the Lord commanded thee, as now the Lord would have confirmed thy kingdom over Israel for ever.

fresh_translation: And now your kingdom will not stand, and the Lord will seek for himself a man according to his heart, and the Lord will appoint him as a ruler over his people, because you did not keep what the Lord commanded you.
brenton_translation: But now thy kingdom shall not stand to thee, and the Lord shall seek for himself a man after his own heart; and the Lord shall appoint him to be a ruler over his people, because thou hast not kept all that the Lord commanded thee.

fresh_translation: And Samuel rose and went away from Gilgal on his road, and the remnant of the people went up after Saul to meet their fighting people, from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul mustered the people found with him, about six hundred men.
brenton_translation: And Samuel arose, and departed from Galgala, and the remnant of the people went after Saul to meet him after the men of war, when they had come out of Galgala to Gabaa of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were found with him, about six hundred men.

fresh_translation: And Saul and Jonathan his son and the people found with them were staying in Gibeah of Benjamin and were weeping, and the foreigners had camped in Michmash.
brenton_translation: And Saul and Jonathan his son, and the people that were found with them, halted in Gabaa of Benjamin; and they wept: and the Philistines had encamped in Machmas.

fresh_translation: And the destroyer came out from the camp of the foreigners in three companies. The one company looked toward the road of Ophrah, toward the land of Shual.
brenton_translation: And men came forth to destroy out of the land of the Philistines in three companies; one company turning by the way of Gophera toward the land of Sogal,

fresh_translation: And one company looked toward the road of Bethhoron, and one company looked toward the road of Gibeah that bends down toward the land of Sabin.
brenton_translation: and another company turning the way of Bæthoron, and another company turning by the way of Gabae that turns aside to Gai of Sabim.

fresh_translation: And a smith of iron was not found in all the land of Israel, because the foreigners said, Lest the Hebrews make sword or spear.
brenton_translation: And there was not found a smith in all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make themselves sword or spear.

fresh_translation: And all Israel used to go down into the land of the foreigners for each one to forge his reaping tool and his implement and each one his axe and his sickle.
brenton_translation: And all Israel went down to the land of the Philistines to forge every one his reaping-hook and his tool, and every one his axe and his sickle.

fresh_translation: And the harvest was ready for reaping, and the implements were at three shekels for the tooth, and for the axe and for the sickle the charge was the same.
brenton_translation: And it was near the time of vintage: and their tools were valued at three shekels for a ploughshare, and there was the same rate for the axe and the sickle.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the days of the war at Michmash, sword and spear were not found in the hand of any of the people with Saul and with Jonathan, but they were found for Saul and for Jonathan his son.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the days of the war of Machmas, that there was not a sword or spear found in the hand of all the people, that were with Saul and Jonathan; but with Saul and Jonathan his son was there found.

fresh_translation: And the station of the foreigners came out to the region beyond Michmash.
brenton_translation: And there went out some from the camp of the Philistines to the place beyond Machmas.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on a day, Jonathan son of Saul said to the young man carrying his equipment, Come, and let us cross over to the station of the foreigners that is over there beyond. But to his father he did not report it.
brenton_translation: And when a certain day arrived, Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man that bore his armour, Come, and let us go over to Messab of the Philistines that is on the other side yonder; but he told not his father.

fresh_translation: And Saul was sitting on the edge of the hill under the pomegranate tree in Migron, and about six hundred men were with him.
brenton_translation: And Saul sat on the top of the hill under the pomegranate tree that is in Magdon, and there were with him about six hundred men.

fresh_translation: And Ahijah son of Ahitub, brother of Ichabod, son of Phinehas, son of Eli, priest of God in Shiloh, was carrying an ephod. And the people did not know that Jonathan had gone.
brenton_translation: And Achia son of Achitob, the brother of Jochabed the son of Phinees, the son of Heli, was the priest of God in Selom wearing an ephod: and the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.

fresh_translation: And between the passage where Jonathan was seeking to cross over to the station of the foreigners, there was a rocky spur on this side and a rocky spur on that side. The name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Zenan.
brenton_translation: And in the midst of the passage whereby Jonathan sought to pass over to the encampment of the Philistines, there was both a sharp rock on this side, and a sharp rock on the other side: the name of the one was Bases, and the name of the other Senna.

fresh_translation: The one road was northward, toward Michmash, and the other southward, toward Gibeah.
brenton_translation: The one way was northward to one coming to Machmas, and the other way was southward to one coming to Gabae.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan said to the young man carrying his equipment, Come, let us cross over to the station of these uncircumcised ones; perhaps the Lord may act for us, because for the Lord there is no restraint to save by many or by few.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan said to the young man that bore his armour, Come, let us go over to Messab of these uncircumcised, if peradventure the Lord may do something for us; for the Lord is not straitened to save by many or by few.

fresh_translation: And the one carrying his equipment said to him, Do everything whatever your heart inclines. Behold, I am with you; as your heart, my heart.
brenton_translation: And his armour-bearer said to him, Do all that thine heart inclines toward: behold, I am with thee, my heart is as thy heart.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan said, Behold, we are crossing over to the men, and we will roll ourselves down to them.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan said, Behold, we will go over to the men, and will come down suddenly upon them.

fresh_translation: If they say these things to us, Stand there until we report to you, then we will stand in our place and certainly will not go up against them.
brenton_translation: If they should say thus to us, Stand aloof there until we shall send you word; then we will stand still by ourselves, and will not go up against them.

fresh_translation: But if they say these things to us, Come up to us, then we will go up, because the Lord has delivered them into our hands. This will be the sign for us.
brenton_translation: But if they should say thus to us, Come up to us; then will we go up, for the Lord has delivered them into our hands; this shall be a sign to us.

fresh_translation: And both entered into the station of the foreigners, and the foreigners say, Behold, the Hebrews are coming out from their holes where they had hidden there.
brenton_translation: And they both went in to Messab of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of their caves, where they had hidden themselves.

fresh_translation: And the men of the station answered Jonathan and the one carrying his equipment and say, Come up to us, and we will make a word known to you. And Jonathan said to the one carrying his equipment, Come up after me, because the Lord has delivered them into the hands of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the men of Messab answered Jonathan and his armour-bearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing: and Jonathan said to his armour-bearer, Come up after me, for the Lord has delivered them into the hands of Israel.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan went up on his hands and on his feet, and the one carrying his equipment after him. And they looked into the face of Jonathan, and he struck them down, and the one carrying his equipment kept finishing them off behind him.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan went up on his hands and feet, and his armour-bearer with him; and they looked on the face of Jonathan, and he smote them, and his armour-bearer did smite them after him.

fresh_translation: And the first blow that Jonathan and the one carrying his equipment struck was about twenty men, with darts and sling-stones and field-pebbles.
brenton_translation: And the first slaughter which Jonathan and his armour-bearer effected was twenty men, with darts and slings, and pebbles of the field.

fresh_translation: And there was astonishment in the camp and in the field, and all the people in the station and the destroyers stood outside themselves, and they themselves were not willing to act, and the earth was amazed, and there was astonishment from the Lord.
brenton_translation: And there was dismay in the camp, and in the field; and all the people in Messab, and the spoilers were amazed; and they would not act, and the land was terror-struck, and there was dismay from the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin saw, and behold, the camp was troubled here and there.
brenton_translation: And the watchmen of Saul beheld in Gabaa of Benjamin, and, behold, the army was thrown into confusion on every side.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to the people with him, Muster now and see who has gone out from you. And they mustered, and behold, Jonathan and the one carrying his equipment were not found.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to the people with him, Number yourselves now, and see who has gone out from you: and they numbered themselves, and behold, Jonathan and his armour-bearer were not found.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to Ahijah, Bring the ephod near, because he was carrying the ephod on that day before Israel.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to Achia, Bring the ephod; for he wore the ephod in that day before Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, as Saul was speaking to the priest, the sound in the camp of the foreigners kept going and increasing. And Saul said to the priest, Gather in your hands.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass while Saul was speaking to the priest, that the sound in the camp of the Philistines continued to increase greatly; and Saul said to the priest, Withdraw thy hands.

fresh_translation: And Saul cried out, and all the people with him, and they came as far as the battle, and behold, the sword of each man came against his neighbor, a very great confusion.
brenton_translation: And Saul went up and all the people that were with him, and they come to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his neighbour, a very great confusion.

fresh_translation: And the slaves who were with the foreigners yesterday and the third day, who had gone up into the camp, they also turned to be with Israel, those with Saul and Jonathan.
brenton_translation: And the servants who had been before with the Philistines, who had gone up to the army, turned themselves also to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

fresh_translation: And all Israel, the ones hiding in the hill-country of Ephraim, heard that the foreigners had fled, and they also joined after them in the battle.
brenton_translation: And all the Israelites who were hidden in mount Ephraim heard also that the Philistines fled; and they also gather themselves after them to battle: and the Lord saved Israel in that day; and the war passed through Bamoth; and all the people with Saul were about ten thousand men.

fresh_translation: And the Lord saved Israel on that day, and the battle passed through Bethhoron, and all the people with Saul were about ten thousand men, and the battle was scattered through the whole city in the hill-country of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And the battle extended itself to every city in the mount Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And Saul committed a great ignorance on that day, and he bound the people under oath, saying, Cursed is the man who eats bread until evening, until I take vengeance on my enemy. And none of the people tasted bread.
brenton_translation: And Saul committed a great trespass of ignorance in that day, and he lays a curse on the people, saying, Cursed is the man who shall eat bread before the evening; so I will avenge myself on my enemy: and none of the people tasted bread, though all the land was dining.

fresh_translation: And all the land came into a wooded forest, and there was a honeycomb on the face of the field.
brenton_translation: And Jaal was a wood abounding in swarms of bees on the face of the ground.

fresh_translation: And the people entered into the honey-place, and behold, honey was going along, and there was no one turning his hand to his mouth, because the people feared the oath of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the people went into the place of the bees, and, behold, they continued speaking; and, behold, there was none that put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan had not heard when his father put the people under oath, and he stretched out the tip of his staff that was in his hand and dipped it into the comb of the honey and turned his hand to his mouth, and his eyes looked up.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan had not heard when his father adjured the people; and he reached forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and dipped it into the honeycomb, and returned his hand to his mouth, and his eyes recovered their sight.

fresh_translation: And one from the people answered and said, Your father bound the people with an oath, saying, Cursed is the man who eats bread today, and the people grew faint.
brenton_translation: And one of the people answered and said, Thy father solemnly adjured the people, saying, Cursed is the man who shall eat bread to-day. And the people were very faint,

fresh_translation: And Jonathan understood and said, My father has troubled the land. See now that my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.
brenton_translation: and Jonathan knew it, and said, My father has destroyed the land: see how my eyes have received sight now that I have tasted a little of this honey.

fresh_translation: How much more, if the people today had eaten from the spoil of their enemies that they found. For now the blow among the foreigners would have been greater.
brenton_translation: Surely if the people had this day eaten freely of the spoils of their enemies which they found, the slaughter among the Philistines would have been greater.

fresh_translation: And on that day he struck down the foreigners from Michmash, and the people grew very weary.
brenton_translation: And on that day he smote some of the Philistines in Machmas; and the people were very weary.

fresh_translation: And the people turned aside to the spoil, and the people took flocks and cattle and calves of oxen and slaughtered them on the ground, and the people were eating with the blood.
brenton_translation: And the people turned to the spoil; and the people took flocks, and herds, and calves, and slew them on the ground, and the people ate with the blood.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Saul, saying, The people have sinned against the Lord by eating with the blood. And he said, In Getthaim, roll to me a great stone here.
brenton_translation: And it was reported to Saul, saying, The people have sinned against the Lord, eating with the blood: and Saul said, Out of Getthaim roll a great stone to me hither.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, Scatter among the people and tell them to bring here, each his calf and each his sheep, and let him slaughter on this and not sin against the Lord by eating with the blood. And all the people brought near, each the thing in his hand, and they slaughtered there.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and tell them to bring hither every one his calf, and every one his sheep: and let them slay it on this stone and sin not against the Lord in eating with the blood: and the people brought each one that which was in his hand, and they slew them there.

fresh_translation: And Saul built there an altar to the Lord. This was what Saul began to build as an altar to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Saul built an altar there to the Lord: this was the first altar that Saul built to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, Let us go down after the foreigners by night and plunder among them until the day gives light, and let us not leave a man among them. And they said, Do everything good in your sight. And the priest said, Let us come near to God here.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines this night, and let us plunder among them till the day break, and let us not leave a man among them. And they said, Do all that is good in thy sight: and the priest said, Let us draw nigh hither to God.

fresh_translation: And Saul inquired of God, Shall I go down after the foreigners? Will you deliver them into the hands of Israel? And he did not answer him on that day.
brenton_translation: And Saul enquired of God, If I go down after the Philistines, wilt thou deliver them into the hands of Israel? And he answered him not in that day.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, Bring near here all the corners of Israel, and know and see in what this sin has happened today.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, Bring hither all the chiefs of Israel, and know and see by whom this sin has been committed this day.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord lives, who saved Israel, that if it is found in Jonathan my son, he will surely die. And there was not one answering from all the people.
brenton_translation: For as the Lord lives who has saved Israel, if answer should be against my son Jonathan, he shall surely die. And there was no one that answered out of all the people.

fresh_translation: And he said to all Israel, You will be for one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be for one side. And the people said to Saul, Do what is good in your sight.
brenton_translation: And he said to all the men of Israel, Ye shall be under subjection, and I and Jonathan my son will be under subjection: and the people said to Saul, Do that which is good in thy sight.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, Lord God of Israel, why have you not answered your servant today? If the wrong is in me or in Jonathan my son, Lord God of Israel, give clear signs; and if thus you say, In your people Israel, give holiness. And Jonathan and Saul were taken by lot, and the people went out.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, O Lord God of Israel, why hast thou not answered thy servant this day? is the iniquity in me, or in Jonathan my son? Lord God of Israel, give clear manifestations; and if the lot should declare this, give, I pray thee, to thy people Israel, give, I pray, holiness. And Jonathan and Saul are taken, and the people escaped.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, Cast lot between me and between Jonathan my son; whomever the Lord may take by lot, let him die. And the people said to Saul, This word is not right. But Saul prevailed over the people, and they cast lot between him and between Jonathan his son, and Jonathan was taken by lot.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and my son Jonathan: whomsoever the Lord shall cause to be taken by lot, let him die: and the people said to Saul, This thing is not to be done: and Saul prevailed against the people, and they cast lots between him and Jonathan his son, and Jonathan is taken by lot.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what you have done. And Jonathan told him and said, Tasting, I tasted a little honey on the tip of the staff that was in my hand. Behold, I am dying.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done: and Jonathan told him, and said, I did indeed taste a little honey, with the end of my staff that was in my hand, and, lo! I am to die.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to him, Thus may God do to me and thus may he add, because you will surely die today.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to him, God do so to me, and more also, thou shalt surely die to-day.

fresh_translation: And the people said to Saul, Will the one who worked this great salvation in Israel be put to death today? The Lord lives, if a hair of his head will fall to the ground, because he worked with the people of God on this day. And the people prayed for Jonathan on that day, and he did not die.
brenton_translation: And the people said to Saul, Shall he that has wrought this great salvation in Israel be put to death this day? As the Lord lives, there shall not fall to the ground one of the hairs of his head; for the people of God have wrought successfully this day. And the people prayed for Jonathan in that day, and he died not.

fresh_translation: And Saul went up from after the foreigners, and the foreigners went away to their place.
brenton_translation: And Saul went up from following the Philistines; and the Philistines departed to their place.

fresh_translation: And Saul took up rule over Israel and fought all his enemies round about, against Moab and against the sons of Ammon and against the sons of Edom and against the kings of Zobah and against the foreigners. Wherever he turned, he was being saved.
brenton_translation: And Saul received the kingdom, by lot he inherits the office of ruling over Israel: and he fought against all his enemies round about, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against the children of Edom, and against Bæthæor, and against the king of Suba, and against the Philistines: whithersoever he turned, he was victorious.

fresh_translation: And he worked might and struck Amalek and delivered Israel from the hand of those trampling him.
brenton_translation: And he wrought valiantly, and smote Amalec, and rescued Israel out of the hand of them that trampled on him.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Saul were Jonathan and Ishui and Melchishua, and the names of his two daughters: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the second Michal.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Jessiu, and Melchisa: and these were the names of his two daughters, the name of the first-born Merob, and the name of the second Melchol.

fresh_translation: And the name of his wife was Ahinoam, daughter of Ahimaaz, and the name of the commander of his army was Abner, son of Ner, son of a kinsman of Saul.
brenton_translation: And the name of his wife was Achinoom, the daughter of Achimaa: and the name of his captain of the host was Abenner, the son of Ner, son of a kinsman of Saul.

fresh_translation: And Kish, father of Saul, and Ner, father of Abner, were sons of Jamin, son of Abiel.
brenton_translation: And Kis was the father of Saul, and Ner, the father of Abenner, was son of Jamin, son of Abiel.

fresh_translation: And the war against the foreigners was fierce all the days of Saul, and when Saul saw every mighty man and every man a son of strength, he gathered them to himself.
brenton_translation: And the war was vehement against the Philistines all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any mighty man, and any valiant man, then he took them to himself.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to Saul, The Lord sent me to anoint you as king over Israel, and now hear the voice of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to Saul, The Lord sent me to anoint thee king over Israel: and now hear the voice of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord of hosts, Now I will avenge what Amalek did to Israel, how he met him on the road when he was coming up out of Egypt.
brenton_translation: Thus said the Lord of hosts, Now will I take vengeance for what Amalec did to Israel, when he met him in the way as he came up out of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And now go, and you will strike Amalek and devote all that is his, and you will not preserve anything from him, and you will utterly destroy him and devote him and all his things, and you will not spare from him, and you will kill from man to woman and from infant to one nursing and from calf to sheep and from camel to donkey.
brenton_translation: And now go, and thou shalt smite Amalec and Hierim and all that belongs to him, and thou shalt not save anything of him alive, but thou shalt utterly destroy him: and thou shalt devote him and all his to destruction, and thou shalt spare nothing belonging to him; and thou shalt slay both man and woman, and infant and suckling, and calf and sheep, and camel and ass.

fresh_translation: And Saul gave orders to the people and musters them in Gilgal, four hundred thousand companies, and Judah thirty thousand companies.
brenton_translation: And Saul summoned the people, and he numbered them in Galgala, four hundred thousand regular troops, and Juda thirty thousand regular troops.

fresh_translation: And Saul came as far as the cities of Amalek and lay in ambush in the wadi.
brenton_translation: And Saul came to the cities of Amalec, and laid wait in the valley.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to the Kenites, Go away and turn aside from the midst of Amalek, lest I add you with him, because you worked mercy with the sons of Israel when they were coming up out of Egypt. And the Kenites turned aside from the midst of Amalek.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to the Kinite, Go, and depart out of the midst of the Amalekites, lest I put thee with them; for thou dealedst mercifully with the children of Israel when they went up out of Egypt. So the Kinite departed from the midst of Amalec.

fresh_translation: And Saul struck Amalek from Havilah as far as Shur, in front of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And Saul smote Amalec from Evilat to Sur fronting Egypt.

fresh_translation: And he captured Agag king of Amalek alive, and all the people he killed by the mouth of the sword.
brenton_translation: And he took Agag the king of Amalec alive, and he slew all the people and Hierim with the edge of the sword.

fresh_translation: And Saul and all the people preserved Agag alive and the good things of the flocks and the herds and the foods and the vineyards and all the good things, and they were not willing to destroy them. But every dishonored and worthless thing they destroyed.
brenton_translation: And Saul and all the people saved Agag alive, and the best of the flocks, and of the herds, and of the fruits, of the vineyards, and of all the good things; and they would not destroy them: but every worthless and refuse thing they destroyed.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Samuel, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Samuel, saying,
