fresh_translation: I have been comforted that I made Saul king, because he turned from behind me and did not keep my words. And Samuel was troubled, and he cried out to the Lord all the night.
brenton_translation: I have repented that I have made Saul to be king: for he has turned back from following me, and has not kept my word. And Samuel was grieved, and cried to the Lord all night.

fresh_translation: And Samuel rose early and went to meet Israel in the morning, and it was reported to Samuel, saying, Saul has come to Carmel and has raised a hand for himself and turned the chariot and gone down to Gilgal toward Saul. And behold, he had offered whole burnt offerings to the Lord, the first of the spoil that he brought from Amalek.
brenton_translation: And Samuel rose early and went to meet Israel in the morning, and it was told Saul, saying, Samuel has come to Carmel, and he has raised up help for himself: and he turned his chariot, and came down to Galgala to Saul; and, behold, he was offering up a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord, the chief of the spoils which he brought out of Amalec.

fresh_translation: And Samuel came to Saul, and he said to him, Blessed are you to the Lord. I have established everything whatever the Lord spoke.
brenton_translation: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said to him, Blessed art thou of the Lord: I have performed all that the Lord said.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said, And what is this voice of the flock in my ears, and the voice of cattle that I hear?
brenton_translation: And Samuel said, What then is the bleating of this flock in my ears, and the sound of the oxen which I hear?

fresh_translation: And Saul said, I brought them from Amalek, the things that the people preserved, the strongest of the flock and of the herds, so that they may be sacrificed to the Lord your God, and the rest I destroyed.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, I have brought them out of Amalec, that which the people preserved, even the best of the sheep, and of the cattle, that it might be sacrificed to the Lord thy God, and the rest have I utterly destroyed.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to Saul, Let it be, and I will report to you what the Lord spoke to me in the night. And he said to him, Speak.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the Lord has said to me this night: and he said to him, Say on.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to Saul, Were you not small before him, leader of the scepter of a tribe of Israel? And the Lord anointed you as king over Israel.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to Saul, Art thou not little in his eyes, though a leader of one of the tribes of Israel? and yet the Lord anointed thee to be king over Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord sent you on a road and said to you, Go, and utterly destroy Amalek, the ones sinning against me, and you will fight them until you finish them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord sent thee on a journey, and said to thee, Go, and utterly destroy: thou shalt slay the sinners against me, even the Amalekites; and thou shalt war against them until thou have consumed them.

fresh_translation: And why did you not hear the voice of the Lord, but rushed to set yourself on the spoil and did the evil before the Lord?
brenton_translation: And why didst not thou hearken to the voice of the Lord, but didst haste to fasten upon the spoils, and didst that which was evil in the sight of the Lord?

fresh_translation: And Saul said to Samuel, Because I heard the voice of the people, I went on the road on which the Lord sent me, and I brought Agag king of Amalek, and Amalek I destroyed utterly.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to Samuel, Because I listened to the voice of the people: yet I went the way by which the Lord sent me, and I brought Agag the king of Amalec, and I destroyed Amalec.

fresh_translation: And the people took from the spoil flocks and herds, the first of the devoted destruction, to sacrifice before the Lord our God in Gilgal.
brenton_translation: But the people took of the spoils the best flocks and herds out of that which was destroyed, to sacrifice before the Lord our God in Galgal.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said, Is it acceptable to the Lord, whole burnt offerings and sacrifices, as hearing the voice of the Lord? Behold, hearing is better than sacrifice, and listening than the fat of rams.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said, Does the Lord take pleasure in whole-burnt-offerings and sacrifices, as in hearing the words of the Lord? behold, obedience is better than a good sacrifice, and hearkening than the fat of rams.

fresh_translation: Because sin is divination, and pain and grief bring on teraphim, because you counted the word of the Lord as nothing, and the Lord will count you as nothing from being king over Israel.
brenton_translation: For sin is as divination; idols bring on pain and grief. Because thou hast rejected the word of the Lord, the Lord also shall reject thee from being king over Israel.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to Samuel, I have sinned, because I transgressed the word of the Lord and your saying, because I feared the people and heard their voice.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to Samuel, I have sinned, in that I have transgressed the word of the Lord and thy direction; for I feared the people, and I hearkened to their voice.

fresh_translation: And now take away my sin, and turn back with me, and I will bow down to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And now remove, I pray thee, my sin, and turn back with me, and I will worship the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to Saul, I will not turn back with you, because you counted the word of the Lord as nothing, and the Lord will count you as nothing from being king over Israel.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to Saul, I will not turn back with thee, for thou hast rejected the word of the Lord, and the Lord will reject thee from being king over Israel.

fresh_translation: And Samuel turned his face to go away, and Saul seized the wing of his double cloak and tore it.
brenton_translation: And Samuel turned his face to depart, and Saul caught hold of the skirt of his garment, and tore it.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to him, The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from your hand today and will give it to your neighbor, the good one beyond you.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to him, The Lord has rent thy kingdom from Israel out of thy hand this day, and will give it to thy neighbour who is better than thou.

fresh_translation: And Israel will be divided into two, and he will not turn back, nor will he repent, because he is not like a human, for him to repent.
brenton_translation: And Israel shall be divided to two: and God will not turn nor repent, for he is not as a man to repent.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, I have sinned, but glorify me now before the elders of Israel and before my people, and turn back with me, and I will bow down to the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, I have sinned; yet honour me, I pray thee, before the elders of Israel, and before my people; and turn back with me, and I will worship the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And Samuel turned back after Saul, and he bowed down to the Lord.
brenton_translation: So Samuel turned back after Saul, and he worshipped the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said, Bring near to me Agag king of Amalek. And Agag came to him trembling, and Agag said, Is death thus bitter?
brenton_translation: And Samuel said, Bring me Agag the king of Amalec: and Agag came to him trembling; and Agag said, Is death thus bitter?

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to Agag, As your sword made women childless, so your mother will be made childless among women. And Samuel slaughtered Agag before the Lord in Gilgal.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to Agag, As thy sword has bereaved women of their children, so shall thy mother be made childless among women: and Samuel slew Agag before the Lord in Galgal.

fresh_translation: And Samuel went away to Ramathaim-Zophim, and Saul went up to his house at Gibeah.
brenton_translation: And Samuel departed to Armathaim, and Saul went up to his house at Gabaa.

fresh_translation: And Samuel did not add again to see Saul until the day of his death, because Samuel was mourning for Saul, and the Lord repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.
brenton_translation: And Samuel did not see Saul again till the day of his death, for Samuel mourned after Saul, and the Lord repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Samuel, How long do you mourn over Saul, while I have counted him as nothing from reigning over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and come, I will send you to Jesse in Bethlehem, because I have seen among his sons one for me to reign.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Samuel, How long dost thou mourn for Saul, whereas I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? Fill thy horn with oil, and come, I will send thee to Jessæ, to Bethleem; for I have seen among his sons a king for me.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said, How shall I go? Saul will hear and kill me. And the Lord said, Take a heifer of the cattle in your hand, and you will say, I have come to sacrifice to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said, How can I go? whereas Saul will hear of it, and slay me: and the Lord said, Take a heifer in thine hand and thou shalt say, I am come to sacrifice to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you will call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will make known to you what you shall do, and you will anoint whomever I tell you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt call Jessæ to the sacrifice, and I will make known to thee what thou shalt do; and thou shalt anoint him whom I shall mention to thee.

fresh_translation: And Samuel did everything whatever the Lord spoke to him, and he came to Bethlehem, and the elders of the city stood outside themselves to meet him and said, Seer, is your coming peace?
brenton_translation: And Samuel did all that the Lord told him; and he came to Bethleem: and the elders of the city were amazed at meeting him, and said, Dost thou come peaceably, thou Seer?

fresh_translation: And he said, Peace. I have come to sacrifice to the Lord. Consecrate yourselves and be glad with me today. And he consecrated Jesse and his sons and called them to the sacrifice.
brenton_translation: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice to the Lord. Sanctify yourselves, and rejoice with me this day: and he sanctified Jessæ and his sons, and he called them to the sacrifice.

fresh_translation: And it came to be as they were entering, he saw Eliab and said, Then indeed his anointed is before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when they came in, that he saw Eliab, and said, Surely the Lord's anointed is before him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Samuel, Do not look on his appearance, nor on the condition of his stature, because I have counted him as nothing. For God will not see as a human sees, because a human sees into the face, but God sees into the heart.
brenton_translation: But the Lord said to Samuel, Look not on his appearance, nor on his stature, for I have rejected him; for God sees not as a man looks; for man looks at the outward appearance, but God looks at the heart.

fresh_translation: And Jesse called Amminadab and brought him before Samuel, and he said, Neither has the Lord chosen this one.
brenton_translation: And Jessæ called Aminadab, and he passed before Samuel: and he said, Neither has God chosen this one.

fresh_translation: And Jesse brought Shammah, and he said, Neither in this one has the Lord chosen.
brenton_translation: And Jessæ caused Sama to pass by: and he said, Neither has God chosen this one.

fresh_translation: And Jesse brought his seven sons before Samuel, and Samuel said, The Lord has not chosen among these.
brenton_translation: And Jessæ caused his seven sons to pass before Samuel: and Samuel said, The Lord has not chosen these.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said to Jesse, Have the young men failed? And he said, There is still the small one; behold, he is shepherding among the flock. And Samuel said to Jesse, Send and take him, because we certainly will not recline until he comes here.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said to Jessæ, Hast thou no more sons? And Jessæ said, There is yet a little one; behold, he tends the flock. And Samuel said to Jessæ, Send and fetch him, for we may not sit down till he comes.

fresh_translation: And he sent and brought him in. And he was ruddy, with the beauty of eyes, and good in appearance to the Lord. And the Lord said to Samuel, Rise and anoint David, because this one is good.
brenton_translation: And he sent and fetched him: and he was ruddy, with beauty of eyes, and very goodly to behold. And the Lord said to Samuel, Arise, and anoint David, for he is good.

fresh_translation: And Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the midst of his brothers, and the Spirit of the Lord leapt upon David from that day and beyond. And Samuel rose and went away to Ramathaim-Zophim.
brenton_translation: And Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward: and Samuel arose, and departed to Armathaim.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord was choking him.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord tormented him.

fresh_translation: And the servants of Saul said to him, Behold now, an evil spirit from the Lord is choking you.
brenton_translation: And Saul's servants said to him, Behold now, an evil spirit from the Lord torments thee.

fresh_translation: Let your servants before you speak now, and let them seek for our lord a man knowing how to play on a lyre, and it will be when an evil spirit is upon you, he will play with his lyre, and it will be good for you and will give you rest.
brenton_translation: Let now thy servants speak before thee, and let them seek for our lord a man skilled to play on the harp; and it shall come to pass when an evil spirit comes upon thee and he shall play on his harp, that thou shalt be well, and he shall refresh thee.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to his servants, Find for me now a man playing rightly, and bring him to me.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to his servants, Look now out for me a skilful player, and bring him to me.

fresh_translation: And one of his young men answered and said, Behold, I have seen a son belonging to Jesse the Bethlehemite, and he knows song, and the man is prudent and a warrior and wise in word and good in appearance, and the Lord is with him.
brenton_translation: And one of his servants answered and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jessæ the Bethleemite, and he understands playing on the harp, and the man is prudent, and a warrior, and wise in speech, and the man is handsome, and the Lord is with him.

fresh_translation: And Saul sent messengers to Jesse, saying, Send to me your son David, the one with your flock.
brenton_translation: And Saul sent messengers to Jessæ, saying, Send to me thy son David who is with thy flock.

fresh_translation: And Jesse took a gomor of breads and a skin of wine and one kid of the goats and sent them by the hand of David his son to Saul.
brenton_translation: And Jessæ took a homer of bread, and a bottle of wine, and one kid of the goats, and sent them by the hand of his son David to Saul.

fresh_translation: And David entered to Saul and stood before him, and he loved him greatly, and he became for him the one carrying his equipment.
brenton_translation: And David went in to Saul, and stood before him; and he loved him greatly; and he became his armour-bearer.

fresh_translation: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David now stand before me, because he has found favor in my eyes.
brenton_translation: And Saul sent to Jessæ, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me, for he has found grace in my eyes.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when the evil spirit was upon Saul, David would take the lyre and play with his hand, and Saul would breathe freely, and it became good for him, and the evil spirit departed from him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the evil spirit was upon Saul, that David took his harp, and played with his hand: and Saul was refreshed, and it was well with him, and the evil spirit departed from him.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners gather their camps for war, and they are gathered at Socoh of Judah, and they camp between Socoh and between Azekah in Epheremem.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines gather their armies to battle, and gather themselves to Socchoth of Judæa, and encamp between Socchoth and Azeca Ephermen.

fresh_translation: And Saul and the men of Israel gather and camp in the valley, and they arrange themselves for war opposite the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And Saul and the men of Israel gather together, and they encamp in the valley, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners stood on the mountain here, and Israel stood on the mountain there, and the valley was between them.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines stand on the mountain on one side, and Israel stands on the mountain on the other side, and the valley was between them.

fresh_translation: And a mighty man came out from the battle-line of the foreigners, Goliath was his name, from Gath; his height was four cubits and a span.
brenton_translation: And there went forth a mighty man out of the army of the Philistines, Goliath by name, out of Geth, his height was four cubits and a span.

fresh_translation: And a helmet was on his head, and he was clothed in a chain breastplate, and the weight of his breastplate was five thousand shekels of bronze and iron.
brenton_translation: And he had a helmet upon his head, and he wore a breastplate of chain armour; and the weight of his breastplate was five thousand shekels of brass and iron.

fresh_translation: And bronze greaves were over his legs, and a bronze shield was between his shoulders.
brenton_translation: And greaves of brass were upon his legs, and a brazen target was between his shoulders.

fresh_translation: And the shaft of his spear was like the beam of weavers, and his spearhead was six hundred shekels of iron, and the one carrying his weapons went before him.
brenton_translation: And the staff of his spear was like a weavers' beam, and the spear's head was formed of six hundred shekels of iron; and his armour-bearer went before him.

fresh_translation: And he stood and cried out to the battle-line of Israel and said to them, Why do you come out to array yourselves for battle against us? Am I not a foreigner, and you Hebrews of Saul? Choose for yourselves a man, and let him come down to me.
brenton_translation: And he stood and cried to the army of Israel, and said to them, Why are ye come forth to set yourselves in battle array against us? Am not I a Philistine, and ye Hebrews of Saul? choose for yourselves a man, and let him come down to me.

fresh_translation: And if he is able to fight with me and if he strikes me, we will be your slaves. But if I prevail and strike him, you will be our slaves and serve us.
brenton_translation: And if he shall be able to fight against me, and shall smite me, then will we be your servants: but if I should prevail and smite him, ye shall be our servants, and serve us.

fresh_translation: And the foreigner said, Behold, I have reproached the battle-line of Israel today in this day. Give me a man, and let the two of us fight alone.
brenton_translation: And the Philistine said, Behold, I have defied the armies of Israel this very day: give me a man, and we will both of us fight in single combat.

fresh_translation: And Saul and all Israel heard these words of the foreigner, and they stood outside themselves and feared greatly.
brenton_translation: And Saul and all Israel heard these words of the Philistine, and they were dismayed, and greatly terrified.

fresh_translation: And David said to Saul, Let not the heart of my lord fall upon him. Your servant will go and fight with this foreigner.
brenton_translation: And David said to Saul, Let not, I pray thee, the heart of my lord be dejected within him: thy servant will go, and fight with this Philistine.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to David, You certainly will not be able to go to the foreigner to fight with him, because you are a young boy, and he is a warrior from his youth.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to David, Thou wilt not in anywise be able to go against this Philistine to fight with him, for thou art a mere youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

fresh_translation: And David said to Saul, Your servant was shepherding for his father among the flock, and whenever the lion or the bear came and took a sheep from the herd,
brenton_translation: And David said to Saul, Thy servant was tending the flock for his father; and when a lion came and a she-bear, and took a sheep out of the flock,

fresh_translation: I would go out after it and strike it and snatch it from its mouth. And if it rose up against me, I seized its throat and struck and killed it.
brenton_translation: then I went forth after him, and smote him, and drew the spoil out of his mouth: and as he rose up against me, then I caught hold of his throat, and smote him, and slew him.

fresh_translation: And your servant used to strike both the bear and the lion, and this uncircumcised foreigner will be like one of them. Will I not go and strike him and remove today reproach from Israel? Because who is this uncircumcised one, who has reproached the battle-line of the living God?
brenton_translation: Thy servant smote both the lion and the bear, and the uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them: shall I not go and smite him, and remove this day a reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised one, who has defied the army of the living God?

fresh_translation: The Lord who delivered me from the hand of the lion and from the hand of the bear, he will deliver me from the hand of this uncircumcised foreigner. And Saul said to David, Go, and the Lord will be with you.
brenton_translation: The Lord who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this uncircumcised Philistine. And Saul said to David, Go, and the Lord shall be with thee.

fresh_translation: And Saul clothed David with a cloak and put a bronze helmet around his head.
brenton_translation: And Saul clothed David with a military coat, and put his brazen helmet on his head.

fresh_translation: And David girded on his sword over his cloak and labored to walk once and twice, and David said to Saul, I certainly will not be able to go in these things, because I have not tried them. And they take them off from him.
brenton_translation: And he girt David with his sword over his coat: and he made trial walking with them once and again: and David said to Saul, I shall not be able to go with these, for I have not proved them: so they remove them from him.

fresh_translation: And he took his staff in his hand and chose for himself five smooth stones from the wadi and put them in the shepherd’s pouch that belonged to him for gathering, and his sling was in his hand, and he came near to the foreign man.
brenton_translation: And he took his staff in his hand, and he chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the shepherd's scrip which he had for his store, and his sling was in his hand; and he approached the Philistine.

fresh_translation: And Goliad saw David and dishonored him, because he was a youth, and he was ruddy, with the beauty of eyes.
brenton_translation: And Goliath saw David, and despised him; for he was a lad, and ruddy, with a fair countenance.

fresh_translation: And the foreigner said to David, Am I like a dog, that you come against me with staff and stones? And David said, No, but worse than a dog’s hand. And the foreigner cursed David by his gods.
brenton_translation: And the Philistine said to David, Am I as a dog, that thou comest against me with a staff and stones? [and David said, Nay, but worse than a dog.] And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

fresh_translation: And the foreigner said to David, Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky and to the beasts of the earth.
brenton_translation: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh to the birds of the air, and to the beasts of the earth.

fresh_translation: And David said to the foreigner, You come to me with sword and spear and shield, but I go to you in the name of the Lord of hosts, God of the battle-line of Israel, whom you have reproached today.
brenton_translation: And David said to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with sword, and with spear, and with shield; but I come to thee in the name of the Lord God of hosts of the army of Israel, which thou hast defied

fresh_translation: And the Lord will shut you up into my hand today, and I will kill you and remove your head from you, and I will give your limbs and the limbs of the camp of the foreigners in this day to the birds of the sky and to the beasts of the earth, and all the earth will know that there is a God in Israel.
brenton_translation: this day. And the Lord shall deliver thee this day into my hand; and I will slay thee, and take away thy head from off thee, and will give thy limbs and the limbs of the army of the Philistines this day to the birds of the sky, and to the wild beasts of the earth; and all the earth shall know that there is a God in Israel.

fresh_translation: And all this assembly will know that the Lord does not save with sword and spear, because the battle is the Lord’s, and the Lord will deliver you into our hands.
brenton_translation: And all this assembly shall know that the Lord delivers not by sword or spear, for the battle is the Lord's, and the Lord will deliver you into our hands.

fresh_translation: And the foreigner rose and went to meet David.
brenton_translation: And the Philistine arose and went to meet David.

fresh_translation: And David stretched out his hand into the pouch and took from there one stone and slung it and struck the foreigner on his forehead, and the stone went through the helmet into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the ground.
brenton_translation: And David stretched out his hand to his scrip, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine on his forehead, and the stone penetrated through the helmet into his forehead, and he fell upon his face to the ground.

fresh_translation: And David ran and stood over him and took his sword and killed him and removed his head. And the foreigners saw that their mighty one had died, and they fled.
brenton_translation: And David ran, and stood upon him, and took his sword, and slew him, and cut off his head: and the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, and they fled.

fresh_translation: And the men of Israel and Judah rose and shouted and chased after them as far as the entrance of Gath and as far as the gate of Ashkelon, and wounded men of the foreigners fell on the road of the gates and as far as Gath and as far as Ekron.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel and Juda arose, and shouted and pursued them as far as the entrance to Geth, and as far as the gate of Ascalon: and the slain men of the Philistines fell in the way of the gates, both to Geth, and to Accaron.

fresh_translation: And the men of Israel returned, turning aside from after the foreigners, and they trampled their camps.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel returned from pursuing after the Philistines, and they destroyed their camp.

fresh_translation: And David took the head of the foreigner and brought it into Jerusalem, and his equipment he placed in his tent.
brenton_translation: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.

fresh_translation: And the dancing women came out to meet David from all the cities of Israel with tambourines and with rejoicing and with cymbals.
brenton_translation: And there came out women in dances to meet David out of all the cities of Israel, with timbrels, and with rejoicing, and with cymbals.

fresh_translation: And the women went out and were saying, Saul struck in his thousands, and David in his tens of thousands.
brenton_translation: And the women began the strain, and said, Saul has smitten his thousands, and David his ten thousands.

fresh_translation: And the saying appeared evil in the eyes of Saul because of this word, and he said, To David they gave the tens of thousands, and to me they gave the thousands.
brenton_translation: And it seemed evil in the eyes of Saul concerning this matter, and he said, To David they have given ten thousands, and to me they have given thousands.

fresh_translation: And Saul was looking askance at David from that day and beyond.
And Saul feared from before David.
brenton_translation: And Saul was alarmed on account of David.

fresh_translation: And he removed him from himself and appointed him for himself commander of a thousand, and he went out and came in before the people.
brenton_translation: And he removed him from him, and made him a captain of a thousand for himself; and he went out and came in before the people.

fresh_translation: And David was understanding in all his ways, and the Lord was with him.
brenton_translation: And David was prudent in all his ways, and the Lord was with him.

fresh_translation: And Saul saw that he was understanding exceedingly, and he stood in awe from before him.
brenton_translation: And Saul saw that he was very wise, and he was afraid of him.

fresh_translation: And all Israel and Judah loved David, because he was going out and coming in before the people.
brenton_translation: And all Israel and Juda loved David, because he came in and went out before the people.

fresh_translation: And Michal daughter of Saul loved David, and it was reported to Saul, and it was made straight in his eyes.
brenton_translation: And Melchol the daughter of Saul loved David; and it was told Saul, and the thing was pleasing in his eyes.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, I will give her to him, and she will be to him for a stumbling, and the hand of the foreigners will be against Saul.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, I will give her to him, and she shall be a stumbling-block to him. Now the hand of the Philistines was against Saul.

fresh_translation: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Speak secretly to David, saying, Behold, the king delights in you, and all his servants love you, and you become son-in-law to the king.
brenton_translation: And Saul charged his servants, saying, Speak ye privately to David, saying, Behold, the king delights in thee, and all his servants love thee, and do thou become the king's son-in-law.

fresh_translation: And the servants of Saul spoke these words into the ears of David, and David said, Is it a light thing in your eyes to become son-in-law to a king? And I am a humble man and not honored.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Saul spoke these words in the ears of David; and David said, Is it a light thing in your eyes to become son-in-law to the king? whereas I am an humble man, and not honourable?

fresh_translation: And the servants of Saul reported to him according to these words that David spoke.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Saul reported to him according to these words, which David spoke.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, Thus you will say to David: The king does not desire in a marriage gift, except one hundred foreskins of foreigners, to avenge on the enemies of the king. And Saul thought to cast him into the hands of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, Thus shall ye speak to David, The king wants no gift but a hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to avenge himself on the king's enemies. Now Saul thought to cast him into the hands of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And the servants of Saul report these words to David, and the word was made straight in the eyes of David, to become son-in-law to the king.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Saul report these words to David, and David was well pleased to become the son-in-law to the king.

fresh_translation: And David rose and went, he and his men, and struck among the foreigners one hundred men, and he brought their foreskins to the king, and he became son-in-law to the king, and he gives to him Michal his daughter to be his wife.
brenton_translation: And David arose, and went, he and his men, and smote among the Philistines a hundred men: and he brought their foreskins, and he becomes the king's son-in-law, and Saul gives him Melchol his daughter to wife.

fresh_translation: And Saul saw that the Lord was with David, and all Israel loved him.
brenton_translation: And Saul saw that the Lord was with David, and that all Israel loved him.

fresh_translation: And Saul added still more to stand in awe from before David.
brenton_translation: And he was yet more afraid of David.

fresh_translation: And Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants to put David to death, but Jonathan son of Saul preferred David greatly.
brenton_translation: And Saul spoke to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, to slay David.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan reported to David, saying, Saul seeks to put you to death. Therefore guard yourself tomorrow morning and hide and sit concealed.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan, Saul's son, loved David much: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul seeks to kill thee: take heed to thyself therefore to-morrow morning, and hide thyself, and dwell in secret.

fresh_translation: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are there, and I will speak concerning you to my father, and I will see what there may be, and I will report to you.
brenton_translation: And I will go forth, and stand near my father in the field where thou shalt be, and I will speak concerning thee to my father; and I will see what his answer may be, and I will tell thee.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan spoke good things concerning David to Saul his father and said to him, Let not the king sin against your servant David, because he has not sinned against you, and his deeds are very good.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan spoke favourably concerning David to Saul his father, and said to him, Let not the king sin against thy servant David, for he has not sinned against thee, and his deeds are very good.

fresh_translation: And he put his life in his hand and struck the foreigner, and the Lord worked a great salvation, and all Israel saw and rejoiced. And why do you sin against innocent blood, to put David to death for nothing?
brenton_translation: And he put his life in his hand, and smote the Philistine, and the Lord wrought a great deliverance; and all Israel saw, and rejoiced: why then dost thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?

fresh_translation: And Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan, and Saul swore, saying, As the Lord lives, he will not die.
brenton_translation: And Saul hearkened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, saying, As the Lord lives, he shall not die.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan called David and reported to him all these words, and Jonathan brought David in to Saul, and he was before him as yesterday and the third day.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan called David, and told him all these words; and Jonathan brought David in to Saul, and he was before him as in former times.

fresh_translation: And the war was added to be against Saul, and David prevailed and fought the foreigners and struck among them a very great blow, and they fled from before him.
brenton_translation: And there was again war against Saul; and David did valiantly, and fought against the Philistines, and smote them with a very great slaughter, and they fled from before him.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, an evil spirit of God was on Saul, and he was in the house sitting, and a spear was in his hand, and David was playing with his hands.
brenton_translation: And an evil spirit from God was upon Saul, and he was resting in his house, and a spear was in his hand, and David was playing on the harp with his hands.

fresh_translation: And Saul sought to strike the spear into David, but David withdrew from before Saul, and he struck the spear into the wall, and David departed and escaped.
brenton_translation: And Saul sought to smite David with the spear; and David withdrew suddenly from the presence of Saul; and he drove the spear into the wall; and David retreated and escaped.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on that night, Saul sent messengers to the house of David to guard him so as to kill him in the morning. And Michal his wife reported to David, saying, If you do not save your life this night, tomorrow you will be put to death.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in that night, that Saul sent messengers to the house of David to watch him, in order to slay him in the morning; and Melchol David's wife told him, saying, Unless thou save thy life this night, to-morrow thou shalt be slain.

fresh_translation: And Michal let David down through the window, and he went away and fled and was saved.
brenton_translation: So Melchol lets David down by the window, and he departed, and fled, and escaped.

fresh_translation: And Michal took the tomb-images and placed them on the bed, and she put a goat’s liver at his head and covered them with a garment.
brenton_translation: And Melchol took images, and laid them on the bed, and she put the liver of a goat by his head, and covered them with clothes.

fresh_translation: And Saul sent messengers to take David, and they say that he is sick.
brenton_translation: And Saul sent messengers to take David; and they say that he is sick.

fresh_translation: And Saul sent for David, saying, Bring him to me on the bed, so as to put him to death.
brenton_translation: And he sends to David, saying, Bring him to me on the bed, that I may slay him.

fresh_translation: And the messengers come, and behold, the tomb-images were on the bed and a goat’s liver at his head.
brenton_translation: And the messengers come, and, behold, the images were on the bed, and the goat's liver at his head.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to Michal, Why did you thus deceive me and send away my enemy, and he escaped? And Michal said to Saul, He said, Send me away, or else I will kill you.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to Melchol, Why hast thou thus deceived me, and suffered my enemy to depart, and he has escaped? and Melchol said to Saul, He said, Let me go, and if not, I will slay thee.

fresh_translation: And David fled and was saved and comes to Samuel at Ramathaim-Zophim and reports to him all that Saul did to him. And David and Samuel went and sat in Naioth at Ramah.
brenton_translation: So David fled, and escaped, and comes to Samuel to Armathaim, and tells him all that Saul had done to him: and Samuel and David went, and dwelt in Navath in Rama.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Saul, saying, Behold, David is in Naioth at Ramah.
brenton_translation: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is in Navath in Rama.

fresh_translation: And Saul sent messengers to take David, and they saw the assembly of the prophets, and Samuel stood appointed over them. And the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul, and they prophesy.
brenton_translation: And Saul sent messengers to take David, and they saw the assembly of the prophets, and Samuel stood as appointed over them; and the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul, and they prophesy.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Saul, and he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. And Saul added to send third messengers, and they also prophesied.
brenton_translation: And it was told Saul, and he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied: and Saul sent again a third set of messengers, and they also prophesied.

fresh_translation: And the anger of Saul burned, and he also went to Ramathaim-Zophim, and he comes as far as the well of the threshing floor in Sechu and asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And they said, Behold, in Naioth at Ramah.
brenton_translation: And Saul was very angry, and went himself also to Armathaim, and he comes as far as the well of the threshing-floor that is in Sephi; and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? and they said, Behold, in Navath in Rama.

fresh_translation: And he went from there to Naioth at Ramah, and the Spirit of God also came upon him, and he went on prophesying until he came into Naioth at Ramah.
brenton_translation: And he went thence to Navath in Rama: and there came the Spirit of God upon him also, and he went on prophesying till he came to Navath in Rama.

fresh_translation: And he stripped off his garments and prophesied before them and fell naked all that day and all that night. Because of this they said, Is Saul also among prophets?
brenton_translation: And he took off his clothes, and prophesied before them; and lay down naked all that day and all that night: therefore they said, Is Saul also among the prophets?

fresh_translation: And David fled from Naioth at Ramah and comes before Jonathan and said, What have I done, and what is my wrongdoing, and in what have I sinned before your father, that he seeks my life?
brenton_translation: And David fled from Navath in Rama, and comes into the presence of Jonathan; and he said, What have I done, and what is my fault, and wherein have I sinned before thy father, that he seeks my life?

fresh_translation: And Jonathan said to him, Far from you. You certainly will not die. Behold, my father will not do a great word or a small one without uncovering my ear, and why should my father hide this word from me? It is not so.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan said to him, Far be it from thee: thou shalt not die: behold, my father will not do any thing great or small without discovering it to me; and why should my father hide this matter from me? this thing is not so.

fresh_translation: And David answered Jonathan and said, Knowing, your father knows that I have found favor in your eyes, and he said, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he not be willing. But as the Lord lives and as your life lives, as I said, there is only the fullness between me and death.
brenton_translation: And David answered Jonathan, and said, Thy father knows surely that I have found grace in thy sight, and he said, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he refuse his consent: but as the Lord lives and thy soul lives, as I said, the space is filled up between me and death.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan said to David, Whatever your soul desires, I will do for you.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan said to David, What does thy soul desire, and what shall I do for thee?

fresh_translation: And David said to Jonathan, Behold now, new moon is tomorrow, and sitting I will not sit with the king to eat, and you will send me away, and I will hide in the field until evening.
brenton_translation: And David said to Jonathan, Behold, to-morrow is the new moon, and I shall not on any account sit down to eat, but thou shalt let me go, and I will hide in the plain till the evening.

fresh_translation: If your father inspecting should inspect for me, then you will say, David earnestly asked leave from me to run to Bethlehem his city, because there is there a sacrifice of days for all the tribe.
brenton_translation: And if thy father do in anywise enquire for me, then shalt thou say, David earnestly asked leave of me to run to Bethleem his city, for there is there a yearly sacrifice for all the family.

fresh_translation: If he says thus, Good, there is peace for your servant. But if he answers harshly, know that evil is completed by him.
brenton_translation: If he shall say thus, Well,— all is safe for thy servant: but if he shall answer harshly to thee, know that evil is determined by him.

fresh_translation: And you will do mercy with your servant, because you brought your servant into a covenant of the Lord with yourself. And if there is wrongdoing in your servant, you put me to death, and why do you thus bring me to your father?
brenton_translation: And thou shalt deal mercifully with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the Lord with thyself: and if there is iniquity in thy servant, slay me thyself; but why dost thou thus bring me to thy father?

fresh_translation: And Jonathan said, Far from you. For if in knowing I know that evil has been completed by my father to come upon you, will I not report it to you even into your cities?
brenton_translation: And Jonathan said, That be far from thee: for if I surely know that evil is determined by my father to come upon thee, although it should not be against thy cities, I will tell thee.

fresh_translation: And David said to Jonathan, Who will report to me if your father answers you harshly?
brenton_translation: And David said to Jonathan, Who can tell me if thy father should answer roughly?

fresh_translation: And Jonathan said to David, Go and remain in the field. And both went out into the field.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan said to David, Go, and abide in the field. And they went out both into the field.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan said to David, The Lord God of Israel knows that I will search out my father about this time tomorrow and the third day, and behold, if there is good concerning David and I do not send to you into the field,
brenton_translation: And Jonathan said to David, The Lord God of Israel knows that I will sound my father as I have an opportunity, three several times, and, behold, if good should be determined concerning David, and I do not send to thee to the field,

fresh_translation: thus may God do to Jonathan and thus may he add, if I bring the evils upon you and do not uncover your ear and send you away, and you go in peace. And the Lord will be with you as he was with my father.
brenton_translation: God do so to Jonathan and more also: as I shall also report the evil to thee, and make it known to thee, and I will let thee go; and thou shalt depart in peace, and the Lord shall be with thee, as he was with my father.

fresh_translation: And if I am still living, you will indeed do mercy with me, and if I surely die,
brenton_translation: And if indeed I continue to live, then shalt thou deal mercifully with me; and if I indeed die,

fresh_translation: you will not remove your mercy from my house forever, and not even when the Lord removes the enemies of David, each one from the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: thou shalt not withdraw thy mercy from my house for ever: and if thou doest not, when the Lord cuts off the enemies of David each from the face of the earth,

fresh_translation: May the name of Jonathan be removed from the house of David, and may the Lord seek out the enemies of David.
brenton_translation: should it happen that the name of Jonathan be discovered by the house of David, then let the Lord seek out the enemies of David.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan added still to swear to David, because he loved the soul of the one loving him.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan swore yet again to David, because he loved the soul of him that loved him.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan said, Tomorrow is new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be inspected.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan said, To-morrow is the new moon, and thou wilt be enquired for, because thy seat will be observed as vacant.

fresh_translation: And you will do it a third time and inspect, and you will come to your place where you hid on the working day, and you will sit beside the stone Ezel.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt stay three days, and watch an opportunity, and shalt come to thy place where thou mayest hide thyself in the day of thy business, and thou shalt wait by that ergab.

fresh_translation: And I will make the third shot with arrows, sending toward Amattari.
brenton_translation: And I will shoot three arrows, aiming them at a mark.

fresh_translation: And behold, I will send the young man, saying, Come, find the arrow for me. If in saying I say to the young man, Here is the arrow from you and on this side, take it, come, because there is peace for you and there is no word, as the Lord lives.
brenton_translation: And behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go find me the arrow.

fresh_translation: But if I say thus to the young man, Here is the arrow from you and beyond, go, because the Lord has sent you away.
brenton_translation: If I should expressly say to the lad, The arrow is here, and on this side of thee, take it; then come, for it is well with thee, and there is no reason for fear, as the Lord lives: but if I should say thus to the young man, The arrow is on that side of thee, and beyond; go, for the Lord hath sent thee away.

fresh_translation: And the word that we spoke, I and you, behold, the Lord is witness between me and you forever.
brenton_translation: And as for the word which thou and I have spoken, behold, the Lord is witness between me and thee for ever.

fresh_translation: And David hid in the field, and the month arrives, and the king comes to the table to eat.
brenton_translation: So David hides himself in the field, and the new month arrives, and the king comes to the table to eat.

fresh_translation: And the king sat on his seat, as once and once, on the seat by the wall, and he came before Jonathan, and Abner sat by the side of Saul, and David’s place was inspected.
brenton_translation: And he sat upon his seat as in former times, even on his seat by the wall, and he went before Jonathan; and Abenner sat on one side of Saul, and the place of David was empty.

fresh_translation: And Saul did not speak anything on that day, because he said, An incident appears, he is not clean, because he has not been purified.
brenton_translation: And Saul said nothing on that day, for he said, It seems to have fallen out that he is not clean, because he has not purified himself.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the next day of the month, the second day, David’s place was inspected, and Saul said to Jonathan his son, Why is the son of Jesse not present, both yesterday and today, at the table?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, on the second day of the month, that the place of David was empty; and Saul said to Jonathan his son, Why has not the son of Jessæ attended both yesterday and to-day at the table?

fresh_translation: And Jonathan answered Saul and said to him, David has earnestly requested from me to go to Bethlehem his city,
brenton_translation: And Jonathan answered Saul, and said to him, David asked leave of me to go as far as Bethleem his city;

fresh_translation: and he said, Send me away now, because we have a tribal sacrifice in the city, and my brothers have given charge to me, and now if I have found favor in your eyes, I will indeed escape and see my brothers. Because of this he has not come to the king’s table.
brenton_translation: and he said, Let me go, I pray thee, for we have a family sacrifice in the city, and my brethren have sent for me; and now, if I have found grace in thine eyes, I will even go over and see my brethren: therefore he is not present at the table of the king.

fresh_translation: And the anger of Saul burned very greatly against Jonathan, and he said to him, Son of fleeing girls, for I know that you share with the son of Jesse to your shame and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness.
brenton_translation: And Saul was exceedingly angry with Jonathan, and said to him, Thou son of traitorous damsels! for do I not know that thou art an accomplice with the son of Jessæ to thy shame, and to the shame of thy mother's nakedness?

fresh_translation: Because all the days that the son of Jesse lives upon the earth, your kingdom will not be established. Now therefore, send and take the young man, because he is a son of death.
brenton_translation: For so long as the son of Jessæ lives upon the earth, thy kingdom shall not be established: now then send and take the young man, for he shall surely die.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan answered Saul, Why should he die? What has he done?
brenton_translation: And Jonathan answered Saul, Why is he to die? what has he done?

fresh_translation: And Saul lifted the spear against Jonathan to put him to death, and Jonathan knew that this evil from his father had been completed, to put David to death.
brenton_translation: And Saul lifted up his spear against Jonathan to slay him: so Jonathan knew that this evil was determined on by his father to slay David.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan sprang up from the table in the anger of wrath and did not eat bread on the second of the month, because he was shattered over David, because his father had brought it to completion against him.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan sprang up from the table in great anger, and did not eat bread on the second day of the month, for he grieved bitterly for David, because his father determined on mischief against him.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the morning, Jonathan went out into the field, as he had appointed, for the testimony with David, and a little young man was with him.
brenton_translation: And morning came, and Jonathan went out to the field, as he appointed to do for a signal to David, and a little boy was with him.

fresh_translation: And he said to the young man, Run, find for me the arrows in which I am shooting. And the young man ran, and he shot the arrow and brought it past him.
brenton_translation: And he said to the boy, Run, find me the arrows which I shoot: and the boy ran, and Jonathan shot an arrow, and sent it beyond him.

fresh_translation: And the young man came as far as the place of the arrow that Jonathan shot, and Jonathan cried out behind the young boy and said, Is not the arrow from you and beyond?
brenton_translation: And the boy came to the place where the arrow was which Jonathan shot; and Jonathan cried out after the lad, and said, The arrow is on that side of thee and beyond thee.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan cried out behind his young man, saying, Hurry, make haste, do not stand. And the young man of Jonathan gathered the arrows to his lord.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan cried out after his boy, saying, Make all speed, and stay not. And Jonathan's boy gathered up the arrows, and brought the arrows to his master.

fresh_translation: And the young man knew nothing, except that Jonathan and David knew the word.
brenton_translation: And the boy knew nothing, only Jonathan and David knew.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan gave his equipment to his young man and said to his young man, Go, enter into the city.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to his boy, Go, enter into the city.

fresh_translation: And as the young man entered, David arose from the stone Ezel and fell on his face and bowed down to him three times, and each kissed his neighbor, and each wept to his neighbor until great completion.
brenton_translation: And when the lad went in, then David arose from the argab, and fell upon his face, and did obeisance to him three times, and they kissed each other, and wept for each other, for a great while.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan said, Go in peace, and as we two swore in the name of the Lord, saying, The Lord will be witness between me and you and between my seed and between your seed forever.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, and as we have both sworn in the name of the Lord, saying, The Lord shall be witness between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever—even so let it be.

fresh_translation: And David rose and went away, and Jonathan entered into the city.
brenton_translation: And David arose and departed, and Jonathan went into the city.

fresh_translation: And David comes to Nob to Abimelech the priest, and Abimelech stood outside himself to meet him and said to him, Why are you alone, and no one with you?
brenton_translation: And David comes to Nomba to Abimelech the priest: and Abimelech was amazed at meeting him, and said to him, Why art thou alone, and nobody with thee?

fresh_translation: And David said to the priest, The king has charged me with a word today and said to me, Let no one know the word concerning which I am sending you and concerning which I have charged you. And I have directed the young men to the place called God’s faith, Phellani, Alemoni.
brenton_translation: And David said to the priest, The king gave me a command to-day, and said to me, Let no one know the matter on which I send thee, and concerning which I have charged thee: and I have charged my servants to be in the place that is called, The faithfulness of God, phellani maemoni.

fresh_translation: And now, if there are five loaves under your hand, give into my hand what is found.
brenton_translation: And now if there are under thy hand five loaves, give into my hand what is ready.

fresh_translation: And the priest answered David and said, There are no common breads under my hand, but only holy breads are here, if the young men have kept themselves from woman, and he will eat.
brenton_translation: And the priest answered David, and said, There are no common loaves under my hand, for I have none but holy loaves: if the young men have been kept at least from women, then they shall eat them.

fresh_translation: And David answered the priest and said to him, On the contrary, we have been kept from woman yesterday and the third day since my going out on the road. All the young men have become purified, and this road is common, because today it will be sanctified by my equipment.
brenton_translation: And David answered the priest, and said to him, Yea, we have been kept from women for three days: when I came forth for the journey all the young men were purified; but this expedition is unclean, wherefore it shall be sanctified this day because of my weapons.

fresh_translation: And Abimelech the priest gave him the loaves of presentation, because there was no bread there except the breads of the presence, the ones removed from the face of the Lord, to set warm bread on the day he took them.
brenton_translation: So Abimelech the priest gave him the shewbread; for there were no loaves there, but only the presence loaves which had been removed from the presence of the Lord, in order that hot bread should be set on, on the day on which he took them.

fresh_translation: And there was there one of the servants of Saul on that day, held in before the Lord, and his name was Doeg the Syrian, pasturing the mules of Saul.
brenton_translation: And there was there on that day one of Saul's servants detained before the Lord, and his name was Doec the Syrian, tending the mules of Saul.

fresh_translation: And David said to Abimelech, Look, is there here under your hand spear or sword? Because I did not take my sword and my equipment in my hand, because the king’s word was in haste.
brenton_translation: And David said to Abimelech, See if there is here under thy hand spear or sword, for I have not brought in my hand my sword or my weapons, for the word of the king was urgent.

fresh_translation: And the priest said, Behold, the sword of Goliath the foreigner, whom you struck in the valley of Ela, and it is wrapped in a garment. If you will take it for yourself, take it, because there is no other besides this here. And David said, Behold, there is none like it. Give it to me.
brenton_translation: And the priest said, Behold the sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou smotest in the valley of Ela; and it is wrapt in a cloth: if thou wilt take it, take it for thyself, for there is no other except it here. And David said, Behold, there is none like it; give it me.

fresh_translation: And he gave it to him. And David rose and fled on that day from before Saul, and David came to Achish king of Gath.
brenton_translation: And he gave it him; and David arose, and fled in that day from the presence of Saul: and David came to Anchus king of Geth.

fresh_translation: And the servants of Achish said to him, Is not this David, king of the land? Is it not to this one that the dancers came out, saying, Saul struck in his thousands, and David in his tens of thousands?
brenton_translation: And the servants of Anchus said to him, Is not this David the king of the land? Did not the dancing women begin the song to him, saying, Saul has smitten his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

fresh_translation: And David put the words in his heart and feared greatly from before Achish king of Gath.
brenton_translation: And David laid up the words in his heart, and was greatly afraid of Anchus king of Geth.

fresh_translation: And he altered his face before him and pretended on that day, and was drumming on the doors of the city, and was carried along in his hands, and was falling on the doors of the gate, and his saliva was running down on his beard.
brenton_translation: And he changed his appearance before him, and feigned himself a false character in that day; and drummed upon the doors of the city, and used extravagant gestures with his hands, and fell against the doors of the gate, and his spittle ran down upon his beard.

fresh_translation: And Achish said to his servants, Behold, you see a possessed man. Why did you bring him to me?
brenton_translation: And Anchus said to his servants, Lo! ye see the man is mad: why have ye brought him in to me?

fresh_translation: Do I lack possessed men, that you have brought him for acting possessed toward me? This one will not enter into the house.
brenton_translation: Am I in want of madmen, that ye have brought him in to me to play the madman? he shall not come into the house.

fresh_translation: And David went away from there and was saved and comes into the cave of Adullam, and his brothers and all his father’s house heard and came down there to him.
brenton_translation: And David departed thence, and escaped; and he comes to the cave of Odollam, and his brethren hear, and the house of his father, and they go down to him there.

fresh_translation: And everyone in distress and everyone in debt and everyone bitter in soul gathered to him, and he was leader over them, and there were with him about four hundred men.
brenton_translation: And there gathered to him every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was troubled in mind; and he was a leader over them, and there were with him about four hundred men.

fresh_translation: And David went from there to Mizpah of Moab and said to the king of Moab, Let now my father and my mother be with you until I know what God will do to me.
brenton_translation: And David departed thence to Massephath of Moab, and said to the king of Moab, Let, I pray thee, my father and my mother be with thee, until I know what God will do to me.

fresh_translation: And he entreated the face of the king of Moab, and they stayed with him all the days David was in the stronghold.
brenton_translation: And he persuaded the king of Moab, and they dwelt with him continually, while David was in the hold.

fresh_translation: And Gad the prophet said to David, Do not sit in the stronghold. Go, and you will come into the land of Judah. And David went and came and sat in the city of Sarich.
brenton_translation: And Gad the prophet said to David, Dwell not in the hold: go, and thou shalt enter the land of Juda. So David went, and came and dwelt in the city of Saric.

fresh_translation: And Saul heard that David and the men with him had become known. And Saul was sitting on the hill under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, and the spear was in his hand, and all his servants stood by him.
brenton_translation: And Saul heard that David was discovered, and his men with him: now Saul dwelt in the hill below the field that is in Rama, and his spear was in his hand, and all his servants stood near him.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to his servants standing by him, Hear now, sons of Benjamin. Will the son of Jesse truly give to all of you fields and vineyards and appoint all of you centurions and commanders of thousands,
brenton_translation: And Saul said to his servants that stood by him, Hear now, ye sons of Benjamin, will the son of Jessæ indeed give all of you fields and vineyards, and will he make you all captains of hundreds and captains of thousands?

fresh_translation: that all of you conspire against me, and there is no one uncovering my ear when my son makes a covenant with the son of Jesse, and there is no one among you grieved concerning me and uncovering my ear that my son has stirred up my servant against me as an enemy, as this day?
brenton_translation: that ye are all conspiring against me, and there is no one that informs me, whereas my son has made a covenant with the son of Jessæ, and there is no one of you that is sorry for me, or informs me that my son has stirred up my servant against me for an enemy, as it is this day?

fresh_translation: And Doeg the Syrian answered, the one set over the mules of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob to Abimelech son of Ahitub the priest.
brenton_translation: And Doec the Syrian who was over the mules of Saul answered and said, I saw the son of Jessæ as he came to Nomba to Abimelech son of Achitob the priest.

fresh_translation: And he inquired for him through God and gave him provisions and gave him the sword of Goliath the foreigner.
brenton_translation: And the priest enquired of God for him, and gave him provisions, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

fresh_translation: And the king sent to call Abimelech son of Ahitub and all the sons of his father, the priests in Nob, and all came to the king.
brenton_translation: And the king sent to call Abimelech son of Achitob and all his father's sons, the priests that were in Nomba; and they all came to the king.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, Hear now, son of Ahitub. And he said, Behold, I am here, speak, lord.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Achitob. And he said, Lo! I am here, speak, my lord.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to him, Why did you conspire against me, you and the son of Jesse, by giving him bread and sword and by inquiring for him through God, to set him against me as an enemy, as this day?
brenton_translation: And Saul said to him, Why have thou and the son of Jessæ conspired against me, that thou shouldest give him bread and a sword, and shouldest enquire of God for him, to raise him up against me as an enemy, as he is this day?

fresh_translation: And he answered the king and said, And who among all your servants is like David, faithful and son-in-law of the king and ruler of all your commands and honored in your house?
brenton_translation: And he answered the king, and said, And who is there among all thy servants faithful as David, and he is a son-in-law of the king, and he is executor of all thy commands, and is honourable in thy house?

fresh_translation: Have I begun today to inquire for him through God? Far be it. Let not the king put a word against his servant and against all the house of my father, because your servant knew nothing in all these things, small or great.
brenton_translation: Have I begun to-day to enquire of God for him? by no means: let not the king bring a charge against his servant, and against the whole of my father's house; for thy servant knew not in all these matters anything great or small.

fresh_translation: And King Saul said, Dying you will die, Abimelech, you and all your father’s house.
brenton_translation: And king Saul said, Thou shalt surely die, Abimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.

fresh_translation: And the king said to the runners standing over him, Bring forward and kill the priests of the Lord, because their hand is with David, and because they knew that he was fleeing and did not uncover my ear. And the servants of the king were not willing to bring their hands upon the priests of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the king said to the footmen that attended on him, Draw nigh and slay the priests of the Lord, because their hand is with David, and because they knew that he fled, and they did not inform me. But the servants of the king would not lift their hands to fall upon the priests of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Doeg, Turn yourself and attack the priests. And Doeg the Syrian turned and killed the priests of the Lord on that day, three hundred and five men, all carrying ephod.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Doec, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests: and Doec the Syrian turned, and slew the priests of the Lord in that day, three hundred and five men, all wearing an ephod.

fresh_translation: And he struck Nob, the city of the priests, by the mouth of the sword, from man to woman, from infant to nursing child, and ox and donkey and sheep.
brenton_translation: And he smote Nomba the city of the priests with the edge of the sword, both man and woman, infant and suckling, and calf, and ox, and sheep.

fresh_translation: And one son of Abimelech son of Ahitub escaped, and his name was Abiathar, and he fled after David.
brenton_translation: And one son of Abimelech son of Achitob escapes, and his name was Abiathar, and he fled after David.

fresh_translation: And Abiathar reported to David that Saul had killed all the priests of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Abiathar told David that Saul had slain all the priests of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And David said to Abiathar, I knew on that day that Doeg the Syrian would surely report to Saul. I am guilty for the lives of your father’s house.
brenton_translation: And David said to Abiathar, I knew it in that day, that Doec the Syrian would surely tell Saul: I am guilty of the death of the house of thy father.

fresh_translation: Stay with me. Do not fear, because where I seek my life, I will seek a place for your life, because you are guarded with me.
brenton_translation: Dwell with me; fear not, for wherever I shall seek a place of safety for my life, I will also seek a place for thy life, for thou art safely guarded while with me.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to David, saying, Behold, the foreigners are making war at Keilah, and they are plundering and trampling the threshing floors.
brenton_translation: And it was told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines war in Keila, and they rob, they trample on the threshing-floors.

fresh_translation: And David inquired through the Lord, saying, Shall I go and strike these foreigners? And the Lord said, Go, and you will strike these foreigners and save Keilah.
brenton_translation: And David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the Lord said, Go, and thou shalt smite these Philistines, and shalt save Keila.

fresh_translation: And the men of David said to him, Behold, we here in Judah are afraid, and how will it be if we go to Keilah? We will enter into the spoils of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And the men of David said to him, Behold, we are afraid here in Judea; and how shall it be if we go to Keila? shall we go after the spoils of the Philistines?

fresh_translation: And David added still to inquire through the Lord, and the Lord answered him and said to him, Rise and go down to Keilah, because I am delivering the foreigners into your hands.
brenton_translation: And David enquired yet again of the Lord; and the Lord answered him, and said to him, Arise and go down to Keila, for I will deliver the Philistines into thy hands.

fresh_translation: And David and the men with him went to Keilah and fought among the foreigners, and they fled from before him, and he brought away their cattle and struck among them a great blow, and David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
brenton_translation: So David and his men with him went to Keila, and fought with the Philistines; and they fled from before him, and he carried off their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter, and David rescued the inhabitants of Keila.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Abiathar son of Abimelech fled to David, he himself went down with David into Keilah, having ephod in his hand.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Abiathar the son of Achimelech fled to David, that he went down with David to Keila, having an ephod in his hand.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Saul that David had come to Keilah, and Saul said, God has sold him into my hands, because he has shut himself in by entering a city of doors and bars.
brenton_translation: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keila: and Saul said, God has sold him into my hands, for he is shut up, having entered into a city that has gates and bars.

fresh_translation: And Saul ordered all the people for war, to go down to Keilah, to hem in David and his men.
brenton_translation: And Saul charged all the people to go down to war to Keila, to besiege David and his men.

fresh_translation: And David knew that Saul was not silent about evil against him, and David said to Abiathar the priest, Bring near the ephod of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And David knew that Saul spoke openly of mischief against him: and David said to Abiathar the priest, Bring the ephod of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And David said, Lord God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come against Keilah to destroy the city because of me.
brenton_translation: And David said, Lord God of Israel, thy servant has indeed heard, that Saul seeks to come against Keila to destroy the city on my account.

fresh_translation: Will it be shut up? And now will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Lord God of Israel, report to your servant. And the Lord said, It will be shut up.
brenton_translation: Will the place be shut up? and now will Saul come down, as thy servant has heard? Lord God of Israel, tell thy servant. And the Lord said, It will be shut up.

fresh_translation: And David rose, and the men with him, about four hundred, and they went out from Keilah and were going wherever they went. And it was reported to Saul that David had escaped from Keilah, and he let go of going out.
brenton_translation: And David arose, and the men with him, in number about four hundred, and they went forth from Keila, and went whithersoever they could go: and it was told Saul that David had escaped from Keila, and he forbore to come.

fresh_translation: And David sat in the wilderness in Maserem in the narrow places, and he sat in the wilderness on the mountain of Ziph in the dry land, and Saul sought him all the days, but the Lord did not deliver him into his hands.
brenton_translation: And he dwelt in Maserem in the wilderness, in the narrow passes; and dwelt in the wilderness in mount Ziph, in the dry country. And Saul sought him continually, but the Lord delivered him not into his hands.

fresh_translation: And David saw that Saul was going out to seek David, and David was on the dry mountain in the New Place of Ziph.
brenton_translation: And David perceived that Saul went forth to seek David; and David was in the dry mountain in the New Ziph.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan son of Saul rose and went to David into the New Place and strengthened his hands in the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan son of Saul rose, and went to David to Cæne, and strengthened his hands in the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Do not fear, because the hand of Saul my father certainly will not find you, and you will reign over Israel, and I will be second to you, and Saul my father also knows thus.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Fear not, for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be second to thee; and Saul my father knows it.

fresh_translation: And both made a covenant before the Lord, and David sat in the New Place, and Jonathan went away to his house.
brenton_translation: So they both made a covenant before the Lord; and David dwelt in Cæne, and Jonathan went to his home.

fresh_translation: And the Ziphites went up from the dry land to Saul on the hill, saying, Is not David hidden with us in the strongholds in the narrow places, in the New Place on the mountain of Hachilah, which is on the right of Jeshimon?
brenton_translation: And the Ziphites came up out of the dry country to Saul to the hill, saying, Behold, is not David hidden with us in Messara, in the narrows in Cæne in the hill of Echela, which is on the right of Jessæmon?

fresh_translation: And now let the king come down with all the desire of his soul for going down. They have shut him into the hands of the king.
brenton_translation: And now according to all the king's desire to come down, let him come down to us; they have shut him up into the hands of the king.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to them, Blessed are you to the Lord, because you grieved for me.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to them, Blessed be ye of the Lord, for ye have been grieved on my account.

fresh_translation: Go now and prepare still more, and know his place, where his foot will be in haste there, where you said, Lest perhaps he act craftily.
brenton_translation: Go, I pray you, and make preparations yet, and notice his place where his foot shall be, quickly, in that place which ye spoke of, lest by any means he should deal craftily.

fresh_translation: And see and know, and we will go with you, and if he is on the land, I will search him out in all the thousands of Judah.
brenton_translation: Take notice, then, and learn, and I will go with you; and it shall come to pass that if he is in the land, I will search him out among all the thousands of Juda.

fresh_translation: And the Ziphites rose and went before Saul, and David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, toward evening, on the right of Jeshimon.
brenton_translation: And the Ziphites arose, and went before Saul: and David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, westward, to the right of Jessæmon.

fresh_translation: And Saul and his men went to seek him, and they reported to David, and he went down to the rock in the wilderness of Maon. And Saul heard and pursued after David into the wilderness of Maon.
brenton_translation: And Saul and his men went to seek him: and they brought word to David, and he went down to the rock that was in the wilderness of Maon: and Saul heard, and followed after David to the wilderness of Maon.

fresh_translation: And Saul and his men were going from one side of this mountain, and David and his men from the side of that mountain, and David was hiding himself to go from before Saul, and Saul and his men had camped against David and his men to seize them.
brenton_translation: And Saul and his men go on one side of the mountain, and David and his men are on the other side of the mountain: and David was hiding himself to escape from Saul: and Saul and his men encamped against David and his men, in order to take them.
