fresh_translation: And a messenger came to Saul, saying, Hasten and come, because the foreigners have attacked the land.
brenton_translation: And there came a messenger to Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come hither, for the Philistines have invaded the land.

fresh_translation: And Saul turned back from pursuing after David and went to meet the foreigners. Because of this that place was called Divided Rock.
brenton_translation: So Saul returned from following after David, and went to meet the Philistines: therefore that place was called The divided Rock.

fresh_translation: And David went up from there and sat in the narrow places of Engedi.
brenton_translation: And David rose up from thence, and dwelt in the narrow passes of Engaddi.

fresh_translation: And it came to be as Saul turned back from after the foreigners, that it was reported to him saying that David was in the wilderness of Engedi.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Saul returned from pursuing after the Philistines, that it was reported to him, saying, David is in the wilderness of Engaddi.

fresh_translation: And he took with himself three thousand chosen men from all Israel and went to seek David and his men upon the face of Saddaeim.
brenton_translation: And he took with him three thousand men, chosen out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men in front of Saddæem.

fresh_translation: And he came to the sheepfolds by the road, and there was a cave there, and Saul entered to prepare himself, and David and his men were sitting in the innermost part of the cave.
brenton_translation: And he came to the flocks of sheep that were by the way, and there was a cave there; and Saul went in to make preparation, and David and his men were sitting in the inner part of the cave.

fresh_translation: And the men of David said to him, Behold, this day of which the Lord spoke to you, to deliver your enemy into your hands, and you will do to him as good in your eyes. And David rose and removed the wing of Saul’s double cloak secretly.
brenton_translation: And the men of David said to him, Behold, this is the day of which the Lord spoke to thee, that he would deliver thine enemy into thy hands; and thou shalt do to him as it is good in thy sight. So David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul's garment secretly.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after these things that David’s heart struck him because he had removed the wing of his double cloak.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after this that David's heart smote him, because he had cut off the skirt of his garment.

fresh_translation: And David said to his men, Far be it from me before the Lord if I do this thing to my lord, the anointed of the Lord, to bring my hand upon him, because this one is anointed of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And David said to his men, The Lord forbid it me, that I should do this thing to my lord the anointed of the Lord, to lift my hand against him; for he is the anointed of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And David persuaded his men with words and did not let them rise to put Saul to death, and Saul rose and went down on the road.
brenton_translation: So David persuaded his men by his words, and did not suffer them to arise and slay Saul: and Saul arose and went his way.

fresh_translation: And David rose after him from the cave and cried out behind Saul, saying, Lord king. And Saul looked behind him, and David bent his face to the ground and bowed down to him.
brenton_translation: And David rose up and went after him out of the cave: and David cried after Saul, saying, My lord, O king! and Saul looked behind him, and David bowed with his face to the ground, and did obeisance to him.

fresh_translation: And David said to Saul, Why do you listen to the words of the people saying, Behold, David seeks your life?
brenton_translation: And David said to Saul, Why dost thou hearken to the words of the people, saying, Behold, David seeks thy life?

fresh_translation: Behold, on this day your eyes have seen that the Lord delivered you today into my hand in the cave, and I was not willing to kill you, and I spared you and said, I will not put my hand upon my lord, because he is anointed of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Behold, thine eyes have seen this day how that the Lord has delivered thee this day into my hands in the cave; and I would not slay thee, but spared thee, and said, I will not lift up my hand against my lord, for he is the Lord's anointed.

fresh_translation: And behold, the wing of your double cloak is in my hand. I removed the wing and did not kill you. Know and see today that there is no evil in my hand, nor impiety and revolt, and I have not sinned against you, but you bind my life to take it.
brenton_translation: And behold, the skirt of thy mantle is in my hand, I cut off the skirt, and did not slay thee: know then and see to-day, there is no evil in my hand, nor impiety, nor rebellion; and I have not sinned against thee, yet thou layest snares for my soul to take it.

fresh_translation: May the Lord judge between me and you, and may the Lord avenge me from you, but my hand will not be upon you.
brenton_translation: The Lord judge between me and thee, and the Lord requite thee on thyself: but my hand shall not be upon thee.

fresh_translation: As the ancient proverb says, From lawless ones wrongdoing will go out, but my hand will not be upon you.
brenton_translation: As the old proverb says, Transgression will proceed from the wicked ones: but my hand shall not be upon thee.

fresh_translation: And now, after whom do you come out, king of Israel? After whom do you pursue? After a dead dog and after one flea.
brenton_translation: And now after whom dost thou come forth, O king of Israel? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, and after a flea?

fresh_translation: May the Lord become judge and justice between me and you. May the Lord see and judge my judgment and give me justice from your hand.
brenton_translation: The Lord be judge and umpire between me and thee, the Lord look upon and judge my cause, and rescue me out of thy hand.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when David finished speaking these words to Saul, Saul said, Is this your voice, child David? And Saul lifted up his voice and wept.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, son David? and Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to David, You are more righteous than I, because you repaid me good things, but I repaid you evil things.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to David, Thou art more righteous than I, for thou hast recompensed me good, but I have recompensed thee evil.

fresh_translation: And you reported to me today what good things you did to me, how the Lord shut me up today into your hands and you did not kill me.
brenton_translation: And thou hast told me to-day what good thou hast done me, how the Lord shut me up into thy hands to-day, and thou didst not slay me.

fresh_translation: And because if anyone should find his enemy in affliction and send him away on a good road, then the Lord will repay him good things, as you have done today.
brenton_translation: And if any one should find his enemy in distress, and should send him forth in a good way, then the Lord will reward him good, as thou hast done this day.

fresh_translation: And now, behold, I know that in reigning you will reign, and the kingdom of Israel will stand in your hands.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, I know that thou shalt surely reign, and the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thy hand.

fresh_translation: And now swear to me by the Lord that you will not destroy my seed after me and will not wipe out my name from the house of my father.
brenton_translation: Now then swear to me by the Lord, that thou wilt not destroy my seed after me, that thou wilt not blot out my name from the house of my father.

fresh_translation: And David swore to Saul, and Saul went away to his place, and David and his men went up to the narrow stronghold.
brenton_translation: So David swore to Saul: and Saul departed to his place, and David and his men went up to the strong-hold of Messera.

fresh_translation: And Samuel died, and all Israel gathered and mourned for him and buried him in his house at Ramathaim-Zophim. And David rose and went down into the wilderness of Maon.
brenton_translation: And Samuel died, and all Israel assembled, and bewailed him, and they bury him in his house in Armathaim: and David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Maon.

fresh_translation: And there was a man in Maon, and his flocks were in Carmel, and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep and one thousand goats. And it came to be when he was shearing his flock in Carmel,
brenton_translation: And there was a man in Maon, and his flocks were in Carmel, and he was a very great man; and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand she-goats: and he happened to be shearing his flock in Carmel.

fresh_translation: the name of the man was Nabal, and the name of his wife was Abigail, and his wife was good in understanding and very beautiful in appearance, but the man was harsh and evil in practices, and the man was doglike.
brenton_translation: And the man's name was Nabal, and his wife's name was Abigaia: and his wife was of good understanding and very beautiful in person: but the man was harsh and evil in his doings, and the man was churlish.

fresh_translation: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal the Carmelite was shearing his flock.
brenton_translation: And David heard in the wilderness, that Nabal the Carmelite was shearing his sheep.

fresh_translation: And David sent ten young men and said to the young men, Go up to Carmel and go to Nabal and ask him in my name about peace.
brenton_translation: And David sent ten young men, and he said to the young men, Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and ask him in my name how he is.

fresh_translation: And you will say these things at the season: And you are in health, and your house, and all your things in health.
brenton_translation: And thus shall ye say, May thou and thy house seasonably prosper, and all thine be in prosperity.

fresh_translation: And now behold, I have heard that they are shearing for you. Now your shepherds who were with us in the wilderness, we did not hinder them, and we did not command anything from them all the days they were in Carmel.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, I have heard that thy shepherds who were with us in the wilderness are shearing thy sheep, and we hindered them not, neither did we demand any thing from them all the time they were in Carmel.

fresh_translation: Ask your young men, and they will report to you. And let the young men find favor in your eyes, because we have come on a good day. Give now whatever your hand may find to your son David.
brenton_translation: Ask thy servants, and they will tell thee. Let then thy servants find grace in thine eyes, for we are come on a good day; give, we pray thee, whatsoever thy hand may find, to thy son David.

fresh_translation: And the young men come and speak these words to Nabal according to all these words in the name of David, and he sprang away.
brenton_translation: So the servants come and speak these words to Nabal, according to all these words in the name of David.

fresh_translation: And Nabal answered the servants of David and said, Who is David, and who is the son of Jesse? Today servants who withdraw each one from before his lord have multiplied.
brenton_translation: And Nabal sprang up, and answered the servants of David, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jessæ? now-a-days there is abundance of servants who depart every one from his master.

fresh_translation: And shall I take my breads and my wine and my victims that I have slaughtered for those shearing my sheep and give them to men whose origin I do not know?
brenton_translation: And shall I take my bread, and my wine, and my beasts that I have slain for my shearers, and shall I give them to men of whom I know not whence they are?

fresh_translation: And David’s young men turned on their way and returned and came and reported to David according to these words.
brenton_translation: So the servants of David turned back, and returned, and came and reported to David according to these words.

fresh_translation: And David said to his men, Gird on each his sword. And about four hundred men went up after David, and two hundred sat with the baggage.
brenton_translation: And David said to his men, Gird on every man his sword. And they went up after David, about four hundred men: and two hundred abode with the stuff.

fresh_translation: And one of the young men reported to Abigail wife of Nabal, saying, Behold, David sent messengers from the wilderness to bless our lord, and he turned away from them.
brenton_translation: And one of the servants reported to Abigaia the wife of Nabal, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our lord; but he turned away from them.

fresh_translation: And the men were very good to us. They did not hinder us, nor did they command anything to us all the days we were with them and while we were in the field.
brenton_translation: And the men were very good to us; they did not hinder us, neither did they demand from us any thing all the days that we were with them.

fresh_translation: They were like a wall around us, both night and day, all the days we were with them shepherding the flock.
brenton_translation: And when we were in the field, they were as a wall round about us, both by night and by day, all the days that we were with them feeding the flock.

fresh_translation: And now know and see what you will do, because evil has been completed against our lord and against his house, and he is a pestilent son, and no one can speak to him.
brenton_translation: And now do thou consider, and see what thou wilt do; for mischief is determined against our lord and against his house; and he is a vile character, and one cannot speak to him.

fresh_translation: And Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves and two vessels of wine and five prepared sheep and five ophi of fine flour and one gomor of raisins and two hundred cakes and put them on the donkeys.
brenton_translation: And Abigaia hasted, and took two hundred loaves, and two vessels of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five ephahs of fine flour, and one homer of dried grapes, and two hundred cakes of figs, and put them upon asses.

fresh_translation: And she said to her young men, Go on before me, and behold, I am coming behind you. But to her husband she did not report it.
brenton_translation: And she said to her servants, Go on before me, and behold I come after you: but she told not her husband.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, as she was mounted on the donkey and going down under the shelter of the mountain, behold, David and his men were coming down to meet her, and she met them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when she had mounted her ass and was going down by the covert of the mountain, behold, David and his men came down to meet her, and she met them.

fresh_translation: And David said, Perhaps in vain I have guarded all his things in the wilderness, and we did not command taking anything from all his things, and he repaid me evil instead of good.
brenton_translation: And David said, Perhaps I have kept all his possessions in the wilderness that he should wrong me, and we did not order the taking any thing of all his goods; yet he has rewarded me evil for good.

fresh_translation: Thus may God do to David and thus may he add, if I leave from all the things of Nabal until morning one who urinates against a wall.
brenton_translation: So God do to David and more also, if I leave one male of all that belong to Nabal until the morning.

fresh_translation: And Abigail saw David and hurried and sprang down from the donkey and fell before David on her face and bowed down to him on the ground.
brenton_translation: And Abigaia saw David, and she hasted, and alighted from her ass; and she fell before David on her face, and did obeisance to him, bowing to the ground

fresh_translation: At his feet she said, In me, my lord, is the wrongdoing. Let your servant speak into your ears now, and hear the word of your servant.
brenton_translation: even to his feet, and said, On me, my lord, be my wrong: let, I pray thee, thy servant speak in thine ears, and hear thou the words of thy servant.

fresh_translation: Let not my lord set his heart on this pestilent man, because as his name, so he is: Nabal is his name, and folly is with him. But I, your servant, did not see your young men whom you sent.
brenton_translation: Let not my lord, I pray thee, take to heart this pestilent man, for according to his name, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thy handmaid saw not the servants of my lord whom thou didst send.

fresh_translation: And now, my lord, as the Lord lives and as your life lives, just as the Lord kept you back from coming into innocent blood and from saving your hand for yourself, now let your enemies and the ones seeking evil for my lord become like Nabal.
brenton_translation: And now, my lord, as the Lord lives, and thy soul lives, as the Lord has kept thee from coming against innocent blood, and from executing vengeance for thyself, now therefore let thine enemies, and those that seek evil against my lord, become as Nabal.

fresh_translation: And now take this blessing that your servant has brought to my lord, and you will give it to the young men standing by my lord.
brenton_translation: And now accept this token of goodwill, which thy servant has brought to my lord, and thou shalt give it to the servants that wait on my lord.

fresh_translation: Take away the lawless deed of your servant, because in doing the Lord will make for my lord a faithful house, because my lord fights the battles of the Lord, and evil will not be found in you ever.
brenton_translation: Remove, I pray thee, the trespass of thy servant; for the Lord will surely make for my lord a sure house, for the Lord fights the battles of my lord, and there shall no evil be ever found in thee.

fresh_translation: And a man will rise up pursuing you and seeking your life, and the life of my lord will be bound in the bundle of life with the Lord your God, and the life of your enemies you will sling out in the middle of the sling.
brenton_translation: And if a man shall rise up persecuting thee and seeking thy life, yet shall the life of my lord be bound up in the bundle of life with the Lord God, and thou shalt whirl the life of thine enemies as in the midst of a sling.

fresh_translation: And it will be that the Lord will do for my lord all the good things he spoke concerning you, and the Lord will appoint you as a leader over Israel.
brenton_translation: And it shall be when the Lord shall have wrought for my lord all the good things he has spoken concerning thee, and shall appoint thee to be ruler over Israel;

fresh_translation: And this will not be to you an abomination and a stumbling for my lord, to pour out innocent blood for nothing and for the hand of my lord to save for himself. And the Lord will do good to my lord, and you will remember your servant to do good to her.
brenton_translation: then this shall not be an abomination and offence to my lord, to have shed innocent blood without cause, and for my lord to have avenged himself: and so may the Lord do good to my lord, and thou shalt remember thine handmaid to do her good.

fresh_translation: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who sent you today on this day to meet me.
brenton_translation: And David said to Abigaia, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who sent thee this very day to meet me:

fresh_translation: And blessed be your discernment, and blessed are you, who kept me back today on this day from coming into bloods and from saving my hand for myself.
brenton_translation: and blessed be thy conduct, and blessed be thou, who hast hindered me this very day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself.

fresh_translation: Except that the Lord God of Israel lives, who kept me back today from doing evil to you, because if you had not hurried and come to meet me, then I said, Surely there would have been left to Nabal until morning one urinating against a wall.
brenton_translation: But surely as the Lord God of Israel lives, who hindered me this day from doing thee harm, if thou hadst not hasted and come to meet me, then I said, There shall surely not be left to Nabal till the morning one male.

fresh_translation: And David took from her hand all that she brought to him and said to her, Go up in peace to your house. See, I have heard your voice and honored your face.
brenton_translation: And David took of her hand all that she brought to him, and said to her, Go in peace to thy house: see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and accepted thy petition.

fresh_translation: And Abigail came to Nabal, and behold, a feast was for him in his house like a king’s feast, and the heart of Nabal was good upon him, and he was very drunk, and she did not report to him a thing, small or great, until morning light.
brenton_translation: And Abigaia came to Nabal: and, behold, he had a banquet in his house, as the banquet of a king, and the heart of Nabal was merry within him, and he was very drunken: and she told him nothing great or small till the morning light.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the morning, as Nabal sobered from the wine, his wife reported these words to him, and his heart died within him, and he became like a stone.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the morning, when Nabal recovered from his wine, his wife told him these words; and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after about ten days, the Lord struck Nabal, and he died.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after about ten days, that the Lord smote Nabal, and he died.

fresh_translation: And David heard and said, Blessed be the Lord, who judged the judgment of my reproach from the hand of Nabal and preserved his servant from the hand of evils, and the Lord turned back the evil of Nabal on his own head. And David sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her for himself as wife.
brenton_translation: And David heard it and said, Blessed be the Lord, who has judged the cause of my reproach at the hand of Nabal, and has delivered his servant from the power of evil; and the Lord has returned the mischief of Nabal upon his own head.

fresh_translation: And the servants of David came to Abigail at Carmel and spoke to her, saying, David has sent us to you, to take you for himself as wife.
brenton_translation: So the servants of David came to Abigaia to Carmel, and spoke to her, saying, David has sent us to thee, to take thee to himself for a wife.

fresh_translation: And she rose and bowed down to the ground on her face and said, Behold, your servant is for a slave-girl to wash the feet of your servants.
brenton_translation: And she arose, and did reverence with her face to the earth, and said, Behold, thy servant is for an handmaid to wash the feet of thy servants.

fresh_translation: And Abigail rose and mounted the donkey, and five girls were following her, and she went behind the servants of David and became his wife.
brenton_translation: And Abigaia arose, and mounted her ass, and five damsels followed her: and she went after the servants of David, and became his wife.

fresh_translation: And David took Ahinoam from Jezreel, and both became his wives.
brenton_translation: And David took Achinaam out of Jezrael, and they were both his wives.

fresh_translation: And Saul gave Michal his daughter, the wife of David, to Palti son of Laish from Romma.
brenton_translation: And Saul gave Melchol his daughter, David's wife, to Phalti the son of Amis who was of Romma.

fresh_translation: And the Ziphites come from the dry land to Saul on the hill, saying, Behold, David is hiding with us on the mountain of Hachilah, opposite Jeshimon.
brenton_translation: And the Ziphites come out of the dry country to Saul to the hill, saying, Behold, David hides himself with us in the hill Echela, opposite Jessemon.

fresh_translation: And Saul rose and went down into the wilderness of Ziph, and with him were three thousand chosen men from Israel, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
brenton_translation: And Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, and with him went three thousand men chosen out of Israel, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

fresh_translation: And Saul camped on the mountain of Hachilah opposite Jeshimon by the road, and David sat in the wilderness, and David saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And Saul encamped in the hill of Echela in front of Jessemon, by the way, and David dwelt in the wilderness: and David saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And David sent spies and knew that Saul came prepared from Keilah.
brenton_translation: And David sent spies, and ascertained that Saul was come prepared out of Keila.

fresh_translation: And David rose secretly and enters into the place where Saul was sleeping there, and there was Abner son of Ner, his commander, and Saul was sleeping in the wagon circle, and the people had camped around him.
brenton_translation: And David arose secretly, and goes into the place where Saul was sleeping, and there was Abenner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul was sleeping in a chariot, and the people had encamped round about him.

fresh_translation: And David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite and to Abishai son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, Who will go in with me to Saul into the camp? And Abishai said, I will go in with you.
brenton_translation: And David answered and spoke to Abimelech the Chettite, and to Abessa the son of Saruia the brother of Joab, saying, Who will go in with me to Saul into the camp? And Abessa said, I will go in with thee.

fresh_translation: And David and Abishai enter into the people by night, and behold, Saul was sleeping in slumber in the wagon circle, and the spear was fixed in the ground at his head, and Abner and his people were sleeping around him.
brenton_translation: So David and Abessa go in among the people by night: and behold, Saul was fast asleep in the chariot, and his spear was stuck in the ground near his head, and Abenner and his people slept round about him.

fresh_translation: And Abishai said to David, Today the Lord has shut your enemy into your hands, and now I will strike him with the spear into the ground, once, and I will not need a second time for him.
brenton_translation: And Abessa said to David, The Lord has this day shut up thine enemy into thine hands, and now I will smite him to the earth with the spear to the ground once for all, and I will not smite him again.

fresh_translation: And David said to Abishai, Do not humble him, because who will bring his hand upon the anointed of the Lord and be held innocent?
brenton_translation: And David said to Abessa, Do not lay him low, for who shall lift up his hand against the anointed of the Lord, and be guiltless?

fresh_translation: And David said, As the Lord lives, unless the Lord strikes him, or his day comes and he dies, or he goes down into battle and is swept away,
brenton_translation: And David said, As the Lord lives, if the Lord smite him not, or his day come and he die, or he go down to battle and be added to his fathers, do not so.

fresh_translation: far be it from me before the Lord to bring my hand upon the anointed of the Lord. And now take the spear from his head and the flask of water, and let us go for ourselves.
brenton_translation: The Lord forbid it me that I should lift up my hand against the anointed of the Lord: and now take, I pray thee, the spear from his bolster, and the pitcher of water, and let us return home.

fresh_translation: And David took the spear and the flask of water from his head, and they went away by themselves, and there was none seeing and none knowing and none waking; all were sleeping, because astonishment from the Lord had fallen upon them.
brenton_translation: So David took the spear, and the pitcher of water from his bolster, and they went home: and there was no one that saw, and no one that knew, and there was no one that awoke, all being asleep, for a stupor from the Lord had fallen upon them.

fresh_translation: And David crossed over to the other side and stood on the top of the mountain far off, and the road between them was great.
brenton_translation: So David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of a hill afar off, and there was a good distance between them.

fresh_translation: And David called to the people and spoke to Abner, saying, Will you not answer, Abner? And Abner answered and said, Who are you, the one calling me?
brenton_translation: And David called to the people, and spoke to Abenner, saying, Wilt thou not answer, Abenner? and Abenner answered and said, Who art thou that callest?

fresh_translation: And David said to Abner, Are you not a man, and who is like you in Israel? And why do you not guard your lord the king? Because one from the people entered to destroy your lord the king.
brenton_translation: And David said to Abenner, Art not thou a man? and who is like thee in Israel? Why then dost thou not guard thy lord the king? for one out of the people went in to destroy thy lord the king.

fresh_translation: And this word that you have done is not good. As the Lord lives, you are sons of death, the ones guarding your lord the king, the anointed of the Lord. And now see the king’s spear and the flask of water where they are by his head.
brenton_translation: And this thing is not good which thou hast done. As the Lord lives, ye are worthy of death, ye who guard your lord the king, the anointed of the Lord: and now behold, I pray you, the spear of the king, and the cruse of water: where are the articles that should be at his head?

fresh_translation: And Saul recognized the voice of David and said, Is this your voice, child David? And David said, Your servant, lord king.
brenton_translation: And Saul recognised the voice of David, and said, Is this thy voice, son David? and David said, I am thy servant, my lord, O king.

fresh_translation: And he said, Why is my lord pursuing after his servant? Because in what have I sinned, and what wrongdoing has been found in me?
brenton_translation: And he said, Why does my lord thus pursue after his servant? for in what have I sinned? and what unrighteousness has been found in me?

fresh_translation: And now let my lord the king hear the word of his servant. If God stirs you up against me, may he smell your sacrifices. But if sons of men, cursed are these before the Lord, because they cast me out today from being established in the inheritance of the Lord, saying, Go, serve other gods.
brenton_translation: And now let my lord the king hear the word of his servant. If God stirs thee up against me, let thine offering be acceptable: but if the sons of men, they are cursed before the Lord, for they have cast me out this day so that I should not be established in the inheritance of the Lord, saying, Go, serve other gods.

fresh_translation: And now let not my blood fall to the ground opposite the face of the Lord, because the king of Israel has come out seeking my life, as the night-raven pursues in the mountains.
brenton_translation: And now let not my blood fall to the ground before the Lord, for the king of Israel has come forth to seek thy life, as the night hawk pursues its prey in the mountains.

fresh_translation: And Saul said, I have sinned. Return, child David, because I will not do evil to you, because my life was precious in your eyes on this day. I have been made foolish and have been very greatly ignorant.
brenton_translation: And Saul said, I have sinned: turn, son David, for I will not hurt thee, because my life was precious in thine eyes; and to-day I have been foolish and have erred exceedingly.

fresh_translation: And David answered and said, Behold, the spear of the king. Let one of the young men cross over and take it.
brenton_translation: And David answered and said, Behold, the spear of the king: let one of the servants come over and take it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will return to each his righteousness and his faithfulness, just as the Lord delivered you today into my hands, and I was not willing to bring my hand upon the anointed of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall recompense each according to his righteousness and his truth, since the Lord delivered thee this day into my hands, and I would not lift my hand against the Lord's anointed.

fresh_translation: And behold, just as your life was magnified today on this day in my eyes, so may my life be magnified before the Lord, and may he shelter me and deliver me from all affliction.
brenton_translation: And, behold, as thy life has been precious this very day in my eyes, so let my life be precious before the Lord, and may he protect me, and deliver me out of all affliction.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to David, Blessed are you, child; doing you will do, and prevailing you will prevail. And David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to David, Blessed be thou, my son; and thou shalt surely do valiantly, and surely prevail. And David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.

fresh_translation: And David said in his heart, saying, Now one day I will be swept away into the hands of Saul, and there is nothing good for me unless I am saved into the land of the foreigners. And Saul will let go of seeking me in every border of Israel, and I will be saved from his hand.
brenton_translation: And David said in his heart, Now shall I be one day delivered for death into the hands of Saul; and there is no good thing for me unless I should escape into the land of the Philistines, and Saul should cease from seeking me through every coast of Israel: so I shall escape out of his hand.

fresh_translation: And David rose, and the four hundred men with him, and went to Achish son of Maoch, king of Gath.
brenton_translation: So David arose, and the six hundred men that were with him, and he went to Anchus, son of Ammach, king of Geth.

fresh_translation: And David sat with Achish in Gath, he and his men, each and his household, and David and both his wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelite and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
brenton_translation: And David dwelt with Anchus, he and his men, each with his family; and David and both his wives, Achinaam the Jezraelitess, and Abigaia the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Saul that David had fled to Gath, and he no longer added to seek him.
brenton_translation: And it was told Saul that David had fled to Geth; and he no longer sought after him.

fresh_translation: And David said to Achish, If your servant has found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in one of the country towns, and I will sit there. And why should your servant sit in a royal city with you?
brenton_translation: And David said to Anchus, If now thy servant has found grace in thine eyes, let them give me, I pray thee, a place in one of the cities in the country, and I will dwell there: for why does thy servant dwell with thee in a royal city?

fresh_translation: And he gave him on that day Ziklag. Therefore Ziklag became to the king of Judah until this day.
brenton_translation: And he gave him Sekelac in that day: therefore Sekelac came into possession of the king of Judea to this day.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, the number of the days David sat in the countryside of the foreigners was four months.
brenton_translation: And the number of the days that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was four months.

fresh_translation: And David and his men were going up and attacking all the Geshurites and the Amalekite, and behold, the land had been inhabited from those belonging to Gelampsour, fortified, and as far as the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And David and his men went up, and made an attack on all the Gesirites and on the Amalekites: and behold, the land was inhabited, (even the land from Gelampsur) by those who come from the fortified cities even to the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And he would strike the land and would not keep alive man and woman, and he took flocks and herds and donkeys and camels and clothing, and they returned and came to Achish.
brenton_translation: And he smote the land, and saved neither man nor woman alive; and they took flocks, and herds, and asses, and camels, and raiment; and they returned and came to Anchus.

fresh_translation: And Achish said to David, Against whom did you attack today? And David said to Achish, Against the south of Judah and against the south of Jerahmeelites and against the south of the Kenezite.
brenton_translation: And Anchus said to David, On whom have ye made an attack to-day? And David said to Anchus, On the south of Judea, and on the south of Jesmega, and on the south of the Kenezite.

fresh_translation: And he did not keep alive man and woman to bring into Gath, saying, Lest they report in Gath against us, saying, Thus David does. And this was his rule all the days David sat in the countryside of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And I have not saved man or woman alive to bring them to Geth, saying, Lest they carry a report to Geth against us, saying, These things David does. And this was his manner all the days that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And David was deeply trusted by Achish, saying, In shaming he has been shamed among his people in Israel, and he will be my servant forever.
brenton_translation: So David had the full confidence of Anchus, who said, He is thoroughly disgraced among his people in Israel, and he shall be my servant for ever.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in those days, the foreigners gathered in their camps to go out to fight against Israel. And Achish said to David, In knowing you will know that you and your men will go out with me into battle.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in those days that the Philistines gathered themselves together with their armies to go out to fight with Israel; and Anchus said to David, Know surely, that thou shalt go forth to battle with me, thou, and thy men.

fresh_translation: And David said to Achish, Thus now you will know what your servant will do. And Achish said to David, Thus I will appoint you chief bodyguard all the days.
brenton_translation: And David said to Anchus, Thus now thou shalt know what thy servant will do. And Anchus said to David, So will I make thee captain of my body-guard continually.

fresh_translation: And Samuel died, and all Israel mourned for him and buried him in Ramathaim-Zophim, in his city. And Saul removed the ventriloquists and the knowers from the land.
brenton_translation: And Samuel died, and all Israel lamented for him, and they bury him in his city, in Armathaim. And Saul had removed those who had in them divining spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners gather and come and camp in Shunem, and Saul gathers every man of Israel and they camp in Gilboa.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines assemble themselves, and come and encamp in Sonam: and Saul gathers all the men of Israel, and they encamp in Gelbue.

fresh_translation: And Saul saw the camp of the foreigners and feared, and his heart stood outside itself greatly.
brenton_translation: And Saul saw the camp of the Philistines, and he was alarmed, and his heart was greatly dismayed.

fresh_translation: And Saul inquired through the Lord, and the Lord did not answer him in dreams and in manifestations and in prophets.
brenton_translation: And Saul enquired of the Lord; and the Lord answered him not by dreams, nor by manifestations, nor by prophets.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to his servants, Seek for me a ventriloquist woman, and I will go to her and inquire by her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a ventriloquist woman in Endor.
brenton_translation: Then Saul said to his servants, Seek for me a woman who has in her a divining spirit, and I will go to her, and enquire of her: and his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman who has in her a divining spirit at Aendor.

fresh_translation: And Saul disguised himself and clothed himself with other garments, and he goes, he and two men with him, and they come to the woman by night, and he said to her, Divine for me now by the ventriloquist, and bring up for me whomever I tell you.
brenton_translation: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he goes, and two men with him, and they come to the woman by night; and he said to her, Divine to me, I pray thee, by the divining spirit within thee, and bring up to me him whom I shall name to thee.

fresh_translation: And the woman said to him, Behold now, you know what Saul did, how he destroyed the ventriloquists and the knowers from the land. And why are you trapping my life to put it to death?
brenton_translation: And the woman said to him, Behold now, thou knowest what Saul has done, how he has cut off those who had in them divining spirits, and the wizards from the land, and why dost thou spread a snare for my life to destroy it?

fresh_translation: And Saul swore to her, saying, As the Lord lives, wrongdoing will not meet you in this matter.
brenton_translation: And Saul swore to her, and said, As the Lord lives, no injury shall come upon thee on this account.

fresh_translation: And the woman said, Whom shall I bring up for you? And he said, Bring up Samuel for me.
brenton_translation: And the woman said, Whom shall I bring up to thee? and he said, Bring up to me Samuel.

fresh_translation: And the woman saw Samuel and cried out with a great voice, and the woman said to Saul, Why did you deceive me? And you are Saul.
brenton_translation: And the woman saw Samuel, and cried out with a loud voice: and the woman said to Saul, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou art Saul.

fresh_translation: And the king said to her, Do not fear. Tell me, what have you seen? And she said to him, I have seen gods coming up from the earth.
brenton_translation: And the king said to her, Fear not; tell me whom thou hast seen. And the woman said to him, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.

fresh_translation: And he said to her, What did you recognize? And she said to him, An upright man coming up from the earth, and he had a double cloak wrapped around him. And Saul knew that this was Samuel, and he bent on his face to the ground and bowed down to him.
brenton_translation: And he said to her, What didst thou perceive? and she said to him, An upright man ascending out of the earth, and he was clothed with a mantle. And Saul knew that this was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the earth, and did obeisance to him.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said, Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up? And Saul said, I am in great distress, and the foreigners are fighting against me, and God has departed from me and no longer listened to me, both by the hand of prophets and in dreams. And now I have called you to make known to me what I shall do.
brenton_translation: And Samuel said, Why hast thou troubled me, that I should come up? And Saul said, I am greatly distressed, and the Philistines war against me, and God has departed from me, and no longer hearkens to me either by the hand of prophets or by dreams: and now I have called thee to tell me what I shall do.

fresh_translation: And Samuel said, Why do you ask me, since the Lord has departed from you and has come to be with your neighbor?
brenton_translation: And Samuel said, Why askest thou me, whereas the Lord has departed from thee, and taken part with thy neighbour?

fresh_translation: And the Lord has done for you just as he spoke by my hand, and the Lord will tear your kingdom from your hand and give it to your neighbor, to David.
brenton_translation: And the Lord has done to thee, as the Lord spoke by me; and the Lord will rend thy kingdom out of thy hand, and will give it to thy neighbour David,

fresh_translation: Because you did not hear the voice of the Lord and did not carry out the anger of his wrath in Amalek, because of this thing the Lord has done this to you on this day.
brenton_translation: because thou didst not hearken to the voice of the Lord, and didst not execute his fierce anger upon Amalec, therefore the Lord has done this thing to thee this day.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will deliver Israel with you into the hands of the foreigners, and tomorrow you and your sons with you will fall, and the camp of Israel the Lord will give into the hands of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall deliver Israel with thee into the hands of the Philistines, and to-morrow thou and thy sons with thee shall fall, and the Lord shall deliver the army of Israel into the hands of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And Saul hurried and fell standing to the ground, and he feared greatly from the words of Samuel, and there was no strength in him still, because he had not eaten bread all that day and all that night.
brenton_translation: And Saul instantly fell at his full length upon the earth, and was greatly afraid because of the words of Samuel; and there was no longer any strength in him, for he had eaten no bread all that day, and all that night.

fresh_translation: And the woman came in to Saul and saw that he had been greatly shaken, and she said to him, Behold now, your servant listened to your voice and set my life in my hand, and I listened to the words you spoke to me.
brenton_translation: And the woman went in to Saul, and saw that he was greatly disquieted, and said to him, Behold now, thine handmaid has hearkened to thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have heard the words which thou hast spoken to me.

fresh_translation: And now listen now to the voice of your servant, and I will set before you a morsel of bread, and eat, and there will be strength in you because you will go on the road.
brenton_translation: And now hearken, I pray thee, to the voice of thine handmaid, and I will set before thee a morsel of bread, and eat, and thou shalt be strengthened, for thou wilt be going on thy way.

fresh_translation: And he was not willing to eat, and his servants and the woman pressed him, and he listened to their voice and rose from the ground and sat on the couch.
brenton_translation: But he would not eat; so his servants and the woman constrained him, and he hearkened to their voice, and rose up from the earth, and sat upon a bench.

fresh_translation: And the woman had a grazing heifer in the house, and she hurried and slaughtered it and took flour and kneaded it and baked unleavened bread.
brenton_translation: And the woman had a fat heifer in the house; and she hasted and slew it; and she took meal and kneaded it, and baked unleavened cakes.

fresh_translation: And she brought it before Saul and before his servants, and they ate and rose and went away that night.
brenton_translation: And she brought the meat before Saul, and before his servants; and they ate, and rose up, and departed that night.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners gather all their camps in Aphek, and Israel camped in Endor in Jezreel.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines gather all their armies to Aphec, and Israel encamped in Aendor, which is in Jezrael.

fresh_translation: And the satraps of the foreigners were passing by in hundreds and thousands, and David and his men were passing by at the rear with Achish.
brenton_translation: And the lords of the Philistines went on by hundreds and thousands, and David and his men went on in the rear with Anchus.

fresh_translation: And the satraps of the foreigners said, Who are these passing over? And Achish said to the generals of the foreigners, Is not this David, servant of Saul king of Israel, who has been with us these days, this second year, and I have found nothing in him from the day he fell in with me until this day?
brenton_translation: And the lords of the Philistines said, Who are these that pass by? And Anchus said to the captains of the Philistines, Is not this David the servant of Saul king of Israel? he has been with us some time, even this second year, and I have not found any fault in him from the day that he attached himself to me even until this day.

fresh_translation: And the generals of the foreigners were grieved over him and say to him, Turn the man back to his place where you stationed him, and let him not come with us into battle, and let him not become a plotter in the camp. And by what will this man be reconciled to his lord? Is it not by the heads of those men?
brenton_translation: And the captains of the Philistines were displeased at him, and they say to him, Send the man away, and let him return to his place, where thou didst set him; and let him not come with us to the war, and let him not be a traitor in the camp: and wherewith will he be reconciled to his master? will it not be with the heads of those men?

fresh_translation: Is not this David, to whom they came out in dances, saying, Saul struck in his thousands, and David in his tens of thousands?
brenton_translation: Is not this David whom they celebrated in dances, saying, Saul has smitten his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

fresh_translation: And Achish called David and said to him, As the Lord lives, you are upright, and good in my eyes is your going out and your coming in with me in the camp, and I have found no evil against you from the day you came to me until this day, but in the eyes of the satraps you are not good.
brenton_translation: And Anchus called David, and said to him, As the Lord lives, thou art right and approved in my eyes, and so is thy going out and thy coming in with me in the army, and I have not found any evil to charge against thee from the day that thou camest to me until this day: but thou art not approved in the eyes of the lords.

fresh_translation: And now turn back and go in peace, and you certainly will not do evil in the eyes of the satraps of the foreigners.
brenton_translation: Now then return and go in peace, thus thou shalt not do evil in the sight of the lords of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And David said to Achish, What have I done to you, and what have you found in your servant from the day I was before you until this day, that I should not come to fight the enemies of my lord the king?
brenton_translation: And David said to Anchus, What have I done to thee? and what hast thou found in thy servant from the first day that I was before thee even until this day, that I should not come and war against the enemies of the lord my king?

fresh_translation: And Achish answered David, I know that you are good in my eyes, but the satraps of the foreigners say, He will not come with us into battle.
brenton_translation: And Anchus answered David, I know that thou art good in my eyes, but the lords of the Philistines say, He shall not come with us to the war.

fresh_translation: And now rise early in the morning, you and the servants of your lord who came with you, and go to the place where I stationed you there, and do not set a pestilent word in your heart, because you are good before me. And rise early on the road, and let it grow light for you, and go.
brenton_translation: Now then rise up early in the morning, thou and the servants of thy lord that are come with thee, and go to the place where I appointed you, and entertain no evil thought in thy heart, for thou art good in my sight: and rise early for your journey when it is light, and depart.

fresh_translation: And David rose early, he and his men, to depart and keep the land of the foreigners, and the foreigners went up to fight against Israel.
brenton_translation: So David arose early, he and his men, to depart and guard the land of the Philistines: and the Philistines went up to Jezrael to battle.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when David and his men entered into Ziklag on the third day, Amalek attacked the south and Ziklag and struck Ziklag and burned it with fire.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when David and his men had entered Sekelac on the third day, that Amalec had made an incursion upon the south, and upon Sekelac, and smitten Sekelac, and burnt it with fire.

fresh_translation: And they did not kill man or woman among the women and all in it from small to great, but they took them captive and went on their way.
brenton_translation: And as to the women and all things that were in it, great and small, they slew neither man nor woman, but carried them captives, and went on their way.

fresh_translation: And David and his men came to the city, and behold, it had been burned with fire, and their wives and their sons and their daughters had been taken captive.
brenton_translation: And David and his men came into the city, and, behold, it was burnt with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were carried captive.

fresh_translation: And David and his men lifted up their voice and wept until there was no longer strength in them to weep.
brenton_translation: And David and his men lifted up their voice, and wept till there was no longer any power within them to weep.

fresh_translation: And both David’s wives had been taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelite and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
brenton_translation: And both the wives of David were carried captive, Achinaam the Jezraelitess, and Abigaia the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

fresh_translation: And David was greatly distressed, because the people spoke of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was bitter, each for his sons and for his daughters. And David strengthened himself in the Lord his God.
brenton_translation: And David was greatly distressed, because the people spoke of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, each for his sons and his daughters: but David strengthened himself in the Lord his God.

fresh_translation: And David said to Abiathar the priest son of Ahimelech, Bring near the ephod.
brenton_translation: And David said to Abiathar the priest the son of Achimelech, Bring near the ephod.

fresh_translation: And David inquired through the Lord, saying, Shall I pursue after this raiding band? Shall I overtake them? And he said to him, Pursue, because overtaking you will overtake, and rescuing you will rescue.
brenton_translation: And David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? and he said to him, Pursue, for thou shalt surely overtake them, and thou shalt surely rescue the captives.

fresh_translation: And David went, he and the six hundred men with him, and they come as far as the wadi Besor, and the excess stood there.
brenton_translation: So David went, he and the six hundred men with him, and they come as far as the brook Bosor, and the superfluous ones stopped.

fresh_translation: And David pursued with four hundred men, but two hundred men lagged behind, who sat beyond the wadi Besor.
brenton_translation: And he pursued them with four hundred men; and there remained behind two hundred men, who tarried on the other side of the brook Bosor.

fresh_translation: And they find an Egyptian man in the field and take him and lead him to David in the field, and they give him bread, and he ate, and they gave him water to drink.
brenton_translation: And they find an Egyptian in the field, and they take him, and bring him to David; and they gave him bread and he ate, and they caused him to drink water.

fresh_translation: And they gave him a piece of a cake, and he ate, and his spirit was restored within him, because he had not eaten bread and had not drunk water three days and three nights.
brenton_translation: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and he ate, and his spirit was restored in him; for he had not eaten bread, and had not drunk water three days and three nights.

fresh_translation: And David said to him, Whose are you, and from where are you? And the Egyptian young man said, I am slave of an Amalekite man, and my lord left me because I became sick, today the third day.
brenton_translation: And David said to him, Whose art thou? and whence art thou? and the young man the Egyptian said, I am the servant of an Amalekite; and my master left me, because I was taken ill three days ago.

fresh_translation: And we attacked the south of Cherethites and the parts of Judah and the south of Caleb, and we burned Ziklag with fire.
brenton_translation: And we made an incursion on the south of the Chelethite, and on the parts of Judea, and on the south of Chelub, and we burnt Sekelac with fire.

fresh_translation: And David said to him, Will you lead me down against this raiding band? And he said, Swear to me by God not to put me to death and not to hand me into the hands of my lord, and I will lead you down against this raiding band.
brenton_translation: And David said to him, Wilt thou bring me down to this troop? and he said, Swear now to me by God, that thou wilt not kill me, and that thou wilt not deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down upon this troop.

fresh_translation: And he led him down there, and behold, they were spread out over the face of all the land, eating and drinking and feasting over all the great spoil they had taken from the land of the foreigners and from the land of Judah.
brenton_translation: So he brought him down thither, and behold, they were scattered abroad upon the surface of the whole land, eating and drinking, and feasting by reason of all the great spoils which they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Juda.

fresh_translation: And David came upon them and struck them from dawn until evening and on the next day, and there was not saved from them a man, except four hundred young men who had mounted on the camels and fled.
brenton_translation: And David came upon them, and smote them from the morning till the evening, and on the next day; and not one of them escaped, except four hundred young men, who were mounted on camels, and fled.

fresh_translation: And David took away all that the Amalekites had taken, and he rescued both his wives.
brenton_translation: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and he rescued both his wives.

fresh_translation: And nothing was missing to them from small to great and from the spoil and to sons and daughters and to all that they had taken from them; David returned everything.
brenton_translation: And nothing was wanting to them of great or small, either of the spoils, or the sons and daughters, or anything that they had taken of theirs; and David recovered all.

fresh_translation: And David took all the flocks and the herds and drove them before the spoils, and to those spoils it was said, These are David’s spoils.
brenton_translation: And he took all the flocks, and the herds, and led them away before the spoils: and it was said of these spoils, These are the spoils of David.

fresh_translation: And David comes to the two hundred men who had become too faint to go after David, and he seated them at the wadi Besor. And they went out to meet David and to meet the people with him, and David came near to the people, and they asked him the things of peace.
brenton_translation: And David comes to the two hundred men who were left behind that they should not follow after David, and he had caused them to remain by the brook of Bosor; and they came forth to meet David, and to meet his people with him: and David drew near to the people, and they asked him how he did.

fresh_translation: And every pestilent and evil man of the fighting men who had gone with David answered and said, Because they did not pursue with us, we will not give them from the spoil that we rescued, except each his wife and his children; let them take them and go away.
brenton_translation: Then every ill-disposed and bad man of the soldiers who had gone with David, answered and said, Because they did not pursue together with us, we will not give them of the spoils which we have recovered, only let each one lead away with him his wife and his children, and let them return.

fresh_translation: And David said, You will not do thus, after the Lord gave to us and guarded us and delivered the raiding band coming against us into our hands.
brenton_translation: And David said, Ye shall not do so, after the Lord has delivered the enemy to us, and guarded us, and the Lord has delivered into our hands the troop that came against us.

fresh_translation: And who will listen to you in these words? Because their portion is no less, for according to the portion of the one going down into battle, so will be the portion of the one sitting over the baggage; they will divide alike.
brenton_translation: And who will hearken to these your words? for they are not inferior to us; for according to the portion of him that went down to the battle, so shall be the portion of him that abides with the baggage; they shall share alike.

fresh_translation: And it came to be from that day and above, and it became an ordinance and a judgment for Israel until today.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass from that day forward, that it became an ordinance and a custom in Israel until this day.

fresh_translation: And David came to Ziklag and sent from the spoils to the elders of Judah and to his neighbors, saying, Behold, from the spoils of the enemies of the Lord,
brenton_translation: And David came to Sekelac, and sent of the spoils to the elders of Juda, and to his friends, saying, Behold some of the spoils of the enemies of the Lord;

fresh_translation: to those in Bethzur and to those in Ramah of the south and to those in Ietthor,
brenton_translation: to those in Bæthsur, and to those in Rama of the south, and to those in Gethor.

fresh_translation: and to those in Aroer and to those in Ammadi and to those in Siphmoth and to those in Esthie, and to those in Gath and to those in Kinan and to those in Saphek and to those in Thimath,
brenton_translation: And to those in Aroer, and to those in Ammadi, and to those in Saphi, and to those in Esthie,

fresh_translation: and to those in Carmel and to those in the cities of Jerahmeelites and to those in the cities of the Kenezite,
brenton_translation: and to those in Carmel, and to those in the cities of Jeremeel, and to those in the cities of the Kenezite;

fresh_translation: and to those in Jerimoth and to those in Beersheba and to those in Noo,
brenton_translation: and to those in Jerimuth, and to those in Bersabee, and to those in Nombe,

fresh_translation: and to those in Hebron and to all the places through which David passed, he and his men.
brenton_translation: and to those in Chebron, and to all the places which David and his men had passed through.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners were fighting against Israel, and the men of Israel fled from before the foreigners and fell wounded on Mount Gilboa.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines fought with Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and they fall down wounded in the mountain of Gelbue.

fresh_translation: And the foreigners closed with Saul and his sons, and the foreigners struck Jonathan and Amminadab and Melchishua, sons of Saul.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines press closely on Saul and his sons, and the Philistines smite Jonathan, and Aminadab, and Melchisa son of Saul.

fresh_translation: And the battle grew heavy against Saul, and the men, the archers, found him, and he was wounded in the flanks.
brenton_translation: And the battle prevails against Saul, and the shooters with arrows, even the archers find him, and he was wounded under the ribs.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to the one carrying his equipment, Draw your sword and pierce me with it, lest these uncircumcised ones come and pierce me and mock me. But the one carrying his equipment was not willing, because he feared greatly. And Saul took the sword and fell upon it.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to his armour-bearer, Draw thy sword and pierce me through with it; lest these uncircumcised come and pierce me through, and mock me. But his armour-bearer would not, for he feared greatly: so Saul took his sword and fell upon it.

fresh_translation: And the one carrying his equipment saw that Saul had died, and he too fell upon his own sword and died with him.
brenton_translation: And his armour-bearer saw that Saul was dead, and he fell also himself upon his sword, and died with him.

fresh_translation: And Saul died, and his three sons, and the one carrying his equipment, on that day together.
brenton_translation: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armour-bearer, in that day together.

fresh_translation: And the men of Israel who were beyond the valley and those beyond the Jordan saw that the men of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, and they abandoned their cities and fled, and the foreigners come and live in them.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those beyond Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead; and they leave their cities and flee: and the Philistines come and dwell in them.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the next day, the foreigners came to strip the dead, and they find Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the morrow that the Philistines come to strip the dead, and they find Saul and his three sons fallen on the mountains of Gelbue.

fresh_translation: And they turned him and stripped off his equipment and send them throughout the land of the foreigners round about, proclaiming good news to their idols and to their people.
brenton_translation: And they turned him, and stripped off his armour, and sent it into the land of the Philistines, sending round glad tidings to their idols and to the people.

fresh_translation: And they placed his equipment in the temple of Ashtaroth, and his body they fixed in the wall of Bethshan.
brenton_translation: And they set up his armour at the temple of Astarte, and they fastened his body on the wall of Bæthsam.

fresh_translation: And the inhabitants of Jabesh of Gileadites heard what the foreigners had done to Saul.
brenton_translation: And the inhabitants of Jabis Galaad hear what the Philistines did to Saul.

fresh_translation: And every mighty man rose and went all the night and took the body of Saul and the body of Jonathan his son from the wall of Bethshan and bring them into Jabesh and burn them there.
brenton_translation: And they rose up, even every man of might, and marched all night, and took the body of Saul and the body of Jonathan his son from the wall of Bæthsam; and they bring them to Jabis, and burn them there.

fresh_translation: And they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree at Jabesh and fasted seven days.
brenton_translation: And they take their bones, and bury them in the field that is in Jabis, and fast seven days.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after the death of Saul, David returned from striking Amalek, and David sat in Ziklag two days.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after Saul was dead, that David returned from smiting Amalec, and David abode two days in Sekelac.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the third day, behold, a man came from the camp from the people of Saul, and his garments were torn and earth was on his head. And it came to be when he entered to David, he fell to the ground and bowed down to him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came from the camp, from the people of Saul, and his garments were rent, and earth was upon his head: and it came to pass when he went in to David, that he fell upon the earth, and did obeisance to him.

fresh_translation: And David said to him, From where do you come? And he said to him, I have escaped from the camp of Israel.
brenton_translation: And David said to him, Whence comest thou? and he said to him, I have escaped out of the camp of Israel.

fresh_translation: And David said to him, What is this word? Report to me. And he said, The people fled from the battle, and many of the people have fallen and died, and both Saul and Jonathan his son have died.
brenton_translation: And David said to him, What is the matter? tell me. And he said, The people fled out of the battle, and many of the people have fallen and are dead, and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead.

fresh_translation: And David said to the young man reporting to him, How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son have died?
brenton_translation: And David said to the young man who brought him the tidings, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?

fresh_translation: And the young man reporting to him said, By chance I happened on Mount Gilboa, and behold, Saul had leaned upon his spear, and behold, the chariots and the horse-commanders had joined close to him.
brenton_translation: And the young man that brought the tidings, said to him, I happened accidentally to be upon mount Gelbue; and, behold, Saul was leaning upon his spear, and, behold, the chariots and captains of horse pressed hard upon him.

fresh_translation: And he looked behind him and saw me and called me, and I said, Behold, here I am.
brenton_translation: And he looked behind him, and saw me, and called me; and I said, Behold, here am I.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Who are you? And I said, I am an Amalekite.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Who art thou? and I said, I am an Amalekite.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Stand now over me and put me to death, because terrible darkness seized me, because all my life is still in me.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Stand, I pray thee, over me, and slay me, for a dreadful darkness has come upon me, for all my life is in me.

fresh_translation: And I stood over him and put him to death, because I knew that he would not live after his fall. And I took the kingship-band that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm and have brought them here to my lord.
brenton_translation: So I stood over him and slew him, because I knew he would not live after he was fallen; and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was upon his arm, and I have brought them hither to my lord.

fresh_translation: And David seized his garments and tore them, and all the men with him tore their garments.
brenton_translation: And David laid hold of his garments, and rent them; and all the men who were with him rent their garments.

fresh_translation: And they mourned and wept and fasted until evening over Saul and over Jonathan his son and over the people of Judah and over the house of Israel, because they were struck by the sword.
brenton_translation: And they lamented, and wept, and fasted till evening, for Saul and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Juda, and for the house of Israel, because they were smitten with the sword.

fresh_translation: And David said to the young man reporting to him, From where are you? And he said, I am son of a sojourning Amalekite man.
brenton_translation: And David said to the young man who brought the tidings to him, Whence art thou? and he said, I am the son of an Amalekite sojourner.

fresh_translation: And David said to him, How were you not afraid to bring your hand to destroy the anointed of the Lord?
brenton_translation: And David said to him, How was it thou wast not afraid to lift thy hand to destroy the anointed of the Lord?

fresh_translation: And David called one of his young men and said, Come near, strike him. And he struck him, and he died.
brenton_translation: And David called one of his young men, and said, Go and fall upon him: and he smote him, and he died.

fresh_translation: And David said to him, Your blood is on your head, because your mouth answered against you, saying, I myself killed the anointed of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And David said to him, Thy blood be upon thine own head; for thy mouth has testified against thee, saying, I have slain the anointed of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And David lamented this lament over Saul and over Jonathan his son.
brenton_translation: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son.

fresh_translation: And he said to teach the sons of Judah; behold, it is written in the Book of the Upright.
brenton_translation: And he gave orders to teach it the sons of Juda: behold, it is written in the book of Right.

fresh_translation: Set up, O Israel, over your dead, upon your high places the wounded. How the mighty have fallen.
brenton_translation: Set up a pillar, O Israel, for the slain that died upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!

fresh_translation: Do not report it in Gath, and do not proclaim good news in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the foreigners rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised exult.
brenton_translation: Tell it not in Geth, and tell it not as glad tidings in the streets of Ascalon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

fresh_translation: Mountains of Gilboa, let no dew come down on you and no rain on you, nor fields of firstfruits, because there the shield of the mighty was defiled, the shield of Saul not anointed with oil.
brenton_translation: Ye mountains of Gelbue, let not dew nor rain descend upon you, nor fields of first-fruits be upon you, for there the shield of the mighty ones has been grievously assailed; the shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.

fresh_translation: From the blood of the wounded, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not turn back empty, and the sword of Saul did not return empty.
brenton_translation: From the blood of the slain, and from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan returned not empty; and the sword of Saul turned not back empty.

fresh_translation: Saul and Jonathan, the beloved and beautiful, not separated, lovely in their life and in their death they were not divided; swifter than eagles, they were made stronger than lions.
brenton_translation: Saul and Jonathan, the beloved and the beautiful, were not divided: comely were they in their life, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, and they were stronger than lions.

fresh_translation: Daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, the one clothing you in scarlet with your ornament, the one bringing golden ornament upon your garments.
brenton_translation: Daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you with scarlet together with your adorning, who added golden ornaments to your apparel.

fresh_translation: How the mighty have fallen in the midst of battle. Jonathan, wounded on your high places.
brenton_translation: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, even the slain ones upon thy high places!

fresh_translation: I am in pain for you, my brother Jonathan. You were made very beautiful to me; your love to me was made wonderful beyond the love of women.
brenton_translation: I am grieved for thee, my brother Jonathan; thou wast very lovely to me; thy love to me was wonderful beyond the love of women.

fresh_translation: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished.
brenton_translation: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

fresh_translation: And it came to be after these things, David inquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up into one of the cities of Judah? And the Lord said to him, Go up. And David said, Where shall I go up? And he said, To Hebron.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after this that David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up into one of the cities of Juda? and the Lord said to him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? and he said, To Chebron.

fresh_translation: And David went up there to Hebron, and both his wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelite and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
brenton_translation: And David went up thither to Chebron, he and both his wives, Achinaam the Jezraelitess, and Abigaia the wife of Nabal the Carmelite,

fresh_translation: And the men with him, each and his household, and they lived in the cities of Hebron.
brenton_translation: and the men that were with him, every one and his family; and they dwelt in the cities of Chebron.

fresh_translation: And the men of Judah come and anoint David there to reign over the house of Judah. And they reported to David, saying that the men of Jabesh of Gileadites buried Saul.
brenton_translation: And the men of Judea come, and anoint David there to reign over the house of Juda; and they reported to David, saying, The men of Jabis of the country of Galaad have buried Saul.

fresh_translation: And David sent messengers to the leaders of Jabesh of Gileadites and said to them, Blessed are you to the Lord, because you did this mercy for your lord, for Saul the anointed of the Lord, and buried him and Jonathan his son.
brenton_translation: And David sent messengers to the rulers of Jabis of the country of Galaad, and David said to them, Blessed be ye of the Lord, because ye have wrought this mercy toward your lord, even toward Saul the anointed of the Lord, and ye have buried him and Jonathan his son.

fresh_translation: And now may the Lord do mercy and truth with you, and indeed I will do these good things with you, because you did this word.
brenton_translation: And now may the Lord deal in mercy and truth towards you: and I also will requite towards you this good deed, because ye have done this.

fresh_translation: And now let your hands be strengthened, and become sons of strength, because your lord Saul has died, and indeed the house of Judah has anointed me over themselves as king.
brenton_translation: And now let your hands be made strong, and be valiant; for your master Saul is dead, and moreover the house of Juda have anointed me to be king over them.

fresh_translation: And Abner son of Ner, commander of Saul, took Ishbosheth son of Saul and brought him up from the camp into Mahanaim.
brenton_translation: But Abenner, the son of Ner, the commander-in-chief of Saul's army, took Jebosthe son of Saul, and brought him up from the camp to Manaem

fresh_translation: And he made him king over Gileadites and over Ashurites and over Jezreel and over Ephraim and over Benjamin and over all Israel.
brenton_translation: and made him king over the land of Galaad, and over Thasiri, and over Jezrael, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

fresh_translation: Forty years old was Ishbosheth son of Saul when he reigned over Israel, and he reigned two years, except that the house of Judah was following David.
brenton_translation: Jebosthe, Saul's son was forty years old, when he reigned over Israel; and he reigned two years, but not over the house of Juda, who followed David.
