fresh_translation: And Joab said to him, You are not a bearer of good news on this day, but you may bring good news on another day. On this day you shall not bring good news, because the king's son is dead.
brenton_translation: And Joab said to him, Thou shalt not be a messenger of glad tidings this day; thou shalt bear them another day; but on this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.

fresh_translation: And Joab said to Cushi, Go, report to the king what you have seen. And Cushi bowed to Joab and ran.
brenton_translation: And Joab said to Chusi, Go, report to the king all that thou hast seen. And Chusi did obeisance to Joab, and went out.

fresh_translation: And Ahimaaz son of Zadok again added and said to Joab, Whatever may happen, let me run too after Cushi. And Joab said, Why would you run, my son, since no payment of good news is for you?
brenton_translation: And Achimaas the son of Sadoc said again to Joab, Nay, let me also run after Chusi. And Joab said, Why wouldest thou thus run, my son? attend, thou hast no tidings for profit if thou go.

fresh_translation: And he said, Whatever may happen, I will run. And he said to him, Run. And Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain and passed Cushi.
brenton_translation: And he said, Why should I not run? and Joab said to him, Run. And Achimaas ran along the way of Kechar, and outran Chusi.

fresh_translation: And David was sitting between the two gates. And the watchman went up to the roof of the gate by the wall and lifted his eyes and saw, and behold, one man was running alone.
brenton_translation: And David was sitting between the two gates: and the watchman went up on the top of the gate of the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone before him.

fresh_translation: And the watchman called out and reported to the king. And the king said, If he is alone, good news is in his mouth. And he came, going and coming near.
brenton_translation: And the watchman cried out, and reported to the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there are good tidings in his mouth. And the man came and drew near.

fresh_translation: And the watchman saw another man running, and the watchman called out to the gatekeeper and said, Behold, another man runs alone. And the king said, This one too is bringing good news.
brenton_translation: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman cried at the gate, and said, And look, another man running alone. And the king said, He also brings glad tidings.

fresh_translation: And the watchman said, I see the running of the first like the running of Ahimaaz son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man and comes in good news.
brenton_translation: And the watchman said, I see the running of the first as the running of Achimaas the son of Sadoc. And the king said, He is a good man, and will come to report glad tidings.

fresh_translation: And Ahimaaz called out and said to the king, Peace. And he bowed before the king with his face to the ground and said, Blessed be the Lord your God, who shut up the men who lifted their hand against my lord the king.
brenton_translation: And Achimaas cried out and said to the king, Peace. And he did obeisance to the king with his face to the ground, and said, Blessed be the Lord thy God, who has delivered up the men that lifted up their hands against my lord the king.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Is it well with the young man Absalom? And Ahimaaz said, I saw the great crowd when Joab sent the servant of the king and your servant, and I did not know what was there.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Is the young man Abessalom safe? and Achimaas said, I saw a great multitude at the time of Joab's sending the king's servant and thy servant, and I knew not what was there.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Turn aside, stand here. And he turned aside and stood.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Turn aside, stand still here. And he turned aside, and stood.

fresh_translation: And behold, Cushi arrived and said to the king, Let my lord the king receive good news, because the Lord has judged for you today against the hand of all those rising against you.
brenton_translation: And, behold, Chusi came up, and said to the king, Let my lord the king hear glad tidings, for the Lord has avenged thee this day upon all them that rose up against thee.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Cushi, Is it well with the young man Absalom? And Cushi said, May the enemies of my lord the king and all who have risen up against him for evil become like that young man.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Chusi, Is it well with the young man Abessalom? and Chusi said, Let the enemies of my lord the king, and all whosoever have risen up against him for evil, be as that young man.

fresh_translation: And the king was troubled and went up to the upper room of the gate and wept, and thus he said as he went, My son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom. Who will give my death instead of you? I, instead of you, Absalom, my son, my son.
brenton_translation: And the king was troubled, and went to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and thus he said as he went, My son Abessalom, my son, my son Abessalom; would God I had died for thee, even I had died for thee, Abessalom, my son, my son!

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Joab, saying, Behold, the king is weeping and mourning over Absalom.
brenton_translation: And they brought Joab word, saying, Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And the victory on that day became mourning for all the people, because the people heard on that day, saying, The king grieves over his son.
brenton_translation: And the victory was turned that day into mourning to all the people, for the people heard say that day, The king grieves after his son.

fresh_translation: And the people were slipping into the city on that day, as the people slip in ashamed when they flee in battle.
brenton_translation: And the people stole away that day to go into the city, as people steal away when they are ashamed as they flee in the battle.

fresh_translation: And the king hid his face, and the king cried out with a loud voice, saying, My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son.
brenton_translation: And the king hid his face: and the king cried with a loud voice, My son Abessalom! Abessalom my son!

fresh_translation: And Joab came to the king in the house and said, Today you have put to shame the face of all your servants, those who are rescuing you today and the lives of your sons and your daughters and the lives of your wives and your concubines,
brenton_translation: And Joab went in to the king, into the house, and said, Thou hast this day shamed the faces of all thy servants that have delivered thee this day, and have saved the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and of thy concubines,

fresh_translation: by loving those who hate you and hating those who love you. For you declared today that your commanders and servants are nothing, because I know today that if Absalom were alive and all of us today dead, then it would have been right in your eyes.
brenton_translation: forasmuch as thou lovest them that hate thee, and hatest them that love thee; and thou hast this day declared, that thy princes and thy servants are nothing in thy sight: for I know this day, that if Abessalom were alive, and all of us dead to-day, then it would have been right in thy sight.

fresh_translation: And now rise, go out, and speak to the heart of your servants, because by the Lord I have sworn that if you do not go out, not a man will lodge with you tonight, and know for yourself that this will be worse for you than all the evil that has come upon you from your youth until now.
brenton_translation: And now arise, and go forth, and speak comfortably to thy servants; for I have sworn by the Lord, that unless thou wilt go forth to-day, there shall not a man remain with thee this night: and know for thyself, this thing will indeed be evil to thee beyond all the evil that has come upon thee from thy youth until now.

fresh_translation: And the king rose and sat in the gate, and all the people reported, saying, Behold, the king sits in the gate. And all the people came before the king. And Israel fled, a man to his tents.
brenton_translation: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate: and all the people reported, saying, Behold, the king sits in the gate. And all the people went in before the king to the gate; for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

fresh_translation: And all the people were disputing in all the tribes of Israel, saying, King David rescued us from all our enemies and himself delivered us from the hand of the foreigners, and now he has fled from the land and from his kingdom because of Absalom.
brenton_translation: And all the people disputed among all the tribes of Israel, saying, King David delivered us from all our enemies, and he rescued us from the hand of the Philistines: and now he has fled from the land, and from his kingdom, and from Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, has died in battle. So now why are you silent about bringing back the king? And the word of all Israel came to the king.
brenton_translation: And Abessalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle: and now why are ye silent about bringing back the king? And the word of all Israel came to the king.

fresh_translation: And King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, Why do you become the last to bring back the king to his house, since the word of all Israel has come to the king?
brenton_translation: And king David sent to Sadoc and Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak to the elders of Israel, saying, Why are ye the last to bring back the king to his house? whereas the word of all Israel is come to the king to his house.

fresh_translation: You are my brothers; you are my bones and my flesh. Why then do you become the last to bring back the king to his house?
brenton_translation: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: why are ye the last to bring back the king to his house?

fresh_translation: And you shall say to Amasa, Are you not my bone and my flesh? Thus may God do to me, and thus may he add, if you shall not be commander of the army before me all the days in place of Joab.
brenton_translation: And ye shall say to Amessai, Art thou not my bone and my flesh? and now God do so to me, and more also, if thou shalt not be commander of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

fresh_translation: And he inclined the heart of every man of Judah as one man, and they sent to the king, saying, Return, you and all your servants.
brenton_translation: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Juda as that of one man; and they sent to the king, saying, Return thou, and all thy servants.

fresh_translation: And the king returned and came as far as the Jordan, and the men of Judah came to Gilgal to go and meet the king, to bring the king across the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And the king returned, and came as far as Jordan. And the men of Juda came to Galgala on their way to meet the king, to cause the king to pass over Jordan.

fresh_translation: And Shimei son of Gera a Benjamite from Bahurim hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.
brenton_translation: And Semei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Baurim, hasted and went down with the men of Juda to meet king David.

fresh_translation: And with him were one thousand men from Benjamin and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons with him and his twenty servants with him, and they made straight for the Jordan before the king.
brenton_translation: And a thousand men of Benjamin were with him, and Siba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons with him, and his twenty servants with him: and they went directly down to Jordan before the king,

fresh_translation: And they performed the service of bringing the king across, and the crossing went over to carry the house of the king across and to do what was right in his eyes. And Shimei son of Gera fell on his face before the king as he was crossing the Jordan.
brenton_translation: and they performed the service of bringing the king over; and there went over a ferry-boat to remove the household of the king, and to do that which was right in his eyes. And Semei the son of Gera fell on his face before the king, as he went over Jordan;

fresh_translation: And he said to the king, Let not my lord reckon lawlessness against me, and do not remember how your servant did wrong on the day when my lord the king went out from Jerusalem, so that the king should put it to heart.
brenton_translation: and said to the king, Let not my lord now impute iniquity, and remember not all the iniquity of thy servant in the day in which my lord went out from Jerusalem, so that the king should mind it.

fresh_translation: For your servant knows that I have sinned. And behold, I came today first of all the house of Joseph to come down and meet my lord the king.
brenton_translation: For thy servant knows that I have sinned: and, behold, I am come to-day before all Israel and the house of Joseph, to go down and meet my lord the king.

fresh_translation: And Abishai son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the anointed of the Lord?
brenton_translation: And Abessai the son of Saruia answered and said, Shall not Semei therefore be put to death, because he cursed the Lord's anointed?

fresh_translation: And David said, What is it to me and to you, sons of Zeruiah, that today you become an enemy to me? Today shall any man in Israel be put to death? For do I not know that today I reign over Israel?
brenton_translation: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Saruia, that ye as it were lie in wait against me this day? to-day no man in Israel shall be put to death, for I know not if I this day reign over Israel.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Shimei, You shall not die. And the king swore to him.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Semei, Thou shalt not die: and the king swore to him.

fresh_translation: And Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul came down to meet the king, and he had not cared for his feet, nor trimmed his nails, nor tended his mustache, nor washed his garments from the day the king left until the day he came in peace.
brenton_translation: And Memphibosthe the son of Saul's son went down to meet the king, and had not dressed his feet, nor pared his nails, nor shaved himself, neither had he washed his garments, from the day that the king departed, until the day when he arrived in peace.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when he entered Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said to him, Why did you not go with me, Mephibosheth?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he went into Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said to him, Why didst thou not go with me, Memphibosthe?

fresh_translation: And Mephibosheth said to him, My lord king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said to him, Saddle the donkey for me, and I will mount it and go with the king, because your servant is lame.
brenton_translation: And Memphibosthe said to him, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me; for thy servant said to him, Saddle me the ass, and I will ride upon it, and go with the king; for thy servant is lame.

fresh_translation: And he schemed against your servant to my lord the king. But my lord the king is like an angel of God. So do what is good in your eyes.
brenton_translation: And he has dealt deceitfully with thy servant to my lord the king: but my lord the king is as an angel of God, and do thou that which is good in thine eyes.

fresh_translation: For all the house of my father were nothing but men of death to my lord the king, yet you set your servant among those eating at your table. And what right have I still, even to cry out further to the king?
brenton_translation: For all the house of my father were but as dead men before my lord the king; yet thou hast set thy servant among them that eat at thy table: and what right have I any longer even to cry to the king?

fresh_translation: And the king said to him, Why do you still speak your words? I have said, You and Ziba shall divide the field.
brenton_translation: And the king said to him, Why speakest thou any longer of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Siba shall divide the land.

fresh_translation: And Mephibosheth said to the king, Indeed, let him take all, after my lord the king has come in peace to his house.
brenton_translation: And Memphibosthe said to the king, Yea, let him take all, since my lord the king has come in peace to his house.

fresh_translation: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim and crossed with the king over the Jordan to escort him over the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And Berzelli the Galaadite came down from Rogellim, and crossed over Jordan with the king, that he might conduct the king over Jordan.

fresh_translation: And Barzillai was a very old man, a son of eighty years, and he had sustained the king while he stayed in Mahanaim, because he was a very great man.
brenton_translation: And Berzelli was a very old man, eighty years old; and he had maintained the king when he dwelt in Manaim; for he was a very great man.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Barzillai, You shall cross over with me, and I will sustain your old age with me in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Berzelli, Thou shalt go over with me, and I will nourish thine old age with me in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Barzillai said to the king, How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?
brenton_translation: And Berzelli said to the king, How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

fresh_translation: I am eighty years old today. Will I still know between good and evil? Will your servant still taste what I eat or what I drink? Will I still hear the voice of singers and singing women? Why then should your servant still be a burden to my lord the king?
brenton_translation: I am this day eighty years old: can I then distinguish between good and evil? Can thy servant taste any longer what I eat or drink? can I any longer hear the voice of singing men or singing women? and wherefore shall thy servant any longer be a burden to my lord the king?

fresh_translation: Your servant will just cross the Jordan a little way with the king. Why should the king repay me with this repayment?
brenton_translation: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why does the king return me this recompense?

fresh_translation: Let your servant sit now, and I will die in my city, beside the tomb of my father and my mother. And behold, your servant Chimham will cross over with my lord the king, and do for him what is good in your eyes.
brenton_translation: Let, I pray thee, thy servant remain, and I will die in my city, by the tomb of my father and of my mother. And, behold, thy servant Chamaam shall go over with my lord the king; and do thou to him as it seems good in thine eyes.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Chimham shall cross with me, and I will do for him what is good in your eyes, and whatever you choose from me, I will do for you.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Let Chamaam go over with me, and I will do to him what is good in my sight; and whatsoever thou shalt choose at my hand, I will do for thee.

fresh_translation: And all the people crossed the Jordan, and the king crossed. And the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him, and he returned to his place.
brenton_translation: And all the people went over Jordan, and the king went over; and the king kissed Berzelli, and blessed him; and he returned to his place.

fresh_translation: And the king crossed into Gilgal, and Chimham crossed with him, and all the people of Judah crossing with the king, and also half the people of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the king went over to Galgala, and Chamaam went over with him: and all the men of Juda went over with the king, and also half the people of Israel.

fresh_translation: And behold, every man of Israel came to the king and said to the king, Why did our brothers, the men of Judah, steal you away and bring the king and his house across the Jordan, and all David's men with him?
brenton_translation: And behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, Why have our brethren the men of Juda stolen thee away, and caused the king and all his house to pass over Jordan, and all the men of David with him?

fresh_translation: And every man of Judah answered the man of Israel, and they said, Because the king is near to me. And why have you been angered about this matter? Did we eat by eating from the king, or did he give us a gift, or did he lift something for us?
brenton_translation: And all the men of Juda answered the men of Israel, and said, Because the king is near of kin to us: and why were you thus angry concerning this matter? have we indeed eaten of the king's food? or has he given us a gift, or has he sent us a portion?

fresh_translation: And the man of Israel answered the man of Judah and said, I have ten hands in the kingdom, and I am firstborn more than you, and indeed I have more claim in David than you. So why did you treat me lightly? And was not my word first for bringing back my king? But the word of the men of Judah was harsher than the word of the men of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the men of Israel answered the men of Juda, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we are older than you, we have also an interest in David above you: and why have ye thus insulted us, and why was not our advice taken before that of Juda, to bring back our king? And the speech of the men of Juda was sharper than the speech of the men of Israel.

fresh_translation: And there happened to be there a lawless man, and his name was Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjamite man. And he sounded the horn and said, We have no share in David, nor inheritance for us in the son of Jesse. Each man to your tents, O Israel.
brenton_translation: And there was a transgressor so called there, and his name was Sabee, a Benjamite, the son of Bochori: and he blew the trumpet, and said, We have no portion in David, neither have we any inheritance in the son of Jessæ: to thy tents, O Israel, every one.

fresh_translation: And every man of Israel went up from following David after Sheba son of Bichri, but the men of Judah clung to their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And all the men of Israel went up from following David after Sabee the son of Bochori: but the men of Juda adhered to their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And David entered his house at Jerusalem, and the king took the ten women, his concubines, whom he had left to guard the house, and gave them into a house of custody and sustained them, but he did not go in to them. And they were shut away until the day of their death, living as widows.
brenton_translation: And David went into his house at Jerusalem: and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and he put them in a place of custody, and maintained them, and went not in to them; and they were kept living as widows, till the day of their death.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Amasa, Summon for me the men of Judah within three days, and you yourself stand here.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Amessai, Call to me the men of Juda for three days, and do thou be present here.

fresh_translation: And Amasa went to summon Judah, but he delayed beyond the set time that David had appointed for him.
brenton_translation: And Amessai went to call Juda, and delayed beyond the time which David appointed him.

fresh_translation: And David said to Abishai, Now Sheba son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom. So now take with you the servants of your lord and pursue after him, lest he find fortified cities for himself and hide from our eyes.
brenton_translation: And David said to Amessai, Now shall Sabee the son of Bochori do us more harm than Abessalom: now then take thou with thee the servants of thy lord, and follow after him, lest he find for himself strong cities, so will he blind our eyes.

fresh_translation: And after him went out the men of Joab and the Cherethite and the Pelethites and all the mighty men, and they went out from Jerusalem to pursue after Sheba son of Bichri.
brenton_translation: And there went out after him Amessai and the men of Joab, and the Cherethites, and the Phelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out from Jerusalem to pursue after Sabee the son of Bochori.

fresh_translation: And they were by the great stone that is in Gibeon, and Amasa came before them. And Joab was girded with his cloak, his garment, and over it he was girded with a sword fastened at his waist in its sheath, and the sword came out and fell.
brenton_translation: And they were by the great stone that is in Gabaon: and Amessai went in before them: and Joab had upon him a military cloak over his apparel, and over it he was girded with a dagger fastened upon his loins in its scabbard: and the dagger came out, it even came out and fell.

fresh_translation: And Joab said to Amasa, Are you well, my brother? And the right hand of Joab took hold of the beard of Amasa to kiss him.
brenton_translation: And Joab said to Amessai, Art thou in health, my brother? and the right hand of Joab took hold of the beard of Amessai to kiss him.

fresh_translation: And Amasa did not guard against the sword in the hand of Joab, and Joab struck him with it in the belly, and his entrails poured out on the ground, and he did not strike him a second time, and he died. And Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba son of Bichri.
brenton_translation: And Amessai observed not the dagger that was in the hand of Joab: and Joab smote him with it on the loins, and his bowels were shed out upon the ground, and he did not repeat the blow, and he died: and Joab and Abessai his brother pursued after Sabee the son of Bochori.

fresh_translation: And a man from the young men of Joab stood over him and said, Whoever delights in Joab and whoever belongs to David, after Joab.
brenton_translation: And there stood over him one of the servants of Joab, and said, Who is he that is for Joab, and who is on the side of David following Joab?

fresh_translation: And Amasa lay wallowing in blood in the middle of the road, and the man saw that all the people stood still. And he turned Amasa out of the road into a field and threw a garment over him, because he saw that everyone coming upon him had stopped.
brenton_translation: And Amessai was weltering in blood in the midst of the way. And a man saw that all the people stood still; and he removed Amessai out of the path into a field, and he cast a garment upon him, because he saw every one that came to him standing still.

fresh_translation: And when he was removed from the road, every man of Israel passed on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba son of Bichri.
brenton_translation: And when he was quickly removed from the road, every man of Israel passed after Joab to pursue after Sabee the son of Bochori.

fresh_translation: And he passed through all the tribes of Israel into Abel and into Bethmaachah, and all the men in Charri gathered and came after him.
brenton_translation: And he went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, and to Bethmacha; and all in Charri too were assembled, and followed after him.

fresh_translation: And they came and besieged him at Abel and Bethmaachah, and they poured out a siege mound against the city, and it stood at the outer wall, and all the people with Joab were intending to throw down the wall.
brenton_translation: And they came and besieged him in Abel and Phermacha: and they raised a mound against the city and it stood close to the wall; and all the people with Joab proposed to throw down the wall.

fresh_translation: And a wise woman cried out from the wall and said, Hear, hear. Tell Joab now, Come near here, and I will speak to him.
brenton_translation: And a wise woman cried from the wall, and said, Hear, hear; say, I pray ye, to Joab, Draw near hither, and I will speak to him.

fresh_translation: And he came near to her, and the woman said, Are you Joab? And he said, I am. And she said to him, Hear the words of your servant. And Joab said, I am listening.
brenton_translation: And he drew nigh to her, and the woman said to him, Art thou Joab? and he said, I am. And she said to him, Hear the words of thy handmaid; and Joab said, I do hear.

fresh_translation: And she said, saying, In earlier times they spoke a word, saying, They surely asked in Abel and in Dan whether what the faithful of Israel established had failed, and thus they ended matters.
brenton_translation: And she spoke, saying, Of old time they said thus, Surely one was asked in Abel, and Dan, whether the faithful in Israel failed in what they purposed; they will surely ask in Abel, even in like manner, whether they have failed.

fresh_translation: I am one of the peaceful, of the strongholds of Israel, but you seek to put to death a city and a mother-city in Israel. Why are you drowning the inheritance of the Lord?
brenton_translation: I am a peaceable one of the strong ones in Israel; but thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother-city in Israel: why dost thou seek to ruin the inheritance of the Lord?

fresh_translation: And Joab answered and said, Far be it from me, far be it from me, if I should drown or if I should destroy.
brenton_translation: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should ruin or destroy.

fresh_translation: This is not the matter, but a man from the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba son of Bichri is his name, and he lifted his hand against King David. Give him to me alone, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said to Joab, Behold, his head will be thrown to you through the wall.
brenton_translation: Is not the case thus, that a man of mount Ephraim, Sabee son of Bochori by name, has even lifted up his hand against king David? Give him only to me, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said to Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

fresh_translation: And the woman went to all the people and spoke to all the city in her wisdom, and they removed the head of Sheba son of Bichri and threw it to Joab. And he sounded the horn, and they were scattered from the city, each man to his tents. And Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.
brenton_translation: And the woman went in to all the people, and she spoke to all the city in her wisdom; and they took off the head of Sabee the son of Bochori; and took it away and threw it to Joab: and he blew the trumpet, and the people separated from the city away from him, every man to his tent: and Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

fresh_translation: And Joab was over all the army of Israel, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethite and over the Pelethites.
brenton_translation: And Joab was over all the forces of Israel: and Banaias the son of Jodae was over the Cherethites and over the Phelethites.

fresh_translation: And Adoniram was over the tribute, and Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder.
brenton_translation: And Adoniram was over the tribute: and Josaphath the son of Achiluth was recorder.

fresh_translation: And Sheva was secretary, and Zadok and Abiathar were priests.
brenton_translation: And Susa was scribe: and Sadoc and Abiathar were priests.

fresh_translation: And Ira the Jairite too was priest to David.
brenton_translation: Moreover Iras the son of Iarin was priest to David.

fresh_translation: And there was famine in the days of David three years, year following year. And David sought the face of the Lord, and the Lord said, There is guilt on Saul and on his house for blood, because he put the Gibeonites to death.
brenton_translation: And there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David sought the face of the Lord. And the Lord said, There is guilt upon Saul and his house because of his bloody murder, whereby he slew the Gabaonites.

fresh_translation: And King David called the Gibeonites and said to them. Now the Gibeonites are not from the sons of Israel, but from the remnant of the Amorite, and the sons of Israel had sworn to them, yet Saul sought to strike them in his zeal for the sons of Israel and Judah.
brenton_translation: And king David called the Gabaonites, and said to them;—(now the Gabaonites are not the children of Israel, but are of the remnant of the Amorite, and the children of Israel had sworn to them: but Saul sought to smite them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Juda.)

fresh_translation: And David said to the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you, and by what shall I make atonement, so that you may bless the inheritance of the Lord?
brenton_translation: And David said to the Gabaonites, What shall I do to you? and wherewithal shall I make atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the Lord?

fresh_translation: And the Gibeonites said to him, There is no silver or gold for us with Saul and with his house, and it is not for us to put a man to death in Israel. And he said, What you say, I will do for you.
brenton_translation: And the Gabaonites said to him, We have no question about silver or gold with Saul and with his house; and there is no man for us to put to death in Israel.

fresh_translation: And they said to the king, The man brought us to an end and pursued us, he who schemed to wipe us out. Let us destroy him from having any standing in all the border of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he said, What say ye? speak, and I will do it for you. And they said to the king, The man who would have made an end of us, and persecuted us, who plotted against us to destroy us, let us utterly destroy him, so that he shall have no standing in all the coasts of Israel.

fresh_translation: Let seven men be given to us from his sons, and we will expose them to the sun before the Lord in Gibeon of Saul, chosen of the Lord. And the king said, I will give them.
brenton_translation: Let one give us seven men of his sons, and let us hang them up in the sun to the Lord in Gabaon of Saul, as chosen out for the Lord. And the king said, I will give them.

fresh_translation: But the king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul, because of the oath of the Lord that was between them, between David and between Jonathan son of Saul.
brenton_translation: But the king spared Memphibosthe son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the oath of the Lord that was between them, even between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

fresh_translation: And the king took the two sons of Rizpah daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Hermoni and Mephibosheth, and the five sons of Michal daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel son of Barzillai the Moulathite.
brenton_translation: And the king took the two sons of Respha the daughter of Aia, whom she bore to Saul, Hermonoi and Memphibosthe, and the five sons of Michol daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Esdriel son of Berzelli the Moülathite.

fresh_translation: And he gave them into the hand of the Gibeonites, and they exposed them to the sun on the mountain before the Lord. And the seven fell together, and they were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.
brenton_translation: And he gave them into the hand of the Gabaonites, and they hanged them up to the sun in the mountain before the Lord: and they fell, even the seven together: moreover they were put to death in the days of harvest at the commencement, in the beginning of barley-harvest.

fresh_translation: And Rizpah daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock from the beginning of barley harvest until water dripped on them from heaven, and she did not allow the birds of heaven to rest on them by day nor the beasts of the field by night.
brenton_translation: And Respha the daughter of Aia took sackcloth, and fixed it for herself on the rock in the beginning of barley harvest, until water dropped upon them out of heaven: and she did not suffer the birds of the air to rest upon them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to David what Rizpah daughter of Aiah, concubine of Saul, had done, and they were released, and Dan son of Ioa from the offspring of the giants took hold of them.
brenton_translation: And it was told David what Respha the daughter of Aia the concubine of Saul had done, [and they were faint, and Dan the son of Joa of the offspring of the giants overtook them.]

fresh_translation: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men, sons of Jabesh Gilead, who stole them from the square of Bethshan, because the foreigners had set them there on the day the foreigners struck Saul on Gilboa.
brenton_translation: And David went and took the bones of Saul, and the bones of Jonathan his son, from the men of the sons of Jabis Galaad, who stole them from the street of Bæthsan; for the Philistines set them there in the day in which the Philistines smote Saul in Gelbue.

fresh_translation: And he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son, and they gathered the bones of the ones exposed to the sun.
brenton_translation: And he carried up thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son, and gathered the bones of them that had been hanged.

fresh_translation: And they buried the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son and of the ones exposed to the sun in the land of Benjamin at the side, in the tomb of Kish his father, and they did all that the king commanded, and afterward God listened to the land.
brenton_translation: And they buried the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son, and the bones of them that had been hanged, in the land of Benjamin in the hill, in the sepulchre of Cis his father; and they did all things that the king commanded: and after this God hearkened to the prayers of the land.

fresh_translation: And again there was war for the foreigners with Israel, and David went down, and his servants with him, and they fought with the foreigners, and David grew faint.
brenton_translation: And there was yet war between the Philistines and Israel: and David went down and his servants with him, and they fought with the Philistines, and David went.

fresh_translation: And Iesbi, who was among the offspring of Rapha, and the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze, and he was girded with a club, intended to strike David.
brenton_translation: And Jesbi, who was of the progeny of Rapha, and the head of whose spear was three hundred shekels of brass in weight, who also was girt with a club, even he thought to smite David.

fresh_translation: And Abishai son of Zeruiah helped him, and he struck the foreigner and put him to death. Then the men of David swore, saying, You shall no longer go out with us to battle, and you shall not extinguish the lamp of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Abessa the son of Saruia helped him and smote the Philistine, and slew him. Then the men of David swore, saying, Thou shalt not any longer go out with us to battle, and thou shalt not quench the lamp of Israel.

fresh_translation: And after these things there was again war at Gath with the foreigners. Then Sebocha the Astathothite struck Sepph, one of the offspring of Rapha.
brenton_translation: And after this there was a battle again with the Philistines in Geth: then Sebocha the Astatothite slew Seph of the progeny of Rapha.

fresh_translation: And there was war at Gob with the foreigners, and Elhanan son of Ariorgim the Bethlehemite struck Goliath the Gittite, and the shaft of his spear was like a weavers' beam.
brenton_translation: And there was a battle in Rom with the Philistines; and Eleanan son of Ariorgim the Bethleemite slew Goliath the Gittite; and the staff of his spear was as a weaver's beam.

fresh_translation: And again there was war at Gath, and there was a man of measure, and the fingers of his hands and the fingers of his feet were six and six, twenty-four in number, and he too was born to Rapha.
brenton_translation: And there was yet a battle in Geth: and there was a man of stature, and the fingers of his hands and the toes of his feet were six on each, four and twenty in number: and he also was born to Rapha.

fresh_translation: And he reproached Israel, and Jonathan son of Shimeah brother of David struck him.
brenton_translation: And he defied Israel, and Jonathan son of Semei brother of David, smote him.

fresh_translation: These four were born as offspring of the giants in Gath, in the house of Rapha, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
brenton_translation: These four were born descendants of the giants in Geth, the family of Rapha; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

fresh_translation: And David spoke to the Lord the words of this song in the day when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
brenton_translation: And David spoke to the Lord the words of this song, in the day in which the Lord rescued him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul.

fresh_translation: And he said, O Lord, my rock and my fortress and my rescuer for me,
brenton_translation: And the song was thus:

fresh_translation: my God will be my guard; I will trust in him, my shield and horn of my salvation, my supporter and my refuge of salvation; from injustice you will save me.
brenton_translation: my God; he shall be to me my guard, I will trust in him: he is my protector, and the horn of my salvation, my helper, and my sure refuge; thou shalt save me from the unjust man.

fresh_translation: I will call upon the Lord, worthy of praise, and I will be saved from my enemies.
brenton_translation: I will call upon the Lord who is worthy to be praised, and I shall be saved from my enemies.

fresh_translation: For breakers of death surrounded me; torrents of lawlessness terrified me.
brenton_translation: For the troubles of death compassed me, the floods of iniquity amazed me:

fresh_translation: The birth-pangs of death encircled me; hardnesses of death came before me.
brenton_translation: the pangs of death surrounded me, the agonies of death prevented me.

fresh_translation: When I was afflicted, I will call on the Lord, and I will cry out to my God, and he will hear my voice from his temple, and my cry will be in his ears.
brenton_translation: When I am afflicted I will call upon the Lord, and will cry to my God, and he shall hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry shall come into his ears.

fresh_translation: And the earth was shaken and quaked, and the foundations of heaven were troubled and convulsed, because the Lord was angry with them.
brenton_translation: And the earth was troubled and quaked, and the foundations of heaven were confounded and torn asunder, because the Lord was wroth with them.

fresh_translation: Smoke went up in his anger, and fire from his mouth devours; coals were kindled from it.
brenton_translation: There went up a smoke in his wrath, and fire out of his mouth devours: coals were kindled at it.

fresh_translation: And he bent the heavens and came down, and gloom was under his feet.
brenton_translation: And he bowed the heavens, and came down, and there was darkness under his feet.

fresh_translation: And he rode on cheroubin and flew, and he was seen on the wings of wind.
brenton_translation: And he rode upon the cherubs and did fly, and was seen upon the wings of the wind.

fresh_translation: And he made darkness his hiding place around him, his tent, dark water thickened in the clouds of air.
brenton_translation: And he made darkness his hiding-place; his tabernacle round about him was the darkness of waters, he condensed it with the clouds of the air.

fresh_translation: From the brightness before him coals of fire were kindled.
brenton_translation: At the brightness before him coals of fire were kindled.

fresh_translation: The Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave his voice.
brenton_translation: The Lord thundered out of heaven, and the Most High uttered his voice.

fresh_translation: And he sent arrows and scattered them, lightning and threw them into panic.
brenton_translation: And he sent forth arrows, and scattered them, and he flashed lightning, and dismayed them.

fresh_translation: And the channels of the sea were seen, and the foundations of the world were uncovered at the rebuke of the Lord, from the breath of the spirit of his wrath.
brenton_translation: And the channels of the sea were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuke of the Lord, at the blast of the breath of his anger.

fresh_translation: He sent from on high and took me; he drew me out of many waters.
brenton_translation: He sent from above and took me; he drew me out of many waters.

fresh_translation: He rescued me from my strong enemies, from those hating me, because they were stronger than I.
brenton_translation: He delivered me from my strong enemies, from them that hated me, for they were stronger than I.

fresh_translation: They came before me in the day of my affliction, and the Lord became my support.
brenton_translation: The days of my affliction prevented me; but the Lord was my stay.

fresh_translation: And he brought me out into breadth and delivered me, because he delighted in me.
brenton_translation: And he brought me into a wide place, and rescued me, because he delighted in me.

fresh_translation: And the Lord repaid me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he repaid me.
brenton_translation: And the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness; even according to the purity of my hands did he recompense me.

fresh_translation: Because I kept the ways of the Lord and did not act impiously away from my God.
brenton_translation: Because I kept the ways of the Lord, and did not wickedly depart from my God.

fresh_translation: Because all his judgments were before me, and his ordinances I did not turn away from.
brenton_translation: For all his judgments and his ordinances were before me: I departed not from them.

fresh_translation: And I will be blameless with him, and I will keep myself from my lawlessness.
brenton_translation: And I shall be blameless before him, and will keep myself from my iniquity.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness and according to the cleanness of my hands before his eyes.
brenton_translation: And the Lord will recompense me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands in his eye-sight.

fresh_translation: With the holy one you will be holy, and with the perfect man you will be perfect.
brenton_translation: With the holy thou wilt be holy, and with the perfect man thou wilt be perfect,

fresh_translation: And with the chosen one you will be chosen, and with the crooked you will be twisted.
brenton_translation: and with the excellent thou wilt be excellent, and with the froward thou wilt be froward.

fresh_translation: And you will save the poor people, and the eyes of the proud you will humble.
brenton_translation: And thou wilt save the poor people, and wilt bring down the eyes of the haughty.

fresh_translation: Because you are my lamp, O Lord, and the Lord will light up my darkness.
brenton_translation: For thou, Lord, art my lamp, and the Lord shall shine forth to me in my darkness.

fresh_translation: Because in you I will run as a raider, and in my God I will leap over a wall.
brenton_translation: For by thee shall I run as a girded man, and by my God shall I leap over a wall.

fresh_translation: The Mighty One, blameless is his way; the word of the Lord is strongly refined by fire; he is a shield for all who trust in him.
brenton_translation: As for the Mighty One, his way is blameless: the word of the Lord is strong and tried in the fire: he is a protector to all that put their trust in him.

fresh_translation: For who is mighty besides the Lord, and who will be a creator besides our God?
brenton_translation: Who is strong, but the Lord? and who will be a Creator except our God?

fresh_translation: The Mighty One who strengthens me with power and made my way blameless,
brenton_translation: It is the Mighty One who strengthens me with might, and has prepared my way without fault.

fresh_translation: making my feet like deer's feet and setting me upon the heights,
brenton_translation: He makes my feet like harts' feet, and sets me upon the high places.

fresh_translation: teaching my hands for war and bending a bronze bow with my arms.
brenton_translation: He teaches my hands to war, and has broken a brazen bow by my arm.

fresh_translation: And you gave me the shield of my salvation, and your attentive hearing multiplied me.
brenton_translation: And thou hast given me the shield of my salvation, and thy propitious dealing has increased me,

fresh_translation: You widened my steps under me, and my ankles did not give way.
brenton_translation: so as to make room under me for my going, and my legs did not totter.

fresh_translation: I will pursue my enemies and destroy them, and I will not turn back until I finish them.
brenton_translation: I will pursue my enemies, and will utterly destroy them; and I will not turn again till I have consumed them.

fresh_translation: And I will crush them, and they will not rise; they will fall under my feet.
brenton_translation: And I will crush them, and they shall not rise; and they shall fall under my feet.

fresh_translation: And you will strengthen me with power for battle; you will bend under me those rising against me.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt strengthen me with power for the war; thou shalt cause them that rise up against me to bow down under me.

fresh_translation: And you gave me the back of my enemies, those hating me, and I destroyed them.
brenton_translation: And thou hast caused mine enemies to flee before me, even them that hated me, and thou hast slain them.

fresh_translation: They will cry out, and there is no helper, to the Lord, and he did not answer them.
brenton_translation: They shall cry, and there shall be no helper; to the Lord, but he hearkens not to them.

fresh_translation: And I beat them small as dust of the earth; like the mud of exits I crushed them thin.
brenton_translation: And I ground them as the dust of the earth, I beat them small as the mire of the streets.

fresh_translation: And you will rescue me from the strivings of peoples; you will keep me as head of nations. A people I had not known served me.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt deliver me from the striving of the peoples, thou shalt keep me to be the head of the Gentiles: a people which I knew not served me.

fresh_translation: Sons of foreigners lied to me; at the hearing of the ear they listened to me.
brenton_translation: The strange children feigned obedience to me; they hearkened to me as soon as they heard.

fresh_translation: Sons of foreigners will fall away and stagger out of their enclosures.
brenton_translation: The strange children shall be cast away, and shall be overthrown out of their hiding-places.

fresh_translation: The Lord lives, and blessed is my guard, and the God, the guard of my salvation, will be exalted,
brenton_translation: The Lord lives, and blessed be my guardian, and my God, my strong keeper, shall be exalted.

fresh_translation: the mighty Lord who gives avenges to me, disciplining peoples under me,
brenton_translation: The Lord who avenges me is strong, chastening the nations under me,

fresh_translation: and bringing me out from my enemies. And you will lift me high above those rising against me; from a man of injustices you will rescue me.
brenton_translation: and bringing me out from my enemies: and thou shalt set me on high from among those that rise up against me: thou shalt deliver me from the violent man.

fresh_translation: Because of this I will confess you, Lord, among the nations, and to your name I will sing psalms,
brenton_translation: Therefore will I confess to thee, O Lord, among the Gentiles, and sing to thy name.

fresh_translation: magnifying the salvations of his king and doing mercy for his anointed, for David and for his seed forever.
brenton_translation: He magnifies the salvation of his king, and works mercy for his anointed, even for David and for his seed for ever.

fresh_translation: And these are the last words of David: Faithful is David son of Jesse, and faithful the man whom the Lord raised up to be the anointed of the God of Jacob, and beautiful are the psalms of Israel.
brenton_translation: And these are the last words of David.

fresh_translation: The Spirit of the Lord spoke in me, and his word was on my tongue.
brenton_translation: The Spirit of the Lord spoke by me, and his word was upon my tongue.

fresh_translation: The God of Israel says; the guard of Israel spoke to me: I will speak a parable. In humanity, how will you make strong the fear of God?
brenton_translation: The God of Israel says, A watchman out of Israel spoke to me a parable: I said among men, How will ye strengthen the fear of the anointed?

fresh_translation: And in God: morning light, when the sun rises at morning, a morning not passed over from brightness, and as grass from the earth after rain.
brenton_translation: And in the morning light of God, let the sun arise in the morning, from the light of which the Lord passed on, and as it were from the rain of the tender grass upon the earth.

fresh_translation: For not so is my house with the Mighty One? For he set for me an everlasting covenant, ready in every time, guarded, because all my salvation and every desire, shall not the lawless one sprout?
brenton_translation: For my house is not so with the Mighty One: for he has made an everlasting covenant with me, ready, guarded at every time; for all my salvation and all my desire is, that the wicked should not flourish.

fresh_translation: But all the lawless are like a thorn thrown out, because they are not taken by hand.
brenton_translation: All these are as a thorn thrust forth, for they shall not be taken with the hand,

fresh_translation: And the man who touches them will arm himself with full iron and the shaft of a spear, and they shall be utterly burned with fire in their shame.
brenton_translation: and a man shall not labour among them; and one shall have that which is fully armed with iron, and the staff of a spear, and he shall burn them with fire, and they shall be burnt in their shame.

fresh_translation: These are the names of the mighty men of David: Ishbosheth the Canaanite, chief of the third. This is Adinon the Asonaean. He drew his sword over eight hundred wounded at one time.
brenton_translation: These are the names of the mighty men of David: Jebosthe the Chananite is a captain of the third part: Adinon the Asonite, he drew his sword against eight hundred soldiers at once.

fresh_translation: And after him Eleazar son of his father's brother, son of a Sousite, among the three mighty men. He was with David at Serran, and when he reproached him among the foreigners, they were gathered there for battle, and the men of Israel went up.
brenton_translation: And after him Eleanan the son of his uncle, son of Dudi who was among the three mighty men with David; and when he defied the Philistines they were gathered there to war, and the men of Israel went up.

fresh_translation: He rose and struck among the foreigners until his hand grew weary and his hand clung to the sword. And the Lord worked a great deliverance on that day, and the people returned after him only to strip the slain.
brenton_translation: He arose and smote the Philistines, until his hand was weary, and his hand clave to the sword: and the Lord wrought a great salvation in that day, and the people rested behind him only to strip the slain.

fresh_translation: And after him Sammaia son of Asa the Aruchite. And the foreigners gathered into a troop, and there was a plot of the field full of lentils, and the people fled from before the foreigners.
brenton_translation: And after him Samaia the son of Asa the Arachite: and the Philistines were gathered to Theria; and there was there a portion of ground full of lentiles; and the people fled before the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And he stood firm in the middle of the plot and rescued it and struck the foreigners, and the Lord worked a great deliverance.
brenton_translation: And he stood firm in the midst of the portion, and rescued it, and smote the Philistines; and the Lord wrought a great deliverance.

fresh_translation: And three from the thirty went down and came at harvest to David at the cave of Adullam, and a troop of foreigners had camped in the valley of Rephaim.
brenton_translation: And three out of the thirty went down, and came to Cason to David, to the cave of Odollam; and there was an army of the Philistines, and they encamped in the valley of Raphain.

fresh_translation: And David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the foreigners was then in Bethlehem.
brenton_translation: And David was then in the strong hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethleem.

fresh_translation: And David desired and said, Who will give me water to drink from the well at Bethlehem that is by the gate? And the station of the foreigners was then in Bethlehem.
brenton_translation: And David longed, and said, Who will give me water to drink out of the well that is in Bethleem by the gate? now the band of the Philistines was then in Bethleem.

fresh_translation: And the three mighty men broke through the camp of the foreigners and drew water from the well at Bethlehem that is by the gate and took it and came to David, but he would not drink it, and poured it out to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the three mighty men broke through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well that was in Bethleem in the gate: and they took it, and brought it to David, and he would not drink it, but poured it out before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he said, Be it far from me, Lord, to do this. Shall I drink the blood of the men who went in their lives? And he would not drink it. These things the three mighty men did.
brenton_translation: And he said, O Lord, forbid that I should do this, that I should drink the blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives: and he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

fresh_translation: And Abishai brother of Joab son of Zeruiah, he was chief among the three, and he lifted his spear against three hundred wounded, and he had a name among the three.
brenton_translation: And Abessa the brother of Joab the son of Saruia, he was chief among the three, and he lifted up his spear against three hundred whom he slew; and he had a name among three.

fresh_translation: From those three he was honored and became their commander, yet he did not come up to the three.
brenton_translation: Of those three he was most honourable, and he became a chief over them, but he reached not to the first three.

fresh_translation: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada, he was a man abundant in deeds, from Kabzeel. He struck the two sons of Ariel of Moab, and he himself went down and struck the lion in the midst of the pit on the day of snow.
brenton_translation: And Banæas the son of Jodae, he was abundant in mighty deeds, from Cabeseel, and he smote the two sons of Ariel of Moab: and he went down and smote a lion in the midst of a pit on a snowy day.

fresh_translation: He struck the Egyptian man, a man worth seeing, and in the hand of the Egyptian was a spear like a weavers' beam. And he went down to him with a staff and snatched the spear from the hand of the Egyptian and killed him with his own spear.
brenton_translation: He smote an Egyptian, a wonderful man, and in the hand of the Egyptian was a spear as the side of a ladder; and he went down to him with a staff, and snatched the spear from the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

fresh_translation: These things Benaiah son of Jehoiada did, and he had a name among the three mighty men.
brenton_translation: These things did Banæas the son of Jodae, and he had a name among the three mighty men.

fresh_translation: He was honored among the three, but to the three he did not come, and David set him over his audience.
brenton_translation: He was honourable among the second three, but he reached not to the first three: and David made him his reporter.

fresh_translation: And these are the names of the mighty men of David the king: Asahel brother of Joab was among the thirty, Elhanan son of Doudi his father's brother in Bethlehem,
brenton_translation: Asael Joab's brother; he was among the thirty. Eleanan son of Dudi his uncle in Bethleem.

fresh_translation: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
brenton_translation: Sæma the Rudæan.

fresh_translation: Helez the Phelothite, Ira son of Ikkesh the Thekoite,
brenton_translation: Selles the Kelothite: Iras the son of Isca the Thecoite.

fresh_translation: Abiezer the Anathothite, from the sons of the Hushathite,
brenton_translation: Abiezer the Anothite, of the sons of the Anothite.

fresh_translation: Zalmon the Aonite, Moore the Netophathite,
brenton_translation: Ellon the Aoite; Noëre the Netophatite.

fresh_translation: Ela son of Baana the Netophathite, Ittai son of Ribai from Gabaeth of Benjamin,
brenton_translation: Esthai the son of Riba of Gabaeth, son of Benjamin the Ephrathite; Asmoth the Bardiamite; Emasu the Salabonite:

fresh_translation: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Huri from Nachaligaias,
Abiel son of the Arabothite, Azmaveth the Barsamite,
Eliahba the Shaalbonite, sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
brenton_translation: the sons of Asan, Jonathan;

fresh_translation: Shammah the Arodite, Achian son of Sarad the Hararite,
brenton_translation: Samnan the Arodite; Amnan the son of Arai the Saraurite.

fresh_translation: Eliphaleth son of the Ahasbai, son of the Maachathite, Eliab son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
brenton_translation: Aliphaleth the son of Asbites, the son of the Machachachite; Eliab the son of Achitophel the Gelonite.

fresh_translation: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Erchi,
brenton_translation: Asarai the Carmelite the son of Uræoerchi.

fresh_translation: Igal son of Nathan from Dynaimea, son of Gaddi,
brenton_translation: Gaal the son of Nathana. The son of much valour, the son of Galaaddi.

fresh_translation: Zelek the Ammonite, Gelorai the Beerothite, carrying the arms of Joab son of Zeruiah,
brenton_translation: Elie the Ammanite.

fresh_translation: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
brenton_translation: Iras the Ethirite. Gerab the Ethenite.

fresh_translation: Uriah the Hittite, altogether thirty-seven.
brenton_translation: Urias the Chettite: thirty-seven in all.

fresh_translation: And again the anger of the Lord burned in Israel, and he shook David among them, saying, Go, number Israel and Judah.
brenton_translation: And the Lord caused his anger to burn forth again in Israel, and Satan stirred up David against them, saying, Go, number Israel and Juda.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Joab, commander of the strength with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba and count the people, and I will know the number of the people.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Joab commander of the host, who was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel and Juda, from Dan even to Bersabee, and number the people, and I will know the number of the people.

fresh_translation: And Joab said to the king, May the Lord your God add to the people as they are and a hundredfold more, with the eyes of my lord the king seeing. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?
brenton_translation: And Joab said to the king, Now may the Lord add to the people a hundred-fold as many as they are, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it: but why does my lord the king desire this thing?

fresh_translation: But the word of the king prevailed against Joab and against the commanders of the force, and Joab and the commanders of the force went out from before the king to count the people of Israel.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless the word of the king prevailed against Joab and the captains of the host:

fresh_translation: And they crossed the Jordan and camped at Aroer, to the right of the city in the middle of the ravine, Gad and Eliezer.
brenton_translation: And they went over Jordan, and encamped in Aroer, on the right of the city which is in the midst of the valley of Gad and Eliezer.

fresh_translation: And they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi, which is Adasai, and they came to Danidan and Udan and went around to Sidon.
brenton_translation: And they came to Galaad, and into the land of Thabason, which is Adasai, and they came to Danidan and Udan, and compassed Sidon.

fresh_translation: And they came to Mapsar of Tyre and all the cities of the Hivite and the Canaanite, and they came south of Judah to Beersheba.
brenton_translation: And they came to Mapsar of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Evite and the Chananite: and they came by the south of Juda to Bersabee.

fresh_translation: And they went around in all the land and came at the end of nine months and twenty days to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And they compassed the whole land; and they arrived at Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

fresh_translation: And Joab gave the number of the counting of the people to the king, and Israel became eight hundred thousand men of strength drawing sword, and the men of Judah five hundred thousand fighting men.
brenton_translation: And Joab gave in the number of the census of the people to the king: and Israel consisted of eight hundred thousand men of might that drew sword; and the men of Juda, five hundred thousand fighting men.

fresh_translation: And David's heart struck him after he had counted the people. And David said to the Lord, I have sinned greatly in what I have done. And now, Lord, please cause the lawlessness of your servant to pass over, because I have acted very foolishly.
brenton_translation: And the heart of David smote him after he had numbered the people; and David said to the Lord, I have sinned grievously, O Lord, in what I have now done: remove, I pray thee, the iniquity of thy servant, for I have been exceedingly foolish.

fresh_translation: And David rose in the morning, and the word of the Lord came to Gad the prophet, the seer of David, saying,
brenton_translation: And David rose early in the morning, and the word of the Lord came to the prophet Gad, the seer, saying, Go, and speak to David, saying,

fresh_translation: Go and speak to David, saying, Thus says the Lord: Three things I am lifting upon you, and choose for yourself one of them, and I will do it to you.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, I bring one of three things upon thee: now choose thee one of them, and I will do it to thee.

fresh_translation: And Gad came to David and reported to him and said to him, Choose for yourself whether three years of famine shall come to you in your land, or three months of your fleeing before your enemies while they pursue you, or three days of death to be in your land. Now then know and see what word I should answer the one who sent me.
brenton_translation: And Gad went in to David, and told him, and said to him, Choose one of these things to befal thee, whether there shall come upon thee for three years famine in thy land; or that thou shouldest flee three months before thine enemies, and they should pursue thee; or that there should be for three days mortality in thy land. Now then decide, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

fresh_translation: And David said to Gad, Distress presses me greatly from every side. Let me now fall into the hand of the Lord, because his mercies are very many. But into the hands of man I will not fall. And David chose death for himself.
brenton_translation: And David said to Gad, On every side I am much straitened: let me fall now into the hands of the Lord, for his compassions are very many; and let me not fall into the hands of man.

fresh_translation: And it was the days of wheat harvest, and the Lord gave death in Israel from morning until the dinner hour, and the break in the people began, and from the people, from Dan to Beersheba, seventy thousand men died.
brenton_translation: So David chose for himself the mortality: and they were the days of wheat-harvest; and the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel from morning till noon, and the plague began among the people; and there died of the people from Dan even to Bersabee seventy thousand men.

fresh_translation: And the angel of God stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, and the Lord relented concerning the evil and said to the angel destroying among the people, Enough now, let your hand go. And the angel of the Lord was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord stretched out his hand against Jerusalem to destroy it, and the Lord repented of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough now, withhold thine hand. And the angel of the Lord was by the threshing-floor of Orna the Jebusite.

fresh_translation: And David said to the Lord when he saw the angel striking among the people, and he said, Behold, I am the one who did wrong, and I am the shepherd who did evil. But these sheep, what have they done? Let your hand now be against me and against my father's house.
brenton_translation: And David spoke to the Lord when he saw the angel smiting the people, and he said, Behold, it is I that have done wrong, but these sheep what have they done? Let thy hand, I pray thee, be upon me, and upon my father's house.

fresh_translation: And Gad came to David on that day and said to him, Go up and set up an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
brenton_translation: And Gad came to David in that day, and said to him, Go up, and set up to the Lord an altar in the threshing-floor of Orna the Jebusite.

fresh_translation: And David went up according to the word of Gad, just as the Lord commanded him.
brenton_translation: And David went up according to the word of Gad, as the Lord commanded him.

fresh_translation: And Araunah looked down and saw the king and his servants passing along above him, and Araunah went out and bowed to the king with his face to the ground.
brenton_translation: And Orna looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on before him: and Orna went forth, and did obeisance to the king with his face to the earth.

fresh_translation: And Araunah said, Why has my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshing floor from you, to build an altar to the Lord, and the plague will be restrained from upon the people.
brenton_translation: And Orna said, Why has my lord the king come to his servant? and David said, To buy of thee the threshing-floor, in order to build an altar to the Lord, that the plague may be restrained from off the people.

fresh_translation: And Araunah said to David, Let my lord the king take and offer to the Lord what is good in his eyes. Behold, the oxen are for whole burnt offerings, and the wheels and the implements of the oxen are for wood.
brenton_translation: And Orna said to David, Let my lord the king take and offer to the Lord that which is good in his eyes: behold, here are oxen for a whole-burnt-offering, and the wheels and furniture of the oxen for wood.

fresh_translation: Araunah gave all these things to the king. And Araunah said to the king, May the Lord your God bless you.
brenton_translation: Orna gave all to the king: and Orna said to the king, The Lord thy God bless thee.

fresh_translation: And the king said to Araunah, No, because in buying I will buy from you for a price, and I will not offer to the Lord my God a whole burnt offering for nothing. And David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Orna, Nay, but I will surely buy it of thee at a fair price, and I will not offer to the Lord my God a whole-burnt-offering for nothing. So David purchased the threshing-floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

fresh_translation: And David built there an altar to the Lord and offered whole burnt offerings and peace offerings, and afterward Solomon added to the altar, because it had been small at first. And the Lord listened to the land, and the plague was restrained from over Israel.
brenton_translation: And David built there an altar to the Lord, and offered up whole-burnt-offerings and peace-offerings: and Solomon made an addition to the altar afterwards, for it was little at first. And the Lord hearkened to the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

fresh_translation: And King David was old, advanced in days, and they covered him with garments, but he did not get warm.
brenton_translation: And king David was old and advanced in days, and they covered him with clothes, and he was not warmed.

fresh_translation: And his servants said, Let them seek for my lord the king a virgin young woman, and she will stand before the king and be warming him and will lie with him, and my lord the king will get warm.
brenton_translation: And his servants said, Let them seek for the king a young virgin, and she shall wait on the king, and cherish him, and lie with him, and my lord the king shall be warmed.

fresh_translation: And they sought a beautiful young woman from all the border of Israel, and they found Abishag the Shunammite and brought her to the king.
brenton_translation: So they sought for a fair damsel out of all the coasts of Israel; and they found Abisag the Somanite, and they brought her to the king.

fresh_translation: And the young woman was very beautiful, and she was warming the king and ministering to him, but the king did not know her.
brenton_translation: And the damsel was extremely beautiful, and she cherished the king, and ministered to him, but the king knew her not.

fresh_translation: And Adonijah son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will reign. And he made for himself chariots and horsemen and fifty men to run before him.
brenton_translation: And Adonias the son of Aggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king; and he prepared for himself chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.

fresh_translation: And his father had never restrained him, saying, Why have you done thus? And he too was very handsome in appearance, and she had borne him after Absalom.
brenton_translation: And his father never at any time checked him, saying, Why hast thou done thus? and he was also very handsome in appearance, and his mother bore him after Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And his words were with Joab son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they were helping after Adonijah.
brenton_translation: And he conferred with Joab the son of Saruia, and with Abiathar the priest, and they followed after Adonias.

fresh_translation: But Zadok the priest and Benaiah son of Jehoiada and Nathan the prophet and Shimei and Rei and the mighty men of David were not after Adonijah.
brenton_translation: But Sadoc the priest, and Banæas the son of Jodae, and Nathan the prophet, and Semei, and Resi, and the mighty men of David, did not follow Adonias.

fresh_translation: And Adonijah sacrificed sheep and calves and lambs beside the stone of Zoheleth, which was near the spring Enrogel, and he called all his brothers and all the nobles of Judah, the servants of the king.
brenton_translation: And Adonias sacrificed sheep and calves and lambs by the stone of Zoelethi, which was near Rogel: and he called all his brethren, and all the adult men of Juda, servants of the king.

fresh_translation: But Nathan the prophet and Benaiah and the mighty men and Solomon his brother he did not call.
brenton_translation: But Nathan the prophet, and Banæas, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he did not call.

fresh_translation: And Nathan said to Beersheba mother of Solomon, saying, Have you not heard that Adonijah son of Haggith has become king, and our lord David did not know?
brenton_translation: And Nathan spoke to Bersabee the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonias the son of Aggith reigns, and our lord David knows it not?

fresh_translation: And now come, let me counsel you with counsel, and rescue your life and the life of your son Solomon.
brenton_translation: And now come, let me, I pray, give thee counsel, and thou shalt rescue thy life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

fresh_translation: Come, go in to King David and say to him, Did you not, my lord king, swear to your servant, saying, Solomon your son will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne? Then why has Adonijah become king?
brenton_translation: Haste, and go in to king David, and thou shalt speak to him, saying, Hast not thou, my lord, O king, sworn to thine handmaid, saying, Thy son Solomon shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then does Adonias reign?

fresh_translation: And behold, while you are still speaking there with the king, I will come in after you and fill out your words.
brenton_translation: And behold, while thou art still speaking there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and will confirm thy words.

fresh_translation: And Beersheba entered to the king in the chamber. And the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was ministering to the king.
brenton_translation: So Bersabee went in to the king into the chamber: and the king was very old, and Abisag the Somanite was ministering to the king.

fresh_translation: And Beersheba bowed and did obeisance to the king, and the king said, What is with you?
brenton_translation: And Bersabee bowed, and did obeisance to the king; and the king said, What is thy request?

fresh_translation: And she said, My lord king, you swore by the Lord your God to your servant, saying, Solomon your son will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne.
brenton_translation: And she said, My lord, thou didst swear by the Lord thy God to thine handmaid, saying, Thy son Solomon shall reign after me, and shall sit upon my throne.

fresh_translation: And now behold, Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord king, did not know.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, Adonias reigns, and thou, my lord, O king, knowest it not.

fresh_translation: And he sacrificed calves and lambs and sheep in abundance and called all the sons of the king and Abiathar the priest and Joab commander of the force, but Solomon your servant he did not call.
brenton_translation: And he has sacrificed calves and lambs and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king's sons, and Abiathar the priest and Joab the commander-in-chief of the host; but Solomon thy servant he has not called.
