fresh_translation: And you, my lord king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, for you to report to them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
brenton_translation: And thou, my lord, O king,—the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, to tell them who shall sit upon the throne of my lord the king after him.

fresh_translation: And it will be, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be sinners.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and Solomon my son shall be offenders.

fresh_translation: And behold, while she was still speaking with the king, Nathan the prophet came.
brenton_translation: And behold, while she was yet talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came. And it was reported to the king,

fresh_translation: And it was reported to the king, Behold, Nathan the prophet. And he entered before the king and bowed to the king with his face to the ground.
brenton_translation: Behold, Nathan the prophet is here: and he came in to the king's presence, and did obeisance to the king with his face to the ground.

fresh_translation: And Nathan said, My lord king, did you say, Adonijah will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne?
brenton_translation: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, didst thou say, Adonias shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

fresh_translation: For he went down today and sacrificed calves and lambs and sheep in abundance and called all the sons of the king and the commanders of the force and Abiathar the priest. And behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and they said, Long live King Adonijah.
brenton_translation: For he has gone down to-day, and has sacrificed calves and lambs and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king's sons, and the chiefs of the army, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and they said, Long live king Adonias.

fresh_translation: But me, your servant, and Zadok the priest and Benaiah son of Jehoiada and Solomon your servant he did not call.
brenton_translation: But he has not invited me thy servant, and Sadoc the priest, and Banæas the son of Jodae, and Solomon thy servant.

fresh_translation: Has this thing happened by my lord the king, and have you not made known to your servant who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
brenton_translation: Has this matter happened by the authority of my lord the king, and hast thou not made known to thy servant who shall sit upon the throne of my lord the king after him?

fresh_translation: And David answered and said, Call Beersheba to me. And she entered before the king and stood before him.
brenton_translation: And king David answered and said, Call me Bersabee: and she came in before the king, and stood before him.

fresh_translation: And the king swore and said, As the Lord lives, who redeemed my life from every affliction,
brenton_translation: And the king swore, and said, As the Lord lives who redeemed my soul out of all affliction,

fresh_translation: that as I swore to you by the Lord God of Israel, saying, Solomon your son will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne instead of me, so I will do on this day.
brenton_translation: as I swore to thee by the Lord God of Israel, saying, Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead, so will I do this day.

fresh_translation: And Beersheba bowed with her face to the ground and did obeisance to the king and said, May my lord King David live forever.
brenton_translation: And Bersabee bowed with her face to the ground, and did obeisance to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

fresh_translation: And King David said, Call Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada to me. And they entered before the king.
brenton_translation: And king David said, Call me Sadoc the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Banæas the son of Jodae: and they came in before the king.

fresh_translation: And the king said to them, Take the servants of your lord with you and mount my son Solomon on my mule and lead him down to Gihon.
brenton_translation: And the king said to them, Take the servants of your lord with you, and mount my son Solomon upon my own mule, and bring him down to Gion.

fresh_translation: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there as king over Israel, and sound the horn and say, Long live King Solomon.
brenton_translation: And there let Sadoc the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him to be king over Israel, and do ye sound the trumpet, and ye shall say, Let king Solomon live.

fresh_translation: And he will sit on my throne, and he will reign instead of me, and I have commanded him to be ruler over Israel and Judah.
brenton_translation: And he shall sit upon my throne, and reign in my stead: and I have given charge that he should be for a prince over Israel and Juda.

fresh_translation: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada answered the king and said, May it be so. May the Lord God of my lord the king confirm it.
brenton_translation: And Banæas the son of Jodae answered the king and said, So let it be: may the Lord God of my lord the king confirm it.

fresh_translation: Just as the Lord was with my lord the king, so may he be with Solomon, and may he enlarge his throne beyond the throne of my lord King David.
brenton_translation: As the Lord was with my lord the king, so let him be with Solomon, and let him exalt his throne beyond the throne of my lord king David.

fresh_translation: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada and the Cherethite and the Pelethites went down and set Solomon upon the mule of King David and led him to Gihon.
brenton_translation: And Sadoc the priest went down, and Nathan the prophet, and Banæas son of Jodae, and the Cherethite, and the Phelethite, and they mounted Solomon upon the mule of king David, and led him away to Gion.

fresh_translation: And Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tent and anointed Solomon, and they sounded the horn, and all the people said, Long live King Solomon.
brenton_translation: And Sadoc the priest took the horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon, and blew the trumpet; and all the people said, Let king Solomon live.

fresh_translation: And all the people went up after him, and they were dancing in dances and rejoicing with great joy, and the earth split at their sound.
brenton_translation: And all the people went up after him, and they danced in choirs, and rejoiced with great joy, and the earth quaked with their voice.

fresh_translation: And Adonijah heard, and all his invited guests with him, and they themselves finished eating. And Joab heard the sound of the horn and said, What is the sound of the city in uproar?
brenton_translation: And Adonias and all his guests heard, and they had just left off eating: and Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, and said, What means the voice of the city in tumult?

fresh_translation: While he was still speaking, behold, Jonathan son of Abiathar the priest came, and Adonijah said, Come in, for you are a man of strength and bring good news.
brenton_translation: While he was yet speaking, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came in: and Adonias said, Come in, for thou art a mighty man, and thou comest to bring glad tidings.

fresh_translation: And Jonathan answered and said, And truly, our lord King David has made Solomon king.
brenton_translation: And Jonathan answered and said, Verily our lord king David has made Solomon king:

fresh_translation: And the king sent with him Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada and the Cherethite and the Pelethites, and they set him upon the mule of the king.
brenton_translation: and the king has sent with him Sadoc the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Banæas the son of Jodae, and the Cherethite, and the Phelethite, and they have mounted him on the king's mule;

fresh_translation: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anointed him as king at Gihon, and they came up from there rejoicing, and the city rang. This is the sound that you heard.
brenton_translation: and Sadoc the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him in Gion, and have gone up thence rejoicing, and the city resounded: this is the sound which ye have heard.

fresh_translation: And Solomon has sat upon the throne of the kingdom.
brenton_translation: And Solomon is seated upon the throne of the kingdom.

fresh_translation: And the servants of the king entered to bless our lord King David, saying, May God make the name of Solomon your son better than your name, and may he enlarge his throne beyond your throne. And the king bowed on his bed.
brenton_translation: And the servants of the king have gone in to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne; and the king worshipped upon his bed.

fresh_translation: And thus too the king said, Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, who gave today one from my seed sitting on my throne, and my eyes are seeing it.
brenton_translation: Moreover thus said the king, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who has this day appointed one of my seed sitting on my throne, and my eyes see it.

fresh_translation: And all the invited guests of Adonijah were terrified and rose up, and each man went on his way.
brenton_translation: And all the guests of Adonias were dismayed, and every man went his way.

fresh_translation: And Adonijah feared before Solomon, and he rose and went away and took hold of the horns of the altar.
brenton_translation: And Adonias feared because of Solomon, and arose, and departed, and laid hold on the horns of the altar.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feared King Solomon and has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death by the sword.
brenton_translation: And it was reported to Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonias fears king Solomon, and holds the horns of the altar, saying, Let Solomon swear to me this day, that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

fresh_translation: And Solomon said, If he becomes a son of strength, not one hair of his will fall to the ground, but if evil is found in him, he will die.
brenton_translation: And Solomon said, If he should be a valiant man, there shall not a hair of his fall to the ground; but if evil be found in him, he shall die.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon sent and brought him down from the altar, and he entered and bowed to King Solomon, and Solomon said to him, Go to your house.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon sent, and they brought him away from the altar; and he went in and did obeisance to king Solomon: and Solomon said to him, Go to thy house.

fresh_translation: And the days drew near for David to die, and he commanded Solomon his son, saying,
brenton_translation: And the days of David drew near that he should die: and he addressed his son Solomon, saying, I go the way of all the earth:

fresh_translation: I am going on the way of all the earth, and you must be strong and become a man.
brenton_translation: but be thou strong, and shew thyself a man;

fresh_translation: And you must keep the charge of the Lord your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his commandments and his ordinances and his judgments, the things written in the law of Moses, so that you may understand what you will do according to all that I command you.
brenton_translation: and keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep the commandments and the ordinances and the judgments which are written in the law of Moses; that thou mayest understand what thou shalt do in all things that I command thee:

fresh_translation: So that the Lord may establish his word that he spoke, saying, If your sons guard their way to walk before me in truth, with all their heart and with all their soul, there will not be destroyed for you a man from upon the throne of Israel.
brenton_translation: that the Lord may confirm his word which he spoke, saying, If thy children shall take heed to their way to walk before me in truth with all their heart, I promise thee, saying, there shall not fail thee a man on the throne of Israel.

fresh_translation: And indeed, you know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me, what he did to the two commanders of the forces of Israel, to Abner son of Ner and to Amasa son of Jether, and he killed them and assigned blood of war in peace and put innocent blood on the belt on his waist and on the sandal on his foot.
brenton_translation: Moreover thou knowest all that Joab the son of Saruia did to me, what he did to the two captains of the forces of Israel, to Abenner the son of Ner, and to Amessai the son of Jether, that he slew them, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put innocent blood on his girdle that was about his loins, and on his sandal that was on his foot.

fresh_translation: And you will do according to your wisdom, and you will not bring his gray hair down in peace to Hades.
brenton_translation: Therefore thou shalt deal with him according to thy wisdom, and thou shalt not bring down his grey hairs in peace to the grave.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite you will do mercy, and they will be among those eating at your table, because thus they came near to me when I was fleeing from before Absalom your brother.
brenton_translation: But thou shalt deal kindly with the sons of Berzelli the Galaadite, and they shall be among those that eat at thy table; for thus they drew nigh to me when I fled from the face of thy brother Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And behold, with you is Shimei son of Gera a Benjamite from Bahurim, and he cursed me with a grievous curse on the day when I was going to the Camps. And he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the Lord, saying, I will not put you to death by the sword.
brenton_translation: And, behold, there is with thee Semei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Baurim: and he cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went into the camp; and he came down to Jordan to meet me, and I swore to him by the Lord, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

fresh_translation: And now do not hold him guiltless, because you are a wise man and will know what you will do to him, and you will bring his gray hair down in blood to Hades.
brenton_translation: But thou shalt by no means hold him guiltless, for thou art a wise man, and wilt know what thou shalt do to him, and shalt bring down his grey hairs with blood to the grave.

fresh_translation: And David slept with his fathers and was buried in the City of David.
brenton_translation: And David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

fresh_translation: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years. In Hebron he reigned seven years, and in Jerusalem thirty-three years.
brenton_translation: And the days which David reigned over Israel were forty years; he reigned seven years in Chebron, and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Solomon sat on the throne of David his father, a son of twelve years, and his kingdom was greatly prepared.
brenton_translation: And Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his kingdom was established greatly.

fresh_translation: And Adonijah son of Haggith entered to Beersheba mother of Solomon and bowed to her. And she said, Is your coming peace? And he said, Peace.
brenton_translation: And Adonias the son of Aggith came in to Bersabee the mother of Solomon, and did obeisance to her: and she said, Dost thou enter peaceably? and he said, Peaceably:

fresh_translation: And he said, A word is mine to you. And she said to him, Speak.
brenton_translation: I have business with thee. And she said to him, Say on.

fresh_translation: And he said to her, You know that the kingdom was mine, and all Israel set its face on me for the king, but the kingdom turned and became my brother's, because it came to him from the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he said to her, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and all Israel turned their face toward me for a king; but the kingdom was turned from me and became my brother's: for it was appointed to him from the Lord.

fresh_translation: And now I ask one request from you. Do not turn away your face. And Beersheba said to him, Speak.
brenton_translation: And now I make one request of thee, do not turn away thy face. And Bersabee said to him, Speak on.

fresh_translation: And he said to her, Speak now to King Solomon, for he will not turn his face from you, and let him give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.
brenton_translation: And he said to her, Speak, I pray thee, to king Solomon, for he will not turn away his face from thee, and let him give me Abisag the Somanite for a wife.

fresh_translation: And Beersheba said, Good. I will speak to the king concerning you.
brenton_translation: And Bersabee said, Well; I will speak for thee to the king.

fresh_translation: And Beersheba entered to King Solomon to speak to him concerning Adonijah. And the king rose to meet her and kissed her and sat on his throne, and a throne was set for the mother of the king, and she sat at his right hand.
brenton_translation: And Bersabee went in to king Solomon to speak to him concerning Adonias; and the king rose up to meet her, and kissed her, and sat on the throne, and a throne was set for the mother of the king, and she sat on his right hand.

fresh_translation: And she said to him, I ask one small request from you. Do not turn away your face. And the king said to her, Ask, my mother, for I will not turn you away.
brenton_translation: And she said to him, I ask of thee one little request; turn not away my face from thee. And the king said to her, Ask, my mother, and I will not reject thee.

fresh_translation: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.
brenton_translation: And she said, Let, I pray thee, Abisag the Somanite be given to Adonias thy brother to wife.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon answered and said to his mother, And why did you ask Abishag for Adonijah? Ask the kingdom for him too, because he is my elder brother greater than I, and he has Abiathar the priest and Joab son of Zeruiah the commander as companion.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon answered and said to his mother, And why hast thou asked Abisag for Adonias? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is my elder brother, and he has for his companion Abiathar the priest, and Joab the son of Saruia the commander-in-chief.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon swore by the Lord, saying, Thus may God do to me, and thus may he add, because Adonijah spoke this word against his own life.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon swore by the Lord, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if it be not that Adonias has spoken this word against his own life.

fresh_translation: And now, as the Lord lives, who prepared me and set me on the throne of David my father and made me a house as the Lord spoke, today Adonijah will be put to death.
brenton_translation: And now as the Lord lives who has established me, and set me on the throne of my father David, and he has made me a house, as the Lord spoke, this day shall Adonias be put to death.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he struck him and Adonijah died on that day.
brenton_translation: So king Solomon sent by the hand of Banæas the son of Jodae, and he slew him, and Adonias died in that day.

fresh_translation: And to Abiathar the priest the king said, Run away to Anathoth, to your field, because you are a man of death on this day. But I will not put you to death, because you carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord before my father and because you were afflicted in all the things in which my father was afflicted.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Abiathar the priest, Depart thou quickly to Anathoth to thy farm, for thou art worthy of death this day; but I will not slay thee, because thou hast borne the ark of the covenant of the Lord before my father, and because thou wast afflicted in all things wherein my father was afflicted.

fresh_translation: And Solomon cast out Abiathar from being priest of the Lord, for the word of the Lord to be fulfilled, which he spoke against the house of Eli at Shallum.
brenton_translation: And Solomon removed Abiathar from being a priest of the Lord, that the word of the Lord might be fulfilled, which he spoke concerning the house of Heli in Selom.

fresh_translation: And the report came to Joab son of Zeruiah, because Joab had inclined after Adonijah, but after Solomon he did not incline. And Joab fled to the tent of the Lord and took hold of the horns of the altar.
brenton_translation: And the report came to Joab son of Saruia; for Joab had turned after Adonias, and he went not after Solomon: and Joab fled to the tabernacle of the Lord, and caught hold of the horns of the altar.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Solomon, saying that Joab fled to the tent of the Lord, and behold, he holds the horns of the altar. And Solomon sent to Joab, saying, What has happened to you that you fled to the altar? And Joab said, Because I feared from before you, and I fled to the Lord. And King Solomon sent Benaiah son of Jehoiada, saying, Go and kill him and bury him.
brenton_translation: And it was told Solomon, saying, Joab has fled to the tabernacle of the Lord, and lo! he has hold of the horns of the altar. And king Solomon sent to Joab, saying, What ails thee, that thou hast fled to the altar? and Joab said, Because I was afraid of thee, and fled for refuge to the Lord. And Solomon sent Banæas son of Jodae, saying, Go and slay him, and bury him.

fresh_translation: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada came to Joab at the tent of the Lord and said to him, Thus says the king: Come out. And Joab said, I will not come out, because I will die here. And Benaiah son of Jehoiada turned back and said to the king, Thus Joab has spoken, and thus he answered me.
brenton_translation: And Banæas son of Jodae came to Joab to the tabernacle of the Lord, and said to him, Thus says the king, Come forth. And Joab said, I will not come forth, for I will die here. And Banæas son of Jodae returned and spoke to the king, saying, Thus has Joab spoken, and thus has he answered me.

fresh_translation: And the king said to him, Go and do to him just as he said, and kill him and bury him, and you will remove today the blood that Joab poured out for nothing from me and from the house of my father.
brenton_translation: And the king said to him, Go, and do to him as he has spoken, and kill him: and thou shalt bury him, and thou shalt remove this day the blood which he shed without cause, from me and from the house of my father.

fresh_translation: And the Lord turned the blood of his injustice onto his head, because he met two men more righteous and better than he and killed them by the sword, and my father David did not know their blood: Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah.
brenton_translation: And the Lord has returned upon his own head the blood of his unrighteousness, inasmuch as he attacked two men more righteous and better than himself, and slew them with the sword, and my father David knew not of their blood, even Abenner the son of Ner the commander-in-chief of Israel, and Amessa the son of Jether the commander-in-chief of Juda.

fresh_translation: And their blood returned upon his head and upon the head of his seed forever, but for David and for his seed and for his house and for his throne, may there be peace forever from the Lord.
brenton_translation: And their blood is returned upon his head, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but to David, and his seed, and his house, and his throne, may there be peace for ever from the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada met Joab and killed him and buried him at his house in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: So Banæas son of Jodae went up, and attacked him, and slew him, and buried him in his house in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And the king gave Benaiah son of Jehoiada in his place over the generalship, and the kingdom was being set right in Jerusalem, and the king gave Zadok the priest as first priest instead of Abiathar. And the Lord gave understanding to Solomon and very much wisdom and breadth of heart like the sand that is beside the sea. And the understanding of Solomon was multiplied greatly beyond the understanding of all the ancients and beyond all the wise of Egypt. And he took the daughter of Pharaoh and brought her into the City of David until he finished his own house and the house of the Lord first and the wall of Jerusalem all around. In seven years he made it and finished it. And Solomon had seventy thousand carrying burdens and eighty thousand stonecutters in the mountain. And Solomon made the Sea and the bases and the great basins and the pillars and the fountain of the court and the bronze sea. And he built the citadel and its battlements and cut through the City of David. Thus the daughter of Pharaoh was going up from the City of David into her house that he built for her. Then he built the citadel. And Solomon offered up three times in the year whole burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar that he built to the Lord and was burning incense before the Lord and finished the house. And these were the rulers set over the works of Solomon, three thousand six hundred overseers of the people doing the works. And he built Asshur and Magdo and Gezer and upper Bethhoron and Baalath. But after he built the house of the Lord and the wall of Jerusalem all around, after these things he built these cities. And while David was still living he commanded Solomon, saying, Behold, with you is Shimei son of Gera, of Benjamite seed from Hebron. He cursed me with a grievous curse on the day when I was going to the Camps, and he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the Lord, saying, He shall not be put to death by the sword. And now do not hold him guiltless, because you are a prudent man and you will know what you will do to him, and you will bring his gray hair down in blood to Hades.
brenton_translation: And the king appointed Banæas son of Jodae in his place over the host; and the kingdom was established in Jerusalem; and as for Sadoc the priest, the king appointed him to be high priest in the room of Abiathar. And Solomon son of David reigned over Israel and Juda in Jerusalem:

fresh_translation: And the king called Shimei and said to him, Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and dwell there, and do not go out from there anywhere.
brenton_translation: And the king called Semei, and said to him, Build thee a house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and thou shalt not go out thence any whither.

fresh_translation: And it will be on the day of your going out and crossing the torrent Kidron, knowing you will know that you will die by death. Your blood will be on your head. And the king made him swear on that day.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in the day that thou shalt go forth and cross over the brook Kedron, know assuredly that thou shalt certainly die: thy blood shall be upon thine head. And the king caused him to swear in that day.

fresh_translation: And Shimei said to the king, Good is the word that you spoke, my lord king. Thus your servant will do. And Shimei sat in Jerusalem three years.
brenton_translation: And Semei said to the king, Good is the word that thou hast spoken, my lord O king: thus will thy servant do. And Semei dwelt in Jerusalem three years.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after three years that two slaves of Shimei ran away to Achish son of Maachah king of Gath, and it was reported to Shimei, saying, Behold, your slaves are in Gath.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the three years, that two servants of Semei ran away to Anchus son of Maacha king of Geth: and it was told Semei, saying, Behold, thy servants are in Geth.

fresh_translation: And Shimei rose and saddled his donkey and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves, and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.
brenton_translation: And Semei rose up, and saddled his ass, and went to Geth to Anchus to seek out his servants: and Semei went, and brought his servants out of Geth.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to Solomon, saying that Shimei went from Jerusalem to Gath and brought back his slaves.
brenton_translation: And it was told Solomon, saying, Semei is gone out of Jerusalem to Geth, and has brought back his servants.

fresh_translation: And the king sent and called Shimei and said to him, Did I not make you swear by the Lord and testify against you, saying, On whatever day you go out from Jerusalem and go to the right or to the left, knowing you will know that you will die by death?
brenton_translation: And the king sent and called Semei, and said to him, Did I not adjure thee by the Lord, and testify to thee, saying, In whatsoever day thou shalt go out of Jerusalem, and go to the right or left, know certainly that thou shalt assuredly die?

fresh_translation: And why did you not keep the oath of the Lord and the commandment that I commanded against you?
brenton_translation: And why hast thou not kept the oath of the Lord, and the commandment which I commanded thee?

fresh_translation: And the king said to Shimei, You know all your evil, which your heart knew, what you did to David my father, and the Lord has returned your evil upon your head.
brenton_translation: And the king said to Semei, Thou knowest all thy mischief which thy heart knows, which thou didst to David my father: and the Lord has recompensed thy mischief on thine own head.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon is blessed, and the throne of David will be prepared before the Lord forever.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon is blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the Lord for ever.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon commanded Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck him and he died. And King Solomon was very understanding and wise, and Judah and Israel were exceedingly many, like the sand on the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and rejoicing. And Solomon was ruler over all the kingdoms, and they were bringing gifts and serving Solomon all the days of his life. And Solomon began opening the domains of Lebanon. And he built Thermai in the wilderness. And this was Solomon's provision: thirty cors of fine flour and sixty cors of beaten flour, ten choice calves and twenty pasture-fed cattle and one hundred sheep, besides deer and gazelles and choice fatted birds. For he was ruler over everything beyond the river, from Raphi to Gaza, over all the kings beyond the river. And he had peace from all his sides all around, and Judah and Israel lived trusting, each under his vine and under his fig tree, eating and drinking, from Dan to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon. And these were the chiefs of Solomon: Azariah son of Zadok the priest, and Orniou son of Nathan, chief of the overseers, and Edram over his house, and Shisha secretary, and Basa son of Achithalam recorder, and Abi son of Joab commander in chief, and Achire son of Edrai over the levies, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the court guard and over the brickwork, and Zachour son of Nathan the counselor. And Solomon had forty thousand brood mares for chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. And he was ruler in all the kingdoms from the river to the land of the foreigners and to the borders of Egypt. Solomon son of David reigned over Israel and Judah in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And Solomon commanded Banæas the son of Jodae, and he went forth and slew him.

fresh_translation: Yet the people were burning incense on the high places, because a house was not yet built for the name of the Lord until now.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless the people burnt incense on the high places, because a house had not yet been built to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Solomon loved the Lord, walking in the ordinances of David his father, except that on the high places he was sacrificing and burning incense.
brenton_translation: And Solomon loved the Lord, so as to walk in the ordinances of David his father; only he sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places.

fresh_translation: And he rose and went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, because that was the highest and greatest high place. Solomon offered one thousand whole burnt offerings on the altar in Gibeon.
brenton_translation: And he arose and went to Gabaon to sacrifice there, for that was the highest place, and great: Solomon offered a whole-burnt-offering of a thousand victims on the altar in Gabaon.

fresh_translation: And the Lord appeared to Solomon in sleep by night, and the Lord said to Solomon, Ask what request for yourself.
brenton_translation: And the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream by night, and the Lord said to Solomon, Ask some petition for thyself.

fresh_translation: And Solomon said, You did great mercy with your servant David my father, just as he walked before you in truth and in righteousness and in the uprightness of heart with you, and you kept for him this great mercy, to give his son upon his throne, as on this day.
brenton_translation: And Solomon said, Thou hast dealt very mercifully with thy servant David my father according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee, and thou hast kept for him this great mercy, to set his son upon his throne, as it is this day.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord my God, you gave your servant instead of David my father, and I am a small child and do not know my going out and my coming in.
brenton_translation: And now, O Lord my God, thou hast appointed thy servant in the room of David my father; and I am a little child, and know not my going out and my coming in.

fresh_translation: And your servant is in the midst of your people whom you chose, a numerous people who will not be numbered.
brenton_translation: But thy servant is in the midst of thy people, whom thou hast chosen, a great people, which cannot be numbered.

fresh_translation: And you will give your servant a heart that hears and discerns your people in righteousness, to understand between good and evil. For who will be able to judge this heavy people of yours?
brenton_translation: Thou shalt give therefore to thy servant a heart to hear and to judge thy people justly, and to discern between good and evil: for who will be able to judge this thy great people?

fresh_translation: And it was pleasing before the Lord that Solomon asked this word.
brenton_translation: And it was pleasing before the Lord, that Solomon asked this thing.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to him, Because you asked from me this word and did not ask for yourself many days and did not ask riches and did not ask the lives of your enemies, but asked for yourself understanding to hear judgment,
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to him, Because thou hast asked this thing of me, and hast not asked for thyself long life, and hast not asked wealth, nor hast asked the lives of thine enemies, but hast asked for thyself understanding to hear judgment;

fresh_translation: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart. One like you did not come to be before you, and after you none like you will arise.
brenton_translation: behold, I have done according to thy word: behold, I have given thee an understanding and wise heart: there has not been any one like thee before thee, and after thee there shall not arise one like thee.

fresh_translation: And what you did not ask I have given you too, both riches and glory, so that no man like you has come to be among kings.
brenton_translation: And I have given thee what thou hast not asked, wealth and glory, so that there has not been any one like thee among kings.

fresh_translation: And if you walk in my way, keeping my commandments and my ordinances as David your father walked, I will multiply your days.
brenton_translation: And if thou wilt walk in my way, to keep my commandments and my ordinances, as David thy father walked, then will I multiply thy days.

fresh_translation: And Solomon awoke, and behold, it was a dream. And he rose and comes to Jerusalem and stood before the altar that was before the ark of the covenant of the Lord in Zion and offered whole burnt offerings and made peace offerings and made a great drinking-feast for himself and for all his servants.
brenton_translation: And Solomon awoke, and, behold, it was a dream: and he arose and came to Jerusalem, and stood before the altar that was in front of the ark of the covenant of the Lord in Sion: and he offered whole-burnt-offerings, and sacrificed peace-offerings, and made a great banquet for himself and all his servants.

fresh_translation: Then two prostitute women appeared to the king and stood before him.
brenton_translation: Then there appeared two harlots before the king, and they stood before him.

fresh_translation: And the one woman said, In me, my lord, I and this woman live in one house, and we gave birth in the house.
brenton_translation: And the one woman said, Hear me, my lord; I and this woman dwelt in one house, and we were delivered in the house.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on the third day after I gave birth, that this woman also gave birth, and we were together, and there was no one with us except the two of us in the house.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the third day after I was delivered, this woman also was delivered: and we were together; and there was no one with us besides our two selves in the house.

fresh_translation: And the son of this woman died in the night, because she lay on him.
brenton_translation: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

fresh_translation: And she rose in the middle of the night and took my son from my embrace while your servant was sleeping and laid him in her bosom, and her dead son she laid in my bosom.
brenton_translation: And she arose in the middle of the night, and took my son from my arms, and laid him in her bosom, and laid her dead son in my bosom.

fresh_translation: And I rose in the morning to nurse my son, and he was dead. And behold, I considered him in the morning, and behold, he was not my son whom I bore.
brenton_translation: And I arose in the morning to suckle my son, and he was dead: and, behold, I considered him in the morning, and, behold, it was not my son whom I bore.

fresh_translation: And the other woman said, No, but my son is the living one, and your son is the dead one. And they were speaking before the king.
brenton_translation: And the other woman said, No, but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. So they spoke before the king.

fresh_translation: And the king said to them, You say, This is my living son, and this one's son is the dead one. And you say, No, but my son is the living one, and your son is the dead one.
brenton_translation: And the king said to them, Thou sayest, This is my son, even the living one, and this woman's son is the dead one: and thou sayest, No, but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought the sword before the king.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Fetch a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Divide the living nursing child into two, and give half of him to this one and half of him to this one.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Divide the live child, the suckling, in two; and give half of it to one, and half of it to the other.

fresh_translation: And the woman whose son was the living one answered and said to the king, because her womb was troubled over her son, In me, my lord, give her the child, and by death do not put him to death. But the other said, Let him be neither mine nor hers. Divide him.
brenton_translation: And the woman whose the living child was, answered and said to the king, (for her bowels yearned over her son) and she said, I pray thee, my lord, give her the child, and in nowise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor hers; divide it.

fresh_translation: And the king answered and said, Give the child to the one who said, Give him to her, and by death do not put him to death. She is his mother.
brenton_translation: Then the king answered and said, Give the child to her that said, ‘Give it to her, and by no means slay it:’ she is its mother.

fresh_translation: And all Israel heard this judgment that the king judged, and they feared before the king, because they saw that understanding of God was in him for doing justice.
brenton_translation: And all Israel heard this judgment which the king judged, and they feared before the king; because they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to execute judgment.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon was reigning over Israel.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon reigned over Israel.

fresh_translation: And these were his rulers: Azariah son of Zadok,
brenton_translation: And these are the princes which he had; Azarias son of Sadoc.

fresh_translation: and Elihoreph and Ahijah sons of Shisha, secretaries, and Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud, recorder,
brenton_translation: Eliaph, and Achia son of Seba, scribes; and Josaphat son of Achilud, recorder.

fresh_translation: and Sadouch and Abiathar, priests,
brenton_translation: And Banæas son of Jodae over the host; and Sadoc and Abiathar were priests.

fresh_translation: and Azariah son of Nathan over those appointed, and Zabud son of Nathan, companion of the king,
brenton_translation: And Ornia the son of Nathan was over the officers; and Zabuth son of Nathan was the king's friend.

fresh_translation: and Achiel household steward, and Eliab son of Saph over the family line, and Adoniram son of Abda over the levies,
brenton_translation: And Achisar was steward, and Eliac the chief steward; and Eliab the son of Saph was over the family: and Adoniram the son of Audon over the tribute.

fresh_translation: and Solomon had twelve appointed officers over all Israel to provide for the king and his house. One month in the year it fell on each to provide.
brenton_translation: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, to provide for the king and his household; each one's turn came to supply for a month in the year.

fresh_translation: And these were their names: Ben-Hur in the hill country of Ephraim, one.
brenton_translation: And these were their names: Been the son of Or in the mount of Ephraim, one.

fresh_translation: Son of Rechab in Makaz and Shaalbim and Beth-shemesh and Elon as far as Elon-beth-hanan, one.
brenton_translation: The son of Dacar, in Makes, and in Salabin, and Bæthsamys, and Elon as far as Bethanan, one.

fresh_translation: Son of Esoth: Berbethnema, Lousamencha, and Hepher.
brenton_translation: The son of Esdi in Araboth; his was Socho, and all the land of Opher.

fresh_translation: Abinadab and Anaphathi. The man of Taphath, daughter of Solomon, was his wife, one.
brenton_translation: All Nephthador belonged to the son of Aminadab, Tephath daughter of Solomon was his wife, one.

fresh_translation: Baana son of Ahilud: Taanach and Megiddo and all the house of San that was beside Beth-shean below Esrae, from Baisaphoud to Abelmeholah to Maeber Loukam, one.
brenton_translation: Bana son of Achiluth had Ithaanach, and Mageddo, and his was the whole house of San which was by Sesathan below Esrae, and from Bethsan as far as Sabelmaula, as far as Maëber Lucam, one.

fresh_translation: Son of Gibbar in Ramath Gilead. To this one belonged the line-measure of Eregaba that is in Bashan, sixty great walled cities and bronze bars.
brenton_translation: The son of Naber in Raboth Galaad, to him fell the lot of Ergab in Basan, sixty great cities with walls, and brazen bars, one.

fresh_translation: Ahinadab son of Eshcol in Mahanaim, one.
brenton_translation: Achinadab son of Saddo, had Maanaim.

fresh_translation: Ahimaaz in Naphtali, and he took Basemmath daughter of Solomon as wife, one.
brenton_translation: Achimaas was in Nephthalim, and he took Basemmath daughter of Solomon to wife, one.

fresh_translation: Baana son of Cushi in Mahlahth, one.
brenton_translation: Baana son of Chusi, in Aser and in Baaloth, one,

fresh_translation: Shimei son of Elah in Benjamin.
brenton_translation: Semei son of Ela, in Benjamin.

fresh_translation: Gibbar son of Adai in the land of Gad, land of Seon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan, and Nasiph one in the land of Judah.
brenton_translation: Gaber son of Adai in the land of Gad, the land of Seon king of Esebon, and of Og king of Basan, and one officer in the land of Juda.

fresh_translation: Jehoshaphat son of Phouasoud in Issachar.
brenton_translation: Josaphat son of Phuasud was in Issachar.

fresh_translation: And the appointed officers were thus providing for King Solomon and all the charges upon the table of the king, each in his month. They did not alter a word. And they were bringing the barley and the straw for the horses and the chariots to the place where the king might be, each according to his arrangement.
brenton_translation: And thus the officers provided king Solomon: and they execute every one in his month all the orders for the table of the king, they omit nothing. And they carried the barley and the straw for the horses and the chariots to the place where the king might be, each according to his charge.

fresh_translation: And these were the needs for Solomon in one day: thirty cors of fine flour and sixty cors of beaten flour,
brenton_translation: And these were the requisite supplies for Solomon: in one day thirty measures of fine flour, and sixty measures of fine pounded meal,

fresh_translation: and ten choice calves and twenty pasture-fed cattle and one hundred sheep, besides deer and gazelles and choice fatted birds.
brenton_translation: and ten choice calves, and twenty pastured oxen, and a hundred sheep, besides stags, and choice fatted does.

fresh_translation: For he was ruler beyond the river, and he had peace from all sides all around.
brenton_translation: For he had dominion on this side the river, and he was at peace on all sides round about.

fresh_translation: And the Lord gave understanding to Solomon and very great wisdom and breadth of heart like the sand that is beside the sea.
brenton_translation: And the Lord gave understanding to Solomon, and very much wisdom, and enlargement of heart, as the sand on the seashore.

fresh_translation: And Solomon was greatly multiplied in understanding beyond the understanding of all the ancient men and beyond all the wise of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And Solomon abounded greatly beyond the wisdom of all the ancients, and beyond all the wise men of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And he became wiser than all the men, wiser than Ethan the Ezrite and Heman and Chalcala and Darda, sons of Mal.
brenton_translation: And he was wiser than all other men: and he was wiser than Gæthan the Zarite, and than Ænan, and than Chalcad and Darala the sons of Mal.

fresh_translation: And Solomon spoke three thousand parables, and his songs were five thousand.
brenton_translation: And Solomon spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs were five thousand.

fresh_translation: And he spoke concerning trees, from the cedar in Lebanon even to the hyssop that comes out through the wall, and he spoke concerning cattle and concerning birds and concerning creeping things and concerning fish.
brenton_translation: And he spoke of trees, from the cedar in Libanus even to the hyssop which comes out through the wall: he spoke also of cattle, and of birds, and of reptiles, and of fishes.

fresh_translation: And all the peoples were coming to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and he was receiving gifts from all the kings of the earth, all who were hearing his wisdom. And Solomon took the daughter of Pharaoh for himself as wife and brought her into the City of David until he finished the house of the Lord and his own house and the wall of Jerusalem. Then Pharaoh king of Egypt went up and took Gezer beforehand and burned it, and the Canaanite who lived in Mergab, and Pharaoh gave them as gifts to his daughter, wife of Solomon, and Solomon built Gezer.
brenton_translation: And all the nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and ambassadors from all the kings of the earth, as many as heard of his wisdom.

fresh_translation: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to anoint Solomon in place of David his father, because Hiram loved David all his days.
brenton_translation: And Chiram king of Tyre sent his servants to anoint Solomon in the room of David his father, because Chiram always loved David.

fresh_translation: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
brenton_translation: And Solomon sent to Chiram, saying,

fresh_translation: You know David my father, that he was not able to build a house for the name of the Lord my God because of the wars that encircled him, until the Lord gave them under the soles of his feet.
brenton_translation: Thou knewest my father David, that he could not build a house to the name of the Lord my God because of the wars that compassed him about, until the Lord put them under the soles of his feet.

fresh_translation: And now the Lord my God has given me rest all around. There is no adversary, and there is no evil encounter.
brenton_translation: And now the Lord my God has given me rest round about; there is no one plotting against me, and there is no evil trespass against me.

fresh_translation: And behold, I say that I will build a house for the name of the Lord my God, just as the Lord God spoke to David my father, saying, Your son, whom I will give instead of you upon your throne, he will build the house for my name.
brenton_translation: And, behold, I intend to build a house to the name of the Lord my God, as the Lord God spoke to my father David, saying, Thy son whom I will set on thy throne in thy place, he shall build a house to my name.

fresh_translation: And now command, and let them cut wood for me from Lebanon. And behold, my servants are with your servants, and I will give you the wage of your service according to all that you say, because you know that there is no one among us knowing how to cut wood like the Sidonians.
brenton_translation: And now command, and let men cut wood for me out of Libanus: and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants, and I will give thee the wages of thy service, according to all that thou shalt say, because thou knowest that we have no one skilled in cutting timber like the Sidonians.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly and said, Blessed is God today, who gave to David a wise son over this many people.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, as soon as Chiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be God to-day, who has given to David a wise son over this numerous people.

fresh_translation: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have heard concerning all that you sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning cedar wood and fir wood.
brenton_translation: And he sent to Solomon, saying, I have listened concerning all that thou hast sent to me for: I will do all thy will: as for timber of cedar and fir,

fresh_translation: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will place them in rafts to the place that you send to me, and I will shake them out there, and you will take them. And you will do my will by giving bread to my house.
brenton_translation: my servants shall bring them down from Libanus to the sea: I will form them into rafts, and bring them to the place which thou shalt send to me about; and I will land them there, and thou shalt take them up: and thou shalt do my will, in giving bread to my household.

fresh_translation: And Hiram was giving cedars to Solomon and all his desire.
brenton_translation: So Chiram gave to Solomon cedars, and fir trees, and all his desire.

fresh_translation: And Solomon gave to Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat and provision for his house and twenty thousand baths of beaten oil. According to this Solomon was giving to Hiram year by year.
brenton_translation: And Solomon gave to Chiram twenty thousand measures of wheat as food for his house, and twenty thousand baths of beaten oil thus Solomon gave to Chiram yearly.

fresh_translation: And the Lord gave wisdom to Solomon just as he spoke to him, and there was peace between Hiram and between Solomon, and they cut a covenant between themselves.
brenton_translation: And the Lord gave wisdom to Solomon as he promised him; and there was peace between Chiram and Solomon, and they made a covenant between them.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon raised a levy from all Israel, and the levy was thirty thousand men.
brenton_translation: And the king raised a levy out of all Israel, and the levy was thirty thousand men.

fresh_translation: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand in the month by turns. One month they were in Lebanon and two months in their houses, and Adoniram was over the levy.
brenton_translation: And he sent them to Libanus, ten thousand taking turn every month: they were a month in Libanus and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.

fresh_translation: And Solomon had seventy thousand carrying burdens and eighty thousand stonecutters in the mountain,
brenton_translation: And Solomon had seventy thousand bearers of burdens, and eighty thousand hewers of stone in the mountain;

fresh_translation: except for the chiefs appointed over the works of Solomon, three thousand six hundred overseers doing the works.
brenton_translation: besides the rulers that were appointed over the works of Solomon, there were three thousand six hundred masters who wrought in the works.

fresh_translation: And they prepared the stones and the timbers for three years.
brenton_translation: And they prepared the stones and the timber during three years.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the four hundred and fortieth year of the coming out of the sons of Israel from Egypt, in the fourth year, in the second month, of King Solomon reigning over Israel. And the king commanded, and they took great costly stones for the foundation of the house, and unhewn stones. And the sons of Solomon and the sons of Hiram dressed them and laid them. In the fourth year he founded the house of the Lord in the month Niso, the second month. In the eleventh year, in the month Baal, this is the eighth month, the house was completed in every word of it and in every arrangement of it.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the four hundred and fortieth year after the departure of the children of Israel out of Egypt, in the fourth year and second month of the reign of king Solomon over Israel,

fresh_translation: And the house that King Solomon built to the Lord: forty cubits was its length and twenty cubits in breadth and twenty-five cubits in height.
brenton_translation: And the house which the king built to the Lord was forty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and its height five and twenty cubits.

fresh_translation: And the porch before the nave was twenty cubits in length, according to the breadth of the house, and its breadth before the house was ten cubits. And he built the house and finished it.
brenton_translation: And the porch in front of the temple—twenty cubits was its length according to the breadth of the house in front of the house: and he built the house, and finished it.

fresh_translation: And he made to the house windows looking out, concealed.
brenton_translation: And he made to the house secret windows inclining inward.

fresh_translation: And he set beam-structures upon the wall of the house all around, for the nave and for the debir, and he made side chambers all around.
brenton_translation: And against the wall of the house he set chambers round about the temple and the ark.

fresh_translation: The lower side chamber had a width of five cubits, and the middle six, and the third seven cubits in width, because he gave offsets to the house all around outside the house, so that they would not seize the walls of the house.
brenton_translation: The under side was five cubits broad, and the middle part six, and the third was seven cubits broad; for he formed an interval to the house round about without the house, that they might not touch the walls of the house.

fresh_translation: And the house, while it was being built, was built with quarry-cut prepared stones, and hammer and axe and every iron tool was not heard in the house while it was being built.
brenton_translation: And the house was built in the construction of it with rough hewn stones: and there was not heard in the house in the building of it hammer or axe, or any iron tool.

fresh_translation: And the doorway of the lower side chamber was under the shoulder of the house on the right side, and a winding ascent led to the middle and from the middle to the third stories.
brenton_translation: And the porch of the under side was below the right wing of the house, and there was a winding ascent into the middle chamber, and from the middle to the third story.

fresh_translation: And he built the house and finished it and paneled the house with cedars.
brenton_translation: So he built the house and finished it; and he made the ceiling of the house with cedars.

fresh_translation: And he built the bonds across the whole house, five cubits its height, and he fastened the bond with cedar woods.
brenton_translation: And he made the partitions through all the house, each five cubits high, and enclosed each partition with cedar boards.

fresh_translation: And he built the walls of the house with cedar woods, from the floor of the house to the rafters and to the walls, and he paneled them continuously with woods inside, and he encircled the inside of the house with pine boards.
brenton_translation: And he framed the walls of the house within with cedar boards, from the floor of the house and on to the inner walls and to the beams: he lined the parts enclosed with boards within, and compassed the inward parts of the house with planks of fir.

fresh_translation: And he built the twenty cubits from the end of the house, the one side from the floor to the rafters, and he made the debir from it as the holy of holies.
brenton_translation: And he built the twenty cubits from the top of the wall, one side from the floor to the beams, and he made it from the oracle to the most holy place.

fresh_translation: And the nave in front was forty cubits.
brenton_translation: And the temple was forty cubits in extent,

fresh_translation: The debir was in the middle of the house within, to place there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
brenton_translation: in front of the oracle in the midst of the house within, in order to put there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Twenty cubits was its length and twenty cubits its breadth and twenty cubits its height, and he encircled it with shut-up gold and made an altar.
brenton_translation: The length was twenty cubits, and the breadth was twenty cubits, and the height of it was twenty cubits. And he covered it with perfect gold, and he made an altar

fresh_translation: It was before the face of the debir, and he encircled it with gold.
brenton_translation: in front of the oracle, and covered it with gold.

fresh_translation: And the whole house he encircled with gold until the completion of the whole house.
brenton_translation: And he covered the whole house with gold, till he had finished gilding the whole house.

fresh_translation: And he made in the debir two cheroubin, ten cubits in size, proportioned.
brenton_translation: And he made in the oracle two cherubs of ten cubits measured size.

fresh_translation: And five cubits was one wing of the one cheroub and five cubits its second wing, ten cubits from part of its wing to part of its wing.
brenton_translation: And the wing of one cherub was five cubits, and his other wing was five cubits; ten cubits from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other wing.

fresh_translation: So too for the second cheroub, one measure, one completion for both.
brenton_translation: Thus it was with the other cherub, both were alike finished with one measure.

fresh_translation: And the height of the one cheroub was ten cubits, and so the second cheroub.
brenton_translation: And the height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it with the second cherub.

fresh_translation: And he put both the cheroubin in the middle of the innermost house, and they spread out their wings, and one wing touched the wall and one wing touched the second wall, and their wings in the middle of the house touched wing to wing.
brenton_translation: And both the cherubs were in the midst of the innermost part of the house; and they spread out their wings, and one wing touched the wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings in the midst of the house touched each other.

fresh_translation: And he encircled the cheroubin with gold.
brenton_translation: And he covered the cherubs with gold.

fresh_translation: And all the walls of the house all around he engraved with a stylus, cheroubin and palms, the inner and the outer.
brenton_translation: He graved all the walls of the house round about with the graving of cherubs, and he sculptured palm trees within and without the house.

fresh_translation: And the floor of the house he encircled with gold, of the innermost and of the outermost.
brenton_translation: And he covered the floor of the house within and without with gold.

fresh_translation: And for the doorway of the debir he made doors of juniper wood, and the doorposts were fivefold.
brenton_translation: And for the door-way of the oracle he made doors of juniper wood, there were porches in a four-fold way.

fresh_translation: And two doors of pine wood, and carved upon them were engraved cheroubin and palms and spread petals, and he encircled them with gold, and the gold came down upon the cheroubin and upon the palms.
And thus he made for the gateway of the nave doorposts of juniper wood, four-sided porches.
And on both doors were pine woods, two folds on the one door and their turnings, and two folds on the second door turning.
brenton_translation: In both the doors were planks of fir; the one door had two leaves and their hinges, and the other door had two leaves and turned on hinges,

fresh_translation: Carved cheroubin and palms and spread petals, and covered with gold being brought down upon the impression.
brenton_translation: being carved with cherubs, and there were palm-trees and open flower-leaves, and it was overlaid with gold gilt upon the engraving.

fresh_translation: And he built the innermost court, three rows of hewn stone and a row of worked cedar all around. And he built a curtain for the court of the porch of the house that was before the nave.
brenton_translation: And he built the inner court, three rows of hewn stones, and a row of wrought cedar round about,

fresh_translation: And King Solomon sent and took Hiram from Tyre,
brenton_translation: And king Solomon sent, and took Chiram out of Tyre,

fresh_translation: son of a widow woman, and he was from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a Tyrian man, a craftsman in bronze, and he was filled with skill and understanding and knowledge to do every work in bronze. And he was brought to King Solomon and did all the works.
brenton_translation: the son of a widow woman; and he was of the tribe of Nephthalim, and his father was a Tyrian; a worker in brass, and accomplished in art and skill and knowledge to work every work in brass: and he was brought in to king Solomon, and he wrought all the works.

fresh_translation: And he cast the two pillars for the porch of the house. Eighteen cubits was the height of the pillar, and a circumference of fourteen cubits encircled it, and the thickness of the pillar was four fingers, hollow. And so was the second pillar.
brenton_translation: And he cast the two pillars for the porch of the house: eighteen cubits was the height of each pillar, and a circumference of fourteen cubits encompassed it, even the thickness of the pillar: the flutings were four fingers wide, and thus was the other pillar formed.

fresh_translation: And he made two capitals, cast in bronze, to put upon the heads of the pillars. Five cubits was the height of the one capital and five cubits the height of the second.
brenton_translation: And he made two molten chapiters to put on the heads of the pillars: five cubits was the height of one chapiter, and five cubits was the height of the other chapiter.

fresh_translation: And he made two networks to cover the capitals of the pillars, a network for the one capital and a network for the second capital.
brenton_translation: And he made two ornaments of net-work to cover the chapiters of the pillars; even a net for one chapiter, and a net for the other chapiter.

fresh_translation: And hanging work, two rows of bronze pomegranates, netted hanging work, row upon row. And thus he made for the second capital.
brenton_translation: And hanging work, two rows of brazen pomegranates, formed with net-work, hanging work, row upon row: and thus he framed the ornaments for the second chapiter.

fresh_translation: And he set up the pillars of the porch of the temple, and he set up the one pillar and called its name Iachoum, and he set up the second pillar and called its name Baaz.
brenton_translation: And he set up the pillars of the porch of the temple: and he set up the one pillar, and called its name Jachum: and he set up the second pillar, and called its name Boloz.

fresh_translation: And on the heads of the pillars was lily-work by the porch, four cubits.
brenton_translation: And on the heads of the pillars he made lily-work against the porch, of four cubits,

fresh_translation: And a beam-structure was on both pillars, and above the sides the capital, the beam-structure according to the thickness.
brenton_translation: and a chamber over both the pillars, and above the sides an addition equal to the chamber in width.

fresh_translation: And he made the Sea, ten cubits from its rim to its rim, round all around, the same, and its height was five cubits, and thirty-three cubits in a gathering encircled it.
brenton_translation: And he made the sea, ten cubits from one rim to the other, the same was completely circular round about: its height was five cubits, and its circumference thirty-three cubits.

fresh_translation: And supports beneath its rim all around were encircling it, ten cubits all around, raising the Sea.
brenton_translation: And stays underneath its rim round about compassed it ten cubits round;

fresh_translation: And its rim was like the work of a cup-rim, a lily-bud, and its thickness was a handbreadth.
brenton_translation: and its rim was as the work of the rim of a cup, a lily-flower, and the thickness of it was a span.

fresh_translation: And twelve oxen were under the Sea, three looking north and three looking sea-ward and three looking south and three looking east, and all their hind parts were toward the house, and the Sea was above them.
brenton_translation: And there were twelve oxen under the sea; three looking to the north, and three looking to the west, and three looking to the south, and three looking to the east: and all their hinder parts were inward, and the sea was above upon them.

fresh_translation: And he made ten bronze stands. Five cubits was the length of one stand and four cubits its breadth and six cubits its height.
brenton_translation: And he made ten brazen bases: five cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth of it, and its height was six cubits.

fresh_translation: And this was the work of the stands: enclosed panels for them, and enclosure between the projections.
brenton_translation: And this work of the bases was formed with a border to them, and there was a border between the ledges.

fresh_translation: And on their enclosures between the projections were lions and oxen and cheroubin, and so too upon the projections, and above and below the lions and the oxen spaces with descending work.
brenton_translation: And upon their borders between the projections were lions, and oxen, and cherubs: and on the projections, even so above, and also below were the places of lions and oxen, hanging work.

fresh_translation: And four bronze wheels belonged to each stand, and their axle-pieces were bronze, and their four parts had shoulders under the basins.
brenton_translation: And there were four brazen wheels to one base; and there were brazen bases, and their four sides answering to them, side pieces under the bases.

fresh_translation: And handles were in the wheels in the stand, and the height of one wheel was a cubit and a half.
brenton_translation: And there were axles in the wheels under the base. And the height of one wheel was a cubit and a half.

fresh_translation: And the work of the wheels was wheel-work of a chariot. Their handles and their backs and their workmanship, all were cast.
brenton_translation: And the work of the wheels was as the work of chariot wheels: their axles, and their felloes, and the rest of their work, were all molten.

fresh_translation: The four shoulders were at the four corners of each stand, from the stand were its shoulders.
brenton_translation: The four side-pieces were at the four corners of each base; its shoulders were formed of the base.

fresh_translation: And upon the top of the stand was half a cubit in size, round all around, upon the top of the stand, and the beginning of its handles and its enclosures, and it opened out toward the beginnings of its handles.
brenton_translation: And on the top of the base half a cubit was the size of it, there was a circle on the top of the base, and there was the top of its spaces and its borders: and it was open at the top of its spaces.

fresh_translation: And on its enclosures were cheroubin and lions and palms standing, each next to its facing one within, and the things all around.
brenton_translation: And its borders were cherubs, and lions, and palm-trees, upright, each was joined in front and within and round about.

fresh_translation: Accordingly he made all ten stands, one arrangement and one measure for all.
brenton_translation: According to the same form he made all the ten bases, even one order and one measure to all.

fresh_translation: And he made ten bronze wash-basins, each wash-basin holding forty baths by measure, one wash-basin upon each of the ten stands.
brenton_translation: And he made ten brazen lavers, each laver containing forty baths, and measuring four cubits, each laver placed on a several base throughout the ten bases.

fresh_translation: And he placed the ten stands, five from the shoulder of the house on the right and five from the shoulder of the house on the left, and the Sea from the shoulder of the house on the right, eastward, toward the south side.
brenton_translation: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and the sea was placed on the right side of the house eastward in the direction of the south.

fresh_translation: And Hiram made the pots and the shovels and the bowls, and Hiram completed doing all the works that he did for King Solomon in the house of the Lord:
brenton_translation: And Chiram made the caldrons, and the pans, and the bowls; and Chiram finished making all the works that he wrought for king Solomon in the house of the Lord:

fresh_translation: the two pillars and the twisted works upon the heads of the pillars, two, and the two networks for covering both twisted works of the carvings that were upon the pillars,
brenton_translation: two pillars and the wreathen works of the pillars on the heads of the two pillars; and the two net-works to cover both the wreathen works of the flutings that were upon the pillars.

fresh_translation: the four hundred pomegranates for both networks, two rows of pomegranates for the one network, to cover both twisted works upon both pillars,
brenton_translation: The four hundred pomegranates for both the net-works, two rows of pomegranates for one net-work, to cover both the wreathen works of the bases belonging to both pillars.

fresh_translation: and the ten stands and the ten wash-basins upon the stands,
brenton_translation: And the ten bases, and the ten lavers upon the bases.

fresh_translation: and the one Sea and the twelve oxen under the Sea,
brenton_translation: And one sea, and the twelve oxen under the sea.

fresh_translation: and the pots and the shovels and the bowls and all the vessels that Hiram made for King Solomon for the house of the Lord, and the forty-eight pillars of the house of the king and of the house of the Lord, all the works of the king that Hiram made, all entirely of bronze.
brenton_translation: And the caldrons, and pans, and bowls, and all the furniture, which Chiram made for king Solomon for the house of the Lord: and there were eight and forty pillars of the house of the king and of the house of the Lord: all the works of the king which Chiram made were entirely of brass.

fresh_translation: There was no weight for the bronze from which he made all these works because of the very great abundance. There was no end to the weighing of the bronze.
brenton_translation: There was no reckoning of the brass of which he made all these works, from the very great abundance, there was no end of the weight of the brass.

fresh_translation: In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the thickness of the earth, between Succoth and between Zarethan.
brenton_translation: In the country round about Jordan did he cast them, in the clay land between Socchoth and Sira.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon gave the vessels that he made in the house of the Lord: the golden altar, and the golden table on which were the loaves of offering,
brenton_translation: And king Solomon took the furniture which Chiram made for the house of the Lord, the golden altar, and the golden table of shewbread.

fresh_translation: and the lampstands, five at the right and five at the left before the debir, of closed gold, and the lamps and the wicks and the libation-bowls of gold,
brenton_translation: And he put the five candlesticks on the left, and five on the right in front of the oracle, being of pure gold, and the lamp-stands, and the lamps, and the snuffers of gold.

fresh_translation: and the doorposts and the nails and the bowls and the pans and the censers of closed gold, and the hinges of the doors of the innermost house, holy of holies, and the doors of the house of the nave, of gold.
brenton_translation: And there were made the porches, and the nails, and the bowls, and the spoons, and the golden censers, of pure gold: and the panels of the doors of the innermost part of the house, even the holy of holies, and the golden doors of the temple.

fresh_translation: And all the work that Solomon made for the house of the Lord was completed, and Solomon brought in the holy things of David his father and all the holy things of Solomon, the silver and the gold and the vessels, and he put them into the treasuries of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: So the work of the house of the Lord which Solomon wrought was finished; and Solomon brought in the holy things of David his father, and all the holy things of Solomon; he put the silver, and the gold, and the furniture, into the treasures of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Solomon built his own house in thirteen years.
brenton_translation: And Solomon built a house for himself in thirteen years.

fresh_translation: And he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon, one hundred cubits its length and fifty cubits its breadth and thirty cubits its height, with three rows of cedar pillars and cedar shoulders upon the pillars.
brenton_translation: And he built the house with the wood of Libanus; its length was a hundred cubits, and its breadth was fifty cubits, and its height was of thirty cubits, and it was made with three rows of cedar pillars, and the pillars had side-pieces of cedar.

fresh_translation: And he roofed the house above upon the sides of the pillars, and the number of the pillars was forty-five, fifteen in a row.
brenton_translation: And he formed the house with chambers above on the sides of the pillars, and the number of the pillars was each row forty and five,

fresh_translation: And three beam-frames, and opening facing opening, threefold.
brenton_translation: and there were three chambers, and space against space in three rows.

fresh_translation: And all the doors and the openings were squared with beam-work, and from door to door, threefold.
brenton_translation: And all the doors and spaces formed like chambers were square, and from door to door was a correspondence in three rows.

fresh_translation: And the Porch of the Pillars was fifty cubits in length and thirty in breadth, fitted in balance, a porch before them, and pillars and a thickness before it for the porches.
brenton_translation: And he made the porch of the pillars, they were fifty cubits long and fifty broad, the porch joining them in front; and the other pillars and the thick beam were in front of the house by the porches.

fresh_translation: And the Porch of the Throne, where he would judge there, the Porch of Judgment.
brenton_translation: And there was the Porch of seats where he would judge, the porch of judgment.

fresh_translation: And his house where he would sit there, one court winding around these, according to this work, and a house for the daughter of Pharaoh whom Solomon took, according to this porch.
brenton_translation: And their house where he would dwell, had one court communicating with these according to this work; and he built the house for the daughter of Pharao whom Solomon had taken, according to this porch.

fresh_translation: All these were of costly stones, dressed according to interval, inside and from the foundation to the coping and outside to the great court,
brenton_translation: All these were of costly stones, sculptured at intervals within even from the foundation even to the top, and outward to the great court,

fresh_translation: founded with costly stones, great stones, ten-cubit stones and eight-cubit stones,
brenton_translation: founded with large costly stones, stones of ten cubits and eight cubits long.

fresh_translation: and above with costly stones according to the measure of hewn stones and cedars,
brenton_translation: And above with costly stones, according to the measure of hewn stones, and with cedars.

fresh_translation: the great court all around, three rows of hewn stones and a row of dressed cedar,
brenton_translation: There were three rows of hewn stones round about the great hall, and a row of sculptured cedar:

fresh_translation: and Solomon completed his whole house.
brenton_translation: and Solomon finished all his house.
