fresh_translation: And it came to be when Solomon finished building the house of the Lord and his own house, after twenty years, then King Solomon assembled all the elders of Israel in Zion, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the City of David, this is Zion.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Solomon had finished building the house of the Lord and his own house after twenty years, then king Solomon assembled all the elders of Israel in Sion, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, this is Sion,

fresh_translation: In the month Athanin.
brenton_translation: in the month of Athanin.

fresh_translation: And the priests lifted the ark,
brenton_translation: And the priests took up the ark,

fresh_translation: and the tent of witness and all the holy vessels that were in the tent of witness,
brenton_translation: and the tabernacle of testimony, and the holy furniture that was in the tabernacle of testimony.

fresh_translation: and the king and all Israel before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle beyond number.
brenton_translation: And the king and all Israel were occupied before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, without number.

fresh_translation: And the priests bring the ark to its place, into the debir of the house, into the holy of holies, under the wings of the cheroubin,
brenton_translation: And the priests bring in the ark into its place, into the oracle of the house, even into the holy of holies, under the wings of the cherubs.

fresh_translation: because the cheroubin had their wings spread over the place of the ark, and the cheroubin were covering the ark and its holy things from above.
brenton_translation: For the cherubs spread out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubs covered the ark and its holy things above.

fresh_translation: And the holy poles projected, and the heads of the holy poles were seen from the holy place before the debir, but they were not visible outside.
brenton_translation: And the holy staves projected, and the ends of the holy staves appeared out of the holy places in front of the oracle, and were not seen without.

fresh_translation: There was nothing in the ark except two stone tablets, tablets of the covenant, which Moses put there in Horeb, which the Lord covenanted with the sons of Israel when they came out from the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: There was nothing in the ark except the two tables of stone, the tables of the covenant which Moses put there in Choreb, which tables the Lord made as a covenant with the children of Israel in their going forth from the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, as the priests came out from the holy place, that the cloud filled the house,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the priests departed out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house.

fresh_translation: and the priests were not able to stand to minister because of the cloud, because the glory of the Lord filled the house.
brenton_translation: And the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud, because the glory of the Lord filled the house.

fresh_translation: And the king turned his face and the king blessed all Israel, and all the assembly of Israel was standing.
brenton_translation: And the king turned his face, and the king blessed all Israel, (and the whole assembly of Israel stood:)

fresh_translation: And he said, Blessed is the Lord God of Israel today, who spoke with his mouth concerning David my father and with his hands fulfilled it, saying,
brenton_translation: and he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel to-day, who spoke by his mouth concerning David my father, and has fulfilled it with his hands, saying,

fresh_translation: From the day I brought out my people Israel from Egypt, I did not choose a city in one scepter of Israel to build a house for my name to be there, but I chose Jerusalem for my name to be there, and I chose David to be over my people Israel.
brenton_translation: From the day that I brought out my people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any one tribe of Israel to build a house, so that my name should be there: but I chose Jerusalem that my name should be there, and I chose David to be over my people Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came to be upon the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And it was in the heart of my father to build a house to the name of the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to David my father, Because it came upon your heart to build a house for my name, you did well, because it came upon your heart.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to David my father, Forasmuch as it came into thine heart to build a house to my name, thou didst well that it came upon thine heart.

fresh_translation: Yet you shall not build the house, but only your son, the one coming out from your sides, he will build the house for my name.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house, but thy son that has proceeded out of thy bowels, he shall build the house to my name.

fresh_translation: And the Lord raised up his word that he spoke, and I rose in place of David my father and sat upon the throne of Israel just as the Lord spoke, and I built the house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the Lord has confirmed the word that he spoke, and I am risen up in the place of my father David, and I have sat down on the throne of Israel, as the Lord spoke, and I have built the house to the name of the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And I placed there a place for the ark, in which is there the covenant of the Lord, which the Lord covenanted with our fathers when he brought them out from the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And I have set there a place for the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord, which the Lord made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the sight of all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven,
brenton_translation: And Solomon stood up in front of the altar before all the congregation of Israel; and he spread out his hands toward heaven:

fresh_translation: and said, O Lord God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven above and upon the earth below, keeping covenant and mercy for your servant who walks before you with all his heart,
brenton_translation: and he said, Lord God of Israel, there is no God like thee in heaven above and on the earth beneath, keeping covenant and mercy with thy servant who walks before thee with all his heart;

fresh_translation: the things which you kept for your servant David my father, and you spoke with your mouth and fulfilled with your hands, as on this day.
brenton_translation: which thou hast kept toward thy servant David my father: for thou hast spoken by thy mouth and thou hast fulfilled it with thine hands, as at this day.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the things you spoke to him, saying, A man for you will not be lifted away from before me, sitting upon the throne of Israel, if only your children keep their ways to walk before me as you walked before me.
brenton_translation: And now, O Lord God of Israel, keep for thy servant David my father, the promises which thou hast spoken to him, saying, There shall not be taken from thee a man sitting before me on the throne of Israel, provided only thy children shall take heed to their ways, to walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord God of Israel, let your word be made firm for David my father.
brenton_translation: And now, O Lord God of Israel, let, I pray thee, thy word to David my father be confirmed.

fresh_translation: For will God truly dwell with humans upon the earth? If heaven and heaven of heaven will not suffice for you, much less this house that I built for your name.
brenton_translation: But will God indeed dwell with men upon the earth? if the heaven and heaven of heavens will not suffice thee, how much less even this house which I have built to thy name?

fresh_translation: And yet look upon my petition, Lord God of Israel, to hear the delight with which your servant prays before you today,
brenton_translation: Yet, O Lord God of Israel, thou shalt look upon my petition, to hear the prayer which thy servant prays to thee in thy presence this day,

fresh_translation: for your eyes to be opened toward this house day and night, toward the place of which you said, My name will be there, to hear the prayer that your servant prays toward this place day and night,
brenton_translation: that thine eyes may be open toward this house day and night, even toward the place of which thou saidst, My name shall be there, to hear the prayer which thy servant prays at this place day and night.

fresh_translation: and you will hear the petition of your servant and of your people Israel, whatever they pray toward this place. And you will hear in the place of your dwelling in heaven, and you will act and be gracious.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt hearken to the prayer of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall pray toward this place; and thou shalt hear in thy dwelling-place in heaven, and thou shalt do and be gracious.

fresh_translation: Whatever each person sins against his neighbor, and if he takes upon himself a curse to curse him, and comes and declares openly before your altar in this house,
brenton_translation: Whatsoever trespasses any one shall commit against his neighbour,—and if he shall take upon him an oath so that he should swear, and he shall come and make confession before thine altar in this house,

fresh_translation: then you will hear from heaven and act and judge your people Israel, to condemn the lawless by giving his way upon his own head, and to justify the righteous by giving to him according to his righteousness.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hear from heaven, and do, and thou shalt judge thy people Israel, that the wicked should be condemned, to recompense his way upon his head; and to justify the righteous, to give to him according to his righteousness.

fresh_translation: When your people Israel stumble before enemies because they sinned against you, and they turn back and confess to your name and pray and entreat in this house,
brenton_translation: When thy people Israel falls before enemies, because they shall sin against thee, and they shall return and confess to thy name, and they shall pray and supplicate in this house,

fresh_translation: then you will hear from heaven and be gracious to the sins of your people Israel and return them to the land that you gave to their fathers.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hear from heaven, and be gracious to the sins of thy people Israel, and thou shalt restore them to the land which thou gavest to their fathers.

fresh_translation: When heaven is shut and rain does not come because they sinned against you, and they pray toward this place and confess to your name and turn back from their sins when you humble them,
brenton_translation: When the heaven is restrained, and there is no rain, because they shall sin against thee, and they shall pray toward this place, and shall make confession to thy name, and shall turn from their sins when thou shalt have humbled them,

fresh_translation: then you will hear from heaven and be gracious to the sins of your servant and of your people Israel, because you will show them the good way to walk in it, and you will give rain upon the land that you gave to your people for an inheritance.
brenton_translation: then thou shalt hear from heaven, and be merciful to the sins of thy servant and of thy people Israel; for thou shalt shew them the good way to walk in it, and thou shalt give rain upon the earth which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: If famine happens, if death happens, if blight happens, mildew, locust, rust, if his enemy afflicts him in one of his cities, every encounter, every pain,
brenton_translation: If there should be famine, if there should be death, because there should be blasting, locust, or if there be mildew, and if their enemy oppress them in any one of their cities, with regard to every calamity, every trouble,

fresh_translation: every prayer, every petition, whatever happens to any person, as each knows the touch of his own heart and spreads out his hands toward this house,
brenton_translation: every prayer, every supplication whatever shall be made by any man, as they shall know each the plague of his heart, and shall spread abroad his hands to this house,

fresh_translation: then you will hear from heaven from your ready dwelling place and be gracious and act and give to each man according to his ways, as you know his heart, because you alone know the heart of all the sons of humans,
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hearken from heaven, out of thine established dwelling-place, and shalt be merciful, and shalt do, and recompense to every man according to his ways, as thou shalt know his heart, for thou alone knowest the heart of all the children of men:

fresh_translation: so that they may fear you all the days they live upon the land that you gave to our fathers.
brenton_translation: that they may fear thee all the days that they live upon the land, which thou hast given to our fathers.

fresh_translation: And also for the foreigner who is not from this people of yours,
brenton_translation: And for the stranger who is not of thy people,

fresh_translation: and they will come and pray toward this place,
brenton_translation: when they shall come and pray toward this place,

fresh_translation: then you will hear from heaven from your ready dwelling place and do according to all that the foreigner calls on you for, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you as your people Israel do, and may know that your name is called upon this house that I built.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hear them from heaven, out of thine established dwelling-place, and thou shalt do according to all that the stranger shall call upon thee for, that all the nations may know thy name, and fear thee, as do thy people Israel, and may know that thy name has been called on this house which I have builded.

fresh_translation: When your people go out to war against their enemies by the way that you send them, and they pray in the name of the Lord in the direction of the city that I chose in it and of the house that I built for your name,
brenton_translation: If it be that thy people shall go forth to war against their enemies in the way by which thou shalt turn them, and pray in the name of the Lord toward the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built to thy name,

fresh_translation: then you will hear from heaven their petition and their prayer and do justice for them.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hear from heaven their supplication and their prayer, and shalt execute judgment for them.

fresh_translation: Because they will sin against you, for there is no human who will not sin, and you will bring against them and deliver them before enemies, and those who capture them will carry them captive to a far land or near,
brenton_translation: If it be that they shall sin against thee, (for there is not a man who will not sin,) and thou shalt bring them and deliver them up before their enemies, and they that take them captive shall carry them to a land far or near,

fresh_translation: and they will turn their hearts back in the land where they were carried there and turn and entreat you in the land of their migration, saying, We sinned, we acted lawlessly, we did wrong,
brenton_translation: and they shall turn their hearts in the land whither they have been carried captives, and turn in the land of their sojourning, and supplicate thee, saying, We have sinned, we have done unjustly, we have transgressed,

fresh_translation: and turn to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies where you carried them away, and they pray toward you in the direction of their land that you gave to their fathers, the city that I chose and the house that I built for your name,
brenton_translation: and they shall turn to thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies whither thou hast carried them captives, and shall pray to thee toward their land which thou hast given to their fathers, and the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built to thy name:

fresh_translation: then you will hear from heaven from your ready dwelling place
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hear from heaven thine established dwelling-place,

fresh_translation: and be gracious to their wrongs by which they sinned against you and to all their rebellions with which they rebelled against you, and you will give them into compassions before those taking them captive, and they will pity them,
brenton_translation: and thou shalt be merciful to their unrighteousness wherein they have trespassed against thee, and according to all their transgressions wherewith they have transgressed against thee, and thou shalt cause them to be pitied before them that carried them captives, and they shall have compassion on them:

fresh_translation: because they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out from the land of Egypt, from the midst of the iron furnace.
brenton_translation: for they are thy people and thine inheritance, whom thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, out of the midst of the furnace of iron.

fresh_translation: And let your eyes and your ears be opened toward the petition of your servant and toward the petition of your people Israel, to hear them in all things whatsoever they call on you for,
brenton_translation: And let thine eyes and thine ears be opened to the supplication of thy servant, and to the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken to them in all things for which they shall call upon thee.

fresh_translation: because you set them apart to yourself for an inheritance from all the peoples of the earth, just as you spoke by the hand of your servant Moses, when you brought out our fathers from the land of Egypt, O Lord, Lord. Then Solomon spoke concerning the house, as he finished building it: The sun the Lord made known in heaven. He said he would dwell in gloom. Build my house, a splendid house for yourself, for dwelling in newness. Behold, is not this written in the Book of the Song?
brenton_translation: Because thou hast set them apart for an inheritance to thyself out of all the nations of the earth, as thou spokest by the hand of thy servant Moses, when thou broughtest our fathers out of the land of Egypt, O Lord God.—

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Solomon finished praying to the Lord all this prayer and petition, he rose from before the altar of the Lord, kneeling upon his knees and his hands spread out toward heaven,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Solomon had finished praying to the Lord all this prayer and supplication, that he rose up from before the altar of the Lord, after having knelt upon his knees, and his hands were spread out towards heaven.

fresh_translation: and stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
brenton_translation: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord today, who gave rest to his people Israel according to all that he spoke. Not one word failed from all his good words that he spoke by the hand of Moses his servant.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord this day, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he said: there has not failed one word among all his good words which he spoke by the hand of his servant Moses.

fresh_translation: May the Lord our God be with us just as he was with our fathers. May he not leave us nor turn away from us,
brenton_translation: May the Lord our God be with us, as he was with our fathers; let him not desert us nor turn from us,

fresh_translation: to incline our hearts toward him, to walk in all his ways and keep all his commandments and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.
brenton_translation: that he may turn our hearts toward him to walk in all his ways, and to keep all his commandments, and his ordinances which he commanded our fathers.

fresh_translation: And let these words, which I have entreated before the Lord our God, be near to the Lord our God day and night, to do the justice of your servant and the justice of his people Israel, each day's matter on its day,
brenton_translation: And let these words, which I have prayed before the Lord our God, be near to the Lord our God day and night, to maintain the cause of thy servant, and the cause of thy people Israel for ever.

fresh_translation: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord, he is God, and there is no other.
brenton_translation: That all the nations of the earth may know that the Lord God, he is God, and there is none beside.

fresh_translation: And let our hearts be perfect toward the Lord our God and holy in walking in his ordinances and keeping his commandments, as on this day.
brenton_translation: And let our hearts be perfect toward the Lord our God, to walk also holily in his ordinances, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

fresh_translation: And the king and all the sons of Israel sacrificed a sacrifice before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the king and all the children of Israel offered sacrifice before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon sacrificed the sacrifices of peace offerings that he sacrificed to the Lord, twenty-two thousand cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. And the king and all the sons of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon offered for the sacrifices of peace-offering which he sacrificed to the Lord, two and twenty thousand oxen, an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: and the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: On that day the king consecrated the middle of the court that was before the house of the Lord, because there he made the whole burnt offering and the sacrifices and the fats of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the Lord was too small to carry the whole burnt offering and the sacrifices of the peace offerings.
brenton_translation: In that day the king consecrated the middle of the court in the front of the house of the Lord; for there he offered the whole-burnt-offering, and the sacrifices, and the fat of the peace-offerings, because the brazen altar which was before the Lord was too little to bear the whole-burnt-offering and the sacrifices of peace-offerings.

fresh_translation: And Solomon kept the feast on that day, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the river of Egypt, before the Lord our God, in the house that he built, eating and drinking and rejoicing before the Lord our God for seven days.
brenton_translation: And Solomon kept the feast in that day, and all Israel with him, even a great assembly from the entering in of Hemath to the river of Egypt, before the Lord our God in the house which he built, eating and drinking, and rejoicing before the Lord our God seven days.

fresh_translation: And on the eighth day he sent away the people and blessed them, and they went each to his tents, rejoicing and good of heart over the good things that the Lord did for David his servant and for Israel his people.
brenton_translation: And on the eighth day he sent away the people: and they blessed the king, and each departed to his tabernacle rejoicing, and their heart was glad because of the good things which the Lord had done to his servant David, and to Israel his people.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when Solomon finished building the house of the Lord and the house of the king and all the workmanship of Solomon, whatever he desired to do,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Solomon had finished building the house of the Lord, and the king's house, and all the work of Solomon, whatever he wished to perform,

fresh_translation: that the Lord appeared to Solomon a second time, just as he appeared at Gibeon.
brenton_translation: that the Lord appeared to Solomon a second time, as he appeared in Gabaon.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to him, I have heard the voice of your prayer and your petition with which you petitioned before me. I have done for you according to all your prayer. I have made this house holy that you built, to put my name there forever, and my eyes and my heart will be there all the days.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to him, I have heard the voice of thy prayer, and thy supplication which thou madest before me: I have done for thee according to all thy prayer: I have hallowed this house which thou hast built to put my name there for ever, and mine eyes and my heart shall be there always.

fresh_translation: And you, if you walk before me just as David your father walked, in holiness of heart and in uprightness, doing according to all that I commanded him, and if you keep my ordinances and my commandments,
brenton_translation: And if thou wilt walk before me as David thy father walked, in holiness of heart and uprightness, and so as to do according to all that I commanded him, and shalt keep my ordinances and my commandments:

fresh_translation: then I will raise up the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, just as I spoke to David your father, saying, A man leading in Israel will not be lifted away from you.
brenton_translation: then will I establish the throne of thy kingdom in Israel for ever, as I spoke to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to rule in Israel.

fresh_translation: But if by turning away you turn away, you and your children, from me and do not keep my commandments and my ordinances that Moses gave before you, and you go and serve other gods and bow to them,
brenton_translation: But if ye or your children do in any wise revolt from me, and do not keep my commandments and my ordinances, which Moses set before you, and ye go and serve other gods, and worship them:

fresh_translation: then I will remove Israel from the land that I gave them, and this house that I made holy for my name I will cast away from before me, and Israel will become for ruin and for a proverb among all the peoples.
brenton_translation: then will I cut off Israel from the land which I have given them, and this house which I have consecrated to my name I will cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a desolation and a by-word to all nations.

fresh_translation: And this house, exalted as it is, everyone passing through it will be astonished and will hiss, and they will say, For what cause did the Lord do thus to this land and to this house?
brenton_translation: And this house, which is high, shall be so that every one that passes by it shall be amazed, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Wherefore has the Lord done thus to this land, and to this house?

fresh_translation: And they will say, Because they forsook the Lord their God who brought their fathers out of Egypt, from the house of slavery, and they held fast to foreign gods and bowed to them and served them. Therefore the Lord brought upon them this evil. Then Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh from the City of David to his house that he built for himself in those days.
brenton_translation: And men shall say, Because they forsook the Lord their God, who brought out their fathers from Egypt, out of the house of bondage, and they attached themselves to strange gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore the Lord has brought this evil upon them.

fresh_translation: Twenty years in which Solomon built the two houses, the house of the Lord and the house of the king,
brenton_translation: During twenty years in which Solomon was building the two houses, the house of the Lord, and the house of the king,

fresh_translation: Hiram king of Tyre had supported Solomon with cedar woods and pine woods and with gold and with all his desire. Then the king gave to Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
brenton_translation: Chiram king of Tyre helped Solomon with cedar wood, and fir wood, and with gold, and all that he wished for: then the king gave Chiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

fresh_translation: And Hiram went out from Tyre and went to Galilee to see the cities that Solomon gave him, and they were not pleasing to him.
brenton_translation: So Chiram departed from Tyre, and went into Galilee to see the cities which Solomon gave to him; and they pleased him not. And he said,

fresh_translation: And he said, What are these cities that you gave me, brother? And he called them Border until this day.
brenton_translation: What are these cities which thou hast given me, brother? And he called them Boundary until this day.

fresh_translation: And Hiram brought to Solomon one hundred and twenty talents of gold.
brenton_translation: And Chiram brought to Solomon a hundred and twenty talents of gold,

fresh_translation: And King Solomon made a ship at Eziongeber, which is near Elath on the shore of the last sea, in the land of Edom.
brenton_translation: even that for which king Solomon built a ship in Gasion Gaber near Ælath on the shore of the extremity of the sea in the land of Edom.

fresh_translation: And Hiram sent in the ship his servants, seafaring men skilled to drive the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
brenton_translation: And Chiram sent in the ship together with the servants of Solomon servants of his own, mariners to row, men acquainted with the sea.

fresh_translation: And they came to Ophir and took from there one hundred and twenty talents of gold and brought them to King Solomon.
brenton_translation: And they came to Sophira, and took thence a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

fresh_translation: And the queen of Sheba heard Solomon's name and the name of the Lord and came to test him with riddles.
brenton_translation: And the queen of Saba heard of the name of Solomon, and the name of the Lord, and she came to try him with riddles.

fresh_translation: And she came to Jerusalem with a very heavy force and camels carrying spices and very much gold and costly stone, and she entered to Solomon and spoke to him all that was in her heart.
brenton_translation: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train; and there came camels bearing spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and she came in to Solomon, and told him all that was in her heart.

fresh_translation: And Solomon reported to her all her words. There was not a word hidden from the king that he did not report to her.
brenton_translation: And Solomon answered all her questions: and there was not a question overlooked by the king which he did not answer her.

fresh_translation: And the queen of Sheba saw all the understanding of Solomon and the house that he built,
brenton_translation: And the queen of Saba saw all the wisdom of Solomon, and the house which he built,

fresh_translation: and the foods of Solomon and the seating of his servants and the standing of his ministers and his clothing and his cupbearers and his whole burnt offering that he offered up in the house of the Lord, and she was beside herself.
brenton_translation: and the provision of Solomon and the sitting of his attendants, and the standing of his servants, and his raiment, and his cup-bearers, and his whole-burnt-offering which he offered in the house of the Lord, and she was utterly amazed.

fresh_translation: And she said to King Solomon, True is the word that I heard in my land concerning your words and concerning your understanding.
brenton_translation: And she said to king Solomon, It was a true report which I heard in my land of thy words and thy wisdom.

fresh_translation: And I did not believe those speaking to me until I came and my eyes saw. And behold, it is not even half according to what they reported to me. You have added goodness to all the report that I heard in my land.
brenton_translation: But I believed not them that told me, until I came and my eyes saw: and, behold, the words as they reported to me are not the half: thou hast exceeded in goodness all the report which I heard in my land.

fresh_translation: Blessed are your women. Blessed are these servants of yours who stand before you continually, hearing all your understanding.
brenton_translation: Blessed are thy wives, blessed are these thy servants who stand before thee continually, who hear all thy wisdom.

fresh_translation: May the Lord your God be blessed, who delighted in you to give you upon the throne of Israel, because the Lord loved Israel to establish it forever, and he set you as king over them to do judgment in righteousness and in their judgments.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord thy God, who has taken pleasure in thee, to set thee upon the throne of Israel, because the Lord loved Israel to establish him for ever; and he has made thee king over them, to execute judgment with justice, and in their causes.

fresh_translation: And she gave to Solomon one hundred and twenty talents of gold and very many spices and costly stone. Such a multitude of spices as those that the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon had not come again.
brenton_translation: And she gave to Solomon a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and very many spices, and precious stones: there had not come any other spices so abundant as those which the queen of Saba gave to king Solomon.

fresh_translation: And the ship of Hiram, carrying the gold from Ophir, brought very many worked timbers and costly stone.
brenton_translation: And the ship of Chiram which brought the gold from Suphir, brought very much hewn timber and precious stones.

fresh_translation: And the king made the worked timbers into supports for the house of the Lord and for the house of the king and lyres and harps for the singers. Such worked timbers had not come upon the earth nor been seen anywhere until this day.
brenton_translation: And the king made the hewn timber into buttresses of the house of the Lord and the king's house, and lyres and harps for singers: such hewn timber had not come upon the earth, nor have been seen anywhere until this day.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all that she desired, whatever she asked, besides all that he had given her by the hand of King Solomon. And she turned and went to her land, she and all her servants.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Saba all that she desired, whatsoever she asked, besides all that he had given her by the hand of king Solomon: and she returned, and came into her own land, she and her servants.

fresh_translation: And the weight of the gold coming to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
brenton_translation: And the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold.

fresh_translation: besides the levies of the subjects and the merchants and all the kings from beyond and the satraps of the land.
brenton_translation: Besides the tributes of them that were subjects, both merchants and all the kings of the country beyond the river, and of the princes of the land.

fresh_translation: And Solomon made three hundred beaten-gold spears. Three hundred gold pieces were upon each spear.
brenton_translation: And Solomon made three hundred spears of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold were upon one spear.

fresh_translation: And three hundred beaten-gold shields, three minas of gold were in each shield, and he put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
brenton_translation: And three hundred shields of beaten gold: and three pounds of gold were in one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

fresh_translation: And the king made a great ivory throne and covered it around with refined gold.
brenton_translation: And the king made a great ivory throne, and gilded it with pure gold.

fresh_translation: Six steps belonged to the throne, and backs of calves belonged to the throne behind it, and hands on this side and on that side of the seat, and two lions standing beside the hands.
brenton_translation: The throne had six steps, and calves in bold relief to the throne behind it, and side-pieces on either hand of the place of the seat, and two lions standing by the side-pieces,

fresh_translation: And twelve lions standing upon the six steps on this side and on that. Thus it was not made for any kingdom.
brenton_translation: and twelve lions standing there on the six steps on either side: it was not so done in any other kingdom.

fresh_translation: And all the drinking vessels of Solomon were golden, and the wash-basins were golden, all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon, of closed gold. There was no silver, because it was not reckoned in the days of Solomon.
brenton_translation: And all the vessels made by Solomon were of gold, and the lavers were golden, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; there was no silver, for it was not accounted of in the days of Solomon.

fresh_translation: For the king had a ship of Tarshish in the sea with the ships of Hiram. Once every three years a ship from Tarshish would come to the king, bringing gold and silver and carved and hewn stones. This was the undertaking of the spoil that King Solomon brought up, to build the house of the Lord and the house of the king and the wall of Jerusalem and the citadel, to fence the enclosure of the City of David, and Asshur and Magdan and Gezer and upper Bethhoron and Iethermath and all the chariot-cities and all the horse-cities and the enterprise of Solomon that he undertook to build in Jerusalem and in all the land from the beginning of his rule. All the people remaining from the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Canaanite and the Hivite and the Jebusite and the Girgashite, who were not from the sons of Israel, whose children remained after them in the land, whom the sons of Israel were not able to destroy utterly, Solomon brought them up into levy until this day. But from the sons of Israel Solomon did not assign any to forced work, because they were the warrior men and his servants and his rulers of his chariots and his horsemen.
brenton_translation: For Solomon had a ship of Tharsis in the sea with the ships of Chiram: one ship came to the king every three years out of Tharsis, laden with gold and silver, and wrought stones, and hewn stones.

fresh_translation: And Solomon was made greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and understanding.
brenton_translation: And Solomon increased beyond all the kings of the earth in wealth and wisdom.

fresh_translation: And all the kings of the earth were seeking the face of Solomon to hear his understanding that the Lord put in his heart.
brenton_translation: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom which the Lord had put into his heart.

fresh_translation: And they were bringing each his gifts: golden vessels and clothing and myrrh and spices and horses and mules, according to year by year.
brenton_translation: And they brought every one their gifts, vessels of gold, and raiment, and stacte, and spices, and horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

fresh_translation: And Solomon had four thousand brood mares for chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he placed them in the cities of the chariots and with the king in Jerusalem. And he was ruling all the kings from the river even to the land of the foreigners and to the borders of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And Solomon had four thousand mares for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen: and he put them in the cities of his chariots, and with the king in Jerusalem:

fresh_translation: And the king made the gold and the silver in Jerusalem like stones, and the cedars he made like the sycamores in the plain in multitude.
brenton_translation: And the king made gold and silver in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars as the sycamores in the plain for multitude.

fresh_translation: And the export of the horses of Solomon was from Egypt and from Kue. The merchants of the king were receiving them from Kue by exchange.
brenton_translation: And the goings forth of Solomon's horsemen was also out of Egypt, and the king's merchants were of Thecue; and they received them out of Thecue at a price.

fresh_translation: And an export chariot would come up from Egypt for one hundred silver pieces and a horse for fifty silver pieces, and so they would go out by sea for all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria.
brenton_translation: And that which proceeded out of Egypt went up thus, even a chariot for a hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for fifty shekels of silver: and thus for all the kings of the Chettians, and the kings of Syria, they came out by sea.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon was a lover of women, and he had seven hundred wives who were rulers and three hundred concubines, and he took foreign wives, and the daughter of Pharaoh, Moabites, Ammonites, Syrians, Edomites, Hittites, and Amorites,
brenton_translation: And king Solomon was a lover of women. And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. And he took strange women, as well as the daughter of Pharao, Moabitish, Ammanitish women, Syrians and Idumeans, Chettites, and Amorites;

fresh_translation: from the nations of which the Lord said to the sons of Israel, You shall not go in to them, and they shall not go in to you, lest they turn your hearts aside after their idols. To these Solomon clung, to love.
brenton_translation: of the nations concerning whom the Lord forbade the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall not go in to them, and they shall not come in to you, lest they turn away your hearts after their idols: Solomon clave to these in love.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the time of Solomon's old age, and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God like the heart of David his father, and the foreign women turned aside his heart after their gods.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the time of the old age of Solomon, that his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as was the heart of David his father. And the strange women turned away his heart after their gods.

fresh_translation: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh, idol of Moab, and for their king, idol of the sons of Ammon,
brenton_translation: Then Solomon built a high place to Chamos the idol of Moab, and to their king the idol of the children of Ammon,

fresh_translation: and for Ashtaroth, abomination of the Sidonians.
brenton_translation: and to Astarte the abomination of the Sidonians.

fresh_translation: And thus he did for all his foreign wives, burning incense and sacrificing to their idols.
brenton_translation: And thus he acted towards all his strange wives, who burnt incense and sacrificed to their idols.

fresh_translation: And Solomon did evil before the Lord. He did not walk after the Lord as David his father did.
brenton_translation: And Solomon did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he went not after the Lord, as David his father.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was angered against Solomon because he turned his heart away from the Lord God of Israel, who appeared to him twice,
brenton_translation: And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because he turned away his heart from the Lord God of Israel, who had appeared twice to him,

fresh_translation: and who had commanded him concerning this matter, not at all to go after other gods, and to keep and do what the Lord God commanded him.
brenton_translation: and charged him concerning this matter, by no means to go after other gods, but to take heed to do what the Lord God commanded him; neither was his heart perfect with the Lord, according to the heart of David his father.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Solomon, Because these things came to be with you and you did not keep my commandments and my ordinances that I commanded you, in tearing I will tear your kingdom out of your hand and give it to your servant.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Solomon, Because it has been thus with thee, and thou hast not kept my commandments and my ordinances which I commanded thee, I will surely rend thy kingdom out of thy hand, and give it to thy servant.

fresh_translation: Yet in your days I will not do it, for the sake of David your father. From the hand of your son I will take it.
brenton_translation: Only in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will take it out of the hand of thy son.

fresh_translation: Yet I will not take the whole kingdom. I will give one scepter to your son for the sake of David my servant and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city that I chose.
brenton_translation: Only I will not take away the whole kingdom: I will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen.

fresh_translation: And the Lord raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite, and Hezron son of Eliada, who was in Ramah, of Hadadezer king of Zobah his lord. And men were gathered to him, and he was the chief of a band, and he took Damascus beforehand, and they were an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon. And Hadad the Edomite was from the seed of the kingdom in Edom.
brenton_translation: And the Lord raised up an enemy to Solomon, Ader the Idumæan, and Esrom son of Eliadaë who dwelt in Raama, and Adadezer king of Suba his master; (and men gathered to him, and he was head of the conspiracy, and he seized on Damasec,) and they were adversaries to Israel all the days of Solomon: and Ader the Idumæan was of the seed royal in Idumæa.

fresh_translation: And it happened when David was destroying Edom, when Joab commander of the army went to bury the wounded, they cut down every male in Edom.
brenton_translation: And it happened, that while David was utterly destroying Edom, while Joab captain of the host was going to bury the dead, when they slew every male in Idumæa;

fresh_translation: For six months Joab and all Israel sat there in Edom until he destroyed every male from Edom.
brenton_translation: (for Joab and all Israel abode there six months in Idumæa, until he utterly destroyed every male in Idumæa;)

fresh_translation: And Hadad fled, he and all the Edomite men from the servants of his father with him, and they entered into Egypt, and Hadad was a small boy.
brenton_translation: that Ader ran away, he and all the Idumæans of the servants of his father with him; and they went into Egypt; and Ader was then a little child.

fresh_translation: And men rose from the city of Midian and came to Paran and took men with them and came to Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Hadad entered to Pharaoh, and he gave him a house and appointed bread for him.
brenton_translation: And there rise up men out of the city of Madiam, and they come to Pharan, and take men with them, and come to Pharao king of Egypt: and Ader went in to Pharao, and he gave him a house, and appointed him provision.

fresh_translation: And Hadad found favor before Pharaoh greatly, and he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, sister of Tahpenes the elder.
brenton_translation: And Ader found great favour in the sight of Pharao, and he gave him his wife's sister in marriage, the elder sister of Thekemina.

fresh_translation: And the sister of Tahpenes bore to Hadad Genubath her son, and Tahpenes weaned him in the midst of the sons of Pharaoh, and Genubath was in the midst of the sons of Pharaoh.
brenton_translation: And the sister of Thekemina bore to him, even to Ader, Ganebath her son; and Thekemina brought him up in the midst of the sons of Pharao, and Ganebath was in the midst of the sons of Pharao.

fresh_translation: And Hadad heard in Egypt that David had slept with his fathers and that Joab the commander of the army had died, and Hadad said to Pharaoh, Send me away, and I will return to my land.
brenton_translation: And Ader heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead; and Ader said to Pharao, Let me go, and I will return to my country.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh said to Hadad, In what are you lacking with me? And behold, you seek to go away to your land. And Hadad said to him, In sending away, send me away. And Hadad returned to his land.
brenton_translation: And Pharao said to Ader, What lackest thou with me? that lo! thou seekest to depart to thy country? and Ader said to him, By all means let me go. So Ader returned to his country;

fresh_translation: This was the evil that Hadad did, and he was disgusted with Israel, and he reigned in the land of Edom.
brenton_translation: this is the mischief which Ader did, and he was a bitter enemy of Israel, and he reigned in the land of Edom.

fresh_translation: And Jeroboam son of Nebat, the Ephrathite from Zereda, son of a widow woman, a servant of Solomon,
brenton_translation: And Jeroboam the son of Nabat, the Ephrathite of Sarira, the son of a widow, was servant of Solomon.

fresh_translation: and this was the matter in which he lifted his hands against King Solomon: he built the citadel; he closed up the breach of the City of David his father.
brenton_translation: And this was the occasion of his lifting up his hands against king Solomon: now king Solomon built the citadel, he completed the fortification of the city of David his father.

fresh_translation: And the man Jeroboam was strong in power, and Solomon saw the young man that he was a man of works, and he appointed him over the burdens of the house of Joseph.
brenton_translation: And the man Jeroboam was very strong; and Solomon saw the young man that he was active, and he set him over the levies of the house of Joseph.

fresh_translation: And it came to be at that time that Jeroboam went out from Jerusalem, and Ahijah the Shilonite the prophet found him on the road, and he pulled him off the road. And Ahijah was clothed with a new garment, and both were in the open country.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass at that time, that Jeroboam went forth from Jerusalem, and Achia the Selonite the prophet found him in the way, and caused him to turn aside out of the way: and Achia was clad with a new garment, and they two were alone in the field.

fresh_translation: And Ahijah took hold of his new garment that was upon him and tore it into twelve pieces.
brenton_translation: And Achia laid hold of his new garment that was upon him, and tore it into twelve pieces:

fresh_translation: And he said to Jeroboam, Take for yourself ten pieces, because thus says the Lord God of Israel: Behold, I am tearing the kingdom from the hand of Solomon, and I will give you ten scepters.
brenton_translation: and he said to Jeroboam, Take to thyself ten pieces, for thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Behold, I rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give thee ten tribes.

fresh_translation: And two scepters will belong to him for the sake of my servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city that I chose in it from all the tribes of Israel,
brenton_translation: Yet he shall have two tribes, for my servant David's sake, and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel.

fresh_translation: because he forsook me and did to Ashtaroth, abomination of the Sidonians, and to Chemosh and to the idols of Moab and to their king, provocation of the sons of Ammon, and he did not walk in my ways to do what is right before me, as David his father did.
brenton_translation: Because he forsook me, and sacrificed to Astarte the abomination of the Sidonians, and to Chamos, and to the idols of Moab, and to their king the abomination of the children of Ammon, and he walked not in my ways, to do that which was right before me, as David his father did.

fresh_translation: And I will not take the whole kingdom from his hand, because in resisting I will resist him all the days of his life for the sake of David my servant, whom I chose.
brenton_translation: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, (for I will certainly resist him all the days of his life,) for David my servant's sake, whom I have chosen.

fresh_translation: And I will take the kingdom from the hand of his son and give you the ten scepters.
brenton_translation: But I will take the kingdom out of the hand of his son, and give thee ten tribes.

fresh_translation: And to his son I will give the two scepters, so that there may be a setting for my servant David all the days before me in Jerusalem, the city that I chose for myself to put my name there.
brenton_translation: But to his son I will give the two remaining tribes, that my servant David may have an establishment continually before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.

fresh_translation: And I will take you, and you will reign over whatever your soul desires, and you will be king over Israel.
brenton_translation: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign as thy soul desires, and thou shalt be king over Israel.

fresh_translation: And it will be, if you keep all that I command you and walk in my ways and do what is right before me, to keep my commandments and my ordinances just as David my servant did, then I will be with you and build for you a faithful house just as I built for David.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, if thou wilt keep all the commandments that I shall give thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that which is right before me, to keep my ordinances and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with thee, and will build thee a sure house, as I built to David.

fresh_translation: And Solomon sought to put Jeroboam to death, and he rose and fled into Egypt to Shishak king of Egypt and was in Egypt until Solomon died.
brenton_translation: And Solomon sought to slay Jeroboam: but he arose and fled into Egypt, to Susakim king of Egypt, and he was in Egypt until Solomon died.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Solomon and all that he did and all his understanding, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of Solomon?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the history of Solomon, and all that he did, and all his wisdom, behold are not these things written in the book of the life of Solomon?

fresh_translation: And the days that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem were forty years.
brenton_translation: And the days during which Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel were forty years.

fresh_translation: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David his father. And it happened when Jeroboam son of Nebat heard, while he was still in Egypt, as he fled from before Solomon and sat in Egypt, that he set straight and comes to his city, to the land of Zereda in the hill country of Ephraim. And King Solomon slept with his fathers, and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David his father. And it came to pass when Jeroboam son of Nabat heard of it, even while he was yet in Egypt as he fled from the face of Solomon and dwelt in Egypt, he straightway comes into his own city, into the land of Sarira in the mount of Ephraim. And king Solomon slept with his fathers, and Roboam his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And King Rehoboam went to Shechem, because all Israel was coming to Shechem to make him king.
brenton_translation: And king Roboam goes to Sikima; for all Israel were coming to Sikima to make him king.

fresh_translation: And the people spoke to King Rehoboam, saying,
brenton_translation: And the people spoke to king Roboam, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy;

fresh_translation: Your father made our yoke heavy, and you now lighten from the hard service of your father and from his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve you.
brenton_translation: but do thou now lighten somewhat of the hard service of thy father, and of his heavy yoke which he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Go away until three days and return to me. And they went away.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Depart for three days, and return to me. And they departed.

fresh_translation: And the king gave charge to the elders who had stood before Solomon his father while he still lived, saying, How do you counsel, and shall I answer this people a word?
brenton_translation: And the king referred the matter to the elders, who stood before Solomon his father while he was yet living, saying, How do ye advise that I should answer this people?

fresh_translation: And they spoke to him, saying, If on this day you will be servant to this people and serve them and speak good words to them, they will be your servants all the days.
brenton_translation: And they spoke to him, saying, If thou wilt this day be a servant to this people, and wilt serve them, and wilt speak to them good words, then will they be thy servants continually.

fresh_translation: But he forsook the counsel of the elders, what they had counseled him, and took counsel with the young men reared with him who stood before his face.
brenton_translation: But he forsook the counsel of the old men which they gave him, and consulted with the young men who were brought up with him, who stood in his presence.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, What do you counsel, and what shall I answer this people, who spoke to me, saying, Lighten from the yoke that your father put upon us?
brenton_translation: And he said to them, What counsel do ye give? And what shall I answer to this people who speak to me, saying, Lighten somewhat of the yoke which thy father has put upon us?

fresh_translation: And the young men reared with him, those standing before his face, spoke to him, saying, Thus you will speak to this people who said to you, Your father made our yoke heavy, and you now lighten from us. Thus you will speak to them: My littleness is thicker than my father's loins.
brenton_translation: And the young men who had been brought up with him, who stood before his face, spoke to him, saying, Thus shalt thou say to this people who have spoken to thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, and do thou now lighten it from off us: thus shalt thou say to them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

fresh_translation: And now my father laid a heavy yoke upon you, and I will add upon your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.
brenton_translation: And whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I also will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

fresh_translation: And all Israel came to King Rehoboam on the third day, just as the king spoke to them, saying, Return to me on the third day.
brenton_translation: And all Israel came to king Roboam on the third day, as the king spoke to them, saying, Return to me on the third day.

fresh_translation: And the king answered the people harshly, and Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the elders that they counseled him,
brenton_translation: And the king answered the people harshly; and Roboam forsook the counsel of the old men which they counselled him.

fresh_translation: and he spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add upon your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.
brenton_translation: And he spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

fresh_translation: And the king did not hear the people, because the turnabout was from the Lord, so that he might establish his word that he spoke by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat.
brenton_translation: And the king hearkened not to the people, because the change was from the Lord, that he might establish his word which he spoke by Achia the Selonite concerning Jeroboam the son of Nabat.

fresh_translation: And all Israel saw that their king did not hear them, and the people answered the king, saying, What share is ours in David, and there is no inheritance for us in the son of Jesse. Turn away, Israel, to your tents. Now shepherd your own house, David. And Israel went away to their tents.
brenton_translation: And all Israel saw that the king did not hearken to them: and the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we any inheritance in the son of Jessæ. Depart, O Israel, to thy tents: now feed thine own house, David. So Israel departed to his tents.

fresh_translation: And the king sent Adoniram, the one over the levy, and all Israel stoned him with stones and he died. And King Rehoboam hurried to go up to flee to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And the king sent Adoniram who was over the tribute; and they stoned him with stones, and he died: and king Roboam made haste to rise to flee to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Israel rebelled against the house of David until this day.
brenton_translation: So Israel rebelled against the house of David until this day.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when all Israel heard that Jeroboam came back from Egypt, they sent and called him to the assembly and made him king over Israel, and there was none after the house of David except the scepter of Judah and Benjamin alone.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned out of Egypt, that they sent and called him to the assembly, and they made him king over Israel: and none followed the house of David except the tribe of Juda and Benjamin only.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam entered Jerusalem and assembled the congregation of Judah and the scepter of Benjamin, one hundred twenty thousand young men who make war, to fight against the house of Israel, to return the kingdom to Rehoboam son of Solomon.
brenton_translation: And Roboam went into Jerusalem, and he assembled the congregation of Juda, and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and twenty thousand young men, warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to recover the kingdom to Roboam the son of Solomon.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Samaia the man of God, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to Rehoboam son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin and to the remnant of the people, saying,
brenton_translation: Speak to Roboam the son of Solomon, king of Juda, and to all the house of Juda and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: You shall not go up nor fight with your brothers, sons of Israel. Let each return to his own house, because this word has happened from me. And they heard the word of the Lord and stopped from going according to the word of the Lord. And King Solomon sleeps with his fathers and is buried with his fathers in the City of David, and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place in Jerusalem, being sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twelve years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Naanan daughter of Anan son of Nahash king of the sons of Ammon, and he did evil before the Lord and did not walk in the way of David his father. And there was a man from the hill country of Ephraim, servant to Solomon, and his name was Jeroboam, and his mother's name was Zereda, a prostitute woman, and Solomon gave him as chief officer of the staff over the burdens of the house of Joseph, and he built for Solomon Zereda in the hill country of Ephraim, and he had three hundred chariots of horses. This one built the citadel among the burdens of the house of Ephraim. This one closed up the City of David and was being lifted up against the kingdom. And Solomon sought to put him to death, and he feared and fled to Shishak king of Egypt and was with him until Solomon died. And Jeroboam heard in Egypt that Solomon died, and he spoke into the ears of Shishak king of Egypt, saying, Send me away, and I will depart to my land. And Shishak said to him, Ask what request and I will give it to you. And Shishak gave to Jeroboam the elder sister of Tahpenes, his own wife, for a wife. She was great among the daughters of the king and bore to Jeroboam Abijah his son. And Jeroboam said to Shishak, Truly send me away, and I will depart. And Jeroboam went out from Egypt and came to the land of Zereda in the hill country of Ephraim and gathered there all the scepter of Ephraim and built a fort there. And his young child became very sick with a very severe sickness, and Jeroboam went to inquire concerning the child, and he said to Ano his wife, Rise and go inquire of God concerning the child, whether he will live from his sickness. And there was a man in Shallum, and his name was Ahijah, and he was sixty years old, and the word of the Lord was with him. And Jeroboam said to his wife, Rise and take in your hand to the man of God loaves and cakes for his children and grapes and a jar of honey. And the woman rose and took in her hand loaves and two cakes and grapes and a jar of honey for Ahijah, and the man was old and his eyes were dim from seeing. And she rose from Zereda and went. And it came to be when she entered the city to Ahijah the Shilonite, Ahijah said to his young servant, Go out now to meet Ano wife of Jeroboam and say to her, Come in and do not stand still, because thus says the Lord: Hard things I am sending upon you. And Ano entered to the man of God, and Ahijah said to her, Why have you brought me loaves and grapes and cakes and a jar of honey? Thus says the Lord: Behold, you will depart from me, and it will be when you enter the gate into Zereda and your maidens come out to meet you and say to you, The child has died, because thus says the Lord: Behold, I will destroy from Jeroboam one urinating against a wall, and those dying of Jeroboam in the city dogs will devour, and the one dying in the field the birds of heaven will devour, and for the child they will mourn. Alas, Lord, because a good word concerning the Lord was found in him. And the woman departed when she heard, and it came to be when she entered into Zereda, the child died and the cry went out to meet her. And Jeroboam went to Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and gathered there the tribes of Israel, and Rehoboam son of Solomon went up there. And the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the Elamite, saying, Take for yourself a new garment not yet entered into water and tear it into twelve pieces, and give them to Jeroboam and say to him, Thus says the Lord: Take for yourself ten pieces to put on, and Jeroboam took them, and Shemaiah said, Thus says the Lord concerning the ten tribes of Israel. And the people said to Rehoboam son of Solomon, Your father made his yoke heavy upon us and made the foods of his table heavy. And now, if you lighten things upon us, we will serve you. And Rehoboam said to the people, In three days I will answer you a word. And he said, Bring in to me the elders and I will take counsel with them what word I should answer the people on the third day. And Rehoboam spoke into their ears, just as the people sent to him, and the elders said, Thus the people spoke to you. And Rehoboam scattered their counsel, and it was not pleasing before him, and he sent and brought in his companions and spoke these same things to them: Thus the people sent to me. And his companions said, Thus you will speak to the people, saying, My littleness is thicker than my father's loin. My father whipped you with whips, but I will rule you with scorpions. And the word was pleasing before Rehoboam, and he answered the people just as his companions, the young men, counseled him. And all the people cried out as one man, each to his neighbor, and they all cried aloud, saying, There is no share for us in David and no inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel, because this man is not for ruler nor for leader. And all the people were scattered from Sikim and each went to his tent, and Rehoboam prevailed and went and mounted his chariot and entered into Jerusalem, and all the scepter of Judah and all the scepter of Benjamin went after him. And it came to be at the turn of the year, and Rehoboam gathered all the men of Judah and Benjamin and went up to war against Jeroboam at Shechem. And the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying, Speak to Rehoboam king of Judah and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin and to the remnant of the people, saying, Thus says the Lord: You shall not go up nor fight against your brothers the sons of Israel. Return each to his house, because this word has happened from me. And they heard the word of the Lord and held back from going according to the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, neither shall ye fight with your brethren the sons of Israel: return each man to his own home; for this thing is from me; and they hearkened to the word of the Lord, and they ceased from going up, according to the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived in it, and he went out from there and built Penuel.
brenton_translation: And Jeroboam built Sikima in mount Ephraim and dwelt in it, and went forth thence and built Phanuel.

fresh_translation: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Behold, now the kingdom will turn back to the house of David.
brenton_translation: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Behold, now the kingdom will return to the house of David.

fresh_translation: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, then the heart of the people will turn back to their lord, to Rehoboam king of Judah, and they will kill me.
brenton_translation: If this people shall go up to offer sacrifice in the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, then the heart of the people will return to the Lord, and to their master, to Roboam king of Juda, and they will slay me.

fresh_translation: And the king took counsel and went and made two golden heifers and said to the people, Let it be enough for you to go up to Jerusalem. Behold your gods, Israel, that brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And the king took counsel, and went, and made two golden heifers, and said to the people, Let it suffice you to have gone hitherto to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And he placed one in Bethel and one he gave in Dan.
brenton_translation: And he put one in Bethel, and he put the other in Dan.

fresh_translation: And this word became sin, and the people went before the one as far as Dan.
brenton_translation: And this thing became a sin; and the people went before one as far as Dan, and left the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he made houses upon high places and made priests from a part of the people, who were not from the sons of Levi.
brenton_translation: And he made houses on the high places, and made priests of any part of the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

fresh_translation: And Jeroboam made a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, according to the feast in the land of Judah, and he went up upon the altar that he made in Bethel to sacrifice to the heifers that he made, and he stationed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he made.
brenton_translation: And Jeroboam appointed a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, according to the feast in the land of Juda;

fresh_translation: And he went up upon the altar that he made on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, in the feast that he devised from his own heart, and he made a feast for the sons of Israel and went up upon the altar to offer incense.
brenton_translation: and went up to the altar which he made in Bæthel to sacrifice to the heifers which he made, and he placed in Bæthel the priests of the high places which he had made. And he went up to the altar which he had made, on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, at the feast which he devised out of his own heart; and he made a feast to the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to sacrifice.

fresh_translation: And behold, a man of God came from Judah to Bethel by the word of the Lord, and Jeroboam had stood by the altar to sacrifice.
brenton_translation: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Juda by the word of the Lord to Bæthel, and Jeroboam stood at the altar to sacrifice.

fresh_translation: And he cried against the altar by the word of the Lord and said, Altar, altar, thus says the Lord: Behold, a son is being born to the house of David, Josiah his name, and he will sacrifice upon you the priests of the high places who sacrifice upon you, and he will burn human bones upon you.
brenton_translation: And he cried against the altar by the word of the Lord, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the Lord, Behold, a son is to be born to the house of David, Josias by name; and he shall offer upon thee the priests of the high places, even of them that sacrifice upon thee, and he shall burn men's bones upon thee.

fresh_translation: And on that day he gave a sign, saying, This is the word that the Lord spoke, saying, Behold, the altar is splitting apart, and the fat upon it will be poured out.
brenton_translation: And in that day one shall give a sign, saying, This is the word which the Lord has spoken, saying, Behold, the altar is rent, and the fatness upon it shall be poured out.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when King Jeroboam heard the words of the man of God, the one who cried against the altar in Bethel, the king stretched out his hand from the altar, saying, Seize him. And behold, his hand that he stretched out against him dried up, and he could not turn it back to himself.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when king Jeroboam heard the words of the man of God who called on the altar that was in Bæthel, that the king stretched forth his hand from the altar, saying, Take hold of him. And, behold, his hand, which he stretched forth against him, withered, and he could not draw it back to himself.

fresh_translation: And the altar split apart, and the fat was poured out from the altar according to the sign that the man of God gave by the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the altar was rent, and the fatness was poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God gave by the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And King Jeroboam said to the man of God, Entreat the face of the Lord your God, and let my hand return to me. And the man of God entreated the face of the Lord, and the king's hand returned to him and became as before.
brenton_translation: And king Jeroboam said to the man of God, Intreat the Lord thy God, and let my hand be restored to me. And the man of God intreated the Lord, and he restored the king's hand to him, and it became as before.

fresh_translation: And the king spoke to the man of God, Come in with me into the house and breakfast, and I will give you a gift.
brenton_translation: And the king said to the man of God, Enter with me into the house, and dine, and I will give thee a gift.

fresh_translation: And the man of God said to the king, If you give me half your house, I will not go in with you, and I will certainly not eat bread nor certainly drink water in this place.
brenton_translation: And the man of God said to the king, If thou shouldest give me the half of thine house, I would not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread, neither will I drink water in this place; for thus the Lord charged me by his word, saying,

fresh_translation: For thus the Lord commanded me by word, saying, Eat no bread and drink no water and do not return by the way in which you went.
brenton_translation: Eat no bread, and drink no water, and return not by the way by which thou camest.

fresh_translation: And he went away by another road and did not return by the road on which he came into Bethel.
brenton_translation: So he departed by another way, and returned not by the way by which he came to Bæthel.

fresh_translation: And one old prophet lived in Bethel, and his sons came and recounted to him all the deeds that the man of God did on that day in Bethel and the words that he spoke to the king, and they told them before their father.
brenton_translation: And there dwelt an old prophet in Bæthel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God did on that day in Bæthel, and the words which he spoke to the king: and they turned the face of their father.

fresh_translation: And their father spoke to them, saying, Which road did he go? And his sons showed him the road by which the man of God who came from Judah went up.
brenton_translation: And their father spoke to them, saying, Which way went he? and his sons shew him the way by which the man of God who came out of Juda went up.

fresh_translation: And he said to his sons, Saddle the donkey for me. And they saddled the donkey for him, and he mounted it.
brenton_translation: And he said to his sons, Saddle me the ass: and they saddled him the ass, and he mounted it,

fresh_translation: And he went after the man of God and found him sitting under an oak, and said to him, Are you the man of God who came from Judah? And he said to him, I am.
brenton_translation: and went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said to him, Art thou the man of God that came out of Juda? And he said to him, I am.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Come with me and eat bread.
brenton_translation: And he said to him, Come with me, and eat bread.

fresh_translation: And he said, I am certainly not able to return with you, and I will certainly not eat bread nor drink water in this place.
brenton_translation: And he said, I shall not by any means be able to return with thee, neither will I eat bread, neither will I drink water in this place.

fresh_translation: For thus it has been commanded me by the word of the Lord, saying, Eat no bread there and drink no water there and do not return by the road in which you went.
brenton_translation: For thus the Lord commanded me by word, saying, Eat not bread there, and drink not water, and return not thither by the way by which thou camest.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, I also am a prophet as you are, and an angel spoke to me by a word of the Lord, saying, Bring him back with yourself into your house, and let him eat bread and drink water. But he lied to him.
