brenton_translation: And he said to him, I also am a prophet as thou art; and an angel spoke to me by the word of the Lord, saying, Bring him back to thee into thy house, and let him eat bread and drink water: but he lied to him.

fresh_translation: And he brought him back, and he ate bread and drank water in his house.
brenton_translation: And he brought him back, and he ate bread and drank water in his house.

fresh_translation: And it came to be while they were sitting at the table, the word of the Lord came to the prophet who had brought him back.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass while they were sitting at the table, that the word of the Lord came to the prophet that brought him back;

fresh_translation: And he said to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, Thus says the Lord: Because you defied the word of the Lord and did not keep the commandment that the Lord your God commanded you,
brenton_translation: and he spoke to the man of God that came out of Juda, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Because thou hast resisted the word of the Lord, and hast not kept the commandment which the Lord thy God commanded thee,

fresh_translation: and you turned back and ate bread and drank water in the place of which he spoke to you, saying, Eat no bread and drink no water, your body shall certainly not enter into the tomb of your fathers.
brenton_translation: but hast returned, and eaten bread and drunk water in the place of which he spoke to thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat bread, and shalt not drink water; therefore thy body shall in nowise enter into the sepulchre of thy fathers.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after he ate bread and drank water, the donkey was saddled for him, and he went back.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after he had eaten bread and drunk water, that he saddled the ass for him, and he turned and departed.

fresh_translation: And he went away, and a lion found him on the road and killed him, and his body was thrown on the road, and the donkey stood beside it, and the lion stood beside the body.
brenton_translation: And a lion found him in the way, and slew him; and his body was cast out in the way, and the ass was standing by it, and the lion also was standing by the body.

fresh_translation: And behold, men passing by saw the corpse thrown on the road and the lion standing next to the corpse, and they came in and spoke in the city where the old prophet lived.
brenton_translation: And, behold, men were passing by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion was standing near the carcase: and they went in and spoke of it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

fresh_translation: And the one who brought him back from the road heard and said, This is the man of God who defied the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the prophet that turned him back out of the way heard, and said, This is the man of God who rebelled against the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he went and found his body thrown on the road, and the donkey and the lion had stood beside the body. The lion had not eaten the body of the man of God and had not crushed the donkey.
brenton_translation: And he went and found the body cast in the way, and the ass and the lion were standing by the body: and the lion had not devoured the body of the man of God, and had not torn the ass.

fresh_translation: And the prophet lifted the body of the man of God and put it upon the donkey and brought him back into the city, the prophet to bury him.
brenton_translation: And the prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on his ass; and the prophet brought him back to his city, to bury him in his own tomb,

fresh_translation: And they laid him in his own tomb, and they mourned for him, Alas, brother.
brenton_translation: and they bewailed him, saying, Alas, brother.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after mourning for him, he said to his sons, saying, If I die, bury me in this tomb where the man of God has been buried. Put me beside his bones, so that my bones may be preserved with his bones.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after he had lamented him, that he spoke to his sons, saying, Whenever I die, bury me in this tomb wherein the man of God is buried; lay me by his bones, that my bones may be preserved with his bones.

fresh_translation: For the word that he spoke by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against the houses of the high places in Samaria will surely happen.
brenton_translation: For the word will surely come to pass which he spoke by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bæthel, and against the high houses in Samaria.

fresh_translation: And after this word Jeroboam did not turn back from his evil, and he turned again and made priests of high places from every part of the people. Whoever wished, he filled his hand, and he became priest for the high places.
brenton_translation: And after this Jeroboam turned not from his sin, but he turned and made of part of the people priests of the high places: whoever would, he consecrated him, and he became a priest for the high places.

fresh_translation: And this word became sin to the house of Jeroboam, and for ruin and for destruction from the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: And this thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to its destruction and its removal from the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned over Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that the Lord chose to put his name there from all the tribes of Israel, and his mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite.
brenton_translation: And Roboam son of Solomon ruled over Juda. Roboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in the city Jerusalem, which the Lord chose to put his name there out of all the tribes of Israel: and his mother's name was Naama the Ammonitess.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam did evil before the Lord and provoked him to jealousy by all that his fathers did and by their sins that they sinned.
brenton_translation: And Roboam did evil in the sight of the Lord; and he provoked him in all the things which their fathers did in their sins which they sinned.

fresh_translation: And they built for themselves high places and pillars and groves upon every high hill and under every shady tree.
brenton_translation: And they built for themselves high places, and pillars, and planted groves on every high hill, and under every shady tree.

fresh_translation: And a conspiracy came to be in the land, and they acted according to all the abominations of the nations that the Lord drove out from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And there was a conspiracy in the land, and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the Lord removed from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the fifth year of the reign of Roboam, Susakim king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;

fresh_translation: And he took all the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king's house, and the golden spears that David took from the hand of the sons of Hadadezer king of Zobah and brought them into Jerusalem. He took everything, the golden arms.
brenton_translation: and took all the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house, and the golden spears which David took out of the hand of the sons of Adrazaar king of Suba, and brought them into Jerusalem, even all that he took, and the golden shields which Solomon had made, [and carried them away into Egypt.]

fresh_translation: And King Rehoboam made bronze arms in their place, and the chiefs of the runners, those guarding the gate of the king's house, were set over them.
brenton_translation: And king Roboam made brazen shields instead of them; and the chiefs of the body guard, who kept the gate of the house of the king, were placed in charge over them.

fresh_translation: And it came to be whenever the king entered into the house of the Lord, the runners carried them and returned them to the chamber of the runners.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the king went into the house of the Lord, that the body guard took them up, and fixed them in the chamber of the body guard.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Rehoboam and all that he did, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the history of Roboam, and all that he did, behold, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days.
brenton_translation: And there was war between Roboam and Jeroboam continually.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the City of David, and Abijam his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Roboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Abiu his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijam son of Rehoboam reigned over Judah.
brenton_translation: And in the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nabat, Abiu son of Roboam reigns over Juda.

fresh_translation: And he reigned six years, and his mother's name was Maachah daughter of Absalom.
brenton_translation: And he reigned three years over Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Maacha, daughter of Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And he walked in the sins of his father that he did before him, and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God like the heart of David his father.
brenton_translation: And he walked in the sins of his father which he wrought in his presence, and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as was the heart of his father David.

fresh_translation: For on account of David the Lord gave him a remnant, to set up his children after him and to establish Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Howbeit for David's sake the Lord gave him a remnant, that he might establish his children after him, and might establish Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: Because David did what was right before the Lord and did not turn aside from all that he commanded him all the days of his life.
brenton_translation: Forasmuch as David did that which was right in the sight of the Lord: he turned not from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Abijam and all that he did, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the history of Abiu, and all that he did, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda? And there was war between Abiu and Jeroboam.

fresh_translation: And Abijam slept with his fathers in the twenty-fourth year of Jeroboam and was buried with his fathers in the City of David, and Asa his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Abiu slept with his fathers in the twenty-fourth year of Jeroboam; and he is buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Asa his son reigns in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the twenty-fourth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa reigned over Judah.
brenton_translation: In the four and twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa begins to reign over Juda.

fresh_translation: And he reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem, and his mother's name was Anah daughter of Absalom.
brenton_translation: And he reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Ana, daughter of Abessalom.

fresh_translation: And Asa did what was right before the Lord, as David his father did.
brenton_translation: And Asa did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, as David his father.

fresh_translation: And he removed the rites from the land and sent away all the practices that his fathers made.
brenton_translation: And he removed the sodomites out of the land, and abolished all the practices which his fathers had kept up.

fresh_translation: And he removed Anah his mother from being leader, because she made an assembly in her grove, and Asa cut down her recesses and burned them with fire in the Kidron wadi.
brenton_translation: And he removed Ana his mother from being queen, forasmuch as she gathered a meeting in her grove: and Asa cut down her retreats, and burnt them with fire in the brook of Kedron.

fresh_translation: But the high places he did not remove. Yet the heart of Asa was perfect with the Lord all his days.
brenton_translation: But he removed not the high places; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with the Lord all his days.

fresh_translation: And he brought the pillars of his father, and his own pillars he brought into the house of the Lord, silver and gold and vessels.
brenton_translation: And he brought in the pillars of his father, he even brought in his gold and silver pillars into the house of the Lord, and his vessels.

fresh_translation: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all the days.
brenton_translation: And there was war between Asa and Baasa king of Israel all their days.

fresh_translation: And Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah and built Ramah so that there might not be one going out or one coming in to Asa king of Judah.
brenton_translation: And Baasa king of Israel went up against Juda, and built Rama, so that no one should go out or come in for Asa king of Juda.

fresh_translation: And Asa took the silver and the gold found in the treasures of the king's house and gave them into the hands of his servants, and King Asa sent them to Ben-hadad son of Tabrimon son of Hezion, king of Syria, the one dwelling in Damascus, saying,
brenton_translation: And Asa took all the silver and the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house, and gave them into the hands of his servants; and king Asa sent them out to the son of Ader, the son of Taberema son of Azin king of Syria, who dwelt in Damascus, saying,

fresh_translation: Make a covenant between me and you and between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you gifts, silver and gold. Come, scatter your covenant with Baasha king of Israel, and he will go up from me.
brenton_translation: Make a covenant between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: lo! I have sent forth to thee gold and silver for gifts: come, break thy league with Baasa king of Israel, that he may go up from me.

fresh_translation: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the cities of Israel and struck Ijon and Dan and Abel-beth-maachah and all Cinneroth as far as all the land of Naphtali.
brenton_translation: And the son of Ader hearkened to king Asa, and sent the chiefs of his forces to the cities of Israel; and they smote Ain, Dan, and Abel of the house of Maacha, and all Chennereth, as far as the whole land of Nephthali.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Baasha heard, he stopped building Ramah and returned to Tirzah.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Baasa heard it, that he left off building Rama, and returned to Thersa.

fresh_translation: And King Asa gave charge to all Judah without exception, and they carried off the stones of Ramah and its timbers that Baasha built, and King Asa built with them all the hill of Benjamin and the watchtower.
brenton_translation: And king Asa charged all Juda without exception: and they take up the stones of Rama and its timbers with which Baasa was building; and king Asa built with them upon the whole hill of Benjamin, and the watch-tower.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Asa and all his dominion that he exercised, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Judah? Yet in the time of his old age his feet were in pain.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the history of Asa, and all his mighty deeds which he wrought, and the cities which he built, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

fresh_translation: And Asa slept and was buried with his fathers in the City of David, and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Josaphat his son reigns in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Nadab son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.
brenton_translation: And Nabat son of Jeroboam reigns over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Juda, and he reigned two years in Israel.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before the Lord and walked in the way of his father and in his sins by which he made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sins wherein he caused Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: And Baasha son of Ahijah of the house of Belaan conspired against him and struck him at Gibbethon of the Philistines, while Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.
brenton_translation: And Baasa son of Achia, who was over the house of Belaan son of Achia, conspired against him, and smote him in Gabathon of the Philistines; for Nabat and all Israel were besieging Gabathon.

fresh_translation: And Baasha killed him in the third year of Asa son of Abijam king of Judah and reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Baasa slew him in the third year of Asa son of Asa king of Juda; and reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when he reigned, he struck the house of Jeroboam and left no breathing thing of Jeroboam until he destroyed him, according to the word of the Lord that he spoke by the hand of his servant Ahijah the Shilonite,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he reigned, that he smote the whole house of Jeroboam, and left none that breathed of Jeroboam, until he had destroyed him utterly, according to the word of the Lord which he spoke by his servant Achia the Selonite,

fresh_translation: because of the sins of Jeroboam, as he made Israel sin, and by his provocation with which he provoked the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: for the sins of Jeroboam, who led Israel into sin, even by his provocation wherewith he provoked the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Nadab and all that he did, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the history of Nabat, and all that he did, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah reigned over Israel in Tirzah twenty-four years.
brenton_translation: And in the third year of Asa king of Juda, Baasa the son of Achia begins to reign over Israel in Thersa, twenty and four years.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before the Lord and walked in the way of Jeroboam son of Nebat and in his sins by which he made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, and in his sins, as he caused Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came by the hand of Jehu son of Anani against Baasha,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came by the hand of Ju son of Anani to Baasa, saying,

fresh_translation: Because I lifted you up from the earth and gave you as a leader over my people Israel, and you walked in the way of Jeroboam and made my people Israel sin, to provoke me by their vanities,
brenton_translation: Forasmuch as I lifted thee up from the earth, and made thee ruler over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast caused my people Israel to sin, to provoke me with their vanities;

fresh_translation: behold, I am raising up after Baasha and after his house, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
brenton_translation: Behold, I raise up enemies after Baasa, and after his house; and I will make thy house as the house of Jeroboam son of Nabat.

fresh_translation: The dead one of Baasha in the city, dogs will eat him, and the dead one of his in the field, birds of the sky will eat him.
brenton_translation: Him that dies of Baasa in the city the dogs shall devour, and him that dies of his in the field the birds of the sky shall devour.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Baasha and all that he did and his acts of power, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: Now the rest of the history of Baasa, and all that he did, and his mighty acts, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And Baasha slept with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah, and Ela his son reigned in his place in the twentieth year of King Asa.
brenton_translation: And Baasa slept with his fathers, and they bury him in Thersa; and Ela his son reigns in his stead.

fresh_translation: And by the hand of Jehu son of Anani the Lord spoke against Baasha and against his house, all the evil that he did before the Lord, provoking him by the works of his hands, by becoming like the house of Jeroboam and because he struck him.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke by Ju the son of Anani against Baasa, and against his house, even all the evil which he wrought before the Lord to provoke him to anger by the works of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he smote him.

fresh_translation: And Ela son of Baasha reigned over Israel two years in Tirzah.
brenton_translation: And Ela son of Baasa reigned over Israel two years in Thersa.

fresh_translation: And Zimri, commander of half the cavalry, conspired against him, while he was in Tirzah drinking himself drunk in the house of Osa the steward in Tirzah.
brenton_translation: And Zambri, captain of half his cavalry, conspired against him, while he was in Thersa, drinking himself drunk in the house of Osa the steward at Thersa.

fresh_translation: And Zimri went in and struck him and killed him and reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Zambri went in and smote him and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when he reigned, when he sat upon his throne, he struck the whole house of Baasha.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he reigned, when he sat upon his throne,

fresh_translation: This happened according to the word that the Lord spoke against the house of Baasha through Jehu the prophet,
brenton_translation: that he smote all the house of Baasa, according to the word which the Lord spoke against the house of Baasa, and to Ju the prophet,

fresh_translation: because of all the sins of Baasha and Ela his son, by which they made Israel sin, to provoke the Lord God of Israel by their vanities.
brenton_translation: for all the sins of Baasa and Ela his son, as he led Israel astray to sin, to provoke the Lord God of Israel with their vanities.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Ela and all that he did, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the deeds of Ela which he did, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah, and the camp of Israel was at Gibbethon of the Philistines.
brenton_translation: And Zambri reigned in Thersa seven days: and the army of Israel was encamped against Gabathon of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And the people in the camp heard them saying, Zimri has conspired and has struck the king, and on that day in the camp they made Omri, commander of the army, king over Israel.
brenton_translation: And the people heard in the army, saying, Zambri has conspired and smitten the king: and the people of Israel made Ambri the captain of the host king in that day in the camp over Israel.

fresh_translation: And Omri went up, and all Israel with him, from Gibbethon and they besieged Tirzah.
brenton_translation: And Ambri went up, and all Israel with him, out of Gabathon; and they besieged Thersa.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Zimri saw that his city had been seized, he entered into the citadel of the king's house and burned the king's house over himself with fire and died,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Zambri saw that his city was taken, that he goes into the inner chamber of the house of the king, and burnt the king's house over him, and died.

fresh_translation: because of his sins that he did, by doing evil before the Lord, by walking in the way of Jeroboam son of Nebat and in his sins by which he made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: Because of his sins which he committed, doing that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, so as to walk in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, and in his sins wherein he caused Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Zimri and his conspiracies that he conspired, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the history of Zambri, and his conspiracies wherein he conspired, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: Then the people of Israel were divided: half the people were behind Tibni son of Ginath to make him king, and half the people were behind Omri.
brenton_translation: Then the people of Israel divides; half the people goes after Thamni the son of Gonath to make him king; and half the people goes after Ambri.

fresh_translation: The people who were behind Omri prevailed over the people who were behind Tibni son of Ginath, and Tibni died, and Joram his brother at that time, and Omri reigned after Tibni.
brenton_translation: The people that followed Ambri overpowered the people that followed Thamni son of Gonath: and Thamni died and Joram his brother at that time, and Ambri reigned after Thamni.

fresh_translation: In the thirty-first year of King Asa, Omri reigned over Israel twelve years; in Tirzah he reigned six years.
brenton_translation: In the thirty-first year of king Asa, Ambri begins to reign over Israel twelve years: he reigns six years in Thersa.

fresh_translation: And Omri bought the mountain of Shemer from Shemer, lord of the mountain, for two talents of silver, and built the mountain and called the name of the mountain that he built by the name of Shemer, lord of the mountain, Shemer.
brenton_translation: And Ambri bought the mount Semeron of Semer the lord of the mountain for two talents of silver; and he built upon the mountain, and they called the name of the mountain on which he built, after the name of Semer the lord of the mount, Semeron.

fresh_translation: And Omri did evil before the Lord and did worse than all those who came before him.
brenton_translation: And Ambri did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and wrought wickedly beyond all that were before him.

fresh_translation: And he walked in every way of Jeroboam son of Nebat and in his sins by which he made Israel sin, to provoke the Lord God of Israel by their vanities.
brenton_translation: And he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, and in his sins wherewith he caused Israel to sin, to provoke the Lord God of Israel by their vanities.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the matters of Omri and all that he did and his dominion, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Israel?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Ambri, and all that he did, and all his might, behold, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

fresh_translation: And Omri slept with his fathers and was buried in Samaria, and Ahab his son reigned in his place. And in the eleventh year of Omri, Jehoshaphat son of Asa reigned, thirty-five years old in his reign, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem, and his mother's name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi. And he walked in the way of Asa his father and did not turn aside from it, doing what was right before the Lord, except the high places they did not remove; they sacrificed on the high places and burned incense. And the rest of the alliances that Jehoshaphat made and all the dominion that he exercised and those against whom he fought, behold, are these not written in the Book of the Matters of the Days of the kings of Judah? And the rest of the entanglements that were imposed in the days of Asa his father he removed from the land. And there was no king in Syria, only a deputy. And King Jehoshaphat made a ship for Tarshish to go to Sophir for gold, and it did not go because the ship was broken at Eziongeber. Then the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will send your servants and my servants in the ship, and Jehoshaphat was not willing. And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the City of David, and Joram his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Ambri slept with his fathers, and is buried in Samaria; and Achaab his son reigns in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the second year of Jehoshaphat, Ahab son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
brenton_translation: In the second year of Josaphat king of Juda, Achaab son of Ambri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

fresh_translation: And Ahab did evil before the Lord. He did worse than all those before him.
brenton_translation: And Achaab did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and did more wickedly than all that were before him.

fresh_translation: And it was not enough for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and he took Jezebel daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians for a wife and went and served Baal and bowed down to him.
brenton_translation: And it was not enough for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, but he took to wife Jezabel the daughter of Jethebaal king of the Sidonians; and he went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

fresh_translation: And he set up an altar to Baal in the house of his abominations, which he built in Samaria.
brenton_translation: And he set up an altar to Baal in the house of his abominations, which he built in Samaria.

fresh_translation: And Ahab made a grove, and Ahab added by making provocations, provoking his own soul toward destruction. He did evil beyond all the kings of Israel who came before him.
brenton_translation: And Achaab made a grove; and Achaab did yet more abominably, to provoke the Lord God of Israel, and to sin against his own life so that he should be destroyed: he did evil above all the kings of Israel that were before him.

fresh_translation: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. In Abiram his firstborn he founded it, and in Segub his youngest he set up its gates, according to the word of the Lord that he spoke by the hand of Joshua son of Nun.
brenton_translation: And in his days Achiel the Bæthelite built Jericho: he laid the foundation of it in Abiron his first-born, and he set up the doors of it in Segub his younger son, according to the word of the Lord which he spoke by Joshua the son of Naue.

fresh_translation: And Elijah the prophet, the Tishbite from Thesbon of Gilead, said to Ahab, As the Lord God of hosts, God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, these years there shall be no dew and rain except by the word of my mouth.
brenton_translation: And Eliu the prophet, the Thesbite of Thesbæ of Galaad, said to Achaab, As the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be these years dew nor rain, except by the word of my mouth.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Elijah,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Eliu, saying,

fresh_translation: Go from here eastward and hide yourself by the wadi Cherith, the one before the Jordan.
brenton_translation: Depart hence eastward, and hide thee by the brook of Chorrath, that is before Jordan.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, you will drink water from the wadi, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.
brenton_translation: And it shall be that thou shalt drink water of the brook, and I will charge the ravens to feed thee there.

fresh_translation: And Elijah did according to the word of the Lord and sat by the wadi Cherith before the Jordan.
brenton_translation: And Eliu did according to the word of the Lord, and he sat by the brook of Chorrath before Jordan.

fresh_translation: And the ravens brought him breads in the morning and meat in the evening, and he drank water from the wadi.
brenton_translation: And the ravens brought him loaves in the morning, and flesh in the evening, and he drank water of the brook.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after days, the wadi dried up because no rain came upon the land.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after some time, that the brook was dried up, because there had been no rain upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Elijah,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Eliu, saying,

fresh_translation: Rise and go to Sarepta of Sidonia. Behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to feed you.
brenton_translation: Arise, and go to Sarepta of the Sidonian land: behold, I have there commanded a widow-woman to maintain thee.

fresh_translation: And he rose and went to Sarepta, to the gate of the city, and behold, there a widow woman was gathering sticks. And Elijah cried after her and said to her, Please fetch me a little water in a vessel and I will drink.
brenton_translation: And he arose and went to Sarepta, and came to the gate of the city: and, behold, a widow-woman was there gathering sticks; and Eliu cried after her, and said to her, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

fresh_translation: And as she went to fetch it, Elijah cried after her and said, Please take for me a morsel of bread in your hand.
brenton_translation: And she went to fetch it; and Eliu cried after her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of the bread that is in thy hand.

fresh_translation: And the woman said, As the Lord your God lives, I have no cake except as much as a handful of flour in the jar and a little oil in the jug, and behold, I am gathering two little sticks and will go in and make it for myself and my children, and we will eat and die.
brenton_translation: And the woman said, As the Lord thy God lives, I have not a cake, but only a handful of meal in the pitcher, and a little oil in a cruse, and, behold, I am going to gather two sticks, and I shall go in and dress it for myself and my children, and we shall eat it and die.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to her, Take courage. Go in and do according to your word, but first make for me from there a little cake and bring it out to me, and for yourself and your children you will make it afterward.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to her, Be of good courage, go in and do according to thy word: but make me thereof a little cake, and thou shalt bring it out to me first, and thou shalt make some for thyself and thy children last.

fresh_translation: For thus says the Lord: the jar of flour will not fail and the jug of oil will not lessen until the day the Lord gives rain upon the land.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, The pitcher of meal shall not fail, and the cruse of oil shall not diminish, until the day that the Lord gives rain upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And the woman went and did, and she and he and her children were eating.
brenton_translation: And the woman went and did so, and did eat, she, and he, and her children.

fresh_translation: And the jar of flour did not fail, and the jug of oil did not lessen, according to the word of the Lord that he spoke by the hand of Elijah.
brenton_translation: And the pitcher of meal failed not, and the cruse of oil was not diminished, according to the word of the Lord which he spoke by the hand of Eliu.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after these things, the son of the woman, mistress of the house, became sick, and his sickness was very severe until no breath was left in him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass afterward, that the son of the woman the mistress of the house was sick; and his sickness was very severe, until there was no breath left in him.

fresh_translation: And she said to Elijah, What is to me and to you, man of God? You entered to me to bring my injustices to remembrance and to put my son to death.
brenton_translation: And she said to Eliu, What have I to do with thee, O man of God? hast thou come in to me to bring my sins to remembrance, and to slay my son?

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to the woman, Give me your son. And he took him from her bosom and brought him up into the upper room where he himself sat there and laid him upon his bed.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to the woman, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and took him up to the chamber in which he himself lodged, and laid him on the bed.

fresh_translation: And Elijah cried out and said, Alas, Lord, witness of the widow with whom I dwell, with her you have done evil, by putting her son to death?
brenton_translation: And Eliu cried aloud, and said, Alas, O Lord, the witness of the widow with whom I sojourn, thou hast wrought evil for her in slaying her son.

fresh_translation: And he breathed on the child three times and called upon the Lord and said, Lord my God, let the soul of this child now return into him.
brenton_translation: And he breathed on the child thrice, and called on the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, let, I pray thee, the soul of this child return to him.

fresh_translation: And it came to be so, and the child cried out.
brenton_translation: And it was so, and the child cried out,

fresh_translation: And he brought him down from the upper room into the house and gave him to his mother, and Elijah said, Look, your son lives.
brenton_translation: and he brought him down from the upper chamber into the house, and gave him to his mother; and Eliu said, See, thy son lives.

fresh_translation: And the woman said to Elijah, Behold, I now know that you are a man of God and the word of the Lord in your mouth is true.
brenton_translation: And the woman said to Eliu, Behold, I know that thou art a man of God, and the word of the Lord in thy mouth is true.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after many days, the word of the Lord came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go and appear to Ahab, and I will give rain upon the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the Lord came to Eliu in the third year, saying, Go, and appear before Achaab, and I will bring rain upon the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: And Elijah went to appear to Ahab, and the famine was severe in Samaria.
brenton_translation: And Eliu went to appear before Achaab: and the famine was severe in Samaria.

fresh_translation: And Ahab called Obadiah the steward, and Obadiah was fearing the Lord greatly.
brenton_translation: And Achaab called Abdiu the steward. Now Abdiu feared the Lord greatly.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Jezebel was striking the prophets of the Lord, Obadiah took one hundred prophet-men and hid them by fifty in a cave and fed them with bread and water.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Jezabel smote the prophets of the Lord, that Abdiu took a hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.

fresh_translation: And Ahab said to Obadiah, Come, let us pass through the land, to the springs of the waters and to the wadis, if somehow we may find grass and preserve horses and mules, and they will not be destroyed from among the livestock.
brenton_translation: And Achaab said to Abdiu, Come, and let us go through the land, and to the fountains of water, and to the brooks, if by any means we may find grass, and may save the horses and mules, and so they will not perish from the tents.

fresh_translation: And they divided for themselves the road to pass through it. Ahab went one road alone, and Obadiah went another road alone.
brenton_translation: And they made a division of the way between them to pass through it: Achaab went one way, and Abdiu went by another way alone.

fresh_translation: And Obadiah was on the road alone, and Elijah came to meet him alone, and Obadiah hurried and fell upon his face and said, Are you really my lord Elijah?
brenton_translation: And Abdiu was alone in the way; and Eliu came alone to meet him: and Abdiu hasted, and fell upon his face, and said, My lord Eliu, art thou indeed he?

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to him, I am. Go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to him, I am: go, say to thy master, Behold, Eliu is here.

fresh_translation: And Obadiah said, What have I sinned, that you are giving your servant into the hand of Ahab to kill me?
brenton_translation: And Abdiu said, What sin have I committed, that thou givest thy servant into the hand of Achaab to slay me?

fresh_translation: As the Lord your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you, and they said, He is not here, and he bound the kingdom and its regions by oath that it had not found you.
brenton_translation: As the Lord thy God lives, there is not a nation or kingdom, whither my lord has not sent to seek thee; and if they said, He is not here, then has he set fire to the kingdom and its territories, because he has not found thee.

fresh_translation: And now you say, Go, announce to your lord, Behold, Elijah.
brenton_translation: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Eliu is here.

fresh_translation: And it will be, if I go away from you, the Spirit of the Lord will carry you to a land that I do not know, and I will go in to report to Ahab, and he will kill me. Yet your servant has been fearing the Lord from his youth.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when I shall have departed from thee, that the Spirit of the Lord shall carry thee to a land which I know not, and I shall go in to tell the matter to Achaab, and he will not find thee and will slay me: yet thy servant fears the Lord from his youth.

fresh_translation: Was it not reported to you, my lord, what I did when Jezebel was killing the prophets of the Lord, that I hid one hundred men of the prophets of the Lord, fifty by fifty in a cave, and fed them with breads and water?
brenton_translation: Has it not been told to thee my lord, what I did when Jezabel slew the prophets of the Lord, that I hid a hundred men of the prophets of the Lord, by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

fresh_translation: And now you say to me, Go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah, and he will kill me.
brenton_translation: And now thou sayest to me, Go, say to thy master, Behold, Eliu is here: and he shall slay me.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said, As the Lord of hosts lives, before whom I stand, today I will appear to him.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said, As the Lord of Hosts before whom I stand lives, to-day I will appear before him.

fresh_translation: And Obadiah went to meet Ahab and reported to him, and Ahab ran out and went to meet Elijah.
brenton_translation: And Abdiu went to meet Achaab, and told him: and Achaab hasted forth, and went to meet Eliu.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to Elijah, Are you really the one disturbing Israel?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Achaab saw Eliu, that Achaab said to Eliu, Art thou he that perverts Israel?

fresh_translation: And Elijah said, I am not disturbing Israel, but you and your father's house, in that you forsook the Lord your God and went after the Baalim.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said, I do not pervert Israel; but it is thou and thy father's house, in that ye forsake the Lord your God, and thou hast gone after Baalim.

fresh_translation: And now send, gather to me all Israel at Mount Carmel and the prophets of the Shame, four hundred fifty, and the prophets of the groves, four hundred, eating Jezebel's table.
brenton_translation: And now send, gather to me all Israel to mount Carmel, and the prophets of shame four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, that eat at Jezabel's table.

fresh_translation: And Ahab sent to all Israel and gathered all the prophets at Mount Carmel.
brenton_translation: And Achaab sent to all Israel, and gathered all the prophets to mount Carmel.

fresh_translation: And Elijah came near to all and said to them, How long will you limp on both knees? If the Lord is God, go after him; but if Baal is, go after him. And the people did not answer a word.
brenton_translation: And Eliu drew near to them all: and Eliu said to them, How long wilt ye halt on both feet? if the Lord be God, follow him; but if Baal, follow him. And the people answered not a word.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to the people, I alone am left as a prophet of the Lord, utterly alone, and the prophets of Baal are four hundred fifty men and the prophets of the grove four hundred.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to the people, I am left, the only one prophet of the Lord; and the prophets of Baal are four hundred and fifty men, and the prophets of the groves four hundred.

fresh_translation: Let them give us two calves, and let them choose one for themselves and butcher it and place it upon the woods, and put no fire. And I will prepare the other bull, and I will certainly place no fire.
brenton_translation: Let them give us two oxen, and let them choose one for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire on the wood: and I will dress the other bullock, and put on no fire.

fresh_translation: And call aloud on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the Lord my God, and the god who answers by fire, he is God. And all the people answered and said, Good is the word that you spoke.
brenton_translation: And do ye call loudly on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the Lord my God, and it shall come to pass that the God who shall answer by fire, he is God. And all the people answered and said, The word which thou hast spoken is good.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to the prophets of the Shame, Choose for yourselves the one calf and prepare it first, because you are many, and call on the name of your god, but put no fire.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to the prophets of shame, Choose to yourselves one calf, and dress it first, for ye are many; and call ye on the name of your god; but apply no fire.

fresh_translation: And they took the calf and prepared it, and they kept calling in the name of Baal from morning until midday and said, Answer us, O Baal, answer us. And there was no voice, and there was no hearing, and they ran about on the altar that they made.
brenton_translation: And they took the calf and drest it, and called on the name of Baal from morning till noon, and said, Hear us, O Baal, hear us. And there was no voice, neither was there hearing, and they ran up and down on the altar which they had made.

fresh_translation: And it came to be at midday, Elijah the Tishbite mocked them and said, Call with a loud voice, because he is god. Surely he has talk on his mind, or perhaps he is occupied, or perhaps he sleeps and will awaken.
brenton_translation: And it was noon, and Eliu the Thesbite mocked them, and said, Call with a loud voice, for he is a god; for he is meditating, or else perhaps he is engaged in business, or perhaps he is asleep, and is to be awaked.

fresh_translation: And they called with a loud voice and cut themselves according to their custom with swords and lances until blood poured out upon them.
brenton_translation: And they cried with a loud voice, and cut themselves according to their custom with knives and lancets until the blood gushed out upon them.

fresh_translation: And they prophesied until the evening passed, and it came to be at the time for the sacrifice to go up, and there was no voice. And Elijah the Tishbite spoke to the prophets of the abominations, saying, Stand aside now, and I will make my whole burnt offering. And they stood aside and went away.
brenton_translation: And they prophesied until the evening came; and it came to pass as it was the time of the offering of the sacrifice, that Eliu the Thesbite spoke to the prophets of the abominations, saying, Stand by for the present, and I will offer my sacrifice. And they stood aside and departed.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to the people, Come near to me. And all the people came near to him.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to the people, Come near to me. And all the people came near to him.

fresh_translation: And Elijah took twelve stones according to the number of the tribes of Israel, as the Lord spoke to him, saying, Israel shall be your name.
brenton_translation: And Eliu took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of Israel, as the Lord spoke to him, saying, Israel shall be thy name.

fresh_translation: And he built the stones in the name of the Lord and healed the torn-down altar and made a trench around the altar, able to hold two measures of seed.
brenton_translation: And he built up the stones in the name of the Lord, and repaired the altar that had been broken down; and he made a trench that would hold two measures of seed round about the altar.

fresh_translation: And he stacked the split wood upon the altar that he made and cut up the whole burnt offering and placed it upon the wood and stacked it upon the altar.
brenton_translation: And he piled the cleft wood on the altar which he had made, and divided the whole-burnt-offering, and laid it on the wood, and laid it in order on the altar, and said, Fetch me four pitchers of water, and pour it on the whole-burnt-offering, and on the wood. And they did so.

fresh_translation: And he said, Take for me four jars of water and pour it upon the whole burnt offering and upon the wood. And they did so. And he said, Do it a second time, and they did it a second time. And he said, Do it a third time, and they did it a third time.
brenton_translation: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.

fresh_translation: And the water kept going around the altar, and they filled the trench with water.
brenton_translation: And the water ran round about the altar, and they filled the trench with water.

fresh_translation: And Elijah cried out to heaven and said, Lord God of Abraham and Isaac and Israel, answer me, Lord, answer me today by fire, and let all this people know that you are Lord, God of Israel, and I am your servant, and because of you I have done these works.
brenton_translation: And Eliu cried aloud to heaven, and said, Lord God of Abraam, and Isaac, and Israel, answer me, O Lord, answer me this day by fire, and let all this people know that thou art the Lord, the God of Israel, and I am thy servant, and for thy sake I have wrought these works.

fresh_translation: Answer me, Lord, answer me by fire, and let this people know that you are the Lord, God, and you have turned back the heart of this people.
brenton_translation: Hear me, O Lord, hear me, and let this people know that thou art the Lord God, and thou hast turned back the heart of this people.

fresh_translation: And fire from the Lord fell from heaven and devoured the whole burnt offering and the split wood and the water in the trench, and the fire licked up the stones and the dust.
brenton_translation: Then fire fell from the Lord out of heaven, and devoured the whole-burnt-offerings, and the wood and the water that was in the trench, and the fire licked up the stones and the earth.

fresh_translation: And all the people fell on their faces and said, Truly the Lord, he is God, he is God.
brenton_translation: And all the people fell upon their faces, and said, Truly the Lord is God; he is God.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to the people, Seize the prophets of Baal. Let not one of them be saved. And they seized them, and Elijah brought them down to the wadi Kishon and slaughtered them there.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to the people, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them; and Eliu brings them down to the brook Kisson, and he slew them there.

fresh_translation: And Elijah said to Ahab, Go up, eat and drink, because there is a sound of the feet of rain.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said to Achaab, Go up, and eat and drink, for there is a sound of the coming of rain.

fresh_translation: And Ahab went up to eat and drink, and Elijah went up upon Carmel and bent to the ground and put his face between his knees.
brenton_translation: And Achaab went up to eat and to drink; and Eliu went up to Carmel, and stooped to the ground, and put his face between his knees,

fresh_translation: And he said to his servant-boy, Go up and look in the direction of the sea. And the servant-boy looked and said, There is nothing. And Elijah said, Then return seven times, and the servant-boy returned seven times.
brenton_translation: and said to his servant, Go up, and look toward the sea. And the servant looked, and said, There is nothing: and Eliu said, Do thou then go again seven times.

fresh_translation: And it came to be at the seventh time, behold, a little cloud like a man's footprint bringing up water, and he said, Go up and tell Ahab, Harness your chariot and go down, lest the rain overtake you.
brenton_translation: And the servant went again seven times: and it came to pass at the seventh time, that, behold, a little cloud like the sole of a man's foot brought water; and he said, Go up, and say to Achaab, Make ready thy chariot, and go down, lest the rain overtake thee.

fresh_translation: And it came to be here and there, and the sky grew dark with clouds and wind, and a great rain came, and Ahab wept and went to Jezreel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the meanwhile, that the heaven grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Achaab wept, and went to Jezrael.

fresh_translation: And the hand of the Lord was upon Elijah, and he girded up his waist and ran before Ahab as far as Jezreel.
brenton_translation: And the hand of the Lord was upon Eliu, and he girt up his loins, and ran before Achaab to Jezrael.

fresh_translation: And Ahab reported to Jezebel his wife all that Elijah did and how he killed the prophets with the sword.
brenton_translation: And Achaab told Jezabel his wife all that Eliu had done, and how he had slain the prophets with the sword.

fresh_translation: And Jezebel sent to Elijah and said, If you are Elijah and I am Jezebel, may God do thus to me and add thus, because by this time tomorrow I will make your life like the life of one of them.
brenton_translation: And Jezabel sent to Eliu, and said, If thou art Eliu and I am Jezabel, God do so to me, and more also, if I do not make thy life by this time to-morrow as the life of one of them.

fresh_translation: And Elijah feared and rose and went for his own life, and he came to Beersheba of Judah and left his servant-boy there.
brenton_translation: And Eliu feared, and rose, and departed for his life: and he comes to Bersabee to the land of Juda, and he left his servant there.

fresh_translation: And he himself went in the wilderness a day's road and came and sat under one broom plant, and he asked for his life to die and said, Let it be enough now. Take away my life from me, Lord, because I am no better than my fathers.
brenton_translation: And he himself went a day's journey in the wilderness, and came and sat under a juniper tree; and asked concerning his life that he might die, and said, Let it be enough now, O Lord, take, I pray thee, my life from me; for I am no better than my fathers.

fresh_translation: And he lay down and slept there under a plant, and behold, someone touched him and said to him, Rise and eat.
brenton_translation: And he lay down and slept there under a tree; and behold, some one touched him, and said to him, Arise and eat.

fresh_translation: And Elijah looked, and behold, at his head was a barley cake and a jug of water. And he rose and ate and drank and turned back and slept.
brenton_translation: And Eliu looked, and, behold, at his head there was a cake of meal and a cruse of water; and he arose, and ate and drank, and returned and lay down.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord returned a second time and touched him and said to him, Rise, eat, because the road is too much for you.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord returned again, and touched him, and said to him, Arise, and eat, for the journey is far from thee.

fresh_translation: And he rose and ate and drank and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights as far as Mount Horeb.
brenton_translation: And he arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights to mount Choreb.

fresh_translation: And he entered there into the cave and lodged there. And behold, the word of the Lord came to him and said, What are you doing here, Elijah?
brenton_translation: And he entered there into a cave, and rested there; and, behold, the word of the Lord came to him, and he said, What doest thou here, Eliu?

fresh_translation: And Elijah said, In zeal I have been very zealous for the Lord Almighty, because the sons of Israel forsook you, they tore down your altars, and they killed your prophets with the sword, and I alone am left, utterly alone, and they seek my life to take it.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said, I have been very jealous for the Lord Almighty, because the children of Israel have forsaken thee: they have digged down thine altars, and have slain thy prophets with the sword; and I only am left alone, and they seek my life to take it.

fresh_translation: And he said, You will go out tomorrow and stand before the Lord on the mountain. Behold, the Lord will pass by, and a great strong wind, dissolving mountains and crushing rocks before the Lord. The Lord was not in the wind. And after the wind, an earthquake. The Lord was not in the earthquake.
brenton_translation: And he said, Thou shalt go forth to-morrow, and shalt stand before the Lord in the mount; behold, the Lord will pass by. And, behold, a great and strong wind rending the mountains, and crushing the rocks before the Lord; but the Lord was not in the wind; and after the wind an earthquake; but the Lord was not in the earthquake:

fresh_translation: And after the earthquake, fire. The Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire, a voice of a thin breeze, and there the Lord.
brenton_translation: and after the earthquake a fire; but the Lord was not in the fire: and after the fire the voice of a gentle breeze.

fresh_translation: And it came to be as Elijah heard, he covered his face with his sheepskin cloak and went out and stood under the cave. And behold, a voice came to him and said, What are you doing here, Elijah?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Eliu heard, that he wrapt his face in his mantle, and went forth and stood in the cave: and, behold, a voice came to him and said, What doest thou here, Eliu?

fresh_translation: And Elijah said, In zeal I have been very zealous for the Lord Almighty, because the sons of Israel forsook your covenant, they pulled down your altars, and they killed your prophets with the sword, and I alone am left, utterly alone, and they seek my life to take it.
brenton_translation: And Eliu said, I have been very jealous for the Lord Almighty; for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, and they have overthrown thine altars, and have slain thy prophets with the sword! and I am left entirely alone, and they seek my life to take it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to him, Go, return on your way, and you will come to the wilderness road of Damascus, and you will anoint Hazael king of Syria.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to him, Go, return, and thou shalt come into the way of the wilderness of Damascus: and thou shalt go and anoint Azael to be king over Syria.

fresh_translation: And Jehu son of Nimshi you will anoint king over Israel, and Elisha son of Shaphat from Abelmeholah you will anoint prophet in your place.
brenton_translation: And Ju the son of Namessi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel; and Elisaie the son of Saphat shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, the one escaping from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will put to death, and the one escaping from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will put to death.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapes from the sword of Azael, Ju shall slay; and him that escapes from the sword of Ju, Elisaie shall slay.

fresh_translation: And you will leave in Israel seven thousand men, every knee that did not bend knee to Baal and every mouth that did not bow to him.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt leave in Israel seven thousand men, all the knees which had not bowed themselves to Baal, and every mouth which had not worshipped him.

fresh_translation: And he went away from there and found Elisha son of Shaphat, and he was plowing with twelve pairs of oxen before him, and he himself was with the twelve, and Elijah came upon him and threw his sheepskin cloak upon him.
brenton_translation: And he departed thence, and finds Elisaie the son of Saphat, and he was ploughing with oxen; there were twelve yoke before him, and he with the twelve, and he passed by to him, and cast his mantle upon him.

fresh_translation: And Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah and said, Let me kiss my father, and I will follow after you. And Elijah said, Return, because what have I done to you?
brenton_translation: And Elisaie left the cattle, and ran after Eliu and said, I will kiss my father, and follow after thee. And Eliu said, Return, for I have done a work for thee.

fresh_translation: And he turned back from after him and took the pairs of oxen and sacrificed and boiled them with the gear of the oxen and gave them to the people, and they ate. And he rose and went after Elijah and ministered to him.
brenton_translation: And he returned from following him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled them with the instruments of the oxen, and gave to the people, and they ate: and he arose, and went after Eliu, and ministered to him.

fresh_translation: And one vineyard belonged to Naboth the Jezreelite beside the threshing floor of Ahab king of Samaria.
brenton_translation: And Nabuthai the Jezraelite had a vineyard, near the threshingfloor of Achaab king of Samaria.

fresh_translation: And Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, Give me your vineyard, and it shall be for me as a garden of vegetables because it is near to my house, and I will give you another vineyard, better than it. But if it pleases before you, I will give you silver, the exchange-price of this vineyard, and it shall be for me as a garden of vegetables.
brenton_translation: And Achaab spoke to Nabuthai, saying, Give me thy vineyard, and I will have it for a garden of herbs, for it is near my house: and I will give thee another vineyard better than it; or if it please thee, I will give thee money, the price of this thy vineyard, and I will have it for a garden of herbs.

fresh_translation: And Naboth said to Ahab, May it not be for me from my God to give the inheritance of my fathers to you.
brenton_translation: And Nabuthai said to Achaab, My God forbid me that I should give thee the inheritance of my fathers.

fresh_translation: And Ahab's spirit became troubled, and he lay upon his bed and covered his face and did not eat bread.
brenton_translation: And the spirit of Achaab was troubled, and he lay down upon his bed, and covered his face, and ate no bread.

fresh_translation: And Jezebel his wife came in to him and spoke to him, Why is your spirit troubled and you are not eating bread?
brenton_translation: And Jezabel his wife went in to him, and spoke to him, saying, Why is thy spirit troubled, and why dost thou eat no bread?

fresh_translation: And he said to her, Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, saying, Give me your vineyard for silver, and if you wish, I will give you another vineyard in place of it, and he said, I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.
brenton_translation: And he said to her, Because I spoke to Nabuthai the Jezraelite, saying, Give me thy vineyard for money; or if thou wilt, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers.

fresh_translation: And Jezebel his wife said to him, Do you now act as king over Israel? Rise, eat bread, and become your own man. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
brenton_translation: And Jezabel his wife said to him, Dost thou now thus act the king over Israel? arise, and eat bread, and be thine own master, and I will give thee the vineyard of Nabuthai the Jezraelite.

fresh_translation: And she wrote a letter in the name of Ahab and sealed it with his seal and sent the letter to the elders and the free men living with Naboth.
brenton_translation: And she wrote a letter in the name of Achaab, and sealed it with his seal, and sent the letter to the elders, and to the freemen who dwelt with Nabuthai.

fresh_translation: And it was written in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast and seat Naboth at the head of the people.
brenton_translation: And it was written in the letters, saying, Keep a fast, and set Naboth in a chief place among the people.

fresh_translation: And seat two men, sons of lawlessness, opposite him, and let them testify against him, saying, He blessed God and the king. And let them bring him out and stone him, and let him die.
brenton_translation: And set two men, sons of transgressors, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, He blessed God and the king: and let them lead him forth, and stone him, and let him die.

fresh_translation: And the men of his city, the elders and the free men dwelling in his city, did just as Jezebel sent to them, just as it was written in the letters that she sent to them.
brenton_translation: And the men of his city, the elders, and the nobles who dwelt in his city, did as Jezabel sent to them, and as it had been written in the letters which she sent to them.

fresh_translation: They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth at the head of the people.
brenton_translation: And they proclaimed a fast, and set Nabuthai in a chief place among the people.

fresh_translation: And two men, sons of lawlessness, came and sat opposite him and testified against him, saying, You blessed God and the king. And they brought him out outside the city and stoned him with stones, and he died.
brenton_translation: And two men, sons of transgressors, came in, and sat opposite him, and bore witness against him, saying, Thou hast blessed God and the king. And they led him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, and he died.

fresh_translation: And they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth has been stoned and is dead.
brenton_translation: And they sent to Jezabel, saying, Nabuthai is stoned, and is dead.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Jezebel heard, she said to Ahab, Rise, inherit the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, who did not give it to you for silver, because Naboth is not alive; he is dead.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when Jezabel heard it, that she said to Achaab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Nabuthai the Jezraelite, who would not sell it to thee: for Nabuthai is not alive, for he is dead.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Ahab heard that Naboth the Jezreelite was dead, he tore his garments and put on sackcloth, and after these things Ahab rose and went down into the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite to inherit it.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when Achaab heard that Nabuthai the Jezraelite was dead, that he rent his garments, and put on sackcloth. And it came to pass afterward, that Achaab arose and went down to the vineyard of Nabuthai the Jezraelite, to take possession of it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Eliu the Thesbite, saying,

fresh_translation: Rise and go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, the one in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth because he has gone down there to inherit it.
brenton_translation: Arise, and go down to meet Achaab king of Israel, who is in Samaria, for he is in the vineyard of Nabuthai, for he has gone down thither to take possession of it.

fresh_translation: And you will speak to him, saying, Thus says the Lord: As you murdered and inherited, because of this thus says the Lord: In every place where the sows and the dogs licked the blood of Naboth, there the dogs will lick your blood, and the prostitutes will wash in your blood.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt speak to him, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Forasmuch as thou hast slain and taken possession, therefore thus saith the Lord, In every place where the swine and the dogs have licked the blood of Nabuthai, there shall the dogs lick thy blood; and the harlots shall wash themselves in thy blood.

fresh_translation: And Ahab said to Elijah, Have you found me, my enemy? And he said, I have found you, because you have vainly sold yourself to do evil before the Lord, provoking him.
brenton_translation: And Achaab said to Eliu, Hast thou found me, mine enemy? and he said, I have found thee: because thou hast wickedly sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger;

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing evils upon you and will burn after you and destroy from Ahab one pissing against a wall, hemmed in and forsaken in Israel.
brenton_translation: behold, I bring evil upon thee: and I will kindle a fire after thee, and I will utterly destroy every male of Achaab, and him that is shut up and him that is left in Israel.

fresh_translation: And I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah, because of the provocations by which you provoked and made Israel sin.
brenton_translation: And I will make thy house as the house of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, and as the house of Baasa son of Achia, because of the provocations wherewith thou hast provoked me, and caused Israel to sin.

fresh_translation: And concerning Jezebel the Lord spoke, saying, Dogs will eat her in the forewall of Jezreel.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke of Jezabel, saying, The dogs shall devour her within the fortification of Jezrael.

fresh_translation: The dead one of Ahab in the city, dogs will eat, and the dead one of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.
brenton_translation: Him that is dead of Achaab in the city shall the dogs eat, and him that is dead of him in the field shall the birds of the sky eat.

fresh_translation: Yet vainly Ahab sold himself to do evil before the Lord, because Jezebel his wife turned him aside.
brenton_translation: But Achaab did wickedly, in that he sold himself to do that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his wife Jezabel led him astray.

fresh_translation: And he was greatly abominated by going after abominations, according to all that the Amorite did, whom the Lord destroyed from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he did very abominably in following after the abominations, according to all that the Amorite did, whom the Lord utterly destroyed from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And because of the word, as Ahab was cut to the heart before the Lord and went weeping, he tore his tunic and girded sackcloth upon his body and fasted and put on sackcloth on the day when he struck Naboth the Jezreelite.
brenton_translation: And because of the word, Achaab was pierced with sorrow before the Lord, and he both went weeping, and rent his garment, and girt sackcloth upon his body, and fasted; he put on sackcloth also in the day that he smote Nabuthai the Jezraelite, and went his way.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came by the hand of his servant Elijah concerning Ahab, and the Lord said,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came by the hand of his servant Eliu concerning Achaab, and the Lord said,

fresh_translation: Have you seen how Ahab was cut to the heart before me? I will not bring the evil in his days, but in the days of his son I will bring the evil.
brenton_translation: Hast thou seen how Achaab has been pricked to the heart before me? I will not bring on the evil in his days, but in his son's days will I bring on the evil.

fresh_translation: And Ben-hadad gathered all his force and went up and besieged Samaria, and thirty-two kings with him and all horse and chariot, and they went up and besieged Samaria and fought against it.
brenton_translation: And the son of Ader gathered all his forces, and went up and besieged Samaria, he and thirty-two kings with him, and all his horse and chariots: and they went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.

fresh_translation: And he sent to Ahab king of Israel into the city.
brenton_translation: And he sent into the city to Achaab king of Israel, and said to him, Thus says the son of Ader,

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Thus says Ben-hadad: Your silver and your gold are mine, and your wives and your children are mine.
brenton_translation: Thy silver and thy gold are mine, and thy wives and thy children are mine.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel answered and said, According as you spoke, my lord king, I am yours and all that is mine.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel answered and said, As thou hast said, my lord, O king, I am thine, and all mine also.

fresh_translation: And the messengers returned and said, Thus says Ben-hadad: I sent to you, saying, Your silver and your gold and your wives and your children you will give to me.
brenton_translation: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus says the son of Ader, I sent to thee, saying, Thou shalt give me thy silver and thy gold, and thy wives and thy children.

fresh_translation: For by this time tomorrow I will send my servants to you, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants, and whatever is the desire of their eyes, upon it they will lay their hands and take it.
brenton_translation: For at this time to-morrow I will send my servants to thee, and they shall search thy house, and the houses of thy servants, and it shall be that all the desirable objects of their eyes on which they shall lay their hands, they shall even take them.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel called all the elders and said, Know now and see that this one is seeking evil, because he sent to me concerning my wives and my sons and my daughters. My silver and my gold I did not withhold from him.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Take notice now and consider, that this man seeks mischief: for he has sent to me concerning my wives, and concerning my sons, and concerning my daughters: I have not kept back from him my silver and my gold.

fresh_translation: And the elders and all the people said to him, Do not listen and do not be willing.
brenton_translation: And the elders and all the people said to him, Hearken not, and consent not.

fresh_translation: And he said to the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell your lord, All that you sent to your servant at first I will do, but this thing I cannot do. And the men departed and returned a word to him.
brenton_translation: And he said to the messengers of the son of Ader, Say to your master, All things that thou hast sent to thy servant about at first I will do; but this thing I shall not be able to do. And the men departed, and carried back the answer to him.

fresh_translation: And Ben-hadad sent back to him, saying, Thus may God do to me and thus add, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for foxes, for all my footmen.
brenton_translation: And the son of Ader sent to him, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for foxes to all the people, even my infantry.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel answered and said, Let it be enough. Let not the bent one boast like the upright one.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel answered and said, Let it be sufficient; let not the humpbacked boast as he that is upright.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when he answered him this word, he himself was drinking, and all the kings with him, in tents, and he said to his servants, Build a palisade, and they set a palisade against the city.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when he returned him this answer, he and all the kings with him were drinking in tents: and he said to his servants, Form a trench. And they made a trench against the city.

fresh_translation: And behold, one prophet came near to the king of Israel and said, Thus says the Lord: Have you seen all this great crowd? Behold, I am giving it today into your hands, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And, behold, a prophet came to Achaab king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the Lord, Hast thou seen this great multitude? behold, I give it this day into thine hands; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus says the Lord: By the servant-boys of the rulers of the regions. And Ahab said, Who will join the battle? And he said, You.
brenton_translation: And Achaab said, Whereby? And he said, Thus saith the Lord, By the young men of the heads of the districts. And Achaab said, Who shall begin the battle? and he said, Thou.

fresh_translation: And Ahab reviewed the servant-boys of the rulers of the regions, and they were two hundred thirty, and after these he reviewed the people, every son of strength, sixty thousand.
brenton_translation: And Achaab numbered the young men the heads of the districts, and they were two hundred and thirty: and afterwards he numbered the people, even every man fit for war, seven thousand.

fresh_translation: And they went out at midday, and Ben-hadad was drinking himself drunk in Socchoth, he and the thirty-two kings, helpers with him.
brenton_translation: And he went forth at noon, and the son of Ader was drinking and getting drunk in Socchoth, he and the kings, even thirty and two kings, his allies.

fresh_translation: And the servant-boys of the rulers of the regions went out first, and they sent and reported to the king of Syria, saying, Men have come out from Samaria.
