brenton_translation: And as for thy sons which shall come forth of thee, which thou shalt beget, the enemy shall take them, and they shall be eunuchs in the house of the king of Babylon.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which you spoke. Let there be peace in my days.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias said to Esaias, Good is the word of the Lord which he has spoken: only let there be peace in my days.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Hezekiah and all his might and what he did, the spring and the conduit, and how he brought the water into the city, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Ezekias, and all his might, and all that he made, the fountain and the aqueduct, and how he brought water into the city, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of David, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias slept with his fathers: and Manasses his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Hephzibah.
brenton_translation: Manasses was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Apsiba.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord according to the abominations of the nations whom the Lord drove out from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord, according to the abominations of the nations which the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he turned back and rebuilt the high places which Hezekiah his father tore down and raised up an altar to Baal and made groves, as Ahab king of Israel did, and bowed down to all the host of heaven and served them.
brenton_translation: And he built again the high places, which Ezekias his father had demolished; and set up an altar to Baal, and made groves as Achaab king of Israel made them; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

fresh_translation: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which he said, In Jerusalem I will put my name.
brenton_translation: And he built an altar in the house of the Lord, whereas he had said, In Jerusalem I will place my name.

fresh_translation: And he built altars to all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he built an altar to all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he made his sons pass through fire and practiced divination and omens and made spirit-mediums and knowers. He multiplied to do evil in the eyes of the Lord, to provoke him.
brenton_translation: And he caused his sons to pass through the fire, and used divination and auspices, and made groves, and multiplied wizards, so as to do that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.

fresh_translation: And he set the carved image of the grove in the house, of which the Lord said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house and in Jerusalem, which I chose from all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name there forever.
brenton_translation: And he set up the graven image of the grove in the house of which the Lord said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, will I even place my name for ever.

fresh_translation: And I will not again add to shake the foot of Israel from the land which I gave to their fathers, if only they keep all that I commanded, according to all the commandment which my servant Moses commanded them.
brenton_translation: And I will not again remove the foot of Israel from the land which I gave to their fathers, even of those who shall keep all that I commanded, according to all the commandments which my servant Moses commanded them.

fresh_translation: And they did not listen, and Manasseh led them astray to do evil in the eyes of the Lord beyond the nations which the Lord destroyed from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: But they hearkened not; and Manasses led them astray to do evil in the sight of the Lord, beyond the nations whom the Lord utterly destroyed from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke by the hand of his servants the prophets, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,

fresh_translation: Because Manasseh king of Judah did these evil abominations, beyond all that the Amorite who was before him did, and even caused Judah to sin with their idols,
brenton_translation: Forasmuch as Manasses the king of Juda has wrought all these evil abominations, beyond all that the Amorite did, who lived before him, and has led Juda also into sin by their idols,

fresh_translation: not so. Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Behold, I am bringing evils on Jerusalem and on Judah, so that whoever hears, both his ears will ring.
brenton_translation: it shall not be so. Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Behold, I bring calamities upon Jerusalem and Juda, so that both the ears of every one that hears shall tingle.

fresh_translation: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the measure of Samaria and the plummet of the house of Ahab, and I will wipe Jerusalem as an alabaster vessel is wiped, being wiped and turned on its face.
brenton_translation: And I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measure of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Achaab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a jar is wiped, and turned upside down in the wiping.

fresh_translation: And I will push away the remnant of my inheritance and give them into the hands of their enemies, and they will become plunder and spoil to all their enemies,
brenton_translation: And I will reject the remnant of my inheritance, and will deliver them into the hands of their enemies; and they shall be for a plunder and for a spoil to all their enemies:

fresh_translation: because they did evil in my eyes and were provoking me from the day I brought out their fathers from Egypt until this day.
brenton_translation: forasmuch as they have done wickedly in my sight, and have provoked me from the day that I brought out their fathers out of Egypt, even until this day.

fresh_translation: And Manasseh also poured out very much innocent blood until he filled Jerusalem from mouth to mouth, besides his sins with which he made Judah sin by doing evil in the eyes of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Moreover Manasses shed very much innocent blood, until he filled Jerusalem with it from one end to the other, beside his sins with which he caused Juda to sin, in doing evil in the eyes of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Manasseh and all that he did and the sin which he sinned, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Manasses, and all that he did, and his sin which he sinned, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And Manasseh slept with his fathers and was buried in the garden of his house, in the garden of Uzza, and Amon his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Manasses slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his house, even in the garden of Oza: and Amos his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz from Jotbah.
brenton_translation: Twenty and two years old was Amos when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Mesollam, daughter of Arus of Jeteba.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as Manasseh his father did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as Manasses his father did.

fresh_translation: And he walked in every way in which his father walked and served the idols which his father served and bowed down to them.
brenton_translation: And he walked in all the way in which his father walked, and served the idols which his father served, and worshipped them.

fresh_translation: And he abandoned the Lord God of his fathers and did not walk in the way of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he forsook the Lord God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the servants of Amon conspired against him and put the king to death in his house.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Amos conspired against him, and slew the king in his house.

fresh_translation: And all the people of the land struck down all those conspiring against King Amon, and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
brenton_translation: And the people of the land slew all that had conspired against king Amos; and the people of the land made Josias his son king in his room.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Amon, what he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Amos, even all that he did, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And they buried him in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And they buried him in his tomb in the garden of Oza: and Josias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah from Boscath.
brenton_translation: Josias was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jedia, daughter of Edeia of Basuroth.

fresh_translation: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and walked in every way of David his father. He did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in all the way of David his father; he turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, in the eighth month, the king sent Shaphan son of Azaliah son of Meshullam, the scribe of the house of the Lord, saying,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josias, in the eighth month, the king sent Sapphan the son of Ezelias the son of Mesollam, the scribe of the house of the Lord, saying,

fresh_translation: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and seal the silver brought into the house of the Lord, which the keepers of the threshold gathered from the people.
brenton_translation: Go up to Chelcias the high priest, and take account of the money that is brought into the house of the Lord, which they that keep the door have collected of the people.

fresh_translation: And let them give it into the hand of those doing the works, those appointed in the house of the Lord. And he gave it to those doing the works, those in the house of the Lord, to strengthen the breach of the house,
brenton_translation: And let them give it into the hand of the workmen that are appointed in the house of the Lord. And he gave it to the workmen in the house of the Lord, to repair the breaches of the house,

fresh_translation: to the carpenters and the builders and the masons, and to buy timber and quarried stones to strengthen the breach of the house.
brenton_translation: even to the carpenters, and builders, and masons, and also to purchase timber and hewn stones, to repair the breaches of the house.

fresh_translation: Only, they did not reckon with them the silver being given to them, because they act in faithfulness.
brenton_translation: Only they did not call them to account for the money that was given to them, because they dealt faithfully.

fresh_translation: And Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, I found a book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
brenton_translation: And Chelcias the high priest said to Sapphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Chelcias gave the book to Sapphan, and he read it.

fresh_translation: And Shaphan brought it to King Josiah and brought word back to the king and said, Your servants poured out the silver found in the house of the Lord and gave it into the hand of those doing the works, those appointed in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he went into the house of the Lord to the king, and reported the matter to the king, and said, Thy servants have collected the money that was found in the house of the Lord, and have given it into the hand of the workmen that are appointed in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Shaphan the scribe said to the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest gave me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
brenton_translation: And Sapphan the scribe spoke to the king, saying, Chelcias the priest has given me a book. And Sapphan read it before the king.

fresh_translation: And it came to be, when the king heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his garments.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his garments.

fresh_translation: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest and Ahikam son of Shaphan and Achbor son of Michaiah and Shaphan the scribe and Asaiah servant of the king, saying,
brenton_translation: And the king commanded Chelcias the priest, and Achikam the son of Sapphan, and Achobor the son of Michaias, and Sapphan the scribe, and Asaias the king's servant, saying,

fresh_translation: Go, seek the Lord concerning me and concerning all the people and concerning all Judah, concerning the words of this book that was found, because great is the anger of the Lord, which burns in us, because our fathers did not listen to all the words of this book to do according to all written for us.
brenton_translation: Go, enquire of the Lord for me, and for all the people, and for all Juda, and concerning the words of this book that has been found: for the wrath of the Lord that has been kindled against us is great, because our fathers hearkened not to the words of this book, to do according to all the things written concerning us.

fresh_translation: And Hilkiah the priest and Ahikam and Achbor and Shaphan and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, wife of Hillel son of Tikvah son of Harhas keeper of the wardrobe, and she dwelt in Jerusalem in the Maseña, and they spoke to her.
brenton_translation: So Chelcias the priest went, and Achicam, and Achobor, and Sapphan, and Asaias, to Olda the prophetess, the mother of Sellem the son of Thecuan son of Aras, keeper of the robes; and she dwelt in Jerusalem in Masena; and they spoke to her.

fresh_translation: And she said to them, Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Say to the man who sent you to me,
brenton_translation: And she said to them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Say to the man that sent you to me,

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing evils upon this place and upon those dwelling in it, all the words of the book which the king of Judah read,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I bring evil upon this place, and upon them that dwell in it, even all the words of the book which the king of Juda has read:

fresh_translation: because they abandoned me and burned incense to other gods, so as to provoke me in all the works of their hands, and my wrath will burn in this place and will not be quenched.
brenton_translation: because they have forsaken me, and burnt incense to other gods, that they might provoke me with the works of their hands: therefore my wrath shall burn forth against this place, and shall not be quenched.

fresh_translation: And to the king of Judah who sent you to seek the Lord, thus you shall say to him: Thus says the Lord God of Israel concerning the words which you heard:
brenton_translation: And to the king of Juda that sent you to enquire of the Lord,—thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, As for the words which thou hast heard;

fresh_translation: Because your heart was softened and you were ashamed from before the Lord when you heard what I spoke against this place and against those dwelling in it, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and you tore your garments and wept before me, I also heard, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: because thy heart was softened, and thou wast humbled before me, when thou heardest all that I spoke against this place, and against the inhabitants of it, that it should be utterly destroyed and accursed, and thou didst rend thy garments, and weep before me; I also have heard, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Not so. Behold, I am adding you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your tomb in peace, and your eyes will not see among all the evils that I am bringing upon this place. And they returned word to the king.
brenton_translation: It shall not be so therefore: behold, I will add thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy tomb in peace, and thine eyes shall not see any among all the evils which I bring upon this place.

fresh_translation: And the king sent and gathered to himself all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: So they reported the word to the king: and the king sent and gathered all the elders of Juda and Jerusalem to himself.

fresh_translation: And the king went up to the house of the Lord, and every man of Judah and all those dwelling in Jerusalem with him, and the priests and the prophets and all the people from small to great. And he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant found in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the king went up to the house of the Lord, and every man of Juda and all who dwelt in Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people small and great; and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his ordinances with all his heart and with all his soul, to establish the words of this covenant written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
brenton_translation: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his ordinances with all the heart and with all the soul, to confirm the words of this covenant; even the things written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

fresh_translation: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest and the priests of the second order and the keepers of the threshold to bring out from the temple of the Lord all the vessels made for Baal and for the grove and for all the force of heaven, and he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron and carried their dust to Bethel.
brenton_translation: And the king commanded Chelcias the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and them that kept the door, to bring out of the temple of the Lord all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and all the host of heaven, and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kedron, and took the ashes of them to Bæthel.

fresh_translation: And he put an end to the idol-priests whom the kings of Judah appointed and who were burning incense in the high places and in the cities of Judah and around Jerusalem, and those burning incense to Baal and to the sun and to the moon and to the Mazouroth and to all the force of heaven.
brenton_translation: And he burned the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Juda had appointed, (and they burned incense in the high places and in the cities of Juda, and the places round about Jerusalem); and them that burned incense to Baal, and to the sun, and to the moon, and to Mazuroth, and to all the host of heaven.

fresh_translation: And he brought the grove out from the house of the Lord, outside Jerusalem to the wadi Kidron, and burned it in the wadi Kidron and beat it small to dust and threw its dust on the tombs of the sons of the people.
brenton_translation: And he carried out the grove from the house of the Lord to the brook Kedron, and burned it at the brook Kedron, and reduced it to powder, and cast its powder on the sepulchres of the sons of the people.

fresh_translation: And he tore down the houses of the consecrated ones which were in the house of the Lord, where the women were weaving hangings for the grove.
brenton_translation: And he pulled down the house of the sodomites that were by the house of the Lord, where the women wove tents for the grove.

fresh_translation: And he brought all the priests from the cities of Judah and defiled the high places where the priests burned incense, from Gibeah to Beersheba, and he tore down the house of the gates by the entrance of the gate of Joshua governor of the city, those on the left at the gate of the city.
brenton_translation: And he brought up all the priests from the cities of Juda, and defiled the high places where the priests burned incense, from Gæbal even to Bersabee; and he pulled down the house of the gates that was by the door of the gate of Joshua the ruler of the city, on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.

fresh_translation: Only, the priests of the high places did not go up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, except they ate unleavened bread in the midst of their brothers.
brenton_translation: Only the priests of the high places went not up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, for they only ate leavened bread in the midst of their brethren.

fresh_translation: And he defiled Topheth in the valley of the son of Hinnom, so as not to make a man bring his son or a man bring his daughter through fire to Moloch.
brenton_translation: And he defiled Tapheth which is in the valley of the son of Ennom, constructed for a man to cause his son or his daughter to pass through fire to Moloch.

fresh_translation: And he put an end to the horses which the kings of Judah gave to the sun at the entrance of the house of the Lord, in the treasury of Nathan the king's eunuch in the suburbs, and the chariot of the sun he burned with fire.
brenton_translation: And he burned the horses which the kings of Juda had given to the sun in the entrance of the house of the Lord, by the treasury of Nathan the king's eunuch, in the suburbs; and he burned the chariot of the sun with fire.

fresh_translation: And the altars on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah made, and the altars which Manasseh made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, the king tore down and broke up there and threw their dust into the wadi Kidron.
brenton_translation: And the altars that were on the roof of the upper chamber of Achaz, which the kings of Juda had made, and the altars which Manasses had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, did the king pull down and forcibly remove from thence, and cast their dust into the brook of Kedron.

fresh_translation: And the house that was before Jerusalem, to the right of the mount of Mosoath, which Solomon king of Israel built to Ashtoreth, abomination of the Sidonians, and to Chemosh, abomination of Moab, and to Molochol, abomination of the sons of Ammon, the king defiled.
brenton_translation: And the king defiled the house that was before Jerusalem, on the right hand of the mount of Mosthath, which Solomon king of Israel built to Astarte the abomination of the Sidonians, and to Chamos the abomination of Moab, and to Moloch the abomination of the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And he crushed the pillars and destroyed the groves and filled their places with human bones.
brenton_translation: And he broke in pieces the pillars, and utterly destroyed the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

fresh_translation: And indeed the altar in Bethel, the high place which Jeroboam son of Nebat made, who made Israel sin, indeed that altar and the high place he tore down and crushed its stones and beat them small to dust and burned the grove.
brenton_translation: Also the high altar in Bæthel, which Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that high altar he tore down, and broke in pieces the stones of it, and reduced it to powder, and burnt the grove.

fresh_translation: And Josiah turned and saw the tombs there in the city, and he sent and took the bones from the tombs and burned them upon the altar and defiled it, according to the word of the Lord which the man of God spoke.
brenton_translation: And Josias turned aside, and saw the tombs that were there in the city, and sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burnt them on the altar, and defiled it, according to the word of the Lord which the man of God spoke, when Jeroboam stood by the altar at the feast: and he turned and raised his eyes to the tomb of the man of God that spoke these words.

fresh_translation: And he said, What is that marker which I see? And the men of the city said to him, It is the man of God who came out from Judah and called out these words which he called out against the altar of Bethel.
brenton_translation: And he said, What is that mound which I see? And the men of the city said to him, It is the grave of the man of God that came out of Juda, and uttered these imprecations which he imprecated upon the altar of Bæthel.

fresh_translation: And he said, Leave him. Let no man move his bones. And they preserved his bones with the bones of the prophet who came out from Samaria.
brenton_translation: And he said, Let him alone; let no one disturb his bones. So his bones were spared, together with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

fresh_translation: And also all the houses of the high places which were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel made to provoke the Lord, Josiah removed and did to them according to all the deeds that he did in Bethel.
brenton_translation: Moreover Josias removed all the houses of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel made to provoke the Lord, and did to them all that he did in Bæthel.

fresh_translation: And he sacrificed all the priests of the high places who were there upon the altars and burned the bones of humans upon them and returned to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And he sacrificed all the priests of the high places that were there on the altars, and burnt the bones of men upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the Passover to the Lord our God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.
brenton_translation: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover to the Lord your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.

fresh_translation: Because this Passover was not held from the days of the judges who judged Israel and all the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah,
brenton_translation: For a passover such as this had not been kept from the days of the judges who judged Israel, even all the days of the kings of Israel, and of the kings of Juda.

fresh_translation: except in the eighteenth year of King Josiah this Passover was held to the Lord in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: But in the eighteenth year of king Josias, was the passover kept to the Lord in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And indeed the spirit-mediums and the knowers and the theraphin and the idols and all the abominations that had appeared in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem King Josiah removed, to establish the words of the law written upon the book which Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Moreover Josias removed the sorcerers, and the wizards, and the theraphin, and the idols, and all the abominations that had been set up in the land of Juda and in Jerusalem, that he might keep the words of the law that were written in the book, which Chelcias the priest found in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Like him there was no king before him who turned to the Lord with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength according to all the law of Moses, and after him none like him arose.
brenton_translation: There was no king like him before him, who turned to the Lord with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his strength, according to all the law of Moses; and after him there rose not one like him.

fresh_translation: Only, the Lord did not turn away from the fury of his great anger, with which his anger burned in Judah, because of the provocations with which Manasseh provoked him.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless the Lord turned not from the fierceness of his great anger, wherewith he was wroth in his anger against Juda, because of the provocations, wherewith Manasses provoked him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, Also Judah I will remove from before my face, as I removed Israel, and I will reject this city which I chose, Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, My name will be there.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, I will also remove Juda from my presence, as I removed Israel, and will reject this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Josiah and all that he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Josias, and all that he did, are not these things written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And in his days Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt went up against the king of the Assyrians by the river Euphrates, and Josiah went to meet him, and Necho put him to death in Megiddo when he saw him.
brenton_translation: And in his days went up Pharao Nechao king of Egypt against the king of the Assyrians to the river Euphrates: and Josias went out to meet him: and Nechao slew him in Mageddo when he saw him.

fresh_translation: And his servants set him on the chariot, dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem and buried him in his tomb in the city of David. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father.
brenton_translation: And his servants carried him dead from Mageddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre: and the people of the land took Joachaz the son of Josias, and anointed him, and made him king in the room of his father.

fresh_translation: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
brenton_translation: Twenty and three years old was Joachaz when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Amital, daughter of Jeremias of Lobna.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord according to all that his fathers did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers did.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh Necho removed him in Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he should not reign in Jerusalem, and he imposed a penalty on the land of a hundred talents of silver and a hundred talents of gold.
brenton_translation: And Pharao Nechao removed him to Rablaam in the land of Emath, so that he should not reign in Jerusalem; and imposed a tribute on the land, a hundred talents of silver, and a hundred talents of gold.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh Necho made Eliakim son of Josiah king of Judah king in place of Josiah his father, and he changed his name to Joakim, and he took Jehoahaz and brought him into Egypt, and he died there.
brenton_translation: And Pharao Nechao made Eliakim son of Josias king of Juda king over them in the place of his father Josias, and he changed his name to Joakim, and he took Joachaz and brought him to Egypt, and he died there.

fresh_translation: And Joakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh, but he assessed the land to give the silver according to the mouth of Pharaoh. Each man according to his valuation they gave the silver and the gold with the people of the land, to give to Pharaoh Necho.
brenton_translation: And Joakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharao; but he assessed the land to give the money at the command of Pharao: they gave the silver and the gold each man according to his assessment together with the people of the land to give to Pharao Nechao.

fresh_translation: Joakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Zebudah daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah.
brenton_translation: Twenty-five years old was Joakim when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jeldaph, daughter of Phadaïl of Ruma.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord according to all that his fathers did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.

fresh_translation: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Joakim became his servant three years, and he turned and rebelled against him.
brenton_translation: In his days went up Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and Joakim became his servant three years; and then he turned and revolted from him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord sent against him raiding bands of the Chaldeans and raiding bands of Syria and raiding bands of Moab and raiding bands of the sons of Ammon, and he sent them into the land of Judah to strengthen against it, according to the word of the Lord which he spoke by the hand of his servants the prophets.
brenton_translation: And the Lord sent against him the bands of the Chaldeans, and the bands of Syria, and the bands of Moab, and the bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them into the land of Juda to prevail against it, according to the word of the Lord, which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

fresh_translation: Only, it was upon the anger of the Lord in Judah to remove him from before his face, because of the sins of Manasseh according to all that he did,
brenton_translation: Moreover it was the purpose of the Lord concerning Juda, to remove them from his presence, because of the sins of Manasses, according to all that he did.

fresh_translation: and indeed he poured out innocent blood and filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the Lord did not wish to be propitiated.
brenton_translation: Moreover he shed innocent blood, and filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the Lord would not pardon it.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the words of Joakim and all that he did, are these not written in the book of the words of the days for the kings of Judah?
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Joakim, and all that he did, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

fresh_translation: And Joakim slept with his fathers, and Joakim his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Joakim slept with his fathers: and Joachim his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And the king of Egypt no longer added to go out from his land, because the king of Babylon took from the wadi of Egypt as far as the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And the king of Egypt came no more out of his land: for the king of Babylon took away all that belonged to the king of Egypt from the river of Egypt as far as the river Euphrates.

fresh_translation: Joakim was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Eighteen years old was Joachim when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Nestha, daughter of Ellanastham, of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord according to all that his father did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father did.

fresh_translation: At that time Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city came under siege.
brenton_translation: At that time went up Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

fresh_translation: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon entered into the city, and his servants were besieging it.
brenton_translation: And Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants besieged it.

fresh_translation: And Joakim king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he and his servants and his mother and his rulers and his eunuchs, and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.
brenton_translation: And Joachim king of Juda came forth to the king of Babylon, he and his servants, and his mother, and his princes, and his eunuchs; and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

fresh_translation: And he carried out from there all the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king's house and cut in pieces all the golden vessels which Solomon king of Israel made in the temple of the Lord, according to the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he brought forth thence all the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house, and he cut up all the golden vessels which Solomon the king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, according to the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he deported Jerusalem and all the rulers and the mighty in strength, ten thousand in captivity, and every craftsman and every smith, and none was left except the poor of the land.
brenton_translation: And he carried away the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and all the captains, and the mighty men, taking captive ten thousand prisoners, and every artificer and smith: and only the poor of the land were left.

fresh_translation: And he deported Joakim to Babylon, and the king's mother and the king's wives and his eunuchs and the mighty of the land he led away in exile from Jerusalem into Babylon.
brenton_translation: And he carried Joachim away to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his eunuchs: and he carried away the mighty men of the land into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

fresh_translation: And all the men of force, seven thousand, and the craftsman and the smith, a thousand, all mighty ones making war, the king of Babylon brought them as exiles into Babylon.
brenton_translation: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and one thousand artificers and smiths: all were mighty men fit for war; and the king of Babylon carried them captive to Babylon.

fresh_translation: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his kinsman king in his place and set his name Zedekiah.
brenton_translation: And the king of Babylon made Batthanias his son king in his stead, and called his name Sedekias.

fresh_translation: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah.
brenton_translation: Twenty and one years old was Sedekias when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Amital, daughter of Jeremias.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before the Lord according to all that Joakim did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Joachim did.

fresh_translation: Because it was upon the anger of the Lord against Jerusalem and Judah until he cast them from before his face. And Zedekiah rebelled against the kingdom of Babylon.
brenton_translation: For it was according to the Lord's anger against Jerusalem and on Juda, until he cast them out of his presence, that Sedekias revolted against the king of Babylon.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, and all his force, against Jerusalem, and they encamped against it and built a siege-wall around it.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, that Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon came, and all his host, against Jerusalem; and he encamped against it, and built a mound against it.

fresh_translation: And the city came under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
brenton_translation: And the city was besieged until the eleventh year of king Sedekias on the ninth day of the month.

fresh_translation: On the ninth day of the month, famine became strong in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
brenton_translation: And the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

fresh_translation: And the city was breached, and all the men of war went out by night by way of the gate between the walls, which is by the king's garden, and the Chaldeans were around the city, and he went by way of the Arabah.
brenton_translation: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war went forth by night, by the way of the gate between the walls, this is the gate of the king's garden: and the Chaldeans were set against the city round about: and the king went by the way of the plain.

fresh_translation: And the force of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho, and all his force was scattered from upon him.
brenton_translation: And the force of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army was dispersed from about him.

fresh_translation: And they captured the king and brought him to the king of Babylon at Riblah, and he spoke judgment with him.
brenton_translation: And they took the king, and brought him to the king of Babylon to Reblatha; and he gave judgment upon him.

fresh_translation: And he slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and the eyes of Zedekiah he blinded, and he bound him in fetters and brought him into Babylon.
brenton_translation: And he slew the sons of Sedekias before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Sedekias, and bound him in fetters, and brought him to Babylon.

fresh_translation: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the chief guard, standing before the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month (this is the nineteenth year of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon), came Nabuzardan, captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he burned the house of the Lord and the king's house and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great house he burned.
brenton_translation: And he burnt the house of the Lord, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every house did the captain of the guard burn.

fresh_translation: And the force of the Chaldeans that was with the chief guard tore down the walls of Jerusalem all around.
brenton_translation: And the force of the Chaldeans pulled down the wall of Jerusalem round about.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the people left in the city and those who had fallen away, who fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the support Nebuzaradan the chief guard removed.
brenton_translation: And Nabuzardan the captain of the guard removed the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the men who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

fresh_translation: And from the poor of the land the chief guard left some for vinedressers and field-workers.
brenton_translation: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vine-dressers and husbandmen.

fresh_translation: And the bronze pillars in the house of the Lord and the bases and the bronze sea in the house of the Lord the Chaldeans broke up and carried their bronze into Babylon.
brenton_translation: And the Chaldeans broke to pieces the brazen pillars that were in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the brazen sea that was in the house of the Lord, and carried their brass to Babylon.

fresh_translation: And the pots and the shovels and the bowls and the censers and all the bronze vessels with which they ministered, he took.
brenton_translation: And the caldrons, and the shovels, and the bowls, and the censers, and all the brazen vessels with which they minister, he took.

fresh_translation: And the firepans and the bowls, those of gold and those of silver, the chief guard took.
brenton_translation: And the captain of the guard took the fire-pans, and the gold and silver bowls.

fresh_translation: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases which Solomon made for the house of the Lord, there was no weight to the bronze of all the vessels.
brenton_translation: Two pillars, and one sea, and the bases which Solomon made for the house of the Lord: there was no weight of the brass of all the vessels.

fresh_translation: Eighteen cubits was the height of the one pillar, and the bronze capital was upon it, and the height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the capital round about, all bronze. And the same for the second pillar with the network.
brenton_translation: The height of one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was of brass: and the height of the chapiter was three cubits: the border, and the pomegranates on the chapiter round about were all of brass: and so it was with the second pillar with its border.

fresh_translation: And the chief guard took Seraiah the first priest and Zephaniah of the second order and the three keeping the threshold.
brenton_translation: And the captain of the guard took Saraias the high-priest, and Sophonias the second in order, and the three door-keepers.

fresh_translation: And from the city he took one eunuch who was overseer over the men of war and five men of those seeing the king's face who were found in the city and the scribe of the ruler of the force, the one mustering the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land found in the city.
brenton_translation: And they took out of the city one eunuch who was commander of the men of war, and five men that saw the face of the king, that were found in the city, and the secretary of the commander-in-chief, who took account of the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land that were found in the city.

fresh_translation: And Nebuzaradan the chief guard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
brenton_translation: And Nabuzardan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Reblatha.

fresh_translation: And the king of Babylon struck them and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath, and Judah was deported from its land.
brenton_translation: And the king of Babylon smote them and slew them at Reblatha in the land of Æmath. So Juda was carried away from his land.

fresh_translation: And the people left in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon left, over them he appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan.
brenton_translation: And as for the people that were left in the land of Juda, whom Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon left, even over them he set Godolias son of Achicam son of Saphan.

fresh_translation: And all the commanders of the force, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah, and they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah, even Ishmael son of Nethaniah and Johanan son of Careah and Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite and Iezonias son of the Maachathite, they and their men.
brenton_translation: And all the captains of the host, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had thus appointed Godolias, and they came to Godolias to Massephath, both Ismael the son of Nathanias, and Jona son of Careth, and Saraias, son of Thanamath the Netophathite, and Jezonias son of a Machathite, they and their men.

fresh_translation: And Gedaliah swore to them and to their men and said to them, Do not fear the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well for you.
brenton_translation: And Godolias swore to them and their men, and said to them, Fear not the incursion of the Chaldeans; dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the seventh month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elishama from the seed of the kings, and ten men with him, came and struck Gedaliah, and he died, and also the Judeans and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the seventh month that Ismael son of Nathanias son of Helisama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and he smote Godolias, that he died, him and the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him in Massepha.

fresh_translation: And all the people rose, from small to great, and the commanders of the forces, and they entered into Egypt, because they feared from before the Chaldeans.
brenton_translation: And all the people, great and small rose up, they and the captains of the forces, and went into Egypt; because they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Joakim king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year of his reign, lifted up the head of Joakim king of Judah from prison.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the thirty-seventh year of the carrying away of Joachim king of Juda, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, that Evialmarodec king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Joachim king of Juda, and brought him out of his prison-house.

fresh_translation: And he spoke good things with him and gave his throne above the thrones of the kings who were with him in Babylon.
brenton_translation: And he spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the thrones of the kings that were with him in Babylon;

fresh_translation: And he changed the garments of his prison, and he ate bread continually before him all the days of his life.
brenton_translation: and changed his prison garments: and he ate bread continually before him all the days of his life.

fresh_translation: And his allowance, a continual allowance, was given to him from the king's house, a day's portion on its day, all the days of his life.
brenton_translation: And his portion, a continual portion, was given him out of the house of the king, a daily rate for every day all the days of his life.

fresh_translation: Adam, Seth, Enos,
brenton_translation: Adam, Seth, Enos,

fresh_translation: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jared,
brenton_translation: and Cainan, Maleleel, Jared,

fresh_translation: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
brenton_translation: Enoch, Mathusala, Lamech,

fresh_translation: Noah. Sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, Japheth.
brenton_translation: Noe: the sons of Noe, Sem, Cham, Japheth.

fresh_translation: Sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Elishah, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
brenton_translation: The sons of Japheth, Gamer, Magog, Madaim, Jovan, Helisa, Thobel, Mosoch, and Thiras.

fresh_translation: Sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Gamer, Aschanaz, and Riphath, and Thorgama.

fresh_translation: Sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rhodioi.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jovan, Helisa, and Tharsis, the Citians, and Rhodians.

fresh_translation: Sons of Ham: Cush, Mestraim, Phut, and Canaan.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Cham, Chus, and Mesraim, Phud and Chanaan.

fresh_translation: Sons of Cush: Sheba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sebekatha. Sons of Raamah: Sheba and Oudadan.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Chus, Saba, and Evila, and Sabatha, and Regma, and Sebethaca: and the sons of Regma, Saba, and Dadan.

fresh_translation: And Cush begot Nimrod. This one began to be a giant hunter upon the earth.
brenton_translation: And Chus begot Nebrod: he began to be a mighty hunter on the earth.

fresh_translation: Sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arphaxad.
brenton_translation: The sons of Sem, Ælam, and Assur,

fresh_translation: Shelah.
brenton_translation: and Arphaxad, Sala,

fresh_translation: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
brenton_translation: Eber, Pheleg, Ragan,

fresh_translation: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
brenton_translation: Seruch, Nachor, Tharrha,

fresh_translation: Abraham.
brenton_translation: Abraam.

fresh_translation: And sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Abraam, Isaac, and Ismael.

fresh_translation: And these are their generations: Nebajoth the firstborn of Ishmael, and Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
brenton_translation: And these are their generations: the first-born of Ismael, Nabæoth, and Kedar, Nabdeel, Massam,

fresh_translation: Massa, Idouma, Massa, Hadad, Teman,
brenton_translation: Masma, Iduma, Masse, Chondan, Thæman,

fresh_translation: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are sons of Ishmael.
brenton_translation: Jettur, Naphes, Kedma: these are the sons of Ismael.

fresh_translation: And sons of Keturah, concubine of Abraham, and she bore to him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, Soe. And sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Chettura Abraam's concubine:—and she bore him Zembram, Jexan, Madiam, Madam, Sobac, Soe: and the sons of Jexan; Dædan, and Sabai;

fresh_translation: And sons of Midian: Ephah, Hepher, Enoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were sons of Keturah.
brenton_translation: and the sons of Madiam; Gephar, and Opher, and Enoch, and Abida, and Eldada; all these were the sons of Chettura.

fresh_translation: And Abraham begot Isaac. Sons of Isaac: Esau and Jacob.
brenton_translation: And Abraam begot Isaac: and the sons of Isaac were Jacob, and Esau.

fresh_translation: Sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Ieoul, Ieglom, and Kore.
brenton_translation: The sons of Esau, Eliphaz, and Raguel, and Jeul, and Jeglom, and Core.

fresh_translation: Sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, and from Timnah, Amalek.
brenton_translation: The sons of Eliphaz: Thæman, and Omar, Sophar, and Goötham, and Kenez, and Thamna, and Amalec.

fresh_translation: And sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Some, and Mizzah.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Raguel, Naches, Zare, Some, and Moze.

fresh_translation: Sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
brenton_translation: The sons of Seir, Lotan, Sobal, Sebegon, Ana, Deson, Osar, and Disan.

fresh_translation: And sons of Lotan: Horites and Heman, and Elath and Namna.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Lotan, Chorri, and Æman; and the sister of Lotan was Thamna.

fresh_translation: Sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
brenton_translation: The sons of Sobal; Alon, Machanath, Tæbel, Sophi, and Onan: and the sons of Sebegon; Æth, and Sonan.

fresh_translation: Sons of Anah: Dishan. Sons of Dishan: Emeron, Eshban, Ithran, and Haran.
brenton_translation: The sons of Sonan, Dæson: and the sons of Dæson; Emeron, and Asebon, and Jethram, and Charran.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zoukan, and Jakan. Sons of Dishan also: Os and Haran.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Hosar, Balaam, and Zucam, and Acan: the sons of Disan, Os, and Aran.

fresh_translation: And these were their kings: Balak son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
brenton_translation: And these are their kings, Balac the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dennaba.

fresh_translation: And Balak died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Balac died, and Jobab the son of Zara of Bosorrha reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Jobab died, and Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Jobab died, and Asom of the land of the Thæmanites reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the plain of Moab, reigned in his place, and the name of his city was Gittaim.
brenton_translation: And Asom died, and Adad the son of Barad reigned in his stead, who smote Madiam in the plain of Moab: and the name of his city was Gethaim.

fresh_translation: And Hadad died, and Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Adad died, and Sebla of Masecca reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Samlah died, and Saul from Rehoboth by the river reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Sebla died, and Saul of Rhoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Saul died, and Balaennor son of Achobor reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, and Hadad son of Bedad reigned in his place, and the name of his city was Peor.
brenton_translation: And Balaennor died, and Adad son of Barad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Phogor.

fresh_translation: And Hadad died, and the chiefs of Edom were: chief Timnah, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
brenton_translation: The princes of Edom: prince Thamna, prince Golada, prince Jether,

fresh_translation: chief Elibamas, chief Elas, chief Pinon,
brenton_translation: prince Elibamas, prince Elas, prince Phinon,

fresh_translation: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mabsar,
brenton_translation: prince Kenez, prince Thæman, prince Babsar, prince Magediel,

fresh_translation: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These were chiefs of Edom.
brenton_translation: prince Zaphoin. These are the princes of Edom.

fresh_translation: These are names of the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
brenton_translation: These are the names of the sons of Israel;

fresh_translation: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, Asher.
brenton_translation: Ruben, Symeon, Levi, Juda, Issachar, Zabulon, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Nephthali, Gad, Aser.

fresh_translation: Sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shallum. These three were born to him from the daughter of Shua the Canaanite. And Er, firstborn of Judah, was evil before the Lord, and he put him to death.
brenton_translation: The sons of Juda; Er, Aunan, Selom. These three were born to him of the daughter of Sava the Chananitish woman: and Er, the first-born of Juda, was wicked before the Lord, and he slew him.

fresh_translation: And Tamar his bride bore to him Perez and Zerah. All sons of Judah were five.
brenton_translation: And Thamar his daughter-in-law bore to him Phares, and Zara: all the sons of Juda were five.

fresh_translation: Sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
brenton_translation: The sons of Phares, Esrom, and Jemuel.

fresh_translation: And sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara, all five.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Zara, Zambri, and Ætham, and Æmuan, and Calchal, and Darad, in all five.

fresh_translation: And sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the devoted thing.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Charmi; Achar the troubler of Israel, who was disobedient in the accursed thing.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ethan: Azariah.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ætham; Azarias,

fresh_translation: And sons of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, Caleb, and Aram.
brenton_translation: and the sons of Esrom who were born to him; Jerameel, and Aram, and Chaleb.

fresh_translation: And Aram begot Amminadab, and Amminadab begot Nahshon, ruler of the house of Judah.
brenton_translation: And Aram begot Aminadab, and Aminadab begot Naasson, chief of the house of Juda.

fresh_translation: And Nahshon begot Salmon, and Salmon begot Boaz.
brenton_translation: And Naasson begot Salmon, and Salmon begot Booz,

fresh_translation: And Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse.
brenton_translation: and Booz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jessæ.

fresh_translation: And Jesse begot his firstborn Eliab, Amminadab the second, Shimma the third,
brenton_translation: And Jessæ begot his first-born Eliab, Aminadab was the second, Samaa the third,

fresh_translation: Nathanael the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
brenton_translation: Nathanael the fourth, Zabdai the fifth,

fresh_translation: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh.
brenton_translation: Asam the sixth, David the seventh.

fresh_translation: And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
brenton_translation: And their sister was Saruia, and another Abigaia: and the sons of Saruia were Abisa, and Joab, and Asael, three.

fresh_translation: And Abigail begot Amasa, and father of Amasa was Jether the Ismaelite.
brenton_translation: And Abigaia bore Amessab: and the father of Amessab was Jothor the Ismaelite.

fresh_translation: And Caleb son of Hezron begot with Azubah his wife and Jerioth. And these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Araunah.
brenton_translation: And Chaleb the son of Esrom took Gazuba to wife, and Jerioth: and these were her sons; Jasar, and Subab, and Ardon.

fresh_translation: And Azubah died, and Caleb took to himself Ephrath, and she bore to him Or.
brenton_translation: And Gazuba died; and Chaleb took to himself Ephrath, and she bore to him Or.

fresh_translation: And Or begot Huri, and Huri begot Beseleel.
brenton_translation: And Or begot Uri, and Uri begot Beseleel.

fresh_translation: And after this Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir father of Gilead, and he took her, and he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.
brenton_translation: And after this Esron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Galaad, and he took her when he was sixty-five years old; and she bore him Seruch.

fresh_translation: And Segub begot Jair, and he had twenty-three cities in Gilead.
brenton_translation: And Seruch begot Jair, and he had twenty-three cities in Galaad.

fresh_translation: And Geshur and Aram took the villages of Jair from them, even Kanath and its villages, sixty cities. All these were sons of Machir father of Gilead.
brenton_translation: And he took Gedsur and Aram, the towns of Jair from them; with Canath and its towns, sixty cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Galaad.

fresh_translation: And after Hezron died, Caleb came to Ephrathah, and Abijah wife of Hezron bore to him Ashur father of Tekoa.
brenton_translation: And after the death of Esron, Chaleb came to Ephratha; and the wife of Esron was Abia; and she bore him Ascho the father of Thecoe.

fresh_translation: And sons of Jerahmeel firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, and Baana, and Aran, and Ozem his brother.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jerameel the first-born of Esron were, the first-born Ram, and Banaa, and Aram, and Asan his brother.

fresh_translation: And Jerahmeel had another wife, and her name was Atarah. She is the mother of Onam.
brenton_translation: And Jerameel had another wife, and her name was Atara: she is the mother of Ozom.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ram firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ram the first-born of Jerameel were Maas, and Jamin, and Acor.

fresh_translation: And sons of Onam were Shammai and Jedaiah. And sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ozom were, Samai, and Jadae: and the sons of Samai; Nadab, and Abisur.

fresh_translation: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bore to him Achabar and Molid.
brenton_translation: And the name of the wife of Abisur was Abichaia, and she bore him Achabar, and Moel.

fresh_translation: Sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. And Seled died having no children.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Nadab; Salad and Apphain; and Salad died without children.

fresh_translation: And sons of Appaim: Ishi. And sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Apphain, Isemiel; and the sons of Isemiel, Sosan; and the sons of Sosan, Dadai.

fresh_translation: And sons of Jedaiah: Shammai, Jether, and Jonathan. And Jether died having no children.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Dadai, Achisamas, Jether, Jonathan: and Jether died childless.

fresh_translation: And sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were sons of Jerahmeel.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jonathan; Phaleth, and Hozam. These were the sons of Jerameel.

fresh_translation: And Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, and his name was Jekuthiel.
brenton_translation: And Sosan had no sons, but daughters. And Sosan had an Egyptian servant, and his name was Jochel.

fresh_translation: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jekuthiel his servant for a wife, and she bore to him Attai.
brenton_translation: And Sosan gave his daughter to Jochel his servant to wife; and she bore him Ethi.

fresh_translation: And Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad.
brenton_translation: And Ethi begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabed,

fresh_translation: And Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed.
brenton_translation: and Zabed begot Aphamel, and Aphamel begot Obed.

fresh_translation: And Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah.
brenton_translation: And Obed begot Jeu, and Jeu begot Azarias,

fresh_translation: And Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Eleasah.
brenton_translation: and Azarias begot Chelles, and Chelles begot Eleasa,

fresh_translation: And Eleasah begot Sisamai, and Sisamai begot Shallum.
brenton_translation: and Eleasa begot Sosomai, and Sosomai begot Salum,

fresh_translation: And Shallum begot Iechemian, and Iechemias begot Elishama.
brenton_translation: and Salum begot Jechemias, and Jechemias begot Elisama, and Elisama begot Ismael.

fresh_translation: And sons of Caleb brother of Jerahmeel: Mareshah his firstborn. This one was the father of Ziph, and sons of Mareshah father of Hebron.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Chaleb the brother of Jerameel were, Marisa his first-born, he is the father of Ziph:—and the sons of Marisa the father of Chebron.

fresh_translation: And sons of Hebron: Kore, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Chebron; Core, and Thapphus, and Recom, and Samaa.

fresh_translation: And Shema begot Raem father of Jorkeam, and Jorkeam begot Shammai.
brenton_translation: And Samaa begot Raem the father of Jeclan: and Jeclan begot Samai.

fresh_translation: And his son was Maon, and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
brenton_translation: And his son was Maon: and Maon is the father of Bæthsur.

fresh_translation: And Ephah, concubine of Caleb, bore Haran and Mesha and Gazez, and Haran begot Gazez.
brenton_translation: And Gæpha the concubine of Chaleb bore Aram, and Mosa, and Gezue.

fresh_translation: And sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Gershon, Phalet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Addai were Ragem, and Joatham, and Sogar, and Phalec, and Gæpha, and Sagae.

fresh_translation: And concubine of Caleb, Maachah, bore Sheber and Tharchna.
brenton_translation: And Chaleb's concubine Mocha bore Saber, and Tharam.

fresh_translation: And Shaaph begot father of Madmannah and Saou father of Machbenah and father of Gaibaa. And daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
brenton_translation: She bore also Sagae the father of Madmena, and Sau the father of Machabena, and the father of Gæbal: and the daughter of Chaleb was Ascha.

fresh_translation: These were sons of Caleb, sons of Or firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal father of Kirjathjearim,
brenton_translation: These were the sons of Chaleb: the sons of Or the first-born of Ephratha; Sobal the father of Cariathiarim,

fresh_translation: Solomon father of Bethlehem, Hareph father of Bethgader.
brenton_translation: Salomon the father of Bætha, Lammon the father of Bæthalaem, and Arim the father of Bethgedor.

fresh_translation: And sons of Shobal father of Kirjathjearim were Haroeh and half of the Manahethites.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Sobal the father of Cariathiarim were Araa, and Æsi, and Ammanith,

fresh_translation: And the families of Kirjathjearim were the Ithrites, Puhites, Shumathites, and Mishraites; from these came out the Zareathites and Eshtaulites.
brenton_translation: and Umasphaë, cities of Jair; Æthalim, and Miphithim, and Hesamathim, and Hemasaraim; from these went forth the Sarathæans, and the sons of Esthaam.

fresh_translation: Sons of Solomon: Bethlehem, Netophathites, Ataroth, house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, Esarei.
brenton_translation: The sons of Salomon; Bæthalaem, the Netophathite, Ataroth of the house of Joab, and half of the family of Malathi, Esari.

fresh_translation: Families of scribes dwelling in Iabes: Thargathiim, Samathiim, Sookathiim. These are the Kinaioi who came from Mesema, father of the house of Rechab.
brenton_translation: The families of the scribes dwelling in Jabis; Thargathiim, and Samathiim, and Sochathim, these are the Kinæans that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

fresh_translation: And these were sons of David born to him in Hebron: the firstborn Amnon by Ahinoam the Jezreelite, the second Daniel by Abigail the Carmelite,
brenton_translation: Now these were the sons of David that were born to him in Chebron; the first-born Amnon, born of Achinaam the Jezraelitess; the second Damniel, of Abigaia the Carmelitess.

fresh_translation: the third Absalom son of Maachah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur, the fourth Adonijah son of Haggith,
brenton_translation: The third, Abessalom, the son of Mocha the daughter of Tholmai king of Gedsur; the fourth, Adonia the son of Aggith.

fresh_translation: the fifth Shephatiah by Abital, the sixth Ithream by Eglah his wife.
brenton_translation: The fifth, Saphatia, the son of Abital; the sixth, Jethraam, born of Agla his wife.

fresh_translation: Six were born to him in Hebron, and he reigned there seven years and six months, and thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Six were born to him in Chebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months: and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Beersheba daughter of Ammiel,
brenton_translation: And these were born to him in Jerusalem; Samaa, Sobab, Nathan, and Solomon; four of Bersabee the daughter of Amiel:

fresh_translation: and Ibhar and Elishama and Eliphelet,
brenton_translation: and Ebaar, and Elisa, and Eliphaleth,

fresh_translation: and Nogah and Nepheg and Ianoue,
brenton_translation: and Nagai, and Naphec, and Japhie,

fresh_translation: and Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet, nine.
brenton_translation: and Helisama, and Eliada, and Eliphala, nine.

fresh_translation: All were sons of David, besides sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
brenton_translation: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and there was also Themar their sister.

fresh_translation: Sons of Solomon: Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
brenton_translation: The sons of Solomon; Roboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Josaphat his son,

fresh_translation: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
brenton_translation: Joram his son, Ochozias his son, Joas his son,

fresh_translation: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
brenton_translation: Amasias his son, Azarias his son, Joathan his son,

fresh_translation: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
brenton_translation: Achaz his son, Ezekias his son, Manasses his son,

fresh_translation: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
brenton_translation: Amon his son, Josia his son.

fresh_translation: And sons of Josiah: firstborn Johanan, second Joakim, third Zedekiah, fourth Shallum.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Josia; the first-born Joanan, the second Joakim, the third Sedekias, the fourth Salum.

fresh_translation: And sons of Joakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Joakim; Jechonias his son, Sedekias his son.

fresh_translation: And sons of Iechonia-asir: Shealtiel his son,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jechonias; Asir, Salathiel his son,

fresh_translation: Melchiram and Pedaiah and Shenazar and Jecamiah and Hoshama and Denethi.
brenton_translation: Melchiram, and Phadaias, and Sanesar, and Jekimia, and Hosamath, and Nabadias.

fresh_translation: And sons of Shealtiel: Zerubbabel and Shimei. And sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Phadaias; Zorobabel, and Semei: and the sons of Zorobabel; Mosollam, and Anania, and Salomethi was their sister.

fresh_translation: and Hashubah and Ohel and Berechiah and Hasadiah and Jushabhesed, five.
brenton_translation: And Asube, and Ool, and Barachia, and Asadia, and Asobed, five.

fresh_translation: And sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jesaiah his son, Rephaiah his son, Araunah his son, Obadiah his son, Shecaniah his son.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Anania, Phalettia, and Jesias his son, Raphal his son, Orna his son, Abdia his son, Sechenias his son.

fresh_translation: And son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And sons of Shemaiah: Hattush and Joel and Bariah and Neariah and Shaphat, six.
brenton_translation: And the son of Sechenias; Samaia: and the sons of Samaia; Chattus, and Joel, and Berri and Noadia, and Saphath, six.

fresh_translation: And sons of Neariah: Elioenai and Hezekiah and Azrikam, three.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Noadia: Elithenan, and Ezekia, and Ezricam, three.

fresh_translation: And sons of Elioenai: Hodaiah and Eliashib and Pelaiah and Akkub and Johanan and Dalaiah and Anani, seven.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Elithenan; Odolia, and Heliasebon, and Phadaia, and Akub, and Joanan, and Dalaaïa, and Anan, seven.

fresh_translation: And sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Or, and Shobal.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Juda; Phares, Esrom, and Charmi, and Or, Subal,

fresh_translation: And Reaiah his son, and Shobal begot Jahath, and Jahath begot Ahumai and Lahad. These are generations of the Sarathi.
brenton_translation: and Rada his son; and Subal begot Jeth; and Jeth begot Achimai, and Laad: these are the generations of the Arathites.

fresh_translation: And these are sons of Etam: Jezreel and Ragma and Idbash, and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi.
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Ætam; Jezrael and Jesman, and Jebdas: and their sister's name was Eselebbon.

fresh_translation: And Penuel father of Gedor, and Asher father of Osan. These are sons of Or, the firstborn of Ephrathah, father of Bethlehem.
brenton_translation: And Phanuel the father of Gedor, and Jazer the father of Osan: these are the sons of Or, the first-born of Ephratha, the father of Bæthalaen.

fresh_translation: And to Ashur father of Tekoa were two wives, Helah and Naarah.
brenton_translation: And Asur the father of Thecoe had two wives, Aoda and Thoada.

fresh_translation: And Helah bore to him Ahuzam and Hepher and Teman and Haahashtari. All these were sons of Helah.
brenton_translation: And Aoda bore to him Ochaia, and Ephal, and Thæman, and Aasther: all these were the sons of Aoda.

fresh_translation: And sons of Naarah: Zereth and Jezoar and Ethnan.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Thoada; Sereth, and Saar, and Esthanam.

fresh_translation: And Koes begot Anub and Zobebah and generations of brother of Rechab son of Harum.
brenton_translation: And Coe begot Enob, and Sabatha, and the progeny of the brother of Rechab, the son of Jarin.

fresh_translation: And Jabez was more honored than his brothers, and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, I bore as with pain.
brenton_translation: And Igabes was more famous than his brethren; and his mother called his name Igabes, saying, I have born as a sorrowful one.

fresh_translation: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, If in blessing you bless me and multiply my borders, and your hand be with me, and you make knowledge so as not to humble me. And God brought upon him all that he asked.
brenton_translation: And Igabes called on the God of Israel, saying, O that thou wouldest indeed bless me, and enlarge my coasts, and that thy hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest make me know that thou wilt not grieve me! And God granted him all that he asked.

fresh_translation: And Caleb father of Achsah begot Machir. This one was the father of Eshton.
brenton_translation: And Chaleb the father of Ascha begot Machir; he was the father of Assathon.

fresh_translation: And Eshton begot Bathrephan and Phessee and Thana father of the city Nahash, brother of Azelon the Kenezite. These are men of Repha.
brenton_translation: He begot Bathraias, and Besseë, and Thæman the founder of the city of Naas the brother of Eselom the Kenezite: these were the men of Rechab.

fresh_translation: And sons of Kenaz: Gothoniel and Seraiah. And sons of Gothoniel: Hathath.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Kenez; Gothoniel, and Saraia: and the sons of Gothoniel; Athath.

fresh_translation: And Manahethites begot Ophrah, and Seraiah begot Joab father of Ageaddair, because they were craftsmen.
brenton_translation: And Manathi begot Gophera: and Saraia begot Jobab, the father of Ageaddair, for they were artificers.

fresh_translation: And sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Era, Elah, and Naam. And sons of Elah: Kenaz.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Chaleb the son of Jephonne; Er, Ada, and Noom: and the sons of Ada, Kenez.

fresh_translation: And his son: Jehaleleel, Aemiachi, Zapha, Tiria, and Eserael.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Aleel, Zib, and Zepha, and Thiria, and Eserel.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ezra: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. And Jether begot Maron and Shammai and Mareth father of Eshtemoa.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Esri; Jether, Morad, and Apher, and Jamon: and Jether begot Maron, and Semei, and Jesba the father of Esthæmon.

fresh_translation: And his wife, Jehudijah, bore Jared father of Gedor and Heber father of Sochon and Jekuthiel father of Zanoah. And these are sons of Geli daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
brenton_translation: And his wife, that is Adia, bore Jared the father of Gedor, and Aber the father of Sochon, and Chetiel the father of Zamon: and these are the sons of Betthia the daughter of Pharao, whom Mored took.

fresh_translation: And sons of wife of Hodiah, sister of Naham: Dalia father of Keilah and Shimon father of Ioman. And sons of Naem father of Keilah: Agarmi and Eshtemoa Machathi.
