brenton_translation: And the sons of the wife of Iduia the sister of Nachaim the father of Keila; Garmi, and Esthæmon the Nochathite.

fresh_translation: And sons of Shimon: Amnon and Rinnah son of Anan and Tilon. And sons of Ishi: Zoheth and sons of Zoheth.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Semon; Amnon, and Ana the son of Phana, and Inon: and the sons of Sei, Zoan, and the sons of Zoab.

fresh_translation: Sons of Shallum son of Judah: Er father of Lecha and Laadah father of Mareshah and generations of houses of workers of fine linen for the house of Esoba.
brenton_translation: The sons of Selom the son of Juda; Er the father of Lechab, and Laada the father of Marisa, and the offspring of the family of Ephrathabac belonging to the house of Esoba.

fresh_translation: And Joakim and men of Chozeba and Joash and Saraph, who dwelt in Moab and brought them back to Abedeirin Athoukiin.
brenton_translation: And Joakim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joas, and Saraph, who dwelt in Moab, and he changed their names to Abederin and Athukiim.

fresh_translation: These were potters, those dwelling in Nataim and Gadira. With the king in his kingdom they strengthened and dwelt there.
brenton_translation: These are the potters who dwelt in Ataim and Gadira with the king: they grew strong in his kingdom, and dwelt there.

fresh_translation: Sons of Simeon: Nemuel and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Saul,
brenton_translation: The sons of Semeon; Namuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zares, Saul:

fresh_translation: Salem his son, Mibsam his son, Massa his son,
brenton_translation: Salem his son, Mabasam his son, Masma his son:

fresh_translation: Amouel his son, Saboud his son, Zakchour his son, Shimei his son.
brenton_translation: Amuel his son, Sabud his son, Zacchur his son, Semei his son.

fresh_translation: And to Shimei were sixteen sons and three daughters, and to their brothers there were not many sons, and all their families did not multiply like sons of Judah.
brenton_translation: Semei had sixteen sons, and six daughters; and his brethren had not many sons, neither did all their families multiply as the sons of Juda.

fresh_translation: And they dwelt in Beersheba and Sheba and Moladah and Esersoual
brenton_translation: And they dwelt in Bersabee, and Molada, and in Esersual,

fresh_translation: and in Bilhah and Ezem and Tolad
brenton_translation: and in Balaa, and in Æsem, and in Tholad,

fresh_translation: and Bethuel and Hormah and Ziklag
brenton_translation: and in Bathuel, and in Herma, and in Sikelag,

fresh_translation: and Bethmarcaboth and Hemi-soseim and house of Baroumseorim. These were their cities until King David.
brenton_translation: and in Bæthmarimoth, and Hemisuseosin, and the house of Baruseorim: these were their cities until the time of king David.

fresh_translation: And their villages were Etam and Enremmon and Thokkan and Ashan, five cities,
brenton_translation: And their villages were Ætan, and En, Remnon, and Thocca, and Æsar, five cities.

fresh_translation: and all their villages around these cities as far as Baal. This was their possession and their encampment.
brenton_translation: And all their villages were round about these cities, as far as Baal: this was their possession, and their distribution.

fresh_translation: And Mosobab and Iemoloch and Joshah son of Amaziah
brenton_translation: And Mosobab, and Jemoloch, and Josia the son of Amasia;

fresh_translation: and Joel, and this one was the son of Isabia son of Seraiah son of Asiel,
brenton_translation: and Joel, and Jeu the son of Asabia, the son of Sarau, the son of Asiel;

fresh_translation: and Elioenai and Jaakobah and Iasouia and Asaiah and Adiel and Ishmael and Benaiah
brenton_translation: and Elionai, and Jocaba, and Jasuia, and Asaia, and Jediel, and Ismael, and Banaias;

fresh_translation: and Ziza son of Shiphi son of Allon son of Jedaiah son of Shimri son of Shemaiah.
brenton_translation: and Zuza the son of Saphai, the son of Alon, the son of Jedia, the son of Semri, the son of Samaias.

fresh_translation: These who came by names were rulers in their generations, and in the houses of their fathers they were multiplied into a multitude.
brenton_translation: These went by the names of princes in their families, and they increased abundantly in their fathers' households.

fresh_translation: And they went until coming to Gerar, to the east of the valley, to seek pasture for their cattle.
brenton_translation: And they went till they came to Gerara, to the east of Gai, to seek pasture for their cattle.

fresh_translation: And they found rich and good pasture, and the land before them was wide, and peace and quiet, because from the sons of Ham those dwelling there had been before.
brenton_translation: And they found abundant and good pastures, and the land before them was wide, and there was peace and quietness; for there were some of the children of Cham who dwelt there before.

fresh_translation: And these who were written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and struck their houses and the Meunites whom they found there and devoted them until this day and dwelt in their place, because there was pasture there for their cattle.
brenton_translation: And these who are written by name came in the days of Ezekias king of Juda, and they smote the people's houses, and the Minæans whom they found there, and utterly destroyed them until this day: and they dwelt in their place, because there was pasture there for their cattle.

fresh_translation: And from them, from the sons of Simeon, five hundred men went to Mount Seir, and Pelatiah and Neariah and Rephaiah and Uzziel, sons of Ishi, were their leaders.
brenton_translation: And some of them, even of the sons of Symeon, went to mount Seir, even five hundred men; and Phalaettia, and Noadia, and Raphaia, and Oziel, sons of Jesi, were their rulers.

fresh_translation: And they struck the remaining survivors of Amalek and dwelt there until this day.
brenton_translation: And they smote the remnant that were left of Amalec, until this day.

fresh_translation: And sons of Reuben, firstborn of Israel, because he was the firstborn, but when he went up upon the bed of his father, his blessing was given to his son Joseph son of Israel, and he was not enrolled for firstborn rights,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ruben the first-born of Israel (for he was the first-born; but because of his going up to his father's couch, his father gave his blessing to his son Joseph, even the son of Israel; and he was not reckoned as first-born;

fresh_translation: because Judah was strong in power among his brothers, and from him came a ruler, but the blessing was Joseph's.
brenton_translation: for Judas was very mighty even among his brethren, and one was to be a ruler out of him: but the blessing was Joseph's).

fresh_translation: Sons of Reuben firstborn of Israel: Enoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
brenton_translation: The sons of Ruben the first-born of Israel; Enoch, and Phallus, Asrom, and Charmi.

fresh_translation: Sons of Joel: Shemaiah, and Benaiah his son, and sons of Gog son of Shemaiah,
brenton_translation: The sons of Joel; Semei, and Banaia his son: and the sons of Gug the son of Semei.

fresh_translation: his son Micah, his son Recha, his son Baal,
brenton_translation: His son was Micha, his son Recha, his son Joel,

fresh_translation: his son Beerah, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria deported. He was the ruler of the Reubenites.
brenton_translation: his son Beël, whom Thagla-phallasar king of Assyria carried away captive: he is the chief of the Rubenites.

fresh_translation: And his brothers by his family in their encampments by their generations: the chief Joel and Zechariah,
brenton_translation: And his brethren in his family, in their distribution according to their generations; the chief, Joel, and Zacharia.

fresh_translation: and Balek son of Ozouz son of Shammah son of Joel. He dwelt in Aroer and upon Nabaub and Baalmeon,
brenton_translation: And Balec the son of Azuz, the son of Sama, the son of Joel: he dwelt in Aroer, and even to Naban, and Beelmasson.

fresh_translation: and toward the east he dwelt as far as entering of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their cattle were many in the land of Gilead.
brenton_translation: And he dwelt eastward to the borders of the wilderness, from the river Euphrates: for they had much cattle in the land of Galaad.

fresh_translation: And in the days of Saul they made war against the sojourners, and they fell into their hands, dwelling in tents as far as all the east of Gilead.
brenton_translation: And in the days of Saul they made war upon the sojourners in the land; and they fell into their hands, all of them dwelling in their tents eastward of Galaad.

fresh_translation: Sons of Gad opposite them dwelt in Bashan as far as Salcah.
brenton_translation: The sons of Gad dwelt over against them in the land of Basan even to Sela.

fresh_translation: Joel the firstborn, and Shapham the second, and Iani the scribe, in Bashan.
brenton_translation: Joel the first-born, and Sapham the second, and Janin the scribe in Basan.

fresh_translation: And their brothers according to the houses of their fathers: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Ioree, Jachan, Zoue, and Obed, seven.
brenton_translation: And their brethren according to the houses of their fathers; Michael, Mosollam, and Sebee, and Joree, and Joachan, and Zue, and Obed, seven.

fresh_translation: These were sons of Abihail son of Huri son of Idai son of Gilead son of Michael son of Jeshishai son of Iouri son of Buz,
brenton_translation: These are the sons of Abichaia the son of Uri, the son of Idai, the son of Galaad, the son of Michael, the son of Jesai, the son of Jeddai, the son of Buz,

fresh_translation: son of Abdiel son of Guni, chief of the house of fathers.
brenton_translation: who was the brother of the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, he was chief of the house of their families.

fresh_translation: They dwelt in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns and all the surrounding regions of Sharon, to their extremity.
brenton_translation: They dwelt in Galaad, in Basan, and in their villages, and in all the country round about Saron to the border.

fresh_translation: The enrollment of all of them was in the days of Jotham king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
brenton_translation: The enumeration of them all took place in the days of Joatham king of Juda, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

fresh_translation: Sons of Reuben and Gad and half tribe of Manasseh, from the sons of power, men bearing shields and sword and drawing bow and taught in war, forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty, going out to war.
brenton_translation: The sons of Ruben and Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasse, of mighty men, bearing shields and sword, and bending the bow, and skilled in war, were forty and four thousand and seven hundred and sixty, going forth to battle.

fresh_translation: And they made war with the Hagarites and Jetur and Nephish and Nodab.
brenton_translation: And they made war with the Agarenes, and Itureans, and Naphiseans, and Nadabeans,

fresh_translation: And they prevailed over them, and the Hagarites and all their tents were given into their hands, because they cried to God in the war, and he heard them, because they hoped in him.
brenton_translation: and they prevailed against them: and the Agaræans were given into their hands, they and all their tents: for they cried to God in the battle, and he hearkened to them, because they trusted on him.

fresh_translation: And they took captive their goods: five thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep, two thousand donkeys, and one hundred thousand human lives.
brenton_translation: And they took captive their store; five thousand camels, and two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, two thousand asses, and a hundred thousand men.

fresh_translation: Because many wounded fell, because the war was from God. And they dwelt in their place until the exile.
brenton_translation: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their place until the captivity.

fresh_translation: And the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land from Bashan to Baalhermon and Senir and Mount Hermon and in Lebanon. They multiplied.
brenton_translation: And the half-tribe of Manasse dwelt from Basan to Baal, Ermon, and Sanir, and to the mount Aërmon: and they increased in Libanus.

fresh_translation: And these were chiefs of houses of their fathers: Hepher and Ishi and Eliel and Azriel and Jeremiah and Hodaiah and Jahdiel, mighty men of power, men of name, chiefs of houses of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And these were the heads of the houses of their families; Opher, and Sei, and Eliel, and Jeremia, and Oduia, and Jediel, mighty men of valour, men of renown, heads of the houses of their families.

fresh_translation: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers and whored after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God drove out from before them.
brenton_translation: But they rebelled against the God of their fathers, and went a-whoring after the gods of the nations of the land, whom God cast out from before them.

fresh_translation: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he deported Reuben and the Gadites and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Calah and Habor and Hara and to the river Gozan, until this day.
brenton_translation: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Phaloch king of Assyria, and the spirit of Thagla-phallasar king of Assyria, and carried away Ruben and Gaddi, and the half-tribe of Manasse, and brought them to Chaach, and Chabor, and to the river Gozan, until this day.

fresh_translation: Sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
brenton_translation: The sons of Levi: Gedson, Caath, and Merari.

fresh_translation: And sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Caath; Ambram, and Issaar, Chebron, and Oziel.

fresh_translation: And sons of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. And sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ambram; Aaron, and Moses, and Mariam: and the sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abiud, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

fresh_translation: Eleazar begot Phinehas, Phinehas begot Abishua,
brenton_translation: Eleazar begot Phinees, Phinees begot Abisu;

fresh_translation: Abishua begot Bukki, Bukki begot Uzzi,
brenton_translation: Abisu begot Bokki, and Bokki begot Ozi;

fresh_translation: Uzzi begot Zerahiah, Zerahiah begot Meraioth,
brenton_translation: Ozi begot Zaraia, Zaraia begot Mariel;

fresh_translation: and Meraioth begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub,
brenton_translation: and Mariel begot Amaria, and Amaria begot Achitob;

fresh_translation: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Ahimaaz,
brenton_translation: and Achitob begot Sadoc, and Sadoc begot Achimaas;

fresh_translation: and Ahimaaz begot Azariah, and Azariah begot Johanan,
brenton_translation: and Achimaas begot Azarias, and Azarias begot Joanan;

fresh_translation: and Johanan begot Azariah. This one served as priest in the house which Solomon built in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: and Joanan begot Azarias: he ministered as priest in the house which Solomon built in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Azariah begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub,
brenton_translation: And Azarias begot Amaria, and Amaria begot Achitob;

fresh_translation: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Shallum,
brenton_translation: and Achitob begot Sadoc, and Sadoc begot Salom;

fresh_translation: and Shallum begot Chelkian, and Hilkiah begot Azariah,
brenton_translation: and Salom begot Chelcias, and Chelcias begot Azarias;

fresh_translation: and Azariah begot Seraiah, and Seraiah begot Jehozadak.
brenton_translation: and Azarias begot Saraia, and Saraias begot Josadac.

fresh_translation: And Jehozadak went away in the exile with Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
brenton_translation: And Josadac went into captivity with Juda and Jerusalem under Nabuchodonosor.

fresh_translation: Sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
brenton_translation: The sons of Levi: Gedson, Caath, and Merari.

fresh_translation: And these are names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimi.
brenton_translation: And these are the names of the sons of Gedson; Lobeni, and Semei.

fresh_translation: Sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
brenton_translation: The sons of Caath; Ambram, and Issaar, Chebron, and Oziel.

fresh_translation: Sons of Merari: Mahali and Mushi. And these are families of Levi according to their families.
brenton_translation: The sons of Merari; Mooli and Musi: and these are the families of Levi, according to their families.

fresh_translation: To Gershon: Libni his son, Ieeeth his son, Zemma his son,
brenton_translation: To Gedson—to Lobeni his son—were born Jeth his son, Zammath his son,

fresh_translation: Joab his son, Addi his son, Zerah his son, Jethri his son.
brenton_translation: Joab his son, Addi his son, Zara his son, Jethri his son.

fresh_translation: Sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Kore his son, Assir his son,
brenton_translation: The sons of Caath; Aminadab his son, Core his son, Aser his son;

fresh_translation: Elkanah his son, and Abiasaph his son, Assir his son,
brenton_translation: Helcana his son, Abisaph his son, Aser his son:

fresh_translation: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, Saul his son.
brenton_translation: Thaath his son, Uriel his son, Ozia his son, Saul his son.

fresh_translation: And sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Achimoth.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Helcana; Amessi, and Achimoth.

fresh_translation: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, and Naath his son,
brenton_translation: Helcana his son, Suphi his son, Cainaath his son;

fresh_translation: Eliab his son, Idaer his son, Elkanah his son.
brenton_translation: Eliab his son, Jeroboam his son, Helcana his son.

fresh_translation: Sons of Samuel: the firstborn Sani and Abijah.
brenton_translation: The sons of Samuel; the first-born Sani, and Abia.

fresh_translation: Sons of Merari: Mahali, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
brenton_translation: The sons of Merari; Mooli, Lobeni his son, Semei his son, Oza his son;

fresh_translation: Somea his son, Aggia his son, Asaiah his son.
brenton_translation: Samaa his son, Angia his son, Asaias his son.

fresh_translation: And these are whom David appointed by the hands of singers in the house of the Lord, when the ark came to rest.
brenton_translation: And these were the men whom David set over the service of the singers in the house of the Lord when the ark was at rest.

fresh_translation: And they were ministering before the tent of the house of testimony with instruments until Solomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, and they stood according to their judgment over their services.
brenton_translation: And they ministered in front of the tabernacle of witness playing on instruments, until Solomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem; and they stood according to their order for their services.

fresh_translation: And these are those standing, and their sons. From the sons of Kohath: Heman the singer, son of Joel son of Samuel,
brenton_translation: And these were the men that stood, and their sons, of the sons of Caath: Æman the psalm singer, son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

fresh_translation: son of Elkanah son of Edad son of Eliel son of Thie,
brenton_translation: the son of Helcana, the son of Jeroboam, the son of Eliel, the son of Thoas,

fresh_translation: son of Souph son of Elkanah son of Meth son of Amaziah,
brenton_translation: the son of Suph, the son of Helcana, the son of Maath, the son of Amathi,

fresh_translation: son of Elkanah son of Joel son of Azariah son of Saphania,
brenton_translation: the son of Helcana, the son of Joel, the son of Azarias, the son of Japhanias,

fresh_translation: son of Tahath son of Assir son of Abiasaph son of Kore,
brenton_translation: the son of Thaath, the son of Aser, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Core,

fresh_translation: son of Izhar son of Kohath son of Levi son of Israel.
brenton_translation: the son of Isaar, the son of Caath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

fresh_translation: And his brother Asaph stood at his right hand: Asaph son of Berechiah son of Shimea,
brenton_translation: And his brother Asaph, who stood at his right hand; Asaph the son of Barachias, the son of Samaa,

fresh_translation: son of Michael son of Amasai son of Malchijah,
brenton_translation: the son of Michael, the son of Baasia, the son of Melchia,

fresh_translation: son of Athani son of Zophai son of Nahath,
brenton_translation: the son of Athani, the son of Zaarai,

fresh_translation: son of Ethan son of Zamma son of Shimei,
brenton_translation: the son of Adai, the son of Ætham, the son of Zammam, the son of Semei,

fresh_translation: son of Echa son of Gershon son of Levi.
brenton_translation: the son of Jeeth, the son of Gedson, the son of Levi.

fresh_translation: And sons of Merari their brother at the left hand: Ethan son of Kisai son of Abdi son of Maloch,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Merari their brethren on the left hand: Ætham the son of Kisa, the son of Abai, the son of Maloch,

fresh_translation: son of Asebi son of Amessia son of Chelkiou,
brenton_translation: the son of Asebi,

fresh_translation: son of Amasai son of Bani son of Semmer,
brenton_translation: the son of Amessias, the son of Bani, the son of Semer,

fresh_translation: son of Mahali son of Mushi son of Merari son of Levi.
brenton_translation: the son of Mooli, the son of Musi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

fresh_translation: And their brothers according to the houses of their fathers, the Levites, were given for every work of service of the tent of the house of God.
brenton_translation: And their brethren according to the houses of their fathers, were the Levites who were appointed to all the work of ministration of the tabernacle of the house of God.

fresh_translation: And Aaron and his sons were burning incense upon the altar of the whole-burnt-offerings and upon the altar of incense for every work of the holy of holies and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses child of God commanded.
brenton_translation: And Aaron and his sons were to burn incense on the altar of whole-burnt-offerings, and on the altar of incense, for all the ministry in the holy of holies, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all things that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.

fresh_translation: And these are sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
brenton_translation: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinees his son, Abisu his son,

fresh_translation: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
brenton_translation: Bokki his son, Ozi his son, Saraia his son,

fresh_translation: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
brenton_translation: Mariel his son, Amaria his son, Achitob his son,

fresh_translation: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
brenton_translation: Sadoc his son, Achimaas his son.

fresh_translation: And these are their dwellings in their villages, in their borders, for the sons of Aaron, the family of the Kohathites, because to them came the lot.
brenton_translation: And these are their residences in their villages, in their coasts, to the sons of Aaron, to their family the Caathites: for they had the lot.

fresh_translation: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands.
brenton_translation: And they gave them Chebron in the land of Juda, and its suburbs round about it.

fresh_translation: And the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
brenton_translation: But the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Chaleb the son of Jephonne.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron and Libnah and its surrounding lands, and Selna and its surrounding lands, and Esthamo and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, even Chebron, and Lobna and her suburbs round about, and Selna and her suburbs, and Esthamo and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Ieththar and its surrounding lands, and Debir and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Jethar and her suburbs, and Dabir and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Ashan and its surrounding lands, and Attan and its surrounding lands, and Basamys and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Asan and her suburbs, and Bæthsamys and her suburbs:

fresh_translation: and from the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeah and its surrounding lands, and Alemeth and its surrounding lands, and Angoch and its surrounding lands. All their cities were thirteen cities according to their families.
brenton_translation: and of the tribe of Benjamin Gabai and her suburbs, and Galemath and her suburbs, and Anathoth and her suburbs: all their cities were thirteen cities according to their families.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Kohath, the rest, from the families, from the tribe, from the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Caath that were left of their families, there were given out of the tribe, namely, out of the half-tribe of Manasse, by lot, ten cities.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Gershon according to their families, from the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Gedson according to their families there were given thirteen cities of the tribe of Issachar, of the tribe of Aser, of the tribe of Nephthali, of the tribe of Manasse in Basan.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Merari according to their families, from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Gad, from the tribe of Zebulun, by lot, twelve cities.
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Merari according to their families there were given, by lot, twelve cities of the tribe of Ruben, of the tribe of Gad, and of the tribe of Zabulon.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: So the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their suburbs.

fresh_translation: And they gave by lot from the tribe of sons of Judah and from the tribe of sons of Simeon these cities which he called by name.
brenton_translation: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Juda, and out of the tribe of the children of Symeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which they call by name.

fresh_translation: And from the families of sons of Kohath were their border cities from the tribe of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And to the members of the families of the sons of Caath there were also given the cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And they gave to him the cities of refuge, Shechem and its surrounding lands in hill Ephraim, and Gezer and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: And they gave them the cities of refuge, Sychem and her suburbs in mount Ephraim, and Gazer and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Iekmaam and its surrounding lands, and Bethhoron and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Jecmaan and her suburbs, and Bæthoron and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Eglaim and its surrounding lands, and Gathrimmon and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Ælon and her suburbs, and Gethremmon and her suburbs:

fresh_translation: and from the half tribe of Manasseh, Anar and its surrounding lands, and Ibleam and its surrounding lands, according to family, to the rest of the sons of Kohath.
brenton_translation: and of the half-tribe of Manasse Anar and her suburbs, and Jemblaan and her suburbs, to the sons of Caath that were left, according to each several family.

fresh_translation: To the sons of Gershon, from the families of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan from Bashan and its surrounding lands, and Hazeroth and its surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: To the sons of Gedson from the families of the half-tribe of Manasse they gave Golan of Basan and her suburbs, and Aseroth and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: And from the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh and its surrounding lands, and Deberi and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedes and her suburbs, and Deberi and her suburbs, and Dabor and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Dabor and its surrounding lands, and Anam and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Ramoth, and Ænan and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: and from the tribe of Asher, Masal and its surrounding lands, and Abaran and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: And of the tribe of Aser; Maasal and her suburbs, and Abdon and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Ikak and its surrounding lands, and Rehob and its surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: and Acac and her suburbs, and Roob and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: And from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee and its surrounding lands, and Chamoth and its surrounding lands, and Kirjathaim and its surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: And of the tribe of Nephthali; Kedes in Galilee and her suburbs, and Chamoth and her suburbs, and Kariathaim and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: To the sons of Merari, the rest, from the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon and its surrounding lands, and Thachchia and its surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: To the sons of Merari that were left, they gave out of the tribe of Zabulon Remmon and her suburbs, and Thabor and her suburbs:

fresh_translation: And from beyond Jordan of Jericho, west of Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben, Besor in the wilderness and its surrounding lands, and Iasa and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: out of the country beyond Jordan; Jericho westward of Jordan: out of the tribe of Ruben; Bosor in the wilderness and her suburbs, and Jasa and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Kademoth and its surrounding lands, and Mephaath and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: and Kadmoth and her suburbs, and Maephla and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: and from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth Gilead and its surrounding lands, and Mahanaim and its surrounding lands,
brenton_translation: Out of the tribe of Gad; Rammoth Galaad and her suburbs, and Maanaim and her suburbs,

fresh_translation: and Heshbon and its surrounding lands, and Iazer and its surrounding lands.
brenton_translation: and Esebon and her suburbs, and Jazer and her suburbs.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Issachar: Tola and Puah and Jashub and Semeron, four.
brenton_translation: And as to the sons of Issachar, they were Thola, and Phua, and Jasub, and Semeron, four.

fresh_translation: And sons of Tola: Uzzi and Rephaiah and Jeriel and Iemou and Jibsam and Samuel, chiefs of houses of their fathers, to Tola, mighty men of power according to their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Thola; Ozi, Raphaia, and Jeriel, and Jamai, and Jemasan, and Samuel, chiefs of their fathers' houses belonging to Thola, men of might according to their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty and two thousand and six hundred.

fresh_translation: And sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. And sons of Izrahiah: Michael and Obadiah and Joel and Ishiah, five, all chiefs.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ozi; Jezraia: and the sons of Jezraia; Michael, Abdiu, and Joel, and Jesia, five, all rulers.

fresh_translation: And with them by their generations, by the houses of their fathers, mighty men to draw up for war, thirty-six thousand, because they multiplied wives and sons.
brenton_translation: And with them, according to their generations, according to the houses of their families, were men mighty to set armies in array for war, thirty and six thousand, for they had multiplied their wives and children.

fresh_translation: And their brothers in all families of Issachar, mighty in power, were eighty-seven thousand, the full number of them.
brenton_translation: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar, also mighty men, were eighty-seven thousand—this was the number of them all.

fresh_translation: Benjamin: Bela and Becher and Jediael, three.
brenton_translation: The sons of Benjamin; Bale, and Bachir, and Jediel, three.

fresh_translation: And sons of Bela: Ezbon and Uzzi and Uzziel and Jerimoth and Huri, five, chiefs of the houses of fathers, mighty men of power, and their number was twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Bale; Esebon, and Ozi, and Oziel, and Jerimuth, and Uri, five; heads of houses of families, mighty men; and their number was twenty and two thousand and thirty-four.

fresh_translation: And sons of Becher: Zamarias and Joash and Eliezer and Elioenai and Amariah and Jerimoth and Abijam and Anathoth and Gemeeth. All these were sons of Becher.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Bachir; Zemira, and Joas, and Eliezer, and Elithenan, and Amaria, and Jerimuth, and Abiud, and Anathoth, and Eleemeth: all these were the sons of Bachir.

fresh_translation: And their number by their generations, chiefs of houses of their fathers, mighty men of power, was twenty thousand two hundred.
brenton_translation: And their number according to their generations, (they were chiefs of their fathers' houses, men of might), was twenty thousand and two hundred.

fresh_translation: And sons of Jediael: Bilhan. And sons of Bilhan: Jeush and Benjamin and Aoth and Chenaanah and Zaithan and Ramessai and Achisaar.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jediel; Balaan: and the sons of Balaan; Jaüs, and Benjamin, and Aoth, and Chanana, and Zæthan, and Tharsi, and Achisaar.

fresh_translation: All these sons of Jediael, chiefs of fathers, mighty in power, were seventeen thousand two hundred, going out in force to make war.
brenton_translation: All these were the sons of Jediel, chiefs of their families, men of might, seventeen thousand and two hundred, going forth to war with might.

fresh_translation: And Sapphin and Apphin and sons of Ir: his son Aher.
brenton_translation: And Sapphin, and Apphin, and the sons of Or, Asom, whose son was Aor.

fresh_translation: Sons of Naphtali: Jahziel and Guni and Jezer and Shallum, sons of Bilhah.
brenton_translation: The sons of Nephthali; Jasiel, Goni, and Aser, and Sellum, his sons, Balam his son.

fresh_translation: Sons of Manasseh: Ashriel, whom his Syrian concubine bore. She bore Machir father of Gilead.
brenton_translation: The sons of Manasse; Esriel, whom his Syrian concubine bore; and she bore to him also Machir the father of Galaad.

fresh_translation: And Machir took a wife for Amphin and Maphin, and the name of his sister was Maachah, and the name of the second was Zelophehad, and daughters were born to Zelophehad.
brenton_translation: And Machir took a wife for Apphin and Sapphin, and his sister's name was Moöcha; and the name of the second son was Sapphaad; and to Sapphaad were born daughters.

fresh_translation: And Maachah wife of Machir bore a son and called his name Perez, and the name of his brother was Soros. His son was Ulam.
brenton_translation: And Moöcha the wife of Machir bore a son, and called his name Phares; and his brother's name was Surus; his sons were Ulam, and Rocom.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were sons of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ulam; Badam. These were the sons of Galaad, the son of Machir, the son of Manasse.

fresh_translation: And his sister Malecheth bore Ishod and Abiezer and Mahalah.
brenton_translation: And his sister Malecheth bore Isud, and Abiezer, and Maela.

fresh_translation: And sons of Semira were Iaaim and Shechem and Lakei and Aniam.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Semira were, Aim, and Sychem, and Lakim, and Anian.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ephraim: Sothala and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, Eladah his son, Nomee his son,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ephraim; Sothalath, and Barad his son, and Thaath his son, Elada his son, Saath his son,

fresh_translation: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead. And the men of Gath, those born in the land, killed them, because they went down to take their cattle.
brenton_translation: and Zabad his son, Sothele his son, and Azer, and Elead: and the men of Geth who were born in the land slew them, because they went down to take their cattle.

fresh_translation: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
brenton_translation: And their father Ephraim mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

fresh_translation: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Baraga, because he came in evils to my house.
brenton_translation: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he called his name Beria, because, said he, He was afflicted in my house.

fresh_translation: And his daughter Sherah built lower Bethhoron and upper Bethhoron and Uzzensherah.
brenton_translation: And his daughter was Saraa, and he was among them that were left, and he built Bæthoron the upper and the lower. And the descendants of Ozan were Seera,

fresh_translation: And Rephah his son, Resheph, and Thale his son, Tahan his son,
brenton_translation: and Raphe his son, Saraph and Thalees his sons, Thaen his son.

fresh_translation: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
brenton_translation: To Laadan his son was born his son Amiud, his son Helisamai, his son

fresh_translation: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.
brenton_translation: Nun, his son Jesue, these were his sons.

fresh_translation: And their possession and their dwelling were Bethel and its villages, eastward Naaran, westward Gezer and its villages, and Shechem and its villages as far as Gaza and its villages.
brenton_translation: And their possession and their dwelling were Bæthel and her towns, to the east Noaran, westward Gazer and her towns, and Sychem and her towns, as far as Gaza and her towns.

fresh_translation: And to the borders of the sons of Manasseh: Baithsaan and its villages, Taanach and its villages, Balad and its villages, Megiddo and its villages, Dor and its villages. In these dwelt the sons of Joseph son of Israel.
brenton_translation: And as far as the borders of the sons of Manasse, Bæthsaan and her towns, Thanach and her towns, Mageddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In this the children of Joseph the son of Israel dwelt.

fresh_translation: Sons of Asher: Imnah and Isoua and Isoui and Beriah and Sore their sister.
brenton_translation: The sons of Aser; Jemna, and Suia, and Isui, and Beria, and Sore their sister.

fresh_translation: And sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, this one father of Berzaith.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Beria; Chaber, and Melchiel; he was the father of Berthaith.

fresh_translation: And Heber begot Japhlet and Shomer and Hotham and Shua their sister.
brenton_translation: And Chaber begot Japhlet, and Samer, and Chothan, and Sola their sister.

fresh_translation: And sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Asith. These were sons of Japhlet.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Japhlet; Phasec, and Bamael, and Asith: these are the sons of Japhlet.

fresh_translation: And sons of Shamer: Achiouraoga and Oba and Aram.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Semmer; Achir, and Rooga, and Jaba, and Aram.

fresh_translation: And sons of Helem his brother: Zophah and Imana and Selles and Amal.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Elam his brother; Sopha, and Imana, and Selles, and Amal.

fresh_translation: Sons of Zophah: Chouchi, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, and Imrah,
brenton_translation: The sons of Sopha; Sue, and Arnaphar, and Suda, and Barin, and Imran,

fresh_translation: Shobal and Hod and Semma and Salisa and Ithran and Beera.
brenton_translation: and Basan, and Oa, and Sama, and Salisa, and Jethra, and Beëra.

fresh_translation: And sons of Jether: Iphina and Phaspha and Ara.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Jether, Jephina, and Phaspha, and Ara.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rezia.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ola; Orech, Aniel, and Rasia.

fresh_translation: All these were sons of Asher, all chiefs of fathers, chosen mighty men of power, leading chiefs. Their number for drawing up battle was twenty-six thousand men.
brenton_translation: All these were the sons of Aser, all heads of families, choice, mighty men, chief leaders: their number for battle array—their number was twenty-six thousand men.

fresh_translation: And Benjamin begot Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
brenton_translation: Now Benjamin begot Bale his first-born, and Asbel his second son, Aara the third, Noa the fourth,

fresh_translation: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
brenton_translation: and Rapha the fifth.

fresh_translation: And there were sons to Bela: Hadad and Gera and Abihu,
brenton_translation: And the sons of Bale were, Adir, and Gera, and Abiud,

fresh_translation: and Abishua and Naaman and Ahijah,
brenton_translation: and Abessue, and Noama, and Achia,

fresh_translation: and Gera and Shephuphan and Oim.
brenton_translation: and Gera, and Sephupham, and Uram.

fresh_translation: These are sons of Ohad. These are chiefs of fathers for those dwelling in Gibeah, and they deported them to Manahethites,
brenton_translation: These were the sons of Aod: these are the heads of families to them that dwell in Gabee, and they removed them to Machanathi:

fresh_translation: and Naaman and Ahijah and Gera. This one begot Naana and Ahihud.
brenton_translation: and Nooma, and Achia and Gera, he removed them, and he begot Aza, and Jachicho.

fresh_translation: And Saarim begot in the plain of Moab after sending away Hushim and Baara his wives.
brenton_translation: And Saarin begot children in the plain of Moab, after that he had sent away Osin and Baada his wives.

fresh_translation: And by Adah his wife he begot Jobab and Sebia and Mesha and Malcham,
brenton_translation: And he begot of his wife Ada, Jolab, and Sebia, and Misa, and Melchas,

fresh_translation: and Iaos and Shachia and Marma. These were chiefs of fathers.
brenton_translation: and Jebus, and Zabia, and Marma: these were heads of families.

fresh_translation: And from Hushim he begot Abitub and Elpaal.
brenton_translation: And of Osin he begot Abitol, and Alphaal.

fresh_translation: And sons of Elpaal: Obed, Misham, Shamed. This one built Ono and Lod and its villages.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Alphaal; Obed, Misaal, Semmer: he built Ona, and Lod, and its towns:

fresh_translation: And Beriah and Shammah, these were chiefs of fathers for those dwelling in Aijalon, and these drove out those dwelling in Gath.
brenton_translation: and Beria, and Sama; these were heads of families among the dwellers in Elam, and they drove out the inhabitants of Geth.

fresh_translation: And his brother Shashak and Jeremoth,
brenton_translation: And his brethren were Sosec, and Arimoth,

fresh_translation: and Zebadiah and Orer and Oded,
brenton_translation: and Zabadia, and Ored, and Eder,

fresh_translation: and Michael and Ispah and Joha, sons of Beriah,
brenton_translation: and Michael, and Jespha, and Joda, the sons of Beria:

fresh_translation: and Zebadiah and Meshullam and Azaki and Abar,
brenton_translation: and Zabadia, and Mosollam, and Azaki, and Abar,

fresh_translation: and Ishmerai and Iezlia and Jobab, sons of Elpaal,
brenton_translation: and Isamari, and Jexlias, and Jobab, the sons of Elphaal:

fresh_translation: and Jakim and Zichri and Zabdi,
brenton_translation: and Jakim, and Zachri, and Zabdi,

fresh_translation: and Elienai and Zilthai and Eliel,
brenton_translation: and Elionai, and Salathi,

fresh_translation: and Adaiah and Beraiah and Shimrath, sons of Shammai,
brenton_translation: and Elieli, and Adaia, and Baraia, and Samarath, sons of Samaith:

fresh_translation: and Ishpan and Obed and Eliel,
brenton_translation: and Jesphan, and Obed, and Eliel,

fresh_translation: and Abdon and Zichri and Anan,
brenton_translation: and Abdon, and Zechri, and Anan,

fresh_translation: and Hananiah and Omri and Elam and Antothijah,
brenton_translation: and Anania, and Ambri, and Ælam, and Anathoth,

fresh_translation: and Athin and Iepheria and Penuel, sons of Shashak,
brenton_translation: and Jathin, and Jephadias, and Phanuel, the sons of Sosec:

fresh_translation: and Shamsherai and Shehariah and Athaliah,
brenton_translation: and Samsari, and Saarias, and Gotholia,

fresh_translation: and Jaresiah and Eliah and Zichri, sons of Jeroham.
brenton_translation: and Jarasia, and Eria, and Zechri, son of Iroam.

fresh_translation: These were chiefs of fathers according to their generations, chiefs. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: These were heads of families, chiefs according to their generations: these dwelt in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And in Gibeon dwelt father of Gibeon, and the name of his wife was Maachah.
brenton_translation: And the father of Gabaon dwelt in Gabaon; and his wife's name was Moacha.

fresh_translation: And her firstborn son was Abdon, and Shur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab,
brenton_translation: And her first-born son was Abdon, and Sur, and Kis, and Baal, and Nadab, and Ner,

fresh_translation: and Gedor and his brother and Ahio and Mikloth.
brenton_translation: and Gedur and his brother, and Zacchur, and Makeloth.

fresh_translation: And Mikloth begot Shema, and these also dwelt opposite their brothers in Jerusalem with their brothers.
brenton_translation: And Makeloth begot Samaa: for these dwelt in Jerusalem in the presence of their brethren with their brethren.

fresh_translation: And Ner begot Kish, and Kish begot Saul, and Saul begot Jonathan and Melchishua and Amminadab and Eshbaal.
brenton_translation: And Ner begot Kis, and Kis begot Saul, and Saul begot Jonathan, and Melchisue, and Aminadab, and Asabal.

fresh_translation: And sons of Jonathan: Meribbaal. And Meribbaal begot Micah.
brenton_translation: And the son of Jonathan was Meribaal; and Meribaal begot Micha.

fresh_translation: And sons of Micah: Pithon and Malchiel and Tarea and Ahaz.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Micha; Phithon, and Melach, and Tharach, and Achaz.

fresh_translation: And Ahaz begot Jehoadah, and Jehoadah begot Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri begot Moza.
brenton_translation: And Achaz begot Jada, and Jada begot Salæmath, and Asmoth, and Zambri; and Zambri begot Mæsa;

fresh_translation: And Moza begot Baana, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
brenton_translation: and Mæsa begot Baana: Rhaphæa, was his son, Elasa his son, Esel his son.

fresh_translation: And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam his firstborn, and Ishmael and Seraiah and Obadiah and Anan. All these were sons of Azel.
brenton_translation: And Esel had six sons, and these were their names; Ezricam his first-born, and Ismael, and Saraia, and Abdia, and Anan, and Asa: all these were the sons of Esel.

fresh_translation: And sons of Asel his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Iais the second, Eliphelet the third.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Asel his brother; Ælam his first-born, and Jas the second, and Eliphalet the third.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ulam were mighty men of power, drawing bow, multiplying sons and sons of sons, a hundred fifty. All these were from the sons of Benjamin.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Ælam were mighty men, bending the bow, and multiplying sons and grandsons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And all Israel, their enrollment, and these are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, with those deported to Babylon in their lawlessness.
brenton_translation: And this is all Israel, even their enrolment: and these are written down in the book of the kings of Israel and Juda, with the names of them that were carried away to Babylon for their transgressions.

fresh_translation: And those dwelling first in their possessions in the cities of Israel were the priests, the Levites, and the given ones.
brenton_translation: And they that dwelt before in their possessions in the cities of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the appointed ones.

fresh_translation: And in Jerusalem dwelt from the sons of Judah and from the sons of Benjamin and from the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh,
brenton_translation: And there dwelt in Jerusalem some of the children of Juda, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasse.

fresh_translation: Gouthi son of Ammihud son of Amri, of the sons of Perez son of Judah.
brenton_translation: And Gnothi, and the son of Samiud, the son of Amri, the son of Ambraim, the son of Buni, son of the sons of Phares, the son of Juda.

fresh_translation: And from the Shilonites: Asaiah his firstborn and his sons.
brenton_translation: And of the Selonites; Asaia his first-born, and his sons.

fresh_translation: From the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Zara; Jeel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam son of Hodaiah son of Senaah,
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Benjamin; Salom, son of Mosollam, son of Odouia, son of Asinu.

fresh_translation: and Ibanaa son of Jeroham, and these sons of Uzzi son of Machir, and Meshullam son of Shephatiah son of Reuel son of Benaiah,
brenton_translation: And Jemnaa son of Jeroboam, and Elo: these are the sons of Ozi the son of Machir: and Mosollam, son of Saphatia, son of Raguel, son of Jemnai;

fresh_translation: and their brothers by their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All the men were chiefs of fathers by the houses of their fathers.
brenton_translation: and their brethren according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six, all the men were heads of families according to the houses of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And from the priests: Jedaiah and Jehoiarib and Jachin,
brenton_translation: And of the priests; Jodaë, and Joarim, and Jachin,

fresh_translation: and Azariah son of Hilkiah son of Meshullam son of Zadok son of Meraioth son of Ahitub, ruler of the house of God,
brenton_translation: and Azaria the son of Chelcias, the son of Mosollam, the son of Sadoc, the son of Maraïoth, the son of Achitob, the ruler of the house of God;

fresh_translation: and Adaiah son of Jeroham son of Pashur son of Malchijah, and Amasai son of Adiel son of Jahzerah son of Meshullam son of Maselmoth son of Immer,
brenton_translation: and Adaia son of Iraam, son of Phascor, son of Melchia, and Maasaia son of Adiel, son of Ezira, son of Mosollam, son of Maselmoth, son of Emmer;

fresh_translation: and their brothers, chiefs of the houses of fathers, one thousand seven hundred sixty, mighty in strength for the work of service of the house of God.
brenton_translation: and their brethren, chiefs of their families, a thousand seven hundred and sixty, mighty men for the work of the ministration of the house of God.

fresh_translation: And from the Levites: Shemaiah son of Asob son of Azrikam son of Hashabiah, from the sons of Merari,
brenton_translation: And of the Levites; Samaia son of Asob, son of Ezricam, son of Asabia, of the sons of Merari.

fresh_translation: and Bakbakar and Heresh and Galal and Mattaniah son of Micah son of Zichri son of Asaph,
brenton_translation: And Bacbacar, and Ares, and Galaal, and Matthanias son of Micha, son of Zechri, son of Asaph;

fresh_translation: and Obadiah son of Shemaiah son of Galal son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah son of Asa son of Elkanah, the one dwelling in the villages of the Netophathites.
brenton_translation: and Abdia, son of Samia, son of Galaal, son of Idithun, and Barachia son of Ossa, son of Helcana—who dwelt in the villages of the Notephatites.

fresh_translation: The gatekeepers: Shallum and Akkub and Talman and Heman and their brothers. Shallum the chief.
brenton_translation: The door-keepers; Salom, Acum, Telmon, and Diman, and their brethren; Salom was the chief;

fresh_translation: And until this day at the king's gate eastward, these were the gates of the encampments of the sons of Levi.
brenton_translation: and he waited hitherto in the king's gate eastward: these are the gates of the companies of the sons of Levi.

fresh_translation: And Shallum son of Kore son of Abiasaph son of Kore, and his brothers to the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the works of the service, guarding the guards of the tent, and their fathers were over the encampment of the Lord, guarding the entrance.
brenton_translation: And Sellum the son of Core, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Core, and his brethren belonging to the house of his father, the Corites were over the works of the service, keeping the watches of the tabernacle, and their fathers over the camp of the Lord, keeping the entrance.

fresh_translation: And Phinehas son of Eleazar was ruler over them before, and these were with him.
brenton_translation: And Phinees son of Eleazar was head over them before the Lord, and these were with him.

fresh_translation: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper of the door of the tent of testimony.
brenton_translation: Zacharias the son of Mosollami was keeper of the door of the tabernacle of witness.

fresh_translation: All the chosen ones at the gates in the gates were two hundred twelve. These in their courts: their enrollment. David and Samuel the seer established them in their faithfulness.
brenton_translation: All the chosen porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve, these were in their courts, this was their distribution: these David and Samuel the seer established in their charge.

fresh_translation: And these and their sons were over the gates in the house of the Lord, in the house of the tent, to guard.
brenton_translation: And these and their sons were over the gates in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the tabernacle, to keep watch.

fresh_translation: To the four winds were the gates: east, west, north, south.
brenton_translation: The gates were toward the four winds, eastward, westward, northward, southward.

fresh_translation: And their brothers in their courts were to enter every seven days from time to time with them.
brenton_translation: And their brethren were in their courts, to enter in weekly from time to time with these.

fresh_translation: Because in faithfulness there were four mighty gatekeepers. The Levites were over the storerooms and over the treasuries of the house of God.
brenton_translation: For four strong men have the charge of the gates; and the Levites were over the chambers, and they keep watch over the treasures of the house of God.

fresh_translation: And around the house of God they encamped, because the guard was upon them, and they were over the keys, to open the doors of the sanctuary morning by morning.
brenton_translation: For the charge was upon them, and these were charged with the keys to open the doors of the temple every morning.

fresh_translation: And from them some were over the vessels of the service, because by number they bring them in and by number they bring them out.
brenton_translation: And some of them were appointed over the vessels of service, that they should carry them in by number, and carry them out by number.

fresh_translation: And from them some were appointed over the vessels and over all the holy vessels and over the fine flour and the wine and the oil and the frankincense and the spices.
brenton_translation: And some of them were appointed over the furniture, and over all the holy vessels, and over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of the priests were mixers of the ointment and of the spices.
brenton_translation: And some of the priests were makers of the ointment, and appointed to prepare the spices.

fresh_translation: And Mattithiah from the Levites, this one firstborn to Shallum the Korahite, in faithfulness over the works of the pan of the high priest.
brenton_translation: And Matthathias of the Levites, (he was the first-born of Salom the Corite,) was set in charge over the sacrifices of meat-offering of the pan belonging to the high priest.

fresh_translation: And Benaiah the Kohathite, from their brothers, was over the bread of presentation, to prepare it Sabbath by Sabbath.
brenton_translation: And Banaias the Caathite, from among their brethren, was set over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

fresh_translation: And these were singers, chiefs of fathers of the Levites, appointed by courses, because day and night the works were upon them.
brenton_translation: And these were the singers, heads of families of the Levites, to whom were established daily courses, for they were employed in the services day and night.

fresh_translation: These were chiefs of fathers of the Levites according to their generations, chiefs. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: These were the heads of the families of the Levites according to their generations; these chiefs dwelt in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And in Gibeon dwelt father of Gibeon, Jehiel, and the name of his wife was Maachah.
brenton_translation: And Jeël the father of Gabaon dwelt in Gabaon; and his wife's name was Moöcha.

fresh_translation: And her firstborn son was Abdon, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab,
brenton_translation: And his first-born son was Abdon, and he had Sur, and Kis, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

fresh_translation: and Gedor and his brother and Zechariah and Mikloth.
brenton_translation: and Gedur and his brother, and Zacchur, and Makeloth.

fresh_translation: And Mikloth begot Shimeam. And these also dwelt in Jerusalem in the midst of their brothers with their brothers.
brenton_translation: And Makeloth begot Samaa: and these dwelt in the midst of their brethren in Jerusalem, even in the midst of their brethren.

fresh_translation: And Ner begot Kish, and Kish begot Saul, and Saul begot Jonathan and Melchishua and Amminadab and Eshbaal.
brenton_translation: And Ner begot Kis, and Kis begot Saul, and Saul begot Jonathan, and Melchisue, and Aminadab, and Asabal.

fresh_translation: And son of Jonathan was Meribbaal, and Meribbaal begot Micah.
brenton_translation: And the son of Jonathan was Meribaal: and Meribaal begot Micha.

fresh_translation: And sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tahrea.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Micha were Phithon and Malach, and Tharach.

fresh_translation: And Ahaz begot Jehoaddah, and Jehoaddah begot Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri begot Moza.
brenton_translation: And Achaz begot Jada: and Jada begot Galemeth, and Gazmoth, and Zambri; and Zambri begot Massa.

fresh_translation: And Moza begot Baana, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
brenton_translation: And Massa begot Baana, and Rhaphaïa was his son, Elasa his son, Esel his son.

fresh_translation: And Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam his firstborn, Ishmael and Saria and Obadiah and Anan. These were sons of Azel.
brenton_translation: And Esel had six sons, and these were their names; Esricam his first-born, and Ismael, and Saraia, and Abdia, and Anan, and Asa: these were the sons of Esel.

fresh_translation: And Philistines fought against Israel, and Israel fled from before Philistines, and wounded men fell on Mount Gilboa.
brenton_translation: Now the Philistines warred against Israel; and they fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gelbue.

fresh_translation: And Philistines pursued after Saul and after his sons, and Philistines struck Jonathan and Amminadab and Melchishua, sons of Saul.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines pursued after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines smote Jonathan, and Aminadab, and Melchisue, sons of Saul.

fresh_translation: And battle grew heavy against Saul, and archers found him with bows, and he was pained from arrows.
brenton_translation: And the battle prevailed against Saul, and the archers hit him with bows and arrows, and they were wounded of the bows.

fresh_translation: And Saul said to one carrying his weapons, Draw your sword and pierce me with it, lest these uncircumcised come and mock me. But one carrying his weapons would not, because he feared greatly. And Saul took sword and fell upon it.
brenton_translation: And Saul said to his armour-bearer, Draw thy sword, and pierce me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and mock me. But his armour-bearer would not, for he was greatly afraid: so Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

fresh_translation: And one carrying his weapons saw that Saul had died, and he too fell upon his sword and died.
brenton_translation: And his armour-bearer saw that Saul was dead, and he also fell upon his sword.

fresh_translation: And Saul died, and his three sons died on that day, and all his house died together.
brenton_translation: So Saul died, and his three sons on that day, and all his family died at the same time.

fresh_translation: And every man of Israel in valley saw that Israel fled and that Saul and his sons had died, and they left their cities and fled, and Philistines came and lived in them.
brenton_translation: And all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, and they left their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass on next day, and Philistines came to strip slain men, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the next day that the Philistines came to strip the slain, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on mount Gelbue.

fresh_translation: And they stripped him and took his head and his weapons, and sent into the land of Philistines all around to proclaim good news to their idols and to people.
brenton_translation: And they stripped him, and took his head, and his armour, and sent them into the land of the Philistines round about, to proclaim the glad tidings to their idols, and to the people.

fresh_translation: And they put his weapons in the house of their god, and they put his head in the house of Dagon.
brenton_translation: And they put their armour in the house of their god, and they put his head in the house of Dagon.

fresh_translation: And all dwelling in Gilead heard all that Philistines had done to Saul and to Israel.
brenton_translation: And all the dwellers in Galaad heard of all that the Philistines had done to Saul and to Israel.

fresh_translation: And every mighty man from Gilead rose and took body of Saul and bodies of his sons and brought them to Jabesh, and they buried their bones under oak in Jabesh and fasted seven days.
brenton_translation: And all the mighty men rose up from Galaad, and they took the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabis, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabis, and fasted seven days.

fresh_translation: And Saul died in his lawless deeds which he committed lawlessly against the Lord, against the word of the Lord, because he did not keep it, because Saul inquired through ventriloquist to seek, and Samuel prophet answered him.
brenton_translation: So Saul died for his transgressions, wherein he transgressed against God, against the word of the Lord, forasmuch as he kept it not, because Saul enquired of a wizard to seek counsel, and Samuel the prophet answered him:

fresh_translation: And he did not seek the Lord, and he put him to death and turned kingdom to David son of Jesse.
brenton_translation: and he sought not the Lord: so he slew him, and turned the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.

fresh_translation: And all Israel came to David in Hebron, saying, Behold, we are your bones and your flesh.
brenton_translation: And all Israel came to David in Chebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bones and thy flesh.

fresh_translation: Even yesterday and third day, when Saul was king, you were one bringing Israel out and bringing it in, and the Lord your God said to you, You shall shepherd my people Israel, and you shall be ruler over Israel.
brenton_translation: And heretofore when Saul was king, thou wast he that led Israel in and out, and the Lord of Israel said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be for a ruler over Israel.

fresh_translation: And all the elders of Israel came to the king in Hebron, and King David made covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord, and they anointed David king over Israel according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Samuel.
brenton_translation: And all the elders of Israel came to the king to Chebron; and king David made a covenant with them in Chebron before the Lord: and they anointed David to be king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.

fresh_translation: And the king and men of Israel went to Jerusalem, this is Jebus, and there were Jebusites dwelling in the land.
brenton_translation: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem, this is Jebus; and there the Jebusites the inhabitants of the land said to David,

fresh_translation: And those dwelling in Jebus said to David, You shall not enter here. But he captured stronghold of Zion; this is the City of David.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not enter in hither. But he took the strong hold of Sion: this is the city of David.

fresh_translation: And David said, Whoever strikes Jebusite first shall become ruler and commander. And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first and became ruler.
brenton_translation: And David said, Whoever first smites the Jebusite, even he shall be chief and captain. And Joab the son of Saruia went up first, and became chief.

fresh_translation: And David settled in stronghold; therefore he called it the City of David.
brenton_translation: And David dwelt in the strong hold; therefore he called it the city of David.

fresh_translation: And he built the city all around and fought and took the city.
brenton_translation: And he fortified the city round about.

fresh_translation: And David kept going, going and growing great, and the Lord Almighty was with him.
brenton_translation: And David continued to increase, and the Lord Almighty was with him.

fresh_translation: And these were chiefs of mighty men who belonged to David, those prevailing with him in his kingdom with all Israel to make him king according to the word of the Lord over Israel.
brenton_translation: And these are the chiefs of the mighty men, whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.

fresh_translation: And this was the number of mighty men of David: Jashobeam son of Hachmoni, first of thirty; he drew his sword once against three hundred wounded men at one time.
brenton_translation: And this is the list of the mighty men of David; Jesebada, son of Achaman, first of the thirty: he drew his sword once against three hundred whom he slew at one time.

fresh_translation: And after him Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite; he was among three mighty men.
brenton_translation: And after him Eleazar son of Dodai, the Achochite: he was among the three mighty men.

fresh_translation: He was with David in Phasodomin, and Philistines gathered there for battle, and there was a portion of field full of barley, and people fled from before Philistines.
brenton_translation: He was with David in Phasodamin, and the Philistines were gathered there to battle, and there was a portion of the field full of barley; and the people fled before the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And he stood in the middle of the portion and saved it and struck Philistines, and the Lord made great deliverance.
brenton_translation: And he stood in the midst of the portion, and rescued it, and smote the Philistines; and the Lord wrought a great deliverance.

fresh_translation: And three from thirty chiefs went down to rock, to David, into the cave of Adullam, and the camp of the Philistines had camped in the valley of giants.
brenton_translation: And three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David, to the cave of Odollam, and the camp of the Philistines was in the giants' valley.

fresh_translation: And David was then in stronghold, and garrison of Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
brenton_translation: And David was then in the hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethleem.

fresh_translation: And David desired and said, Who will give me water to drink from cistern of Bethlehem, one by gate?
brenton_translation: And David longed, and said, Who will give me water to drink of the well of Bethleem, that is in the gate?

fresh_translation: And three broke through the camp of the Philistines and drew water from cistern in Bethlehem, which was by gate, and took it and came to David. But David would not drink it, and he poured it out to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the three broke through the camp of the Philistines, and they drew water out of the well that was in Bethleem, which was in the gate, and they took it, and came to David: but David would not drink it, and poured it out to the Lord, and said,

fresh_translation: And he said, God be merciful to me from doing this thing. Shall I drink blood of these men with their lives? For with their lives they brought it. And he would not drink it. These things three mighty men did.
brenton_translation: God forbid that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men with their lives? for with the peril of their lives they brought it. So he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.

fresh_translation: And Abishai brother of Joab, he was chief of the three. He drew his sword against three hundred wounded men at one time, and he was named among three.
brenton_translation: And Abisa the brother of Joab, he was chief of three: he drew his sword against three hundred slain at one time, and he had a name among the second three.

fresh_translation: Of three he was more glorious than two, and he was their ruler, but he did not attain to three.
brenton_translation: He was more famous than the two others of the three, and he was chief over them; yet he reached not to the first three.

fresh_translation: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada, son of mighty man, his deeds were many, above Kabasael. He struck two sons of Ariel of Moab, and he went down and struck lion in pit on snowy day.
brenton_translation: And Banaia the son of Jodae was the son of a mighty man: many were his acts for Cabasael: he smote two lion-like men of Moab, and he went down and smote a lion in a pit on a snowy day.

fresh_translation: And he struck Egyptian man, visible man, five cubits tall, and in the hand of Egyptian was spear like a beam of weavers, and Benaiah went down against him with staff and took spear from the hand of Egyptian and killed him with his own spear.
brenton_translation: And he smote an Egyptian, a wonderful man five cubits high; and in the hand of the Egyptian there was a spear like a weavers' beam; and Banaia went down to him with a staff, and took the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

fresh_translation: These things Benaiah son of Jehoiada did, and to him was name among three mighty men.
brenton_translation: These things did Banaia son of Jodae, and his name was among the three mighties.

fresh_translation: He was glorious above thirty, but he did not attain to three, and David set him over his family.
brenton_translation: He was distinguished beyond the thirty, yet he reached not to the first three: and David set him over his family.

fresh_translation: And mighty men of forces: Asahel brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem,
brenton_translation: And the mighty men of the forces were, Asael the brother of Joab, Eleanan the son of Dodoe of Bethleem,

fresh_translation: Shammoth the Adi, Helez the Pelonite,
brenton_translation: Samaoth the Arorite, Chelles the Phelonite,

fresh_translation: Ira son of Ikkesh the Thekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
brenton_translation: Ora the son of Ekkis the Thecoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

fresh_translation: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Eli the Ahohite,
brenton_translation: Sobochai the Usathite, Eli the Achonite,

fresh_translation: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Nooza the Netophathite,
brenton_translation: Marai the Netophathite, Chthaod the son of Nooza the Netophathite,

fresh_translation: Ithai son of Ribai from the hill of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
brenton_translation: Airi the son of Rebie of the hill of Benjamin, Banaias the Pharathonite,

fresh_translation: Huri from Gaash, Abiel the Garabeththite,
brenton_translation: Uri of Nachali Gaas, Abiel the Garabæthite,

fresh_translation: Azmaveth the Beermi, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
brenton_translation: Azbon the Baromite, Eliaba the Salabonite,

fresh_translation: Bennaias, Hosom the Gennounite, Jonathan son of Sola the Hararite,
brenton_translation: the son of Asam the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Sola the Ararite,

fresh_translation: Achim son of Sachar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Our,
brenton_translation: Achim the son of Achar the Ararite, Elphat the son of Thyrophar

fresh_translation: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
brenton_translation: the Mechorathrite, Achia the Phellonite,

fresh_translation: Heserai the Carmelite, Naarai son of Azobai,
brenton_translation: Esere the Charmadaite, Naarai the son of Azobai,

fresh_translation: Joel brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Haggeri,
brenton_translation: Joel the son of Nathan, Mebaal son of Agari,

fresh_translation: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahor the Berthite, carrier of weapons of Joab son of Zeruiah,
brenton_translation: Sele the son of Ammoni, Nachor the Berothite, armour-bearer to the son of Saruia,

fresh_translation: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
brenton_translation: Ira the Jethrite, Gaber the Jethrite,

fresh_translation: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,
brenton_translation: Uria the Chettite, Zabet son of Achaia,

fresh_translation: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, ruler, and with him thirty,
brenton_translation: Adina son of Sæza, a chief of Ruben, and thirty with him,

fresh_translation: Anan son of Maachah, and Jehoshaphat the Mithnite,
brenton_translation: Anan the son of Moöcha, and Josaphat the Matthanite,

fresh_translation: Uzziah the Astarothite, Shammah and Jehiel sons of Chothan the Hararite,
brenton_translation: Ozia the Astarothite, Samatha and Jeiel sons of Chotham the Ararite,

fresh_translation: Jahdiel son of Shimri and Ioazae his brother the Ieasite,
brenton_translation: Jediel the son of Sameri, and Jozae his brother the Thosaite,

fresh_translation: Eliel the Mii, and Iaribi, and Joshah son of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
brenton_translation: Eliel the Maoite, and Jaribi, and Josia his son, Ellaam, and Jethama the Moabite,

fresh_translation: Eliel and Obed and Jasiel the Misabian.
brenton_translation: Daliel, and Obeth, and Jessiel of Mesobia.

fresh_translation: And these were those who came to David in Ziklag, while he was still shut in away from before Saul son of Kish, and these were among mighty men helping in war,
brenton_translation: And these are they that came to Sikelag, when he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kis; and these were among the mighty, aiding him in war,

fresh_translation: with bow in right hand and in left hand, slingers with stones and arrows, from the brothers of Saul, from Benjamin.
brenton_translation: and using the bow with the right hand and with the left, and slingers with stones, and shooters with bows. Of the brethren of Saul of Benjamin,

fresh_translation: Chief was Ahiezer and Joash son of Asma the Gebothite, and Joel and Iophalet sons of Azmaveth, and Berachah, and Jeziel the Anathothite,
brenton_translation: the chief was Achiezer, and Joas son of Asma the Gabathite, and Joel and Jophalet, sons of Asmoth, and Berchia, and Jeul of Anathoth,

fresh_translation: and Shemaiah the Gabaonite, mighty among thirty and over thirty,
brenton_translation: and Samaias the Gabaonite a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty;

fresh_translation: Jeremiah and Jeziel and Johanan and Jozabad the Gadarathite,
brenton_translation: and Jeremia, and Jeziel, and Joanan, and Jozabath of Gadarathiim,

fresh_translation: Eluzai and Jerimoth and Bealiah and Samaria and Shephatiah the Korhites,
brenton_translation: Azai and Arimuth, and Baalia, and Samaraia, and Saphatias of Charæphiel,

fresh_translation: Elkanah and Jesiah and Azareel and Joezer and Jashobeam the Korahites,
brenton_translation: Helcana, and Jesuni, and Ozriel, and Jozara, and Sobocam, and the Corites,

fresh_translation: and Eliah and Zebadiah sons of Jeroham, sons of Gedor.
brenton_translation: and Jelia and Zabadia, sons of Iroam, and the men of Gedor.

fresh_translation: And from Gadites men separated themselves to David from the wilderness, mighty men, men of battle line for war, carrying shields and spears, and their faces were lion faces, and they were swift as gazelles on mountains.
brenton_translation: And from Gad these separated themselves to David from the wilderness, strong mighty men of war, bearing shields and spears, and their faces were as the face of a lion, and they were nimble as roes upon the mountains in speed.

fresh_translation: Azer chief, Obadiah second, Eliab third,
brenton_translation: Aza the chief, Abdia the second, Eliab the third,

fresh_translation: Mishmannah fourth, Jeremiah fifth,
brenton_translation: Masmana the fourth, Jeremias the fifth,

fresh_translation: Ithai sixth, Eliab seventh,
brenton_translation: Jethi the sixth, Eliab the seventh,

fresh_translation: Johanan eighth, Eliazer ninth,
brenton_translation: Joanan the eighth, Eleazer the ninth,

fresh_translation: Jeremiah tenth, Machabannai eleventh.
brenton_translation: Jeremia the tenth, Melchabanai the eleventh.

fresh_translation: These from the sons of Gad were chiefs of army; least one was over hundred, and greatest over thousand.
brenton_translation: These were chiefs of the army of the sons of Gad, the least one commander of a hundred, and the greatest one of a thousand.

fresh_translation: These crossed Jordan in the first month, when it was filled over all its banks, and they drove out all dwelling in valleys from east to west.
brenton_translation: These are the men that crossed over Jordan in the first month, and it had overflowed all its banks; and they drove out all the inhabitants of the valleys, from the east to the west.

fresh_translation: And some from the sons of Benjamin and Judah came for help to David.
brenton_translation: And there came some of the sons of Benjamin and Juda to the assistance of David.

fresh_translation: And David went out to meet them and said to them, If you have come to me in peace, let my heart be united with you; but if to betray me to my enemies, though no truth of hand is against me, may God of our fathers see and rebuke.
