brenton_translation: And David went out to meet them, and said to them, If ye are come peaceably to me, let my heart be at peace with you: but if ye are come to betray me to my enemies unfaithfully, the God of your fathers look upon it, and reprove it.

fresh_translation: And spirit clothed Amasai, chief of thirty, and he said, Go, and your people, David son of Jesse. Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, because your God has helped you. And David received them and set them as chiefs of forces.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit came upon Amasai, a captain of the thirty, and he said, Go, David, son of Jesse, thou and thy people, peace, peace be to thee, and peace to thy helpers, for thy God has helped thee. And David received them, and made them captains of the forces.

fresh_translation: And from Manasseh some joined David when Philistines came against Saul for battle, and he did not help them, because by counsel commanders of Philistines sent him away, saying, At cost of heads of those men he will return to his lord Saul.
brenton_translation: And some came to David from Manasse, when the Philistines came against Saul to war: and he helped them not, because the captains of the Philistines took counsel, saying, With the heads of those men will he return to his master Saul.

fresh_translation: When he went to Ziklag, there joined him from Manasseh: Edna and Iozabath and Jediael and Michael and Iosabeth and Elimouth and Selathi, heads of thousands of Manasseh.
brenton_translation: When David was going to Sikelag, there came to him of Manasse, Edna and Jozabath, and Rodiel, and Michael, and Josabaith, and Elimuth, and Semathi: these are the captains of thousands of Manasse.

fresh_translation: And they fought alongside David against raiding band, because all were mighty of strength, and they became leaders in army, in force.
brenton_translation: And they fought on the side of David against a troop, for they were all men of might; and they were commanders in the army, because of their might.

fresh_translation: Because day by day they kept coming to David, into great force, like the force of God.
brenton_translation: For daily men came to David, till they amounted to a great force, as the force of God.

fresh_translation: And these were names of chiefs of army who came to David in Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him according to the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And these are the names of the commanders of the army, who came to David to Chebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him according to the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Sons of Judah, shield-bearers and spear-bearers, six thousand eight hundred, mighty for battle line.
brenton_translation: The sons of Juda, bearing shields and spears, six thousand and eight hundred mighty in war.

fresh_translation: From the sons of Simeon, mighty in strength for battle line, seven thousand one hundred.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Symeon mighty for battle, seven thousand and a hundred.

fresh_translation: From the sons of Levi, four thousand six hundred.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Levi, four thousand and six hundred.

fresh_translation: And Joadas leader for Aaron, and with him three thousand seven hundred.
brenton_translation: And Joadas the chief of the family of Aaron, and with him three thousand and seven hundred.

fresh_translation: And Zadok, young man mighty in strength, and from his father’s house, twenty-two chiefs.
brenton_translation: And Sadoc, a young man mighty in strength, and there were twenty-two leaders of his father's house.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Benjamin, brothers of Saul, three thousand, and still most of them were keeping watch of the house of Saul.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Benjamin, the brethren of Saul, three thousand: and still the greater part of them kept the guard of the house of Saul.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Ephraim, twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty in strength, men of name by the houses of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Ephraim, twenty thousand and eight hundred mighty men, famous in the houses of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And from the half tribe of Manasseh, eighteen thousand who were named by name to come make David king.
brenton_translation: And of the half-tribe of Manasse, eighteen thousand, even those who were named by name, to make David king.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Issachar, knowing understanding for times, knowing what Israel should do, their chiefs were two hundred, and all their brothers with them.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Issachar having wisdom with regard to the times, knowing what Israel should do, two hundred; and all their brethren with them.

fresh_translation: And from Zebulun, going out for battle line with every weapon of war, fifty thousand to help David, not double-hearted.
brenton_translation: And of Zabulon they that went out to battle, with all weapons of war, were fifty thousand to help David, not weak-handed.

fresh_translation: And from Naphtali, one thousand chiefs, and with them with shields and spears, thirty-seven thousand.
brenton_translation: And of Nephthali a thousand captains, and with them men with shields and spears, thirty-seven thousand.

fresh_translation: And from Danites, drawing up for battle, twenty-eight thousand eight hundred.
brenton_translation: And of the Danites men ready for war twenty-eight thousand and eight hundred.

fresh_translation: And from Asher, going out to help in war, forty thousand.
brenton_translation: And of Aser, they that went out to give aid in war, forty thousand.

fresh_translation: And from beyond Jordan, from Reuben and Gad and from the half tribe of Manasseh, with every weapon of war, one hundred twenty thousand.
brenton_translation: And from the country beyond Jordan, from Ruben, and the Gadites, and from the half-tribe of Manasse, a hundred and twenty thousand, with all weapons of war.

fresh_translation: All these were men of war, drawing up battle line with peaceful soul, and they came to Hebron to make David king over all Israel, and the remnant of Israel were one soul to make David king.
brenton_translation: All these were men of war, setting the army in battle array, with a peaceful mind towards him, and they came to Chebron to make David king over all Israel: and the rest of Israel were of one mind to make David king.

fresh_translation: And they were there three days, eating and drinking, because their brothers had prepared for them.
brenton_translation: And they were there three days eating and drinking, for their brethren had made preparations.

fresh_translation: And those bordering them, even as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, were bringing to them on camels and donkeys and mules and on calves provisions, meal, fig cakes, raisins, wine and oil, calves and sheep in abundance, because gladness was in Israel.
brenton_translation: And their neighbours, as far as Issachar and Zabulon and Nephthali, brought to them upon camels, and asses, and mules, and upon calves, victuals, meal, cakes of figs, raisins, wine, and oil, calves and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

fresh_translation: And David took counsel with commanders of thousands and of hundreds, with every leader.
brenton_translation: And David took counsel with the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even with every commander.

fresh_translation: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, If this seems good to you, and if it has been prospered from the Lord our God, let us send to our brothers left behind in all the land of Israel, and with them to priests and Levites in the cities of their possession, and let them gather to us.
brenton_translation: And David said to the whole congregation of Israel, If it seem good to you, and it should be prospered by the Lord our God, let us send to our brethren that are left in all the land of Israel, and let the priests the Levites who are with them in the cities of their possession come, and let them be gathered to us.

fresh_translation: And let us bring the ark of our God to us, because from the days of Saul they did not seek it.
brenton_translation: And let us bring over to us the ark of our God; for men have not enquired at it since the days of Saul.

fresh_translation: And all the assembly said to do so, because word was upright in the eyes of all the people.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation said that they would do thus; for the saying was right in the eyes of all the people.

fresh_translation: And David assembled all Israel from the borders of Egypt and as far as entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from the city of Kirjathjearim.
brenton_translation: So David assembled all Israel, from the borders of Egypt even to the entering in of Hemath, to bring in the ark of God from the city of Jarim.

fresh_translation: And David brought it up, and all Israel went up to the City of David, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, the Lord seated upon cheroubim, where his name was called upon it.
brenton_translation: And David brought it up: and all Israel went up to the city of David, which belonged to Juda, to bring up thence the ark of the Lord God who sits between the cherubim, whose name is called on it.

fresh_translation: And they placed the ark of God on new wagon from the house of Amminadab, and Uzza and his brothers were leading wagon.
brenton_translation: And they set the ark of God on a new waggon brought out of the house of Aminadab: and Oza and his brethren drove the waggon.

fresh_translation: And David and all Israel were playing before God with all their strength, and with songs and lyres and harps and tambourines and cymbals and trumpets.
brenton_translation: And David and all Israel were playing before the Lord with all their might, and that together with singers, and with harps, and with lutes, with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

fresh_translation: And they came as far as threshing floor, and Uzza stretched out his hand to grasp ark, because calf turned it aside.
brenton_translation: And they came as far as the threshing-floor: and Oza put forth his hand to hold the ark, because the bullock moved it from its place.

fresh_translation: And the Lord’s anger grew hot against Uzza, and he struck him there because he stretched out his hand upon ark, and he died there before God.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Oza, and smote him there, because of his stretching forth his hand upon the ark: and he died there before God.

fresh_translation: And David was troubled because the Lord had broken out with breach against Uzza, and he called that place Breach-of-Uzza until this day.
brenton_translation: And David was dispirited, because the Lord had made a breach on Oza: and he called that place the Breach of Oza until this day.

fresh_translation: And David feared God on that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God to myself?
brenton_translation: And David feared God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God in to myself?

fresh_translation: And David did not bring back ark to himself into the City of David, but turned it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
brenton_translation: So David brought not the ark home to himself into the city of David, but he turned it aside into the house of Abeddara the Gethite.

fresh_translation: And the ark of God stayed in the house of Obededom three months, and God blessed Abeddaram and all his things.
brenton_translation: And the ark of God abode in the house of Abeddara three months: and God blessed Abeddara and all that he had.

fresh_translation: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar woods and builders of walls and carpenters of wood to build him house.
brenton_translation: And Chiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar timbers, and masons, and carpenters, to build a house for him.

fresh_translation: And David knew that the Lord had established him over Israel, because his kingdom was exalted on high for the sake of his people Israel.
brenton_translation: And David knew that the Lord had designed him to be king over Israel; because his kingdom was highly exalted, on account of his people Israel.

fresh_translation: And David took yet more wives in Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to David.
brenton_translation: And David took more wives in Jerusalem: and there were born to David more sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And these were names of children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
brenton_translation: And these are the names of those that were born, who were born to him in Jerusalem; Samaa, Sobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

fresh_translation: and Ibhar and Elishua and Elpalet,
brenton_translation: and Baar, and Elisa, and Eliphaleth,

fresh_translation: and Nogah and Nepheg and Ianouou,
brenton_translation: and Nageth, and Naphath, and Japhie,

fresh_translation: and Elishama and Beeliada and Elpalet.
brenton_translation: and Elisamae, and Eliade, and Eliphala.

fresh_translation: And Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, and all Philistines went up to seek David, and David heard and went out to meet them.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel: and all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard it, and went out to meet them.

fresh_translation: And Philistines came and fell upon the valley of giants.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines came and assembled together in the giants' valley.

fresh_translation: And David inquired through God, saying, Shall I go up against Philistines, and will you give them into my hands? And the Lord said to him, Go up, and I will give them into your hands.
brenton_translation: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into my hand? And the Lord said to him, Go up, and I will deliver them into thy hands.

fresh_translation: And he went up to Baalpharasin, and David struck them there. And David said, God broke through my enemies by my hand like the breaking of waters. Therefore name of that place was called Breach-of-Pharasin.
brenton_translation: And he went up to Baal Pharasin, and David smote them there; and David said, God has broken through enemies by my hand like a breach of water: therefore he called the name of that place, the Breach of Pharasin.

fresh_translation: And they left their gods there, and David said to burn them with fire.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines left their gods there; and David gave orders to burn them with fire.

fresh_translation: And Philistines added yet again and again fell upon the valley of giants.
brenton_translation: And the Philistines once more assembled themselves in the giants' valley.

fresh_translation: And David again inquired of God, and God said to him, You shall not go after them; turn away from them and come upon them near pear trees.
brenton_translation: And David enquired of God again; and God said to him, Thou shalt not go after them; turn away from them, and thou shalt come upon them near the pear trees.

fresh_translation: And when you hear the sound of shaking in tops of pear trees, then you shall go out into battle, because God has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.
brenton_translation: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear the sound of their tumult in the tops of the pear trees, then thou shalt go into the battle: for God has gone out before thee to smite the army of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And he did as God commanded him, and he struck the camp of the Philistines from Gibeon as far as Gezer.
brenton_translation: And he did as God commanded him: and he smote the army of the Philistines from Gabaon to Gazera.

fresh_translation: And the name of David became in all the land, and the Lord put his fear upon all nations.
brenton_translation: And the name of David was famous in all the land; and the Lord put the terror of him on all the nations.

fresh_translation: And he made houses for himself in the City of David, and he prepared place for the ark of God and made tent for it.
brenton_translation: And David made for himself houses in the city of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and made a tent for it.

fresh_translation: Then David said, It is not for any to carry the ark of God except Levites, because the Lord chose them to carry the ark of the Lord and to minister to him forever.
brenton_translation: Then said David, It is not lawful for any to bear the ark of God, but the Levites; for the Lord has chosen them to bear the ark of the Lord, and to minister to him for ever.

fresh_translation: And David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the Lord to place which he prepared for it.
brenton_translation: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord to the place which he had prepared for it.

fresh_translation: And David gathered sons of Aaron and Levites:
brenton_translation: And David gathered together the sons of Aaron the Levites.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Kohath, Uriel chief, and his brothers, one hundred twenty;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Caath; there was Uriel the chief, and his brethren, a hundred and twenty.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Merari, Asaiah chief, and his brothers, two hundred fifty;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Merari; Asaia the chief, and his brethren, two hundred and twenty.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Gershom, Joel chief, and his brothers, one hundred fifty;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Gedson; Joel the chief, and his brethren, a hundred and thirty.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Elzaphan, Shemaiah chief, and his brothers, two hundred;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Elisaphat; Semei the chief, and his brethren, two hundred.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Hebron, Eliel chief, and his brothers, eighty;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Chebrom; Eliel the chief, and his brethren eighty.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab chief, and his brothers, one hundred twelve.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Oziel; Aminadab the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twelve.

fresh_translation: And David called Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, Amminadab,
brenton_translation: And David called Sadoc and Abiathar the priests, and the Levites, Uriel, Asaia, and Joel, and Semaia, and Eliel, and Aminadab,

fresh_translation: and he said to them, You are chiefs of fathers of Levites. Sanctify yourselves, you and your brothers, and bring up the ark of God of Israel, which I prepared for it.
brenton_translation: and said to them, Ye are the heads of the families of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, you and your brethren, and ye shall carry up the ark of the God of Israel, to the place which I have prepared for it.

fresh_translation: Because when you were not there at first, our God made breach among us, because we did not seek him according to ordinance.
brenton_translation: For because ye were not ready at the first, our God made a breach upon us, because we sought him not according to the ordinance.

fresh_translation: And priests and Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of God of Israel.
brenton_translation: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves, to bring up the ark of the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And sons of Levites took the ark of God as Moses commanded by the word of God, according to writing, with carrying-poles upon them.
brenton_translation: And the sons of the Levites took the ark of God, (as Moses commanded by the word of God according to the scripture) upon their shoulders with staves.

fresh_translation: And David said to the chiefs of Levites, Station their brothers, singers with the instruments of songs, lyres and harps and cymbals, to raise sound with the voice of gladness.
brenton_translation: And David said to the chiefs of the Levites, Set your brethren the singers with musical instruments, lutes, harps, and cymbals, to sound aloud with a voice of joy.

fresh_translation: And Levites stationed Heman son of Joel, and from his brothers Asaph son of Berechiah, and from the sons of Merari, their brothers, Ethan son of Kushaiah,
brenton_translation: So the Levites appointed Æman the son of Joel; Asaph the son of Barachias was one of his brethren; and Æthan the son of Kisæus was of the sons of Merari their brethren;

fresh_translation: and with them their brothers of second rank: Zechariah and Uzziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni and Eliab and Benaiah and Maaseiah and Maaseiah and Eliphalia and Makenia and Obededom and Jeiel and Uzziah, gatekeepers.
brenton_translation: and with them their brethren of the second rank, Zacharias, and Oziel, and Semiramoth, and Jeiel, and Elioel, and Eliab, and Banaia, and Maasaia, and Matthathia, and Eliphena, and Makellia, and Abdedom, and Jeiel, and Ozias, the porters.

fresh_translation: And singers Heman, Asaph, and Ethan had bronze cymbals to make sound heard.
brenton_translation: And the singers, Æman, Asaph, and Æthan, with brazen cymbals to make a sound to be heard.

fresh_translation: Zechariah and Uzziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Masaias, Benaiah, with harps on alamoth.
brenton_translation: Zacharias, and Oziel, Semiramoth, Jeiel, Oni, Eliab, Maasæas, Banæas, with lutes, on alæmoth.

fresh_translation: And Mattathias and Eliphalias and Makenias and Obededom and Jeiel and Uzziah with lyres on the eighth, to lead strongly.
brenton_translation: And Mattathias, and Eliphalu, and Makenia, and Abdedom, and Jeiel, and Ozias, with harps of Amasenith, to make a loud noise.

fresh_translation: And Chenaniah, chief of Levites, was chief over songs, because he was understanding.
brenton_translation: And Chonenia chief of the Levites was master of the bands, because he was skilful.

fresh_translation: And Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers of ark.
brenton_translation: And Barachia and Elcana were door-keepers of the ark.

fresh_translation: And Shebaniah and Jehoshaphat and Nathanael and Amasai and Zechariah and Benaiah and Eliezer, the priests, were blowing trumpets before the ark of God, and Obededom and Iia were gatekeepers of the ark of God.
brenton_translation: And Somnia, and Josaphat, and Nathanael, and Amasai, and Zacharia, and Banæa, and Eliezer, the priests, were sounding with trumpets before the ark of God: and Abdedom and Jeia were door-keepers of the ark of God.

fresh_translation: And David and elders of Israel and commanders of thousands were going to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obededom with gladness.
brenton_translation: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains of thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant from the house of Abdedom with gladness.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass, when God strengthened Levites carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord, they sacrificed seven calves and seven rams.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when God strengthened the Levites bearing the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they sacrificed seven calves and seven rams.

fresh_translation: And David was girded with linen robe, and all Levites carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and singers, and Chenaniah chief of songs of singers; and upon David was linen robe.
brenton_translation: And David was girt with a fine linen robe, and all the Levites who were bearing the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the singers, and Chonenias the master of the band of singers; also upon David there was a robe of fine linen.

fresh_translation: And all Israel were bringing up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with signal and the sound of shophar and with trumpets and with cymbals, sounding aloud with harps and lyres.
brenton_translation: And all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of a horn, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, playing loudly on lutes and harps.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass, the ark of the covenant of the Lord came as far as the City of David, and Michal daughter of Saul looked through window and saw King David dancing and playing, and she despised him in her soul.
brenton_translation: And the ark of the covenant of the Lord arrived, and came to the city of David; and Melchol the daughter of Saul looked down through the window, and saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

fresh_translation: And they brought in the ark of God and set it in the middle of the tent which David pitched for it, and they offered whole burnt offerings and offerings of salvation before God.
brenton_translation: So they brought in the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tabernacle which David pitched for it; and they offered whole-burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before God.

fresh_translation: And David finished offering whole burnt offerings and offerings of salvation and blessed people in the name of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And David finished offering up whole-burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and blessed the people in the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he distributed to every man of Israel, from man to woman, to each man one loaf of bread, one bakery-cake, and one raisin-cake.
brenton_translation: And he divided to every man of Israel (both men and women), to every man one baker's loaf, and a cake.

fresh_translation: And he appointed before the ark of the covenant of the Lord from Levites, ministers proclaiming aloud and giving thanks and praising the Lord God of Israel:
brenton_translation: And he appointed before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, Levites to minister and lift up the voice, and to give thanks and praise the Lord God of Israel:

fresh_translation: Asaph leader, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattathias, Eliab, and Benaiah and Obededom and Jeiel with instruments, harps and lyres, and Asaph sounding aloud with cymbals,
brenton_translation: Asaph was the chief, and next to him Zacharias, Jeiel, Semiramoth, and Jeiel, Mattathias, Eliab, and Banæas, and Abdedom: and Jeiel sounding with musical instruments, lutes and harps, and Asaph with cymbals:

fresh_translation: and Benaiah and Uzziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
brenton_translation: and Banæas and Oziel the priests sounding continually with trumpets before the ark of the covenant of God in that day.

fresh_translation: On that day then David first appointed by the hand of Asaph and his brothers to praise the Lord.
brenton_translation: Then David first gave orders to praise the Lord by the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

fresh_translation: Give thanks to the Lord; call upon him in his name; make known among peoples his practices.
brenton_translation: Song. Give thanks to the Lord, call upon him by his name, make known his designs among the people.

fresh_translation: Sing to him and hymn to him; tell all his wonders, those things the Lord did.
brenton_translation: Sing songs to him, and sing hymns to him, relate to all people his wonderful deeds, which the Lord has wrought.

fresh_translation: Praise in his holy name; heart seeking his good pleasure shall rejoice.
brenton_translation: Praise his holy name, the heart that seeks his pleasure shall rejoice.

fresh_translation: Seek the Lord and grow strong; seek his face continually.
brenton_translation: Seek the Lord and be strong, seek his face continually.

fresh_translation: Remember his wonders which he did, his marvels and judgments of his mouth,
brenton_translation: Remember his wonderful works which he has wrought, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

fresh_translation: seed of Israel, his servants, sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.
brenton_translation: ye seed of Israel his servants, ye seed of Jacob his chosen ones.

fresh_translation: He is the Lord our God; in all the earth are his judgments.
brenton_translation: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

fresh_translation: Remembering forever his covenant, his word which he commanded for thousand generations,
brenton_translation: Let us remember his covenant for ever, his word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

fresh_translation: which he covenanted with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac,
brenton_translation: which he covenanted with Abraham, and his oath sworn to Isaac.

fresh_translation: and he set it for Jacob as ordinance, for Israel as everlasting covenant,
brenton_translation: He confirmed it to Jacob for an ordinance, to Israel as an everlasting covenant,

fresh_translation: saying, To you I will give the land of Canaan, measuring-line of your inheritance.
brenton_translation: saying, To thee will I give the land of Chanaan, the line of your inheritance:

fresh_translation: When they were few in number, as they were diminished and sojourned in it,
brenton_translation: when they were few in number, when they were but little, and dwelt as strangers in it;

fresh_translation: and they went from nation to nation and from kingdom to another people,
brenton_translation: and went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people.

fresh_translation: he did not let man oppress them, and he rebuked kings concerning them:
brenton_translation: He suffered not a man to oppress them, and he reproved kings for their sakes,

fresh_translation: Do not touch my anointed ones, and do not do evil among my prophets.
brenton_translation: saying, Touch not my anointed ones, and deal not wrongfully with my prophets.

fresh_translation: Sing to the Lord, all the earth; announce his salvation from day to day.
brenton_translation: Sing ye to the Lord, all the earth; proclaim his salvation from day to day.

fresh_translation: For the Lord is great and greatly praised; he is fearful above all gods.
brenton_translation: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

fresh_translation: For all gods of nations are idols, but our God made heaven.
brenton_translation: For all the gods of the nations are idols; but our God made the heavens.

fresh_translation: Glory and praise are before him; strength and boasting are in his place.
brenton_translation: Glory and praise are in his presence; strength and rejoicing are in his place.

fresh_translation: Give to the Lord, families of nations; give to the Lord glory and strength.
brenton_translation: Give to the Lord, ye families of the nations, give to the Lord glory and strength.

fresh_translation: Give to the Lord glory of his name; take gifts and bring them before him, and worship the Lord in his holy courts.
brenton_translation: Give to the Lord the glory belonging to his name: take gifts and offer them before him; and worship the Lord in his holy courts.

fresh_translation: Let all the earth fear from before him; let earth be set right and not be shaken.
brenton_translation: Let the whole earth fear before him; let the earth be established, and not be moved.

fresh_translation: Let heaven rejoice and earth exult, and let them say among the nations, the Lord reigns.
brenton_translation: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth exult; and let them say among the nations, The Lord reigns.

fresh_translation: Sea shall thunder with its fullness, and tree of field and all things in it.
brenton_translation: The sea with its fulness shall resound and the tree of the field, and all things in it.

fresh_translation: Then trees of the forest shall rejoice from before the Lord, because he came to judge earth.
brenton_translation: Then shall the trees of the wood rejoice before the Lord, for he is come to judge the earth.

fresh_translation: Give thanks to the Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever.
brenton_translation: Give thanks to the Lord, for it is good, for his mercy is for ever.

fresh_translation: And say, Save us, O God of our salvation, and deliver us from the nations, to praise your holy name and to boast in your praises.
brenton_translation: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us, and rescue us from among the heathen, that we may praise thy holy name, and glory in thy praises.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord God of Israel from age and unto age. And all the people shall say, Amen, and they praised the Lord.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting and to everlasting:

fresh_translation: And they left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brothers to minister before the ark continually, each day’s matter for its day,
brenton_translation: And they left there Asaph and his brethren before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to minister before the ark continually, according to the service of each day: from day to day.

fresh_translation: and Obededom and his brothers, sixty-eight, and Obededom son of Jeduthun and Ossa as gatekeepers,
brenton_translation: And Abdedom and his brethren were sixty and eight; and Abdedom the son of Idithun, and Osa, were to be door-keepers.

fresh_translation: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tent of the Lord at high place in Gibeon,
brenton_translation: And they appointed Sadoc the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place in Gabaon,

fresh_translation: to offer whole burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of whole burnt offerings continually, morning and evening, and according to all things written in the law of the Lord, whatever he commanded for the sons of Israel by the hand of Moses servant of God,
brenton_translation: to offer up whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord on the altar of whole-burnt-offerings continually morning and evening, and according to all things written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded the children of Israel by Moses the servant of God.

fresh_translation: and with him Heman and Jeduthun and rest of chosen ones named by name to praise the Lord, because his mercy is forever,
brenton_translation: And with him were Æman and Idithun, and the rest chosen out by name to praise the Lord, for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: and with them trumpets and cymbals for sounding aloud, and instruments of songs of God; sons of Jeduthun were at gate.
brenton_translation: And with them there were trumpets and cymbals to sound aloud, and musical instruments for the songs of God: and the sons of Idithun were at the gate.

fresh_translation: And all the people went each to his house, and David returned to bless his house.
brenton_translation: And all the people went every one to his home: and David returned to bless his house.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass, as David settled in his house, David said to Nathan prophet, Behold, I dwell in cedar house, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under curtains.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as David dwelt in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Behold, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under curtains of skins.

fresh_translation: And Nathan said to David, Do all that is in your soul, because God is with you.
brenton_translation: And Nathan said to David, Do all that is in thy heart; for God is with thee.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass in that night, the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in that night, that the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,

fresh_translation: Go and speak to David my servant, Thus says the Lord, You shall not build me house for me to dwell in it.
brenton_translation: Go and say to David my servant, Thus said the Lord, Thou shalt not build me a house for me to dwell in it.

fresh_translation: Because I have not dwelt in a house from the day when I brought up Israel until this day, but I have been in tent and in dwelling-place.
brenton_translation: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought up Israel until this day, but I have been in a tabernacle and a tent,

fresh_translation: In all places where I went through among all Israel, did I ever speak to one tribe of Israel, to shepherd my people, saying, Why have you not built me cedar house?
brenton_translation: in all places through which I have gone with all Israel: did I ever speak to any one tribe of Israel whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why is it that ye have not built me a house of cedar?

fresh_translation: And now thus you shall say to my servant David, Thus says the Lord Almighty, I took you from the fold, from behind the sheep, to be ruler over my people Israel.
brenton_translation: And now thus shalt thou say to my servant David, Thus saith the Lord Almighty, I took thee from the sheepfold, from following the flocks, to be a ruler over my people Israel:

fresh_translation: And I was with you in all places where you went, and I destroyed all your enemies from before you, and I made for you name like the name of great ones on earth.
brenton_translation: and I was with thee in all places whither thou wentest, and I destroyed all thine enemies from before thee, and I made for thee a name according to the name of the great ones that are upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And I will appoint place for my people Israel and plant him, and he shall dwell by himself and not be anxious anymore, and unrighteousness shall not again afflict him as from the beginning,
brenton_translation: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and I will plant him, and he shall dwell by himself, and shall no longer be anxious; and the son of iniquity shall no longer afflict him, as at the beginning,

fresh_translation: and from days when I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I humbled all your enemies, and I will increase you, and the Lord will build a house for you.
brenton_translation: and from the days when I appointed judges over my people Israel. Also I have humbled all thine enemies, and I will increase thee, and the Lord will build thee a house.

fresh_translation: And it shall be, when your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will raise up your seed after you, who shall be from your belly, and I will prepare his kingdom.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass when thy days shall be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

fresh_translation: He shall build me house, and I will set upright his throne forever.
brenton_translation: He shall build me a house, and I will set up his throne for ever.

fresh_translation: I will be to him for father, and he shall be to me for son, and I will not remove my mercy from him, as I removed it from those before you.
brenton_translation: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son: and my mercy will I not withdraw from him, as I withdrew it from them that were before thee.

fresh_translation: And I will make him faithful in my house and in his kingdom forever, and his throne shall stand upright forever.
brenton_translation: And I will establish him in my house and in his kingdom for ever; and his throne shall be set up for ever.

fresh_translation: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
brenton_translation: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so spoke Nathan to David.

fresh_translation: And King David came and sat before the Lord and said, Who am I, the Lord God, and what is my house, that you loved me unto forever?
brenton_translation: And king David came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God? and what is my house, that thou hast loved me for ever?

fresh_translation: And these things were made small before you, O God, and you spoke concerning the house of your servant for long distance, and you looked upon me as vision of man, and you exalted me, Lord God.
brenton_translation: And these things were little in thy sight, O God: thou hast also spoken concerning the house of thy servant for a long time to come, and thou hast looked upon me as a man looks upon his fellow, and hast exalted me, O Lord God.

fresh_translation: What more shall David add to you to glorify? And you know your servant.
brenton_translation: What shall David do more toward thee to glorify thee? and thou knowest thy servant.

fresh_translation: And according to your heart you did all this greatness.
brenton_translation: And thou hast wrought all this greatness according to thine heart.

fresh_translation: Lord, there is none like you, and there is none besides you, according to all things we heard with our ears.
brenton_translation: O Lord, there is none like thee, and there is no God beside thee, according to all things which we have heard with our ears.

fresh_translation: And there is no nation on earth like your people Israel, whom God led to redeem for himself as people, to make for himself great and manifest name, to drive out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt.
brenton_translation: Neither is there another nation upon the earth such as thy people Israel, whereas God led him in the way, to redeem a people for himself, to make for himself a great and glorious name, to cast out nations from before thy people, whom thou redeemedst out of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And you gave your people Israel to yourself as people forever, and you, Lord, became God to them.
brenton_translation: And thou hast appointed thy people Israel as a people to thyself for ever; and thou, Lord, didst become a God to them.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord, let your word which you spoke concerning your servant and concerning his house be made faithful forever.
brenton_translation: And now, Lord, let the word which thou spokest to thy servant, and concerning his house, be confirmed for ever, and do thou as thou hast spoken.

fresh_translation: Let them say, O Lord, Lord Almighty, God of Israel, and let the house of David your servant be established before you.
brenton_translation: And let thy name be established and magnified for ever, men saying, Lord, Lord, Almighty God of Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

fresh_translation: Because you, Lord, opened ear of your servant to build him house. Therefore your servant found courage to pray before you.
brenton_translation: For thou, O Lord my God, hast revealed to the ear of thy servant that thou wilt build him a house; therefore thy servant has found a willingness to pray before thee.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord, you are that God, and you spoke these good things concerning your servant.
brenton_translation: And now, Lord, thou thyself art God, and thou hast spoken these good things concerning thy servant.

fresh_translation: And now you began to bless the house of your servant, that it may be forever before you, because you, Lord, blessed; bless forever.
brenton_translation: And now thou hast begun to bless the house of thy servant, so that it should continue for ever before thee: for thou, Lord, hast blessed it, and do thou bless it for ever.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after these things, David struck Philistines and routed them, and he took Gath and its villages from the hand of Philistines.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass afterwards, that David smote the Philistines, and routed them, and took Geth and its villages out of the hand of the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And he struck Moab, and Moab became servants to David, bringing gifts.
brenton_translation: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David, and tributaries.

fresh_translation: And David struck Hadarezer king of Zobah-Hamath, as he was going to set his hand upon the river Euphrates.
brenton_translation: And David smote Adraazar king of Suba of Emath, as he was going to establish power toward the river Euphrates.

fresh_translation: And David captured from them one thousand chariots and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand footmen, and David hamstrung all chariots, but left of them one hundred chariots.
brenton_translation: And David took of them a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand infantry: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but there were reserved of them a hundred chariots.

fresh_translation: And Syrian from Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, and David struck among Syrians twenty-two thousand men.
brenton_translation: And the Syrian came from Damascus to help Adraazar king of Suba; and David smote of the Syrian army twenty and two thousand men.

fresh_translation: And David put garrison in Syria by Damascus, and they became servants to David, bringing gifts, and the Lord kept saving David in all places he went.
brenton_translation: And David put a garrison in Syria near Damascus; and they became tributary servants to David: and the Lord delivered David wherever he went.

fresh_translation: And David took golden armlets which were on the servants of Hadarezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And David took the golden collars that were on the servants of Adraazar, and brought them to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And from Tibhath and from chosen cities of Hadarezer, David took very much bronze. From it Solomon made bronze sea and pillars and bronze vessels.
brenton_translation: And David took out of Matabeth, and out of the chief cities of Adraazar very much brass: of this Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the brazen vessels.

fresh_translation: And Tou king of Hamath heard that David struck all force of Hadarezer king of Zobah.
brenton_translation: And Thoa king of Emath heard that David had smitten the whole force of Adraazar king of Suba.

fresh_translation: And he sent Hadoram his son to King David to ask about peace and to bless him because he fought Hadarezer and struck him, because Hadarezer was a man of war against Tou, with every silver and gold vessel.
brenton_translation: And he sent Aduram his son to king David to ask how he was, and to congratulate him because he had fought against Adraazar, and smitten him; for Thoa was the enemy of Adraazar.

fresh_translation: These also King David consecrated to the Lord, with silver and gold which he took from all nations, from Edom and Moab and sons of Ammon and Philistines and Amalek.
brenton_translation: And all the golden and silver and brazen vessels, even these king David consecrated to the Lord, with the silver and the gold which he took from all the nations; from Idumæa, and Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalec.

fresh_translation: And Abishai son of Zeruiah struck Edom in the valley of salt pits, eighteen thousand.
brenton_translation: And Abesa son of Saruia smote the Idumeans in the valley of Salt, eighteen thousand.

fresh_translation: And he put garrisons in valley, and all Edomites became David's servants, and the Lord kept saving David in all places he went.
brenton_translation: And he put garrisons in the valley; and all the Idumæans became David's servants: and the Lord delivered David wherever he went.

fresh_translation: And David reigned over all Israel, and he was doing judgment and righteousness for all his people.
brenton_translation: So David reigned over all Israel; and he executed judgment and justice to all his people.

fresh_translation: And Joab son of Zeruiah was over army, and Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder,
brenton_translation: And Joab the son of Saruia was over the army, and Josaphat the son of Achilud was recorder.

fresh_translation: and Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests, and Shavsha was scribe,
brenton_translation: And Sadoc son of Achitob, and Achimelech son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Susa was the scribe;

fresh_translation: and Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over Cherethites and Pelethites, and sons of David were first successors of the king.
brenton_translation: and Banæas the son of Jodae was over the Cherethite and the Phelethite, and the sons of David were the chief deputies of the king.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after these things, Nahash king of sons of Ammon died, and Anan his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after this, that Naas the king of the children of Ammon died, and Anan his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And David said, I will do mercy with Anan son of Nahash, as his father did mercy with me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And the servants of David came into the land of sons of Ammon to comfort him.
brenton_translation: And David said, I will act kindly toward Anan the son of Naas, as his father acted kindly towards me. And David sent messengers to condole with him on the death of his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Anan, to comfort him.

fresh_translation: And the rulers of Ammon said to Anan, Does David honor your father before you because he sent comforters to you? Did not his servants come to you to search city and spy out land?
brenton_translation: And the chiefs of the children of Ammon said to Anan, Is it to honour thy father before thee, that David has sent comforters to thee? Have not his servants come to thee that they might search the city, and to spy out the land?

fresh_translation: And Anan took servants of David and shaved them and cut away half their cloaks as far as garment and sent them away.
brenton_translation: And Anan took the servants of David, and shaved them, and cut off the half of their garments as far as their tunic, and sent them away.

fresh_translation: And men came to report to David concerning men, and he sent to meet them, because men had been greatly dishonored. And the king said, Sit in Jericho until your beards grow, and then return.
brenton_translation: And there came men to report to David concerning the men: and he sent to meet them, for they were greatly disgraced: and the king said, Dwell in Jericho until your beards have grown, and return.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ammon saw that people of David had been shamed, and Anan and sons of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Syria of Mesopotamia and from Syria of Maachah and from Zobah.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon saw that the people of David were ashamed, and Anan and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen out of Syria of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria Maacha, and from Sobal.

fresh_translation: And they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots and the king of Maachah and his people, and they came and camped opposite Medeba. And sons of Ammon gathered from their cities and came to battle.
brenton_translation: And they hired for themselves two and thirty thousand chariots, and the king of Maacha and his people; and they came and encamped before Medaba: and the children of Ammon assembled out of their cities, and came to fight.

fresh_translation: And David heard and sent Joab and all army of mighty men.
brenton_translation: And David heard, and sent Joab and all the host of mighty men.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ammon came out and drew up for battle by the gate of the city, and kings who came camped by themselves in the plain.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon came forth, and set themselves in array for battle by the gate of the city: and the kings that were come forth encamped by themselves in the plain.

fresh_translation: And Joab saw that front of battle had come against him before and behind, and he chose from every young man of Israel, and they drew up against Syrians.
brenton_translation: And Joab saw that they were fronting him to fight against him before and behind, and he chose some out of all the young men of Israel, and they set themselves in array against the Syrian.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the people he gave into the hand of Abishai his brother, and they drew up opposite sons of Ammon.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the people he gave into the hand of his brother Abesai, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And he said, If Syrians prevail over me, you shall be for salvation to me, and if sons of Ammon prevail over you, I will save you.
brenton_translation: And he said, If the Syrian should prevail against me, then shalt thou deliver me: and if the children of Ammon should prevail against thee, then will I deliver thee.

fresh_translation: Act like a man, and let us strengthen ourselves for our people and for the cities of our God, and the Lord will do what is good in his eyes.
brenton_translation: Be of good courage, and let us be strong, for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the Lord shall do what is good in his eyes.

fresh_translation: And Joab drew up, and people with him, opposite Syrians for battle, and they fled from him.
brenton_translation: So Joab and the people that were with him set themselves in battle array against the Syrians, and they fled from them.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ammon saw that Syrians fled, and they too fled from before Joab and from before Abishai his brother and came into the city. And Joab came to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians fled, and they also fled from before Abesai, and from before Joab his brother, and they came to the city: and Joab came to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Syria saw that Israel routed him, and they sent messengers and brought out Syrians from beyond river, with Shophach commander of force of Hadarezer before them.
brenton_translation: And the Syrian saw that Israel had defeated him, and he sent messengers, and they brought out the Syrians from beyond the river; and Sophath the commander-in-chief of the forces of Adraazar was before them.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to David, and he gathered all Israel and crossed Jordan and came against them and drew up against them. And Syria drew up opposite David and fought him.
brenton_translation: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and crossed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So David set his army in array to fight against the Syrians, and they fought against him.

fresh_translation: And Syria fled from before David, and David killed from Syria seven thousand chariots and forty thousand footmen, and he killed Shophach commander of force.
brenton_translation: And the Syrians fled from before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand riders in chariots, and forty thousand infantry, and he slew Sophath the commander-in-chief of the forces.

fresh_translation: And the servants of Hadarezer saw that they had fallen before Israel, and they made covenant with David and served him. And Syria did not want to help sons of Ammon anymore.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Adraazar saw that they were defeated before Israel, and they made peace with David and served him: and the Syrians would not any more help the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass in following year, at time when kings go out, Joab led all force of army and ruined land of sons of Ammon and came and besieged Rabbah, while David stayed in Jerusalem. And Joab struck Rabbah and tore it down.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass at the return of the year, at the time of the going forth of kings to war, that Joab gathered the whole force of the army, and they ravaged the land of the children of Ammon; and he came and besieged Rabba. But David abode in Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabba and destroyed it.

fresh_translation: And David took crown of Molchol their king from his head, and its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and in it was precious stone, and it was upon the head of David. And he brought out spoils of the city very many.
brenton_translation: And David took the crown of Molchom their king off his head, and the weight of it was found to be a talent of gold, and on it were precious stones; and it was placed on the head of David: and he brought out the spoils of the city which were very great.

fresh_translation: And the people in it he brought out and cut with saws and with iron picks, and thus David did to all the sons of Ammon. And David and all his people returned to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And he brought out the people that were in it, and sawed them asunder with saws, and cut them with iron axes, and with harrows: and thus David did to all the children of Ammon. And David and all his people returned to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after these things, there was still war in Gezer with Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite struck Saph from the sons of giants, and he humbled him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass afterward that there was again war with the Philistines in Gazer: then Sobochai the Sosathite smote Saphut of the sons of the giants, and laid him low.

fresh_translation: And there was yet war with Philistines, and Elhanan son of Jair struck Lahmi brother of Goliath the Gittite, and wood of his spear was like a beam of weavers.
brenton_translation: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Eleanan the son of Jair smote Lachmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, and the wood of his spear was as a weavers' beam.

fresh_translation: And there was still war in Gath, and there was an oversized man, and his fingers were six and six, twenty-four, and he was a descendant of giants.
brenton_translation: And there was again war in Geth, and there was a man of extraordinary size, and his fingers and toes were six on each hand and foot, four and twenty; and he was descended from the giants.

fresh_translation: And he reproached Israel, and Jonathan son of Shimea brother of David struck him.
brenton_translation: And he defied Israel, and Jonathan the son of Samaa the brother of David slew him.

fresh_translation: These were born to Rapha in Gath; all were four giants, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
brenton_translation: These were born to Rapha in Geth; all four were giants, and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

fresh_translation: And slanderer stood up against Israel and stirred David to number Israel.
brenton_translation: And the devil stood up against Israel, and moved David to number Israel.

fresh_translation: And King David said to Joab and to the chiefs of force, Go, number Israel from Beersheba to Dan, and bring to me, and I shall know their number.
brenton_translation: And king David said to Joab and to the captains of the forces, Go, number Israel from Bersabee even to Dan, and bring me the account, and I shall know their number.

fresh_translation: And Joab said, May the Lord add to his people a hundredfold as they are, and are not eyes of my lord the king seeing that all are servants to my lord? Why does my lord seek this, so that it should not become sin for Israel?
brenton_translation: And Joab said, May the Lord add to his people, a hundred-fold as many as they are, and let the eyes of my lord the king see it: all are the servants of my lord. Why does my lord seek this thing? do it not, lest it become a sin to Israel.

fresh_translation: But the word of the king prevailed over Joab. And Joab went out and passed through every border of Israel and came to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab; and Joab went out and passed through all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Joab gave number of mustering of the people to David, and all Israel was one million one hundred thousand men drawing sword, and Judah was four hundred eighty thousand men drawing sword.
brenton_translation: And Joab gave the number of the mustering of the people to David: and all Israel was a million and a hundred thousand men that drew sword: and the sons of Juda were four hundred and seventy thousand men that drew sword.

fresh_translation: But Levi and Benjamin he did not count among them, because word of the king overpowered Joab.
brenton_translation: But he numbered not Levi and Benjamin among them; for the word of the king was painful to Joab.

fresh_translation: And thing appeared evil before God concerning this matter, and he struck Israel.
brenton_translation: And there was evil in the sight of the Lord respecting this thing; and he smote Israel.

fresh_translation: And David said to God, I sinned greatly because I did this thing, and now please take away evil of your servant, because I acted very foolishly.
brenton_translation: And David said to God, I have sinned exceedingly, in that I have done this thing: and now, I pray thee, remove the sin of thy servant; for I have been exceedingly foolish.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to Gad, seer of David, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Gad the seer, saying,

fresh_translation: Go and speak to David, saying, Thus says the Lord, I lift three things upon you; choose one of them for yourself, and I will do it to you.
brenton_translation: Go and speak to David, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I bring three things upon thee: choose one of them for thyself, and I will do it to thee.

fresh_translation: And Gad came to David and said to him, Thus says the Lord, Choose for yourself:
brenton_translation: And Gad came to David, and said to him, Thus saith the Lord, Choose for thyself,

fresh_translation: either three years of famine, or three months for you to flee from before your enemies while sword of your enemies destroys, or three days sword of the Lord and death in the land, and angel of the Lord destroying in all inheritance of Israel. And now see what word I should answer to one who sent me.
brenton_translation: either three years of famine, or that thou shouldest flee three months from the face of thine enemies, and the sword of thine enemies shall be employed to destroy thee, or that the sword of the Lord and pestilence should be three days in the land, and the angel of the Lord shall be destroying in all the inheritance of Israel. And now consider what I shall answer to him that sent the message.

fresh_translation: And David said to Gad, All three press me very hard. Let me now fall into the hands of the Lord, because his mercies are very many; but into the hands of men I shall not fall.
brenton_translation: And David said to Gad, They are very hard for me, even all the three: let me fall now into the hands of the Lord, for his mercies are very abundant, and let me not fall by any means into the hands of man.

fresh_translation: And the Lord gave death in Israel, and seventy thousand men fell from Israel.
brenton_translation: So the Lord brought pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

fresh_translation: And God sent angel into Jerusalem to destroy it, and as he destroyed, the Lord saw and relented over evil and said to angel destroying, It is enough for you; let go your hand. And the angel of the Lord was standing at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
brenton_translation: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the Lord saw, and repented for the evil, and said to the angel that was destroying, Let it suffice thee; withhold thine hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshing-floor of Orna the Jebusite.

fresh_translation: And David lifted his eyes and saw angel of the Lord standing between earth and between heaven, with his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem. And David and elders clothed in sackcloth fell on their faces.
brenton_translation: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord, standing between the earth and the heaven, and his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem: and David and the elders clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

fresh_translation: And David said to God, Was it not I who said to number among people? And I am one who sinned; I acted evilly with evil. But these sheep, what did they do? Lord God, let your hand be on me and on the house of my father, and not on your people for destruction, Lord.
brenton_translation: And David said to God, Was it not I that gave orders to number the people? and I am the guilty one; I have greatly sinned: but these sheep, what have they done? O Lord God, let thy hand be upon me, and upon my father's house, and not on thy people for destruction, O Lord!

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord said to Gad to tell David to go up and set altar to the Lord at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord told Gad to tell David, that he should go up to erect an altar to the Lord, in the threshing-floor of Orna the Jebusite.

fresh_translation: And David went up according to the word of Gad, which he spoke in the name of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And David went up according to the word of Gad, which he spoke in the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Araunah turned and saw king, and his four sons with him were hiding themselves, and Araunah was threshing wheat.
brenton_translation: And Orna turned and saw the king; and he hid himself and his four sons with him. Now Orna was threshing wheat.

fresh_translation: And David came to Araunah, and Araunah came out from threshing floor and bowed to David with his face to the ground.
brenton_translation: And David came to Orna; and Orna came forth from the threshing-floor, and did obeisance to David with his face to the ground.

fresh_translation: And David said to Araunah, Give me place of your threshing floor, and I will build on it altar to the Lord. For silver at full worth give it to me, and plague will stop from people.
brenton_translation: And David said to Orna, Give me thy place of the threshing-floor, and I will build upon it an altar to the Lord: give it me for its worth in money, and the plague shall cease from among the people.

fresh_translation: And Araunah said to David, Take for yourself, and let my lord the king do good in his sight. Behold, I have given calves for whole burnt offering, and plow and wagons for wood, and wheat for sacrifice; I have given all.
brenton_translation: And Orna said to David, Take it to thyself, and let my lord the king do what is right in his eyes: see, I have given the calves for a whole-burnt-offering, and the plough for wood, and the corn for a meat-offering; I have given all.

fresh_translation: And King David said to Araunah, No, because by buying I will buy for full worth in silver, because I shall not take what is yours for the Lord, to offer free whole burnt offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And king David said to Orna, Nay; for I will surely buy it for its worth in money: for I will not take thy property for the Lord, to offer a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord without cost to myself.

fresh_translation: And David gave to Araunah in his place six hundred shekels of weight in gold.
brenton_translation: And David gave to Orna for his place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

fresh_translation: And David built there altar to the Lord and offered whole burnt offerings and offerings of salvation, and cried out to the Lord, and he answered him with fire from heaven upon the altar of whole burnt offering and consumed whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: And David built there an altar to the Lord, and offered up whole-burnt-offerings and peace-offerings: and he cried to the Lord, and he answered him by fire out of heaven on the altar of whole-burnt-offerings, and it consumed the whole-burnt-offering.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke to angel, and he put sword into sheath.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to the angel; and he put up the sword into its sheath.

fresh_translation: At that time, when David saw that the Lord answered him at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, he sacrificed there.
brenton_translation: At that time when David saw that the Lord answered him in the threshing-floor of Orna the Jebusite, he also sacrificed there.

fresh_translation: And tent of the Lord which Moses made in the wilderness, and altar of whole burnt offerings, were at that time at high place in Gibeon.
brenton_translation: And the tabernacle of the Lord which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of whole-burnt-offerings, were at that time in the high place at Gabaon.

fresh_translation: And David was not able to go before it to seek God, because he hurried in fear from before sword of angel of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And David could not go before it to enquire of God; for he hasted not because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar for whole burnt offering for Israel.
brenton_translation: And David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar for whole-burnt-offering for Israel.

fresh_translation: And David told them to gather all sojourners in the land of Israel, and he appointed stonecutters to cut dressed stones to build a house for God.
brenton_translation: And David gave orders to gather all the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he appointed stone-hewers to hew polished stones to build the house to God.

fresh_translation: And David prepared much iron for the nails of doors and gates and hinges, and bronze in abundance without weight,
brenton_translation: And David prepared much iron for the nails of the doors and the gates; the hinges also and brass in abundance, there was no weighing of it.

fresh_translation: and cedar woods without number, because Sidonians and Tyrians brought cedar woods in abundance to David.
brenton_translation: And cedar trees without number: for the Sidonians and the Tyrians brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

fresh_translation: And David said, Solomon my son is tender youth, and house to build for the Lord must be for greatness beyond, for name and for glory in all the earth; I will prepare for him. And David prepared in abundance before his death.
brenton_translation: And David said, My son Solomon is a tender child, and the house for me to build to the Lord is for superior magnificence for a name and for a glory through all the earth: I will make preparation for it. And David prepared abundantly before his death.

fresh_translation: And he called Solomon his son and charged him to build a house to God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he called Solomon his son, and commanded him to build the house for the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And David said, Solomon, my child, it was upon my heart to build a house for the name of the Lord God,
brenton_translation: And David said to Solomon, My child, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the Lord God.

fresh_translation: but the word of the Lord came upon me, saying, You poured out blood in abundance and made great wars; you shall not build a house to my name, because you poured out much blood on earth before me.
brenton_translation: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast carried on great wars: thou shalt not build a house to my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth before me.

fresh_translation: Behold, son is born to you. He shall be man of rest, and I will give him rest from all enemies around, because Solomon shall be his name, and peace and quietness I will give upon Israel in his days.
brenton_translation: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, he shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

fresh_translation: He shall build a house to my name, and he shall be to me for son, and I to him for father, and I will set upright throne of his kingdom in Israel forever.
brenton_translation: He shall build a house to my name; and he shall be a son to me, and I will be a father to him; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom in Israel for ever.

fresh_translation: And now, my son, the Lord shall be with you and prosper you, and you shall build a house to your God as he spoke concerning you.
brenton_translation: And now, my son, the Lord shall be with thee, and prosper thee; and thou shalt build a house to the Lord thy God, as he spoke concerning thee.

fresh_translation: Only may the Lord give you wisdom and understanding, and strengthen you over Israel, to keep and to do the law of the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Only may the Lord give thee wisdom and prudence, and strengthen thee over Israel, both to keep and to do the law of the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: Then you shall prosper if you keep doing ordinances and judgments which the Lord commanded Moses for Israel. Act like a man and be strong; do not fear and do not be dismayed.
brenton_translation: Then will he prosper thee, if thou take heed to do the commandments and judgments which the Lord commanded Moses for Israel: be courageous and strong; fear not, nor be terrified.

fresh_translation: And behold, in my poverty I prepared for the house of the Lord one hundred thousand talents of gold and one thousand thousand talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight, because it is in abundance, and wood and stones I prepared, and to these add more.
brenton_translation: And, behold, I according to my poverty have prepared for the house of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a million talents of silver, and brass and iron without measure; for it is abundant; and I have prepared timber and stones; and do thou add to these.

fresh_translation: And with you are workers in abundance, craftsmen and builders of stone and carpenters of wood and every wise man in every work,
brenton_translation: And of them that are with thee do thou add to the multitude of workmen; let there be artificers and masons, and carpenters, and every skilful workman in every work;

fresh_translation: in gold, in silver, in bronze, and in iron there is no number. Rise and do, and the Lord be with you.
brenton_translation: in gold and silver, brass and iron, of which there is no number. Arise and do, and the Lord be with thee.

fresh_translation: And David commanded all rulers of Israel to help Solomon his son:
brenton_translation: And David charged all the chief men of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

fresh_translation: Is not the Lord with you and has he not given you rest all around? Because he gave inhabitants of the land into hands, and land is subdued before the Lord and before his people.
brenton_translation: Is not the Lord with you? and he has given you rest round about, for he has given into your hands the inhabitants of the land; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.

fresh_translation: Now set your hearts and your souls to seek the Lord your God, and rise and build a sanctuary to the Lord your God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the holy vessels of God into the house being built for the name of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Now set your hearts and souls to seek after the Lord your God: and rise, and build a sanctuary to your God to carry in the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And David was old and full of days, and he made Solomon his son king in his place over Israel.
brenton_translation: And David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel in his stead.

fresh_translation: And he gathered all rulers of Israel and priests and Levites.
brenton_translation: And he assembled all the chief men of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites.

fresh_translation: And Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward, and their number by heads, men, was thirty-eight thousand.
brenton_translation: And the Levites numbered themselves from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls amounted to thirty and eight thousand men.

fresh_translation: From these, overseers over the works of the house of the Lord were twenty-four thousand, and scribes and judges six thousand,
brenton_translation: Of the overseers over the works of the house of the Lord there were twenty-four thousand, and there were six thousand scribes and judges;

fresh_translation: and four thousand gatekeepers, and four thousand praising the Lord with instruments which he made for praising the Lord.
brenton_translation: and four thousand door-keepers, and four thousand to praise the Lord with instruments which he made to praise the Lord.

fresh_translation: And David divided them into courses for the sons of Levi: to Gershon, Kohath, Merari.
brenton_translation: And David divided them into daily courses, for the sons of Levi, for Gedson, Caath, and Merari.

fresh_translation: And to Gershon, to Laadan and to Shimei.
brenton_translation: And for the family of Gedson, Edan, and Semei.

fresh_translation: Sons of Laadan: chief Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
brenton_translation: The sons of Edan were Jeiel, the chief, and Zethan, and Joel, three.

fresh_translation: Sons of Shimei: Shelomith and Jeiel and Haran, three. These were chiefs of fathers for Laadan.
brenton_translation: The sons of Semei; Salomith, Jeiel, and Dan, three: these were the chiefs of the families of Edan.

fresh_translation: And to the sons of Shimei: Jahath and Ziza and Joash and Beriah; these were four sons of Shimei.
brenton_translation: And to the sons of Semei, Jeth, and Ziza, and Joas, and Beria: these were the four sons of Semei.

fresh_translation: And Jahath was chief and Ziza second; Joash and Beriah did not multiply sons, and they became one father-house in one reckoning.
brenton_translation: And Jeth was the chief, and Ziza the second: and Joas and Beria did not multiply sons, and they became only one reckoning according to the house of their father.

fresh_translation: Sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel, four.
brenton_translation: The sons of Caath; Ambram, Isaar, Chebron, Oziel, four.

fresh_translation: Sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was set apart to be sanctified as holy of holies, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister, and to bless upon his name forever.
brenton_translation: The sons of Ambram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was appointed for the consecration of the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister and bless in his name for ever.

fresh_translation: And Moses, man of God, his sons were called into the tribe of Levi.
brenton_translation: And as for Moses the man of God, his sons were reckoned to the tribe of Levi.

fresh_translation: Sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
brenton_translation: The sons of Moses; Gersam, and Eliezer.

fresh_translation: Sons of Gershom: Shebuel chief.
brenton_translation: The sons of Gersam; Subael the chief.

fresh_translation: And sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah chief. And Eliezer had no other sons, but sons of Rehabiah increased greatly.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rabia the chief: and Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rabia were very greatly multiplied.
