brenton_translation: And their snuffers, and their lamps were made, and he made the bowls, and the censers, and the fire-pans, of pure gold.

fresh_translation: and inner door of the house into the holy of holies, and doors of the house of the temple, golden.
brenton_translation: And there was the inner door of the house opening into the holy of holies, and he made the inner doors of the temple of gold. So all the work which Solomon wrought for the house of the Lord was finished.

fresh_translation: And all work which Solomon made in the house of the Lord was finished, and Solomon brought in the holy things of David his father, silver and gold and vessels, and gave them into treasure of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Solomon brought in the holy things of his father David, the silver, and the gold, and the other vessels, and put them in the treasury of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Then Solomon assembled elders of Israel and all rulers of tribes, leaders of fathers of sons of Israel, in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the City of David, this is Zion.
brenton_translation: Then Solomon assembled all the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, even the leaders of the families of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David,—this is Sion.

fresh_translation: And every man of Israel was assembled to the king at feast, this seventh month.
brenton_translation: And all Israel were assembled unto the king in the feast, this is the seventh month.

fresh_translation: And all the elders of Israel came, and all the Levites took the ark.
brenton_translation: And all the elders of Israel came; and all the Levites took up the ark,

fresh_translation: And they brought up ark and the tent of testimony and all holy vessels in tent; priests and Levites brought them up.
brenton_translation: and the tabernacle of witness, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle; and the priests and the Levites brought it up.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon and all congregation of Israel, those fearing and gathered with him before the ark, were sacrificing calves and sheep which cannot be numbered and cannot be reckoned from multitude.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon, and all the elders of Israel, and the religious of them, and they of them that were gathered before the ark, were sacrificing calves and sheep, which could not be numbered or reckoned for multitude.

fresh_translation: And priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord to its place, into debir of the house, into the holy of holies, under wings of cheroubim.
brenton_translation: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord into its place, into the oracle of the house, even into the holy of holies, under the wings of the cherubs.

fresh_translation: And cheroubim were spreading out their wings over the place of the ark, and cheroubim were covering the ark and its carrying-poles above.
brenton_translation: And the cherubs stretched out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubs covered the ark, and its staves above.

fresh_translation: And carrying-poles projected, and heads of poles were seen from holy place before debir, but were not seen outside, and they were there until this day.
brenton_translation: And the staves projected, and the heads of the staves were seen from the holy place in front of the oracle, they were not seen without: and there they were to this day.

fresh_translation: There was nothing in the ark except two tablets which Moses put in Horeb, when the Lord made covenant with the sons of Israel as they came out from the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: There was nothing in the ark except the two tables which Moses placed there in Choreb, which God gave in covenant with the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when priests came out from holy place, because all priests found there had sanctified themselves; they were not arranged by courses.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the priests went out of the holy place, (for all the priests that were found were sanctified, they were not then arranged according to their daily course,)

fresh_translation: And Levites, singers, all sons of Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, clothed in linen robes with cymbals and harps and lyres, were standing opposite altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests blowing trumpets.
brenton_translation: that all the singing Levites assigned to the sons of Asaph, to Æman, to Idithun, and to his sons, and to his brethren, of them that were clothed in linen garments, with cymbals and lutes and harps, were standing before the altar, and with them a hundred and twenty priests, blowing trumpets.

fresh_translation: And one sound came to be in blowing trumpets and in singing psalms and in sounding one voice, to give thanks and praise to the Lord. And as they raised voice with trumpets and cymbals and instruments of songs and said, Give thanks to the Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever, house was filled with cloud of the glory of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And there was one voice in the trumpeting and in the psalm-singing, and in the loud utterance with one voice to give thanks and praise the Lord; and when they raised their voice together with trumpets and cymbals, and instruments of music, and said, Give thanks to the Lord, for it is good, for his mercy endures for ever:—then the house was filled with the cloud of the glory of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And priests were not able to stand to minister from the presence of cloud, because the glory of the Lord filled the house of God.
brenton_translation: And the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the Lord filled the house of God.

fresh_translation: Then Solomon said, the Lord said he would dwell in thick darkness.
brenton_translation: Then said Solomon, The Lord said that he would dwell in thick darkness.

fresh_translation: And I built holy house to your name for you, ready for dwelling forever.
brenton_translation: But I have built a house to thy name, holy to thee, and prepared for thee to dwell in for ever.

fresh_translation: And the king turned his face and blessed all the assembly of Israel, and all the assembly of Israel stood there.
brenton_translation: And the king turned his face, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood by.

fresh_translation: And he said, Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father and with his hands fulfilled it, saying,
brenton_translation: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel: he has even fulfilled with his hands as he spoke with his mouth to my father David, saying,

fresh_translation: From the day when I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I did not choose city from all the tribes of Israel to build a house for to be there, and I did not choose man to be ruler over my people Israel,
brenton_translation: From the day when I brought up my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city of all the tribes of Israel, to build a house that my name should be there; neither did I choose a man to be a leader over my people Israel.

fresh_translation: but I chose Jerusalem for my name to be there, and I chose David to be over my people Israel.
brenton_translation: But I chose Jerusalem that my name should be there; and I chose David to be over my people Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came upon the heart of David my father to build a house to the name of the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came into the heart of David my father, to build a house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to David my father, Because it came upon your heart to build a house to my name, you did well that it came upon your heart.
brenton_translation: But the Lord said to my father David, Whereas it came into thy heart to build a house for my name, thou didst well that it came into thy heart.

fresh_translation: Nevertheless, you shall not build a house, but your son who shall come out from your loins, he shall build a house to my name.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; for thy son who shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

fresh_translation: And the Lord raised up his word which he spoke, and I came to be in place of David my father and sat upon the throne of Israel, as the Lord spoke, and I built a house to the name of the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the Lord has confirmed this word, which he spoke; and I am raised up in the room of my father David, and I sit upon the throne of Israel as the Lord said, and I have built the house for the name of the Lord God of Israel:

fresh_translation: And there I put ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord which he made with Israel.
brenton_translation: and I have set there the ark in which is the covenant of the Lord, which he made with Israel.

fresh_translation: And he stood before the altar of the Lord in presence of all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.
brenton_translation: And he stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread out his hands.

fresh_translation: For Solomon made bronze platform and set it in the midst of court of sanctuary, its length five cubits and breadth five cubits and height three cubits, and he stood upon it and fell on his knees before all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.
brenton_translation: For Solomon had made a brazen scaffold, and set it in the midst of the court of the sanctuary; the length of it was five cubits, and the breadth of it five cubits, and the height of it three cubits: and he stood upon it, and fell upon his knees before the whole congregation of Israel, and spread abroad his hands to heaven,

fresh_translation: And he said, Lord God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven and on earth, keeping covenant and mercy for your servants walking before you with all their heart,
brenton_translation: and said,

fresh_translation: what you kept for your servant David my father, what you spoke to him saying, and you spoke with your mouth and fulfilled with your hands, as this day.
brenton_translation: Even as thou hast kept them with thy servant David my father, as thou hast spoken to him in words:—thou hast both spoken with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thy hands, as it is this day.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father what you spoke to him, saying, Man shall not fail for you from before me sitting on the throne of Israel, if only your sons keep their way to walk in my law as you walked before me.
brenton_translation: And now, Lord God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father the things which thou spokest to him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man before me sitting on the throne of Israel, if only thy sons will take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou didst walk before me.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord God of Israel, let your word be made faithful, which you spoke to your servant David.
brenton_translation: And now, Lord God of Israel, let, I pray thee, thy word be confirmed, which thou hast spoken to thy servant David.

fresh_translation: For will God truly dwell with men upon the earth? If heaven and heaven of heaven are not sufficient for you, then what is this house which I built?
brenton_translation: For will God indeed dwell with men upon the earth? if the heaven and the heaven of heavens will not suffice thee, what then is this house which I have built?

fresh_translation: And you shall look upon the prayer of your servant and upon my petition, O Lord God, to hear the petition and the prayer which your servant prays before you today,
brenton_translation: Yet thou shalt have respect to the prayer of thy servant, and to my petition, O Lord God, so as to hearken to the petition and the prayer which thy servant prays before thee this day:

fresh_translation: that your eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon this place where you said your name would be called there, to hear the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.
brenton_translation: so that thine eyes should be open over this house by day and by night, towards this place, whereon thou saidst thy name should be called, so as to hear the prayer which thy servant prays towards this house.

fresh_translation: And you shall hear petition of your servant and your people Israel, whatever they pray toward this place, and you shall hear from place of your dwelling, from heaven, and you shall hear and be merciful.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt hear the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, whatsoever prayers they shall make towards this place: and thou shalt hearken in thy dwelling-place out of heaven, yea thou shalt hear, and be merciful.

fresh_translation: If man sins against his neighbor and takes oath upon him to swear him, and comes and swears before the altar in this house,
brenton_translation: If a man sin against his neighbour, and he bring an oath upon him so as to make him swear, and he come and swear before the altar in this house;

fresh_translation: then you shall hear from heaven and do and judge your servants, repaying lawless one, to return his ways upon his head, and justifying righteous one, to give to him according to his righteousness.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hearken out of heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, to recompense the transgressor, and to return his ways upon his head: and to justify the righteous, to recompense him according to his righteousness.

fresh_translation: And if your people Israel are crushed before enemy when they sin against you, and they turn and give thanks to your name and pray and entreat before you in this house,
brenton_translation: And if thy people Israel should be put to the worse before the enemy, if they should sin against thee, and then turn and confess to thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;

fresh_translation: then you shall hear from heaven and be merciful to the sins of your people Israel and return them to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hearken out of heaven and shalt be merciful to the sins of thy people Israel, and thou shalt restore them to the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.

fresh_translation: When heaven is shut and rain does not come because they sin against you, and they pray toward this place and praise your name and turn from their sins because you humbled them,
brenton_translation: When heaven is restrained, and there is no rain, because they shall have sinned against thee, and when they shall pray towards this place, and praise thy name, and shall turn from their sins, because thou shalt afflict them;

fresh_translation: then you shall hear from heaven and be merciful to the sins of your servants and your people Israel, because you will show them good way in which they shall walk, and you will give rain upon your land which you gave to your people for inheritance.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hearken from heaven, and thou shalt be merciful to the sins of thy servants, and of thy people Israel; for thou shalt shew them the good way in which they shall walk; and thou shalt send rain upon thy land, which thou gavest to thy people for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: If famine comes on the land, if death comes, if blight and jaundice come, locust and caterpillar, if enemy afflicts them before their cities, according to every plague and every pain,
brenton_translation: If there should be famine upon the land, if there should be death, a pestilent wind and blight; if there should be locust and caterpillar, and if the enemy should harass them before their cities: in whatever plague and whatever distress they may be;

fresh_translation: then every prayer and every petition which happens to every man and to all your people Israel, if a man knows his own touch and his own weakness and spreads out his hands toward this house,
brenton_translation: then whatever prayer and whatever supplication shall be made by any man and all thy people Israel, if a man should know his own plague and his own sickness, and should spread forth his hands toward this house;

fresh_translation: then you shall hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, and be gracious and give to each man according to his ways, as you know his heart, because you alone know the heart of sons of men,
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hear from heaven, out of thy prepared dwelling-place, and shalt be merciful, and shalt recompense to the man according to his ways, as thou shalt know his heart to be; for thou alone knowest the heart of the children of men:

fresh_translation: so that they may fear your ways all days which they live upon the face of land which you gave to our fathers.
brenton_translation: that they may reverence all thy ways all the days which they live upon the face of the land, which thou gavest to our fathers.

fresh_translation: And every foreigner who is not from your people Israel, and comes from far land because of your great name and your strong hand and your uplifted arm, and comes and prays toward this place,
brenton_translation: And every stranger who is not himself of thy people Israel, and who shall have come from a distant land because of thy great name, and thy mighty hand, and thy high arm; when they shall come and worship toward this place;—

fresh_translation: then you shall hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, and do according to all things whatever a foreigner calls upon you for, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you as your people Israel do, and know that your name is called upon this house which I built.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hearken out of heaven, out of thy prepared dwelling-place, and shalt do according to all that the stranger shall call upon thee for; that all the nations of the earth may know thy name, and that they may fear thee, as thy people Israel do, and that they may know that thy name is called upon this house which I have built.

fresh_translation: If your people go out to battle against their enemies on way where you send them, and they pray to you by way of this city which you chose and house which I built to your name,
brenton_translation: And if thy people shall go forth to war against their enemies by the way by which thou shalt send them, and shall pray to thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built to thy name;

fresh_translation: then hear from heaven their petition and their prayer and do their justice.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hear out of heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

fresh_translation: Because they will sin against you, for there will not be man who will not sin, and you will strike them and hand them over before enemies, and those taking them captive shall take them captive to the land of enemies, far or near,
brenton_translation: Whereas if they shall sin against thee, (for there is no man who will not sin,) and thou shalt smite them, and deliver them up before their enemies, and they that take them captive shall carry them away into a land of enemies, to a land far off or near;

fresh_translation: and they will turn heart in their land where they were taken, and indeed turn and entreat you in their captivity, saying, We sinned, we acted unjustly, we acted lawlessly,
brenton_translation: and if they shall repent in their land whither they were carried captive, and shall also turn and make supplication to thee in their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have transgressed, we have wrought unrighteously;

fresh_translation: and turn toward you with all their heart and all their soul in the land of those who took them captive, and pray by way of their land which you gave to their fathers and city which you chose and house which I built to your name,
brenton_translation: and if they shall turn to thee with all their heart and all their soul in the land of them that carried them captives, whither they carried them captives, and shall pray toward their land which thou gavest to their fathers, and the city which thou didst choose, and the house which I built to thy name:—

fresh_translation: then hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, their prayer and their petition and do judgments and be merciful to your people who sinned against you.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou hear out of heaven, out of thy prepared dwelling-place, their prayer and their supplication, and thou shalt execute justice, and shalt be merciful to thy people that sin against thee.

fresh_translation: Now, Lord, let your eyes be open and your ears attentive to petition of this place.
brenton_translation: And now, Lord, let, I pray thee, thine eyes be opened, and thine ears be attentive to the petition made in this place.

fresh_translation: And now rise up, Lord God, into your resting place, you and ark of your strength. Let your priests, Lord God, put on salvation, and let your sons rejoice in good things.
brenton_translation: And now, O Lord God, arise into thy resting-place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O Lord God, clothe themselves with salvation, and thy sons rejoice in prosperity.

fresh_translation: Lord God, do not turn away face of your anointed one; remember mercies of David your servant.
brenton_translation: O Lord God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of thy servant David.

fresh_translation: And when Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed whole burnt offerings and sacrifices, and the glory of the Lord filled the house.
brenton_translation: And when Solomon had finished praying, then the fire came down from heaven, and devoured the whole-burnt-offerings and the sacrifices; and the glory of the Lord filled the house.

fresh_translation: And priests were not able to enter the house of the Lord at that time, because the glory of the Lord filled the house.
brenton_translation: And the priests could not enter into the house of the Lord at that time, for the glory of the Lord filled the house.

fresh_translation: And all sons of Israel saw fire coming down and the glory of the Lord upon the house, and they fell upon face to ground on pavement and worshiped and praised the Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever.
brenton_translation: And all the children of Israel saw the fire descending, and the glory of the Lord was upon the house: and they fell upon their face to the ground on the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the Lord; for it is good to do so, because his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: And the king and all the people were sacrificing sacrifices before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the king and all the people were offering sacrifices before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Solomon sacrificed sacrifice of twenty-two thousand calves and one hundred twenty thousand cattle, and the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of calves twenty and two thousand, of sheep a hundred and twenty thousand: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

fresh_translation: And priests stood at their charges, and Levites with the instruments of songs of the Lord, of David king, for giving thanks before the Lord, because his mercy is forever, with hymns of David by their hand, and priests were blowing trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.
brenton_translation: And the priests were standing at their watches, and the Levites with instruments of music of the Lord, belonging to king David, to give thanks before the Lord, for his mercy endures for ever, with the hymns of David, by their ministry: and the priests were blowing the trumpets before them, and all Israel standing.

fresh_translation: And Solomon sanctified middle of court in the house of the Lord, because there he made whole burnt offerings and fat of offerings of salvation, because bronze altar which Solomon made was not able to receive whole burnt offerings and grain offerings and fats.
brenton_translation: And Solomon consecrated the middle of the court that was in the house of the Lord: for he offered there the whole-burnt-offerings and the fat of the peace-offerings, for the brazen altar which Solomon had made was not sufficient to receive the whole-burnt-offerings, and the meat-offerings, and the fat.

fresh_translation: And Solomon made feast at that time seven days, and all Israel with him, very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath and as far as river of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And Solomon kept the feast at that time seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entering in of Æmath, and as far as the river of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And on the eighth day he made dismissal, because dedication of altar he made seven days, feast.
brenton_translation: And on the eighth day he kept a solemn assembly: for he kept a feast of seven days as the dedication of the altar.

fresh_translation: And on twenty-third of seventh month he sent people to their tents rejoicing and with good heart over good things which the Lord did to David and to Solomon and to Israel his people.
brenton_translation: And on the twenty-third day of the seventh month he dismissed the people to their tents, rejoicing, and with a glad heart because of the good deeds which the Lord had done to David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

fresh_translation: And Solomon finished house of the Lord and the house of the king, and all things which Solomon desired in his soul to do in the house of the Lord and in his house prospered.
brenton_translation: So Solomon finished the house of the Lord, and the king's house: and in whatever Solomon wished in his heart to do in the house of the Lord and in his own house, he prospered.

fresh_translation: And God appeared to Solomon by night and said to him, I heard your prayer and chose in this place for myself as a house of sacrifice.
brenton_translation: And the Lord appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, I have heard thy prayer, and I have chosen this place to myself for a house of sacrifice.

fresh_translation: If I shut heaven and rain does not come, and if I command locust to eat tree, and if I send death among my people,
brenton_translation: If I should restrain the heaven and there should be no rain, and if I should command the locust to devour the trees, and if I should send pestilence upon my people;

fresh_translation: and my people upon whom my name has been called are put to shame, and they pray and seek my face and turn from their evil ways, then I will hear from heaven and be merciful to their sins and heal their land.
brenton_translation: then if my people, on whom my name is called, should repent, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their evil ways, I also will hear from heaven, and I will be merciful to their sins, and I will heal their land.

fresh_translation: Now my eyes shall be open and my ears attentive to the prayer of this place.
brenton_translation: And now my eyes shall be open, and my ears attentive to the prayer of this place.

fresh_translation: And now I have chosen and sanctified this house for my name to be there forever, and my eyes and my heart shall be there all days.
brenton_translation: And now I have chosen and sanctified this house, that my name should be there for ever: and my eyes and my heart shall be there always.

fresh_translation: And you, if you walk before me as David your father and do according to all things I commanded you and keep my ordinances and my judgments,
brenton_translation: And if thou wilt walk before me as David thy father did, and wilt do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my ordinances and my judgments;

fresh_translation: then I will set up throne of your kingdom as I covenanted with David your father, saying, Man leading in Israel shall not be removed from you.
brenton_translation: then will I establish the throne of thy kingdom, as I covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man ruling in Israel.

fresh_translation: And if you turn away and forsake my ordinances and my commandments which I gave before you and go and serve other gods and worship them,
brenton_translation: But if ye should turn away, and forsake my ordinances and my commandments, which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods, and worship them;

fresh_translation: then I will lift you out of land which I gave them, and this house which I sanctified to my name I will cast away from my face and give it for parable and tale among all nations.
brenton_translation: then will I remove you from the land which I gave them; and this house which I have consecrated to my name I will remove out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a by-word among all nations.

fresh_translation: And this exalted house, everyone passing by it will be astonished and say, For what reason did the Lord do thus to this land and to this house?
brenton_translation: And as for this lofty house, every one that passes by it shall be amazed, and shall say, Wherefore has the Lord done thus to this land, and to this house?

fresh_translation: And they shall say, Because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, who brought them out from the land of Egypt, and laid hold of other gods and worshiped them and served them, therefore he brought upon them all this evil.
brenton_translation: And men shall say, Because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they attached themselves to other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: and therefore he has brought upon them all this evil.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after twenty years in which Solomon built the house of the Lord and his own house,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after twenty years, in which Solomon built the house of the Lord, and his own house,

fresh_translation: and cities which Hiram gave to Solomon, Solomon built them and settled sons of Israel there.
brenton_translation: that Solomon rebuilt the cities which Chiram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell in them.

fresh_translation: And Solomon came to Hamath-Zobah and prevailed over it.
brenton_translation: And Solomon came to Bæsoba, and fortified it.

fresh_translation: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness and all strong cities which he built in Hamath.
brenton_translation: And he built Thoedmor in the wilderness, and all the strong cities which he built in Emath.

fresh_translation: And he built Bethhoron the upper and Bethhoron the lower, fortified cities, walls, gates, and bars,
brenton_translation: And he built Bæthoron the upper, and Bæthoron the lower, strong cities,—they had walls, gates, and bars;

fresh_translation: and Baalath and all strong cities which belonged to Solomon and all cities of chariots and cities of horsemen and whatever Solomon desired according to desire to build in Jerusalem and in Lebanon and in all his kingdom.
brenton_translation: and Balaath, and all the strong cities which Solomon had, and all his chariot cities, and cities of horsemen, and all things that Solomon desired according to his desire of building, in Jerusalem, and in Libanus, and in all his kingdom.

fresh_translation: All the people left over from Hittite and Amorite and Perizzite and Hivite and Jebusite, who were not from Israel,
brenton_translation: As for all the people that was left of the Chettites, and the Amorites, and the Pherezites, and the Evites, and the Jebusites, who are not of Israel,

fresh_translation: from their sons left after them in the land whom sons of Israel did not destroy, Solomon brought them up as tribute until this day.
brenton_translation: but were of the children of them whom the children of Israel destroyed not, that were left after them in the land, even them did Solomon make tributaries to this day.

fresh_translation: But from the sons of Israel Solomon did not make servants for his kingdom, because they were men of war and rulers and mighty men and rulers of chariots and horsemen.
brenton_translation: But Solomon did not make any of the children of Israel servants in his kingdom; for, behold, they were warriors and rulers, and mighty men, and captains of chariots and horsemen.

fresh_translation: And these were chiefs of officers of King Solomon, two hundred fifty overseeing work among people.
brenton_translation: And these are the chiefs of the officers of king Solomon, two hundred and fifty overseeing the work among the people.

fresh_translation: And Solomon brought daughter of Pharaoh up from the City of David into the house which he built for her, because he said, My wife shall not dwell in the City of David king of Israel, because holy is the place where the ark of the Lord entered.
brenton_translation: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharao from the city of David to the house which he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the city of David, the king of Israel, for the place is holy into which the ark of the Lord has entered.

fresh_translation: Then Solomon brought up whole burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar which he built opposite temple.
brenton_translation: Then Solomon offered up to the Lord whole-burnt-offerings on the altar which he had built to the Lord before the temple,

fresh_translation: And according to the matter of each day, for offering according to commandments of Moses, on Sabbaths and on new moons and on feasts three times of year, in the feast of unleavened bread and in the feast of weeks and in the feast of tents.
brenton_translation: according to the daily rate, to offer up sacrifices according to the commandments of Moses, on the sabbaths, and at the new moons, and at the feasts, three times in the year, at the feast of unleavened bread, and at the feast of weeks, and at the feast of tabernacles.

fresh_translation: And he established according to the ordinance of David divisions of priests according to their services, and Levites in their charges to praise and minister before priests according to each day's matter on its day, and gatekeepers in their divisions for gate and gate, because thus were commandments of David man of God.
brenton_translation: And he established, according to the order of his father David, the courses of the priests, and that according to their public ministrations: and the Levites were appointed over their charges, to praise and minister before the priests according to the daily order: and the porters were appointed according to their courses to the different gates: for thus were the commandments of David the man of God.

fresh_translation: They did not pass by commands of the king concerning priests and Levites in every matter and concerning treasuries.
brenton_translation: They transgressed not the commandments of the king concerning the priests and the Levites with regard to everything else, and with regard to the treasures.

fresh_translation: And all work was prepared from the day the house was founded until Solomon finished the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Now all the work had been prepared from the day when the foundation was laid, until Solomon finished the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Then Solomon went to Eziongeber and to Elath by sea in the land of Edom.
brenton_translation: Then Solomon went to Gasion Gaber, and to Ælath near the sea in the land of Idumea.

fresh_translation: And Hiram sent by the hands of his servants ships and servants knowing sea, and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir and took from there four hundred fifty talents of gold and came to King Solomon.
brenton_translation: And Chiram sent by the hand of his servants ships, and servants skilled in naval affairs; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Sophira, and brought thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and they came to king Solomon.

fresh_translation: And the queen of Sheba heard the name of Solomon and came to test Solomon with riddles in Jerusalem, with very weighty force, and camels carrying spices and gold in abundance and precious stone, and she came to Solomon and spoke with him all things in her soul.
brenton_translation: And the queen of Saba heard of the name of Solomon, and she came to Jerusalem with a very large force, to prove Solomon with hard questions, and she had camels bearing spices in abundance, and gold, and precious stones: and she came to Solomon, and told him all that was in her mind.

fresh_translation: And Solomon declared to her all her matters, and no matter passed from Solomon which he did not declare to her.
brenton_translation: And Solomon told her all her words; and there passed not a word from Solomon which he told her not.

fresh_translation: And the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon and the house which he built,
brenton_translation: And the queen of Saba saw the wisdom of Solomon, and the house which he had built,

fresh_translation: and foods of his tables and seating of his servants and standing of his ministers and their clothing and his cupbearers and their apparel and whole burnt offerings which he offered in the house of the Lord, and she was beside herself.
brenton_translation: and the meat of the tables, and the sitting of his servants, and the standing of his ministers, and their raiment; and his cupbearers, and their apparel; and the whole-burnt-offerings which he offered up in the house of the Lord; then she was in ecstasy.

fresh_translation: And she said to the king, True was word which I heard in my land concerning your matters and concerning your wisdom.
brenton_translation: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in my land concerning thy words, and concerning thy wisdom.

fresh_translation: And I did not believe words until I came and my eyes saw, and behold, half multitude of your wisdom was not reported to me. You added beyond report which I heard.
brenton_translation: Yet I believed not the reports until I came, and my eyes saw: and, behold, the half of the abundance of thy wisdom was not told me: thou hast exceeded the report which I heard.

fresh_translation: Blessed are your men; blessed are these servants of yours standing before you continually and hearing your wisdom.
brenton_translation: Blessed are thy men, blessed are these thy servants, who stand before thee continually, and hear thy wisdom.

fresh_translation: Blessed be the Lord your God, who delighted in you to set you on his throne as king for the Lord your God. Because the Lord your God loved Israel to establish him forever, he gave you over them as king to do judgment and righteousness.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord thy God, who took pleasure in thee, to set thee upon his throne for a king, to the Lord thy God: forasmuch as the Lord thy God loved Israel to establish them for ever, therefore he has set thee over them for a king to execute judgment and justice.

fresh_translation: And she gave to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold and spices in very great abundance and precious stone, and there were no spices like those which queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
brenton_translation: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and spices in very great abundance, and precious stones: and there were not any where else such spices as those which the queen of Saba gave king Solomon.

fresh_translation: And the servants of Solomon and servants of Hiram were bringing gold to Solomon from Ophir and pine woods and precious stone.
brenton_translation: And the servants of Solomon and the servants of Chiram brought gold to Solomon out of Suphir, and pine timber, and precious stones.

fresh_translation: And the king made from pine woods stairways for the house of the Lord and for the house of the king and lyres and harps for singers, and such things were not seen before in the land of Judah.
brenton_translation: And the king made of the pine timber steps to the house of the Lord, and to the king's house, and harps and lutes for the singers: and such were not seen before in the land of Juda.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desires which she asked, besides all which she brought to King Solomon, and she returned to her land.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Saba all that she requested, besides all that she brought to king Solomon: and she returned to her own land.

fresh_translation: And weight of gold brought to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
brenton_translation: And the weight of the gold that was brought to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,

fresh_translation: besides what subject men and traders brought, and all kings of Arabia and satraps of land brought gold and silver to King Solomon.
brenton_translation: besides what the men who were regularly appointed and the merchants brought, and all the kings of Arabia and princes of the land: all brought gold and silver to king Solomon.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon made two hundred beaten-gold shields; six hundred pure golds went upon one shield.
brenton_translation: And king Solomon made two hundred shields of beaten gold: there were six hundred shekels of pure gold to one shield.

fresh_translation: And three hundred beaten-gold bucklers; three hundred golds went up on each buckler, and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
brenton_translation: And three hundred bucklers of beaten gold: the weight of three hundred gold shekels went to one buckler: and the king placed them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

fresh_translation: And the king made great ivory throne and overlaid it with refined gold.
brenton_translation: And the king made a great throne of ivory, and he gilded it with pure gold.

fresh_translation: And six steps to throne, fastened with gold, and armrests on this side and on that side on the seat of throne, and two lions standing beside armrests.
brenton_translation: And there were six steps to the throne, riveted with gold, and elbows on either side of the seat of the throne, and two lions standing by the elbows:

fresh_translation: And twelve lions standing there on six steps, on this side and that side. Thus it had not been done in any kingdom.
brenton_translation: and twelve lions standing there on the six steps on each side. There was not the like in any other kingdom.

fresh_translation: And all vessels of King Solomon were of gold, and all vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon covered with gold; silver was not reckoned in the days of Solomon as anything.
brenton_translation: And all king Solomon's vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were covered with gold: silver was not thought anything of in the days of Solomon.

fresh_translation: Because ships went for the king to Tarshish with the servants of Hiram; once every three years ships came from Tarshish to the king full of gold and silver and ivory and monkeys.
brenton_translation: For a ship went for the king to Tharsis with the servants of Chiram: once every three years came vessels from Tharsis to the king, laden with gold, and silver, and ivory, and apes.

fresh_translation: And Solomon was magnified above all kings in wealth and wisdom.
brenton_translation: And Solomon exceeded all other kings both in riches and wisdom.

fresh_translation: And all kings of the earth were seeking the face of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God gave in his heart.
brenton_translation: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

fresh_translation: And they were bringing each his gifts, silver vessels and gold vessels and clothing, myrrh and spices, horses and mules, year by year.
brenton_translation: And they brought every one his gifts, silver vessels and golden vessels, and raiment, myrrh and spices, horses and mules, a rate every year.

fresh_translation: And Solomon had four thousand mares for chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he put them in the cities of chariots and with the king in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And Solomon had four thousand mares for chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; and he put them in the chariot cities, and with the king in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he was ruling all kings from the river and as far as land of Philistines and as far as border of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And he ruled over all the kings from the river even to the land of the Philistines, and to the borders of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And the king made gold and silver in Jerusalem like stones, and cedars like sycamines in lowland in abundance.
brenton_translation: And the king made gold and silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars as the sycamore trees in the plain for abundance.

fresh_translation: And the export of horses from Egypt was for Solomon, and from all the land.
brenton_translation: And Solomon imported horses from Egypt, and from every other country.

fresh_translation: And the rest of matters of Solomon, first and last, behold, written in the words of Nathan prophet and in the words of Ahijah the Shilonite and in visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, the first and the last, behold, these are written in the words of Nathan the prophet, and in the words of Achia the Selonite, and in the visions of Joel the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nabat.

fresh_translation: And King Solomon reigned over all Israel forty years.
brenton_translation: And Solomon reigned over all Israel forty years.

fresh_translation: And Solomon slept, and they buried him in the city of David his father, and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Solomon fell asleep, and they buried him in the city of David his father: and Roboam his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam came to Shechem, because all Israel came to Shechem to make him king.
brenton_translation: And Roboam came to Sychem: for all Israel came to Sychem to make him king.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when Jeroboam son of Nebat heard, while he himself was in Egypt, since he fled from before King Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt, and Jeroboam returned from Egypt,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Jeroboam the son of Nabat heard it, (now he was in Egypt, forasmuch as he had fled thither from the face of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt,) that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

fresh_translation: and they sent and called him, and Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came to Rehoboam, saying,
brenton_translation: And they sent and called him: and Jeroboam and all the congregation came to Roboam, saying,

fresh_translation: Your father made our yoke hard, and now lighten from hard service of your father and from his heavy yoke which he put upon us, and we will serve you.
brenton_translation: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now then abate somewhat of thy father's grievous rule, and of his heavy yoke which he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Go for three days and come again to me. And people departed.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Go away for three days, and then come to me. So the people departed.

fresh_translation: And King Rehoboam gathered elders who stood before Solomon his father while he lived, saying, How do you counsel to answer word to this people?
brenton_translation: And king Roboam assembled the elders that stood before his father Solomon in his life-time, saying, How do ye counsel me to return an answer to this people?

fresh_translation: And they spoke to him, saying, If today you become for good to this people and are pleased and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants all days.
brenton_translation: And they spoke to him, saying, If thou wouldest this day befriend this people, and be kind to them, and speak to them good words, then will they be thy servants for ever.

fresh_translation: But he left counsel of elders who counseled him and took counsel with young men brought up with him, who stood before him.
brenton_translation: But he forsook the advice of the old men, who took counsel with him, and he took counsel with the young men who had been brought up with him, who stood before him.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, What do you counsel, and what word shall I answer this people who spoke to me saying, Lighten from yoke which your father put upon us?
brenton_translation: And he said to them, What do ye advise that I should answer this people, who spoke to me, saying, Ease somewhat of the yoke which thy father laid upon us?

fresh_translation: And young men brought up with him spoke to him thus: Thus you shall speak to people who spoke to you saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, and you, lighten from us. Thus you shall say: My little finger is thicker than loins of my father.
brenton_translation: And the young men that had been brought up with him spoke to him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak to the people that spoke to thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, and do thou lighten somewhat of it from us; thus shalt thou say, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

fresh_translation: And now, my father disciplined you with heavy yoke, and I will add upon your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.
brenton_translation: And whereas my father chastised you with a heavy yoke, I will also add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, and I will chastise you with scorpions.

fresh_translation: And Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on third day, as king spoke saying, Return to me on third day.
brenton_translation: And Jeroboam and all the people came to Roboam on the third day, as the king had spoken, saying, Return to me on the third day.

fresh_translation: And the king answered harshly, and King Rehoboam left counsel of elders.
brenton_translation: And the king answered harshly; and king Roboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

fresh_translation: And he spoke to them according to the counsel of younger men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add upon it. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.
brenton_translation: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

fresh_translation: And the king did not listen to people, because turn came from God, so that the Lord might raise up his word which he spoke by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat.
brenton_translation: And the king hearkened not to the people, for there was a change of their minds from God, saying, The Lord has confirmed his word, which he spoke by the hand of Achia the Selonite concerning Jeroboam the son of Nabat, and concerning all Israel;

fresh_translation: And all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, and people answered the king saying, What share do we have in David and inheritance in son of Jesse? To your tents, Israel. Now see your house, David. And all Israel went to his tents.
brenton_translation: for the king did not hearken to them. And the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David, or inheritance in the son of Jessæ? to thy tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So all Israel went to their tents.

fresh_translation: But over the men of Israel dwelling in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
brenton_translation: But the men of Israel, even those who dwelt in the cities of Juda, remained and made Roboam king over them.

fresh_translation: And King Rehoboam sent Hadoram over tribute, and sons of Israel stoned him with stones, and he died. And King Rehoboam hurried to go up into chariot to flee to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And king Roboam sent to them Adoniram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, and he died. And king Roboam hasted to mount his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Israel broke covenant with the house of David until this day.
brenton_translation: So Israel rebelled against the house of David until this day.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam came to Jerusalem and assembled Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand young men making war, and he fought against Israel to return kingdom to Rehoboam.
brenton_translation: And Roboam came to Jerusalem; and he assembled Juda and Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand young men fit for war, and he waged war with Israel to recover the kingdom to Roboam.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah man of God, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Samaias the man of God, saying,

fresh_translation: Speak to Rehoboam son of Solomon and to all Judah and Benjamin, saying,
brenton_translation: Speak to Roboam the son of Solomon, and to all Juda and Benjamin, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: You shall not go up and shall not fight against your brothers. Return each to his house, because this thing came from me. And they listened to the word of the Lord and turned back from not going against Jeroboam.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, and ye shall not war against your brethren: return every one to his home; for this thing is of me. And they hearkened to the word of the Lord, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem and built fortified cities in Judah.
brenton_translation: And Roboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and he built walled cities in Judæa.

fresh_translation: And he built Bethlehem and Etam and Tekoa,
brenton_translation: And he built Bethleem, and Ætan and Thecoe,

fresh_translation: and Bethzur and Socoh and Adullam,
brenton_translation: and Bæthsura, and Sochoth, and Odollam,

fresh_translation: and Gath and Mareshah and Ziph,
brenton_translation: and Geth, and Marisa, and Ziph,

fresh_translation: and Adoraim and Lachish and Azekah,
brenton_translation: and Adorai, and Lachis, and Azeca,

fresh_translation: and Zorah and Aijalon and Hebron, which are of Judah and Benjamin, fortified cities.
brenton_translation: and Saraa, and Ælom, and Chebron, which belongs to Juda and Benjamin, walled cities.

fresh_translation: And he fortified them with walls and gave leaders in them and stores of foods, oil, and wine,
brenton_translation: And he fortified them with walls, and placed in them captains, and stores of provisions, oil and wine,

fresh_translation: city by city, shields and spears, and strengthened them very greatly, and Judah and Benjamin were his.
brenton_translation: shields and spears in every several city, and he fortified them very strongly, and he had on his side Juda and Benjamin.

fresh_translation: And priests and Levites who were in all Israel gathered to him from all borders,
brenton_translation: And the priests and the Levites who were in all Israel were gathered to him out of all the coasts.

fresh_translation: because Levites left tents of their possession and went to Judah, to Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons cast them out from ministering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: For the Levites left the tents of their possession, and went to Juda to Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had ejected them so that they should not minister to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he appointed for himself priests of high places and for idols and vanities and calves which Jeroboam made.
brenton_translation: And he made for himself priests of the high places, and for the idols, and for the vanities, and for the calves which Jeroboam made.

fresh_translation: And he cast out from tribes of Israel those who gave their hearts to seek the Lord God of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And he cast out from the tribes of Israel those who set their heart to seek the Lord God of Israel: and they came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice to the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And they strengthened kingdom of Judah and strengthened Rehoboam son of Solomon for three years, because he walked in the ways of David and Solomon three years.
brenton_translation: And they strengthened the kingdom of Juda; and Juda strengthened Roboam the son of Solomon for three years, for he walked three years in the ways of David and Solomon.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam took for himself Mahalath daughter of Jerimoth son of David, Abijah daughter of Eliab son of Jesse.
brenton_translation: And Roboam took to himself for a wife Moolath daughter of Jerimuth the son of David, and Abigaia daughter of Heliab the son of Jessæ.

fresh_translation: And she bore him sons, Jeush and Shamariah and Zaham.
brenton_translation: And she bore him sons; Jeus, and Samoria, and Zaam.

fresh_translation: And after these things he took for himself Maachah daughter of Absalom, and she bore him Abijah and Attai and Ziza and Shelomith.
brenton_translation: And afterwards he took to himself Maacha the daughter of Abessalom; and she bore him Abia, and Jetthi, and Zeza, and Salemoth.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam loved Maachah daughter of Absalom above all his wives and concubines, because he had eighteen wives and thirty concubines, and he fathered twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
brenton_translation: And Roboam loved Maacha the daughter of Abessalom more than all his wives and all his concubines: for he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines; and he begot twenty-eight sons, and sixty daughters.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maachah as a ruler, as a leader among his brothers, because he intended to make him king.
brenton_translation: And he made Abia the son of Maacha chief, even a leader among his brethren, for he intended to make him king.

fresh_translation: And he increased above all his sons in all borders of Judah and Benjamin and in fortified cities, and he gave them food in great abundance and sought multitude of wives.
brenton_translation: And he was exalted beyond all his other sons in all the coasts of Juda and Benjamin, and in the strong cities; and he gave them provisions in great abundance: and he desired many wives.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass, when kingdom of Rehoboam was prepared and as he grew strong, he forsook commandments of the Lord, and all Israel with him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the kingdom of Roboam was established, and when he had grown strong, that he forsook the commandments of the Lord, and all Israel with him.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass in the fifth year of the reign of Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they sinned against the Lord,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the fifth year of the reign of Roboam, Susakim king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had sinned against the Lord,

fresh_translation: with one thousand two hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen, and there was no number for multitude coming with him from Egypt: Libyans, Trogodytes, and Ethiopians.
brenton_translation: with twelve hundred chariots, and sixty thousand horse: and there was no number of the multitude that came with him from Egypt; Libyans, Trogodytes, and Ethiopians.

fresh_translation: And they seized fortified cities that were in Judah and came to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And they obtained possession of the strong cities, which were in Juda, and came to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and rulers of Judah, those gathered into Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, Thus says the Lord: You forsake me, and I also will forsake you into the hand of Shishak.
brenton_translation: And Samaias the prophet came to Roboam, and to the princes of Juda that were gathered to Jerusalem for fear of Susakim, and said to them, Thus said the Lord, Ye have left me, and I will leave you in the hand of Susakim.

fresh_translation: And the rulers of Israel and the king were put to shame and said, the Lord is righteous.
brenton_translation: And the elders of Israel and the king were ashamed, and said, The Lord is righteous.

fresh_translation: And when the Lord saw that they were put to shame, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah saying, They were put to shame; I will not destroy them, and I will give them a little salvation, and my wrath shall not drip upon Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And when the Lord saw that they repented, then came the word of the Lord to Samaias, saying, They have repented; I will not destroy them, but I will set them in safety for a little while, and my wrath shall not be poured out on Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: For they shall be servants, and they shall know my service and service of kingdom of earth.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless they shall be servants, and know my service, and the service of the kings of the earth.

fresh_translation: And Shishak king of Egypt came up and took treasures in the house of the Lord and treasures in the house of the king. He took all, and he took golden shields which Solomon made.
brenton_translation: So Susakim king of Egypt went up against Jerusalem, and took the treasures that were in the house of the Lord, and the treasures that were in the king's house: he took all; and he took the golden shields which Solomon had made.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam made bronze shields instead of them and set over them Shishak chiefs of runners guarding gate of the king.
brenton_translation: And king Roboam made brazen shields instead of them. And Susakim set over him captains of footmen, as keepers of the gate of the king.

fresh_translation: And whenever king entered the house of the Lord, guards and runners entered and then returned to chamber of runners.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the king went into the house of the Lord, the guards and the footmen went in, and they that returned to meet the footmen.

fresh_translation: And when he was put to shame, the wrath of the Lord turned away from him and not for destruction to end, and indeed in Judah there were good matters.
brenton_translation: And when he repented, the anger of the Lord turned from him, and did not destroy him utterly; for there were good things in Juda.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam was strengthened in Jerusalem and reigned. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, in the city which the Lord chose from all the tribes of the sons of Israel to have his name called there, and his mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite.
brenton_translation: So king Roboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: and Roboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, in the city which the Lord chose out of all the tribes of the children of Israel to call his name there: and his mother's name was Noomma the Ammanitess.

fresh_translation: And he did evil, because he did not direct his heart to seek the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he did evil, for he directed not his heart to seek the Lord.

fresh_translation: And matters of Rehoboam, first and last, behold, are they not written in the words of Shemaiah the prophet and Iddo the seer and his acts? And Rehoboam fought Jeroboam all his days.
brenton_translation: And the acts of Roboam, the first and the last, behold, are they not written in the book of Samaia the prophet, and Addo the seer, with his achievements.

fresh_translation: And Rehoboam died and was buried with his fathers and was buried in the City of David, and Abijah his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Roboam made war with Jeroboam all his days. And Roboam died with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abia his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam, Abijah reigned over Judah.
brenton_translation: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam Abia began to reign over Juda.

fresh_translation: He reigned three years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Maachah daughter of Uriel from Gibeon. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
brenton_translation: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maacha, daughter of Uriel of Gabaon.

fresh_translation: And Abijah drew up battle with a force of mighty warriors, four hundred thousand mighty men, and Jeroboam drew up battle against him with eight hundred thousand mighty warriors.
brenton_translation: And Abia set the battle in array with an army, with mighty men of war, even four hundred thousand mighty men: and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand, they were mighty warriors of the host.

fresh_translation: And Abijah stood up from mount Zemaraim, which is in the mountain of Ephraim, and said, Hear, Jeroboam and all Israel.
brenton_translation: And Abia rose up from the mount Somoron, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear ye, Jeroboam, and all Israel:

fresh_translation: Is it not for you to know that the Lord God of Israel gave kingdom over Israel forever to David and to his sons, covenant of salt?
brenton_translation: Is it not for you to know that the Lord God of Israel has given a king over Israel for ever to David, and to his sons, by a covenant of salt?

fresh_translation: And Jeroboam son of Nebat, servant of Solomon son of David, rose up and rebelled from his lord.
brenton_translation: But Jeroboam the son of Nabat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and has revolted from his master:

fresh_translation: And pestilent men, lawless sons, gathered to him and stood against Rehoboam son of Solomon, and Rehoboam was younger and timid in heart and did not stand against him.
brenton_translation: and there are gathered to him pestilent men, transgressors, and he has risen up against Roboam the son of Solomon, while Roboam was young and fearful in heart, and he withstood him not.

fresh_translation: And now you say you will stand against the kingdom of the Lord by the hand of sons of David, and you are many people, and with you are golden calves which Jeroboam made for you as gods.
brenton_translation: And now ye profess to resist the kingdom of the Lord in the hand of the sons of David; and ye are a great multitude, and with you are golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

fresh_translation: Did you not cast out priests of the Lord, sons of Aaron, and Levites, and make for yourselves priests from the people of the land? Everyone coming to fill hands with young bull from cattle and seven rams became priest to what was not god.
brenton_translation: Did ye not cast out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and make to yourselves priests of the people of any other land? whoever came to consecrate himself with a calf of the herd and seven rams, he forthwith became a priest to that which is no god.

fresh_translation: But we have not forsaken the Lord our God, and his priests minister to the Lord, sons of Aaron, and Levites in their courses.
brenton_translation: But we have not forsaken the Lord our God, and his priests, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, minister to the Lord; and in their daily courses

fresh_translation: They burn to the Lord whole burnt offerings morning and evening and incense of compounded spices and presentations of bread upon pure table, and golden lampstand and its lamps for burning to light at evening, because we keep charges of the Lord God of our fathers, but you forsake him.
brenton_translation: they sacrifice to the Lord whole-burnt-offering, morning and evening, and compound incense, and set the shewbread on the pure table; and there is the golden candlestick, and the lamps for burning, to light in the evening: for we keep the charge of the Lord God of our fathers; but ye have forsaken him.

fresh_translation: And behold, with us at beginning is the Lord, and his priests and trumpets of signal to sound against you. Sons of Israel, do not fight against the Lord God of our fathers, because it will not prosper for you.
brenton_translation: And, behold, the Lord and his priests are with us at our head, and the signal trumpets to sound an alarm over us. Children of Israel, fight not against the Lord God of our fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

fresh_translation: And Jeroboam turned ambush to come upon them from behind, and battle was before Judah and ambush behind them.
brenton_translation: Now Jeroboam had caused an ambush to come round upon him from behind: and he himself was before Juda, and the ambush behind.

fresh_translation: And Judah turned and behold, battle was before and behind them, and they cried out to the Lord, and priests sounded trumpets.
brenton_translation: And Juda looked back, and, behold, the battle was against them before and behind: and they cried to the Lord, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

fresh_translation: And the men of Judah shouted, and it came to pass when men of Judah shouted, the Lord struck Jeroboam and Israel before Abijah and Judah.
brenton_translation: And the men of Juda shouted: and it came to pass, when the men of Juda shouted, that the Lord smote Jeroboam and Israel before Abia and Juda.

fresh_translation: And sons of Israel fled from before Judah, and the Lord gave them into their hands.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel fled from before Juda; and the Lord delivered them into their hands.

fresh_translation: And Abijah and his people struck among them great blow, and five hundred thousand mighty men fell wounded from Israel.
brenton_translation: And Abia and his people smote them with a great slaughter: and there fell slain of Israel five hundred thousand mighty men.

fresh_translation: And sons of Israel were humbled in that day, and sons of Judah prevailed, because they hoped in the Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: So the children of Israel were brought low in that day, and the children of Juda prevailed, because they trusted on the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam and seized from him cities: Bethel and its villages, and Isana and its villages, and Ephraim and its villages.
brenton_translation: And Abia pursued after Jeroboam, and he took from him the cities, Bæthel and her towns, and Jesyna and her towns, and Ephron and her towns.

fresh_translation: And Jeroboam had no more strength all days of Abijah, and the Lord struck him and he died.
brenton_translation: And Jeroboam did not recover strength again all the days of Abia: and the Lord smote him, and he died.

fresh_translation: And Abijah grew strong and took for himself fourteen wives and fathered twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
brenton_translation: But Abia strengthened himself, and took to himself fourteen wives, and he begot twenty-two sons, and sixteen daughters.

fresh_translation: And the rest of matters of Abijah and his deeds and his words are written in the book of prophet Iddo.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Abia, and his deeds, and his sayings, are written in the book of the prophet Addo.

fresh_translation: And Abijah died with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David, and Asa his son reigned in his place. In the days of Asa, land of Judah was quiet ten years.
brenton_translation: And Abia died with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David; and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In the days of Asa the land of Juda had rest ten years.

fresh_translation: And he did good and upright in the sight of the Lord his God.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was good and right in the sight of the Lord his God.

fresh_translation: And he removed altars of foreigners and high places and broke pillars and cut down groves.
brenton_translation: And he removed the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and broke the pillars in pieces, and cut down the groves:

fresh_translation: And he told Judah to seek the Lord God of their fathers and to do law and commandments.
brenton_translation: and he told Juda to seek earnestly the Lord God of their fathers, and to perform the law and the commandments.

fresh_translation: And he removed from all the cities of Judah altars and idols, and land was at peace.
brenton_translation: And he removed from all the cities of Juda the altars and the idols, and established in quietness

fresh_translation: He built fortified cities in the land of Judah, because land was at peace, and there was no war with him in these years, because the Lord gave him rest.
brenton_translation: fortified cities in the land of Juda; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in these years; for the Lord gave him rest.

fresh_translation: And he said to Judah, Let us build these cities and make walls and towers and gates and bars, while we master land, because as we sought the Lord our God, he sought us and gave us rest all around, and he prospered us.
brenton_translation: And he said to Juda, Let us fortify these cities, and make walls, and towers, and gates, and bars: we shall prevail over the land, for as we have sought out the Lord our God, he has sought out us, and has given us rest round about, and prospered us.

fresh_translation: And Asa had force of shield-bearers and spear-carriers in the land of Judah, three hundred thousand, and in the land of Benjamin, peltasts and archers, two hundred fifty thousand. All these were mighty men of force.
brenton_translation: And Asa had a force of armed men bearing shields and spears in the land of Juda, even three hundred thousand, and in the land of Benjamin two hundred and eighty thousand targeteers and archers: all these were mighty warriors.

fresh_translation: And Zerah the Aithiopian came out against them with force of one million and three hundred chariots and came as far as Mareshah.
brenton_translation: And Zare the Ethiopian went out against them, with a force of a million, and three hundred chariots; and came to Maresa.

fresh_translation: And Asa went out to meet him and drew up battle in ravine north of Mareshah.
brenton_translation: And Asa went out to meet him, and set the battle in array in the valley north of Maresa.

fresh_translation: And Asa cried to the Lord his God and said, Lord, with you it is not impossible to save with many and with few. Strengthen us, Lord our God, because in you we trust, and in your name we came against this great multitude. Lord our God, let not man prevail against you.
brenton_translation: And Asa cried to the Lord his God, and said, O Lord, it is not impossible with thee to save by many or by few: strengthen us, O Lord our God; for we trust in thee, and in thy name have we come against this great multitude. O Lord our God, let not man prevail against thee.

fresh_translation: And the Lord struck Ethiopians before Judah, and Ethiopians fled.
brenton_translation: And the Lord smote the Ethiopians before Juda; and the Ethiopians fled.

fresh_translation: And Asa and his people pursued them as far as Gerar, and Ethiopians fell so that there was no preservation in them, because they were crushed before the Lord and before his force, and they plundered many spoils.
brenton_translation: And Asa and his people pursued them to Gedor; and the Ethiopians fell, so that they could not recover themselves; for they were crushed before the Lord, and before his host; and they took many spoils.

fresh_translation: And they cut off their villages around Gerar, because terror of the Lord came upon them, and they plundered all their cities, because there became much spoil for them.
brenton_translation: And they destroyed their towns round about Gedor; for a terror of the Lord was upon them: and they spoiled all their cities, for they had much spoil.

fresh_translation: And indeed they cut off tents of livestock of Amazons and took many sheep and camels and returned to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Also they destroyed the tents of cattle, and the Alimazons, and took many sheep and camels, and returned to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Azariah son of Oded, spirit of the Lord came upon him.
brenton_translation: And Azarias the son of Oded—upon him came the Spirit of the Lord,

fresh_translation: And he went out to meet Asa and all Judah and Benjamin and said, Hear me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin: The Lord is with you while you are with him, and if you seek him, he will be found by you, and if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
brenton_translation: and he went out to meet Asa, and all Juda and Benjamin, and said, Hear me, Asa, and all Juda and Benjamin. The Lord is with you, while ye are with him; and if ye seek him out, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.

fresh_translation: And many days Israel was without true God and without priest showing way and without law.
brenton_translation: And Israel has been a long time without the true God, and without a priest to expound the truth, and without the law.

fresh_translation: And he will return upon the Lord God of Israel, and he will be found by them.
brenton_translation: But he shall turn them to the Lord God of Israel, and he will be found of them.

fresh_translation: And in that time there is no peace to one going out and to one coming in, because terror of the Lord is upon all dwelling in lands.
brenton_translation: And in that time there is no peace to one going out, or to one coming in, for the terror of the Lord is upon all that inhabit the lands.

fresh_translation: And nation will fight against nation and city against city, because God troubled them with every affliction.
brenton_translation: And nation shall fight against nation, and city against city; for God has confounded them with every kind of affliction.

fresh_translation: And you, be strong, and do not let your hands be weakened, because there is reward for your work.
brenton_translation: But be ye strong, and let not your hands be weakened: for there is a reward for your work.

fresh_translation: And when he heard these words and prophecy of Hadad the prophet, he was strengthened and cast out abominations from all the land of Judah and Benjamin and from cities which he seized in the mountain of Ephraim and renewed altar of the Lord which was before the temple of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Adad the prophet, then he strengthened himself, and cast out the abominations from all the land of Juda and Benjamin, and from the cities which Jeroboam possessed, in mount Ephraim, and he renewed the altar of the Lord, which was before the temple of the Lord.
