fresh_translation: And he assembled Judah and Benjamin and sojourners dwelling with him from Ephraim and from Manasseh and from Simeon, because many from Israel joined themselves to him when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.
brenton_translation: And he assembled Juda and Benjamin, and the strangers that dwelt with him, of Ephraim, and of Manasse, and of Symeon: for many of Israel were joined to him, when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.

fresh_translation: And they were gathered into Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the kingdom of Asa.
brenton_translation: And they assembled at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

fresh_translation: And they sacrificed to the Lord in that day from spoils they brought, seven hundred calves and seven thousand sheep.
brenton_translation: And he sacrificed to the Lord in that day of the spoils which they brought, seven hundred calves and seven thousand sheep.

fresh_translation: And he entered into covenant to seek the Lord God of their fathers with all heart and with all soul.
brenton_translation: And he entered into a covenant that they should seek the Lord God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul.

fresh_translation: And everyone who would not seek the Lord God of Israel shall die, from younger to elder, from man to woman.
brenton_translation: And that whoever should not seek the Lord God of Israel, should die, whether young or old, whether man or woman.

fresh_translation: And they swore in the Lord with loud voice and with trumpets and with horns.
brenton_translation: And they swore to the Lord with a loud voice, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

fresh_translation: And all Judah rejoiced over oath, because with all their soul they swore and with all their desire sought him, and he was found by them, and the Lord gave them rest all around.
brenton_translation: And all Juda rejoiced concerning the oath: for they swore with all their heart, and they sought him with all their desires; and he was found of them: and the Lord gave them rest round about.

fresh_translation: And he removed Maachah his mother from not being one serving Ashtaroth, and he cut down idol and burned it in torrent of Kidron.
brenton_translation: And he removed Maacha his mother from being priestess to Astarte; and he cut down the idol, and burnt it in the brook of Kedron.

fresh_translation: But high places were not removed; there was still in Israel. Yet heart of Asa became full all his days.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless they removed not the high places: they still existed in Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

fresh_translation: And he brought in the holy things of David his father and holy things of the house of the Lord God, silver and gold and vessels.
brenton_translation: And he brought in the holy things of David his father, and the holy things of the house of God, silver, and gold, and vessels.

fresh_translation: And there was no war with him until the thirty-fifth year of the kingdom of Asa.
brenton_translation: And there was no war waged with him until the thirty-fifth year of the reign of Asa.

fresh_translation: And in the thirty-eighth year of the kingdom of Asa, Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah and built Ramah so as not to give exit and entry to Asa king of Judah.
brenton_translation: And in the thirty-eighth year of the reign of Asa, the king of Israel went up against Juda, and built Rama, so as not to allow egress or ingress to Asa king of Juda.

fresh_translation: And Asa took gold and silver from treasures of the house of the Lord and the house of the king and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria dwelling in Damascus, saying,
brenton_translation: And Asa took silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the Lord, and of the king's house, and sent them to the son of Ader king of Syria, which dwelt in Damascus, saying,

fresh_translation: Make covenant between me and you and between my father and your father. Behold, I sent you gold and silver. Come, scatter away from me Baasha king of Israel, and let him depart from me.
brenton_translation: Make a covenant between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee gold and silver: come, and turn away from me Baasa king of Israel, and let him depart from me.

fresh_translation: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent chiefs of his force against the cities of Israel, and he struck Ijon and Dan and Abelmaim and all surrounding places of Naphtali.
brenton_translation: And the son of Ader hearkened to king Asa, and sent the captains of his host against the cities of Israel; and smote Æon, and Dan, and Abelmain, and all the country round Nephthali.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when Baasha heard, he left off building Ramah and stopped his work.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when Baasa heard it, he left off building Rama, and put a stop to his work:

fresh_translation: And Asa the king took all Judah and took stones of Ramah and its timbers, with which Baasha had built, and built with them Geba and Mizpeh.
brenton_translation: then king Asa took all Juda, and took the stones of Rama, and its timber, with which Baasa had built; and he built with them Gabae and Maspha.

fresh_translation: And at that time Anani the prophet came to Asa king of Judah and said to him, Because you trusted in king of Syria and did not trust in the Lord your God, because of this force of Syria escaped from your hand.
brenton_translation: And at that time came Anani the prophet to Asa king of Juda, and said to him, Because thou didst trust on the king of Syria, and didst not trust on the Lord thy God, therefore the army of Syria is escaped out of thy hand.

fresh_translation: Were not Ethiopians and Libyans for very great force, for courage, horsemen in great multitude? Yet when you trusted in the Lord, he gave them into your hands.
brenton_translation: Were not the Ethiopians and Libyans a great force, in courage, in horsemen, in great numbers? and did not He deliver them into thy hands, because thou trustedst in the Lord?

fresh_translation: Because eyes of the Lord look through all the earth to strengthen every heart full toward him. You acted foolishly in this; from now on wars shall be with you.
brenton_translation: For the eyes of the Lord look upon all the earth, to strengthen every heart that is perfect toward him. In this thou hast done foolishly; henceforth there shall be war with thee.

fresh_translation: And Asa was angry with prophet and put him in prison, because he was enraged over this, and Asa brought harm among people at that time.
brenton_translation: And Asa was angry with the prophet, and put him in prison, for he was angry at this: and Asa vexed some of the people at that time.

fresh_translation: And behold, matters of Asa, first and last, are written in the book of kings of Judah and Israel.
brenton_translation: And, behold, the acts of Asa, the first and the last, are written in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel.

fresh_translation: And Asa became diseased in his feet in the thirty-ninth year of his kingdom, until he was very diseased, and in his disease he did not seek the Lord but physicians.
brenton_translation: And Asa was diseased in his feet in the thirty-ninth year of his reign, until he was very ill: but in his disease he sought not to the Lord, but to the physicians.

fresh_translation: And Asa slept with his fathers and died in the thirty-ninth year of his kingdom.
brenton_translation: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the fortieth year of his reign.

fresh_translation: And they buried him in tomb which he dug for himself in the City of David and laid him on bier, and they filled it with spices and kinds of perfumed ointments, and they made for him very great funeral.
brenton_translation: And they buried him in the sepulchre which he had dug for himself in the city of David, and they laid him on a bed, and filled it with spices and all kinds of perfumes of the apothecaries; and they made for him a very great funeral.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and Jehoshaphat prevailed over Israel.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat his son reigned in his stead, and Josaphat strengthened himself against Israel.

fresh_translation: And he put force in all fortified cities of Judah and set rulers in all cities of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim which Asa his father seized.
brenton_translation: And he put garrisons in all the strong cities of Juda, and appointed captains in all the cities of Juda, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in first ways of his father and did not seek idols,
brenton_translation: And the Lord was with Josaphat, for he walked in the first ways of his father, and did not seek to idols;

fresh_translation: but sought the Lord God of his father and walked in the commandments of his father and not according to the works of Israel.
brenton_translation: but he sought to the Lord God of his father, and walked in the commandments of his father, and not according to the works of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord directed kingdom in his hand, and all Judah gave gifts to Jehoshaphat, and he had much wealth and glory.
brenton_translation: And the Lord prospered the kingdom in his hand; and all Juda gave gifts to Josaphat; and he had great wealth and glory.

fresh_translation: And his heart was lifted high in the way of the Lord, and he further removed high places and groves from the land of Judah.
brenton_translation: And his heart was exalted in the way of the Lord; and he removed the high places and the groves from the land of Juda.

fresh_translation: And in the third year of his kingdom he sent his rulers and sons of mighty men, Abdian and Zechariah and Nathanael and Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah,
brenton_translation: And in the third year of his reign, he sent his chief men, and his mighty men, Abdias and Zacharias, and Nathanael, and Michaias, to teach in the cities of Juda.

fresh_translation: and with them Levites Samouias and Nethaniah and Zebadiah and Jaasiel and Shemiramoth and Jonathan and Adonijah and Tobijah, the Levites, and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
brenton_translation: And with them were the Levites, Samaias, and Nathanias, and Zabdias, and Asiel, and Semiramoth, and Jonathan, and Adonias, and Tobias, and Tobadonias, Levites, and with them Elisama and Joram, the priests.

fresh_translation: And they were teaching in Judah, and with them was the book of the law of the Lord, and they went through the cities of Judah and taught the people.
brenton_translation: And they taught in Juda, and there was with them the book of the law of the Lord, and they passed through the cities of Juda, and taught the people.

fresh_translation: And terror of the Lord came upon all kingdoms of the earth around Judah, and they did not war against Jehoshaphat.
brenton_translation: And a terror of the Lord was upon all the kingdoms of the land round about Juda, and they made no war against Josaphat.

fresh_translation: And from Philistines they were bringing to Jehoshaphat gifts and silver and tribute, and Arabs brought him seven thousand seven hundred rams of sheep.
brenton_translation: And some of the Philistines brought to Josaphat gifts, and silver, and presents; and the Arabians brought him seven thousand seven hundred rams.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat was becoming greater and greater on high, and he built dwellings in Judah and fortified cities.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat increased in greatness exceedingly, and built in Judea places of abode, and strong cities.

fresh_translation: And many works came to him in Judah, and mighty men of war were strong in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And he had many works in Judea: and the mighty men of war, the men of strength, were in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And this was their number according to the houses of their fathers: for Judah, commanders of thousands: Adnah the chief, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of force;
brenton_translation: And this is their number according to the houses of their fathers; even the captains of thousands in Juda were, Ednas the chief, and with him mighty men of strength three hundred thousand.

fresh_translation: and with him Jehohanan the leader, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;
brenton_translation: And after him, Joanan the captain, and with him two hundred and eighty thousand.

fresh_translation: and with him Amaziah son of Zichri, one willingly given to the Lord, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of force;
brenton_translation: And after him Amasias the son of Zari, who was zealous for the Lord; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of strength.

fresh_translation: and from Benjamin, mighty man of force Eliada, and with him archers and peltasts, two hundred thousand;
brenton_translation: And out of Benjamin there was a mighty man of strength, even Eliada, and with him two hundred thousand archers and targeteers.

fresh_translation: and with him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand mighty for war.
brenton_translation: And after him Jozabad, and with him a hundred and eighty thousand mighty men of war.

fresh_translation: These were those ministering to the king, besides those whom king placed in fortified cities in all Judah.
brenton_translation: These were the king's servants, besides those whom the king put in the strong cities in all Judea.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat had still much wealth and glory, and he joined by marriage with the house of Ahab.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat had yet great wealth and glory, and he connected himself by marriage with the house of Achaab.

fresh_translation: And after the end of years he went down to Ahab in Samaria, and Ahab sacrificed to him many sheep and calves and to people with him, and deceived him to go up with him to Ramoth of Gilead.
brenton_translation: And he went down after a term of years to Achaab to Samaria: and Achaab slew for him sheep and calves, in abundance, and for the people with him, and he much desired him to go up with him to Ramoth of the country of Galaad.

fresh_translation: And Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Will you go with me to Ramoth of Gilead? And he said to him, As I am, so are you; as your people, so my people, with you in battle.
brenton_translation: And Achaab king of Israel said to Josaphat king of Juda, Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth of the country of Galaad? And he said to him, As I am, so also art thou, as thy people, so also is my people with thee for the war.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Seek now today Lord.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat said to the king of Israel, Seek, I pray thee, the Lord to-day.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel gathered prophets, four hundred men, and said to them, Shall I go to Ramoth Gilead for battle, or shall I hold back? And they said, Go up, and God will give into the hands of the king.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel gathered the prophets, four hundred men, and said to them, Shall I go to Ramoth Galaad to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up, and God shall deliver it into the hands of the king.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here still prophet of the Lord, and shall we seek through him?
brenton_translation: And Josaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord besides, that we may enquire of him?

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, There is still one man through whom to seek the Lord, and I hated him, because he is not prophesying good concerning me, but all his days evil. This is Micaiah son of Imlah. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king speak thus.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat, There is yet one man by whom to enquire of the Lord; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy concerning me for good, for all his days are for evil: this is Michaias the son of Jembla. And Josaphat said, Let not the king say so.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel called one eunuch and said, Quickly, Micaiah son of Imlah.
brenton_translation: And the king called an eunuch, and said, Fetch quickly Michaias the son of Jembla.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, clothed in robes, sitting in the broad place of gate of Samaria, and all prophets were prophesying before them.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel and Josaphat king of Juda were sitting each on his throne, and clothed in their robes, sitting in the open space at the entrance of the gate of Samaria: and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

fresh_translation: And Zedekiah son of Chenaanah made for himself iron horns and said, Thus says the Lord: With these you shall gore Syria until it is finished.
brenton_translation: And Sedekias son of Chanaan made for himself iron horns, and said, Thus saith the Lord, With these thou shalt thrust Syria until it be consumed.

fresh_translation: And all prophets were prophesying thus, saying, Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper, and the Lord will give into the hands of the king.
brenton_translation: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth Galaad, and thou shalt prosper; and the Lord shall deliver it into the hands of the king.

fresh_translation: And messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, Behold, prophets spoke with one mouth good things about king. Let your words now be like one of them, and you shall speak good things.
brenton_translation: And the messenger that went to call Michaias spoke to him, saying, Behold, the prophets have spoken favourably concerning the king with one mouth; let now, I pray thee, thy words be as the words of one of them, and do thou speak good things.

fresh_translation: And Micaiah said, As the Lord lives, whatever God says to me, this I will speak.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, As the Lord lives, whatever God shall say to me, that will I speak.

fresh_translation: And he came to the king, and the king said to him, Micaiah, shall I go to Ramoth Gilead for battle, or shall I hold back? And he said, Go up, and you will prosper, and they shall be given into your hands.
brenton_translation: And he came to the king, and the king said to him, Michaias, shall I go up to Ramoth Galaad to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go up, and thou shalt prosper, and they shall be given into your hands.

fresh_translation: And the king said to him, How many times shall I make you swear that you speak to me nothing except truth in the name of the Lord?
brenton_translation: And the king said to him, How often shall I solemnly charge thee that thou speak to me nothing but truth in the name of the Lord?

fresh_translation: And he said, I saw Israel scattered on mountains like sheep which have no shepherd, and the Lord said, These have no ruler; let each return to his house in peace.
brenton_translation: And he said, I saw Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep without a shepherd: and the Lord said, These have no commander; let each return to his home in peace.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not say to you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat, Said I not to thee, that he would not prophesy concerning me good, but evil?

fresh_translation: And he said, Not so. Hear the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all force of heaven stood at his right and at his left.
brenton_translation: But he said, Not so. Hear ye the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven stood by on his right hand and on his left.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, Who will deceive Ahab king of Israel, and he will go up and fall in Ramoth Gilead? And one said thus and another said thus.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, Who will deceive Achaab king of Israel, that he may go up, and fall in Ramoth Galaad? And one spoke this way, and another spoke that way.

fresh_translation: And spirit came out and stood before the Lord and said, I will deceive him. And the Lord said, In what way?
brenton_translation: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the Lord, and said, I will deceive him. And the Lord said, Whereby?

fresh_translation: And he said, I will go out and be lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, You shall deceive and you shall be able; go out and do so.
brenton_translation: And he said, I will go forth, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And the Lord said, Thou shalt deceive him, and shalt prevail: go forth, and do so.

fresh_translation: And now, behold, the Lord has put lying spirit in the mouth of all these prophets of yours, and the Lord spoke evil against you.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, the Lord has put a false spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the Lord has spoken evil against thee.

fresh_translation: And Zedekiah son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on jaw and said to him, By what way did spirit of the Lord pass from me to speak to you?
brenton_translation: Then Sedekias the son of Chanaan drew near, and smote Michaias on the cheek, and said to him, By what way passed the Spirit of the Lord from me to speak to thee?

fresh_translation: And Micaiah said, Behold, you will see in that day when you enter chamber from chamber to hide yourself.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go from chamber to chamber to hide thyself.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah and return him to Amon ruler of the city and to Joash ruler, son of the king,
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said, Take Michaias, and carry him back to Emer the governor of the city, and to Joas the captain, the king's son;

fresh_translation: and say, Thus says king: Put this one into the house of prison, and let him eat bread of affliction and water of affliction until I return in peace.
brenton_translation: and ye shall say, Thus said the king, Put this fellow into the prison-house, and let him eat the bread of affliction, and drink the water of affliction, until I return in peace.

fresh_translation: And Micaiah said, If you indeed return in peace, the Lord did not speak in me. Hear, all peoples.
brenton_translation: And Michaias said, If thou do at all return in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me. And he said, Hear, all ye people.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.
brenton_translation: So the king of Israel, and Josaphat king of Juda, went up to Ramoth Galaad.

fresh_translation: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself and enter into battle, and you put on my clothing. And the king of Israel disguised himself and entered into battle.
brenton_translation: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat, Disguise me, and I will enter into the battle: and do thou put on my raiment. So the king of Israel disguised himself, and entered into the battle.

fresh_translation: And the king of Syria commanded chiefs of chariots with him, saying, Do not fight small and great, except the king of Israel only.
brenton_translation: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight neither against small nor great, but only against the king of Israel.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when the chiefs of chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, It is the king of Israel. And they surrounded him to fight, and Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord saved him, and God turned them away from him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Josaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel: and they compassed him about to fight against him: and Josaphat cried out, and the Lord delivered him; and God turned them away from him.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when the chiefs of chariots saw that he was not king of Israel, they turned away from him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned away from him.

fresh_translation: And a man bent bow by good aim and struck king of Israel between lung and between chest, and he said to driver, Turn your hand and bring me out of battle, because I am in pain.
brenton_translation: And a man drew a bow with a good aim, and smote the king of Israel between the lungs and the breastplate: and he said to the charioteer, Turn thine hand, drive me out of the battle, for I am wounded.

fresh_translation: And battle turned in that day, and the king of Israel was standing on chariot until evening against Syria, and he died at setting of sun.
brenton_translation: And the battle turned in that day; and the king of Israel remained on the chariot against Syria until evening, and died at sunset.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned to his house in peace, to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat king of Juda returned to his house at Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Jehu son of Anani the prophet went out to meet him and said to him, King Jehoshaphat, do you help sinner, or make friendship with one hated by the Lord? Because of this wrath came upon you from the Lord.
brenton_translation: And there went out to meet him Jeu the prophet the son of Anani, and said to him, King Josaphat, dost thou help a sinner, or act friendly towards one hated of the Lord? Therefore has wrath come upon thee from the Lord.

fresh_translation: Yet good matters were found in you, because you removed groves from the land of Judah and directed your heart to seek the Lord.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless some good things have been found in thee, forasmuch as thou didst remove the groves from the land of Juda, and didst direct thine heart to seek after the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat dwelt in Jerusalem and again went out to people from Beersheba to the mountain of Ephraim and turned them back to the Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat dwelt in Jerusalem: and he again went out among the people from Bersabee to the mount of Ephraim, and turned them back to the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And he appointed judges in all fortified cities of Judah, city by city.
brenton_translation: And he appointed judges in all the strong cities of Juda, city by city.

fresh_translation: And he said to judges, See what you do, because you do not judge for man, but for the Lord, and matters of judgment are with you.
brenton_translation: And he said to the judges, Take good heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the Lord, and with you are matters of judgment.

fresh_translation: And now let the fear of the Lord be upon you, and keep and do, because with the Lord our God there is no injustice, nor regard of face, nor taking of gifts.
brenton_translation: And now let the fear of the Lord be upon you, and be wary, and do your duty: for there is no unrighteousness with the Lord our God, neither is it for him to respect persons, nor to take bribes.

fresh_translation: And also in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed from priests and Levites and patriarchs of Israel for the judgment of the Lord and to judge those dwelling in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Moreover Josaphat appointed in Jerusalem some of the priests, and Levites, and heads of houses of Israel, for the judgment of the Lord, and to judge the dwellers in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he commanded them, saying, Thus you shall do in the fear of the Lord, in truth and with full heart.
brenton_translation: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the Lord, in truth and with a perfect heart.

fresh_translation: Every case that comes upon you from your brothers dwelling in their cities, between blood and blood and between ordinance and commandment and statutes and judgments, you shall make distinction for them, and they shall not sin against the Lord, and wrath shall not be on you and on your brothers. Thus you shall do and you shall not sin.
brenton_translation: Whatsoever man of your brethren that dwell in their cities shall bring the cause that comes before you, between blood and blood, and between precept and commandment, and ordinances and judgments, ye shall even decide for them; so they shall not sin against the Lord, and there shall not be wrath upon you, and upon your brethren: thus ye shall do, and ye shall not sin.

fresh_translation: And behold, Amariah the priest is leader over you for every matter of the Lord, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael is leader for the house of Judah for every matter of the king, and scribes and Levites are before you. Be strong and do, and the Lord shall be with good man.
brenton_translation: And, behold, Amarias the priest is head over you in every matter of the Lord; and Zabdias the son of Ismael is head over the house of Juda in every matter of the king; and the scribes and Levites are before you: be strong and active, and the Lord shall be with the good.

fresh_translation: And after these things sons of Moab and sons of Ammon and with them from Meunites came against Jehoshaphat for battle.
brenton_translation: And after this came the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Minæans, against Josaphat to battle.

fresh_translation: And they came and reported to Jehoshaphat, saying, Great multitude has come against you from beyond sea, from Syria, and behold, they are in Asasanthamar, this is Engedi.
brenton_translation: And they came and told Josaphat, saying, There is come against thee a great multitude from Syria, from beyond the sea; and, behold, they are in Asasan Thamar, this is Engadi.

fresh_translation: And he feared, and Jehoshaphat set his face to seek the Lord and proclaimed fast in all Judah.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat was alarmed, and set his face to seek the Lord earnestly, and he proclaimed a fast in all Juda.

fresh_translation: And Judah gathered to seek the Lord, and from all the cities of Judah they came to seek the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Juda gathered themselves together to seek after the Lord: even from all the cities of Juda they came to seek the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah in Jerusalem, in the house of the Lord, before new court,
brenton_translation: And Josaphat stood up in the assembly of Juda in Jerusalem, in the house of the Lord, in front of the new court.

fresh_translation: and said, Lord God of our fathers, are you not God in heaven, and do you not rule over all kingdoms of nations? And in your hand are strength and power, and none can stand against you.
brenton_translation: And he said, O Lord God of my fathers, art not thou God in heaven above, and art not thou Lord of all the kingdoms of the nations? and is there not in thy hand the might of dominion, and there is no one who can resist thee?

fresh_translation: Are you not the Lord who destroyed inhabitants of this land from before your people Israel and gave it to the seed of Abraham your beloved forever?
brenton_translation: Art not thou the Lord that didst destroy the inhabitants of this land before the face of thy people Israel, and didst give it to thy beloved seed of Abraham for ever?

fresh_translation: And they dwelt in it and built in it sanctuary to your name, saying,
brenton_translation: And they dwelt in it, and built in it a sanctuary to thy name, saying,

fresh_translation: If evils come upon us, sword, judgment, death, famine, we shall stand before this house and before you, because your name is upon this house, and we shall cry to you from affliction, and you will hear and save.
brenton_translation: If there should come upon us evils, sword, judgment, pestilence, famine, we will stand before this house, and before thee, (for thy name is upon this house,) and we will cry to thee because of the affliction, and thou shalt hear, and deliver.

fresh_translation: And now, behold, sons of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, through whom you did not allow Israel to pass when they came out from the land of Egypt, because they turned away from them and did not destroy them,
brenton_translation: And now, behold, the children of Ammon, and Moab, and mount Seir, with regard to whom thou didst not permit Israel to pass through their border, when they had come out of the land of Egypt, (for they turned away from them, and did not destroy them;)—

fresh_translation: and now, behold, they attempt against us, to come cast us out from our inheritance which you gave us.
brenton_translation: yet now, behold, they make attempts against us, to come forth to cast us out from our inheritance which thou gavest us.

fresh_translation: Lord our God, will you not judge among them? Because there is no strength in us to stand against this great multitude that came upon us, and we do not know what we should do, but our eyes are upon you.
brenton_translation: O Lord our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no strength to resist this great multitude that is come against us; and we know not what we shall do to them: but our eyes are toward thee.

fresh_translation: And all Judah stood before the Lord, and their little children and wives.
brenton_translation: And all Juda was standing before the Lord, and their children, and their wives.

fresh_translation: And upon Uzziel son of Zechariah, from the sons of Benaiah, from the sons of Levite, from Mattaniah the Levite, from the sons of Asaph, spirit of the Lord came in assembly,
brenton_translation: And Oziel the son of Zacharias, of the children of Banaias, of the sons of Eleïel the sons of Matthanias the Levite, of the sons of Asaph,—upon him came the Spirit of the Lord in the assembly:

fresh_translation: and he said, Hear, all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and King Jehoshaphat. Thus says the Lord to you: Do not fear and do not be dismayed before this great multitude, because battle is not yours but God’s.
brenton_translation: and he said, Hear ye, all Juda, and the dwellers in Jerusalem, and king Josaphat: Thus saith the Lord to you, even you, Fear not, neither be alarmed, before all this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.

fresh_translation: Tomorrow go down against them. Behold, they are going up by ascent of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the river of the wilderness Jeruel.
brenton_translation: To-morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the ascent of Assis, and ye shall find them at the extremity of the river of the wilderness of Jeriel.

fresh_translation: It is not for you to fight in this. Stand and see salvation of the Lord with you, Judah and Jerusalem. Do not fear and do not be dismayed. Tomorrow go out to meet them, and the Lord is with you.
brenton_translation: It is not for you to fight: understand these things, and see the deliverance of the Lord with you, Juda and Jerusalem: fear not, neither be afraid to go forth to-morrow to meet them; and the Lord shall be with you.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat bowed with his face to the ground, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the Lord to worship the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat bowed with his face to the ground with all Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem, and they fell before the Lord to worship the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Levites from the sons of Kohath and from the sons of Kore rose to praise the Lord God of Israel with very great loud voice.
brenton_translation: And the Levites of the children of Caath, and they of the sons of Core, rose up to praise the Lord God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

fresh_translation: And they rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa, and as they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and cried, saying, Hear me, Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem. Trust in the Lord your God and you shall be trusted; trust in his prophet and you shall prosper.
brenton_translation: And they rose early in the morning and went out to the wilderness of Thecoe: and as they went out, Josaphat stood and cried, and said, Hear me, Juda, and the dwellers in Jerusalem; put your trust in the Lord God, and your trust shall be honoured; trust in his prophet, and ye shall prosper.

fresh_translation: And he took counsel with people and set singers and praisers to give thanks and praise holy things as they went out before force, and they said, Give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy is forever.
brenton_translation: And he took counsel with the people, and set appointed men to sing psalms and praises, to give thanks, and sing the holy songs of praise in going forth before the host: and they said, Give thanks to the Lord, for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: And when he began praise of thanksgiving, the Lord made sons of Ammon fight against Moab and mount Seir, those coming out against Judah, and they were routed.
brenton_translation: And when they began the praise and thanksgiving, the Lord caused the children of Ammon to fight against Moab, and the inhabitants of mount Seir that came out against Juda; and they were routed.

fresh_translation: And sons of Ammon and Moab rose against the inhabitants of mount Seir to destroy and wipe out, and when they finished inhabitants of Seir, they rose against one another for destruction.
brenton_translation: Then the children of Ammon and Moab rose up against the dwellers in mount Seir, to destroy and consume them; and when they had made an end of destroying the inhabitants of Seir, they rose up against one another so that they were utterly destroyed.

fresh_translation: And Judah came to watchtower of the wilderness and looked, and saw multitude, and behold, all were dead, fallen on ground; there was none being saved.
brenton_translation: And Juda came to the watch-tower of the wilderness, and looked, and saw the multitude, and, behold, they were all fallen dead upon the earth, not one escaped.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat and his people came to plunder their spoils and found many cattle and baggage and spoils and desirable vessels, and they plundered for themselves, and it was three days they plundered spoils, because it was much.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat and his people went out to spoil them, and they found much cattle, and furniture, and spoils, and precious things: and they spoiled them, and they were three days gathering the spoil, for it was abundant.

fresh_translation: And on fourth day they were gathered to the valley of blessing, because there they blessed the Lord. Therefore name of that place was called Valley of Blessing until this day.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the fourth day they were gathered to the Valley of Blessing; for there they blessed the Lord: therefore they called the name of that place the Valley of Blessing, until this day.

fresh_translation: And every man of Judah returned to Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat leading them, with great gladness, because the Lord gladdened them from their enemies.
brenton_translation: And all the men of Juda returned to Jerusalem, and Josaphat led them with great joy; for the Lord gave them joy over their enemies.

fresh_translation: And they entered into Jerusalem with harps and lyres and trumpets to the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they entered into Jerusalem with lutes and harps and trumpets, going into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And terror of the Lord came upon all kingdoms of the earth when they heard that the Lord fought against adversaries of Israel.
brenton_translation: And there was a terror of the Lord upon all the kingdoms of the land, when they heard that the Lord fought against the enemies of Israel.

fresh_translation: And kingdom of Jehoshaphat was at peace, and his God gave him rest all around.
brenton_translation: And the kingdom of Josaphat was at peace; and his God gave him rest round about.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah, being thirty-five years old when he reigned, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem, and his mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat reigned over Juda, being thirty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Azuba, daughter of Sali.

fresh_translation: And he walked in the ways of Asa his father and did not turn aside from doing upright in the sight of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he walked in the ways of his father Asa, and turned not aside from doing that which was right in the sight of the Lord.

fresh_translation: But high places still existed, and people still did not direct heart toward the Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless the high places yet remained; and as yet the people did not direct their heart to the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And the rest of matters of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, written in the words of Jehu son of Anani, who wrote book of kings of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Josaphat, the first and the last, behold, they are written in the history of Jeu the son of Anani, who wrote the book of the kings of Israel.

fresh_translation: And after these things Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, and he acted lawlessly.
brenton_translation: And afterwards Josaphat king of Juda entered into an alliance with Ochozias king of Israel, (now this was an unrighteous man,)

fresh_translation: In making and going with him to make ships to go to Tarshish, he made ships in Eziongeber.
brenton_translation: by acting with and going to him, to build ships to go to Tharsis: and he built ships in Gasion Gaber.

fresh_translation: And Eliezer son of Dodavah from Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because you made friendship with Ahaziah, the Lord broke your work, and your ships were wrecked and were not able to go to Tarshish.
brenton_translation: And Eliezer the son of Dodia of Marisa prophesied against Josaphat, saying, Forasmuch as thou hast allied thyself with Ochozias, the Lord has broken thy work, and thy vessels have been wrecked. And they could not go to Tharsis.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers and was buried beside his fathers in the City of David, and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Josaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Joran his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And he had brothers, sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah and Jehiel and Zechariah and Azariah and Michael and Shephatiah; all these were sons of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.
brenton_translation: And he had brothers, the six sons of Josaphat, Azarias, and Jeiel, and Zacharias, and Azarias, and Michael, and Zaphatias: all these were the sons of Josaphat king of Juda.

fresh_translation: And their father gave them many gifts, silver and gold and weapons, with fortified cities in Judah, but kingdom he gave to Jehoram, because he was firstborn.
brenton_translation: And their father gave them many gifts, silver, and gold, and arms, together with fortified cities in Juda: but he gave the kingdom to Joram, for he was the first-born.

fresh_translation: And Jehoram rose over his kingdom and grew strong and killed all his brothers with sword, and also from rulers of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Joram entered upon his kingdom, and strengthened himself, and slew all his brothers with the sword, and some of the princes of Israel.

fresh_translation: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and eight years he reigned in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: When he was thirty and two years old, Joram succeeded to his kingdom, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he walked in the way of kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab did, because daughter of Ahab was his wife, and he did evil before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Achaab; for a daughter of Achaab was his wife: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord:

fresh_translation: And the Lord did not want to destroy the house of David because of covenant which he made with David and as he said to give to him lamp and to his sons all days.
brenton_translation: nevertheless the Lord would not utterly destroy the house of David, because of the covenant which he made with David, and as he said to him that he would give a light to him and his sons for ever.

fresh_translation: In those days Edom rebelled from Judah and made king over themselves.
brenton_translation: In those days Edom revolted from Juda, and they made a king over themselves.

fresh_translation: And Jehoram went with rulers and all cavalry with him, and it came to pass, he rose by night and struck Edom encircling him and commanders of chariots, and people fled to their tents.
brenton_translation: And Joram went with the princes, and all the cavalry with him: and it came to pass that he arose by night, and smote Edom that compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots, and the people fled to their tents.

fresh_translation: And Edom rebelled from Judah until this day. Then Libnah rebelled at that time from his hand, because he forsook the Lord God of his fathers.
brenton_translation: And Edom revolted from Juda until this day. Then Lomna at that time revolted from under his hand, because he forsook the Lord God of his fathers.

fresh_translation: And he too made high places in the cities of Judah and prostituted the inhabitants of Jerusalem and led Judah astray.
brenton_translation: For he built high places in the cities of Juda, and caused the dwellers in Jerusalem to go a-whoring, and led Juda astray.

fresh_translation: And writing came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus says the Lord God of David your father: Because you did not walk in the way of Jehoshaphat your father and in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
brenton_translation: And there came to him a message in writing from Eliu the prophet, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of thy father David, Because thou hast not walked in the way of thy father Josaphat, nor in the ways of Asa king of Juda,

fresh_translation: but walked in the ways of kings of Israel and prostituted Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem as the house of Ahab prostituted, and you killed your brothers, sons of your father, those better than you,
brenton_translation: but hast walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and hast caused Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem to go a-whoring, as the house of Achaab caused Israel to go a-whoring, and thou hast slain thy brethren, the sons of thy father, who were better than thyself;

fresh_translation: behold, the Lord will strike you with great plague among your people and among your sons and among your wives and among all your baggage.
brenton_translation: behold, the Lord shall smite thee with a great plague among thy people, and thy sons, and thy wives, and all thy store:

fresh_translation: And you with evil weakness, in disease of belly, until your belly comes out with sickness from day to day.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt be afflicted with a grievous disease, with a disease of the bowels, until thy bowels shall fall out day by day with the sickness.

fresh_translation: And the Lord stirred up against Jehoram Philistines and Arabs and neighbors of Ethiopians.
brenton_translation: So the Lord stirred up the Philistines against Joram, and the Arabians, and those who bordered on the Æthiopians:

fresh_translation: And they went up against Judah and overpowered and carried away all baggage they found in the house of the king and his sons and his daughters, and no son was left to him except Ahaziah, youngest of his sons.
brenton_translation: and they went up against Juda, and prevailed against them, and took away all the store which they found in the house of the king, and his sons, and his daughters; and there was no son left to him but Ochozias the youngest of his sons.

fresh_translation: And after all these things the Lord struck him in belly with weakness that had no healing.
brenton_translation: And after all these things the Lord smote him in the bowels with an incurable disease.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass from days to days, and as time of days came, two days, his belly came out with disease, and he died in evil weakness, and his people did not make funeral for him like the funeral of his fathers.
brenton_translation: And it continued from day to day: and when the time of the days came to two years, his bowels fell out with the disease, and he died by a grievous distemper: and his people performed no funeral, like the funeral of his fathers.

fresh_translation: He was thirty-two years old when he reigned, and eight years he reigned in Jerusalem, and he went away without praise and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of kings.
brenton_translation: He was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. And he departed without honour, and was buried in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

fresh_translation: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his son, youngest, king in his place, because raiding band that came upon them, Arabs and Alimazones, killed all elders. And Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
brenton_translation: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ochozias his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of robbers that came against them, even the Arabians and the Alimazonians, had slain all the elder ones. So Ochozias son of Joram king of Juda reigned.

fresh_translation: Ahaziah was twenty years old when he reigned, and one year he reigned in Jerusalem, and his mother’s name was Athaliah daughter of Omri.
brenton_translation: Ochozias began to reign when he was twenty years old, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Gotholia, the daughter of Ambri.

fresh_translation: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, because his mother was counselor to him in sinning.
brenton_translation: And he walked in the way of the house of Achaab; for his mother was his counsellor to do evil.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before the Lord like the house of Ahab, because they were counselors to him after the death of his father, to destroy him.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord as the house of Achaab had done: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.

fresh_translation: And in their counsels he walked and went with Joram son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramah Gilead, and archers struck Joram.
brenton_translation: And he walked in their counsels, and he went with Joram son of Achaab king of Israel to war against Azael king of Syria to Ramoth Galaad: and the archers smote Joram.

fresh_translation: And Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from wounds which Syrians gave him in Ramah when he fought Hazael king of Syria, and Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah came down to visit Joram son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
brenton_translation: And Joram returned to Jezrael to be healed of the wounds wherewith the Syrians smote him in Ramoth, when he fought against Azael king of Syria.

fresh_translation: And from God came destruction of Ahaziah by coming to Joram. And when he came, Joram went out with him toward Jehu son of Nimshi, anointed of the Lord, against the house of Ahab.
brenton_translation: And destruction from God came upon Ochozias in his coming to Joram; for when he had come, Joram went out with him against Jeu the son of Namessei, the anointed of the Lord against the house of Achaab.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when Jehu avenged the house of Ahab and found rulers of Judah and brothers of Ahaziah ministering to Ahaziah, he killed them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when Jeu was taking vengeance on the house of Achaab, that he found the princes of Juda and the brethren of Ochozias ministering to Ochozias, and he slew them.

fresh_translation: And he told them to seek Ahaziah, and they seized him while he was being healed in Samaria and brought him to Jehu, and he killed him and buried him, because they said, He is a son of Jehoshaphat who sought the Lord with all his heart. And there was none in the house of Ahaziah strong enough for the kingdom.
brenton_translation: And he gave orders to seek Ochozias: and they took him while he was healing his wounds in Samaria, and they brought him to Jeu, and he slew him; and they buried him, for they said, He is the son of Josaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart.

fresh_translation: And Athaliah mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, and she rose and destroyed all royal seed in the house of Judah.
brenton_translation: And Gotholia the mother of Ochozias saw that her son was dead, and she arose and destroyed all the seed royal in the house of Juda.

fresh_translation: And Jehoshabeath daughter of the king took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him from the midst of the king’s sons who were being put to death and put him and his nurse in chamber of beds. And Jehoshabeath daughter of King Jehoram, sister of Ahaziah, wife of Jehoiada the priest, hid him from before Athaliah, and she did not kill him.
brenton_translation: But Josabeeth, the daughter of the king, took Joas the son of Ochozias and rescued him secretly out of the midst of the sons of the king that were put to death, and she placed him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Josabeeth daughter of king Joram, sister of Ochozias, wife of Jodae the priest, hid him, and she even hid him from Gotholia, and she did not slay him.

fresh_translation: And he was with her in the house of God, hidden six years, and Athaliah reigned over the land.
brenton_translation: And he was with him hid in the house of God six years; and Gotholia reigned over the land.

fresh_translation: And in seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself and took the centurions, Azariah son of Jeroham and Ishmael son of Jehohanan and Azariah son of Obed and Maaseiah son of Adaiah and Elzaphan son of Zechariah, with him into the house.
brenton_translation: And in the eighth year Jodae strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azarias the son of Joram, and Ismael the son of Joanan, and Azarias the son of Obed, and Maasæas the son of Adia, and Elisaphan the son of Zacharias, with him into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they went around Judah and gathered Levites from all the cities of Judah and chiefs of fathers of Israel and came to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And they went round about Juda, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Juda, and heads of the families of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And all the assembly of Judah made covenant in the house of God with the king, and he showed them son of the king and said to them, Behold, son of the king, let him reign, as the Lord spoke concerning the house of David.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation of Juda made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he shewed them the king's son, and said to them, Lo, let the king's son reign, as the Lord said concerning the house of David.

fresh_translation: Now this is thing which you shall do: one-third of you entering on Sabbath, of priests and Levites, shall be at the gates of entries,
brenton_translation: Now this is the thing which ye shall do. Let a third part of you, even of the priests and of the Levites, enter in on the sabbath, even into the gates of the entrances;

fresh_translation: and one-third in the house of the king, and one-third at middle gate, and all the people in the courts of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: and let a third part be in the house of the king; and another third at the middle gate: and all the people in the courts of the Lord's house.

fresh_translation: And no one shall enter house of the Lord except priests and Levites and ministers of Levites. They shall enter because they are holy, and all the people shall keep charges of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And let not any one enter into the house of the Lord, except the priests and the Levites, and the servants of the Levites; they shall enter in, because they are holy: and let all the people keep the watch of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Levites shall surround king all around, each man with weapon in his hand, and one entering house shall die, and they shall be with the king when he enters and goes out.
brenton_translation: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man's weapon in his hand; and whoever else goes into the house shall die: but they shall be with the king when he goes out, and when he comes in.

fresh_translation: And Levites and all Judah did according to all things which Jehoiada the priest commanded, and each took his men from the beginning of Sabbath to the end of Sabbath, because Jehoiada did not dismiss courses.
brenton_translation: And the Levites and all Juda did according to all that the priest Jodae commanded them, and they took each his men from the beginning of the sabbath to the end of the sabbath, for Jodae the priest did not dismiss the courses.

fresh_translation: And he gave swords and shields and weapons which belonged to King David in the house of God.
brenton_translation: And Jodae gave to the men the swords, and the shields, and the arms, which had belonged to king David, in the house of God.

fresh_translation: And he set all the people, each with his weapons, from the right shoulder of the house to the left shoulder of the altar and the house, around the king.
brenton_translation: And he set the whole people, every man with his arms, from the right side of the house to the left side of the altar and the house, over against the king round about.

fresh_translation: And they brought out son of the king and put kingdom and testimonies upon him, and they made him king and anointed him, Jehoiada and his sons, and said, Let king live.
brenton_translation: And he brought out the king's son, and put on him the crown and the testimony, and Jodae the priest and his sons proclaimed him king, and anointed him, and said, Long live the king!

fresh_translation: And Athaliah heard the sound of the people running and giving thanks and praising the king and entered to the king in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Gotholia heard the sound of the people running, and acknowledging and praising the king: and she went in to the king into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And she saw, and behold, the king stood at his station and at the entrance, rulers and trumpets around the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and they sounded with trumpets, and singers with the instruments of songs and hymning praise. And Athaliah tore her robe and cried, Conspiracy, conspire!
brenton_translation: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood in his place, and the princes and trumpets were at the entrance, and the princes were round the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded the trumpets, and there were the singers singing with instruments, and singing hymns of praise. And Gotholia rent her robe, and cried, Ye surely are plotting against me.

fresh_translation: And Jehoiada the priest went out and commanded centurions and leaders of force and said to them, Throw her out beyond house, and whoever enters after her, let him die by sword, because priest said, Let her not die in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Jodae the priest went forth, and Jodae the priest charged the captains of hundreds, even the captains of the host, and said to them, Thrust her forth outside the house, and follow her, and let her be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Let her not be slain in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they gave her free passage, and she went through the horse gate of the house of the king, and they killed her there.
brenton_translation: So they let her go out; and she went through the horsemen's gate of the house of the king, and they slew her there.

fresh_translation: And Jehoiada made covenant between himself and people and the king, that they should be people to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Jodae made a covenant between himself, and the people, and the king, that the people should be the Lord's.

fresh_translation: And all the people of the land entered the house of Baal and pulled it down, and his altars and idols they crushed small, and Matthan priest of Baal they killed before his altars.
brenton_translation: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and tore down it and its altars, and they ground his images to powder, and they slew Matthan the priest of Baal before his altars.

fresh_translation: And Jehoiada the priest entrusted works of the house of the Lord by the hand of priests and Levites and restored courses of priests and Levites which David appointed over the house of the Lord, to offer whole burnt offerings to the Lord as written in the law of Moses, with gladness and with songs by the hand of David.
brenton_translation: And Jodae the priest committed the works of the house of the Lord into the hand of the priests and Levites, and he re-established the courses of the priests and Levites which David appointed over the house of the Lord, and he appointed them to offer whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord, as it is written in the law of Moses, with gladness, and with songs by the hand of David.

fresh_translation: And they stationed gatekeepers at the gates of the house of the Lord, and no unclean person in any matter shall enter.
brenton_translation: And the porters stood at the gates of the house of the Lord, that no one unclean in any respect should enter in.

fresh_translation: And he took patriarchs and mighty men and rulers of the people and all the people of the land, and brought up king to the house of the Lord, and entered by inner gate into the house of the king and seated king upon the throne of kingdom.
brenton_translation: And he took the heads of families, and the mighty men, and the chiefs of the people, and all the people of the land, and they conducted the king into the house of the Lord; and he went through the inner gate into the king's house, and they seated the king on the throne of the kingdom.

fresh_translation: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet, and they killed Athaliah with sword.
brenton_translation: And all the people of the land rejoiced; and the city was quiet: and they slew Gotholia.

fresh_translation: Joash was seven years old when he reigned, and forty years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Shachia from Beersheba.
brenton_translation: Joas was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Sabia of Beersabee.

fresh_translation: And Joash did upright in the sight of the Lord all days of Jehoiada the priest.
brenton_translation: And Joas did that which was right in the sight of the Lord all the days of Jodae the priest.

fresh_translation: And Jehoiada took for him two wives, and he fathered sons and daughters.
brenton_translation: And Jodae took to himself two wives, and they bore sons and daughters.

fresh_translation: And after these things it came upon the heart of Joash to repair the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass afterward that it came into the heart of Joas to repair the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he gathered priests and Levites and said to them, Go out into the cities of Judah and gather from all Israel silver to strengthen the house of the Lord year by year, and hurry to speak. And Levites did not hurry.
brenton_translation: And he gathered the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out into the cities of Juda, and collect money of all Israel to repair the house of the Lord from year to year, and make haste to speak of it. But the Levites hasted not.

fresh_translation: And King Joash called Jehoiada the chief and said to him, Why did you not see about Levites to bring from Judah and Jerusalem what was ordained by Moses man of God when he assembled Israel for the tent of testimony?
brenton_translation: And king Joas called Jodae the chief, and said to him, Why hast thou not looked after the Levites, so that they should bring from Juda and Jerusalem that which was prescribed by Moses the man of God, when he assembled Israel at the tabernacle of witness?

fresh_translation: Because Athaliah was lawless, and her sons pulled down the house of God, and indeed holy things of the house of the Lord they made for Baals.
brenton_translation: For Gotholia was a transgressor, and her sons tore down the house of God; for they offered the holy things of the house of the Lord to Baalim.

fresh_translation: And the king said, Let a chest be made and placed at the gate of the house of the Lord outside.
brenton_translation: And the king said, Let a box be made, and let it be put at the gate of the house of the Lord without.

fresh_translation: And let them proclaim in Judah and in Jerusalem to bring to the Lord as Moses servant of God spoke upon Israel in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And let men proclaim in Juda and in Jerusalem, that the people should bring to the Lord, as Moses the servant of God spoke concerning Israel in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And all rulers and all the people gave and brought and put into chest until it was full.
brenton_translation: And all the princes and all the people gave, and brought in, and cast into the box until it was filled.

fresh_translation: And whenever chest was brought to the king’s officers by the hand of Levites, and when they saw silver had multiplied, then king’s scribe came and officer of high priest and emptied chest and restored it to its place. Thus they did day by day and gathered much silver.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when they brought in the box to the officers of the king by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that the money was more than sufficient, then came the king's scribe, and the officer of the high priest, and emptied the box, and restored it to its place. Thus they did day by day, and collected much money.

fresh_translation: And the king and Jehoiada the priest gave it to those doing works for the work of the house of the Lord, and they hired stonecutters and carpenters to repair the house of the Lord, and workers in iron and bronze to repair the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the king and Jodae the priest gave it to the workmen employed in the service of the house of the Lord, and they hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the Lord, also smiths and braziers to repair the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And workers did work, and length of works went up in their hands, and they restored house of the Lord to its standing and strengthened it.
brenton_translation: And the workmen wrought, and the works prospered in their hands, and they established the house of the Lord on its foundation, and strengthened it.

fresh_translation: And when they finished, they brought remaining silver to the king and to Jehoiada, and they made vessels for the house of the Lord, ministering vessels for whole burnt offerings and censers of gold and silver, and they offered whole burnt offerings in the house of the Lord continually all days of Jehoiada.
brenton_translation: And when they had finished it, they brought to the king and to Jodae the remainder of the money, and they made vessels for the house of the Lord, vessels of service for whole-burnt-offerings, and gold and silver censers: and they offered up whole-burnt-offerings in the house of the Lord continually all the days of Jodae.

fresh_translation: And Jehoiada grew old, full of days, and died, being one hundred thirty years old at his death.
brenton_translation: And Jodae grew old, being full of days, and he died, being a hundred and thirty years old at his death.

fresh_translation: And they buried him in the City of David with kings, because he did goodness with Israel and with God and his house.
brenton_translation: And they buried him with the kings in the city of David, because he had dealt well with Israel, and with God and his house.

fresh_translation: And after the death of Jehoiada, rulers of Judah came and bowed to the king; then king listened to them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the death of Jodae, that the princes of Juda went in, and did obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened to them.

fresh_translation: And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers and served Ashtaroth and idols, and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem in this day.
brenton_translation: And they forsook the house of the Lord God of their fathers, and served the Astartes and idols: and there was wrath upon Juda and Jerusalem in that day.

fresh_translation: And he sent prophets to them to return to the Lord, and they did not listen, and they testified to them and they did not listen.
brenton_translation: Yet he sent prophets to them, to turn them to the Lord; but they hearkened not: and he testified to them, but they obeyed not.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of God clothed Azariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and he stood above the people and said, Thus says the Lord: Why do you transgress the commandments of the Lord and not prosper? Because you forsake the Lord, he will forsake you.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of God came upon Azarias the son of Jodae the priest, and he stood up above the people, and said, Thus saith the Lord, Why do ye transgress the commandments of the Lord? so shall ye not prosper; for ye have forsaken the Lord, and he will forsake you.

fresh_translation: And they conspired against him and stoned him by the command of King Joash in the court of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they conspired against him, and stoned him by command of king Joas in the court of the Lord's house.

fresh_translation: And Joash did not remember mercy which Jehoiada his father did with him and killed his son. And as he was dying, he said, Let the Lord see and judge.
brenton_translation: So Joas remembered not the kindness which his father Jodae had exercised towards him, but slew his son. And as he died, he said, The Lord look upon it, and judge.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after completion of year, force of Syria came up against him and came upon Judah and Jerusalem and destroyed all rulers of the people among people, and all their spoils they sent to the king of Damascus.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the end of the year, that the host of Syria went up against him, and came against Juda and Jerusalem: and they slew all the chiefs of the people among the people, and all their spoils they sent to the king of Damascus.

fresh_translation: Because with few men force of Syria came, and God gave into their hands very great force, because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, and against Joash he made judgments.
brenton_translation: For the army of Syria came with few men, yet God gave into their hands a very large army, because they had forsaken the God of their fathers; and he brought judgments on Joas.

fresh_translation: And after they departed from him, leaving him in great weaknesses, his servants conspired against him over bloods of son of Jehoiada the priest and killed him on his bed, and he died. And they buried him in the City of David, but they did not bury him in tomb of kings.
brenton_translation: And after they had departed from him, when they had left him in sore diseases, then his servants conspired against him because of the blood of the son of Jodae the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died, and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchre of the kings.

fresh_translation: And those conspiring against him were Zabad son of Shimeath the Ammonite and Jehozabad son of Shimrith the Moabite.
brenton_translation: And they that conspired against him were Zabed the son of Samaath the Ammanite, and Jozabed the son of Samareth the Moabite.

fresh_translation: And all his sons and the five things brought upon him and the rest, behold, written on commentary of kings, and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And all his sons, and the five came to him: and the other matters, behold, they are written in the book of the kings. And Amasias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he reigned, and twenty-nine years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Jehoaddan from Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Amasias began to reign when he was twenty and five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Joadaen of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did upright in the sight of the Lord, but not with full heart.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, but not with a perfect heart.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who killed king his father.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the kingdom was established in his hand, that he slew his servants who had slain the king his father.

fresh_translation: But their sons he did not kill, according to the covenant of the law of the Lord, as written, as the Lord commanded, saying, Fathers shall not die for children, and sons shall not die for fathers, but each shall die for his own sin.
brenton_translation: But he slew not their sons, according to the covenant of the law of the Lord, as it is written, and as the Lord commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, and the sons shall not die for the fathers, but they shall die each for his own sin.

fresh_translation: And Amaziah gathered the house of Judah and set them by the houses of their fathers over thousands and hundreds in all Judah and Jerusalem, and counted them from twenty years old and upward and found them three hundred thousand able to go out to battle, holding spear and shield.
brenton_translation: And Amasias assembled the house of Juda, and appointed them according to the houses of their families for captains of thousands and captains of hundreds in all Juda and Jerusalem: and he numbered them from twenty years old and upwards, and found them three hundred thousand able to go out to war, holding spear and shield.

fresh_translation: And he hired from Israel one hundred thousand mighty men of strength for one hundred talents of silver.
brenton_translation: Also he hired of Israel a hundred thousand mighty men for a hundred talents of silver.

fresh_translation: And man of God came to him, saying, King, force of Israel shall not go with you, because the Lord is not with Israel, with all sons of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the host of Israel go with thee; for the Lord is not with Israel, even all the sons of Ephraim.

fresh_translation: Because if you suppose to prevail by these, the Lord will rout you before enemies, because with the Lord there is power both to strengthen and to route.
brenton_translation: For if thou shalt undertake to strengthen thyself with these, then the Lord shall put thee to flight before the enemies: for it is of the Lord both to strengthen and to put to flight.

fresh_translation: And Amaziah said to the man of God, And what shall I do with hundred talents which I gave to force of Israel? And man of God said, the Lord is able to give you many more than these.
brenton_translation: And Amasias said to the man of God, But what shall I do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God said, The Lord can give thee much more than these.

fresh_translation: And Amaziah separated force that came to him from Ephraim to go to their place, and they were very angry against Judah and returned to their place in the heat of anger.
brenton_translation: And Amasias separated from the army that came to him from Ephraim, that they might go away to their place; and they were very angry with Juda, and they returned to their place with great wrath.

fresh_translation: And Amaziah strengthened himself and took his people and went to the valley of salt pits and struck there ten thousand sons of Seir.
brenton_translation: And Amasias strengthened himself, and took his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote there the children of Seir ten thousand.

fresh_translation: And ten thousand sons of Judah took captive alive and brought them to the top of cliff and threw them down from the top of cliff, and all were broken apart.
brenton_translation: And the children of Juda took ten thousand prisoners, and they carried them to the top of the precipice, and cast them headlong from the top of the precipice, and they were all dashed to pieces.

fresh_translation: And sons of force whom Amaziah sent back from not going with him to war attacked the cities of Judah from Samaria to Bethhoron and struck among them three thousand and plundered much spoil.
brenton_translation: And the men of the host whom Amasias sent back so that they should not go with him to battle, went and attacked the cities of Juda, from Samaria to Bæthoron; and they smote three thousand among them, and took much spoil.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass after Amaziah came from striking Edom, he brought to them gods of sons of Seir and set them up for himself as gods, and bowed before them and burned sacrifice to them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, after Amasias had returned from smiting Idumea, that he brought home the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up for himself as gods, and bowed down before them, and he sacrificed to them.

fresh_translation: And the anger of the Lord came upon Amaziah and he sent prophets to him and said to him, Why did you seek gods of the people who did not rescue their own people from your hand?
brenton_translation: And the anger of the Lord came upon Amasias, and he sent him a prophet, and he said to him, Why hast thou sought the gods of the people, which have not rescued their own people out of thine hand?

fresh_translation: And it came to pass as he spoke to him, he said to him, Have I made you counselor of the king? Take heed lest you be whipped. And prophet was silent and said, I know that this was intended against you to destroy you, because you did this and did not listen to my counsel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass when the prophet was speaking to him, that he said to him, Have I made thee king's counsellor? take heed lest thou be scourged: and the prophet forebore, and said, I know that God is disposed against thee to destroy thee, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not hearkened to my counsel.

fresh_translation: And Amaziah took counsel and sent to Joash son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in face.
