brenton_translation: And Amasias king of Juda took counsel, and sent to Joas, son of Joachaz, son of Jeu, king of Israel, saying, Come, and let us look one another in the face.

fresh_translation: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, Thornbush in Lebanon sent to cedar in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son for wife. And behold, beasts of the field in Lebanon came and trampled thornbush.
brenton_translation: And Joas king of Israel sent to Amasias king of Juda, saying, The thistle that was in Libanus sent to the cedar that was in Libanus, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife; but, behold, the wild beasts of the field that are in Libanus shall come: and the wild beasts did come, and trod down the thistle.

fresh_translation: You said, Behold, you struck Edom, and your heavy heart lifts you up. Now sit in your house. Why provoke evil and fall, you and Judah with you?
brenton_translation: Thou hast said, Behold, I have smitten Idumea, and thy stout heart exalts thee: now stay at home; for why dost thou implicate thyself in mischief, that thou shouldest fall, and Juda with thee?

fresh_translation: And Amaziah did not listen, because it came from the Lord to hand him over, because he sought gods of Edomites.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless Amasias hearkened not, for it was of the Lord to deliver him into the enemy's hands, because he sought after the gods of the Idumeans.

fresh_translation: And Joash king of Israel went up, and they looked one another in face, he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
brenton_translation: So Joas king of Israel went up; and they saw one another, he and Amasias king of Juda, in Bæthsamys, which is of Juda.

fresh_translation: And Judah was routed before Israel, and each fled to his tent.
brenton_translation: And Juda was put to flight before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.

fresh_translation: And Joash king of Israel seized Amaziah king of Judah, son of Joash, at Beth-shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem and pulled down from the wall of Jerusalem, from the gate of Ephraim to corner gate, four hundred cubits.
brenton_translation: And Joas king of Israel took prisoner Amasias king of Juda, son of Joas, son of Joachaz, in Bæthsamys, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he pulled down part of the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

fresh_translation: And all gold and silver and all vessels found in the house of the Lord and with Obededom and treasures of the house of the king and sons of mixtures, and he returned to Samaria.
brenton_translation: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord and with Abdedom, and the treasures of the king's house, and the hostages, and he returned to Samaria.

fresh_translation: And Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
brenton_translation: And Amasias the son of Joas king of Juda lived after the death of Joas the son of Joachaz king of Israel fifteen years.

fresh_translation: And the rest of matters of Amaziah, first and last, behold, written upon the book of kings of Judah and Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Amasias, the first and the last, lo! are they not written in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel?

fresh_translation: And at time when Amaziah rebelled from the Lord they conspired against him, and he fled from Jerusalem to Lachish, and they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
brenton_translation: And at the time when Amasias departed from the Lord, then they formed a conspiracy against him; and he fled from Jerusalem to Lachis: and they sent after him to Lachis, and slew him there.

fresh_translation: And they carried him upon horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of David.
brenton_translation: And they took him up on horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of David.

fresh_translation: And all the people of the land took Uzziah, and he was sixteen years old, and they made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
brenton_translation: Then all the people of the land took Ozias, and he was sixteen years old, and they made him king in the room of his father Amasias.

fresh_translation: He built Elath; he restored it to Judah after king slept with his fathers.
brenton_translation: He built Ælath, he recovered it to Juda, after the king slept with his fathers.

fresh_translation: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he reigned, and fifty-two years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Jecoliah from Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Ozias began to reign at the age of sixteen years, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jechelia of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did upright in the sight of the Lord according to all things Amaziah his father did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Amasias his father did.

fresh_translation: And he was seeking the Lord in the days of Zechariah, one understanding in the fear of the Lord, and in his days he sought the Lord and the Lord prospered him.
brenton_translation: And he sought the Lord in the days of Zacharias, who understood the fear of the Lord; and in his days he sought the Lord, and the Lord prospered him.

fresh_translation: And he went out and fought against Philistines and pulled down walls of Gath and walls of Jabneh and walls of Ashdod and built cities of Ashdod and among Philistines.
brenton_translation: And he went out and fought against the Philistines, and pulled down the walls of Geth, and the walls of Jabner, and the walls of Azotus, and he built cities near Azotus, and among the Philistines.

fresh_translation: And the Lord strengthened him against Philistines and against Arabs dwelling upon rock and against Meunites.
brenton_translation: And the Lord strengthened him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt on the rock, and against the Minæans.

fresh_translation: And Meunites gave gifts to Uzziah, and his name was until entrance of Egypt, because he grew strong exceedingly.
brenton_translation: And the Minæans gave gifts to Ozias; and his fame spread as far as the entering in of Egypt, for he strengthened himself exceedingly.

fresh_translation: And Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem, at corner gate and at valley gate and at corners, and strengthened them.
brenton_translation: And Ozias built towers in Jerusalem, both at the gate of the corner and at the valley gate, and at the corners, and he fortified them.

fresh_translation: And he built towers in the wilderness and cut many pits, because much cattle belonged to him in lowland and in the plain, and vine-workers in hill-country and in Carmel, because he loved farming.
brenton_translation: And he built towers in the wilderness, and dug many wells, for he had many cattle in the low country and in the plain; and vinedressers in the mountain country and in Carmel: for he was a husbandman.

fresh_translation: And Uzziah had forces making war and going out for battle in number, and their number by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maasaiou the judge, by the hand of Ananiou, successor of the king.
brenton_translation: And Ozias had a host of warriors, and that went out orderly to war, and returned orderly in number; and their number was made by the hand of Jeiel the scribe, and Maasias the judge, by the hand of Ananias the king's deputy.

fresh_translation: Whole number of patriarchs of mighty men for war was two thousand six hundred.
brenton_translation: The whole number of the chiefs of families of the mighty men of war was two thousand six hundred;

fresh_translation: And with them military force was three hundred seven thousand five hundred, those doing war with the strength of power to help king against adversaries.
brenton_translation: and with them was a warrior force, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred: these waged war mightily to help the king against his enemies.

fresh_translation: And Uzziah prepared for them, for all force, shields and spears and helmets and breastplates and bows and sling-stones.
brenton_translation: And Ozias prepared for them, even for all the host, shields, and spears, and helmets, and breastplates, and bows, and slings for stones.

fresh_translation: And he made in Jerusalem machines, invented by designer, to be on towers and corners, to cast arrows and large stones, and the sound of their making was heard far away, because he was marvelously helped until he became strong.
brenton_translation: And he made in Jerusalem machines invented by a wise contriver, to be upon the towers and upon the corners, to cast darts and great stones: and the fame of their preparation was heard at a distance; for he was wonderfully helped, till he was strong.

fresh_translation: And when he became strong, his heart was lifted up to ruin, and he acted unjustly against the Lord his God and entered into the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.
brenton_translation: And when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction; and he transgressed against the Lord his God, and went into the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.

fresh_translation: And Azariah the priest entered after him and with him eighty priests of the Lord, mighty sons.
brenton_translation: And there went in after him Azarias the priest, and with him eighty priests of the Lord, mighty men.

fresh_translation: And they stood against Uzziah the king and said to him, Not for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord, but for priests, sons of Aaron, those sanctified to burn incense. Go out from sanctuary, because you rebelled from the Lord, and this shall not be for glory to you from the Lord God.
brenton_translation: And they withstood Ozias the king, and said to him, It is not for thee, Ozias, to burn incense to the Lord, but only for the priests the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to sacrifice: go forth of the sanctuary, for thou hast departed from the Lord; and this shall not be for glory to thee from the Lord God.

fresh_translation: And Uzziah was angry, and in his hand was censer to burn incense in the temple, and when he was angry with priests, leprosy rose in his forehead before priests in the house of the Lord above altar of incense.
brenton_translation: And Ozias was angry, and in his hand was the censer to burn incense in the temple: and when he was angry with the priests, then the leprosy rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the Lord, over the altar of incense.

fresh_translation: And chief priest and priests turned to him, and behold, he was leprous in forehead, and they hurried him out from there, and indeed he himself hurried to go out because the Lord rebuked him.
brenton_translation: And Azarias the chief priest, and the other priests, turned to look at him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead; and they got him hastily out thence, for he also hasted to go out, because the Lord had rebuked him.

fresh_translation: And Uzziah the king was leprous until the day of his death, and as a leper he sat in a separate house, because he was cut off from the house of the Lord, and Jotham his son was over kingdom, judging people of the land.
brenton_translation: And Ozias the king was a leper to the day of his death, and he dwelt as a leper in a separate house; for he was cut off from the house of the Lord: and Joathan his son was set over his kingdom, judging the people of the land.

fresh_translation: And the rest of matters of Uzziah, first and last, were written by Isaiah the prophet.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Ozias, the first and the last, are written by Jessias the prophet.

fresh_translation: And Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial of kings, because they said he is leprous, and Jotham his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Ozias slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial place of the kings, for they said, He is a leper; and Joatham his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he reigned, and sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.
brenton_translation: Joatham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jerusa, daughter of Sadoc.

fresh_translation: And he did upright in the sight of the Lord according to all things which Uzziah his father did, but he did not enter into the temple of the Lord, and still people were being corrupted.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Ozias did: but he went not into the temple of the Lord. And still the people corrupted themselves.

fresh_translation: He built high gate of the house of the Lord, and in the wall of Ophel he built much.
brenton_translation: He built the high gate of the house of the Lord, and he built much in the wall of Opel.

fresh_translation: And he built cities in the mountain of Judah, and in forests dwellings and towers.
brenton_translation: In the mountain of Juda, and in the woods, he built both dwelling-places and towers.

fresh_translation: He fought against the king of sons of Ammon and prevailed over him, and sons of Ammon gave him year by year one hundred talents of silver and ten thousand kors of wheat and ten thousand of barley. These king of Ammon brought him in the first year and second and third.
brenton_translation: He fought against the king of the children of Ammon, and prevailed against him: and the children of Ammon gave him even annually a hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. These the king of the children of Ammon brought to him annually in the first and second and third years.

fresh_translation: And Jotham grew strong, because he prepared his ways before the Lord his God.
brenton_translation: Joatham grew strong, because he prepared his ways before the Lord his God.

fresh_translation: And the rest of matters of Jotham and war and deeds of him, behold, written in the book of kings of Judah and Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Joatham, and his war, and his deeds, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel.

fresh_translation: And Jotham slept with his fathers and was buried in the City of David, and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Joatham slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Achaz his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Ahaz was twenty years old when he reigned, and sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem, and he did not do upright in the sight of the Lord like David his father.
brenton_translation: Achaz was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: and he did not that which was right in the sight of the Lord, as David his father.

fresh_translation: And he walked according to the ways of kings of Israel, and indeed he made carved things for their idols.
brenton_translation: But he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, for he made graven images.

fresh_translation: And he sacrificed in Gaibennom and brought his children through fire according to the abominations of nations which the Lord destroyed from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he sacrificed to their idols in the valley of Benennom, and passed his children through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he burned incense on high places and on roofs and under every grove tree.
brenton_translation: And he burnt incense upon the high places, and upon the roofs, and under every shady tree.

fresh_translation: And the Lord his God gave him into the hand of the king of Syria, and he struck him and took from them many captives and brought them to Damascus. And indeed into the hands of the king of Israel he gave him, and he struck him with great blow.
brenton_translation: And the Lord his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and he smote him, and took captive of them a great band of prisoners, and carried him to Damascus. Also God delivered him into the hands of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.

fresh_translation: And Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel killed in Judah in one day one hundred twenty thousand mighty men of strength, because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And Phakee the son of Romelias king of Israel, slew in Juda in one day a hundred and twenty thousand mighty men; because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And Zichri, mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah son of the king and Azrikam ruler of his house and Elkanah successor of the king.
brenton_translation: And Zechri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maasias the king's son, and Ezrican the chief of his house, and Elcana the king's deputy.

fresh_translation: And sons of Israel took captive from their brothers three hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and they plundered much spoil from them and brought spoil to Samaria.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel took captive of their brethren three hundred thousand, women, and sons, and daughters, and they spoiled them of much property, and brought the spoils to Samaria.

fresh_translation: And there was a prophet of the Lord there, Oded his name, and he went out to meet force coming to Samaria and said to them, Behold, the wrath of the Lord God of your fathers came upon Judah and he gave them into your hands, and you killed among them in wrath reaching to heavens.
brenton_translation: And there was there a prophet of the Lord, his name was Oded: and he went out to meet the host that were coming to Samaria, and said to them, Behold, the wrath of the Lord God of your fathers is upon Juda, and he has delivered them into your hands, and ye have slain them in wrath, and it has reached even to heaven.

fresh_translation: And now sons of Judah and Jerusalem you say to acquire as male and female servants. Behold, am I not with you to testify to the Lord your God?
brenton_translation: And now ye talk of keeping the children of Juda and Jerusalem for servants and handmaidens. Lo, am I not with you to testify for the Lord your God?

fresh_translation: And now hear me and return captivity which you took captive from your brothers, because wrath of heat of the Lord is upon you.
brenton_translation: And now hearken to me, and restore the prisoners of your brethren whom ye have taken: for the fierce anger of the Lord is upon you.

fresh_translation: And rulers from the sons of Ephraim rose up: Oudia son of Johanan and Berechiah son of Meshillemoth and Ezechias son of Hillel and Amaziah son of Hadlai, against those coming from war.
brenton_translation: And the chiefs of the sons of Ephraim rose up, Udias the son of Joanas, and Barachias the son of Mosolamoth, and Ezekias the son of Sellem, and Amasias the son of Eldai, against those that came from the war,

fresh_translation: And they said to them, You shall not bring captivity here to us, because you say to add upon our sins and upon our ignorance in sinning to the Lord, because our sin is great, and heat of the wrath of the Lord is upon Israel.
brenton_translation: and said to them, Ye shall not bring in hither the prisoners to us, for whereas sin against the Lord is upon us, ye mean to add to our sins, and to our trespass: for our sin is great, and the fierce anger of the Lord is upon Israel.

fresh_translation: And warriors left captivity and spoils before rulers and all the assembly.
brenton_translation: So the warriors left the prisoners and the spoils before the princes and all the congregation.

fresh_translation: And men called by name rose and took hold of captivity, and all naked they clothed from spoils and dressed them and shod them and gave them to eat and to be anointed, and took hold of every weak one on the beasts of burden and set them in Jericho, the city of palms, by their brothers, and returned to Samaria.
brenton_translation: And the men who were called by name rose up, and took hold of the prisoners, and clothed all the naked from the spoils, and gave them garments and shoes, and gave them food to eat, and oil to anoint themselves with, and they helped also every one that was weak with asses, and placed them in Jericho, the city of palm-trees, with their brethren; and they returned to Samaria.

fresh_translation: At that time Ahaz sent to the king of Asshur to help him.
brenton_translation: At that time king Achaz sent to the king of Assyria to help him, and on this occasion,

fresh_translation: And also because Edomites attacked and struck in Judah and took captivity.
brenton_translation: because the Idumæans had attacked him, and smitten Juda, and taken a number of prisoners.

fresh_translation: And Philistines attacked cities of the plain and of south of Judah and took Beth-shemesh and Elon and Gederoth and Shocho and its villages and Timnah and its villages and Gimzo and its villages, and they dwelt there.
brenton_translation: Also the Philistines had made an attack on the cities of the plain country, and the cities of the south of Juda, and taken Bæthsamys, and [the things in the house of the Lord, and the things in the house of the king, and of the princes: and they gave to the king] Ælon, and Galero, and Socho and her villages, and Thamna and her villages, and Gamzo and her villages: and they dwelt there.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord humbled Judah through Ahaz king of Judah, because he rebelled in rebellion from the Lord.
brenton_translation: For the Lord humbled Juda because of Achaz king of Juda, because he grievously departed from the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came upon him and struck him.
brenton_translation: And there came against him Thalgaphellasar king of Assyria, and he afflicted him.

fresh_translation: And Ahaz took what was in the house of the Lord and in the house of the king and of rulers and gave to the king of Asshur, and it was not for help to him.
brenton_translation: And Achaz took the things that were in the house of the Lord, and the things in the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave them to the king of Assyria: but he was no help to him,

fresh_translation: But when he was afflicted he added to rebel further from the Lord, and the king said,
brenton_translation: but only troubled him in his affliction: and he departed yet more from the Lord, and king Achaz said,

fresh_translation: I will seek gods of Damascus who strike me. And he said, Because gods of the king of Syria strengthened them, therefore I will sacrifice to them and they will help me. But they became to him as a stumbling-block and to all Israel.
brenton_translation: I will seek after the gods of Damascus that smite me. And he said, Forasmuch as the gods of the king of Syria themselves strengthen them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, and they will help me. But they became a stumbling-block to him, and to all Israel.

fresh_translation: And Ahaz removed vessels of the house of the Lord and cut them up and shut doors of the house of the Lord and made for himself altars in every corner in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And Achaz removed the vessels of the house of the Lord, and cut them in pieces, and shut the doors of the house of the Lord, and made to himself altars in every corner in Jerusalem:

fresh_translation: And in every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to foreign gods, and they provoked the Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: and in each several city in Juda he made high places to burn incense to strange gods: and they provoked the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And the rest of his matters and his deeds, first and last, behold, written upon the book of kings of Judah and Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of his acts, and his deeds, the first and the last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel.

fresh_translation: And Ahaz slept with his fathers and was buried in the City of David, because they did not bring him into tombs of kings of Israel, and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Achaz slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David; for they did not bring him into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Ezekias his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah reigned, being twenty-five years old, and twenty-nine years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias began to reign at the age of twenty-five years, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Abia, daughter of Zacharias.

fresh_translation: And he did upright in the sight of the Lord according to all things David his father did.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father David had done.

fresh_translation: And it came to pass when he stood over his kingdom, in the first month, he opened doors of the house of the Lord and repaired them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when he was established over his kingdom, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the Lord, and repaired them.

fresh_translation: And he brought in priests and Levites and stationed them in east court.
brenton_translation: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and put them on the east side,

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Hear, Levites. Now sanctify yourselves and sanctify house of the Lord God of your fathers and throw out uncleanness from holy place.
brenton_translation: and said to them, Hear, ye Levites: now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the Lord God of your fathers, and cast out the impurity from the holy places.

fresh_translation: Because our fathers rebelled and did evil before the Lord and forsook him and turned face away from the tent of the Lord and gave neck.
brenton_translation: For our fathers have revolted, and done that which was evil before the Lord our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their face from the tabernacle of the Lord, and have turned their back.

fresh_translation: And they shut doors of the temple and quenched lamps and did not burn incense and did not offer whole burnt offerings in holy place to God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And they have shut up the doors of the temple, and put out the lamps, and have not burnt incense, and have not offered whole-burnt-offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the wrath of the Lord was against Judah and Jerusalem, and he gave them to terror and to desolation and to hissing, as you see with your eyes.
brenton_translation: And the Lord was very angry with Juda and Jerusalem, and made them an astonishment, and a desolation, and a hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

fresh_translation: And behold, your fathers have fallen by sword and your sons and daughters and wives are in captivity in a land not theirs, which even now is so.
brenton_translation: And, behold, your fathers have been smitten with the sword, and your sons and your daughters and your wives are in captivity in a land not their own, as it is even now.

fresh_translation: Upon these things now it is in my heart to make covenant of the Lord God of Israel, and he will turn away heat of his wrath from us.
brenton_translation: Therefore it is now in my heart to make a covenant, a covenant with the Lord God of Israel, that he may turn away his fierce wrath from us.

fresh_translation: And now do not fail, because the Lord chose in you to stand before him to minister and to be ministers and burners of incense.
brenton_translation: And now be not wanting to your duty, for the Lord has chosen you to stand before him to minister, and to be ministers and burners of incense to him.

fresh_translation: And Levites rose: Maath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah from the sons of Kohath, and from the sons of Merari, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Igal, and from the sons of Gershonites, Igal son of Zemmath and Joadam son of Joah,
brenton_translation: Then the Levites rose up, Maath the son of Amasi, and Joel the son of Azarias, of the sons of Caath: and of the sons of Merari, Kis the son of Abdi, and Azarias the son of Ilaelel: and of the sons of Gedsoni, Jodaad the son of Zemmath, and Joadam: these were the sons of Joacha.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Elzaphan, Shimri and Jeiel, and from the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah,
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Elisaphan; Zambri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zacharias, and Matthanias:

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei, and from the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
brenton_translation: and of the sons of Æman; Jeiel, and Semei: and of the sons of Idithun; Samaias, and Oziel.

fresh_translation: And they gathered their brothers and sanctified themselves according to the command of the king by ordinance of the Lord to cleanse house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they gathered their brethren, and they purified themselves according to the king's command by the order of the Lord, to purify the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And priests entered inside the house of the Lord to sanctify it and threw out every uncleanness found in the house of the Lord into the court of the house of the Lord, and Levites received it to throw outside into the torrent of Kidron.
brenton_translation: And the priests entered into the house of the Lord, to purify it, and they cast out all the uncleanness that was found in the house of the Lord, even into the court of the house of the Lord: and the Levites received it to cast into the brook of Kedron without.

fresh_translation: And they began on the first day of new moon of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they entered the temple of the Lord, and they sanctified house of the Lord in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias began on the first day, even on the new moon of the first month, to purify, and on the eighth day of the month they entered into the temple of the Lord: and they purified the house of the Lord in eight days; and on the thirteenth day of the first month they finished the work.

fresh_translation: And they went inside to Hezekiah the king and said, We sanctified all things in the house of the Lord, altar of whole burnt offering and its vessels and table of presentation and its vessels.
brenton_translation: And they went in to king Ezekias, and said, We have purified all the things in the house of the Lord, the altar of whole-burnt-offering, and its vessels, and the table of shew-bread, and its vessels;

fresh_translation: And all vessels which King Ahaz defiled in his kingdom in his rebellion we prepared and sanctified. Behold, they are before the altar of the Lord.
brenton_translation: and all the vessels which king Achaz polluted in his reign, in his apostacy, we have prepared and purified: behold, they are before the altar of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah the king rose early and gathered rulers of the city and went up to the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And king Ezekias rose early in the morning, and gathered the chief men of the city, and went up to the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they brought seven calves, seven rams, seven lambs, seven male goats of goats for sin, for the kingdom and for holy things and for Israel, and he told sons of Aaron the priests to go up upon the altar of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he brought seven calves, seven rams, seven lambs, seven kids of goats for a sin-offering, for the kingdom, and for the holy things, and for Israel: and he told the priests the sons of Aaron to go up to the altar of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they slaughtered calves, and priests received blood and poured it upon the altar, and they slaughtered rams and poured blood upon the altar, and they slaughtered lambs and poured blood to the altar.
brenton_translation: And they slew the calves, and the priests received the blood, and poured it on the altar: and they slew the rams, and poured the blood upon the altar: also they slew the lambs, and poured the blood round the altar.

fresh_translation: And they brought male goats for sin before the king and assembly, and they put hands upon them.
brenton_translation: And they brought the goats for a sin-offering before the king and the congregation; and laid their hands upon them.

fresh_translation: And priests slaughtered them and made atonement with their blood toward altar and made atonement for all Israel, because the king said whole burnt offering and sin offerings were for all Israel.
brenton_translation: And the priests slew them, and offered their blood as a propitiation on the altar; and they made atonement for all Israel: for the king said, The whole-burnt-offering, and the sin-offerings are for all Israel.

fresh_translation: And he stationed Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals and harps and lyres according to the command of David king and Gad the seer for the king and Nathan the prophet, because ordinance was from the Lord by the hand of prophets.
brenton_translation: And he stationed the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, and lutes, and harps, according to the commandment of king David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for by the commandment of the Lord the order was in the hand of the prophets.

fresh_translation: And Levites stood with the instruments of David, and priests with trumpets.
brenton_translation: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah said to offer whole burnt offering upon the altar, and when they began to offer whole burnt offering, they began to sing to the Lord, and trumpets with the instruments of David king of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias told them to offer up the whole-burnt-offering on the altar: and when they began to offer the whole-burnt-offering, they began to sing to the Lord, and the trumpets accompanied the instruments of David king of Israel.

fresh_translation: And all the assembly worshiped, and singers were singing and trumpets sounding, until whole burnt offering was finished.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation worshipped, and the psalm-singers were singing, and the trumpets sounding, until the whole-burnt-sacrifice had been completely offered.

fresh_translation: And as they finished offering, king bent knee and all those found with him and worshiped.
brenton_translation: And when they had done offering it, the king and all that were present bowed, and worshipped.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah the king and rulers told Levites to hymn the Lord in the words of David and Asaph the prophet, and they hymned with gladness and fell and worshiped.
brenton_translation: And king Ezekias and the princes told the Levites to sing hymns to the Lord in the words of David, and of Asaph the prophet: and they sang hymns with gladness, and fell down and worshipped.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah answered and said, Now you have filled your hands to the Lord; come near and bring sacrifices and praises into the house of the Lord. And assembly brought sacrifices and praises into the house of the Lord, and everyone willing in heart brought whole burnt offerings.
brenton_translation: Then Ezekias answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves to the Lord, bring near and offer sacrifices of praise in the house of the Lord. And the congregation brought sacrifices and thank-offerings into the house of the Lord; and every one who was ready in his heart brought whole-burnt-offerings.

fresh_translation: And number of whole burnt offerings which assembly brought was seventy calves, one hundred rams, two hundred lambs. All these for whole burnt offering to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the number of the whole-burnt-offerings which the congregation brought, was seventy calves, a hundred rams, two hundred lambs: all these were for a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And holy things were six hundred calves and three thousand sheep.
brenton_translation: And the consecrated calves were six hundred, and the sheep three thousand.

fresh_translation: But priests were few and were not able to flay whole burnt offerings, and their brothers Levites took hold with them until work was finished and until priests were sanctified, because Levites were more willing to sanctify than priests.
brenton_translation: But the priests were few, and could not flay the whole-burnt-offering, so their brethren the Levites helped them, until the work was finished, and until the priests had purified themselves: for the Levites more zealously purified themselves than the priests.

fresh_translation: And whole burnt offering was much, with fats of completion of the offering of salvation and libations of whole burnt offering, and work in the house of the Lord was set right.
brenton_translation: And the whole-burnt-offering was abundant, with the fat of the complete peace-offering, and the drink-offerings of the whole-burnt-sacrifice. So the service was established in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because God prepared for people, because word came suddenly.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias and all the people rejoiced, because God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah sent over all Israel and Judah and wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh to come to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem to do passover to the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias sent to all Israel and Juda, and wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasse, that they should come into the house of the Lord to Jerusalem, to keep the passover to the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the king and rulers and all the assembly in Jerusalem took counsel to do passover in the second month.
brenton_translation: For the king, and the princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, designed to keep the passover in the second month.

fresh_translation: For they were not able to do it at that time, because priests had not sanctified themselves enough and people had not been gathered into Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: For they could not keep it at that time, because a sufficient number of priests had not purified themselves, and the people was not gathered to Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And word pleased king and assembly.
brenton_translation: And the proposal pleased the king and the congregation.

fresh_translation: And they established word to make proclamation pass through all Israel from Beersheba to Dan, that they should come do passover to the Lord God of Israel in Jerusalem, because multitude did not do it according to writing.
brenton_translation: And they established a decree that a proclamation should go through all Israel, from Bersabee to Dan, that they should come and keep the passover to the Lord God of Israel at Jerusalem: for the multitude had not done it lately according to the scripture.

fresh_translation: And runners went with letters from the king and rulers through all Israel and Judah according to the command of the king, saying, Sons of Israel, return to God of Abraham and Isaac and Israel, and he will return remnant, those left from the hand of the king of Asshur.
brenton_translation: And the posts went with the letters from the king and the princes to all Israel and Juda, according to the command of the king, saying, Children of Israel, return to the Lord God of Abraam, and Isaac, and Israel, and bring back them that have escaped even those that were left of the hand of the king of Assyria.

fresh_translation: And do not become like your fathers and your brothers who rebelled from the Lord God of their fathers, and he gave them to desolation, as you see.
brenton_translation: And be not as your fathers, and your brethren, who revolted from the Lord God of their fathers, and he gave them up to desolation, as ye see.

fresh_translation: And now do not harden your necks; give glory to the Lord God, and enter into his sanctuary which he sanctified forever, and serve the Lord your God, and he will turn away fury of wrath from you.
brenton_translation: And now harden not your hearts, as your fathers did: give glory to the Lord God, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified for ever: and serve the Lord your God, and he shall turn away his fierce anger from you.

fresh_translation: Because when you return to the Lord, your brothers and your children shall be in mercies before all who took them captive and he will return to this land, because the Lord our God is merciful and compassionate and will not turn away his face from us if we return to him.
brenton_translation: For when ye turn to the Lord, your brethren and your children shall be pitied before all that have carried them captives, and he will restore you to this land: for the Lord our God is merciful and pitiful, and will not turn away his face from you, if we return to him.

fresh_translation: And runners were passing from one city to another in hill-country of Ephraim and Manasseh and as far as Zebulun, and they became as a laughingstock and mockery to them.
brenton_translation: So the posts went through from city to city in mount Ephraim, and Manasse, and as far as Zabulon: and they as it were laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

fresh_translation: But men from Asher and from Manasseh and from Zebulun were put to shame and came to Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: But the men of Aser, and some of Manasses and of Zabulon, were ashamed, and came to Jerusalem and Juda.

fresh_translation: And in Judah the hand of the Lord came to give them one heart, to come do according to the command of the king and rulers in the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the hand of the Lord was present to give them one heart to come, to do according to the commands of the king and of the princes, by the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And much people gathered into Jerusalem to do feast of unleavened bread in the second month, very great assembly.
brenton_translation: And a great multitude were gathered to Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

fresh_translation: And they rose and took down altars in Jerusalem, and all things in which they burned incense to false gods they pulled down and threw into the torrent of Kidron.
brenton_translation: And they arose, and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all on which they burnt incense to false gods they tore down and cast into the brook Kedron.

fresh_translation: And they sacrificed passover on the fourteenth of the second month, and priests and Levites were put to shame and sanctified themselves and brought whole burnt offerings into the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites repented, and purified themselves, and brought whole-burnt-offerings into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they stood at their station according to their ordinance, according to the command of Moses man of God, and priests received blood from the hand of Levites.
brenton_translation: And they stood at their post, according to their ordinance, according to the commandment of Moses the man of God: and the priests received the blood from the hand of the Levites.

fresh_translation: Because many of the assembly had not sanctified themselves, and Levites were to sacrifice passover for everyone not able to sanctify to the Lord.
brenton_translation: For a great part of the congregation was not sanctified; and the Levites were ready to kill the passover for every one who could not sanctify himself to the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because most of the people from Ephraim and Manasseh and Issachar and Zebulun had not sanctified themselves, but they ate passover contrary to writing, and Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, May the good Lord make atonement concerning
brenton_translation: For the greatest part of the people of Ephraim, and Manasse, and Issachar, and Zabulon, had not purified themselves, but ate the passover contrary to the scripture. On this account also Ezekias prayed concerning them, saying,

fresh_translation: every heart directing itself to seek the Lord God of their fathers and not according to the purity of holy things.
brenton_translation: The good Lord be merciful with regard to every heart that sincerely seeks the Lord God of their fathers, and is not purified according to the purification of the sanctuary.

fresh_translation: And the Lord listened to Hezekiah and healed people.
brenton_translation: And the Lord hearkened to Ezekias, and healed the people.

fresh_translation: And sons of Israel found in Jerusalem kept feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness, and priests and Levites hymning to the Lord day by day with instruments to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel who were present in Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great joy; and they continued to sing hymns to the Lord daily, and the priests and the Levites played on instruments to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah spoke to every heart of Levites, those understanding good understanding for the Lord, and they completed feast of unleavened bread seven days, sacrificing sacrifices of salvation and giving thanks to the Lord God of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias encouraged all the Levites, and those that had good understanding of the Lord: and they completely kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days, offering peace-offerings, and confessing to the Lord God of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And assembly took counsel together to do another seven days, and they did seven days with gladness.
brenton_translation: And the congregation purposed together to keep other seven days: and they kept seven days with gladness.

fresh_translation: Because Hezekiah contributed to Judah for assembly one thousand calves and seven thousand sheep, and rulers contributed to people one thousand calves and ten thousand sheep, and many holy things for priests.
brenton_translation: For Ezekias set apart for Juda, even for the congregation, a thousand calves and seven thousand sheep; and the princes set apart for the people a thousand calves and ten thousand sheep: and the holy things of the priests abundantly.

fresh_translation: And all the assembly rejoiced, priests and Levites and all the assembly from Judah and those found from Israel and sojourners who came from the land of Israel and those dwelling in Judah.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation, the priests and the Levites, rejoiced, and all the congregation of Juda, and they that were present of Jerusalem, and the strangers that came from the land of Israel, and the dwellers in Juda.

fresh_translation: And there was great gladness in Jerusalem; from the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel there had not been such feast in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And there was great joy in Jerusalem: from the days of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not such a feast in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And priests the Levites rose and blessed people, and their voice was heard and their prayer came to his holy dwelling, to heaven.
brenton_translation: Then the priests the Levites rose up and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came into his holy dwelling-place, even into heaven.

fresh_translation: And when all these things were finished, all Israel found in the cities of Judah went out and broke pillars and cut down groves and pulled down high places and altars from all Judah and Benjamin and from Ephraim and from Manasseh until end, and all Israel returned each to his inheritance and to their cities.
brenton_translation: And when all these things were finished, all Israel that were found in the cities of Juda went out, and broke in pieces the pillars, and cut down the groves, and tore down the high places and the altars out of all Judea and Benjamin, also of Ephraim and Manasse, till they made an end: and all Israel returned, every one to his inheritance, and to their cities.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah appointed courses of priests and Levites, each course according to its own service, priests and Levites for whole burnt offering and sacrifice of salvation and to praise and give thanks and minister at gates in the courts of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites, and the courses of each one according to his ministry, to the priests and to the Levites, for the whole-burnt-offering, and for the peace-offering, and to praise, and to give thanks, and to minister in the gates and in the courts of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And portion of the king from his possessions was for whole burnt offerings, morning and evening, and whole burnt offerings for Sabbaths and new moons and feasts written in the law of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the king's proportion out of his substance was appointed for the whole-burnt-offerings, the morning and the evening one, and the whole-burnt-offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the feasts that were ordered in the law of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he told people dwelling in Jerusalem to give portion of priests and Levites so that they might grow strong in service of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they told the people who dwelt in Jerusalem, to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be strong in the ministry of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And as word was commanded, sons of Israel increased firstfruits of grain and wine and oil and honey and every produce of field, and tithes of all things they brought in abundance.
brenton_translation: And as he gave the command, Israel brought abundantly first-fruits of corn, and wine, and oil, and honey, and every fruit of the field: and the children of Israel and Juda brought tithes of everything abundantly.

fresh_translation: Sons of Israel and Judah and those dwelling in the cities of Judah also brought tithes of calves and sheep and tithes of goats and sanctified to the Lord their God and brought in and set in heaps, heaps.
brenton_translation: And they that dwelt in the cities of Juda themselves also brought tithes of calves and sheep, and tithes of goats, and consecrated them to the Lord their God, and they brought them and laid them in heaps.

fresh_translation: In the third month they began to lay foundation of heaps, and in seventh month they finished.
brenton_translation: In the third month the heaps began to be piled, and in the seventh month they were finished.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah and rulers came and saw heaps and blessed the Lord and his people Israel.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias and the princes came and saw the heaps, and blessed the Lord, and his people Israel.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah inquired of priests and Levites concerning heaps.
brenton_translation: Then Ezekias enquired of the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

fresh_translation: And Azariah the chief priest for the house of Zadok said to him, From when firstfruits began to be brought into the house of the Lord, we ate and drank and left over, because the Lord blessed his people, and we still left over this great abundance.
brenton_translation: And Azarias the priest, the chief over the house of Sadoc, spoke to him, and said, From the time that the first-fruits began to be brought into the house of the Lord, we have eaten and drunk, and left even abundantly; for the Lord has blessed his people, and we have left to this amount.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah said to prepare storerooms in the house of the Lord, and they prepared them.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias told them yet farther to prepare chambers for the house of the Lord; and they prepared them,

fresh_translation: And they brought there firstfruits and tithes in faithfulness, and over them overseer was Cononiah the Levite and Shimei his brother second.
brenton_translation: and they brought thither the first-fruits and the tithes faithfully: and Chonenias the Levite was superintendent over them, and Semei his brother was next.

fresh_translation: And Jehiel and Azaziah and Nahath and Asahel and Jerimoth and Jozabad and Eliel and Samachia and Maath and Benaiah and his sons were set under Cononiah and Shimei his brother, as King Hezekiah and Azariah leader of the house of the Lord commanded.
brenton_translation: And Jeiel, and Ozias, and Naeth, and Asael, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Samachia, and Maath, and Banaias, and his sons, were appointed by Chonenias and Semei his brother, as Ezekias the king, and Azarias who was over the house of the Lord commanded.

fresh_translation: And Kore son of Imnah the Levite, gatekeeper eastward, was over freewill gifts to give firstfruits to the Lord and holy of holies.
brenton_translation: And Core, the son of Jemna the Levite, the porter eastward, was over the gifts, to distribute the first-fruits of the Lord, and the most holy things,

fresh_translation: By hand of Odom and Benjamin and Joshua and Shemaiah and Amariah and Shecaniah, by the hand of priests in faithfulness, to give to their brothers according to courses, to great and small.
brenton_translation: by the hand of Odom, and Benjamin, and Jesus, and Semei, and Amarias, and Sechonias, by the hand of the priests faithfully, to give to their brethren according to the courses, as well to great as small;

fresh_translation: Besides genealogy of males from three years and upward, to everyone entering house of the Lord for matter of days day by day, for service in courses of their ordinance.
brenton_translation: besides the increase of males from three years old and upward, to every one entering into the house of the Lord, a portion according to a daily rate, for service in the daily courses of their order.

fresh_translation: This is reckoning of priests by the houses of fathers, and Levites in their courses from twenty years and upward in their arrangement.
brenton_translation: This is the distribution of the priests according to the houses of their families; and the Levites in their daily courses from twenty years old and upward were in their order,

fresh_translation: In genealogies among all their offspring, their sons and daughters, for all multitude, because in faithfulness they sanctified holy thing.
brenton_translation: to assign stations for all the increase of their sons and their daughters, for the whole number: for they faithfully sanctified the holy place.

fresh_translation: For the sons of Aaron, those serving as priests, and those from their cities in every city and city, men named by name to give portion to every male among priests and to every one counted among Levites.
brenton_translation: As for the sons of Aaron that executed the priests' office,—even those from their cities, the men in each several city who were named expressly,—were appointed to give a portion to every male among the priests, and to every one reckoned among the Levites.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah did thus in all Judah and did good and upright before the Lord his God.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias did so through all Juda, and did that which was good and right before the Lord his God.

fresh_translation: And in every work which he began in service in the house of the Lord and in law and in ordinances, he sought his God with all his soul and did it, and he prospered.
brenton_translation: And in every work which he began in service in the house of the Lord, and in the law, and in the ordinances, he sought his God with all his soul, and wrought, and prospered.

fresh_translation: And after these words and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of the Assyrians came, and he came against Judah and encamped against fortified cities and said to seize them.
brenton_translation: And after these things and this faithful dealing, came Sennacherim king of the Assyrians, and he came to Juda, and encamped against the fortified cities, and intended to take them for himself.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come and that his face was set to fight against Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias saw that Sennacherim was come, and that his face was set to fight against Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he took counsel with his elders and his mighty men to stop up waters of springs which were outside city, and they strengthened him.
brenton_translation: And he took counsel with his elders and his mighty men to stop the wells of water which were without the city: and they helped him.

fresh_translation: And he gathered much people and stopped up waters of springs and river dividing through the city, saying, Lest king of Asshur come and find much water and prevail.
brenton_translation: And he collected many people, and stopped the wells of water, and the river that flowed through the city, saying, Lest the king of Assyria come, and find much water, and strengthen himself.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah grew strong and built all wall that had been pulled down, and towers, and another outer wall, and strengthened supporting-wall of the City of David, and prepared many weapons.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias strengthened himself, and built all the wall that had been pulled down, and the towers, and another wall in front without, and fortified the strong place of the city of David, and prepared arms in abundance.

fresh_translation: And he set war-captains over people, and they were gathered to him in the broad place of gate of valley, and he spoke to their heart, saying,
brenton_translation: And he appointed captains of war over the people, and they were gathered to meet him to the open place of the gate of the valley, and he encouraged them, saying,

fresh_translation: Be strong and act like men. Do not fear from the face of the king of Asshur and from the face of all nation with him, because more are with us than with him.
brenton_translation: Be strong and courageous, and fear not, neither be dismayed before the king of Assyria, and before all the nation that is with him: for there are more with us than with him.

fresh_translation: With him are fleshly arms, but with us is the Lord our God, to save and to fight our battle. And people grew bold upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
brenton_translation: With him are arms of flesh; but with us is the Lord our God to save us, and to fight our battle. And the people were encouraged at the words of Ezekias king of Juda.

fresh_translation: And after these things Sennacherib king of the Assyrians sent his servants to Jerusalem, while he himself was at Lachish and all force with him, and he sent to Hezekiah king of Judah and to all Judah in Jerusalem, saying,
brenton_translation: And afterward Sennacherim king of the Assyrians sent his servants to Jerusalem; and he went himself against Lachis, and all his army with him, and sent to Ezekias king of Juda, and to all Juda that was in Jerusalem, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus says Sennacherib king of the Assyrians: Upon what do you trust and remain in siege in Jerusalem?
brenton_translation: Thus says Sennacherim king of the Assyrians, On what do ye trust, that ye will remain in the siege in Jerusalem?

fresh_translation: Does not Hezekiah deceive you, to give you over to death and to famine and to thirst, saying, The Lord our God will save us from the hand of the king of Asshur?
brenton_translation: Does not Ezekias deceive you, to deliver you to death and famine and thirst, saying, The Lord our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

fresh_translation: Is not this Hezekiah himself the one who removed his altars and his high places and said to Judah and to those dwelling in Jerusalem, saying, Before this altar you shall bow down, and upon it you shall burn incense?
brenton_translation: Is not this Ezekias who has taken down his altars and his high places, and has spoken to Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before this altar, and burn incense upon it?

fresh_translation: Will you not know what I and my fathers did to all peoples of lands? Were gods of nations of all the earth at all able to save their people from my hand?
brenton_translation: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done to all the nations of the countries? Could the gods of the nations of all the earth at all rescue their people out of my hand?

fresh_translation: Who among all gods of these nations whom my fathers destroyed was unable to save their people from my hand, that your God will be able to save you from my hand?
brenton_translation: Who is there among all the gods of those nations whom my fathers utterly destroyed, worthy of trust? Could they deliver their people out of my hand, that your God should deliver you out of my hand?

fresh_translation: Now let not Hezekiah deceive you, and let him not make you trust according to these things, and do not believe him, because no god of any nation and kingdom was able to save his people from my hand and from the hand of my fathers. So your God will certainly not save you from my hand.
brenton_translation: Now then, let not Ezekias deceive you, and let him not make you thus confident, and believe him not: for no god of any kingdom or nation is at all able to deliver his people out of my hand, or the hand of my fathers: therefore your God shall not deliver you out of my hand.

fresh_translation: And still his servants spoke against the Lord God and against Hezekiah his servant.
brenton_translation: And his servants continued to speak against the Lord God, and against his servant Ezekias.

fresh_translation: And he wrote letter to reproach the Lord God of Israel and spoke concerning him, saying, As gods of the nations of the earth did not deliver their peoples from my hand, so God of Hezekiah will certainly not deliver his people from my hand.
brenton_translation: And he wrote a letter to reproach the Lord God of Israel, and spoke concerning him, saying, As the gods of the nations of the earth have not delivered their people out of my hand, so the God of Ezekias shall by no means deliver his people out of my hand.

fresh_translation: And he cried with loud voice in Ioudaisti over people of Jerusalem on wall, to frighten them and throw them down, so that they might seize city.
brenton_translation: And he cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language to the people of Jerusalem on the wall, calling them to assist them, and pull down the walls, that they might take the city.

fresh_translation: And he spoke against God of Jerusalem as also against gods of peoples of earth, works of the hands of men.
brenton_translation: And he spoke against the God of Jerusalem, even as against the gods of the nations of the earth, the works of the hands of men.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah king and Isaiah son of Amoz prophet prayed about these things and cried out to heaven.
brenton_translation: And king Ezekias and Esaias the prophet the son of Amos prayed concerning these things, and they cried to heaven.

fresh_translation: And the Lord sent angel and crushed every mighty warrior and ruler and commander in camp of the king of Asshur, and he returned with the shame of face to his land, and he came into the house of his god, and those coming from his own belly struck him down there with sword.
brenton_translation: And the Lord sent an angel, and he destroyed every mighty man and warrior, and leader and captain in the camp of the king of Assyria: and he returned with shame of face to his own land and came into the house of his god: and some of them that came out of his bowels slew him with the sword.

fresh_translation: And the Lord saved Hezekiah and those dwelling in Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib king of Asshur and from the hand of all, and gave them rest round about.
brenton_translation: So the Lord delivered Ezekias and the dwellers in Jerusalem out of the hand of Sennacherim king of Assyria, and out of the hand of all his enemies, and gave them rest round about.

fresh_translation: And many brought gifts to the Lord in Jerusalem, and offerings to Hezekiah king of Judah, and he was lifted up in the eyes of all nations after these things.
brenton_translation: And many brought gifts to the Lord to Jerusalem, and presents to Ezekias king of Juda; and he was exalted in the eyes of all the nations after these things.

fresh_translation: In those days Hezekiah became sick to point of death, and he prayed to the Lord, and he heard him and gave him sign.
brenton_translation: In those days Ezekias was sick even to death, and prayed to the Lord: and he hearkened to him, and gave him a sign.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah did not repay according to recompense given him, but his heart was lifted up, and wrath came upon him and upon Judah and Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: But Ezekias did not recompense the Lord according to the return which he made him, but his heart was lifted up: and wrath came upon him, and upon Juda and Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah was humbled from the height of his heart, he and those dwelling in Jerusalem, and the wrath of the Lord did not come upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias humbled himself after the exaltation of his heart, he and the dwellers in Jerusalem; and the wrath of the Lord did not come upon them in the days of Ezekias.

fresh_translation: And there came to Hezekiah very much wealth and glory, and he made for himself treasuries of silver and gold and precious stone and for spices and armories and for desirable vessels,
brenton_translation: And Ezekias had wealth and very great glory: and he made for himself treasuries of gold, and silver, and precious stones, also for spices, and stores for arms, and for precious vessels;

fresh_translation: and store-cities for produce of grain and oil and wine, and stalls for every beast and folds for flocks.
brenton_translation: and cities for the produce of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls and mangers for every kind of cattle, and folds for flocks;

fresh_translation: And he built cities for himself, and possession of sheep and cattle in abundance, because the Lord gave him very much possession.
brenton_translation: and cities which he built for himself, and store of sheep and oxen in abundance, for the Lord gave him a very great store.

fresh_translation: This Hezekiah stopped up upper outlet of water of Gihon and directed them down toward south of the City of David, and Hezekiah prospered in all his works.
brenton_translation: The same Ezekias stopped up the course of the water of Gion above, and brought the water down straight south of the city of David. And Ezekias prospered in all his works.

fresh_translation: And so, with ambassadors of rulers from Babylon who had been sent to him to inquire from him about wonder that happened upon earth, the Lord left him to test him, to know things in his heart.
brenton_translation: Notwithstanding, in regard to the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who were sent to him to enquire of him concerning the prodigy which came upon the land, the Lord left him, to try him, to know what was in his heart.

fresh_translation: And the rest of words of Hezekiah and his mercy, behold, written in prophecy of Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet and in the book of kings of Judah and Israel.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Ezekias, and his kindness, behold, they are written in the prophecy of Esaias the son of Amos the prophet, and in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in ascent of tombs of sons of David, and all Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem gave him glory and honor in his death, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias slept with his fathers, and they buried him in a high place among the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem gave him glory and honour at his death. And Manasses his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Manasseh was twelve years old when he reigned, and fifty-five years he reigned in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Manasses was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before the Lord, from all abominations of nations whom the Lord destroyed from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord destroyed from before the face of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And he turned again and rebuilt high places which Hezekiah his father pulled down, and set up pillars to Baalim and made groves and bowed down to all the army of heaven and served them.
brenton_translation: And he returned and built the high places, which his father Ezekias had pulled down, and set up images to Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

fresh_translation: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord said, In Jerusalem my name will be forever.
brenton_translation: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, concerning which the Lord said, In Jerusalem shall be my name for ever.

fresh_translation: And he built altars to all the army of heaven in two courts of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he built altars to all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he himself brought his children through fire in Valley of Ben-Hinnom, and practiced divination and omens and sorcery, and made ventriloquists and enchanters. He multiplied doing evil before the Lord, to provoke him.
brenton_translation: He also passed his children through the fire in the valley of Benennom; and he divined, and used auspices, and sorceries, and appointed those who had divining spirits, and enchanters, and wrought abundant wickedness before the Lord, to provoke him.

fresh_translation: And he set carved and molten image which he made in the house of God, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house and Jerusalem, which I chose from all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.
brenton_translation: And he set the graven image, the molten statue, the idol which he made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name for ever;

fresh_translation: And I will not again add to move foot of Israel from the land which I gave to their fathers, only if they keep to do all things which I commanded them, according to all law and ordinances and judgments by the hand of Moses.
brenton_translation: and I will not again remove the foot of Israel from the land which I gave to their fathers, if only they will take heed to do all things which I have commanded them, according to all the law and the ordinances and the judgments given by the hand of Moses.

fresh_translation: And Manasseh led Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem astray, to do evil beyond all nations which the Lord removed from before the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: So Manasses led astray Juda and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to do evil beyond all the nations which the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord spoke against Manasseh and against his people, and they did not listen.
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to Manasses, and to his people: but they hearkened not.

fresh_translation: And the Lord brought upon them commanders of the force of the king of Asshur, and they seized Manasseh in bonds and bound him in fetters and brought him to Babylon.
brenton_translation: And the Lord brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, and they took Manasses in bonds, and bound him in fetters, and brought him to Babylon.

fresh_translation: And when he was afflicted, he sought the face of the Lord his God and humbled himself greatly before God of his fathers.
brenton_translation: And when he was afflicted, he sought the face of the Lord his God, and was greatly humbled before the face of the God of his fathers;

fresh_translation: And he prayed to him, and he heard him and heard his cry and restored him to Jerusalem, to his kingdom. And Manasseh knew that Lord, he is God.
brenton_translation: and he prayed to him: and he hearkened to him, and listened to his cry, and brought him back to Jerusalem to his kingdom: and Manasses knew that the Lord he is God.

fresh_translation: And after these things he built wall outside the City of David from west toward Gihon in ravine and at those going out of gate round about and to Ophel, and he raised it very high, and set commanders of force in all fortified cities in Judah.
brenton_translation: And afterward he built a wall without the city of David, from the southwest southward in the valleys and at the entrance through the fish-gate, as men go out by the gate round about, even as far as Opel; and he raised it much, and set captains of the host in all the fortified cities in Juda.

fresh_translation: And he removed foreign gods and carved thing from the house of the Lord, and all altars which he built on the mountain of the house of the Lord and in Jerusalem, and he threw them outside city.
brenton_translation: And he removed the strange gods and the graven image out of the house of the Lord, and all the altars which he had built in the mount of the house of the Lord, and in Jerusalem, and without the city.

fresh_translation: And he restored the altar of the Lord and sacrificed upon it a sacrifice of salvation and of praise, and told Judah to serve the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he repaired the altar of the Lord, and offered upon it a sacrifice of peace-offering and thank-offering, and he told Juda to serve the Lord God of Israel.

fresh_translation: Except that people still sacrificed on high places, only to the Lord their God.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed on the high places, only to the Lord their God.

fresh_translation: And the rest of words of Manasseh and his prayer to God and words of seers speaking to him in the name of the Lord God of Israel, behold, upon records.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the acts of Manasses, and his prayer to God, and the words of the seers that spoke to him in the name of the God of Israel,

fresh_translation: And his prayer and how he was heard, and all his sins and his rebellions and places on which he built high places and set up groves and carved things before he turned back, behold, written upon the words of seers.
brenton_translation: behold, they are in the account of his prayer; and God hearkened to him. And all his sins, and his backslidings, and the spots on which he built the high places, and set there groves and graven images, before he repented, behold, they are written in the books of the seers.

fresh_translation: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in garden of his house, and Amon his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And Manasses slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the garden of his house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: Amon was twenty-two years old when he reigned, and two years he reigned in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did evil before the Lord as Manasseh his father did, and to all idols which Manasseh his father made Amon sacrificed and served them.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasses did: and Amon sacrificed to all the idols which his father Manasses had made, and served them.

fresh_translation: And he did not humble himself before the Lord as Manasseh his father humbled himself, because this Amon multiplied trespass.
brenton_translation: And he was not humbled before the Lord as his father Manasses was humbled; for his son Amon abounded in transgression.

fresh_translation: And his servants attacked him and struck him in his house.
brenton_translation: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his house.

fresh_translation: And the people of the land struck those attacking King Amon, and people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
brenton_translation: And the people of the land slew the men who had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josias his son king in his stead.

fresh_translation: Josiah was eight years old when he reigned, and thirty-one years he reigned in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Josias was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And he did upright before the Lord and walked in the ways of David his father and did not turn aside right or left.
brenton_translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the ways of his father David, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

fresh_translation: And in the eighth year of his kingdom, while he was still a young boy, he began to seek the Lord God of David his father. And in the twelfth year of his kingdom he began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem from high places and groves and molten things.
brenton_translation: And in the eighth year of his reign, and he being yet a youth, he began to seek the Lord God of his father David: and in the twelfth year of his reign he began to purge Juda and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the ornaments for the altars, and the molten images.

fresh_translation: And they pulled down before his face altars of Baalim, and high places above them, and he cut down groves, and carved and molten things he crushed and ground small and threw on tombs of those sacrificing to them.
brenton_translation: And he pulled down the altars of Baalim that were before his face, and the high places that were above them; and he cut down the groves, and the graven images, and broke in pieces the molten images, and reduced them to powder, and cast it upon the surface of the tombs of those who had sacrificed to them.

fresh_translation: And bones of priests he burned upon altars, and he cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon the altars, and purged Juda and Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And in the cities of Ephraim and Manasseh and Simeon and Naphtali and in their places round about.
