brenton_translation: and has given me favour in the eyes of the king, and of his councillors, and all the rulers of the king, the exalted ones. And I was strengthened according to the good hand of God upon me, and I gathered chief men of Israel to go up with me.

fresh_translation: And these were chiefs of their father-houses, leaders going up with me in the reign of Artaxerxes, king of Babylon:
brenton_translation: And these are the heads of their families, the leaders that went up with me in the reign of Arthasastha the king of Babylon.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Phinehas, Gershom; from the sons of Ithamar, Daniel; from the sons of David, Hattush;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Phinees; Gerson: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Attus.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Sechanias; from the sons of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him a band of one hundred fifty males;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Sachania, and of the sons of Phoros; Zacharias: and with him a company of a hundred and fifty.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Pahathmoab, Elianas son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males;
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Phaath-Moab; Eliana the son of Saraia, and with him two hundred that were males.

fresh_translation: from the sons of Zathoes, Shechaniah son of Aziel, and with him three hundred males;
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Zathoes; Sechenias the son of Aziel, and with him three hundred males.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Adin, Obeth son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males;
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Adin; Obeth the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males;
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Elam; Isæas the son of Athelia, and with him seventy males.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him eighty males;
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Saphatia; Zabadias the son of Michael, and with him eighty males.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Joab, Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred eighteen males;
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Joab; Abadia the son of Jeiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Baani, Salimoth son of Iosephia, and with him one hundred sixty males;
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Baani; Selimuth the son of Josephia, and with him a hundred and sixty males.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him seventy-eight males;
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Babi; Zacharias the son of Babi, and with him twenty-eight males.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Azgad, Johanan son of Hakkatan, and with him one hundred ten males;
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Asgad; Joanan the son of Accatan, and with him a hundred and ten males.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Adonikam, the last, and these their names: Eliphalat, Jehiel, and Shemaiah, and with them sixty males;
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Adonicam were the last, and these were their names, Eliphalat, Jeel, and Samæa, and with them sixty males.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of Bigvai, Uthai, and with him seventy males.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Baguæ, Uthai, and Zabud, and with him seventy males.

fresh_translation: And I gathered them to the river coming to Ahava, and we camped there three days, and I discerned among the people and the priests, but from the sons of Levi I found no one there.
brenton_translation: And I gathered them to the river that comes to Evi, and we encamped there three days: and I reviewed the people and the priests, and found none of the sons of Levi there.

fresh_translation: And I sent for Eleazar, Ariel, Shemaiah, Alonam, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, men, and for Ioarib and Elnathan, those with understanding.
brenton_translation: And I sent men of understanding to Eleazar, to Ariel, to Semeias, and to Alonam, and to Jarib, and to Elnatham, and to Nathan, and to Zacharias, and to Mesollam, and to Joarim, and to Elnathan.

fresh_translation: And I sent them out to the leader at Casiphia the place, and I put words in their mouth to speak to their brothers the nethinim at Casiphia the place, to bring us singers for the house of our God.
brenton_translation: And I forwarded them to the rulers with the money of the place, and I put words in their mouth to speak to their brethren the Athinim with the money of the place, that they should bring us singers for the house of our God.

fresh_translation: And they came to us, because good hand of our God was upon us, a man, Mahli, from the sons of Mahali son of Levi son of Israel, and his sons and his brothers, eighteen.
brenton_translation: And they came to us, as the good hand of our God was upon us, even a man of understanding of the sons of Mooli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, and at the commencement came his sons and his brethren, eighteen.

fresh_translation: And Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty.
brenton_translation: And Asebia, and Isaia of the sons of Merari, his brethren and his sons, twenty.

fresh_translation: And from the nethinim, whom David and the rulers gave for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty nethinim. All were enrolled by names.
brenton_translation: And of the Nathinim, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites there were two hundred and twenty Nathinim; all were gathered by their names.

fresh_translation: And I proclaimed a fast there at river Ahava, to humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us and for our children and for all our possessions.
brenton_translation: And I proclaimed there a fast, at the river Aüe, that we should humble ourselves before our God, to seek of him a straight way for us, and for our children, and for all our property.

fresh_translation: For I was ashamed to ask from the king force and horsemen to save us from enemy on the road, because we had spoken to the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all seeking him for good, but his might and his wrath are upon all forsaking him.
brenton_translation: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a guard and horsemen to save us from the enemy in the way: for we had spoken to the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all that seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath are upon all that forsake him.

fresh_translation: And we fasted and sought from our God concerning this, and he listened to us.
brenton_translation: So we fasted, and asked of our God concerning this; and he hearkened to us.

fresh_translation: And I separated twelve from the chiefs of the priests: Seraiah, Hashabiah, and with them ten from their brothers.
brenton_translation: And I gave charge to twelve of the chiefs of the priests, to Saraia, to Asabia, and ten of their brethren with them.

fresh_translation: And I weighed out to them the silver and the gold and the vessels, the firstfruits of the house of our God, which the king and his counselors and his rulers and all Israel found there had lifted up.
brenton_translation: And I weighed to them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of the first-fruits of the house of our God, which the king, and his councillors, and his princes, and all Israel that were found, had dedicated.

fresh_translation: And I weighed into their hands six hundred fifty talents of silver and one hundred silver vessels and one hundred talents of gold,
brenton_translation: I even weighed into their hands six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and a hundred silver vessels, and a hundred talents of gold;

fresh_translation: and twenty golden bowls worth one thousand chamanim, and vessels of shining good bronze, choice as gold.
brenton_translation: and twenty golden bowls, weighing about a thousand drachms, and superior vessels of fine shining brass, precious as gold.

fresh_translation: And I said to them, You are holy to the Lord, and the vessels are holy, and the silver and gold are a freewill offering to the Lord God of your fathers.
brenton_translation: And I said to them, Ye are holy to the Lord; and the vessels are holy; and the silver and the gold are freewill-offerings to the Lord God of our fathers.

fresh_translation: Stay awake and guard them until you stand before chiefs of the priests and the Levites and chiefs of father-houses in Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Be watchful and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief priests and the Levites, and the chiefs of families in Jerusalem, at the chambers of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver and the gold and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem into the house of our God.
brenton_translation: So the priests and the Levites took the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring to Jerusalem into the house of our God.

fresh_translation: And we set out from the river Ahava on twelfth day of the first month to come to Jerusalem, and hand of our God was upon us, and he rescued us from the hand of enemy and foe on the road.
brenton_translation: And we departed from the river of Aüe on the twelfth day of the first month, to come to Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and delivered us from the hand of the enemy and adversary in the way.

fresh_translation: And we came to Jerusalem and sat there three days.
brenton_translation: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.

fresh_translation: And it happened on fourth day that we weighed the silver and the gold and the vessels in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth son of Uriah the priest, and with him Eleazar son of Phinehas, and with them Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Benaiah, the Levites,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on the fourth day that we weighed the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, in the house of our God, into the hand of Merimoth the son of Uria the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinees, and with them Jozabad the son of Jesus, and Noadia the son of Banaia, the Levites.

fresh_translation: by number and by weight, everything, and all the weight was written at that time.
brenton_translation: All things were reckoned by number and weight, and the whole weight was written down.

fresh_translation: Those coming from captivity, sons of exile, offered whole burnt offerings to God of Israel: twelve calves for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, twelve goat kids for sin, all as whole burnt offerings to the Lord.
brenton_translation: At that time the children of the banishment that came from the captivity offered whole-burnt-offerings to the God of Israel, twelve calves for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, twelve goats for a sin-offering: all whole-burnt-offerings to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they gave king's decree to the king's administrators and governors beyond the River, and they honored the people and the house of God.
brenton_translation: And they gave the king's mandate to the king's lieutenants, and the governors beyond the river: and they honoured the people and the house of God.

fresh_translation: And when these things were finished, the rulers came near to me saying, People of Israel and the priests and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands in their abominations, from the Canaanite, Hittite, Perizzite, Jebusite, Ammonite, Moabite, Moserite, and Amorite.
brenton_translation: And when these things were finished, the princes drew near to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands in their abominations, even the Chananite, the Ethite, the Pherezite, the Jebusite, the Ammonite, the Moabite, and the Moserite and the Amorite.

fresh_translation: For they took from their daughters for themselves and for their sons, and the holy seed was mixed with the peoples of the lands, and hand of the rulers was first in this faithlessness.
brenton_translation: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and their sons; and the holy seed has passed among the nations of the lands, and the hand of the rulers has been first in this transgression.

fresh_translation: And when I heard this word, I tore my garments and mantle and plucked hair from my head and from my beard and sat devastated.
brenton_translation: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garments, and trembled, and plucked some of the hairs of my head and of my beard, and sat down mourning.

fresh_translation: And everyone pursuing word of God of Israel was gathered to me over the faithlessness of the exile, and I sat devastated until evening sacrifice.
brenton_translation: Then there assembled to me all that followed the word of the God of Israel, on account of the transgression of the captivity; and I remained mourning until the evening sacrifice.

fresh_translation: And at evening sacrifice I rose from my humbling, and as I tore my garments and mantle I bent upon my knees and spread out my hands to the Lord God
brenton_translation: And at the evening sacrifice I rose up from my humiliation; and when I had rent my garments, then I trembled, and I bow myself on my knees, and spread out my hands to the Lord God,

fresh_translation: and said, Lord, I was ashamed and embarrassed to lift my face to you, because our lawlessnesses multiplied above our head and our trespasses grew great unto heaven.
brenton_translation: and I said, O Lord, I am ashamed and confounded, O my God, to lift up my face to thee: for our transgressions have abounded over our head, and our trespasses have increased even to heaven.

fresh_translation: From the days of our fathers we have been in great trespass until this day, and in our lawlessnesses we and our kings and our sons were given into the hand of kings of the nations, to sword and captivity and plundering and shame of face, as this day.
brenton_translation: From the days of our fathers we have been in a great trespass until this day: and because of our iniquities we, and our kings, and our children, have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the Gentiles by the sword, and by captivity, and by spoil, and with shame of our face, as at this day.

fresh_translation: And now the Lord our God dealt gently with us, to leave us a remnant for salvation and give us a foothold in place of his sanctuary, to enlighten our eyes and give us a little reviving in our slavery.
brenton_translation: And now our God has dealt mercifully with us, so as to leave us to escape, and to give us an establishment in the place of his sanctuary, to enlighten our eyes, and to give a little quickening in our servitude.

fresh_translation: For slaves we are, yet in our slavery the Lord our God did not forsake us, and he bent mercy upon us before kings of Persia, to give us reviving, to raise up house of our God and restore its desolate places and give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: For we are slaves, yet in our servitude the Lord our God has not deserted us; and he has extended favour to us in the sight of the kings of the Persians, to give us a quickening, that they should raise up the house of our God, and restore the desolate places of it, and to give us a fence in Juda and Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And what shall we say, our God, after this? For we forsook your commandments,
brenton_translation: What shall we say, our God, after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,

fresh_translation: which you gave by the hand of your servants the prophets, saying, The land into which you enter to inherit it is a land made unclean in uncleanness of peoples of the nations, in their abominations with which they filled it from one end to the other with their uncleannesses.
brenton_translation: which thou hast given us by the hand of thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, into which ye go to inherit it, is a land subject to disturbance by the removal of the people of the nations for their abominations, wherewith they have filled it from one end to the other by their uncleannesses.

fresh_translation: And now do not give your daughters to their sons, and do not take from their daughters for your sons, and do not seek their peace and their good forever, so that you may grow strong and eat good things of the land and leave it as inheritance to your sons forever.
brenton_translation: And now give not your daughters to their sons, and take not of their daughters for your sons, neither shall ye seek their peace or their good for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and transmit it as an inheritance to your children for ever.

fresh_translation: And after all that came upon us for our evil deeds and our great trespass, since you, our God, lightened from our lawlessnesses and gave us such deliverance,
brenton_translation: And after all that is come upon us because of our evil deeds, and our great trespass, it is clear that there is none such as our God, for thou hast lightly visited our iniquities, and given us deliverance;

fresh_translation: shall we turn again to scatter your commandments and intermarry with the peoples of the lands? Do not be angry with us until completion, so that there be no remnant and no one escaping.
brenton_translation: whereas we have repeatedly broken thy commandments, and intermarried with the people of the lands: be not very angry with us to our utter destruction, so that there should be no remnant or escaping one.

fresh_translation: Lord God of Israel, righteous are you, because we were left escaping as this day. Behold, we are before you in our trespasses, because there is no standing before you on account of this.
brenton_translation: O Lord God of Israel, thou art righteous; for we remain yet escaped, as at this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee on this account.

fresh_translation: And as Ezra prayed and confessed, weeping and praying before the house of God, a very great assembly from Israel was gathered to him, men and women and young people, because the people wept and lifted up weeping.
brenton_translation: So when Esdras had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and praying before the house of God, a very great assembly of Israel came together to him, men and women and youths; for the people wept, and wept aloud.

fresh_translation: And Shechaniah son of Jehiel, from the sons of Elam, answered and said to Ezra, We acted faithlessly against our God and seated foreign women from the peoples of the land, and now there is patient hope for Israel about this.
brenton_translation: And Sechenias the son of Jeel, of the sons of Elam, answered and said to Esdras, We have broken covenant with our God, and have taken strange wives of the nations of the land: yet now there is patience of hope to Israel concerning this thing.

fresh_translation: And now let us make a covenant with our God to put out all the women and those born from them, according to your counsel. Rise and warn them in the commandments of our God, and let it be according to law.
brenton_translation: Now then let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and their offspring, as thou shalt advise:

fresh_translation: Rise, because the matter is on you, and we are with you. Be strong and do it.
brenton_translation: arise, and alarm them with the commands of our God; and let it be done according to the law. Rise up, for the matter is upon thee; and we are with thee: be strong and do.

fresh_translation: And Ezra rose and made the rulers, the priests, and the Levites and all Israel swear to do according to this word, and they swore.
brenton_translation: Then Esdras arose, and caused the rulers, the priests, and Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they would do according to this word: and they swore.

fresh_translation: And Ezra rose from before the house of God and went into the treasury-room of Johanan son of Eliashib, and he went there. He ate no bread and drank no water, because he mourned over the faithlessness of the exile.
brenton_translation: And Esdras rose up from before the house of God, and went to the treasury of Joanan the son of Elisub; he even went thither: he ate no bread, and drank no water; for he mourned over the unfaithfulness of them of the captivity.

fresh_translation: And they proclaimed through Judah and Jerusalem to all the sons of the exile to gather into Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And they made proclamation throughout Juda and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should assemble at Jerusalem, saying,

fresh_translation: And everyone who would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the rulers and the elders, all his substance would be devoted, and he himself would be separated from assembly of the exile.
brenton_translation: Every one who shall not arrive within three days, as is the counsel of the rulers and the elders, all his substance shall be forfeited, and he shall be separated from the congregation of the captivity.

fresh_translation: And all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered into Jerusalem within three days. This was the ninth month, on twentieth day of the month. And all the people sat in the open square of the house of God, trembling because of the matter and because of the winter.
brenton_translation: So all the men of Juda and Benjamin assembled at Jerusalem within the three days. This was the ninth month: on the twentieth day of the month all the people sat down in the street of the house of the Lord, because of their alarm concerning the word, and because of the storm.

fresh_translation: And Ezra the priest stood and said to them, You have acted faithlessly and seated foreign women, to add to trespass of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Esdras the priest arose, and said to them, Ye have broken covenant, and have taken strange wives, to add to the trespass of Israel.

fresh_translation: And now give praise to the Lord God of your fathers and do what is pleasing before him, and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.
brenton_translation: Now therefore give praise to the Lord God of our fathers, and do that which is pleasing in his sight: and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land, and from the strange wives.

fresh_translation: And all the assembly answered and said, Great is this word of yours upon us to do.
brenton_translation: Then all the congregation answered and said, This thy word is powerful upon us to do it.

fresh_translation: But the people are many, and the season is rainy, and there is no strength to stand outside, and the work is not for one day and not for two, because we multiplied wrongdoing in this matter.
brenton_translation: But the people is numerous, and the season is stormy, and there is no power to stand without, and the work is more than enough for one day or for two; for we have greatly sinned in this matter.

fresh_translation: Let our rulers stand for the whole assembly, and all in our cities who seated foreign women, let them come at appointed times, and with them elders of the city by city and judges, to turn away anger of wrath of our God from us concerning this matter.
brenton_translation: Let now our rulers stand, and for all those in our cities who have taken strange wives, let them come at appointed times, and with them elders from every several city, and judges, to turn away the fierce wrath of our God from us concerning this matter.

fresh_translation: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahaziah son of Tikvah stood for this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite were helping them.
brenton_translation: Only Jonathan the son of Asael, and Jazias the son of Thecoe were with me concerning this; and Mesollam, and Sabbathai the Levite helped them.

fresh_translation: And the sons of the exile did thus, and Ezra the priest and men, leaders of father-houses by house, all by names, were set apart, and they sat on the first day of the tenth month to investigate the matter.
brenton_translation: And the children of the captivity did thus: and Esdras the priest, and heads of families according to their house were separated, and all by their names, for they returned in the first day of the tenth month to search out the matter.

fresh_translation: And they finished with all the men who had seated foreign women by first day of the first month.
brenton_translation: And they made an end with all the men who had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of the priests who had seated foreign women were found these: from the sons of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers, Maaseiah and Eliezer and Jarib and Gedaliah.
brenton_translation: And there were found some of the sons of the priests who had taken strange wives: of the sons of Jesus the son of Josedec, and his brethren; Maasia, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gadalia.

fresh_translation: And they gave their hands to put out their wives, and for their trespass a ram from the sheep for their trespass.
brenton_translation: And they pledged themselves to put away their wives, and offered a ram of the flock for a trespass-offering because of their trespass.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Immer: Anani and Zebadiah.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Emmer; Anani, and Zabdia.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Harim: Maaseiah and Eliah and Shemaiah and Jehiel and Uzziah.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Eram; Masael, and Elia, and Samaia, and Jeel, and Ozia.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Pashur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nathanael, Jozabad, and Elasah.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Phasur; Elionai, Maasia, and Ismael, and Nathanael, and Jozabad, and Elasa.

fresh_translation: And from the Levites: Jozabad and Samou and Kelaiah, he is Kolitas, and Pethahiah and Iodom and Eliezer.
brenton_translation: And of the Levites; Jozabad, and Samu, and Colia (he is Colitas,) and Phetheia, and Judas, and Eliezer.

fresh_translation: And from the singers: Eliasaph. And from the gatekeepers: Shillem and Telem and Odoue.
brenton_translation: And of the singers; Elisab: and of the porters; Solmen, and Telmen, and Oduth.

fresh_translation: And from Israel, from the sons of Parosh: Ramiah and Iazia and Malchijah and Mijamin and Eleazar and Hashabiah and Benaiah.
brenton_translation: Also of Israel: of the sons of Phoros; Ramia, and Azia, and Melchia, and Meamin, and Eleazar, and Asabia, and Banaia.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Elam: Mattaniah and Zechariah and Jehiel and Obadiah and Jeremoth and Eliah.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Helam; Matthania, and Zacharia, and Jaïel, and Abdia, and Jarimoth, and Elia.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Oziza.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Zathua; Elionai, Elisub, Matthanai, and Armoth, and Zabad, and Oziza.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Bebai: Johanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Babei; Joanan, Anania, and Zabu, and Thali.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Salouia, and Ramoth.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Banui; Mosollam, Maluch, Adaias, Jasub, and Saluia, and Remoth.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Pahathmoab: Edna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, Bani, and Manasseh.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Phaath Moab; Edne, and Chalel, and Banaia, Maasia, Matthania, Beseleel, and Banui, and Manasse.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Iessia, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Eram; Eliezer, Jesia, Melchia, Samaias, Semeon,

fresh_translation: Benjamin, Malluch, Samaria.
brenton_translation: Benjamin, Baluch, Samaria.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mathatha, Zabad, Eliphaleph, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Asem; Metthania, Matthatha, Zadab, Eliphalet, Jerami, Manasse, Semei.

fresh_translation: From the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,
brenton_translation: And of the sons of Bani; Moodia, Amram, Uel,

fresh_translation: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
brenton_translation: Banaia, Badaia, Chelkia,

fresh_translation: Ouechoa, Meremoth, Eliashib,
brenton_translation: Uvania, Marimoth, Eliasiph,

fresh_translation: Mattaniah, Mathanai, and they made.
brenton_translation: Matthania, Matthanai:

fresh_translation: The sons of Bani and the sons of Shimei,
brenton_translation: and so did the children of Banui, and the children of Semei,

fresh_translation: and Shelemiah and Nathan and Adaiah,
brenton_translation: and Selemia, and Nathan, and Adaia,

fresh_translation: Machnadebai, Sese, Sharai,
brenton_translation: Machadnabu, Sesei, Sariu,

fresh_translation: Azareel and Shelemiah and Samaria,
brenton_translation: Ezriel, and Selemia, and Samaria,

fresh_translation: and Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.
brenton_translation: and Sellum, Amaria, Joseph.

fresh_translation: From the sons of Nebo: Jehiel, Mattithiah, Zedem, Zebina, Jahdai, Joel, and Benaiah.
brenton_translation: Of the sons of Nabu; Jael, Matthanias, Zabad, Zebennas, Jadai, and Joel, and Banaia.

fresh_translation: All these took foreign women and begot sons from them.
brenton_translation: All these had taken strange wives, and had begotten sons of them.

fresh_translation: The words of Nehemiah son of Hachaliah. And it came to be in the month of Chisleu, in the twentieth year, and I was in Shushan the citadel.
brenton_translation: The words of Neemias the son of Chelcia. And it came to pass in the month Chaseleu, of the twentieth year, that I was in Susan the palace.

fresh_translation: And Anani, one from my brothers, came, he and men of Judah, and I asked them concerning the survivors who were left from captivity and concerning Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And Anani, one of my brethren, came, he and some men of Juda; and I asked them concerning those that had escaped, who had been left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And they said to me, The ones left, who were left from captivity there in the province, are in great evil and reproach, and walls of Jerusalem are broken down and its gates have been burned with fire.
brenton_translation: And they said to me, The remnant, even those that are left of the captivity, are there in the land, in great distress and reproach: and the walls of Jerusalem are thrown down, and its gates are burnt with fire.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when I heard these words, I sat and wept and mourned for days, and I was fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned for several days, and continued fasting and praying before the God of heaven.

fresh_translation: And I said, Please, O Lord God of heaven, strong, great, and fearful, keeping the covenant and the mercy for those loving him and keeping his commandments,
brenton_translation: And I said, Nay, I pray thee, O Lord God of heaven, the mighty, the great and terrible, keeping thy covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to those that keep his commandments:

fresh_translation: let your ear now be attentive and your eyes open to hear prayer of your servant which I pray before you today, day and night, concerning the sons of Israel your servants, and I confess over sins of sons of Israel, which we sinned against you; both I and house of my father sinned.
brenton_translation: let now thine ear be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee at this time, this day both day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and make confession for the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and the house of my father have sinned.

fresh_translation: In ruin we were ruined toward you, and we did not keep the commandments and the ordinances and the judgments which you commanded Moses your servant.
brenton_translation: We have altogether broken covenant with thee, and we have not kept the commandments, and the ordinances, and the judgments, which thou didst command thy servant Moses.

fresh_translation: Remember, please, the word which you commanded Moses your servant, saying, If you act faithlessly, I will scatter you among the peoples.
brenton_translation: Remember, I pray thee, the word wherewith thou didst charge thy servant Moses, saying, If ye break covenant with me, I will disperse you among the nations.

fresh_translation: But if you return to me and keep my commandments and do them, even if your dispersion is from the edge of heaven, from there I will gather them and bring them into the place which I chose for my name to dwell there.
brenton_translation: But if ye turn again to me, and keep my commandments, and do them; if ye should be scattered under the utmost bound of heaven, thence will I gather them, and I will bring them into the place which I have chosen to cause my name to dwell there.

fresh_translation: And they are your servants and your people, whom you redeemed by your great power and your strong hand.
brenton_translation: Now they are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed with thy great power, and with thy strong hand.

fresh_translation: Please, Lord, let your ear be attentive to the prayer of your servant and to the prayer of your servants who desire to fear your name, and prosper your servant today and give him for compassions before this man. And I was cupbearer to the king.
brenton_translation: Turn not away, I pray thee, O Lord, but let thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and cause him to find mercy in the sight of this man. Now I was the king's cup-bearer.

fresh_translation: And it came to be in month Nisan, twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, and wine was before me, and I took the wine and gave it to the king, and I had not been sad before him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the month Nisan of the twentieth year of king Arthasastha, that the wine was before me: and I took the wine, and gave it to the king: and there was not another before him.

fresh_translation: And the king said to me, Why is your face troubled while you are not sick? This is nothing except trouble of heart. And I feared very greatly,
brenton_translation: And the king said to me, Why is thy countenance sad, and dost thou not control thyself? and now this is nothing but sorrow of heart. Then I was very much alarmed,

fresh_translation: and I said to the king, Let the king live forever. Why should my face not be troubled, because the city, house of the tombs of my fathers, was laid waste and its gates were devoured by fire?
brenton_translation: and I said to the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be said, forasmuch as the city, even the home of the sepulchres of my fathers, has been laid waste, and her gates have been devoured with fire?

fresh_translation: And the king said to me, For what do you seek this? And I prayed to the God of heaven,
brenton_translation: And the king said to me, For what dost thou ask thus? So I prayed to the God of heaven.

fresh_translation: and I said to the king, If it seems good to the king, and if your servant will be dealt well with before you, send him to Judah, to the city of the tombs of my fathers, and I will rebuild it.
brenton_translation: And I said to the king, If it seem good to the king, and if thy servant shall have found favour in thy sight, I ask that thou wouldest send him into Juda, to the city of the sepulchres of my fathers; then will I rebuild it.

fresh_translation: And the king and the concubine sitting beside him said to me, Until when will your journey be, and when will you return? And it seemed good before the king, and he sent me, and I gave him a time.
brenton_translation: And the king, and his concubine that sat next to him, said to me, For how long will thy journey be, and when wilt thou return? and the proposal was pleasing before the king, and he sent me away, and I appointed him a time.

fresh_translation: And I said to the king, If it seems good to the king, let letters be given to me for governors beyond the River, so that they may send me through until I come to Judah,
brenton_translation: And I said to the king, If it seem good to the king, let him give me letters to the governors beyond the river, so as to forward me till I come to Juda;

fresh_translation: and a letter to Asaph, keeper of the king's park, so that he may give me timbers to roof the gates of the citadel belonging to the house and for the wall of the city and for the house into which I will enter. And the king gave to me, as the good hand of God was upon me.
brenton_translation: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the garden which belongs to the king, that he may give me timber to cover the gates, and for the wall of the city, and for the house into which I shall enter. And the king gave to me, according as the good hand of God was upon me.

fresh_translation: And I came to the governors beyond the River and gave to them letters of the king, and the king sent with me leaders of force and horsemen.
brenton_translation: And I came to the governors beyond the river, and I gave them the king's letters. (Now the king had sent with me captains of the army and horsemen.)

fresh_translation: And Sanballat the Horonite heard, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and it became evil to them that a man had come to seek good for the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And Sanaballat the Aronite heard it, and Tobia the servant, the Ammonite, and it was grievous to them that a man was come to seek good for the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And I came to Jerusalem and was there three days.
brenton_translation: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

fresh_translation: And I rose by night, I and a few men with me, and I did not tell any man what God was giving in my heart to do with Israel, and no beast was with me except the beast on which I rode.
brenton_translation: And I rose up by night, I and a few men with me; and I told no man what God put into my heart to do with Israel; and there was no beast with me, except the beast which I rode upon.

fresh_translation: And I went out by night through the gate of Goleila and toward mouth of spring of the figs and to the gate of the dung-heaps, and I was inspecting wall of Jerusalem, which they are pulling down, and its gates were devoured by fire.
brenton_translation: And I went forth by the gate of the valley by night, and to the mouth of the well of fig trees, and to the dung-gate: and I mourned over the wall of Jerusalem which they were destroying, and her gates were devoured with fire.

fresh_translation: And I passed on to the gate of Ain and to the king's pool, and there was no place for the beast under me to pass.
brenton_translation: And I passed on to the fountain gate, and to the king's pool; and there was no room for the beast to pass under me.

fresh_translation: And I was going up by night along wall of the torrent and was inspecting the wall, and I went in by the gate of the gorge and returned.
brenton_translation: And I went up by the wall of the brook by night, and mourned over the wall, and passed through the gate of the valley, and returned.

fresh_translation: And the guards did not know where I went and what I was doing, and to the Jews and to the priests and to the nobles and to the generals and to the rest doing the works I had not told it until then.
brenton_translation: And the sentinels knew not why I went, nor what I was doing; and until that time I told it not to the Jews, or to the priests, or to the nobles, or to the captains, or to the rest of the men who wrought the works.

fresh_translation: And I said to them, You see the evil in which we are, how Jerusalem lies waste and its gates were given to fire. Come, let us rebuild wall of Jerusalem, and we will no longer be a reproach.
brenton_translation: Then I said to them, Ye see this evil, in which we are, how Jerusalem is desolate, and her gates have been set on fire: come, and let us build throughout the wall of Jerusalem, and we shall be no longer a reproach.

fresh_translation: And I told them of the hand of God, that it is good upon me, and of the words of the king which he spoke to me. And they said, Let us rise and build. And their hands were strengthened for good.
brenton_translation: And I told them of the hand of God which was good upon me, also about the words of the king which he spoke to me: and I said, Let us arise and build. And their hands were strengthened for the good work.

fresh_translation: And Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the servant the Ammonite and Geshem the Arab heard and mocked us and came against us and said, What is this thing you are doing? Are you rebelling against the king?
brenton_translation: And Sanaballat the Aronite, and Tobia the servant, the Ammonite, and Gesam the Arabian, heard it, and they laughed us to scorn, and came to us, and said, What is this thing that ye are doing? are ye revolting against the king?

fresh_translation: And I answered them with a word and said to them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us, and we his servants are clean and will build, but to you there is no share and no right and no memorial in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And I answered them, and said to them, The God of heaven, he shall prosper us, and we his servants are pure, and we will build: but ye have no part, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And Eliashib the high priest and his brothers the priests rose up and built the Sheep Gate. They sanctified it and set up its doors, and sanctified it as far as Tower of Hundred, as far as Tower of Hananeel.
brenton_translation: Then Eliasub the high priest, and his brethren the priests, rose up, and built the sheep-gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even to the tower of the hundred they sanctified it, to the tower of Anameel.

fresh_translation: And next to them were sons of men of Jericho, and next to them sons of Zaccur son of Imri.
brenton_translation: And they builded by the side of the men of Jericho, and by the side of the sons of Zacchur, the son of Amari.

fresh_translation: And sons of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate. They roofed it and set its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Asana built the fish-gate; they roofed it, and covered in its doors, and bolts, and bars.

fresh_translation: And next to them Meremoth son of Urijah son of Koz repaired, and next to them Meshullam son of Berechiah son of Meshezabeel repaired, and next to them Zadok son of Baana repaired.
brenton_translation: And next to them the order reached to Ramoth the son of Uria, the son of Accos, and next to them Mosollam son of Barachias the son of Mazebel took his place: and next to them Sadoc the son of Baana took his place.

fresh_translation: And next to them the Tekoites repaired, but their nobles did not bring their neck into service of their lord.
brenton_translation: And next to them the Thecoim took their place; but the Adorim applied not their neck to their service.

fresh_translation: And Ioda son of Phasek and Meshullam son of Basodia repaired the Old Gate. They roofed it and set its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
brenton_translation: And Joida the son of Phasec, and Mesulam son of Basodia, repaired the old gate; they covered it in, and set up its doors, and its bolts, and its bars.

fresh_translation: And next to them Hananiah son of the perfumers repaired, and they left Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
brenton_translation: And next to him Oziel the son of Arachias of the smiths, carried on the repairs: and next to them Ananias the son of one of the apothecaries repaired, and they finished Jerusalem to the broad wall.

fresh_translation: And next to them Rephaiah, ruler of half district of Jerusalem, repaired.
brenton_translation: And next to them repaired Raphaea the son of Sur, the ruler of half the district round about Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And next to them Jedaiah son of Harumaph repaired opposite his house, and next to him Hattush son of Hashabniah repaired.
brenton_translation: And next to them repaired Jedaia the son of Eromaph, and that in front of his house: and next to him repaired Attuth son of Asabania.

fresh_translation: A second section Malchiah son of Harim and Shobek son of Pahathmoab repaired, and as far as Tower of Ovens.
brenton_translation: And next to him repaired Melchias son of Heram, and Asub son of Phaat Moab, even to the tower of the furnaces.

fresh_translation: And next to him Shallum son of Alloes, ruler of half district of Jerusalem, repaired, he and his daughters.
brenton_translation: And next to him repaired Sallum the son of Alloes, the ruler of half the district round about Jerusalem, he and his daughters.

fresh_translation: Hanun and inhabitants of Zanoah repaired Valley Gate. They built it and set its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits on the wall, as far as Dung Gate.
brenton_translation: Anun and the inhabitants of Zano repaired the gate of the valley: they built it, and set up its doors, and its bolts, and its bars, and a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the dung-gate.

fresh_translation: And Malchiah son of Rechab, ruler of district of Bethacharm, repaired Dung Gate, he and his sons. They roofed it and set its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
brenton_translation: And Melchia the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district round about Beth-accharim, repaired the dung-gate, he and his sons; and they covered it, and set up its doors, and its bolts, and its bars.

fresh_translation: And the wall of pool of Kodia at the king's garden, and as far as the stairs going down from the city of David.
brenton_translation: But Solomon the son of Choleze repaired the gate of the fountain, the ruler of part of Maspha; he built it, and covered it, and set up its doors and its bars, and the wall of the pool of the skins by the meadow of the king, and as far as the steps that lead down from the city of David.

fresh_translation: After him Nehemiah son of Azabouch, ruler of half district of Bethzur, repaired as far as garden of tomb of David and as far as pool that was made and as far as House of the Mighty Men.
brenton_translation: After him repaired Neemias son of Azabuch, ruler of half the district round about Bethsur, as far as the garden of David's sepulchre, and as far as the artificial pool, and as far as the house of the mighty men.

fresh_translation: After him the Levites repaired: Rehum son of Bani. Next to him Hashabiah, ruler of half district of Keilah, repaired for his district.
brenton_translation: After him repaired the Levites, even Raum the son of Bani: next to him repaired Asabia, ruler of half the district round about Keila, in his district.

fresh_translation: After him their brothers repaired: Beni son of Henadad, ruler of half district of Keilah.
brenton_translation: And after him repaired his brethren, Benei son of Enadad, ruler of half the district round about Keila.

fresh_translation: And next to him Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired a second measure from the tower of ascent adjoining the angle.
brenton_translation: And next to him repaired Azur the son of Joshua, ruler of Masphai, another portion of the tower of ascent, where it meets the corner.

fresh_translation: After him Baruch son of Zabbai repaired a second measure, from the angle to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
brenton_translation: After him repaired Baruch the son of Zabu, a second portion, from the corner as far as the door of the house of Eliasub the high priest.

fresh_translation: After him Meremoth son of Urijah son of Koz repaired a second measure, from the door of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house of Eliashib.
brenton_translation: After him repaired Meramoth the son of Uria the son of Accos, a second part from the door of the house of Eliasub, to the end of the house of Eliasub.

fresh_translation: And after him the priests, men of Achechar, repaired.
brenton_translation: And after him repaired the priests, the men of Ecchechar.

fresh_translation: And after him Benjamin and Shobek repaired opposite their house. After him Azariah son of Amasai son of Hananiah repaired beside his house.
brenton_translation: And after him repaired Benjamin and Asub over against their house: and after him repaired Azarias son of Maasias the son of Ananias, the parts near to his house.

fresh_translation: After him Bani son of Henadad repaired a second measure, from the house of Azariah to the angle and to the turning.
brenton_translation: After him repaired Bani the son of Adad, another portion from the house of Azaria as far as the corner and to the turning,

fresh_translation: Palal son of Uzai repaired opposite the angle and the tower projecting from upper house of the king, the one at court of the guard, and after him Pedaiah son of Parosh.
brenton_translation: of Phalach the son of Uzai, opposite the corner, and where is also the tower that projects from the king's house, even the upper one of the prison-house: and after him repaired Phadaea the son of Phoros.

fresh_translation: And the nethinim were dwelling in the Ophel as far as Water Gate eastward and the projecting tower.
brenton_translation: And the Nathinim dwelt in Ophal, as far as the garden of the water-gate eastward, and there is the projecting tower.

fresh_translation: After him the Tekoites repaired a second measure, opposite the great projecting tower and as far as wall of Ophel.
brenton_translation: And after them the Thecoim repaired, another portion opposite the great projecting tower, even as far as the wall of Ophla.

fresh_translation: Above Horse Gate the priests repaired, each opposite his own house.
brenton_translation: The priests repaired above the horse-gate, every man over against his own house.

fresh_translation: After him Zadok son of Immer repaired opposite his house, and after him Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, keeper of East Gate, repaired.
brenton_translation: And after him Sadduc the son of Emmer repaired opposite his own house: and after him repaired Samaea son of Sechenia, guard of the east-gate.

fresh_translation: After him Hananiah son of Shelemiah and Hanun son of Zalaph, the sixth, repaired a second measure. After him Meshullam son of Berechiah repaired opposite his treasury-room.
brenton_translation: After him repaired Anania son of Selemia, and Anom, the sixth son of Seleph, another portion: after him Mesulam the son of Barachia repaired over against his treasury.

fresh_translation: After him Malchijah son of the goldsmith repaired as far as house of the nethinim and the traders, opposite Gate of the Mustering and as far as ascent of the turning.
brenton_translation: After him repaired Melchia the son of Sarephi as far as the house of the Nathinim, and the chapmen over against the gate of Maphecad, and as far as the steps of the corner.

fresh_translation: And between ascent of the turning and Sheep Gate the smiths and the traders repaired.
brenton_translation: And between that and the sheep-gate the smiths and chapmen repaired.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when Sanballat heard that we are building the wall, it was evil to him and he became very angry and mocked the Jews.
And he said before his brothers, This force of Samaria, that these Jews build their own city?
And Tobiah the Ammonite beside him came, and they said among themselves, Will they not sacrifice or eat on their place? Surely a fox will go up and tear down wall of their stones.
Hear, our God, because we became a mockery, and turn their reproach upon their own head and give them for mockery in the land of captivity.
And do not cover over their lawlessness.
And it came to be as Sanballat and Tobiah and the Arabs and the Ammonites heard that growth had come to walls of Jerusalem, that the breaches began to be closed, it seemed very evil to them.
brenton_translation: Now it came to pass, when Sanaballat heard that we were building the wall, that it was grievous to him, and he was very angry, and railed against the Jews.

fresh_translation: And they all gathered together to come to array against Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And he said before his brethren (that is the army of the Samaritans) Is it true that these Jews are building their city? do they indeed offer sacrifices? will they prevail? and will they this day restore the stones, after they have been burnt and made a heap of rubbish?

fresh_translation: And we prayed to our God and set guards over them day and night because of them.
brenton_translation: And Tobias the Ammanite came near to him, and said to them, Do they sacrifice or eat in their place? shall not a fox go up and pull down their wall of stones?

fresh_translation: And Judah said, The strength of the enemies was crushed, and the dust is much, and we shall not be able to build on the wall.
brenton_translation: Hear, O our God, for we have become a scorn; and return thou their reproach upon their head, and make them a scorn in a land of captivity,

fresh_translation: And those afflicting us said, They will not know and they will not see until we come into their midst and kill them and stop the work.
brenton_translation: and do not cover their iniquity.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when the Jews dwelling near them came and said to us, They are coming up against us from all the places.
And I stationed in the lowest parts of the place behind the wall, in the sheltered places, and I stationed the people by clans with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
brenton_translation: But it came to pass, when Sanaballat and Tobia, and the Arabians, and the Ammanites, heard that the building of the walls of Jerusalem was advancing, and that the breaches began to be stopped, that it appeared very grievous to them.

fresh_translation: And I looked and rose and said to the nobles and the generals and the rest of the people, Do not fear before them. Remember our God, the great and fearful, and array yourselves for your brothers, your sons and daughters, your wives and your houses.
brenton_translation: And all of them assembled together, to come to fight against Jerusalem, and to destroy it utterly.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when our enemies heard that it had become known to us and God scattered their counsel, we all returned to the wall, each man to his own work.
brenton_translation: So we prayed to our God and set watchmen against them day and night, because of them.

fresh_translation: And it came to be from that day, half of those shaken out were doing the work, and half of them were holding spears and shields and bows and breastplates, and the rulers were behind the whole house of Judah.
brenton_translation: And Juda said, The strength of the enemies is broken, yet there is much rubbish, and we shall not be able to build the wall.

fresh_translation: Those building on the wall and those carrying in the loads, in arms, with one hand each was doing the work and one was holding the dart.
brenton_translation: And they that afflicted us said, They shall not know, and they shall not see, until we come into the midst of them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.

fresh_translation: And the builders, each man girded his sword upon his loins, and they were building, and the one sounding on the horn was beside him.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the Jews who lived near them came, that they said to us, They are coming up against us from every quarter.

fresh_translation: And I said to the nobles and to the rulers and to the rest of the people, The work is wide and much, and we are scattered on the wall, far each man from his brother.
brenton_translation: So I set men in the lowest part of the place behind the wall in the lurking-places, I even set the people according to their families, with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

fresh_translation: In place where you hear the sound of the horn, there you shall gather to us, and our God will fight for us.
brenton_translation: And I looked, and arose, and said to the nobles, and to the captains, and to the rest of the people, Be not afraid of them: remember our great and terrible God, and fight for your brethren, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.

fresh_translation: And we were doing the work, and half of them were holding the spears from the rising of dawn until coming out of the stars.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was made known to us, and God had frustrated their counsel, that we all returned to the wall, every man to his work.

fresh_translation: And at that time I said to the people, Lodge inside Jerusalem, and let the night be a watch for you and the day a work.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass from that day that half of them that had been driven forth, wrought the work, and half of them kept guard; and there were spears, and shields, and bows, and breast-plates, and rulers behind the whole house of Juda,

fresh_translation: And I and men of the watch behind me, not one of us was taking off his clothes.
brenton_translation: even of them that were building the wall:—and those who carried the burdens were under arms: each with one hand wrought his work, and with the other held his dart.

fresh_translation: And cry of the people and of their women was great against their brothers the Jews.
brenton_translation: And the cry of the people and their wives was great against their brethren the Jews.

fresh_translation: And some were saying, In our sons and in our daughters we are many, and we shall get grain and eat and live.
brenton_translation: And some said, We are numerous with our sons and our daughters; so we will take corn, and eat, and live.

fresh_translation: And some were saying, Our fields and our vineyards and our houses we are pledging, and we shall get grain and eat.
brenton_translation: And some said, As to our fields and vineyards and houses, let us pledge them, and we will take corn, and eat.

fresh_translation: And some were saying, We borrowed silver for taxes of the king on our fields and our vineyards and our houses.
brenton_translation: And some said, We have borrowed money for the king's tributes:—our fields, and our vineyards, and houses are pledged.

fresh_translation: And now flesh of our brothers is our flesh, as their sons are our sons, and behold we oppress our sons and our daughters into slavery, and some from our daughters are being oppressed, and there is no power in our hands, and our fields and our vineyards belong to the nobles.
brenton_translation: And now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children are as their children: yet, behold, we are reducing our sons and our daughters to slavery, and some of our daughters are enslaved: and there is no power of our hands, for our fields and our vineyards belong to the nobles.

fresh_translation: And I was very grieved when I heard their cry and these words.
brenton_translation: And I was much grieved as I heard their cry and these words.

fresh_translation: And my heart counseled within me, and I contended with the nobles and the rulers and said to them, Each man demands from his brother? You are demanding. And I set against them a great assembly.
brenton_translation: And my heart took counsel within me, and I contended against the nobles, and the princes, and I said to them, Should every man demand of his brother what ye demand? And I appointed against them a great assembly,

fresh_translation: And I said to them, We bought our brothers the Jews, those sold to the nations, according to our will, and you sell your brothers? And they were silent and found no word.
brenton_translation: and I said to them, We of our free-will have redeemed our brethren the Jews that were sold to the Gentiles; and do ye sell your brethren? and shall they be delivered to us? And they were silent, and found no answer.

fresh_translation: And I said, The thing you are doing is not good. Should you not thus walk in fear of our God, away from reproach of nations our enemies?
brenton_translation: And I said, The thing which ye do is not good; ye will not so walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the Gentiles our enemies.

fresh_translation: And my brothers and my acquaintances and I placed silver and grain among them. Let us leave off this demand.
brenton_translation: Both my brethren, and my acquaintances, and I, have lent them money and corn: let us now leave off this exaction.

fresh_translation: Return to them today their fields, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, and bring out to them from the silver and the grain and the wine and the oil.
brenton_translation: Restore to them, I pray, as at this day, their fields, and their vineyards, and their olive-yards, and their houses, and bring forth to them corn and wine and oil of the money.

fresh_translation: And they said, We will give it back and will not ask from them; thus we will do as you say. And I called the priests and made them swear to do according to this word.
brenton_translation: And they said, We will restore, and we will not exact of them; we will do thus as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and bound them by oath to do according to this word.

fresh_translation: And I shook out my fold and said, Thus may God shake out every man who does not fulfill this word, from his house and from his labor, and thus may he be shaken out and empty. And all the assembly said, Amen, and they praised the Lord, and the people did this word.
brenton_translation: And I shook out my garment, and said, So may God shake out every man who shall not keep to this word, from his house, and from his labours, he shall be even thus shaken out, as an outcast and empty. And all the congregation said, Amen, and they praised the Lord: and the people did this thing.

fresh_translation: From the day when he commanded me to be governor over them in the land of Judah, from twentieth year until thirty-second year of Artaxerxes, twelve years, I and my brothers did not eat their exaction.
brenton_translation: From the day that he charged me to be their ruler in the land of Juda, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Arthasastha, twelve years, I and my brethren ate not provision extorted from them.

fresh_translation: But the first exactions which were before me weighed heavily upon them, and they took from them in breads and in wine, at last forty didrachmas of silver, and those shaken out from them exercised power over the people. But I did not do so because of fear of God.
brenton_translation: But as for the former acts of extortion wherein those who were before me oppressed them, they even took of them their last money, forty didrachms for bread and wine; and the very outcasts of them exercised authority over the people: but I did not so, because of the fear of God.

fresh_translation: And in work of this wall I did not take possession of field, I did not acquire any, and all gathered there were for the work.
brenton_translation: Also in the work of the wall I treated them not with rigor, I bought not land: and all that were gathered together came thither to the work.

fresh_translation: And one hundred fifty Jews men, and those coming to us from the nations around us, were at my table.
brenton_translation: And the Jews, to the number of a hundred and fifty men, besides those coming to us from the nations round about, were at my table.

fresh_translation: And what was made for one day was one calf, and six choice sheep, and a goat were made for me, and every ten days wine in abundance for all. Yet with these I did not seek bread of exaction, because service was heavy upon this people.
brenton_translation: And there came to me for one day one calf, and I had six choice sheep and a goat; and every ten days wine in abundance of all sorts: yet with these I required not the bread of extortion, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

fresh_translation: Remember me, O God, for good, all that I did for this people.
brenton_translation: Remember me, O God, for good, in all that I have done to this people.

fresh_translation: And it came to be as Sanballat and Tobiah and Geshem the Arab and the rest of our enemies heard that I had built the wall and no breach was left in it, though until that time I had not set doors in the gates,
brenton_translation: Now it came to pass, when Sanaballat, and Tobias, and Gesam the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had built the wall, and that there was no opening left therein; (but hitherto I had not set up the doors on the gates;)

fresh_translation: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me saying, Come, let us gather together in the villages in the plain of Ono. But they were reckoning to do evil to me.
brenton_translation: that Sanaballat and Gesam sent to me, saying, Come and let us meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono. But they were plotting to do me mischief.

fresh_translation: And I sent messengers to them saying, Great work I do, and I will not be able to come down, lest the work stop. As soon as I complete it, I will come down to you.
brenton_translation: So I sent messengers to them, saying, I am doing a great work, and I shall not be able to come down, lest the work should cease: as soon as I shall have finished it, I will come down to you.

fresh_translation: And they sent to me according to this word four times, and I sent them according to these things.
brenton_translation: And they sent to me again to this effect; and I sent them word accordingly.

fresh_translation: And Sanballat sent to me his servant and an open letter in his hand.
brenton_translation: Then Sanaballat sent his servant to me with an open letter in his hand.

fresh_translation: And written in it was, Among nations it was heard that you and the Jews are reckoning to rebel; because of this you build the wall and you will become king to them.
brenton_translation: And in it was written, It has been reported among the Gentiles that thou and the Jews are planning to revolt: therefore thou art building the wall, and thou wilt be a king to them.

fresh_translation: And besides these things, you appointed prophets for yourself so that you might sit in Jerusalem as king in Judah, and now these words will be reported to the king. So now come, let us take counsel together.
brenton_translation: And moreover thou has appointed prophets to thyself, that thou mightest dwell in Jerusalem as a king over Juda: and now these words will be reported to the king. Now then, come, let us take counsel together.

fresh_translation: And I sent to him saying, These words which you say did not happen, because from your own heart you invent them.
brenton_translation: And I sent to him, saying, It has not happened according to these words, even as thou sayest, for thou framest them falsely out of thy heart.

fresh_translation: For all are frightening us, saying, Their hands will be loosened from this work, and it will not be done. And now I strengthened my hands.
brenton_translation: For all were trying to alarm us, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from this work, and it shall not be done. Now therefore I have strengthened my hands.

fresh_translation: And I entered the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah son of Meehtabel, and he, being confined, said, Let us gather in the house of God, in its midst, and let us shut its doors, because they are coming by night to kill you.
brenton_translation: And I came into the house of Semei the son of Dalaia the Son of Metabeel, and he was shut up; and he said, Let us assemble together in the house of God, in the midst of it, and let us shut the doors of it; for they are coming by night to slay thee.

fresh_translation: And I said, What kind of man will go into the house and live?
brenton_translation: And I said, Who is the man that shall enter into the house, that he may live?

fresh_translation: And I recognized, and behold, God had not sent him, but he spoke the prophecy-word against me, and Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
brenton_translation: And I observed, and, behold, God had not sent him, for the prophecy was a fable devised against me:

fresh_translation: They hired him against me so that I might fear and do thus and sin and become to them for an evil name, so that they might reproach me.
brenton_translation: and Tobias and Sanaballat had hired against me a multitude, that I might be frightened, and do this, and sin, and become to them an ill name, that they might reproach me.

fresh_translation: Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these deeds of his, and Noadiah the prophet and the rest of the prophets who were frightening me.
brenton_translation: Remember, O God, Tobias and Sanaballat, according to these their deeds, and the prophetess Noadia, and the rest of the prophets who tried to alarm me.

fresh_translation: And the wall was completed on twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days.
brenton_translation: So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty-two days.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when all our enemies heard and all nations around us feared, fear fell very greatly in their eyes, and they knew that this work came to completion from our God.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when all our enemies heard of it, that all the nations round about us feared, and great alarm fell upon them, and they knew that it was of our God that this work should be finished.

fresh_translation: And in those days letters from many nobles of Judah were going to Tobiah, and those of Tobiah were coming to them.
brenton_translation: And in those days letters came to Tobias from many nobles of Juda, and those of Tobias came to them.

fresh_translation: For many in Judah were under oath to him, because he was son-in-law of Shecaniah son of Arah, and Johanan his son had taken daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah as wife.
brenton_translation: For many in Juda were bound to him by oath, because he was son-in-law of Sechenias the son of Herae; and Jonan his son had taken the daughter of Mesulam the son of Barachia to wife.

fresh_translation: And they were speaking his words to me, and they were carrying my words out to him, and Tobiah sent letters to frighten me.
brenton_translation: And they reported his words to me, and carried out my words to him: and Tobias sent letters to terrify me.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when the wall was built, and I set up the doors, that the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

fresh_translation: And I commanded Hanani my brother and Hananiah ruler of the citadel in Jerusalem, because he was as a truthful man and fearing God beyond many,
brenton_translation: that I gave charge to Ananias my brother, and Ananias the ruler of the palace, over Jerusalem: for he was a true man, and one that feared God beyond many.

fresh_translation: and I said to them, The gates of Jerusalem shall not be opened until the sun is hot, and while they are still keeping watch let the doors be shut and barred. And station guards from the inhabitants of Jerusalem, each man in his watch and each man opposite his own house.
brenton_translation: And I said to them, The gates of Jerusalem shall not be opened till sunrise; and while they are still watching, let the doors be shut, and bolted; and set watches of them that dwell in Jerusalem, every man at his post, and every man over against his house.

fresh_translation: And the city was wide and great, but the people in it were few, and no houses had been built.
brenton_translation: Now the city was wide and large; and the people were few in it, and the houses were not built.

fresh_translation: And God gave into my heart, and I gathered the nobles and the rulers and the people for enrollment, and I found book of enrollment of those who came up at first, and I found written in it:
brenton_translation: And God put it into my heart, and I gathered the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, into companies: and I found a register of the company that came up first, and I found written in it as follows:

fresh_translation: And these are sons of the province, those who came up from the captivity of the exile whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon exiled, and they returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, each man to his own city,
brenton_translation: Now these are the children of the country, that came up from captivity, of the number which Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon carried away, and they returned to Jerusalem and to Juda, every man to his city;

fresh_translation: with Zerubbabel and Jeshua and Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baana. Men of the people of Israel:
brenton_translation: with Zorobabel, and Jesus, and Neemia, Azaria, and Reelma, Naemani, Mardochaeus, Balsan, Maspharath, Esdra, Boguia, Inaum, Baana, Masphar, men of the people of Israel.
