brenton_translation: All the Nathinim, and children of the servants of Solomon, were three hundred and ninety-two.

fresh_translation: And these came up from Telmelah, Harsha, Cherub, Heron, and Immer, and they were not able to declare their father-houses and their seed, whether they were from Israel:
brenton_translation: And these went up from Thelmeleth, Thelaresa, Charub, Eron, Jemer: but they could not declare the houses of their families, or their seed, whether they were of Israel.

fresh_translation: sons of Delaiah, sons of Tobiah, sons of Nekoda: 642.
brenton_translation: The children of Dalaia, the children of Tobia, the children of Necoda, six hundred and forty-two.

fresh_translation: And from the priests: sons of Habaiah, sons of Koz, sons of Barzillai, because he took wives from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name.
brenton_translation: And of the priests; the children of Ebia, the children of Acos, the children of Berzelli, for they took wives of the daughters of Berzelli the Galaadite, and they were called by their name.

fresh_translation: These sought their writing of enrollment and it was not found, and they were excluded from the priesthood.
brenton_translation: These sought the pedigree of their company, and it was not found, and they were removed as polluted from the priesthood.

fresh_translation: And the Tirshatha said that they should not eat from the holy of holies until the priest might arise giving light.
brenton_translation: And the Athersastha said, that they should not eat of the most holy things, until a priest should stand up to give light.

fresh_translation: And all the assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
brenton_translation: And all the congregation was about forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty,

fresh_translation: besides their male slaves and female slaves, these being seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven, and singers and singing women, two hundred forty-five.
brenton_translation: besides their men-servants and their maid-servants: these were seven thousand three hundred and thirty seven: and the singing-men and singing-women, two hundred and forty-five.

fresh_translation: Horses: 736. Mules: 245.
Camels: 435. Donkeys: 6,720.
brenton_translation: Two thousand seven hundred asses.

fresh_translation: And from part of chiefs of father-houses they gave to the work. To Nehemiah, for the treasury: one thousand gold pieces, fifty bowls, and thirty priestly tunics.
brenton_translation: And part of the heads of families gave into the treasury to Neemias for the work a thousand pieces of gold, fifty bowls, and thirty priests' garments.

fresh_translation: And from the chiefs of father-houses they gave to treasury of the work twenty thousand gold pieces and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.
brenton_translation: And some of the heads of families gave into the treasuries of the work, twenty thousand pieces of gold, and two thousand three hundred pounds of silver.

fresh_translation: And the rest of the people gave twenty thousand gold pieces and two thousand two hundred minas of silver and sixty-seven priestly tunics.
brenton_translation: And the rest of the people gave twenty thousand pieces of gold, and two thousand two hundred pounds of silver, and sixty-seven priests' garments.

fresh_translation: And the priests and the Levites and the gatekeepers and the singers and some from the people and the nethinim and all Israel settled in their cities. And the seventh month arrived, and sons of Israel were in their cities.
brenton_translation: And the priests, and Levites, and porters, and singers, and some of the people, and the Nathinim, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities.

fresh_translation: And all the people were gathered as one man into the broad place before Water Gate, and they told Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses which the Lord commanded to Israel.
brenton_translation: And the seventh month arrived, and the children of Israel were settled in their cities; and all the people were gathered as one man to the broad place before the water-gate, and they told Esdras the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the Lord commanded Israel.

fresh_translation: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, from man to woman, and everyone who could understand what they heard, on the first day of the seventh month.
brenton_translation: So Esdras the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and every one who had understanding was present to hearken, on the first day of the seventh month.

fresh_translation: And he read in it from the hour when the sun was giving light until middle of the day, before the men and the women, and they were understanding, and ears of all the people were toward the book of the law.
brenton_translation: And he read in it from the time of sun-rise to the middle of the day, before the men and the women; and they understood it, and the ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.

fresh_translation: And Ezra the scribe stood on a wooden platform, and standing beside him on his right were Mattathias and Shemaiah and Ananias and Urijah and Hilkiah and Maaseiah, and on his left Pedaiah and Mishael and Malchiah and Osam and Asabdana and Zechariah and Meshullam.
brenton_translation: And Esdras the scribe stood on a wooden stage, and there stood next to him Mattathias, and Samaeas, and Ananias, and Urias, and Chelcia, and Massia, on his right hand; and on his left Phadaeas, and Misael, and Melchias, and Asom, and Asabadma, and Zacharias, and Mesollam.

fresh_translation: And Ezra opened the book before all the people, because he was above all the people, and it came to be when he opened it all the people stood.
brenton_translation: And Esdras opened the book before all the people, for he was above the people; and it came to pass when he had opened it, that all the people stood.

fresh_translation: And Ezra blessed the Lord, the great God, and all the people answered and said, Amen, lifting up their hands. And they bowed and worshiped the Lord with face to the ground.
brenton_translation: And Esdras blessed the Lord, the great God: and all the people answered, and said, Amen, lifting up their hands: and they bowed down and worshipped the Lord with their face to the ground.

fresh_translation: And Jeshua and Benaiah and Sherebiah were causing the people to understand the law, and the people stood in their place.
brenton_translation: And Jesus and Banaias and Sarabias instructed the people in the law, and the people stood in their place.

fresh_translation: And they read in the book of the law of God, and Ezra was teaching and distinguishing it by knowledge of the Lord, and the people understood in the reading.
brenton_translation: And they read in the book of the law of God, and Esdras taught, and instructed them distinctly in the knowledge of the Lord, and the people understood the law in the reading.

fresh_translation: And Nehemiah and Ezra the priest and scribe and the Levites teaching the people said to all the people, This day is holy to the Lord our God. Do not mourn and do not weep. For all the people were weeping as they heard the words of the law.
brenton_translation: And Neemias, and Esdras the priest and scribe, and the Levites, and they that instructed the people, spoke and said to all the people, It is a holy day to the Lord our God; do not mourn, nor weep. For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Go, eat fat things and drink sweet things and send portions to those having nothing, because the day is holy to our Lord, and do not fall away, because he is your strength.
brenton_translation: And the governor said to them, Go, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions to them that have nothing; for the day is holy to our Lord: and faint not, for the Lord is our strength.

fresh_translation: And the Levites were silencing all the people, saying, Be silent, because the day is holy, and do not fall away.
brenton_translation: And the Levites caused all the people to be silent, saying, Be silent, for it is a holy day, and despond not.

fresh_translation: And all the people went away to eat and drink and send portions and make great rejoicing, because they understood in the words which he made known to them.
brenton_translation: So all the people departed to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, for they understood the words which he made known to them.

fresh_translation: And on the second day chiefs of the fathers of all the people, the priests and the Levites, were gathered to Ezra the scribe, to gain insight into all the words of the law.
brenton_translation: And on the second day the heads of families assembled with all the people, also the priests and Levites, to Esdras the scribe, to attend to all the words of the law.

fresh_translation: And they found written in the law which the Lord commanded by Moses that sons of Israel should dwell in booths during the feast in the seventh month,
brenton_translation: And they found written in the law which the Lord commanded Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths, in the feast in the seventh month:

fresh_translation: and that they should sound with trumpets in all their cities and in Jerusalem. And Ezra said, Go out to the mountain and bring leaves of olive and leaves of cypress woods and leaves of myrtle and leaves of palms and leaves of thick wood, to make booths according to what is written.
brenton_translation: and that they should sound with trumpets in all their cities, and in Jerusalem. And Esdras said, Go forth to the mountain, and bring branches of olive, and branches of cypress trees, and branches of myrtle, and branches of palm trees, and branches of every thick tree, to make booths, according to that which was written.

fresh_translation: And the people went out and brought them and made booths for themselves, each on his roof and in their courts and in the courts of the house of God and in the broad places of the city, even to Gate of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And the people went forth, and brought them, and made booths for themselves, each one upon his roof, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the streets of the city, and as far as the gate of Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And all the assembly, those returned from captivity, made booths and sat in booths, for the sons of Israel had not done thus from the days of Jeshua son of Nun until that day. And there was very great rejoicing.
brenton_translation: And all the congregation who had returned from the captivity, made booths, and dwelt in booths: for the children of Israel had not done so from the days of Jesus the son of Naue until that day: and there was great joy.

fresh_translation: And he read in the book of the law of God day by day, from the first day until the last day, and they kept feast seven days, and on the eighth day an assembly according to ordinance.
brenton_translation: And Esdras read in the book of the law of God daily, from the first day even to the last day: and they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

fresh_translation: And on the twenty-fourth day of this month sons of Israel were gathered in fasting and in sackcloth.
brenton_translation: Now on the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel assembled with fasting, and in sackcloths, and with ashes on their head.

fresh_translation: And sons of Israel were separated from every foreign son and stood and confessed their sins and lawless deeds of their fathers.
brenton_translation: And the children of Israel separated themselves from every stranger, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And they stood at their standing place and read in the book of the law of the Lord their God, and they were confessing to the Lord and worshiping the Lord their God.
brenton_translation: And they stood in their place, and read in the book of the law of the Lord their god: and they confessed their sins to the Lord, and worshipped the Lord their God.

fresh_translation: And on the platform of the Levites stood Jeshua and sons of Kadmiel, Sachania son of Sherebiah, sons of Chenani, and they cried with a loud voice to the Lord their God.
brenton_translation: And there stood upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jesus, and the sons of Cadmiel, Sechenia the son of Sarabia, sons of Choneni; and they cried with a loud voice to the Lord their God.

fresh_translation: And the Levites, Jeshua and Kadmiel, said, Rise, bless the Lord your God from age to age, and they will bless the name of your glory and will exalt it above every blessing and praise.
brenton_translation: And the Levites, Jesus and Cadmiel, said, Rise up, bless the Lord our God forever and ever: and let them bless thy glorious name, and exalt it with all blessing and praise.

fresh_translation: And Ezra said, You are the one, Lord alone. You made heaven and heaven of heaven and all their array, the earth and all things in it, the seas and all things in them, and you give life to all, and armies of heaven worship you.
brenton_translation: And Esdras said, Thou art the only true Lord; thou madest the heaven, and the heaven of heavens, and all their array, the earth, and all things that are in it, the seas, and all things in them; and thou quickenest all things, and the hosts of heaven worship thee.

fresh_translation: You are the Lord God. You chose Abram and brought him out from the land of the Chaldeans and placed on him the name Abraham.
brenton_translation: Thou art the Lord God, thou didst choose Abram, and broughtest him out of the land of the Chaldeans, and gavest him the name of Abraam:

fresh_translation: And you found his heart faithful before you and made covenant with him, to give to him land of the Canaanites and Hittites and Amorites and Perizzites and Jebusites and Girgashites, and to his seed, and you established your words, because you are righteous.
brenton_translation: and thou foundest his heart faithful before thee, and didst make a covenant with him to give to him and to his seed the land of the Chananites, and the Chettites, and Amorites, and Pherezites, and Jebusites, and Gergesites; and thou hast confirmed thy words, for thou art righteous.

fresh_translation: And you saw humiliation of our fathers in Egypt, and their cry you heard at Red Sea.
brenton_translation: And thou sawest the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and thou heardest their cry at the Red Sea.

fresh_translation: And you gave signs in Egypt against Pharaoh and all his servants and all the people of his land, because you knew that they acted proudly against them, and you made a name for yourself as this day.
brenton_translation: And thou shewedst signs and wonders in Egypt, on Pharao and all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knowest that they behaved insolently against them: and thou madest thyself a name, as at this day.

fresh_translation: And you split the sea before them, and they passed through the middle of the sea on dry land, and their pursuers you threw into the deep like a stone in mighty water.
brenton_translation: And thou didst cleave the sea before them, and they passed through the midst of the sea on dry land; and thou didst cast into the deep them that were about to pursue them, as a stone in the mighty water.

fresh_translation: And in the pillar of cloud you guided them by day, and in the pillar of fire by night, to enlighten for them the road in which they would go.
brenton_translation: And thou guidedst them by day by a pillar of cloud, and by night by a pillar of fire, to enlighten for them the way wherein they should walk.

fresh_translation: And upon Mount Sinai you came down and spoke to them from heaven and gave them straight judgments and laws of truth, good ordinances and commandments.
brenton_translation: Also thou camest down upon mount Sina, and thou spakest to them out of heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and laws of truth, ordinances, and good commandments.

fresh_translation: And your holy Sabbath you made known to them, and by the hand of Moses your servant you commanded to them commandments and ordinances and law.
brenton_translation: And thou didst make known to them thy holy sabbath; thou didst enjoin upon them commandments, and ordinances, and a law, by the hand of thy servant Moses.

fresh_translation: And bread from heaven you gave to them for their hunger, and water from a rock you brought out for them for their thirst, and you told them to enter to inherit the land over which you stretched out your hand to give to them.
brenton_translation: And thou gavest them bread from heaven for their food, and thou broughtest them forth water from a rock for their thirst; and thou badest them go in to inherit the land over which thou stretchedst out thy hand to give it them.

fresh_translation: But they and our fathers acted proudly and hardened their neck and did not hear your commandments.
brenton_translation: But they and our fathers behaved proudly, and hardened their neck, and did not hearken to thy commandments,

fresh_translation: And they refused to hear and did not remember your wonders which you did with them, and they hardened their neck and gave a chief to return into their slavery in Egypt. But you are a God merciful and compassionate, long-suffering and abundant in mercy, and you did not forsake them.
brenton_translation: and refused to listen, and remembered not thy wonders which thou wroughtest with them; and they hardened their neck, and appointed a leader to return to their slavery in Egypt: but thou, O God, art merciful and compassionate, long-suffering, and abundant in mercy, and thou didst not forsake them.

fresh_translation: Even when they made for themselves a molten calf and said, These are your gods who brought us up from Egypt, and committed great provocations,
brenton_translation: And still farther they even made to themselves a molten calf, and said, These are the gods that brought us up out of Egypt: and they wrought great provocations.

fresh_translation: you, in your many compassions, did not forsake them in the wilderness. Pillar of cloud did not turn away from them by day to guide them in the road, nor pillar of fire by night to enlighten them the road in which they would go.
brenton_translation: Yet thou in thy great compassions didst not forsake them in the wilderness: thou didst not turn away from them the pillar of the cloud by day, to guide them in the way, nor the pillar of fire by night, to enlighten for them the way wherein they should walk.

fresh_translation: And your good Spirit you gave to instruct them, and your manna you did not withhold from their mouth, and water you gave to them for their thirst.
brenton_translation: And thou gavest thy good Spirit to instruct them, and thou didst not withhold thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water in their thirst.

fresh_translation: And forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They did not lack. Their garments did not grow old, and their feet did not split.
brenton_translation: And thou didst sustain them forty years in the wilderness; thou didst not allow anything to fail them: their garments did not wax old, and their feet were not bruised.

fresh_translation: And you gave to them kingdoms and peoples and divided them out to them, and they inherited land of Sihon king of Heshbon and land of Og king of Bashan.
brenton_translation: Moreover, thou gavest them kingdoms, and didst divide nations to them: and they inherited the land of Seon king of Esebon, and the land of Og king of Basan.

fresh_translation: And their sons you multiplied like stars of heaven, and you brought them into the land which you told their fathers, and they inherited it.
brenton_translation: And thou didst multiply their children as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land of which thou spokest to their fathers;

fresh_translation: And you subdued before them inhabitants of the land of the Canaanites and gave them into their hands, both their kings and the peoples of the land, to do to them as was pleasing before them.
brenton_translation: And they inherited it: and thou didst destroy from before them the dwellers in the land of the Chananites, and thou gavest into their hands them and their kings, and the nations of the land, to do unto them as it pleased them.

fresh_translation: And they seized lofty cities and inherited houses full of every good thing, hewn cisterns, vineyards and oliveyards and every edible tree in abundance. And they ate and were filled and grew fat and luxuriated in your great goodness.
brenton_translation: And they took lofty cities, and inherited houses full of all good things, wells dug, vineyards, and oliveyards, and every fruit tree in abundance: so they ate, and were filled, and grew fat, and rioted in thy great goodness.

fresh_translation: And they changed and turned away from you and cast your law behind their body, and your prophets they killed, the ones who testified among them to turn them back to you, and they committed great provocations.
brenton_translation: But they turned, and revolted from thee, and cast thy law behind their backs; and they slew thy prophets, who testified against them to turn them back to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

fresh_translation: And you gave them into the hand of those afflicting them, and they afflicted them, and they cried out to you in the time of their affliction, and you from heaven heard, and in your great compassions gave them saviors, and they saved them from the hand of those afflicting them.
brenton_translation: Then thou gavest them into the hand of them that afflicted them, and they did afflict them: and they cried to thee in the time of their affliction, and thou didst hear them from thy heaven, and in thy great compassions gavest them deliverers, and didst save them from the hand of them that afflicted them.

fresh_translation: And when they rested, they turned again to do evil before you, and you forsook them into the hands of their enemies, and they ruled over them. And they cried out to you again, and you from heaven heard and rescued them in your many compassions.
brenton_translation: But when they rested, they did evil again before thee: so thou leftest them in the hands of their enemies, and they ruled over them: and they cried again to thee, and thou heardest them from heaven, and didst deliver them in thy great compassions.

fresh_translation: And you testified to them to turn them back to your law, but they did not hear. Instead, in your commandments and in your judgments they sinned, which if a man does he will live in them. And they gave a stubborn back and hardened their neck and did not hear.
brenton_translation: And thou didst testify against them, to bring them back to thy law: but they hearkened not, but sinned against thy commandments and thy judgments, which if a man do, he shall live in them; and they turned their back, and hardened their neck, and heard not.

fresh_translation: And you drew over them many years and testified to them by your Spirit in the hand of your prophets, and they gave no ear, and you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the land.
brenton_translation: Yet thou didst bear long with them many years, and didst testify to them by thy Spirit by the hand of thy prophets: but they hearkened not; so thou gavest them into the hand of the nations of the land.

fresh_translation: But you, in your many compassions, did not make an end of them and did not forsake them, because strong and merciful and compassionate you are.
brenton_translation: But thou in thy many mercies didst not appoint them to destruction, and didst not forsake them; for thou art strong, and merciful, and pitiful.

fresh_translation: And now, our God, strong, great, mighty, and fearful, keeping your covenant and your mercy, let not all the toil grow little before you, which found us and our kings and our rulers and our priests and our prophets and our fathers and all your people, from the days of kings of Asshur until this day.
brenton_translation: And now, O our God, the powerful, the great, the mighty, and the terrible, keeping thy covenant and thy mercy, let not all the trouble seem little in thy sight which has come upon us, and our kings, and our princes, and our priests, and our prophets, and our fathers, and upon all thy people, from the days of the kings of Assur even to this day.

fresh_translation: And you are righteous over all things coming upon us, because you did truth, and we sinned.
brenton_translation: But thou art righteous in all the things that come upon us; for thou hast wrought faithfully, but we have greatly sinned.

fresh_translation: And our kings and our rulers and our priests and our fathers did not do your law and did not pay attention to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified to them.
brenton_translation: And our kings, and our princes, and our priests, and our fathers, have not performed thy law, and have not given heed to thy commandments, and have not kept thy testimonies which thou didst testify to them.

fresh_translation: And they in your kingdom and in your great goodness which you gave to them, and in the broad and fat land which you gave before them, did not serve you and did not turn from their evil practices.
brenton_translation: And they did not serve thee in thy kingdom, and in thy great goodness which thou gavest to them, and in the large and fat land which thou didst furnish before them, and they turned not from their evil devices.

fresh_translation: Behold, we are slaves today, and the land which you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit,
brenton_translation: Behold, we are servants this day, and as for the land which thou gavest to our fathers to eat the fruit of it and the good things of it, behold, we are servants upon it:

fresh_translation: belongs to kings whom you set over us because of our sins, and over our bodies they rule, and over our cattle as is pleasing to them, and we are in great affliction.
brenton_translation: and its produce is abundant for the kings whom thou didst appoint over us because of our sins; and they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, as it pleases them, and we are in great affliction.

brenton_translation: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nathinim, and every one who drew off from the nations of the land to the law of God, their wives, their sons, their daughters, every one who had knowledge and understanding,

fresh_translation: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the nethinim, and everyone joining from the peoples of the land to the law of God, their wives, their sons, their daughters, everyone knowing and understanding,
brenton_translation: were urgent with their brethren, and bound them under a curse, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in the law of God, which was given by the hand of Moses, the servant of God; to keep and to do all the commandments of the Lord, and his judgments, and his ordinances;

fresh_translation: were strengthening themselves upon their brothers, and cursed themselves and entered into a curse and into an oath, to walk in the law of God which was given by the hand of Moses servant of God, and to keep and do all commandments of the Lord our God and his judgments,
brenton_translation: and that we will not, they said,give our daughters to the people of the land, nor will we take their daughters to our sons.

fresh_translation: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land and would not take their daughters for our sons,
brenton_translation: And as for the people of the land who bring wares and all manner of merchandise to sell on the sabbath-day, we will not buy of them on the sabbath or on the holy day: and we will leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

fresh_translation: and that from the peoples of the land bringing wares and every merchandise on Sabbath day to sell, we would not buy from them on Sabbath and on holy day, and we would leave the seventh year and demand of every hand.
brenton_translation: And we will impose ordinances upon ourselves, to levy on ourselves the third part of a didrachm yearly for the service of the house of our God;

fresh_translation: And we will set commandments upon ourselves, to give upon ourselves a third of a didrachma yearly for the service of the house of our God,
brenton_translation: the shewbread, and the continual meat-offering, and for the continual whole-burnt-offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moon, for the feast, and for the holy things, and the sin-offerings, to make atonement for Israel, and for the works of the house of our God.

fresh_translation: for the bread of the presence and sacrifice of the continual offering and for the continual whole burnt offering of the Sabbaths, of the new moons, for the feasts and for the holy things and for the sin offerings to make atonement concerning Israel, and for the works of the house of our God.
brenton_translation: And we cast lots for the office of wood-bearing, we the priests, and the Levites, and the people, to bring wood into the house of our God, according to the house of our families, at certain set times, year by year, to burn on the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the law:

fresh_translation: And we cast lots concerning lot of wood-bearing, the priests and the Levites and the people, to bring into the house of our God, to the house of our fathers, at appointed times from years, year by year, to burn on the altar of the Lord our God as written in the law,
brenton_translation: and to bring the first-fruits of our land, and the first-fruits of the fruit of every tree, year by year, into the house of the Lord:

fresh_translation: and to bring firstfruits of our land and firstfruits of fruit of every tree, year by year, into the house of the Lord,
brenton_translation: the first-born of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the first-born of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, for the priests that minister in the house of our God.

fresh_translation: and the firstborn of our sons and our cattle as written in the law, and firstborn of our cattle and our flocks, to bring into the house of our God, to the priests ministering in the house of our God,
brenton_translation: And the first-fruits of our corn, and the fruit of every tree, of wine, and of oil, will we bring to the priests to the treasury of the house of God; and a tithe of our land to the Levites: for the Levites themselves shall receive tithes in all the cities of the land we cultivate.

fresh_translation: and the firstfruit of our grains and fruit of every tree, wine and oil, we will bring to the priests into the treasury-room of the house of God, and tithe of our land to the Levites, and they, the Levites, are tithing in all cities of our service.
brenton_translation: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites in the tithe of the Levite: and the Levites shall bring up the tenth part of their tithe to the house of our God, into the treasuries of the house of God.

fresh_translation: And priest son of Aaron shall be with the Levite in tithe of the Levite, and the Levites shall bring up tithe of the tithe into the house of our God, into the treasury-rooms, into the house of God.
brenton_translation: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring into the treasuries the first-fruits of the corn, and wine, and oil; and there are the holy vessels, and the priests, and the ministers, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.

fresh_translation: For into the treasuries sons of Israel and sons of Levi will bring the firstfruits of the grain and the wine and the oil, and there are the holy vessels and the ministering priests and the gatekeepers and the singers, and we will not forsake house of our God.
And the rulers of the people settled in Jerusalem, and the rest of the people cast lots to bring one of ten to settle in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the cities.
brenton_translation: And the chiefs of the people dwelt in Jerusalem: and the rest of the people cast lots, to bring one of every ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.

fresh_translation: And the people blessed all the men freely choosing to settle in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And the people blessed all the men that volunteered to dwell in Jerusalem.

brenton_translation: Now these are the chiefs of the province who dwelt in Jerusalem, and in the cities of Juda; every man dwelt in his possession in their cities: Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nathinim, and the children of the servants of Solomon.

fresh_translation: Sons of Levi, heads of fathers, were written in the book of words of the days until days of Johanan son of Eliashib.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Levi, heads of families, were written in the book of the chronicles, even to the days of Joanan son of Elisue.

fresh_translation: And leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah and Sherebiah and Jeshua and sons of Kadmiel, and their brothers opposite them, to hymn and praise by the command of David man of God, course by course.
brenton_translation: And the heads of the Levites were Asabia, and Sarabia, and Jesu: and the sons of Cadmiel, and their brethren over against them, were to sing hymns of praise, according to the commandment of David the man of God, course by course.

fresh_translation: When I was gathering the gatekeepers.
brenton_translation: When I gathered the porters,

fresh_translation: In the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah and Ezra the priest, the scribe.
brenton_translation: it was in the days of Joakim son of Jesus, son of Josedec, and in the days of Neemia: and Esdras the priest was scribe.

fresh_translation: And at the dedication of wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites in their places, to bring them into Jerusalem to make dedication and rejoicing, in thanksgiving and in songs, with cymbals and stringed instruments and lyres.
brenton_translation: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites in their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep a feast of dedication and gladness with thanksgiving, and they sounded cymbals with songs, and had psalteries and harps.

fresh_translation: And the sons of the singers were gathered both from the district round about into Jerusalem and from the farmsteads,
brenton_translation: And the sons of the singers were assembled both from the neighbourhood round about to Jerusalem, and from the villages,

fresh_translation: and from the fields, because the singers built farmsteads for themselves in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: and from the country: for the singers built themselves villages by Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and they purified the people and the gatekeepers and the wall.
brenton_translation: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and they purified the people, and the porters, and the wall.

fresh_translation: And I brought up rulers of Judah upon the wall and set two great thanksgiving choirs, and they went to the right upon the wall by the Dung Gate.
brenton_translation: And they brought up the princes of Juda on the wall, and they appointed two great companies for thanksgiving, and they passed on the right hand on the wall of the dung-gate.

fresh_translation: And after them went Hoshaiah and half of rulers of Judah,
brenton_translation: And after them went Osaia, and half the princes of Juda,

fresh_translation: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
brenton_translation: and Azarias, and Esdras, and Mesollam,

fresh_translation: Judah and Benjamin and Shemaiah and Jeremiah,
brenton_translation: and Juda, and Benjamin, and Samaias and Jeremia.

fresh_translation: and from the sons of the priests with trumpets, Zechariah son of Jonathan, son of Shemaiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Micah, son of Zaccur, son of Asaph,
brenton_translation: And some of the sons of the priest with trumpets, Zacharias son of Jonathan, son of Samaias, son of Matthania, son of Michaia, son of Zacchur, son of Asaph:

fresh_translation: and his brothers, Shemaiah and Uzziel, praising in songs of David man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them,
brenton_translation: and his brethren, Samaia, and Oziel, Gelol, Jama, Aia, Nathanael, and Juda, Anani, to praise with the hymns of David the man of God; and Esdras the scribe was before them,

fresh_translation: at Gate of Ain opposite them. They went up on steps of the city of David, on the ascent of the wall above the house of David and as far as Water Gate eastward.
brenton_translation: at the gate, to praise before them, and they went up by the steps of the city of David, in the ascent of the wall, above the house of David, even to the water-gate

fresh_translation: And the second thanksgiving choir was going to meet them, and I after it, and half of the people upon the wall above Tower of Ovens and as far as Broad Wall,
and above the Gate of Ephraim and to the Old Gate and to Fish Gate and Tower of Hananeel and as far as Sheep Gate, and they stood in Gate of the Guard.
brenton_translation: of Ephraim, and to the fish-gate, and by the tower of Anameel, and as far as the sheep-gate.

fresh_translation: And the two choirs stood in the house of God, and I and half of the generals with me,
and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Benjamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, Ananias, with trumpets,
and Maaseiah and Shemaiah and Eleazar and Uzzi and Jehohanan and Malchiah and Elam and Ezour. And the singers were heard, and they were appointed.
brenton_translation: And the singers were heard, and were numbered.

fresh_translation: And they sacrificed on that day great sacrifices and rejoiced, because God gladdened them greatly, and their wives and their children rejoiced, and rejoicing in Jerusalem was heard from far away.
brenton_translation: And in that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced; for God had made them very joyful: and their wives and their children rejoiced: and the joy in Jerusalem was heard from afar off.

fresh_translation: And on that day men were appointed over the treasury-rooms, for the treasures, the firstfruits, the tithes, and the things gathered in them by rulers of the cities, portions for the priests and for the Levites, because rejoicing was in Judah over the priests and over the Levites who stood.
brenton_translation: And in that day they appointed men over the treasuries, for the treasures, the first-fruits, and the tithes, and for the chiefs of the cities who were assembled among them, to furnish portions for the priests and Levites: for there was joy in Juda over the priests and over the Levites that waited.

fresh_translation: And they kept charges of their God and charges of the purification and the singers and the gatekeepers, as commands of David and Solomon his son.
brenton_translation: And they kept the charges of their God, and the charges of the purification, and ordered the singers and the porters, according to the commandments of David and his son Solomon.

fresh_translation: For in the days of David, Asaph from the beginning was the chief of the singers, and there was hymn and praise to God.
brenton_translation: For in the days of David Asaph was originally first of the singers, and they sang hymns and praise to God.

fresh_translation: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel were giving portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, matter of each day on its day, and sanctifying for the Levites, and the Levites sanctifying for the sons of Aaron.
brenton_translation: And all Israel in the days of Zorobabel, and in the days of Neemias, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, a daily rate: and consecrated them to the Levites: and the Levites consecrated them to the sons of Aaron.

fresh_translation: On that day it was read in the book of Moses in the ears of the people, and it was found written in it that Ammonites and Moabites should not enter into assembly of God forever,
brenton_translation: In that day they read in the book of Moses in the ears of the people; and it was found written in it, that the Ammonites and Moabites should not enter into the congregation of God for ever;

fresh_translation: because they did not meet sons of Israel with bread and water, and they hired Balaam against him to curse him, and our God turned the curse into blessing.
brenton_translation: because they met not the children of Israel with bread and water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them: but our God turned the curse into a blessing.

fresh_translation: And it came to be when they heard the law, they separated every mixed group in Israel.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when they heard the law, that they were separated, even every alien in Israel.

fresh_translation: And before this, Eliashib the priest was dwelling in treasury-room of the house of our God, being near to Tobiah,
brenton_translation: And before this time Eliasib the priest dwelt in the treasury of the house of our God, connected with Tobias;

fresh_translation: and he made for him a great treasury-room, and there they formerly gave the manna and the frankincense and the vessels and the tithe of grain and wine and oil, the command for the Levites and the singers and the gatekeepers, and firstfruits of the priests.
brenton_translation: and he made himself a great treasury, and there they were formerly in the habit of bestowing the offerings, and the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithe of the corn, and the wine, and the oil, the ordered portion of the Levites, and singers, and porters; and the first-fruits of the priests.

fresh_translation: And in all this I was not in Jerusalem, because in thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I came to the king, and after the end of days I asked leave from the king.
brenton_translation: But in all this time I was not in Jerusalem; for in the thirty-second year of Arthasastha king of Babylon I came to the king, and after a certain time I made my request of the king;

fresh_translation: And I came to Jerusalem and understood the evil which Eliashib did for Tobiah, making for him a treasury-room in the court of the house of God.
brenton_translation: and I came to Jerusalem, and I understood the mischief which Eliasib had done in the case of Tobias, in making for him a treasury in the court of the house of God.

fresh_translation: And it seemed very evil to me, and I threw all vessels of the house of Tobiah outside the treasury-room.
brenton_translation: And it appeared very evil to me: so I cast forth all the furniture of the house of Tobias from the treasury.

fresh_translation: And I said, and they purified the treasury-rooms, and I restored there vessels of the house of God, the manna, and the frankincense.
brenton_translation: And I gave orders, and they purified the treasuries: and I restored thither the vessels of the house of God, and the offerings, and the frankincense.

fresh_translation: And I knew that portions of the Levites had not been given, and the Levites and the singers doing the work fled, each man to his own field.
brenton_translation: And I understood that the portion of the Levites had not been given: and they had fled every one to his field, the Levites and the singers doing the work.

fresh_translation: And I contended with the generals and said, Why was the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them and set them in their standing.
brenton_translation: And I strove with the commanders, and said, Wherefore has the house of God been abandoned? and I assembled them, and set them in their place.

fresh_translation: And all Judah brought tithe of the grain and the wine and the oil into the treasuries.
brenton_translation: And all Juda brought a tithe of the wheat and the wine and the oil into the treasuries,

fresh_translation: Over the hand of Shelemiah the priest and Zadok the scribe and Pedaiah from the Levites, and over their hand Hanan son of Zaccur son of Mattaniah, because they were reckoned faithful to divide to their brothers.
brenton_translation: to the charge of Selemia the priest, and Sadoc the scribe, and Phadaea of the Levites: and next to them was Anan the son of Zacchur, son of Matthanias; for they were accounted faithful: it was their office to distribute to their brethren.

fresh_translation: Remember me, O God, in this, and let not my mercy be wiped out, which I did in the house of the Lord God.
brenton_translation: Remember me, O God, in this, and let not my kindness be forgotten which I have wrought in regard to the house of the Lord God.

fresh_translation: In those days I saw in Judah men treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing sheaves and loading them on the donkeys, and wine and grapes and figs and every burden, and bringing them into Jerusalem on Sabbath day, and I testified on the day of their selling.
brenton_translation: In those days I saw in Juda men treading wine-presses on the sabbath, and carrying sheaves, and loading asses with both wine, and grapes, and figs, and every kind of burden, and bringing them into Jerusalem on the sabbath-day:

fresh_translation: And they were dwelling in it, bringing fish and every kind of merchandise, selling on the Sabbath to the sons of Judah and in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: and I testified in the day of their sale. Also their dwelt in it men bringing fish, and selling every kind of merchandise to the children of Juda and in Jerusalem on the sabbath.

fresh_translation: And I contended with the sons of Judah, the free men, and said to them, What is this evil thing you are doing, profaning the Sabbath day?
brenton_translation: And I strove with the free children of Juda, and said to them, What is this evil thing which ye do, and profane the sabbath-day?

fresh_translation: Did not your fathers do thus, and our God brought all these evils upon them and upon us and upon this city? And you add wrath upon Israel by profaning the Sabbath.
brenton_translation: Did not your fathers thus, and our God brought upon them and upon us and upon this city all these evils? and do ye bring additional wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath?

fresh_translation: And it came to be when the gates of Jerusalem were set before the Sabbath, I gave word and they shut the gates, and I said that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. And from my servants I set some over the gates, so that no burden be brought in on Sabbath day.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when the gates were set up in Jerusalem, before the sabbath, that I spoke, and they shut the gates; and I gave orders that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and I set some of my servants at the gates, that none should bring in burdens on the sabbath-day.

fresh_translation: And all the traders and sellers of merchandise lodged outside Jerusalem once and twice.
brenton_translation: So all the merchants lodged, and carried on traffic without Jerusalem once or twice.

fresh_translation: And I testified among them and said to them, Why do you lodge opposite the wall? If you do this a second time, I will stretch out my hand against you. From that time they did not come on the Sabbath.
brenton_translation: Then I testified against them, and said to them, Why do ye lodge in front of the wall? if ye do so again, I will stretch out my hand upon you. From that time they came not on the sabbath.

fresh_translation: And I told the Levites, those being purified and coming to guard the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Concerning these things remember me, O God, and spare me according to the abundance of your mercy.
brenton_translation: and I told the Levites who were purifying themselves, and came and kept the gates, that they should sanctify the sabbath-day. Remember me, O God, for these things, and spare me according to the abundance of thy mercy.

fresh_translation: And in those days I saw the Jews who had seated Ashdodite, Ammonite, and Moabite women.
brenton_translation: And in those days I saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:

fresh_translation: And half of their sons were speaking Ashdodite and were not recognizing how to speak Ioudaian.
brenton_translation: and their children spoke half in the language of Ashdod, and did not know how to speak in the Jewish language.

fresh_translation: And I contended with them and cursed them and struck men among them and made them bald, and made them swear by God that you will not give your daughters to their sons and will not take from their daughters for your sons.
brenton_translation: And I strove with them and cursed them; and I smote some of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying,Ye shall not give your daughters to their sons, and ye shall not take of their daughters to your sons.

fresh_translation: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin thus? And among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by God, and God gave him as king over all Israel, yet foreign women turned even him aside.
brenton_translation: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin thus? though there was no king like him among many nations, and he was beloved of God, and God made him king over all Israel; yet strange women turned him aside.

fresh_translation: And shall we listen to you to do all this evil, to act faithlessly toward our God, seating foreign women?
brenton_translation: So we will not hearken to you to do all this evil, to break covenant with our God, —to marry strange wives.

fresh_translation: And from the sons of Joiada, of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law of Sanballat the Horonite, and I drove him out from me.
brenton_translation: and Elisub the high priest, one of the sons of Joada, being son-in-law of Sanaballat the Uranite, I chased him away from me.

fresh_translation: Remember them, O God, for kinship with the priesthood and covenant of the priesthood and the Levites.
brenton_translation: Remember them, O God, for their false connection with the priesthood, and the breaking the covenant of the priesthood, and for defiling the Levites.

fresh_translation: And I purified them from every foreign thing and set courses for the priests and for the Levites, each man as his work,
brenton_translation: So I purged them from all foreign connection, and established courses for the priests and the Levites, every man according to his work.

fresh_translation: and the gift of the wood-bearers at appointed times, year by year, and in the firstfruits. Remember me, O our God, for goodness.
brenton_translation: And the offering of the wood-bearers was at certain set times, and in the times of the first-fruits. Remember me, O our God, for good.

fresh_translation: And it came to be after these words, in the days of Artaxerxes, this Artaxerxes ruled from India over one hundred twenty-seven provinces.
In those days, when King Artaxerxes was enthroned in Shushan the city,
in the third year of his reign he made a feast for his friends and the rest of the nations and the nobles of Persia and Media and rulers of the satrapies,
and after this, after showing them wealth of his kingdom and glory of joy of his riches for one hundred eighty days,
when days of the marriage were fulfilled, the king made a drinking-feast for the nations found in the city for six days, in the court of the house of the king,

adorned with linen and carbasus stretched on linen and purple cords, on rings of gold and silver, on marble pillars, and couches of gold and silver on pavement of emerald stone and pearl and marble stone, and coverings transparent and variously flowered, with roses scattered around.
And golden and silver cups, and a carbuncle cup set forth worth thirty thousand talents. Wine was much and sweet, which the king himself drank.
And this drinking was not according to fixed law, for thus the king willed, and he ordered the stewards to do his pleasure and that of the men.
And Vashti the queen made a drinking-feast for the women in the royal house where King Artaxerxes was.
And on the seventh day, when the king became merry, he said to Aman and Bazan and Tharra and Bigtha and Abagtha and Abataza and Tharaba, the seven eunuchs serving King Artaxerxes,
to bring in the queen to him, to crown her and put the diadem on her and show her beauty to all the rulers and the nations, because she was beautiful.
And Vashti the queen would not listen to come with the eunuchs, and the king was grieved and enraged.
And he said to his friends, Thus Vashti has spoken. So make law and judgment concerning this.
And Arkesaios and Sarsathaios and Marsena approached him, rulers of Persians and Medes, those near the king, first seated beside the king,
and they reported to him according to the laws what ought to be done to Vashti the queen, because she did not do what was commanded by the king through the eunuchs.
And Memucan said to the king and the rulers, Not against the king only did Vashti the queen do wrong, but also against all the rulers and leaders of the king.
For he recounted to them words of the queen and how she contradicted the king, even as she contradicted King Artaxerxes.
Thus today the remaining princesses of rulers of Persia and Media, hearing what she said to the king, will likewise dare to dishonor their husbands.

If then it seems good to the king, let him issue a royal command and let it be written among laws of Medes and Persians and not otherwise used, that the queen enter to him no more, and let the king give her royal place to a woman better than she.
And let the law which the king makes be heard in his kingdom, and thus all women will give honor to their husbands, from poor to rich.
And the word pleased the king and the rulers, and the king did as Memucan spoke.
And he sent into all the kingdom, province by province in their own language, so that there might be fear in their houses.
And after these words the king ceased from wrath and no longer remembered Vashti, remembering what she said and how he condemned her.
And the servants of the king said, Let incorrupt young girls, beautiful in appearance, be sought for the king.

And let the king appoint local rulers in all provinces of his kingdom, and let them choose virgin girls, beautiful in appearance, into Shushan the city, into the women's house, and let them be delivered to eunuch of the king, keeper of the women, and let cosmetics and the rest of care be given.
And the woman who pleases the king shall reign instead of Vashti. And the matter pleased the king, and he did thus.
And there was a Jewish man in Shushan the city, and his name was Mordecai son of Jair, son of Shimei, son of Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin,
who was a captive from Jerusalem, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon carried away captive.

And he had a foster-child, daughter of Amminadab his father's brother, and her name was Esther. And after her parents died he trained her for himself as a wife, and the girl was beautiful in appearance.
And when command of the king was heard, many girls were gathered into Shushan the city under the hand of Hegai, and Esther was led to Hegai, keeper of the women.

And the girl pleased him and found favor before him, and he hurried to give her the cosmetics and the portion and the seven girls appointed to her from the royal house, and he treated her and her maidservants well in the women's house.
And Esther did not reveal her race or her homeland, for Mordecai commanded her not to report it.
And every day Mordecai walked around the women's court, looking to see what would happen to Esther.

And this was the time for a girl to go in to the king, when she completed twelve months, for thus the days of treatment are completed: six months being anointed with the oil of myrrh and six months with spices and with the women's cosmetics.
And then she goes in to the king, and whatever she says will be given to her to go in with her from the women's house as far as the royal rooms.
In evening she goes in, and by day she returns to the second women's house, where Shaashgaz the king's eunuch, keeper of the women, is, and she no longer goes in to the king unless called by name.

And when time of Esther, daughter of Amminadab the father's brother of Mordecai, was fulfilled to go in to the king, she rejected nothing of what Hegai the eunuch, keeper of the women, commanded her. For Esther was finding favor from all seeing her.
And Esther went in to Artaxerxes the king in the twelfth month, which is Adar, in the seventh year of his reign.
And the king loved Esther, and she found favor beyond all the virgins, and he put upon her the woman's diadem.
And the king made a feast for all his friends and the forces for seven days, and exalted wedding of Esther and made a remission for those under his kingdom.
And Mordecai was serving in the court.
And Esther did not reveal her homeland, for thus Mordecai commanded her to fear God and do his commandments, just as when she was with him, and Esther did not change her conduct.
And the two eunuchs of the king, chief bodyguards, were grieved because Mordecai had been promoted, and they sought to kill Artaxerxes the king.
And the matter became known to Mordecai, and he signaled it to Esther, and she made known to the king the details of the plot.
And the king examined the two eunuchs and hanged them, and the king ordered it to be recorded for remembrance in the royal library concerning the favor of Mordecai, with praise.
And after these things King Artaxerxes honored Aman son of Hammedatha the Agagite and exalted him and gave him first rank beyond all his friends.
And all in the court were bowing to him, for thus the king commanded it to be done, but Mordecai was not bowing to him.
And those in the court of the king said to Mordecai, Mordecai, why do you disregard things spoken by the king?
Every day they spoke to him, and he was not listening to them, and they reported Mordecai to Aman, as one opposing words of the king, and Mordecai showed them that he is a Jew.
And Aman, perceiving that Mordecai was not bowing to him, was enraged greatly.
And he planned to destroy all the Jews under kingdom of Artaxerxes.

And he made a decree in the twelfth year of the reign of Artaxerxes and cast lots, day by day and month by month, so as to destroy the race of Mordecai in one day, and the lot fell on the fourteenth of the month, which is Adar.

And he spoke to King Artaxerxes, saying, There is a nation scattered among the nations in all your kingdom, and their laws differ from all nations, and they disregard laws of the king, and it is not advantageous for the king to let them remain.
If it seems good to the king, let it be decreed to destroy them, and I will write ten thousand talents of silver into the treasury of the king.
And the king removed the ring and gave it into the hand of Aman to seal against the writings against the Jews.
And the king said to Aman, Keep the silver, and use the nation as you wish.

And scribes of the king were called on the thirteenth of the first month, and they wrote as Aman commanded to the generals and the rulers over every province, from India to Ethiopia, to the one hundred twenty-seven provinces, and to the rulers of the nations in their own language, by Artaxerxes the king.
And it was sent by book-carriers into the kingdom of Artaxerxes to destroy the race of the Jews in one day of the twelfth month, which is Adar, and to plunder their goods.
Copies of the letters were posted province by province, and command was given to all the nations to be ready for this day.
And the matter was hurried, even in Shushan. But the king and Aman were drinking, while the city was troubled.

And Mordecai, perceiving what was being carried out, tore his garments and put on sackcloth and sprinkled himself with ashes, and leaping through the broad place of the city he cried with a loud voice, A nation that did no wrong is being taken away.
And he came as far as the king's gate and stood, for it was not lawful for him to enter the court wearing sackcloth and ashes.
And in every province where the letters were posted, there was cry and beating and great mourning for the Jews. They spread sackcloth and ashes for themselves.

And maidservants and eunuchs of the queen came in and reported to her, and hearing what happened she was troubled, and she sent to clothe Mordecai and take away the sackcloth from him, but he was not persuaded.
And Esther called Hathach her eunuch, who stood by her, and sent to learn from Mordecai the exact truth.
And Mordecai showed him what had happened and the promise which Aman promised to the king, ten thousand talents to the treasury, so as to destroy the Jews.

And he gave him copy of the notice posted in Shushan for their destruction, to show Esther, and he told him to command her, after going in, to plead with the king and urge him for the people, remembering days of your humiliation, how you were nourished in my hand, because Aman, the second to the kingdom, has spoken against us for death. Call upon the Lord and speak to the king concerning us and rescue us from death.
And Hathach went in and spoke to her all these words.
And Esther said to Hathach, Go to Mordecai and say that

all nations of the kingdom know that every man or woman who enters to the king in the inner court uncalled has no salvation, except the one to whom the king stretches out the golden scepter, that one will be saved. And I have not been called to go in to the king these thirty days.
And Hathach reported to Mordecai all words of Esther.
And Mordecai said to Hathach, Go and tell Esther, Do not say to yourself that you alone in the kingdom will be saved beyond all the Jews.
For if you disregard in this time, help and shelter will be for the Jews from another place, but you and house of your father will perish. And who knows whether for this very time you came to reign?
And Esther sent back the one who came to her, to Mordecai, saying,

Go, gather the Jews in Shushan and fast for me, and do not eat or drink for three days, night and day. And I and my maidservants will likewise go without food, and then I will go in to the king contrary to the law. If then I must perish, I will perish.
And Mordecai went and did all that Esther commanded him.
And it happened on the third day, when she ceased praying, she took off garments of service and put on her glory.
And after lifting the golden scepter she placed it on her neck and kissed it and said, Speak to me.
And the king said, What do you want, Esther, and what is your request? Even to half of my kingdom, it shall be yours.
And Esther said, My marked day is today. If then it seems good to the king, let him and Aman come to the feast which I will make today.
And the king said, Hasten Aman, so that we may do word of Esther. And both came to the feast which Esther spoke of.
And during the drinking the king said to Esther, What is it, Queen Esther? It shall be yours, whatever you ask.
And she said, My petition and my request are this:
If I found favor before the king, let the king and Aman come tomorrow to the feast which I will make for them, and tomorrow I will do the same things.
And Aman went out from the king overjoyed and rejoicing. But when Aman saw Mordecai the Jew in the court, he was enraged greatly.
And after entering his own house he called his friends and Zeresh his wife.
And he showed them his wealth and the honor which the king placed on him and how he made him hold first place and lead the kingdom.
And Aman said, The queen called no one to the feast with the king except me, and for tomorrow I have been called.
And these things do not please me whenever I see Mordecai the Jew in the court.

And Zeresh his wife and the friends said to him, Let a timber of fifty cubits be cut for you, and in the morning speak to the king, and let Mordecai be hanged on the timber. But you go into the feast with the king and rejoice. And the word pleased Aman, and the timber was prepared.
But the Lord drove sleep away from the king in that night, and he told his teacher to bring in memorial records of the days, to read to him.
And he found the writings written concerning Mordecai, how he reported to the king about the two eunuchs of the king while they were guarding him and seeking to lay hands on Artaxerxes.
And the king said, What honor or favor have we done for Mordecai? And the servants of the king said, You did nothing for him.

And as the king was inquiring concerning the favor of Mordecai, behold Aman was in the court. And the king said, Who is in the court? And Aman came in to speak to the king to hang Mordecai on the timber which he prepared.
And the servants of the king said, Behold, Aman stands in the court. And the king said, Call him.
And the king said to Aman, What shall I do for the man whom I wish to honor? And Aman said in himself, Whom does the king wish to honor except me?
And he said to the king, For the man whom the king wishes to honor,
let servants of the king bring linen robe which the king wears and horse on which the king rides,

and let one of the king's glorious friends give it, and let him robe the man whom the king loves and lift him upon the horse and proclaim through the broad place of the city, saying, Thus it shall be to every man whom the king honors.
And the king said to Aman, As you spoke, so do to Mordecai the Jew, who serves in the court, and let not one word of what you spoke fall away.

And Aman took the robe and the horse and robed Mordecai and lifted him upon the horse and went through the broad place of the city and proclaimed, saying, Thus it shall be to every man whom the king wishes to honor.
And Mordecai returned to the court, but Aman returned to his own house grieving, with head covered.

And Aman recounted to Zeresh his wife and to the friends what happened to him, and the friends and the wife said to him, If Mordecai is from race of Jews, you began to be humbled before him, and falling you will fall; you will never be able to resist him, because living God is with him.
While they were still speaking, the eunuchs arrived, hurrying Aman to the drinking-feast which Esther prepared.
And the king and Aman went in to drink with the queen.
And on the second day during the drinking the king said, What is it, Queen Esther, and what is your petition and what is your request? Even to half of my kingdom, let it be yours.
And she answered and said, If I found favor before the king, let my life be given for my petition and my people for my request.

For I and my people were sold for destruction and plundering and slavery, we and our children, for boy-servants and girl-servants. And I kept silent, for the accuser is not worthy of the king's court.
And the king said, Who is this one who dared to do this thing?
And Esther said, An enemy, Aman, this evil one. And Aman was thrown into turmoil before the king and the queen.
And the king rose from the banquet into the garden, but Aman was begging the queen, for he saw himself in evils.

And the king returned from the garden. Aman had fallen on the couch, begging the queen. And the king said, So then will he even force the woman in my own house? And Aman, hearing, was struck in the face.

And Bouthathan, one of the eunuchs, said to the king, Behold, Aman also prepared a timber for Mordecai, the one who spoke for the king, and it stands in Aman's house, fifty cubits. And the king said, Let him be impaled on it.
And Aman was hanged on the timber which he prepared for Mordecai, and then the king ceased from wrath.
And on that day King Artaxerxes gave to Esther all things that belonged to Aman the accuser, and Mordecai was called by the king, for Esther showed that he was related to her.
And the king took the ring which he removed from Aman and gave it to Mordecai, and Esther appointed Mordecai over all things of Aman.
And Esther added and spoke to the king and fell at his feet and asked him to remove evil of Aman and all he did against the Jews.
And the king stretched out to Esther the golden scepter. And Esther rose to stand by the king.
And Esther said, If it seems good to you and I found favor, let the letters sent by Aman be turned back, the ones written to destroy the Jews who are in your kingdom.
For how shall I be able to see mistreatment of my people? And how shall I be saved amid destruction of my homeland?
And the king said to Esther, If all things of Aman I gave and granted to you, and him I hanged on timber because he laid hands on the Jews, what do you still seek?
Write also yourselves in my name as seems good to you, and seal it with my ring. For whatever is written when the king commands and sealed with my ring, there is no contradicting it.

And the scribes were called in the first month, which is Nisan, on the twenty-third of that year, and it was written for the Jews what he commanded to the administrators and rulers of the satrapies, from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven satrapies, province by province in its own language.
And it was written through the king and sealed with his ring, and they sent the letters through book-carriers,
just as he commanded them to use their laws in every city, to help themselves and deal with their adversaries and those opposing them as they wish,
on one day in all kingdom of Artaxerxes, on the thirteenth of the twelfth month, which is Adar.
And let copies be publicly posted in all the kingdom, and let all the Jews be ready for this day to fight those set against them.
So the riders went out hurrying to fulfill what the king spoke, and the decree was also posted in Shushan.
And Mordecai went out clothed in royal robe and wearing golden crown and linen purple diadem, and those in Shushan, seeing, rejoiced.
And for the Jews there came light and gladness,

in each city and province wherever the decree and notice were posted, joy and gladness came for the Jews, a feast and rejoicing, and many of the nations were circumcised and became Ioudaizing because of fear of the Jews.
For in the twelfth month, on the thirteenth of the month, which is Adar, the letters written by the king were at hand.
On that day those opposing the Jews were destroyed, for no one stood against them, fearing them.
For rulers of the satrapies and the tyrants and the king's scribes were honoring the Jews, for fear of Mordecai was pressing upon them.
For decree of the king had fallen that his name be spoken in all the kingdom.
And in Shushan the city the Jews killed five hundred men,
both Parshandatha and Dalphon and Pisgah,
and Poratha and Adalia and Sarbacha,
and Parmashta and Arisai and Aridai and Vaizatha,
the ten sons of Aman son of Hammedatha the Agagite, enemy of the Jews, and they plundered.
On that day the number of the slain in Shushan was reported to the king.
And the king said to Esther, The Jews destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the city, and in the district how do you think they acted? What more do you request? And it shall be yours.
And Esther said to the king, Let it be given to the Jews to act likewise tomorrow, and to hang the ten sons of Aman.
And he permitted it to happen thus and ordered bodies of Aman's sons to be hung for the Jews of the city.
And the Jews were gathered in Shushan on the fourteenth of Adar and killed three hundred men, and they plundered nothing.

And the rest of the Jews in the kingdom gathered and were helping themselves, and they rested from the war. For they destroyed fifteen thousand of them on the thirteenth of Adar and plundered nothing.
And they rested on the fourteenth of the same month and kept it as day of rest with joy and gladness.
But the Jews in Shushan the city were gathered on the fourteenth and did not rest, but kept the fifteenth with joy and gladness.

Therefore the Jews scattered in every country outside keep the fourteenth of Adar as a good day with joy, sending portions each to his neighbor, and those dwelling in the capitals keep also the fifteenth of Adar as a good day of rejoicing, sending portions to neighbors.
And Mordecai wrote these words into a book and sent to the Jews, as many as were in the kingdom of Artaxerxes, both near and far,
to establish these good days, to keep both the fourteenth and the fifteenth of Adar,

for in these days the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month in which, being Adar, it was turned for them from mourning into joy and from grief into a good day, to keep all as good days of marriages and rejoicing, sending portions to friends and to the poor.
And the Jews accepted it, just as Mordecai wrote to them,
how Aman son of Hammedatha the Macedonian warred against them, as he made decree and lot to destroy them,
and how he entered to the king, saying to hang Mordecai. But the evils which he attempted to bring upon the Jews came upon him, and he and his children were hanged.

Therefore these days were called Purim because of the lots, for in their language they call them Purim, because of words of this letter and what they suffered because of these things and what happened to them.

And the Jews established and accepted it upon themselves and upon their seed and upon those added to them, and they will use no other way, but these days will be a memorial kept generation by generation and city and father-house and province.
And these days of Purim will be kept for all time, and their memorial shall never fail from the generations.
And Esther the queen, daughter of Amminadab, and Mordecai the Jew wrote all that they did, even the confirming of the letter of Purim.
And Mordecai and Esther the queen established for themselves by themselves, and then after establishing according to their safety and their counsel,
Esther established by word forever, and it was written for remembrance.
And the king wrote taxes upon the kingdom of both land and sea.
And his strength and bravery and the wealth and glory of his kingdom, behold, these are written in the book of kings of Persia and Media for remembrance.
And Mordecai succeeded King Artaxerxes and was great in the kingdom and glorified by the Jews and loved, recounting the way of life to all his nation.
There was a certain man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job, and that man was true, blameless, righteous, god-fearing, turning away from every evil thing.
brenton_translation: There was a certain man in the land of Ausis, whose name was Job; and that man was true, blameless, righteous, and godly, abstaining from everything evil.

fresh_translation: And there came to him seven sons and three daughters.
brenton_translation: And he had seven sons and three daughters.

fresh_translation: And his livestock was seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred grazing she-donkeys, and very much service, and great works were his upon the land. And that man was noblest of those from sunrise.
brenton_translation: And his cattle consisted of seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred she-asses in the pastures, and a very great household, and he had a great husbandry on the earth; and that man was most noble of the men of the east.

fresh_translation: And his sons, going to one another, were making a feast each day, bringing along also their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
brenton_translation: And his sons visiting one another prepared a banquet every day, taking with them also their three sisters to eat and drink with them.

fresh_translation: And when days of the feast were completed, Job sent and purified them. Rising early, he offered sacrifices for them according to their number, and one calf for sin concerning their souls. For Job said, Lest my sons thought evil things in their mind toward God. Thus Job was doing all the days.
brenton_translation: And when the days of the banquet were completed, Job sent and purified them, having risen up in the morning, and offered sacrifices for them, according to their number, and one calf for a sin-offering for their souls: for Job said, Lest peradventure my sons have thought evil in their minds against God. Thus then Job did continually.

fresh_translation: And when this day came, behold, angels of God came to stand before the Lord, and the slanderer came with them.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on a day, that, behold, the angels of God came to stand before the Lord, and the devil came with them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to the slanderer, From where are you here? And answering, the slanderer said to the Lord, After going around the earth and walking about under heaven, I am here.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to the devil, Whence art thou come? And the devil answered the Lord, and said, I am come from compassing the earth, and walking up and down in the world.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to him, Did you set your mind against my servant Job, because there is no man like him on the earth, blameless, true, god-fearing, turning away from every evil thing?
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to him, Hast thou diligently considered my servant Job, that there is none like him on the earth, a man blameless, true, godly, abstaining from everything evil?

fresh_translation: And the slanderer answered and said before the Lord, Does Job fear God for nothing?
brenton_translation: Then the devil answered, and said before the Lord, Does Job worship the Lord for nothing?

fresh_translation: Did you not fence in things outside him and inside his house and outside all that belongs to him round about? The works of his hands you blessed, and his cattle you made many upon the earth.
brenton_translation: Hast thou not made a hedge about him, and about his household, and all his possessions round about? and hast thou not blessed the works of his hands, and multiplied his cattle upon the land?

fresh_translation: But stretch out your hand and touch all that he has, and surely he will bless you to your face.
brenton_translation: But put forth thine hand, and touch all that he has: verily he will bless thee to thy face.

fresh_translation: Then the Lord said to the slanderer, Behold, all things that are his I give into your hand, only do not touch him. And the slanderer went out from the Lord.
brenton_translation: Then the Lord said to the devil, Behold, I give into thine hand all that he has, but touch not himself. So the devil went out from the presence of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it happened on a day when Job's sons and daughters were drinking wine in the house of their elder brother,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on a certain day, that Job's sons and his daughters were drinking wine in the house of their elder brother.

fresh_translation: and behold, a messenger came to Job and said to him, The yoke of oxen were plowing, and the she-donkeys were grazing beside them,
brenton_translation: And, behold, there came a messenger to Job, and said to him, The yokes of oxen were ploughing, and the she-asses were feeding near them;

fresh_translation: and the raiders came and took them captive, and the servants they killed with swords. And I alone escaped and came to report to you.
