brenton_translation: and the spoilers came and took them for a prey, and slew the servants with the sword; and I having escaped alone am come to tell thee.

fresh_translation: While this one was still speaking, another messenger came and said to Job, Fire fell from heaven and burned up the sheep and devoured the shepherds likewise. And I alone escaped and came to report to you.
brenton_translation: While he was yet speaking, there came another messenger, and said to Job, Fire has fallen from heaven, and burnt up the sheep, and devoured the shepherds likewise; and I having escaped alone am come to tell thee.

fresh_translation: While this one was still speaking, another messenger came and said to Job, The horsemen made against us three heads, and they surrounded the camels and took them captive, and the servants they killed with swords. And I alone escaped and came to report to you.
brenton_translation: While he was yet speaking, there came another messenger, and said to Job, The horsemen formed three companies against us, and surrounded the camels, and took them for a prey, and slew the servants with the sword; and I only escaped, and am come to tell thee.

fresh_translation: While this one was still speaking, another messenger came, saying to Job, Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking at their elder brother's house,
brenton_translation: While he is yet speaking, another messenger comes, saying to Job, While thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking with their elder brother,

fresh_translation: and suddenly a great wind came from the wilderness and touched the four corners of the house, and the house fell on your children, and they died. And I alone escaped and came to report to you.
brenton_translation: suddenly a great wind came on from the desert, and caught the four corners of the house, and the house fell upon thy children, and they are dead; and I have escaped alone, and am come to tell thee.

fresh_translation: So Job rose, tore his garments, shaved hair of his head, and falling to the ground worshiped and said,
brenton_translation: So Job arose, and rent his garments, and shaved the hair of his head, and fell on the earth, and worshipped,

fresh_translation: Naked I came out from the womb of my mother, naked also I will go away there. The Lord gave, the Lord took away. As it seemed good to the Lord, so also it came to pass. Let the name of the Lord be blessed.
brenton_translation: and said, I myself came forth naked from my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the Lord gave, the Lord has taken away: as it seemed good to the Lord, so has it come to pass; blessed be the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: In all these things that happened to him, Job sinned in nothing before the Lord and gave no folly to God.
brenton_translation: In all these events that befel him Job sinned not at all before the Lord, and did not impute folly to God.

fresh_translation: And it came to be on this day also that angels of God came to stand before the Lord, and the slanderer came among them to stand before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass on a certain day, that the angels of God came to stand before the Lord, and the devil came among them to stand before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to the slanderer, From where do you come? Then the slanderer said before the Lord, After passing through what is under heaven and walking all around, I am here.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to the devil, Whence comest thou? Then the devil said before the Lord, I am come from going through the world, and walking about the whole earth.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to the slanderer, Did you then give attention to my servant Job, because there is no man like him on the earth, innocent, true, blameless, god-fearing, turning away from every evil, and he still holds fast his innocence? Yet you spoke against his possessions to destroy them for nothing.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to the devil, Hast thou then observed my servant Job, that there is none of men upon the earth like him, a harmless, true, blameless, godly man, abstaining from all evil? and he yet cleaves to innocence, whereas thou hast told me to destroy his substance without cause?

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, the slanderer said to the Lord, Skin for skin, all things a man has he will pay for his life.
brenton_translation: And the devil answered and said to the Lord, Skin for skin, all that a man has will he give as a ransom for his life.

fresh_translation: But stretch out your hand and touch his bones and his flesh, and surely he will bless you to your face.
brenton_translation: Nay, but put forth thine hand, and touch his bones and his flesh: verily he will bless thee to thy face.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to the slanderer, Behold, I hand him over to you; only preserve his life.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to the devil, Behold, I deliver him up to thee; only save his life.

fresh_translation: And the slanderer went out from the Lord and struck Job with a grievous sore from feet to head.
brenton_translation: So the devil went out from the Lord, and smote Job with sore boils from his feet to his head.

fresh_translation: And he took a potsherd to scrape the discharge, and he sat upon the dung-heap outside the city.
brenton_translation: And he took a potsherd to scrape away the discharge, and sat upon a dung-heap outside the city.

fresh_translation: And when much time had passed, his wife said to him, How long will you endure, saying, Behold, I wait yet a little time, expecting hope of my deliverance? For behold, your memorial has vanished from the earth, sons and daughters of my womb, pangs and labors which I toiled for in vain with hardships. And you yourself sit in decay of worms, passing the night in the open air. And I am a wanderer and servant, going from place to place and house to house, waiting for sun to set so that I may rest from labors and pains that now hold me fast. But speak some word to the Lord and die.
brenton_translation: And when much time had passed, his wife said to him, How long wilt thou hold out, saying,

fresh_translation: And looking at her, he said to her, You spoke like one of the foolish women. If we accepted good things from the hand of the Lord, shall we not bear evil things? In all these things that happened to him, Job sinned in nothing with his lips before God.
brenton_translation: But he looked on her, and said to her, Thou hast spoken like one of the foolish women. If we have received good things of the hand of the Lord, shall we not endure evil things?

fresh_translation: And hearing all the evils that came upon him, his three friends came, each from his own country, to him: Eliphaz the Temanite king, Bildad the Sauchaian tyrant, and Zophar the Naamathite king. And they came to him with one purpose, to encourage and visit him.
brenton_translation: Now his three friends having heard of all the evil that was come upon him, came to him each from his own country: Eliphaz the king of the Thæmans, Baldad sovereign of the Saucheans, Sophar king of the Minæans: and they came to him with one accord, to comfort and to visit him.

fresh_translation: And seeing him from far off, they did not recognize him, and crying with a loud voice they wept, each tearing his own robe and scattering dust.
brenton_translation: And when they saw him from a distance they did not know him; and they cried with a loud voice, and wept, and rent every one his garment, and sprinkled dust upon their heads,

fresh_translation: They sat with him seven days and seven nights, and none of them spoke, for they saw that the blow was dreadful and very great.
brenton_translation: and they sat down beside him seven days and seven nights, and no one of them spoke; for they saw that his affliction was dreadful and very great.

fresh_translation: After this Job opened his mouth
brenton_translation: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed his day,

fresh_translation: and cursed his day, saying,
brenton_translation: saying,

fresh_translation: Let the day perish in which I was born, and the night in which they said, Behold, a male.
brenton_translation: Let the day perish in which I was born, and that night in which they said, Behold a man-child!

fresh_translation: Let that day be darkness, and let not the Lord seek it from above, nor let light come upon it.
brenton_translation: Let that night be darkness, and let not the Lord regard it from above, neither let light come upon it.

fresh_translation: Let darkness and the shadow of death take it. Let gloom come upon it.
brenton_translation: But let darkness and the shadow of death seize it; let blackness come upon it;

fresh_translation: Let the day and that night be cursed. Let darkness take it away. Let it not be among days of the year, nor counted among days of months.
brenton_translation: let that day and night be cursed, let darkness carry them away; let it not come into the days of the year, neither let it be numbered with the days of the months.

fresh_translation: But let that night be pain, and let no gladness come upon it, nor joy.
brenton_translation: But let that night be pain, and let not mirth come upon it, nor joy.

fresh_translation: But let the one cursing that day curse it, the one preparing to master the great sea-beast.
brenton_translation: But let him that curses that day curse it, even he that is ready to attack the great whale.

fresh_translation: Let stars of that night be darkened. Let it wait and not come into light, nor see morning-star rising,
brenton_translation: Let the stars of that night be darkened; let it remain dark, and not come into light; and let it not see the morning star arise:

fresh_translation: because it did not shut gates of my mother's womb, for then it would have removed pain from my eyes.
brenton_translation: because it shut not up the gates of my mother's womb, for so it would have removed sorrow from my eyes.

fresh_translation: For why did I not die in the belly? And coming out from the womb, why did I not immediately perish?
brenton_translation: For why died I not in the belly? and why did I not come forth from the womb and die immediately?

fresh_translation: Why then did knees meet me? And why breasts, that I sucked?
brenton_translation: And why did the knees support me? and why did I suck the breasts?

fresh_translation: Now, having lain down, I would have been quiet. Having slept, I would have rested
brenton_translation: Now I should have lain down and been quiet, I should have slept and been at rest,

fresh_translation: with kings, counselors of earth, who gloried themselves over swords,
brenton_translation: with kings and councillors of the earth, who gloried in their swords;

fresh_translation: or with rulers whose gold was much, who filled their houses with silver,
brenton_translation: or with rulers, whose gold was abundant, who filled their houses with silver:

fresh_translation: or like miscarriage coming out from the womb of a mother, or like infants who never saw light.
brenton_translation: or I should have been as an untimely birth proceeding from his mother's womb, or as infants who never saw light.

fresh_translation: There the ungodly burned out rage of wrath. There the weary in body rested.
brenton_translation: There the ungodly have burnt out the fury of rage; there the wearied in body rest.

fresh_translation: And there the eternal ones together did not hear the voice of tax-collector.
brenton_translation: And the men of old time have together ceased to hear the exactor's voice.

fresh_translation: Small and great are there, and servant not fearing his lord.
brenton_translation: The small and great are there, and the servant that feared his lord.

fresh_translation: Why then is light given to those in bitterness, and life to souls in pains,
brenton_translation: For why is light given to those who are in bitterness, and life to the souls which are in griefs?

fresh_translation: who long for death and do not obtain it, digging for it as for treasures,
brenton_translation: who desire death, and obtain it not, digging for it as for treasures;

fresh_translation: who become overjoyed if they should attain it?
brenton_translation: and would be very joyful if they should gain it?

fresh_translation: Death is rest for a man, for God shut in against him.
brenton_translation: Death is rest to such a man, for God has hedged him in.

fresh_translation: For before my food, groaning comes to me, and I weep, being held fast by fear.
brenton_translation: For my groaning comes before my food, and I weep being beset with terror.

fresh_translation: For fear which I pondered came upon me, and what I dreaded met me.
brenton_translation: For the terror of which I meditated has come upon me, and that which I had feared has befallen me.

fresh_translation: I neither had peace nor was quiet nor rested, but wrath came to me.
brenton_translation: I was not at peace, nor quiet, nor had I rest; yet wrath came upon me.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Eliphaz the Temanite says,
brenton_translation: Then Eliphaz the Thæmanite answered and said,

fresh_translation: Were many times spoken to you in distress? But strength of your words, who will bear?
brenton_translation: Hast thou been often spoken to in distress? but who shall endure the force of thy words?

fresh_translation: For you instructed many and encouraged weak hands.
brenton_translation: For whereas thou hast instructed many, and hast strengthened the hands of the weak one,

fresh_translation: And those failing you raised up by words, and upon knees without strength you put courage.
brenton_translation: and hast supported the failing with words, and hast imparted courage to feeble knees.

fresh_translation: But now pain comes upon you and touches you, and you were hasty.
brenton_translation: Yet now that pain has come upon thee, and touched thee, thou art troubled.

fresh_translation: Is not your fear foolishness, and your hope, and innocence of your way?
brenton_translation: Is not thy fear founded in folly, thy hope also, and the mischief of thy way?

fresh_translation: Remember then, who being pure perished? Or when did true men perish root and all?
brenton_translation: Remember then who has perished, being pure? or when were the true-hearted utterly destroyed?

fresh_translation: In the way I saw, those plowing improper things and those sowing them will reap pains for themselves.
brenton_translation: Accordingly as I have seen men ploughing barren places, and they that sow them will reap sorrows for themselves.

fresh_translation: By the command of the Lord they will perish, and by breath of his wrath they will be wiped out.
brenton_translation: They shall perish by the command of the Lord, and shall be utterly consumed by the breath of his wrath.

fresh_translation: The strength of a lion, the voice of a lioness, and boast of dragons were quenched.
brenton_translation: The strength of the lion, and the voice of the lioness, and the exulting cry of serpents are quenched.

fresh_translation: Ant-lion perished for not having food, and lion cubs abandoned one another.
brenton_translation: The old lion has perished for want of food, and the lions' whelps have forsaken one another.

fresh_translation: But if any true word happened in your sayings, none of these evils would ever have met you. Will not my ear receive strange things from him?
brenton_translation: But if there had been any truth in thy words, none of these evils would have befallen thee. Shall not mine ear receive excellent revelations from him?

fresh_translation: But fears and the sound of night, fear falling on men,
brenton_translation: But as when terror falls upon men, with dread and a sound in the night,

fresh_translation: dread met me and trembling, and greatly my bones shook together.
brenton_translation: horror and trembling seized me, and caused all my bones greatly to shake.

fresh_translation: And a spirit came upon my face, and my hairs and flesh shuddered.
brenton_translation: And a spirit came before my face; and my hair and flesh quivered.

fresh_translation: I stood up and did not recognize; I looked, and there was no form before my eyes, but only a breeze, and I was hearing a voice:
brenton_translation: I arose and perceived it not: I looked, and there was no form before my eyes: but I only heard a breath and a voice, saying,

fresh_translation: What then? Shall mortal be pure before the Lord, or shall a man be blameless by his works?
brenton_translation: What, shall a mortal be pure before the Lord? or a man be blameless in regard to his works?

fresh_translation: If he does not trust in his servants, and against his angels he devised something crooked,
brenton_translation: Whereas he trusts not in his servants, and perceives perverseness in his angels.

fresh_translation: then those dwelling in the houses of clay, from which we also are from the same clay, he struck like a moth.
brenton_translation: But as for them that dwell in houses of clay, of whom we also are formed of the same clay, he smites them like a moth.

fresh_translation: And from morning until evening they no longer exist, because they were not able to help themselves. They perished.
brenton_translation: And from morning to evening they no longer exist: they have perished, because they cannot help themselves.

fresh_translation: For he breathed on them and they dried up. They perished for not having wisdom.
brenton_translation: For he blows upon them, and they are withered: they have perished for lack of wisdom.

fresh_translation: But call, if anyone will hear you, or if you will see any of the holy angels.
brenton_translation: But call, if any one will hearken to thee, or if thou shalt see any of the holy angels.

fresh_translation: For anger kills the fool, and jealousy kills the wandering one.
brenton_translation: For wrath destroys the foolish one, and envy slays him that has gone astray.

fresh_translation: But I saw fools throwing down root, yet immediately their way of life was eaten up.
brenton_translation: And I have seen foolish ones taking root: but suddenly their habitation was devoured.

fresh_translation: Let their sons be far from deliverance, and let them be beaten at the doors of inferiors, and there will be no one rescuing.
brenton_translation: Let their children be far from safety, and let them be crushed at the doors of vile men, and let there be no deliverer.

fresh_translation: For what they gathered, righteous men will eat, but they themselves will not be delivered from evils. Let their strength be drained away.
brenton_translation: For what they have collected, the just shall eat; but they shall not be delivered out of calamities: let their strength be utterly exhausted.

fresh_translation: For toil will not come out from the earth, nor will pain sprout up from the mountains.
brenton_translation: For labour cannot by any means come out of the earth, nor shall trouble spring out of the mountains:

fresh_translation: But man is born for toil, and young vultures fly to the heights.
brenton_translation: yet man is born to labour, and even so the vulture's young seek the high places.

fresh_translation: Yet I will petition the Lord, and I will call on the Master of all.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless I will beseech the Lord, and will call upon the Lord, the sovereign of all;

fresh_translation: He does great and unsearchable things, glorious and extraordinary things beyond number,
brenton_translation: who does great things and untraceable, glorious things also, and marvellous, of which there is no number:

fresh_translation: giving rain upon the earth, sending water upon what is under heaven,
brenton_translation: who gives rain upon the earth, sending water on the earth:

fresh_translation: making lowly ones into height, raising up those who were lost,
brenton_translation: who exalts the lowly, and raises up them that are lost:

fresh_translation: turning aside counsels of the crafty, and their hands will never do what is true,
brenton_translation: frustrating the counsels of the crafty, and their hands shall not perform the truth:

fresh_translation: the one catching wise men in their cunning, and overthrowing counsel of the twisted,
brenton_translation: who takes the wise in their wisdom, and subverts the counsel of the crafty.

fresh_translation: in daytime darkness will meet them, and at noon they will grope as in night.
brenton_translation: In the day darkness shall come upon them, and let them grope in the noon-day even as in the night:

fresh_translation: But let the weak perish in war, and let the powerless come out from the hand of the mighty.
brenton_translation: and let them perish in war, and let the weak escape from the hand of the mighty.

fresh_translation: And let there be hope for the powerless, but mouth of the unrighteous be stopped.
brenton_translation: And let the weak have hope, but the mouth of the unjust be stopped.

fresh_translation: But blessed is man whom the Lord corrected; do not reject discipline of the Almighty.
brenton_translation: But blessed is the man whom the Lord has reproved; and reject not thou the chastening of the Almighty.

fresh_translation: For he causes pain and again restores. He struck, and his hands healed.
brenton_translation: For he causes a man to be in pain, and restores him again: he smites, and his hands heal.

fresh_translation: Six times from necessities he will deliver you, and in the seventh evil will not touch you.
brenton_translation: Six times he shall deliver thee out of distresses: and in the seventh harm shall not touch thee.

fresh_translation: In famine he will rescue you from death, and in war he will free you from the hand of iron.
brenton_translation: In famine he shall deliver thee from death: and in war he shall free thee from the power of the sword.

fresh_translation: From scourge of the tongue he will hide you, and you will not fear evils coming.
brenton_translation: He shall hide thee from the scourge of the tongue: and thou shalt not be afraid of coming evils.

fresh_translation: You will laugh at unjust and lawless men, and you will not fear from wild beasts,
brenton_translation: Thou shalt laugh at the unrighteous and the lawless: and thou shalt not be afraid of wild beasts.

fresh_translation: for wild beasts will be at peace with you.
brenton_translation: For the wild beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

fresh_translation: Then you will know that your house will be at peace, and dwelling of your tent will never go wrong.
brenton_translation: Then shalt thou know that thy house shall be at peace, and the provision for thy tabernacle shall not fail.

fresh_translation: And you will know that your seed is many, and your children will be like all-herbage of the field.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt know that thy seed shall be abundant; and thy children shall be like the herbage of the field.

fresh_translation: And you will come to the grave like ripe grain harvested in its season, or like a heap of threshing floor gathered at its time.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt come to the grave like ripe corn reaped in its season, or as a heap of the corn-flour collected in proper time.

fresh_translation: Behold, these things we searched out. These are what we heard. But you, know for yourself if you did anything.
brenton_translation: Behold, we have thus sought out these matters; these are what we have heard: but do thou reflect with thyself, if thou hast done anything wrong.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Job says,
brenton_translation: But Job answered and said,

fresh_translation: If only someone might weigh my anger, and lift my pains together in balance.
brenton_translation: Oh that one would indeed weigh the wrath that is upon me, and take up my griefs in a balance together!

fresh_translation: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seashore; but, as it seems, my words are worthless.
brenton_translation: And verily they would be heavier than the sand by the seashore: but, as it seems, my words are vain.

fresh_translation: For arrows of the Lord are in my body, whose fury drinks up my blood; whenever I begin to speak, they stab me.
brenton_translation: For the arrows of the Lord are in my body, whose violence drinks up my blood: whenever I am going to speak, they pierce me.

fresh_translation: For surely wild donkey does not cry for nothing, unless seeking grain; nor will ox bellow at manger while having fodder.
brenton_translation: What then? will the wild ass bray for nothing, if he is not seeking food? or again, will the ox low at the manger, when he has fodder?

fresh_translation: Will bread be eaten without salt? Or is there taste in empty words?
brenton_translation: Shall bread be eaten without salt? or again, is there taste in empty words?

fresh_translation: For my soul cannot cease, for I see my foods as stench, like smell of lion.
brenton_translation: For my wrath cannot cease; for I perceive my food as the smell of a lion to be loathsome.

fresh_translation: If only my request might come, and the Lord might give my hope.
brenton_translation: For oh that he would grant my desire, and my petition might come, and the Lord would grant my hope!

fresh_translation: Let the Lord begin and wound me; but in end let him not destroy me.
brenton_translation: Let the Lord begin and wound me, but let him not utterly destroy me.

fresh_translation: Let my city be grave, upon whose walls I leaped; upon it I will by no means spare myself, for I did not lie about words of holy God.
brenton_translation: Let the grave be my city, upon the walls of which I have leaped: I will not shrink from it; for I have not denied the holy words of my God.

fresh_translation: For what strength have I, that I keep enduring? Or what time remains for me, that my soul keeps bearing?
brenton_translation: For what is my strength, that I continue? what is my time, that my soul endures?

fresh_translation: Is my strength the strength of stones, or is my flesh bronze?
brenton_translation: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

fresh_translation: Or was I not trusting in him? But help has gone far from me.
brenton_translation: Or have I not trusted in him? but help is far from me.

fresh_translation: Mercy renounced me, and visitation of the Lord overlooked me.
brenton_translation: Mercy has rejected me; and the visitation of the Lord has disregarded me.

fresh_translation: My near ones did not regard me; like failing torrents, or like a wave they passed me by.
brenton_translation: My nearest relations have not regarded me; they have passed me by like a failing brook, or like a wave.

fresh_translation: Those who feared me before have now fallen upon me, like snow or frozen ice.
brenton_translation: They who used to reverence me, now have come against me like snow or congealed ice.

fresh_translation: As things melted when heat came, what they were was not recognized.
brenton_translation: When it has melted at the approach of heat, it is not known what it was.

fresh_translation: Thus I too was abandoned by all; I perished and became homeless.
brenton_translation: Thus I also have been deserted of all; and I am ruined, and become an outcast.

fresh_translation: Look at ways of Tema, paths of Sheba, those who look intently.
brenton_translation: Behold the ways of the Thæmanites, ye that mark the paths of the Sabæans.

fresh_translation: They will owe shame, those trusting in cities and riches.
brenton_translation: They too that trust in cities and riches shall come to shame.

fresh_translation: But now you too fell upon me without mercy, so that seeing my wound you were afraid.
brenton_translation: But ye also have come to me without pity; so that beholding my wound ye are afraid.

fresh_translation: For what? Did I ask anything from you, or do I need some of your strength?
brenton_translation: What? have I made any demand of you? or do I ask for strength from you,

fresh_translation: So as to save me from enemies, or rescue me from the hand of rulers?
brenton_translation: to deliver me from enemies, or to rescue me from the hand of the mighty ones?

fresh_translation: Teach me, and I will be silent; if I have gone astray, show me.
brenton_translation: Teach ye me, and I will be silent: if in anything I have erred, tell me.

fresh_translation: As it seems, the words of truth are worthless, for I do not ask strength from you.
brenton_translation: But as it seems, the words of a true man are vain, because I do not ask strength of you.

fresh_translation: Nor will your reproof stop me with words, for neither will I endure the sound of your speech.
brenton_translation: Neither will your reproof cause me to cease my words, for neither will I endure the sound of your speech.

fresh_translation: Only because you fall upon orphan, and spring against your friend.
brenton_translation: Even because ye attack the fatherless, and insult your friend.

fresh_translation: But now, looking into your faces, I will not lie.
brenton_translation: But now, having looked upon your countenances, I will not lie.

fresh_translation: Sit down then, and let there not be injustice; and again come together with righteous judgment.
brenton_translation: Sit down now, and let there not be unrighteousness; and unite again with the just.

fresh_translation: For there is no injustice on my tongue; does not my throat ponder understanding?
brenton_translation: For there is no injustice in my tongue; and does not my throat meditate understanding?

fresh_translation: Is not life of man on earth a trial, and his life like that of day-laborer?
brenton_translation: Is not the life of man upon earth a state of trial? and his existence as that of a hireling by the day?

fresh_translation: Like servant fearing his master and having attained shade, like a hired man waiting for his wage,
brenton_translation: Or as a servant that fears his master, and one who has grasped a shadow? or as a hireling waiting for his pay?

fresh_translation: so I too inherited empty months, and nights of pains were given me.
brenton_translation: So have I also endured months of vanity, and nights of pain have been appointed me.

fresh_translation: If I lie down, I say, When day? and when I rise again, When evening? And I am full of pains from evening until morning.
brenton_translation: Whenever I lie down, I say, When will it be day? and whenever I rise up, again I say when will it be evening? and I am full of pains from evening to morning.

fresh_translation: My body is mixed with rottenness of worms; I melt clods of earth, scraping off the discharge.
brenton_translation: And my body is covered with loathsome worms; and I waste away, scraping off clods of dust from my eruption.

fresh_translation: My life is lighter than speech, and has perished in empty hope.
brenton_translation: And my life is lighter than a word, and has perished in vain hope.

fresh_translation: Remember then that my life is breath, and my eye will no longer return to see good.
brenton_translation: Remember then that my life is breath, and mine eye shall not yet again see good.

fresh_translation: Eye of one seeing me will not look on me; your eyes are on me, and I am no longer.
brenton_translation: The eye of him that sees me shall not see me again: thine eyes are upon me, and I am no more.

fresh_translation: Like cloud cleansed away from heaven, if man goes down to Hades, he will certainly not come up again.
brenton_translation: I am as a cloud that is cleared away from the sky: for if a man go down to the grave, he shall not come up again:

fresh_translation: Nor will he ever return again to his own house, nor will his place know him anymore.
brenton_translation: and he shall surely not return to his own house, neither shall his place know him any more.

fresh_translation: But therefore neither will I spare my mouth; I will speak in distress, opening bitterness of my soul while hard pressed.
brenton_translation: Then neither will I refrain my mouth: I will speak being in distress; being in anguish I will disclose the bitterness of my soul.

fresh_translation: Am I sea or dragon, that you set a guard over me?
brenton_translation: Am I a sea, or a serpent, that thou hast set a watch over me?

fresh_translation: If I say, My bed will comfort me, and my couch will bear my complaint for me,
brenton_translation: I said that my bed should comfort me, and I would privately counsel with myself on my couch.

fresh_translation: then you frighten me with dreams and terrify me with visions.
brenton_translation: Thou scarest me with dreams, and dost terrify me with visions.

fresh_translation: You will free my soul from breath, and my bones from death.
brenton_translation: Thou wilt separate life from my spirit; and yet keep my bones from death.

fresh_translation: For I will not live forever, that I should be patient. Depart from me, for my life is empty.
brenton_translation: For I shall not live for ever, that I should patiently endure: depart from me, for my life is vain.

fresh_translation: What is man, that you magnified him, or that you set your mind on him,
brenton_translation: For what is man, that thou hast magnified him? or that thou givest heed to him?

fresh_translation: or make visitation of him until morning, and judge him for rest?
brenton_translation: Wilt thou visit him till the morning, and judge him till the time of rest?

fresh_translation: Until when will you not let me be, nor release me until I swallow my spittle in pain?
brenton_translation: How long dost thou not let me alone, nor let me go, until I shall swallow down my spittle?

fresh_translation: If I sinned, what can I do to you, knower of minds of men? Why did you set me as your accuser? And I have become burden to you.
brenton_translation: If I have sinned, what shall I be able to do, O thou that understandest the mind of men? why hast thou made me as thine accuser, and why am I a burden to thee?

fresh_translation: And why did you not make forgetfulness of my lawlessness and cleansing of my sin? For now I will depart into earth, and seeking me early, I am no more.
brenton_translation: Why hast thou not forgotten my iniquity, and purged my sin? but now I shall depart to the earth; and in the morning, I am no more.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Bildad the Shuhite says,
brenton_translation: Then Baldad the Sauchite answered, and said,

fresh_translation: How long will you speak these things, wind of many words from your mouth?
brenton_translation: How long wilt thou speak these things, how long shall the breath of thy mouth be abundant in words?

fresh_translation: Will the Lord do injustice in judging, or will maker of all disturb what is right?
brenton_translation: Will the Lord be unjust when he judges; or will he that has made all things pervert justice?

fresh_translation: If your sons sinned before him, he sent them away in the hand of their lawlessness.
brenton_translation: If thy sons have sinned before him, he has cast them away because of their transgression.

fresh_translation: But you, rise early toward the Lord, begging Almighty.
brenton_translation: But be thou early in prayer to the Lord Almighty.

fresh_translation: If you are pure and true, he will hear your petition and restore to you dwelling of righteousness.
brenton_translation: If thou art pure and true, he will hearken to thy supplication, and will restore to thee the habitation of righteousness.

fresh_translation: Then your first things will be few, but your last things beyond counting.
brenton_translation: Though then thy beginning should be small, yet thy end should be unspeakably great.

fresh_translation: Ask indeed former generation, and search out race of fathers.
brenton_translation: For ask of the former generation, and search diligently among the race of our fathers:

fresh_translation: For we are of yesterday and do not know; for our life on earth is shadow.
brenton_translation: (for we are of yesterday, and know nothing; for our life upon the earth is a shadow:)

fresh_translation: Will not these teach you and tell you, and bring out words from their heart?
brenton_translation: shall not these teach thee, and report to thee, and bring out words from their heart?

fresh_translation: Does papyrus flourish without water, or will reed rise high without drink?
brenton_translation: Does the rush flourish without water, or shall the flag grow up without moisture?

fresh_translation: While still on its root and not yet cut, before any herb drinks, does it not dry up?
brenton_translation: When it is yet on the root, and though it has not been cut down, does not any herb wither before it has received moisture?

fresh_translation: So then will be the end of all who forget the Lord, for the hope of the ungodly will perish.
brenton_translation: Thus then shall be the end of all that forget the Lord: for the hope of the ungodly shall perish.

fresh_translation: For his house will be uninhabited, and his tent will turn out to be spider's web.
brenton_translation: For his house shall be without inhabitants, and his tent shall prove a spider's web.

fresh_translation: If he lean on his house, it will not stand; if he take hold of it, it will not endure.
brenton_translation: If he should prop up his house, it shall not stand: and when he has taken hold of it, it shall not remain.

fresh_translation: For it is moist under the sun, and from its decay its shoot will come out.
brenton_translation: For it is moist under the sun, and his branch shall come forth out of his dung-heap.

fresh_translation: It sleeps upon gathering of stones, and in the midst of pebbles it will live.
brenton_translation: He lies down upon a gathering of stones, and shall live in the midst of flints.

fresh_translation: If place swallow it up, it will deny it: You have not seen such things.
brenton_translation: If God should destroy him, his place shall deny him. Hast thou not seen such things,

fresh_translation: For such is overthrow of the ungodly, and from earth another will sprout.
brenton_translation: that such is the overthrow of the ungodly? and out of the earth another shall grow.

fresh_translation: For the Lord will by no means reject blameless one, but will not receive any gift of the ungodly.
brenton_translation: For the Lord will by no means reject the harmless man; but he will not receive any gift of the ungodly.

fresh_translation: Yet he will fill mouth of true ones with laughter, and their lips with confession.
brenton_translation: But he will fill with laughter the mouth of the sincere, and their lips with thanksgiving.

fresh_translation: But their enemies will clothe themselves with shame, and the dwelling of the ungodly will not be.
brenton_translation: But their adversaries shall clothe themselves with shame; and the habitation of the ungodly shall perish.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Job says,
brenton_translation: Then Job answered and said,

fresh_translation: In truth I know that it is so; for how will a mortal be righteous before the Lord?
brenton_translation: I know of a truth that it is so: for how shall a mortal man be just before the Lord?

fresh_translation: If he should wish to enter judgment with him, he will not answer him one word out of thousand.
brenton_translation: For if he would enter into judgment with him, God would not hearken to him, so that he should answer to one of his charges of a thousand.

fresh_translation: For he is wise in mind, mighty and great. Who, having hardened himself against him, endured?
brenton_translation: For he is wise in mind, and mighty, and great: who has hardened himself against him and endured?

fresh_translation: He who ages mountains, and they do not know, overthrowing them in anger.
brenton_translation: Who wears out the mountains, and men know it not: who overturns them in anger.

fresh_translation: He who shakes what is under heaven from foundations, and its pillars totter.
brenton_translation: Who shakes the earth under heaven from its foundations, and its pillars totter.

fresh_translation: He who says to sun, and it does not rise, and seals up stars.
brenton_translation: Who commands the sun, and it rises not; and he seals up the stars.

fresh_translation: He who stretched out heaven alone and walks as upon ground on sea.
brenton_translation: Who alone has stretched out the heavens, and walks on the sea as on firm ground.

fresh_translation: He who makes Pleiad and Evening Star and Bear and chambers of south.
brenton_translation: Who makes Pleias, and Hesperus, and Arcturus, and the chambers of the south.

fresh_translation: He who does great and unsearchable things, glorious and astonishing things without number.
brenton_translation: Who does great and unsearchable things; glorious also and excellent things, innumerable.

fresh_translation: If he pass over me, I will not see; if he go by me, I would not know.
brenton_translation: If ever he should go beyond me, I shall not see him: if he should pass by me, neither thus have I known it.

fresh_translation: If someone turn him away, who will turn him back? Or who will say to him, What have you done?
brenton_translation: If he would take away, who shall turn him back? or who shall say to him, What hast thou done?

fresh_translation: For he turned away wrath; under him sea-monsters beneath heaven were bowed down.
brenton_translation: For if he has turned away his anger, the whales under heaven have stooped under him.

fresh_translation: And if he should hear me, will he discern my words?
brenton_translation: Oh then that he would hearken to me, or judge my cause.

fresh_translation: For even if I am righteous, he will not hear me; I will plead with my judge.
brenton_translation: For though I be righteous, he will not hearken to me: I will intreat his judgment.

fresh_translation: And if I call and he answers, I do not believe that he has heard my voice.
brenton_translation: And if I should call and he should not hearken, I cannot believe that he has listened to my voice.

fresh_translation: Let him not rub me out in storm-cloud; he made my shatterings many for nothing.
brenton_translation: Let him not crush me with a dark storm: but he has made my bruises many without cause.

fresh_translation: For he does not let me take breath, but filled me with bitterness.
brenton_translation: For he suffers me not to take breath, but he has filled me with bitterness.

fresh_translation: If it is matter of strength, he is strong; but in judgment, who will withstand him?
brenton_translation: For indeed he is strong in power: who then shall resist his judgment?

fresh_translation: Even if I am righteous, my mouth will act ungodly; if I am blameless, I will turn crooked.
brenton_translation: For though I should seem righteous, my mouth will be profane: and though I should seem blameless, I shall be proved perverse.

fresh_translation: For even if I did act ungodly, I do not know in my soul; only this, that my life is taken away.
brenton_translation: For even if I have sinned, I know it not in my soul: but my life is taken away.

fresh_translation: Therefore I said, wrath destroys both great man and ruler.
brenton_translation: Wherefore I said, Wrath slays the great and mighty man.

fresh_translation: For worthless men are remarkable in death, but the righteous are laughed to scorn.
brenton_translation: For the worthless die, but the righteous are laughed to scorn.

fresh_translation: For the earth is given into the hands of the ungodly; he covers faces of its judges. But if not he, who is it?
brenton_translation: For they are delivered into the hands of the unrighteous man: he covers the faces of the judges of the earth: but if it be not he, who is it?

fresh_translation: My life is lighter than runner; they fled and did not know.
brenton_translation: But my life is swifter than a post: my days have fled away, and they knew it not.

fresh_translation: Or is there track of way for ships, or of eagle flying and seeking food?
brenton_translation: Or again, is there a trace of their path left by ships? or is there one of the flying eagle as it seeks its prey?

fresh_translation: If then I say, I will forget my speaking, stooping with face I will groan,
brenton_translation: And if I should say, I will forget to speak, I will bow down my face and groan;

fresh_translation: I shudder in all my limbs, for I know that you will not leave me innocent.
brenton_translation: I quake in all my limbs, for I know that thou wilt not leave me alone as innocent.

fresh_translation: Since I am ungodly, why then did I not die?
brenton_translation: But since I am ungodly, why have I not died?

fresh_translation: For if I wash myself with snow and cleanse my hands with purity,
brenton_translation: For if I should wash myself with snow, and purge myself with pure hands,

fresh_translation: sufficiently you dipped me in filth, and my garment loathed me.
brenton_translation: thou hadst thoroughly plunged me in filth, and my garment had abhorred me.

fresh_translation: For you are not man like me, against whom I will answer, that we might come together into judgment.
brenton_translation: For thou art not man like me, with whom I could contend, that we might come together to judgment.

fresh_translation: If only there were mediator of us, and reprover, and one hearing between both.
brenton_translation: Would that he our mediator were present, and a reprover, and one who should hear the cause between both.

fresh_translation: Let him take his rod away from me, and let his fear not whirl me about.
brenton_translation: Let him remove his rod from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

fresh_translation: Then I would not fear, but speak, for I do not know myself so.
brenton_translation: so shall I not be afraid, but I will speak: for I am not thus conscious of guilt.

fresh_translation: Weary in my soul, groaning, I will let my words go upon him; I will speak bitterness of my soul while hard pressed.
brenton_translation: Weary in my soul, I will pour my words with groans upon him: I will speak being straitened in the bitterness of my soul.

fresh_translation: And I will say to the Lord, Do not treat me as ungodly; teach me why you judged me thus.
brenton_translation: And I will say to the Lord, Do not teach me to be impious; and wherefore hast thou thus judged me?

fresh_translation: Is it good to you if I act unjustly, that you reject works of your hands, but give heed to the counsel of the ungodly?
brenton_translation: Is it good before thee if I be unrighteous? for thou hast disowned the work of thy hands, and attended to the counsel of the ungodly.

fresh_translation: Do you look as mortal looks, or see as man sees?
brenton_translation: Or dost thou see as a mortal sees? or wilt thou look as a man sees?

fresh_translation: Is your life human, or your years those of man,
brenton_translation: Or is thy life human, or thy years the years of a man,

fresh_translation: that you searched out my lawlessness and tracked down my sins?
brenton_translation: that thou hast enquired into mine iniquity, and searched out my sins?

fresh_translation: For you know that I did not act ungodly, but there is none rescuing from your hands.
brenton_translation: For thou knowest that I have not committed iniquity: but who is he that can deliver out of thy hands?

fresh_translation: Your hands formed me and made me; then changing, you struck me.
brenton_translation: Thy hands have formed me and made me; afterwards thou didst change thy mind, and smite me.

fresh_translation: Remember that you molded me like clay, and you turn me back into earth.
brenton_translation: Remember that thou hast made me as clay, and thou dost turn me again to earth.

fresh_translation: Did you not milk me out like milk and curdle me like cheese?
brenton_translation: Hast thou not poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

fresh_translation: With skin and flesh you clothed me, and with bones and sinews you wove me.
brenton_translation: And thou didst clothe me with skin and flesh, and frame me with bones and sinews.

fresh_translation: Life and mercy you set with me, and your oversight guarded my spirit.
brenton_translation: And thou didst bestow upon me life and mercy, and thy oversight has preserved my spirit.

fresh_translation: Holding these things within yourself, I know that you can do all things, and nothing is impossible to you.
brenton_translation: Having these things in thyself, I know that thou canst do all things; for nothing is impossible with thee.

fresh_translation: If I sin, you watch me, and from lawlessness you did not make me innocent.
brenton_translation: And if I should sin, thou watchest me; and thou hast not cleared me from iniquity.

fresh_translation: If I am ungodly, woe to me; if I am righteous, I cannot lift myself up, for I am full of dishonor.
brenton_translation: Or if I should be ungodly, woe is me: and if I should be righteous, I cannot lift myself up, for I am full of dishonour.

fresh_translation: For I am hunted like a lion for slaughter, and again changing, you destroy me terribly.
brenton_translation: For I am hunted like a lion for slaughter; for again thou hast changed and art terribly destroying me;

fresh_translation: Renewing my examination against me, you used great wrath toward me and brought trials upon me.
brenton_translation: renewing against me my torture: and thou hast dealt with me in great anger, and thou hast brought trials upon me.

fresh_translation: Why then did you bring me out from womb? Would that I had died and eye had not seen me.
brenton_translation: Why then didst thou bring me out of the womb? and why did I not die, and no eye see me,

fresh_translation: And I would have become as if I had not been. Why then was I not carried from belly to grave?
brenton_translation: and I become as if I had not been? for why was I not carried from the womb to the grave?

fresh_translation: Is not time of my life small? Let me be, that I may rest a little,
brenton_translation: Is not the time of my life short? suffer me to rest a little,

fresh_translation: before I go from where I will not return, into a dark and gloomy land,
brenton_translation: before I go whence I shall not return, to a land of darkness and gloominess;

fresh_translation: into the land of eternal darkness, where there is no light, nor seeing of life among mortals.
brenton_translation: to a land of perpetual darkness, where there is no light, neither can any one see the life of mortals.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Zophar the Naamathite says,
brenton_translation: Then Sophar the Minæan answered and said,

fresh_translation: Will one who says many things also answer back? Or does wordy man think himself righteous, blessed though born of woman and short-lived?
brenton_translation: He that speaks much, should also hear on the other side: or does the fluent speaker think himself to be righteous? blessed is the short-lived offspring of woman.

fresh_translation: Do not become abundant in words, for there is no one answering you.
brenton_translation: Be not a speaker of many words; for is there none to answer thee?

fresh_translation: For do not say, I am pure in works and blameless before him.
brenton_translation: For say not, I am pure in my works, and blameless before him.

fresh_translation: But how might the Lord speak to you and open his lips with you!
brenton_translation: But oh that the Lord would speak to thee, and open his lips with thee!

fresh_translation: Then he would declare to you power of wisdom, because they will be double to what is with you. And then you will know that what came to you from the Lord matches what you sinned.
brenton_translation: Then shall he declare to thee the power of wisdom; for it shall be double of that which is with thee: and then shalt thou know, that a just recompence of thy sins has come to thee from the Lord.

fresh_translation: Will you find track of the Lord, or reach to the ends of what Almighty made?
brenton_translation: Wilt thou find out the traces of the Lord? or hast thou come to the end of that which the Almighty has made?

fresh_translation: Heaven is high; what will you do? Deeper than things in Hades; what do you know?
brenton_translation: Heaven is high; and what wilt thou do? and there are deeper things than those in hell; what dost thou know?

fresh_translation: Longer than measure of earth and broader than sea.
brenton_translation: Or longer than the measure of the earth, or the breadth of the sea.

fresh_translation: If he overturn all things, who will say to him, What did you do?
brenton_translation: And if he should overthrow all things, who will say to him, What hast thou done?

fresh_translation: For he knows the works of lawless men, and seeing wrongs he will not overlook.
brenton_translation: For he knows the works of transgressors; and when he sees wickedness, he will not overlook it.

fresh_translation: But man drifts vainly in words, and mortal born of woman is like a desert donkey.
brenton_translation: But man vainly buoys himself up with words; and a mortal born of woman is like an ass of the desert.

fresh_translation: For if you set your heart pure and stretch out hands toward him,
brenton_translation: For if thou hast made thine heart pure, and liftest up thine hands towards him;

fresh_translation: if any lawless thing is in your hands, put it far from you, and let not injustice lodge in your dwelling.
brenton_translation: if there is any iniquity in thy hands, put it far from thee, and let not unrighteousness lodge in thy habitation.

fresh_translation: For then your face will shine like pure water, and you will strip off filth and by no means fear.
brenton_translation: For thus shall thy countenance shine again, as pure water; and thou shalt divest thyself of uncleanness, and shalt not fear.

fresh_translation: And you will forget toil, like a wave that passed by, and you will not be alarmed.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt forget trouble, as a wave that has passed by; and thou shalt not be scared.

fresh_translation: And your prayer will be like a morning star, and life will rise for you from midday.
brenton_translation: And thy prayer shall be as the morning star, and life shall arise to thee as from the noon-day.

fresh_translation: And you will be confident because there is hope for you; and out of care and anxiety peace will appear for you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt be confident, because thou hast hope; and peace shall dawn to thee from out of anxiety and care.

fresh_translation: For you will be at rest, and none will make war on you; and many changing course will entreat you.
brenton_translation: For thou shalt be at ease, and there shall be no one to fight against thee; and many shall charge, and make supplication to thee.

fresh_translation: But salvation will fail them, for their hope is destruction, and the eyes of the ungodly will melt.
brenton_translation: But safety shall fail them; for their hope is destruction, and the eyes of the ungodly shall waste away.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Job says,
brenton_translation: And Job answered and said,

fresh_translation: Then you are men indeed, and wisdom will die with you?
brenton_translation: So then ye alone are men, and wisdom shall die with you?

fresh_translation: But I too have heart like you.
brenton_translation: But I also have a heart as well as you.

fresh_translation: For a righteous and blameless man became an object of mockery.
brenton_translation: For a righteous and blameless man has become a subject for mockery.

fresh_translation: For an appointed time was prepared for him to fall under others and for his houses to be plundered by lawless men.
brenton_translation: For it had been ordained that he should fall under others at the appointed time, and that his houses should be spoiled by transgressors: let not however any one trust that, being evil, he shall be held guiltless,

fresh_translation: Yet let no one, being evil, trust that he will be innocent; all who provoke Lord, is there not examination for them too?
brenton_translation: even as many as provoke the Lord, as if there were indeed to be no inquisition made of them.

fresh_translation: But now ask beasts, if they will tell you, and birds of heaven, if they will report to you.
brenton_translation: But ask now the beasts, if they may speak to thee; and the birds of the air, if they may declare to thee.

fresh_translation: Or tell earth, if it should explain to you, and fish of the sea will recount to you.
brenton_translation: Tell the earth, if it may speak to thee: and the fishes of the sea shall explain to thee.

fresh_translation: Who does not know in all these that the hand of the Lord made these things,
brenton_translation: Who then has not known in all these things, that the hand of the Lord has made them?

fresh_translation: if not that in his hand is the soul of every living thing and breath of every human?
brenton_translation: Whereas the life of all living things is in his hand, and the breath of every man.

fresh_translation: For throat discerns words, and palate tastes foods.
brenton_translation: For the ear tries words, and the palate tastes meats.

fresh_translation: In much time is wisdom, and in long life knowledge.
brenton_translation: In length of time is wisdom, and in long life knowledge.

fresh_translation: With him are wisdom and power; with him counsel and understanding.
brenton_translation: With him are wisdom and power, with him counsel and understanding.

fresh_translation: If he throws down, who will build? If he shuts against men, who will open?
brenton_translation: If he should cast down, who will build up? if he should shut up against men, who shall open?

fresh_translation: If he hold back water, he will dry earth; if he let it loose, he ruined it by overthrowing.
brenton_translation: If he should withhold the water, he will dry the earth: and if he should let it loose, he overthrows and destroys it.

fresh_translation: With him are might and strength; with him knowledge and understanding.
brenton_translation: With him are strength and power: he has knowledge and understanding.

fresh_translation: Leading counselors away captive, he drove judges of earth mad.
brenton_translation: He leads counsellors away captive, and maddens the judges of the earth.

fresh_translation: Setting kings on thrones, he bound belt around their loins.
brenton_translation: He seats kings upon thrones, and girds their loins with a girdle.

fresh_translation: Sending priests away captive, he overthrew rulers of the earth.
brenton_translation: He sends away priests into captivity, and overthrows the mighty ones of the earth.

fresh_translation: Changing lips of faithful men, he takes away understanding of elders.
brenton_translation: He changes the lips of the trusty, and he knows the understanding of the elders.

fresh_translation: Pouring dishonor on rulers, but healing humble ones.
brenton_translation: He pours dishonour upon princes, and heals the lowly.

fresh_translation: Revealing deep things from darkness, and bringing the shadow of death into light.
brenton_translation: Revealing deep things out of darkness: and he has brought into light the shadow of death.

fresh_translation: Leading nations astray and destroying them, spreading out nations and guiding them.
brenton_translation: Causing the nations to wander, and destroying them: overthrowing the nations, and leading them away.

fresh_translation: Changing hearts of rulers of the earth, he led them astray in path they did not know.
brenton_translation: Perplexing the minds of the princes of the earth: and he causes them to wander in a way they have not known, saying,

fresh_translation: Let them grope darkness and not light, and let them wander like a drunkard.
brenton_translation: Let them grope in darkness, and let there be no light, and let them wander as a drunken man.

fresh_translation: Behold, my eye has seen these things, and my ear heard them.
brenton_translation: Behold, mine eye has seen these things, and mine ear has heard them.

fresh_translation: What you know, I also know; I am not less understanding than you.
brenton_translation: And I know all that ye too know; and I have not less understanding than you.

fresh_translation: But indeed I will speak to the Lord, and if he wishes I will reason before him.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless I will speak to the Lord, and I will reason before him, if he will.

fresh_translation: But you are unjust physicians and healers of evils, all of you.
brenton_translation: But ye are all bad physicians, and healers of diseases.

fresh_translation: If only you would be silent, and it would turn out to be wisdom for you.
brenton_translation: But would that ye were silent, and it would be wisdom to you in the end.

fresh_translation: Hear correction of my mouth, and give attention to the judgment of my lips.
brenton_translation: But hear ye the reasoning of my mouth, and attend to the judgment of my lips.

fresh_translation: Do you not speak before the Lord, and utter deceit before him?
brenton_translation: Do ye not speak before the Lord, and utter deceit before him?

fresh_translation: Will you shrink back, and become judges yourselves?
brenton_translation: Or will ye draw back? nay, do ye yourselves be judges.

fresh_translation: It will indeed be good if he searches you out, if in doing all things you attach yourselves to him?
brenton_translation: For it were well if he would thoroughly search you: for though doing all things in your power ye should attach yourselves to him,

fresh_translation: Yet he will surely reprove you, even if in secret you admire faces.
brenton_translation: he will not reprove you at all the less: but if moreover ye should secretly respect persons,

fresh_translation: Will not his terrors whirl you, and fear from him fall upon you?
brenton_translation: shall not his whirlpool sweep you round, and terror from him fall upon you?

fresh_translation: Your boasting will turn out equal to ashes, and body to clay.
brenton_translation: And your glorying shall prove in the end to you like ashes, and your body like a body of clay.

fresh_translation: Be silent, so I may speak, and let wrath rest from me.
brenton_translation: Be silent, that I may speak, and cease from mine anger,

fresh_translation: Taking my flesh in my teeth, I will put my soul in my hand.
brenton_translation: while I may take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand.

fresh_translation: If Mighty One should lay hand on me, since he has begun, yet I will speak and reason before him.
brenton_translation: Though the Mighty One should lay hand upon me, forasmuch as he has begun, verily I will speak, and plead before him.

fresh_translation: And this will turn out for me into salvation, for deceit will not enter before him.
brenton_translation: And this shall turn to me for salvation; for fraud shall have no entrance before him.

fresh_translation: Hear, hear my words, for I will declare with you listening.
brenton_translation: Hear, hear ye my words, for I will declare in your hearing.

fresh_translation: Behold, I am near my judgment; I know that I will appear righteous.
brenton_translation: Behold, I am near my judgment: I know that I shall appear evidently just.

fresh_translation: For who is he that will contend with me? Then I would be silent and expire.
brenton_translation: For who is he that shall plead with me, that I should now be silent, and expire?

fresh_translation: But use two things toward me; then I will not hide from your face.
brenton_translation: But grant me two things: then I will not hide myself from thy face.

fresh_translation: Hold back your hand from me, and let not your fear terrify me.
brenton_translation: Withhold thine hand from me: and let not thy fear terrify me.

fresh_translation: Then you will call, and I will answer you; or you will speak, and I will give you reply.
brenton_translation: Then shalt thou call, and I will hearken to thee: or thou shalt speak, and I will give thee an answer.

fresh_translation: How many are my sins and lawless acts? Teach me what they are.
brenton_translation: How many are my sins and my transgressions? teach me what they are.

fresh_translation: Why do you hide from me and count me your opponent?
brenton_translation: Wherefore hidest thou thyself from me, and deemest me thine enemy?

fresh_translation: Will you fear leaf moved by wind, or oppose me as grass carried by breath?
brenton_translation: Wilt thou be startled at me, as at a leaf shaken by the wind? or wilt thou set thyself against me as against grass borne upon the breeze?

fresh_translation: For you wrote bitter things against me and laid on me sins of youth.
brenton_translation: For thou hast written evil things against me, and thou hast compassed me with the sins of my youth.

fresh_translation: You put my foot in restraint, and watched all my works, and came up to roots of my feet.
brenton_translation: And thou hast placed my foot in the stocks; and thou hast watched all my works, and hast penetrated to my heels.

fresh_translation: And I grow old like a skin-bag, like a garment eaten by moth.
brenton_translation: I am as that which waxes old like a bottle, or like a moth-eaten garment.

fresh_translation: Mortal born of woman, short-lived and full of wrath.
brenton_translation: For a mortal born of a woman is short-lived, and full of wrath.

fresh_translation: Like a flower blooming he fell off; he fled like a shadow and will not stand.
brenton_translation: Or he falls like a flower that has bloomed; and he departs like a shadow, and cannot continue.

fresh_translation: And on this one you made account, and this one you caused to enter judgment before you?
brenton_translation: Hast thou not taken account even of him, and caused him to enter into judgment before thee?

fresh_translation: For who will be clean from defilement? No one.
brenton_translation: For who shall be pure from uncleanness? not even one;

fresh_translation: Even if his life is one day on earth, and his months beyond number are with you, you set him a time and he will not pass it.
brenton_translation: if even his life should be but one day upon the earth: and his months are numbered by him: thou hast appointed him for a time, and he shall by no means exceed it.

fresh_translation: Depart from him, that he may rest and take pleasure in his life like a hired man.
brenton_translation: Depart from him, that he may be quiet, and take pleasure in his life, though as a hireling.

fresh_translation: For there is hope for tree: if it be cut down, it will bloom again, and its shoot will not fail.
brenton_translation: For there is hope for a tree, even if it should be cut down, that it shall blossom again, and its branch shall not fail.

fresh_translation: If its root should grow old in earth and its stump die in rock,
brenton_translation: For though its root should grow old in the earth, and its stem die in the rock;

fresh_translation: by scent of water it will blossom and make harvest like young plant.
brenton_translation: it will blossom from the scent of water, and will produce a crop, as one newly planted.

fresh_translation: But man, having died, is gone; and mortal, having fallen, is no more.
brenton_translation: But a man that has died is utterly gone; and when a mortal has fallen, he is no more.

fresh_translation: For in time sea grows scarce, and river, having deserted, dried up.
brenton_translation: For the sea wastes in length of time, and a river fails and is dried up.

fresh_translation: So man, having fallen asleep, will certainly not rise until heaven is stitched together. They will not be awakened from their sleep.
brenton_translation: And man that has lain down in death shall certainly not rise again till the heaven be dissolved, and they shall not awake from their sleep.

fresh_translation: If only you had kept me in Hades and hidden me until your wrath ceased, and set me a time in which you would remember me.
brenton_translation: For oh that thou hadst kept me in the grave, and hadst hidden me until thy wrath should cease, and thou shouldest set me a time in which thou wouldest remember me!

fresh_translation: For if man die, will he live again? Having completed days of my life, I wait until I become again.
brenton_translation: For if a man should die, shall he live again, having accomplished the days of his life? I will wait till I exist again?

fresh_translation: Then you will call, and I will listen to you. Do not reject works of your hands.
brenton_translation: Then shalt thou call, and I will hearken to thee: but do not thou reject the work of thine hands.

fresh_translation: You counted my practices, and none of my sins will escape you.
brenton_translation: But thou hast numbered my devices: and not one of my sins shall escape thee?

fresh_translation: You sealed my lawless acts in purse, and marked if in anything I transgressed unwillingly.
brenton_translation: And thou hast sealed up my transgressions in a bag, and marked if I have been guilty of any transgression unawares.

fresh_translation: Yet mountain falling will collapse, and rock will grow old out of its place.
brenton_translation: And verily a mountain falling will utterly be destroyed, and a rock shall be worn out of its place.

fresh_translation: Waters wore stones smooth, and waters flooded dust of the earth, and you destroyed hope of man.
brenton_translation: The waters wear the stones, and waters falling headlong overflow a heap of the earth: and thou destroyest the hope of man.

fresh_translation: Pushing him to end, he is gone; you set his face and sent him away.
brenton_translation: Thou drivest him to an end, and he is gone: thou settest thy face against him, and sendest him away;

fresh_translation: If his sons become many, he does not know; if they become few, he is not aware.
brenton_translation: and though his children be multiplied, he knows it not; and if they be few, he is not aware.

fresh_translation: But his flesh grieved, and his soul mourned.
brenton_translation: But his flesh is in pain, and his soul mourns.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Eliphaz the Temanite says,
brenton_translation: Then Eliphaz the Thæmanite answered and said,

fresh_translation: Will wise man give answer of understanding's spirit, and fill belly with pain?
brenton_translation: Will a wise man give for answer a mere breath of wisdom? and does he fill up the pain of his belly,

fresh_translation: Reproving with words that are not needed, and speeches with no profit.
brenton_translation: reasoning with improper sayings, and with words wherein is no profit?

fresh_translation: Indeed you cast off fear and brought such words to completion before the Lord.
brenton_translation: Hast not thou moreover cast off fear, and accomplished such words before the Lord?

fresh_translation: You are guilty by the words of your mouth, nor did you discern words of mighty men.
brenton_translation: Thou art guilty by the words of thy mouth, neither hast thou discerned the words of the mighty.

fresh_translation: Your own mouth will reprove you, not I; your lips will testify against you.
brenton_translation: Let thine own mouth, and not me, reprove thee: and thy lips shall testify against thee.

fresh_translation: For were you first of men to be born, or were you fixed in place before hills?
brenton_translation: What! art thou the first man that was born? or wert thou established before the hills?

fresh_translation: Did you hear ordinance of the Lord, and did wisdom reach to you alone?
brenton_translation: Or hast thou heard the ordinance of the Lord? or has God used thee as his counsellor? and has wisdom come only to thee?

fresh_translation: For what do you know that we do not know? What do you understand that is not also with us?
brenton_translation: For what knowest thou, that we know not? or what understandest thou, which we do not also?

fresh_translation: Both gray-haired and aged men are among us, heavier in days than your father.
brenton_translation: Truly among us are both the old and very aged man, more advanced in days than thy father.

fresh_translation: For little things in which you sinned you were chastised greatly; you spoke excessively beyond measure.
brenton_translation: Thou hast been scourged for but few of thy sins: thou hast spoken haughtily and extravagantly.

fresh_translation: What did your heart dare, and what did your eyes bring on?
brenton_translation: What has thine heart dared? or what have thine eyes aimed at,

fresh_translation: That you burst out wrath against the Lord and brought out such words from your mouth.
brenton_translation: that thou hast vented thy rage before the Lord, and delivered such words from thy mouth?

fresh_translation: For what is mortal, that he will be blameless? Or how will one born of woman be righteous?
brenton_translation: For who, being a mortal, is such that he shall be blameless? or, who that is born of a woman, that he should be just?

fresh_translation: If he does not trust his holy ones, and heaven is not clean before him,
brenton_translation: Forasmuch as he trusts not his saints; and the heaven is not pure before him.

fresh_translation: how much more abominable and unclean is man, drinking injustice like drink.
brenton_translation: Alas then, abominable and unclean is man, drinking unrighteousness as a draught.

fresh_translation: But I will declare to you; hear me. What things I indeed have seen, I will tell you,
brenton_translation: But I will tell thee, hearken to me; I will tell thee now what I have seen;

fresh_translation: what wise men will say and did not hide from their fathers.
brenton_translation: things wise men say, and their fathers have not hidden.

fresh_translation: To them alone earth was given, and foreigner did not come upon them.
brenton_translation: To them alone the earth was given, and no stranger came upon them.

fresh_translation: All the life of the ungodly is in care, and numbered years are given to a tyrant.
brenton_translation: All the life of the ungodly is spent in care, and the years granted to the oppressor are numbered.

fresh_translation: Fear is in his ears; when he thinks he is at peace, destruction will come on him.
brenton_translation: And his terror is in his ears: just when he seems to be at peace, his overthrow will come.

fresh_translation: Let him not believe he will turn back from darkness, for he is already appointed into the hands of iron.
brenton_translation: Let him not trust that he shall return from darkness, for he has been already made over to the power of the sword.

fresh_translation: He is appointed for vultures as food; he knows in himself that he remains for corpse, and dark day will whirl him.
brenton_translation: And he has been appointed to be food for vultures; and he knows within himself that he is doomed to be a carcase: and a dark day shall carry him away as with a whirlwind.

fresh_translation: Necessity and distress will hold him, like commanding general falling in front rank.
brenton_translation: Distress also and anguish shall come upon him: he shall fall as a captain in the first rank.

fresh_translation: Because he raised hands against the Lord and stiffened neck against the Lord Almighty.
brenton_translation: For he has lifted his hands against the Lord, and he has hardened his neck against the Almighty Lord.

fresh_translation: He ran against him in insolence, in thickness of hump of his shield.
brenton_translation: And he has run against him with insolence, on the thickness of the back of his shield.

fresh_translation: Because he covered his face in his fat, and made collar upon thighs.
brenton_translation: For he has covered his face with his fat, and made layers of fat upon his thighs.

fresh_translation: Let him lodge in deserted cities, and enter uninhabited houses; what those men prepared, others will carry off.
brenton_translation: And let him lodge in desolate cities, and enter into houses without inhabitant: and what they have prepared, others shall carry away.

fresh_translation: He will by no means grow rich, nor will his possessions remain; his shadow will not fall on earth.
brenton_translation: Neither shall he at all grow rich, nor shall his substance remain: he shall not cast a shadow upon the earth.

fresh_translation: Nor will he escape darkness; wind will wither his shoot, and his flower will fall off.
brenton_translation: Neither shall he in any wise escape the darkness: let the wind blast his blossom, and let his flower fall off.

fresh_translation: Let him not believe he endures, for empty things will turn out for him.
brenton_translation: Let him not think that he shall endure; for his end shall be vanity.

fresh_translation: His cutting-down will be completed before its time, and his shoot will not flourish.
brenton_translation: His harvest shall perish before the time, and his branch shall not flourish.

fresh_translation: Let him be harvested like unripe grape before its time, and fall off like a flower of olive.
brenton_translation: And let him be gathered as the unripe grape before the time, and let him fall as the blossom of the olive.

fresh_translation: For the witness of the ungodly is death, and fire will burn houses of gift-takers.
brenton_translation: For death is the witness of an ungodly man, and fire shall burn the houses of them that receive gifts.

fresh_translation: In belly he will receive pains, and empty things will turn out for him, and his belly will bear deceit.
brenton_translation: And he shall conceive sorrows, and his end shall be vanity, and his belly shall bear deceit.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Job says,
brenton_translation: But Job answered and said,

fresh_translation: I heard many such things, all of you comforters of evils.
brenton_translation: I have heard many such things: poor comforters are ye all.

fresh_translation: For is there not order to windy words? Or what troubles you that you answer?
brenton_translation: What! is there any reason in vain words? or what will hinder thee from answering?

fresh_translation: I too would speak like you, if only your soul lay in place of mine; then I would exult over you with words and shake head against you.
brenton_translation: I also will speak as ye do: if indeed your soul were in my soul's stead, then would I insult you with words, and I would shake my head at you.

fresh_translation: But let there be strength in my mouth; I will not spare movement of my lips.
brenton_translation: And would there were strength in my mouth, and I would not spare the movement of my lips.

fresh_translation: For if I speak, I will not ease the wound; if I keep silent, how much less will I be wounded?
brenton_translation: For if I should speak, I shall not feel the pain of my wound: and if I should be silent, how shall I be wounded the less?

fresh_translation: But now he made me worn out, rotten and foolish.
brenton_translation: But now he has made me weary, and a worn-out fool; and thou hast laid hold of me.

fresh_translation: He seized me for witness; it became so, and my lie rose up in me, answering against my face.
brenton_translation: My falsehood has become a testimony, and has risen up against me: it has confronted me to my face.

fresh_translation: Using wrath, he threw me down; he gnashed teeth at me. Arrows of his raiders fell on me.
