brenton_translation: In his anger he has cast me down; he has gnashed his teeth upon me: the weapons of his robbers have fallen upon me.

fresh_translation: With sharpness of eyes he leaped on me; he struck me sharply on cheek, and with one accord they rushed upon me.
brenton_translation: He has attacked me with the keen glances of his eyes; with his sharp spear he has smitten me down upon my knees; and they have run upon me with one accord.

fresh_translation: For the Lord handed me over into the hands of an unjust one, and threw me upon ungodly men.
brenton_translation: For the Lord has delivered me into the hands of unrighteous men, and thrown me upon the ungodly.

fresh_translation: At peace, he scattered me; taking me by hair he tore me, set me up like target.
brenton_translation: When I was at peace he distracted me: he took me by the hair of the head, and plucked it out: he set me up as a mark.

fresh_translation: Spears encircled me, throwing into my kidneys without sparing; he poured my gall upon earth.
brenton_translation: They surrounded me with spears, aiming at my reins: without sparing me they poured out my gall upon the ground.

fresh_translation: He cast me down corpse upon corpse; mighty ones ran upon me.
brenton_translation: They overthrew me with fall upon fall: they ran upon me in their might.

fresh_translation: I sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and my strength was quenched in earth.
brenton_translation: They sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and my strength has been spent on the ground.

fresh_translation: My belly is burned from weeping, and shadow upon my eyelids.
brenton_translation: My belly has been parched with wailing, and darkness is on my eyelids.

fresh_translation: Yet there was nothing unjust in my hands, and my prayer was pure.
brenton_translation: Yet there was no injustice in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

fresh_translation: Earth, do not cover over blood of my flesh, nor let there be place for my cry.
brenton_translation: Earth, cover not over the blood of my flesh, and let my cry have no place.

fresh_translation: And now, behold, my witness is in heavens, and my confirmer in highest places.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my advocate is on high.

fresh_translation: Let my petition come to the Lord, and before him let my eye drop tears.
brenton_translation: Let my supplication come to the Lord, and let mine eye weep before him.

fresh_translation: Let there be reproof for man before the Lord, and son of man for his neighbor.
brenton_translation: Oh that a man might plead before the Lord, even as the son of man with his neighbour!

fresh_translation: For numbered years have come, and I will go way from which I will not return.
brenton_translation: But my years are numbered and their end come, and I shall go by the way by which I shall not return.

fresh_translation: I am ruined, carried by breath; I beg for burial and do not obtain it.
brenton_translation: I perish, carried away by the wind, and I seek for burial, and obtain it not.

fresh_translation: I am worn out in supplication. And what have I done?
brenton_translation: Weary I intreat; and what have I done? and strangers have stolen my goods.

fresh_translation: Strangers stole my goods. Who is this? Let him be bound with my hand.
brenton_translation: Who is this? let him join hands with me.

fresh_translation: For you hid their heart from understanding; because of this you will not exalt them.
brenton_translation: For thou hast hid their heart from wisdom; therefore thou shalt not exalt them.

fresh_translation: He will declare evils for a share, and my eyes melted away over my sons.
brenton_translation: He shall promise mischief to his companions: but their eyes have failed for their children.

fresh_translation: And you set me for byword among nations, and I became a laughingstock to them.
brenton_translation: But thou hast made me a byword among the nations, and I am become a scorn to them.

fresh_translation: For my eyes are dimmed from wrath; I have been greatly besieged by all.
brenton_translation: For my eyes are dimmed through pain; I have been grievously beset by all.

fresh_translation: True men were amazed at this, and a righteous man would rise up against a lawless one.
brenton_translation: Wonder has seized true men upon this; and let the just rise up against the transgressor.

fresh_translation: Let faithful one hold fast his own way, and clean of hands take courage.
brenton_translation: But let the faithful hold on his own way, and let him that is pure of hands take courage.

fresh_translation: But all of you brace yourselves and come; for I do not find truth among you.
brenton_translation: Howbeit, do ye all strengthen yourselves and come now, for I do not find truth in you.

fresh_translation: My days passed in stench, and joints of my heart were broken.
brenton_translation: My days have passed in groaning, and my heart-strings are broken.

fresh_translation: They turned night into day; light is near from the face of darkness.
brenton_translation: I have turned the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

fresh_translation: For if I endure, Hades is my house; in gloom my bed is spread.
brenton_translation: For if I remain, Hades is my habitation: and my bed has been made in darkness.

fresh_translation: I called death my father, and rot my mother and my sister.
brenton_translation: I have called upon death to be my father, and corruption to be my mother and sister.

fresh_translation: Where then is my hope? Or my good things? Will I see them?
brenton_translation: Where then is yet my hope? or where shall I see my good?

fresh_translation: Will they go down with me into Hades, or shall we descend together to dust?
brenton_translation: Will they go down with me to Hades, or shall we go down together to the tomb?

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Bildad the Shuhite says,
brenton_translation: Then Baldad the Sauchite answered and said,

fresh_translation: How long will you not stop? Hold back, so we also may speak.
brenton_translation: How long wilt thou continue? forbear, that we also may speak.

fresh_translation: Why have we been silenced like beasts before you?
brenton_translation: For wherefore have we been silent before thee like brutes?

fresh_translation: Wrath has used you. For what, if you die, will what is under heaven be uninhabited, or mountains overturned from foundations?
brenton_translation: Anger has possessed thee: for what if thou shouldest die; would the earth under heaven be desolate? or shall the mountains be overthrown from their foundations?

fresh_translation: But the light of the ungodly will be quenched, and their flame will not blaze forth.
brenton_translation: But the light of the ungodly shall be quenched, and their flame shall not go up.

fresh_translation: His light is darkness in his dwelling, and lamp over him will be extinguished.
brenton_translation: His light shall be darkness in his habitation, and his lamp shall be put out with him.

fresh_translation: Let smallest things hunt down his possessions, and his counsel slip.
brenton_translation: Let the meanest of men spoil his goods, and let his counsel deceive him.

fresh_translation: His foot is cast into snare, and let him be twisted in net.
brenton_translation: His foot also has been caught in a snare, and let it be entangled in a net.

fresh_translation: Let traps come upon him, and let thirsty ones overpower him.
brenton_translation: And let snares come upon him: he shall strengthen those that thirst for his destruction.

fresh_translation: His rope is hidden in ground, and his capture on paths.
brenton_translation: His snare is hid in the earth, and that which shall take him is by the path.

fresh_translation: Let pains destroy him around, and let many come about his feet in hunger.
brenton_translation: Let pains destroy him round about, and let many enemies come about him,

fresh_translation: An extraordinary corpse has been prepared for him.
brenton_translation: vex him with distressing hunger: and a signal destruction has been prepared for him.

fresh_translation: Let branches of his feet be eaten, and let death devour his beauties.
brenton_translation: Let the soles of his feet be devoured: and death shall consume his beauty.

fresh_translation: Let healing be torn from his dwelling, and let royal necessity seize him.
brenton_translation: And let health be utterly banished from his tabernacle, and let distress seize upon him with a charge from the king.

fresh_translation: It will lodge in his tent in his night; his fair things will be scattered with sulfur.
brenton_translation: It shall dwell in his tabernacle in his night: his excellency shall be sown with brimstone.

fresh_translation: His roots below will be dried up, and above his harvest will fall.
brenton_translation: His roots shall be dried up from beneath, and his crop shall fall away from above.

fresh_translation: His memorial perish from earth, and let there be no name of his on outside.
brenton_translation: Let his memorial perish out of the earth, and his name shall be publicly cast out.

fresh_translation: Let him be driven from light into darkness.
brenton_translation: Let one drive him from light into darkness.

fresh_translation: He will not be known among his people, nor saved under heaven his house; others will live in what is his.
brenton_translation: He shall not be known among his people, nor his house preserved on the earth.

fresh_translation: Last ones groaned over him, and first ones were seized with amazement.
brenton_translation: But strangers shall dwell in his possessions: the last groaned for him, and wonder seized the first.

fresh_translation: These are houses of unjust men, and this is the place of those not knowing the Lord.
brenton_translation: These are the houses of the unrighteous, and this is the place of them that know not the Lord.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Job says,
brenton_translation: Then Job answered and said,

fresh_translation: Until when will you trouble my soul and tear me down with words?
brenton_translation: How long will ye vex my soul, and destroy me with words? only know that the Lord has dealt with me thus.

fresh_translation: Know only that the Lord did this to me. Speaking against me, not ashamed, you press upon me.
brenton_translation: Ye speak against me; ye do not feel for me, but bear hard upon me.

fresh_translation: Yes then, if in truth I went astray, my wandering lodges with me. To speak word not needed, my words wander and not in season.
brenton_translation: Yea verily, I have erred in truth, (but the error abides with myself)

fresh_translation: If indeed you magnify yourselves against me and throw reproach at me,
brenton_translation: But alas! for ye magnify yourselves against me, and insult me with reproach.

fresh_translation: know then that the Lord is one who troubled me and raised his stronghold over me.
brenton_translation: Know then that it is the Lord that has troubled me, and has raised his bulwark against me.

fresh_translation: Behold, I laugh at reproach and will not speak; I will cry out, and there is nowhere judgment.
brenton_translation: Behold, I laugh at reproach; I will not speak: or I will cry out, but there is nowhere judgment.

fresh_translation: All around I am walled in, and I will certainly not pass; over my face he set darkness.
brenton_translation: I am fenced round about, and can by no means escape: he has set darkness before my face.

fresh_translation: He stripped glory from me and took crown from my head.
brenton_translation: And he has stripped me of my glory, and has taken the crown from my head.

fresh_translation: He tore me apart round about, and I am gone; he cut off my hope like a tree.
brenton_translation: He has torn me round about, and I am gone: and he has cut off my hope like a tree.

fresh_translation: He used wrath terribly against me and regarded me like an enemy.
brenton_translation: And he has dreadfully handled me in anger, and has counted me for an enemy.

fresh_translation: His raiding bands came together against me; they encircled me in ambushes on my paths.
brenton_translation: His troops also came upon me with one accord, liers in wait compassed my ways.

fresh_translation: My brothers stood far from me, and they knew me as stranger; my friends became without mercy.
brenton_translation: My brethren have stood aloof from me; they have recognised strangers rather than me: and my friends have become pitiless.

fresh_translation: My nearest ones did not acknowledge me, and those knowing my name forgot me.
brenton_translation: My nearest of kin have not acknowledged me, and they that knew my name, have forgotten me.

fresh_translation: Neighbors of my house and my servant girls treated me as stranger before them.
brenton_translation: As for my household, and my maid-servants, I was a stranger before them.

fresh_translation: I called my servant, and he did not obey; my mouth pleaded with him.
brenton_translation: I called my servant, and he hearkened not; and my mouth intreated him.

fresh_translation: And I begged my wife, and flattering, I was calling sons of my concubines.
brenton_translation: And I besought my wife, and earnestly intreated the sons of my concubines.

fresh_translation: Those forever rejected me; when I rise, they speak against me.
brenton_translation: But they rejected me for ever; whenever I rise up, they speak against me.

fresh_translation: Those who knew me abhorred me; those I had loved rose against me.
brenton_translation: They that saw me abhorred me: the very persons whom I had loved, rose up against me.

fresh_translation: My flesh rotted upon my skin, and my bones are held in my teeth.
brenton_translation: My flesh is corrupt under my skin, and my bones are held in my teeth.

fresh_translation: Pity me, pity me, O friends, for the hand of the Lord is what touched me.
brenton_translation: Pity me, pity me, O friends; for it is the hand of the Lord that has touched me.

fresh_translation: Why do you persecute me as the Lord does, and are not filled from my flesh?
brenton_translation: Wherefore do ye persecute me as also the Lord does, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

fresh_translation: If only someone would grant my words be written, and set down in book forever,
brenton_translation: For oh that my words were written, and that they were recorded in a book for ever,

fresh_translation: engraved with iron stylus and lead, or cut into rocks.
brenton_translation: with an iron pen and lead, or graven in the rocks!

fresh_translation: For I know that eternal is the one who is about to free me upon earth.
brenton_translation: For I know that he is eternal who is about to deliver me,

fresh_translation: he will raise up my skin enduring these things, for from the Lord these things were accomplished for me.
brenton_translation: and to raise up upon the earth my skin that endures these sufferings: for these things have been accomplished to me of the Lord;

fresh_translation: Which things I know in myself, which my eye has seen and not another; all things have been fulfilled for me in my bosom.
brenton_translation: which I am conscious of in myself, which mine eye has seen, and not another, but all have been fulfilled to me in my bosom.

fresh_translation: But if you say, What shall we say against him, and we will find root of matter in him,
brenton_translation: But if ye shall also say, What shall we say before him, and so find the root of the matter in him?

fresh_translation: then you also beware of covering; for wrath will come upon lawless men, and then they will know where their substance is.
brenton_translation: Do ye also beware of deceit: for wrath will come upon transgressors; and then shall they know where their substance is.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Zophar the Naamathite says,
brenton_translation: Then Sophar the Minæan answered and said,

fresh_translation: Did I not suppose you would answer back thus? Do you not understand more than I do?
brenton_translation: I did not suppose that thou wouldest answer thus: neither do ye understand more than I.

fresh_translation: I will hear discipline of my shame, and spirit from my understanding answers me.
brenton_translation: I will hear my shameful reproach; and the spirit of my understanding answers me.

fresh_translation: Do you not know these things from long ago, from when man was placed upon earth,
brenton_translation: Hast thou not known these things of old, from the time that man was set upon the earth?

fresh_translation: that the gladness of the ungodly is a sudden fall, and the joy of lawless men is destruction?
brenton_translation: But the mirth of the ungodly is a signal downfall, and the joy of transgressors is destruction:

fresh_translation: If his gifts go up to heaven and his sacrifice touches clouds,
brenton_translation: although his gifts should go up to heaven, and his sacrifice reach the clouds.

fresh_translation: then when he thinks he is already established, he will utterly perish, and those who saw him will say, Where is he?
brenton_translation: For when he shall seem to be now established, then he shall utterly perish: and they that knew him shall say, Where is he?

fresh_translation: Like dream flown away, he will not be found; he flew off like night phantom.
brenton_translation: Like a dream that has fled away, he shall not be found; and he has fled like a vision of the night.

fresh_translation: Eye passed by him and will not continue, and his place will not notice him anymore.
brenton_translation: The eye has looked upon him, but shall not see him again; and his place shall no longer perceive him.

fresh_translation: Let lesser men destroy his sons, and his hands kindle pains.
brenton_translation: Let his inferiors destroy his children, and let his hands kindle the fire of sorrow.

fresh_translation: His bones were filled with youth, and with him it will lie down in dust.
brenton_translation: His bones have been filled with vigour of his youth, and it shall lie down with him in the dust.

fresh_translation: If evil be sweet in his mouth, he will hide it under his tongue.
brenton_translation: Though evil be sweet in his mouth, though he will hide it under his tongue;

fresh_translation: He will not spare it and will not abandon it, but hold it fast in the midst of his throat.
brenton_translation: though he will not spare it, and will not leave it, but will keep it in the midst of his throat:

fresh_translation: And he will not be able to help himself; venom of asp is in his belly.
brenton_translation: yet he shall not at all be able to help himself; the gall of an asp is in his belly.

fresh_translation: Wealth unjustly gathered will be vomited out; angel will drag him from his house.
brenton_translation: His wealth unjustly collected shall be vomited up; a messenger of wrath shall drag him out of his house.

fresh_translation: Let him suck wrath of dragons, and tongue of serpent will kill him.
brenton_translation: And let him suck the poison of serpents, and let the serpent's tongue slay him.

fresh_translation: Let him not see milking of nomads, nor pastures of honey and butter.
brenton_translation: Let him not see the milk of the pastures, nor the supplies of honey and butter.

fresh_translation: He labored for empty and vain things; wealth from which he will not taste, like twisted thing unchewed and unswallowable.
brenton_translation: He has laboured unprofitably and in vain, for wealth of which he shall not taste: it is as a lean thing, unfit for food, which he cannot swallow.

fresh_translation: For he crushed houses of many weak ones, and seized dwelling he did not build.
brenton_translation: For he has broken down the houses of many mighty men: and he has plundered an habitation, though he built it not.

fresh_translation: There is no salvation for his possessions; in his desire he will not be saved.
brenton_translation: There is no security to his possessions; he shall not be saved by his desire.

fresh_translation: There is no remnant for his foods; therefore his good things will not flourish.
brenton_translation: There is nothing remaining of his provisions; therefore his goods shall not flourish.

fresh_translation: And when he thinks he is already full, he will be distressed, and every necessity will come upon him.
brenton_translation: But when he shall seem to be just satisfied, he shall be straitened; and all distress shall come upon him.

fresh_translation: The wrath of anger will be sent upon him and pains washed upon him, if only to fill his belly.
brenton_translation: If by any means he would fill his belly, let God send upon him the fury of wrath; let him bring a torrent of pains upon him.

fresh_translation: And he will not be saved from the hand of iron; bronze bow will wound him.
brenton_translation: And he shall by no means escape from the power of the sword; let the brazen bow wound him.

fresh_translation: Let arrow go through his body, and let lightnings walk in his dwelling; fears upon him.
brenton_translation: And let the arrow pierce through his body; and let the stars be against his dwelling-place: let terrors come upon him.

fresh_translation: Let all darkness wait for him; unquenchable fire will devour him, and stranger will afflict his house.
brenton_translation: And let all darkness wait for him: a fire that burns not out shall consume him; and let a stranger plague his house.

fresh_translation: Heaven will reveal his lawless acts, and earth rise up against him.
brenton_translation: And let the heaven reveal his iniquities, and the earth rise up against him.

fresh_translation: Destruction will drag away his house; final end, day of wrath will come upon him.
brenton_translation: Let destruction bring his house to an end; let a day of wrath come upon him.

fresh_translation: This is the portion of an ungodly man from the Lord, and possession of his goods from the Overseer.
brenton_translation: This is the portion of an ungodly man from the Lord, and the possession of his goods appointed him by the all-seeing God.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Job says,
brenton_translation: But Job answered and said,

fresh_translation: Hear, hear my words, so that this from you may be my consolation.
brenton_translation: Hear ye, hear ye my words, that I may not have this consolation from you.

fresh_translation: Bear with me, and I will speak; then afterward laugh at me.
brenton_translation: Raise me, and I will speak; then ye shall not laugh me to scorn.

fresh_translation: For is my reproof against man? And why should I not be angry?
brenton_translation: What! is my reproof of man? and why should I not be angry?

fresh_translation: Looking at me, be amazed, laying hand upon cheek.
brenton_translation: Look upon me, and wonder, laying your hand upon your cheek.

fresh_translation: For if I remember, I hurried, and pains seized my flesh.
brenton_translation: For even when I remember, I am alarmed, and pains seize my flesh.

fresh_translation: Why do ungodly men live, grow old, and even abound in wealth?
brenton_translation: Wherefore do the ungodly live, and grow old even in wealth?

fresh_translation: Their offspring remain with them, and their children before their eyes.
brenton_translation: Their seed is according to their desire, and their children are in their sight.

fresh_translation: Their houses prosper, and fear is nowhere; scourge from the Lord is not upon them.
brenton_translation: Their houses are prosperous, neither have they any where cause for fear, neither is there a scourge from the Lord upon them.

fresh_translation: Their cow did not miscarry; what was in womb was preserved and did not fail.
brenton_translation: Their cow does not cast her calf, and their beast with young is safe, and does not miscarry.

fresh_translation: And they remain like perpetual sheep, and their little children play.
brenton_translation: And they remain as an unfailing flock, and their children play before them, taking up the psaltery and harp;

fresh_translation: Taking up psaltery and harp, they rejoice at the sound of song.
brenton_translation: and they rejoice at the voice of a song.

fresh_translation: They completed their life in good things, and in rest of Hades they fell asleep.
brenton_translation: And they spend their days in wealth, and fall asleep in the rest of the grave.

fresh_translation: Yet they say to the Lord, Depart from me; I do not want to know your ways.
brenton_translation: Yet such a man says to the Lord, Depart from me; I desire not to know thy ways.

fresh_translation: What is Sufficient One, that we should serve him, and what profit if we meet him?
brenton_translation: What is the Mighty One, that we should serve him? and what profit is there that we should approach him?

fresh_translation: For their good things were in their hands, but he does not regard the works of ungodly men.
brenton_translation: For their good things were in their hands, but he regards not the works of the ungodly.

fresh_translation: Yet the lamp of ungodly men will be quenched, and destruction will come upon them, and pains will hold them from wrath.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless, the lamp of the ungodly also shall be put out, and destruction shall come upon them, and pangs of vengeance shall seize them.

fresh_translation: And they will be like chaff before wind, or like dust that whirlwind carried off.
brenton_translation: And they shall be as chaff before the wind, or as dust which the storm has taken up.

fresh_translation: Let his possessions fail his sons; he will repay it to him, and he will know.
brenton_translation: Let his substance fail to supply his children: God shall recompense him, and he shall know it.

fresh_translation: Let his eyes see his own slaughter, and let him not be rescued from the Lord.
brenton_translation: Let his eyes see his own destruction, and let him not be saved by the Lord.

fresh_translation: For what is his will in his house after him, when numbers of his months were divided?
brenton_translation: For his desire is in his house with him, and the number of his months has been suddenly cut off.

fresh_translation: Is it not the Lord who teaches understanding and knowledge? He judges murders.
brenton_translation: Is it not the Lord who teaches understanding and knowledge? and does not he judge murders?

fresh_translation: This man will die in the strength of his simplicity, altogether prosperous and flourishing.
brenton_translation: One shall die in his perfect strength, and wholly at ease and prosperous;

fresh_translation: His inward parts are full of fat, and his marrow pours out.
brenton_translation: and his inwards are full of fat, and his marrow is diffused throughout him.

fresh_translation: But another dies in bitterness of soul, not having eaten any good thing.
brenton_translation: And another dies in bitterness of soul, not eating any good thing.

fresh_translation: Yet together they lie down on earth, and rot covered them.
brenton_translation: But they lie down in the earth together, and corruption covers them.

fresh_translation: So I know that you boldly press upon me.
brenton_translation: So I know you, that ye presumptuously attack me:

fresh_translation: For you will say, Where is the house of a ruler, and where is the shelter of the tents of ungodly men?
brenton_translation: so that ye will say, Where is the house of the prince? and where is the covering of the tabernacles of the ungodly?

fresh_translation: Ask those passing along way, and you will not reject their signs.
brenton_translation: Ask those that go by the way, and do not disown their tokens.

fresh_translation: For wicked man is spared in the day of destruction; they will be led away in the day of his wrath.
brenton_translation: For the wicked hastens to the day of destruction: they shall be led away for the day of his vengeance.

fresh_translation: Who will declare his way to his face? And what he did, who will repay to him?
brenton_translation: Who will tell him his way to his face, whereas he has done it? who shall recompense him?

fresh_translation: And he was carried off to tombs, and kept watch over on mound.
brenton_translation: And he has been led away to the tombs, and he has watched over the heaps.

fresh_translation: The pebbles of a torrent were sweet to him, and after him every man will depart, and before him were beyond number.
brenton_translation: The stones of the valley have been sweet to him, and every man shall depart after him, and there are innumerable ones before him.

fresh_translation: How then do you comfort me with empty things? To make me cease from you, nothing remains.
brenton_translation: How then do ye comfort me in vain? whereas I have no rest from your molestation.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Eliphaz the Temanite says,
brenton_translation: Then Eliphaz the Thæmanite answered and said,

fresh_translation: Is it not the Lord who teaches understanding and knowledge?
brenton_translation: Is it not the Lord that teaches understanding and knowledge?

fresh_translation: For what does it matter to the Lord if you were blameless in works, or what profit if you made your way simple?
brenton_translation: For what matters it to the Lord, if thou wert blameless in thy works? or is it profitable that thou shouldest perfect thy way?

fresh_translation: Will he reprove you because he takes account of your words, and enter judgment with you?
brenton_translation: Wilt thou maintain and plead thine own cause? and will he enter into judgment with thee?

fresh_translation: Is not your evil great, and your sins beyond number?
brenton_translation: Is not thy wickedness abundant, and thy sins innumerable?

fresh_translation: You took pledges from your brothers for nothing, and stripped clothing from naked men.
brenton_translation: And thou hast taken security of thy brethren for nothing, and hast taken away the clothing of the naked.

fresh_translation: You did not give water to thirsty men, but withheld bread from hungry men.
brenton_translation: Neither hast thou given water to the thirsty to drink, but hast taken away the morsel of the hungry.

fresh_translation: And you admired faces of certain men, and settled those upon earth.
brenton_translation: And thou hast accepted the persons of some; and thou hast established those that were already settled on the earth.

fresh_translation: But you sent widows away empty, and afflicted orphans.
brenton_translation: But thou hast sent widows away empty, and hast afflicted orphans.

fresh_translation: Therefore snares encircled you, and extraordinary war made you hurry.
brenton_translation: Therefore snares have compassed thee, and disastrous war has troubled thee.

fresh_translation: The light turned to darkness for you, and water covered you as you slept.
brenton_translation: The light has proved darkness to thee, and water has covered thee on thy lying down.

fresh_translation: Is not he who dwells in heights watching, and he humbled those carried in arrogance?
brenton_translation: Does not he that dwells in the high places observe? and has he not brought down the proud?

fresh_translation: And you said, What did Mighty One know? Does he judge through thick gloom?
brenton_translation: And thou hast said, What does the Mighty One know? does he judge in the dark?

fresh_translation: Clouds are his hiding place, and he will not be seen; and he walks about circuit of heaven.
brenton_translation: A cloud is his hiding-place, and he shall not be seen; and he passes through the circle of heaven.

fresh_translation: Will you keep the ancient path which unjust men trod,
brenton_translation: Wilt thou not mark the old way, which righteous men have trodden?

fresh_translation: who were seized before their time, their foundations a river pouring over?
brenton_translation: who were seized before their time: their foundations are as an overflowing stream.

fresh_translation: Who say, What will the Lord do to us, or what will Almighty bring upon us?
brenton_translation: Who say, What will the Lord do to us? or what will the Almighty bring upon us?

fresh_translation: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of ungodly men is far from him.
brenton_translation: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from him.

fresh_translation: Righteous men saw and laughed, and blameless one mocked.
brenton_translation: The righteous have seen it, and laughed, and the blameless one has derided them.

fresh_translation: If indeed their substance did not vanish, and fire will devour what remains of them.
brenton_translation: Verily their substance has been utterly destroyed, and the fire shall devour what is left of their property.

fresh_translation: Become firm then, if you endure, and then your fruit will be in good things.
brenton_translation: Be firm, I pray thee, if thou canst endure; then thy fruit shall prosper.

fresh_translation: Receive declaration from his mouth, and take his words into your heart.
brenton_translation: And receive a declaration from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

fresh_translation: And if you return and humble yourself before the Lord, you made injustice far from your dwelling.
brenton_translation: And if thou shalt turn and humble thyself before the Lord, thou hast thus removed unrighteousness far from thy habitation.

fresh_translation: You will place Ophir on rock in dust and as torrent-stones among rocks.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt lay up for thyself treasure in a heap on the rock; and Sophir shall be as the rock of the torrent.

fresh_translation: Then Almighty will be your helper against enemies, and will restore you pure like silver refined by fire.
brenton_translation: So the Almighty shall be thy helper from enemies, and he shall bring thee forth pure as silver that has been tried by fire.

fresh_translation: Then you will speak boldly before the Lord, looking up to heaven with cheerfulness.
brenton_translation: Then shalt thou have boldness before the Lord, looking up cheerfully to heaven.

fresh_translation: And when you pray to him, he will hear you, and will give you to pay your vows.
brenton_translation: And he shall hear thee when thou prayest to him, and he shall grant thee power to pay thy vows.

fresh_translation: And he will restore to you dwelling of righteousness, and upon your ways there will be light.
brenton_translation: And he shall establish to thee again a habitation of righteousness and there shall be light upon thy paths.

fresh_translation: For he humbled him, and you will say, He acted proudly; but one bent in eyes he will save.
brenton_translation: Because thou hast humbled thyself; and thou shalt say, Man has behaved proudly, but he shall save him that is of lowly eyes.

fresh_translation: He will rescue innocent one, and be saved through purity of your hands.
brenton_translation: He shall deliver the innocent, and do thou save thyself by thy pure hands.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Job says,
brenton_translation: Then Job answered and said,

fresh_translation: And now I know that my reproof is from my hand, and his hand has become heavy upon my groaning.
brenton_translation: Yea, I know that pleading is out of my reach; and his hand has been made heavy upon my groaning.

fresh_translation: Who then would know that I might find him and come to end?
brenton_translation: Who would then know that I might find him, and come to an end of the matter?

fresh_translation: I would state my judgment to myself, and fill my mouth with reproofs.
brenton_translation: And I would plead my own cause, and he would fill my mouth with arguments.

fresh_translation: And I would know words that he will say to me, and perceive what he will tell me.
brenton_translation: And I would know the remedies which he would speak to me, and I would perceive what he would tell me.

fresh_translation: And if he comes upon me in much strength, then he will not use threats against me.
brenton_translation: Though he should come on me in his great strength, then he would not threaten me;

fresh_translation: For truth and reproof are from him, and he would bring my judgment out to end.
brenton_translation: for truth and reproof are from him; and he would bring forth my judgment to an end.

fresh_translation: For I will go to first things, and I am no longer there; and at last things, what do I know?
brenton_translation: For if I shall go first, and exist no longer, still what do I know concerning the latter end?

fresh_translation: When he works on left, I did not grasp it; he will wrap right side, and I will not see.
brenton_translation: When he wrought on the left hand, then I observed it not: his right hand shall encompass me but I shall not see it.

fresh_translation: For he already knows my way, and he judged me like gold.
brenton_translation: For he knows already my way; and he has tried me as gold.

fresh_translation: And I will come forth in his commands; for I kept his ways and will by no means turn aside.
brenton_translation: And I will go forth according to his commandments, for I have kept his ways; and I shall not turn aside from his commandments,

fresh_translation: And I will by no means pass beyond his commands; in my bosom I hid his words.
brenton_translation: neither shall I transgress; but I have hid his words in my bosom.

fresh_translation: But if he judged thus, who is one contradicting him? For what he himself willed, he also did.
brenton_translation: And if too he has thus judged, who is he that has contradicted, for he has both willed a thing and done it.

fresh_translation: Because of this I hurried at him; being admonished, I took thought of him. Because of this let one make haste from his face; I will consider and be alarmed because of him.
brenton_translation: Therefore am I troubled at him; and when I was reproved, I thought of him.

fresh_translation: But the Lord softened my heart, and Almighty made me hurry.
brenton_translation: But the Lord has softened my heart, and the Almighty has troubled me.

fresh_translation: For I did not know that darkness would come upon me, and gloom covered me before my face.
brenton_translation: For I knew not that darkness would come upon me, and thick darkness has covered me before my face.

fresh_translation: Why then were seasons hidden from the Lord?
brenton_translation: But why have the seasons been hidden from the Lord,

fresh_translation: But ungodly men crossed boundary, seizing flock together with shepherd.
brenton_translation: while the ungodly have passed over the bound, carrying off the flock with the shepherd?

fresh_translation: They drove away orphan's donkey and took widow's ox as pledge.
brenton_translation: They have led away the ass of the fatherless, and taken the widow's ox for a pledge.

fresh_translation: They turned weak ones aside from right way; together meek ones of earth were hidden.
brenton_translation: They have turned aside the weak from the right way: and the meek of the earth have hidden themselves together.

fresh_translation: They went out like donkeys in the field against me, going forth to their own labor; bread became sweet to him for younger ones.
brenton_translation: And they have departed like asses in the field, having gone forth on my account according to their own order: his bread is sweet to his little ones.

fresh_translation: Before the right time they reaped a field not their own, and weak men worked the vineyards of ungodly men without pay and unfed.
brenton_translation: They have reaped a field that was not their own before the time: the poor have laboured in the vineyards of the ungodly without pay and without food.

fresh_translation: They put many naked ones to sleep without clothing, and took away covering of their souls.
brenton_translation: They have caused many naked to sleep without clothes, and they have taken away the covering of their body.

fresh_translation: They are drenched by mountain showers; because they have no shelter, they wrapped themselves around rock.
brenton_translation: They are wet with the drops of the mountains: they have embraced the rock, because they had no shelter.

fresh_translation: They snatched orphan from the breast, and humbled one who had fallen out.
brenton_translation: They have snatched the fatherless from the breast, and have afflicted the outcast.

fresh_translation: They put naked men to sleep unjustly, and took away bread from hungry men.
brenton_translation: And they have wrongfully caused others to sleep without clothing, and taken away the morsel of the hungry.

fresh_translation: In narrow places they lay in wait unjustly, and they did not know a righteous way.
brenton_translation: They have unrighteously laid wait in narrow places, and have not known the righteous way.

fresh_translation: They were cast out from the city and their own houses, and soul of infants groaned greatly. Yet why has he not made inspection of these things?
brenton_translation: Who have cast forth the poor from the city and their own houses, and the soul of the children has groaned aloud.

fresh_translation: While they were on earth, they did not recognize way of righteousness, nor knew its paths, nor walked them.
brenton_translation: Why then has he not visited these? forasmuch as they were upon the earth, and took no notice, and they knew not the way of righteousness, neither have they walked in their appointed paths?

fresh_translation: But knowing their works, he handed them over to darkness, and in night he will be like thief.
brenton_translation: But having known their works, he delivered them into darkness: and in the night one will be as a thief:

fresh_translation: And eye of adulterer watched darkness, saying, Eye will not notice me, and he put hiddenness of face.
brenton_translation: and the eye of the adulterer has watched for the darkness, saying, Eye shall not perceive me, and he puts a covering on his face.

fresh_translation: In darkness he dug through houses; by day they sealed themselves up; they did not know light.
brenton_translation: In darkness he digs through houses: by day they conceal themselves securely: they know not the light.

fresh_translation: For morning is to them the shadow of death, because he will recognize terrors of the shadow of death.
brenton_translation: For the morning is to them all as the shadow of death, for each will be conscious of the terror of the shadow of death.

fresh_translation: He is light upon the face of water; let their portion be cursed upon earth.
brenton_translation: He is swift on the face of the water: let his portion be cursed on the earth; and let their plants be laid bare.

fresh_translation: And let their plants appear upon dry earth, for they snatched embrace of orphans.
brenton_translation: Let them be withered upon the earth; for they have plundered the sheaves of the fatherless.

fresh_translation: Then his sin was remembered; like mist of dew he became unseen. Let what he did be repaid to him, and let every unjust man be shattered like incurable wood.
brenton_translation: Then is his sin brought to remembrance, and he vanishes like a vapour of dew: but let what he has done be recompensed to him, and let every unrighteous one be crushed like rotten wood.

fresh_translation: For he did not treat barren woman well, and did not pity woman.
brenton_translation: For he has not treated the barren woman well, and has had no pity on a feeble woman.

fresh_translation: But by wrath he overthrew weak men; therefore rising up he will by no means trust in his own life.
brenton_translation: And in wrath he has overthrown the helpless: therefore when he has arisen, a man will not feel secure of his own life.

fresh_translation: Being softened, let him not hope to be healed, but he will fall in sickness.
brenton_translation: When he has fallen sick, let him not hope to recover: but let him perish by disease.

fresh_translation: For his exaltation afflicted many, but he withered like mallow in heat, or like ear of grain falling of itself from stalk.
brenton_translation: For his exaltation has hurt many; but he has withered as mallows in the heat, or as an ear of corn falling off of itself from the stalk.

fresh_translation: If not, who is one saying I speak lies and will make my words into nothing?
brenton_translation: But if not, who is he that says I speak falsely, and will make my words of no account?

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Bildad the Shuhite says,
brenton_translation: Then Baldad the Sauchite answered and said,

fresh_translation: For what foreword or fear is from him, he who makes whole order in highest place?
brenton_translation: What beginning or fear is his—even he that makes all things in the highest?

fresh_translation: For let no one suppose there is delay for raiders; upon whom will ambush from him not come?
brenton_translation: For let none think that there is a respite for robbers: and upon whom will there not come a snare from him?

fresh_translation: For how will mortal be righteous before the Lord, or who could cleanse himself, one born of woman?
brenton_translation: For how shall a mortal be just before the Lord? or who that is born of a woman shall purify himself?

fresh_translation: If he orders moon, and it does not shine, and stars are not clean before him,
brenton_translation: If he gives an order to the moon, then it shines not; and the stars are not pure before him.

fresh_translation: how much less man, rot, and son of man, worm.
brenton_translation: But alas! man is corruption, and the son of man a worm.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Job says,
brenton_translation: But Job answered and said,

fresh_translation: To whom will you attach yourself, and whom are you about to help? Is it not one of much strength and mighty arm?
brenton_translation: To whom dost thou attach thyself, or whom art thou going to assist? is it not he that has much strength, and he who has a strong arm?

fresh_translation: To whom did you give counsel? Is it not one of all wisdom? And whom will you follow? Is it not one of greatest power?
brenton_translation: To whom hast thou given counsel? is it not to him who has all wisdom? whom wilt thou follow? is it not one who has the greatest power?

fresh_translation: To whom did you declare words? And breath of whom is that which came out from you?
brenton_translation: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose breath is it that has come forth from thee?

fresh_translation: Will not giants be brought forth from under water, and its neighbors?
brenton_translation: Shall giants be born from under the water and the inhabitants thereof?

fresh_translation: Hades is naked before him, and destruction has no covering.
brenton_translation: Hell is naked before him, and destruction has no covering.

fresh_translation: Stretching out north over nothing, hanging earth upon nothing.
brenton_translation: He stretches out the north wind upon nothing, and he upon nothing hangs the earth;

fresh_translation: Binding water in his clouds, and cloud was not torn under him.
brenton_translation: binding water in his clouds, and the cloud is not rent under it.

fresh_translation: Holding face of throne, spreading his cloud upon it.
brenton_translation: He keeps back the face of his throne, stretching out his cloud upon it.

fresh_translation: He drew boundary by decree upon the face of water, until completion of light with darkness.
brenton_translation: He has encompassed the face of the water by an appointed ordinance, until the end of light and darkness.

fresh_translation: The pillars of heaven were spread out and were astonished at his rebuke.
brenton_translation: The pillars of heaven are prostrate and astonished at his rebuke.

fresh_translation: By strength he stilled sea, and by knowledge wounded sea-monster.
brenton_translation: He has calmed the sea with his might, and by his wisdom the whale has been overthrown.

fresh_translation: And bolts of heaven fear him, and by decree he killed dragon that turned away.
brenton_translation: And the barriers of heaven fear him, and by a command he has slain the apostate dragon.

fresh_translation: Behold, these are parts of his way, and upon mere drop of word we will hear in him; but strength of his thunder, who knows when he will make it?
brenton_translation: Behold, these are parts of his way; and we will hearken to him at the least intimation of his word: but the strength of his thunder who knows, when he shall employ it?

fresh_translation: And again adding, Job said in his opening discourse,
brenton_translation: And Job further continued and said in his parable,

fresh_translation: As the Lord lives, who has judged me thus, and Almighty, who embittered my soul,
brenton_translation: As God lives, who has thus judged me; and the Almighty, who has embittered my soul;

fresh_translation: as long as my breath is still in me and divine spirit in my nostrils,
brenton_translation: verily, while my breath is yet in me, and the breath of God which remains to me is in my nostrils,

fresh_translation: my lips will by no means speak lawless things, nor will my soul meditate unjust things.
brenton_translation: my lips shall not speak evil words, neither shall my soul meditate unrighteous thoughts.

fresh_translation: Far be it from me to declare you righteous until I die, for I will not put away my innocence.
brenton_translation: Far be it from me that I should justify you till I die; for I will not let go my innocence,

fresh_translation: And clinging to righteousness, I will by no means let go, for I am not conscious to myself of having done improper things.
brenton_translation: but keeping fast to my righteousness I will by no means let it go: for I am not conscious to myself of having done any thing amiss.

fresh_translation: Yet let my enemies be as the overthrow of ungodly men, and those rising against me as the destruction of lawless men.
brenton_translation: Nay rather, but let mine enemies be as the overthrow of the ungodly, and they that rise up against me, as the destruction of transgressors.

fresh_translation: For what hope is there for an ungodly man, that he clings, trusting upon the Lord? Will he be saved?
brenton_translation: For what is the hope of the ungodly, that he holds to it? will he indeed trust in the Lord and be saved?

fresh_translation: Or will the Lord hear his petition, or when necessity comes upon him?
brenton_translation: Will God hear his prayer? or, when distress has come upon him,

fresh_translation: Does he have any boldness before him, or when he calls upon him, will he hear him?
brenton_translation: has he any confidence before him? or will God hear him as he calls upon him?

fresh_translation: But now I will declare to you what is in the hand of the Lord; what things are with Almighty I will not lie about.
brenton_translation: Yet now I will tell you what is in the hand of the Lord: I will not lie concerning the things which are with the Almighty.

fresh_translation: Behold now, you all know that you heap empty things upon empty things.
brenton_translation: Behold, ye all know that ye are adding vanity to vanity.

fresh_translation: This is the portion of an ungodly man from the Lord, and possession of tyrants will come upon them from Almighty.
brenton_translation: This is the portion of an ungodly man from the Lord, and the possession of oppressors shall come upon them from the Almighty.

fresh_translation: And if his sons become many, they will be for slaughter; and if they grow into men, they will beg.
brenton_translation: And if their children be many, they shall be for slaughter: and if they grow up, they shall beg.

fresh_translation: And those left of him will end in death, and no one will pity their widows.
brenton_translation: And they that survive of him shall utterly perish, and no one shall pity their widows.

fresh_translation: If he gathers silver like earth, and prepares gold like clay,
brenton_translation: Even if he should gather silver as earth, and prepare gold as clay;

fresh_translation: righteous men will obtain all these things, and true men will hold his goods.
brenton_translation: all these things shall the righteous gain, and the truehearted shall possess his wealth.

fresh_translation: And his house turned out like a moth, and like a spider.
brenton_translation: And his house is gone like moths, and like a spider's web.

fresh_translation: Rich man, having lain down, will add no more; he opened his eyes, and he is not.
brenton_translation: The rich man shall lie down, and shall not continue: he has opened his eyes, and he is not.

fresh_translation: Pains met him like water, and by night gloom carried him away.
brenton_translation: Pains have come upon him as water, and darkness has carried him away by night.

fresh_translation: Scorching wind will carry him off and depart, and will winnow him from his place.
brenton_translation: And a burning wind shall catch him, and he shall depart, and it shall utterly drive him out of his place.

fresh_translation: And it will hurl itself upon him and not spare; fleeing, he will flee from its hand.
brenton_translation: And God shall cast trouble upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

fresh_translation: He will clap his hands against him and hiss him out of his place.
brenton_translation: He shall cause men to clap their hands against them, and shall hiss him out of his place.

fresh_translation: For silver has place from where it comes, and gold place from where it is refined.
brenton_translation: For there is a place for the silver, whence it comes, and a place for the gold, whence it is refined.

fresh_translation: For iron comes from earth, and bronze is quarried like stone.
brenton_translation: For iron comes out of the earth, and brass is hewn out like stone.

fresh_translation: He set order for darkness, and he himself searches out every limit, stone of gloom and the shadow of death.
brenton_translation: He has set a bound to darkness, and he searches out every limit: a stone is darkness, and the shadow of death.

fresh_translation: Torrent breaks off from dust, and those forgetting a righteous way grew weak among mortals.
brenton_translation: There is a cutting off of the torrent by reason of dust: so they that forget the right way are weakened; they are removed from among men.

fresh_translation: Earth, from it bread will come out, but underneath it is turned up as by fire.
brenton_translation: As for the earth, out of it shall come bread: under it has been turned up as it were fire.

fresh_translation: Its stones are place of sapphire, and its dust has gold with it.
brenton_translation: Her stones are the place of the sapphire: and her dust supplies man with gold.

fresh_translation: Bird did not know that path, nor did eye of vulture look upon it.
brenton_translation: There is a path, the fowl has not known it, neither has the eye of the vulture seen it:

fresh_translation: Sons of arrogant men did not tread it, nor did lion pass over it.
brenton_translation: neither have the sons of the proud trodden it, a lion has not passed upon it.

fresh_translation: He stretched out his hand upon sharp rock, and overturned mountains from roots.
brenton_translation: He has stretched forth his hand on the sharp rock, and turned up mountains by the roots:

fresh_translation: And he broke open whirlings of rivers, and my eye saw every precious thing.
brenton_translation: and he has interrupted the whirlpools of rivers, and mine eye has seen every precious thing.

fresh_translation: And he uncovered depths of rivers and brought his power into light.
brenton_translation: And he has laid bare the depths of rivers, and has brought his power to light.

fresh_translation: But wisdom, from where was it found? And what place is there for knowledge?
brenton_translation: But whence has wisdom been discovered? and what is the place of knowledge?

fresh_translation: Mortal does not know its way, nor will it be found among men.
brenton_translation: A mortal has not known its way, neither indeed has it been discovered among men.

fresh_translation: Deep said, It is not in me, and sea said, It is not with me.
brenton_translation: The depth said, It is not in me: and the sea said, It is not with me.

fresh_translation: He will not give enclosure in exchange for it, and silver will not stand as its price.
brenton_translation: One shall not give fine gold instead of it, neither shall silver be weighed in exchange for it.

fresh_translation: Nor will it be weighed with gold of Ophir, with precious onyx and sapphire.
brenton_translation: Neither shall it be compared with gold of Sophir, with the precious onyx and sapphire.

fresh_translation: Gold and glass will not equal it, and exchange for it is vessels of gold.
brenton_translation: Gold and crystal shall not be equalled to it, neither shall vessels of gold be its exchange.

fresh_translation: Coral and crystal will not be remembered, and draw wisdom above innermost things.
brenton_translation: Coral and fine pearl shall not be mentioned: but do thou esteem wisdom above the most precious things.

fresh_translation: Topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it, nor will it be weighed with pure gold.
brenton_translation: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not be equalled to it; it shall not be compared with pure gold.

fresh_translation: But wisdom, from where was it found? And what place is there for understanding?
brenton_translation: Whence then is wisdom found? and of what kind is the place of understanding?

fresh_translation: It escaped every man and was hidden from the birds of heaven.
brenton_translation: It has escaped the notice of every man, and has been hidden from the birds of the sky.

fresh_translation: Destruction and death said, We heard its fame.
brenton_translation: Destruction and Death said, We have heard the report of it.

fresh_translation: God well understood its way, and he knows its place.
brenton_translation: God has well ordered the way of it, and he knows the place of it.

fresh_translation: For he watches all that is under heaven, knowing all things on earth, whatever he made.
brenton_translation: For he surveys the whole earth under heaven, knowing the things in the earth:

fresh_translation: Weight of winds and measures of waters,
brenton_translation: all that he has made; the weight of the winds, the measures of the water.

fresh_translation: when he thus made rain and counted it, and path in roaring voices.
brenton_translation: When he made them, thus he saw and numbered them, and made a way for the pealing of the thunder.

fresh_translation: Then he saw it and declared it, preparing it and searching it out.
brenton_translation: Then he saw it, and declared it: he prepared it and traced it out.

fresh_translation: And he said to man, Behold, godliness is wisdom, and to abstain from evils is understanding.
brenton_translation: And he said to man, Behold, godliness is wisdom; and to abstain from evil is understanding.

fresh_translation: And again adding, Job said in his opening discourse,
brenton_translation: And Job continued and said in his parable,

fresh_translation: Who might set me as in months before, in days when God guarded me,
brenton_translation: Oh that I were as in months past, wherein God preserved me!

fresh_translation: as when his lamp shone over my head, when by his light I walked in darkness,
brenton_translation: As when his lamp shone over my head; when by his light I walked through darkness.

fresh_translation: when I was heavy upon my ways, when God made visitation of my house,
brenton_translation: As when I steadfastly pursued my ways, when God took care of my house.

fresh_translation: when I was very leafy, and my children round about me,
brenton_translation: When I was very fruitful, and my children were about me;

fresh_translation: when my ways were poured out with butter, and my mountains poured out milk,
brenton_translation: when my ways were moistened with butter, and the mountains flowed for me with milk.

fresh_translation: when I went out early in the city, and my seat was set in squares,
brenton_translation: When I went forth early in the city, and the seat was placed for me in the streets.

fresh_translation: young men seeing me hid themselves, and all elders stood up,
brenton_translation: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and all the old men stood up.

fresh_translation: and great men stopped speaking, putting finger upon mouth.
brenton_translation: And the great men ceased speaking, and laid their finger on their mouth.

fresh_translation: And those hearing me blessed me, and their tongue stuck to their throat.
brenton_translation: And they that heard me blessed me, and their tongue clave to their throat.

fresh_translation: For ear heard and blessed me, and eye seeing me turned aside toward me,
brenton_translation: For the ear heard, and blessed me; and the eye saw me, and turned aside.

fresh_translation: because I rescued a poor man from the hand of a mighty man, and I helped an orphan who had no helper.
brenton_translation: For I saved the poor out of the hand of the oppressor, and helped the fatherless who had no helper.

fresh_translation: The blessing of one perishing came upon me, and the mouth of the widow blessed me.
brenton_translation: Let the blessing of the perishing one come upon me; yea, the mouth of the widow has blessed me.

fresh_translation: And I put on righteousness and clothed myself with judgment like double robe.
brenton_translation: Also I put on righteousness, and clothed myself with judgment like a mantle.

fresh_translation: I was the eye of the blind and foot of the lame.
brenton_translation: I was the eye of the blind, and the foot of the lame.

fresh_translation: I was a father to weak men, and case that I did not know I searched out.
brenton_translation: I was the father of the helpless; and I searched out the cause which I knew not.

fresh_translation: And I shattered jaws of unjust men, and from the midst of their teeth I snatched prey.
brenton_translation: And I broke the jaw-teeth of the unrighteous; I plucked the spoil out of the midst of their teeth.

fresh_translation: And I said, My age will grow old like stem of palm; I will live long time.
brenton_translation: And I said, My age shall continue as the stem of a palm-tree; I shall live a long while.

fresh_translation: My root is opened upon water, and dew will lodge in my harvest.
brenton_translation: My root was spread out by the water, and the dew would lodge on my crop.

fresh_translation: My glory is fresh with me, and my bow will go in his hand.
brenton_translation: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow prospered in his hand.

fresh_translation: Hearing me, they paid attention, and kept silence at my counsel.
brenton_translation: Men heard me, and gave heed, and they were silent at my counsel.

fresh_translation: And upon my word they added nothing, and they became joyful whenever I spoke to them.
brenton_translation: At my word they spoke not again, and they were very glad whenever I spoke to them.

fresh_translation: Like thirsty earth expecting rain, so these expected my speech.
brenton_translation: As the thirsty earth expecting the rain, so they waited for my speech.

fresh_translation: If I laugh toward them, they will by no means believe, and light of my face did not fall away.
brenton_translation: Were I to laugh on them, they would not believe it; and the light of my face has not failed.

fresh_translation: I chose their way and sat as a ruler, and dwelt like king among lone-belted men, as one comforting those in grief.
brenton_translation: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the midst of warriors, as one comforting mourners.

fresh_translation: But now least men laughed at me; now they admonish me in part, whose fathers I despised, whom I did not count worthy of dogs of my flocks.
brenton_translation: But now the youngest have laughed me to scorn, now they reprove me in their turn, whose fathers I set at nought; whom I did not deem worthy to be with my shepherd dogs.

fresh_translation: And strength of their hands, why should it be to me? Completion perished upon them.
brenton_translation: Yea, why had I the strength of their hands? for them the full term of life was lost.

fresh_translation: In want and famine, barren men, fleeing dry place yesterday, distress and misery,
brenton_translation: One is childless in want and famine, such as they that fled but lately the distress and misery of drought.

fresh_translation: plucking saltwort upon scrub, whose foods were saltwort, dishonored and made worthless, lacking every good thing, even chewing roots of trees because of great hunger.
brenton_translation: Who compass the salt places on the sounding shore, who had salt herbs for their food, and were dishonourable and of no repute, in want of every good thing; who also ate roots of trees by reason of great hunger.

fresh_translation: Robbers rose against me.
brenton_translation: Thieves have risen up against me,

fresh_translation: Whose houses were caves of rocks.
brenton_translation: whose houses were the caves of the rocks, who lived under the wild shrubs.

fresh_translation: Among pleasant-sounding places they will cry out; under wild brush they had their way of life.
brenton_translation: They will cry out among the rustling bushes.

fresh_translation: Sons of fools and dishonored men, name and fame wiped out from earth.
brenton_translation: They are sons of fools and vile men, whose name and glory are quenched from off the earth.

fresh_translation: But now I am their harp, and they have me for byword.
brenton_translation: But now I am their music, and they have me for a by-word.

fresh_translation: And standing far off they abhorred me, and they did not spare spittle from my face.
brenton_translation: And they stood aloof and abhorred me, and spared not to spit in my face.

fresh_translation: For opening his quiver he afflicted me, and they sent away bridle from my face.
brenton_translation: For he has opened his quiver and afflicted me: they also have cast off the restraint of my presence.

fresh_translation: On right hand shoot rose against me; they stretched out their foot and made roads of their destruction against me.
brenton_translation: They have risen up against me on the right hand of their offspring; they have stretched out their foot, and directed against me the ways of their destruction.

fresh_translation: My paths were crushed, for he stripped off my garment.
brenton_translation: My paths are ruined; for they have stripped off my raiment: he has shot at me with his weapons.

fresh_translation: With his arrows he struck me down; he dealt with me as he wished; I am mixed up in pains.
brenton_translation: And he has pleaded against me as he will: I am overwhelmed with pains.

fresh_translation: My pains turn back upon me; my hope went away like wind, and my salvation like a cloud.
brenton_translation: My pains return upon me; my hope is gone like the wind, and my safety as a cloud.

fresh_translation: And now my soul will be poured out upon me, and days of pains hold me.
brenton_translation: Even now my life shall be poured forth upon me; and days of anguish seize me.

fresh_translation: And by night my bones are burned together, and my sinews are dissolved.
brenton_translation: And by night my bones are confounded; and my sinews are relaxed.

fresh_translation: In much strength he took hold of my garment; like collar of my tunic it encircled me.
brenton_translation: With great force my disease has taken hold of my garment: it has compassed me as the collar of my coat.

fresh_translation: And you counted me like clay in earth, and ash is my portion.
brenton_translation: And thou hast counted me as clay; my portion is in dust and ashes.

fresh_translation: And I cried to you, and you do not hear me; they stood and observed me.
brenton_translation: And I have cried to thee, but thou hearest me not: but they stood still, and observed me.

fresh_translation: And you came upon me without mercy; with mighty hand you scourged me.
brenton_translation: They attacked me also without mercy: thou hast scourged me with a strong hand.

fresh_translation: And you appointed me in pains and cast me away from salvation.
brenton_translation: And thou hast put me to grief, and hast cast me away from safety.

fresh_translation: For I know that death will wear me out, for the earth is a house for every mortal.
brenton_translation: For I know that death will destroy me: for the earth is the house appointed for every mortal.

fresh_translation: For if only I might be able to lay hand on myself; and having asked another, he will do this for me.
brenton_translation: Oh then that I might lay hands upon myself, or at least ask another, and he should do this for me.

fresh_translation: But I wept over every weak man, and groaned when seeing man in necessities.
brenton_translation: Yet I wept over every helpless man; I groaned when I saw a man in distress.

fresh_translation: But I, waiting for good things, behold, days of evils met me rather.
brenton_translation: But I, when I waited for good things, behold, days of evils came the more upon me.

fresh_translation: My belly boiled and will not be silent; days of poverty came before me.
brenton_translation: My belly boiled, and would not cease: the days of poverty prevented me.

fresh_translation: Groaning, I have gone without muzzle; I stood in assembly crying out.
brenton_translation: I went mourning without restraint: and I have stood and cried out in the assembly.

fresh_translation: I have become brother of sirens and companion of ostriches.
brenton_translation: I am become a brother of monsters, and a companion of ostriches.

fresh_translation: And my skin is greatly blackened, and my bones from heat.
brenton_translation: And my skin has been greatly blackened, and my bones are burned with heat.

fresh_translation: And my harp turned to mourning, and my song to weeping for me.
brenton_translation: My harp also has been turned into mourning, and my song into my weeping.

fresh_translation: I made covenant with my eyes, and I will not think upon virgin.
brenton_translation: I made a covenant with mine eyes, and I will not think upon a virgin.

fresh_translation: And what did God divide from above, and inheritance of Sufficient One from heights?
brenton_translation: Now what portion has God given from above? and is there an inheritance given of the Mighty One from the highest?

fresh_translation: Is it not destruction for unjust man, and estrangement for those doing lawless things?
brenton_translation: Alas! destruction to the unrighteous, and rejection to them that do iniquity.

fresh_translation: Does he not see my way and count all my steps?
brenton_translation: Will he not see my way, and number all my steps?

fresh_translation: But if I walked with mockers, and if my foot hurried toward deceit,
brenton_translation: But if I had gone with scorners, and if too my foot has hasted to deceit:

fresh_translation: let him set me then in righteous balance, and the Lord knows my innocence.
brenton_translation: (for I am weighed in a just balance, and the Lord knows my innocence:)

fresh_translation: If my foot turned aside from way, and if my heart followed eye, and if with my hands I touched gifts,
brenton_translation: if my foot has turned aside out of the way, or if mine heart has followed mine eye, and if too I have touched gifts with my hands;

fresh_translation: then let me sow and let others eat, and let me become rootless upon earth.
brenton_translation: then let me sow, and let others eat; and let me be uprooted on the earth.

fresh_translation: If my heart followed after the wife of another man, and if I sat in ambush at her doors,
brenton_translation: If my heart has gone forth after another man's wife, and if I laid wait at her doors;

fresh_translation: then let my wife please another man, and let my little ones be humbled.
brenton_translation: then let my wife also please another, and let my children be brought low.

fresh_translation: For the wrath of anger is unrestrainable, to defile the wife of a man.
brenton_translation: For the rage of anger is not to be controlled, in the case of defiling another man's wife.

fresh_translation: For it is fire burning upon all my members, which wherever it comes destroys from roots.
brenton_translation: For it is a fire burning on every side, and whomsoever it attacks, it utterly destroys.

fresh_translation: And if I despised case of my servant or my servant girl when they were contending with me,
brenton_translation: And if too I despised the judgment of my servant or my handmaid, when they pleaded with me;

fresh_translation: what then will I do when the Lord makes inspection of me, and if he makes visitation, what answer will I give?
brenton_translation: what then shall I do if the Lord should try me? and if also he should at all visit me, can I make an answer?

fresh_translation: Were they not formed in womb as I also was? And were we not made in same womb?
brenton_translation: Were not they too formed as I also was formed in the womb? yea, we were formed in the same womb.

fresh_translation: And weak men, whatever need they had, did not fail to obtain it from me, and I did not make eye of widow waste away.
brenton_translation: But the helpless missed not whatever need they had, and I did not cause the eye of the widow to fail.

fresh_translation: And if I ate my morsel alone, and did not share it with orphan,
brenton_translation: And if too I ate my morsel alone, and did not impart of it to the orphan;

fresh_translation: for from my youth I reared them as father, and from my mother's womb I guided them.
brenton_translation: (for I nourished them as a father from my youth, and guided them from my mother's womb.)

fresh_translation: And if I overlooked naked man perishing and did not clothe him,
brenton_translation: And if too I overlooked the naked as he was perishing, and did not clothe him;

fresh_translation: and weak men did not bless me, and from shearings of my lambs their shoulders were warmed,
brenton_translation: and if the poor did not bless me, and their shoulders were not warmed with the fleece of my lambs;

fresh_translation: if I lifted hand against orphan, trusting that much help surrounded me,
brenton_translation: if I lifted my hand against an orphan, trusting that my strength was far superior to his:

fresh_translation: then let my shoulder fall away from collarbone, and let my arm be broken from elbow.
brenton_translation: let then my shoulder start from the blade-bone, and my arm be crushed off from the elbow.

fresh_translation: For the fear of the Lord constrained me, and because of his burden I will not endure.
brenton_translation: For the fear of the Lord constrained me, and I cannot bear up by reason of his burden.

fresh_translation: If I made gold my strength, or trusted in precious stone,
brenton_translation: If I made gold my treasure, and if too I trusted the precious stone;

fresh_translation: and if I rejoiced because much wealth came to me, and because I laid hand upon countless things,
brenton_translation: and if too I rejoiced when my wealth was abundant, and if too I laid my hand on innumerable treasures:

fresh_translation: or if I saw sun shining, moon waning, for these things are not mine,
brenton_translation: (do we not see the shining sun eclipsed, and the moon waning? for they have not power to continue:)

fresh_translation: and if my heart was secretly deceived, and laying hand upon my mouth I kissed them,
brenton_translation: and if my heart was secretly deceived, and if I have laid my hand upon my mouth and kissed it:

fresh_translation: then let this too be counted to me as greatest lawlessness, because I lied against the Lord Most High.
brenton_translation: let this also then be reckoned to me as the greatest iniquity: for I should have lied against the Lord Most High.

fresh_translation: And if I became glad at downfall of my enemies, and my heart said, Good!
brenton_translation: And if too I was glad at the fall of mine enemies, and mine heart said, Aha!

fresh_translation: then let my ear hear my curse, and let me become a byword among my people while afflicted.
brenton_translation: let then mine ear hear my curse, and let me be a by-word among my people in my affliction.

fresh_translation: And if my servant girls often said, Who would give us of his flesh that we might be very full, because I was good?
brenton_translation: And if too my handmaids have often said, Oh that we might be satisfied with his flesh; (whereas I was very kind:

fresh_translation: Stranger did not lodge outside, and my door stood open to every comer.
brenton_translation: for the stranger did not lodge without, and my door was opened to every one that came:)

fresh_translation: And if sinning unwillingly I hid my sin,
brenton_translation: or if too having sinned unintentionally, I hid my sin;

fresh_translation: for I was not ashamed of great crowd, so as not to confess before them, and if I let weak man not go out from my empty bosom-door,
brenton_translation: (for I did not stand in awe of a great multitude, so as not to declare boldly before them:) and if too I permitted a poor man to go out of my door with an empty bosom:

fresh_translation: who would grant one hearing me? And if not, the hand of the Lord I would have feared. And written indictment I had against someone.
brenton_translation: (Oh that I had a hearer,) and if I had not feared the hand of the Lord; and as to the written charge which I had against any one,

fresh_translation: Placing it upon my shoulders, I would read it as crown.
brenton_translation: I would place it as a chaplet on my shoulders, and read it.

fresh_translation: And if, not tearing it up, I repaid nothing taken from debtor,
brenton_translation: And if I did not read it and return it, having taken nothing from the debtor:

fresh_translation: if ever land groaned against me, and its furrows wept together,
brenton_translation: If at any time the land groaned against me, and if its furrows mourned together;

fresh_translation: and if I ate its strength alone without payment, and grieving I cast out soul of lord of land,
brenton_translation: and if I ate its strength alone without price, and if too I grieved the heart of the owner of the soil, by taking aught from him:

fresh_translation: then let nettle come out for me instead of wheat, and thorn-bush instead of barley. And Job ceased from words.
brenton_translation: then let the nettle come up to me instead of wheat, and a bramble instead of barley. And Job ceased speaking.

fresh_translation: And his three friends were quiet, no longer answering Job, for Job was righteous before them.
brenton_translation: And his three friends also ceased any longer to answer Job: for Job was righteous before them.

fresh_translation: And Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite of kin of Ram from the country of Uz was angered; and against Job he was greatly angered because he declared himself righteous before the Lord.
brenton_translation: Then Elius the son of Barachiel, the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram, of the country of Ausis, was angered: and he was very angry with Job, because he justified himself before the Lord.
