fresh_translation: And against the three friends he was greatly angered, because they were not able to answer contrary things to Job, and they made him out to be ungodly.
brenton_translation: And he was also very angry with his three friends, because they were not able to return answers to Job, yet set him down for an ungodly man.

fresh_translation: But Elihu waited to give answer to Job because they were older than he in days.
brenton_translation: But Elius had forborne to give an answer to Job, because they were older than he.

fresh_translation: And Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, and his wrath became angry.
brenton_translation: And Elius saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men; and he was angered in his wrath.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite said, I am younger in time, but you are elders; therefore I kept silent, fearing to declare to you my own knowledge.
brenton_translation: And Elius the Buzite the son of Barachiel answered and said,

fresh_translation: And I said, Time is what speaks, and in many years they know wisdom.
brenton_translation: And I said, It is not time that speaks, though in many years men know wisdom:

fresh_translation: But spirit is in mortals, and breath of Almighty is what teaches.
brenton_translation: but there is a spirit in mortals; and the inspiration of the Almighty is that which teaches.

fresh_translation: Not long-lived men are wise, nor do elders know judgment.
brenton_translation: The long-lived are not wise as such; neither do the aged know judgment.

fresh_translation: Therefore I said, Hear me, and I will declare to you what I know.
brenton_translation: Wherefore I said, Hear me, and I will tell you what I know.

fresh_translation: Give ear to my words, for I will speak with you listening, until you test sayings.
brenton_translation: Hearken to my words; for I will speak in your hearing, until ye shall have tried the matter with words:

fresh_translation: And up to you I will understand. And behold, there was none from you reproving Job or answering his words.
brenton_translation: and I shall understand as far as you; and, behold, there was no one of you that answered Job his words in argument,

fresh_translation: Lest you say, We found wisdom by adding to the Lord.
brenton_translation: lest ye should say, We have found that we have added wisdom to the Lord.

fresh_translation: But you allowed man to speak such words.
brenton_translation: And ye have commissioned a man to speak such words.

fresh_translation: They were terrified; they answered no more; words grew old from them.
brenton_translation: They were afraid, they answered no longer; they gave up their speaking.

fresh_translation: I waited, for they did not speak, because they stood and did not answer.
brenton_translation: I waited, (for I had not spoken,) because they stood still, they answered not.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Elihu says,
brenton_translation: And Elius continued, and said, I will again speak,

fresh_translation: Again I will speak, for I am full of words; spirit of my belly destroys me.
brenton_translation: for I am full of words, for the spirit of my belly destroys me.

fresh_translation: And my belly is like a skin-bag of sweet wine boiling, tied up, or like broken bronze-worker's bellows.
brenton_translation: And my belly is as a skin of sweet wine bound up and ready to burst; or as a brazier's labouring bellows.

fresh_translation: I will speak, that I may have rest, opening my lips.
brenton_translation: I will speak, that I may open my lips and relieve myself.

fresh_translation: For I will not be ashamed before man, nor indeed will I feel shame before mortal.
brenton_translation: For truly I will not be awed because of man, nor indeed will I be confounded before a mortal.

fresh_translation: For I do not know how to admire face, else moths would eat even me.
brenton_translation: For I know not how to respect persons: and if otherwise, even the moths would eat me.

fresh_translation: Yet hear my words, Job, and give ear to my speech.
brenton_translation: Howbeit hear, Job, my words, and hearken to my speech.

fresh_translation: For behold, I opened my mouth, and my tongue spoke.
brenton_translation: For behold, I have opened my mouth, and my tongue has spoken.

fresh_translation: My heart is pure in words, and understanding of my lips knows purely.
brenton_translation: My heart shall be found pure by my words; and the understanding of my lips shall meditate purity.

fresh_translation: Divine spirit made me, and breath of Almighty teaches me.
brenton_translation: The Divine Spirit is that which formed me, and the breath of the Almighty that which teaches me.

fresh_translation: If you are able, give me answer to these things; endure, stand against me, and I against you.
brenton_translation: If thou canst, give me an answer: wait therefore; stand against me, and I will stand against thee.

fresh_translation: You were fashioned from clay as I also; from same thing we were formed.
brenton_translation: Thou art formed out of the clay as also I: we have been formed out of the same substance.

fresh_translation: My fear will not whirl you, nor will my hand be heavy upon you.
brenton_translation: My fear shall not terrify thee, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

fresh_translation: Still, you said in my ears, and I heard the voice of your words,
brenton_translation: But thou hast said in mine ears, (I have heard the voice of thy words;) because thou sayest, I am pure, not having sinned;

fresh_translation: saying, I am pure, not sinning; I am blameless, for I did not act lawlessly.
brenton_translation: I am blameless, for I have not transgressed.

fresh_translation: But he found complaint against me and counts me as opponent.
brenton_translation: Yet he has discovered a charge against me, and he has reckoned me as an adversary.

fresh_translation: And he put my foot in stocks, and watched all my ways.
brenton_translation: And he has put my foot in the stocks, and has watched all my ways.

fresh_translation: For how do you say, I am righteous, and Eternal did not hear me? For he is eternal above mortals.
brenton_translation: For how sayest thou, I am righteous, yet he has not hearkened to me? for he that is above mortals is eternal.

fresh_translation: And you say, Why did he not hear every word of my case?
brenton_translation: But thou sayest, Why has he not heard every word of my cause?

fresh_translation: For when the Lord speaks once, and second time in dream,
brenton_translation: For when the Lord speaks once, or a second time,

fresh_translation: or in nighttime meditation, as fearful dread falls upon men in slumberings on bed,
brenton_translation: sending a dream, or in the meditation of the night; (as when a dreadful alarm happens to fall upon men, in slumberings on the bed:)

fresh_translation: then he uncovers mind of men; in such kinds of fear he frightened them,
brenton_translation: then opens he the understanding of men: he scares them with such fearful visions:

fresh_translation: to turn man from injustice, and rescued his body from fall.
brenton_translation: to turn a man from unrighteousness, and he delivers his body from a fall.

fresh_translation: And he spared his soul from death and him from falling in war.
brenton_translation: He spares also his soul from death, and suffers him not to fall in war.

fresh_translation: And again he reproved him in weakness upon bed, and great number of his bones grew numb.
brenton_translation: And again, he chastens him with sickness on his bed, and the multitude of his bones is benumbed.

fresh_translation: And he will by no means be able to receive every edible thing of grain, and his soul will desire food.
brenton_translation: And he shall not be able to take any food, though his soul shall desire meat;

fresh_translation: Until his flesh rots away and his bones are shown bare.
brenton_translation: until his flesh shall be consumed, and he shall shew his bones bare.

fresh_translation: And his soul came near to death, and his life to Hades.
brenton_translation: His soul also draws nigh to death, and his life is in Hades.

fresh_translation: If there are a thousand death-bearing angels, not one of them will wound him, if he understands in heart to turn to the Lord and tells man his own blame and shows his folly,
brenton_translation: Though there should be a thousand messengers of death, not one of them shall wound him: if he should purpose in his heart to turn to the Lord, and declare to man his fault, and shew his folly;

fresh_translation: he will hold out against his falling into death, and will renew his body like plaster on wall, and fill his bones with marrow.
brenton_translation: he will support him, that he should not perish, and will restore his body as fresh plaster upon a wall; and he will fill his bones with marrow.

fresh_translation: And he will soften his flesh like that of infant and restore him as grown man among men.
brenton_translation: And he will make his flesh tender as that of a babe, and he will restore him among men in his full strength.

fresh_translation: And when he prays to the Lord, things will be acceptable to him, and he will enter with clean face, with confession; and he will repay righteousness to men.
brenton_translation: And he shall pray to the Lord, and his prayer shall be accepted of him; he shall enter with a cheerful countenance, with a full expression of praise: for he will render to men their due.

fresh_translation: Then man himself will blame himself, saying, What things I completed, and he did not examine me according to what I sinned.
brenton_translation: Even then a man shall blame himself, saying, What kind of things have I done? and he has not punished me according to the full amount of my sins.

fresh_translation: Save my soul from coming into corruption, and my life will see light.
brenton_translation: Deliver my soul, that it may not go to destruction, and my life shall see the light.

fresh_translation: Behold, Mighty One works all these things, three ways with man,
brenton_translation: Behold, all these things the Mighty One works in a threefold manner with a man.

fresh_translation: but he rescued my soul from death, so that my life in light may praise him.
brenton_translation: And he has delivered my soul from death, that my life may praise him in the light.

fresh_translation: Give ear, Job, and hear me; be silent, and I will speak.
brenton_translation: Hearken, Job, and hear me: be silent, and I will speak.

fresh_translation: If there are words, answer me; speak, for I want to justify you.
brenton_translation: If thou hast words, answer me: speak, for I desire thee to be justified.

fresh_translation: If not, you hear me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom.
brenton_translation: If not, do thou hear me: be silent, and I will teach thee.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Elihu says,
brenton_translation: And Elius continued, and said,

fresh_translation: Hear me, wise men; you who know, give ear to what is good.
brenton_translation: Hear me, ye wise men; hearken, ye that have knowledge.

fresh_translation: For ear tests words, and throat tastes foods.
brenton_translation: For the ear tries words, and the mouth tastes meat.

fresh_translation: Let us choose judgment for ourselves; let us know among ourselves what is good.
brenton_translation: Let us choose judgment to ourselves: let us know among ourselves what is right.

fresh_translation: For Job said, I am righteous; the Lord took away my judgment.
brenton_translation: For Job has said, I am righteous: the Lord has removed my judgment.

fresh_translation: And he lied against my judgment; my arrow is violent without injustice.
brenton_translation: And he has erred in my judgment: my wound is severe without unrighteousness of mine.

fresh_translation: What man is like Job, drinking mockery like water,
brenton_translation: What man is as Job, drinking scorning like water?

fresh_translation: not sinning nor acting ungodly, but sharing road with those doing lawless things, to walk with ungodly men?
brenton_translation: saying, I have not sinned, nor committed ungodliness, nor had fellowship with workers of iniquity, to go with the ungodly.

fresh_translation: For do not say that there will not be inspection of man, and inspection for him from the Lord.
brenton_translation: For thou shouldest not say, There shall be no visitation of a man, whereas there is a visitation on him from the Lord.

fresh_translation: Therefore, you who are wise in heart, hear me: far be it from me to act impiously before the Lord, and before the Almighty to pervert what is right.
brenton_translation: Wherefore hear me, ye that are wise in heart: far be it from me to sin before the Lord, and to pervert righteousness before the Almighty.

fresh_translation: But he repays man according to what each does, and in the path of man he will find him.
brenton_translation: Yea, he renders to a man accordingly as each of them does, and in a man's path he will find him.

fresh_translation: Do not think the Lord will do strange things, or Almighty disturb judgment.
brenton_translation: And thinkest thou that the Lord will do wrong, or will the Almighty who made the earth wrest judgment?

fresh_translation: Who made earth? And who made what is under heaven and all things within it?
brenton_translation: And who is he that made the whole world under heaven, and all things therein?

fresh_translation: For if he should wish to hold fast and keep spirit with himself,
brenton_translation: For if he would confine, and restrain his spirit with himself;

fresh_translation: all flesh would die together, and every mortal would depart into earth from where he was formed.
brenton_translation: all flesh would die together, and every mortal would return to the earth, whence also he was formed.

fresh_translation: But if not, take warning; hear these things; give ear to the voice of words.
brenton_translation: Take heed lest he rebuke thee: hear this, hearken to the voice of words.

fresh_translation: Look at one hating lawless things and destroying evil men, being eternal and righteous.
brenton_translation: Behold then the one that hates iniquities, and that destroys the wicked, who is for ever just.

fresh_translation: He is ungodly who says to the king, You act lawlessly, and Most Ungodly One to rulers.
brenton_translation: He is ungodly that says to a king, Thou art a transgressor, that says to princes, O most ungodly one.

fresh_translation: He who did not feel shame before honorable face, nor knows to give honor by admiring faces of great men.
brenton_translation: Such a one as would not reverence the face of an honourable man, neither knows how to give honour to the great, so as that their persons should be respected.

fresh_translation: Their crying out and begging from man will turn out empty to them, for they used lawlessly while weak men were turning aside.
brenton_translation: But it shall turn out vanity to them, to cry and beseech a man; for they dealt unlawfully, the poor being turned aside from their right.

fresh_translation: For he is seer of works of men, and nothing of what they do is hidden from him.
brenton_translation: For he surveys the works of men, and nothing of what they do has escaped him.

fresh_translation: Nor will there be place to hide for those doing lawless things.
brenton_translation: Neither shall there be a place for the workers of iniquity to hide themselves.

fresh_translation: For he will no longer appoint anything over man, for the Lord watches all.
brenton_translation: For he will not lay upon a man more than right.

fresh_translation: He who grasps unsearchable things, glorious and extraordinary things without number.
brenton_translation: For the Lord looks down upon all men, who comprehends unsearchable things, glorious also and excellent things without number.

fresh_translation: He who makes known their works and turns night, and they will be humbled.
brenton_translation: Who discovers their works, and will bring night about upon them, and they shall be brought low.

fresh_translation: And he quenched ungodly men; they are visible before him,
brenton_translation: And he quite destroys the ungodly, for they are seen before him.

fresh_translation: because they turned aside from the law of God and did not know his ordinances,
brenton_translation: Because they turned aside from the law of God, and did not regard his ordinances,

fresh_translation: so as to bring cry of the poor upon him, and he will hear cry of needy men.
brenton_translation: so as to bring before him the cry of the needy; for he will hear the cry of the poor.

fresh_translation: And he will provide quiet, and who will condemn? And he will hide face, and who will see him, against nation and against man alike?
brenton_translation: And he will give quiet, and who will condemn? and he will hide his face, and who shall see him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man also:

fresh_translation: He reigns over hypocritical man because of hardship of the people.
brenton_translation: causing a hypocrite to be king, because of the waywardness of the people.

fresh_translation: Because one says to Mighty One, I have received; I will not take pledges.
brenton_translation: For there is one that says to the Mighty One, I have received blessings; I will not take a pledge:

fresh_translation: Apart from myself I will see; you show me if I worked injustice; I will add no more.
brenton_translation: I will see apart from myself: do thou shew me if I have done unrighteousness; I will not do so any more.

fresh_translation: Will he repay it from you because you rejected it? For you will choose, not I. And what you know, speak.
brenton_translation: Will he take vengeance for it on thee, whereas thou wilt put it far from thee? for thou shalt choose, and not I; and what thou knowest, speak thou.

fresh_translation: Therefore men of understanding heart will say these things, and wise man heard my word.
brenton_translation: Because the wise in heart shall say this, and a wise man listens to my word.

fresh_translation: But Job did not speak with understanding, and his words were not with knowledge.
brenton_translation: But Job has not spoken with understanding, his words are not uttered with knowledge.

fresh_translation: Yet learn, Job: do not yet give answer like foolish men,
brenton_translation: Howbeit do thou learn, Job: no longer make answer as the foolish:

fresh_translation: lest we add lawlessness to our sins, and let lawlessness be counted upon us while speaking many words against the Lord.
brenton_translation: that we add not to our sins: for iniquity will be reckoned against us, if we speak many words before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Elihu says,
brenton_translation: And Elius resumed and said,

fresh_translation: What is this you counted in judgment, you who said, I am righteous before the Lord?
brenton_translation: What is this that thou thinkest to be according to right? who art thou that thou hast said, I am righteous before the Lord?

fresh_translation: Or will you say, What shall I do if I sinned?
I will give you answer, and your three friends too.
brenton_translation: I will answer thee, and thy three friends.

fresh_translation: Look up to heaven and see, and study clouds, how high they are above you.
brenton_translation: Look up to the sky and see; and consider the clouds, how high they are above thee.

fresh_translation: If you sinned, what will you do? And if you committed much lawlessness, what are you able to do?
brenton_translation: If thou hast sinned, what wilt thou do? and if too thou hast transgressed much, what canst thou perform?

fresh_translation: Since therefore you are righteous, what will you give him, or what will he receive from your hand?
brenton_translation: And suppose thou art righteous, what wilt thou give him? or what shall he receive of thy hand?

fresh_translation: Your ungodliness is to man like you, and your righteousness to a son of man.
brenton_translation: Thy ungodliness may affect a man who is like to thee; or thy righteousness a son of man.

fresh_translation: Being oppressed by multitude, they will cry out; they will cry for help from arm of many.
brenton_translation: They that are oppressed of a multitude will be ready to cry out; they will call for help because of the arm of many.

fresh_translation: And he did not say, Where is God, maker of me, appointing night watches,
brenton_translation: But none said, Where is God that made me, who appoints the night-watches;

fresh_translation: distinguishing me from beasts of the earth and from the birds of heaven?
brenton_translation: who makes me to differ from the four-footed beasts of the earth, and from the birds of the sky?

fresh_translation: There they will cry out, and he will by no means hear, because of arrogance of evil men.
brenton_translation: There they shall cry, and none shall hearken, even because of the insolence of wicked men.

fresh_translation: For the Lord does not wish to see strange things, for Almighty himself is seer.
brenton_translation: For the Lord desires not to look on error, for he is the Almighty One.

fresh_translation: Of those completing lawless things he will save me. And be judged before him, if you are able to praise him as he is.
brenton_translation: He beholds them that perform lawless deeds, and he will save me: and do thou plead before him, if thou canst praise him, as it is possible even now.

fresh_translation: And now, because there is no one visiting his wrath, and he did not know the trespass greatly,
brenton_translation: For he is not now regarding his wrath, nor has he noticed severely any trespass.

fresh_translation: Job opens his mouth vainly; in ignorance he makes words heavy.
brenton_translation: Yet Job vainly opens his mouth, in ignorance he multiplies words.

fresh_translation: And Elihu still added and says,
brenton_translation: And Elius further continued, and said,

fresh_translation: Wait for me a little longer, that I may teach you, for still there is speech in me.
brenton_translation: Wait for me yet a little while, that I may teach thee: for there is yet speech in me.

fresh_translation: Taking up my knowledge from far, I will speak righteous things to my works.
brenton_translation: Having fetched my knowledge from afar, and according to my works,

fresh_translation: Truly my words are not unjust; you understand unjustly.
brenton_translation: I will speak just things truly, and thou shalt not unjustly receive unjust words.

fresh_translation: Know that the Lord will by no means reject blameless one, mighty in the strength of heart.
brenton_translation: But know that the Lord will not cast off an innocent man: being mighty in strength of wisdom,

fresh_translation: He will by no means keep an ungodly man alive, but will give judgment to poor men.
brenton_translation: he will not by any means save alive the ungodly: and he will grant the judgment of the poor.

fresh_translation: He will not take away his eyes from a righteous man, and with kings on a throne he will set them, and they will be exalted in strife.
brenton_translation: He will not turn away his eyes from the righteous, but they shall be with kings on the throne: and he will establish them in triumph, and they shall be exalted.

fresh_translation: And if they have been bound in shackles and held fast in ropes of poverty,
brenton_translation: But they that are bound in fetters shall be holden in cords of poverty.

fresh_translation: then he will declare to them their works and their transgressions, because they will be strong.
brenton_translation: And he shall recount to them their works, and their transgressions, for such will act with violence.

fresh_translation: But he will hear the righteous man and said that they will turn from injustice.
brenton_translation: But he will hearken to the righteous: and he has said that they shall turn from unrighteousness.

fresh_translation: If they hear and serve, they will complete their days in good things and their years in comeliness.
brenton_translation: If they should hear and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in honour.

fresh_translation: But ungodly men he does not save, because they were unwilling to know Lord, and because, though admonished, they were disobedient.
brenton_translation: But he preserves not the ungodly; because they are not willing to know the Lord, and because when reproved they were disobedient.

fresh_translation: And hypocrites in heart will appoint wrath; they will not cry for help because he bound them.
brenton_translation: And the hypocrites in heart will array wrath against themselves; they will not cry, because he has bound them.

fresh_translation: Therefore let their soul die in youth, and their life wounded by angels.
brenton_translation: Therefore let their soul die in youth, and their life be wounded by messengers of death.

fresh_translation: In return for what they oppressed, he will bring out judgment of meek men for weak and powerless men.
brenton_translation: Because they afflicted the weak and helpless: and he will vindicate the judgment of the meek.

fresh_translation: And further he deceived you from the mouth of enemy: abyss, pouring out beneath it, and your table came down full of richness.
brenton_translation: And he has also enticed thee out of the mouth of the enemy:

fresh_translation: Yet judgment will not fail from the righteous.
brenton_translation: there is a deep gulf and a rushing stream beneath it, and thy table came down full of fatness. Judgment shall not fail from the righteous;

fresh_translation: But wrath will be upon the ungodly because of the ungodliness of gifts which they received upon injustices.
brenton_translation: but there shall be wrath upon the ungodly, by reason of the ungodliness of the bribes which they received for iniquities.

fresh_translation: Let not willing mind of prayer turn you aside in necessity when weak men exist, and all strengthening power.
brenton_translation: Let not thy mind willingly turn thee aside from the petition of the feeble that are in distress.

fresh_translation: Do not draw out night, for peoples go up instead of them.
brenton_translation: And draw not forth all the mighty men by night, so that the people should go up instead of them.

fresh_translation: But take heed not to do strange things, for because of this I rescued you from poverty.
brenton_translation: But take heed lest thou do that which is wrong: for of this thou hast made choice because of poverty.

fresh_translation: Behold, Mighty One will strengthen in his strength. For who is ruler against him?
brenton_translation: Behold, the Mighty One shall prevail by his strength: for who is powerful as he is?

fresh_translation: And who is one examining his works? Or who said, You did unjust things?
brenton_translation: And who is he that examines his works? or who can say, He has wrought injustice?

fresh_translation: Remember that his works are great, which men began.
brenton_translation: Remember that his works are great beyond those which men have attempted.

fresh_translation: Every man has seen in himself, as many mortals as are being wounded.
brenton_translation: Every man has seen in himself, how many mortals are wounded.

fresh_translation: Behold, Mighty One is great, and we will not know; number of his years is endless.
brenton_translation: Behold, the Mighty One is great, and we shall not know him: the number of his years is even infinite.

fresh_translation: The drops of rain are counted for him, and they will be poured out as rain for cloud.
brenton_translation: And the drops of rain are numbered by him, and shall be poured out in rain to form a cloud.

fresh_translation: Ancient things will flow down, and clouds cast shadow over countless mortals. He set time for beasts, and they know order of resting place. Over all these things your mind is not amazed, nor does your heart change from body.
brenton_translation: The ancient heavens shall flow, and the clouds overshadow innumerable mortals:

fresh_translation: And if he understands stretchings of cloud, equality of his tent?
brenton_translation: And though one should understand the outspreadings of the clouds, or the measure of his tabernacle;

fresh_translation: Behold, he stretches water upon it and covered roots of sea.
brenton_translation: behold he will stretch his bow against him, and he covers the bottom of the sea.

fresh_translation: For by them he will judge peoples; he will give food to one who is strong.
brenton_translation: For by them he will judge the nations: he will give food to him that has strength.

fresh_translation: Upon hands he covered light, and commanded concerning it in meeting one.
brenton_translation: He has hidden the light in his hands, and given charge concerning it to the interposing cloud.

fresh_translation: His friend will announce concerning him, possession also concerning injustice.
brenton_translation: The Lord will declare concerning this to his friend: but there is a portion also for unrighteousness.

fresh_translation: And because of this my heart was troubled and leaped from its place.
brenton_translation: At this also my heart is troubled, and moved out of its place.

fresh_translation: Hear hearing in the anger of the Lord's wrath, and meditation will come out from his mouth.
brenton_translation: Hear thou a report by the anger of the Lord's wrath, and a discourse shall come out of his mouth.

fresh_translation: Under whole heaven is his rule, and his light upon the wings of earth.
brenton_translation: His dominion is under the whole heaven, and his light is at the extremities of the earth.

fresh_translation: After him voice will roar; he will thunder with the voice of his arrogance, and he will not exchange them when he hears his voice.
brenton_translation: After him shall be a cry with a loud voice; he shall thunder with the voice of his excellency, yet he shall not cause men to pass away, for one shall hear his voice.

fresh_translation: Mighty One will thunder wondrously in his voice, for he did great things which we did not know.
brenton_translation: The Mighty One shall thunder wonderfully with his voice: for he has done great things which we knew not;

fresh_translation: Commanding snow, Become upon earth, and winter rain, and winter rains of his strength.
brenton_translation: commanding the snow, Be thou upon the earth, and the stormy rain, and the storm of the showers of his might.

fresh_translation: He seals every man's hand, that every man may know his own weakness.
brenton_translation: He seals up the hand of every man, that every man may know his own weakness.

fresh_translation: And beasts entered under shelter and were quiet on their resting places.
brenton_translation: And the wild beasts come in under the covert, and rest in their lair.

fresh_translation: Whirlwinds come from storehouses, and cold from extremities.
brenton_translation: Troubles come on out of the secret chambers, and cold from the mountain-tops.

fresh_translation: And from the breath of Mighty One he will give frost, and he pilots water as he wishes.
brenton_translation: And from the breath of the Mighty One he will send frost; and he guides the water in whatever way he pleases.

fresh_translation: And choice thing fashions cloud, and cloud will scatter his light.
brenton_translation: And if a cloud obscures what is precious to him, his light will disperse the cloud.

fresh_translation: And he will turn roundabout his circuits by divine counsels into all their works; whatever he commands them, these have been arranged by him upon earth.
brenton_translation: And he will carry round the encircling clouds by his governance, to perform their works: whatsoever he shall command them,

fresh_translation: Whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy, he will find him.
brenton_translation: this has been appointed by him on the earth, whether for correction, or for his land, or if he shall find him an object for mercy.

fresh_translation: Give ear to these things, Job; stand still and understand power of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Hearken to this, O Job: stand still, and be admonished of the power of the Lord.

fresh_translation: We know that God set his works, making light out of darkness.
brenton_translation: We know that God has disposed his works, having made light out of darkness.

fresh_translation: And he knows distinctions of clouds, and extraordinary falls of evil men.
brenton_translation: And he knows the divisions of the clouds, and the signal overthrows of the ungodly.

fresh_translation: And your garment is warm; yet earth rests quietly.
brenton_translation: But thy robe is warm, and there is quiet upon the land.

fresh_translation: Will you make firm with him ancient things, strong as vision of molten metal?
brenton_translation: Wilt thou establish with him foundations for the ancient heavens? they are strong as a molten mirror.

fresh_translation: Why? Teach me what we shall say to him, and let us stop saying many things.
brenton_translation: Wherefore teach me, what shall we say to him? and let us cease from saying much.

fresh_translation: Did book or scribe stand by me, that standing I should make man silent?
brenton_translation: Have I a book or a scribe by me, that I may stand and put man to silence?

fresh_translation: But light is not visible to all; it shines afar in ancient things, like what is with him upon clouds.
brenton_translation: But the light is not visible to all: it shines afar off in the heavens, as that which is from him in the clouds.

fresh_translation: From north clouds shine with gold; over these things is great glory and honor of Almighty.
brenton_translation: From the north come the clouds shining like gold: in these great are the glory and honour of the Almighty;

fresh_translation: And we do not find another like his strength; judging righteous things, he does not think to hear.
brenton_translation: and we do not find another his equal in strength: as for him that judges justly, dost thou not think that he listens?

fresh_translation: Therefore men will fear him, and wise of heart will fear him.
brenton_translation: Wherefore men shall fear him; and the wise also in heart shall fear him.

fresh_translation: And after Elihu ceased from speech, the Lord said to Job through whirlwind and clouds,
brenton_translation: And after Elius had ceased from speaking, the Lord spoke to Job through the whirlwind and clouds, saying,

fresh_translation: Who is this hiding counsel, and holding words in heart, but thinking to hide them from me?
brenton_translation: Who is this that hides counsel from me, and confines words in his heart, and thinks to conceal them from me?

fresh_translation: Gird your loins like a man; I will ask you, and you answer me.
brenton_translation: Gird thy loins like a man; and I will ask thee, and do thou answer me.

fresh_translation: Where were you when I founded earth? Declare to me, if you know understanding.
brenton_translation: Where wast thou when I founded the earth? tell me now, if thou hast knowledge,

fresh_translation: Who set its measures, if you know, or who stretched line upon it?
brenton_translation: who set the measures of it, if thou knowest? or who stretched a line upon it?

fresh_translation: Upon what have its rings been fastened? And who is one laying cornerstone upon it,
brenton_translation: On what are its rings fastened? and who is he that laid the corner-stone upon it?

fresh_translation: when stars were born and all my angels praised me with loud voice?
brenton_translation: When the stars were made, all my angels praised me with a loud voice.

fresh_translation: And I fenced in sea with gates when it rushed out, coming forth from the womb of its mother,
brenton_translation: And I shut up the sea with gates, when it rushed out, coming forth out of its mother's womb.

fresh_translation: and I put cloud as its clothing and wrapped it in mist,
brenton_translation: And I made a cloud its clothing, and swathed it in mist.

fresh_translation: and I put boundaries to it, setting bars and gates around,
brenton_translation: And I set bounds to it, surrounding it with bars and gates.

fresh_translation: and I said to it, Up to this you will come and not pass beyond, but in yourself your waves will be broken.
brenton_translation: And I said to it, Hitherto shalt thou come, but thou shalt not go beyond, but thy waves shall be confined within thee.

fresh_translation: Or did I arrange morning light for you, and morning-star see its own order,
brenton_translation: Or did I order the morning light in thy time; and did the morning star then first see his appointed place;

fresh_translation: to seize wings of earth and shake ungodly men out of it?
brenton_translation: to lay hold of the extremities of the earth, to cast out the ungodly out of it?

fresh_translation: Or did you take earth, clay, and shape living thing, and set speaking one upon the earth?
brenton_translation: Or didst thou take clay of the ground, and form a living creature, and set it with the power of speech upon the earth?

fresh_translation: And you took the light from ungodly men, and shattered the arm of proud men.
brenton_translation: And hast thou removed light from the ungodly, and crushed the arm of the proud?

fresh_translation: And did you come upon spring of sea, and walk in tracks of deep?
brenton_translation: Or hast thou gone to the source of the sea, and walked in the tracks of the deep?

fresh_translation: And are the gates of death opened to you in fear, and gatekeepers of Hades, seeing you, were terrified?
brenton_translation: And do the gates of death open to thee for fear; and did the porters of hell quake when they saw thee?

fresh_translation: And did you perceive breadth of what is under heaven? Declare then to me how great it is.
brenton_translation: And hast thou been instructed in the breadth of the whole earth under heaven? tell me now, what is the extent of it?

fresh_translation: And what land does light lodge in, and what is the place of darkness,
brenton_translation: And in what kind of a land does the light dwell? and of what kind is the place of darkness?

fresh_translation: if you would bring me to their boundaries and know their paths?
brenton_translation: If thou couldest bring me to their utmost boundaries, and if also thou knowest their paths;

fresh_translation: I know then that you were born at that time, and number of your years is great.
brenton_translation: I know then that thou wert born at that time, and the number of thy years is great.

fresh_translation: And did you come upon treasuries of snow, and see treasuries of hail,
brenton_translation: But hast thou gone to the treasures of snow? and hast thou seen the treasures of hail?

fresh_translation: kept aside for you for hour of enemies, for the day of war and battle?
brenton_translation: And is there a store of them, for thee against the time of thine enemies, for the day of wars and battle?

fresh_translation: And from where does frost come out, or south wind scatter into what is under heaven?
brenton_translation: And whence proceeds the frost? or whence is the south wind dispersed over the whole world under heaven?

fresh_translation: And who prepared channel for violent rain, and way for thunderings,
brenton_translation: And who prepared a course for the violent rain, and a way for the thunders;

fresh_translation: to rain upon a land where there is no man, wilderness where no man exists in it,
brenton_translation: to rain upon the land where there is no man, the wilderness, where there is not a man in it; so as to feed the untrodden and uninhabited land,

fresh_translation: to satisfy pathless and uninhabited land and make growth of grass spring out?
brenton_translation: and cause it to send forth a crop of green herbs?

fresh_translation: Who is the father of rain, and who begot clods of dew?
brenton_translation: Who is the rain's father? and who has generated the drops of dew?

fresh_translation: And from whose womb does ice come out, and who begot frost in heaven?
brenton_translation: And out of whose womb comes the ice? and who has produced the frost in the sky,

fresh_translation: Or does it descend like flowing water, and who froze face of deep?
brenton_translation: which descends like flowing water? who has terrified the face of the ungodly?

fresh_translation: And did you understand bond of Pleiad, and open barrier of Orion?
brenton_translation: And dost thou understand the band of Pleias, and hast thou opened the barrier of Orion?

fresh_translation: Or will you open Mazzaroth in its season, and bring Evening Star with its tail?
brenton_translation: Or wilt thou reveal Mazuroth in his season, and the evening star with his rays? Wilt thou guide them?

fresh_translation: And do you know turnings of heaven, or things happening together under heaven?
brenton_translation: And knowest thou the changes of heaven, or the events which take place together under heaven?

fresh_translation: And will you call cloud with voice, and will trembling of abundant water obey you?
brenton_translation: And wilt thou call a cloud with thy voice, and will it obey thee with a violent shower of much rain?

fresh_translation: And will you send out lightnings, and they will go and say to you, What is it?
brenton_translation: And wilt thou send lightnings, and they shall go? and shall they say to thee, What is thy pleasure?

fresh_translation: And who gave women skill in weaving, or embroidered knowledge?
brenton_translation: And who has given to women skill in weaving, or knowledge of embroidery?

fresh_translation: And who counts clouds in wisdom, and bent heaven down to earth,
brenton_translation: And who is he that numbers the clouds in wisdom, and has bowed the heaven down to the earth?

fresh_translation: and it was poured out like dusty earth, and I glued it together like a stone cube?
brenton_translation: For it is spread out as dusty earth, and I have cemented it as one hewn stone to another.

fresh_translation: And will you hunt food for lions, and fill souls of dragons,
brenton_translation: And wilt thou hunt a prey for the lions? and satisfy the desires of the serpents?

fresh_translation: for they fear in their lairs and sit in woods lying in wait?
brenton_translation: For they fear in their lairs, and lying in wait couch in the woods.

fresh_translation: And who prepared food for raven? For its young cry to the Lord, wandering and seeking food.
brenton_translation: And who has prepared food for the raven? for its young ones wander and cry to the Lord, in search of food.

fresh_translation: Do you know time of giving birth of rock-goats, and did you watch birth-pangs of hinds?
brenton_translation: Say if thou knowest the time of the bringing forth of the wild goats of the rock, and if thou hast marked the calving of the hinds:

fresh_translation: And did you count full months of their bearing, and loosen their pangs?
brenton_translation: and if thou hast numbered the full months of their being with young, and if thou hast relieved their pangs:

fresh_translation: And did you rear their young without fear, and send out their birth-pangs?
brenton_translation: and hast reared their young without fear; and wilt thou loosen their pangs?

fresh_translation: Their young will burst forth, increase with produce, go out and by no means return to them.
brenton_translation: Their young will break forth; they will be multiplied with offspring: their young will go forth, and will not return to them.

fresh_translation: And who let wild donkey go free, and who loosed its bonds?
brenton_translation: And who is he that sent forth the wild ass free? and who loosed his bands?

fresh_translation: And I set its dwelling in the wilderness, and its tents in salt land.
brenton_translation: whereas I made his habitation the wilderness, and the salt land his coverts.

fresh_translation: Laughing at tumult of the city, and not hearing rebuke of tax-collector,
brenton_translation: He laughs to scorn the multitude of the city, and hears not the chiding of the tax-gatherer.

fresh_translation: it will inspect mountains for its pasture and seek after every green thing.
brenton_translation: He will survey the mountains as his pasture, and he seeks after every green thing.

fresh_translation: Will unicorn be willing to serve you, or sleep at your manger?
brenton_translation: And will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or to lie down at thy manger?

fresh_translation: And will you bind its yoke with straps, or will it drag your furrows in the plain?
brenton_translation: And wilt thou bind his yoke with thongs, or will he plough furrows for thee in the plain?

fresh_translation: And do you trust in it because its strength is great? And will you leave your works to it?
brenton_translation: And dost thou trust him, because his strength is great? and wilt thou commit thy works to him?

fresh_translation: And will you trust that it will return your seed and bring it into your threshing floor?
brenton_translation: And wilt thou believe that he will return to thee thy seed, and bring it in to thy threshing-floor?

fresh_translation: Wing of rejoicing ostriches, if it should conceive stork and hawk,
brenton_translation: The peacock has a beautiful wing: if the stork and the ostrich conceive, it is worthy of notice,

fresh_translation: because it will leave its eggs in earth and brood them upon dust,
brenton_translation: for the ostrich will leave her eggs in the ground, and warm them on the dust,

fresh_translation: and forgot that foot will scatter them and beasts of the field trample them.
brenton_translation: and has forgotten that the foot will scatter them, and the wild beasts of the field trample them.

fresh_translation: It hardened its young so as not to be its own; for nothing it labored without fear,
brenton_translation: She has hardened herself against her young ones, as though she bereaved not herself: she labours in vain without fear.

fresh_translation: because God made wisdom silent to it and did not divide understanding to it.
brenton_translation: For God has withholden wisdom from her, and not given her a portion in understanding.

fresh_translation: At time on high it will raise itself up; it will laugh at horse and its rider.
brenton_translation: In her season she will lift herself on high; she will scorn the horse and his rider.

fresh_translation: And did you clothe horse with strength, and put fear on its neck?
brenton_translation: Hast thou invested the horse with strength, and clothed his neck with terror?

fresh_translation: And did you put armor on it, and boldness on its chest?
brenton_translation: And hast thou clad him in perfect armour, and made his breast glorious with courage?

fresh_translation: Pawing in the plain in pride, it goes out to field in strength.
brenton_translation: He paws exulting in the plain, and goes forth in strength into the plain.

fresh_translation: Meeting arrow, it laughs and will by no means turn back from iron.
brenton_translation: He laughs to scorn a king as he meets him, and will by no means turn back from the sword.

fresh_translation: Over it boast bow and sword.
brenton_translation: The bow and sword resound against him; and his rage will swallow up the ground:

fresh_translation: And anger will destroy earth, and it will by no means believe until trumpet sounds.
brenton_translation: and he will not believe until the trumpet sounds.

fresh_translation: And when trumpet sounds it says, Good! And from far off it smells war with leap and cry.
brenton_translation: And when the trumpet sounds, he says, Aha! and afar off he smells the war with prancing and neighing.

fresh_translation: And by your knowledge has hawk stood still, spreading out wings motionless and looking southward?
brenton_translation: And does the hawk remain steady by thy wisdom, having spread out her wings unmoved, looking toward the region of the south?

fresh_translation: And by your command does eagle rise up, and vulture, sitting, lodge at its nest?
brenton_translation: And does the eagle rise at thy command, and the vulture remain sitting over his nest,

fresh_translation: Upon projection of rock and hidden place.
brenton_translation: on a crag of a rock, and in a secret place?

fresh_translation: From there, being there, it seeks foods; its eyes watch from far away.
brenton_translation: Thence he seeks food, his eyes observe from far.

fresh_translation: And its young wallow in blood, and wherever corpses are, they are immediately found.
brenton_translation: And his young ones roll themselves in blood, and wherever the carcases may be, immediately they are found.

fresh_translation: And the Lord God answered Job and said,
brenton_translation: And the Lord God answered Job, and said,

fresh_translation: Will one turning aside judgment with Sufficient One, reproving God, answer this?
brenton_translation: Will any one pervert judgment with the Mighty One? and he that reproves God, let him return it for answer.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Job says to the Lord,
brenton_translation: And Job answered and said to the Lord,

fresh_translation: Why am I still judged, being admonished and reproving Lord, hearing such things while I am nothing? What answer shall I give to these things? I will put hand on my mouth.
brenton_translation: Why do I yet plead? being rebuked even while reproving the Lord: hearing such things, whereas I am nothing: and what shall I answer to these arguments? I will lay my hand upon my mouth.

fresh_translation: Once I spoke, but on second time I will not add.
brenton_translation: I have spoken once; but I will not do so a second time.

fresh_translation: And again taking up the matter, the Lord said to Job out of cloud,
brenton_translation: And the Lord yet again answered and spoke to Job out of the cloud, saying,

fresh_translation: But gird your loins like a man; I will ask you, and you answer me.
brenton_translation: Nay, gird up now thy loins like a man; and I will ask thee, and do thou answer me.

fresh_translation: Do not reject my judgment; do you think I have dealt with you otherwise than that you might appear righteous?
brenton_translation: Do not set aside my judgment: and dost thou think that I have dealt with thee in any other way, than that thou mightest appear to be righteous?

fresh_translation: Or is your arm against the Lord, or your voice thundering against him?
brenton_translation: Hast thou an arm like the Lord's? or dost thou thunder with a voice like his?

fresh_translation: Take up then height and power, and clothe yourself with glory and honor.
brenton_translation: Assume now a lofty bearing and power; and clothe thyself with glory and honour.

fresh_translation: And send out angels in wrath, and humble every arrogant man.
brenton_translation: And send forth messengers with wrath; and lay low every haughty one.

fresh_translation: And quench proud man, and rot ungodly men at once.
brenton_translation: Bring down also the proud man; and consume at once the ungodly.

fresh_translation: Hide them together outside in earth, and fill their faces with dishonor.
brenton_translation: And hide them together in the earth; and fill their faces with shame.

fresh_translation: Then I too will confess that your right hand can save.
brenton_translation: Then will I confess that thy right hand can save thee.

fresh_translation: But now behold beasts beside you; it eats grass like oxen.
brenton_translation: But now look at the wild beasts with thee; they eat grass like oxen.

fresh_translation: Behold then its strength upon loins, and its power upon navel of belly.
brenton_translation: Behold now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.

fresh_translation: It set tail like cypress, and its sinews are interwoven.
brenton_translation: He sets up his tail like a cypress; and his nerves are wrapped together.

fresh_translation: Its ribs are bronze ribs, and its backbone cast iron.
brenton_translation: His sides are sides of brass; and his backbone is as cast iron.

fresh_translation: This is the beginning of the Lord's creation, made to be mocked by his angels.
brenton_translation: This is the chief of the creation of the Lord; made to be played with by his angels.

fresh_translation: And going upon steep mountain, it made joy for quadrupeds in Tartarus.
brenton_translation: And when he has gone up to a steep mountain, he causes joy to the quadrupeds in the deep.

fresh_translation: It sleeps under every kind of tree, beside papyrus and reed and rush.
brenton_translation: He lies under trees of every kind, by the papyrus, and reed, and bulrush.

fresh_translation: And great trees shade it, with branches and shoots of agnus-tree.
brenton_translation: And the great trees make a shadow over him with their branches, and so do the bushes of the field.

fresh_translation: If flood happens, it will not notice; it trusts that Jordan will dash into its mouth.
brenton_translation: If there should be a flood, he will not perceive it; he trusts that Jordan will rush up into his mouth.

fresh_translation: Will one take it in its eye? With snare one will pierce its nose.
brenton_translation: Yet one shall take him in his sight; one shall catch him with a cord, and pierce his nose.

fresh_translation: And will you lead dragon with hook, and put halter around its nose?
brenton_translation: But wilt thou catch the serpent with a hook, and put a halter about his nose?

fresh_translation: Or will you bind ring in its nostril and pierce its lip with bracelet?
brenton_translation: Or wilt thou fasten a ring in his nostril, and bore his lip with a clasp?

fresh_translation: And will it speak to you with petition, making supplications softly?
brenton_translation: Will he address thee with a petition? softly, with the voice of a suppliant?

fresh_translation: And will it make covenant with you, and you will take it for eternal slave?
brenton_translation: And will he make a covenant with thee? and wilt thou take him for a perpetual servant?

fresh_translation: And will you play with it like a bird, or bind it like a sparrow for child?
brenton_translation: And wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or bind him as a sparrow for a child?

fresh_translation: And nations feed upon it, and races of Phoenicians divide it up.
brenton_translation: And do the nations feed upon him, and the nations of the Phœnicians share him?

fresh_translation: And all ships gathered together will by no means carry one skin of its tail, nor in fishing boats its head.
brenton_translation: And all the ships come together would not be able to bear the mere skin of his tail; neither shall they carry his head in fishing-vessels.

fresh_translation: And will you lay hand upon it, remembering war happening in its body, and let it happen no more?
brenton_translation: But thou shalt lay thy hand upon him once, remembering the war that is waged by his mouth; and let it not be done any more.

fresh_translation: Have you not seen it, nor marveled at things spoken of it?
brenton_translation: Hast thou not seen him? and hast thou not wondered at the things said of him?

fresh_translation: Have you not feared because it has been prepared for me? For who is one standing against me?
brenton_translation: Dost thou not fear because preparation has been made by me? for who is there that resists me?

fresh_translation: Or who will withstand me and endure, if all that is under heaven is mine?
brenton_translation: Or who will resist me, and abide, since the whole world under heaven is mine?

fresh_translation: I will not be silent because of it, and word of power will have mercy on its equal.
brenton_translation: I will not be silent because of him: though because of his power one shall pity his antagonist.

fresh_translation: Who will uncover the face of its clothing? And who would enter fold of its breastplate?
brenton_translation: Who will open the face of his garment? and who can enter within the fold of his breast-plate?

fresh_translation: Who will open gates of its face? Around its teeth is fear.
brenton_translation: Who will open the doors of his face? terror is round about his teeth.

fresh_translation: Its inward parts are bronze shields, and its binding like emery stone.
brenton_translation: His inwards are as brazen plates, and the texture of his skin as a smyrite stone.

fresh_translation: One cleaving to another, and breath will by no means pass through it.
brenton_translation: One part cleaves fast to another, and the air cannot come between them.

fresh_translation: A man to his brother will be glued; they hold together and will by no means be torn apart.
brenton_translation: They will remain united each to the other: they are closely joined, and cannot be separated.

fresh_translation: At its sneezing light shines, and its eyes like form of morning star.
brenton_translation: At his sneezing a light shines, and his eyes are as the appearance of the morning star.

fresh_translation: From its mouth go out burning lamps, and hearths of fire are scattered abroad.
brenton_translation: Out of his mouth proceed as it were burning lamps, and as it were hearths of fire are cast abroad.

fresh_translation: From its nostrils comes out smoke of furnace burning with coals of fire.
brenton_translation: Out of his nostrils proceeds smoke of a furnace burning with fire of coals.

fresh_translation: Its soul is coals, and flame goes out from its mouth.
brenton_translation: His breath is as live coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.

fresh_translation: And in its neck strength lodges; destruction runs before it.
brenton_translation: And power is lodged in his neck, before him destruction runs.

fresh_translation: Fleshes of its body are joined together; he will pour upon it, and it will not be shaken.
brenton_translation: The flesh also of his body is joined together: if one pours violence upon him, he shall not be moved.

fresh_translation: Its heart is fixed like stone, standing like unhammersmitten anvil.
brenton_translation: His heart is firm as a stone, and it stands like an unyielding anvil.

fresh_translation: When it turns, there is fear to beasts, to quadrupeds on earth leaping.
brenton_translation: And when he turns, he is a terror to the four-footed wild beasts which leap upon the earth.

fresh_translation: If spears meet it, they will do nothing, nor raised spear and breastplate.
brenton_translation: If spears should come against him, men will effect nothing, either with the spear or the breast-plate.

fresh_translation: For it counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.
brenton_translation: For he considers iron as chaff, and brass as rotten wood.

fresh_translation: Bronze bow will by no means wound it; it counts stone-slinger as grass.
brenton_translation: The bow of brass shall not wound him, he deems a slinger as grass.

fresh_translation: Hammers were counted as reed, and it laughs at shaking of fire-bearer.
brenton_translation: Mauls are counted as stubble; and he laughs to scorn the waving of the firebrand.

fresh_translation: Its bed is sharp spits, and all gold of sea under it like immeasurable clay.
brenton_translation: His lair is formed of sharp points; and all the gold of the sea under him is as an immense quantity of clay.

fresh_translation: It makes deep boil like a bronze pot, and counts sea like a perfume-vessel.
brenton_translation: He makes the deep boil like a brazen caldron; and he regards the sea as a pot of ointment,

fresh_translation: And Tartarus of deep it counted like captive, and deep for its walking.
brenton_translation: and the lowest part of the deep as a captive: he reckons the deep as his range.

fresh_translation: There is nothing upon earth like it, made to be mocked by my angels.
brenton_translation: There is nothing upon the earth like to him, formed to be sported with by my angels.

fresh_translation: It sees every high thing; and it is the king of all things in waters.
brenton_translation: He beholds every high thing: and he is king of all that are in the waters.

fresh_translation: And taking up the matter, Job says to the Lord,
brenton_translation: Then Job answered and said to the Lord,

fresh_translation: I know that you can do all things, and nothing is impossible for you.
brenton_translation: I know that thou canst do all things, and nothing is impossible with thee.

fresh_translation: For who is one hiding counsel from you, sparing words, and thinking to hide you? And who will tell me things I did not know, great and wonderful things which I did not understand?
brenton_translation: For who is he that hides counsel from thee? or who keeps back his words, and thinks to hide them from thee? and who will tell me what I knew not, great and wonderful things which I understood not?

fresh_translation: Hear me, Lord, that I too may speak; I will ask you, and you teach me.
brenton_translation: But hear me, O Lord, that I also may speak: and I will ask thee, and do thou teach me.

fresh_translation: By hearing of ear I formerly heard you, but now my eye has seen you.
brenton_translation: I have heard the report of thee by the ear before; but now mine eye has seen thee.

fresh_translation: Therefore I despised myself and melted away, and I count myself earth and ashes.
brenton_translation: Wherefore I have counted myself vile, and have fainted: and I esteem myself dust and ashes.

fresh_translation: And it happened after the Lord spoke all these words to Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, You and your two friends sinned, for you spoke nothing true before me, as my servant Job did.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after the Lord had spoken all these words to Job, that the Lord said to Eliphaz the Thæmanite, Thou hast sinned, and thy two friends: for ye have not said anything true before me, as my servant Job has.

fresh_translation: Now then take seven calves and seven rams and go to my servant Job, and he will make fruit-offering concerning you. And my servant Job will pray concerning you, because unless I receive his face, for his sake I would have destroyed you, for you did not speak truth concerning my servant Job.
brenton_translation: Now then take seven bullocks, and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and he shall offer a burnt-offering for you. And my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will only accept him: for but for his sake, I would have destroyed you, for ye have not spoken the truth against my servant Job.

fresh_translation: And Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the Lord instructed them, and through Job he loosed their sin.
brenton_translation: So Eliphaz the Thæmanite, and Baldad the Sauchite, and Sophar the Minæan, went and did as the Lord commanded them: and he pardoned their sin for the sake of Job.

fresh_translation: And the Lord increased Job. And when he prayed also concerning his friends, he forgave them their sin. And the Lord gave double whatever had been before Job, for doubling.
brenton_translation: And the Lord prospered Job: and when he prayed also for his friends, he forgave them their sin: and the Lord gave Job twice as much, even the double of what he had before.

fresh_translation: And all his brothers and sisters heard all things that happened to him, and they came to him, and all who had known him from first. And eating and drinking with him, they comforted him and marveled over all that the Lord brought upon him. And each gave him one lamb and a gold four-drachma piece unstamped.
brenton_translation: And all his brethren and his sisters heard all that had happened to him, and they came to him, and so did all that had known him from the first: and they ate and drank with him, and comforted him, and wondered at all that the Lord had brought upon him: and each one gave him a lamb, and four drachms' weight of gold, even of unstamped gold.

fresh_translation: And the Lord blessed last things of Job more than former things. And his livestock was fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and one thousand female grazing donkeys.
brenton_translation: And the Lord blessed the latter end of Job, more than the beginning: and his cattle were fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen, a thousand she-asses of the pastures.

fresh_translation: And seven sons and three daughters were born to him.
brenton_translation: And there were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

fresh_translation: And he called first Day, second Cassia, and third Horn of Amaltheia.
brenton_translation: And he called the first, Day, and the second, Casia, and the third, Amalthæa's horn.

fresh_translation: And no women under heaven were found better than daughters of Job, and father gave them inheritance among their brothers.
brenton_translation: And there were not found in comparison with the daughters of Job, fairer women than they in all the world: and their father gave them an inheritance among their brethren.

fresh_translation: And Job lived after the blow one hundred seventy years; altogether he lived two hundred forty-eight years, and Job saw his sons and sons of his sons, fourth generation.
brenton_translation: And Job lived after his affliction a hundred and seventy years: and all the years he lived were two hundred and forty: and Job saw his sons and his sons' sons, the fourth generation.

fresh_translation: And Job died old and full of days. And it is written that he will rise again with those whom the Lord raises up. This man, interpreted from the Syriac book, dwelt in the land of Uz on the borders of Idumaia and Arabia, and his former name was Jobab. Taking an Arabian wife, he fathered a son whose name was Ennon. And he himself was the son of Zerah, one of the sons of Esau, from his mother Bozrah, so as to be fifth from Abraham. And these were kings who reigned in Edom, over which he also first ruled: Balak son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah; after Balak, Jobab called Job; after him Husham, ruler from the country of Temanite; after him Hadad son of Bedad, who cut down Midian in the plain of Moab, and the name of his city was Gittaim. And friends coming to him were Eliphaz king of the sons of Esau from the Temanites, Bildad tyrant of the Sauchites, and Zophar king of the Naamathites.
brenton_translation: And Job died, an old man and full of days:

fresh_translation: Blessed is the man who did not walk in the counsel of ungodly men, and did not stand in the way of sinners, and did not sit upon the seat of pestilent men,
brenton_translation: Blessed is the man who has not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, and has not stood in the way of sinners, and has not sat in the seat of evil men.

fresh_translation: but his delight is in the law of the Lord, and in his law he will meditate day and night.
brenton_translation: But his pleasure is in the law of the Lord; and in his law will he meditate day and night.

fresh_translation: And he will be like a tree planted by outlets of waters, which will give its fruit in its season, and its leaf will not wither, and all things whatever he does will prosper.
brenton_translation: And he shall be as a tree planted by the brooks of waters, which shall yield its fruit in its season, and its leaf shall not fall off; and whatsoever he shall do shall be prospered.

fresh_translation: Not so ungodly men, not so, but like chaff which wind throws from the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: Not so the ungodly;—not so: but rather as the chaff which the wind scatters away from the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: Because of this ungodly men will not stand in judgment, nor sinners in the counsel of righteous men.
brenton_translation: Therefore the ungodly shall not rise in judgment, nor sinners in the counsel of the just.

fresh_translation: For the Lord knows the way of righteous men, but the way of ungodly men will perish.
brenton_translation: For the Lord knows the way of the righteous; but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

fresh_translation: Why did nations rage, and peoples meditate empty things?
brenton_translation: Wherefore did the heathen rage, and the nations imagine vain things?

fresh_translation: The kings of the earth stood by, and rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against his Anointed. Interlude.
brenton_translation: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers gathered themselves together, against the Lord, and against his Christ;

fresh_translation: Let us tear their bonds apart and cast their yoke from us.
brenton_translation: saying, Let us break through their bonds, and cast away their yoke from us.

fresh_translation: One dwelling in heavens will laugh at them, and the Lord will mock them.
brenton_translation: He that dwells in the heavens shall laugh them to scorn, and the Lord shall mock them.

fresh_translation: Then he will speak to them in his wrath and trouble them in his anger.
brenton_translation: Then shall he speak to them in his anger, and trouble them in his fury.

fresh_translation: But I was set as king by him upon Zion, his holy mountain,
brenton_translation: But I have been made king by him on Sion his holy mountain,

fresh_translation: declaring decree of the Lord. The Lord said to me, You are my son; today I have begotten you.
brenton_translation: declaring the ordinance of the Lord: the Lord said to me, Thou art my Son, to-day have I begotten thee.

fresh_translation: Ask from me, and I will give nations as your inheritance and ends of the earth as your possession.
brenton_translation: Ask of me, and I will give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the ends of the earth for thy possession.

fresh_translation: You will shepherd them with iron rod; like potter's vessel you will shatter them.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt rule them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces as a potter's vessel.

fresh_translation: And now, kings, understand; be instructed, all judging earth.
brenton_translation: Now therefore understand, ye kings: be instructed, all ye that judge the earth.

fresh_translation: Serve the Lord in fear and rejoice in him with trembling.
brenton_translation: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice in him with trembling.

fresh_translation: Take hold of instruction lest the Lord be angered and you perish from a righteous way when his wrath is quickly kindled. Blessed are all who trust in him.
brenton_translation: Accept correction, lest at any time the Lord be angry, and ye should perish from the righteous way: whensoever his wrath shall be suddenly kindled, blessed are all they that trust in him.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David, when he fled from the face of Absalom his son.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David, when he fled from the presence of his son Abessalom.

fresh_translation: Lord, why were those afflicting me multiplied? Many rise up against me.
brenton_translation: O Lord, why are they that afflict me multiplied? many rise up against me.

fresh_translation: Many say to my soul, There is no salvation for him in his God. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Many say concerning my soul, There is no deliverance for him in his God. Pause.

fresh_translation: But you, Lord, are my defender, my glory, and one lifting my head.
brenton_translation: But thou, O Lord, art my helper: my glory, and the one that lifts up my head.

fresh_translation: With my voice I cried to the Lord, and he heard me from his holy mountain. Interlude.
brenton_translation: I cried to the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy mountain. Pause.

fresh_translation: I lay down and slept; I awoke, because the Lord will help me.
brenton_translation: I lay down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord will help me.

fresh_translation: I will not fear from myriads of the people those surrounding and attacking me.
brenton_translation: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, who beset me round about.

fresh_translation: Rise up, Lord; save me, my God, because you struck all who hate me for nothing; the teeth of sinners you shattered.
brenton_translation: Arise, Lord; deliver me, my God: for thou hast smitten all who were without cause mine enemies; thou hast broken the teeth of sinners.

fresh_translation: Salvation belongs to the Lord, and your blessing upon your people.
brenton_translation: Deliverance is the Lord's, and thy blessing is upon thy people.

fresh_translation: For end. In psalms. Song of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Song of David among the Psalms.

fresh_translation: When I call, God of my righteousness heard me; in affliction you widened space for me. Have pity on me and hear my prayer.
brenton_translation: When I called upon him, the God of my righteousness heard me: thou hast made room for me in tribulation; pity me, and hearken to my prayer.

fresh_translation: Sons of men, until when heavy-hearted? Why do you love vanity and seek lie? Interlude.
brenton_translation: O ye sons of men, how long will ye be slow of heart? wherefore do ye love vanity, and seek falsehood? Pause.

fresh_translation: And know that the Lord made his holy one wondrous; The Lord will hear me when I cry to him.
brenton_translation: But know ye that the Lord has done wondrous things for his holy one: the Lord will hear me when I cry to him.

fresh_translation: Be angry and do not sin; say within your hearts, and upon your beds be pierced through. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Be ye angry, and sin not; feel compunction upon your beds for what ye say in your hearts. Pause.

fresh_translation: Offer a sacrifice of righteousness and hope upon the Lord.
brenton_translation: Offer the sacrifice of righteousness, and trust in the Lord.

fresh_translation: Many say, Who will show us good things? Light of your face, Lord, was marked upon us.
brenton_translation: Many say, Who will shew us good things? the light of thy countenance, O Lord, has been manifested towards us.

fresh_translation: You gave gladness into my heart, from season when their grain and wine and oil were multiplied.
brenton_translation: Thou hast put gladness into my heart: they have been satisfied with the fruit of their corn and wine and oil.

fresh_translation: In peace, at same time, I will lie down and sleep, because you, Lord, alone settled me in hope.
brenton_translation: I will both lie down in peace and sleep: for thou, Lord, only hast caused me to dwell securely.

fresh_translation: For end. Concerning her who inherits. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David, concerning her that inherits.

fresh_translation: Give ear to my words, Lord; understand my cry.
brenton_translation: Hearken to my words, O Lord, attend to my cry.

fresh_translation: Attend to the voice of my petition, my King and my God, because to you I will pray, Lord.
brenton_translation: Attend to the voice of my supplication, my King, and my God: for to thee, O Lord, will I pray.

fresh_translation: In morning you will hear my voice; in morning I will stand before you and keep watch.
brenton_translation: In the morning thou shalt hear my voice: in the morning will I wait upon thee, and will look up.

fresh_translation: For you are not God willing lawlessness, nor will one doing evil dwell with you.
brenton_translation: For thou art not a God that desires iniquity; neither shall the worker of wickedness dwell with thee.

fresh_translation: Lawless men will not remain before your eyes; you hated all working lawlessness.
brenton_translation: Neither shall the transgressors continue in thy sight: thou hatest, O Lord, all them that work iniquity.

fresh_translation: You will destroy all speaking lie; man of bloods and deceit the Lord abhors.
brenton_translation: Thou wilt destroy all that speak falsehood: the Lord abhors the bloody and deceitful man.

fresh_translation: But I, in the multitude of your mercy, will enter into your house; I will worship toward your holy temple in your fear.
brenton_translation: But I will enter into thine house in the multitude of thy mercy: I will worship in thy fear toward thy holy temple.

fresh_translation: Lord, lead me in your righteousness because of my enemies; make your way straight before me.
brenton_translation: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make my way plain before thy face.

fresh_translation: Because there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is vain; their throat open grave; with their tongues they dealt deceitfully.
brenton_translation: For there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is vain; their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit.

fresh_translation: Judge them, God; let them fall from their counsels. According to the multitude of their ungodliness cast them out, because they embittered you, Lord.
brenton_translation: Judge them, O God; let them fail of their counsels: cast them out according to the abundance of their ungodliness; for they have provoked thee, O Lord.

fresh_translation: And let all hoping in you be glad; into age they will rejoice, and you will dwell among them; and all loving your name will boast in you.
brenton_translation: But let all that trust on thee be glad in thee: they shall exult for ever, and thou shalt dwell among them; and all that love thy name shall rejoice in thee.

fresh_translation: Because you will bless a righteous man, Lord; as with a weapon of favor you crowned us.
brenton_translation: For thou, Lord, shalt bless the righteous: thou hast compassed us as with a shield of favour.

fresh_translation: For end. In hymns. Concerning eighth. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David among the Hymns for the eighth.

fresh_translation: Lord, do not reprove me in your fury, nor discipline me in your anger.
brenton_translation: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath, neither chasten me in thine anger.

fresh_translation: Have mercy on me, Lord, because I am weak. Heal me, Lord, because my bones were troubled.
brenton_translation: Pity me, O Lord; for I am weak: heal me, O Lord; for my bones are vexed.

fresh_translation: And my soul was greatly troubled. And you, Lord, until when?
brenton_translation: My soul also is grievously vexed: but thou, O Lord, how long?

fresh_translation: Turn back, Lord; rescue my soul. Save me because of your mercy.
brenton_translation: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: save me for thy mercy's sake.

fresh_translation: Because in death there is none remembering you; and in Hades who will confess to you?
brenton_translation: For in death no man remembers thee: and who will give thee thanks in Hades?

fresh_translation: I toiled in my groaning; every night I will wash my bed, with my tears I will soak my couch.
brenton_translation: I am wearied with my groaning; I shall wash my bed every night; I shall water my couch with my tears.

fresh_translation: My eye was troubled from anger; I grew old among all my enemies.
brenton_translation: Mine eye is troubled because of my wrath; I am worn out because of all my enemies.

fresh_translation: Depart from me, all working lawlessness, because the Lord heard the voice of my weeping.
brenton_translation: Depart from me, all ye that work iniquity; for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.

fresh_translation: The Lord heard my petition; The Lord received my prayer.
