brenton_translation: The Lord has hearkened to my petition; the Lord has accepted my prayer.

fresh_translation: Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; let them turn back and be greatly ashamed very quickly.
brenton_translation: Let all mine enemies be put to shame and sore troubled: let them be turned back and grievously put to shame speedily.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David, which he sang to the Lord concerning the words of Cushi son of Iemeni.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David, which he sang to the Lord because of the words of Chusi the Benjamite.

fresh_translation: Lord my God, upon you I hoped; save me from all pursuing me and rescue me,
brenton_translation: O Lord my God, in thee have I trusted: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me.

fresh_translation: lest he seize my soul like a lion, while there is none redeeming and none saving.
brenton_translation: Lest at any time the enemy seize my soul as a lion, while there is none to ransom, nor to save.

fresh_translation: Lord my God, if I did this, if there is injustice in my hands,
brenton_translation: O Lord my God, if I have done this; (if there is unrighteousness in my hands;)

fresh_translation: if I repaid evil to those repaying me, then let me fall away from my enemies empty.
brenton_translation: if I have requited with evil those who requited me with good; may I then perish empty by means of my enemies.

fresh_translation: Then let enemy pursue my soul and seize it, and trample my life into earth, and settle my glory in dust. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; and let him trample my life on the ground, and lay my glory in the dust. Pause.

fresh_translation: Rise up, Lord, in your anger; be lifted up at ends of my enemies. Wake up, Lord my God, in command which you enjoined.
brenton_translation: Arise, O Lord, in thy wrath; be exalted in the utmost boundaries of mine enemies: awake, O Lord my God, according to the decree which thou didst command.

fresh_translation: And a gathering of peoples will encircle you, and over this return on high.
brenton_translation: And the congregation of the nations shall compass thee: and for this cause do thou return on high.

fresh_translation: The Lord judges peoples. Judge me, Lord, according to my righteousness and according to my innocence upon me.
brenton_translation: The Lord shall judge the nations: judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to my innocence that is in me.

fresh_translation: Let the evil of sinners come to an end, and you will set a righteous man straight, examining hearts and kidneys, O God.
brenton_translation: Oh let the wickedness of sinners come to an end; and then thou shalt direct the righteous, O God that searchest the hearts and reins.

fresh_translation: My help is righteous from God, the one saving upright ones in heart.
brenton_translation: My help is righteous, coming from God who saves the upright in heart.

fresh_translation: God is righteous judge, strong and patient, not bringing on anger each day.
brenton_translation: God is a righteous judge, and strong, and patient, not inflicting vengeance every day.

fresh_translation: If you do not turn back, he will polish his sword, stretch his bow, and prepare it.
brenton_translation: If ye will not repent, he will furbish his sword; he has bent his bow, and made it ready.

fresh_translation: And in it he prepared instruments of death; his arrows he worked out for burning ones.
brenton_translation: And on it he has fitted the instruments of death; he has completed his arrows for the raging ones.

fresh_translation: Behold, he travailed with injustice, conceived toil, and gave birth to lawlessness.
brenton_translation: Behold, he has travailed with unrighteousness, he has conceived trouble, and brought forth iniquity.

fresh_translation: He dug pit and scooped it out, and he will fall into hole which he made.
brenton_translation: He has opened a pit, and dug it up, and he shall fall into the ditch which he has made.

fresh_translation: His toil will return upon his head, and his injustice will come down upon his crown.
brenton_translation: His trouble shall return on his own head, and his unrighteousness shall come down on his own crown.

fresh_translation: I will confess to the Lord according to his righteousness, and I will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
brenton_translation: I will give thanks to the Lord according to his righteousness; I will sing to the name of the Lord most high.

fresh_translation: For end. Concerning winepresses. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, concerning the wine-presses, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Lord, our Lord, how wondrous your name in all the earth, because your magnificence was lifted above heavens.
brenton_translation: O Lord, our Lord, how wonderful is thy name in all the earth! for thy magnificence is exalted above the heavens.

fresh_translation: Out of mouth of infants and nursing ones you prepared praise, because of your enemies, to tear down enemy and avenger.
brenton_translation: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou perfected praise, because of thine enemies; that thou mightest put down the enemy and avenger.

fresh_translation: Because I will see heavens, works of your fingers, moon and stars which you founded.
brenton_translation: For I will regard the heavens, the work of thy fingers; the moon and stars, which thou hast established.

fresh_translation: What is man, that you remember him, or son of man, that you visit him?
brenton_translation: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

fresh_translation: You lessened him a little from angels; with glory and honor you crowned him.
brenton_translation: Thou madest him a little less than angels, thou hast crowned him with glory and honour;

fresh_translation: And you set him over the works of your hands; all things you subjected under his feet:
brenton_translation: and thou hast set him over the works of thy hands: thou hast put all things under his feet:

fresh_translation: sheep and oxen, all of them, and also beasts of the field,
brenton_translation: sheep and all oxen, yea, and the cattle of the field;

fresh_translation: birds of heaven and fish of the sea, things passing through paths of seas.
brenton_translation: the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea, the creatures passing through the paths of the sea.

fresh_translation: Lord, our Lord, how wondrous your name in all the earth.
brenton_translation: O Lord our Lord, how wonderful is thy name in all the earth!

fresh_translation: For end. Concerning hidden things of son. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David, concerning the secrets of the Son.

fresh_translation: I will confess to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will recount all your wondrous deeds.
brenton_translation: I will give thanks to thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will recount all thy wonderful works.

fresh_translation: I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing praise to your name, Most High,
brenton_translation: I will be glad and exult in thee: I will sing to thy name, O thou Most High.

fresh_translation: when my enemy turns back. They will grow weak and perish from your face,
brenton_translation: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall be feeble and perish at thy presence.

fresh_translation: because you made my judgment and my case. You sat upon a throne, judging righteousness.
brenton_translation: For thou hast maintained my cause and my right; thou satest on the throne, that judgest righteousness.

fresh_translation: You rebuked nations, and the ungodly man perished. Their name you wiped out into age and into age of age.
brenton_translation: Thou hast rebuked the nations, and the ungodly one has perished; thou hast blotted out their name for ever, even for ever and ever.

fresh_translation: The swords of the enemy failed to end, and you pulled down cities. Their memorial perished with noise.
brenton_translation: The swords of the enemy have failed utterly; and thou hast destroyed cities: their memorial has been destroyed with a noise,

fresh_translation: But the Lord remains into age; he prepared his throne in judgment.
brenton_translation: but the Lord endures for ever: he has prepared his throne for judgment.

fresh_translation: And he himself will judge inhabited world in righteousness; he will judge peoples in uprightness.
brenton_translation: And he will judge the world in righteousness, he will judge the nations in uprightness.

fresh_translation: And the Lord became a refuge for the poor man, a helper in opportunities, in affliction.
brenton_translation: The Lord also is become a refuge for the poor, a seasonable help, in affliction.

fresh_translation: And let those knowing your name hope upon you, because you did not forsake those seeking you, Lord.
brenton_translation: And let them that know thy name hope in thee: for thou, O Lord, hast not failed them that diligently seek thee.

fresh_translation: Sing praise to the Lord dwelling in Zion; announce among nations his deeds.
brenton_translation: Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Sion: declare his dealings among the nations.

fresh_translation: Because, seeking out their bloods, he remembered; he did not forget the cry of poor men.
brenton_translation: For he remembered them, in making inquisition for blood: he has not forgotten the supplication of the poor.

fresh_translation: Have mercy on me, Lord; see my humiliation from my enemies, you lifting me up from the gates of death,
brenton_translation: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; look upon my affliction which I suffer of mine enemies, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

fresh_translation: so that I may declare all your praises in the gates of daughter of Zion. I will rejoice in your salvation.
brenton_translation: that I may declare all thy praises in the gates of the daughter of Sion: I will exult in thy salvation.

fresh_translation: Nations were trapped in corruption which they made; in this snare which they hid, their foot was caught.
brenton_translation: The heathen are caught in the destruction which they planned: in the very snare which they hid is their foot taken.

fresh_translation: The Lord is known, making judgments; in the works of his hands the sinner was caught. Song of interlude.
brenton_translation: The Lord is known as executing judgments: the sinner is taken in the works of his hands. A song of Pause.

fresh_translation: Let sinners turn back into Hades, all nations forgetting God.
brenton_translation: Let sinners be driven away into Hades, even all the nations that forget God.

fresh_translation: Because the poor man will not be forgotten to the end, and endurance of poor men will not perish into age.
brenton_translation: For the poor shall not be forgotten for ever: the patience of the needy ones shall not perish for ever.

fresh_translation: Rise up, Lord; let not man prevail. Let nations be judged before you.
brenton_translation: Arise, O Lord, let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged before thee.

fresh_translation: Appoint lawgiver over them, Lord; let nations know that they are men. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Appoint, O Lord, a lawgiver over them: let the heathen know that they are men. Pause.

fresh_translation: Why, Lord, have you stood far off, overlooking in opportunities, in affliction?
brenton_translation: Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? why dost thou overlook us in times of need, in affliction?

fresh_translation: When the ungodly man acts proudly, the poor man is set on fire; they are caught in schemes which they devise.
brenton_translation: While the ungodly one acts proudly, the poor is hotly pursued: the wicked are taken in the crafty counsels which they imagine.

fresh_translation: Because the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul, and the unjust man is blessed.
brenton_translation: Because the sinner praises himself for the desires of his heart; and the unjust one blesses himself.

fresh_translation: The sinner provoked the Lord; according to the multitude of his anger he will not seek him. God is not before him.
brenton_translation: The sinner has provoked the Lord: according to the abundance of his pride he will not seek after him: God is not before him.

fresh_translation: His ways are profaned in every season; your judgments are taken away from before him. He will dominate all his enemies.
brenton_translation: His ways are profane at all times; thy judgments are removed from before him: he will gain the mastery over all his enemies.

fresh_translation: For he said in his heart, I will not be shaken from generation to generation, without evil.
brenton_translation: For he has said in his heart, I shall not be moved, continuing without evil from generation to generation.

fresh_translation: His mouth is full of curse and bitterness and deceit; under his tongue are toil and pain.
brenton_translation: Whose mouth is full of cursing, and bitterness, and fraud: under his tongue are trouble and pain.

fresh_translation: He sits in ambush with rich men in hidden places to kill an innocent man; his eyes look toward the poor man.
brenton_translation: He lies in wait with rich men in secret places, in order to slay the innocent: his eyes are set against the poor.

fresh_translation: He lies in ambush in a hidden place like a lion in its den, lying in ambush to seize a poor man, to seize a poor man by dragging him away.
brenton_translation: He lies in wait in secret as a lion in his den: he lies in wait to ravish the poor, to ravish the poor when he draws him after him: he will bring him down in his snare.

fresh_translation: In his snare he will humble him; he will crouch and fall when he dominates poor men.
brenton_translation: He will bow down and fall when he has mastered the poor.

fresh_translation: For he said in his heart, God has forgotten; he turned away his face so as never to see.
brenton_translation: For he has said in his heart, God has forgotten: he has turned away his face so as never to look.

fresh_translation: Rise up, Lord God; let your hand be lifted high. Do not forget poor men.
brenton_translation: Arise, O Lord God; let thy hand be lifted up: forget not the poor.

fresh_translation: For what reason did the ungodly man provoke God? For he said in his heart, He will not seek out.
brenton_translation: Wherefore has the wicked provoked God? for he has said in his heart, He will not require it.

fresh_translation: You see, because you observe toil and wrath, to hand them over into your hands. To you the poor man is left; you were a helper to an orphan.
brenton_translation: Thou seest it; for thou dost observe trouble and wrath, to deliver them into thy hands: the poor has been left to thee; thou wast a helper to the orphan.

fresh_translation: Break the arm of the sinner and evil man; his sin will be sought and by no means found because of it.
brenton_translation: Break thou the arm of the sinner and wicked man: his sin shall be sought for, and shall not be found.

fresh_translation: The Lord will reign into age and into age of age; nations, you will perish from his land.
brenton_translation: The Lord shall reign for ever, even for ever and ever: ye Gentiles shall perish out of his land.

fresh_translation: The Lord heard the desire of poor men; your ear attended to the preparation of their heart,
brenton_translation: The Lord has heard the desire of the poor: thine ear has inclined to the preparation of their heart;

fresh_translation: to judge an orphan and a lowly man, so that man upon earth may no longer add to acting great.
brenton_translation: to plead for the orphan and afflicted, that man may no more boast upon the earth.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David. In the Lord I trusted. How will you say to my soul, Migrate to mountains like a sparrow?
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Because behold, sinners stretched bow, prepared arrows in quiver, to shoot in darkness at upright ones in heart.
brenton_translation: For behold the sinners have bent their bow, they have prepared their arrows for the quiver, to shoot privily at the upright in heart.

fresh_translation: Because what you fitted together they tore down; but the righteous man, what did he do?
brenton_translation: For they have pulled down what thou didst frame, but what has the righteous done?

fresh_translation: The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord's throne is in heaven. His eyes look toward the poor man; his eyelids examine sons of men.
brenton_translation: The Lord is in his holy temple, as for the Lord, his throne is in heaven: his eyes look upon the poor, his eyelids try the sons of men.

fresh_translation: The Lord examines the righteous man and the ungodly man, but one loving injustice hates his own soul.
brenton_translation: The Lord tries the righteous and the ungodly: and he that loves unrighteousness hates his own soul.

fresh_translation: He will rain snares upon sinners, fire and sulfur and blast of storm, the portion of their cup.
brenton_translation: He shall rain upon sinners snares, fire, and brimstone, and a stormy blast shall be the portion of their cup.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord is righteous and loved righteousnesses; his face saw uprightness.
brenton_translation: For the Lord is righteous, and loves righteousness; his face beholds uprightness.

fresh_translation: For end. Concerning eighth. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David, upon the eighth.

fresh_translation: Save me, Lord, because holy man failed, because truths were diminished from the sons of men.
brenton_translation: Save me, O Lord; for the godly man has failed; for truth is diminished from among the children of men.

fresh_translation: Each spoke vain things to his neighbor; with deceitful lips, with heart and heart they spoke.
brenton_translation: Every one has spoken vanity to his neighbour: their lips are deceitful, they have spoken with a double heart.

fresh_translation: May the Lord utterly destroy all deceitful lips and tongue speaking great things,
brenton_translation: Let the Lord destroy all the deceitful lips, and the tongue that speaks great words:

fresh_translation: those saying, We will magnify our tongue; our lips are with us; who is lord over us?
brenton_translation: who have said, We will magnify our tongue; our lips are our own: who is Lord of us?

fresh_translation: Because of misery of poor men and groaning of needy men, now I will rise up, says the Lord; I will set him in salvation; I will speak boldly in him.
brenton_translation: Because of the misery of the poor, and because of the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the Lord, I will set them in safety; I will speak to them thereof openly.

fresh_translation: The words of the Lord are pure words, silver refined by fire, tested in earth, purified sevenfold.
brenton_translation: The oracles of the Lord are pure oracles; as silver tried in the fire, proved in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

fresh_translation: You, Lord, will guard us and preserve us from this generation and into age.
brenton_translation: Thou, O Lord, shalt keep us, and shalt preserve us, from this generation, and for ever.

fresh_translation: Ungodly men walk around in circle; according to your height you made sons of men much observed.
brenton_translation: The ungodly walk around: according to thy greatness thou hast greatly exalted the sons of men.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Until when, Lord, will you forget me to end? Until when will you turn your face from me?
brenton_translation: How long, O Lord, wilt thou forget me? for ever? how long wilt thou turn away thy face from me?

fresh_translation: Until when will I place counsels in my soul, pains in my heart by day? Until when will my enemy be lifted up over me?
brenton_translation: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrows in my heart daily? how long shall my enemy be exalted over me?

fresh_translation: Look, hear me, Lord my God. Enlighten my eyes, lest I sleep into death,
brenton_translation: Look on me, hearken to me, O Lord my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep in death;

fresh_translation: lest my enemy say, I prevailed against him. Those afflicting me will rejoice if I am shaken.
brenton_translation: lest at any time mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him: my persecutors will exult if ever I should be moved.

fresh_translation: But I hoped in your mercy; my heart will rejoice in your salvation. I will sing to the Lord who did good to me, and sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
brenton_translation: But I have hoped in thy mercy; my heart shall exult in thy salvation. I will sing to the Lord who has dealt bountifully with me, and I will sing psalms to the name of the Lord most high.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David. The fool said in his heart, There is no God. They were corrupted and became abominable in pursuits; there is none doing kindness, there is not even one.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if there is one understanding or seeking God.
brenton_translation: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see if there were any that understood, or sought after God.

fresh_translation: All turned aside; together they became useless. There is none doing kindness, there is not even one. Their throat open grave; with their tongues they dealt deceitfully; venom of asps under their lips; whose mouth is full of curse and bitterness; their feet sharp to pour out blood.
brenton_translation: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become good for nothing, there is none that does good, no not one. Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips: whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness; their feet are swift to shed blood: destruction and misery are in their ways; and the way of peace they have not known: there is no fear of God before their eyes.

fresh_translation: Will not all workers of lawlessness know, those eating my people as food of bread? They did not call upon the Lord.
brenton_translation: Will not all the workers of iniquity know, who eat up my people as they would eat bread? they have not called upon the Lord.

fresh_translation: There they feared with fear where there was no fear, because God is in righteous generation.
brenton_translation: There were they alarmed with fear, where there was no fear; for God is in the righteous generation.

fresh_translation: You shamed counsel of a poor man, because the Lord is his hope.
brenton_translation: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his hope.

fresh_translation: Who will give from Zion salvation of Israel? When the Lord turns back captivity of his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad.
brenton_translation: Who will bring the salvation of Israel out of Sion? when the Lord brings back the captivity of his people, let Jacob exult, and Israel be glad.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David. Lord, who will sojourn in your tent, and who will camp on your holy mountain?
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: One walking blamelessly and working righteousness, speaking truth in his heart,
brenton_translation: He that walks blameless, and works righteousness, who speaks truth in his heart.

fresh_translation: who did not deal deceitfully with his tongue, nor do evil to his neighbor, and did not take reproach against those near him.
brenton_translation: Who has not spoken craftily with his tongue, neither has done evil to his neighbour, nor taken up a reproach against them that dwelt nearest to him.

fresh_translation: Evildoer is despised before him, but those fearing the Lord he glorifies; one swearing to his neighbor and not setting it aside,
brenton_translation: In his sight an evil-worker is set at nought, but he honours them that fear the Lord. He swears to his neighbour, and disappoints him not.

fresh_translation: his silver he did not give at interest, and did not take gifts against innocent men. One doing these things will not be shaken into age.
brenton_translation: He has not lent his money on usury, and has not received bribes against the innocent. He that does these things shall never be moved.

fresh_translation: Inscription of David. Guard me, Lord, because upon you I hoped.
brenton_translation: A writing of David.

fresh_translation: I said to the Lord, You are my Lord, because you have no need of my good things.
brenton_translation: I said to the Lord, Thou art my Lord; for thou hast no need of my goodness.

fresh_translation: To holy ones in his land he made all his wills wondrous in them.
brenton_translation: On behalf of the saints that are in his land, he has magnified all his pleasure in them.

fresh_translation: Their weaknesses were multiplied; after these things they hastened. I will by no means gather their gatherings from bloods, nor by any means remember their names with my lips.
brenton_translation: Their weaknesses have been multiplied; afterward they hasted. I will by no means assemble their bloody meetings, neither will I make mention of their names with my lips.

fresh_translation: Lord, portion of my inheritance and of my cup, you are one restoring my inheritance to me.
brenton_translation: The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou art he that restores my inheritance to me.

fresh_translation: Measuring lines fell to me among best things, and indeed my inheritance is best to me.
brenton_translation: The lines have fallen to me in the best places, yea, I have a most excellent heritage.

fresh_translation: I will bless the Lord who gave me understanding; and still, until night, my kidneys disciplined me.
brenton_translation: I will bless the Lord who has instructed me; my reins too have chastened me even till night.

fresh_translation: I foresaw the Lord before me through all things, because he is at my right hand so that I may not be shaken.
brenton_translation: I foresaw the Lord always before my face; for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

fresh_translation: Because of this my heart was gladdened and my tongue rejoiced; and still my flesh will camp in hope,
brenton_translation: Therefore my heart rejoiced and my tongue exulted; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:

fresh_translation: because you will not forsake my soul to Hades, nor will you give your holy one to see corruption.
brenton_translation: because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

fresh_translation: You made known to me ways of life; you will fill me with gladness with your face; delights at your right hand to end.
brenton_translation: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou wilt fill me with joy with thy countenance: at thy right hand there are delights for ever.

fresh_translation: Prayer of David. Hear, Lord, my righteousness; attend to my petition; give ear to my prayer, not with deceitful lips.
brenton_translation: A Prayer of David.

fresh_translation: Let my judgment come out from your face; let my eyes see straight things.
brenton_translation: Let my judgment come forth from thy presence; let mine eyes behold righteousness.

fresh_translation: You tested my heart, visited by night, refined me, and injustice was not found in me.
brenton_translation: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me by night; thou hast tried me as with fire, and unrighteousness has not been found in me: I am purposed that my mouth shall not speak amiss.

fresh_translation: So that my mouth might not speak works of men, because of words of your lips I kept hard ways.
brenton_translation: As for the works of men, by the words of thy lips I have guarded myself from hard ways.

fresh_translation: Set right my steps in your tracks, so that my steps may not be shaken.
brenton_translation: Direct my steps in thy paths, that my steps slip not.

fresh_translation: I cried out because you heard me, God. Incline your ear to me and hear my words.
brenton_translation: I have cried, for thou heardest me, O God: incline thine ear to me, and hearken to my words.

fresh_translation: Make your mercies wondrous, you saving those hoping upon you from those standing against your right hand.
brenton_translation: Shew the marvels of thy mercies, thou that savest them that hope in thee.

fresh_translation: Guard me as apple of eye; in the shelter of your wings you will cover me
brenton_translation: Keep me as the apple of the eye from those that resist thy right hand: thou shalt screen me by the covering of thy wings,

fresh_translation: from the face of ungodly men who distressed me. My enemies enclosed my soul.
brenton_translation: from the face of the ungodly that have afflicted me: mine enemies have compassed about my soul.

fresh_translation: Their fat they shut up; their mouth spoke arrogance.
brenton_translation: They have enclosed themselves with their own fat: their mouth has spoken pride.

fresh_translation: Casting me out, now they encircled me; their eyes they set to turn aside into earth.
brenton_translation: They have now cast me out and compassed me round about: they have set their eyes so as to bow them down to the ground.

fresh_translation: They took me up like a lion ready for the hunt and like a lion-cub dwelling in hidden places.
brenton_translation: They laid wait for me as a lion ready for prey, and like a lion's whelp dwelling in secret places.

fresh_translation: Rise up, Lord; get before them and trip them up. Rescue my soul from ungodly men, your sword, from enemies of your hand,
brenton_translation: Arise, O Lord, prevent them, and cast them down: deliver my soul from the ungodly: draw thy sword,

fresh_translation: Lord, from few men of earth divide them in their life; and with your hidden things their belly was filled. They were satisfied with sons and left remainders to their little ones.
brenton_translation: because of the enemies of thine hand: O Lord, destroy them from the earth; scatter them in their life, though their belly has been filled with thy hidden treasures: they have been satisfied with uncleanness, and have left the remnant of their possessions to their babes.

fresh_translation: But I in righteousness will appear before your face; I will be satisfied when your glory appears.
brenton_translation: But I shall appear in righteousness before thy face: I shall be satisfied when thy glory appears.

fresh_translation: For end. To the servant of the Lord, David, what he spoke to the Lord, words of this song, on the day when the Lord rescued him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David the servant of the Lord; the words which he spoke to the Lord, even the words of this Song, in the day in which the Lord delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul: and he said:

fresh_translation: And he said, I will love you, Lord, my strength.
brenton_translation: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.

fresh_translation: Lord my firm place and my refuge and my rescuer, my God my helper, and I will hope upon him, my defender and horn of my salvation, my supporter.
brenton_translation: The Lord is my firm support, and my refuge, and my deliverer; my God is my helper, I will hope in him; he is my defender, and the horn of my salvation, and my helper.

fresh_translation: Praising, I will call upon the Lord, and from my enemies I will be saved.
brenton_translation: I will call upon the Lord with praises, and I shall be saved from mine enemies.

fresh_translation: The pangs of death enclosed me, and torrents of lawlessness troubled me.
brenton_translation: The pangs of death compassed me, and the torrents of ungodliness troubled me exceedingly.

fresh_translation: The pangs of Hades surrounded me; snares of death came before me.
brenton_translation: The pangs of hell came round about me: the snares of death prevented me.

fresh_translation: And in my affliction I called upon the Lord, and to my God I cried out. He heard my voice from his holy temple, and my cry before him will enter into his ears.
brenton_translation: And when I was afflicted I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God: he heard my voice out of his holy temple, and my cry shall enter before him, even into his ears.

fresh_translation: And earth was shaken and became trembling; foundations of mountains were troubled and shaken, because God was angered with them.
brenton_translation: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains were disturbed, and were shaken, because God was angry with them.

fresh_translation: Smoke went up in his anger, and fire from his face flamed up; coals were kindled from him.
brenton_translation: There went up a smoke in his wrath, and fire burst into a flame at his presence: coals were kindled at it.

fresh_translation: And he bent heaven and came down, and gloom under his feet.
brenton_translation: And he bowed the heaven, and came down: and thick darkness was under his feet.

fresh_translation: And he mounted cheroub and flew; he flew upon the wings of winds.
brenton_translation: And he mounted on cherubs and flew: he flew on the wings of winds.

fresh_translation: And he made darkness his hiding place; around him his tent, dark water in the clouds of air.
brenton_translation: And he made darkness his secret place: round about him was his tabernacle, even dark water in the clouds of the air.

fresh_translation: From brightness before him clouds passed through, hail and coals of fire.
brenton_translation: At the brightness before him the clouds passed, hail and coals of fire.

fresh_translation: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and Most High gave his voice.
brenton_translation: The Lord also thundered from heaven, and the Highest uttered his voice.

fresh_translation: And he sent out arrows and scattered them; he multiplied lightnings and threw them into confusion.
brenton_translation: And he sent forth his weapons, and scattered them; and multiplied lightnings, and routed them.

fresh_translation: And the fountains of waters were seen, and the foundations of the inhabited world were uncovered from your rebuke, Lord, from the breath of the spirit of your wrath.
brenton_translation: And the springs of waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blasting of the breath of thy wrath.

fresh_translation: He sent from on high and took me; he received me out of many waters.
brenton_translation: He sent from on high and took me, he drew me to himself out of many waters.

fresh_translation: He will rescue me from my strong enemies and from those hating me, because they were stronger than I.
brenton_translation: He will deliver me from my mighty enemies, and from them that hate me; for they are stronger than I.

fresh_translation: They came before me in the day of my affliction, and the Lord became my support.
brenton_translation: They prevented me in the day of mine affliction: but the Lord was my stay against them.

fresh_translation: And he brought me out into broad place; he will rescue me because he desired me.
brenton_translation: And he brought me out into a wide place: he will deliver me, because he has pleasure in me.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands he will repay me,
brenton_translation: And the Lord will recompense me according to my righteousness; even according to the purity of my hands will he recompense me.

fresh_translation: because I kept ways of the Lord and did not act ungodly from my God.
brenton_translation: For I have kept the ways of the Lord and have not wickedly departed from my God.

fresh_translation: Because all his judgments were before me, and his ordinances I did not turn away from me.
brenton_translation: For all his judgments were before me, and his ordinances departed not from me.

fresh_translation: And I will be blameless with him, and guard myself from my lawlessness.
brenton_translation: And I shall be blameless with him, and shall keep myself from mine iniquity.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness and according to the purity of my hands before his eyes.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall recompense me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands before his eyes.

fresh_translation: With holy one you will be holy, and with innocent man you will be innocent.
brenton_translation: With the holy thou wilt be holy; and with the innocent man thou wilt be innocent.

fresh_translation: And with chosen one you will be chosen, and with crooked one you will twist.
brenton_translation: And with the excellent man thou wilt be excellent; and with the perverse thou wilt shew frowardness.

fresh_translation: Because you will save humble people and humble eyes of proud men.
brenton_translation: For thou wilt save the lowly people, and wilt humble the eyes of the proud.

fresh_translation: Because you will light my lamp, Lord; my God, you will light my darkness.
brenton_translation: For thou, O Lord, wilt light my lamp: my God, thou wilt lighten my darkness.

fresh_translation: Because in you I will be rescued from trap, and in my God I will leap over wall.
brenton_translation: For by thee shall I be delivered from a troop; and by my God I will pass over a wall.

fresh_translation: My God, his way blameless; the words of the Lord refined by fire. He is defender of all hoping upon him.
brenton_translation: As for my God, his way is perfect: the oracles of the Lord are tried in the fire; he is a protector of all them that hope in him.

fresh_translation: Because who is God besides Lord, and who is God besides our God?
brenton_translation: For who is God but the Lord? and who is a God except our God?

fresh_translation: God who girds me with strength and set my way blameless,
brenton_translation: It is God that girds me with strength, and has made my way blameless:

fresh_translation: fitting my feet like deer and setting me upon heights,
brenton_translation: who strengthens my feet as hart's feet, and sets me upon high places.

fresh_translation: teaching my hands for war, and you made my arms bronze bow.
brenton_translation: He instructs my hands for war; and thou hast made my arms as a brazen bow.

fresh_translation: And you gave me defense of my salvation, and your right hand held me up, and your discipline set me straight to end, and this discipline of yours will teach me.
brenton_translation: And thou hast made me secure in my salvation: and thy right hand has helped me, and thy correction has upheld me to the end; yea, thy correction itself shall instruct me.

fresh_translation: You widened my steps under me, and my tracks did not weaken.
brenton_translation: Thou hast made room for my goings under me, and my footsteps did not fail.

fresh_translation: I will pursue my enemies and overtake them, and I will not turn back until they fail.
brenton_translation: I will pursue mine enemies, and overtake them; and I will not turn back until they are consumed.

fresh_translation: I will crush them and they will not be able to stand; they will fall under my feet.
brenton_translation: I will dash them to pieces and they shall not be able to stand: they shall fall under my feet.

fresh_translation: And you girded me with strength for war; you shackled under me all rising against me.
brenton_translation: For thou hast girded me with strength for war: thou hast beaten down under me all that rose up against me.

fresh_translation: And my enemies you gave to me back, and those hating me you destroyed.
brenton_translation: And thou hast made mine enemies turn their backs before me; and thou hast destroyed them that hated me.

fresh_translation: They cried out, and there was none saving, to the Lord, and he did not hear them.
brenton_translation: They cried, but there was no deliverer: even to the Lord, but he hearkened not to them.

fresh_translation: And I will pulverize them like dust before wind; like mud of streets I will smooth them down.
brenton_translation: I will grind them as the mud of the streets: and I will beat them small as dust before the wind.

fresh_translation: Rescue me from contradictions of the people; you will set me as head of nations. People whom I did not know served me.
brenton_translation: Deliver me from the gainsayings of the people: thou shalt make me head of the Gentiles: a people whom I knew not served me,

fresh_translation: At the hearing of ear they obeyed me; foreign sons lied to me.
brenton_translation: at the hearing of the ear they obeyed me: the strange children lied to me.

fresh_translation: Foreign sons grew old and limped from their paths.
brenton_translation: The strange children waxed old, and fell away from their paths through lameness.

fresh_translation: The Lord lives, and blessed is my God, and let God of my salvation be exalted,
brenton_translation: The Lord lives; and blessed be my God; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

fresh_translation: God giving vengeance to me and subjecting peoples under me,
brenton_translation: It is God that avenges me, and has subdued the nations under me;

fresh_translation: my rescuer from angry enemies. From those rising against me you will lift me up; from unjust man you will rescue me.
brenton_translation: my deliverer from angry enemies: thou shalt set me on high above them that rise up against me: thou shalt deliver me from the unrighteous man.

fresh_translation: Because of this I will confess to you among nations, Lord, and to your name I will sing praise,
brenton_translation: Therefore will I confess to thee, O Lord, among the Gentiles, and sing to thy name.

fresh_translation: magnifying salvations of his king and doing mercy to his Anointed, to David and to his seed into age.
brenton_translation: God magnifies the deliverances of his king; and deals mercifully with David his anointed, and his seed, for ever.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Heavens recount the glory of God, and firmament announces making of his hands.
brenton_translation: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament proclaims the work of his hands.

fresh_translation: Day to day gushes word, and night to night announces knowledge.
brenton_translation: Day to day utters speech, and night to night proclaims knowledge.

fresh_translation: There are no speeches nor words where their voices are not heard.
brenton_translation: There are no speeches or words, in which their voices are not heard.

fresh_translation: Into all the earth their sound went out, and to the ends of inhabited world their words. In sun he set his tent.
brenton_translation: Their voice is gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world.

fresh_translation: And he as bridegroom coming out of bridal chamber will rejoice like a giant to run his course.
brenton_translation: In the sun he has set his tabernacle; and he comes forth as a bridegroom out of his chamber: he will exult as a giant to run his course.

fresh_translation: From the edge of heaven is his going out, and his return to edge of heaven, and there is none who will hide from his heat.
brenton_translation: His going forth is from the extremity of heaven, and his circuit to the other end of heaven: and no one shall be hidden from his heat.

fresh_translation: The law of the Lord is blameless, turning souls back; the testimony of the Lord is faithful, making little ones wise.
brenton_translation: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting souls: the testimony of the Lord is faithful, instructing babes.

fresh_translation: The ordinances of the Lord are straight, gladdening heart; the command of the Lord is radiant, enlightening eyes.
brenton_translation: The ordinances of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is bright, enlightening the eyes.

fresh_translation: The fear of the Lord is pure, remaining into age of age; judgments of the Lord are true, justified together.
brenton_translation: The fear of the Lord is pure, enduring for ever and ever: the judgments of the Lord are true, and justified altogether.

fresh_translation: More to be desired than gold and much precious stone, and sweeter than honey and honeycomb.
brenton_translation: To be desired more than gold, and much precious stone: sweeter also than honey and the honey-comb.

fresh_translation: And indeed your servant guards them; in guarding them, much repayment.
brenton_translation: For thy servant keeps to them: in the keeping of them there is great reward.

fresh_translation: Who will understand trespasses? From my hidden ones cleanse me,
brenton_translation: Who will understand his transgressions? purge thou me from my secret sins.

fresh_translation: and from strangers spare your servant. If they do not dominate me, then I will be blameless, and I will be cleansed from great sin.
brenton_translation: And spare thy servant the attack of strangers: if they do not gain the dominion over me, then shall I be blameless, and I shall be clear from great sin.

fresh_translation: And words of my mouth and meditation of my heart will be for favor before you through all things, Lord, my helper and my redeemer.
brenton_translation: So shall the sayings of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be pleasing continually before thee, O Lord my helper, and my redeemer.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: May the Lord hear you in the day of affliction; may the name of God of Jacob defend you.
brenton_translation: The Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee.

fresh_translation: May he send you help from holy place, and from Zion may he support you.
brenton_translation: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and aid thee out of Sion.

fresh_translation: May he remember all your sacrifice and let your whole burnt offering be fat. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Remember all thy sacrifice, and enrich thy whole-burnt-offering. Pause.

fresh_translation: May he give you according to your heart and fulfill all your counsel.
brenton_translation: Grant thee according to thy heart, and fulfil all thy desire.

fresh_translation: We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will be magnified. May the Lord fulfill all your requests.
brenton_translation: We will exult in thy salvation, and in the name of our God shall we be magnified: the Lord fulfil all thy petitions.

fresh_translation: Now I knew that the Lord saved his Anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven. Salvation of his right hand is in the acts of power.
brenton_translation: Now I know that the Lord has saved his Christ: he shall hear him from his holy heaven: the salvation of his right hand is mighty.

fresh_translation: These in chariots and these in horses, but we in the name of the Lord our God will be magnified.
brenton_translation: Some glory in chariots, and some in horses: but we will glory in the name of the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: They were shackled and fell, but we rose and were set upright.
brenton_translation: They are overthrown and fallen: but we are risen, and have been set upright.

fresh_translation: Lord, save your king, and hear us in whatever day we call upon you.
brenton_translation: O Lord, save the king: and hear us in whatever day we call upon thee.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Lord, in your strength king will be gladdened, and in your salvation he will greatly rejoice.
brenton_translation: O Lord, the king shall rejoice in thy strength; and in thy salvation he shall greatly exult.

fresh_translation: The desire of his soul you gave to him, and longing of his lips you did not deprive him of. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Thou hast granted him the desire of his soul, and hast not withheld from him the request of his lips. Pause.

fresh_translation: Because you got before him with blessings of goodness; you set upon his head crown from precious stone.
brenton_translation: For thou hast prevented him with blessings of goodness: thou hast set upon his head a crown of precious stone.

fresh_translation: He asked life from you, and you gave it to him, length of days into age of age.
brenton_translation: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest him length of days for ever and ever.

fresh_translation: Great his glory in your salvation; glory and magnificence you will place upon him.
brenton_translation: His glory is great in thy salvation: thou wilt crown him with glory and majesty.

fresh_translation: Because you will give him blessing into age of age; you will gladden him with joy with your face.
brenton_translation: For thou wilt give him a blessing for ever and ever: thou wilt gladden him with joy with thy countenance.

fresh_translation: Because the king hopes upon the Lord, and in the mercy of Most High he will by no means be shaken.
brenton_translation: For the king trusts in the Lord, and through the mercy of the Highest he shall not be moved.

fresh_translation: May your hand be found by all your enemies; may your right hand find all hating you.
brenton_translation: Let thy hand be found by all thine enemies: let thy right hand find all that hate thee.

fresh_translation: You will set them like a furnace of fire in the time of your face; The Lord in his anger will trouble them, and fire will devour them.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven at the time of thy presence: the Lord shall trouble them in his anger, and fire shall devour them.

fresh_translation: Their fruit from earth you will destroy, and their seed from the sons of men,
brenton_translation: Thou shalt destroy their fruit from the earth, and their seed from among the sons of men.

fresh_translation: because they bent evils toward you; they devised counsel which they will not be able to establish.
brenton_translation: For they intended evils against thee; they imagined a device which they shall by no means be able to perform.

fresh_translation: Because you will set them as back in your remnants; you will prepare their face.
brenton_translation: For thou shalt make them turn their back in thy latter end, thou wilt prepare their face.

fresh_translation: Be exalted, Lord, in your strength; we will sing and praise your mighty acts.
brenton_translation: Be thou exalted, O Lord, in thy strength: we will sing and praise thy mighty acts.

fresh_translation: For end. Concerning morning help. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, concerning the morning aid, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: God, my God, attend to me. Why did you forsake me? Far from my salvation are words of my trespasses.
brenton_translation: O God, my God, attend to me: why hast thou forsaken me? the account of my transgressions is far from my salvation.

fresh_translation: My God, I will cry by day and you will not hear, and by night, and it is not folly to me.
brenton_translation: O my God, I will cry to thee by day, but thou wilt not hear: and by night, and it shall not be accounted for folly to me.

fresh_translation: But you dwell among holy ones, praise of Israel.
brenton_translation: But thou, the praise of Israel, dwellest in a sanctuary.

fresh_translation: Upon you our fathers hoped; they hoped and you rescued them.
brenton_translation: Our fathers hoped in thee; they hoped, and thou didst deliver them.

fresh_translation: To you they cried and were saved; upon you they hoped and were not ashamed.
brenton_translation: They cried to thee, and were saved: they hoped in thee, and were not ashamed.

fresh_translation: But I am worm and not man, reproach of man and despising of the people.
brenton_translation: But I am a worm, and not a man; a reproach of men, and scorn of the people.

fresh_translation: All seeing me mocked me; they spoke with lips, they shook head,
brenton_translation: All that saw me mocked me: they spoke with their lips, they shook the head, saying,

fresh_translation: He hoped upon the Lord; let him rescue him, let him save him, because he wants him.
brenton_translation: He hoped in the Lord: let him deliver him, let him save him, because he takes pleasure in him.

fresh_translation: Because you are one drawing me out from womb, my hope from the breasts of my mother.
brenton_translation: For thou art he that drew me out of the womb; my hope from my mother's breasts.

fresh_translation: Upon you I was cast from womb; from the belly of my mother you are my God.
brenton_translation: I was cast on thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.

fresh_translation: Do not stand far from me, because affliction is near, because there is no helper.
brenton_translation: Stand not aloof from me; for affliction is near; for there is no helper.

fresh_translation: Many calves encircled me; fat bulls surrounded me.
brenton_translation: Many bullocks have compassed me: fat bulls have beset me round.

fresh_translation: They opened their mouth upon me like a lion seizing and roaring.
brenton_translation: They have opened their mouth against me, as a ravening and roaring lion.

fresh_translation: Like water I was poured out, and all my bones were scattered; my heart became like wax melting in the midst of my belly.
brenton_translation: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are loosened: my heart in the midst of my belly is become like melting wax.

fresh_translation: My strength dried up like potsherd, and my tongue was glued to my throat, and you brought me down into dust of death.
brenton_translation: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue is glued to my throat; and thou hast brought me down to the dust of death.

fresh_translation: Because many dogs encircled me; gathering of evildoers surrounded me; they dug my hands and feet.
brenton_translation: For many dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked doers has beset me round: they pierced my hands and my feet.

fresh_translation: I counted all my bones, and they observed and looked on me.
brenton_translation: They counted all my bones; and they observed and looked upon me.

fresh_translation: They divided my garments among themselves, and cast lot upon my clothing.
brenton_translation: They parted my garments among themselves, and cast lots upon my raiment.

fresh_translation: But you, Lord, do not put my help far away; attend to my support.
brenton_translation: But thou, O Lord, remove not my help afar off: be ready for mine aid.

fresh_translation: Rescue my soul from sword, and my only one from the hand of dog.
brenton_translation: Deliver my soul from the sword; my only-begotten one from the power of the dog.

fresh_translation: Save me from the mouth of lion, and my humiliation from horns of unicorns.
brenton_translation: Save me from the lion's mouth; and regard my lowliness from the horns of the unicorns.

fresh_translation: I will recount your name to my brothers; in the midst of assembly I will hymn you.
brenton_translation: I will declare thy name to my brethren: in the midst of the church will I sing praise to thee.

fresh_translation: You fearing Lord, praise him; all seed of Jacob, glorify him; let all seed of Israel fear him,
brenton_translation: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him; all ye seed of Jacob, glorify him: let all the seed of Israel fear him.

fresh_translation: because he did not despise nor loathe petition of a poor man, nor turn his face from me, and when I cried to him he heard me.
brenton_translation: For he has not despised nor been angry at the supplication of the poor; nor turned away his face from me; but when I cried to him, he heard me.

fresh_translation: From you my praise in great assembly; my vows I will repay before those fearing him.
brenton_translation: My praise is of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

fresh_translation: Poor men will eat and be filled, and those seeking him will praise the Lord; their hearts will live into age of age.
brenton_translation: The poor shall eat and be satisfied; and they shall praise the Lord that seek him: their heart shall live for ever.

fresh_translation: All ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, and all families of nations will worship before you.
brenton_translation: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the Lord: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before him.

fresh_translation: Because the kingdom belongs to the Lord, and he rules over the nations.
brenton_translation: For the kingdom is the Lord's; and he is the governor of the nations.

fresh_translation: All fat ones of earth ate and worshiped; before him all going down into earth will fall down, and my soul lives to him.
brenton_translation: All the fat ones of the earth have eaten and worshipped: all that go down to the earth shall fall down before him: my soul also lives to him.

fresh_translation: And my seed will serve him; coming generation will be announced to the Lord.
brenton_translation: And my seed shall serve him: the generation that is coming shall be reported to the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they will announce his righteousness to people being born, because the Lord did it.
brenton_translation: And they shall report his righteousness to the people that shall be born, whom the Lord has made.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David. The Lord shepherds me, and nothing will fail me.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Into place of grass there he camped me; beside water of rest he nourished me.
brenton_translation: In a place of green grass, there he has made me dwell: he has nourished me by the water of rest.

fresh_translation: He turned my soul back; he led me upon tracks of righteousness for the sake of his name.
brenton_translation: He has restored my soul: he has guided me into the paths of righteousness, for his name's sake.

fresh_translation: For even if I walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will not fear evils, because you are with me; your rod and your staff, these comforted me.
brenton_translation: Yea, even if I should walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will not be afraid of evils: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff, these have comforted me.

fresh_translation: You prepared table before me opposite those afflicting me; you anointed my head with oil, and your cup intoxicating like strongest wine.
brenton_translation: Thou hast prepared a table before me in presence of them that afflict me: thou hast thoroughly anointed my head with oil; and thy cup cheers me like the best wine.

fresh_translation: And your mercy will pursue me all days of my life, and my dwelling in the house of the Lord to the length of days.
brenton_translation: Thy mercy also shall follow me all the days of my life: and my dwelling shall be in the house of the Lord for a very long time.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David. Of first of Sabbaths. Earth belongs to the Lord and its fullness, inhabited world and all dwelling in it.
brenton_translation: A Psalm for David on the first day of the week.

fresh_translation: He founded it upon seas and prepared it upon rivers.
brenton_translation: He has founded it upon the seas, and prepared it upon the rivers.

fresh_translation: Who will go up to the mountain of the Lord, and who will stand in his holy place?
brenton_translation: Who shall go up to the mountain of the Lord, and who shall stand in his holy place?

fresh_translation: Innocent in hands and clean in heart, who did not take his soul upon vanity and did not swear in deceit to his neighbor.
brenton_translation: He that is innocent in his hands and pure in his heart; who has not lifted up his soul to vanity, nor sworn deceitfully to his neighbour.

fresh_translation: This one will receive blessing from the Lord and mercy from God his savior.
brenton_translation: He shall receive a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from God his Saviour.

fresh_translation: This is generation of those seeking him, seeking face of God of Jacob. Interlude.
brenton_translation: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek the face of the God of Jacob. Pause.

fresh_translation: Lift up gates, your rulers, and be lifted up, everlasting gates, and the king of glory will enter.
brenton_translation: Lift up your gates, ye princes, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors; and the king of glory shall come in.

fresh_translation: Who is this king of glory? The Lord, strong and mighty; the Lord, mighty in war.
brenton_translation: Who is this king of glory? the Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.

fresh_translation: Lift up gates, your rulers, and be lifted up, everlasting gates, and the king of glory will enter.
brenton_translation: Lift up your gates, ye princes; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the king of glory shall come in.

fresh_translation: Who is this king of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the king of glory.
brenton_translation: Who is this king of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is this king of glory.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David. To you, Lord, I lifted my soul, O my God.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Upon you I trusted; may I not be ashamed, nor let my enemies mock me.
brenton_translation: O my God, I have trusted in thee: let me not be confounded, neither let mine enemies laugh me to scorn.

fresh_translation: For indeed all enduring you will by no means be ashamed; let all acting lawlessly for nothing be ashamed.
brenton_translation: For none of them that wait on thee shall in any wise be ashamed: let them be ashamed that transgress without cause.

fresh_translation: Your ways, Lord, make known to me, and your paths teach me.
brenton_translation: Shew me thy ways, O Lord; and teach me thy paths.

fresh_translation: Lead me upon your truth and teach me, because you are God my savior, and I endured you all day.
brenton_translation: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art God my Saviour: and I have waited on thee all the day.

fresh_translation: Remember your compassions, Lord, and your mercies, because they are from age.
brenton_translation: Remember thy compassions, O Lord, and thy mercies, for they are from everlasting.

fresh_translation: Sins of my youth and my ignorances do not remember; according to your mercy remember me, because of your goodness, Lord.
brenton_translation: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my sins of ignorance: remember me according to thy mercy, for thy goodness' sake, O Lord.

fresh_translation: Good and upright is the Lord; because of this he will give law to sinners in way.
brenton_translation: Good and upright is the Lord: therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.

fresh_translation: He will guide meek ones in judgment; he will teach meek ones his ways.
brenton_translation: The meek will he guide in judgment: the meek will he teach his ways.

fresh_translation: All ways of the Lord are mercy and truth to those seeking out his covenant and his testimonies.
brenton_translation: All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth to them that seek his covenant and his testimonies.

fresh_translation: For the sake of your name, Lord, you will be propitious to my sin, because it is great.
brenton_translation: For thy name's sake, O Lord, do thou also be merciful to my sin; for it is great.

fresh_translation: Who is man fearing Lord? He will give law to him in way which he chose.
brenton_translation: Who is the man that fears the Lord? he shall instruct him in the way which he has chosen.

fresh_translation: His soul will lodge among good things, and his seed will inherit earth.
brenton_translation: His soul shall dwell in prosperity; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

fresh_translation: The Lord is stronghold of those fearing him, and the name of the Lord belongs to those fearing him, and his covenant to show it to them.
brenton_translation: The Lord is the strength of them that fear him; and his covenant is to manifest truth to them.

fresh_translation: My eyes are always toward the Lord, because he will draw my feet out of snare.
brenton_translation: Mine eyes are continually to the Lord; for he shall draw my feet out of the snare.

fresh_translation: Look upon me and have mercy on me, because I am only one and poor.
brenton_translation: Look upon me, and have mercy upon me; for I am an only child and poor.

fresh_translation: Afflictions of my heart were widened; out of my necessities bring me out.
brenton_translation: The afflictions of my heart have been multiplied; deliver me from my distresses.

fresh_translation: See my humiliation and my toil, and forgive all my sins.
brenton_translation: Look upon mine affliction and my trouble; and forgive all my sins.

fresh_translation: See my enemies, because they were multiplied and hated me with unjust hatred.
brenton_translation: Look upon mine enemies; for they have been multiplied; and they have hated me with unjust hatred.

fresh_translation: Guard my soul and rescue me; may I not be ashamed, because I hoped upon you.
brenton_translation: Keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I have hoped in thee.

fresh_translation: Blameless and upright men clung to me, because I endured you, Lord.
brenton_translation: The harmless and upright joined themselves to me: for I waited for thee, O Lord.

fresh_translation: Redeem, O God, Israel from all his afflictions.
brenton_translation: Deliver Israel, O God, out of all his afflictions.

fresh_translation: Of David. Judge me, Lord, because I walked in my innocence, and hoping upon the Lord I will by no means weaken.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Test me, Lord, and try me; refine my kidneys and my heart.
brenton_translation: Prove me, O Lord, and try me; purify as with fire my reins and my heart.

fresh_translation: Because your mercy is before my eyes, and I was well-pleasing in your truth.
brenton_translation: For thy mercy is before mine eyes: and I am well pleased with thy truth.

fresh_translation: I did not sit with the assembly of vanity, and with lawless men I will by no means enter.
brenton_translation: I have not sat with the council of vanity, and will in nowise enter in with transgressors.

fresh_translation: I hated assembly of evildoers, and with ungodly men I will by no means sit.
brenton_translation: I have hated the assembly of wicked doers; and will not sit with ungodly men.

fresh_translation: I will wash my hands among innocent ones, and circle your altar, Lord,
brenton_translation: I will wash my hands in innocency, and compass thine altar, O Lord:

fresh_translation: to hear the voice of praise and recount all your wondrous deeds.
brenton_translation: to hear the voice of praise, and to declare all thy wonderful works.

fresh_translation: Lord, I loved beauty of your house and place of tent of your glory.
brenton_translation: O Lord, I have loved the beauty of thy house, and the place of the tabernacle of thy glory.

fresh_translation: Do not destroy my soul together with ungodly men, nor my life with men of bloods,
brenton_translation: Destroy not my soul together with the ungodly, nor my life with bloody men:

fresh_translation: in whose hands are lawless acts, and their right hand was filled with gifts.
brenton_translation: in whose hands are iniquities, and their right hand is filled with bribes.

fresh_translation: But I walked in my innocence; redeem me and have mercy on me.
brenton_translation: But I have walked in my innocence: redeem me, and have mercy upon me.

fresh_translation: For my foot stood in uprightness; in assemblies I will bless you, Lord.
brenton_translation: My foot stands in an even place: in the congregations will I bless thee, O Lord.

fresh_translation: Of David, before being anointed. The Lord is my illumination and my savior; whom shall I fear? The Lord is defender of my life; from whom shall I be afraid?
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David, before he was anointed.

fresh_translation: When evildoers draw near upon me to eat my flesh, those afflicting me and my enemies, they weakened and fell.
brenton_translation: When evil-doers drew nigh against me to eat up my flesh, my persecutors and mine enemies, they fainted and fell.

fresh_translation: If camp should line up against me, my heart will not fear. If war rise up against me, in this I hope.
brenton_translation: Though an army should set itself in array against me, my heart shall not be afraid: though war should rise up against me, in this am I confident.

fresh_translation: One thing I asked from the Lord; this I will seek out: to dwell me in the house of the Lord all days of my life, to behold delight of the Lord and visit his temple.
brenton_translation: One thing have I asked of the Lord, this will I earnestly seek: that I should dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, that I should behold the fair beauty of the Lord, and survey his temple.

fresh_translation: Because he hid me in tent in the day of my evils; he sheltered me in the hidden place of his tent; on rock he lifted me up.
brenton_translation: For in the day of mine afflictions he hid me in his tabernacle: he sheltered me in the secret of his tabernacle; he set me up on a rock.

fresh_translation: And now behold, he lifted my head over enemies around me. I went around and sacrificed in his tent sacrifice of shouting; I will sing and praise the Lord.
brenton_translation: And now, behold, he has lifted up mine head over mine enemies: I went round and offered in his tabernacle the sacrifice of joy; I will sing, even sing psalms to the Lord.

fresh_translation: Hear, Lord, my voice with which I cried out; have mercy on me and hear me.
brenton_translation: Hear, O Lord, my voice which I have uttered aloud: pity me, and hearken to me.

fresh_translation: To you my heart said, My face sought your face; your face, Lord, I will seek.
brenton_translation: My heart said to thee, I have diligently sought thy face: thy face, O Lord, I will seek.

fresh_translation: Do not turn your face from me, nor turn away in anger from your servant. Become my helper; do not cast me off and do not forsake me, God my savior.
brenton_translation: Turn not thy face away from me, turn not thou away from thy servant in anger: be thou my helper, forsake me not; and, O God my Saviour, overlook me not.

fresh_translation: Because my father and my mother forsook me, but the Lord took me in.
brenton_translation: For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the Lord has taken me to himself.

fresh_translation: Give me law, Lord, in your way, and lead me in straight path because of my enemies.
brenton_translation: Teach me, O Lord, in thy way, and guide me in a right path, because of mine enemies.

fresh_translation: Do not hand me over to the souls of those afflicting me, because unjust witnesses rose against me and injustice lied to itself.
brenton_translation: Deliver me not over to the desire of them that afflict me; for unjust witnesses have risen up against me, and injustice has lied within herself.

fresh_translation: I believe to see good things of the Lord in the land of living ones.
brenton_translation: I believe that I shall see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

fresh_translation: Endure Lord; act like a man, and let your heart be strengthened, and endure Lord.
brenton_translation: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and let thy heart be strengthened: yea, wait on the Lord.

fresh_translation: Of David. To you, Lord, I cried out. My God, do not be silent from me, lest if you be silent from me, I become like those going down into pit.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Hear voice of my petition when I beg to you, when I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
brenton_translation: Hearken to the voice of my supplication, when I pray to thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy temple.

fresh_translation: Do not drag my soul away with sinners, and do not destroy me together with those working injustice, those speaking peace with their neighbors while evils are in their hearts.
brenton_translation: Draw not away my soul with sinners, and destroy me not with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace with their neighbours, but evils are in their hearts.

fresh_translation: Give to them according to their works and according to evil of their pursuits; according to the works of their hands give to them; repay to them their repayment.
brenton_translation: Give them according to their works, and according to the wickedness of their devices: give them according to the works of their hands; render their recompence unto them.

fresh_translation: Because they did not understand works of the Lord and works of his hands, you will pull them down and by no means build them up.
brenton_translation: Because they have not attended to the works of the Lord, even to the works of his hands, thou shalt pull them down, and shalt not build them up.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord, because he heard the voice of my petition.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord, for he has hearkened to the voice of my petition.

fresh_translation: Lord my helper and my defender; upon him my heart hoped and I was helped, and my flesh bloomed again, and by my will I will confess to him.
brenton_translation: The Lord is my helper and my defender; my heart has hoped in him, and I am helped: my flesh has revived, and willingly will I give praise to him.

fresh_translation: The Lord is strength of his people, and defender of salvations of his Anointed is he.
brenton_translation: The Lord is the strength of his people, and the saving defender of his anointed.

fresh_translation: Save your people and bless your inheritance, and shepherd them and lift them up until age.
brenton_translation: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: and take care of them, and lift them up for ever.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David. Of exiting tent. Bring to the Lord, sons of God; bring to the Lord sons of rams; bring to the Lord glory and honor.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David on the occasion of the solemn assembly of the Tabernacle.

fresh_translation: Bring to the Lord glory to his name; worship the Lord in his holy court.
brenton_translation: Bring to the Lord glory, due to his name; worship the Lord in his holy court.

fresh_translation: The voice of the Lord is upon waters; God of glory thundered; Lord upon many waters.
brenton_translation: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory has thundered: the Lord is upon many waters.

fresh_translation: The voice of the Lord is in strength; the voice of the Lord is in magnificence.
brenton_translation: The voice of the Lord is mighty; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.

fresh_translation: The voice of the Lord shattering cedars, and the Lord will shatter cedars of Lebanon.
brenton_translation: There is the voice of the Lord who breaks the cedars; the Lord will break the cedars of Libanus.

fresh_translation: And he will pulverize them like a calf, Lebanon, and the beloved one like son of unicorns.
brenton_translation: And he will beat them small, even Libanus itself, like a calf; and the beloved one is as a young unicorn.

fresh_translation: The voice of the Lord cutting through flame of fire.
brenton_translation: There is a voice of the Lord who divides a flame of fire.

fresh_translation: The voice of the Lord shaking wilderness, and the Lord will shake wilderness of Kadesh.
brenton_translation: A voice of the Lord who shakes the wilderness; the Lord will shake the wilderness of Cades.

fresh_translation: The voice of the Lord fitting deer and uncovering forests; and in his temple every one says, Glory.
brenton_translation: The voice of the Lord strengthens the hinds, and will uncover the thickets: and in his temple every one speaks of his glory.

fresh_translation: The Lord will dwell over flood, and the Lord will sit king into age.
brenton_translation: The Lord will dwell on the waterflood: and the Lord will sit a king for ever.

fresh_translation: The Lord will give strength to his people; The Lord will bless his people in peace.
brenton_translation: The Lord will give strength to his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm, song of dedication of the house, of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house of David.

fresh_translation: I will exalt you, Lord, because you took me up and did not gladden my enemies over me.
brenton_translation: I will exalt thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and not caused mine enemies to rejoice over me.

fresh_translation: Lord my God, I cried to you and you healed me.
brenton_translation: O Lord my God, I cried to thee, and thou didst heal me.

fresh_translation: Lord, you brought up my soul from Hades; you saved me from those going down into pit.
brenton_translation: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from Hades, thou hast delivered me from among them that go down to the pit.

fresh_translation: Sing praise to the Lord, his holy ones, and confess to remembrance of his holiness.
brenton_translation: Sing to the Lord, ye his saints, and give thanks for the remembrance of his holiness.

fresh_translation: Because anger in his wrath and life in his will. At evening weeping will lodge, and by morning glad shouting.
brenton_translation: For anger is in his wrath, but life in his favour: weeping shall tarry for the evening, but joy shall be in the morning.

fresh_translation: But I said in my prosperity, I will by no means be shaken into age.
brenton_translation: And I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.

fresh_translation: Lord, in your will you supplied strength to my beauty; but you turned your face away and I became troubled.
brenton_translation: O Lord, in thy good pleasure thou didst add strength to my beauty: but thou didst turn away thy face, and I was troubled.

fresh_translation: To you, Lord, I will cry, and to my God I will beg.
brenton_translation: To thee, O Lord, will I cry; and to my God will I make supplication.

fresh_translation: What profit in my blood, in my going down into corruption? Will dust confess to you or announce your truth?
brenton_translation: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to destruction? Shall the dust give praise to thee? or shall it declare thy truth?

fresh_translation: The Lord heard and had mercy on me; The Lord became my helper.
brenton_translation: The Lord heard, and had compassion upon me; the Lord is become my helper.

fresh_translation: You turned my mourning into dance for me; you tore my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,
brenton_translation: Thou hast turned my mourning into joy for me: thou hast rent off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

fresh_translation: so that my glory might sing to you and by no means be pierced through. Lord my God, into age I will confess to you.
brenton_translation: that my glory may sing praise to thee, and I may not be pierced with sorrow. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to thee for ever.
