fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David, of ecstasy.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David, an utterance of extreme fear.

fresh_translation: Upon you, Lord, I hoped; may I not be ashamed into age. In your righteousness rescue me and deliver me.
brenton_translation: O Lord, I have hoped in thee; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness and rescue me.

fresh_translation: Incline your ear to me; hurry to deliver me. Become to me God defender and a house of refuge to save me.
brenton_translation: Incline thine ear to me; make haste to rescue me: be thou to me for a protecting God, and for a house of refuge to save me.

fresh_translation: Because you are my strength and my refuge, and for the sake of your name you will lead me and nourish me.
brenton_translation: For thou art my strength and my refuge; and thou shalt guide me for thy name's sake, and maintain me.

fresh_translation: You will bring me out from this snare which they hid for me, because you are my defender.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt bring me out of the snare which they have hidden for me; for thou, O Lord, art my defender.

fresh_translation: Into your hands I will entrust my spirit. You redeemed me, Lord, God of truth.
brenton_translation: Into thine hands I will commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.

fresh_translation: You hated those keeping worthless vanities for nothing, but I hoped upon the Lord.
brenton_translation: Thou hast hated them that idly persist in vanities: but I have hoped in the Lord.

fresh_translation: I will rejoice and be glad in your mercy, because you looked upon my humiliation; you saved my soul from necessities.
brenton_translation: I will exult and be glad in thy mercy: for thou hast looked upon mine affliction; thou hast saved my soul from distresses.

fresh_translation: And you did not shut me up into enemy hands; you set my feet in broad place.
brenton_translation: And thou hast not shut me up into the hands of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a wide place.

fresh_translation: Have mercy on me, Lord, because I am afflicted; my eye was troubled in anger, my soul and my belly.
brenton_translation: Pity me, O Lord, for I am afflicted: my eye is troubled with indignation, my soul and my belly.

fresh_translation: Because my life failed in pain and my years in groanings; my strength weakened in poverty and my bones were troubled.
brenton_translation: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with groanings: my strength has been weakened through poverty, and my bones are troubled.

fresh_translation: Beyond all my enemies I became a reproach, and greatly to my neighbors, and fear to those known to me; those seeing me outside fled from me.
brenton_translation: I became a reproach among all mine enemies, but exceedingly so to my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that saw me without fled from me.

fresh_translation: I was forgotten like a dead man from heart; I became like a ruined vessel.
brenton_translation: I have been forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am become as a broken vessel.

fresh_translation: Because I heard blame of many dwelling around, when they gathered together against me, they planned to take my soul.
brenton_translation: For I heard the slander of many that dwelt round about: when they were gathered together against me, they took counsel to take my life.

fresh_translation: But I hoped upon you, Lord; I said, You are my God.
brenton_translation: But I hoped in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.

fresh_translation: My times in your hands. Rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those pursuing me.
brenton_translation: My lots are in thy hands: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies,

fresh_translation: Shine your face upon your servant; save me in your mercy.
brenton_translation: and from them that persecute me. Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me in thy mercy.

fresh_translation: Lord, may I not be ashamed, because I called upon you. Let ungodly men be ashamed and brought down into Hades.
brenton_translation: O Lord, let me not be ashamed, for I have called upon thee: let the ungodly be ashamed, and brought down to Hades.

fresh_translation: Let deceitful lips become dumb, those speaking lawlessness against the righteous man in pride and contempt.
brenton_translation: Let the deceitful lips become dumb, which speak iniquity against the righteous with pride and scorn.

fresh_translation: How much the multitude of your goodness, Lord, which you hid for those fearing you; you worked it out for those hoping upon you before the sons of men.
brenton_translation: How abundant is the multitude of thy goodness, O Lord, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee! thou hast wrought it out for them that hope on thee, in the presence of the sons of men.

fresh_translation: You will hide them in the hidden place of your face from disturbance of men; you will shelter them in tent from contradiction of tongues.
brenton_translation: Thou wilt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the vexation of man: thou wilt screen them in a tabernacle from the contradiction of tongues.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord, because he made his mercy wondrous in the city of enclosure.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord: for he has magnified his mercy in a fortified city.

fresh_translation: But I said in my ecstasy, So then I am cast away from the face of your eyes. Because of this you heard the voice of my petition when I cried out to you.
brenton_translation: But I said in my extreme fear, I am cast out from the sight of thine eyes: therefore thou didst hearken, O Lord, to the voice of my supplication when I cried to thee.

fresh_translation: Love Lord, all his holy ones, because the Lord seeks truths and repays those doing pride beyond measure.
brenton_translation: Love the Lord, all ye his saints: for the Lord seeks for truth, and renders a reward to them that deal very proudly.

fresh_translation: Act like men and let your heart be strengthened, all hoping upon the Lord.
brenton_translation: Be of good courage, and let your heart be strengthened, all ye that hope in the Lord.

fresh_translation: Of David. Of understanding. Blessed are those whose lawless acts were forgiven and whose sins were covered.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of instruction by David.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will by no means count sin, nor is deceit in his mouth.
brenton_translation: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin, and in whose mouth there is no guile.

fresh_translation: Because I was silent, my bones grew old from my crying all day.
brenton_translation: Because I kept silence, my bones waxed old, from my crying all the day.

fresh_translation: Because day and night your hand grew heavy upon me; I was turned into misery when thorn was fixed in. Interlude.
brenton_translation: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: I became thoroughly miserable while a thorn was fastened in me. Pause.

fresh_translation: My sin I made known, and my lawlessness I did not cover. I said, I will confess against myself my lawlessness to the Lord, and you forgave ungodliness of my sin. Interlude.
brenton_translation: I acknowledged my sin, and hid not mine iniquity: I said, I will confess mine iniquity to the Lord against myself; and thou forgavest the ungodliness of my heart. Pause.

fresh_translation: Because of this every holy one will pray to you in fitting season. Yet in flood of many waters they will not come near him.
brenton_translation: Therefore shall every holy one pray to thee in a fit time: only in the deluge of many waters they shall not come nigh to him.

fresh_translation: You are my refuge from affliction surrounding me, my joy. Redeem me from those encircling me. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Thou art my refuge from the affliction that encompasses me; my joy, to deliver me from them that have compassed me. Pause.

fresh_translation: I will make you understand and instruct you in this way which you will go; I will fix my eyes upon you.
brenton_translation: I will instruct thee and guide thee in this way wherein thou shalt go: I will fix mine eyes upon thee.

fresh_translation: Do not become like horse and mule, which have no understanding, in bridle and bit to clamp their jaws, of those not drawing near to you.
brenton_translation: Be ye not as horse and mule, which have no understanding: but thou must constrain their jaws with bit and curb, lest they should come nigh to thee.

fresh_translation: Many scourges belong to sinner, but mercy will encircle one hoping upon the Lord.
brenton_translation: Many are the scourges of the sinner: but him that hopes in the Lord mercy shall compass about.

fresh_translation: Be glad in the Lord and rejoice, righteous ones, and boast, all upright in heart.
brenton_translation: Be glad in the Lord, and exult, ye righteous: and glory, all ye that are upright in heart.

fresh_translation: Of David. Rejoice in the Lord, righteous ones; praise is fitting for upright ones.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Confess to the Lord with harp; with ten-stringed psaltery sing to him.
brenton_translation: Praise the Lord on the harp; play to him on a psaltery of ten strings.

fresh_translation: Sing to him new song; play well with shouting.
brenton_translation: Sing to him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

fresh_translation: Because the word of the Lord is straight, and all his works in faithfulness.
brenton_translation: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his works are faithful.

fresh_translation: He loves mercy and judgment; earth full of mercy of the Lord.
brenton_translation: He loves mercy and judgment; the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.

fresh_translation: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made firm, and by the spirit of his mouth all their power.
brenton_translation: By the word of the Lord the heavens were established; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

fresh_translation: Gathering waters of sea like a wineskin, putting deeps in treasuries.
brenton_translation: Who gathers the waters of the sea as in a bottle; who lays up the deeps in treasuries.

fresh_translation: Let all the earth fear Lord, and from him let all dwelling inhabited world be shaken,
brenton_translation: Let all the earth fear the Lord; and let all that dwell in the world be moved because of him.

fresh_translation: because he said and they came to be; he commanded and they were created.
brenton_translation: For he spoke, and they were made; he commanded, and they were created.

fresh_translation: The Lord scatters counsels of nations, sets aside reasonings of peoples, and sets aside counsels of rulers.
brenton_translation: The Lord frustrates the counsels of the nations; he brings to nought also the reasonings of the peoples, and brings to nought the counsels of princes.

fresh_translation: But counsel of the Lord remains into age, reasonings of his heart from generation to generation.
brenton_translation: But the counsel of the Lord endures for ever, the thoughts of his heart from generation to generation.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, people whom he chose for inheritance to himself.
brenton_translation: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

fresh_translation: From heaven the Lord looked down; he saw all sons of men.
brenton_translation: The Lord looks out of heaven; he beholds all the sons of men.

fresh_translation: From his prepared dwelling he looked upon all dwelling earth,
brenton_translation: He looks from his prepared habitation on all the dwellers on the earth;

fresh_translation: he who formed their hearts one by one, he who understands all their works.
brenton_translation: who fashioned their hearts alone; who understands all their works.

fresh_translation: King is not saved by much power, and giant will not be saved by the multitude of his strength.
brenton_translation: A king is not saved by reason of a great host; and a giant shall not be delivered by the greatness of his strength.

fresh_translation: Horse false thing for salvation, and in the multitude of its power it will not be saved.
brenton_translation: A horse is vain for safety; neither shall he be delivered by the greatness of his power.

fresh_translation: Behold, eyes of the Lord upon those fearing him, those hoping upon his mercy,
brenton_translation: Behold, the eyes of the Lord are on them that fear him, those that hope in his mercy;

fresh_translation: to rescue their souls from death and nourish them in famine.
brenton_translation: to deliver their souls from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

fresh_translation: Our soul endures for the Lord, because he is our helper and defender.
brenton_translation: Our soul waits on the Lord; for he is our helper and defender.

fresh_translation: Because in him our heart will be gladdened, and in his holy name we hoped.
brenton_translation: For our heart shall rejoice in him, and we have hoped in his holy name.

fresh_translation: Let your mercy, Lord, be upon us, just as we hoped upon you.
brenton_translation: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we have hoped in thee.

fresh_translation: Of David, when he altered his face before Abimelech, and he released him and he went away.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David, when he changed his countenance before Abimelech; and he let him go, and he departed.

fresh_translation: I will bless the Lord in every season; continually his praise in my mouth.
brenton_translation: I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall be continually in my mouth.

fresh_translation: In the Lord my soul will be praised; let meek hear and be glad.
brenton_translation: My soul shall boast herself in the Lord: let the meek hear, and rejoice.

fresh_translation: Magnify the Lord with me, and let us lift up his name together.
brenton_translation: Magnify ye the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.

fresh_translation: I sought out Lord, and he heard me, and rescued me from all my sojournings.
brenton_translation: I sought the Lord diligently, and he hearkened to me, and delivered me from all my sojournings.

fresh_translation: Draw near to him and be enlightened, and your faces will by no means be ashamed.
brenton_translation: Draw near to him, and be enlightened: and your faces shall not by any means be ashamed.

fresh_translation: This poor man cried out, and the Lord heard him and saved him from all his afflictions.
brenton_translation: This poor man cried, and the Lord hearkened to him, and delivered him out of all his afflictions.

fresh_translation: Angel of the Lord will encamp around those fearing him and will rescue them.
brenton_translation: The angel of the Lord will encamp round about them that fear him, and will deliver them.

fresh_translation: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the man who hopes upon him.
brenton_translation: Taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man who hopes in him.

fresh_translation: Fear the Lord, his holy ones, because there is no lack to those fearing him.
brenton_translation: Fear the Lord, all ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

fresh_translation: Rich men became poor and hungry, but those seeking the Lord will not be diminished of any good thing. Interlude.
brenton_translation: The rich have become poor and hungry: but they that seek the Lord diligently shall not want any good thing. Pause.

fresh_translation: Come, children, hear me; The fear of the Lord I will teach you.
brenton_translation: Come, ye children, hear me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Who is man wanting life, loving days to see good things?
brenton_translation: What man is there that desires life, loving to see good days?

fresh_translation: Stop your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
brenton_translation: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

fresh_translation: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
brenton_translation: Turn away from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

fresh_translation: The eyes of the Lord are upon righteous ones and his ears toward their petition.
brenton_translation: The eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayer:

fresh_translation: But the face of the Lord against those doing evils, to destroy their memorial from earth.
brenton_translation: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to destroy their memorial from the earth. The righteous cried, and the Lord hearkened to them,

fresh_translation: The righteous cried out and the Lord heard them, and rescued them from all their afflictions.
brenton_translation: and delivered them out of all their afflictions.

fresh_translation: The Lord near to those crushed in heart, and he will save humble in spirit.
brenton_translation: The Lord is near to them that are of a contrite heart; and will save the lowly in spirit.

fresh_translation: Many are the afflictions of the righteous ones, and from all of them he will rescue them.
brenton_translation: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but out of them all the Lord will deliver them.

fresh_translation: The Lord guards all their bones; not one of them will be broken.
brenton_translation: He keeps all their bones: not one of them shall be broken.

fresh_translation: The death of sinners is evil, and those hating the righteous man will go astray.
brenton_translation: The death of sinners is evil: and they that hate righteousness will go wrong.

fresh_translation: The Lord will redeem souls of his servants, and all hoping upon him will by no means go astray.
brenton_translation: The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants: and none of those that hope in him shall go wrong.

fresh_translation: Of David. Judge, Lord, those doing me injustice; war against those warring against me.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Take hold of weapon and shield, and rise up for my help.
brenton_translation: Take hold of shield and buckler, and arise for my help.

fresh_translation: Pour out sword and shut off those opposite my pursuers; say to my soul, I am your salvation.
brenton_translation: Bring forth a sword, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say to my soul, I am thy salvation.

fresh_translation: Let those seeking my soul be ashamed and put to shame; let those devising evils for me turn backward and be ashamed.
brenton_translation: Let them that seek my soul be ashamed and confounded: let them that devise evils against me be turned back and put to shame.

fresh_translation: Let them become like chaff before wind, and angel of the Lord afflicting them.
brenton_translation: Let them be as dust before the wind, and an angel of the Lord afflicting them.

fresh_translation: Let their way become darkness and slipperiness, and angel of the Lord pursuing them.
brenton_translation: Let their way be dark and slippery, and an angel of the Lord persecuting them.

fresh_translation: Because without cause they hid for me destruction of their snare; in vain they reproached my soul.
brenton_translation: For without cause they have hid for me their destructive snare: without a cause they have reproached my soul.

fresh_translation: Let snare come upon them which they do not know, and hunt which they hid catch them, and in that snare let them fall.
brenton_translation: Let a snare which they know not come upon them: and the gin which they hid take them; and let them fall into the very same snare.

fresh_translation: But my soul will rejoice in the Lord, delighting in his salvation.
brenton_translation: But my soul shall exult in the Lord: it shall delight in his salvation.

fresh_translation: All my bones will say, Lord, who like you, rescuing a poor man from the hand of those stronger than he, and a poor and needy one from those plundering him?
brenton_translation: All my bones shall say, O Lord, who is like to thee? delivering the poor out of the hand of them that are stronger than he, yea, the poor and needy one from them that spoil him.

fresh_translation: Unjust witnesses rising up asked me things I did not know.
brenton_translation: Unjust witnesses arose, and asked me of things I knew not.

fresh_translation: They repaid me evils for good things and childlessness to my soul.
brenton_translation: They rewarded me evil for good, and bereavement to my soul.

fresh_translation: But when they troubled me, I clothed myself in sackcloth and humbled my soul in fasting, and my prayer will return into my bosom.
brenton_translation: But I, when they troubled me, put on sackcloth, and humbled my soul with fasting: and my prayer shall return to my own bosom.

fresh_translation: Like neighbor, like our brother, so I was pleasing; like mourning and glooming, so I humbled myself.
brenton_translation: I behaved agreeably towards them as if it had been our neighbour or brother: I humbled myself as one mourning and sad of countenance.

fresh_translation: And against me they rejoiced and gathered together; scourges gathered upon me and I did not know; they were torn apart and were not pierced through.
brenton_translation: Yet they rejoiced against me, and plagues were plentifully brought against me, and I knew it not: they were scattered, but repented not.

fresh_translation: They tested me, mocked me with mocking, gnashed their teeth at me.
brenton_translation: They tempted me, they sneered at me most contemptuously, they gnashed their teeth upon me.

fresh_translation: Lord, when will you look? Restore my soul from their villainies, my only one from lions.
brenton_translation: O Lord, when wilt thou look upon me? Deliver my soul from their mischief, mine only-begotten one from the lions.

fresh_translation: I will confess to you, Lord, in great assembly; among heavy people I will praise you.
brenton_translation: I will give thanks to thee even in a great congregation: in an abundant people I will praise thee.

fresh_translation: Let those hating me unjustly not rejoice over me, those hating me without cause and winking with eyes,
brenton_translation: Let not them that are mine enemies without a cause rejoice against me; who hate me for nothing, and wink with their eyes.

fresh_translation: because to me they spoke peaceful things, and in anger they devised deceits.
brenton_translation: For to me they spoke peaceably, but imagined deceits in their anger.

fresh_translation: And they opened wide their mouth upon me; they said, Good, good, our eyes saw.
brenton_translation: And they opened wide their mouth upon me; they said, Aha, aha, our eyes have seen it.

fresh_translation: You saw, Lord; do not be silent. Lord, do not stand far from me.
brenton_translation: Thou hast seen it, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, withdraw not thyself from me.

fresh_translation: Wake up, Lord, and attend to my judgment, my God and my Lord, to my case.
brenton_translation: Awake, O Lord, and attend to my judgment, even to my cause, my God and my Lord.

fresh_translation: Judge me according to your righteousness, Lord my God, and let them not rejoice over me.
brenton_translation: Judge me, O Lord, according to thy righteousness, O Lord my God; and let them not rejoice against me.

fresh_translation: Let them not say in their hearts, Good, good, to our soul, nor say, We swallowed him up.
brenton_translation: Let them not say in their hearts, Aha, aha, it is pleasing to our soul: neither let them say, We have devoured him.

fresh_translation: Let those rejoicing at my evils be ashamed and put to shame together; let those speaking great things against me be clothed with shame and embarrassment.
brenton_translation: Let them be confounded and ashamed together that rejoice at my afflictions: let them be clothed with shame and confusion that speak great swelling words against me.

fresh_translation: Let those wanting my righteousness rejoice and be glad, and let them always say, Let the Lord be magnified, those wanting peace of his servant.
brenton_translation: Let them that rejoice in my righteousness exult and be glad: and let them say continually, The Lord be magnified, who desire the peace of his servant.

fresh_translation: And my tongue will meditate your righteousness, all day your praise.
brenton_translation: And my tongue shall meditate on thy righteousness, and on thy praise all the day.

fresh_translation: For end. To the servant of the Lord, David.
brenton_translation: For the end, by David the servant of the Lord.

fresh_translation: The lawless man says of sinning within himself, There is no fear of God before his eyes.
brenton_translation: The transgressor, that he may sin, says within himself, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

fresh_translation: Because he dealt deceitfully before him, to find his lawlessness and hate it.
brenton_translation: For he has dealt craftily before him, to discover his iniquity and hate it.

fresh_translation: The words of his mouth lawlessness and deceit; he did not wish to understand so as to do good.
brenton_translation: The words of his mouth are transgression and deceit: he is not inclined to understand how to do good.

fresh_translation: He devised lawlessness upon his bed; he stood upon every way not good, and he did not loathe evil.
brenton_translation: He devises iniquity on his bed; he gives himself to every evil way; and does not abhor evil.

fresh_translation: Lord, in heaven your mercy and your truth up to clouds.
brenton_translation: O Lord, thy mercy is in the heaven; and thy truth reaches to the clouds.

fresh_translation: Your righteousness like mountains of God; your judgments great deep. Men and cattle you will save, Lord.
brenton_translation: Thy righteousness is as the mountains of God, thy judgments are as a great deep: O Lord, thou wilt preserve men and beasts.

fresh_translation: How you multiplied your mercy, God; but sons of men will hope in the shelter of your wings.
brenton_translation: How hast thou multiplied thy mercy, O God! so the children of men shall trust in the shelter of thy wings.

fresh_translation: They will be intoxicated from richness of your house, and you will give them drink from torrent of your delight.
brenton_translation: They shall be fully satisfied with the fatness of thine house; and thou shalt cause them to drink of the full stream of thy delights.

fresh_translation: Because with you spring of life; in your light we will see light.
brenton_translation: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light we shall see light.

fresh_translation: Stretch out your mercy to those knowing you and your righteousness to upright in heart.
brenton_translation: Extend thy mercy to them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

fresh_translation: Let the foot of pride not come to me, and the hand of sinners not shake me.
brenton_translation: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of sinners move me.

fresh_translation: There the workers of lawlessness fell; they were thrust out and will not be able to stand.
brenton_translation: There have all the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast out, and shall not be able to stand.

fresh_translation: Of David. Do not be jealous among evildoers, nor envy those doing lawlessness,
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: because like grass they will quickly dry up, and like green herbs they will quickly fall away.
brenton_translation: For they shall soon be withered as the grass, and shall soon fall away as the green herbs.

fresh_translation: Hope upon the Lord and do kindness, and dwell in earth, and you will be shepherded upon its wealth.
brenton_translation: Hope in the Lord, and do good; and dwell on the land, and thou shalt be fed with the wealth of it.

fresh_translation: Take delight in the Lord, and he will give you requests of your heart.
brenton_translation: Delight thyself in the Lord; and he shall grant thee the requests of thine heart.

fresh_translation: Reveal your way to the Lord and hope upon him, and he will do it.
brenton_translation: Disclose thy way to the Lord, and hope in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

fresh_translation: And he will bring out your righteousness like light and your judgment like noonday.
brenton_translation: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noon-day.

fresh_translation: Be subjected to the Lord and entreat him. Do not be jealous in one prospering in his way, in man doing lawless things.
brenton_translation: Submit thyself to the Lord, and supplicate him: fret not thyself because of him that prospers in his way, at the man that does unlawful deeds.

fresh_translation: Cease from anger and leave wrath behind; do not be jealous so as to do evil.
brenton_translation: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself so as to do evil.

fresh_translation: Because evildoers will be utterly destroyed, but those enduring Lord, they will inherit earth.
brenton_translation: For evil-doers shall be destroyed: but they that wait on the Lord, they shall inherit the land.

fresh_translation: And still a little, and sinner will by no means exist; and you will seek his place and by no means find it.
brenton_translation: And yet a little while, and the sinner shall not be, and thou shalt seek for his place, and shalt not find it.

fresh_translation: But meek ones will inherit earth and take delight in the abundance of peace.
brenton_translation: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

fresh_translation: The sinner will watch a righteous man and gnash his teeth upon him.
brenton_translation: The sinner will watch for the righteous, and gnash his teeth upon him.

fresh_translation: But the Lord will laugh at him, because he foresees that his day will come.
brenton_translation: But the Lord shall laugh at him: for he foresees that his day will come.

fresh_translation: Sinners drew sword and stretched their bow, to cast down poor and needy, to slaughter upright in heart.
brenton_translation: Sinners have drawn their swords, they have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy one, and to slay the upright in heart.

fresh_translation: Their sword may enter into their heart, and their bows may be broken.
brenton_translation: Let their sword enter into their own heart, and their bows be broken.

fresh_translation: Better a little thing to the righteous man than much wealth of sinners,
brenton_translation: A little is better to the righteous than abundant wealth of sinners.

fresh_translation: because the arms of sinners will be broken, but the Lord supports righteous ones.
brenton_translation: For the arms of sinners shall be broken; but the Lord supports the righteous.

fresh_translation: The Lord knows ways of blameless ones, and their inheritance will be into age.
brenton_translation: The Lord knows the ways of the perfect; and their inheritance shall be for ever.

fresh_translation: They will not be ashamed in evil season, and in the days of famine they will be filled.
brenton_translation: They shall not be ashamed in an evil time; and in days of famine they shall be satisfied.

fresh_translation: Because sinners will perish, and enemies of the Lord, when they are glorified and lifted up, failing away like smoke they failed away.
brenton_translation: For the sinners shall perish; and the enemies of the Lord at the moment of their being honoured and exalted have utterly vanished like smoke.

fresh_translation: The sinner borrows and will not repay, but a righteous man has compassion and gives.
brenton_translation: The sinner borrows, and will not pay again: but the righteous has compassion, and gives.

fresh_translation: Because those blessing him will inherit earth, but those cursing him will be utterly destroyed.
brenton_translation: For they that bless him shall inherit the earth; and they that curse him shall be utterly destroyed.

fresh_translation: From the Lord the steps of a man are directed straight, and he will desire his way.
brenton_translation: The steps of a man are rightly ordered by the Lord: and he will take pleasure in his way.

fresh_translation: When he falls, he will not be dashed down, because the Lord supports his hand.
brenton_translation: When he falls, he shall not be ruined: for the Lord supports his hand.

fresh_translation: I became younger and indeed I grew old, and I did not see a righteous man forsaken, nor his seed seeking breads.
brenton_translation: I was once young, indeed I am now old; yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.

fresh_translation: All day he has mercy and lends, and his seed will be into blessing.
brenton_translation: He is merciful, and lends continually; and his seed shall be blessed.

fresh_translation: Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell into age of age,
brenton_translation: Turn aside from evil, and do good; and dwell for ever.

fresh_translation: because the Lord loves judgment and will not forsake his holy ones. Into age they will be guarded, but lawless men will be driven out, and the seed of ungodly men will be utterly destroyed.
brenton_translation: For the Lord loves judgment, and will not forsake his saints; they shall be preserved for ever: the blameless shall be avenged, but the seed of the ungodly shall be utterly destroyed.

fresh_translation: But righteous ones will inherit earth and dwell upon it into age of age.
brenton_translation: But the righteous shall inherit the earth, and dwell upon it for ever.

fresh_translation: The mouth of a righteous man will meditate wisdom, and his tongue will speak judgment.
brenton_translation: The mouth of the righteous will meditate wisdom, and his tongue will speak of judgment.

fresh_translation: The law of his God is in his heart, and his steps will not be tripped up.
brenton_translation: The law of his God is in his heart; and his steps shall not slide.

fresh_translation: The sinner watches a righteous man and seeks to put him to death.
brenton_translation: The sinner watches the righteous, and seeks to slay him.

fresh_translation: But the Lord will by no means forsake him into his hands, nor by any means condemn him when judgment comes to him.
brenton_translation: But the Lord will not leave him in his hands, nor by any means condemn him when he is judged.

fresh_translation: Wait for the Lord and keep his way, and he will lift you up to inherit earth; when sinners are utterly destroyed you will see.
brenton_translation: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are destroyed, thou shalt see it.

fresh_translation: I saw an ungodly man highly exalted and lifted up like cedars of Lebanon.
brenton_translation: I saw the ungodly very highly exalting himself, and lifting himself up like the cedars of Libanus.

fresh_translation: And I passed by, and behold, he was not; and I sought him, and his place was not found.
brenton_translation: Yet I passed by, and lo! he was not: and I sought him, but his place was not found.

fresh_translation: Guard innocence and see uprightness, because there is remnant for peaceful man.
brenton_translation: Maintain innocence, and behold uprightness: for there is a remnant to the peaceable man.

fresh_translation: But lawless men will be utterly destroyed together; the remnants of ungodly men will be utterly destroyed.
brenton_translation: But the transgressors shall be utterly destroyed together: the remnants of the ungodly shall be utterly destroyed.

fresh_translation: But salvation of the righteous ones is from the Lord, and he is their defender in the time of affliction.
brenton_translation: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord; and he is their defender in the time of affliction.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will help them and rescue them and deliver them from sinners and save them, because they hoped upon him.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: and he shall rescue them from sinners, and save them, because they have hoped in him.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David, for remembrance concerning Sabbath.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David for remembrance concerning the Sabbath-day.

fresh_translation: Lord, do not reprove me in your fury, nor discipline me in your anger,
brenton_translation: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath, neither chasten me in thine anger.

fresh_translation: because your arrows were fixed in me and you set your hand firmly upon me.
brenton_translation: For thy weapons are fixed in me, and thou hast pressed thy hand heavily upon me.

fresh_translation: There is no healing in my flesh from the face of your wrath; no peace to my bones from the face of my sins.
brenton_translation: For there is no health in my flesh because of thine anger; there is no peace to my bones because of my sins.

fresh_translation: Because my lawless acts rose above my head; like heavy burden they weighed heavily upon me.
brenton_translation: For my transgressions have gone over mine head: they have pressed heavily upon me like a weighty burden.

fresh_translation: My wounds stank and rotted from the face of my foolishness.
brenton_translation: My bruises have become noisome and corrupt, because of my foolishness.

fresh_translation: I was miserable and bent down to end; all day mourning-faced I went about.
brenton_translation: I have been wretched and bowed down continually: I went with a mourning countenance all the day.

fresh_translation: Because my loins were filled with mockings, and there is no healing in my flesh.
brenton_translation: For my soul is filled with mockings; and there is no health in my flesh.

fresh_translation: I was afflicted and humbled beyond measure; I roared from groaning of my heart.
brenton_translation: I have been afflicted and brought down exceedingly: I have roared for the groaning of my heart.

fresh_translation: Lord, all my desire before you, and my groaning was not hidden from you.
brenton_translation: But all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hidden from thee.

fresh_translation: My heart was troubled; my strength forsook me, and light of my eyes, even this not with me.
brenton_translation: My heart is troubled, my strength has failed me; and the light of mine eyes is not with me.

fresh_translation: My friends and my neighbors drew near opposite me and stood, and my near ones stood far off.
brenton_translation: My friends and my neighbours drew near before me, and stood still; and my nearest of kin stood afar off.

fresh_translation: And those seeking my soul used violence, and those seeking my evils spoke vanities and meditated deceits all day.
brenton_translation: While they pressed hard upon me that sought my soul: and they that sought my hurt spoke vanities, and devised deceits all the day.

fresh_translation: But I like a deaf man was not hearing, and like mute not opening his mouth.
brenton_translation: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and was as a dumb man not opening his mouth.

fresh_translation: And I became like a man not hearing and not having reproofs in his mouth.
brenton_translation: And I was as a man that hears not, and who has no reproofs in his mouth.

fresh_translation: Because upon you, Lord, I hoped; you will hear, Lord my God.
brenton_translation: For I hoped in thee, O Lord: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

fresh_translation: Because I said, Lest my enemies rejoice over me, and when my feet are shaken they spoke great things against me.
brenton_translation: For I said, Lest mine enemies rejoice against me: for when my feet were moved, they spoke boastingly against me.

fresh_translation: Because I am ready for scourges, and my pain before me always.
brenton_translation: For I am ready for plagues, and my grief is continually before me.

fresh_translation: Because my lawlessness I will announce, and I will be anxious concerning my sin.
brenton_translation: For I will declare mine iniquity, and be distressed for my sin.

fresh_translation: But my enemies live and are stronger than I, and those hating me unjustly were multiplied.
brenton_translation: But mine enemies live, and are mightier than I: and they that hate me unjustly are multiplied.

fresh_translation: Those repaying evil for good slandered me because I pursued righteousness and cast me away, beloved one, like a dead man abhorred.
brenton_translation: They that reward evil for good slandered me; because I followed righteousness.

fresh_translation: Do not forsake me, Lord my God; do not stand far from me.
brenton_translation: Forsake me not, O Lord my God: depart not from me.

fresh_translation: Attend to my help, Lord of my salvation.
brenton_translation: Draw nigh to my help, O Lord of my salvation.

fresh_translation: For end. To Jeduthun. Song of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Song of David, to Idithun.

fresh_translation: I said, I will guard my ways so as not to sin with my tongue; I set guard for my mouth when sinner stood opposite me.
brenton_translation: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I set a guard on my mouth, while the sinner stood in my presence.

fresh_translation: I became mute and humbled and was silent from good things, and my pain was renewed.
brenton_translation: I was dumb, and humbled myself, and kept silence from good words; and my grief was renewed.

fresh_translation: My heart grew hot within me, and in my meditation fire will blaze; I spoke with my tongue,
brenton_translation: My heart grew hot within me, and a fire would kindle in my meditation: I spoke with my tongue,

fresh_translation: Make known to me, Lord, my end and number of my days, what it is, that I may know what I lack.
brenton_translation: O Lord, make me to know mine end, and the number of my days, what it is; that I may know what I lack.

fresh_translation: Behold, you made my days old-span lengths, and my existence like nothing before you. Yet all things vanity, every living man. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Behold, thou hast made my days old; and my existence is as nothing before thee: nay, every man living is altogether vanity. Pause.

fresh_translation: Surely man passes by in image; yet in vain they are troubled; he stores up and does not know for whom he will gather them.
brenton_translation: Surely man walks in a shadow; nay, he is disquieted in vain: he lays up treasures, and knows not for whom he shall gather them.

fresh_translation: And now what is my endurance? Is it not Lord? And my substance is from you.
brenton_translation: And now what is my expectation? is it not the Lord? and my ground of hope is with thee. Pause.

fresh_translation: From all my lawless acts rescue me; you gave me as reproach to fool.
brenton_translation: Deliver me from all my transgressions: thou hast made me a reproach to the foolish.

fresh_translation: I became mute and did not open my mouth, because you are one who made me.
brenton_translation: I was dumb, and opened not my mouth; for thou art he that made me.

fresh_translation: Remove your scourges from me; from the strength of your hand I failed away.
brenton_translation: Remove thy scourges from me: I have fainted by reason of the strength of thine hand.

fresh_translation: With reproofs over lawlessness you disciplined man and melted his soul like a spider. Yet in vain every man is troubled. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Thou chastenest man with rebukes for iniquity, and thou makest his life to consume away like a spider's web: nay, every man is disquieted in vain. Pause.

fresh_translation: Hear my prayer, Lord, and give ear to my petition. Do not be silent at my tears, because I am sojourner with you and passing resident, like all my fathers.
brenton_translation: O Lord, hearken to my prayer and my supplication: attend to my tears: be not silent, for I am a sojourner in the land, and a stranger, as all my fathers were.

fresh_translation: Leave me, that I may be refreshed before I depart and no longer exist.
brenton_translation: Spare me, that I may be refreshed, before I depart, and be no more.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Waiting, I waited for the Lord, and he attended to me and heard my petition.
brenton_translation: I waited patiently for the Lord; and he attended to me, and hearkened to my supplication.

fresh_translation: And he brought me up from pit of misery and from mud of mire and set my feet upon rock and straightened my steps.
brenton_translation: And he brought me up out of a pit of misery, and from miry clay: and he set my feet on a rock, and ordered my goings aright.

fresh_translation: And he threw into my mouth new song, hymn to our God. Many will see and fear and hope upon the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he put a new song into my mouth, even a hymn to our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall hope in the Lord.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the man whose hope is the name of the Lord, and did not look toward vanities and false frenzies.
brenton_translation: Blessed is the man whose hope is the name of the Lord, and who has not regarded vanities and false frenzies.

fresh_translation: Many things you did, Lord my God, your wonders; and in your reasonings there is none who will be likened to you. I declared and spoke; they were multiplied beyond number.
brenton_translation: O Lord my God, thou hast multiplied thy wonderful works, and in thy thoughts there is none who shall be likened to thee: I declared and spoke of them: they exceeded number.

fresh_translation: Sacrifice and offering you did not want, but ears you fitted for me; whole burnt offering and concerning sin you did not ask.
brenton_translation: Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not; but a body hast thou prepared me: whole-burnt-offering and sacrifice for sin thou didst not require.

fresh_translation: Then I said, Behold, I came. In head-roll of book it is written concerning me.
brenton_translation: Then I said, Behold, I come: in the volume of the book it is written concerning me,

fresh_translation: To do your will, O my God, I wanted, and your law in the midst of my belly.
brenton_translation: I desired to do thy will, O my God, and thy law in the midst of mine heart.

fresh_translation: I proclaimed righteousness in great assembly; behold, my lips I will by no means restrain. Lord, you knew.
brenton_translation: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation; lo! I will not refrain my lips; O Lord, thou knowest my righteousness.

fresh_translation: Your righteousness I did not hide in my heart; your truth and your salvation I spoke; I did not hide your mercy and your truth from great gathering.
brenton_translation: I have not hid thy truth within my heart, and I have declared thy salvation; I have not hid thy mercy and thy truth from the great congregation.

fresh_translation: But you, Lord, do not keep your compassions far from me; your mercy and your truth always supported me.
brenton_translation: But thou, Lord, remove not thy compassion far from me; thy mercy and thy truth have helped me continually.

fresh_translation: Because evils without number enclosed me; my lawless acts overtook me and I was not able to look. They were multiplied beyond hairs of my head, and my heart forsook me.
brenton_translation: For innumerable evils have encompassed me; my transgressions have taken hold of me, and I could not see; they are multiplied more than the hairs of my head; and my heart has failed me.

fresh_translation: Be pleased, Lord, to rescue me; Lord, attend to help me.
brenton_translation: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me; O Lord, draw nigh to help me.

fresh_translation: Let those seeking my soul to take it away be ashamed and put to shame together; let those wanting evils for me turn backward and be put to shame.
brenton_translation: Let those that seek my soul, to destroy it, be ashamed and confounded together; let those that wish me evil be turned backward and put to shame.

fresh_translation: Let those saying to me, Good, good, carry away at once their shame.
brenton_translation: Let those that say to me, Aha, aha, quickly receive shame for their reward.

fresh_translation: Let all seeking you rejoice and be glad upon you, Lord, and let those loving your salvation always say, Let the Lord be magnified.
brenton_translation: Let all those that seek thee, O Lord, exult and rejoice in thee; and let them that love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.

fresh_translation: But I am poor and needy; The Lord will care for me. My helper and my defender are you; my God, do not delay.
brenton_translation: But I am poor and needy; the Lord will take care of me; thou art my helper, and my defender, O my God, delay not.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the one understanding concerning poor and needy man; in evil day the Lord will rescue him.
brenton_translation: Blessed is the man who thinks on the poor and needy: the Lord shall deliver him in an evil day.

fresh_translation: The Lord guard him and make him live and bless him in earth and not hand him over into the hands of his enemy.
brenton_translation: May the Lord preserve him and keep him alive, and bless him on the earth, and not deliver him into the hands of his enemy.

fresh_translation: The Lord help him upon the bed of his pain; you turned all his bed in his sickness.
brenton_translation: May the Lord help him upon the bed of his pain; thou hast made all his bed in his sickness.

fresh_translation: I said, Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, because I sinned against you.
brenton_translation: I said, O Lord, have mercy upon me; heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

fresh_translation: My enemies spoke evils to me: When will he die and his name perish?
brenton_translation: Mine enemies have spoken evil against me, saying, When shall he die, and his name perish?

fresh_translation: And if he entered to see, he spoke vain things; his heart gathered lawlessness to itself; he went outside and spoke.
brenton_translation: And if he came to see me, his heart spoke vainly; he gathered iniquity to himself; he went forth and spoke in like manner.

fresh_translation: Together all my enemies whispered against me; against me they reasoned evils for me:
brenton_translation: All my enemies whispered against me; against me they devised my hurt.

fresh_translation: They set lawless word against me: Will not one lying down add to rise again?
brenton_translation: They denounced a wicked word against me, saying, Now that he lies, shall he not rise up again?

fresh_translation: And indeed man of my peace, upon whom I hoped, one eating my breads, magnified heel-tripping against me.
brenton_translation: For even the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, lifted up his heel against me.

fresh_translation: But you, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, and I will repay them.
brenton_translation: But thou, O Lord, have compassion upon me, and raise me up, and I shall requite them.

fresh_translation: In this I knew that you wanted me, because my enemy will by no means rejoice over me.
brenton_translation: By this I know that thou hast delighted in me, because mine enemy shall not rejoice over me.

fresh_translation: But of me, because of my innocence, you took hold and established me before you into age.
brenton_translation: But thou didst help me because of mine innocence, and hast established me before thee for ever.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord God of Israel from age and into age. Let it be, let it be.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. So be it, so be it.

fresh_translation: For end, for understanding, for the sons of Korah.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm for instruction, for the sons of Core.

fresh_translation: As deer longs for springs of waters, so my soul longs for you, O God.
brenton_translation: As the hart earnestly desires the fountains of water, so my soul earnestly longs for thee, O God.

fresh_translation: My soul thirsted for living God; when will I come and appear before the face of God?
brenton_translation: My soul has thirsted for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

fresh_translation: My tears became bread to me day and night, while they say to me each day, Where is your God?
brenton_translation: My tears have been bread to me day and night, while they daily said to me, Where is thy God?

fresh_translation: These things I remembered, and I poured out my soul upon me, because I will pass through into place of wondrous tent, as far as the house of God, with the voice of exultation and confession, the sound of festival-keepers.
brenton_translation: I remembered these things, and poured out my soul in me, for I will go to the place of thy wondrous tabernacle, even to the house of God, with a voice of exultation and thanksgiving and of the sound of those who keep festival.

fresh_translation: Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.
brenton_translation: Wherefore art thou very sad, O my soul? and wherefore dost thou trouble me? hope in God; for I will give thanks to him; he is the salvation of my countenance.

fresh_translation: Toward myself my soul was troubled; therefore I will remember you from the land of Jordan and Hermoniim, from little mountain.
brenton_translation: O my God, my soul has been troubled within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Ermonites, from the little hill.

fresh_translation: Abyss calls abyss at the sound of your cataracts; all your surges and your waves passed over me.
brenton_translation: Deep calls to deep at the voice of thy cataracts: all thy billows and thy waves have gone over me.

fresh_translation: By day the Lord will command his mercy, and by night his song with me, prayer to God of my life.
brenton_translation: By day the Lord will command his mercy, and manifest it by night: with me is prayer to the God of my life.

fresh_translation: I will say to God, my supporter, Why did you forget me? Why do I go gloomy when enemy afflicts me?
brenton_translation: I will say to God, Thou art my helper; why hast thou forgotten me? wherefore do I go sad of countenance, while the enemy oppresses me?

fresh_translation: When my bones were crushed, those afflicting me reproached me, while they say to me each day, Where is your God?
brenton_translation: While my bones were breaking, they that afflicted me reproached me; while they said to me daily, Where is thy God?

fresh_translation: Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.
brenton_translation: Wherefore art thou very sad, O my soul? and wherefore dost thou trouble me? hope in God; for I will give thanks to him; he is the health of my countenance, and my God.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David. Judge me, O God, and judge my case from nation not holy; from unjust and deceitful man rescue me.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Because you are God, my strength. Why did you reject me? Why do I go gloomy when enemy afflicts me?
brenton_translation: For thou, O God, art my strength: wherefore hast thou cast me off? and why do I go sad of countenance, while the enemy oppresses me?

fresh_translation: Send out your light and your truth; they guided me and brought me to your holy mountain and to your tabernacles.
brenton_translation: Send forth thy light and thy truth: they have led me, and brought me to thy holy mountain, and to thy tabernacles.

fresh_translation: And I will go in to the altar of God, to God gladdening my youth; I will confess to you with harp, O God, my God.
brenton_translation: And I will go in to the altar of God, to God who gladdens my youth: I will give thanks to thee on the harp, O God, my God.

fresh_translation: Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.
brenton_translation: Wherefore art thou very sad, O my soul? and wherefore dost thou trouble me? Hope in God; for I will give thanks to him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

fresh_translation: For end, for the sons of Korah, for understanding, psalm.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm for instruction, for the sons of Core.

fresh_translation: O God, with our ears we heard; our fathers told us work you worked in their days, in ancient days.
brenton_translation: O God, we have heard with our ears, our fathers have told us, the work which thou wroughtest in their days, in the days of old.

fresh_translation: Your hand destroyed nations, and you planted them; you afflicted peoples and cast them out.
brenton_translation: Thine hand utterly destroyed the heathen, and thou didst plant them: thou didst afflict the nations, and cast them out.

fresh_translation: Because not by their sword did they inherit land, and their arm did not save them, but your right hand and your arm and light of your face, because you took pleasure in them.
brenton_translation: For they inherited not the land by their own sword, and their own arm did not deliver them; but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou wert well pleased in them.

fresh_translation: You are same my king and my God, one commanding salvations of Jacob.
brenton_translation: Thou art indeed my King and my God, who commandest deliverances for Jacob.

fresh_translation: In you we will gore our enemies, and in your name we will despise those rising against us.
brenton_translation: In thee will we push down our enemies, and in thy name will we bring to nought them that rise up against us.

fresh_translation: Because not in my bow will I hope, and my sword will not save me.
brenton_translation: For I will not trust in my bow, and my sword shall not save me.

fresh_translation: Because you saved us from those afflicting us, and those hating us you shamed.
brenton_translation: For thou hast saved us from them that afflicted us, and hast put to shame them that hated us.

fresh_translation: In God we will boast whole day, and in your name we will confess forever. Interlude.
brenton_translation: In God will we make our boast all the day, and to thy name will we give thanks for ever. Pause.

fresh_translation: But now you rejected and shamed us, and you will not go out with our powers.
brenton_translation: But now thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and thou wilt not go forth with our hosts.

fresh_translation: You turned us back before our enemies, and those hating us plundered for themselves.
brenton_translation: Thou hast turned us back before our enemies; and they that hated us spoiled for themselves.

fresh_translation: You gave us like sheep for food, and among nations you scattered us.
brenton_translation: Thou madest us as sheep for meat; and thou scatteredst us among the nations.

fresh_translation: You sold your people without price, and there was no multitude in their exchanges.
brenton_translation: Thou hast sold thy people without price, and there was no profit by their exchange.

fresh_translation: You made us reproach to our neighbors, mockery and derision to those around us.
brenton_translation: Thou hast made us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

fresh_translation: You made us proverb among nations, shaking of head among peoples.
brenton_translation: Thou hast made us a proverb among the Gentiles, a shaking of the head among the nations.

fresh_translation: Whole day my shame before me, and shame of my face covered me,
brenton_translation: All the day my shame is before me, and the confusion of my face has covered me,

fresh_translation: from the voice of reproacher and slanderer, from the face of enemy and pursuer.
brenton_translation: because of the voice of the slanderer and reviler; because of the enemy and avenger.

fresh_translation: All these things came upon us, and we did not forget you, and we did not act unjustly in your covenant.
brenton_translation: All these things are come upon us: but we have not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt unrighteously in thy covenant.

fresh_translation: And our heart did not turn back, and you turned our paths aside from your way,
brenton_translation: And our heart has not gone back; but thou hast turned aside our paths from thy way.

fresh_translation: because you humbled us in place of affliction, and the shadow of death covered us.
brenton_translation: For thou hast laid us low in a place of affliction, and the shadow of death has covered us.

fresh_translation: If we forgot name of our God and stretched out our hands to strange god,
brenton_translation: If we have forgotten the name of our God, and if we have spread out our hands to a strange god; shall not God search these things out?

fresh_translation: will not God seek these things out? For he knows hidden things of heart.
brenton_translation: for he knows the secrets of the heart.

fresh_translation: Because for your sake we are put to death whole day; we were counted as sheep of slaughter.
brenton_translation: For, for thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for slaughter.

fresh_translation: Awake. Why do you sleep, Lord? Rise up and do not reject to end.
brenton_translation: Awake, wherefore sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, and do not cast us off for ever.

fresh_translation: Why do you turn away your face, forgetting our poverty and our affliction?
brenton_translation: Wherefore turnest thou thy face away, and forgettest our poverty and our affliction?

fresh_translation: Because our soul was humbled into dust; our belly clung to earth.
brenton_translation: For our soul has been brought down to the dust; our belly has cleaved to the earth.

fresh_translation: Rise up, Lord, help us, and redeem us for the sake of your name.
brenton_translation: Arise, O Lord, help us, and redeem us for thy name's sake.

fresh_translation: For end, concerning those to be changed, for the sons of Korah, for understanding, song concerning beloved.
brenton_translation: For the end, for alternate strains by the sons of Core; for instruction, a Song concerning the beloved.

fresh_translation: My heart poured forth good word; I speak my works to the king; my tongue reed of swift-writing scribe.
brenton_translation: My heart has uttered a good matter: I declare my works to the king: my tongue is the pen of a quick writer.

fresh_translation: Beautiful in form beyond sons of men; grace was poured upon your lips; therefore God blessed you forever.
brenton_translation: Thou art more beautiful than the sons of men: grace has been shed forth on thy lips: therefore God has blessed thee for ever.

fresh_translation: Gird your sword upon thigh, mighty one, in your beauty and your loveliness.
brenton_translation: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O Mighty One, in thy comeliness, and in thy beauty;

fresh_translation: And draw, and prosper, and reign, because of truth and meekness and righteousness, and your right hand will guide you wondrously.
brenton_translation: and bend thy bow, and prosper, and reign, because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall guide thee wonderfully.

fresh_translation: Your arrows sharpened, mighty one; peoples will fall under you, in the heart of enemies of the king.
brenton_translation: Thy weapons are sharpened, Mighty One, (the nations shall fall under thee) they are in the heart of the king's enemies.

fresh_translation: Your throne, O God, forever and ever; rod of uprightness rod of your kingdom.
brenton_translation: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a sceptre of righteousness.

fresh_translation: You loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, anointed you with the oil of exultation beyond your companions.
brenton_translation: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity: therefore God, thy God, has anointed thee with the oil of gladness beyond thy fellows.

fresh_translation: Myrrh and stacte and cassia from your garments, from ivory palaces from which they gladdened you.
brenton_translation: Myrrh, and stacte, and cassia are exhaled from thy garments, and out of the ivory palaces,

fresh_translation: Daughters of kings in your honor; queen stood at your right hand, clothed in gold-woven garments, adorned with many colors.
brenton_translation: with which kings' daughters have gladdened thee for thine honour: the queen stood by on thy right hand, clothed in vesture wrought with gold, and arrayed in divers colours.

fresh_translation: Hear, daughter, and see, and incline your ear, and forget your people and house of your father,
brenton_translation: Hear, O daughter, and see, and incline thine ear; forget also thy people, and thy father's house.

fresh_translation: because the king desired your beauty, because he is your lord.
brenton_translation: Because the king has desired thy beauty; for he is thy Lord.

fresh_translation: And daughters of Tyre will worship him with gifts; rich ones of the people will entreat your face.
brenton_translation: And the daughter of Tyre shall adore him with gifts; the rich of the people of the land shall supplicate thy favour.

fresh_translation: All glory of daughter of the king within, clothed in golden fringes, adorned with many colors.
brenton_translation: All her glory is that of the daughter of the king of Esebon, robed as she is in golden fringed garments,

fresh_translation: Virgins after her will be brought to the king; her companions will be brought to you.
brenton_translation: in embroidered clothing: virgins shall be brought to the king after her: her fellows shall be brought to thee.

fresh_translation: They will be brought in gladness and exultation; they will be led into the temple of the king.
brenton_translation: They shall be brought with gladness and exultation: they shall be led into the king's temple.

fresh_translation: In place of your fathers sons were born to you; you will appoint them rulers over all the earth.
brenton_translation: Instead of thy fathers children are born to thee: thou shalt make them princes over all the earth.

fresh_translation: They will remember your name in every generation and generation; therefore peoples will confess to you forever, even forever and ever.
brenton_translation: They shall make mention of thy name from generation to generation: therefore shall the nations give thanks to thee for ever, even for ever and ever.

fresh_translation: For end, for the sons of Korah, concerning hidden things, psalm.
brenton_translation: For the end, for the sons of Core; a Psalm concerning secret things.

fresh_translation: God ours refuge and strength, helper in afflictions that found us greatly.
brenton_translation: God is our refuge and strength, a help in the afflictions that have come heavily upon us.

fresh_translation: Therefore we will not fear when earth is shaken and mountains are shifted into hearts of seas.
brenton_translation: Therefore will we not fear when the earth is troubled, and the mountains are removed into the depths of the seas.

fresh_translation: Their waters roared and were troubled; mountains were troubled by his might. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Their waters have roared and been troubled, the mountains have been troubled by his might. Pause.

fresh_translation: Rushings of the river gladden the city of God; Most High sanctified his dwelling.
brenton_translation: The flowings of the river gladden the city of God: the Most High has sanctified his tabernacle.

fresh_translation: God is in the midst of her; she will not be shaken. God will help her toward morning.
brenton_translation: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her with his countenance.

fresh_translation: Nations were troubled, kingdoms bowed; he gave his voice, earth was shaken.
brenton_translation: The nations were troubled, the kingdoms tottered: he uttered his voice, the earth shook.

fresh_translation: The Lord of hosts is with us; our supporter God of Jacob. Interlude.
brenton_translation: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our helper. Pause.

fresh_translation: Come, see works of the Lord, what wonders he set upon earth,
brenton_translation: Come, and behold the works of the Lord, what wonders he has achieved on the earth.

fresh_translation: doing away wars to the ends of the earth. He will break bow and shatter weapon and burn shields in fire.
brenton_translation: Putting an end to wars as for the ends of the earth; he will crush the bow, and break in pieces the weapon, and burn the bucklers with fire.

fresh_translation: Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among nations, I will be exalted in earth.
brenton_translation: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.

fresh_translation: The Lord of hosts is with us; our supporter God of Jacob.
brenton_translation: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our helper.

fresh_translation: For end, for the sons of Korah, psalm.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm for the sons of Core.

fresh_translation: All nations, clap hands; shout to God with the voice of exultation.
brenton_translation: Clap your hands, all ye nations; shout to God with a voice of exultation.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord Most High is fearsome, a great king over all the earth.
brenton_translation: For the Lord most high is terrible; he is a great king over all the earth.

fresh_translation: He subjected peoples to us and nations under our feet.
brenton_translation: He has subdued the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.

fresh_translation: He chose for us his inheritance, beauty of Jacob which he loved. Interlude.
brenton_translation: He has chosen out his inheritance for us, the beauty of Jacob which he loved. Pause.

fresh_translation: God went up with a shout, the Lord with the voice of a trumpet.
brenton_translation: God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with a sound of a trumpet.

fresh_translation: Sing to our God, sing; sing to our king, sing.
brenton_translation: Sing praises to our God, sing praises: sing praises to our King, sing praises.

fresh_translation: Because God king of all the earth, sing with understanding.
brenton_translation: For God is king of all the earth: sing praises with understanding.

fresh_translation: God reigned over nations; God sits upon his holy throne.
brenton_translation: God reigns over the nations: God sits upon the throne of his holiness.

fresh_translation: The rulers of peoples gathered with the God of Abraham, because the mighty ones of the earth belong to God; they were greatly exalted.
brenton_translation: The rulers of the people are assembled with the God of Abraam: for God's mighty ones of the earth have been greatly exalted.

fresh_translation: Psalm of song for the sons of Korah, second of Sabbath.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of praise for the sons of Core on the second day of the week.

fresh_translation: Great is the Lord and greatly praised in the city of our God, his holy mountain,
brenton_translation: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

fresh_translation: well-rooted, joy of all the earth. Mounts of Zion, sides of north, city of great king.
brenton_translation: The city of the great King is well planted on the mountains of Sion, with the joy of the whole earth, on the sides of the north.

fresh_translation: God in her citadels is known when he takes hold of her.
brenton_translation: God is known in her palaces, when he undertakes to help her.

fresh_translation: Because behold, kings gathered; they came together.
brenton_translation: For, behold, the kings of the earth were assembled, they came together.

fresh_translation: They, seeing thus, were astonished, were troubled, were shaken.
brenton_translation: They saw, and so they wondered: they were troubled, they were moved.

fresh_translation: Trembling seized them there, pangs as of a woman giving birth.
brenton_translation: Trembling took hold on them: there were the pangs as of a woman in travail.

fresh_translation: With violent wind you will shatter ships of Tarshish.
brenton_translation: Thou wilt break the ships of Tharsis with a vehement wind.

fresh_translation: As we heard, so we saw in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God; God founded her forever. Interlude.
brenton_translation: As we have heard, so have we also seen, in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: God has founded it for ever. Pause.

fresh_translation: We received, O God, your mercy in the midst of your temple.
brenton_translation: We have thought of thy mercy, O God, in the midst of thy people.

fresh_translation: According to your name, O God, so also your praise to the ends of the earth; your right hand full of righteousness.
brenton_translation: According to thy name, O God, so is also thy praise to the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

fresh_translation: Let Mount Zion rejoice; let daughters of Judah exult because of your judgments, Lord.
brenton_translation: Let mount Sion rejoice, let the daughters of Judæa exult, because of thy judgments, O Lord.

fresh_translation: Encircle Zion and surround her; tell in her towers.
brenton_translation: Go round about Sion, and encompass her: tell ye her towers.

fresh_translation: Set your hearts on her power and pass through her citadels, so that you may tell to another generation.
brenton_translation: Mark ye well her strength, and observe her palaces; that ye may tell the next generation.

fresh_translation: Because this is God, our God forever and ever; he will shepherd us forever.
brenton_translation: For this is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide for evermore.

fresh_translation: For end, for the sons of Korah, psalm.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm for the sons of Core.

fresh_translation: Hear these things, all nations; give ear, all inhabiting world,
brenton_translation: Hear these words, all ye nations, hearken, all ye that dwell upon the earth:

fresh_translation: both earthborn and sons of men together, rich and poor.
brenton_translation: both the sons of mean men, and sons of great men; the rich and poor man together.

fresh_translation: My mouth will speak wisdom, and meditation of my heart understanding.
brenton_translation: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall bring forth understanding.

fresh_translation: I will incline my ear into parable; I will open my riddle on harp.
brenton_translation: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my riddle on the harp.

fresh_translation: Why do I fear in evil day? Lawlessness of my heel will surround me,
brenton_translation: Wherefore should I fear in the evil day? the iniquity of my heel shall compass me.

fresh_translation: those trusting in their strength and boasting in the abundance of their wealth.
brenton_translation: They that trust in their strength, and boast themselves in the multitude of their wealth—

fresh_translation: Brother is not redeemed; will man redeem? He will not give to God his atonement,
brenton_translation: A brother does not redeem, shall a man redeem? he shall not give to God a ransom for himself,

fresh_translation: even price of redemption of his soul,
brenton_translation: or the price of the redemption of his soul, though he labour for ever,

fresh_translation: and he labored forever, and he will live to end. He will not see corruption when he sees wise men dying.
brenton_translation: and live to the end, so that he should not see corruption.

fresh_translation: Together fool and senseless will perish and leave their wealth to strangers.
brenton_translation: When he shall see wise men dying, the fool and the senseless one shall perish together; and they shall leave their wealth to strangers.

fresh_translation: And their graves their houses forever, their dwellings from generation to generation; they called their names upon their lands.
brenton_translation: And their sepulchres are their houses for ever, even their tabernacles to all generations: they have called their lands after their own names.

fresh_translation: But man in honor did not understand; he was compared with mindless cattle and was made like them.
brenton_translation: And man being in honour, understands not: he is compared to the senseless cattle, and is like to them.

fresh_translation: This way of theirs stumbling-block to them, and after these things they will delight in their mouth. Interlude.
brenton_translation: This their way is an offence to them: yet afterwards men will commend their sayings. Pause.

fresh_translation: Like sheep they were set in Hades; death will shepherd them, and upright ones will lord over them in morning, and their help will grow old in Hades, away from their glory.
brenton_translation: They have laid them as sheep in Hades; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning, and their help shall fail in Hades from their glory.

fresh_translation: But God will redeem my soul from the hand of Hades when he receives me. Interlude.
brenton_translation: But God shall deliver my soul from the power of Hades, when he shall receive me. Pause.

fresh_translation: Do not fear when man becomes rich and glory of his house is multiplied,
brenton_translation: Fear not when a man is enriched, and when the glory of his house is increased.

fresh_translation: because when he dies he will take nothing; his glory will not go down with him.
brenton_translation: For he shall take nothing when he dies; neither shall his glory descend with him.

fresh_translation: Because his soul in his life will be blessed; he will confess to you when you do good to him.
brenton_translation: For his soul shall be blessed in his life: he shall give thanks to thee when thou dost well to him.

fresh_translation: He will go in as far as generation of his fathers; forever he will not see light.
brenton_translation: Yet he shall go in to the generation of his fathers; he shall never see light.

fresh_translation: Man in honor did not understand; he was compared with mindless cattle and was made like them.
brenton_translation: Man that is in honour, understands not: he is compared to the senseless cattle, and is like them.

fresh_translation: Psalm of Asaph. The God of gods, the Lord, spoke and called earth from the rising of sun to its setting.
brenton_translation: A Psalm for Asaph.

fresh_translation: Out of Zion comeliness of his beauty; God will come openly.
brenton_translation: Out of Sion comes the excellence of his beauty.

fresh_translation: Our God will come and will not keep silent; fire before him will burn, and around him storm exceedingly.
brenton_translation: God, our God, shall come manifestly, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall be kindled before him, and round about him there shall be a very great tempest.

fresh_translation: He will call heaven above and earth to judge his people.
