brenton_translation: He shall summon the heaven above, and the earth, that he may judge his people.

fresh_translation: Gather to him his holy ones, those making his covenant upon sacrifices.
brenton_translation: Assemble ye his saints to him, those that have engaged in a covenant with him upon sacrifices.

fresh_translation: And heavens will declare his righteousness, because God is judge. Interlude.
brenton_translation: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge. Pause.

fresh_translation: Hear, my people, and I will speak to you; Israel, and I will testify to you: God, your God, am I.
brenton_translation: Hear, my people, and I will speak to thee, O Israel: and I will testify to thee: I am God, thy God.

fresh_translation: Not concerning your sacrifices will I rebuke you, and your whole burnt offerings are before me continually.
brenton_translation: I will not reprove thee on account of thy sacrifices; for thy whole-burnt-offerings are before me continually.

fresh_translation: I will not receive calves from your house, nor he-goats from your flocks,
brenton_translation: I will take no bullocks out of thine house, nor he-goats out of thy flocks.

fresh_translation: because all wild animals of the forest are mine, cattle on mountains and oxen.
brenton_translation: For all the wild beasts of the thicket are mine, the cattle on the mountains, and oxen.

fresh_translation: I knew all birds of heaven, and beauty of field with me.
brenton_translation: I know all the birds of the sky; and the beauty of the field is mine.

fresh_translation: If I hunger, I will not tell you, because inhabited world is mine and its fullness.
brenton_translation: If I should be hungry, I will not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness of it.

fresh_translation: Will I eat flesh of bulls, or drink blood of goats?
brenton_translation: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

fresh_translation: Sacrifice to God sacrifice of praise, and pay to Most High your vows.
brenton_translation: Offer to God the sacrifice of praise; and pay thy vows to the Most High.

fresh_translation: And call upon me in the day of affliction, and I will deliver you, and you will glorify me. Interlude.
brenton_translation: And call upon me in the day of affliction; and I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me. Pause.

fresh_translation: But to sinner God said, Why do you recount my righteous acts and take up my covenant in your mouth,
brenton_translation: But to the sinner God has said, Why dost thou declare my ordinances, and take up my covenant in thy mouth?

fresh_translation: but you hated instruction and cast my words behind you?
brenton_translation: Whereas thou hast hated instruction, and hast cast my words behind thee.

fresh_translation: If you saw thief, you ran with him, and with adulterers you set your share.
brenton_translation: If thou sawest a thief, thou rannest along with him, and hast cast in thy lot with adulterers.

fresh_translation: Your mouth abounded in evil, and your tongue wove deceit.
brenton_translation: Thy mouth has multiplied wickedness, and thy tongue has framed deceit.

fresh_translation: Sitting, you spoke against your brother, and against son of your mother you set stumbling-block.
brenton_translation: Thou didst sit and speak against thy brother, and didst scandalise thy mother's son.

fresh_translation: These things you did, and I kept silent. You supposed lawlessness, that I would be like you. I will rebuke you and set them before your face.
brenton_translation: These things thou didst, and I kept silence: thou thoughtest wickedly that I should be like thee; but I will reprove thee, and set thine offences before thee.

fresh_translation: Understand these things, you forgetting God, lest he seize, and there be none rescuing.
brenton_translation: Now consider these things, ye that forget God, lest he rend you, and there be no deliverer.

fresh_translation: A sacrifice of praise will glorify me, and there is way by which I will show him salvation of God.
brenton_translation: The sacrifice of praise will glorify me: and that is the way wherein I will shew to him the salvation of God.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David,

fresh_translation: When Nathan the prophet came to him, when he went in to Beersheba.
brenton_translation: when Nathan the prophet came to him, when he had gone in to Bersabee.

fresh_translation: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your great mercy, and according to the multitude of your compassions blot out my lawlessness.
brenton_translation: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy great mercy; and according to the multitude of thy compassions blot out my transgression.

fresh_translation: Wash me more and more from my lawlessness and cleanse me from my sin,
brenton_translation: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

fresh_translation: because I know my lawlessness, and my sin before me continually.
brenton_translation: For I am conscious of mine iniquity; and my sin is continually before me.

fresh_translation: Against you only I sinned and did evil before you, so that you may be justified in your words and prevail when you are judged.
brenton_translation: Against thee only have I sinned, and done evil before thee: that thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

fresh_translation: For behold, in lawlessnesses I was conceived, and in sins my mother conceived me.
brenton_translation: For, behold, I was conceived in iniquities, and in sins did my mother conceive me.

fresh_translation: For behold, you loved truth; hidden and secret things of your wisdom you showed me.
brenton_translation: For, behold, thou lovest truth: thou hast manifested to me the secret and hidden things of thy wisdom.

fresh_translation: You will sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be cleansed; you will wash me, and beyond snow I will be whitened.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be purified: thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

fresh_translation: You will make me hear exultation and gladness; humbled bones will exult.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt cause me to hear gladness and joy: the afflicted bones shall rejoice.

fresh_translation: Turn your face away from my sins, and blot out all my lawlessnesses.
brenton_translation: Turn away thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

fresh_translation: Create in me clean heart, O God, and renew right spirit in my inward parts.
brenton_translation: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit in my inward parts.

fresh_translation: Do not cast me away from your face, and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.
brenton_translation: Cast me not away from thy presence; and remove not thy Holy Spirit from me.

fresh_translation: Restore to me exultation of your salvation, and strengthen me with guiding spirit.
brenton_translation: Restore to me the joy of thy salvation: establish me with thy directing Spirit.

fresh_translation: I will teach lawless ones your ways, and ungodly ones will turn back to you.
brenton_translation: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and ungodly men shall turn to thee.

fresh_translation: Rescue me from bloodguilt, O God, God of my salvation; my tongue will exult in your righteousness.
brenton_translation: Deliver me from blood-guiltiness, O God, the God of my salvation: and my tongue shall joyfully declare thy righteousness.

fresh_translation: Lord, you will open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.
brenton_translation: O Lord, thou shalt open my lips; and my mouth shall declare thy praise.

fresh_translation: Because if you wanted sacrifice, I would give it; in whole burnt offerings you will not delight.
brenton_translation: For if thou desiredst sacrifice, I would have given it: thou wilt not take pleasure in whole-burnt-offerings.

fresh_translation: Sacrifice to God crushed spirit; crushed and humbled heart God will not despise.
brenton_translation: Sacrifice to God is a broken spirit: a broken and humbled heart God will not despise.

fresh_translation: Do good, Lord, in your good pleasure to Zion, and let walls of Jerusalem be built.
brenton_translation: Do good, O Lord, to Sion in thy good pleasure; and let the walls of Jerusalem be built.

fresh_translation: Then you will delight in sacrifice of righteousness, offering and whole burnt offerings; then they will offer calves upon your altar.
brenton_translation: Then shalt thou be pleased with a sacrifice of righteousness, offering, and whole-burnt-sacrifices: then shall they offer calves upon thine altar.

fresh_translation: For end. For understanding. Of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of instruction by David,

fresh_translation: When Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul and said to him, David came into the house of Abimelech.
brenton_translation: when Doec the Idumean came and told Saul, and said to him, David is gone to the house of Abimelech.

fresh_translation: Why do you boast in evil, mighty one, in lawlessness whole day?
brenton_translation: Why dost thou, O mighty man, boast of iniquity in thy mischief? All the day

fresh_translation: Your tongue devised injustice; like sharpened razor you worked deceit.
brenton_translation: thy tongue has devised unrighteousness; like a sharpened razor thou hast wrought deceit.

fresh_translation: You loved evil beyond goodness, injustice beyond speaking righteousness. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Thou hast loved wickedness more than goodness; unrighteousness better than to speak righteousness. Pause.

fresh_translation: You loved all words of engulfing, a deceitful tongue.
brenton_translation: Thou hast loved all words of destruction, and a deceitful tongue.

fresh_translation: Therefore God will tear you down to end; may he pluck you out and remove you from tent, and your root from the land of living. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Therefore may God destroy thee for ever, may he pluck thee up and utterly remove thee from thy dwelling, and thy root from the land of the living. Pause.

fresh_translation: And righteous ones will see and fear, and over him they will laugh and say,
brenton_translation: And the righteous shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him, and say,

fresh_translation: Behold man who did not make God his helper, but hoped in the multitude of his wealth and was strengthened in his vanity.
brenton_translation: Behold the man who made not God his help; but trusted in the abundance of his wealth, and strengthened himself in his vanity.

fresh_translation: But I like a fruitful olive tree in the house of God; I hoped in the mercy of God forever and forever of forever.
brenton_translation: But I am as a fruitful olive in the house of God: I have trusted in the mercy of God for ever, even for evermore.

fresh_translation: I will confess to you forever, because you did it, and I will wait for your name, because good before your holy ones.
brenton_translation: I will give thanks to thee for ever, for thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

fresh_translation: For end, concerning Mahalath. For understanding. Of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David upon Maeleth, of instruction.

fresh_translation: The fool said in his heart, There is no God. They were corrupted and became abominable in lawlessnesses; there is none doing good.
brenton_translation: The fool has said in his heart, There is no God. They have corrupted themselves, and become abominable in iniquities: there is none that does good.

fresh_translation: God looked down from heaven upon the sons of men to see whether there is one understanding or seeking God.
brenton_translation: God looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see if there were any that understood, or sought after God.

fresh_translation: All turned aside; together they became worthless; there is none doing good, there is not even one.
brenton_translation: They have all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that does good, there is not even one.

fresh_translation: Will not all workers of lawlessness know, those eating my people as eating bread? They did not call upon God.
brenton_translation: Will none of the workers of iniquity know, who devour my people as they would eat bread? they have not called upon God. There were they greatly afraid, where there was no fear:

fresh_translation: There they feared fear where fear was not, because God scattered bones of men-pleasers. They were shamed, because God despised them.
brenton_translation: for God has scattered the bones of the men-pleasers; they were ashamed, for God despised them.

fresh_translation: Who will give out of Zion salvation of Israel? When the Lord turns back captivity of his people, Jacob will exult and Israel will rejoice.
brenton_translation: Who will bring the salvation of Israel out of Sion? When the Lord turns the captivity of his people, Jacob shall exult, and Israel shall be glad.

fresh_translation: For end, in hymns. For understanding. Of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, among the Hymns of instruction by David,

fresh_translation: When Ziphites came and said to Saul, Is not David hidden among us?
brenton_translation: when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Lo, is not David hid with us?

fresh_translation: O God, in your name save me, and in your power judge me.
brenton_translation: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy might.

fresh_translation: O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.
brenton_translation: O God, hear my prayer; hearken to the words of my mouth.

fresh_translation: Because strangers rose up against me, and strong men sought my soul; they did not set God before them. Interlude.
brenton_translation: For strangers have risen up against me, and mighty men have sought my life: they have not set God before them. Pause.

fresh_translation: For behold, God helps me, and the Lord supporter of my soul.
brenton_translation: For lo! God assists me; and the Lord is the helper of my soul.

fresh_translation: He will turn evils back on my enemies; in your truth destroy them.
brenton_translation: He shall return evil to mine enemies; utterly destroy them in thy truth.

fresh_translation: Willingly I will sacrifice to you; I will confess your name, Lord, because good,
brenton_translation: I will willingly sacrifice to thee: I will give thanks to thy name, O Lord; for it is good.

fresh_translation: because from every affliction he rescued me, and among my enemies my eye looked down.
brenton_translation: For thou hast delivered me out of all affliction, and mine eye has seen my desire upon mine enemies.

fresh_translation: For end, in hymns. For understanding. Of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, among Hymns of instruction by David.

fresh_translation: Give ear, O God, to my prayer, and do not overlook my supplication.
brenton_translation: Hearken, O God, to my prayer; and disregard not my supplication.

fresh_translation: Attend to me and hear me; I was grieved in my musing and was troubled
brenton_translation: Attend to me, and hearken to me: I was grieved in my meditation, and troubled;

fresh_translation: from the voice of enemy and from the affliction of sinner, because they bent lawlessness upon me and in wrath were enraged against me.
brenton_translation: because of the voice of the enemy, and because of the oppression of the sinner: for they brought iniquity against me, and were wrathfully angry with me.

fresh_translation: My heart was troubled in me, and dread of death fell upon me.
brenton_translation: My heart was troubled within me; and the fear of death fell upon me.

fresh_translation: Fear and trembling came upon me, and darkness covered me.
brenton_translation: Fear and trembling came upon me, and darkness covered me.

fresh_translation: And I said, Who will give me wings like a dove, and I will fly away and be at rest?
brenton_translation: And I said, O that I had wings as those of a dove! then would I flee away, and be at rest.

fresh_translation: Behold, I went far away in fleeing and lodged in the wilderness. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Lo! I have fled afar off, and lodged in the wilderness. Pause.

fresh_translation: I waited for one saving me from faintheartedness and storm.
brenton_translation: I waited for him that should deliver me from distress of spirit and tempest.

fresh_translation: Drown them, Lord, and divide their tongues, because I saw lawlessness and contradiction in the city.
brenton_translation: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen iniquity and gainsaying in the city.

fresh_translation: Day and night it will encircle her upon her walls; lawlessness and labor in the midst of her,
brenton_translation: Day and night he shall go round about it upon its walls: iniquity and sorrow and unrighteousness are in the midst of it;

fresh_translation: and injustice. And usury and deceit did not fail from her squares.
brenton_translation: and usury and craft have not failed from its streets.

fresh_translation: Because if enemy reproached me, I would bear it; and if one hating me spoke great words against me, I would hide from him.
brenton_translation: For if an enemy had reproached me, I would have endured it; and if one who hated me had spoken vauntingly against me, I would have hid myself from him.

fresh_translation: But you, man equal-souled, my guide and my acquaintance,
brenton_translation: But thou, O man likeminded, my guide, and my acquaintance,

fresh_translation: who together with me sweetened foods; in the house of God we walked in concord.
brenton_translation: who in companionship with me sweetened our food: we walked in the house of God in concord.

fresh_translation: Let death come upon them, and let them go down living to Hades, because evils in their dwellings, in the midst of them.
brenton_translation: Let death come upon them, and let them go down alive into Hades, for iniquity is in their dwellings, in the midst of them.

fresh_translation: But I cried to God, and the Lord heard me.
brenton_translation: I cried to God, and the Lord hearkened to me.

fresh_translation: Evening and morning and midday I will tell and declare, and he will hear my voice.
brenton_translation: Evening, and morning, and at noon I will declare and make known my wants: and he shall hear my voice.

fresh_translation: He will redeem my soul in peace from those drawing near to me, because among many they were with me.
brenton_translation: He shall deliver my soul in peace from them that draw nigh to me: for they were with me in many cases.

fresh_translation: God will hear and humble them, he who exists before ages. Interlude. Because there is no change for them, and they did not fear God.
brenton_translation: God shall hear, and bring them low, even he that has existed from eternity. Pause.

fresh_translation: He stretched out his hand in repaying; they profaned his covenant.
brenton_translation: He has reached forth his hand for retribution; they have profaned his covenant.

fresh_translation: They were divided by wrath of his face, and his heart drew near. His words were softened beyond oil, and they are darts.
brenton_translation: They were scattered at the anger of his countenance, and his heart drew nigh them. His words were smoother than oil, yet are they darts.

fresh_translation: Cast your care upon the Lord, and he will sustain you; he will not give shaking to a righteous one forever.
brenton_translation: Cast thy care upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee; he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

fresh_translation: But you, O God, will bring them down into the pit of corruption; men of bloods and deceit will not halve their days, but I will hope upon you, Lord.
brenton_translation: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down to the pit of destruction; bloody and crafty men shall not live out half their days; but I will hope in thee, O Lord.

fresh_translation: For end, concerning people removed far from holy places. Of David, for inscription, when Philistines seized him in Gath.
brenton_translation: For the end, concerning the people that were removed from the sanctuary, by David for a memorial, when the Philistines caught him in Geth.

fresh_translation: Have mercy on me, Lord, because man trampled me; whole day, warring, he afflicted me.
brenton_translation: Have mercy upon me, O God; for man has trodden me down; all the day long he warring has afflicted me.

fresh_translation: My enemies trampled me whole day, because many warring against me from height.
brenton_translation: Mine enemies have trodden me down all the day from the dawning of the day; for there are many warring against me.

fresh_translation: In day I fear, I will hope upon you.
brenton_translation: They shall be afraid, but I will trust in thee.

fresh_translation: In God I will praise my words; whole day in God I hoped; I will not fear what flesh will do to me.
brenton_translation: In God I will praise my words; all the day have I hoped in God; I will not fear what flesh shall do to me.

fresh_translation: Whole day they were abhorring my words; all their thoughts against me for evil.
brenton_translation: All the day long they have abominated my words; all their devices are against me for evil.

fresh_translation: They will dwell as strangers and hide themselves; they will watch my heel, just as they waited for my soul.
brenton_translation: They will dwell near and hide themselves; they will watch my steps, accordingly as I have waited patiently in my soul.

fresh_translation: For the sake of nothing will you save them? In wrath you will bring down peoples, O God.
brenton_translation: Thou wilt on no account save them; thou wilt bring down the people in wrath.

fresh_translation: My life I told to you; set my tears before you, as also in your promise.
brenton_translation: O God, I have declared my life to thee; thou hast set my tears before thee, even according to thy promise.

fresh_translation: My enemies will turn back in whatever day I call on you; behold, I knew that you are my God.
brenton_translation: Mine enemies shall be turned back, in the day wherein I shall call upon thee; behold, I know that thou art my God.

fresh_translation: In God I will praise word; in the Lord I will praise saying.
brenton_translation: In God will I praise his word; in the Lord will I praise his saying.

fresh_translation: In God I hoped; I will not fear what man will do to me.
brenton_translation: I have hoped in God; I will not be afraid of what man shall do to me.

fresh_translation: In me, O God, are vows; I will repay praises to you,
brenton_translation: The vows of thy praise, O God, which I will pay, are upon me.

fresh_translation: because you rescued my soul from death and my feet from slipping, so that I may be well-pleasing before God in the light of living ones.
brenton_translation: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, and my feet from sliding, that I should be well-pleasing before God in the land of the living.

fresh_translation: For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription, when he fled from the face of Saul into cave.
brenton_translation: For the end. Destroy not: by David, for a memorial, when he fled from the presence of Saul to the cave.

fresh_translation: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me, because my soul has trusted in you, and in the shadow of your wings I will hope until lawlessness passes by.
brenton_translation: Have mercy, upon me, O God, have mercy upon me: for my soul has trusted in thee: and in the shadow of thy wings will I hope, until the iniquity have passed away.

fresh_translation: I will cry to God Most High, to God who benefited me.
brenton_translation: I will cry to God most high; the God who has benefited me. Pause.

fresh_translation: He sent from heaven and saved me; he gave reproach to those trampling me. Interlude. God sent his mercy and his truth.
brenton_translation: He sent from heaven and saved me; he gave to reproach them that trampled on me: God has sent forth his mercy and his truth;

fresh_translation: And he rescued my soul from the midst of lion-cubs. I slept troubled. Sons of men: their teeth weapon and arrows, and their tongue sharp sword.
brenton_translation: and he has delivered my soul from the midst of lions' whelps: I lay down to sleep, though troubled. As for the sons of men, their teeth are arms and missile weapons, and their tongue a sharp sword.

fresh_translation: Be exalted above heavens, O God, and over all the earth your glory.
brenton_translation: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; and thy glory above all the earth.

fresh_translation: They prepared snare for my feet and bent down my soul; they dug pit before my face and fell into it. Interlude.
brenton_translation: They have prepared snares for my feet, and have bowed down my soul: they have dug a pit before my face, and fallen into it themselves. Pause.

fresh_translation: Ready my heart, O God, ready my heart; I will sing and make melody.
brenton_translation: My heart, O God, is ready, my heart is ready: I will sing, yea will sing psalms.

fresh_translation: Awake, my glory; awake, harp and lyre; I will awake at dawn.
brenton_translation: Awake, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I will awake early.

fresh_translation: I will confess to you among peoples, Lord; I will sing to you among nations.
brenton_translation: O Lord, I will give thanks to thee among the nations: I will sing to thee among the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: Because your mercy was magnified unto heavens and your truth unto clouds.
brenton_translation: For thy mercy has been magnified even to the heavens, and thy truth to the clouds.

fresh_translation: Be exalted above heavens, O God, and over all the earth your glory.
brenton_translation: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; and thy glory above all the earth.

fresh_translation: For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription.
brenton_translation: For the end. Destroy not: by David, for a memorial.

fresh_translation: If truly indeed you speak righteousness, judge straight things, sons of men.
brenton_translation: If ye do indeed speak righteousness, then do ye judge rightly, ye sons of men.

fresh_translation: For even in heart you work lawlessnesses; in earth your hands weave together injustice.
brenton_translation: For ye work iniquities in your hearts in the earth: your hands plot unrighteousness.

fresh_translation: Sinners were estranged from womb, they went astray from belly, they spoke lies.
brenton_translation: Sinners have gone astray from the womb: they go astray from the belly: they speak lies.

fresh_translation: Their fury according to the likeness of serpent, like a deaf asp stopping its ears,
brenton_translation: Their venom is like that of a serpent; as that of a deaf asp, and that stops her ears;

fresh_translation: which will not hear the voice of charmers, of drug mixed by wise enchanter.
brenton_translation: which will not hear the voice of charmers, nor heed the charm prepared skilfully by the wise.

fresh_translation: God shattered their teeth in their mouth; The Lord crushed fangs of lions.
brenton_translation: God has crushed their teeth in their mouth: God has broken the cheek-teeth of the lions.

fresh_translation: They will be despised like water passing by; he will bend his bow until they grow weak.
brenton_translation: They shall utterly pass away like water running through: he shall bend his bow till they shall fail.

fresh_translation: Like wax melting they will be done away; fire fell, and they did not see sun.
brenton_translation: They shall be destroyed as melted wax: the fire has fallen and they have not seen the sun.

fresh_translation: Before your thorns understand bramble, as living ones, as in wrath, he will swallow you up.
brenton_translation: Before your thorns feel the white thorn, he shall swallow you up as living, as in his wrath.

fresh_translation: The righteous one will rejoice when he sees vengeance of the ungodly; he will wash his hands in the blood of sinner.
brenton_translation: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance of the ungodly: he shall wash his hands in the blood of the sinner.

fresh_translation: And man will say, Then there is fruit for righteous one; then there is God judging them in earth.
brenton_translation: And a man shall say, Verily then there is a reward for the righteous: verily there is a God that judges them in the earth.

fresh_translation: For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription, when Saul sent and watched his house to kill him.
brenton_translation: For the end. Destroy not: by David for a memorial, when Saul sent, and watched his house to kill him.

fresh_translation: Rescue me from my enemies, O God, and redeem me from those rising against me.
brenton_translation: Deliver me from mine enemies, O God; and ransom me from those that rise up against me.

fresh_translation: Deliver me from those working lawlessness, and save me from the men of bloods.
brenton_translation: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

fresh_translation: Because behold, they hunted my soul; strong men attacked me, neither my lawlessness nor my sin, Lord.
brenton_translation: For, behold, they have hunted after my soul; violent men have set upon me: neither is it my iniquity, nor my sin, O Lord.

fresh_translation: Without lawlessness I ran and went straight; awake to meet me and see.
brenton_translation: Without iniquity I ran and directed my course aright: awake to help me, and behold.

fresh_translation: And you, Lord God of hosts, God of Israel, attend to visit all nations; do not pity all workers of lawlessness. Interlude.
brenton_translation: And thou, Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, draw nigh to visit all the heathen; pity not any that work iniquity. Pause.

fresh_translation: They will return at evening and hunger like a dog and encircle city.
brenton_translation: They shall return at evening, and hunger like a dog, and go round about the city.

fresh_translation: Behold, they will utter with their mouth, and sword on their lips, because who heard?
brenton_translation: Behold, they shall utter a voice with their mouth, and a sword is in their lips; for who, say they, has heard?

fresh_translation: But you, Lord, will laugh at them; you will despise all nations.
brenton_translation: But thou, Lord, wilt laugh them to scorn; thou wilt utterly set at nought all the heathen.

fresh_translation: My strength, toward you I will keep watch, because God my supporter.
brenton_translation: I will keep my strength, looking to thee; for thou, O God, art my helper.

fresh_translation: My God, his mercy will go before me; God will show me among my enemies.
brenton_translation: As for my God, his mercy shall go before me: my God will shew me vengeance on mine enemies.

fresh_translation: Do not kill them, lest they forget my people. Scatter them in your power and bring them down, my defender, Lord.
brenton_translation: Slay them not, lest they forget thy law; scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord, my defender.

fresh_translation: Sin of their mouth, word of their lips. Let them be caught in their pride, and from curse and lie they will be proclaimed in endings.
brenton_translation: For the sin of their mouth, and the word of their lips, let them be even taken in their pride.

fresh_translation: In wrath of ending, and they will be no more; and they will know that God rules Jacob to the ends of the earth. Interlude.
brenton_translation: And for their cursing and falsehood shall utter destruction be denounced: they shall fall by the wrath of utter destruction, and shall not be; so shall they know that the God of Jacob is Lord of the ends of the earth. Pause.

fresh_translation: They will return at evening and hunger like a dog and encircle city.
brenton_translation: They shall return at evening, and be hungry as a dog, and go round about the city.

fresh_translation: They will be scattered to eat; if they are not filled, they will also grumble.
brenton_translation: They shall be scattered hither and thither for meat; and if they be not satisfied, they shall even murmur.

fresh_translation: But I will sing of your power and exult in morning in your mercy, because you became my supporter and refuge in the day of my affliction.
brenton_translation: But I will sing to thy strength, and in the morning will I exult in thy mercy; for thou hast been my supporter, and my refuge in the day of mine affliction.

fresh_translation: My helper, to you I will sing, because God my supporter, my God, my mercy.
brenton_translation: Thou art my helper; to thee, my God, will I sing; thou art my supporter, O my God, and my mercy.

fresh_translation: For end, concerning those to be changed, yet for inscription, of David, for teaching.
brenton_translation: For the end, for them that shall yet be changed; for an inscription by David for instruction,

fresh_translation: When he burned Mesopotamia of Syria and Syria of Zobah, and Joab returned and struck valley of salt, twelve thousand.
brenton_translation: when he had burned Mesopotamia of Syria, and Syria Sobal, and Joab had returned and smitten in the valley of salt twelve thousand.

fresh_translation: O God, you rejected us and pulled us down; you were angry and had compassion on us.
brenton_translation: O God, thou hast rejected and destroyed us; thou hast been angry, yet hast pitied us.

fresh_translation: You shook earth and troubled it; heal its fractures, because it was shaken.
brenton_translation: Thou hast shaken the earth, and troubled it; heal its breaches, for it has been shaken.

fresh_translation: You showed your people hard things; you made us drink wine of staggering.
brenton_translation: Thou hast shewn thy people hard things: thou hast made us drink the wine of astonishment.

fresh_translation: You gave signal to those fearing you, to flee from the face of bow. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Thou hast given a token to them that fear thee, that they might flee from the bow. Pause.

fresh_translation: So that your beloved ones may be rescued, save with your right hand and hear me.
brenton_translation: That thy beloved ones may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

fresh_translation: God spoke in his holy place: I will exult and divide Shechem, and valley of tents I will measure out.
brenton_translation: God has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, and divide Sicima, and measure out the valley of tents.

fresh_translation: Gilead mine and Manasseh mine, and Ephraim strength of my head, Judah my king.
brenton_translation: Galaad is mine, and Manasse is mine; and Ephraim is the strength of my head;

fresh_translation: Moab cauldron of my hope; upon Edom I will stretch out my sandal; foreigners were subjected to me.
brenton_translation: Judas is my king; Moab is the caldron of my hope; over Idumea will I stretch out my shoe; the Philistines have been subjected to me.

fresh_translation: Who will bring me into fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Edom?
brenton_translation: Who will lead me into the fortified city? who will guide me as far as Idumea?

fresh_translation: Is it not you, O God, who rejected us? And God will not go out in our powers.
brenton_translation: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our forces?

fresh_translation: Give us help out of affliction, because salvation of man is vain.
brenton_translation: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the deliverance of man.

fresh_translation: In God we will do mighty deed, and he will despise those afflicting us.
brenton_translation: In God will we do valiantly; and he shall bring to nought them that harass us.

fresh_translation: For end, in hymns. Of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, among the Hymns of David.

fresh_translation: Hear, O God, my supplication; attend to my prayer.
brenton_translation: O God, hearken to my petition; attend to my prayer.

fresh_translation: From the ends of the earth I cried to you when my heart grew faint; on rock you lifted me up.
brenton_translation: From the ends of the earth have I cried to thee, when my heart was in trouble: thou liftedst me up on a rock, thou didst guide me:

fresh_translation: You guided me, because you became my hope, tower of strength from the face of enemy.
brenton_translation: because thou wert my hope, a tower of strength from the face of the enemy.

fresh_translation: I will sojourn in your tent forever; I will be sheltered in cover of your wings. Interlude.
brenton_translation: I will dwell in thy tabernacle for ever; I will shelter myself under the shadow of thy wings. Pause.

fresh_translation: Because you, God, heard my vows; you gave inheritance to those fearing your name.
brenton_translation: For thou, O God, hast heard my prayers; thou hast given an inheritance to them that fear thy name.

fresh_translation: Days upon days of the king you will add; his years until days of generation and generation.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt add days to the days of the king; thou shalt lengthen his years to all generations.

fresh_translation: He remains forever before God; his mercy and truth, who will seek out?
brenton_translation: He shall endure for ever before God: which of them will seek out his mercy and truth?

fresh_translation: Thus I will sing to your name forever and forever, to pay my vows day from day.
brenton_translation: So will I sing to thy name for ever and ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

fresh_translation: For end, concerning Jeduthun. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David for Idithun.

fresh_translation: Will not my soul be subjected to God? For from him my salvation.
brenton_translation: Shall not my soul be subjected to God? for of him is my salvation.

fresh_translation: For he my God and my savior, my supporter; I will not be shaken much.
brenton_translation: For he is my God and my Saviour; my helper, I shall not be moved very much.

fresh_translation: How long do you attack man? You all murder, like leaning wall and thrust fence.
brenton_translation: How long will ye assault a man? ye are all slaughtering as with a bowed wall and a broken hedge.

fresh_translation: Only my honor they planned to cast away; they ran in lie. With their mouth they blessed and with their heart they cursed. Interlude.
brenton_translation: They only took counsel to set at nought mine honour: I ran in thirst: with their mouth they blessed, but with their heart they cursed. Pause.

fresh_translation: Only be subjected to God, my soul, because from him my endurance.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless do thou, my soul, be subjected to God; for of him is my patient hope.

fresh_translation: Because he my God and savior, my supporter; I will not be moved away.
brenton_translation: For he is my God and my Saviour; my helper, I shall not be moved.

fresh_translation: Upon God my salvation and my glory, God of my help and my hope upon God.
brenton_translation: In God is my salvation and my glory: he is the God of my help, and my hope is in God.

fresh_translation: Hope upon him, every assembly of the people; pour out your hearts before him; God our helper. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Hope in him, all ye congregation of the people; pour out your hearts before him, for God is our helper. Pause.

fresh_translation: But vain sons of men, false sons of men, in balances to do injustice; they together from vanity.
brenton_translation: But the sons of men are vain; the sons of men are false, so as to be deceitful in the balances; they are all alike formed out of vanity.

fresh_translation: Do not hope in injustice, and do not desire plunder; if wealth flows, do not set heart on it.
brenton_translation: Trust not in unrighteousness, and lust not after robberies: if wealth should flow in, set not your heart upon it.

fresh_translation: Once God spoke; these two things I heard:
brenton_translation: God has spoken once, and I have heard these two things, that power is of God;

fresh_translation: because strength belongs to God, and to you, Lord, mercy, because you will repay each one according to his works.
brenton_translation: and mercy is thine, O Lord; for thou wilt recompense every one according to his works.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Idumea.

fresh_translation: O God, my God, to you I rise early. My soul thirsted for you; how much my flesh also for you, in a desert and trackless and waterless land.
brenton_translation: O God, my God, I cry to thee early; my soul has thirsted for thee: how often has my flesh longed after thee, in a barren and trackless and dry land!

fresh_translation: Thus in holy place I appeared to you, to see your power and your glory.
brenton_translation: Thus have I appeared before thee in the sanctuary, that I might see thy power and thy glory.

fresh_translation: Because your mercy better than lives; my lips will praise you.
brenton_translation: For thy mercy is better than life: my lips shall praise thee.

fresh_translation: Thus I will bless you in my life; in your name I will lift my hands.
brenton_translation: Thus will I bless thee during my life: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

fresh_translation: Let my soul be filled as with fat and richness, and with lips of exultation my mouth will praise you.
brenton_translation: Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness; and my joyful lips shall praise thy name.

fresh_translation: If I remembered you upon my bed, at dawns I meditated on you.
brenton_translation: Forasmuch as I have remembered thee on my bed: in the early seasons I have meditated on thee.

fresh_translation: Because you became my helper, and in the shelter of your wings I will exult.
brenton_translation: For thou hast been my helper, and in the shelter of thy wings will I rejoice.

fresh_translation: My soul clung after you; your right hand took hold of me.
brenton_translation: My soul has kept very close behind thee: thy right hand has upheld me.

fresh_translation: But they in vain sought my soul; they will enter into lowest parts of earth.
brenton_translation: But they vainly sought after my soul; they shall go into the lowest parts of the earth.

fresh_translation: They will be handed over into the hands of sword; they will be portions for foxes.
brenton_translation: They shall be delivered up to the power of the sword; they shall be portions for foxes.

fresh_translation: But the king will rejoice in God; everyone swearing by him will be praised, because mouth of those speaking unjust things was stopped.
brenton_translation: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that swears by him shall be praised; for the mouth of them that speak unjust things has been stopped.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Hear, O God, my voice in my supplication; from fear of enemy rescue my soul.
brenton_translation: Hear my prayer, O God, when I make my petition to thee; deliver my soul from fear of the enemy.

fresh_translation: You sheltered me from conspiracy of evil-doers, from the multitude of workers of lawlessness,
brenton_translation: Thou hast sheltered me from the conspiracy of them that do wickedly; from the multitude of them that work iniquity;

fresh_translation: who sharpened their tongues like a sword, bent their bow, bitter thing,
brenton_translation: who have sharpened their tongues as a sword; they have bent their bow maliciously;

fresh_translation: to shoot blameless one in secret places. Suddenly they will shoot him and will not fear.
brenton_translation: to shoot in secret at the blameless; they will shoot him suddenly, and will not fear.

fresh_translation: They strengthened for themselves evil word; they told of hiding snares. They said, Who will see them?
brenton_translation: They have set up for themselves an evil matter, they have given counsel to hide snares; they have said, Who shall see them?

fresh_translation: They searched out lawlessnesses; they failed, searching out searchings. Man will come near, and heart deep.
brenton_translation: They have searched out iniquity; they have wearied themselves with searching diligently, a man shall approach and the heart is deep,

fresh_translation: And God will be exalted; arrows of infants were their wounds.
brenton_translation: and God shall be exalted, their wounds were caused by the weapon of the foolish children,

fresh_translation: And their tongues grew weak against them; all seeing them were troubled.
brenton_translation: and their tongues have set him at nought, all that saw them were troubled;

fresh_translation: And every man feared, and they declared works of God and understood his deeds.
brenton_translation: and every man was alarmed, and they related the works of God, and understood his deeds.

fresh_translation: The righteous one will rejoice in the Lord and hope upon him, and all straight in heart will be praised.
brenton_translation: The righteous shall rejoice in the Lord, and hope on him, and all the upright in heart shall be praised.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David. Song of Jeremiah and Ezekiel from word of the sojourning when they were about to go out.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm and Song of David.

fresh_translation: Hymn fits you, O God, in Zion, and vow will be paid to you in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Praise becomes thee, O God, in Sion; and to thee shall the vow be performed.

fresh_translation: Hear my prayer; to you all flesh will come.
brenton_translation: Hear my prayer; to thee all flesh shall come.

fresh_translation: The words of lawless men overpowered us, and our ungodlinesses you will propitiate.
brenton_translation: The words of transgressors have overpowered us; but do thou pardon our sins.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the one whom you chose and took to yourself; he will dwell in your courts. We will be filled with good things of your house; holy is your temple, wondrous in righteousness.
brenton_translation: Blessed is he whom thou hast chosen and adopted; he shall dwell in thy courts; we shall be filled with the good things of thy house; thy temple is holy.

fresh_translation: Hear us, God our savior, hope of all ends of the earth and of those far off in sea,
brenton_translation: Thou art wonderful in righteousness. Hearken to us, O God our Saviour; the hope of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are on the sea afar off:

fresh_translation: preparing mountains in his strength, girded about in dominion,
brenton_translation: who dost establish the mountains in thy strength, being girded about with power;

fresh_translation: troubling depth of sea, the sound of its waves. Nations will be troubled.
brenton_translation: who troublest the depth of the sea, the sounds of its waves.

fresh_translation: And those inhabiting ends will fear at your signs; goings out of morning and evening you will gladden.
brenton_translation: The nations shall be troubled, and they that inhabit the ends of the earth shall be afraid of thy signs; thou wilt cause the outgoings of morning and evening to rejoice.

fresh_translation: You visited earth and made it drunk; you multiplied to enrich it. The river of God was filled with waters; you prepared their food, because thus your preparation.
brenton_translation: Thou hast visited the earth, and saturated it; thou hast abundantly enriched it. The river of God is filled with water; thou hast prepared their food, for thus is the preparation of it.

fresh_translation: Make her furrows drunk; multiply her produce; in its drops that springing thing will rejoice.
brenton_translation: Saturate her furrows, multiply her fruits; the crop springing up shall rejoice in its drops.

fresh_translation: You will bless crown of year of your goodness, and your plains will be filled with richness.
brenton_translation: Thou wilt bless the crown of the year because of thy goodness; and thy plains shall be filled with fatness.

fresh_translation: The beauties of the wilderness will grow fat, and the hills will gird themselves with exultation.
brenton_translation: The mountains of the wilderness shall be enriched; and the hills shall gird themselves with joy.

fresh_translation: Rams of sheep clothed themselves, and valleys will multiply grain; they will cry out, yes, they will sing hymns.
brenton_translation: The rams of the flock are clothed with wool, and the valleys shall abound in corn; they shall cry aloud, yea they shall sing hymns.

fresh_translation: For end. Song of psalm of resurrection. Shout to God, all the earth.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Song of a Psalm of resurrection.

fresh_translation: Sing indeed to his name; give glory to his praise.
brenton_translation: O sing praises to his name; give glory to his praise.

fresh_translation: Say to God, How fearful your works. In the multitude of your power your enemies will lie to you.
brenton_translation: Say unto God, How awful are thy works! through the greatness of thy power thine enemies shall lie to thee.

fresh_translation: Let all the earth worship you and sing to you; let them sing to your name. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Let all the earth worship thee, and sing to thee; let them sing to thy name. Pause.

fresh_translation: Come and see works of God, fearful in counsels beyond sons of men,
brenton_translation: Come and behold the works of God; he is terrible in his counsels beyond the children of men.

fresh_translation: who turns sea into dry land; in the river they will pass through on foot; there we will rejoice in him,
brenton_translation: Who turns the sea into dry land; they shall go through the river on foot; there shall we rejoice in him,

fresh_translation: the one ruling in his dominion forever. His eyes look upon nations; those provoking must not exalt themselves. Interlude.
brenton_translation: who by his power is Lord over the age, his eyes look upon the nations; let not them that provoke him be exalted in themselves. Pause.

fresh_translation: Bless our God, nations, and make voice of his praise heard,
brenton_translation: Bless our God, ye Gentiles, and make the voice of his praise to be heard;

fresh_translation: who set my soul into life and did not give my feet to shaking.
brenton_translation: who quickens my soul in life, and does not suffer my feet to be moved.

fresh_translation: Because you tested us, O God; you purified us as silver is purified.
brenton_translation: For thou, O God, hast proved us; thou hast tried us with fire as silver is tried.

fresh_translation: You brought us into snare; you laid afflictions upon our back.
brenton_translation: Thou broughtest us into the snare; thou laidest afflictions on our back.

fresh_translation: You made men ride upon our heads; we went through fire and water, and you brought us out into refreshment.
brenton_translation: Thou didst mount men upon our heads; we went through fire and water; but thou broughtest us out into a place of refreshment.

fresh_translation: I will enter into your house with whole burnt offerings; I will pay you my vows,
brenton_translation: I will go into thine house with whole-burnt-offerings; I will pay thee my vows,

fresh_translation: which my lips uttered and my mouth spoke in my affliction.
brenton_translation: which my lips framed, and my mouth uttered in my affliction.

fresh_translation: Fattened whole burnt offerings I will offer to you with incense and rams; I will offer oxen with he-goats. Interlude.
brenton_translation: I will offer to thee whole-burnt-sacrifices full of marrow, with incense and rams; I will sacrifice to thee oxen with goats. Pause.

fresh_translation: Come, hear, and I will tell, all fearing God, whatever he did for my soul.
brenton_translation: Come, hear, and I will tell, all ye that fear God, how great things he has done for my soul.

fresh_translation: To him with my mouth I cried, and I exalted under my tongue.
brenton_translation: I cried to him with my mouth, and exalted him with my tongue.

fresh_translation: If I saw injustice in my heart, let not the Lord hear me.
brenton_translation: If I have regarded iniquity in my heart, let not the Lord hearken to me.

fresh_translation: Therefore God heard me; he attended to the voice of my supplication.
brenton_translation: Therefore God has hearkened to me; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.

fresh_translation: Blessed be God, who did not turn away my prayer and his mercy from me.
brenton_translation: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

fresh_translation: For end, in hymns. Psalm of song.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David among the Hymns.

fresh_translation: May God have compassion on us and bless us; may he make his face shine upon us. Interlude.
brenton_translation: God be merciful to us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us. Pause.

fresh_translation: So as to know your way in earth, your salvation among all nations.
brenton_translation: That men may know thy way on the earth, thy salvation among all nations.

fresh_translation: Let peoples confess to you, O God; let all peoples confess to you.
brenton_translation: Let the nations, O God, give thanks to thee; let all the nations give thanks to thee.

fresh_translation: Let nations rejoice and exult, because you judge peoples in uprightness and will guide nations upon earth. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Let the nations rejoice and exult, for thou shalt judge the peoples in equity, and shalt guide the nations on the earth. Pause.

fresh_translation: Let peoples confess to you, O God; let all peoples confess to you.
brenton_translation: Let the peoples, O God, give thanks to thee; let all the peoples give thanks to thee.

fresh_translation: Earth gave her fruit; may God, our God, bless us.
brenton_translation: The earth has yielded her fruit; let God, our God, bless us.

fresh_translation: May God bless us, and let all ends of the earth fear him.
brenton_translation: Let God bless us; and let all the ends of the earth fear him.

fresh_translation: For end. Of David. Psalm of song.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of a Song by David.

fresh_translation: Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered, and let those hating him flee from before him.
brenton_translation: Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered; and let them that hate him flee from before him.

fresh_translation: As smoke fails, let them fail; as wax melts from the face of fire, so let sinners perish from the face of God.
brenton_translation: As smoke vanishes, let them vanish: as wax melts before the fire, so let the sinners perish from before God.

fresh_translation: But let righteous ones rejoice; let them exult before God; let them delight in gladness.
brenton_translation: But let the righteous rejoice; let them exult before God: let them be delighted with joy.

fresh_translation: Sing to God, make melody to his name; make way for one riding upon westlands. The Lord is his name, and exult before him; they will be troubled from before his face,
brenton_translation: Sing to God, sing praises to his name: make a way for him that rides upon the west (the Lord is his name) and exult before him. They shall be troubled before the face of him,

fresh_translation: father of orphans and judge of widows, God in his holy place.
brenton_translation: who is the father of the orphans, and judge of the widows: such is God in his holy place.

fresh_translation: God settles solitary ones in a house, bringing out chained ones in manliness, likewise those provoking, those dwelling in tombs.
brenton_translation: God settles the solitary in a house; leading forth prisoners mightily, also them that act provokingly, even them that dwell in tombs.

fresh_translation: O God, when you go out before your people, when you pass through wilderness. Interlude.
brenton_translation: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou wentest through the wilderness; Pause:

fresh_translation: Earth was shaken, for even heavens dripped from the face of God, this Sinai, from the face of God of Israel.
brenton_translation: the earth quaked, yea, the heavens dropped water at the presence of the God of Sina, at the presence of the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: You will set apart willing rain, O God, for your inheritance; and it grew weak, but you restored it.
brenton_translation: O God, thou wilt grant to thine inheritance a gracious rain; for it was weary, but thou didst refresh it.

fresh_translation: Your living creatures dwell in it; in your goodness you prepared for the poor one, O God.
brenton_translation: Thy creatures dwell in it: thou hast in thy goodness prepared for the poor.

fresh_translation: The Lord will give word to those bringing good news with much power.
brenton_translation: The Lord God will give a word to them that preach it in a great company.

fresh_translation: King of forces of beloved one, and in beauty of the house to divide spoils.
brenton_translation: The king of the forces of the beloved, of the beloved, will even grant them for the beauty of the house to divide the spoils.

fresh_translation: If you sleep between the lots, wings of dove silvered, and her back parts in green sheen of gold. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Even if ye should lie among the lots, ye shall have the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her breast with yellow gold.

fresh_translation: When heavenly one scatters kings upon her, they will be snow-white in Zalmon.
brenton_translation: When the heavenly One scatters kings upon it, they shall be made snow-white in Selmon.

fresh_translation: The mountain of God, rich mountain; curdled mountain, rich mountain.
brenton_translation: The mountain of God is a rich mountain; a swelling mountain, a rich mountain.

fresh_translation: Why do you suppose, curdled mountains, mountain in which God delighted to dwell? And indeed the Lord will tabernacle to end.
brenton_translation: Wherefore do ye conceive evil, ye swelling mountains? this is the mountain which God has delighted to dwell in; yea, the Lord will dwell in it for ever.

fresh_translation: Chariot of God ten-thousandfold, thousands prospering; Lord among them in Sinai, in holy place.
brenton_translation: The chariots of God are ten thousand fold, thousands of rejoicing ones: the Lord is among them, in Sina, in the holy place.

fresh_translation: You went up on high, you led captivity captive; you received gifts in man, for even disobedient ones, for the Lord God to dwell. Blessed.
brenton_translation: Thou art gone up on high, thou hast led captivity captive, thou hast received gifts for man, yea, for they were rebellious, that thou mightest dwell among them.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord day by day; the God of our salvations will make a straight way for us. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord God, blessed be the Lord daily; and the God of our salvation shall prosper us. Pause.

fresh_translation: Our God is God of saving, and exits from death belong to the Lord, Lord.
brenton_translation: Our God is the God of salvation; and to the Lord belong the issues from death.

fresh_translation: But God will crush heads of his enemies, hairy crown of those going on in their trespasses.
brenton_translation: But God shall crush the heads of his enemies; the hairy crown of them that go on in their trespasses.

fresh_translation: The Lord said, From Bashan I will turn back, I will turn back in the depths of sea,
brenton_translation: The Lord said, I will bring again from Basan, I will bring my people again through the depths of the sea.

fresh_translation: so that your foot may be dipped in blood, tongue of your dogs from enemies, from him.
brenton_translation: That thy foot may be dipped in blood, and the tongue of thy dogs be stained with that of thine enemies.

fresh_translation: Your goings were seen, O God, goings of my God, my king, in holy place.
brenton_translation: Thy goings, O God, have been seen; the goings of my God, the king, in the sanctuary.

fresh_translation: Princes went before, close behind singers, in the midst of young women beating tambourines.
brenton_translation: The princes went first, next before the players on instruments, in the midst of damsels playing on timbrels.

fresh_translation: In assemblies bless God, Lord, from the springs of Israel.
brenton_translation: Praise God in the congregations, the Lord from the fountains of Israel.

fresh_translation: There Benjamin, younger one, in ecstasy, princes of Judah, their leaders, princes of Zebulun, princes of Naphtali.
brenton_translation: There is Benjamin the younger one in ecstasy, the princes of Juda their rulers, the princes of Zabulon, the princes of Nephthali.

fresh_translation: Command, O God, your strength; strengthen, O God, this which you worked for us.
brenton_translation: O God, command thou thy strength: strengthen, O God, this which thou hast wrought in us.

fresh_translation: From your temple over Jerusalem kings will bring gifts to you.
brenton_translation: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents to thee.

fresh_translation: Rebuke beasts of reed, gathering of bulls among calves of peoples, so as not to shut out those tested by silver. Scatter nations wanting wars.
brenton_translation: Rebuke the wild beasts of the reed: let the crowd of bulls with the heifers of the nations be rebuked, so that they who have been proved with silver may not be shut out: scatter thou the nations that wish for wars.

fresh_translation: Envoys will come from Egypt; Ethiopia will hasten her hand to God.
brenton_translation: Ambassadors shall arrive out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall hasten to stretch out her hand readily to God.

fresh_translation: Kingdoms of earth, sing to God; make melody to the Lord. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Sing to God, ye kingdoms of the earth; sing psalms to the Lord. Pause.

fresh_translation: Sing to God, to one riding on heaven of heaven toward east; behold, he will give to his voice a voice of power.
brenton_translation: Sing to God that rides on the heaven of heaven, eastward: lo, he will utter a mighty sound with his voice.

fresh_translation: Give glory to God; over Israel his magnificence and his power in clouds.
brenton_translation: Give ye glory to God: his excellency is over Israel, and his power is in the clouds.

fresh_translation: Wonderful God in his holy ones; God of Israel, he will give power and strengthening to his people. Blessed be God.
brenton_translation: God is wonderful in his holy places, the God of Israel: he will give power and strength to his people: blessed be God.

fresh_translation: For end, concerning those to be changed. Of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David, for alternate strains.

fresh_translation: Save me, O God, because waters came in as far as my soul.
brenton_translation: Save me, O God; for the waters have come in to my soul.

fresh_translation: I was stuck in mud of deep, and no standing-place; I came into the depths of sea, and storm sank me.
brenton_translation: I am stuck fast in deep mire, and there is no standing: I am come in to the depths of the sea, and a storm has overwhelmed me.

fresh_translation: I grew weary crying; my throat grew hoarse; my eyes failed from hoping upon my God.
brenton_translation: I am weary of crying, my throat has become hoarse; mine eyes have failed by my waiting on my God.

fresh_translation: Those hating me without cause multiplied beyond hairs of my head; my enemies, unjustly pursuing me, were strengthened. What I did not seize, then I was repaying.
brenton_translation: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: my enemies that persecute me unrighteously are strengthened: then I restored that which I took not away.

fresh_translation: O God, you knew my foolishness, and my trespasses were not hidden from you.
brenton_translation: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my transgressions are not hidden from thee.

fresh_translation: Let not those waiting for you be shamed because of me, Lord, Lord of hosts; let not those seeking you be disgraced because of me, God of Israel.
brenton_translation: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord of hosts, be ashamed on my account: let not them that seek thee, be ashamed on my account, O God of Israel.

fresh_translation: Because for your sake I bore reproach; shame covered my face.
brenton_translation: For I have suffered reproach for thy sake; shame has covered my face.

fresh_translation: I became estranged to my brothers and foreign to the sons of my mother,
brenton_translation: I became strange to my brethren, and a stranger to my mother's children.

fresh_translation: because zeal of your house consumed me, and reproaches of those reproaching you fell upon me.
brenton_translation: For the zeal of thine house has eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

fresh_translation: And I bent my soul in fasting, and it became a reproach to me.
brenton_translation: And I bowed down my soul with fasting, and that was made my reproach.

fresh_translation: And I made my clothing sackcloth, and I became proverb to them.
brenton_translation: And I put on sackcloth for my covering; and I became a proverb to them.

fresh_translation: Those sitting in gate were talking against me, and those drinking wine were singing about me.
brenton_translation: They that sit in the gate talked against me, and they that drank wine sang against me.

fresh_translation: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Lord, at a time of good pleasure. O God, in the multitude of your mercy hear me in the truth of your salvation.
brenton_translation: But I will cry to thee, O Lord, in my prayer; O God, it is a propitious time: in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

fresh_translation: Save me from mire so that I may not be stuck; let me be delivered from those hating me and from depth of waters.
brenton_translation: Save me from the mire, that I stick not in it: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and from the deep waters.

fresh_translation: Let not storm of water sink me, nor let deep swallow me, nor let pit close its mouth over me.
brenton_translation: Let not the waterflood drown me, nor let the deep swallow me up; neither let the well shut its mouth upon me.

fresh_translation: Hear me, Lord, because your mercy kind; according to the multitude of your compassions look upon me.
brenton_translation: Hear me, O Lord; for thy mercy is good: according to the multitude of thy compassions look upon me.

fresh_translation: Do not turn your face away from your servant, because I am afflicted; quickly hear me.
brenton_translation: And turn not away thy face from thy servant; for I am afflicted: hear me speedily.

fresh_translation: Draw near to my soul and redeem it; because of my enemies rescue me.
brenton_translation: Draw nigh to my soul and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

fresh_translation: For you know my reproach and my shame and my dishonor; before you all afflicting me.
brenton_translation: For thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my confusion; all that afflict me are before thee.

fresh_translation: My soul expected reproach and misery, and I waited for one grieving with me, and there was none, and for comforters, and I found none.
brenton_translation: My soul has waited for reproach and misery; and I waited for one to grieve with me, but there was none; and for one to comfort me, but I found none.

fresh_translation: And they gave gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
brenton_translation: They gave me also gall for my food, and made me drink vinegar for my thirst.

fresh_translation: Let their table become snare before them, and retribution and stumbling-block.
brenton_translation: Let their table before them be for a snare, and for a recompence, and for a stumbling-block.

fresh_translation: Let their eyes be darkened so as not to see, and bend down their back continually.
brenton_translation: Let their eyes be darkened that they should not see; and bow down their back continually.

fresh_translation: Pour out your wrath upon them, and let fury of your anger overtake them.
brenton_translation: Pour out thy wrath upon them, and let the fury of thine anger take hold on them.

fresh_translation: Let their homestead become desolate, and in their tents let there be none dwelling.
brenton_translation: Let their habitation be made desolate; and let there be no inhabitant in their tents:

fresh_translation: Because one you struck, they themselves pursued, and to pain of your wounded ones they added.
brenton_translation: because they persecuted him whom thou hast smitten; and they have added to the grief of my wounds.

fresh_translation: Add lawlessness upon their lawlessness, and let them not enter into your righteousness.
brenton_translation: Add iniquity to their iniquity; and let them not come into thy righteousness.

fresh_translation: Let them be blotted out from the book of the living, and with the righteous let them not be written.
brenton_translation: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and let them not be written with the righteous.

fresh_translation: But I poor and pained; salvation of your face, O God, took hold of me.
brenton_translation: I am poor and sorrowful; but the salvation of thy countenance has helped me.

fresh_translation: I will praise the name of God with song; I will magnify him with praise.
brenton_translation: I will praise the name of my God with a song, I will magnify him with praise;

fresh_translation: And it will please God beyond young bull bringing forth horns and hoofs.
brenton_translation: and this shall please God more than a young calf having horns and hoofs.

fresh_translation: Let poor see and rejoice; seek God, and your soul will live.
brenton_translation: Let the poor see and rejoice; seek the Lord diligently, and ye shall live.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord heard poor ones and did not despise his chained ones.
brenton_translation: For the Lord hears the poor, and does not set at nought his fettered ones.

fresh_translation: Let heavens and earth praise him, sea and all creeping things in them,
brenton_translation: Let the heavens and the earth praise him, the sea, and all things moving in them.

fresh_translation: because God will save Zion and the cities of Judah will be built, and they will dwell there and inherit her.
brenton_translation: For God will save Sion, and the cities of Judea shall be built; and men shall dwell there, and inherit it.

fresh_translation: And seed of his servants will possess her, and those loving his name will dwell in her.
brenton_translation: And the seed of his servants shall possess it, and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

fresh_translation: For end. Of David, for remembrance.
brenton_translation: For the end, by David for a remembrance, that the Lord may save me.

fresh_translation: For the Lord to save me. O God, attend to my help.
brenton_translation: Draw nigh, O God, to my help.

fresh_translation: Let those seeking my soul be shamed and disgraced; let those wanting evils for me be turned back and shamed.
brenton_translation: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek my soul: let them be turned backward and put to shame, that wish me evil.

fresh_translation: Let those saying to me, Good, good, be turned back immediately, being shamed.
brenton_translation: Let them that say to me, Aha, aha, be turned back and put to shame immediately.

fresh_translation: Let all seeking you exult and rejoice in you, and let those loving your salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
brenton_translation: Let all that seek thee exult and be glad in thee: and let those that love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

fresh_translation: But I poor and needy; O God, help me. My helper and deliverer you are, Lord; do not delay.
brenton_translation: But I am poor and needy; O God, help me: thou art my helper and deliverer, O Lord, delay not.

fresh_translation: Of David, of sons of Jonadab, and of first captives. O God, on you I hoped; let me not be shamed forever.
brenton_translation: By David, a Psalm sung by the sons of Jonadab, and the first that were taken captive.

fresh_translation: In your righteousness rescue me and deliver me; incline your ear to me and save me.
brenton_translation: In thy righteousness deliver me and rescue me: incline thine ear to me, and save me.

fresh_translation: Become to me God defender and fortified place to save me, because you are my firm place and refuge.
brenton_translation: Be to me a protecting God, and a strong hold to save me: for thou art my fortress and my refuge.

fresh_translation: My God, rescue me from the hand of sinner, from the hand of law-breaking and unjust man.
brenton_translation: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the sinner, from the hand of the transgressor and unjust man.

fresh_translation: Because you are my endurance, Lord, Lord, my hope from my youth.
brenton_translation: For thou art my support, O Lord; O Lord, thou art my hope from my youth.

fresh_translation: On you I was supported from womb; from the belly of my mother you are my protector; in you my hymn continually.
brenton_translation: On thee have I been stayed from the womb: from the belly of my mother thou art my protector: of thee is my praise continually.

fresh_translation: I became like wonder to many, and you strong helper.
brenton_translation: I am become as it were a wonder to many; but thou art my strong helper.

fresh_translation: Let my mouth be filled with praise, so that I may hymn your glory, all day your magnificence.
brenton_translation: Let my mouth be filled with praise, that I may hymn thy glory, and thy majesty all the day.

fresh_translation: Do not cast me away in the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not forsake me.
brenton_translation: Cast me not off at the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails.

fresh_translation: Because my enemies spoke against me, and those watching my soul took counsel together,
brenton_translation: For mine enemies have spoken against me; and they that lay wait for my soul have taken counsel together,

fresh_translation: saying, God forsook him; pursue and seize him, because there is no rescuer.
brenton_translation: saying, God has forsaken him: persecute ye and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

fresh_translation: O God, do not be far from me; my God, attend to my help.
brenton_translation: O God, go not far from me, O my God, draw nigh to my help.

fresh_translation: Let those slandering my soul be shamed and fail; let those seeking evils for me be clothed with shame and dishonor.
brenton_translation: Let those that plot against my soul be ashamed and utterly fail: let those that seek my hurt be clothed with shame and dishonour.

fresh_translation: But I will hope continually and will add upon all your praise.
brenton_translation: But I will hope continually, and will praise thee more and more.

fresh_translation: My mouth will declare your righteousness, all day your salvation, because I did not know writings.
brenton_translation: My mouth shall declare thy righteousness openly, and thy salvation all the day; for I am not acquainted with the affairs of men.

fresh_translation: I will go in by dominion of the Lord, Lord; I will remember your righteousness, yours alone.
brenton_translation: I will go on in the might of the Lord: O Lord, I will make mention of thy righteousness only.

fresh_translation: You taught me, O God, from my youth, and until now I declare your wonders.
brenton_translation: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth, and until now will I declare thy wonders;

fresh_translation: And until old age and gray hair, O God, do not forsake me, until I declare your arm to every coming generation, your dominion and your righteousness,
brenton_translation: even until I am old and advanced in years. O God, forsake me not; until I shall have declared thine arm to all the generation that is to come:

fresh_translation: O God, unto heights, what great things you did; O God, who like you?
brenton_translation: even thy power and thy righteousness, O God, up to the highest heavens, even the mighty works which thou hast done: O God, who is like to thee?

fresh_translation: How many afflictions, many and evil, you showed me; and turning back, you made me live, and from the depths of earth again you brought me up.
brenton_translation: What afflictions many and sore hast thou shewed me! yet thou didst turn and quicken me, and broughtest me again from the depths of the earth.

fresh_translation: You multiplied your greatness, and turning back you comforted me, and from the depths of earth again you brought me up.
brenton_translation: Thou didst multiply thy righteousness, and didst turn and comfort me, and broughtest me again out of the depths of the earth.

fresh_translation: And indeed I will confess to you with instrument of psalm your truth, O God; I will sing to you with lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
brenton_translation: I will also therefore give thanks to thee, O God, because of thy truth, on an instrument of psalmody: I will sing psalms to thee on the harp, O Holy One of Israel.

fresh_translation: My lips will exult when I sing to you, and my soul which you redeemed.
brenton_translation: My lips shall rejoice when I sing to thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

fresh_translation: And still my tongue all day will meditate on your righteousness, when those seeking evils for me are shamed and disgraced.
brenton_translation: Moreover also my tongue shall dwell all the day upon thy righteousness; when they shall be ashamed and confounded that seek my hurt.

fresh_translation: Of Solomon. O God, give your judgment to the king and your righteousness to son of the king,
brenton_translation: For Solomon.

fresh_translation: to judge your people in righteousness and your poor ones in judgment.
brenton_translation: that he may judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

fresh_translation: Let mountains take up peace for your people, and hills in righteousness.
brenton_translation: Let the mountains and the hills raise peace to thy people:

fresh_translation: He will judge poor ones of the people and save sons of needy ones and humble slanderer.
brenton_translation: he shall judge the poor of the people in righteousness, and save the children of the needy; and shall bring low the false accuser.

fresh_translation: And he will continue along with the sun and before the moon for generations of generations.
brenton_translation: And he shall continue as long as the sun, and before the moon for ever.

fresh_translation: And he will come down like rain upon fleece and like drops dripping upon earth.
brenton_translation: He shall come down as rain upon a fleece; and as drops falling upon the earth.

fresh_translation: Righteousness will rise in his days and abundance of peace until the moon is removed.
brenton_translation: In his days shall righteousness spring up; and abundance of peace till the moon be removed.

fresh_translation: And he will rule from sea to sea and from the river to the ends of inhabited world.
