brenton_translation: And he shall have dominion from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.

fresh_translation: Before him Ethiopians will fall, and his enemies will lick dust.
brenton_translation: The Ethiopians shall fall down before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

fresh_translation: The kings of Tarshish and islands will bring gifts; kings of Arabians and Sheba will bring presents.
brenton_translation: The kings of Tharsis, and the isles, shall bring presents: the kings of the Arabians and Saba shall offer gifts.

fresh_translation: And all kings will worship him; all nations will serve him.
brenton_translation: And all kings shall worship him; all the Gentiles shall serve him.

fresh_translation: Because he rescued a poor man from the hand of a ruler and a needy one to whom no helper existed.
brenton_translation: For he has delivered the poor from the oppressor; and the needy who had no helper.

fresh_translation: He will spare poor and needy and save souls of needy ones.
brenton_translation: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall deliver the souls of the needy.

fresh_translation: From usury and from injustice he will redeem their souls, and their name precious before him.
brenton_translation: He shall redeem their souls from usury and injustice: and their name shall be precious before him.

fresh_translation: And he will live, and from gold of Arabia it will be given to him, and they will pray concerning him continually; all day they will bless him.
brenton_translation: And he shall live, and there shall be given him of the gold of Arabia: and men shall pray for him continually; and all the day shall they praise him.

fresh_translation: There will be support in earth on the tops of mountains; his fruit will be lifted above Lebanon, and they will flower from the city like grass of earth.
brenton_translation: There shall be an establishment on the earth on the tops of the mountains: the fruit thereof shall be exalted above Libanus, and they of the city shall flourish as grass of the earth.

fresh_translation: Let his name be blessed forever; before sun his name remains, and in him all tribes of earth will be blessed; all nations will count him blessed.
brenton_translation: Let his name be blessed for ever: his name shall endure longer than the sun: and all the tribes of the earth shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord God, God of Israel, who alone does wonders.
brenton_translation: Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, who alone does wonders.

fresh_translation: And blessed name of his glory forever and forever of forever, and all the earth will be filled with his glory. Amen, amen.
brenton_translation: And blessed is his glorious name for ever, even for ever and ever: and all the earth shall be filled with his glory. So be it, so be it.

fresh_translation: Hymns of David son of Jesse came to end.
brenton_translation: The hymns of David the son of Jessæ are ended.

fresh_translation: Psalm of Asaph. How good God to Israel, to those straight in heart.
brenton_translation: A Psalm for Asaph.

fresh_translation: But as for me, my feet were almost shaken; my steps all but poured out.
brenton_translation: But my feet were almost overthrown; my goings very nearly slipped.

fresh_translation: Because I was jealous over lawless ones, seeing the peace of sinners.
brenton_translation: For I was jealous of the transgressors, beholding the tranquillity of sinners.

fresh_translation: Because there is no relenting in their death and firmness in their scourge.
brenton_translation: For there is no sign of reluctance in their death: and they have firmness under their affliction.

fresh_translation: In labors of men they are not, and with men they will not be scourged.
brenton_translation: They are not in the troubles of other men; and they shall not be scourged with other men.

fresh_translation: Therefore pride took hold of them; they clothed themselves with their injustice and ungodliness.
brenton_translation: Therefore pride has possessed them; they have clothed themselves with their injustice and ungodliness.

fresh_translation: Their injustice will go out as from fatness; they passed into purpose of heart.
brenton_translation: Their injustice shall go forth as out of fatness: they have fulfilled their intention.

fresh_translation: They thought and spoke in evil, they spoke injustice on high.
brenton_translation: They have taken counsel and spoken in wickedness: they have uttered unrighteousness loftily.

fresh_translation: They set their mouth into heaven, and their tongue passed through earth.
brenton_translation: They have set their mouth against heaven, and their tongue has gone through upon the earth.

fresh_translation: Therefore my people will return here, and full days will be found for them.
brenton_translation: Therefore shall my people return hither: and full days shall be found with them.

fresh_translation: And they said, How did God know? And is there knowledge in Most High?
brenton_translation: And they said, How does God know? and is there knowledge in the Most High?

fresh_translation: Behold, these sinners prosper forever and possessed wealth.
brenton_translation: Behold, these are the sinners, and they that prosper always: they have possessed wealth.

fresh_translation: And I said, Then in vain I made my heart righteous and washed my hands among innocent ones.
brenton_translation: And I said, Verily in vain have I justified my heart, and washed my hands in innocency.

fresh_translation: And I became scourged whole day, and my reproof unto mornings.
brenton_translation: For I was plagued all the day, and my reproof was every morning.

fresh_translation: If I said, I will tell thus, behold, against generation of your sons I acted treacherously.
brenton_translation: If I said, I will speak thus; behold, I should have broken covenant with the generation of thy children.

fresh_translation: And I undertook to know this; it is trouble before me,
brenton_translation: And I undertook to understand this, but it is too hard for me,

fresh_translation: until I enter into sanctuary of God and understand their last things.
brenton_translation: until I go into the sanctuary of God; and so understand the latter end.

fresh_translation: Surely because of their deceits you set things for them; you cast them down in their being lifted up.
brenton_translation: Surely thou hast appointed judgments to them because of their crafty dealings: thou hast cast them down when they were lifted up.

fresh_translation: How they came to desolation suddenly; they failed, they perished because of their lawlessness.
brenton_translation: How have they become desolate! suddenly they have failed: they have perished because of their iniquity.

fresh_translation: Like dream of one waking, Lord, in your city you will despise their image.
brenton_translation: As the dream of one awakening, O Lord, in thy city thou wilt despise their image.

fresh_translation: Because my heart burned and my kidneys were altered,
brenton_translation: For my heart has rejoiced, and my reins have been gladdened.

fresh_translation: and I, being despised, did not know; I became beastlike beside you.
brenton_translation: But I was vile and knew not: I became brutish before thee.

fresh_translation: And I continually with you; you held my right hand.
brenton_translation: Yet I am continually with thee: thou hast holden my right hand.

fresh_translation: In your counsel you guided me, and with glory you received me.
brenton_translation: Thou hast guided me by thy counsel, and thou hast taken me to thyself with glory.

fresh_translation: For what exists for me in heaven? And besides you what did I desire upon the earth?
brenton_translation: For what have I in heaven but thee? and what have I desired upon the earth beside thee?

fresh_translation: My heart and my flesh failed; God of my heart and my portion, God forever.
brenton_translation: My heart and my flesh have failed: but God is the strength of my heart, and God is my portion for ever.

fresh_translation: Because behold, those distancing themselves from you will perish; you destroyed everyone prostituting himself away from you.
brenton_translation: For, behold, they that remove themselves far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed every one that goes a whoring from thee.

fresh_translation: But for me, clinging to God good; to place hope in the Lord, to declare all your praises in the gates of daughter of Zion.
brenton_translation: But it is good for me to cleave close to God, to put my trust in the Lord; that I may proclaim all thy praises in the gates of the daughter of Sion.

fresh_translation: For understanding. Of Asaph. Why, O God, did you reject to end? Your anger burned against sheep of your pasture.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of instruction for Asaph.

fresh_translation: Remember your congregation which you acquired from the beginning; you redeemed rod of your inheritance, this Mount Zion in which you dwelt.
brenton_translation: Remember thy congregation which thou hast purchased from the beginning; thou didst ransom the rod of thine inheritance; this mount Sion wherein thou hast dwelt.

fresh_translation: Lift up your hands against their pride to end, against all evil enemy did in your holy places.
brenton_translation: Lift up thine hands against their pride continually; because of all that the enemy has done wickedly in thy holy places.

fresh_translation: And those hating you boasted in the midst of your feast; they set their signs as signs and did not know,
brenton_translation: And they that hate thee have boasted in the midst of thy feast; they have set up their standards for signs,

fresh_translation: as at entrance above.
brenton_translation: ignorantly as it were in the entrance above;

fresh_translation: As in the forest of woods with axes they cut down her doors together; with hatchet and stone-cutter tool they broke her down.
brenton_translation: they cut down its doors at once with axes as in a wood of trees; they have broken it down with hatchet and stone cutter.

fresh_translation: They burned your sanctuary with fire; to ground they profaned tabernacle of your name.
brenton_translation: They have burnt thy sanctuary with fire to the ground; they have profaned the habitation of thy name.

fresh_translation: They said in their heart, their whole kin together, Come, let us burn all feasts of God from earth.
brenton_translation: They have said in their heart, even all their kindred together, Come, let us abolish the feasts of the Lord from the earth.

fresh_translation: Our signs we did not see; there is no longer prophet, and he will not know us any longer.
brenton_translation: We have not seen our signs; there is no longer a prophet; and God will not know us any more.

fresh_translation: How long, O God, will enemy reproach? Will adversary provoke your name to end?
brenton_translation: How long, O God, shall the enemy reproach? shall the enemy provoke thy name for ever?

fresh_translation: Why do you turn away your hand and your right hand from the midst of your bosom to end?
brenton_translation: Wherefore turnest thou away thine hand, and thy right hand from the midst of thy bosom for ever?

fresh_translation: But God our king before age worked salvation in the midst of earth.
brenton_translation: But God is our King of old; he has wrought salvation in the midst of the earth.

fresh_translation: You strengthened sea in your power; you crushed heads of dragons upon water.
brenton_translation: Thou didst establish the sea, in thy might, thou didst break to pieces the heads of the dragons in the water.

fresh_translation: You crushed heads of dragon; you gave him as food to Ethiopian peoples.
brenton_translation: Thou didst break to pieces the heads of the dragon; thou didst give him for meat to the Ethiopian nations.

fresh_translation: You split open springs and torrents; you dried up rivers of Etham.
brenton_translation: Thou didst cleave fountains and torrents; thou driedst up mighty rivers.

fresh_translation: Yours day and yours night; you prepared light and sun.
brenton_translation: The day is thine, and the night is thine; thou hast prepared the sun and the moon.

fresh_translation: You made all boundaries of earth; summer and spring you formed them.
brenton_translation: Thou hast made all the borders of the earth; thou hast made summer and spring.

fresh_translation: Remember this: enemy reproached Lord, and foolish people provoked your name.
brenton_translation: Remember this thy creation: an enemy has reproached the Lord, and a foolish people has provoked thy name.

fresh_translation: Do not hand over to beasts soul confessing to you; souls of your poor ones do not forget to end.
brenton_translation: Deliver not to the wild beasts a soul that gives praise to thee: forget not for ever the souls of thy poor.

fresh_translation: Look upon your covenant, because dark places of earth were filled with houses of lawlessness.
brenton_translation: Look upon thy covenant: for the dark places of the earth are filled with the habitations of iniquity.

fresh_translation: Let humbled one not turn back shamed; poor and needy will praise your name.
brenton_translation: Let not the afflicted and shamed one be rejected: the poor and needy shall praise thy name.

fresh_translation: Rise up, O God, judge your case; remember your reproaches from fool all day.
brenton_translation: Arise, O God, plead thy cause: remember thy reproaches that come from the foolish one all the day.

fresh_translation: Do not forget voice of your suppliants; pride of those hating you went up continually toward you.
brenton_translation: Forget not the voice of thy suppliants: let the pride of them that hate thee continually ascend before thee.

fresh_translation: For end, do not destroy. Psalm of Asaph. Song.
brenton_translation: For the end, Destroy not, a Psalm of a Song for Asaph.

fresh_translation: We will confess to you, O God, we will confess, and we will call on your name.
brenton_translation: We will give thanks to thee, O God, we will give thanks, and call upon thy name: I will declare all thy wonderful works.

fresh_translation: I will tell all your wonders when I receive appointed time; I will judge uprightnesses.
brenton_translation: When I shall take a set time, I will judge righteously.

fresh_translation: Earth melted, and all inhabiting it; I strengthened its pillars. Interlude.
brenton_translation: The earth is dissolved, and all that dwell in it: I have strengthened its pillars. Pause.

fresh_translation: I said to law-breakers, Do not break law, and to sinners, Do not lift horn.
brenton_translation: I said unto the transgressors, Do not transgress; and to the sinners, Lift not up the horn.

fresh_translation: Do not raise your horn on high; do not speak injustice against God.
brenton_translation: Lift not up your horn on high; speak not unrighteousness against God.

fresh_translation: Because neither from exits nor from wests nor from desert mountains,
brenton_translation: For good comes neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the desert mountains.

fresh_translation: because God is judge; this one he humbles and this one he exalts.
brenton_translation: For God is the judge; he puts down one, and raises up another.

fresh_translation: Because cup in the hand of the Lord, of unmixed wine full of mixture, and he tilted from this into that, but its dregs were not emptied; all sinners of earth will drink.
brenton_translation: For there is a cup in the hand of the Lord, full of unmingled wine; and he has turned it from side to side, but its dregs have not been wholly poured out; all the sinners of the earth shall drink them.

fresh_translation: But I will exult forever; I will sing to God of Jacob.
brenton_translation: But I will exult for ever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

fresh_translation: And all the horns of sinners I will shatter, and the horns of the righteous one will be exalted.
brenton_translation: And I will break all the horns of sinners; but the horns of the righteous one shall be exalted.

fresh_translation: For end, in hymns. Psalm of Asaph. Song against Assyrian.
brenton_translation: For the end, among the Hymns, a Psalm for Asaph; a Song for the Assyrian.

fresh_translation: In Judah God known; in Israel great his name.
brenton_translation: God is known in Judea; his name is great in Israel.

fresh_translation: And his place came to be in peace, and his dwelling-place in Zion.
brenton_translation: And his place has been in peace, and his dwelling-place in Sion.

fresh_translation: There he crushed strengths of bows, weapon and sword and war. Interlude.
brenton_translation: There he broke the power of the bows, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Pause.

fresh_translation: You shine wondrously from everlasting mountains.
brenton_translation: Thou dost wonderfully shine forth from the everlasting mountains.

fresh_translation: All senseless in heart were troubled; they slept their sleep and found nothing, all men of wealth, in their hands.
brenton_translation: All the simple ones in heart were troubled; all the men of wealth have slept their sleep, and have found nothing in their hands.

fresh_translation: From your rebuke, God of Jacob, riders of horses grew drowsy.
brenton_translation: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, the riders on horses slumbered.

fresh_translation: You fearful, and who will stand against you from then on, from your anger?
brenton_translation: Thou art terrible; and who shall withstand thee, because of thine anger?

fresh_translation: From heaven you made judgment heard; earth feared and was still,
brenton_translation: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

fresh_translation: when God rose to judgment, to save all meek of earth. Interlude.
brenton_translation: when God arose to judgment, to save all the meek in heart. Pause.

fresh_translation: Because the thought of man will confess to you, and the remnant of thought will celebrate feast to you.
brenton_translation: For the inward thought of man shall give thanks to thee: and the memorial of his inward thought shall keep a feast to thee.

fresh_translation: Vow and pay to the Lord your God; all around him will bring gifts
brenton_translation: Vow, and pay your vows to the Lord our God; all that are round about him shall bring gifts, even to him that is terrible,

fresh_translation: to one fearful and removing spirits of rulers, fearful beyond kings of the earth.
brenton_translation: and that takes away the spirits of princes; to him that is terrible among the kings of the earth.

fresh_translation: For end, concerning Jeduthun. Of Asaph. Psalm.
brenton_translation: For the end, for Idithun, a Psalm of Asaph.

fresh_translation: My voice cried to the Lord, my voice to God, and he attended to me.
brenton_translation: I cried to the Lord with my voice, yea, my voice was addressed to God; and he gave heed to me.

fresh_translation: In the day of my affliction I sought God; my hands by night before him, and I was not deceived. My soul refused to be comforted.
brenton_translation: In the day of mine affliction I earnestly sought the Lord; even with my hands by night before him, and I was not deceived; my soul refused to be comforted.

fresh_translation: I remembered God and was gladdened; I mused and my spirit grew fainthearted. Interlude.
brenton_translation: I remembered God, and rejoiced; I poured out my complaint, and my soul fainted. Pause.

fresh_translation: My eyes seized first watches; I was troubled and did not speak.
brenton_translation: All mine enemies set a watch against me: I was troubled, and spoke not.

fresh_translation: I considered ancient days, and years of old I remembered and meditated.
brenton_translation: I considered the days of old, and remembered ancient years.

fresh_translation: By night with my heart I mused, and my spirit searched out.
brenton_translation: And I meditated; I communed with my heart by night, and diligently searched my spirit, saying,

fresh_translation: Will the Lord reject forever and add no more to take pleasure still?
brenton_translation: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be well pleased no more?

fresh_translation: Or will he cut off his mercy to end, from generation to generation?
brenton_translation: Will he cut off his mercy for ever, even for ever and ever?

fresh_translation: Will God forget to show compassion, or will he hold back his compassions in his anger? Interlude.
brenton_translation: Will God forget to pity? or will he shut up his compassions in his wrath? Pause.

fresh_translation: And I said, Now I began; this change belongs to right hand of Most High.
brenton_translation: And I said, Now I have begun; this is the change of the right hand of the Most High.

fresh_translation: I remembered works of the Lord, because I will remember from the beginning your wonders.
brenton_translation: I remembered the works of the Lord; for I will remember thy wonders from the beginning.

fresh_translation: And I will meditate on all your works and muse on your practices.
brenton_translation: And I will meditate on all thy works, and will consider thy doings.

fresh_translation: O God, your way in holy place; what god great as our God?
brenton_translation: O God, thy way is in the sanctuary; who is a great God as our God?

fresh_translation: You are God doing wonders; you made known your power among peoples.
brenton_translation: Thou art the God that doest wonders; thou hast made known thy power among the nations.

fresh_translation: With your arm you redeemed your people, sons of Jacob and Joseph. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Pause.

fresh_translation: Waters saw you, O God; waters saw you and feared, and deeps were troubled, multitude of sound of waters.
brenton_translation: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee, and feared; and the depths were troubled.

fresh_translation: Clouds gave voice, for your arrows pass through.
brenton_translation: There was an abundant sound of waters: the clouds uttered a voice; for thine arrows went abroad.

fresh_translation: The voice of your thunder in wheel; your lightnings appeared to inhabited world; earth was shaken and became trembling.
brenton_translation: The voice of thy thunder was abroad, and around thy lightnings appeared to the world; the earth trembled and quaked.

fresh_translation: In sea your way and your paths in many waters, and your footprints will not be known.
brenton_translation: Thy way is in the sea, and thy paths in many waters, and thy footsteps cannot be known.

fresh_translation: You guided your people like sheep by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
brenton_translation: Thou didst guide thy people as sheep by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

fresh_translation: For understanding. Of Asaph. Attend, my people, to my law; incline your ear to the words of my mouth.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of instruction for Asaph.

fresh_translation: I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter riddles from the beginning,
brenton_translation: I will open my mouth in parables: I will utter dark sayings which have been from the beginning.

fresh_translation: things we heard and knew, and our fathers told us.
brenton_translation: All which we have heard and known, and our fathers have declared to us.

fresh_translation: It was not hidden from their children, to another generation declaring praises of the Lord and his powers and his wonders which he did.
brenton_translation: They were not hid from their children to a second generation; the fathers declaring the praises of the Lord, and his mighty acts, and his wonders which he wrought.

fresh_translation: And he raised testimony in Jacob and set law in Israel, things he commanded our fathers to make known to their sons,
brenton_translation: And he raised up a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, to make it known to their children:

fresh_translation: so that another generation might know, sons being born, and rise and tell them to their sons,
brenton_translation: that another generation might know, even the sons which should be born; and they should arise and declare them to their children.

fresh_translation: so that they might place their hope upon God and not forget works of God and seek out his commandments,
brenton_translation: That they might set their hope on God, and not forget the works of God, but diligently seek his commandments.

fresh_translation: so that they may not become like their fathers, generation crooked and provoking, generation which did not set its heart straight and whose spirit was not faithful with God.
brenton_translation: That they should not be as their fathers, a perverse and provoking generation; a generation which set not its heart aright, and its spirit was not steadfast with God.

fresh_translation: Sons of Ephraim, stringing and shooting bows, turned back in the day of war.
brenton_translation: The children of Ephraim, bending and shooting with the bow, turned back in the day of battle.

fresh_translation: They did not keep covenant of God and did not want to walk in his law.
brenton_translation: They kept not the covenant of God, and would not walk in his law.

fresh_translation: And they forgot his good deeds and his wonders which he showed them,
brenton_translation: And they forgot his benefits, and his miracles which he had shewed them;

fresh_translation: things he did wondrously before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the plain of Zoan.
brenton_translation: the miracles which he wrought before their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the plain of Tanes.

fresh_translation: He split sea and led them through; he made waters stand like a wineskin.
brenton_translation: He clave the sea, and led them through: he made the waters to stand as in a bottle.

fresh_translation: And he guided them in cloud by day and all night in the light of fire.
brenton_translation: And he guided them with a cloud by day, and all the night with a light of fire.

fresh_translation: He split rock in the wilderness and gave them drink as from great deep.
brenton_translation: He clave a rock in the wilderness, and made them drink as in a great deep.

fresh_translation: And he brought water out from rock and brought waters down like rivers.
brenton_translation: And he brought water out of the rock, and caused waters to flow down as rivers.

fresh_translation: And they added still to sin against him; they provoked Most High in waterless place.
brenton_translation: And they sinned yet more against him; they provoked the Most High in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And they tested God in their hearts by asking foods for their souls.
brenton_translation: And they tempted God in their hearts, in asking meat for the desire of their souls.

fresh_translation: And they spoke against God and said, Will God be able to prepare table in the wilderness?
brenton_translation: They spoke also against God, and said, Will God be able to prepare a table in the wilderness?

fresh_translation: Since he struck rock and waters flowed and torrents overflowed, can he also give bread or prepare table for his people?
brenton_translation: Forasmuch as he smote the rock, and the waters flowed, and the torrents ran abundantly; will he be able also to give bread, or prepare a table for his people?

fresh_translation: Therefore the Lord heard and deferred, and fire was kindled in Jacob, and wrath rose upon Israel,
brenton_translation: Therefore the Lord heard, and was provoked: and fire was kindled in Jacob, and wrath went up against Israel.

fresh_translation: because they did not believe in God nor hope on his salvation.
brenton_translation: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation.

fresh_translation: And he commanded clouds above and opened doors of heaven,
brenton_translation: Yet he commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

fresh_translation: and rained manna on them to eat and gave them bread of heaven.
brenton_translation: and rained upon them manna to eat, and gave them the bread of heaven.

fresh_translation: Man ate bread of angels; he sent them provision unto fullness.
brenton_translation: Man ate angels' bread; he sent them provision to the full.

fresh_translation: He lifted south wind from heaven and brought in by his dominion southwest wind.
brenton_translation: He removed the south wind from heaven; and by his might he brought in the south-west wind.

fresh_translation: And he rained flesh upon them like dust and winged birds like the sand of the seas.
brenton_translation: And he rained upon them flesh like dust, and feathered birds like the sand of the seas.

fresh_translation: And they fell into the midst of their camp, around their tents.
brenton_translation: And they fell into the midst of their camp, round about their tents.

fresh_translation: And they ate and were filled exceedingly, and he brought them their desire.
brenton_translation: So they ate, and were completely filled; and he gave them their desire.

fresh_translation: They were not deprived of their desire; while their food was still in their mouth,
brenton_translation: They were not disappointed of their desire: but when their food was yet in their mouth,

fresh_translation: wrath of God rose upon them and killed among their fat ones and hamstrung chosen ones of Israel.
brenton_translation: then the indignation of God rose up against them, and slew the fattest of them, and overthrew the choice men of Israel.

fresh_translation: In all these things they still sinned and did not believe in his wonders.
brenton_translation: In the midst of all this they sinned yet more, and believed not his miracles.

fresh_translation: And their days failed in vanity and their years in haste.
brenton_translation: And their days were consumed in vanity, and their years with anxiety.

fresh_translation: When he killed them, they sought him, and returned and rose early toward God.
brenton_translation: When he slew them, they sought him: and they returned and called betimes upon God.

fresh_translation: And they remembered that God is their helper and God Most High their redeemer.
brenton_translation: And they remembered that God was their helper, and the most high God was their redeemer.

fresh_translation: And they deceived him with their mouth and lied to him with their tongue.
brenton_translation: Yet they loved him only with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

fresh_translation: But their heart was not straight with him, nor were they faithful in his covenant.
brenton_translation: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they steadfast in his covenant.

fresh_translation: But he compassionate and will propitiate their sins and not destroy, and he will multiply turning away his wrath and will not kindle all his anger.
brenton_translation: But he is compassionate, and will forgive their sins, and will not destroy them: yea, he will frequently turn away his wrath, and will not kindle all his anger.

fresh_translation: And he remembered that they are flesh, spirit going and not returning.
brenton_translation: And he remembered that they are flesh; a wind that passes away, and returns not.

fresh_translation: How often they provoked him in the wilderness, angered him in waterless land.
brenton_translation: How often did they provoke him in the wilderness, and anger him in a dry land!

fresh_translation: And they turned and tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
brenton_translation: Yea, they turned back, and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

fresh_translation: They did not remember his hand, day when he redeemed them from the hand of afflicter,
brenton_translation: They remembered not his hand, the day in which he delivered them from the hand of the oppressor.

fresh_translation: how he set his signs in Egypt and his wonders in the plain of Zoan,
brenton_translation: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Tanes:

fresh_translation: and turned their rivers into blood and their rainfalls so they might not drink.
brenton_translation: and had changed their rivers into blood; and their streams, that they should not drink.

fresh_translation: He sent upon them dog-fly and it devoured them, and frog and it ruined them.
brenton_translation: He sent against them the dog-fly, and it devoured them; and the frog, and it spoiled them.

fresh_translation: And he gave their fruit to mildew and their labors to locust.
brenton_translation: And he gave their fruit to the canker worm, and their labours to the locust.

fresh_translation: He killed their vine with hail and their sycamores with frost.
brenton_translation: He killed their vines with hail, and their sycamores with frost.

fresh_translation: And he handed over their cattle to hail and their possessions to fire.
brenton_translation: And he gave up their cattle to hail, and their substance to the fire.

fresh_translation: He sent upon them wrath of his anger, anger and fury and affliction, dispatch by evil angels.
brenton_translation: He sent out against them the fury of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and affliction, a message by evil angels.

fresh_translation: He made way for his anger; he did not spare their souls from death and enclosed their cattle in death.
brenton_translation: He made a way for his wrath; he spared not their souls from death, but consigned their cattle to death;

fresh_translation: And he struck every firstborn in Egypt, first fruits of their labors in the tents of Ham.
brenton_translation: and smote every first-born in the land of Egypt; the first-fruits of their labours in the tents of Cham.

fresh_translation: And he lifted up his people like sheep and led them like a flock in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And he removed his people like sheep; he led them as a flock in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And he guided them in hope and they did not fear, and sea covered their enemies.
brenton_translation: And he guided them with hope, and they feared not: but the sea covered their enemies.

fresh_translation: And he brought them into boundary of his sanctuary, this mountain which his right hand acquired.
brenton_translation: And he brought them in to the mountain of his sanctuary, this mountain which his right hand had purchased.

fresh_translation: And he cast out nations from before them and gave them inheritance by measuring line and made the tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.
brenton_translation: And he cast out the nations from before them, and made them to inherit by a line of inheritance, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

fresh_translation: And they tested and provoked God Most High, and his testimonies they did not keep.
brenton_translation: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies.

fresh_translation: And they turned back and broke covenant just as their fathers, and were twisted into crooked bow.
brenton_translation: And they turned back, and broke covenant, even as also their fathers: they became like a crooked bow.

fresh_translation: And they angered him with their hills and with their carved images stirred him to jealousy.
brenton_translation: And they provoked him with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

fresh_translation: God heard and disregarded and greatly despised Israel.
brenton_translation: God heard and lightly regarded them, and greatly despised Israel.

fresh_translation: And he rejected tent of Shiloh, his tabernacle where he dwelt among men.
brenton_translation: And he rejected the tabernacle of Selom, his tent where he dwelt among men.

fresh_translation: And he gave their strength into captivity and their beauty into the hand of enemy.
brenton_translation: And he gave their strength into captivity, and their beauty into the enemy's hand.

fresh_translation: And he enclosed his people to sword and disregarded his inheritance.
brenton_translation: And he gave his people to the sword; and disdained his inheritance.

fresh_translation: Fire devoured their young men, and their virgins were not mourned.
brenton_translation: Fire devoured their young men; and their virgins mourned not.

fresh_translation: Their priests fell by sword, and their widows will not be wept.
brenton_translation: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows shall not be wept for.

fresh_translation: And the Lord awoke like one sleeping, like mighty man sobered from wine.
brenton_translation: So the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and as a mighty man who has been heated with wine.

fresh_translation: And he struck his enemies backward; everlasting reproach he gave them.
brenton_translation: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he brought on them a perpetual reproach.

fresh_translation: And he rejected tent of Joseph, and tribe of Ephraim he did not choose.
brenton_translation: And he rejected the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim;

fresh_translation: And he chose tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
brenton_translation: but chose the tribe of Juda, the mount Sion which he loved.

fresh_translation: And he built his sanctuary like unicorns; on earth he founded it forever.
brenton_translation: And he built his sanctuary as the place of unicorns; he founded it for ever on the earth.

fresh_translation: And he chose David his servant and took him up from flocks of sheep.
brenton_translation: He chose David also his servant, and took him up from the flocks of sheep.

fresh_translation: From behind nursing ones he took him to shepherd Jacob his people and Israel his inheritance.
brenton_translation: He took him from following the ewes great with young, to be the shepherd of Jacob his servant, and Israel his inheritance.

fresh_translation: And he shepherded them in the innocence of his heart and guided them in understandings of his hands.
brenton_translation: So he tended them in the innocency of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

fresh_translation: Psalm of Asaph. O God, nations came into your inheritance; they defiled your holy temple; they made Jerusalem into orchard-watch hut.
brenton_translation: A Psalm for Asaph.

fresh_translation: They set dead bodies of your servants as food to the birds of heaven, flesh of your holy ones to the beasts of the earth.
brenton_translation: They have given the dead bodies of thy servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of thy holy ones for the wild beasts of the earth.

fresh_translation: They poured out their blood like water around Jerusalem, and there was none burying.
brenton_translation: They have shed their blood as water, round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

fresh_translation: We became a reproach to our neighbors, mocking and derision to those around us.
brenton_translation: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

fresh_translation: How long, Lord? Will you be angry to end? Will your zeal burn like fire?
brenton_translation: How long, O Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

fresh_translation: Pour out your anger upon nations not knowing you and upon kingdoms which did not call upon your name,
brenton_translation: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms which have not called upon thy name.

fresh_translation: because they devoured Jacob and laid waste his place.
brenton_translation: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid his place waste.

fresh_translation: Do not remember against us ancient lawlessnesses; let your compassions quickly go before us, because we became very poor.
brenton_translation: Remember not our old transgressions; let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us; for we are greatly impoverished.

fresh_translation: Help us, God our savior, for the sake of glory of your name. Lord, rescue us and propitiate our sins for the sake of your name.
brenton_translation: Help us, O God our Saviour; for the glory of thy name, O Lord, deliver us; and be merciful to our sins, for thy name's sake.

fresh_translation: Lest nations say, Where is their God? Let vengeance of blood of your servants poured out be known among nations before our eyes.
brenton_translation: Lest haply they should say among the heathen, Where is their God? and let the avenging of thy servants' blood that has been shed be known among the heathen before our eyes.

fresh_translation: Let groaning of chained ones enter before you; according to greatness of your arm preserve sons of those put to death.
brenton_translation: Let the groaning of the prisoners come in before thee; according to the greatness of thine arm preserve the sons of the slain ones.

fresh_translation: Repay to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom their reproach with which they reproached you, Lord.
brenton_translation: Repay to our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, with which they have reproached thee, O Lord.

fresh_translation: But we are your people and sheep of your pasture will confess to you forever; from generation to generation we will declare your praise.
brenton_translation: For we are thy people and the sheep of thy pasture; we will give thee thanks for ever; we will declare thy praise throughout all generations.

fresh_translation: For end, concerning those to be changed, testimony of Asaph, psalm concerning Assyrian.
brenton_translation: For the end, for alternate strains, a testimony for Asaph, a Psalm concerning the Assyrian.

fresh_translation: You shepherding Israel, attend; you leading Joseph like sheep, you sitting upon cherubim, show yourself.
brenton_translation: Attend, O Shepherd of Israel, who guidest Joseph like a flock; thou who sittest upon the cherubs, manifest thyself;

fresh_translation: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up your dominion and come to save us.
brenton_translation: before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasse, stir up thy power, and come to deliver us.

fresh_translation: O God, turn us back and make your face shine, and we will be saved.
brenton_translation: Turn us, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be delivered.

fresh_translation: Lord God of hosts, how long are you angry over prayer of your servant?
brenton_translation: O Lord God of hosts, how long art thou angry with the prayer of thy servant?

fresh_translation: You feed us bread of tears and give us tears to drink in measure.
brenton_translation: Thou wilt feed us with bread of tears; and wilt cause us to drink tears by measure.

fresh_translation: You set us for contradiction to our neighbors, and our enemies mocked us.
brenton_translation: Thou hast made us a strife to our neighbours; and our enemies have mocked at us.

fresh_translation: Lord God of hosts, turn us back and make your face shine, and we will be saved. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Turn us, O Lord God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved. Pause.

fresh_translation: You transplanted vine out of Egypt; you cast out nations and planted her.
brenton_translation: Thou hast transplanted a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

fresh_translation: You made way before her and planted her roots, and land was filled.
brenton_translation: Thou madest a way before it, and didst cause its roots to strike, and the land was filled with it.

fresh_translation: Her shadow covered mountains, and her branches the cedars of God.
brenton_translation: Its shadow covered the mountains, and its shoots equalled the goodly cedars.

fresh_translation: She stretched out her shoots unto sea and her offshoots unto river.
brenton_translation: It sent forth its branches to the sea, and its shoots to the river.

fresh_translation: Why did you pull down her fence, and all passing by road gather from her?
brenton_translation: Wherefore hast thou broken down its hedge, while all that pass by the way pluck it?

fresh_translation: Boar from the forest ravaged her, and solitary wild beast fed on her.
brenton_translation: The boar out of the wood has laid it waste, and the wild beast has devoured it.

fresh_translation: God of hosts, turn now; look from heaven and see and visit this vine,
brenton_translation: O God of hosts, turn, we pray thee: look on us from heaven, and behold and visit this vine;

fresh_translation: and restore what your right hand planted, and upon the son of man whom you strengthened for yourself.
brenton_translation: and restore that which thy right hand has planted: and look on the son of man whom thou didst strengthen for thyself.

fresh_translation: Burned with fire and dug up, they will perish from rebuke of your face.
brenton_translation: It is burnt with fire and dug up: they shall perish at the rebuke of thy presence.

fresh_translation: Let your hand be upon man of your right hand and upon the son of man whom you strengthened for yourself.
brenton_translation: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, and upon the son of man whom thou didst strengthen for thyself.

fresh_translation: And we will never depart from you; you will make us live, and we will call upon your name.
brenton_translation: So will we not depart from thee: thou shalt quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

fresh_translation: Lord God of hosts, turn us back and make your face shine, and we will be saved.
brenton_translation: Turn us, O Lord God of hosts, and make thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

fresh_translation: For end, concerning winepresses. Of Asaph. Psalm.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm for Asaph, concerning the wine-presses.

fresh_translation: Exult in God our helper; shout to God of Jacob.
brenton_translation: Rejoice ye in God our helper; shout aloud to the God of Jacob.

fresh_translation: Take psalm and give tambourine, pleasant psaltery with lyre.
brenton_translation: Take a psalm, and produce the timbrel, the pleasant psaltery with the harp.

fresh_translation: Blow trumpet at new moon, on notable day of our feast,
brenton_translation: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, in the glorious day of your feast.

fresh_translation: because ordinance for Israel it is and judgment for God of Jacob.
brenton_translation: For this is an ordinance for Israel, and a statute of the God of Jacob.

fresh_translation: He set it as testimony in Joseph when he went out from the land of Egypt; he heard language he did not know.
brenton_translation: He made it to be a testimony in Joseph, when he came forth out of the land of Egypt: he heard a language which he understood not.

fresh_translation: He removed his back from burdens; his hands served in basket.
brenton_translation: He removed his back from burdens: his hands slaved in making the baskets.

fresh_translation: In affliction you called on me, and I rescued you; I heard you in the hidden place of storm; I tested you at the water of contradiction. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Thou didst call upon me in trouble, and I delivered thee; I heard thee in the secret place of the storm: I proved thee at the water of Strife. Pause.

fresh_translation: Hear, my people, and I will testify to you; Israel, if you would hear me,
brenton_translation: Hear, my people, and I will speak to thee, O Israel; and I will testify to thee: if thou wilt hearken to me;

fresh_translation: there will not be in you recent god, nor will you worship strange god.
brenton_translation: there shall be no new god in thee; neither shalt thou worship a strange god.

fresh_translation: For I am the Lord your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt; widen your mouth, and I will fill it.
brenton_translation: For I am the Lord thy God, that brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

fresh_translation: And my people did not hear my voice, and Israel did not attend to me.
brenton_translation: But my people hearkened not to my voice; and Israel gave no heed to me.

fresh_translation: And I sent them according to practices of their hearts; they will walk in their practices.
brenton_translation: So I let them go after the ways of their own hearts: they will go on in their own ways.

fresh_translation: If my people heard me, if Israel walked in my ways,
brenton_translation: If my people had hearkened to me, if Israel had walked in my ways,

fresh_translation: in nothing I would humble their enemies and against those afflicting them I would lay my hand.
brenton_translation: I should have put down their enemies very quickly, and should have laid my hand upon those that afflicted them.

fresh_translation: The enemies of the Lord lied to him, and their time will be forever.
brenton_translation: The Lord's enemies should have lied to him: but their time shall be for ever.

fresh_translation: And he fed them from the fat of wheat, and from rock he satisfied them with honey.
brenton_translation: And he fed them with the fat of wheat; and satisfied them with honey out of the rock.

fresh_translation: Psalm of Asaph. God stood in the gathering of gods, and in midst he judges gods.
brenton_translation: A Psalm for Asaph.

fresh_translation: How long will you judge injustice and take faces of sinners? Interlude.
brenton_translation: How long will ye judge unrighteously, and accept the persons of sinners? Pause.

fresh_translation: Judge an orphan and a poor one; justify a humble one and a needy one.
brenton_translation: Judge the orphan and poor: do justice to the low and needy.

fresh_translation: Rescue a needy one and a poor one; deliver from the hand of a sinner.
brenton_translation: Rescue the needy, and deliver the poor out of the hand of the sinner.

fresh_translation: They did not know nor understand; they walk in darkness; all foundations of the earth will be shaken.
brenton_translation: They know not, nor understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth shall be shaken.

fresh_translation: I said, You are gods, and all sons of Most High.
brenton_translation: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you children of the Most High.

fresh_translation: But you die like men and fall like one of rulers.
brenton_translation: But ye die as men, and fall as one of the princes.

fresh_translation: Rise up, O God, judge earth, because you will inherit among all nations.
brenton_translation: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

fresh_translation: Song of psalm of Asaph.
brenton_translation: A Song of a Psalm for Asaph.

fresh_translation: O God, who will be likened to you? Do not be silent nor be made gentle, O God.
brenton_translation: O God, who shall be compared to thee? be not silent, neither be still, O God.

fresh_translation: Because behold, your enemies sounded out, and those hating you raised head.
brenton_translation: For behold, thine enemies have made a noise; and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

fresh_translation: Against your people they worked crafty counsel and took counsel against your holy ones.
brenton_translation: Against thy people they have craftily imagined a device, and have taken counsel against thy saints.

fresh_translation: They said, Come, and let us destroy them from nation, and the name of Israel will not be remembered any longer.
brenton_translation: They have said, Come, and let us utterly destroy them out of the nation; and let the name of Israel be remembered no more at all.

fresh_translation: Because they took counsel with one accord together; against you they arranged covenant:
brenton_translation: For they have taken counsel together with one consent: they have made a confederacy against thee;

fresh_translation: tents of Edomites and Ishmaelites, Moab and Hagarites,
brenton_translation: even the tents of the Idumeans, and the Ismaelites; Moab, and the Agarenes;

fresh_translation: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, foreigners with those dwelling in Tyre.
brenton_translation: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalec; the Philistines also, with them that dwell at Tyre.

fresh_translation: For Asshur also came along with them; they became support to the sons of Lot. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Yea, Assur too is come with them: they have become a help to the children of Lot. Pause.

fresh_translation: Do to them as to Midian and to Sisera, as to Jabin at torrent Kishon.
brenton_translation: Do thou to them as to Madiam, and to Sisera; as to Jabin at the brook of Kison.

fresh_translation: They were destroyed at Endor; they became like dung for earth.
brenton_translation: They were utterly destroyed at Aendor: they became as dung for the earth.

fresh_translation: Make their rulers like Oreb and Zeeb and Zebee and Zalmunna, all their rulers,
brenton_translation: Make their princes as Oreb and Zeb, and Zebee and Salmana; even all their princes:

fresh_translation: who said, Let us inherit sanctuary of God for ourselves.
brenton_translation: who said, Let us take to ourselves the altar of God as an inheritance.

fresh_translation: My God, make them like a wheel, like stubble before wind,
brenton_translation: O my God, make them as a wheel; as stubble before the face of the wind.

fresh_translation: as fire kindles forest, as a flame burns mountains,
brenton_translation: As fire which shall burn up a wood, as the flame may consume the mountains;

fresh_translation: so you will pursue them in your storm, and in your anger you will trouble them.
brenton_translation: so shalt thou persecute them with thy tempest, and trouble them in thine anger.

fresh_translation: Fill their faces with dishonor, and they will seek your name, Lord.
brenton_translation: Fill their faces with dishonour; so shall they seek thy name, O Lord.

fresh_translation: Let them be shamed and troubled forever and ever, and let them be disgraced and perish.
brenton_translation: Let them be ashamed and troubled for evermore; yea, let them be confounded and destroyed.

fresh_translation: And let them know that your name Lord, you alone Most High over all the earth.
brenton_translation: And let them know that thy name is Lord; that thou alone art Most High over all the earth.

fresh_translation: For end, concerning winepresses, for the sons of Korah, psalm.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm for the sons of Core, concerning the wine-presses.

fresh_translation: How beloved your tabernacles, Lord of hosts.
brenton_translation: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts!

fresh_translation: My soul longs and fails for courts of the Lord; my heart and my flesh exulted in living God.
brenton_translation: My soul longs, and faints for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh have exulted in the living God.

fresh_translation: For even sparrow found house for itself, and turtledove nest for herself where she may place her nestlings: your altars, Lord of hosts, my king and my God.
brenton_translation: Yea, the sparrow has found himself a home, and the turtle-dove a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God.

fresh_translation: Blessed are those dwelling in your house; forever and ever they will praise you. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will praise thee evermore. Pause.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the man whose support is from you, Lord; ascents in his heart he arranged,
brenton_translation: Blessed is the man whose help is of thee, O Lord; in his heart he has purposed to go up

fresh_translation: in the valley of weeping, into place he appointed; for lawgiver will also give blessings.
brenton_translation: the valley of weeping, to the place which he has appointed, for there the law-giver will grant blessings.

fresh_translation: They will go from strength to strength; the God of gods will be seen in Zion.
brenton_translation: They shall go from strength to strength: the God of gods shall be seen in Sion.

fresh_translation: Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, God of Jacob. Interlude.
brenton_translation: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: hearken, O God of Jacob. Pause.

fresh_translation: Our defender, see, O God, and look upon the face of your anointed.
brenton_translation: Behold, O God our defender, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

fresh_translation: Because one day in your courts is better than thousands; I chose to be cast aside in the house of God rather than dwell in the tents of sinners.
brenton_translation: For one day in thy courts is better than thousands. I would rather be an abject in the house of God, than dwell in the tents of sinners.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord God loves mercy and truth; the Lord will give grace and glory; he will not withhold good things from those walking in innocence.
brenton_translation: For the Lord loves mercy and truth: God will give grace and glory: the Lord will not withhold good things from them that walk in innocence.

fresh_translation: Lord of hosts, blessed man hoping on you.
brenton_translation: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusts in thee.

fresh_translation: For end, for the sons of Korah, psalm.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm for the sons of Core.

fresh_translation: You took pleasure, Lord, in your land; you turned back captivity of Jacob.
brenton_translation: O Lord, thou hast taken pleasure in thy land: thou hast turned back the captivity of Jacob.

fresh_translation: You forgave lawlessnesses of your people; you covered all their sins. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Thou hast forgiven thy people their transgressions; thou hast covered all their sins. Pause.

fresh_translation: You stopped all your anger; you turned back from the wrath of your anger.
brenton_translation: Thou hast caused all thy wrath to cease: thou hast turned from thy fierce anger.

fresh_translation: Turn us back, O God of our salvations, and turn your anger away from us.
brenton_translation: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and turn thine anger away from us.

fresh_translation: Will you be angry with us forever, or stretch your anger from generation to generation?
brenton_translation: Wouldest thou be angry with us for ever? or wilt thou continue thy wrath from generation to generation?

fresh_translation: O God, you, turning back, will make us live, and your people will rejoice in you.
brenton_translation: O God, thou wilt turn and quicken us; and thy people shall rejoice in thee.

fresh_translation: Show us, Lord, your mercy, and give us your salvation.
brenton_translation: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.

fresh_translation: I will hear what the Lord God will speak in me, because he will speak peace upon his people and upon his holy ones and upon those turning heart toward him.
brenton_translation: I will hear what the Lord God will say concerning me: for he shall speak peace to his people, and to his saints, and to those that turn their heart toward him.

fresh_translation: Surely his salvation near those fearing him, so that glory may dwell in our land.
brenton_translation: Moreover his salvation is near them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

fresh_translation: Mercy and truth met together; righteousness and peace kissed.
brenton_translation: Mercy and truth are met together: righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

fresh_translation: Truth rose from earth, and righteousness looked down from heaven.
brenton_translation: Truth has sprung out of the earth; and righteousness has looked down from heaven.

fresh_translation: For the Lord will give goodness, and our land will give its fruit.
brenton_translation: For the Lord will give goodness; and our land shall yield her fruit.

fresh_translation: Righteousness will go before him and set his footsteps in the way.
brenton_translation: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set his steps in the way.

fresh_translation: Prayer of David. Incline your ear, Lord, and hear me, because I poor and needy.
brenton_translation: A Prayer of David.

fresh_translation: Guard my soul, because I holy; save your servant, my God, hoping on you.
brenton_translation: Preserve my soul, for I am holy; save thy servant, O God, who hopes in thee.

fresh_translation: Have mercy on me, Lord, because to you I will cry whole day.
brenton_translation: Pity me, O Lord: for to thee will I cry all the day.

fresh_translation: Gladden soul of your servant, because to you, Lord, I lifted my soul.
brenton_translation: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for to thee, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul.

fresh_translation: Because you, Lord, kind and gentle and rich in mercy to all calling on you.
brenton_translation: For thou, O Lord, art kind, and gentle; and plenteous in mercy to all that call upon thee.

fresh_translation: Give ear, Lord, to my prayer and attend to the voice of my supplication.
brenton_translation: Give ear to my prayer, O Lord; and attend to the voice of my supplication.

fresh_translation: In the day of my affliction I cried to you, because you heard me.
brenton_translation: In the day of my trouble I cried to thee: for thou didst hear me.

fresh_translation: There is none like you among gods, Lord, and none according to your works.
brenton_translation: There is none like to thee, O Lord, among the gods; and there are no works like to thy works.

fresh_translation: All nations, as many as you made, will come and worship before you, Lord, and will glorify your name.
brenton_translation: All nations whom thou hast made shall come, and shall worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

fresh_translation: Because you great and doing wonders; you alone the great God.
brenton_translation: For thou art great, and doest wonders: thou art the only and the great God.

fresh_translation: Guide me, Lord, in your way, and I will walk in your truth; let my heart rejoice to fear your name.
brenton_translation: Guide me, O Lord, in thy way, and I will walk in thy truth: let my heart rejoice, that I may fear thy name.

fresh_translation: I will confess to you, Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify your name forever.
brenton_translation: I will give thee thanks, O Lord my God, with all my heart; and I will glorify thy name for ever.

fresh_translation: Because your mercy great upon me, and you rescued my soul from lowest Hades.
brenton_translation: For thy mercy is great toward me; and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

fresh_translation: O God, lawless men rose against me, and gathering of strong men sought my soul, and they did not set you before them.
brenton_translation: O God, transgressors have risen up against me, and an assembly of violent men have sought my life; and have not set thee before them.

fresh_translation: But you, Lord God, compassionate and merciful, long-suffering and rich in mercy and true.
brenton_translation: But thou, O Lord God, art compassionate and merciful, long-suffering, and abundant in mercy and true.

fresh_translation: Look upon me and have mercy on me; give your strength to your child and save son of your handmaid.
brenton_translation: Look thou upon me, and have mercy upon me: give thy strength to thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

fresh_translation: Do with me sign for good, and let those hating me see and be shamed, because you, Lord, helped me and comforted me.
brenton_translation: Establish with me a token for good; and let them that hate me see it and be ashamed; because thou, O Lord, hast helped me, and comforted me.

fresh_translation: For the sons of Korah. Psalm of song. His foundations in holy mountains.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of a Song for the sons of Core.

fresh_translation: The Lord loves gates of Zion above all tabernacles of Jacob.
brenton_translation: The Lord loves the gates of Sion, more than all the tabernacles of Jacob.

fresh_translation: Glorious things were spoken concerning you, city of God. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Glorious things have been spoken of thee, O city of God. Pause.

fresh_translation: I will remember Rahab and Babylon to those knowing me; behold, foreigners and Tyre and people of Ethiopians, these were born there.
brenton_translation: I will make mention of Raab and Babylon to them that know me: behold also the Philistines, and Tyre, and the people of the Ethiopians: these were born there.

fresh_translation: Mother Zion, man will say, and man was born in her, and Most High himself founded her.
brenton_translation: A man shall say, Sion is my mother; and such a man was born in her; and the Highest himself has founded her.

fresh_translation: The Lord will recount in the writing of peoples and rulers, these who were born in her. Interlude.
brenton_translation: The Lord shall recount it in the writing of the people, and of these princes that were born in her. Pause.

fresh_translation: As of all rejoicing ones, dwelling in you.
brenton_translation: The dwelling of all within thee is as the dwelling of those that rejoice.

fresh_translation: Song of psalm for the sons of Korah, for end, concerning Mahalath, for answering, for understanding, of Heman the Israelite.
brenton_translation: A song of a Psalm for the sons of Core for the end, upon Maeleth for responsive strains, of instruction for Æman the Israelite.

fresh_translation: Lord God of my salvation, by day I cried and by night before you.
brenton_translation: O Lord God of my salvation, I have cried by day and in the night before thee.

fresh_translation: Let my prayer enter before you; incline your ear to my supplication, Lord.
brenton_translation: Let my prayer come in before thee; incline thine ear to my supplication, O Lord.

fresh_translation: Because my soul was filled with evils, and my life drew near to Hades.
brenton_translation: For my soul is filled with troubles, and my life has drawn nigh to Hades.

fresh_translation: I was counted with those going down into pit; I became like helpless man among dead, free,
brenton_translation: I have been reckoned with them that go down to the pit; I became as a man without help;

fresh_translation: like wounded ones cast down, sleeping in tomb, whom you no longer remembered and they were thrust away from your hand.
brenton_translation: free among the dead, as the slain ones cast out, who sleep in the tomb; whom thou rememberest no more; and they are rejected from thy hand.

fresh_translation: They set me in lowest pit, in dark places and in the shadow of death.
brenton_translation: They laid me in the lowest pit, in dark places, and in the shadow of death.

fresh_translation: Your wrath was fixed upon me, and all your surges you brought upon me. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Thy wrath has pressed heavily upon me, and thou hast brought upon me all thy billows. Pause.

fresh_translation: You removed my acquaintances from me; they made me abomination to themselves. I was handed over and did not go out.
brenton_translation: Thou hast removed my acquaintance far from me; they have made me an abomination to themselves; I have been delivered up, and have not gone forth.

fresh_translation: My eyes grew weak from poverty; I cried to you, Lord, whole day; I spread out my hands to you.
brenton_translation: Mine eyes are dimmed from poverty; but I cried to thee, O Lord, all the day; I spread forth my hands to thee.

fresh_translation: Will you do wonders for dead, or will physicians raise them and confess to you?
brenton_translation: Wilt thou work wonders for the dead? or shall physicians raise them up, that they shall praise thee?

fresh_translation: Will anyone recount your mercy in tomb, and your truth in destruction?
brenton_translation: Shall any one declare thy mercy in the tomb? and thy truth in destruction?

fresh_translation: Will your wonders be known in darkness and your righteousness in forgotten land?
brenton_translation: Shall thy wonders be known in darkness? and thy righteousness in a forgotten land?

fresh_translation: But I cried to you, Lord, and in morning my prayer will go before you.
brenton_translation: But I cried to thee, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

fresh_translation: Why, Lord, do you reject my soul? You turn your face away from me.
brenton_translation: Wherefore, O Lord, dost thou reject my prayer, and turn thy face away from me?

fresh_translation: I poor and in labors from my youth; having been exalted, I was humbled and came to despair.
brenton_translation: I am poor and in troubles from my youth; and having been exalted, I was brought low and into despair.

fresh_translation: Your angers passed over me, and your terrors troubled me.
brenton_translation: Thy wrath has passed over me; and thy terrors have greatly disquieted me.

fresh_translation: They encircled me like water whole day; together they surrounded me.
brenton_translation: They compassed me like water; all the day they beset me together.

fresh_translation: You removed friend and neighbor from me and my acquaintances from misery.
brenton_translation: Thou hast put far from me every friend, and mine acquaintances because of my wretchedness.

fresh_translation: For understanding. Of Ethan the Israelite.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of instruction for Ætham the Israelite.

fresh_translation: Your mercies, Lord, forever I will sing; from generation to generation I will declare your truth with my mouth.
brenton_translation: I will sing of thy mercies, O Lord, for ever: I will declare thy truth with my mouth to all generations.

fresh_translation: Because you said, Mercy will be built forever; in heavens your truth will be prepared.
brenton_translation: For thou hast said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy truth shall be established in the heavens.

fresh_translation: I arranged covenant with my chosen ones; I swore to David my servant,
brenton_translation: I made a covenant with my chosen ones, I sware unto David my servant.

fresh_translation: Until age I will prepare your seed and build your throne to generation and generation. Interlude.
brenton_translation: I will establish thy seed for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Pause.

fresh_translation: Heavens will confess your wonders, Lord, and your truth in the assembly of holy ones.
brenton_translation: The heavens shall declare thy wonders, O Lord; and thy truth in the assembly of the saints.

fresh_translation: Because who in clouds will be made equal to the Lord, and who will be likened to the Lord among sons of God?
brenton_translation: For who in the heavens shall be compared to the Lord? and who shall be likened to the Lord among the sons of God?

fresh_translation: God glorified in the council of holy ones, great and fearful above all around him.
brenton_translation: God is glorified in the council of the saints; great and terrible toward all that are round about him.

fresh_translation: Lord God of hosts, who like you? Mighty are you, Lord, and your truth around you.
brenton_translation: O Lord God of hosts, who is like to thee? thou art mighty, O Lord, and thy truth is round about thee.

fresh_translation: You rule power of sea, and disturbance of its waves you calm.
brenton_translation: Thou rulest the power of the sea; and thou calmest the tumult of its waves.

fresh_translation: You humbled proud one like a wounded man, and with arm of your power you scattered your enemies.
brenton_translation: Thou hast brought down the proud as one that is slain; and with the arm of thy power thou hast scattered thine enemies.

fresh_translation: Yours the heavens and yours the earth; inhabited world and its fullness, you founded them.
brenton_translation: The heavens are thine, and the earth is thine: thou hast founded the world, and the fulness of it.

fresh_translation: North and seas you created; Tabor and Hermon will exult in your name.
brenton_translation: Thou hast created the north and the west: Thabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

fresh_translation: Yours the arm with dominion; let your hand be strengthened; let your right hand be exalted.
brenton_translation: Thine is the mighty arm: let thy hand be strengthened, let thy right hand be exalted.

fresh_translation: Righteousness and judgment are the foundation of your throne; mercy and truth will go before your face.
brenton_translation: Justice and judgment are the establishment of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

fresh_translation: Blessed are the people knowing shout; Lord, in the light of your face they will walk.
brenton_translation: Blessed is the people that knows the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.

fresh_translation: And in your name they will exult whole day, and in your righteousness they will be exalted.
brenton_translation: And in thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

fresh_translation: Because you boast of their power, and in your good pleasure our horn will be exalted.
brenton_translation: For thou art the boast of their strength; and in thy good pleasure shall our horn be exalted,

fresh_translation: Because support belongs to the Lord, and to the Holy One of Israel, our king.
brenton_translation: for our help is of the Lord; and of the Holy One of Israel, our king.

fresh_translation: Then you spoke in vision to your holy ones and said, I set help upon mighty one; I exalted chosen one from my people.
brenton_translation: Then thou spokest in vision to thy children, and saidst, I have laid help on a mighty one; I have exalted one chosen out of my people.

fresh_translation: I found David my servant; with my holy oil I anointed him.
brenton_translation: I have found David my servant; I have anointed him by my holy mercy.

fresh_translation: For my hand will support him, and my arm will strengthen him.
brenton_translation: For my hand shall support him; and mine arm shall strengthen him.

fresh_translation: Enemy will not profit in him, and son of lawlessness will not add to harm him.
brenton_translation: The enemy shall have no advantage against him; and the son of transgression shall not hurt him again.

fresh_translation: And I will cut down his enemies from before him, and those hating him I will rout.
brenton_translation: And I will hew down his foes before him, and put to flight those that hate him.

fresh_translation: And my truth and my mercy with him, and in my name his horn will be exalted.
brenton_translation: But my truth and my mercy shall be with him; and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

fresh_translation: And I will set his hand in sea and his right hand in rivers.
brenton_translation: And I will set his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

fresh_translation: He will call upon me, You are my father, my God and supporter of my salvation.
brenton_translation: He shall call upon me, saying, Thou art my Father, my God, and the helper of my salvation.

fresh_translation: And I will set him firstborn, high above kings of the earth.
brenton_translation: And I will make him my first-born, higher than the kings of the earth.

fresh_translation: Forever I will keep my mercy for him, and my covenant faithful to him.
brenton_translation: I will keep my mercy for him for ever, and my covenant shall be firm with him.

fresh_translation: And I will set his seed forever and ever and his throne as days of heaven.
brenton_translation: And I will establish his seed for ever and ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

fresh_translation: If his sons forsake my law and do not walk in my judgments,
brenton_translation: If his children should forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

fresh_translation: if they profane my ordinances and do not keep my commandments,
brenton_translation: if they should profane my ordinances, and not keep my commandments;

fresh_translation: I will visit their lawlessnesses with rod and their sins with whips.
brenton_translation: I will visit their transgressions with a rod, and their sins with scourges.

fresh_translation: But my mercy I will certainly not scatter from him, nor will I act unjustly in my truth.
brenton_translation: But my mercy I will not utterly remove from him, nor wrong my truth.

fresh_translation: Nor will I profane my covenant, and what goes out through my lips I will certainly not set aside.
brenton_translation: Neither will I by any means profane my covenant; and I will not make void the things that proceed out of my lips.

fresh_translation: Once I swore in my holy place: will I lie to David?
brenton_translation: Once have I sworn by my holiness, that I will not lie to David.

fresh_translation: His seed remains forever, and his throne as sun before me,
brenton_translation: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me;

fresh_translation: and as moon established forever, and witness in heaven faithful. Interlude.
brenton_translation: and as the moon that is established for ever, and as the faithful witness in heaven. Pause.

fresh_translation: But you rejected and despised; you deferred your anointed.
brenton_translation: But thou hast cast off and set at nought, thou hast rejected thine anointed.

fresh_translation: You overturned covenant of your servant; you profaned his sanctuary to earth.
brenton_translation: Thou hast overthrown the covenant of thy servant; thou hast profaned his sanctuary, casting it to the ground.

fresh_translation: You pulled down all his fences; you made his strongholds fear.
brenton_translation: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast made his strong holds a terror.

fresh_translation: All passing by road plundered him; he became a reproach to his neighbors.
brenton_translation: All that go by the way have spoiled him: he is become a reproach to his neighbours.

fresh_translation: You exalted right hand of his enemies; you gladdened all his enemies.
brenton_translation: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his enemies; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

fresh_translation: You turned back help of his sword and did not support him in war.
brenton_translation: Thou hast turned back the help of his sword, and hast not helped him in the battle.

fresh_translation: You dissolved him from cleansing; his throne you shattered to earth.
brenton_translation: Thou hast deprived him of glory: thou hast broken down his throne to the ground.

fresh_translation: You shortened days of his time; you poured out shame upon him. Interlude.
brenton_translation: Thou hast shortened the days of his throne: thou hast poured shame upon him. Pause.

fresh_translation: How long, Lord? Will you turn away to end? Will your anger burn like fire?
brenton_translation: How long, O Lord, wilt thou turn away, for ever? shall thine anger flame out as fire?

fresh_translation: Remember what my substance is; for not in vain did you create all sons of men.
brenton_translation: Remember what my being is: for hast thou created all the sons of men in vain?

fresh_translation: Who is man who will live and not see death? Will he rescue his soul from the hand of Hades? Interlude.
brenton_translation: What man is there who shall live, and not see death? shall any one deliver his soul from the hand of Hades? Pause.

fresh_translation: Where are your former mercies, Lord, which you swore to David in your truth?
brenton_translation: Where are thine ancient mercies, O Lord, which thou swarest to David in thy truth?

fresh_translation: Remember, Lord, reproach of your servants, which I bore in my bosom from many nations,
