brenton_translation: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of thy servants, which I have borne in my bosom, even the reproach of many nations;

fresh_translation: with which your enemies reproached, Lord, with which they reproached exchange of your anointed.
brenton_translation: wherewith thine enemies have reviled, O Lord: wherewith they have reviled the recompence of thine anointed.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord forever. Amen, amen.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord for ever. So be it, so be it.

fresh_translation: Prayer of Moses, man of God. Lord, you became refuge to us in generation and generation.
brenton_translation: A Prayer of Moses the man of God.

fresh_translation: Before mountains were born and earth and inhabited world were formed, from age until age you are.
brenton_translation: Before the mountains existed, and before the earth and the world were formed, even from age to age, Thou art.

fresh_translation: Do not turn man away into humiliation; and you said, Return, sons of men.
brenton_translation: Turn not man back to his low place, whereas thou saidst, Return, ye sons of men?

fresh_translation: Because thousand years in your eyes like yesterday day that passed and like watch in night.
brenton_translation: For a thousand years in thy sight are as the yesterday which is past, and as a watch in the night.

fresh_translation: Their despised things will be years; in morning like grass let it pass away.
brenton_translation: Years shall be vanity to them: let the morning pass away as grass.

fresh_translation: In morning let it flower and pass away; in evening let it fall, grow hard, and dry up.
brenton_translation: In the morning let it flower, and pass away: in the evening let it droop, let it be withered and dried up.

fresh_translation: Because we failed in your anger and in your fury we were troubled.
brenton_translation: For we have perished in thine anger, and in thy wrath we have been troubled.

fresh_translation: You set our lawlessnesses before you, our age in the light of your face.
brenton_translation: Thou hast set our transgressions before thee: our age is in the light of thy countenance.

fresh_translation: Because all our days failed, and in your anger we failed; our years I kept meditating like a spider.
brenton_translation: For all our days are gone, and we have passed away in thy wrath: our years have spun out their tale as a spider.

fresh_translation: Days of our years, in them seventy years; and if in dominions, eighty years; and more of them labor and pain, because meekness came upon us and we will be disciplined.
brenton_translation: As for the days of our years, in them are seventy years; and if men should be in strength, eighty years: and the greater part of them would be labour and trouble; for weakness overtakes us, and we shall be chastened.

fresh_translation: Who knows strength of your anger and from your fear your fury?
brenton_translation: Who knows the power of thy wrath?

fresh_translation: To number your right hand, thus make known, and those bound in heart in wisdom.
brenton_translation: and who knows how to number his days because of the fear of thy wrath? So manifest thy right hand, and those that are instructed in wisdom in the heart.

fresh_translation: Turn back, Lord, how long, and be comforted over your servants.
brenton_translation: Return, O Lord, how long? and be intreated concerning thy servants.

fresh_translation: We were filled in morning with your mercy, and we exulted and rejoiced in all our days.
brenton_translation: We have been satisfied in the morning with thy mercy; and we did exult and rejoice:

fresh_translation: We rejoiced for days in which you humbled us, years in which we saw evils.
brenton_translation: let us rejoice in all our days, in return for the days wherein thou didst afflict us, the years wherein we saw evil.

fresh_translation: And look upon your servants and your works and guide their sons.
brenton_translation: And look upon thy servants, and upon thy works; and guide their children.

fresh_translation: And let brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and works of our hands direct upon us.
brenton_translation: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: and do thou direct for us the works of our hands.

fresh_translation: Praise, song of David. One dwelling in help of Most High will lodge in the shelter of the God of heaven.
brenton_translation: Praise of a Song, by David.

fresh_translation: He will say to the Lord, You are my supporter and my refuge, my God; I will hope on him.
brenton_translation: He shall say to the Lord, Thou art my helper and my refuge: my God; I will hope in him.

fresh_translation: Because he will rescue me from the snare of hunters and from troubled word.
brenton_translation: For he shall deliver thee from the snare of the hunters, from every troublesome matter.

fresh_translation: With his shoulders he will overshadow you, and under his wings you will hope; his truth will encircle you with shield.
brenton_translation: He shall overshadow thee with his shoulders, and thou shalt trust under his wings: his truth shall cover thee with a shield.

fresh_translation: You will not fear from night fear, from arrow flying by day,
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not be afraid of terror by night; nor of the arrow flying by day;

fresh_translation: from thing passing in darkness, from mishap and midday demon.
brenton_translation: nor of the evil thing that walks in darkness; nor of calamity, and the evil spirit at noon-day.

fresh_translation: A thousand will fall from your side and ten thousand from your right, but it will not come near you.
brenton_translation: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

fresh_translation: Only with your eyes you will observe and see the repayment of sinners.
brenton_translation: Only with thine eyes shalt thou observe and see the reward of sinners.

fresh_translation: Because you, Lord, my hope; you made Most High your refuge.
brenton_translation: For thou, O Lord, art my hope: thou, my soul, hast made the Most High thy refuge.

fresh_translation: Evils will not come near you, and scourge will not draw near your tent.
brenton_translation: No evils shall come upon thee, and no scourge shall draw nigh to thy dwelling.

fresh_translation: Because he will command his angels concerning you, to guard you in all your ways.
brenton_translation: For he shall give his angels charge concerning thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

fresh_translation: On hands they will carry you, lest you strike your foot against stone.
brenton_translation: They shall bear thee up on their hands, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

fresh_translation: You will step on asp and basilisk and trample lion and dragon.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt tread on the asp and basilisk: and thou shalt trample on the lion and dragon.

fresh_translation: Because he hoped on me, and I will rescue him; I will shelter him, because he knew my name.
brenton_translation: For he has hoped in me, and I will deliver him: I will protect him, because he has known my name.

fresh_translation: He will call upon me, and I will hear him; I am with him in affliction, and I will deliver and glorify him.
brenton_translation: He shall call upon me, and I will hearken to him: I am with him in affliction; and I will deliver him, and glorify him.

fresh_translation: With length of days I will fill him and show him my salvation.
brenton_translation: I will satisfy him with length of days, and shew him my salvation.

fresh_translation: Psalm, song for the day of Sabbath.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of a Song for the Sabbath-day.

fresh_translation: Good thing to confess to the Lord and sing to your name, Most High,
brenton_translation: It is a good thing to give thanks to the Lord, and to sing praises to thy name, O thou Most High;

fresh_translation: to proclaim in morning your mercy and your truth by night,
brenton_translation: to proclaim thy mercy in the morning, and thy truth by night,

fresh_translation: on ten-stringed psaltery, with song on lyre.
brenton_translation: on a psaltery of ten strings, with a song on the harp.

fresh_translation: Because you gladdened me, Lord, in your workmanship, and in the works of your hands I will exult.
brenton_translation: For thou, O Lord, hast made me glad with thy work: and in the operations of thy hands will I exult.

fresh_translation: How your works were magnified, Lord; your thoughts were made very deep.
brenton_translation: How have thy works been magnified, O Lord! thy thoughts are very deep.

fresh_translation: Foolish man will not know, and senseless man will not understand these things:
brenton_translation: A foolish man will not know, and a senseless man will not understand this.

fresh_translation: when sinners spring up like grass and all workers of lawlessness peered out, so that they might be destroyed forever and ever.
brenton_translation: When the sinners spring up as the grass, and all the workers of iniquity have watched; it is that they may be utterly destroyed for ever.

fresh_translation: But you, Most High forever, Lord.
brenton_translation: But thou, O Lord, art most high for ever.

fresh_translation: Because behold, your enemies will perish, and all workers of lawlessness will be scattered.
brenton_translation: For, behold, thine enemies shall perish; and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

fresh_translation: And my horn will be exalted like unicorn, and my old age in rich oil.
brenton_translation: But my horn shall be exalted as the horn of a unicorn; and mine old age with rich mercy.

fresh_translation: And my eye looked upon my enemies, and on those rising against me doing evil my ear will hear.
brenton_translation: And mine eye has seen mine enemies, and mine ear shall hear the wicked that rise up against me.

fresh_translation: The righteous one will flower like a palm tree; like a cedar in Lebanon he will multiply.
brenton_translation: The righteous shall flourish as a palm-tree: he shall be increased as the cedar in Libanus.

fresh_translation: Planted in the house of the Lord, in the courts of our God they will flower.
brenton_translation: They that are planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.

fresh_translation: They will still multiply in rich old age and be prospering,
brenton_translation: Then shall they be increased in a fine old age; and they shall be prosperous; that they may declare

fresh_translation: to declare that the Lord my God is upright, and there is no injustice in him.
brenton_translation: that the Lord my God is righteous, and there is no iniquity in him.

fresh_translation: For day before Sabbath, when earth was settled. Praise, song of David. The Lord reigned; he clothed himself with beauty, the Lord clothed himself with power and girded himself; for he also made firm inhabited world which will not be shaken.
brenton_translation: For the day before the Sabbath, when the land was first inhabited, the praise of a Song by David.

fresh_translation: Your throne ready from then; from age you are.
brenton_translation: Thy throne is prepared of old: thou art from everlasting.

fresh_translation: Rivers lifted up, Lord, rivers lifted up their voices.
brenton_translation: The rivers have lifted up, O Lord, the rivers have lifted up their voices,

fresh_translation: From voices of many waters, wondrous the surges of sea; wondrous in heights Lord.
brenton_translation: at the voices of many waters: the billows of the sea are wonderful: the Lord is wonderful in high places.

fresh_translation: Your testimonies were made very faithful; holiness fits your house, Lord, for the length of days.
brenton_translation: Thy testimonies are made very sure: holiness becomes thine house, O Lord, for ever.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David, fourth of Sabbaths. God of vengeances, Lord; God of vengeances spoke openly.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David for the fourth day of the week.

fresh_translation: Be exalted, judge of earth; repay recompense to proud ones.
brenton_translation: Be thou exalted, thou that judgest the earth: render a reward to the proud.

fresh_translation: How long, sinners, Lord, how long will sinners boast?
brenton_translation: How long shall sinners, O Lord, how long shall sinners boast?

fresh_translation: They will utter and speak injustice; all workers of lawlessness will speak.
brenton_translation: They will utter and speak unrighteousness; all the workers of iniquity will speak so.

fresh_translation: Your people, Lord, they humbled, and your inheritance they afflicted.
brenton_translation: They have afflicted thy people, O Lord, and hurt thine heritage.

fresh_translation: Widow and sojourner they killed, and orphans they murdered.
brenton_translation: They have slain the widow and fatherless, and murdered the stranger.

fresh_translation: And they said, the Lord will not see, nor will God of Jacob understand.
brenton_translation: And they said, The Lord shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob understand.

fresh_translation: Understand now, foolish ones among people, and senseless ones, when will you understand?
brenton_translation: Understand now, ye simple among the people; and ye fools, at length be wise.

fresh_translation: One planting ear, does he not hear? One forming eye, does he not perceive?
brenton_translation: He that planted the ear, does he not hear? or he that formed the eye, does not he perceive?

fresh_translation: One disciplining nations, will he not reprove? One teaching man knowledge?
brenton_translation: He that chastises the heathen, shall not he punish, even he that teaches man knowledge?

fresh_translation: The Lord knows thoughts of men, that they are vain.
brenton_translation: The Lord knows the thoughts of men, that they are vain.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Lord, and teach from your law,
brenton_translation: Blessed is the man whomsoever thou shalt chasten, O Lord, and shalt teach him out of thy law;

fresh_translation: to make him gentle away from evil days until pit be dug for sinner.
brenton_translation: to give him rest from evil days, until a pit be digged for the sinful one.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord will not reject his people and will not forsake his inheritance,
brenton_translation: For the Lord will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance;

fresh_translation: until righteousness returns to judgment, and all straight in heart close behind it. Interlude.
brenton_translation: until righteousness return to judgment, and all the upright in heart shall follow it. Pause.

fresh_translation: Who will rise for me against evil-doers, or who will stand with me against workers of lawlessness?
brenton_translation: Who will rise up for me against the transgressors? or who will stand up with me against the workers of iniquity?

fresh_translation: If not that the Lord helped me, my soul would almost have dwelt in Hades.
brenton_translation: If the Lord had not helped me, my soul had almost sojourned in Hades.

fresh_translation: If I said, My foot was shaken, your mercy, Lord, was helping me.
brenton_translation: If I said, My foot has been moved;

fresh_translation: Lord, according to the multitude of my pains in my heart, your comforts loved my soul.
brenton_translation: thy mercy, O Lord, helped me. O Lord, according to the multitude of my griefs within my heart, thy consolations have soothed my soul.

fresh_translation: Will throne of lawlessness join itself with you, one fashioning labor by ordinance?
brenton_translation: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frames mischief by an ordinance?

fresh_translation: They will hunt against soul of a righteous man and condemn innocent blood.
brenton_translation: They will hunt for the soul of the righteous, and condemn innocent blood.

fresh_translation: And the Lord became refuge to me, and my God helper of my hope.
brenton_translation: But the Lord was my refuge; and my God the helper of my hope.

fresh_translation: And he will repay them their lawlessness and in their evil he will destroy them, Lord our God.
brenton_translation: And he will recompense to them their iniquity and their wickedness: the Lord our God shall utterly destroy them.

fresh_translation: Praise, song of David. Come, let us exult in the Lord; let us shout to God our savior.
brenton_translation: The praise of a Song by David.

fresh_translation: Let us come before his face in confession, and in psalms let us shout to him.
brenton_translation: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.

fresh_translation: Because great God Lord and great king over all gods,
brenton_translation: For the Lord is a great God, and a great king over all gods: for the Lord will not cast off his people.

fresh_translation: because ends of the earth in his hand and heights of mountains his.
brenton_translation: For the ends of the earth are in his hands; and the heights of the mountains are his.

fresh_translation: Because sea his and he made it, and dry land his hands formed.
brenton_translation: For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

fresh_translation: Come, let us worship and fall down before him and weep before the Lord who made us,
brenton_translation: Come, let us worship and fall down before him; and weep before the Lord that made us.

fresh_translation: because he our God and we people of his pasture and sheep of his hand. Today, if you hear his voice,
brenton_translation: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand.

fresh_translation: do not harden your hearts as in provocation, according to day of testing in the wilderness,
brenton_translation: To-day, if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, according to the day of irritation in the wilderness:

fresh_translation: where your fathers tested me, tried me, and saw my works.
brenton_translation: where your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works.

fresh_translation: Forty years I felt loathing toward that generation and said, They always go astray in heart, and they did not know my ways,
brenton_translation: Forty years was I grieved with this generation, and said, They do always err in their heart, and they have not known my ways.

fresh_translation: as I swore in my anger, They will not enter into my rest.
brenton_translation: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.

fresh_translation: When house was being built after captivity. Song of David. Sing to the Lord new song; sing to the Lord, all the earth.
brenton_translation: When the house was built after the Captivity, a Song by David.

fresh_translation: Sing to the Lord; bless his name; bring good news day from day of his salvation.
brenton_translation: Sing to the Lord, bless his name: proclaim his salvation from day to day.

fresh_translation: Declare among nations his glory, among all peoples his wonders.
brenton_translation: Publish his glory among the Gentiles, his wonderful works among all people.

fresh_translation: Because great Lord and greatly praised; fearful he over all gods.
brenton_translation: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is terrible above all gods.

fresh_translation: Because all gods of nations demons, but the Lord made heavens.
brenton_translation: For all the gods of the heathen are devils: but the Lord made the heavens.

fresh_translation: Confession and beauty before him, holiness and magnificence in his sanctuary.
brenton_translation: Thanksgiving and beauty are before him: holiness and majesty are in his sanctuary.

fresh_translation: Bring to the Lord, families of nations, bring to the Lord glory and honor.
brenton_translation: Bring to the Lord, ye families of the Gentiles, bring to the Lord glory and honour.

fresh_translation: Bring to the Lord glory to his name; take sacrifices and enter into his courts.
brenton_translation: Bring to the Lord the glory becoming his name: take offerings, and go into his courts.

fresh_translation: Worship the Lord in his holy court; let all the earth be shaken from before him.
brenton_translation: Worship the Lord in his holy court: let all the earth tremble before him.

fresh_translation: Say among nations, the Lord reigned, for he also set inhabited world straight, which will not be shaken; he will judge peoples in uprightness.
brenton_translation: Say among the heathen, The Lord reigns: for he has established the world so that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people in righteousness.

fresh_translation: Let heavens rejoice and earth exult; let sea be shaken and its fullness.
brenton_translation: Let the heavens rejoice, and the earth exult; let the sea be moved, and the fulness of it.

fresh_translation: Fields will be glad and all things in them; then all trees of the forest will exult
brenton_translation: The plains shall rejoice, and all things in them: then shall all the trees of the wood exult before the presence of the Lord:

fresh_translation: before the Lord, because he comes, because he comes to judge earth; he will judge inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in his truth.
brenton_translation: for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth; he shall judge the world in righteousness, and the people with his truth.

fresh_translation: Of David, when his land is established. The Lord reigned; let earth exult; let many islands rejoice.
brenton_translation: For David, when his land is established.

fresh_translation: Cloud and gloom around him; righteousness and judgment correction of his throne.
brenton_translation: Cloud and darkness are round about him; righteousness and judgment are the establishment of his throne.

fresh_translation: Fire will go before him and flame around his enemies.
brenton_translation: Fire shall go before him, and burn up his enemies round about.

fresh_translation: His lightnings shone to inhabited world; earth saw and was shaken.
brenton_translation: His lightnings appeared to the world; the earth saw, and trembled.

fresh_translation: Mountains melted like wax from the face of the Lord, from the face of the Lord of all the earth.
brenton_translation: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

fresh_translation: Heavens declared his righteousness, and all peoples saw his glory.
brenton_translation: The heavens have declared his righteousness, and all the people have seen his glory.

fresh_translation: Let all worshiping carved images be shamed, those boasting in their idols; worship him, all his angels.
brenton_translation: Let all that worship graven images be ashamed, who boast of their idols; worship him, all ye his angels.

fresh_translation: Zion heard and rejoiced, and daughters of Judah exulted because of your judgments, Lord.
brenton_translation: Sion heard and rejoiced; and the daughters of Judea exulted, because of thy judgments, O Lord.

fresh_translation: Because you are Lord, Most High over all the earth; you were greatly exalted above all gods.
brenton_translation: For thou art Lord most high over all the earth; thou art greatly exalted above all gods.

fresh_translation: You who love the Lord, hate evil; The Lord guards the souls of his holy ones; from the hand of sinners he will rescue them.
brenton_translation: Ye that love the Lord, hate evil; the Lord preserves the souls of his saints; he shall deliver them from the hand of sinners.

fresh_translation: Light arose for a righteous one, and gladness for the straight in heart.
brenton_translation: Light is sprung up for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

fresh_translation: Rejoice, righteous ones, in the Lord, and confess to memory of his holiness.
brenton_translation: Rejoice in the Lord, ye righteous; and give thanks for a remembrance of his holiness.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David. Sing to the Lord new song, because the Lord did wondrous things; his right hand saved for him, and his holy arm.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: The Lord made known his salvation; before nations he revealed his righteousness.
brenton_translation: The Lord has made known his salvation, he has revealed his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

fresh_translation: He remembered his mercy to Jacob and his truth to the house of Israel; all ends of the earth saw salvation of our God.
brenton_translation: He has remembered his mercy to Jacob, and his truth to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

fresh_translation: Shout to God, all the earth; sing and exult and make melody.
brenton_translation: Shout to God, all the earth; sing, and exult, and sing psalms.

fresh_translation: Make melody to the Lord with lyre, with lyre and voice of psalm,
brenton_translation: Sing to the Lord with a harp, with a harp, and the voice of a psalm.

fresh_translation: with hammered trumpets and voice of horn trumpet; shout before the king, Lord.
brenton_translation: With trumpets of metal, and the sound of a trumpet of horn make a joyful noise to the Lord before the king.

fresh_translation: Let sea be shaken and its fullness, inhabited world and those dwelling in it.
brenton_translation: Let the sea be moved, and the fulness of it; the world, and they that dwell in it.

fresh_translation: Rivers will clap with hand; together mountains will exult,
brenton_translation: The rivers shall clap their hands together; the mountains shall exult.

fresh_translation: because he comes to judge earth; he will judge inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in uprightness.
brenton_translation: For he is come to judge the earth; he shall judge the world in righteousness, and the nations in uprightness.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David. The Lord reigned; let peoples be angry; one sitting upon cherubim, let earth be shaken.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: The Lord great in Zion and high over all peoples.
brenton_translation: The Lord is great in Sion, and is high over all the people.

fresh_translation: Let them confess to your name, the great one, because it fearful and holy.
brenton_translation: Let them give thanks to thy great name; for it is terrible and holy.

fresh_translation: And honor of the king loves judgment. You prepared uprightnesses; judgment and righteousness in Jacob you did.
brenton_translation: And the king's honour loves judgment; thou hast prepared equity, thou hast wrought judgment and justice in Jacob.

fresh_translation: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at footstool of his feet, because holy he is.
brenton_translation: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

fresh_translation: Moses and Aaron among his priests and Samuel among those calling on his name; they called on the Lord, and he heard them.
brenton_translation: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the Lord, and he heard them.

fresh_translation: In the pillar of cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies and ordinances he gave them.
brenton_translation: He spoke to them in a pillar of cloud; they kept his testimonies, and the ordinances which he gave them.

fresh_translation: Lord our God, you heard them; O God, you became propitious to them and avenging over all their practices.
brenton_translation: O Lord our God, thou heardest them; O God, thou becamest propitious to them, though thou didst take vengeance on all their devices.

fresh_translation: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his holy mountain, because holy is the Lord our God.
brenton_translation: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his holy mountain; for the Lord our God is holy.

fresh_translation: Psalm for confession. Shout to the Lord, all the earth.
brenton_translation: A Psalm for Thanksgiving.

fresh_translation: Serve the Lord with gladness; enter before him with exultation.
brenton_translation: Serve the Lord with gladness; come before his presence with exultation.

fresh_translation: Know that Lord, he is God; he made us, and not we ourselves, his people and sheep of his pasture.
brenton_translation: Know that the Lord he is God; he made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

fresh_translation: Enter his gates in confession, his courts in hymns; confess to him, praise his name.
brenton_translation: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with hymns; give thanks to him, praise his name.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord kind; forever his mercy, and unto generation and generation his truth.
brenton_translation: For the Lord is good, his mercy is for ever; and his truth endures to generation and generation.

fresh_translation: Of David. Psalm. Mercy and judgment I will sing to you, Lord.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: I will sing and understand in blameless way. When will you come to me? I walked in the innocence of my heart in the midst of my house.
brenton_translation: and I will be wise in a blameless way. When wilt thou come to me? I walked in the innocence of my heart, in the midst of my house.

fresh_translation: I did not set before my eyes lawless thing; those doing transgressions I hated.
brenton_translation: I have not set before mine eyes any unlawful thing; I have hated transgressors.

fresh_translation: Crooked heart did not cling to me; when evil one turned away from me, I did not know him.
brenton_translation: A perverse heart has not cleaved to me; I have not known an evil man, forasmuch as he turns away from me.

fresh_translation: One slandering his neighbor secretly, this one I drove out; one with proud eye and insatiable heart, with this one I did not eat.
brenton_translation: Him that privily speaks against his neighbour, him have I driven from me: he that is proud in look and insatiable in heart,—with him I have not eaten.

fresh_translation: My eyes upon faithful ones of earth, so that they may sit with me; one walking in blameless way, this one served me.
brenton_translation: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walked in a perfect way, the same ministered to me.

fresh_translation: One doing pride did not dwell in the midst of my house; one speaking unjust things did not go straight before my eyes.
brenton_translation: The proud doer dwelt not in the midst of my house; the unjust speaker prospered not in my sight.

fresh_translation: In mornings I killed all sinners of earth, to destroy from the city of the Lord all workers of lawlessness.
brenton_translation: Early did I slay all the sinners of the land, that I might destroy out of the city of the Lord all that work iniquity.

fresh_translation: Prayer for the poor man, when he grows faint and pours out his supplication before the Lord.
brenton_translation: A Prayer for the Poor; when he is deeply afflicted, and pours out his supplication before the Lord.

fresh_translation: Hear, Lord, my prayer, and let my cry come to you.
brenton_translation: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come to thee.

fresh_translation: Do not turn your face from me in whatever day I am afflicted; incline your ear to me; in whatever day I call on you, quickly hear me.
brenton_translation: Turn not away thy face from me: in the day when I am afflicted, incline thine ear to me: in the day when I shall call upon thee, speedily hear me.

fresh_translation: Because my days failed like smoke, and my bones were scorched like brushwood.
brenton_translation: For my days have vanished like smoke, and my bones have been parched like a stick.

fresh_translation: My heart was struck like grass and dried up, because I forgot to eat my bread.
brenton_translation: I am blighted like grass, and my heart is dried up; for I have forgotten to eat my bread.

fresh_translation: From the voice of my groaning, my bone clung to my flesh.
brenton_translation: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bone has cleaved to my flesh.

fresh_translation: I became like a desert pelican; I became like night-raven in ruined place.
brenton_translation: I have become like a pelican of the wilderness;

fresh_translation: I kept watch and became like a sparrow solitary on housetop.
brenton_translation: I have become like an owl in a ruined house. I have watched, and am become as a sparrow dwelling alone on a roof.

fresh_translation: Whole day my enemies reproached me, and those praising me swore against me.
brenton_translation: All the day long mine enemies have reproached me; and they that praised me have sworn against me.

fresh_translation: Because I ate ash like bread and mixed my drink with weeping,
brenton_translation: For I have eaten ashes as it were bread, and mingled my drink with weeping;

fresh_translation: from the face of your anger and your fury, because lifting me up you dashed me down.
brenton_translation: because of thine anger and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and dashed me down.

fresh_translation: My days declined like a shadow, and I dried up like grass.
brenton_translation: My days have declined like a shadow; and I am withered like grass.

fresh_translation: But you, Lord, remain forever, and your memorial to generation and generation.
brenton_translation: But thou, Lord, endurest for ever, and thy memorial to generation and generation.

fresh_translation: You, rising up, will have compassion on Zion, because time to pity her, because time came.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Sion: for it is time to have mercy upon her, for the set time is come.

fresh_translation: Because your servants took pleasure in her stones and will pity her dust.
brenton_translation: For thy servants have taken pleasure in her stones, and they shall pity her dust.

fresh_translation: And nations will fear the name of the Lord, and all kings of the earth your glory.
brenton_translation: So the nations shall fear thy name, O Lord, and all kings thy glory.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord will build Zion and will be seen in his glory.
brenton_translation: For the Lord shall build up Sion, and shall appear in his glory.

fresh_translation: He looked upon the prayer of humble ones and did not despise their supplication.
brenton_translation: He has had regard to the prayer of the lowly, and has not despised their petition.

fresh_translation: Let this be written for another generation, and people being created will praise the Lord,
brenton_translation: Let this be written for another generation; and the people that shall be created shall praise the Lord.

fresh_translation: because he looked down from the height of his holy place; The Lord from heaven looked upon earth,
brenton_translation: For he has looked out from the height of his sanctuary; the Lord looked upon the earth from heaven;

fresh_translation: to hear groaning of chained ones, to loose sons of those put to death,
brenton_translation: to hear the groaning of the fettered ones, to loosen the sons of the slain;

fresh_translation: to declare in Zion the name of the Lord and his praise in Jerusalem,
brenton_translation: to proclaim the name of the Lord in Sion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

fresh_translation: when peoples are gathered together and kingdoms to serve Lord.
brenton_translation: when the people are gathered together, and the kings, to serve the Lord.

fresh_translation: He answered him in the way of his strength, Tell me fewness of my days.
brenton_translation: He answered him in the way of his strength: tell me the fewness of my days.

fresh_translation: Do not bring me up in half of my days; your years through the generations of generations.
brenton_translation: Take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are through all generations.

fresh_translation: At beginnings, you, Lord, founded earth, and heavens works of your hands.
brenton_translation: In the beginning thou, O Lord, didst lay the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands.

fresh_translation: They will perish, but you remain; and all will grow old like a garment, and like a cloak you will change them, and they will be changed.
brenton_translation: They shall perish, but thou remainest: and they all shall wax old as a garment; and as a vesture shalt thou fold them, and they shall be changed.

fresh_translation: But you same, and your years will not fail.
brenton_translation: But thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

fresh_translation: Sons of your servants will dwell, and their seed will be directed forever.
brenton_translation: The children of thy servants shall dwell securely, and their seed shall prosper for ever.

fresh_translation: Of David. Bless the Lord, my soul, and all within me, his holy name.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Bless the Lord, my soul, and do not forget all his repayments,
brenton_translation: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his praises:

fresh_translation: the one propitiating all your lawlessnesses, the one healing all your diseases,
brenton_translation: who forgives all thy transgressions, who heals all thy diseases;

fresh_translation: the one redeeming your life from corruption, the one crowning you in mercy and compassions,
brenton_translation: who redeems thy life from corruption; who crowns thee with mercy and compassion;

fresh_translation: the one filling your desire with good things; your youth will be renewed like an eagle.
brenton_translation: who satisfies thy desire with good things: so that thy youth shall be renewed like that of the eagle.

fresh_translation: The Lord doing mercies and judgment for all suffering injustice.
brenton_translation: The Lord executes mercy and judgment for all that are injured.

fresh_translation: He made known his ways to Moses, to the sons of Israel his wills.
brenton_translation: He made known his ways to Moses, his will to the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: Compassionate and merciful Lord, long-suffering and rich in mercy.
brenton_translation: The Lord is compassionate and pitiful, long-suffering, and full of mercy.

fresh_translation: He will not be angry to end, nor rage forever.
brenton_translation: He will not be always angry; neither will he be wrathful for ever.

fresh_translation: Not according to our sins did he do to us, nor according to our lawlessnesses did he repay us.
brenton_translation: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor recompensed us according to our iniquities.

fresh_translation: Because according to height of heaven from earth, the Lord strengthened his mercy upon those fearing him.
brenton_translation: For as the heaven is high above the earth, the Lord has so increased his mercy toward them that fear him.

fresh_translation: As far as east from west, he removed our lawlessnesses from us.
brenton_translation: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

fresh_translation: As father has compassion on sons, the Lord had compassion on those fearing him.
brenton_translation: As a father pities his children, the Lord pities them that fear him.

fresh_translation: Because he knew our formation; remember that we are dust.
brenton_translation: For he knows our frame: remember that we are dust.

fresh_translation: Man, his days like grass; like a flower of field, so he will flower.
brenton_translation: As for man, his days are as grass; as a flower of the field, so shall he flourish.

fresh_translation: Because wind passed in him and he will not exist, and he will no longer know his place.
brenton_translation: For the wind passes over it, and it shall not be; and it shall know its place no more.

fresh_translation: But mercy of the Lord from age and until age upon those fearing him, and his righteousness upon the sons of sons,
brenton_translation: But the mercy of the Lord is from generation to generation upon them that fear him, and his righteousness to children's children;

fresh_translation: to those keeping his covenant and remembering his commandments to do them.
brenton_translation: to them that keep his covenant, and remember his commandments to do them.

fresh_translation: The Lord prepared his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules all.
brenton_translation: The Lord has prepared his throne in the heaven; and his kingdom rules over all.

fresh_translation: Bless the Lord, all his angels, mighty in strength, doing his word, to hear the voice of his words.
brenton_translation: Bless the Lord, all ye his angels, mighty in strength, who perform his bidding, ready to hearken to the voice of his words.

fresh_translation: Bless the Lord, all his powers, his ministers doing his will.
brenton_translation: Bless the Lord, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his that do his will.

fresh_translation: Bless the Lord, all his works, in every place of his lordship; bless the Lord, my soul.
brenton_translation: Bless the Lord, all his works, in every place of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.

fresh_translation: Of David. Bless the Lord, my soul. Lord my God, you were made exceedingly great; confession and beauty you clothed yourself with,
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: wrapping yourself in light like a garment, stretching out heaven like skin,
brenton_translation: who dost robe thyself with light as with a garment; spreading out the heaven as a curtain.

fresh_translation: roofing his upper rooms in waters, setting clouds as his ascent, walking on the wings of winds,
brenton_translation: Who covers his chambers with waters; who makes the clouds his chariot; who walks on the wings of the wind.

fresh_translation: making his angels spirits and his ministers flaming fire,
brenton_translation: Who makes his angels spirits, and his ministers a flaming fire.

fresh_translation: who founded earth on its security; it will not be inclined forever and ever.
brenton_translation: Who establishes the earth on her sure foundation: it shall not be moved for ever.

fresh_translation: Deep like a garment its covering; on mountains waters will stand.
brenton_translation: The deep, as it were a garment, is his covering: the waters shall stand on the hills.

fresh_translation: From your rebuke they will flee; from the voice of your thunder they will fear.
brenton_translation: At thy rebuke they shall flee; at the voice of thy thunder they shall be alarmed.

fresh_translation: Mountains go up and plains go down to place which you founded for them.
brenton_translation: They go up to the mountains, and down to the plains, to the place which thou hast founded for them.

fresh_translation: You set boundary they will not pass, nor return to cover earth.
brenton_translation: Thou hast set a bound which they shall not pass, neither shall they turn again to cover the earth.

fresh_translation: One sending out springs in valleys; among mountains waters will pass.
brenton_translation: He sends forth his fountains among the valleys: the waters shall run between the mountains.

fresh_translation: They give drink to all the beasts of the field; wild donkeys will receive for their thirst.
brenton_translation: They shall give drink to all the wild beasts of the field: the wild asses shall take of them to quench their thirst.

fresh_translation: Upon them birds of heaven will dwell; from the midst of rocks they will give voice.
brenton_translation: By them shall the birds of the sky lodge: they shall utter a voice out of the midst of the rocks.

fresh_translation: One watering mountains from his upper rooms; from the fruit of your works earth will be satisfied.
brenton_translation: He waters the mountains from his chambers: the earth shall be satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

fresh_translation: One causing grass to spring up for cattle and green plant for the service of men, to bring bread out of earth,
brenton_translation: He makes grass to grow for the cattle, and green herb for the service of men, to bring bread out of the earth;

fresh_translation: and wine gladdens the heart of man, to brighten the face with oil, and bread strengthens the heart of man.
brenton_translation: and wine makes glad the heart of man, to make his face cheerful with oil: and bread strengthens man's heart.

fresh_translation: The trees of the plain will be filled, cedars of Lebanon which he planted.
brenton_translation: The trees of the plain shall be full of sap; even the cedars of Libanus which he has planted.

fresh_translation: There sparrows will nest; house of stork leads them.
brenton_translation: There the sparrows will build their nests; and the house of the heron takes the lead among them.

fresh_translation: High mountains for deer, rock refuge for rock-badgers.
brenton_translation: The high mountains are a refuge for the stags, and the rock for the rabbits.

fresh_translation: He made moon for seasons; sun knew its setting.
brenton_translation: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knows his going down.

fresh_translation: You set darkness, and night came; in it all beasts of the forest will pass through.
brenton_translation: Thou didst make darkness, and it was night; in it all the wild beasts of the forest will be abroad:

fresh_translation: Lion-cubs roaring to seize and to seek food for themselves from God.
brenton_translation: even young lions roaring for prey, and to seek meat for themselves from God.

fresh_translation: Sun rose, and they were gathered, and in their dens they will lie down.
brenton_translation: The sun arises, and they shall be gathered together, and shall lie down in their dens.

fresh_translation: Man will go out to his work and to his labor until evening.
brenton_translation: Man shall go forth to his work, and to his labour till evening.

fresh_translation: How your works were magnified, Lord; in wisdom you made all. Earth was filled with your creation.
brenton_translation: How great are thy works, O Lord! in wisdom hast thou wrought them all: the earth is filled with thy creation.

fresh_translation: This sea, great and broad-spaced: there creeping things without number, small animals with great.
brenton_translation: So is this great and wide sea: there are things creeping innumerable, small animals and great.

fresh_translation: There ships pass through; this dragon you formed to play in it.
brenton_translation: There go the ships; and this dragon whom thou hast made to play in it.

fresh_translation: All look to you to give food to them in due season.
brenton_translation: All wait upon thee, to give them their food in due season.

fresh_translation: When you give to them, they will gather; when you open your hand, all things will be filled with goodness.
brenton_translation: When thou hast given it them, they will gather it; and when thou hast opened thine hand, they shall all be filled with good.

fresh_translation: When you turn away your face, they will be troubled; you will take away their spirit, and they will fail and return to their dust.
brenton_translation: But when thou hast turned away thy face, they shall be troubled: thou wilt take away their breath, and they shall fail, and return to their dust.

fresh_translation: You send out your spirit, and they will be created, and you renew face of the earth.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt send forth thy Spirit, and they shall be created; and thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: Let the glory of the Lord be forever; The Lord will rejoice in his works,
brenton_translation: Let the glory of the Lord be for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in his works;

fresh_translation: one looking upon earth and making it tremble, one touching mountains and they smoke.
brenton_translation: who looks upon the earth, and makes it tremble; who touches the mountains, and they smoke.

fresh_translation: I will sing to the Lord in my life; I will make melody to my God while I exist.
brenton_translation: I will sing to the Lord while I live; I will sing praise to my God while I exist.

fresh_translation: Let my discourse be sweet to him; and I will rejoice in the Lord.
brenton_translation: Let my meditation be sweet to him: and I will rejoice in the Lord.

fresh_translation: Let sinners fail from earth, and lawless ones so as not to exist. Bless the Lord, my soul.
brenton_translation: Let the sinners fail from off the earth, and transgressors, so that they shall be no more. Bless the Lord, O my soul.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. Confess to the Lord and call on his name; declare among nations his works.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Sing to him and make melody to him; recount all his wonders.
brenton_translation: Sing to him, yea, sing praises to him: tell forth all his wonderful works.

fresh_translation: Praise in his holy name; let heart of those seeking the Lord rejoice.
brenton_translation: Glory in his holy name: let the heart of them that seek the Lord rejoice.

fresh_translation: Seek the Lord and be strengthened; seek his face continually.
brenton_translation: Seek ye the Lord, and be strengthened; seek his face continually.

fresh_translation: Remember his wonders which he did, his portents and judgments of his mouth,
brenton_translation: Remember his wonderful works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

fresh_translation: seed of Abraham, his servants, sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.
brenton_translation: ye seed of Abraam, his servants, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

fresh_translation: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
brenton_translation: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

fresh_translation: He remembered his covenant forever, word which he commanded for thousand generations,
brenton_translation: He has remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded for a thousand generations:

fresh_translation: which he arranged with Abraham and his oath to Isaac.
brenton_translation: which he established as a covenant to Abraam, and he remembered his oath to Isaac.

fresh_translation: And he set it to Jacob for ordinance and to Israel everlasting covenant,
brenton_translation: And he established it to Jacob for an ordinance, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant;

fresh_translation: saying, To you I will give the land of Canaan, line-measure of your inheritance,
brenton_translation: saying, To thee will I give the land of Chanaan, the line of your inheritance:

fresh_translation: when they were few in number, very few and sojourners in it,
brenton_translation: when they were few in number, very few, and sojourners in it.

fresh_translation: and they passed from nation to nation, from kingdom to another people.
brenton_translation: And they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people.

fresh_translation: He did not allow man to do them injustice, and he reproved kings for their sake:
brenton_translation: He suffered no man to wrong them; and he rebuked kings for their sakes:

fresh_translation: Do not touch my anointed ones, and in my prophets do not do evil.
brenton_translation: saying, Touch not my anointed ones; and do my prophets no harm.

fresh_translation: And he called famine upon earth; he crushed every support of bread.
brenton_translation: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land; he broke the whole support of bread.

fresh_translation: He sent before them man; Joseph was sold for slave.
brenton_translation: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a slave.

fresh_translation: They humbled his feet in shackles; iron went through his soul,
brenton_translation: They hurt his feet with fetters; his soul passed into iron,

fresh_translation: until his word came; saying of the Lord refined him.
brenton_translation: until the time that his cause came on; the word of the Lord tried him as fire.

fresh_translation: King sent and loosed him, ruler of peoples and released him.
brenton_translation: The king sent and loosed him; even the prince of the people, and let him go free.

fresh_translation: He made him lord of his house and ruler of all his possession,
brenton_translation: He made him lord over his house, and ruler of all his substance;

fresh_translation: to discipline his rulers like himself and make his elders wise.
brenton_translation: to chastise his rulers at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

fresh_translation: And Israel entered into Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
brenton_translation: Israel also came into Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Cham.

fresh_translation: And he increased his people exceedingly and strengthened it beyond its enemies.
brenton_translation: And he increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their enemies.

fresh_translation: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal deceitfully with his servants.
brenton_translation: And he turned their heart to hate his people, to deal craftily with his servants.

fresh_translation: He sent Moses his servant, Aaron whom he chose,
brenton_translation: He sent forth Moses his servant, and Aaron whom he had chosen.

fresh_translation: he set among them words of his signs and portents in the land of Ham.
brenton_translation: He established among them his signs, and his wonders in the land of Cham.

fresh_translation: He sent darkness and darkened, and they provoked his words.
brenton_translation: He sent forth darkness, and made it dark; yet they rebelled against his words.

fresh_translation: He turned their waters to blood and killed their fish.
brenton_translation: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

fresh_translation: Their land teemed with frogs in the chambers of their kings.
brenton_translation: Their land produced frogs abundantly, in the chambers of their kings.

fresh_translation: He spoke, and dog-fly came, and gnats in all their borders.
brenton_translation: He spoke, and the dog-fly came, and lice in all their coasts.

fresh_translation: He made their rains hail, burning fire in their land.
brenton_translation: He turned their rain into hail, and sent flaming fire in their land.

fresh_translation: And he struck their vines and their fig trees and shattered every tree of their border.
brenton_translation: And he smote their vines and their fig-trees; and broke every tree of their coast.

fresh_translation: He spoke, and locust came, and young locust without number,
brenton_translation: He spoke, and the locust came, and caterpillars innumerable,

fresh_translation: and devoured all grass in their land and devoured fruit of their earth.
brenton_translation: and devoured all the grass in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

fresh_translation: And he struck every firstborn in their land, firstfruits of all their labor.
brenton_translation: He smote also every first-born of their land, the first-fruits of all their labour.

fresh_translation: And he led them out with silver and gold, and there was none weak in their tribes.
brenton_translation: And he brought them out with silver and gold; and there was not a feeble one among their tribes.

fresh_translation: Egypt rejoiced in their departure, because fear of them fell upon them.
brenton_translation: Egypt rejoiced at their departing; for the fear of them fell upon them.

fresh_translation: He spread out cloud for covering to them and fire to give them light by night.
brenton_translation: He spread out a cloud for a covering to them, and fire to give them light by night.

fresh_translation: They asked, and quail came, and bread of heaven filled them.
brenton_translation: They asked, and the quail came, and he satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

fresh_translation: He split rock and waters flowed; rivers went in waterless places.
brenton_translation: He clave the rock, and the waters flowed; rivers ran in dry places.

fresh_translation: Because he remembered his holy word to Abraham his servant.
brenton_translation: For he remembered his holy word, which he promised to Abraam his servant.

fresh_translation: And he led out his people with exultation and his chosen ones with gladness.
brenton_translation: And he brought out his people with exultation, and his chosen with joy;

fresh_translation: And he gave them lands of nations, and they inherited labors of peoples,
brenton_translation: and gave them the lands of the heathen; and they inherited the labours of the people;

fresh_translation: so that they might keep his ordinances and seek out his law.
brenton_translation: that they might keep his ordinances, and diligently seek his law.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. Confess to the Lord, because kind, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Who will speak powers of the Lord, make all his praises heard?
brenton_translation: Who shall tell the mighty acts of the Lord? who shall cause all his praises to be heard?

fresh_translation: Blessed are those keeping judgment and doing righteousness in every time.
brenton_translation: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and do righteousness at all times.

fresh_translation: Remember us, Lord, in good pleasure of your people; visit us in your salvation,
brenton_translation: Remember us, O Lord, with the favour thou hast to thy people: visit us with thy salvation;

fresh_translation: to see in goodness of your chosen ones, to rejoice in the gladness of your nation, to be praised with your inheritance.
brenton_translation: that we may behold the good of thine elect, that we may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that we may glory with thine inheritance.

fresh_translation: We sinned with our fathers, we acted lawlessly, we did injustice.
brenton_translation: We have sinned with our fathers, we have transgressed, we have done unrighteously.

fresh_translation: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand your wonders; they did not remember multitude of your mercy and provoked while going up at Red Sea.
brenton_translation: Our fathers in Egypt understood not thy wonders, and remembered not the multitude of thy mercy; but provoked him as they went up by the Red Sea.

fresh_translation: And he saved them for the sake of his name, to make known his dominion.
brenton_translation: Yet he saved them for his name's sake, that he might cause his mighty power to be known.

fresh_translation: And he rebuked Red Sea and it dried up, and he guided them in deep as in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up: so he led them through the deep as through the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And he saved them from the hand of those hating and redeemed them from the hand of enemy.
brenton_translation: And he saved them out of the hand of them that hated them, and redeemed them out of the hand of the enemy.

fresh_translation: And water covered those afflicting them; not one of them was left.
brenton_translation: The water covered those that oppressed them: there was not one of them left.

fresh_translation: And they believed in his words and sang his praise.
brenton_translation: Then they believed his words, and celebrated his praise.

fresh_translation: They hurried, they forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel.
brenton_translation: They made haste, they forgot his works; they waited not for his counsel.

fresh_translation: And they desired desire in the wilderness and tested God in waterless place.
brenton_translation: And they lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the dry land.

fresh_translation: And he gave them their request and sent fullness into their souls.
brenton_translation: And he gave them their request, and sent fulness into their souls.

fresh_translation: And they angered Moses in camp, and Aaron, holy one of the Lord.
brenton_translation: They provoked Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the holy one of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Earth opened and swallowed Dathan and covered over assembly of Abiram.
brenton_translation: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and closed upon the congregation of Abiron.

fresh_translation: And fire burned in their assembly; flame consumed sinners.
brenton_translation: And a fire was kindled in their congregation, and a flame burnt up the sinners.

fresh_translation: And they made calf in Horeb and worshiped carved image.
brenton_translation: And they made a calf in Choreb, and worshipped the graven image,

fresh_translation: And they exchanged their glory for likeness of calf eating grass.
brenton_translation: and they changed their glory into the similitude of a calf that feeds on grass.

fresh_translation: They forgot God saving them, one doing great things in Egypt,
brenton_translation: They forgot God that saved them, who had wrought great deeds in Egypt;

fresh_translation: wondrous things in the land of Ham, fearful things by Red Sea.
brenton_translation: wondrous works in the land of Cham, and terrible things at the Red Sea.

fresh_translation: And he said to destroy them, if not Moses, his chosen one, stood in breaking before him to turn back his anger, so as not to destroy.
brenton_translation: So he said that he would have destroyed them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn him away from the fierceness of his anger, so that he should not destroy them.

fresh_translation: And they despised desirable land; they did not believe his word.
brenton_translation: Moreover they set at nought the desirable land, and believed not his word.

fresh_translation: And they grumbled in their tents; they did not hear the voice of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they murmured in their tents: they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he raised his hand against them, to cast them down in the wilderness,
brenton_translation: So he lifted up his hand against them, to cast them down in the wilderness;

fresh_translation: and to cast down their seed among nations and scatter them in lands.
brenton_translation: and to cast down their seed among the nations, and to scatter them in the countries.

fresh_translation: And they were joined to Baal-peor and ate sacrifices of dead ones.
brenton_translation: They were joined also to Beelphegor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead. And they provoked him with their devices;

fresh_translation: And they provoked him in their practices, and falling was multiplied among them.
brenton_translation: and destruction was multiplied among them.

fresh_translation: And Phinehas stood and propitiated, and breaking ceased.
brenton_translation: Then Phinees stood up, and made atonement: and the plague ceased.

fresh_translation: And it was counted to him as righteousness from generation to generation forever.
brenton_translation: And it was counted to him for righteousness, to all generations for ever.

fresh_translation: And they angered him at the water of contradiction, and Moses was harmed because of them,
brenton_translation: They provoked him also at the water of Strife, and Moses was hurt for their sakes;

fresh_translation: because they provoked his spirit, and he distinguished with his lips.
brenton_translation: for they provoked his spirit, and he spoke unadvisedly with his lips.

fresh_translation: They did not destroy nations which the Lord told them,
brenton_translation: They destroyed not the nations which the Lord told them to destroy;

fresh_translation: and they mixed among nations and learned their works.
brenton_translation: but were mingled with the heathen, and learned their works.

fresh_translation: And they served their carved images, and it became to them stumbling-block.
brenton_translation: And they served their graven images; and it became an offence to them.

fresh_translation: And they sacrificed their sons and daughters to demons,
brenton_translation: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to devils,

fresh_translation: and poured out innocent blood, blood of their sons and daughters whom they sacrificed to carved images of Canaan, and land was stained with bloods.
brenton_translation: and shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Chanaan; and the land was defiled with blood,

fresh_translation: And they were defiled in their works and prostituted in their practices.
brenton_translation: and was polluted with their works; and they went a whoring with their own devices.

fresh_translation: And the Lord was angered in fury against his people and abhorred his inheritance.
brenton_translation: So the Lord was very angry with his people, and he abhorred his inheritance.

fresh_translation: And he handed them into the hands of nations, and those hating them ruled over them.
brenton_translation: And he delivered them into the hands of their enemies; and they that hated them ruled over them.

fresh_translation: And their enemies afflicted them, and they were humbled under their hands.
brenton_translation: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were brought down under their hands.

fresh_translation: Many times he rescued them, but they provoked him in their counsel and were humbled in their lawlessnesses.
brenton_translation: Many a time he delivered them; but they provoked him by their counsel, and they were brought low by their iniquities.

fresh_translation: And he saw when they were afflicted, when he heard their supplication.
brenton_translation: Yet the Lord looked upon their affliction, when he heard their petition.

fresh_translation: And he remembered his covenant and relented according to the multitude of his mercy.
brenton_translation: And he remembered his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercy.

fresh_translation: And he gave them into compassions before all who had taken them captive.
brenton_translation: And he caused them to be pitied in the sight of all who carried them captive.

fresh_translation: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from the nations, to confess to your holy name, to boast in your praise.
brenton_translation: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, that we may glory in thy praise.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord God of Israel from age and until age, and let all the people say, Amen, amen.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting and to everlasting; and all the people shall say, Amen, Amen.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. Confess to the Lord, because kind, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Let those redeemed by the Lord say so, whom he redeemed from the hand of enemy
brenton_translation: Let them say so who have been redeemed by the Lord, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

fresh_translation: and gathered them from lands, from east and west and north and sea.
brenton_translation: and gathered them out of the countries, from the east, and west, and north, and south.

fresh_translation: They wandered in the wilderness, in waterless place; they did not find way of the city of dwelling.
brenton_translation: They wandered in the wilderness in a dry land; they found no way to a city of habitation.

fresh_translation: Hungry and thirsty, their soul in them failed.
brenton_translation: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

fresh_translation: And they cried to the Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he rescued them.
brenton_translation: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

fresh_translation: And he guided them in straight way to go into the city of dwelling.
brenton_translation: And he guided them into a straight path, that they might go to a city of habitation.

fresh_translation: Let them confess to the Lord his mercies and his wonders to the sons of men,
brenton_translation: Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies, and his wonderful works to the children of men.

fresh_translation: because he satisfied empty soul, and hungry soul he filled with good things.
brenton_translation: For he satisfies the empty soul, and fills the hungry soul with good things,

fresh_translation: Those sitting in darkness and the shadow of death, chained in poverty and iron,
brenton_translation: even them that sit in darkness and the shadow of death, fettered in poverty and iron;

fresh_translation: because they provoked the words of God and angered counsel of Most High.
brenton_translation: because they rebelled against the words of God, and provoked the counsel of the Most High.

fresh_translation: And their heart was humbled in labors; they grew weak, and there was none helping.
brenton_translation: So their heart was brought low with troubles; they were weak, and there was no helper.

fresh_translation: And they cried to the Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he saved them.
brenton_translation: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction, and he saved them out of their distresses.

fresh_translation: And he led them out from darkness and the shadow of death and tore apart their bonds.
brenton_translation: And he brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bonds asunder.

fresh_translation: Let them confess to the Lord his mercies and his wonders to the sons of men,
brenton_translation: Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies, and his wonders to the children of men.

fresh_translation: because he shattered bronze gates and broke iron bars.
brenton_translation: For he broke to pieces the brazen gates, and crushed the iron bars.

fresh_translation: He took hold of them out of way of their lawlessnesses, for because of their lawlessnesses they were humbled.
brenton_translation: He helped them out of the way of their iniquity; for they were brought low because of their iniquities.

fresh_translation: Their soul abhorred all food, and they drew near to the gates of death.
brenton_translation: Their soul abhorred all meat; and they drew near to the gates of death.

fresh_translation: And they cried to the Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he saved them.
brenton_translation: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction, and he saved them out of their distresses.

fresh_translation: He sent his word and healed them and rescued them from their corruptions.
brenton_translation: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them out of their destructions.

fresh_translation: Let them confess to the Lord his mercies and his wonders to the sons of men,
brenton_translation: Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies, and his wonderful works to the children of men.

fresh_translation: and let them offer a sacrifice of praise and declare his works in exultation.
brenton_translation: And let them offer to him the sacrifice of praise, and proclaim his works with exultation.

fresh_translation: Those going down into sea in ships, doing business in many waters,
brenton_translation: They that go down to the sea in ships, doing business in many waters;

fresh_translation: they saw works of the Lord and his wonders in deep.
brenton_translation: these men have seen the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

fresh_translation: He spoke, and storm wind stood, and its waves were lifted up.
brenton_translation: He speaks, and the stormy wind arises, and its waves are lifted up.

fresh_translation: They go up to heavens and go down to deeps; their soul in evils was melting.
brenton_translation: They go up to the heavens, and go down to the depths; their soul melts because of troubles.

fresh_translation: They were troubled, they were shaken like a drunkard, and all their wisdom was swallowed up.
brenton_translation: They are troubled, they stagger as a drunkard, and all their wisdom is swallowed up.

fresh_translation: And they cried to the Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he brought them out.
brenton_translation: Then they cry to the Lord in their affliction, and he brings them out of their distresses.

fresh_translation: And he commanded storm, and it stood to breeze, and its waves were silent.
brenton_translation: And he commands the storm, and it is calmed into a gentle breeze, and its waves are still.

fresh_translation: And they rejoiced because they were quiet, and he guided them to harbor of their will.
brenton_translation: And they are glad, because they are quiet; and he guides them to their desired haven.

fresh_translation: Let them confess to the Lord his mercies and his wonders to the sons of men,
brenton_translation: Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies, and his wonderful works to the children of men.

fresh_translation: let them exalt him in the assembly of the people, and in the seat of elders let them praise him.
brenton_translation: Let them exalt him in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

fresh_translation: He made rivers into desert and outgoings of waters into thirst,
brenton_translation: He turns rivers into a desert, and streams of water into a dry land;

fresh_translation: fruitful land into salt-flat because of evil of those dwelling in it.
brenton_translation: a fruitful land into saltness, for the wickedness of them that dwell in it.

fresh_translation: He made desert into pools of waters and waterless land into outgoings of waters.
brenton_translation: He turns a wilderness into pools of water, and a dry land into streams of water.

fresh_translation: And he settled there hungry ones, and they established city of dwelling.
brenton_translation: And there he causes the hungry to dwell, and they establish for themselves cities of habitation.

fresh_translation: And they sowed fields and planted vineyards and made fruit of produce.
brenton_translation: And they sow fields, and plant vineyards, and they yield fruit of increase.

fresh_translation: And he blessed them, and they multiplied exceedingly, and their cattle he did not lessen.
brenton_translation: And he blesses them, and they multiply exceedingly, and he diminishes not the number of their cattle.

fresh_translation: And they were few and afflicted from the affliction of evils and pain.
brenton_translation: Again they become few, and are brought low, by the pressure of evils and pain.

fresh_translation: Contempt was poured out upon rulers, and he made them wander in trackless place and not way.
brenton_translation: Contempt is poured upon their princes, and he causes them to wander in a desert and trackless land.

fresh_translation: And he helped a poor man out of poverty and made families like sheep.
brenton_translation: But he helps the poor out of poverty, and makes him families as a flock.

fresh_translation: Straight ones will see and rejoice, and all lawlessness will shut its mouth.
brenton_translation: The upright shall see and rejoice; and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

fresh_translation: Who wise and will keep these things? And they will understand mercies of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Who is wise, and will observe these things, and understand the mercies of the Lord?

fresh_translation: Song of psalm of David.
brenton_translation: Song of a Psalm by David.

fresh_translation: Ready my heart, O God, ready my heart; I will sing and make melody in my glory.
brenton_translation: O God, my heart is ready, my heart is ready; I will sing and sing psalms with my glory.

fresh_translation: Awake, psaltery and lyre; I will awake at dawn.
brenton_translation: Awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake early.

fresh_translation: I will confess to you among peoples, Lord, and sing to you among nations,
brenton_translation: I will give thanks to thee, O Lord, among the people; I will sing praise to thee among the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: because great above heavens your mercy and unto clouds your truth.
brenton_translation: For thy mercy is great above the heavens, and thy truth reaches to the clouds.

fresh_translation: Be exalted above heavens, O God, and over all the earth your glory.
brenton_translation: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; and thy glory above all the earth.

fresh_translation: So that your beloved ones may be rescued, save with your right hand and hear me.
brenton_translation: That thy beloved ones may be delivered, save with thy right hand, and hear me. God has spoken in his sanctuary;

fresh_translation: God spoke in his holy place: I will be exalted and divide Shechem and valley of tents I will measure out.
brenton_translation: I will be exalted, and will divide Sicima, and will measure out the valley of tents.

fresh_translation: Mine Gilead and mine Manasseh, and Ephraim support of my head, Judah my king.
brenton_translation: Galaad is mine; and Manasses is mine; and Ephraim is the help of mine head; Judas is my king;

fresh_translation: Moab cauldron of my hope; upon Edom I will stretch out my sandal; foreigners were subjected to me.
brenton_translation: Moab is the caldron of my hope; over Idumea will I cast my sandal; the Philistines are made subject to me.

fresh_translation: Who will bring me into fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Edom?
brenton_translation: Who will bring me into the fortified city? or who will guide me to Idumea?

fresh_translation: Is it not you, O God, who rejected us? And God will not go out with our powers.
brenton_translation: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast rejected us? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

fresh_translation: Give us help from affliction, and salvation of man is vain.
brenton_translation: Give us help from tribulation: for vain is the help of man.

fresh_translation: In God we will do mighty deed, and he will despise our enemies.
brenton_translation: Through God we shall do valiantly; and he will bring to nought our enemies.

fresh_translation: For end, of David, psalm. O God, my praise, do not pass over in silence,
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: because the mouth of a sinner and the mouth of a deceitful one opened against me; they spoke against me with a deceitful tongue.
brenton_translation: for the mouth of the sinner and the mouth of the crafty man have been opened against me: they have spoken against me with a crafty tongue.

fresh_translation: And with the words of hatred they surrounded me and fought me without cause.
brenton_translation: And they have compassed me with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

fresh_translation: Instead of loving me they slandered me, but I was praying.
brenton_translation: Instead of loving me, they falsely accused me: but I continued to pray.

fresh_translation: And they set against me evils for good things and hatred for my love.
brenton_translation: And they rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

fresh_translation: Appoint sinner over him, and let devil stand at his right hand.
brenton_translation: Set thou a sinner against him; and let the devil stand at his right hand.

fresh_translation: When he is judged, let him go out condemned, and let his prayer become sin.
brenton_translation: When he is judged, let him go forth condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

fresh_translation: Let his days become few, and let another take his oversight.
brenton_translation: Let his days be few: and let another take his office of overseer.

fresh_translation: Let his sons become orphans and his wife widow.
brenton_translation: Let his children be orphans, and his wife a widow.
