fresh_translation: Trembling, let his sons wander and beg; let them be cast out from their homesteads.
brenton_translation: Let his children wander without a dwelling-place, and beg: let them be cast out of their habitations.

fresh_translation: Let lender search out all things he has; let strangers plunder his labors.
brenton_translation: Let his creditor exact all that belongs to him: and let strangers spoil his labours.

fresh_translation: Let there be no supporter for him, nor let there be one compassionate to his orphans.
brenton_translation: Let him have no helper; neither let there be any one to have compassion on his fatherless children.

fresh_translation: Let his children be for destruction; in one generation let his name be blotted out.
brenton_translation: Let his children be given up to utter destruction: in one generation let his name be blotted out.

fresh_translation: Let lawlessness of his fathers be remembered before the Lord, and sin of his mother let it not be blotted out.
brenton_translation: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

fresh_translation: Let them be before the Lord continually, and let their memory be destroyed from earth,
brenton_translation: Let them be before the Lord continually; and let their memorial be blotted out from the earth.

fresh_translation: because he did not remember to do mercy and pursued poor and needy man and one pierced in heart to kill.
brenton_translation: Because he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the needy and poor man, and that to slay him that was pricked in the heart.

fresh_translation: And he loved curse, and it will come to him; and he did not want blessing, and it will be far from him.
brenton_translation: He loved cursing also, and it shall come upon him; and he took not pleasure in blessing, so it shall be removed far from him.

fresh_translation: And he clothed himself with curse like a garment, and it entered like water into his inward parts and like oil into his bones.
brenton_translation: Yea, he put on cursing as a garment, and it is come as water into his bowels, and as oil into his bones.

fresh_translation: Let it become to him like a garment he wraps around and like belt which he girds continually.
brenton_translation: Let it be to him as a garment which he puts on, and as a girdle with which he girds himself continually.

fresh_translation: This work of those slandering me from the Lord and of those speaking evil against my soul.
brenton_translation: This is the dealing of the Lord with those who falsely accuse me, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

fresh_translation: But you, Lord, Lord, deal mercifully with me for the sake of your name, because your mercy kind.
brenton_translation: But thou, O Lord, Lord, deal mercifully with me, for thy name's sake: for thy mercy is good.

fresh_translation: Rescue me, because I poor and needy, and my heart troubled within me.
brenton_translation: Deliver me, for I am poor and needy; and my heart is troubled within me.

fresh_translation: Like shadow in its decline I was taken away; I was shaken out like locusts.
brenton_translation: I am removed as a shadow in its going down: I am tossed up and down like locusts.

fresh_translation: My knees grew weak from fasting, and my flesh was changed away from oil.
brenton_translation: My knees are weakened through fasting, and my flesh is changed by reason of the want of oil.

fresh_translation: And I became a reproach to them; they saw me and shook their heads.
brenton_translation: I became also a reproach to them: when they saw me they shook their heads.

fresh_translation: Help me, Lord my God; save me according to your mercy.
brenton_translation: Help me, O Lord my God; and save me according to thy mercy.

fresh_translation: And let them know that this your hand, and you, Lord, did it.
brenton_translation: And let them know that this is thy hand; and that thou, Lord, hast wrought it.

fresh_translation: They will curse, but you will bless; those rising against me let them be shamed, but your servant will rejoice.
brenton_translation: Let them curse, but thou shalt bless: let them that rise up against me be ashamed, but let thy servant rejoice.

fresh_translation: Let those slandering me be clothed in shame and wrap their shame around themselves like double-cloak.
brenton_translation: Let those that falsely accuse me be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their shame as with a mantle.

fresh_translation: I will confess to the Lord exceedingly with my mouth, and in the midst of many I will praise him,
brenton_translation: I will give thanks to the Lord abundantly with my mouth; and in the midst of many I will praise him.

fresh_translation: because he stood at the right hand of a poor man to save from those pursuing my soul.
brenton_translation: For he stood on the right hand of the poor, to save me from them that persecute my soul.

fresh_translation: Of David. Psalm. The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand until I place your enemies footstool of your feet.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: The Lord will send rod of your power from Zion, and rule in the midst of your enemies.
brenton_translation: The Lord shall send out a rod of power for thee out of Sion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

fresh_translation: With you beginning in the day of your power, in splendors of holy ones; from womb before morning-star I begot you.
brenton_translation: With thee is dominion in the day of thy power, in the splendours of thy saints: I have begotten thee from the womb before the morning.

fresh_translation: The Lord swore and will not regret, You priest forever according to order of Melchizedek.
brenton_translation: The Lord sware, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever, after the order of Melchisedec.

fresh_translation: The Lord at your right hand crushed kings in the day of his anger.
brenton_translation: The Lord at thy right hand has dashed in pieces kings in the day of his wrath.

fresh_translation: He will judge among nations, he will fill corpses, he will crush heads over the land of many.
brenton_translation: He shall judge among the nations, he shall fill up the number of corpses, he shall crush the heads of many on the earth.

fresh_translation: From torrent in way he will drink; therefore he will lift up head.
brenton_translation: He shall drink of the brook in the way; therefore shall he lift up the head.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. I will confess to you, Lord, with all my heart, in the council of straight ones and gathering.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Great works of the Lord, sought out for all his wills.
brenton_translation: The works of the Lord are great, sought out according to all his will.

fresh_translation: Confession and magnificence his work, and his righteousness remains forever and ever.
brenton_translation: His work is worthy of thanksgiving and honour: and his righteousness endures for ever and ever.

fresh_translation: He made remembrance of his wonders; merciful and compassionate Lord.
brenton_translation: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered: the Lord is merciful and compassionate.

fresh_translation: He gave food to those fearing him; he will remember his covenant forever.
brenton_translation: He has given food to them that fear him: he will remember his covenant for ever.

fresh_translation: He declared strength of his works to his people, to give them inheritance of nations.
brenton_translation: He has declared to his people the power of his works, to give them the inheritance of the heathen.

fresh_translation: The works of his hands truth and judgment; all his commandments faithful,
brenton_translation: The works of his hands are truth and judgment: all his commandments are sure:

fresh_translation: established forever and ever, done in truth and uprightness.
brenton_translation: established for ever and ever, done in truth and uprightness.

fresh_translation: He sent redemption to his people; he commanded his covenant forever; holy and fearful his name.
brenton_translation: He sent redemption to his people: he commanded his covenant for ever: holy and fearful is his name.

fresh_translation: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the Lord; good understanding to all doing it; his praise remains forever and ever.
brenton_translation: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and all that act accordingly have a good understanding; his praise endures for ever and ever.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. Blessed is the man fearing the Lord; in his commandments he will desire greatly.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: His seed will be mighty in earth; generation of straight ones will be blessed.
brenton_translation: His seed shall be mighty in the earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

fresh_translation: Glory and wealth are in his house, and his righteousness remains forever and ever.
brenton_translation: Glory and riches shall be in his house; and his righteousness endures for evermore.

fresh_translation: Light rose in darkness for straight ones, merciful and compassionate and righteous.
brenton_translation: To the upright light has sprung up in darkness: he is pitiful, and merciful, and righteous.

fresh_translation: Good man, one showing compassion and lending, will manage his matters in judgment,
brenton_translation: The good man is he that pities and lends: he will direct his affairs with judgment.

fresh_translation: because forever he will not be shaken; righteous one will be in everlasting remembrance.
brenton_translation: For he shall not be moved for ever; the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

fresh_translation: From evil report he will not fear; his heart ready to hope upon the Lord.
brenton_translation: He shall not be afraid of any evil report: his heart is ready to trust in the Lord.

fresh_translation: His heart is established; he will not fear until he looks upon his enemies.
brenton_translation: His heart is established, he shall not fear, till he shall see his desire upon his enemies.

fresh_translation: He scattered, he gave to poor ones; his righteousness remains forever and ever; his horn will be exalted in glory.
brenton_translation: He has dispersed abroad; he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures for evermore: his horn shall be exalted with honour.

fresh_translation: The sinner will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away; the desire of sinners will perish.
brenton_translation: The sinner shall see and be angry, he shall gnash his teeth, and consume away: the desire of the sinner shall perish.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. Praise, servants, Lord; praise the name of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Let the name of the Lord be blessed from now and until age.
brenton_translation: Let the name of the Lord be blessed, from this present time and for ever.

fresh_translation: From risings of sun until settings, praise the name of the Lord.
brenton_translation: From the rising of the sun to his setting, the name of the Lord is to be praised.

fresh_translation: High over all nations Lord, above heavens his glory.
brenton_translation: The Lord is high above all the nations; his glory is above the heavens.

fresh_translation: Who is like the Lord our God, the one dwelling in heights,
brenton_translation: Who is as the Lord our God? who dwells in the high places,

fresh_translation: and watching low things in heaven and on earth,
brenton_translation: and yet looks upon the low things in heaven, and on the earth:

fresh_translation: one raising poor from earth and lifting needy from dung-heap,
brenton_translation: who lifts up the poor from the earth, and raises up the needy from the dunghill;

fresh_translation: to make him sit with rulers, with the rulers of his people,
brenton_translation: to set him with princes, even with the princes of his people:

fresh_translation: one settling barren woman in a house, joyful mother of children.
brenton_translation: who settles the barren woman in a house, as a mother rejoicing over children.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a barbarous people,
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his authority.
brenton_translation: Judea became his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

fresh_translation: Sea saw and fled; Jordan turned backward.
brenton_translation: The sea saw and fled: Jordan was turned back.

fresh_translation: Mountains skipped like rams, and hills like lambs of sheep.
brenton_translation: The mountains skipped like rams, and the hills like lambs.

fresh_translation: What is with you, sea, that you fled, and you, Jordan, that you turned back?
brenton_translation: What ailed thee, O sea, that thou fleddest? and thou Jordan, that thou wast turned back?

fresh_translation: Mountains, why did you skip like rams, and hills like lambs of sheep?
brenton_translation: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams, and ye hills, like lambs?

fresh_translation: From the face of the Lord earth was shaken, from the face of God of Jacob,
brenton_translation: The earth trembled at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

fresh_translation: who turned rock into pools of waters and flint into springs of waters.
brenton_translation: who turned the rock into pools of water, and the flint into fountains of water.

fresh_translation: Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, upon your mercy and your truth.
brenton_translation: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to thy name give glory, because of thy mercy and thy truth;

fresh_translation: Lest nations say, Where is their God?
brenton_translation: lest at any time the nations should say, Where is their God?

fresh_translation: But our God above in heaven, in heavens and on earth, all things whatever he wanted he did.
brenton_translation: But our God has done in heaven and on earth, whatsoever he has pleased.

fresh_translation: The idols of nations silver and gold, works of the hands of men.
brenton_translation: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the works of men's hands.

fresh_translation: They have mouth and will not speak, eyes and will not see,
brenton_translation: They have a mouth, but they cannot speak; they have eyes, but they cannot see:

fresh_translation: they have ears and will not hear, noses and will not smell,
brenton_translation: they have ears, but they cannot hear; they have noses, but they cannot smell;

fresh_translation: they have hands and will not feel, feet and will not walk; they will not make sound in their throat.
brenton_translation: they have hands, but they cannot handle; they have feet, but they cannot walk: they cannot speak through their throat.

fresh_translation: Let those making them become like them, and all trusting in them.
brenton_translation: Let those that make them become like to them, and all who trust in them.

fresh_translation: The house of Israel hoped on the Lord; he is their helper and defender.
brenton_translation: The house of Israel trusts in the Lord: he is their helper and defender.

fresh_translation: The house of Aaron hoped on the Lord; he is their helper and defender.
brenton_translation: The house of Aaron trusts in the Lord: he is their helper and defender.

fresh_translation: Those fearing the Lord hoped on the Lord; he is their helper and defender.
brenton_translation: They that fear the Lord trust in the Lord: he is their helper and defender.

fresh_translation: The Lord remembered us and blessed us; he blessed the house of Israel, he blessed the house of Aaron.
brenton_translation: The Lord has remembered us, and blessed us: he has blessed the house of Israel, he has blessed the house of Aaron.

fresh_translation: He blessed those fearing the Lord, small with great.
brenton_translation: He has blessed them that fear the Lord, both small and great.

fresh_translation: May the Lord add upon you, upon you and upon your sons.
brenton_translation: The Lord add blessings to you and to your children.

fresh_translation: Blessed are you by the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
brenton_translation: Blessed are ye of the Lord, who made the heaven and the earth.

fresh_translation: The heaven of heaven belongs to the Lord, but the earth he gave to the sons of men.
brenton_translation: The heaven of heavens belongs to the Lord: but he has given the earth to the sons of men.

fresh_translation: Dead ones will not praise you, Lord, nor all going down into Hades.
brenton_translation: The dead shall not praise thee, O Lord, nor any that go down to Hades.

fresh_translation: But we living ones will bless the Lord from now and until age.
brenton_translation: But we, the living, will bless the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. I loved because the Lord will hear the voice of my supplication,
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: because he inclined his ear to me, and in my days I will call upon him.
brenton_translation: Because he has inclined his ear to me, therefore will I call upon him while I live.

fresh_translation: The pangs of death surrounded me, dangers of Hades found me; affliction and pain I found.
brenton_translation: The pangs of death compassed me; the dangers of hell found me: I found affliction and sorrow.

fresh_translation: And the name of the Lord I called upon: O Lord, rescue my soul.
brenton_translation: Then I called on the name of the Lord: O Lord, deliver my soul.

fresh_translation: Merciful Lord and righteous, and our God shows mercy.
brenton_translation: The Lord is merciful and righteous; yea, our God has pity.

fresh_translation: The Lord guards little ones; I was humbled, and he saved me.
brenton_translation: The Lord preserves the simple: I was brought low, and he delivered me.

fresh_translation: Return, my soul, into your rest, because the Lord benefited you.
brenton_translation: Return to thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord has dealt bountifully with thee.

fresh_translation: Because he delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.
brenton_translation: For he has delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

fresh_translation: I will be well-pleasing before the Lord in the land of living ones.
brenton_translation: I shall be well-pleasing before the Lord in the land of the living.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. I believed, therefore I spoke; but I was humbled greatly.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: I said in my ecstasy, Every man liar.
brenton_translation: And I said in mine amazement, Every man is a liar.

fresh_translation: What will I repay to the Lord for all things he repaid me?
brenton_translation: What shall I render to the Lord for all the things wherein he has rewarded me?

fresh_translation: The cup of salvation I will take, and the name of the Lord I will call upon.
brenton_translation: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Precious before the Lord is the death of his holy ones.
brenton_translation: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

fresh_translation: O Lord, I am your servant, I am your servant and son of your handmaid; you tore apart my bonds.
brenton_translation: O Lord, I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast burst my bonds asunder.

fresh_translation: To you I will offer a sacrifice of praise.
brenton_translation: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of praise, and will call upon the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: My vows to the Lord I will pay before all his people,
brenton_translation: I will pay my vows unto the Lord, in the presence of all his people,

fresh_translation: in the courts of the house of the Lord, in your midst, Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: in the courts of the Lord's house, in the midst of thee, Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. Praise the Lord, all nations; praise him, all peoples,
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: because his mercy was strengthened upon us, and truth of the Lord remains forever.
brenton_translation: For his mercy has been abundant toward us: and the truth of the Lord endures for ever.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. Confess to the Lord, because good, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Let the house of Israel say now that he good, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Let now the house of Israel say, that he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: Let the house of Aaron say now that he good, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Let now the house of Aaron say, that he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: Let all fearing the Lord say now that he good, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Let now all that fear the Lord say, that he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: In affliction I called on the Lord, and he heard me into broad place.
brenton_translation: I called on the Lord out of affliction: and he hearkened to me, so as to bring me into a wide place.

fresh_translation: The Lord is helper to me; I will not fear what man will do to me.
brenton_translation: The Lord is my helper; and I will not fear what man shall do to me.

fresh_translation: The Lord is helper to me, and I will look upon my enemies.
brenton_translation: The Lord is my helper; and I shall see my desire upon mine enemies.

fresh_translation: Better to trust upon the Lord than to trust upon man.
brenton_translation: It is better to trust in the Lord than to trust in man.

fresh_translation: Better to hope upon the Lord than to hope upon rulers.
brenton_translation: It is better to hope in the Lord, than to hope in princes.

fresh_translation: All nations surrounded me, and in the name of the Lord I drove them off.
brenton_translation: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I repulsed them.

fresh_translation: Surrounding, they surrounded me, and in the name of the Lord I drove them off.
brenton_translation: They completely compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I repulsed them.

fresh_translation: They surrounded me like bees round honeycomb and were burned like fire in thorns, and in the name of the Lord I drove them off.
brenton_translation: They compassed me about as bees do a honeycomb, and they burst into flame as fire among thorns: but in the name of the Lord I repulsed them.

fresh_translation: Pushed, I was overturned to fall, and the Lord took hold of me.
brenton_translation: I was thrust, and sorely shaken, that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.

fresh_translation: The Lord is my strength and my hymn, and he became to me for salvation.
brenton_translation: The Lord is my strength and my song, and is become my salvation.

fresh_translation: The voice of exultation and salvation in the tents of righteous ones; the right hand of the Lord did a mighty deed.
brenton_translation: The voice of exultation and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord has wrought mightily.

fresh_translation: The right hand of the Lord lifted me up; the right hand of the Lord did a mighty deed.
brenton_translation: The right hand of the Lord has exalted me: the right hand of the Lord has wrought powerfully.

fresh_translation: I will not die, but live, and recount works of the Lord.
brenton_translation: I shall not die, but live, and recount the works of the Lord.

fresh_translation: The Lord disciplined me with discipline, and to death he did not hand me over.
brenton_translation: The Lord has chastened me sore: but he has not given me up to death.

fresh_translation: Open to me gates of righteousness; entering through them I will confess to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and give praise to the Lord.

fresh_translation: This gate of the Lord; righteous ones will enter through it.
brenton_translation: This is the gate of the Lord: the righteous shall enter by it.

fresh_translation: I will confess to you because you heard me and became to me for salvation.
brenton_translation: I will give thanks to thee; because thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

fresh_translation: The stone which builders rejected, this became the head of the corner.
brenton_translation: The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner.

fresh_translation: From the Lord this came to be, and it wondrous in our eyes.
brenton_translation: This has been done of the Lord; and it is wonderful in our eyes.

fresh_translation: This day which the Lord made; let us exult and rejoice in it.
brenton_translation: This is the day which the Lord has made: let us exult and rejoice in it.

fresh_translation: O Lord, save indeed; O Lord, prosper indeed.
brenton_translation: O Lord, save now: O Lord, send now prosperity.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the one coming in the name of the Lord; we blessed you from the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: God Lord and he appeared to us; arrange feast with dense branches, up to horns of altar.
brenton_translation: God is the Lord, and he has shined upon us: celebrate the feast with thick branches, binding the victims even to the horns of the altar.

fresh_translation: You my God, and I will confess to you; you my God, and I will exalt you; I will confess to you because you heard me and became to me for salvation.
brenton_translation: Thou art my God, and I will give thee thanks: thou art my God, and I will exalt thee. I will give thanks to thee, for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

fresh_translation: Confess to the Lord, because good, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: Alleluia. Aleph. Blessed blameless ones in way, those walking in the law of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Blessed are those searching out his testimonies; with all their heart they will seek him.
brenton_translation: Blessed are they that search out his testimonies: they will diligently seek him with the whole heart.

fresh_translation: For those working lawlessness did not walk in his ways.
brenton_translation: For they that work iniquity have not walked in his ways.

fresh_translation: You commanded your commandments to be kept exceedingly.
brenton_translation: Thou hast commanded us diligently to keep thy precepts.

fresh_translation: Would that my ways be directed to keep your ordinances.
brenton_translation: O that my ways were directed to keep thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Then I will certainly not be ashamed when I look upon all your commandments.
brenton_translation: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect to all thy commandments.

fresh_translation: I will confess to you, Lord, in the uprightness of heart when I learn the judgments of your righteousness.
brenton_translation: I will give thee thanks with uprightness of heart, when I have learnt the judgments of thy righteousness.

fresh_translation: Your ordinances I will keep; do not forsake me exceedingly.
brenton_translation: I will keep thine ordinances: O forsake me not greatly.

fresh_translation: Beth. In what will young man set straight his way? In keeping your words.
brenton_translation: Wherewith shall a young man direct his way? by keeping thy words.

fresh_translation: With all my heart I sought you; do not push me away from your commandments.
brenton_translation: With my whole heart have I diligently sought thee: cast me not away from thy commandments.

fresh_translation: In my heart I hid your sayings so that I might not sin against you.
brenton_translation: I have hidden thine oracles in my heart, that I might not sin against thee.

fresh_translation: Blessed are you, Lord; teach me your ordinances.
brenton_translation: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: With my lips I declared all judgments of your mouth.
brenton_translation: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

fresh_translation: In the way of your testimonies I delighted as over all wealth.
brenton_translation: I have delighted in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

fresh_translation: In your commandments I will muse and perceive your ways.
brenton_translation: I will meditate on thy commandments, and consider thy ways.

fresh_translation: In your ordinances I will meditate; I will not forget your words.
brenton_translation: I will meditate on thine ordinances: I will not forget thy words.

fresh_translation: Gimel. Repay your servant; I will live and keep your words.
brenton_translation: Render a recompence to thy servant: so shall I live, and keep thy words.

fresh_translation: Uncover my eyes, and I will perceive wonders from your law.
brenton_translation: Unveil thou mine eyes, and I shall perceive wondrous things out of thy law.

fresh_translation: I am sojourner in earth; do not hide your commandments from me.
brenton_translation: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

fresh_translation: My soul longed to desire your judgments at every time.
brenton_translation: My soul has longed exceedingly for thy judgments at all times.

fresh_translation: You rebuked proud ones; cursed those turning away from your commandments.
brenton_translation: Thou hast rebuked the proud: cursed are they that turn aside from thy commandments.

fresh_translation: Take away from me reproach and contempt, because I searched out your testimonies.
brenton_translation: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have sought out thy testimonies.

fresh_translation: For rulers also sat and spoke against me, but your servant mused in your ordinances.
brenton_translation: For princes sat and spoke against me: but thy servant was meditating on thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: For indeed your testimonies my meditation and your ordinances my counselors.
brenton_translation: For thy testimonies are my meditation, and thine ordinances are my counsellors.

fresh_translation: Daleth. My soul clung to ground; make me live according to your word.
brenton_translation: My soul has cleaved to the ground; quicken thou me according to thy word.

fresh_translation: I declared my ways, and you heard me; teach me your ordinances.
brenton_translation: I declared my ways, and thou didst hear me; teach me thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Make me understand way of your ordinances, and I will muse in your wonders.
brenton_translation: Instruct me in the way of thine ordinances; and I will meditate on thy wondrous works.

fresh_translation: My soul dripped from faintheartedness; confirm me in your words.
brenton_translation: My soul has slumbered for sorrow; strengthen thou me with thy words.

fresh_translation: Remove way of injustice from me, and in your law have mercy on me.
brenton_translation: Remove from me the way of iniquity; and be merciful to me by thy law.

fresh_translation: The way of truth I chose; your judgments I did not forget.
brenton_translation: I have chosen the way of truth; and have not forgotten thy judgments.

fresh_translation: I clung to your testimonies, Lord; do not shame me.
brenton_translation: I have cleaved to thy testimonies, O Lord; put me not to shame.

fresh_translation: The way of your commandments I ran when you widened my heart.
brenton_translation: I ran the way of thy commandments, when thou didst enlarge my heart.

fresh_translation: He. Give law to me, Lord, way of your ordinances, and I will seek it continually.
brenton_translation: Teach me, O Lord, the way of thine ordinances, and I will seek it out continually.

fresh_translation: Make me understand, and I will search out your law and keep it with all my heart.
brenton_translation: Instruct me, and I will search out thy law, and will keep it with my whole heart.

fresh_translation: Guide me in the path of your commandments, because I wanted it.
brenton_translation: Guide me in the path of thy commandments; for I have delighted in it.

fresh_translation: Incline my heart to your testimonies and not to greed.
brenton_translation: Incline mine heart to thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

fresh_translation: Turn away my eyes from seeing vanity; in your way make me live.
brenton_translation: Turn away mine eyes that I may not behold vanity: quicken thou me in thy way.

fresh_translation: Establish for your servant your saying toward your fear.
brenton_translation: Confirm thine oracle to thy servant, that he may fear thee.

fresh_translation: Take away my reproach which I suspected, because your judgments kind.
brenton_translation: Take away my reproach which I have feared: for thy judgments are good.

fresh_translation: Behold, I desired your commandments; in your righteousness make me live.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have desired thy commandments: quicken me in thy righteousness.

fresh_translation: Waw. And let your mercy come upon me, Lord, your salvation according to your saying.
brenton_translation: And let thy mercy come upon me, O Lord; even thy salvation, according to thy word.

fresh_translation: And I will answer a word to those reproaching me, because I hoped upon your words.
brenton_translation: And so I shall render an answer to them that reproach me: for I have trusted in thy words.

fresh_translation: And do not take word of truth from my mouth exceedingly, because I hoped upon your judgments.
brenton_translation: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

fresh_translation: And I will keep your law continually, forever and forever of forever.
brenton_translation: So shall I keep thy law continually, for ever and ever.

fresh_translation: And I was walking in broad place, because I searched out your commandments.
brenton_translation: I walked also at large: for I sought out thy commandments.

fresh_translation: And I was speaking in your testimonies before kings, and I was not ashamed.
brenton_translation: And I spoke of thy testimonies before kings, and was not ashamed.

fresh_translation: And I meditated on your commandments, which I loved exceedingly.
brenton_translation: And I meditated on thy commandments, which I loved exceedingly.

fresh_translation: And I lifted my hands to your commandments, which I loved, and mused in your ordinances.
brenton_translation: And I lifted up my hands to thy commandments which I loved; and I meditated in thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Zayin. Remember your word to your servant, by which you gave me hope.
brenton_translation: Remember thy words to thy servant, wherein thou hast made me hope.

fresh_translation: This comforted me in my humiliation, because your saying made me live.
brenton_translation: This has comforted me in mine affliction: for thine oracle has quickened me.

fresh_translation: Proud ones were lawless exceedingly, but from your law I did not turn aside.
brenton_translation: The proud have transgressed exceedingly; but I swerved not from thy law.

fresh_translation: I remembered your judgments from age, Lord, and was comforted.
brenton_translation: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and was comforted.

fresh_translation: Faintheartedness seized me from sinners abandoning your law.
brenton_translation: Despair took hold upon me, because of the sinners who forsake thy law.

fresh_translation: Your ordinances were songs to me in place of my sojourning.
brenton_translation: Thine ordinances were my songs in the place of my sojourning.

fresh_translation: I remembered your name in night, Lord, and kept your law.
brenton_translation: I remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, and kept thy law.

fresh_translation: This came to me because I searched out your ordinances.
brenton_translation: This I had, because I diligently sought thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Heth. My portion, Lord, I said, to keep your law.
brenton_translation: Thou art my portion, O Lord: I said that I would keep thy law.

fresh_translation: I entreated your face with all my heart; have mercy on me according to your saying.
brenton_translation: I besought thy favour with my whole heart: have mercy upon me according to thy word.

fresh_translation: I considered your ways and turned my feet to your testimonies.
brenton_translation: I thought on thy ways, and turned my feet to thy testimonies.

fresh_translation: I made ready and was not troubled to keep your commandments.
brenton_translation: I prepared myself, (and was not terrified,) to keep thy commandments.

fresh_translation: The ropes of sinners entangled me, and your law I did not forget.
brenton_translation: The snares of sinners entangled me: but I forgot not thy law.

fresh_translation: At midnight I rose to confess to you upon the judgments of your righteousness.
brenton_translation: At midnight I arose, to give thanks to thee for the judgments of thy righteousness.

fresh_translation: I companion of all fearing you and of those keeping your commandments.
brenton_translation: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy commandments.

fresh_translation: Of your mercy, Lord, earth full; teach me your ordinances.
brenton_translation: O Lord, the earth is full of thy mercy: teach me thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Teth. You did goodness with your servant, Lord, according to your word.
brenton_translation: Thou hast wrought kindly with thy servant, O Lord, according to thy word.

fresh_translation: Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge, because I believed your commandments.
brenton_translation: Teach me kindness, and instruction, and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

fresh_translation: Before I was humbled, I went astray; therefore I kept your saying.
brenton_translation: Before I was afflicted, I transgressed; therefore have I kept thy word.

fresh_translation: You good, Lord, and in your goodness teach me your ordinances.
brenton_translation: Good art thou, O Lord; therefore in thy goodness teach me thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Injustice of proud ones multiplied upon me; but I will search out your commandments with all my heart.
brenton_translation: The injustice of the proud has been multiplied against me: but I will search out thy commandments with all my heart.

fresh_translation: Their heart curdled like milk, but I meditated on your law.
brenton_translation: Their heart has been curdled like milk; but I have meditated on thy law.

fresh_translation: Good for me that you humbled me, so that I might learn your ordinances.
brenton_translation: It is good for me that thou hast afflicted me; that I might learn thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Good for me law of your mouth beyond thousands of gold and silver.
brenton_translation: The law of thy mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver.

fresh_translation: Yod. Your hands made me and formed me; make me understand, and I will learn your commandments.
brenton_translation: Thy hands have made me, and fashioned me: instruct me, that I may learn thy commandments.

fresh_translation: Those fearing you will see me and rejoice, because I hoped in your words.
brenton_translation: They that fear thee will see me and rejoice: for I have hoped in thy words.

fresh_translation: I knew, Lord, that your judgments righteousness, and in truth you humbled me.
brenton_translation: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are righteousness, and that thou in truthfulness hast afflicted me.

fresh_translation: Let your mercy become indeed to comfort me according to your saying to your servant.
brenton_translation: Let, I pray thee, thy mercy be to comfort me, according to thy word to thy servant.

fresh_translation: Let your compassions come to me and I will live, because your law my meditation.
brenton_translation: Let thy compassions come to me, that I may live: for thy law is my meditation.

fresh_translation: Let proud ones be shamed, because unjustly they acted lawlessly against me; but I will muse in your commandments.
brenton_translation: Let the proud be ashamed; for they transgressed against me unjustly: but I will meditate in thy commandments.

fresh_translation: Let those fearing you turn to me, even those knowing your testimonies.
brenton_translation: Let those that fear thee, and those that know thy testimonies, turn to me.

fresh_translation: Let my heart become blameless in your ordinances, so that I may not be shamed.
brenton_translation: Let mine heart be blameless in thine ordinances, that I may not be ashamed.

fresh_translation: Kaph. My soul fails for your salvation, and upon your word I hoped.
brenton_translation: My soul faints for thy salvation: I have hoped in thy words.

fresh_translation: My eyes failed for your saying, saying, When will you comfort me?
brenton_translation: Mine eyes failed in waiting for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

fresh_translation: Because I became like a wineskin in frost; your ordinances I did not forget.
brenton_translation: For I am become as a bottle in the frost: yet I have not forgotten thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: How many are days of your servant? When will you make judgment for me from those persecuting me?
brenton_translation: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment for me on them that persecute me?

fresh_translation: Lawless men told me idle talk, but not according to your law, Lord.
brenton_translation: Transgressors told me idle tales; but not according to thy law, O Lord.

fresh_translation: All your commandments truth; unjustly they persecuted me; help me.
brenton_translation: All thy commandments are truth; they persecuted me unjustly; help thou me.

fresh_translation: They almost ended me in earth, but I did not forsake your commandments.
brenton_translation: They nearly made an end of me in the earth; but I forsook not thy commandments.

fresh_translation: According to your mercy make me live, and I will keep testimonies of your mouth.
brenton_translation: Quicken me according to thy mercy; so shall I keep the testimonies of thy mouth.

fresh_translation: Lamed. Forever, Lord, your word remains in heaven.
brenton_translation: Thy word, O Lord, abides in heaven for ever.

fresh_translation: To generation and generation your truth; you founded earth, and it remains.
brenton_translation: Thy truth endures to all generations; thou hast founded the earth, and it abides.

fresh_translation: By your ordinance the day remains, because all things your servants.
brenton_translation: The day continues by thy arrangement; for all things are thy servants.

fresh_translation: If not that your law my meditation, then I would have perished in my humiliation.
brenton_translation: Were it not that thy law is my meditation, then I should have perished in mine affliction.

fresh_translation: Forever I will certainly not forget your ordinances, because in them you made me live, Lord.
brenton_translation: I will never forget thine ordinances; for with them thou hast quickened me.

fresh_translation: Yours I am; save me, because I searched out your ordinances.
brenton_translation: I am thine, save me; for I have sought out thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Sinners waited for me to destroy me; your testimonies I understood.
brenton_translation: Sinners laid wait for me to destroy me; but I understood thy testimonies.

fresh_translation: Of every completion I saw end; your commandment very broad.
brenton_translation: I have seen an end of all perfection; but thy commandment is very broad.

fresh_translation: Mem. How I loved your law, Lord; the whole day it is my meditation.
brenton_translation: How I have loved thy law, O Lord! it is my meditation all the day.

fresh_translation: Beyond my enemies you made me wise by your commandment, because forever it mine.
brenton_translation: Thou hast made me wiser than mine enemies in thy commandment; for it is mine for ever.

fresh_translation: Beyond all teaching me I understood, because your testimonies my meditation.
brenton_translation: I have more understanding than all my teachers; for thy testimonies are my meditation.

fresh_translation: Beyond elders I understood, because I searched out your commandments.
brenton_translation: I understand more than the aged; because I have sought out thy commandments.

fresh_translation: From every evil way I kept back my feet, so that I might keep your words.
brenton_translation: I have kept back my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy words.

fresh_translation: From your judgments I did not turn aside, because you gave law to me.
brenton_translation: I have not declined from thy judgments; for thou hast instructed me.

fresh_translation: How sweet to my throat your sayings, beyond honey and honeycomb to my mouth.
brenton_translation: How sweet are thine oracles to my throat! more so than honey to my mouth!

fresh_translation: From your commandments I understood; therefore I hated every way of injustice, because you gave law to me.
brenton_translation: I gain understanding by thy commandments: therefore I have hated every way of unrighteousness.

fresh_translation: Nun. Your word lamp to my feet and light to my paths.
brenton_translation: Thy law is a lamp to my feet, and a light to my paths.

fresh_translation: I swore and established it, to keep the judgments of your righteousness.
brenton_translation: I have sworn and determined to keep the judgments of thy righteousness.

fresh_translation: I was humbled exceedingly; Lord, make me live according to your word.
brenton_translation: I have been very greatly afflicted, O Lord: quicken me, according to thy word.

fresh_translation: Freewill offerings of my mouth accept indeed, Lord, and teach me your judgments.
brenton_translation: Accept, I pray thee, O Lord, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, and teach me thy judgments.

fresh_translation: My soul in my hands continually, and your law I did not forget.
brenton_translation: My soul is continually in thine hands; and I have not forgotten thy law.

fresh_translation: Sinners set snare for me, and from your commandments I did not wander.
brenton_translation: Sinners spread a snare for me; but I erred not from thy commandments.

fresh_translation: I inherited your testimonies forever, because they joy of my heart.
brenton_translation: I have inherited thy testimonies for ever; for they are the joy of my heart.

fresh_translation: I inclined my heart to do your ordinances forever, for recompense.
brenton_translation: I have inclined my heart to perform thine ordinances for ever, in return for thy mercies.

fresh_translation: Samekh. Lawless men I hated, but your law I loved.
brenton_translation: I have hated transgressors; but I have loved thy law.

fresh_translation: You my helper and supporter; upon your word I hoped.
brenton_translation: Thou art my helper and my supporter; I have hoped in thy words.

fresh_translation: Turn away from me, evil-doers, and I will search out commandments of my God.
brenton_translation: Depart from me, ye evil-doers; for I will search out the commandments of my God.

fresh_translation: Take hold of me according to your saying, and I will live, and do not shame me from my expectation.
brenton_translation: Uphold me according to thy word, and quicken me; and make me not ashamed of my expectation.

fresh_translation: Help me, and I will be saved, and I will meditate on your ordinances continually.
brenton_translation: Help me, and I shall be saved; and I will meditate in thine ordinances continually.

fresh_translation: You despised all departing from your ordinances, because unjust their thought.
brenton_translation: Thou hast brought to nought all that depart from thine ordinances; for their inward thought is unrighteous.

fresh_translation: I considered all sinners of earth as transgressors; therefore I loved your testimonies continually.
brenton_translation: I have reckoned all the sinners of the earth as transgressors; therefore have I loved thy testimonies.

fresh_translation: Nail down my flesh from your fear, because I feared your judgments.
brenton_translation: Penetrate my flesh with thy fear; for I am afraid of thy judgments.

fresh_translation: Ayin. I did judgment and righteousness; do not hand me over to those doing me injustice.
brenton_translation: I have done judgment and justice; deliver me not up to them that injure me.

fresh_translation: Receive your servant for good; let proud ones not slander me.
brenton_translation: Receive thy servant for good: let not the proud accuse me falsely.

fresh_translation: My eyes failed for your salvation and for saying of your righteousness.
brenton_translation: Mine eyes have failed for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

fresh_translation: Do with your servant according to your mercy and teach me your ordinances.
brenton_translation: Deal with thy servant according to thy mercy, and teach me thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: I am your servant; make me understand, and I will know your testimonies.
brenton_translation: I am thy servant; instruct me, and I shall know thy testimonies.

fresh_translation: Time for the Lord to act; they scattered your law.
brenton_translation: It is time for the Lord to work: they have utterly broken thy law.

fresh_translation: Therefore I loved your commandments beyond gold and topaz.
brenton_translation: Therefore have I loved thy commandments more than gold, or the topaz.

fresh_translation: Therefore toward all your commandments I was set straight; every unjust way I hated.
brenton_translation: Therefore I directed myself according to all thy commandments: I have hated every unjust way.

fresh_translation: Pe. Wondrous your testimonies; therefore my soul searched them out.
brenton_translation: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore my soul has sought them out.

fresh_translation: The disclosure of your words gives light and makes little ones understand.
brenton_translation: The manifestation of thy words will enlighten, and instruct the simple.

fresh_translation: My mouth I opened and drew in breath, because I longed for your commandments.
brenton_translation: I opened my mouth, and drew breath: for I earnestly longed after thy commandments.

fresh_translation: Look upon me and have mercy on me according to the judgment of those loving your name.
brenton_translation: Look upon me and have mercy upon me, after the manner of them that love thy name.

fresh_translation: Direct my steps according to your saying, and let no lawlessness rule over me.
brenton_translation: Order my steps according to thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

fresh_translation: Redeem me from slander of men, and I will keep your commandments.
brenton_translation: Deliver me from the false accusation of men: so will I keep thy commandments.

fresh_translation: Make your face shine upon your servant and teach me your ordinances.
brenton_translation: Cause thy face to shine upon thy servant: and teach me thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: The streams of waters came down from my eyes because they did not keep your law.
brenton_translation: Mine eyes have been bathed in streams of water, because I kept not thy law.

fresh_translation: Tsade. Righteous are you, Lord, and straight your judgment.
brenton_translation: Righteous art thou, O Lord, and upright are thy judgments.

fresh_translation: You commanded your testimonies in righteousness and truth exceedingly.
brenton_translation: Thou hast commanded righteousness and perfect truth, as thy testimonies.

fresh_translation: Zeal of your house melted me away, because my enemies forgot your words.
brenton_translation: Thy zeal has quite wasted me: because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

fresh_translation: Your saying very refined, and your servant loved it.
brenton_translation: Thy word has been very fully tried; and thy servant loves it.

fresh_translation: Younger I am and despised; your ordinances I did not forget.
brenton_translation: I am young and despised: yet I have not forgotten thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Your righteousness is righteousness forever, and your law is truth.
brenton_translation: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is truth.

fresh_translation: Affliction and necessity found me; your commandments my meditation.
brenton_translation: Afflictions and distresses found me: but thy commandments were my meditation.

fresh_translation: Your testimonies righteousness forever; make me understand and I will live.
brenton_translation: Thy testimonies are an everlasting righteousness: instruct me, and I shall live.

fresh_translation: Qoph. I cried with all my heart; hear me, Lord; I will seek out your statutes.
brenton_translation: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will search out thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: I cried to you; save me, and I will keep your testimonies.
brenton_translation: I cried to thee; save me, and I will keep thy testimonies.

fresh_translation: I came before dawn and cried; in your words I hoped.
brenton_translation: I arose before the dawn, and cried: I hoped in thy words.

fresh_translation: My eyes came before daybreak to meditate on your sayings.
brenton_translation: Mine eyes prevented the dawn, that I might meditate on thine oracles.

fresh_translation: Hear my voice, Lord, according to your mercy; according to your judgment make me live.
brenton_translation: Hear my voice, O Lord, according to thy mercy; quicken me according to thy judgment.

fresh_translation: Those pursuing me in lawlessness drew near; from your law they grew far.
brenton_translation: They have drawn nigh who persecuted me unlawfully; and they are far removed from thy law.

fresh_translation: You near, Lord, and all your commandments truth.
brenton_translation: Thou art near, O Lord; and all thy ways are truth.

fresh_translation: From beginning I knew from your testimonies that forever you founded them.
brenton_translation: I have known of old concerning thy testimonies, that thou hast founded them for ever.

fresh_translation: Resh. See my humiliation and rescue me, because I did not forget your law.
brenton_translation: Look upon mine affliction, and rescue me; for I have not forgotten thy law.

fresh_translation: Judge my case and redeem me; by your word make me live.
brenton_translation: Plead my cause, and ransom me: quicken me because of thy word.

fresh_translation: Salvation far from sinners, because your statutes they did not seek out.
brenton_translation: Salvation is far from sinners: for they have not searched out thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Your compassions many, Lord; according to your judgment make me live.
brenton_translation: Thy mercies, O Lord, are many: quicken me according to thy judgment.

fresh_translation: Many driving me out and afflicting me; from your testimonies I did not turn aside.
brenton_translation: Many are they that persecute me and oppress me: but I have not declined from thy testimonies.

fresh_translation: I saw those breaking faith and wasted away, because they did not keep your words.
brenton_translation: I beheld men acting foolishly, and I pined away; for they kept not thine oracles.

fresh_translation: See that I loved your commandments, Lord; in your mercy make me live.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have loved thy commandments, O Lord: quicken me in thy mercy.

fresh_translation: The beginning of your words is truth, and forever all the judgments of your righteousness.
brenton_translation: The beginning of thy words is truth; and all the judgments of thy righteousness endure for ever.

fresh_translation: Princes pursued me for nothing, and from your words my heart stood in awe.
brenton_translation: Princes persecuted me without a cause, but my heart feared because of thy words.

fresh_translation: I rejoice over your words like one finding much spoil.
brenton_translation: I will exult because of thine oracles, as one that finds much spoil.

fresh_translation: Injustice I hated and abhorred, but your law I loved.
brenton_translation: I hate and abhor unrighteousness; but I love thy law.

fresh_translation: Seven times a day I praised you for the judgments of your righteousness.
brenton_translation: Seven times in a day have I praised thee because of the judgments of thy righteousness.

fresh_translation: Much peace to those loving your law, and no stumbling for them.
brenton_translation: Great peace have they that love thy law: and there is no stumbling-block to them.

fresh_translation: I kept expecting your salvation, Lord, and your commandments I loved.
brenton_translation: I waited for thy salvation, O Lord, and have loved thy commandments.

fresh_translation: My soul kept your testimonies and loved them greatly.
brenton_translation: My soul has kept thy testimonies, and loved them exceedingly.

fresh_translation: I kept your commandments and your testimonies, because all my ways before you, Lord.
brenton_translation: I have kept thy commandments and thy testimonies; for all my ways are before thee, O Lord.

fresh_translation: Tau. Let my petition come near before you, Lord; according to your word make me understand.
brenton_translation: Let my supplication come near before thee, O Lord; instruct me according to thine oracle.

fresh_translation: Let my request enter before you; according to your word rescue me.
brenton_translation: Let my petition come in before thee, O Lord; deliver me according to thine oracle.

fresh_translation: Let my lips pour forth hymn when you teach me your statutes.
brenton_translation: Let my lips utter a hymn, when thou shalt have taught me thine ordinances.

fresh_translation: Let my tongue speak your saying, because all your commandments righteousness.
brenton_translation: Let my tongue utter thine oracles; for all thy commandments are righteous.

fresh_translation: Let your hand come to save me, because I chose your commandments.
brenton_translation: Let thine hand be prompt to save me; for I have chosen thy commandments.

fresh_translation: I longed for your salvation, Lord, and your law my meditation.
brenton_translation: I have longed after thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my meditation.

fresh_translation: My soul will live and praise you, and your judgments will help me.
brenton_translation: My soul shall live, and shall praise thee; and thy judgments shall help me.

fresh_translation: I wandered like sheep lost; seek your servant, because your commandments I did not forget.
brenton_translation: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I have not forgotten thy commandments.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. To the Lord, in my being afflicted, I cried, and he heard me.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: Lord, rescue my soul from unjust lips and from a deceitful tongue.
brenton_translation: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from unjust lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

fresh_translation: What should be given to you, and what should be added to you, against a deceitful tongue?
brenton_translation: What should be given to thee, and what should be added to thee, for thy crafty tongue?

fresh_translation: Sharpened arrows of mighty one, with desert coals.
brenton_translation: Sharpened weapons of the mighty, with coals of the desert.

fresh_translation: Alas me, because my sojourning lengthened; I camped with tents of Kedar.
brenton_translation: Woe is me, that my sojourning is prolonged; I have tabernacled among the tents of Kedar.

fresh_translation: My soul long sojourned.
brenton_translation: My soul has long been a sojourner;

fresh_translation: With those hating peace, I was peaceable; when I spoke to them, they warred against me for nothing.
brenton_translation: I was peaceable among them that hated peace; when I spoke to them, they warred against me without a cause.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. I lifted my eyes to mountains; from where will my help come?
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: My help from the Lord, maker of heaven and earth.
brenton_translation: My help shall come from the Lord, who made the heaven and the earth.

fresh_translation: Do not let your foot be shaken; may one guarding you not slumber.
brenton_translation: Let not thy foot be moved; and let not thy keeper slumber.

fresh_translation: Behold, keeper of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
brenton_translation: Behold, he that keeps Israel shall not slumber nor sleep.

fresh_translation: The Lord will guard you; the Lord is your shelter at right hand.
brenton_translation: The Lord shall keep thee: the Lord is thy shelter upon thy right hand.

fresh_translation: By day sun will not burn you, nor moon by night.
brenton_translation: The sun shall not burn thee by day, neither the moon by night.

fresh_translation: The Lord will guard you from every evil; he will guard your soul.
brenton_translation: May the Lord preserve thee from all evil: the Lord shall keep thy soul.

fresh_translation: The Lord will guard your going in and your going out, from now and until age.
brenton_translation: The Lord shall keep thy coming in, and thy going out, from henceforth and even for ever.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. I rejoiced over those saying to me, "To the house of the Lord we will go."
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: Our feet stood in your courts, Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Our feet stood in thy courts, O Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: Jerusalem, being built as a city whose fellowship together one and same.
brenton_translation: Jerusalem is built as a city whose fellowship is complete.

fresh_translation: For there tribes went up, tribes of the Lord, testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the Lord.
brenton_translation: For thither the tribes went up, the tribes of the Lord, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because there thrones sat for judgment, thrones over the house of David.
brenton_translation: For there are set thrones for judgment, even thrones for the house of David.

fresh_translation: Ask now things for peace of Jerusalem, and prosperity to those loving you.
brenton_translation: Pray now for the peace of Jerusalem: and let there be prosperity to them that love thee.

fresh_translation: Let peace now be in your strength, and prosperity in your towers.
brenton_translation: Let peace, I pray, be within thine host, and prosperity in thy palaces.

fresh_translation: For the sake of my brothers and neighbors, I kept speaking peace concerning you.
brenton_translation: For the sake of my brethren and my neighbours, I have indeed spoken peace concerning thee.

fresh_translation: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I sought good things for you.
brenton_translation: Because of the house of the Lord our God, I have diligently sought thy good.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. To you I lifted my eyes, one dwelling in heaven.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: Behold, as the eyes of servants toward the hands of their masters, as the eyes of a maidservant toward the hands of her mistress, so our eyes are toward the Lord our God until he shows us mercy.
brenton_translation: Behold, as the eyes of servants are directed to the hands of their masters, and as the eyes of a maid-servant to the hands of her mistress; so our eyes are directed to the Lord our God, until he have mercy upon us.

fresh_translation: Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us, because greatly we were filled with contempt.
brenton_translation: Have pity upon us, O Lord, have pity upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

fresh_translation: Still more our soul filled with reproach from prosperous ones and contempt from proud ones.
brenton_translation: Yea, our soul has been exceedingly filled with it: let the reproach be to them that are at ease, and contempt to the proud.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. If not that the Lord was among us, let Israel say now.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: If not that the Lord was among us when men rose against us,
brenton_translation: if it had not been that the Lord was among us, when men rose up against us;

fresh_translation: then alive they would have swallowed us when their anger blazed against us.
brenton_translation: verily they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us:

fresh_translation: Then water would have drowned us; torrent passed over our soul.
brenton_translation: verily the water would have drowned us, our soul would have gone under the torrent.

fresh_translation: Then our soul passed over water unendurable.
brenton_translation: Yea, our soul would have gone under the overwhelming water.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord, who did not give us for prey to their teeth.
brenton_translation: Blessed be the Lord, who has not given us for a prey to their teeth.

fresh_translation: Our soul like a sparrow rescued from the snare of hunters; snare crushed, and we rescued.
brenton_translation: Our soul has been delivered as a sparrow from the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are delivered.

fresh_translation: Our help in the name of the Lord, maker of heaven and earth.
brenton_translation: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. Those trusting in the Lord are like Mount Zion, not shaken forever.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: Mountains around her, and the Lord around his people, from now and until age.
brenton_translation: The mountains are round about her, and so the Lord is round about his people, from henceforth and even for ever.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord will not leave rod of sinners upon the lot of the righteous, lest the righteous stretch out their hands in lawlessness.
brenton_translation: For the Lord will not allow the rod of sinners to be upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous should stretch forth their hands to iniquity.

fresh_translation: Do good, Lord, to good ones and to upright in heart.
brenton_translation: Do good, O Lord, to them that are good, and to them that are upright in heart.

fresh_translation: But those turning aside into crooked ways the Lord will lead away with workers of lawlessness. Peace on Israel.
brenton_translation: But them that turn aside to crooked ways the Lord will lead away with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. When the Lord turned back captivity of Zion, we became like comforted ones.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: Then our mouth filled with joy and our tongue with exultation; then they will say among the nations, "the Lord magnified doing with them."
brenton_translation: Then was our mouth filled with joy, and our tongue with exultation: then would they say among the Gentiles,

fresh_translation: The Lord magnified doing with us; we became rejoicing.
brenton_translation: The Lord has done great things among them. The Lord has done great things for us, we became joyful.

fresh_translation: Turn back, Lord, our captivity, like torrents in south.
brenton_translation: Turn, O Lord, our captivity, as the streams in the south.

fresh_translation: Those sowing in tears will reap in exultation.
brenton_translation: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

fresh_translation: Going they went and wept, carrying their seeds; coming they will come in exultation, carrying their sheaves.
brenton_translation: They went on and wept as they cast their seeds; but they shall surely come with exultation, bringing their sheaves with them.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the Lord builds a house, in vain builders labored; unless the Lord guards a city, in vain guard kept awake.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: In vain for you to rise early, to rise after sitting down, you eating bread of pain, when he gives sleep to his beloved.
brenton_translation: It is vain for you to rise early: ye rise up after resting, ye that eat the bread of grief; while he gives sleep to his beloved.

fresh_translation: Behold, sons inheritance of the Lord, reward of fruit of the womb.
brenton_translation: Behold, the inheritance of the Lord, children, the reward of the fruit of the womb.

fresh_translation: Like arrows in the hand of mighty one, so sons of those thrust out.
brenton_translation: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man; so are the children of those who were outcasts.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the man who will fill his desire from them; they will not be shamed when they speak with their enemies in gate.
brenton_translation: Blessed is the man who shall satisfy his desire with them: they shall not be ashamed when they shall speak to their enemies in the gates.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. Blessed are all fearing the Lord, those walking in his ways.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: The labors of your fruits you will eat; blessed you, and well for you.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt eat the labours of thy hands: blessed art thou, and it shall be well with thee.

fresh_translation: Your wife like a vine flourishing in recesses of your house; your sons like olive shoots around your table.
brenton_translation: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine on the sides of thy house: thy children as young olive-plants round about thy table.

fresh_translation: Behold, thus man fearing the Lord will be blessed.
brenton_translation: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed that fears the Lord.

fresh_translation: May the Lord bless you from Zion, and may you see good things of Jerusalem all days of your life.
brenton_translation: May the Lord bless thee out of Sion; and mayest thou see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

fresh_translation: And may you see sons of your sons. Peace upon Israel.
brenton_translation: And mayest thou see thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. Many times they warred against me from my youth; let Israel say now.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: Many times they warred against me from my youth, yet indeed they could not prevail against me.
brenton_translation: Many a time have they warred against me from my youth: and yet they prevailed not against me.

fresh_translation: On my back sinners built; they lengthened their lawlessness.
brenton_translation: The sinners wrought upon my back: they prolonged their iniquity.

fresh_translation: The righteous Lord cut necks of sinners.
brenton_translation: The righteous Lord has cut asunder the necks of sinners.

fresh_translation: Let all hating Zion be shamed and turned backward.
brenton_translation: Let all that hate Sion be put to shame and turned back.

fresh_translation: Let them become like grass of housetops, which before being pulled up dried up.
brenton_translation: Let them be as the grass of the house-tops, which withers before it is plucked up.

fresh_translation: With which reaper did not fill his hand, nor gatherer of sheaves his bosom.
brenton_translation: Wherewith the reaper fills not his hand, nor he that makes up the sheaves, his bosom.

fresh_translation: And passersby did not say, "Blessing of the Lord upon you; we blessed you in the name of the Lord."
brenton_translation: Neither do they that go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we have blessed you in the name of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. Out of the depths I cried to you, Lord.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: Lord, hear my voice; let your ears attend to the voice of my supplication.
brenton_translation: O Lord, hearken to my voice; let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplication.

fresh_translation: If you should watch lawless deeds, Lord, Lord, who will stand?
brenton_translation: If thou, O Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

fresh_translation: Because with you propitiation.
brenton_translation: For with thee is forgiveness: for thy name's sake

fresh_translation: For the sake of your law I waited for you, Lord; my soul waited for your word.
brenton_translation: have I waited for thee, O Lord, my soul has waited for thy word.

fresh_translation: My soul hoped in the Lord from morning watch until night; from morning watch let Israel hope in the Lord.
brenton_translation: My soul has hoped in the Lord; from the morning watch till night.

fresh_translation: Because with the Lord mercy, and much redemption with him.
brenton_translation: Let Israel hope in the Lord: for with the Lord is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

fresh_translation: And he will redeem Israel from all his lawless deeds.
brenton_translation: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. Of David. Lord, my heart is not exalted, nor my eyes raised high, nor I walked in great things nor in marvels beyond me.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: If not, I was humble-minded, but I lifted my soul like child weaned against its mother, like recompense upon my soul.
brenton_translation: I shall have sinned if I have not been humble, but have exalted my soul: according to the relation of a weaned child to his mother, so wilt thou recompense my soul.

fresh_translation: Let Israel hope in the Lord from now and until age.
brenton_translation: Let Israel hope in the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. Remember, Lord, David and all his gentleness.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: How he swore to the Lord, vowed to God of Jacob.
brenton_translation: how he sware to the Lord, and vowed to the God of Jacob, saying,

fresh_translation: If I enter tent of my house, if I go up upon the bed of my couch,
brenton_translation: I will not go into the tabernacle of my house; I will not go up to the couch of my bed;

fresh_translation: if I give sleep to my eyes and slumber to my eyelids and rest to my temples,
brenton_translation: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, nor slumber to mine eyelids, nor rest to my temples,

fresh_translation: until I find place for the Lord, tabernacle for God of Jacob.
brenton_translation: until I find a place for the Lord, a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

fresh_translation: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in fields of the wood.
brenton_translation: Behold, we heard of it in Ephratha; we found it in the fields of the wood.

fresh_translation: We will enter his tabernacles; we will worship at place where his feet stood.
brenton_translation: Let us enter into his tabernacles: let us worship at the place where his feet stood.

fresh_translation: Rise, Lord, into your rest, you and ark of your holiness.
brenton_translation: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thine holiness.

fresh_translation: Your priests will clothe themselves with righteousness, and your holy ones will exult.
brenton_translation: Thy priests shall clothe themselves with righteousness; and thy saints shall exult.

fresh_translation: For the sake of David your servant, do not turn away face of your anointed.
brenton_translation: For the sake of thy servant David turn not away the face of thine anointed.

fresh_translation: The Lord swore truth to David, and he will not set it aside: from the fruit of your belly I will set upon your throne.
brenton_translation: The Lord sware in truth to David, and he will not annul it, saying, Of the fruit of thy body will I set a king upon thy throne.

fresh_translation: If your sons keep my covenant and these testimonies that I will teach them, their sons also forever will sit upon your throne.
brenton_translation: If thy children will keep my covenant, and these my testimonies which I shall teach them, their children also shall sit upon thy throne for ever.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord chose Zion; he chose her for dwelling to himself.
brenton_translation: For the Lord has elected Sion, he has chosen her for a habitation for himself, saying,

fresh_translation: This my resting-place forever and ever; here I will dwell, because I chose her.
brenton_translation: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have chosen it.

fresh_translation: Her provision blessing I will bless; her poor I will satisfy with breads.
brenton_translation: I will surely bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

fresh_translation: Her priests I will clothe with salvation, and her holy ones with exultation will exult.
brenton_translation: I will clothe her priests with salvation; and her saints shall greatly exult.

fresh_translation: There I will cause horn to spring up for David; I prepared lamp for my anointed.
brenton_translation: There will I cause to spring up a horn to David: I have prepared a lamp for mine anointed.

fresh_translation: His enemies I will clothe with shame, but upon him my holiness will flower.
brenton_translation: His enemies will I clothe with shame; but upon himself shall my holiness flourish.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. Of David. Behold now, what is good or what is pleasant, but brothers dwelling together.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: Like oil upon head, descending upon beard, beard of Aaron, descending upon hem of his garment.
brenton_translation: It is as ointment on the head, that ran down to the beard, even the beard of Aaron; that ran down to the fringe of his clothing.

fresh_translation: Like dew of Hermon descending upon the mountains of Zion, because there the Lord commanded blessing and life until age.
brenton_translation: As the dew of Aermon, that comes down on the mountains of Sion: for there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for ever.

fresh_translation: Song of ascents. Behold now, bless the Lord, all servants of the Lord, standing in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.
brenton_translation: A Song of Degrees.

fresh_translation: In nights lift your hands to holy things and bless the Lord.
brenton_translation: Lift up your hands by night in the sanctuaries, and bless the Lord.

fresh_translation: The Lord will bless you from Zion, maker of heaven and earth.
brenton_translation: May the Lord, who made heaven and earth, bless thee out of Sion.

fresh_translation: Hallelujah. Praise the name of the Lord; praise the Lord, servants.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Those standing in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.
brenton_translation: who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.

fresh_translation: Praise the Lord, because the Lord is good; sing psalms to his name, because good.
brenton_translation: Praise ye the Lord; for the Lord is good: sing praises to his name; for it is good.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord chose Jacob for himself, Israel for his special possession.
brenton_translation: For the Lord has chosen Jacob for himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

fresh_translation: Because I knew that the Lord is great, and our Lord is beyond all gods.
