brenton_translation: For I know that the Lord is great, and our Lord is above all gods;

fresh_translation: All that the Lord wanted he did in heaven and on earth, in seas and in all deeps.
brenton_translation: all that the Lord willed, he did in heaven, and on the earth, in the sea, and in all deeps.

fresh_translation: Raising clouds from the ends of the earth, he made lightnings for rain, bringing winds from his treasuries.
brenton_translation: Who brings up clouds from the extremity of the earth: he has made lightnings for the rain: he brings winds out of his treasures.

fresh_translation: Who struck firstborn of Egypt, from man to beast.
brenton_translation: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, both of man and beast.

fresh_translation: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
brenton_translation: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, on Pharao, and on all his servants.

fresh_translation: Who struck many nations and killed mighty kings.
brenton_translation: Who smote many nations, and slew mighty kings;

fresh_translation: Sihon king of Amorites and Og king of Bashan and all kingdoms of Canaan.
brenton_translation: Seon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Basan, and all the kingdoms of Chanaan:

fresh_translation: And gave their land inheritance, inheritance to Israel his people.
brenton_translation: and gave their land for an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel his people.

fresh_translation: Lord, your name forever; Lord, your memorial from generation to generation.
brenton_translation: O Lord, thy name endures for ever, and thy memorial to all generations.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord will judge his people and over his servants he will be comforted.
brenton_translation: For the Lord shall judge his people, and comfort himself concerning his servants.

fresh_translation: The idols of nations silver and gold, works of the hands of men.
brenton_translation: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the works of men's hands.

fresh_translation: Mouths they have and will not speak; eyes they have and will not see.
brenton_translation: They have a mouth, but they cannot speak; they have eyes, but they cannot see;

fresh_translation: Ears they have and will not hear; noses they have and will not smell; hands they have and will not feel; feet they have and will not walk; no sound in their throat, for no spirit in their mouth.
brenton_translation: they have ears, but they cannot hear; for there is no breath in their mouth.

fresh_translation: Like them may those making them become, and all trusting in them.
brenton_translation: Let those who make them be made like to them; and all those who trust in them.

fresh_translation: The house of Israel, bless the Lord; house of Aaron, bless the Lord.
brenton_translation: O house of Israel, bless ye the Lord: O house of Aaron, bless ye the Lord:

fresh_translation: The house of Levi, bless the Lord; those fearing the Lord, bless the Lord.
brenton_translation: O house of Levi, bless ye the Lord: ye that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the Lord from Zion, one dwelling in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Blessed in Sion be the Lord, who dwells in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the Lord, because kind, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Give thanks to the God of gods, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Give thanks to the God of gods: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: To one doing great wonders alone, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: To him who alone has wrought great wonders: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: To one making heavens in understanding, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: To him who made the heavens by understanding; for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: To one establishing earth upon waters, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: To him who established the earth on the waters; for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: To one making great lights alone, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: To him who alone made great lights; for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: Sun for the authority of day, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: The sun to rule the day; for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: Moon and stars for the authority of night, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: The moon and the stars to rule the night; for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: To one striking Egypt with their firstborn, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: To him who smote Egypt with their first-born; for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: And bringing Israel out from their midst, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: And brought Israel out of the midst of them; for his mercy endures for ever:

fresh_translation: With strong hand and with high arm, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: with a strong hand, and a high arm: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: To one cutting Red Sea into divisions, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: To him who divided the Red Sea into parts: for his mercy endures for ever:

fresh_translation: And leading Israel through its midst, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: and brought Israel through the midst of it: for his mercy endures for ever:

fresh_translation: And shaking off Pharaoh and his force into Red Sea, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: and overthrew Pharao and his host in the Red Sea: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: To one leading his people through wilderness, because his mercy forever; to one bringing water from sheer rock, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: To him who led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: To one striking great kings, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: To him who smote great kings: for his mercy endures for ever:

fresh_translation: And killing mighty kings, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: and slew mighty kings; for his mercy endures for ever:

fresh_translation: Sihon king of Amorites, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Seon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endures for ever:

fresh_translation: And Og king of Bashan, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: and Og king of Basan: for his mercy endures for ever:

fresh_translation: And giving their land inheritance, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: and gave their land for an inheritance: for his mercy endures for ever:

fresh_translation: Inheritance to Israel his servant, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: even an inheritance to Israel his servant: for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: Because in our humiliation the Lord remembered us, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: For the Lord remembered us in our low estate; for his mercy endures for ever:

fresh_translation: And redeemed us from our enemies, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: and redeemed us from our enemies; for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: One giving food to all flesh, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Who gives food to all flesh; for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: Give thanks to the God of heaven, because his mercy forever. Give thanks to the Lord of lords, because his mercy forever.
brenton_translation: Give thanks to the God of heaven; for his mercy endures for ever.

fresh_translation: Of David. By rivers of Babylon, there we sat and wept when remembering Zion.
brenton_translation: For David, a Psalm of Jeremias.

fresh_translation: On willows in the midst of it we hung our instruments.
brenton_translation: We hung our harps on the willows in the midst of it.

fresh_translation: Because there those taking us captive asked us for the words of songs, and those carrying us away asked hymn: "Sing us from songs of Zion."
brenton_translation: For there they that had taken us captive asked of us the words of a song; and they that had carried us away asked a hymn, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Sion.

fresh_translation: How should we sing song of the Lord on foreign land?
brenton_translation: How should we sing the Lord's song in a strange land?

fresh_translation: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand be forgotten.
brenton_translation: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

fresh_translation: Let my tongue cling to my throat if I do not remember you, if I do not set Jerusalem first at the beginning of my gladness.
brenton_translation: May my tongue cleave to my throat, if I do not remember thee; if I do not prefer Jerusalem as the chief of my joy.

fresh_translation: Remember, Lord, sons of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, those saying, "Empty it, empty it, down to its foundation."
brenton_translation: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to its foundations.

fresh_translation: The daughter of Babylon, wretched one, blessed who will repay you repayment that you repaid to us.
brenton_translation: Wretched daughter of Babylon! blessed shall he be who shall reward thee as thou hast rewarded us.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the one who will seize and dash your infants against rock.
brenton_translation: Blessed shall he be who shall seize and dash thine infants against the rock.

fresh_translation: Of David. I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart, because you heard sayings of my mouth; before angels I will sing psalms to you.
brenton_translation: A Psalm for David, of Aggæus and Zacharias.

fresh_translation: I will worship toward your holy temple and give thanks to your name for your mercy and your truth, because you magnified your saying above every name.
brenton_translation: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and give thanks to thy name, on account of thy mercy and thy truth; for thou hast magnified thy holy name above every thing.

fresh_translation: In whatever day I call on you, quickly hear me; with power in my soul you will greatly strengthen me.
brenton_translation: In whatsoever day I shall call upon thee, hear me speedily; thou shalt abundantly provide me with thy power in my soul.

fresh_translation: Let all kings of the earth give thanks to you, Lord, because they heard all sayings of your mouth.
brenton_translation: Let all the kings of the earth, O Lord, give thanks unto thee; for they have heard all the words of thy mouth.

fresh_translation: And let them sing in the ways of the Lord, because great is the glory of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And let them sing in the ways of the Lord; for great is the glory of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord high and looks upon humble things, and high things he knows from far away.
brenton_translation: For the Lord is high, and yet regards the lowly; and he knows high things from afar off.

fresh_translation: If I walk in the midst of affliction, you will make me live; against anger of my enemies you stretched out your hand, and your right hand saved me.
brenton_translation: Though I should walk in the midst of affliction, thou wilt quicken me; thou hast stretched forth thine hands against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand has saved me.

fresh_translation: The Lord will repay on my behalf; Lord, your mercy forever. Works of your hands do not disregard.
brenton_translation: O Lord, thou shalt recompense them on my behalf: thy mercy, O Lord, endures for ever: overlook not the works of thine hands.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David. Lord, you tested me and knew me.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: You knew my sitting down and my rising up; you understood my thoughts from far away.
brenton_translation: Thou knowest my down-sitting and mine up-rising: thou understandest my thoughts long before.

fresh_translation: My path and my measuring line you traced out, and all my ways you foresaw.
brenton_translation: Thou hast traced my path and my bed, and hast foreseen all my ways.

fresh_translation: Because no word on my tongue—
brenton_translation: For there is no unrighteous word in my tongue: behold, O Lord, thou hast known all things,

fresh_translation: behold, the Lord, you knew all last things and first things; you formed me and laid your hand upon me.
brenton_translation: the last and the first: thou hast fashioned me, and laid thine hand upon me.

fresh_translation: Your knowledge made wondrous beyond me; it grew strong; I will not be able toward it.
brenton_translation: The knowledge of thee is too wonderful for me; it is very difficult, I cannot attain to it.

fresh_translation: Where should I go from your spirit, and where should I flee from your face?
brenton_translation: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? and whither shall I flee from thy presence?

fresh_translation: If I go up into heaven, you there; if I go down into Hades, present.
brenton_translation: If I should go up to heaven, thou art there: if I should go down to hell, thou art present.

fresh_translation: If I take up my wings at dawn and dwell in uttermost parts of sea,
brenton_translation: If I should spread my wings to fly straight forward, and sojourn at the extremity of the sea, it would be vain,

fresh_translation: even there your hand will guide me and your right hand will hold me fast.
brenton_translation: for even there thy hand would guide me, and thy right hand would hold me.

fresh_translation: And I said, "Then darkness will trample me," yet night illumination in my delight.
brenton_translation: When I said, Surely the darkness will cover me; even the night was light in my luxury.

fresh_translation: Because darkness will not be darkened from you, and night will be lit as day; as its darkness, so also its light.
brenton_translation: For darkness will not be darkness with thee; but night will be light as day: as its darkness, so shall its light be to thee.

fresh_translation: Because you acquired my inward parts, Lord; you took hold of me from my mother's womb.
brenton_translation: For thou, O Lord, hast possessed my reins; thou hast helped me from my mother's womb.

fresh_translation: I will give thanks to you because fearfully I was made wondrous; wondrous your works, and my soul knows very much.
brenton_translation: I will give thee thanks; for thou art fearfully wondrous; wondrous are thy works; and my soul knows it well.

fresh_translation: My bone not hidden from you, which you made in secret, and my substance in lowest parts of earth.
brenton_translation: My bones which thou madest in secret were not hidden from thee, nor my substance, in the lowest parts of the earth.

fresh_translation: Your eyes saw my unformed thing, and in your book all will be written; days will be formed, and no one among them.
brenton_translation: Thine eyes saw my unwrought substance, and all men shall be written in thy book; they shall be formed by day, though there should for a time be no one among them.

fresh_translation: To me your friends, God, were greatly honored; their chief ones grew very strong.
brenton_translation: But thy friends, O God, have been greatly honoured by me; their rule has been greatly strengthened.

fresh_translation: I will number them, and beyond sand they will multiply; I awoke, and still I am with you.
brenton_translation: I will number them, and they shall be multiplied beyond the sand; I awake, and am still with thee.

fresh_translation: If only you would kill sinners, God; men of blood, turn aside from me.
brenton_translation: Oh that thou wouldest slay the wicked, O God; depart from me, ye men of blood.

fresh_translation: Because they speak of you for scheming; they will take your cities in vain.
brenton_translation: For thou wilt say concerning their thought, that they shall take thy cities in vain.

fresh_translation: Did I not hate those hating you, Lord, and waste away over your enemies?
brenton_translation: Have I not hated them, O Lord, that hate thee? and wasted away because of thine enemies?

fresh_translation: With perfect hatred I hated them; they became enemies to me.
brenton_translation: I have hated them with perfect hatred; they were counted my enemies.

fresh_translation: Test me, God, and know my heart; examine me and know my paths.
brenton_translation: Prove me, O God, and know my heart; examine me, and know my paths;

fresh_translation: And see if way of lawlessness in me, and guide me in age-lasting way.
brenton_translation: and see if there is any way of iniquity in me, and lead me in an everlasting way.

fresh_translation: For end. Psalm of David.
brenton_translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Rescue me, Lord, from evil man; from unjust man deliver me.
brenton_translation: Rescue me, O Lord, from the evil man; deliver me from the unjust man.

fresh_translation: Who devised injustices in heart; whole day they arrayed wars.
brenton_translation: Who have devised injustice in their hearts; all the day they prepared war.

fresh_translation: They sharpened their tongue like serpent; venom of asps under their lips. Selah.
brenton_translation: They have sharpened their tongue as the tongue of a serpent; the poison of asps is under their lips. Pause.

fresh_translation: Guard me, Lord, from the hand of sinner; from unjust men deliver me, who devised to trip my steps.
brenton_translation: Keep me, O Lord, from the hand of the sinner; rescue me from unjust men; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

fresh_translation: Proud ones hid snare for me and stretched ropes; traps for my feet, beside path they set stumbling block for me. Selah.
brenton_translation: The proud have hid a snare for me, and have stretched out ropes for snares for my feet; they set a stumbling-block for me near the path. Pause.

fresh_translation: I said to the Lord, "My God you." Give ear, Lord, to the voice of my supplication.
brenton_translation: I said to the Lord, Thou art my God; hearken, O Lord, to the voice of my supplication.

fresh_translation: Lord, Lord, strength of my salvation, you overshadowed over my head in the day of war.
brenton_translation: O Lord God, the strength of my salvation; thou hast screened my head in the day of battle.

fresh_translation: Do not give me over, Lord, from my desire to sinner; they schemed against me; do not abandon me, lest they be exalted. Selah.
brenton_translation: Deliver me not, O Lord, to the sinner, according to my desire: they have devised mischief against me; forsake me not, lest they should be exalted. Pause.

fresh_translation: The head of their encirclement—labor of their lips will cover them.
brenton_translation: As for the head of them that compass me, the mischief of their lips shall cover them.

fresh_translation: Coals will fall upon them; in fire you will cast them down, in miseries they will not withstand.
brenton_translation: Coals of fire shall fall upon them on the earth; and thou shalt cast them down in afflictions: they shall not bear up under them.

fresh_translation: Tongue-man will not be directed on earth; evil will hunt unjust man into destruction.
brenton_translation: A talkative man shall not prosper on the earth: evils shall hunt the unrighteous man to destruction.

fresh_translation: I knew the Lord will do judgment of a poor one and justice of the needy.
brenton_translation: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the poor, and the right of the needy ones.

fresh_translation: Yet the righteous will give thanks to your name, and the upright will dwell with your face.
brenton_translation: Surely the righteous shall give thanks to thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David. Lord, I cried to you; hear me. Attend to the voice of my supplication when I cry to you.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David.

fresh_translation: Let my prayer be set straight as incense before you, lifting up of my hands evening sacrifice.
brenton_translation: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; the lifting up of my hands as an evening sacrifice.

fresh_translation: Set guard, Lord, for my mouth, and door of enclosure around my lips.
brenton_translation: Set a watch, O Lord, on my mouth, and a strong door about my lips.

fresh_translation: Do not incline my heart to the words of evil, to make excuses of excuses in sins with men working lawlessness, and I will not join with their chosen ones.
brenton_translation: Incline not my heart to evil things, to employ pretexts for sins, with men who work iniquity: and let me not unite with their choice ones.

fresh_translation: A righteous one will instruct me in mercy and reprove me, but oil of a sinner may it not fatten my head; because still my prayer against their pleasures.
brenton_translation: The righteous shall chasten me with mercy, and reprove me: but let not the oil of the sinner anoint my head: for yet shall my prayer also be in their pleasures.

fresh_translation: Their judges were swallowed up beside rock; they will hear my words because they were pleasant.
brenton_translation: Their mighty ones have been swallowed up near the rock: they shall hear my words, for they are sweet.

fresh_translation: Like thickness of earth broken up upon ground, our bones were scattered beside Hades.
brenton_translation: As a lump of earth is crushed upon the ground, our bones have been scattered by the mouth of the grave.

fresh_translation: Because toward you, Lord, Lord, my eyes; in you I hoped; do not take away my soul.
brenton_translation: For mine eyes are to thee, O Lord God: I have hoped in thee; take not away my life.

fresh_translation: Guard me from snare they set together for me and from stumbling blocks of workers of lawlessness.
brenton_translation: Keep me from the snare which they have set for me, and from the stumbling-blocks of them that work iniquity.

fresh_translation: Sinners will fall in his net; alone I am until I pass by.
brenton_translation: Sinners shall fall by their own net: I am alone until I shall escape.

fresh_translation: Of understanding. Of David, when he was in cave. Prayer.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of instruction for David, when he was in the cave,—a Prayer.

fresh_translation: With my voice to the Lord I cried; with my voice to the Lord I made supplication.
brenton_translation: I cried to the Lord with my voice; with my voice I made supplication to the Lord.

fresh_translation: I pour out before him my supplication; my affliction before him I declare.
brenton_translation: I will pour out before him my supplication: I will declare before him mine affliction.

fresh_translation: When my spirit was failing from me, then you knew my paths. In this way where I walked, they hid snare for me.
brenton_translation: When my spirit was fainting within me, then thou knewest my paths; in the very way wherein I was walking, they hid a snare for me.

fresh_translation: I was looking to right and watching, and there was none knowing me; flight perished from me, and none seeking my soul.
brenton_translation: I looked on my right hand, and behold, for there was none that noticed me; refuge failed me; and there was none that cared for my soul.

fresh_translation: I cried to you, Lord; I said, "You my hope, my portion in the land of living."
brenton_translation: I cried unto thee, O Lord, and said, Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the living.

fresh_translation: Attend to my supplication, because I was greatly humbled; rescue me from those pursuing me, because they grew stronger than I.
brenton_translation: Attend to my supplication, for I am brought very low; deliver me from them that persecute me; for they are stronger than I.

fresh_translation: Bring my soul out from prison to give thanks to your name, Lord. The righteous will wait for me until you repay me.
brenton_translation: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to thy name, O Lord; the righteous shall wait for me, until thou recompense me.

fresh_translation: Psalm of David, when son pursued him. Lord, hear my prayer; give ear to my supplication in your truth; hear me in your righteousness.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David, when his son pursued him.

fresh_translation: And do not enter into judgment with your servant, because no living one will be justified before you.
brenton_translation: And enter not into judgment with thy servant, for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

fresh_translation: Because enemy pursued my soul; he humbled my life to earth; he seated me in dark places like the dead of age.
brenton_translation: For the enemy has persecuted my soul; he has brought my life down to the ground; he has made me to dwell in a dark place, as those that have been long dead.

fresh_translation: And my spirit grew weary upon me; within me my heart troubled.
brenton_translation: Therefore my spirit was grieved in me; my heart was troubled within me.

fresh_translation: I remembered ancient days and meditated on all your works; in the works of your hands I kept meditating.
brenton_translation: I remembered the days of old; and I meditated on all thy doings: yea, I meditated on the works of thine hands.

fresh_translation: I spread out my hands to you; my soul as waterless land to you. Selah.
brenton_translation: I spread forth my hands to thee; my soul thirsts for thee, as a dry land. Pause.

fresh_translation: Quickly hear me, Lord; my spirit failed. Do not turn away your face from me, and I will be likened to those going down into pit.
brenton_translation: Hear me speedily, O Lord; my spirit has failed; turn not away thy face from me, else I shall be like to them that go down to the pit.

fresh_translation: Make your mercy heard to me in morning, because on you I hoped. Make known to me, Lord, way in which I should walk, because to you I lifted my soul.
brenton_translation: Cause me to hear thy mercy in the morning; for I have hoped in thee; make known to me, O Lord, the way wherein I should walk; for I have lifted up my soul to thee.

fresh_translation: Rescue me from my enemies, Lord, because to you I fled.
brenton_translation: Deliver me from mine enemies, O Lord; for I have fled to thee for refuge.

fresh_translation: Teach me to do your will, because you my God. Your good spirit will guide me in straight land.
brenton_translation: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God; thy good Spirit shall guide me in the straight way.

fresh_translation: For the sake of your name, Lord, you will make me live; in your righteousness you will bring my soul out from affliction.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt quicken me, O Lord, for thy name's sake; in thy righteousness thou shalt bring my soul out of affliction.

fresh_translation: And in your mercy you will utterly destroy my enemies and destroy all afflicting my soul, because I am your servant.
brenton_translation: And in thy mercy thou wilt destroy mine enemies, and wilt destroy all those that afflict my soul; for I am thy servant.

fresh_translation: Of David, against Goliath. Blessed is the Lord my God, teaching my hands for battle, my fingers for war.
brenton_translation: A Psalm of David concerning Goliad.

fresh_translation: My mercy and my refuge, my helper and my deliverer, my protector, and on him I hoped, one subduing my people under me.
brenton_translation: My mercy, and my refuge; my helper, and my deliverer; my protector, in whom I have trusted; who subdues my people under me.

fresh_translation: Lord, what man that you became known to him, or son of man that you count him?
brenton_translation: Lord, what is man, that thou art made known to him? or the son of man, that thou takest account of him?

fresh_translation: Man was likened to vanity; his days like a passing shadow.
brenton_translation: Man is like to vanity: his days pass as a shadow.

fresh_translation: Lord, bend your heavens and come down; touch mountains and they will smoke.
brenton_translation: O Lord, bow thy heavens, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

fresh_translation: Selah lightning and you will scatter them; send out your arrows and you will throw them into confusion.
brenton_translation: Send lightning, and thou shalt scatter them: send forth thine arrows, and thou shalt discomfit them.

fresh_translation: Send out your hand from height; rescue me and deliver me from many waters, from the hand of foreign sons,
brenton_translation: Send forth thine hand from on high; rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hand of strange children;

fresh_translation: whose mouth spoke vanity and their right hand, the right hand of injustice.
brenton_translation: whose mouth has spoken vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of iniquity.

fresh_translation: God, I will sing new song to you; on ten-stringed psaltery I will sing psalms to you.
brenton_translation: O God, I will sing a new song to thee: I will play to thee on a psaltery of ten strings.

fresh_translation: To one giving salvation to kings, to one redeeming David his servant from evil sword.
brenton_translation: Even to him who gives salvation to kings: who redeems his servant David from the hurtful sword.

fresh_translation: Rescue me and deliver me from the hand of foreign sons, whose mouth spoke vanity and their right hand, the right hand of injustice.
brenton_translation: Deliver me, and rescue me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth has spoken vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of iniquity;

fresh_translation: Whose sons like young shoots established in their youth; their daughters beautified, adorned like the likeness of the temple.
brenton_translation: whose children are as plants, strengthened in their youth: their daughters are beautiful, sumptuously adorned after the similitude of a temple.

fresh_translation: Their storehouses full, pouring out from this into that; their sheep many-bearing, multiplying in their outings.
brenton_translation: Their garners are full, and bursting with one kind of store after another; their sheep are prolific, multiplying in their streets.

fresh_translation: Their oxen fat; no breach of wall, no passing out, no outcry in their squares.
brenton_translation: Their oxen are fat: there is no falling down of a hedge, nor going out, nor cry in their folds.

fresh_translation: They called blessed people to whom these things belong; blessed are the people whose God is the Lord.
brenton_translation: Men bless the people to whom this lot belongs, but blessed is the people whose God is the Lord.

fresh_translation: Praise of David. I will exalt you, my God, my king, and bless your name forever and forever of age.
brenton_translation: David's Psalm of praise.

fresh_translation: Each day I will bless you and praise your name forever and forever of age.
brenton_translation: Every day will I bless thee, and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

fresh_translation: Great is the Lord and greatly praiseworthy, and of his greatness no end.
brenton_translation: The Lord is great, and greatly to be praised; and there is no end of his greatness.

fresh_translation: Generation and generation will praise your works, and they will declare your power.
brenton_translation: Generation after generation shall praise thy works, and tell of thy power.

fresh_translation: They will speak of magnificence of glory of your holiness, and they will relate your wonders.
brenton_translation: And they shall speak of the glorious majesty of thy holiness, and recount thy wonders.

fresh_translation: They will speak of power of your fearful deeds, and they will recount your greatness.
brenton_translation: And they shall speak of the power of thy terrible acts; and recount thy greatness.

fresh_translation: They will pour forth memory of abundance of your kindness, and exult in your righteousness.
brenton_translation: They shall utter the memory of the abundance of thy goodness, and shall exult in thy righteousness.

fresh_translation: Compassionate and merciful Lord, long-suffering and very merciful.
brenton_translation: The Lord is compassionate, and merciful; long-suffering, and abundant in mercy.

fresh_translation: The Lord is kind to all, and his compassions over all his works.
brenton_translation: The Lord is good to those that wait on him; and his compassions are over all his works.

fresh_translation: Let all your works give thanks to you, Lord, and let your holy ones bless you.
brenton_translation: Let all thy works, O Lord, give thanks to thee; and let thy saints bless thee.

fresh_translation: They will speak glory of your kingdom and tell of your dominion,
brenton_translation: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy dominion;

fresh_translation: to make known to the sons of men your dominion and glory of magnificence of your kingdom.
brenton_translation: to make known to the sons of men thy power, and the glorious majesty of thy kingdom.

fresh_translation: Your kingdom is a kingdom of all ages, and your lordship in every generation and generation. Faithful is the Lord in his words and holy in all his works.
brenton_translation: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endures through all generations.

fresh_translation: The Lord supports all falling and straightens all crushed down.
brenton_translation: The Lord supports all that are falling, and sets up all that are broken down.

fresh_translation: The eyes of all hope in you, and you give their food in season.
brenton_translation: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their food in due season.

fresh_translation: You open your hand and fill every living thing with favor.
brenton_translation: Thou openest thine hands, and fillest every living thing with pleasure.

fresh_translation: The Lord is righteous in all his ways and holy in all his works.
brenton_translation: The Lord is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

fresh_translation: The Lord near to all calling upon him, to all calling upon him in truth.
brenton_translation: The Lord is near to all that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

fresh_translation: He will do desire of those fearing him, and he will hear their supplication and save them.
brenton_translation: He will perform the desire of them that fear him: and he will hear their supplication, and save them.

fresh_translation: The Lord guards all loving him, and all sinners he will destroy.
brenton_translation: The Lord preserves all that love him: but all sinners he will utterly destroy.

fresh_translation: The praise of the Lord my mouth will speak, and let all flesh bless his holy name forever and forever of age.
brenton_translation: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

fresh_translation: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord, my soul.
brenton_translation: Alleluia, a Psalm of Aggæus and Zacharias.

fresh_translation: I will praise the Lord in my life; I will sing psalms to my God while I exist.
brenton_translation: While I live will I praise the Lord: I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

fresh_translation: Do not trust in rulers and in the sons of men, in whom no salvation.
brenton_translation: Trust not in princes, nor in the children of men, in whom there is no safety.

fresh_translation: His spirit will go out and he will return to his earth; in that day all their plans will perish.
brenton_translation: His breath shall go forth, and he shall return to his earth; in that day all his thoughts shall perish.

fresh_translation: Blessed is he whose helper is the God of Jacob, his hope upon the Lord his God.
brenton_translation: Blessed is he whose helper is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord his God:

fresh_translation: Who made heaven and earth, sea and all in them, one keeping truth forever.
brenton_translation: who made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all things in them: who keeps truth for ever:

fresh_translation: Doing judgment for wronged ones, giving food to hungry; The Lord frees chained ones.
brenton_translation: who executes judgment for the wronged: who gives food to the hungry. The Lord looses the fettered ones:

fresh_translation: The Lord straightens crushed ones; The Lord makes blind ones wise; The Lord loves righteous.
brenton_translation: the Lord gives wisdom to the blind:

fresh_translation: The Lord guards sojourners; orphan and widow he will take up, and way of sinners he will destroy.
brenton_translation: he will relieve the orphan and widow: but will utterly remove the way of sinners.

fresh_translation: The Lord will reign forever, your God, Zion, to generation and generation.
brenton_translation: The Lord shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Sion, to all generations.

fresh_translation: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord, because psalm to our God good; let praise be sweet.
brenton_translation: Alleluia, a Psalm of Aggæus and Zacharias.

fresh_translation: The Lord building Jerusalem and gathering dispersions of Israel.
brenton_translation: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; and he will gather together the dispersed of Israel.

fresh_translation: Healing crushed in heart and binding up their fractures.
brenton_translation: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

fresh_translation: Numbering multitudes of stars and calling all them by names.
brenton_translation: He numbers the multitudes of stars; and calls them all by names.

fresh_translation: Great our Lord and great his strength, and of his understanding no number.
brenton_translation: Great is our Lord, and great is his strength; and his understanding is infinite.

fresh_translation: The Lord lifting up meek ones and humbling sinners to ground.
brenton_translation: The Lord lifts up the meek; but brings sinners down to the ground.

fresh_translation: Begin with thanksgiving to the Lord; sing psalms to our God on lyre.
brenton_translation: Begin the song with thanksgiving to the Lord; sing praises on the harp to our God:

fresh_translation: To one clothing heaven with clouds, preparing rain for earth, making grass spring up on mountains and green growth for the service of men.
brenton_translation: who covers the heaven with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who causes grass to spring up on the mountains, [and green herb for the service of men;]

fresh_translation: Giving beasts their food and young ravens calling on him.
brenton_translation: and gives to cattle their food, and to the young ravens that call upon him.

fresh_translation: Not in the strength of horse will he desire, nor in legs of man does he delight.
brenton_translation: He will not take pleasure in the strength of a horse; neither is he well-pleased with the legs of a man.

fresh_translation: The Lord delights in those fearing him and hoping upon his mercy.
brenton_translation: The Lord takes pleasure in them that fear him, and in all that hope in his mercy.

fresh_translation: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise, Jerusalem, Lord; praise your God, Zion.
brenton_translation: Alleluia, a Psalm of Aggæus and Zacharias.

fresh_translation: Because he strengthened bars of your gates; he blessed your sons in you.
brenton_translation: For he has strengthened the bars of thy gates; he has blessed thy children within thee.

fresh_translation: One making your borders peace and filling you with the fat of wheat.
brenton_translation: He makes thy borders peaceful, and fills thee with the flour of wheat.

fresh_translation: One sending his saying to earth; with speed his word will run.
brenton_translation: He sends his oracle to the earth: his word will run swiftly.

fresh_translation: One giving snow like wool, scattering mist like ashes.
brenton_translation: He gives snow like wool: he scatters the mist like ashes.

fresh_translation: Throwing his ice like morsels; before his cold who will stand?
brenton_translation: Casting forth his ice like morsels: who shall stand before his cold?

fresh_translation: He will send his word and melt them; his spirit will blow and waters will flow.
brenton_translation: He shall send out his word, and melt them: he shall blow with his wind, and the waters shall flow.

fresh_translation: Declaring his word to Jacob, his statutes and judgments to Israel.
brenton_translation: He sends his word to Jacob, his ordinances and judgments to Israel.

fresh_translation: He did not do thus to every nation, and his judgments he did not show to them.
brenton_translation: He has not done so to any other nation; and he has not shewn them his judgments.

fresh_translation: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord from heavens; praise him in highest places.
brenton_translation: Alleluia, a Psalm of Aggæus and Zacharias.

fresh_translation: Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his powers.
brenton_translation: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

fresh_translation: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all stars and light.
brenton_translation: Praise him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars and light.

fresh_translation: Praise him, heavens of heavens, and water above heavens.
brenton_translation: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and the water that is above the heavens.

fresh_translation: Let them praise the name of the Lord, because he spoke and they came to be; he commanded and they were created.
brenton_translation: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for he spoke, and they were made; he commanded, and they were created.

fresh_translation: He established them forever and forever of age; ordinance he set, and it will not pass away.
brenton_translation: He has established them for ever, even for ever and ever: he has made an ordinance, and it shall not pass away.

fresh_translation: Praise the Lord from earth, dragons and all deeps.
brenton_translation: Praise the Lord from the earth, ye serpents, and all deeps.

fresh_translation: Fire, hail, snow, ice, spirit of storm, things doing his word.
brenton_translation: Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy wind; the things that perform his word.

fresh_translation: Mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars.
brenton_translation: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

fresh_translation: Wild beasts and all cattle, creeping things and winged birds.
brenton_translation: wild beasts, and all cattle; reptiles, and winged birds:

fresh_translation: The kings of the earth and all peoples, rulers and all judges of earth.
brenton_translation: kings of the earth, and all peoples; princes, and all judges of the earth:

fresh_translation: Young men and virgins, elders with younger ones.
brenton_translation: young men and virgins, old men with youths:

fresh_translation: Let them praise the name of the Lord, because his name alone was exalted; his praise upon earth and heaven.
brenton_translation: let them praise the name of the Lord: for his name only is exalted; his praise is above the earth and heaven,

fresh_translation: And he will exalt horn of his people, hymn for all his holy ones, sons of Israel, people drawing near to him.
brenton_translation: and he shall exalt the horn of his people, there is a hymn for all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people who draw near to him.

fresh_translation: Hallelujah. Sing to the Lord new song; his praise in the assembly of holy ones.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Let Israel rejoice over one making him, and sons of Zion exult over their king.
brenton_translation: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him; and let the children of Sion exult in their king.

fresh_translation: Let them praise his name in dance; with tambourine and psaltery let them sing psalms to him.
brenton_translation: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises to him with timbrel and psaltery.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord delights in his people and will exalt meek ones in salvation.
brenton_translation: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people; and will exalt the meek with salvation.

fresh_translation: Holy ones will boast in glory and exult on their beds.
brenton_translation: The saints shall rejoice in glory; and shall exult on their beds.

fresh_translation: The exaltations of God in their throat and two-edged swords in their hands,
brenton_translation: The high praises of God shall be in their throat, and two-edged swords in their hands;

fresh_translation: to do vengeance among nations, reproofs among peoples,
brenton_translation: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments among the peoples;

fresh_translation: to bind their kings in fetters and their glorious ones in iron handcuffs,
brenton_translation: to bind their kings with fetters, and their nobles with manacles of iron;

fresh_translation: to do among them judgment written. This glory for all his holy ones.
brenton_translation: to execute on them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints.

fresh_translation: Hallelujah. Praise God in his holy ones; praise him in firmament of his power.
brenton_translation: Alleluia.

fresh_translation: Praise him for his dominions; praise him according to the multitude of his greatness.
brenton_translation: Praise him on account of his mighty acts: praise him according to his abundant greatness.

fresh_translation: Praise him with the sound of a trumpet; praise him in psaltery and lyre.
brenton_translation: Praise him with the sound of a trumpet: praise him with psaltery and harp.

fresh_translation: Praise him in tambourine and dance; praise him in strings and instrument.
brenton_translation: Praise him with timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and the organ.

fresh_translation: Praise him in clear-sounding cymbals; praise him in cymbals of shout.
brenton_translation: Praise him with melodious cymbals: praise him with loud cymbals.

fresh_translation: Every breath let it praise the Lord. Hallelujah.
brenton_translation: Let every thing that has breath praise the Lord.

fresh_translation: The Proverbs of Solomon son of David, who reigned in Israel.
brenton_translation: The Proverbs of Solomon son of David, who reigned in Israel;

fresh_translation: To know wisdom and discipline, and to understand words of insight.
brenton_translation: to know wisdom and instruction, and to perceive words of understanding;

fresh_translation: To receive turnings of words, and to understand true righteousness and judgment, and to direct judgment.
brenton_translation: to receive also hard sayings, and to understand true justice, and how to direct judgment;

fresh_translation: So that I may give shrewdness to innocent ones, and to child, young perception and understanding.
brenton_translation: that he might give subtlety to the simple, and to the young man discernment and understanding.

fresh_translation: For hearing these, wise will become wiser, and understanding man will acquire guidance.
brenton_translation: For by the hearing of these a wise man will be wiser, and the man of understanding will gain direction;

fresh_translation: And he will understand proverb and dark saying, sayings of wise and riddles.
brenton_translation: and will understand a parable, and a dark speech; the sayings of the wise also, and riddles.

fresh_translation: The beginning of wisdom is fear of God; good understanding for all doing it; piety toward God beginning of perception, but the ungodly will despise wisdom and discipline.
brenton_translation: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; and there is good understanding to all that practise it: and piety toward God is the beginning of discernment; but the ungodly will set at nought wisdom and instruction.

fresh_translation: Hear, son, discipline of your father, and do not reject decrees of your mother.
brenton_translation: Hear, my son, the instruction of thy father, and reject not the rules of thy mother.

fresh_translation: For you will receive crown of graces for your head and golden chain around your neck.
brenton_translation: For thou shalt receive for thine head a crown of graces, and a chain of gold round thy neck.

fresh_translation: Son, let ungodly men not lead you astray, nor be willing if they urge you, saying,
brenton_translation: My son, let not ungodly men lead thee astray, neither consent thou to them.

fresh_translation: "Come with us, share blood; let us hide in earth a righteous man unjustly.
brenton_translation: If they should exhort thee, saying, Come with us, partake in blood, and let us unjustly hide the just man in the earth:

fresh_translation: Let us swallow him alive like Hades, and lift his memory from earth.
brenton_translation: and let us swallow him alive, as Hades would, and remove the memorial of him from the earth:

fresh_translation: Let us seize his costly possession and fill our houses with spoils.
brenton_translation: let us seize on his valuable property, and let us fill our houses with spoils:

fresh_translation: Throw your lot in among us; let us all get common purse, and let one pouch be among us."
brenton_translation: but do thou cast in thy lot with us, and let us all provide a common purse, and let us have one pouch:

fresh_translation: Do not go in way with them; turn your foot away from their tracks.
brenton_translation: go not in the way with them, but turn aside thy foot from their paths:

fresh_translation: For their feet run to evil and swift to pour out blood.
For not for nothing are nets spread for winged creatures.
brenton_translation: for nets are not without cause spread for birds.

fresh_translation: For these sharing in murder store up evils for themselves, and destruction of lawless men evil.
brenton_translation: For they that are concerned in murder store up evils for themselves; and the overthrow of transgressors is evil.

fresh_translation: These ways of all carrying out lawless things, for by ungodliness they take away their own soul.
brenton_translation: These are the ways of all that perform lawless deeds; for by ungodliness they destroy their own life.

fresh_translation: Wisdom is hymned in exits, and in broad places she leads boldness.
brenton_translation: Wisdom sings aloud in passages, and in the broad places speaks boldly.

fresh_translation: Upon heights of walls she is proclaimed, and beside the gates of rulers she sits, and beside the gates of the city, speaking boldly, says,
brenton_translation: And she makes proclamation on the top of the walls, and sits by the gates of princes; and at the gates of the city boldly says,

fresh_translation: "As long as innocent ones hold to righteousness, they will not be shamed; but fools, being desirers of insolence, becoming ungodly, hated perception.
brenton_translation: So long as the simple cleave to justice, they shall not be ashamed: but the foolish being lovers of haughtiness, having become ungodly have hated knowledge, and are become subject to reproofs.

fresh_translation: And they became liable to rebukes. Behold, I will bring forth for you utterance of my spirit, and teach you my word.
brenton_translation: Behold, I will bring forth to you the utterance of my breath, and I will instruct you in my speech.

fresh_translation: Since I called and you did not heed, and I stretched out words and you did not attend,
brenton_translation: Since I called, and ye did not hearken; and I spoke at length, and ye gave no heed;

fresh_translation: but you kept making my counsels invalid, and to my rebukes disobeyed,
brenton_translation: but ye set at nought my counsels, and disregarded my reproofs;

fresh_translation: therefore I too will laugh at your ruin and rejoice when destruction comes to you,
brenton_translation: therefore I also will laugh at your destruction; and I will rejoice against you when ruin comes upon you:

fresh_translation: and when sudden turmoil comes upon you, and downfall comes like a storm, and when affliction and siege or destruction comes upon you.
brenton_translation: yea when dismay suddenly comes upon you, and your overthrow shall arrive like a tempest; and when tribulation and distress shall come upon you, or when ruin shall come upon you.

fresh_translation: For it will be when you call on me, I will not hear you; evil men will seek me and not find.
brenton_translation: For it shall be that when ye call upon me, I will not hearken to you: wicked men shall seek me, but shall not find me.

fresh_translation: For they hated wisdom, and the fear of the Lord they did not choose.
brenton_translation: For they hated wisdom, and did not choose the word of the Lord:

fresh_translation: Nor were they willing to heed my counsels, and they sneered at my rebukes.
brenton_translation: neither would they attend to my counsels, but derided my reproofs.

fresh_translation: Therefore they will eat fruits of their own way and be filled from their own ungodliness.
brenton_translation: Therefore shall they eat the fruits of their own way, and shall be filled with their own ungodliness.

fresh_translation: For because they wronged simple ones, they will be killed, and scrutiny destroys ungodly.
brenton_translation: For because they wronged the simple, they shall be slain; and an inquisition shall ruin the ungodly.

fresh_translation: But one hearing me will settle in hope and rest fearless from every evil."
brenton_translation: But he that hearkens to me shall dwell in confidence, and shall rest securely from all evil.

fresh_translation: Son, if receiving saying of my command you hide it with yourself,
brenton_translation: My son, if thou wilt receive the utterance of my commandment, and hide it with thee;

fresh_translation: your ear will obey wisdom, and you will apply your heart to understanding; yes, apply it as admonition for your son.
brenton_translation: thine ear shall hearken to wisdom; thou shalt also apply thine heart to understanding, and shalt apply it to the instruction of thy son.

fresh_translation: For if you call on wisdom and give your voice to understanding, and seek perception with loud voice,
brenton_translation: For if thou shalt call to wisdom, and utter thy voice for understanding;

fresh_translation: and if you seek it like silver and search it out like treasures,
brenton_translation: and if thou shalt seek it as silver, and search diligently for it as for treasures;

fresh_translation: then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find knowledge of God.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, and find the knowledge of God.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord gives wisdom, and from his face knowledge and understanding.
brenton_translation: For the Lord gives wisdom; and from his presence come knowledge and understanding,

fresh_translation: And he treasures up salvation for those walking straight; he will shield their journey,
brenton_translation: and he treasures up salvation for them that walk uprightly: he will protect their way;

fresh_translation: to guard ways of ordinances, and he will preserve way of those revering him.
brenton_translation: that he may guard the righteous ways: and he will preserve the way of them that fear him.

fresh_translation: Then you will understand righteousness and judgment, and you will straighten all good tracks.
brenton_translation: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment; and shalt direct all thy course aright.

fresh_translation: For if wisdom comes into your mind and perception seems good to your soul,
brenton_translation: For if wisdom shall come into thine understanding, and discernment shall seem pleasing to thy soul,

fresh_translation: good counsel will guard you, and holy thought will keep you,
brenton_translation: good counsel shall guard thee, and holy understanding shall keep thee;

fresh_translation: to rescue you from evil way and from man speaking nothing trustworthy,
brenton_translation: to deliver thee from the evil way, and from the man that speaks nothing faithfully.

fresh_translation: those abandoning straight ways to walk in the ways of darkness,
brenton_translation: Alas for those who forsake right paths, to walk in ways of darkness;

fresh_translation: those rejoicing over evils and delighting in evil perversity,
brenton_translation: who rejoice in evils, and delight in wicked perverseness;

fresh_translation: whose tracks crooked and their paths bent,
brenton_translation: whose paths are crooked, and their courses winding;

fresh_translation: to make you far from straight way and alien to righteous judgment.
brenton_translation: to remove thee far from the straight way, and to estrange thee from a righteous purpose. My son, let not evil counsel overtake thee,

fresh_translation: Son, let evil counsel not overtake you, that which leaves teaching of youth and has forgotten divine covenant.
brenton_translation: of her who has forsaken the instruction of her youth, and forgotten the covenant of God.

fresh_translation: For she set her house beside death, and her tracks beside Hades with earthborn men.
brenton_translation: For she has fixed her house near death, and guided her wheels near Hades with the giants.

fresh_translation: All going in to her will not return, nor ever catch straight paths, for they are not seized by years of life.
brenton_translation: None that go by her shall return, neither shall they take hold of right paths, for they are not apprehended of the years of life.

fresh_translation: For if they had walked paths of good, they would have found smooth tracks of righteousness.
brenton_translation: For had they gone in good paths, they would have found the paths of righteousness easy.

fresh_translation: The good ones will inhabit the earth, and the innocent ones remain in it, for the straight ones will settle in the earth and the holy ones remain in it.
brenton_translation: For the upright shall dwell in the earth, and the holy shall be left behind in it.

fresh_translation: The ways of the ungodly will perish from earth, and lawless men will be thrust out from it.
brenton_translation: The paths of the ungodly shall perish out of the earth, and transgressors shall be driven away from it.

fresh_translation: Son, do not forget my laws, and let your heart keep my sayings.
brenton_translation: My son, forget not my laws; but let thine heart keep my words:

fresh_translation: For the length of life and years of life and peace they will add to you.
brenton_translation: for length of existence, and years of life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

fresh_translation: Acts of mercy and faithfulness let them not fail you; fasten them on your neck, and you will find favor.
brenton_translation: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee; but bind them about thy neck:

fresh_translation: And plan good things before the Lord and men.
brenton_translation: so shalt thou find favour: and do thou provide things honest in the sight of the Lord, and of men.

fresh_translation: Be trusting in God with all your heart, and do not exalt yourself on your own wisdom.
brenton_translation: Trust in God with all thine heart; and be not exalted in thine own wisdom.

fresh_translation: In all your ways know her, so that she may cut straight your ways, and your foot will not stumble.
brenton_translation: In all thy ways acquaint thyself with her, that she may rightly direct thy paths.

fresh_translation: Do not be wise with yourself; fear God and turn from every evil.
brenton_translation: Be not wise in thine own conceit; but fear God, and depart from all evil.

fresh_translation: Then healing to your body and care to your bones.
brenton_translation: Then shall there be health to thy body, and good keeping to thy bones.

fresh_translation: Honor the Lord from your righteous labors and offer firstfruits to him from the fruits of your righteousness.
brenton_translation: Honour the Lord with thy just labours, and give him the first of thy fruits of righteousness:

fresh_translation: So your storehouses may be filled with the fullness of grain, and your wine vats gush wine.
brenton_translation: that thy storehouses may be completely filled with corn, and that thy presses may burst forth with wine.

fresh_translation: Son, do not regard lightly discipline of the Lord, nor faint when reproved by him.
brenton_translation: My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord; nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:

fresh_translation: For whom the Lord loves he disciplines, and he scourges every son whom he receives.
brenton_translation: for whom the Lord loves, he rebukes, and scourges every son whom he receives.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the man who found wisdom, and mortal who saw understanding.
brenton_translation: Blessed is the man who has found wisdom, and the mortal who knows prudence.

fresh_translation: For to trade in her better than treasures of gold and silver.
brenton_translation: For it is better to traffic for her, than for treasures of gold and silver.

fresh_translation: And she more valuable than precious stones; no evil thing will oppose her; she known by all drawing near to her, and every precious thing unworthy of her.
brenton_translation: And she is more valuable than precious stones: no evil thing shall resist her: she is well known to all that approach her, and no precious thing is equal to her in value.

fresh_translation: For the length of life and years of life are in her right hand; in her left are riches and glory. From her mouth comes righteousness, and law and mercy she carries on her tongue.
brenton_translation: For length of existence and years of life are in her right hand; and in her left hand are wealth and glory:

fresh_translation: Her ways good ways, and all her tracks in peace.
brenton_translation: Her ways are good ways, and all her paths are peaceful.

fresh_translation: Tree of life to all holding fast to her, and to those leaning upon her as on the Lord, secure.
brenton_translation: She is a tree of life to all that lay hold upon her; and she is a secure help to all that stay themselves on her, as on the Lord.

fresh_translation: God founded earth by wisdom and prepared heavens by understanding.
brenton_translation: God by wisdom founded the earth, and by prudence he prepared the heavens.

fresh_translation: By perception deeps burst open, and clouds trickled dew.
brenton_translation: By understanding were the depths broken up, and the clouds dropped water.

fresh_translation: Son, do not drift away; keep my counsel and thought,
brenton_translation: My son, let them not pass from thee, but keep my counsel and understanding:

fresh_translation: so that your soul may live and grace be around your neck. And there will be healing for your flesh and care for your bones.
brenton_translation: that thy soul may live, and that there may be grace round thy neck;

fresh_translation: So that you may walk confidently in peace all your ways, and your foot will not stumble.
brenton_translation: that thou mayest go confidently in peace in all thy ways, and that thy foot may not stumble.

fresh_translation: For if you sit, you will be fearless; if you sleep, you will sleep sweetly.
brenton_translation: For if thou rest, thou shalt be undismayed; and if thou sleep, thou shalt slumber sweetly.

fresh_translation: And you will not fear terror coming, nor assaults of the ungodly when they come.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not be afraid of alarm coming upon thee, neither of approaching attacks of ungodly men.

fresh_translation: For the Lord will be over all your ways and brace your foot so that it not be shaken.
brenton_translation: For the Lord shall be over all thy ways, and shall establish thy foot that thou be not moved.

fresh_translation: Do not withhold doing good to needy when your hand has power to help.
brenton_translation: Forbear not to do good to the poor, whensoever thy hand may have power to help him.

fresh_translation: Do not say, "Go, return, and tomorrow I will give," when you can do good, for you do not know what next day will bring forth.
brenton_translation: Say not, Come back another time, to-morrow I will give; while thou art able to do him good: for thou knowest not what the next day will bring forth.

fresh_translation: Do not contrive evils against your friend living nearby and trusting in you.
brenton_translation: Devise not evil against thy friend, living near thee and trusting in thee.

fresh_translation: Do not love strife with man for nothing, lest he work some evil against you.
brenton_translation: Be not ready to quarrel with a man without a cause, lest he do thee some harm.

fresh_translation: Do not gain reproaches of evil men, nor envy their ways.
brenton_translation: Procure not the reproaches of bad men, neither do thou covet their ways.

fresh_translation: For every lawless man unclean before the Lord, and among righteous he does not sit in council.
brenton_translation: For every transgressor is unclean before the Lord; neither does he sit among the righteous.

fresh_translation: The curse of God in the houses of the ungodly, but dwellings of the righteous are blessed.
brenton_translation: The curse of God is in the houses of the ungodly; but the habitations of the just are blessed.

fresh_translation: The Lord opposes proud, but to humble he gives grace.
brenton_translation: The Lord resists the proud; but he gives grace to the humble.

fresh_translation: The wise will inherit glory, but the ungodly exalt dishonor.
brenton_translation: The wise shall inherit glory; but the ungodly have exalted their own dishonour.

fresh_translation: Hear, children, discipline of father, and pay attention to know understanding.
brenton_translation: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

fresh_translation: For I give you good gift; do not forsake my law.
brenton_translation: For I give you a good gift; forsake ye not my law.

fresh_translation: For I also became son to my father, obedient and loved before my mother.
brenton_translation: For I also was a son obedient to my father, and loved in the sight of my mother:

fresh_translation: They were saying and teaching me, "Let our word rest in your heart.
brenton_translation: who spoke and instructed me, saying, Let our speech be fixed in thine heart, keep our commandments, forget them not:

fresh_translation: Keep commandments, do not forget, nor disregard sayings of my mouth.
brenton_translation: and do not neglect the speech of my mouth.

fresh_translation: Do not abandon her, and she will hold you; love her and she will keep you.
brenton_translation: And forsake it not, and it shall cleave to thee: love it, and it shall keep thee.

fresh_translation: Enclose her round about, and she will exalt you; honor her, so that she may embrace you.
brenton_translation: Secure it, and it shall exalt thee: honour it, that it may embrace thee;

fresh_translation: So that she may give your head crown of graces, and with crown of delight defend you.
brenton_translation: that it may give unto thy head a crown of graces, and may cover thee with a crown of delight.

fresh_translation: Hear, son, and receive my words, and years of your life will multiply, so that many ways of life may belong to you.
brenton_translation: Hear, my son, and receive my words; and the years of thy life shall be increased, that the resources of thy life may be many.

fresh_translation: For I teach you ways of wisdom and set you on straight tracks.
brenton_translation: For I teach thee the ways of wisdom; and I cause thee to go in right paths.

fresh_translation: For when you walk, your steps will not be confined; and if you run, you will not grow weary.
brenton_translation: For when thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not be distressed.

fresh_translation: Take hold of my discipline; do not let go, but guard it for yourself as your life.
brenton_translation: Take hold of my instruction; let it not go,—but keep it for thyself for thy life.

fresh_translation: Do not go upon the ways of the ungodly, nor envy ways of lawless men.
brenton_translation: Go not in the ways of the ungodly, neither covet the ways of transgressors.

fresh_translation: Wherever they camp, do not go there; turn aside from them and pass on.
brenton_translation: In whatever place they shall pitch their camp, go not thither; but turn from them, and pass away.

fresh_translation: For they will not sleep unless they do evil; sleep is taken from them, and they do not lie down.
brenton_translation: For they cannot sleep, unless they have done evil: their sleep is taken away, and they rest not.

fresh_translation: For these feed on breads of ungodliness and get drunk on lawless wine.
brenton_translation: For these live upon the bread of ungodliness, and are drunken with wine of transgression.

fresh_translation: The ways of the righteous are like shining light; they go before and give light until day is fully set right.
brenton_translation: But the ways of the righteous shine like light; they go on and shine, until the day be fully come.

fresh_translation: But the ways of the ungodly are dark; they do not know how they stumble.
brenton_translation: But the ways of the ungodly are dark; they know not how they stumble.

fresh_translation: Son, pay attention to my saying; incline your ear to my words,
brenton_translation: My son, attend to my speech; and apply thine ear to my words:

fresh_translation: so that your springs may not fail you; guard them in your heart.
brenton_translation: that thy fountains may not fail thee; keep them in thine heart.

fresh_translation: For they are life to those finding them and healing to all flesh.
brenton_translation: For they are life to those that find them, and health to all their flesh.

fresh_translation: With every guarding keep your heart, for out of these are goings-out of life.
brenton_translation: Keep thine heart with the utmost care; for out of these are the issues of life.

fresh_translation: Remove crooked mouth from yourself, and put unjust lips far from you.
brenton_translation: Remove from thee a froward mouth, and put far away from thee unjust lips.

fresh_translation: Let your eyes look straight, and your eyelids nod what is right.
brenton_translation: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids assent to just things.

fresh_translation: Make straight tracks for your feet and direct your ways.
brenton_translation: Make straight paths for thy feet, and order thy ways aright.

fresh_translation: Do not turn right or left, but turn your foot away from evil way. For God knows ways on right, but those on left twisted; he will make your tracks straight and advance your journeys in peace.
brenton_translation: Turn not aside to the right hand nor to the left, but turn away thy foot from an evil way:

fresh_translation: Son, pay attention to my wisdom, and incline your ear to my words,
brenton_translation: My son, attend to my wisdom, and apply thine ear to my words;

fresh_translation: so that you may guard good thought; and perception of my lips I command you.
brenton_translation: that thou mayest keep good understanding, and the discretion of my lips gives thee a charge.

fresh_translation: Do not pay attention to base woman, for honey drips from lips of prostitute, who for a time fattens your throat.
brenton_translation: for honey drops from the lips of a harlot, who for a season pleases thy palate:

fresh_translation: Yet afterward you will find her more bitter than gall and sharper than two-edged sword.
brenton_translation: but afterwards thou wilt find her more bitter than gall, and sharper than a two-edged sword.

fresh_translation: For feet of folly bring those using her down with death into Hades, and her steps do not stand firm.
brenton_translation: For the feet of folly lead those who deal with her down to the grave with death; and her steps are not established.

fresh_translation: For she does not go upon the ways of life, and her tracks slippery and not well known.
brenton_translation: For she goes not upon the paths of life; but her ways are slippery, and not easily known.

fresh_translation: Now then, son, hear me and do not make my words invalid.
brenton_translation: Now then, my son, hear me, and make not my words of none effect.

fresh_translation: Make your way far from her; do not come near doors of her houses,
brenton_translation: Remove thy way far from her; draw not near to the doors of her house:

fresh_translation: lest you give your life to others and your livelihood to unmerciful men,
brenton_translation: lest thou give away thy life to others, and thy substance to the merciless:

fresh_translation: lest strangers be filled with your strength and your labors enter houses of strangers,
brenton_translation: lest strangers be filled with thy strength, and thy labours come into the houses of strangers;

fresh_translation: and you will regret at end when flesh of your body is worn away.
brenton_translation: and thou repent at last, when the flesh of thy body is consumed,

fresh_translation: And you will say, "How I hated discipline, and my heart turned away from reproofs.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart avoided reproofs!

fresh_translation: I was not hearing the voice of one disciplining me and teaching me, nor inclining my ear.
brenton_translation: I heard not the voice of him that instructed me, and taught me, neither did I apply mine ear.

fresh_translation: I almost came into every evil in the midst of assembly and congregation."
brenton_translation: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

fresh_translation: Drink waters from your vessels and from wells of your spring.
brenton_translation: Drink waters out of thine own vessels, and out of thine own springing wells.

fresh_translation: Let not waters overflow for you from your spring; let your waters pass through your broad places.
brenton_translation: Let not waters out of thy fountain be spilt by thee, but let thy waters go into thy streets.

fresh_translation: Let them be yours alone, and let no stranger share with you.
brenton_translation: Let them be only thine own, and let no stranger partake with thee.

fresh_translation: Let fountain of your water be your own, and rejoice with the wife of your youth.
brenton_translation: Let thy fountain of water be truly thine own; and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

fresh_translation: Doe of love and colt of your graces, let her converse with you; let your own lead you and be with you at all times, for in companionship with her love you will be much.
brenton_translation: Let thy loving hart and thy graceful colt company with thee, and let her be considered thine own, and be with thee at all times; for ravished with her love thou shalt be greatly increased.

fresh_translation: Do not be much with strange woman, nor be held in arms of one not your own.
brenton_translation: Be not intimate with a strange woman, neither fold thyself in the arms of a woman not thine own.

fresh_translation: For the ways of man before the eyes of God, and he watches all his tracks.
brenton_translation: For the ways of a man are before the eyes of God, and he looks on all his paths.

fresh_translation: Lawless deeds hunt man down, and each is bound with cords of his own sins.
brenton_translation: Iniquities ensnare a man, and every one is bound in the chains of his own sins.

fresh_translation: This one dies with undisciplined men, and from the abundance of his own livelihood is cast out and lost through folly.
brenton_translation: Such a man dies with the uninstructed; and he is cast forth from the abundance of his own substance, and has perished through folly.

fresh_translation: Son, if you guarantee your friend, you hand your hand over to enemy.
brenton_translation: My son, if thou become surety for thy friend, thou shalt deliver thine hand to an enemy.

fresh_translation: For own lips strong snare for man, and he is caught by lips of his own mouth.
brenton_translation: For a man's own lips become a strong snare to him, and he is caught with the lips of his own mouth.

fresh_translation: Do, son, what I command you, and save yourself, for you came into the hands of evil men through your friend. Go, do not grow slack, but press your friend whom you guaranteed.
brenton_translation: My son, do what I command thee, and deliver thyself; for on thy friend's account thou art come into the power of evil men: faint not, but stir up even thy friend for whom thou art become surety.

fresh_translation: Do not give sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids,
brenton_translation: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber with thine eyelids;

fresh_translation: that you may save yourself like a gazelle from snares and like a bird from trap.
brenton_translation: that thou mayest deliver thyself as a doe out of the toils, and as a bird out of a snare.

fresh_translation: Go to ant, sluggard, and watch his ways and become wiser than he.
brenton_translation: Go to the ant, O sluggard; and see, and emulate his ways, and become wiser than he.

fresh_translation: For since he has no farming, no one forcing him, nor being under master,
brenton_translation: For whereas he has no husbandry, nor any one to compel him, and is under no master,

fresh_translation: he prepares in summer much food and in harvest makes provision. Or go to bee and learn how worker she is and how dignified she makes her work, whose labors kings and private men use for health. She desired by all and renowned. Though weak in strength, by honoring wisdom she advanced.
brenton_translation: he prepares food for himself in the summer, and lays by abundant store in harvest.

fresh_translation: How long, sluggard, will you lie down? When will you rise from sleep?
brenton_translation: How long wilt thou lie, O sluggard? and when wilt thou awake out of sleep?

fresh_translation: Little you sleep, little you sit, little you slumber, little you fold your hands over your chest,
brenton_translation: Thou sleepest a little, and thou restest a little, and thou slumberest a short time, and thou foldest thine arms over thy breast a little.

fresh_translation: then poverty comes to you like a bad traveler and want like a good runner. But if you are tireless, your harvest will come like a fountain, and want will flee like a bad runner.
brenton_translation: Then poverty comes upon thee as an evil traveller, and want as a swift courier:

fresh_translation: Foolish and lawless man walks in ways not good.
brenton_translation: A foolish man and a transgressor goes in ways that are not good.

fresh_translation: He winks with eye, signals with foot, and teaches with nods of fingers.
brenton_translation: And the same winks with the eye, and makes a sign with his foot, and teaches with the beckonings of his fingers.

fresh_translation: Perverse heart devises evils at every time; such man stirs up disturbances for city.
brenton_translation: His perverse heart devises evils: at all times such a one causes troubles to a city.

fresh_translation: Because of this his ruin comes suddenly, cutting and crushing incurably.
brenton_translation: Therefore his destruction shall come suddenly; overthrow and irretrievable ruin.

fresh_translation: For he rejoices in all things the Lord hates, and he is crushed because of uncleanness of soul.
