brenton_translation: For he rejoices in all things which God hates, and he is ruined by reason of impurity of soul.

fresh_translation: Haughty eye, unjust tongue, hands pouring out blood of righteous,
brenton_translation: The eye of the haughty, a tongue unjust, hands shedding the blood of the just;

fresh_translation: and heart forging evil thoughts, and feet hurrying to do evil,
brenton_translation: and a heart devising evil thoughts, and feet hastening to do evil,—are hateful to God.

fresh_translation: unjust false witness kindling lies and sending judgments among brothers.
brenton_translation: An unjust witness kindles falsehoods, and brings on quarrels between brethren.

fresh_translation: Son, keep laws of your father and do not reject decrees of your mother.
brenton_translation: My son, keep the laws of thy father, and reject not the ordinances of thy mother:

fresh_translation: Fasten them to your soul always and put them as chain on your neck.
brenton_translation: but bind them upon thy soul continually, and hang them as a chain about thy neck.

fresh_translation: Whenever you walk, bring her on, and let her be with you; when you sleep, let her guard you, so that waking she may speak with you.
brenton_translation: Whensoever thou walkest, lead this along and let it be with thee; and when thou sleepest let it keep thee; that it may talk with thee when thou wakest.

fresh_translation: For the command of law lamp and light, and way of life reproof and discipline,
brenton_translation: For the commandment of the law is a lamp and a light; a way of life; reproof also and correction:

fresh_translation: to guard you from married woman and from slanderous tongue of stranger.
brenton_translation: to keep thee continually from a married woman, and from the calumny of a strange tongue.

fresh_translation: Let not beauty conquer you in desire, nor be caught by your eyes, nor be seized by her eyelids.
brenton_translation: Let not the desire of beauty overcome thee, neither be thou caught by thine eyes, neither be captivated with her eyelids.

fresh_translation: For price of prostitute as much as one loaf, but wife of honored men hunts precious souls.
brenton_translation: For the value of a harlot is as much as of one loaf; and a woman hunts for the precious souls of men.

fresh_translation: Will anyone bind fire in bosom and not burn clothes?
brenton_translation: Shall any one bind fire in his bosom, and not burn his garments?

fresh_translation: Or will anyone walk on coals of fire and not burn feet?
brenton_translation: or will any one walk on coals of fire, and not burn his feet?

fresh_translation: So one going in to married woman will not be acquitted, nor anyone touching her.
brenton_translation: So is he that goes in to a married woman; he shall not be held guiltless, neither any one that touches her.

fresh_translation: Not astonishing if one is caught stealing, for he steals to fill soul when hungry.
brenton_translation: It is not to be wondered at if one should be taken stealing, for he steals that when hungry he may satisfy his soul:

fresh_translation: But if caught, he will pay sevenfold, and by giving all his possessions he will rescue himself.
brenton_translation: but if he should be taken, he shall repay sevenfold, and shall deliver himself by giving all his goods.

fresh_translation: But adulterer, through lack of sense, works destruction for his soul.
brenton_translation: But the adulterer through want of sense procures destruction to his soul.

fresh_translation: Pains and dishonor he bears, and his reproach will not be wiped out forever.
brenton_translation: He endures both pain and disgrace, and his reproach shall never be wiped off.

fresh_translation: For jealousy fills wrath of her husband; he will not spare in the day of judgment.
brenton_translation: For the soul of her husband is full of jealousy: he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

fresh_translation: He will not accept any ransom against enmity, nor be reconciled by many gifts.
brenton_translation: He will not forego his enmity for any ransom: neither will he be reconciled for many gifts.

fresh_translation: Son, keep my words, and hide my commands with yourself. Son, honor Lord and you will grow strong; besides him fear no other.
brenton_translation: My son, keep my words, and hide with thee my commandments.

fresh_translation: Keep my commands and live, and my words like apple of eyes.
brenton_translation: keep my commandments, and thou shalt live; and keep my words as the pupils of thine eyes.

fresh_translation: Bind them on your fingers, and write them on the breadth of your heart.
brenton_translation: And bind them on thy fingers, and write them on the table of thine heart.

fresh_translation: Say wisdom your sister, and make understanding your close acquaintance,
brenton_translation: Say that wisdom is thy sister, and gain prudence as an acquaintance for thyself;

fresh_translation: that she may keep you from strange and evil woman if she throw herself at you with winning words.
brenton_translation: that she may keep thee from the strange and wicked woman, if she should assail thee with flattering words.

fresh_translation: For from little window of her house, peering into streets,
brenton_translation: For she looks from a window out of her house into the streets, at one whom she may see of the senseless ones, a young man void of understanding,

fresh_translation: whomever she sees among foolish children, young man lacking sense,
brenton_translation: passing by the corner in the passages near her house,

fresh_translation: passing near corner, in passages of her house,
brenton_translation: and speaking, in the dark of the evening,

fresh_translation: and speaking in evening darkness, when nightly quiet or murky gloom,
brenton_translation: when there happens to be the stillness of night and of darkness:

fresh_translation: woman meets him, having appearance of prostitute, who makes hearts of young men fly away.
brenton_translation: and the woman meets him having the appearance of a harlot, that causes the hearts of young men to flutter.

fresh_translation: She winged and profligate, and in the house her feet do not keep quiet.
brenton_translation: And she is fickle, and debauched, and her feet abide not at home.

fresh_translation: For a time she wanders outside, and a time in squares; beside every corner she lurks.
brenton_translation: For at one time she wanders without, and at another time she lies in wait in the streets, at every corner.

fresh_translation: Then seizing him she kissed him, and with shameless face said to him,
brenton_translation: Then she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said to him,

fresh_translation: "Peace-sacrifice mine; today I pay my vows.
brenton_translation: I have a peace-offering; to-day I pay my vows:

fresh_translation: Because of this I came out to meet you, desiring your face; I found you.
brenton_translation: therefore I came forth to meet thee, desiring thy face; and I have found thee.

fresh_translation: With coverings I decked my bed, and with Egyptian tapestries I spread it.
brenton_translation: I have spread my bed with sheets, and I have covered it with double tapestry from Egypt.

fresh_translation: I sprinkled my couch with saffron, and my house with cinnamon.
brenton_translation: I have sprinkled my couch with saffron, and my house with cinnamon.

fresh_translation: Come, let us enjoy love until dawn; come, let us roll in desire.
brenton_translation: Come, and let us enjoy love until the morning; come, and let us embrace in love.

fresh_translation: For my husband not home, but he has gone long way.
brenton_translation: For my husband is not at home, but is gone on a long journey,

fresh_translation: Taking bundle of silver in his hand; after many days he will return to his house."
brenton_translation: having taken in his hand a bundle of money: after many days he will return to his house.

fresh_translation: She led him astray with much talk, and with snares from lips she pushed him over.
brenton_translation: So with much converse she prevailed on him to go astray, and with the snares of her lips she forced him from the right path.

fresh_translation: He followed her dumbfounded, as ox led to slaughter and as dog to bonds,
brenton_translation: And he followed her, being gently led on, and that as an ox is led to the slaughter, and as a dog to bonds, or as a hart shot in the liver with an arrow:

fresh_translation: or as a deer struck in liver by arrow. He hurries like a bird into snare, not knowing he runs for soul.
brenton_translation: and he hastens as a bird into a snare, not knowing that he is running for his life.

fresh_translation: Now then, son, hear me and pay attention to sayings of my mouth.
brenton_translation: Now then, my son, hearken to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.

fresh_translation: Let your heart not turn aside to her ways.
brenton_translation: Let not thine heart turn aside to her ways:

fresh_translation: For having wounded many, she cast them down, and innumerable those she killed.
brenton_translation: for she has wounded and cast down many, and those whom she has slain are innumerable.

fresh_translation: The ways of Hades are her house, leading down to chambers of death.
brenton_translation: Her house is the way of hell, leading down to the chambers of death.

fresh_translation: You will proclaim wisdom, so that understanding may obey you.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt proclaim wisdom, that understanding may be obedient to thee.

fresh_translation: For she is on high heights, and among paths she stands.
brenton_translation: For she is on lofty eminences, and stands in the midst of the ways.

fresh_translation: For beside the gates of rulers she sits, and in entrances she sings hymns.
brenton_translation: For she sits by the gates of princes, and sings in the entrances, saying,

fresh_translation: To you, men, I call, and I send out my voice to the sons of men.
brenton_translation: You, O men, I exhort; and utter my voice to the sons of men.

fresh_translation: Understand shrewdness, innocent ones; and untrained ones, take heart.
brenton_translation: O ye simple, understand subtlety, and ye that are untaught, imbibe knowledge.

fresh_translation: Hear me, for I will speak noble things, and I will open upright things from my lips.
brenton_translation: Hearken to me; for I will speak solemn truths; and will produce right sayings from my lips.

fresh_translation: For my throat will meditate truth, and lying lips abominable before me.
brenton_translation: For my throat shall meditate truth; and false lips are an abomination before me.

fresh_translation: All sayings of my mouth with righteousness; nothing in them crooked or twisted.
brenton_translation: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing in them wrong or perverse.

fresh_translation: All plain to those understanding and right to those finding knowledge.
brenton_translation: They are all evident to those that understand, and right to those that find knowledge.

fresh_translation: Take discipline and not silver, and choose knowledge above proven gold; and choose perception above pure gold.
brenton_translation: Receive instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than tried gold.

fresh_translation: For wisdom better than precious stones, and every valuable thing not worthy of her.
brenton_translation: For wisdom is better than precious stones; and no valuable substance is of equal worth with it.

fresh_translation: I, wisdom, settled counsel, and knowledge and understanding I called.
brenton_translation: I wisdom have dwelt with counsel and knowledge, and I have called upon understanding.

fresh_translation: The fear of the Lord hates injustice and insolence and pride and evil ways; and twisted ways of evil I hated.
brenton_translation: The fear of the Lord hates unrighteousness, and insolence, and pride, and the ways of wicked men; and I hate the perverse ways of bad men.

fresh_translation: Mine counsel and security, mine understanding, and mine strength.
brenton_translation: Counsel and safety are mine: prudence is mine, and strength is mine.

fresh_translation: Through me kings reign and rulers write righteousness.
brenton_translation: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

fresh_translation: Through me nobles grow great, and tyrants through me rule earth.
brenton_translation: By me nobles become great, and monarchs by me rule over the earth.

fresh_translation: I love those loving me, and those seeking me will find me.
brenton_translation: I love those that love me; and they that seek me shall find me.

fresh_translation: Riches and glory belong to me, and abundance of possessions and righteousness.
brenton_translation: Wealth and glory belong to me; yea, abundant possessions and righteousness.

fresh_translation: Better to bear fruit from me than gold and precious stone, and my produce better than chosen silver.
brenton_translation: It is better to have my fruit than to have gold and precious stones; and my produce is better than choice silver.

fresh_translation: In the ways of righteousness I walk, and among tracks of judgment I turn about,
brenton_translation: I walk in ways of righteousness, and am conversant with the paths of judgment;

fresh_translation: so that I may apportion substance to those loving me and fill their treasuries with good things. If I tell you things happening day by day, I will remember things from age to number them.
brenton_translation: that I may divide substance to them that love me, and may fill their treasures with good things.

fresh_translation: The Lord created me beginning of his ways, for his works.
brenton_translation: The Lord made me the beginning of his ways for his works.

fresh_translation: Before age he founded me, in beginning,
brenton_translation: He established me before time was in the beginning, before he made the earth:

fresh_translation: before making earth and before making deeps, before springs of waters came forth.
brenton_translation: even before he made the depths; before the fountains of water came forth:

fresh_translation: Before mountains were settled, and before all hills, he begets me.
brenton_translation: before the mountains were settled, and before all hills, he begets me.

fresh_translation: The Lord made lands and uninhabited places and inhabited heights under heaven.
brenton_translation: The Lord made countries and uninhabited tracts, and the highest inhabited parts of the world.

fresh_translation: When he prepared heaven, I was alongside him, and when he marked out his throne upon winds,
brenton_translation: When he prepared the heaven, I was present with him; and when he prepared his throne upon the winds:

fresh_translation: when he made strong upper clouds and set secure springs under heaven,
brenton_translation: and when he strengthened the clouds above; and when he secured the fountains of the earth:

fresh_translation: and made strong foundations of the earth,
brenton_translation: and when he strengthened the foundations of the earth:

fresh_translation: I was beside him, fitting together. I was one in whom he delighted, and day by day I rejoiced before him at every time,
brenton_translation: I was by him, suiting myself to him, I was that wherein he took delight; and daily I rejoiced in his presence continually.

fresh_translation: when he rejoiced, having completed inhabited world, and rejoiced in the sons of men.
brenton_translation: For he rejoiced when he had completed the world, and rejoiced among the children of men.

fresh_translation: Now then, son, hear me.
brenton_translation: Now then, my son, hear me: blessed is the man who shall hearken to me, and the mortal who shall keep my ways;

fresh_translation: Blessed is the man who will hear me, and man who will keep my ways, staying awake at my doors daily, keeping posts of my entrances.
brenton_translation: watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my entrances.

fresh_translation: For my goings-out goings-out of life, and favor is prepared from the Lord.
brenton_translation: For my outgoings are the outgoings of life, and in them is prepared favour from the Lord.

fresh_translation: But those sinning against me act ungodly toward their own souls, and those hating me love death.
brenton_translation: But they that sin against me act wickedly against their own souls: and they that hate me love death.

fresh_translation: Wisdom built a house for herself and set seven pillars under it.
brenton_translation: Wisdom has built a house for herself, and set up seven pillars.

fresh_translation: She slaughtered her sacrifices, mixed her wine into bowl, and prepared her table.
brenton_translation: She has killed her beasts; she has mingled her wine in a bowl, and prepared her table.

fresh_translation: She sent her servants, calling with high proclamation upon bowl, saying,
brenton_translation: She has sent forth her servants, calling with a loud proclamation to the feast, saying,

fresh_translation: "Whoever foolish, let him turn aside to me." And to those lacking sense she said,
brenton_translation: Whoso is foolish, let him turn aside to me: and to them that want understanding she says,

fresh_translation: "Come, eat of my breads and drink wine I mixed for you.
brenton_translation: Come, eat of my bread, and drink wine which I have mingled for you.

fresh_translation: Leave folly and live, and seek understanding so that you may live, and set straight by knowledge understanding.
brenton_translation: Leave folly, that ye may reign for ever; and seek wisdom, and improve understanding by knowledge.

fresh_translation: One disciplining evil men will receive dishonor for himself, and rebuking the ungodly man will blame himself.
brenton_translation: He that reproves evil men shall get dishonour to himself; and he that rebukes an ungodly man shall disgrace himself.

fresh_translation: Do not rebuke evil men, lest they hate you; rebuke wise, and he will love you.
brenton_translation: Rebuke not evil men, lest they should hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

fresh_translation: Give wise one opportunity, and he will become wiser; make a righteous man know, and he will add to receiving.
brenton_translation: Give an opportunity to a wise man, and he will be wiser: instruct a just man, and he will receive more instruction.

fresh_translation: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the Lord, and the counsel of holy ones is understanding. For knowing law belongs to good mind.
brenton_translation: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and the counsel of saints is understanding:

fresh_translation: For by this way you will live long time, and years of your life will be added.
brenton_translation: For in this way thou shalt live long, and years of thy life shall be added to thee.

fresh_translation: Son, if you become wise, for yourself you will be wise and for neighbors; but if you become evil, alone you will draw out evils. One leaning on lies pastures winds, and pursues flying birds. For he left ways of his own vineyard and wandered from tracks of his own field; he passes through waterless desert and land appointed in thirsty places, and gathers barrenness with hands.
brenton_translation: Son, if thou be wise for thyself, thou shalt also be wise for thy neighbours; and if thou shouldest prove wicked, thou alone wilt bear the evil.

fresh_translation: Foolish and bold woman, lacking bread, becomes one who does not know shame.
brenton_translation: A foolish and bold woman, who knows not modesty, comes to want a morsel.

fresh_translation: She sat at the doors of her house on chair openly in squares,
brenton_translation: She sits at the doors of her house, on a seat openly in the streets,

fresh_translation: calling those passing by and going straight in their ways,
brenton_translation: calling to passers by, and to those that are going right on their ways;

fresh_translation: "Who among you most foolish? Let him turn aside to me." And to those lacking sense I exhort, saying,
brenton_translation: saying, Whoso is most senseless of you, let him turn aside to me; and I exhort those that want prudence, saying,

fresh_translation: "Touch hidden breads pleasantly and sweet water of theft."
brenton_translation: Take and enjoy secret bread, and the sweet water of theft.

fresh_translation: But he does not know that earthborn men perish beside her, and he meets floor of Hades. But spring away; do not delay in place, nor set your eye toward her. For thus you will cross foreign water and pass over foreign river. Hold back from foreign water and do not drink from foreign spring, so that you may live long time and years of life be added.
brenton_translation: But he knows that mighty men die by her, and he falls in with a snare of hell.

fresh_translation: A wise son gladdens a father, but a foolish son grief to mother.
brenton_translation: A wise son makes his father glad: but a foolish son is a grief to his mother.

fresh_translation: Treasures will not benefit lawless men, but righteousness will rescue from death.
brenton_translation: Treasures shall not profit the lawless: but righteousness shall deliver from death.

fresh_translation: The Lord will not starve righteous soul, but life of the ungodly he will overthrow.
brenton_translation: The Lord will not famish a righteous soul: but he will overthrow the life of the ungodly.

fresh_translation: Poverty humbles man, but hands of brave men make rich. Disciplined son will be wise, but to foolish servant he will make use.
brenton_translation: Poverty brings a man low: but the hands of the vigorous make rich.

fresh_translation: Understanding son saved from heat, but lawless son becomes wind-blasted in harvest.
brenton_translation: A wise son is saved from heat: but a lawless son is blighted of the winds in harvest.

fresh_translation: The blessing of the Lord upon the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the ungodly will cover untimely grief.
brenton_translation: The blessing of the Lord is upon the head of the just: but untimely grief shall cover the mouth of the ungodly.

fresh_translation: The memory of the righteous is with praises, but the name of the ungodly is quenched.
brenton_translation: The memory of the just is praised; but the name of the ungodly man is extinguished.

fresh_translation: The wise in heart will receive commands, but roofless one twisting with lips will be tripped up.
brenton_translation: A wise man in heart will receive commandments; but he that is unguarded in his lips shall be overthrown in his perverseness.

fresh_translation: One walking simply walks confidently, but one twisting his ways will be known.
brenton_translation: He that walks simply, walks confidently; but he that perverts his ways shall be known.

fresh_translation: One winking eyes with deceit gathers griefs for men, but one rebuking with boldness makes peace.
brenton_translation: He that winks with his eyes deceitfully, procures griefs for men; but he that reproves boldly is a peacemaker.

fresh_translation: A fountain of life is in the hand of the righteous, but the mouth of the ungodly will cover destruction.
brenton_translation: There is a fountain of life in the hand of a righteous man; but destruction shall cover the mouth of the ungodly.

fresh_translation: Hatred stirs strife, but friendship covers all not loving strife.
brenton_translation: Hatred stirs up strife; but affection covers all that do not love strife.

fresh_translation: One bringing forth wisdom from lips strikes heartless man with rod.
brenton_translation: He that brings forth wisdom from his lips smites the fool with a rod.

fresh_translation: The wise hide perception, but the mouth of the rash approaches ruin.
brenton_translation: The wise will hide discretion; but the mouth of the hasty draws near to ruin.

fresh_translation: Possession of the rich is a strong city, but poverty is ruin of the ungodly.
brenton_translation: The wealth of rich men is a strong city; but poverty is the ruin of the ungodly.

fresh_translation: The works of the righteous produce life, but fruits of the ungodly produce sins.
brenton_translation: The works of the righteous produce life; but the fruits of the ungodly produce sins.

fresh_translation: Discipline guards the ways of righteous life, but discipline without correction leads astray.
brenton_translation: Instruction keeps the right ways of life; but instruction unchastened goes astray.

fresh_translation: Righteous lips cover enmity, but those bringing out slanders are very foolish.
brenton_translation: Righteous lips cover enmity; but they that utter railings are most foolish.

fresh_translation: In much speech you will not escape sin, but sparing lips you will be understanding.
brenton_translation: By a multitude of words thou shalt not escape sin; but if thou refrain thy lips thou wilt be prudent.

fresh_translation: The tongue of the righteous is refined silver, but the heart of the ungodly will fail.
brenton_translation: The tongue of the just is tried silver; but the heart of the ungodly shall fail.

fresh_translation: The lips of the righteous know high things, but fools die in want.
brenton_translation: The lips of the righteous know sublime truths: but the foolish die in want.

fresh_translation: The blessing of the Lord upon the head of the righteous, it makes rich, and grief in heart will not be added to it.
brenton_translation: The blessing of the Lord is upon the head of the righteous; it enriches him, and grief of heart shall not be added to it.

fresh_translation: In laughter fool practices evil things, but wisdom bears understanding for man.
brenton_translation: A fool does mischief in sport; but wisdom brings forth prudence for a man.

fresh_translation: An ungodly one is carried about in destruction, but the desire of the righteous is acceptable.
brenton_translation: The ungodly is engulphed in destruction; but the desire of the righteous is acceptable.

fresh_translation: When storm passes by, ungodly vanishes, but righteous turning aside is saved forever.
brenton_translation: When the storm passes by, the ungodly vanishes away; but the righteous turns aside and escapes for ever.

fresh_translation: Like sour grape to teeth and smoke to eyes, so lawlessness to those using it.
brenton_translation: As a sour grape is hurtful to the teeth, and smoke to the eyes, so iniquity hurts those that practise it.

fresh_translation: The fear of the Lord adds days, but years of the ungodly will be shortened.
brenton_translation: The fear of the Lord adds length of days: but the years of the ungodly shall be shortened.

fresh_translation: Joy lingers for the righteous, but hope of the ungodly perishes.
brenton_translation: Joy rests long with the righteous: but the hope of the ungodly shall perish.

fresh_translation: The fear of the Lord is a fortress of a holy one, but ruin to workers of evil.
brenton_translation: The fear of the Lord is a strong hold of the saints: but ruin comes to them that work wickedness.

fresh_translation: The righteous forever will not give way, but the ungodly will not inhabit the earth.
brenton_translation: The righteous shall never fail: but the ungodly shall not dwell in the earth.

fresh_translation: The mouth of the righteous drips wisdom, but the tongue of the unjust will perish.
brenton_translation: The mouth of the righteous drops wisdom: but the tongue of the unjust shall perish.

fresh_translation: The lips of righteous men drip graces, but the mouth of the ungodly turns aside.
brenton_translation: The lips of just men drop grace: but the mouth of the ungodly is perverse.

fresh_translation: Deceitful scales abomination before the Lord, but just weight acceptable to him.
brenton_translation: False balances are an abomination before the Lord: but a just weight is acceptable unto him.

fresh_translation: Wherever insolence enters, there also dishonor; but mouth of humble meditates wisdom.
brenton_translation: Wherever pride enters, there will be also disgrace: but the mouth of the lowly meditates wisdom.

fresh_translation: When a righteous one dies, he leaves regret, but destruction of the ungodly comes readily and gladly.
brenton_translation: When a just man dies he leaves regret: but the destruction of the ungodly is speedy, and causes joy.

fresh_translation: The righteousness of the blameless cuts straight ways; but ungodliness falls by injustice.
brenton_translation: Righteousness traces out blameless paths: but ungodliness encounters unjust dealing.

fresh_translation: The righteousness of the upright rescues them, but lawless are caught by their own destruction.
brenton_translation: The righteousness of upright men delivers them: but transgressors are caught in their own destruction.

fresh_translation: When a righteous man dies, hope does not perish, but boast of the ungodly perishes.
brenton_translation: At the death of a just man his hope does not perish: but the boast of the ungodly perishes.

fresh_translation: A righteous one escapes from a trap, and the ungodly one is handed over in his place.
brenton_translation: A righteous man escapes from a snare, and the ungodly man is delivered up in his place.

fresh_translation: In the mouth of the ungodly is a snare to citizens, but perception of the righteous is a good way.
brenton_translation: In the mouth of ungodly men is a snare to citizens: but the understanding of righteous men is prosperous.

fresh_translation: In good things of the righteous, a city prospered.
brenton_translation: In the prosperity of righteous men a city prospers:

fresh_translation: But by the mouths of the ungodly it was torn down.
brenton_translation: but by the mouths of ungodly men it is overthrown.

fresh_translation: One lacking sense sneers at citizens, but prudent man leads quietness.
brenton_translation: A man void of understanding sneers at his fellow citizens: but a sensible man is quiet.

fresh_translation: Double-tongued man reveals counsels in council, but faithful breath hides matters.
brenton_translation: A double-tongued man discloses the secret counsels of an assembly: but he that is faithful in spirit conceals matters.

fresh_translation: Those without guidance fall like leaves, but salvation exists in much counsel.
brenton_translation: They that have no guidance fall like leaves: but in much counsel there is safety.

fresh_translation: Evil man does evil when he joins himself to righteous, but hates the sound of security.
brenton_translation: A bad man does harm wherever he meets a just man: and he hates the sound of safety.

fresh_translation: Pleasant woman raises glory for husband, but woman hating righteousness throne of dishonor. Sluggards become needy, but brave men are supported by wealth.
brenton_translation: A gracious wife brings glory to her husband: but a woman hating righteousness is a theme of dishonour. The slothful come to want: but the diligent support themselves with wealth.

fresh_translation: Merciful man does good to his own soul, but pitiless man destroys his own body.
brenton_translation: A merciful man does good to his own soul: but the merciless destroys his own body.

fresh_translation: An ungodly one does unjust works, but for the seed of righteous ones there is reward of truth.
brenton_translation: An ungodly man performs unrighteous works: but the seed of the righteous is a reward of truth.

fresh_translation: A righteous son is born for life, but pursuit of the ungodly is for death.
brenton_translation: A righteous son is born for life: but the persecution of the ungodly ends in death.

fresh_translation: Crooked ways abomination to the Lord, but blameless in their ways acceptable to him.
brenton_translation: Perverse ways are an abomination to the Lord: but all they that are blameless in their ways are acceptable to him.

fresh_translation: Hand joining hands unjustly will not go unpunished, but one sowing righteousness will receive faithful reward.
brenton_translation: He that unjustly strikes hands shall not be unpunished: but he that sows righteousness shall receive a faithful reward.

fresh_translation: Like earring in nose of swine, so beauty in evil-minded woman.
brenton_translation: As an ornament in a swine's snout, so is beauty to an ill-minded woman.

fresh_translation: The desire of the righteous is altogether good, but hope of the ungodly will perish.
brenton_translation: All the desire of the righteous is good: but the hope of the ungodly shall perish.

fresh_translation: There are those sowing their own things and making them more; there are also those gathering yet becoming less.
brenton_translation: There are some who scatter their own, and make it more: and there are some also who gather, yet have less.

fresh_translation: Every simple soul is blessed, but a hot-tempered man is unseemly.
brenton_translation: Every sincere soul is blessed: but a passionate man is not graceful.

fresh_translation: One withholding grain, may peoples leave him behind, but blessing upon the head of one sharing.
brenton_translation: May he that hoards corn leave it to the nation: but blessing be on the head of him that gives it.

fresh_translation: One devising good seeks good favor, but one seeking evils will be overtaken by them.
brenton_translation: He that devises good counsels seeks good favour: but as for him that seeks after evil, evil shall overtake him.

fresh_translation: One trusting in wealth will fall, but one helping the righteous will spring up.
brenton_translation: He that trusts in wealth shall fall; but he that helps righteous men shall rise.

fresh_translation: One not living well with his own house will inherit wind, and fool will serve wise.
brenton_translation: He that deals not graciously with his own house shall inherit the wind; and the fool shall be servant to the wise man.

fresh_translation: From the fruit of righteousness grows the tree of life, but untimely souls of lawless are taken away.
brenton_translation: Out of the fruit of righteousness grows a tree of life; but the souls of transgressors are cut off before their time.

fresh_translation: If righteous scarcely saved, ungodly and sinner where will appear?
brenton_translation: If the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

fresh_translation: One loving discipline loves perception, but one hating rebukes fool.
brenton_translation: He that loves instruction loves sense, but he that hates reproofs is a fool.

fresh_translation: Better man finding favor from the Lord, but lawless man will be silenced.
brenton_translation: He that has found favour with the Lord is made better; but a transgressor shall be passed over in silence.

fresh_translation: Man will not prosper from lawless thing, but roots of the righteous will not be pulled up.
brenton_translation: A man shall not prosper by wickedness; but the roots of the righteous shall not be taken up.

fresh_translation: Brave wife crown to her husband, but evil-working wife like worm in wood destroys man.
brenton_translation: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband; but as a worm in wood, so a bad woman destroys her husband.

fresh_translation: Thoughts of righteous judgments, but ungodly govern deceits.
brenton_translation: The thoughts of the righteous are true judgments; but ungodly men devise deceits.

fresh_translation: The words of the ungodly are deceitful, but the mouth of the upright will rescue them.
brenton_translation: The words of ungodly men are crafty; but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

fresh_translation: Whenever ungodly turn, they vanish, but houses of righteous remain.
brenton_translation: When the ungodly is overthrown, he vanishes away; but the houses of the just remain.

fresh_translation: The mouth of understanding praised by man, but slack-hearted mocked.
brenton_translation: The mouth of an understanding man is praised by a man; but he that is dull of heart is had in derision.

fresh_translation: Better man in dishonor serving himself than one putting honor round himself and lacking bread.
brenton_translation: Better is a man in dishonour serving himself, than one honouring himself and wanting bread.

fresh_translation: A righteous one pities the souls of his cattle, but inward parts of the ungodly are pitiless.
brenton_translation: A righteous man has pity for the lives of his cattle; but the bowels of the ungodly are unmerciful.

fresh_translation: One working his own land will be filled with breads, but those pursuing empty things lack sense. One sweet in wine-parties will leave dishonor in his strongholds.
brenton_translation: He that tills his own land shall be satisfied with bread; but they that pursue vanities are void of understanding.

fresh_translation: Desires of the ungodly are evil, but roots of the pious are in strongholds.
brenton_translation: The desires of the ungodly are evil; but the roots of the godly are firmly set.

fresh_translation: Through sin of lips a sinner falls into a snare, but a righteous one escapes from them. One whose looks are gentle will receive mercy, but one contending in the gates will afflict souls.
brenton_translation: For the sin of his lips a sinner falls into snares; but a righteous man escapes from them.

fresh_translation: From the fruits of mouth soul of man will be filled with goods, and reward of his lips will be given him.
brenton_translation: The soul of a man shall be filled with good from the fruits of his mouth; and the recompence of his lips shall be given to him.

fresh_translation: The ways of fools are right before themselves, but a wise one listens to counsels.
brenton_translation: The ways of fools are right in their own eyes; but a wise man hearkens to counsels.

fresh_translation: A fool the same day announces his anger, but shrewd hides his own shame.
brenton_translation: A fool declares his wrath the same day; but a prudent man hides his own disgrace.

fresh_translation: A righteous one openly displays faith, but witness of injustices deceitful.
brenton_translation: A righteous man declares the open truth; but an unjust witness is deceitful.

fresh_translation: There are speakers wounding like a sword, but tongues of wise heal.
brenton_translation: Some wound as they speak, like swords; but the tongues of the wise heal.

fresh_translation: Truthful lips set straight witness, but hasty witness has unjust tongue.
brenton_translation: True lips establish testimony; but a hasty witness has an unjust tongue.

fresh_translation: Deceit in the heart of one devising evils, but those willing peace will rejoice.
brenton_translation: There is deceit in the heart of him that imagines evil; but they that love peace shall rejoice.

fresh_translation: Nothing unjust will please the righteous, but the ungodly will be filled with evils.
brenton_translation: No injustice will please a just man; but the ungodly will be filled with mischief.

fresh_translation: Lying lips abomination to the Lord, but one doing faithfulness acceptable to him.
brenton_translation: Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord; but he that deals faithfully is accepted with him.

fresh_translation: Understanding man throne of perception, but the heart of fools will meet curses.
brenton_translation: An understanding man is a throne of wisdom; but the heart of fools shall meet with curses.

fresh_translation: The hand of choice ones will rule easily, but deceitful will be for plunder.
brenton_translation: The hand of chosen men shall easily obtain rule; but the deceitful shall be for a prey.

fresh_translation: A fearful word troubles the heart of a righteous man, but a good message gladdens him.
brenton_translation: A terrible word troubles the heart of a righteous man; but a good message rejoices him.

fresh_translation: A discerning righteous one will be his own friend, but counsels of the ungodly are harsh. Evil will pursue sinners, but the way of the ungodly will mislead them.
brenton_translation: A just arbitrator shall be his own friend; but mischief shall pursue sinners; and the way of ungodly men shall lead them astray.

fresh_translation: Deceitful man will not obtain game, but precious possession pure man.
brenton_translation: A deceitful man shall catch no game; but a blameless man is a precious possession.

fresh_translation: In the ways of righteousness life, but ways of the resentful to death.
brenton_translation: In the ways of righteousness is life; but the ways of those that remember injuries lead to death.

fresh_translation: Shrewd son obedient to father, but disobedient son in destruction.
brenton_translation: A wise son is obedient to his father: but a disobedient son will be destroyed.

fresh_translation: From the fruits of righteousness good man will eat, but souls of lawless perish untimely.
brenton_translation: A good man shall eat of the fruits of righteousness: but the lives of transgressors shall perish before their time.

fresh_translation: One guarding own mouth keeps own soul, but rash in lips will terrify himself.
brenton_translation: He that keeps his own mouth keeps his own life: but he that is hasty with his lips shall bring terror upon himself.

fresh_translation: Every idle man lives in desires, but hands of brave in diligence.
brenton_translation: Every slothful man desires, but the hands of the active are diligent.

fresh_translation: A righteous one hates an unjust word, but the ungodly will be shamed and have no boldness.
brenton_translation: A righteous man hates an unjust word: but an ungodly man is ashamed, and will have no confidence.

fresh_translation: Righteousness guards the innocent, but sin makes the ungodly base.
There are those making themselves rich while having nothing, and there are those humbling themselves in much wealth.
brenton_translation: There are some who, having nothing, enrich themselves: and there are some who bring themselves down in the midst of much wealth.

fresh_translation: Ransom of man's soul his own wealth, but poor does not endure threat.
brenton_translation: A man's own wealth is the ransom of his life: but the poor endures not threatening.

fresh_translation: There is light for the righteous always, but the light of the ungodly is quenched. Deceitful souls wander in sins, but the righteous show compassion and mercy.
brenton_translation: The righteous always have light: but the light of the ungodly is quenched.

fresh_translation: Evil man with insolence works evils, but those knowing themselves wise.
brenton_translation: A bad man does evil with insolence: but they that are judges of themselves are wise.

fresh_translation: Possession hurried with lawlessness becomes less, but one gathering for himself with piety will be multiplied. Righteous pities and lends.
brenton_translation: Wealth gotten hastily with iniquity is diminished: but he that gathers for himself with godliness shall be increased. The righteous is merciful, and lends.

fresh_translation: Better one beginning to help from heart than one promising and leading into hope, for good desire is a tree of life.
brenton_translation: Better is he that begins to help heartily, than he that promises and leads another to hope: for a good desire is a tree of life.

fresh_translation: One despising matter will be despised by it, but one fearing command will be made sound. Deceitful son will have nothing good, but to wise servant actions will prosper and his way will be made straight.
brenton_translation: He that slights a matter shall be slighted of it: but he that fears the commandment has health of soul.

fresh_translation: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, but senseless man will die from snare.
brenton_translation: The law of the wise is a fountain of life: but the man void of understanding shall die by a snare.

fresh_translation: Good understanding gives favor, and knowing law belongs to good mind, but ways of despisers in destruction.
brenton_translation: Sound discretion gives favour, and to know the law is the part of a sound understanding: but the ways of scorners tend to destruction.

fresh_translation: Every shrewd man acts with knowledge, but fool spreads out his own evil.
brenton_translation: Every prudent man acts with knowledge: but the fool displays his own mischief.

fresh_translation: Bold king will fall into evils, but faithful messenger will deliver him.
brenton_translation: A rash king shall fall into mischief: but a wise messenger shall deliver him.

fresh_translation: Discipline removes poverty and dishonor, but one keeping reproofs will be glorified.
brenton_translation: Instruction removes poverty and disgrace: but he that attends to reproofs shall be honoured.

fresh_translation: Desires of the godly sweeten the soul, but works of the ungodly are far from knowledge.
brenton_translation: The desires of the godly gladden the soul, but the works of the ungodly are far from knowledge.

fresh_translation: One walking with wise will be wise, but one walking with fools will be known.
brenton_translation: If thou walkest with wise men thou shalt be wise: but he that walks with fools shall be known.

fresh_translation: Evil will pursue sinners, but goods will overtake righteous.
brenton_translation: Evil shall pursue sinners; but good shall overtake the righteous.

fresh_translation: Good man will inherit sons of sons, but the wealth of the ungodly is stored up for the righteous.
brenton_translation: A good man shall inherit children's children; and the wealth of ungodly men is laid up for the just.

fresh_translation: A righteous one will make many years in wealth, but unjust will be destroyed quickly.
brenton_translation: The righteous shall spend many years in wealth: but the unrighteous shall perish suddenly.

fresh_translation: One sparing rod hates his son, but one loving disciplines diligently.
brenton_translation: He that spares the rod hates his son: but he that loves, carefully chastens him.

fresh_translation: A righteous one eats and fills his soul, but souls of ungodly needy.
brenton_translation: A just man eats and satisfies his soul: but the souls of the ungodly are in want.

fresh_translation: Wise women built houses, but foolish woman tore hers down with her own hands.
brenton_translation: Wise women build houses: but a foolish one digs hers down with her hands.

fresh_translation: One walking upright fears the Lord, but one twisting his ways will be dishonored.
brenton_translation: He that walks uprightly fears the Lord; but he that is perverse in his ways shall be dishonoured.

fresh_translation: From the mouth of fools rod of insolence, but lips of wise will guard them.
brenton_translation: Out of the mouth of fools comes a rod of pride; but the lips of the wise preserve them.

fresh_translation: Where no oxen, stalls clean, but much produce manifest in the strength of ox.
brenton_translation: Where no oxen are, the cribs are clean; but where there is abundant produce, the strength of the ox is apparent.

fresh_translation: Faithful witness does not lie, but unjust witness kindles lies.
brenton_translation: A faithful witness does not lie; but an unjust witness kindles falsehoods.

fresh_translation: You will seek wisdom among evil men and not find it, but perception easy with prudent.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt seek wisdom with bad men, and shalt not find it; but discretion is easily available with the prudent.

fresh_translation: All things contrary to foolish man, but lips of wise weapons of perception.
brenton_translation: All things are adverse to a foolish man; but wise lips are the weapons of discretion.

fresh_translation: The wisdom of the shrewd will know their ways, but the folly of fools is in wandering.
brenton_translation: The wisdom of the prudent will understand their ways; but the folly of fools leads astray.

fresh_translation: The houses of the lawless will owe cleansing, but the houses of the righteous are acceptable.
brenton_translation: The houses of transgressors will need purification; but the houses of the just are acceptable.

fresh_translation: The heart of perceptive man knows grief of its own soul, and when it rejoices it does not mix with insolence.
brenton_translation: If a man's mind is intelligent, his soul is sorrowful; and when he rejoices, he has no fellowship with pride.

fresh_translation: The houses of the ungodly will vanish, but the tents of those setting straight will stand.
brenton_translation: The houses of ungodly men shall be utterly destroyed; but the tabernacles of them that walk uprightly shall stand.

fresh_translation: There is way seeming right before men, but its ends come to floor of Hades.
brenton_translation: There is a way which seems to be right with men, but the ends of it reach to the depth of hell.

fresh_translation: In merriments sorrow not mixed in, but end of joy comes into grief.
brenton_translation: Grief mingles not with mirth; and joy in the end comes to grief.

fresh_translation: Bold-hearted will be filled from his own ways, but good man from his thoughts.
brenton_translation: A stout-hearted man shall be filled with his own ways; and a good man with his own thoughts.

fresh_translation: Innocent believes every word, but shrewd comes to second thoughts.
brenton_translation: The simple believes every word: but the prudent man betakes himself to after-thought.

fresh_translation: A wise man, fearing, turned away from evil, but a fool, trusting himself, mixes with a lawless man.
brenton_translation: A wise man fears, and departs from evil; but the fool trusts in himself, and joins himself with the transgressor.

fresh_translation: Sharp-tempered man acts without counsel, but prudent man endures much.
brenton_translation: A passionate man acts inconsiderately; but a sensible man bears up under many things.

fresh_translation: Fools inherit evil, but shrewd will hold fast perception.
brenton_translation: Fools shall have mischief for their portion; but the prudent shall take fast hold of understanding.

fresh_translation: Evil men will slip before good ones, and the ungodly will serve at the doors of the righteous.
brenton_translation: Evil men shall fall before the good; and the ungodly shall attend at the gates of the righteous.

fresh_translation: Friends will hate poor friend, but friends of rich many.
brenton_translation: Friends will hate poor friends; but the friends of the rich are many.

fresh_translation: One dishonoring poor sins, but one showing mercy to poor blessed.
brenton_translation: He that dishonours the needy sins: but he that has pity on the poor is most blessed.

fresh_translation: Those wandering devise evils, but mercy and truth devise good. Those devising evils do not know mercy and faithfulness, but acts of mercy and faithfulness belong with devisers of good.
brenton_translation: They that go astray devise evils: but the good devise mercy and truth. The framers of evil do not understand mercy and truth: but compassion and faithfulness are with the framers of good.

fresh_translation: In every careful person there is abundance, but one pleasant and insensitive will be in want.
brenton_translation: With every one who is careful there is abundance: but the pleasure-taking and indolent shall be in want.

fresh_translation: Crown of wise shrewdness, but occupation of fools evil.
brenton_translation: A prudent man is the crown of the wise: but the occupation of fools is evil.

fresh_translation: Faithful witness rescues soul from evils, but deceitful one kindles lies.
brenton_translation: A faithful witness shall deliver a soul from evil: but a deceitful man kindles falsehoods.

fresh_translation: In the fear of the Lord hope of strength, and for his children he leaves support.
brenton_translation: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and he leaves his children a support.

fresh_translation: The command of the Lord is a fountain of life, and it makes one turn aside from snares of death.
brenton_translation: The commandment of the Lord is a fountain of life; and it causes men to turn aside from the snare of death.

fresh_translation: In the multitude of nation glory of the king, but in lack of the people crushing of ruler.
brenton_translation: In a populous nation is the glory of a king: but in the failure of people is the ruin of a prince.

fresh_translation: Longsuffering man abundant in understanding, but short-souled man strongly foolish.
brenton_translation: A man slow to wrath abounds in wisdom: but a man of impatient spirit is very foolish.

fresh_translation: Gentle man physician of heart, but sensitive heart rottenness of bones.
brenton_translation: A meek-spirited man is a healer of the heart: but a sensitive heart is a corruption of the bones.

fresh_translation: One slandering poor provokes his Maker, but one honoring him has mercy on poor.
brenton_translation: He that oppresses the needy provokes his Maker: but he that honours him has pity upon the poor.

fresh_translation: In his evil the ungodly will be driven away, but one trusting in his own holiness is righteous.
brenton_translation: The ungodly shall be driven away in his wickedness: but he who is secure in his own holiness is just.

fresh_translation: In the good heart of man wisdom rests, but in the heart of fools it is not discerned.
brenton_translation: There is wisdom in the good heart of a man: but in the heart of fools it is not discerned.

fresh_translation: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sins diminish tribes.
brenton_translation: Righteousness exalts a nation: but sins diminish tribes.

fresh_translation: Understanding servant acceptable to the king, and by his good turning he removes dishonor.
brenton_translation: An understanding servant is acceptable to a king; and by his good behaviour he removes disgrace.

fresh_translation: Anger destroys even prudent ones, but yielding answer turns away wrath, and grievous word stirs angers.
brenton_translation: Anger slays even wise men; yet a submissive answer turns away wrath: but a grievous word stirs up anger.

fresh_translation: The tongue of the wise knows good things, but the mouth of fools will announce evils.
brenton_translation: The tongue of the wise knows what is good: but the mouth of the foolish tells out evil things.

fresh_translation: In every place the eyes of the Lord watch evil ones and good ones.
brenton_translation: The eyes of the Lord behold both the evil and the good in every place.

fresh_translation: A healing tongue is a tree of life, but one sustaining it will be filled with spirit.
brenton_translation: The wholesome tongue is a tree of life, and he that keeps it shall be filled with understanding.

fresh_translation: A fool sneers at the discipline of a father, but one keeping commands more shrewd.
brenton_translation: A fool scorns his father's instruction: but he that keeps his commandments is more prudent. In abounding righteousness is great strength: but the ungodly shall utterly perish from the earth.

fresh_translation: In abundant righteousness much strength, but ungodly root and branch perish from earth. In the houses of righteous much strength, but fruits of ungodly perish.
brenton_translation: In the houses of the righteous is much strength: but the fruits of the ungodly shall perish.

fresh_translation: The lips of wise bound to perception, but hearts of fools unsafe.
brenton_translation: The lips of the wise are bound by discretion: but the hearts of the foolish are not safe.

fresh_translation: Sacrifices of ungodly abomination to the Lord, but prayers of those setting straight acceptable to him.
brenton_translation: The sacrifices of the ungodly are an abomination to the Lord; but the prayers of them that walk honestly are acceptable with him.

fresh_translation: The ways of the ungodly are an abomination to the Lord, but he loves those pursuing righteousness.
brenton_translation: The ways of an ungodly man are an abomination to the Lord; but he loves those that follow after righteousness.

fresh_translation: Discipline of innocent known by passersby, but those hating reproofs die shamefully.
brenton_translation: The instruction of the simple is known by them that pass by; but they that hate reproofs die disgracefully.

fresh_translation: Hades and destruction visible before the Lord; how much more hearts of men.
brenton_translation: Hell and destruction are manifest to the Lord; how shall not also be the hearts of men?

fresh_translation: Untrained man will not love those reproving him, nor will he converse with wise.
brenton_translation: An uninstructed person will not love those that reprove him; neither will he associate with the wise.

fresh_translation: Of rejoicing heart face blooms, but being in grief it grows downcast.
brenton_translation: When the heart rejoices the countenance is cheerful; but when it is in sorrow, the countenance is sad.

fresh_translation: Upright heart seeks perception, but mouth of untrained will know evils.
brenton_translation: An upright heart seeks discretion; but the mouth of the uninstructed will experience evils.

fresh_translation: All the time the eyes of evil ones expect evils, but good ones are at rest continually.
brenton_translation: The eyes of the wicked are always looking for evil things; but the good are always quiet.

fresh_translation: Better little portion with the fear of the Lord than great treasures with fearlessness.
brenton_translation: Better is a small portion with the fear of the Lord, than great treasures without the fear of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Better hospitality of vegetables with love and favor than serving of calves with hatred.
brenton_translation: Better is an entertainment of herbs with friendliness and kindness, than a feast of calves, with enmity.

fresh_translation: Angry man prepares fights, but longsuffering man calms even what is coming. Longsuffering man extinguishes judgments, but ungodly stirs them up more.
brenton_translation: A passionate man stirs up strife; but he that is slow to anger appeases even a rising one.

fresh_translation: The ways of the idle are paved with thorns, but those of brave made smooth.
brenton_translation: The ways of sluggards are strewn with thorns; but those of the diligent are made smooth.

fresh_translation: A wise son gladdens a father, but a foolish son sneers at mother.
brenton_translation: A wise son gladdens his father; but a foolish son sneers at his mother.

fresh_translation: The ways of a mindless man lack sense, but prudent man walks directing straight.
brenton_translation: The ways of a foolish man are void of sense; but a wise man proceeds on his way aright.

fresh_translation: They postpone plans who do not honor council, but counsel remains in hearts of counselors.
brenton_translation: They that honour not councils put off deliberation; but counsel abides in the hearts of counsellors.

fresh_translation: Evil man will not listen to it, nor will he say anything timely and good for public.
brenton_translation: A bad man will by no means attend to counsel; neither will he say anything seasonable, or good for the common weal.

fresh_translation: The ways of life are thoughts of understanding, so that turning aside from Hades he may be saved.
brenton_translation: The thoughts of the wise are ways of life, that he may turn aside and escape from hell.

fresh_translation: The Lord tears down houses of insolent, but he set firm boundary of widow.
brenton_translation: The Lord pulls down the houses of scorners; but he establishes the border of the widow.

fresh_translation: Unjust thought abomination to the Lord, but sayings of pure ones noble.
brenton_translation: An unrighteous thought is abomination to the Lord; but the sayings of the pure are held in honour.

fresh_translation: Gift-taker destroys himself, but one hating taking of gifts is saved. By acts of mercy and faithfulness sins are cleansed, and by the fear of the Lord everyone turns from evil.
brenton_translation: A receiver of bribes destroys himself; but he that hates the receiving of bribes is safe.

fresh_translation: The hearts of the righteous meditate faithfulness, but the mouth of the ungodly answers evils. The ways of righteous men are acceptable to the Lord, and through them even enemies become friends.
brenton_translation: The hearts of the righteous meditate faithfulness; but the mouth of the ungodly answers evil things.

fresh_translation: God is far from the ungodly, but prayers of the righteous he hears. Better little taking with righteousness than much produce with injustice. Let the heart of man reckon righteous things, so that his steps may be corrected by God.
brenton_translation: God is far from the ungodly; but he hearkens to the prayers of the righteous.

fresh_translation: Eye seeing good things gladdens heart, and good report fattens bones.
brenton_translation: The eye that sees rightly rejoices the heart; and a good report fattens the bones.

fresh_translation: One rejecting discipline hates himself, but one keeping reproofs loves his soul.
brenton_translation: He that rejects instruction hates himself; but he that minds reproofs loves his soul.

fresh_translation: The fear of God is discipline and wisdom, and beginning of glory will answer to it.
brenton_translation: The fear of the Lord is instruction and wisdom; and the highest honour will correspond therewith.

fresh_translation: All works of humble plain before God, but ungodly in evil day will perish.
brenton_translation: All the works of the humble man are manifest with God; but the ungodly shall perish in an evil day.

fresh_translation: Every proud in heart unclean before God; joining hand to hand unjustly, he will not go unpunished.
brenton_translation: Every one that is proud in heart is unclean before God, and he that unjustly strikes hands with hand shall not be held guiltless.

fresh_translation: The beginning of a good way is doing righteous things, and more acceptable before God than sacrificing sacrifices.
brenton_translation: The beginning of a good way is to do justly; and it is more acceptable with God than to offer sacrifices.

fresh_translation: One seeking the Lord will find knowledge with righteousness, and those seeking him rightly will find peace.
brenton_translation: He that seeks the Lord shall find knowledge with righteousness: and they that rightly seek him shall find peace.

fresh_translation: All works of the Lord kept with righteousness, but ungodly kept for evil day.
brenton_translation: All the works of the Lord are done with righteousness; and the ungodly man is kept for the evil day.

fresh_translation: Oracle upon lips of the king; in judgment his mouth will not go astray.
brenton_translation: There is an oracle upon the lips of a king; and his mouth shall not err in judgment.

fresh_translation: Balance and scale of righteousness from the Lord, and all weights his righteous works.
brenton_translation: The poise of the balance is righteousness with the Lord; and his works are righteous measures.

fresh_translation: Abomination to the king is one doing evil, for the throne of rule prepared with righteousness.
brenton_translation: An evil-doer is an abomination to a king; for the throne of rule is established by righteousness.

fresh_translation: Righteous lips are acceptable to the king, and he loves upright words.
brenton_translation: Righteous lips are acceptable to a king; and he loves right words.

fresh_translation: The wrath of the king is a messenger of death, but a wise man will appease him.
brenton_translation: The anger of a king is a messenger of death; but a wise man will pacify him.

fresh_translation: In the light of the king's life is son, and those acceptable to him like late cloud.
brenton_translation: The son of a king is in the light of life; and they that are in favour with him are as a cloud of latter rain.

fresh_translation: Nests of wisdom more choice than gold, and nests of understanding more choice than silver.
brenton_translation: The brood of wisdom is more to be chosen than gold, and the brood of prudence more to be chosen than silver.

fresh_translation: Paths of life turn away from evils, and ways of righteousness length of life. One receiving discipline will be among good things, and one keeping reproofs will grow wise. One guarding his own ways keeps his own soul, and one loving his life will spare his mouth.
brenton_translation: The paths of life turn aside from evil; and the ways of righteousness are length of life. He that receives instruction shall be in prosperity; and he that regards reproofs shall be made wise. He that keeps his ways, preserves his own soul; and he that loves his life will spare his mouth.

fresh_translation: Before crushing goes insolence, and before fall evil-mindedness.
brenton_translation: Pride goes before destruction, and folly before a fall.

fresh_translation: Better gentle with humility than one dividing spoils with insolent men.
brenton_translation: Better is a meek-spirited man with lowliness, than one who divides spoils with the proud.

fresh_translation: Understanding in matters finds good things, and one trusting in God blessed.
brenton_translation: He who is skilful in business finds good: but he that trusts in God is most blessed.

fresh_translation: Men call the wise and understanding evil, but those sweet in speech will hear more.
brenton_translation: Men call the wise and understanding evil: but they that are pleasing in speech shall hear more.

fresh_translation: Thought fountain of life to those having it, but discipline of fools evil.
brenton_translation: Understanding is a fountain of life to its possessors; but the instruction of fools is evil.

fresh_translation: The heart of the wise will understand things from its own mouth, and upon lips it will carry discernment.
brenton_translation: The heart of the wise will discern the things which proceed from his own mouth; and on his lips he will wear knowledge.

fresh_translation: Honeycombs are good words, sweetness of them are healing of soul.
brenton_translation: Good words are honeycombs, and the sweetness thereof is a healing of the soul.

fresh_translation: There are ways seeming straight to man, yet their ends look into floor of Hades.
brenton_translation: There are ways that seem to be right to a man, but the end of them looks to the depth of hell.

fresh_translation: Man in pains labors for himself and forces his own destruction, but crooked man carries destruction on his own mouth.
brenton_translation: A man who labours, labours for himself, and drives from him his own ruin.

fresh_translation: Foolish man digs evils for himself, and on his own lips stores fire.
brenton_translation: But the perverse bears destruction upon his own mouth: a foolish man digs up evil for himself, and treasures fire on his own lips.

fresh_translation: Crooked man sends around evils, and lamp of deceit kindles among evil men and separates friends.
brenton_translation: A perverse man spreads mischief, and will kindle a torch of deceit with mischiefs; and he separates friends.

fresh_translation: A lawless man tests friends and leads them on ways not good.
brenton_translation: A transgressor tries to ensnare friends, and leads them in ways that are not good.

fresh_translation: One fixing his eyes plots twisted things and marks out all evils with his lips; this man furnace of evil.
brenton_translation: And the man that fixes his eyes devises perverse things, and marks out with his lips all evils: he is a furnace of wickedness.

fresh_translation: Crown of boasting is old age, and in the ways of righteousness it is found.
brenton_translation: Old age is a crown of honour, but it is found in the ways of righteousness.

fresh_translation: Better longsuffering man than strong man, and one mastering anger better than one taking city.
brenton_translation: A man slow to anger is better than a strong man; and he that governs his temper better than he that takes a city.

fresh_translation: Into laps comes everything for unjust men, but all righteous things from the Lord.
brenton_translation: All evils come upon the ungodly into their bosoms; but all righteous things come of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Better morsel with pleasure in peace than house full of many goods and unjust sacrifices with battle.
brenton_translation: Better is a morsel with pleasure in peace, than a house full of many good things and unjust sacrifices, with strife.

fresh_translation: Understanding servant will rule foolish masters, and among brothers he will divide portions.
brenton_translation: A wise servant shall have rule over foolish masters, and shall divide portions among brethren.

fresh_translation: As silver and gold tested in furnace, so hearts chosen by the Lord.
brenton_translation: As silver and gold are tried in a furnace, so are choice hearts with the Lord.

fresh_translation: Evil man listens to lawless tongue, but a righteous man does not heed lying lips.
brenton_translation: A bad man hearkens to the tongue of transgressors: but a righteous man attends not to false lips.

fresh_translation: One mocking poor provokes his Maker, and one rejoicing over one perishing will not go unpunished; but compassionate one will receive mercy.
brenton_translation: He that laughs at the poor provokes him that made him; and he that rejoices at the destruction of another shall not be held guiltless: but he that has compassion shall find mercy.

fresh_translation: Crown of old men is children's children, and glory of children is their fathers. Of faithful man whole world wealth; of faithless not even small coin.
brenton_translation: Children's children are the crown of old men; and their fathers are the glory of children.

fresh_translation: Faithful lips do not suit fool, nor lying lips a righteous man.
brenton_translation: Faithful lips will not suit a fool; nor lying lips a just man.

fresh_translation: Reward of graces is discipline; wherever it turns, it will prosper.
brenton_translation: Instruction is to them that use it a gracious reward: and whithersoever it may turn, it shall prosper.

fresh_translation: One hiding wrongs seeks friendship, but one hating to hide separates friends and kin.
brenton_translation: He that conceals injuries seeks love; but he that hates to hide them separates friends and kindred.

fresh_translation: Threat shatters heart of prudent, but fool when whipped does not perceive.
brenton_translation: A threat breaks down the heart of a wise man; but a fool, though scourged, understands not.

fresh_translation: Every evil man stirs contradictions, but the Lord will send pitiless angel against him.
brenton_translation: Every bad man stirs up strifes: but the Lord will send out against him an unmerciful messenger.

fresh_translation: Anxiety will fall upon understanding man, but fools plot evils.
brenton_translation: Care may befall a man of understanding; but fools will meditate evils.

fresh_translation: One repaying evils for good: evils will not be moved from his house.
brenton_translation: Whoso rewards evil for good, evil shall not be removed from his house.

fresh_translation: Authority gives beginning to the words of righteousness, but before want comes faction and battle.
brenton_translation: Rightful rule gives power to words; but sedition and strife precede poverty.

fresh_translation: One justifying the unjust and condemning the righteous is unclean and abominable before God.
brenton_translation: He that pronounces the unjust just, and the just unjust, is unclean and abominable with God.

fresh_translation: Why did money come to fool? Heartless man cannot acquire wisdom. One making his house high seeks crushing, and one twisting to learn will fall into evils.
brenton_translation: Why has the fool wealth? for a senseless man will not be able to purchase wisdom.

fresh_translation: At every time let friend be yours, and brothers useful in necessities; for this reason they are born.
brenton_translation: Have thou a friend for every time, and let brethren be useful in distress; for on this account are they born.

fresh_translation: Foolish man claps and rejoices in himself, like one guaranteeing his own friend.
brenton_translation: A foolish man applauds and rejoices over himself, as he also that becomes surety would make himself responsible for his own friends.

fresh_translation: Sin-lover rejoices in fights.
brenton_translation: A lover of sin rejoices in strifes;

fresh_translation: Hard-hearted man will not meet good things; man of shifting tongue will fall into evils.
brenton_translation: and the hard-hearted man comes not in for good. A man of a changeful tongue will fall into mischiefs;

fresh_translation: The heart of a fool is pain to one possessing it; father does not rejoice over undisciplined son, but wise son gladdens mother.
brenton_translation: and the heart of a fool is grief to its possessor. A father rejoices not over an uninstructed son; but a wise son gladdens his mother.

fresh_translation: Rejoicing heart does good healing, but sorrowful man dries bones.
brenton_translation: A glad heart promotes health; but the bones of a sorrowful man dry up.

fresh_translation: When taking gifts in bosom unjustly, ways do not prosper; ungodly turns aside ways of righteousness.
brenton_translation: The ways of a man who unjustly receives gifts in his bosom do not prosper; and an ungodly man perverts the ways of righteousness.

fresh_translation: The face of an understanding man belongs to a wise one, but the eyes of a fool to the ends of the earth.
brenton_translation: The countenance of a wise man is sensible; but the eyes of a fool go to the ends of the earth.

fresh_translation: Foolish son is anger to father and pain to one bearing him.
brenton_translation: A foolish son is a cause of anger to his father, and grief to her that bore him.

fresh_translation: To fine a righteous man is not good, nor holy to plot against righteous rulers.
brenton_translation: It is not right to punish a righteous man, nor is it holy to plot against righteous princes.

fresh_translation: One sparing to utter hard word is discerning; and longsuffering man is prudent.
brenton_translation: He that forbears to utter a hard word is discreet, and a patient man is wise.

fresh_translation: When senseless man questioned about wisdom, wisdom will be reckoned to him; and one making himself mute will seem prudent.
brenton_translation: Wisdom shall be imputed to a fool who asks after wisdom: and he who holds his peace shall seem to be sensible.

fresh_translation: Man wanting to separate from friends seeks excuses; at every time he will be worthy of reproach.
brenton_translation: A man who wishes to separate from friends seeks excuses; but at all times he will be liable to reproach.

fresh_translation: One lacking sense has no need of wisdom, for rather he is led by folly.
brenton_translation: A senseless man feels no need of wisdom, for he is rather led by folly.

fresh_translation: When ungodly comes into the depth of evils, he despises; and dishonor and reproach come upon him.
brenton_translation: When an ungodly man comes into a depth of evils, he despises them; but dishonour and reproach come upon him.

fresh_translation: Deep water is word in the heart of man, and river springing up is fountain of life.
brenton_translation: A word in the heart of a man is a deep water, and a river and fountain of life spring forth.

fresh_translation: It is not good to show partiality to an ungodly person, nor is it holy to turn aside justice in judgment.
brenton_translation: It is not good to accept the person of the ungodly, nor is it holy to pervert justice in judgment.

fresh_translation: The lips of fool lead him into evils, and his bold mouth calls death upon him.
brenton_translation: The lips of a fool bring him into troubles, and his bold mouth calls for death.

fresh_translation: The mouth of fool is ruin to him, and his lips snare to his soul.
brenton_translation: A fool's mouth is ruin to him, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

fresh_translation: Fear casts down the sluggards, and souls of unmanned men will hunger.
brenton_translation: Fear casts down the slothful; and the souls of the effeminate shall hunger.

fresh_translation: One not healing himself in his works is brother of one ruining himself.
brenton_translation: A man who helps not himself by his labour is brother of him that ruins himself.

fresh_translation: The name of the Lord is great in strength; righteous people who run to it are exalted.
brenton_translation: The name of the Lord is of great strength; and the righteous running to it are exalted.

fresh_translation: Wealth of rich man is strong city, and its glory overshadows greatly.
brenton_translation: The wealth of a rich man is a strong city; and its glory casts a broad shadow.

fresh_translation: Before crushing the heart of man is lifted up, and before glory it is humbled.
brenton_translation: Before ruin a man's heart is exalted, and before honour it is humble.

fresh_translation: One answering word before hearing: folly to him and reproach.
brenton_translation: Whoso answers a word before he hears a cause, it is folly and reproach to him.

fresh_translation: A wise servant calms the anger of a man, but short-souled man who can bear?
brenton_translation: A wise servant calms a man's anger; but who can endure a faint-hearted man?

fresh_translation: The heart of prudent acquires perception, and ears of wise seek understanding.
brenton_translation: The heart of the sensible man purchases discretion; and the ears of the wise seek understanding.

fresh_translation: Gift of man broadens him and seats him beside rulers.
brenton_translation: A man's gift enlarges him, and seats him among princes.

fresh_translation: A righteous man accuses himself in first speech, but when opponent comes he is reproved.
brenton_translation: A righteous man accuses himself at the beginning of his speech, but when he has entered upon the attack, the adversary is reproved.

fresh_translation: Lot stops contradictions and marks bounds among rulers.
brenton_translation: A silent man quells strifes, and determines between great powers.

fresh_translation: Brother helped by brother is strong and high city, and it is strong like founded kingdom.
brenton_translation: A brother helped by a brother is as a strong and high city; and is as strong as a well-founded palace.

fresh_translation: From the fruits of mouth man will fill his belly, and from the fruits of his lips he will be filled.
brenton_translation: A man fills his belly with the fruits of his mouth; and he shall be satisfied with the fruits of his lips.

fresh_translation: Death and life are in the hand of the tongue, and those mastering it will eat its fruits.
brenton_translation: Life and death are in the power of the tongue; and they that rule it shall eat the fruits thereof.

fresh_translation: One finding good wife found graces and received cheerfulness from God; one casting out good wife casts out good things, but one keeping adulteress is foolish and ungodly.
brenton_translation: He that has found a good wife has found favours, and has received gladness from God.

fresh_translation: The folly of a man ruins his ways, yet in his heart he blames God.
brenton_translation: The folly of a man spoils his ways: and he blames God in his heart.

fresh_translation: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor man is deserted even by the friend he has.
brenton_translation: Wealth acquires many friends; but the poor is deserted even of the friend he has.

fresh_translation: False witness will not go unpunished, and one accusing unjustly will not escape.
