brenton_translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that accuses unjustly shall not escape.

fresh_translation: Many court faces of kings, and every evil man becomes reproach to man.
brenton_translation: Many court the favour of kings; but every bad man becomes a reproach to another man.

fresh_translation: Everyone hating poor brother, even friendships will be far away. Good understanding draws near to those knowing it, and prudent man will find it. One doing much evil accomplishes evil, and one provoking words will not be saved.
brenton_translation: Every one who hates his poor brother shall also be far from friendship. Good understanding will draw near to them that know it, and a sensible man will find it. He that does much harm perfects mischief; and he that uses provoking words shall not escape.

fresh_translation: One acquiring understanding loves himself, and one keeping understanding will find good things.
brenton_translation: He that procures wisdom loves himself; and he that keeps wisdom shall find good.

fresh_translation: False witness will not go unpunished; one setting evil ablaze will perish by it.
brenton_translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished; and whosoever shall kindle mischief shall perish by it.

fresh_translation: Luxury does not fit fool, nor if slave should begin to rule arrogantly over rulers.
brenton_translation: Delight does not suit a fool, nor is it seemly if a servant should begin to rule with haughtiness.

fresh_translation: Merciful man is longsuffering, and his boast comes upon lawless men.
brenton_translation: A merciful man is long-suffering; and his triumph overtakes transgressors.

fresh_translation: Threat of the king like the roaring of a lion, but his cheerfulness like dew on grass.
brenton_translation: The threatening of a king is like the roaring of a lion; but as dew on the grass, so is his favour.

fresh_translation: Foolish son shame to father, and vows from the wages of prostitute not pure.
brenton_translation: A foolish son is a disgrace to his father: vows paid out of the hire of a harlot are not pure.

fresh_translation: House and substance fathers divide to children, but fitting wife prepared from God for man.
brenton_translation: Fathers divide house and substance to their children: but a wife is suited to a man by the Lord.

fresh_translation: Cowardice holds down unmanned man, and soul of idle man will hunger.
brenton_translation: Cowardice possesses the effeminate man; and the soul of the sluggard shall hunger.

fresh_translation: One keeping command keeps his own soul, but one despising his own ways will perish.
brenton_translation: He that keeps the commandment keeps his own soul; but he that despises his ways shall perish.

fresh_translation: One showing mercy to poor lends to God, and according to his gift he will repay him.
brenton_translation: He that has pity on the poor lends to the Lord; and he will recompense to him according to his gift.

fresh_translation: Discipline your son, for thus he will be hopeful; but do not exalt your soul into insolence.
brenton_translation: Chasten thy son, for so he shall be hopeful; and be not exalted in thy soul to haughtiness.

fresh_translation: Ill-minded man will suffer much damage; and if he causes destruction, he will add even his soul.
brenton_translation: A malicious man shall be severely punished, and if he commit injury, he shall also lose his life.

fresh_translation: Hear, son, discipline of your father, so that you may become wise at your latter end.
brenton_translation: Hear, son, the instruction of thy father, that thou mayest be wise at thy latter end.

fresh_translation: Many reasonings in the heart of man, but counsel of the Lord remains forever.
brenton_translation: There are many thoughts in a man's heart; but the counsel of the Lord abides for ever.

fresh_translation: Fruit for man is mercy; and better poor righteous than rich liar.
brenton_translation: Mercy is a fruit to a man: and a poor man is better than a rich liar.

fresh_translation: The fear of the Lord for life to man, but fear-free man will lodge in places where knowledge is not visited.
brenton_translation: The fear of the Lord is life to a man: and he shall lodge without fear in places where knowledge is not seen.

fresh_translation: One hiding hands in bosom unjustly will certainly not bring them to his mouth.
brenton_translation: He that unjustly hides his hands in his bosom, will not even bring them up to his mouth.

fresh_translation: When pestilent man is scourged, fool becomes more shrewd; but if you rebuke prudent man, he will understand perception.
brenton_translation: When a pestilent character is scourged, a simple man is made wiser: and if thou reprove a wise man, he will understand discretion.

fresh_translation: One dishonoring father and thrusting away mother will be shamed and reproached.
brenton_translation: He that dishonours his father, and drives away his mother, shall be disgraced and shall be exposed to reproach.

fresh_translation: Son, ceasing to keep discipline of father, you will meditate evil sayings.
brenton_translation: A son who ceases to attend to the instruction of a father will cherish evil designs.

fresh_translation: One guaranteeing foolish child insults judgment, and the mouth of the ungodly swallows judgments.
brenton_translation: He that becomes surety for a foolish child will despise the ordinance: and the mouth of ungodly men shall drink down judgments.

fresh_translation: Scourges prepared for unrestrained men, and punishments for backs of fools.
brenton_translation: Scourges are preparing for the intemperate, and punishments likewise for fools.

fresh_translation: Wine unrestrained and drunkenness insolent; everyone mingling with it will not be wise.
brenton_translation: Wine is an intemperate thing, and strong drink full of violence: but every fool is entangled with them.

fresh_translation: Threat of the king not different from the wrath of lion; one provoking him sins against his own soul.
brenton_translation: The threat of a king differs not from the rage of a lion; and he that provokes him sins against his own soul.

fresh_translation: It is glory for a man to turn from insults, but every fool entangles himself with such things.
brenton_translation: It is a glory to a man to turn aside from railing; but every fool is entangled with such matters.

fresh_translation: Being reproached, sluggard is not ashamed; likewise borrower of grain in harvest.
brenton_translation: A sluggard when reproached is not ashamed: so also he who borrows corn in harvest.

fresh_translation: Deep water is counsel in the heart of man, but prudent man will draw it out.
brenton_translation: Counsel in a man's heart is deep water; but a prudent man will draw it out.

fresh_translation: Great man and precious merciful man, but faithful man is hard work to find.
brenton_translation: A man is valuable, and a merciful man precious: but it is hard to find a faithful man.

fresh_translation: One walking blameless in righteousness will leave his children blessed.
brenton_translation: He that walks blameless in justice, shall leave his children blessed.

fresh_translation: When righteous king sits on throne, no evil thing stands against his eyes.
brenton_translation: Whenever a righteous king sits on the throne, no evil thing can stand before his presence.

fresh_translation: Who will boast, "I have pure heart"? Or who will speak boldly, "I am clean from sins"? Lamp of one speaking evil of father or mother will be quenched, and pupils of his eyes will see darkness. Possession hurried at first will not be blessed at last. Do not say, "I will repay enemy," but wait for the Lord so he may help you.
brenton_translation: Who will boast that he has a pure heart? or who will boldly say that he is pure from sins?

fresh_translation: Great and small weights, double measures too, both unclean before the Lord.
brenton_translation: A large and small weight, and divers measures, are even both of them unclean before the Lord; and so is he that makes them.

fresh_translation: And one doing them will be tripped in his practices. Young man with holy man and straight his way.
brenton_translation: A youth when in company with a godly man, will be restrained in his devices, and then his way will be straight.

fresh_translation: Ear hearing and eye seeing, the Lord made both works.
brenton_translation: The ear hears, and the eye sees: even both of them are the Lord's work.

fresh_translation: Do not love speaking against others, lest you be lifted up; open your eyes and be filled with breads.
brenton_translation: Love not to speak ill, lest thou be cut off: open thine eyes, and be filled with bread.

fresh_translation: Double weight abomination to the Lord, and deceitful balance not good before him.
brenton_translation: A double weight is an abomination to the Lord; and a deceitful balance is not good in his sight.

fresh_translation: From the Lord the steps of a man are made straight; mortal, how will he understand his ways?
brenton_translation: A man's goings are directed of the Lord: how then can a mortal understand his ways?

fresh_translation: Snare to man quickly to consecrate some of his own things, for after vowing, regret comes.
brenton_translation: It is a snare to a man hastily to consecrate some of his own property: for in that case repentance comes after vowing.

fresh_translation: A wise king winnows the ungodly and will bring wheel upon them.
brenton_translation: A wise king utterly crushes the ungodly, and will bring a wheel upon them.

fresh_translation: The light of the Lord is the breath of men, searching storerooms of belly.
brenton_translation: The spirit of man is a light of the Lord, who searches the inmost parts of the belly.

fresh_translation: Mercy and truth guard king, and in righteousness they encircle his throne.
brenton_translation: Mercy and truth are a guard to a king, and will surround his throne with righteousness.

fresh_translation: Adornment of young men is wisdom, and glory of elders is gray hairs.
brenton_translation: Wisdom is an ornament to young men; and grey hairs are the glory of old men.

fresh_translation: Blows and bruises meet evils, and wounds into the storerooms of belly.
brenton_translation: Bruises and contusions befall bad men; and plagues shall come into the inward parts of their belly.

fresh_translation: Like rush of water, so heart of the king in the hand of God; wherever he wills to incline, there he bent it.
brenton_translation: As a rush of water, so is the king's heart in God's hand: he turns it whithersoever he may desire to point out.

fresh_translation: Every man appears righteous to himself, but the Lord directs hearts.
brenton_translation: Every man seems to himself righteous; but the Lord directs the hearts.

fresh_translation: Doing righteous things and speaking truth more pleasing to God than blood sacrifices.
brenton_translation: To do justly and to speak truth, are more pleasing to God than the blood of sacrifices.

fresh_translation: High-minded in insolence, bold in heart; the lamp of the ungodly is sin.
brenton_translation: A high-minded man is stout-hearted in his pride; and the lamp of the wicked is sin.

fresh_translation: One working up treasuries with lying tongue pursues vanities into snares of death.
brenton_translation: He that gathers treasures with a lying tongue pursues vanity on to the snares of death.

fresh_translation: Destruction will become foreign to ungodly, for they do not want to do righteous things.
brenton_translation: Destruction shall lodge with the ungodly; for they refuse to do justly.

fresh_translation: Toward crooked men God sends crooked ways, for his works pure and straight.
brenton_translation: To the froward God sends froward ways; for his works are pure and right.

fresh_translation: Better dwell on the corner of open roof than in plastered rooms with injustice and common house.
brenton_translation: It is better to dwell in a corner on the house-top, than in plastered rooms with unrighteousness, and in an open house.

fresh_translation: The soul of the ungodly will not be pitied by anyone of men.
brenton_translation: The soul of the ungodly shall not be pitied by any man.

fresh_translation: When unrestrained man is punished, innocent becomes more shrewd; and when wise understands, he will receive knowledge.
brenton_translation: When an intemperate man is punished the simple becomes wiser: and a wise man understanding will receive knowledge.

fresh_translation: A righteous one understands hearts of ungodly and brings down ungodly in evils.
brenton_translation: A righteous man understands the hearts of the ungodly: and despises the ungodly for their wickedness.

fresh_translation: One stopping his ears from hearing weak man, he himself will call and there will be no hearer.
brenton_translation: He that stops his ears from hearing the poor, himself also shall cry, and there shall be none to hear him.

fresh_translation: Secret gift overturns wraths, but one sparing gifts stirs strong anger.
brenton_translation: A secret gift calms anger: but he that forbears to give stirs up strong wrath.

fresh_translation: The joy of the righteous is doing judgment, but a holy man is unclean among evildoers.
brenton_translation: It is the joy of the righteous to do judgment: but a holy man is abominable with evil-doers.

fresh_translation: Man wandering from the way of righteousness will rest in the assembly of giants.
brenton_translation: A man that wanders out of the way of righteousness, shall rest in the congregation of giants.

fresh_translation: Needy man loves gladness; loving wine and oil not for wealth.
brenton_translation: A poor man loves mirth, loving wine and oil in abundance;

fresh_translation: A lawless man is purging-scrap for the righteous.
brenton_translation: and a transgressor is the abomination of a righteous man.

fresh_translation: Better dwell in desert land than with quarrelsome, talkative, angry woman.
brenton_translation: It is better to dwell in a wilderness than with a quarrelsome and talkative and passionate woman.

fresh_translation: Desired treasure rests on the mouth of wise, but foolish men swallow it down.
brenton_translation: A desirable treasure will rest on the mouth of the wise; but foolish men will swallow it up.

fresh_translation: The way of righteousness and mercy will find life and glory.
brenton_translation: The way of righteousness and mercy will find life and glory.

fresh_translation: A wise man scaled strong cities and pulled down stronghold in which ungodly trusted.
brenton_translation: A wise man assaults strong cities, and demolishes the fortress in which the ungodly trusted.

fresh_translation: One guarding his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from affliction.
brenton_translation: He that keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from trouble.

fresh_translation: Bold and self-willed and braggart is called pest; a lawless one is one remembering wrongs.
brenton_translation: A bold and self-willed and insolent man is called a pest: and he that remembers injuries is a transgressor.

fresh_translation: Desires kill sluggard, for his hands do not choose to do anything.
brenton_translation: Desires kill the sluggard; for his hands do not choose to do anything.

fresh_translation: An ungodly one all day desires evil desires, but righteous shows mercy and pities unsparingly.
brenton_translation: An ungodly man entertains evil desires all the day: but the righteous is unsparingly merciful and compassionate.

fresh_translation: Sacrifices of ungodly abomination to the Lord, especially since they offer them lawlessly.
brenton_translation: The sacrifices of the ungodly are abomination to the Lord, for they offer them wickedly.

fresh_translation: False witness will perish, but obedient man, being guarded, will speak.
brenton_translation: A false witness shall perish; but an obedient man will speak cautiously.

fresh_translation: An ungodly man stands shameless in face, but the upright man himself understands his ways.
brenton_translation: An ungodly man impudently withstands with his face; but the upright man himself understands his ways.

fresh_translation: No wisdom, no courage, no counsel against the ungodly man.
brenton_translation: There is no wisdom, there is no courage, there is no counsel against the ungodly.

fresh_translation: Horse prepared for the day of war, but help from the Lord.
brenton_translation: A horse is prepared for the day of battle; but help is of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Better good name than much wealth, and good favor above silver and gold.
brenton_translation: A fair name is better than much wealth, and good favour is above silver and gold.

fresh_translation: Rich and poor met one another, and the Lord made both.
brenton_translation: The rich and the poor meet together; but the Lord made them both.

fresh_translation: Shrewd man, seeing evil man punished strongly, is himself disciplined; but fools pass by and suffer loss.
brenton_translation: An intelligent man seeing a bad man severely punished is himself instructed, but fools pass by and are punished.

fresh_translation: The fear of the Lord is the offspring of wisdom, and wealth and glory and life.
brenton_translation: The fear of the Lord is the offspring of wisdom, and wealth, and glory, and life.

fresh_translation: Thorns and snares on crooked ways, but one guarding his soul will keep away from them.
brenton_translation: Thistles and snares are in perverse ways; but he that keeps his soul will refrain from them.

fresh_translation: Rich will rule poor, and servants will lend to their own masters.
brenton_translation: The rich will rule over the poor, and servants will lend to their own masters.

fresh_translation: One sowing base things will reap evils, and will finish off blow of his works. God blesses cheerful man and giver, but vanity of his works he will finish off.
brenton_translation: He that sows wickedness shall reap troubles; and shall fully receive the punishment of his deeds.

fresh_translation: One having mercy on poor will himself be nourished, for from his own breads he gave to poor. One giving gifts acquires victory and honor, but takes away soul of possessors.
brenton_translation: He that has pity on the poor shall himself be maintained; for he has given of his own bread to the poor.

fresh_translation: Throw pest out of council, and strife will go out with him; for when he sits in council, he dishonors all.
brenton_translation: Cast out a pestilent person from the council, and strife shall go out with him; for when he sits in the council he dishonours all.

fresh_translation: The Lord loves holy hearts, and all blameless with lips are acceptable to him; king shepherds them.
brenton_translation: The Lord loves holy hearts, and all blameless persons are acceptable with him: a king rules with his lips.

fresh_translation: The eyes of the Lord preserve perception, but lawless man overturns words.
brenton_translation: But the eyes of the Lord preserve discretion; but the transgressor despises wise words.

fresh_translation: Sluggard makes excuse and says, "Lion in roads; in streets I will be killed."
brenton_translation: The sluggard makes excuses, and says, There is a lion in the ways, and murderers in the streets.

fresh_translation: A deep pit is the mouth of a lawless man; one hated by the Lord will fall into it. There are evil ways before a man, and he does not love to turn from them; but one must turn from a crooked and evil way.
brenton_translation: The mouth of a transgressor is a deep pit; and he that is hated of the Lord shall fall into it.

fresh_translation: Folly is fastened to the heart of youth, but the rod and discipline are far from him.
brenton_translation: Folly is attached to the heart of a child, but the rod and instruction are then far from him.

fresh_translation: One slandering poor makes much for himself, but giving to rich for less.
brenton_translation: He that oppresses the poor, increases his own substance, yet gives to the rich so as to make it less.

fresh_translation: Incline your ear to the words of the wise and hear my word, and set your heart on them so that you may know they are good.
brenton_translation: Incline thine ear to the words of wise men: hear also my word, and apply thine heart,

fresh_translation: And if you cast them into your heart, they will gladden you together upon your lips.
brenton_translation: that thou mayest know that they are good: and if thou lay them to heart, they shall also gladden thee on thy lips.

fresh_translation: So that your hope may be on the Lord, and he may make his way known to you.
brenton_translation: That thy hope may be in the Lord, and he may make thy way known to thee.

fresh_translation: And you, write them for yourself threefold for counsel and knowledge on the breadth of your heart.
brenton_translation: And do thou too repeatedly record them for thyself on the table of thine heart, for counsel and knowledge.

fresh_translation: So I teach you true word and good knowledge, to obey by answering the words of truth to those putting things before you.
brenton_translation: I therefore teach thee truth, and knowledge good to hear; that thou mayest answer words of truth to them that question thee.

fresh_translation: Do not use force against poor, for he is poor, and do not dishonor weak man in gates.
brenton_translation: Do no violence to the poor, for he is needy: neither dishonour the helpless man in the gates.

fresh_translation: For the Lord will judge his case and rescue your unplundered soul.
brenton_translation: For the Lord will plead his cause, and thou shalt deliver thy soul in safety.

fresh_translation: Do not be companion to hot-tempered man, nor camp together with angry friend,
brenton_translation: Be not companion to a furious man; neither lodge with a passionate man:

fresh_translation: lest you learn his ways and take snares for your soul.
brenton_translation: lest thou learn of his ways, and get snares to thy soul.

fresh_translation: Do not give yourself as pledge, being ashamed of face.
brenton_translation: Become not surety from respect of a man's person.

fresh_translation: For if you have nothing from which to pay, they will take bedding from under your ribs.
brenton_translation: For if those have not whence to give compensation, they will take the bed that is under thee.

fresh_translation: Do not move age-old boundaries your fathers set.
brenton_translation: Remove not the old landmarks, which thy fathers placed.

fresh_translation: See man with vision and sharp in his works; he must stand beside kings, not beside sluggish men.
brenton_translation: It is fit that an observant man and one diligent in his business should attend on kings, and not attend on slothful men.

fresh_translation: If you sit to dine at table of rulers, intelligently understand things set before you.
brenton_translation: If thou sit to sup at the table of a prince, consider attentively the things set before thee:

fresh_translation: And put your hand there, knowing that such things you must prepare.
brenton_translation: and apply thine hand, knowing that it behoves thee to prepare such meats: but if thou art very insatiable,

fresh_translation: But if you are more insatiable, do not desire his dishes, for these hold false life.
brenton_translation: desire not his provisions; for these belong to a false life.

fresh_translation: Do not stretch yourself out, being poor, toward becoming rich; hold back from your own thought.
brenton_translation: If thou art poor, measure not thyself with a rich man; but refrain thyself in thy wisdom.

fresh_translation: If you set your eye on it, nowhere will it appear, for wings are prepared for it like an eagle, and it returns to the house of one leading it.
brenton_translation: If thou shouldest fix thine eye upon him, he will disappear; for wings like an eagle's are prepared for him, and he returns to the house of his master.

fresh_translation: Do not dine with envious man, nor desire his foods.
brenton_translation: Sup not with an envious man, neither desire thou his meats:

fresh_translation: For as if someone should swallow hair, so he eats and drinks.
brenton_translation: so he eats and drinks as if any one should swallow a hair, and do not bring him in to thyself, nor eat thy morsel with him:

fresh_translation: Do not bring him in to yourself and eat your bread with him, for he will vomit it and will damage your good words.
brenton_translation: for he will vomit it up, and spoil thy fair words.

fresh_translation: Speak nothing into the ears of fool, lest he sneer at your prudent words.
brenton_translation: Say nothing in the ears of a fool, lest at any time he sneer at thy wise words.

fresh_translation: Do not move eternal boundaries, and do not enter possession of orphans.
brenton_translation: Remove not the ancient landmarks; and enter not upon the possession of the fatherless:

fresh_translation: For the Lord, redeeming them, is mighty, and will judge their case against you.
brenton_translation: for the Lord is their redeemer; he is mighty, and will plead their cause with thee.

fresh_translation: Give your heart to discipline and prepare your ears for the words of perception.
brenton_translation: Apply thine heart to instruction, and prepare thine ears for words of discretion.

fresh_translation: Do not hold back from disciplining child, for if you strike him with rod, he will certainly not die.
brenton_translation: Refrain not from chastening a child; for if thou beat him with the rod, he shall not die.

fresh_translation: For you will strike him with rod and rescue his soul from death.
brenton_translation: For thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from death.

fresh_translation: Son, if your heart becomes wise, you will gladden my heart also.
brenton_translation: Son, if thy heart be wise, thou shalt also gladden my heart;

fresh_translation: And your lips will dwell within words toward my lips, if they are upright.
brenton_translation: and thy lips shall converse with my lips, if they be right.

fresh_translation: Let your heart not envy sinners, but be in the fear of the Lord all day.
brenton_translation: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the Lord all the day.

fresh_translation: For if you keep these things, offspring will exist for you, and your hope will not depart.
brenton_translation: For if thou shouldest keep these things, thou shalt have posterity; and thine hope shall not be removed.

fresh_translation: Hear, son, and become wise, and direct thoughts of your heart.
brenton_translation: Hear, my son, and be wise, and rightly direct the thoughts of thine heart.

fresh_translation: Do not be wine-drinker, nor stretch yourself out in bargaining over meat-purchases.
brenton_translation: Be not a wine-bibber, neither continue long at feasts, and purchases of flesh:

fresh_translation: For every drunkard and fornicator will become poor, and every sleepy one will put on torn and ragged things.
brenton_translation: for every drunkard and whoremonger shall be poor; and every sluggard shall clothe himself with tatters and ragged garments.

fresh_translation: Hear, son, father who begot you, and do not despise because your mother has grown old.
brenton_translation: Hearken, my son, to thy father which begot thee, and despise not thy mother because she is grown old.

fresh_translation: A righteous father rears well, and over wise son his soul rejoices.
brenton_translation: A righteous father brings up his children well; and his soul rejoices over a wise son.

fresh_translation: Let father and mother rejoice over you, and let one bearing you be glad.
brenton_translation: Let thy father and thy mother rejoice over thee, and let her that bore thee be glad.

fresh_translation: Give me, son, your heart, and let your eyes keep my ways.
brenton_translation: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

fresh_translation: For a foreign house is a pierced jar, and a strange well is a narrow pit.
brenton_translation: For a strange house is a vessel full of holes; and a strange well is narrow.

fresh_translation: For this one will soon perish, and every lawless man will be consumed.
brenton_translation: For such a one shall perish suddenly; and every transgressor shall be cut off.

fresh_translation: For whom woe? For whom turmoil? For whom judgments? For whom disgusts and babblings? For whom pointless bruises? Whose eyes pale?
brenton_translation: Who has woe? who trouble? who has quarrels? and who vexations and disputes? who has bruises without a cause? whose eyes are livid?

fresh_translation: Not for those lingering over wines? Not for those tracking where drinking bouts happen?
brenton_translation: Are not those of them that stay long at wine? are not those of them that haunt the places where banquets are? Be not drunk with wine; but converse with just men, and converse with them openly.

fresh_translation: Do not get drunk with wine, but talk with righteous men and talk in walkings; for if you give your eyes to bowls and cups, afterward you will walk barer than before.
brenton_translation: For if thou shouldest set thine eyes on bowls and cups, thou shalt afterwards go more naked than a pestle.

fresh_translation: At end, like one struck by serpent he stretches out, and like horned viper venom is poured out for him.
brenton_translation: But at last such a one stretches himself out as one smitten by a serpent, and venom is diffused through him as by a horned serpent.

fresh_translation: When your eyes see strange woman, then your mouth will speak crooked things.
brenton_translation: Whenever thine eyes shall behold a strange woman, then thy mouth shall speak perverse things.

fresh_translation: And you will lie down as in the heart of the sea and as helmsman in great swell.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt lie as in the midst of the sea, and as a pilot in a great storm.

fresh_translation: And you will say, "They strike me, and I did not feel pain; they mocked me, and I did not know. When will dawn come so that I may go seek those with whom I shall gather?"
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say, They smote me, and I was not pained; and they mocked me, and I knew it not: when will it be morning, that I may go and seek those with whom I may go in company?

fresh_translation: Son, do not envy evil men, nor desire to be with them.
brenton_translation: My son, envy not bad men, nor desire to be with them.

fresh_translation: For their heart meditates lies, and their lips speak pains.
brenton_translation: For their heart meditates falsehoods, and their lips speak mischiefs.

fresh_translation: With wisdom house is built, and with understanding it is set upright.
brenton_translation: A house is built by wisdom, and is set up by understanding.

fresh_translation: With perception storerooms are filled from every precious and good wealth.
brenton_translation: By discretion the chambers are filled with all precious and excellent wealth.

fresh_translation: Better wise man than strong man, and man having understanding than great farmer.
brenton_translation: A wise man is better than a strong man; and a man who has prudence than a large estate.

fresh_translation: With steering war happens, and help with counseling heart.
brenton_translation: War is carried on with generalship, and aid is supplied to the heart of a counsellor.

fresh_translation: Wisdom and good understanding are at the gates of the wise; wise men do not turn aside from the mouth of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Wisdom and good understanding are in the gates of the wise: the wise turn not aside from the mouth of the Lord,

fresh_translation: But undisciplined men reason in councils; death meets them.
brenton_translation: but deliberate in council. Death befalls uninstructed men.

fresh_translation: A fool dies in sins, and uncleanness by pestilent man will be defiled.
brenton_translation: The fool also dies in sins; and uncleanness attaches to a pestilent man.

fresh_translation: In evil day and in the day of affliction until he should fail.
brenton_translation: He shall be defiled in the evil day, and in the day of affliction, until he be utterly consumed.

fresh_translation: Rescue those being led to death, and buy back those being killed; do not spare.
brenton_translation: Deliver them that are led away to death, and redeem them that are appointed to be slain; spare not thy help.

fresh_translation: But if you say, "I do not know this man," know that the Lord of all hearts knows, and one forming breath for all himself knows all, who repays each according to his works.
brenton_translation: But if thou shouldest say, I know not this man; know that the Lord knows the hearts of all; and he that formed breath for all, he knows all things, who renders to every man according to his works.

fresh_translation: Eat honey, son, for it is good; comb, so that your throat may be sweetened.
brenton_translation: My son, eat honey, for the honeycomb is good, that thy throat may be sweetened.

fresh_translation: So you will perceive wisdom for your soul; for if you find it, your end will be good, and hope will not abandon you.
brenton_translation: Thus shalt thou perceive wisdom in thy soul: for if thou find it, thine end shall be good, and hope shall not fail thee.

fresh_translation: Do not bring ungodly to pasture of righteous, nor be deceived by filling of belly.
brenton_translation: Bring not an ungodly man into the dwelling of the righteous: neither be deceived by the feeding of the belly.

fresh_translation: For seven times the righteous will fall and rise, but the ungodly will grow weak in evils.
brenton_translation: For a righteous man will fall seven times, and rise again: but the ungodly shall be without strength in troubles.

fresh_translation: If your enemy falls, do not rejoice over him, and in his stumble do not exult.
brenton_translation: If thine enemy should fall, rejoice not over him, neither be elated at his overthrow.

fresh_translation: For the Lord will see and it will not please him, and he will turn his wrath away from him.
brenton_translation: For the Lord will see it, and it will not please him, and he will turn away his wrath from him.

fresh_translation: Do not rejoice over evildoers, nor envy sinners.
brenton_translation: Rejoice not in evil-doers, neither be envious of sinners.

fresh_translation: For no offspring will come to evil men, and the lamp of the ungodly will be quenched.
brenton_translation: For the evil man shall have no posterity: and the light of the wicked shall be put out.

fresh_translation: My son, fear God and the king, and do not disobey either of them.
brenton_translation: My son, fear God and the king; and do not disobey either of them.

fresh_translation: For suddenly they will punish ungodly; punishments of both, who will know? One guarding word will stay outside son of destruction, and one receiving him received him. Let no lie be spoken to the king from tongue, and no lie at all should come out from his tongue. For tongue of the king a sword, not fleshly; whoever is handed over will be crushed. For if his wrath is sharpened, with sinews he consumes men, and eats bones of men and burns like flame, so that even eaglets are uneatable.
brenton_translation: For they will suddenly punish the ungodly, and who can know the vengeance inflicted by both?

fresh_translation: These things I say to you, wise men: to acknowledge and to show partial face in judgment not good.
brenton_translation: And this thing I say to you that are wise for you to learn: It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

fresh_translation: One saying to ungodly, "You are righteous," will be cursed by peoples and hated among nations.
brenton_translation: He that says of the ungodly, He is righteous, shall be cursed by peoples, and hateful among the nations.

fresh_translation: But those reproving will appear better; upon them will come good blessing.
brenton_translation: But they that reprove him shall appear more excellent, and blessing shall come upon them;

fresh_translation: Lips will kiss one answering good words.
brenton_translation: and men will kiss lips that answer well.

fresh_translation: Prepare your works for way out, and get ready for field, and go after me, and you will rebuild your house.
brenton_translation: Prepare thy works for thy going forth, and prepare thyself for the field; and come after me, and thou shalt rebuild thine house.

fresh_translation: Do not be false witness against your neighbor, nor widen with your lips.
brenton_translation: Be not a false witness against thy fellow citizen, neither exaggerate with thy lips.

fresh_translation: Do not say, "As he treated me, so I will treat him; I will repay him what he wronged me."
brenton_translation: Say not, As he has treated me, so will I treat him, and I will avenge myself on him for that wherein he has injured me.

fresh_translation: Like field of foolish man and like vineyard of man lacking sense,
brenton_translation: A foolish man is like a farm, and a senseless man is like a vineyard.

fresh_translation: if you leave it, it will be made fallow and all overgrown with grass, becoming abandoned, and its stone walls torn down.
brenton_translation: If thou let him alone, he will altogether remain barren and covered with weeds; and he becomes destitute, and his stone walls are broken down.

fresh_translation: Afterward I repented; I looked in order to choose discipline.
brenton_translation: Afterwards I reflected, I looked that I might receive instruction.

fresh_translation: A little I slumber, a little I sleep, a little I fold hands over chest.
brenton_translation: The sluggard says, I slumber a little, and I sleep a little, and for a little while I fold my arms across my breast.

fresh_translation: But if you do this, your poverty will come running before you, and your want like a good runner.
brenton_translation: But if thou do this, thy poverty will come speedily; and thy want like a swift courier.

fresh_translation: These undiscriminating disciplines of Solomon, which friends of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
brenton_translation: These are the miscellaneous instructions of Solomon, which the friends of Ezekias king of Judea copied out.

fresh_translation: The glory of God hides a word, but the glory of the king honors matters.
brenton_translation: The glory of God conceals a matter: but the glory of a king honours business.

fresh_translation: Heaven is high, earth is deep, but the heart of the king is unsearchable.
brenton_translation: Heaven is high, and earth is deep, and a king's heart is unsearchable.

fresh_translation: Beat untested silver, and all of it will be cleansed pure.
brenton_translation: Beat the drossy silver, and it shall be made entirely pure.

fresh_translation: Kill ungodly men from the face of the king, and his throne will be set right in righteousness.
brenton_translation: Slay the ungodly from before the king, and his throne shall prosper in righteousness.

fresh_translation: Do not act boastfully before the king, nor stand in the places of rulers.
brenton_translation: Be not boastful in the presence of the king, and remain not in the places of princes;

fresh_translation: For better for you to be told, "Come up to me," than for you to be humbled before ruler. What your eyes saw, speak.
brenton_translation: for it is better for thee that it should be said, Come up to me, than that one should humble thee in the presence of the prince; speak of that which thine eyes have seen.

fresh_translation: Do not fall into fight quickly, lest at end you regret, when your friend reproaches you.
brenton_translation: Get not suddenly into a quarrel, lest thou repent at last.

fresh_translation: Withdraw backward; do not despise,
brenton_translation: Whenever thy friend shall reproach thee, retreat backward, despise him not;

fresh_translation: lest your friend reproach you and your fight and enmity not depart, but be equal to death for you. Grace and friendship free; keep these for yourself, so that you may not become reproached, but guard your ways peaceably.
brenton_translation: lest thy friend continue to reproach thee, so thy quarrel and enmity shall not depart, but shall be to thee like death.

fresh_translation: A golden apple in a necklace of sardius, so to speak a word.
brenton_translation: As a golden apple in a necklace of sardius, so is it to speak a wise word.

fresh_translation: Bound in a golden earring and precious sardius, a wise word to a listening ear.
brenton_translation: In an ear-ring of gold a precious sardius is also set; so is a wise word to an obedient ear.

fresh_translation: As snowfall coming in harvest helps against heat, so a faithful messenger benefits those sending him, for he benefits the souls of those using him.
brenton_translation: As a fall of snow in the time of harvest is good against heat, so a faithful messenger refreshes those that send him; for he helps the souls of his employers.

fresh_translation: Like winds and clouds and most visible rains, so one boasting in false gift.
brenton_translation: As winds and clouds and rains are most evident objects, so is he that boasts of a false gift.

fresh_translation: In longsuffering good-way with kings, but soft tongue breaks bones.
brenton_translation: In long-suffering is prosperity to kings, and a soft tongue breaks the bones.

fresh_translation: If you found honey, eat what is sufficient, lest being filled you vomit.
brenton_translation: Having found honey, eat only what is enough, lest haply thou be filled, and vomit it up.

fresh_translation: Bring your foot rarely into your friend's house, lest filled with you he hate you.
brenton_translation: Enter sparingly into thy friend's house, lest he be satiated with thy company, and hate thee.

fresh_translation: Club and sword and sharp-pointed missile, so also a man testifying false witness against his friend.
brenton_translation: As a club, and a dagger, and a pointed arrow, so also is a man who bears false witness against his friend.

fresh_translation: The way of evil and the foot of a lawless man perish in an evil day.
brenton_translation: The way of the wicked and the foot of the transgressor shall perish in an evil day.

fresh_translation: As vinegar draws what is unfitting, so suffering falling upon the body grieves the heart. As a moth in a garment and a worm in wood, so grief of a man harms the heart.
brenton_translation: As vinegar is bad for a sore, so trouble befalling the body afflicts the heart.

fresh_translation: If your enemy hungers, feed him bread; if he thirsts, give him drink.
brenton_translation: If thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink;

fresh_translation: For doing this you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the Lord will repay you good things.
brenton_translation: for so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord shall reward thee with good.

fresh_translation: North wind stirs clouds, but shameless face stirs tongue.
brenton_translation: The north wind raises clouds; so an impudent face provokes the tongue.

fresh_translation: Better dwell on the corner of a roof than with a scolding woman in a common house.
brenton_translation: It is better to dwell on a corner of the roof, than with a railing woman in an open house.

fresh_translation: As cool water is pleasant to a thirsty soul, so a good message from a far land.
brenton_translation: As cold water is agreeable to a thirsting soul, so is a good message from a land far off.

fresh_translation: As if someone should stop up a spring and spoil a water outlet, so it is indecent for a righteous man to fall before an ungodly man.
brenton_translation: As if one should stop a well, and corrupt a spring of water, so is it unseemly for a righteous man to fall before an ungodly man.

fresh_translation: To eat much honey not good, but one ought to honor glorious words.
brenton_translation: It is not good to eat much honey; but it is right to honour venerable sayings.

fresh_translation: Like a city whose walls are thrown down and unwalled, so a man who does anything without counsel.
brenton_translation: As a city whose walls are broken down, and which is unfortified, so is a man who does anything without counsel.

fresh_translation: As dew in harvest and rain in summer, so honor is not for a fool.
brenton_translation: As dew in harvest, and as rain in summer, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

fresh_translation: As birds fly and sparrows, so empty curse will not come upon anyone.
brenton_translation: As birds and sparrows fly, so a curse shall not come upon any one without a cause.

fresh_translation: As whip for horse and goad for donkey, so rod for lawless nation.
brenton_translation: As a whip for a horse, and a goad for an ass, so is a rod for a simple nation.

fresh_translation: Do not answer fool according to his folly, lest you become like him.
brenton_translation: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou become like him.

fresh_translation: But answer fool according to his folly, lest he seem wise to himself.
brenton_translation: Yet answer a fool according to his folly, lest he seem wise in his own conceit.

fresh_translation: From his own ways one sending word through foolish messenger makes reproach for himself.
brenton_translation: He that sends a message by a foolish messenger procures for himself a reproach from his own ways.

fresh_translation: Take away journey of legs and lawlessness from the mouth of fools.
brenton_translation: As well take away the motion of the legs, as transgression from the mouth of fools.

fresh_translation: One loosening stone in sling resembles one giving glory to fool.
brenton_translation: He that binds up a stone in a sling, is like one that gives glory to a fool.

fresh_translation: Thorns grow in the hand of drunkard, and slavery in the hand of fools.
brenton_translation: Thorns grow in the hand of a drunkard, and servitude in the hand of fools.

fresh_translation: All flesh of fools is storm-tossed much, for their ecstasy is shattered.
brenton_translation: All the flesh of fools endures much hardship; for their fury is brought to nought.

fresh_translation: As a dog when it returns to its own vomit and becomes hateful, so a fool, turning in his own evil, returns to his own sin. There is shame that brings sin, and there is shame that is glory and grace.
brenton_translation: As when a dog goes to his own vomit, and becomes abominable, so is a fool who returns in his wickedness to his own sin.

fresh_translation: I saw a man seeming wise to himself; yet a fool had more hope than he.
brenton_translation: I have seen a man who seemed to himself to be wise; but a fool had more hope than he.

fresh_translation: Sluggard says, sent into road, "Lion in roads, and murderers in squares."
brenton_translation: A sluggard when sent on a journey says, There is a lion in the ways, and there are murderers in the streets.

fresh_translation: As door turns on hinge, so sluggard on his bed.
brenton_translation: As a door turns on the hinge, so does a sluggard on his bed.

fresh_translation: Sluggard hiding his hand in bosom will not be able to bring it to mouth.
brenton_translation: A sluggard having hid his hand in his bosom, will not be able to bring it up to his mouth.

fresh_translation: Sluggard seems wiser to himself than one bringing message back in fullness.
brenton_translation: A sluggard seems to himself wiser than one who most satisfactorily brings back a message.

fresh_translation: Like one holding tail of dog, so one standing over stranger's judgment.
brenton_translation: As he that lays hold of a dog's tail, so is he that makes himself the champion of another's cause.

fresh_translation: As those being healed throw words at men, but one answering to word first will be tripped,
brenton_translation: As those who need correction put forth fair words to men, and he that first falls in with the proposal will be overthrown;

fresh_translation: so all ambushing their own friends; when seen, they say, "I acted in play."
brenton_translation: so are all that lay wait for their own friends, and when they are discovered, say, I did it in jest.

fresh_translation: With much wood fire flourishes, but where there is no double-tongued man, fight grows quiet.
brenton_translation: With much wood fire increases; but where there is not a double-minded man, strife ceases.

fresh_translation: Brazier for coals and wood for fire, and scolding man for turmoil of fight.
brenton_translation: A hearth for coals, and wood for fire; and a railing man for the tumult of strife.

fresh_translation: The words of whisperers are soft, yet these strike into the storerooms of inward parts.
brenton_translation: The words of cunning knaves are soft; but they smite even to the inmost parts of the bowels.

fresh_translation: Silver given with deceit should be considered potsherd; smooth lips cover grieving heart.
brenton_translation: Silver dishonestly given is to be considered as a potsherd: smooth lips cover a grievous heart.

fresh_translation: With lips enemy nods agreement about everything, but in heart he devises deceits.
brenton_translation: A weeping enemy promises all things with his lips, but in his heart he contrives deceit.

fresh_translation: If enemy begs you with loud voice, do not be persuaded, for seven evils are in his soul.
brenton_translation: Though thine enemy intreat thee with a loud voice, consent not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.

fresh_translation: One hiding enmity sets deceit together, but making his own sins plain is known in councils.
brenton_translation: He that hides enmity frames deceit: but being easily discerned, exposes his own sins in the public assemblies.

fresh_translation: One digging pit for neighbor will fall into it, and one rolling stone rolls it on himself.
brenton_translation: He that digs a pit for his neighbour shall fall into it: and he that rolls a stone, rolls it upon himself.

fresh_translation: A lying tongue hates truth, and an unchecked mouth makes disorders.
brenton_translation: A lying tongue hates the truth; and an unguarded mouth causes tumults.

fresh_translation: Do not boast about things for tomorrow, for you do not know what the next day will bring forth.
brenton_translation: Boast not of to-morrow; for thou knowest not what the next day shall bring forth.

fresh_translation: Let a neighbor praise you, not your own mouth; a stranger, not your own lips.
brenton_translation: Let thy neighbour, and not thine own mouth, praise thee; a stranger, and not thine own lips.

fresh_translation: A heavy stone and burdensome sand, but the anger of a fool is heavier than both.
brenton_translation: A stone is heavy, and sand cumbersome; but a fool's wrath is heavier than both.

fresh_translation: Pitiless wrath and sharp anger, but jealousy no one withstands.
brenton_translation: Wrath is merciless, and anger sharp: but envy can bear nothing.

fresh_translation: Better revealed rebukes than hidden friendship.
brenton_translation: Open reproofs are better than secret love.

fresh_translation: Wounds of a friend are more trustworthy than willing kisses of an enemy.
brenton_translation: The wounds of a friend are more to be trusted than the spontaneous kisses of an enemy.

fresh_translation: A soul in fullness mocks honeycombs, but to a needy soul even bitter things seem sweet.
brenton_translation: A full soul scorns honeycombs; but to a hungry soul even bitter things appear sweet.

fresh_translation: As when a bird flies down from its own nest, so a man enslaves himself when alienated from his own places.
brenton_translation: As when a bird flies down from its own nest, so a man is brought into bondage whenever he estranges himself from his own place.

fresh_translation: With perfumes and wines and incense the heart delights, but the soul is torn apart by mishaps.
brenton_translation: The heart delights in ointments and wines and perfumes: but the soul is broken by calamities.

fresh_translation: Do not forsake your friend or ancestral friend, and do not enter the house of your brother when unfortunate. Better a nearby friend than a brother dwelling far away.
brenton_translation: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; and when thou art in distress go not into thy brother's house: better is a friend that is near than a brother living far off.

fresh_translation: Become wise, son, so that your heart may rejoice, and turn reproachful words away from yourself.
brenton_translation: Son, be wise, that thy heart may rejoice; and remove thou from thyself reproachful words.

fresh_translation: A shrewd man hid himself when evils came on; fools, coming on, will pay damage.
brenton_translation: A wise man, when evils are approaching, hides himself; but fools pass on, and will be punished.

fresh_translation: Take away his garment, for an insolent man passed by, who destroys strangers' things.
brenton_translation: Take away the man's garment, (for a scorner has passed by) whoever lays waste another's goods.

fresh_translation: Whoever blesses a friend early in the morning with a loud voice will seem no different from one cursing.
brenton_translation: Whosoever shall bless a friend in the morning with a loud voice, shall seem to differ nothing from one who curses him.

fresh_translation: Drops drive a man out of his house on a winter day; likewise a scolding woman from her own house.
brenton_translation: On a stormy day drops of rain drive a man out of his house; so also does a railing woman drive a man out of his own house.

fresh_translation: A north wind is a hard wind, yet by name it is called dexterous.
brenton_translation: The north wind is sharp, but it is called by name propitious.

fresh_translation: Iron sharpens iron, and a man sharpens the face of a companion.
brenton_translation: Iron sharpens iron; and a man sharpens his friend's countenance.

fresh_translation: One planting a fig tree will eat its fruits, and one guarding his own master will be honored.
brenton_translation: He that plants a fig-tree shall eat the fruits of it: so he that waits on his own master shall be honoured.

fresh_translation: As faces are not alike to faces, so neither are the thoughts of men.
brenton_translation: As faces are not like other faces, so neither are the thoughts of men.

fresh_translation: Hades and destruction are not filled up; likewise the eyes of men are insatiable. One fixing an eye is an abomination to the Lord, and undisciplined men are unrestrained in tongue.
brenton_translation: Hell and destruction are not filled; so also are the eyes of men insatiable.

fresh_translation: Testing for silver and refining for gold, but a man is tested through the mouth of those praising him. The heart of a lawless man seeks evils, but an upright heart seeks knowledge.
brenton_translation: Fire is the trial for silver and gold; and a man is tried by the mouth of them that praise him.

fresh_translation: If you scourge a fool in the midst of council dishonoring him, you still will not strip away his folly.
brenton_translation: Though thou scourge a fool, disgracing him in the midst of the council, thou wilt still in no wise remove his folly from him.

fresh_translation: Know well the souls of your flock, and set your heart on your herds,
brenton_translation: Do thou thoroughly know the number of thy flock, and pay attention to thine herds.

fresh_translation: because strength and power are not forever for a man, nor does he hand down from generation to generation.
brenton_translation: For a man has not strength and power for ever; neither does he transmit it from generation to generation.

fresh_translation: Take care of greens in the field and you will cut grass, and gather mountain hay,
brenton_translation: Take care of the herbage in the field, and thou shalt cut grass, and gather the mountain hay;

fresh_translation: so that you may have sheep for clothing; honor the field so that lambs may be yours.
brenton_translation: that thou mayest have wool of sheep for clothing: pay attention to the land, that thou mayest have lambs.

fresh_translation: Son, from me you have strong sayings for your life and for the life of your attendants.
brenton_translation: My son, thou hast from me words very useful for thy life, and for the life of thy servants.

fresh_translation: An ungodly one flees with none pursuing, but a righteous one trusts like a lion.
brenton_translation: The ungodly man flees when no one pursues: but the righteous is confident as a lion.

fresh_translation: Through sins of the ungodly judgments are stirred up, but a shrewd man will quench them.
brenton_translation: By reason of the sins of ungodly men quarrels arise; but a wise man will quell them.

fresh_translation: A strong man in ungodliness slanders the poor; he is like sweeping and useless rain.
brenton_translation: A bold man oppresses the poor by ungodly deeds. As an impetuous and unprofitable rain,

fresh_translation: Those forsaking the law praise ungodliness, but those loving the law wrap a wall around themselves.
brenton_translation: so they that forsake the law praise ungodliness; but they that love the law fortify themselves with a wall.

fresh_translation: Evil men will not understand judgment, but those seeking the Lord will understand in everything.
brenton_translation: Evil men will not understand judgment: but they that seek the Lord will understand everything.

fresh_translation: Better a poor man walking in truth than a rich liar.
brenton_translation: A poor man walking in truth is better than a rich liar.

fresh_translation: An understanding son keeps the law, but one shepherding prodigality dishonors his father.
brenton_translation: A wise son keeps the law: but he that keeps up debauchery dishonours his father.

fresh_translation: One multiplying wealth with interest and increase gathers it for one showing mercy to the poor.
brenton_translation: He that increases his wealth by usuries and unjust gains, gathers it for him that pities the poor.

fresh_translation: One turning his ear away from hearing the law, even his prayer is abominated.
brenton_translation: He that turns away his ear from hearing the law, even he has made his prayer abominable.

fresh_translation: One leading the upright astray in an evil way will himself fall into corruption; but the lawless will pass by good things and not enter into them.
brenton_translation: He that causes upright men to err in an evil way, himself shall fall into destruction: transgressors also shall pass by prosperity, but shall not enter into it.

fresh_translation: A rich man is wise to himself, but a poor understanding man will expose him.
brenton_translation: A rich man is wise in his own conceit; but an intelligent poor man will condemn him.

fresh_translation: Through help of the righteous much glory comes, but in the places of the ungodly men are caught.
brenton_translation: By reason of the help of righteous men great glory arises: but in the places of the ungodly men are caught.

fresh_translation: One covering his ungodliness will not prosper, but one confessing rebukes will be loved.
brenton_translation: He that covers his own ungodliness shall not prosper: but he that blames himself shall be loved.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the man who trembles always in reverence, but one hardening the heart will fall into evils.
brenton_translation: Blessed is the man who religiously fears always: but the hard of heart shall fall into mischiefs.

fresh_translation: A hungry lion and a thirsty wolf is a tyrant, being poor, over a needy people.
brenton_translation: A hungry lion and a thirsty wolf is he, who, being poor, rules over a poor nation.

fresh_translation: A king lacking revenues is a great slanderer, but one hating injustice will live a long time.
brenton_translation: A king in need of revenues is a great oppressor: but he that hates injustice shall live a long time.

fresh_translation: One guaranteeing a man guilty of murder will be a fugitive and not in safety. Discipline your son and he will love you and give adornment to your soul; he will not listen to a lawless nation.
brenton_translation: He that becomes surety for a man charged with murder shall be an exile, and not in safety.

fresh_translation: One walking justly is helped, but one walking in crooked ways will be entangled.
brenton_translation: He that walks justly is assisted: but he that walks in crooked ways shall be entangled therein.

fresh_translation: One working his own land will be filled with breads, but one pursuing idleness will be filled with poverty.
brenton_translation: He that tills his own land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that follows idleness shall have plenty of poverty.

fresh_translation: A faithful man will be greatly blessed, but an evil man will not go unpunished.
brenton_translation: A man worthy of credit shall be much blessed: but the wicked shall not be unpunished.

fresh_translation: One not respecting faces of the righteous is not good; such a man will be sold for a morsel of bread.
brenton_translation: He that reverences not the persons of the just is not good: such a one will sell a man for a morsel of bread.

fresh_translation: An envious man hurries to become rich and does not know that a merciful man will master him.
brenton_translation: An envious man makes haste to be rich, and knows not that the merciful man will have the mastery over him.

fresh_translation: One reproving the ways of a man will have more favor than one flattering with the tongue.
brenton_translation: He that reproves a man's ways shall have more favour than he that flatters with the tongue.

fresh_translation: One casting away father or mother and thinking he does not sin is a partner of an ungodly man.
brenton_translation: He that casts off father or mother, and thinks he sins not; the same is partaker with an ungodly man.

fresh_translation: A faithless man judges vainly, but one trusting in the Lord will be diligent.
brenton_translation: An unbelieving man judges rashly: but he that trusts in the Lord will act carefully.

fresh_translation: One trusting in a bold heart, that man is a fool; but one walking in wisdom will be saved.
brenton_translation: He that trusts to a bold heart, such an one is a fool: but he that walks in wisdom shall be safe.

fresh_translation: One giving to the poor will not be in need, but one turning away his eye will be in much want.
brenton_translation: He that gives to the poor shall not be in want: but he that turns away his eye from him shall be in great distress.

fresh_translation: In the places of the ungodly the righteous groan, but in their destruction the righteous will multiply.
brenton_translation: In the places of ungodly men the righteous mourn: but in their destruction the righteous shall be multiplied.

fresh_translation: A man who rebukes is better than a stiff-necked man; for when he suddenly catches fire, there is no healing.
brenton_translation: A reprover is better than a stiff-necked man: for when the latter is suddenly set on fire, there shall be no remedy.

fresh_translation: When the righteous are praised, peoples rejoice; but when the ungodly rule, men groan.
brenton_translation: When the righteous are praised, the people will rejoice: but when the ungodly rule, men mourn.

fresh_translation: When a man loves wisdom, his father rejoices; but one shepherding prostitutes destroys wealth.
brenton_translation: When a man loves wisdom, his father rejoices: but he that keeps harlots will waste wealth.

fresh_translation: A righteous king raises up a land, but a lawless man digs it down.
brenton_translation: A righteous king establishes a country: but a transgressor destroys it.

fresh_translation: One preparing a net before his own friend wraps it around his own feet.
brenton_translation: He that prepares a net in the way of his own friend, entangles his own feet in it.

fresh_translation: For a sinful man is a great snare, but the righteous will be in joy and gladness.
brenton_translation: A great snare is spread for a sinner: but the righteous shall be in joy and gladness.

fresh_translation: A righteous one knows how to judge for the poor, but the ungodly one does not understand knowledge, and for a poor man there is no discerning mind.
brenton_translation: A righteous man knows how to judge for the poor: but the ungodly understands not knowledge; and the poor man has not an understanding mind.

fresh_translation: Lawless men set a city on fire, but wise men turned wrath back.
brenton_translation: Lawless men burn down a city: but wise men turn away wrath.

fresh_translation: A wise man will judge nations, but a base man growing angry is laughed at and does not shrink back.
brenton_translation: A wise man shall judge nations: but a worthless man being angry laughs and fears not.

fresh_translation: Men partaking in blood hate a holy man, but the upright will seek his soul.
brenton_translation: Bloody men hate a holy person, but the upright will seek his soul.

fresh_translation: A fool lets out all his anger, but a wise man keeps it back in measure.
brenton_translation: A fool utters all his mind: but the wise reserves his in part.

fresh_translation: When a king listens to an unjust word, all who are under him are lawless.
brenton_translation: When a king hearkens to unjust language, all his subjects are transgressors.

fresh_translation: When a lender and debtor meet one another, the Lord oversees both.
brenton_translation: When the creditor and debtor meet together, the Lord oversees them both.

fresh_translation: When a king judges the poor in truth, his throne will be established as a testimony.
brenton_translation: When a king judges the poor in truth, his throne shall be established for a testimony.

fresh_translation: Blows and reproofs give wisdom, but a wandering child shames his parents.
brenton_translation: Stripes and reproofs give wisdom: but an erring child disgraces his parents.

fresh_translation: When the ungodly are many, sins become many, but when they fall, the righteous are put in fear.
brenton_translation: When the ungodly abound, sins abound: but when they fall, the righteous are warned.

fresh_translation: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest, and he will give honor to your soul.
brenton_translation: Chasten thy son, and he shall give thee rest; and he shall give honour to thy soul.

fresh_translation: There will by no means be an interpreter for a lawless nation, but one keeping the law is blessed.
brenton_translation: There shall be no interpreter to a sinful nation: but he that observes the law is blessed.

fresh_translation: A hard servant will not be disciplined by words; for even if he understands, still he will not obey.
brenton_translation: A stubborn servant will not be reproved by words: for even if he understand, still he will not obey.

fresh_translation: If you see a man swift in words, know that a fool has hope rather than he does.
brenton_translation: If thou see a man hasty in his words, know that the fool has hope rather than he.

fresh_translation: One who lives wantonly from childhood will be a servant, and in the end he will grieve over himself.
brenton_translation: He that lives wantonly from a child, shall be a servant, and in the end shall grieve over himself.

fresh_translation: An angry man digs up strife, and a wrathful man digs up sin.
brenton_translation: A furious man stirs up strife, and a passionate man digs up sin.

fresh_translation: Arrogance humbles a man, but the Lord supports the humble-minded with glory.
brenton_translation: Pride brings a man low, but the Lord upholds the humble-minded with honour.

fresh_translation: One who shares with a thief hates his own soul; and if, when an oath has been set forth, those who heard do not report it,
brenton_translation: He that shares with a thief, hates his own soul: and if any having heard an oath uttered tell not of it,

fresh_translation: fearing and being ashamed before men, they were tripped up; but one trusting in the Lord will rejoice. Ungodliness causes a man to stumble, but one who trusts in the Master will be saved.
brenton_translation: they fearing and reverencing men unreasonably have been overthrown, but he that trusts in the Lord shall rejoice. Ungodliness causes a man to stumble: but he that trusts in his master shall be safe.

fresh_translation: Many attend to the faces of the leaders, but from the Lord justice comes to a man.
brenton_translation: Many wait on the favour of rulers; but justice comes to a man from the Lord.

fresh_translation: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous, and a straight way is an abomination to a lawless man.
brenton_translation: A righteous man is an abomination to an unrighteous man, and the direct way is an abomination to the sinner.

fresh_translation: My words, son, fear and receive them, and repent. These things says the man to those trusting in God, and I stop.
For I am most foolish of all men, and understanding of men is not in me.
But God taught me wisdom, and I knew knowledge of the holy ones.

Who ascended into heaven and came down? Who gathered winds in a bosom? Who wrapped water in a garment? Who held all the ends of the earth? What is his name, or what is the name of his children, so that you may know?
All the words of God are refined; and he defends those revering him.
Do not add to his words, lest he reprove you and you become a liar.
Two things I ask from you; do not take grace from me before my dying:
Make a vain word and a lie far from me; do not give me riches and poverty, but appoint for me the necessary and self-sufficient things,
lest being filled I become a liar and say, "Who sees me?" Or becoming poor I steal and swear by the name of God.
Do not hand a servant over into the hands of his master, lest he curse you and you vanish.
An evil offspring curses its father and does not bless its mother.
An evil offspring judges itself righteous, but has not washed its own filth away.
An evil offspring has lofty eyes, and its eyelids lift themselves up.
An evil offspring has swords for teeth and grinders like knives, so as to consume the humble from the earth and the poor among men.
The leech had three daughters dearly loved, and these three did not fill her, and the fourth was not satisfied to say, "Enough."
Hades and the desire of a woman and Tartarus and land not filled with water, and water and fire will never say, "Enough."
An eye mocking a father and dishonoring the old age of a mother, ravens from ravines may pluck it out and eaglets may devour it.
Three things are impossible for me to understand, and a fourth I do not know:
the tracks of an eagle flying, and the ways of a serpent on a rock, and the paths of a ship voyaging at sea, and the ways of a man in youth.
Such is the way of an adulterous woman: when she acts, having washed herself, she says she did nothing improper.
By three things the earth is shaken, and a fourth it cannot bear:
if a servant reigns and a fool is filled with foods,
and a maidservant throws out her mistress, and a hated woman happens upon a good husband.
Four things on the earth are very little, yet wiser than the wise:
The ants, though they have no strength, prepare food in summer;
and the rock-badgers, a nation not strong, who made houses in the rocks;
The locust has no king, yet marches orderly at one command;
and a lizard bracing itself with its hands, though vulnerable, dwells in the fortresses of the king.
Three things travel well, and a fourth walks well:
A lion's cub is strongest among beasts, and it does not turn back nor shrink from a beast;
and a rooster strutting among females, high-spirited, and a goat leading a flock, and a king speaking publicly among a nation.
If you push yourself forward into gladness and stretch out your hand with battle, you will be dishonored.
When milk is pressed there will be butter; if you squeeze nostrils, blood will come out; if you drag out words, judgments and fights will come out.
My words were spoken by God, an oracle of a king whom his mother taught.
What will you keep, child? What sayings of God? Firstborn, I speak to you, son, child of my womb, child of my vows.
Do not give your wealth to women, and your mind and life to afterthought.
Do everything with counsel; the rulers drink wine with counsel, for they are hot-tempered; but let them not drink wine,
lest drinking they forget wisdom and be unable to judge the weak rightly.
Give strong drink to those in grief and wine to drink for those in pains,
so that they may forget their poverty and remember their troubles no more.
Open your mouth for the word of God and judge all soundly.
Open your mouth and judge justly; discriminate for the poor and weak.
Who will find a brave wife? Such a woman is more precious than precious stones.
brenton_translation: Who shall find a virtuous woman? for such a one is more valuable than precious stones.

fresh_translation: The heart of her husband trusts upon her; such a woman will not lack good spoils.
brenton_translation: The heart of her husband trusts in her: such a one shall stand in no need of fine spoils.

fresh_translation: For she works good things for her husband all her life.
brenton_translation: For she employs all her living for her husband's good.

fresh_translation: She works wool and flax and made them useful with her hands.
brenton_translation: Gathering wool and flax, she makes it serviceable with her hands.

fresh_translation: She became like a merchant ship from far away, and gathers livelihood for herself.
brenton_translation: She is like a ship trading from a distance: so she procures her livelihood.

fresh_translation: And she rises by night and gave foods to the house and tasks to the maidservants.
brenton_translation: And she rises by night, and gives food to her household, and appointed tasks to her maidens.

fresh_translation: Having considered a field, she bought it, and from the fruits of her hands planted a possession.
brenton_translation: She views a farm, and buys it: and with the fruit of her hands she plants a possession.

fresh_translation: Having girded her waist strongly, she braced her arms for work.
brenton_translation: She strongly girds her loins, and strengthens her arms for work.

fresh_translation: She tasted that working is good, and her lamp does not go out the whole night.
brenton_translation: And she finds by experience that working is good; and her candle goes not out all night.

fresh_translation: She stretches her forearms to the useful things, and her hands brace to the spindle.
brenton_translation: She reaches forth her arms to needful works, and applies her hands to the spindle.

fresh_translation: She opened her hands to the poor, and stretched out her wrist to the needy.
brenton_translation: And she opens her hands to the needy, and reaches out fruit to the poor.

fresh_translation: Her husband does not worry about those in the house when he delays somewhere, for all who are from her are clothed.
brenton_translation: Her husband is not anxious about those at home when he tarries anywhere abroad: for all her household are clothed.

fresh_translation: She made double cloaks for her husband, and clothing for herself from fine linen and purple.
brenton_translation: She makes for her husband clothes of double texture, and garments for herself of fine linen and scarlet.

fresh_translation: Her husband becomes conspicuous in the gates whenever he sits in council with the elders of the land.
brenton_translation: And her husband becomes a distinguished person in the gates, when he sits in council with the old inhabitants of the land.

fresh_translation: She made linen cloths and sold them, and belts to the Canaanites.
brenton_translation: She makes fine linens, and sells girdles to the Chananites: she opens her mouth heedfully and with propriety, and controls her tongue.

fresh_translation: Her mouth opened attentively and lawfully, and she sent order to her tongue.
brenton_translation: She puts on strength and honour; and rejoices in the last days.

fresh_translation: She put on strength and dignity and rejoiced in the latter days.
brenton_translation: The ways of her household are careful, and she eats not the bread of idleness.

fresh_translation: Dry are occupations of her house, and she did not eat lazy foods.
brenton_translation: But she opens her mouth wisely, and according to law.

fresh_translation: But her mouth opens wisely and lawfully, and her mercy raised her children and they became rich, and her husband praised her.
brenton_translation: And her kindness to them sets up her children for them, and they grow rich, and her husband praises her.

fresh_translation: Many daughters acquired wealth, many made mighty things; but you excel and surpassed them all.
brenton_translation: Many daughters have obtained wealth, many have wrought valiantly; but thou hast exceeded, thou hast surpassed all.

fresh_translation: False are charms and vain is beauty of a woman; for a prudent woman is blessed. Let her praise the fear of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Charms are false, and woman's beauty is vain: for it is a wise woman that is blessed, and let her praise the fear of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Give her from the fruits of her hands, and let her husband be praised in the gates.
brenton_translation: Give her of the fruit of her lips; and let her husband be praised in the gates.

fresh_translation: The words of Ecclesiastes, son of David, king of Israel in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king of Israel in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: Vanity of vanities, said Ecclesiastes; vanity of vanities, all things are vanity.
brenton_translation: Vanity of vanities, said the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.

fresh_translation: What surplus is there for a man in all his toil with which he toils under the sun?
brenton_translation: What advantage is there to a man in all his labour that he takes under the sun?

fresh_translation: A generation goes and a generation comes, but the earth stands into the age.
brenton_translation: A generation goes, and a generation comes: but the earth stands for ever.

fresh_translation: And the sun rises and the sun sets and draws to its place,
brenton_translation: And the sun arises, and the sun goes down and draws toward its place;

fresh_translation: rising there. It goes toward the south and circles toward the north; circling its circles the wind goes, and on its circles the wind returns.
brenton_translation: arising there it proceeds southward, and goes round toward the north. The wind goes round and round, and the wind returns to its circuits.

fresh_translation: All torrents go into the sea, yet the sea will not be filled; to the place where the torrents go, there they return to go.
brenton_translation: All the rivers run into the sea; and yet the sea is not filled: to the place whence the rivers come, thither they return again.

fresh_translation: All words are wearisome; a man will not be able to speak, and the eye will not be filled with seeing, nor the ear filled from hearing.
brenton_translation: All things are full of labour; a man will not be able to speak of them: neither shall the eye be satisfied with seeing, neither shall the ear be filled with hearing.
