fresh_translation: I sleep, and my heart wakes. The voice of my beloved knocks at the door: "Open to me, my sister, my dear one, my dove, my perfect one, because my head is filled with dew and my locks with drops of night."
brenton_translation: I sleep, but my heart is awake: the voice of my kinsman knocks at the door, saying, Open, open to me, my companion, my sister, my dove, my perfect one: for my head is filled with dew, and my locks with the drops of the night.

fresh_translation: I stripped my tunic; how shall I put it on? I washed my feet; how shall I soil them?
brenton_translation: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet, how shall I defile them?

fresh_translation: My beloved sent his hand through the opening, and my inward parts trembled for him.
brenton_translation: My kinsman put forth his hand by the hole of the door, and my belly was moved for him.

fresh_translation: I rose, I, to open to my beloved; my hands dripped myrrh, my fingers were full of myrrh upon the handles of the lock.
brenton_translation: I rose up to open to my kinsman; my hands dropped myrrh, my fingers choice myrrh, on the handles of the lock.

fresh_translation: I opened, I, to my beloved; my beloved passed by. My soul went out at his word. I sought him and did not find him; I called him and he did not answer me.
brenton_translation: I opened to my kinsman; my kinsman was gone: my soul failed at his speech: I sought him, but found him not; I called him, but he answered me not.

fresh_translation: Watchmen found me, those circling in the city. They struck me, they wounded me; watchers of the walls took my veil from me.
brenton_translation: The watchmen that go their rounds in the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.

fresh_translation: I bound you by oath, daughters of Jerusalem, by the powers and by the strengths of the field, if you find my beloved, what will you report to him? That I am wounded by love.
brenton_translation: I have charged you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the powers and the virtues of the field: if ye should find my kinsman, what are ye to say to him? That I am wounded with love.

fresh_translation: What is your beloved beyond beloved, beautiful among women? What is your beloved beyond beloved, that thus you bound us by oath?
brenton_translation: What is thy kinsman more than another kinsman, O thou beautiful among women? what is thy kinsman more than another kinsman, that thou hast so charged us?

fresh_translation: My beloved is white and ruddy, singled out from myriads.
brenton_translation: My kinsman is white and ruddy, chosen out from myriads.

fresh_translation: His head is gold and fine gold; his curls are like palm branches, black as a raven.
brenton_translation: His head is as very fine gold, his locks are flowing, black as a raven.

fresh_translation: His eyes are like doves by fillings of waters, washed in milk, sitting by fullness of waters.
brenton_translation: His eyes are as doves, by the pools of waters, washed with milk, sitting by the pools.

fresh_translation: His cheeks are like bowls of spice, growing perfumes; his lips are lilies dripping full myrrh.
brenton_translation: His cheeks are as bowls of spices pouring forth perfumes: his lips are lilies, dropping choice myrrh.

fresh_translation: His hands are gold-carved, filled with Tarshish; his belly is an ivory box on a sapphire stone.
brenton_translation: His hands are as turned gold set with beryl: his belly is an ivory tablet on a sapphire stone.

fresh_translation: His legs are marble pillars founded on gold bases; his appearance is like Lebanon, choice as cedars.
brenton_translation: His legs are marble pillars set on golden sockets: his form is as Libanus, choice as the cedars.

fresh_translation: His throat is sweetness, and he is wholly desirable. This is my beloved and this is my dear one, daughters of Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: His throat is most sweet, and altogether desirable. This is my kinsman, and this is my companion, O daughters of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: Where did your beloved go, beautiful among women? Where did your beloved look away, and we will seek him with you?
brenton_translation: Whither is thy kinsman gone, thou beautiful among women? whither has thy kinsman turned aside? tell us, and we will seek him with thee.

fresh_translation: My beloved went down into his garden, into bowls of spice, to shepherd in gardens and gather lilies.
brenton_translation: My kinsman is gone down to his garden, to the beds of spice, to feed his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.

fresh_translation: I am to my beloved, and my beloved is to me, the one shepherding among the lilies.
brenton_translation: I am my kinsman's, and my kinsman is mine, who feeds among the lilies.

fresh_translation: You are beautiful, my dear one, as Delight; lovely as Jerusalem; awe-inspiring as battle-lines.
brenton_translation: Thou art fair, my companion, as Pleasure, beautiful as Jerusalem, terrible as armies set in array.

fresh_translation: Turn your eyes from before me, because they gave me wings. Your hair is like herds of goats that appeared from Gilead.
brenton_translation: Turn away thine eyes from before me, for they have ravished me: thy hair is as flocks of goats which have appeared from Galaad.

fresh_translation: Your teeth are like a herd of shorn sheep that came up from washing, all bearing twins, and there is not a barren one among them.
brenton_translation: Thy teeth are as flocks of shorn sheep, that have gone up from the washing, all of them bearing twins, and there is none barren among them: thy lips are as a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely.

fresh_translation: Your lips are like a scarlet cord, and your speech is beautiful; your cheek is like a piece of pomegranate behind your veil.
brenton_translation: Thy cheek is like the rind of a pomegranate, being seen without thy veil.

fresh_translation: Sixty queens and eighty concubines and maidens without number.
brenton_translation: There are sixty queens, and eighty concubines, and maidens without number.

fresh_translation: One is my dove, my perfect one; one to her mother, chosen to one who bore her. Daughters saw her and will bless her; queens and concubines, and they will praise her.
brenton_translation: My dove, my perfect one is one; she is the only one of her mother; she is the choice of her that bore her. The daughters saw her, and the queens will pronounce her blessed, yea, and the concubines, and they will praise her.

fresh_translation: Who is this looking forth as dawn, beautiful as the moon, chosen as the sun, awe-inspiring as battle-lines?
brenton_translation: Who is this that looks forth as the morning, fair as the moon, choice as the sun, terrible as armies set in array?

fresh_translation: Into a garden of walnut trees I went down, to see among the produce of the torrent, to see whether the vine blossomed, whether the pomegranates bloomed. There I will give my breasts to you.
brenton_translation: I went down to the garden of nuts, to look at the fruits of the valley, to see if the vine flowered, if the pomegranates blossomed.

fresh_translation: My soul did not know; it set me among the chariots of Amminadab.
brenton_translation: There I will give thee my breasts: my soul knew it not: it made me as the chariots of Aminadab.

fresh_translation: Return, return, Shulammite; return, return, and we will look on you. What will you see in Shulammite? She comes like dances of the camps.
brenton_translation: Return, return, O Sunamite; return, return, and we will look at thee.

fresh_translation: How beautiful are your steps in sandals, daughter of Nadab. The curves of your thighs are like necklaces, the work of hands of a craftsman.
brenton_translation: Thy steps are beautiful in shoes, O daughter of the prince: the joints of thy thighs are like chains, the work of the craftsman.

fresh_translation: Your navel is a carved bowl, not lacking mixed wine; your belly is a heap of wheat fenced round with lilies.
brenton_translation: Thy navel is as a turned bowl, not wanting liquor; thy belly is as a heap of wheat set about with lilies.

fresh_translation: Your two breasts are like two twin fawns of a gazelle.
brenton_translation: Thy two breasts are as two twin fawns.

fresh_translation: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like pools in Heshbon at the gates of the daughter of multitudes. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon watching the face of Damascus.
brenton_translation: Thy neck is as an ivory tower; thine eyes are as pools in Esebon, by the gates of the daughter of many: thy nose is as the tower of Libanus, looking toward Damascus.

fresh_translation: Your head upon you is like Carmel, and the braid of your head is like purple; a king is bound in the flowing locks.
brenton_translation: Thy head upon thee is as Carmel, and the curls of thy hair like scarlet; the king is bound in the galleries.

fresh_translation: How beautiful you became, and how sweet, love, in your delights.
brenton_translation: How beautiful art thou, and how sweet art thou, my love!

fresh_translation: This stature of yours was likened to a palm tree, and your breasts to clusters.
brenton_translation: This is thy greatness in thy delights: thou wast made like a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters.

fresh_translation: I said, I will climb the palm tree, I will seize its heights; and now let your breasts be as clusters of the vine, and the scent of your nose as apples.
brenton_translation: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of its high boughs: and now shall thy breasts be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose as apples;

fresh_translation: And your throat is like the good wine, going to my beloved in straightness, fitted to my lips and teeth.
brenton_translation: and thy throat as good wine, going well with my kinsman, suiting my lips and teeth.

fresh_translation: I am to my beloved, and his turning is upon me.
brenton_translation: I am my kinsman's, and his desire is toward me.

fresh_translation: Come, my beloved, let us go out into the field, let us lodge in villages.
brenton_translation: Come, my kinsman, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.

fresh_translation: Let us rise early to the vineyards; let us see whether the vine blossomed, whether the cypress blossomed, whether the pomegranates bloomed. There I will give my breasts to you.
brenton_translation: Let us go early into the vineyards; let us see if the vine has flowered, if the blossoms have appeared, if the pomegranates have blossomed; there will I give thee my breasts.

fresh_translation: The mandrakes gave scent, and at our doors are every choice fruit, new with old, my beloved, I kept for you.
brenton_translation: The mandrakes have given a smell, and at our doors are all kinds of choice fruits, new and old. O my kinsman, I have kept them for thee.

fresh_translation: Who will give you as my beloved, nursing the breasts of my mother? Finding you outside I will kiss you, and indeed they will not despise me.
brenton_translation: I would that thou, O my kinsman, wert he that sucked the breasts of my mother; when I found thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, they should not despise me.

fresh_translation: I will take you, I will bring you into the house of my mother and into the chamber of the one who conceived me. I will give you drink from the perfumed wine, from the juice of my pomegranates.
brenton_translation: I would take thee, I would bring thee into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me; I would make thee to drink of spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranates.

fresh_translation: His left is under my head, and his right will embrace me.
brenton_translation: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.

fresh_translation: I bound you by oath, daughters of Jerusalem, by the powers and by the strengths of the field: why do you rouse and why do you awaken love until it wishes?
brenton_translation: I have charged you, ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the virtues of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.

fresh_translation: Who is this coming up whitened, leaning on her beloved? Under an apple tree I awakened you; there your mother travailed with you, there she travailed, the one who bore you.
brenton_translation: Who is this that comes up all white, leaning on her kinsman? I raised thee up under an apple-tree; there thy mother brought thee forth; there she that bore thee brought thee forth.

fresh_translation: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm, because love is strong as death, jealousy hard as Hades; its wings are wings of fire, its flames.
brenton_translation: Set me as a seal upon thy heart, as a seal upon thine arm; for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave, her shafts are shafts of fire, even the flames thereof.

fresh_translation: Much water will not be able to quench love, and rivers will not flood it. If a man gives all his livelihood in love, despising they will despise him.
brenton_translation: Much water will not be able to quench love, and rivers shall not drown it; if a man would give all his substance for love, men would utterly despise it.

fresh_translation: Our sister is small, and she has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister on the day when they speak in her?
brenton_translation: Our sister is little, and has no breasts; what shall we do for our sister, in the day wherein she shall be spoken for?

fresh_translation: If she is a wall, we will build upon her battlements of silver; and if she is a door, we will engrave upon her a cedar board.
brenton_translation: If she is a wall, let us build upon her silver bulwarks; and if she is a door, let us carve for her cedar panels.

fresh_translation: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers. I became in his eyes as one finding peace.
brenton_translation: I am a wall, and my breasts are as towers; I was in their eyes as one that found peace.

fresh_translation: A vineyard came to Solomon in Baal-hamon. He gave his vineyard to keepers; each man will bring in its fruit a thousand of silver.
brenton_translation: Solomon had a vineyard in Beelamon; he let his vineyard to keepers; every one was to bring for its fruit a thousand pieces of silver.

fresh_translation: My vineyard is mine before me. The thousand are to you, Solomon, and the two hundred to those keeping its fruit.
brenton_translation: My vineyard, even mine, is before me; Solomon shall have a thousand, and they that keep its fruit two hundred.

fresh_translation: You who sit in gardens, companions attending to your voice, let me hear.
brenton_translation: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: make me hear it.

fresh_translation: Flee, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a fawn of deer on the mountains of spices.
brenton_translation: Away, my kinsman, and be like a doe or a fawn on the mountains of spices.

fresh_translation: The vision which Isaiah son of Amoz saw, which he saw against Judah and against Jerusalem in the reign of Uzziah and Jotham and Ahaz and Hezekiah, who reigned over Judah.
brenton_translation: The vision which Esaias the son of Amos saw, which he saw against Juda and against Jerusalem, in the reign of Ozias, and Joatham, and Achaz, and Ezekias, who reigned over Judea.

fresh_translation: Hear, heaven, and give ear, earth, because the Lord spoke: Sons I begot and raised high, but they rejected me.
brenton_translation: Hear, O heaven, and hearken, O earth: for the Lord has spoken, saying, I have begotten and reared up children, but they have rebelled against me.

fresh_translation: The ox knew the one acquiring it, and the donkey the manger of its master; but Israel did not know me, and the people did not understand me.
brenton_translation: The ox knows his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel does not know me, and the people has not regarded me.

fresh_translation: Woe, sinful nation, people full of sins, evil seed, lawless sons. You abandoned the Lord and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
brenton_translation: Ah sinful nation, a people full of sins, an evil seed, lawless children: ye have forsaken the Lord, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

fresh_translation: Why still be struck, adding lawlessness? Every head is in pain and every heart in grief.
brenton_translation: Why should ye be smitten any more, transgressing more and more? the whole head is pained, and the whole heart sad.

fresh_translation: From feet to head neither wound nor bruise nor burning stripe; there is no salve to apply, nor oil, nor bandages.
brenton_translation: From the feet to the head, there is no soundness in them; neither wound, nor bruise, nor festering ulcer are healed: it is not possible to apply a plaister, nor oil, nor bandages.

fresh_translation: Your land is desolate, your cities burned with fire; foreigners devour your country before you, and it has been desolated, overthrown by foreign peoples.
brenton_translation: Your land is desolate, your cities burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is made desolate, overthrown by strange nations.

fresh_translation: The daughter of Zion will be left as a tent in a vineyard, and as a watch-hut in a cucumber patch, as a city under siege.
brenton_translation: The daughter of Sion shall be deserted as a tent in a vineyard, and as a storehouse of fruits in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.

fresh_translation: Unless the Lord of hosts had left us seed, we would have become as Sodom and been made like Gomorrah.
brenton_translation: And if the Lord of Sabaoth had not left us a seed, we should have been as Sodoma, and we should have been made like to Gomorrha.

fresh_translation: Hear the word of the Lord, rulers of Sodom; heed the law of God, people of Gomorrah.
brenton_translation: Hear the word of the Lord, ye rulers of Sodoma; attend to the law of God, thou people of Gomorrha.

fresh_translation: What is the multitude of your sacrifices to me, says the Lord? I am full of whole burnt offerings of rams and fat of lambs, and blood of bulls and goats I do not want.
brenton_translation: Of what value to me is the abundance of your sacrifices? saith the Lord: I am full of whole-burnt-offerings of rams; and I delight not in the fat of lambs, and the blood of bulls and goats:

fresh_translation: Not even when you come to appear to me. For who sought these from your hands, to trample my court?
brenton_translation: neither shall ye come with these to appear before me; for who has required these things at your hands? Ye shall no more tread my court.

fresh_translation: You will not continue. If you bring fine flour, it is vain; incense is an abomination to me. Your new moons and Sabbaths and a great day I do not endure, fasting and idleness.
brenton_translation: Though ye bring fine flour, it is vain; incense is an abomination to me; I cannot bear your new moons, and your sabbaths, and the great day;

fresh_translation: Your new moons and your feasts my soul hates; you became fullness to me; no longer will I pardon your sins.
brenton_translation: your fasting, and rest from work, your new moons also, and your feasts my soul hates: ye have become loathsome to me; I will no more pardon your sins.

fresh_translation: When you stretch out hands to me, I will turn my eyes from you; and if you multiply supplication, I will not hear you, because your hands are full of blood.
brenton_translation: When ye stretch forth your hands, I will turn away mine eyes from you: and though ye make many supplications, I will not hearken to you; for your hands are full of blood.

fresh_translation: Wash, become clean, remove evils from your souls before my eyes; stop from your evils.
brenton_translation: Wash you, be clean; remove your iniquities from your souls before mine eyes; cease from your iniquities;

fresh_translation: Learn to do good, seek judgment, rescue one being wronged, judge for the orphan, justify the widow.
brenton_translation: learn to do well; diligently seek judgment, deliver him that is suffering wrong, plead for the orphan, and obtain justice for the widow.

fresh_translation: Come and let us reason together, says the Lord. And if your sins are as scarlet, I will whiten as snow; if they are as crimson, I will whiten as wool.
brenton_translation: And come, let us reason together, saith the Lord: and though your sins be as purple, I will make them white as snow; and though they be as scarlet, I will make them white as wool.

fresh_translation: If you are willing and listen to me, the good things of the land you will eat.
brenton_translation: And if ye be willing, and hearken to me, ye shall eat the good of the land:

fresh_translation: If you are not willing and do not listen to me, a sword will devour you, for the mouth of the Lord spoke these things.
brenton_translation: but if ye be not willing, nor hearken to me, a sword shall devour you: for the mouth of the Lord has spoken this.

fresh_translation: How the faithful city Zion became a prostitute, full of judgment, in which righteousness slept, but now murderers.
brenton_translation: How has the faithful city Sion, once full of judgment, become a harlot! wherein righteousness lodged, but now murderers.

fresh_translation: Your silver is unapproved, your tavern-keepers mix wine with water.
brenton_translation: Your silver is worthless, thy wine merchants mix the wine with water.

fresh_translation: Your rulers disobey, companions of thieves, loving gifts, pursuing repayment; not judging orphans and not attending to widow's case.
brenton_translation: Thy princes are rebellious, companions of thieves, loving bribes, seeking after rewards; not pleading for orphans, and not heeding the cause of widows.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Master, the Lord of hosts, Woe to the mighty ones of Israel. For my anger will not cease against opponents, and I will execute judgment against my enemies.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts, Woe to the mighty men of Israel; for my wrath shall not cease against mine adversaries, and I will execute judgment on mine enemies.

fresh_translation: I will bring my hand upon you and purge you into purity, but rebellious ones I will destroy; and I will remove all lawless ones from you and humble all proud ones.
brenton_translation: And I will bring my hand upon thee, and purge thee completely, and I will destroy the rebellious, and will take away from thee all transgressors.

fresh_translation: I will appoint your judges as before, and your counselors as from the beginning; afterward you will be called the city of righteousness, faithful mother-city Zion.
brenton_translation: And I will establish thy judges as before, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: and afterward thou shalt be called the city of righteousness, the faithful mother-city Sion.

fresh_translation: For her captivity will be saved with judgment, and with mercy.
brenton_translation: For her captives shall be saved with judgment, and with mercy.

fresh_translation: The lawless and sinners will be shattered together, and those abandoning the Lord will be finished.
brenton_translation: And the transgressors and the sinners shall be crushed together, and they that forsake the Lord shall be utterly consumed.

fresh_translation: Because they will be ashamed over their idols which they wanted, and they were put to shame over their gardens they desired.
brenton_translation: For they shall be ashamed of their idols, which they delighted in, and they are made ashamed of the gardens which they coveted.

fresh_translation: For they will be as a terebinth that has cast off leaves, and as an orchard having no water.
brenton_translation: For they shall be as a turpentine tree that has cast its leaves, and as a garden that has no water.

fresh_translation: Their strength will be as a stalk of tow and their works as sparks of fire, and lawless and sinners will be burned together, and there will not be one to quench.
brenton_translation: And their strength shall be as a thread of tow, and their works as sparks, and the transgressors and the sinners shall be burnt up together, and there shall be none to quench them.

fresh_translation: The word that came from the Lord to Isaiah son of Amoz concerning Judah and concerning Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: The word which came to Esaias the son of Amos concerning Judea, and concerning Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: Because in the last days the mountain of the Lord and the house of God will be manifest on the peaks of mountains, and will be lifted above the hills, and all nations will come upon it.
brenton_translation: For in the last days the mountain of the Lord shall be glorious, and the house of God shall be on the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall come to it.

fresh_translation: Many nations will go and say, Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord and to the house of God of Jacob, and he will announce his way to us, and we will walk in it. For from Zion the law will come out, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And many nations shall go and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will tell us his way, and we will walk in it: for out of Sion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord out of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: He will judge between nations and reprove many people, and they will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into sickles; nation will not take sword against nation anymore, and they will certainly not learn war anymore.
brenton_translation: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plough-shares, and their spears into sickles: and nation shall not take up sword against nation, neither shall they learn to war any more.

fresh_translation: And now, house of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And now, O house of Jacob, come, and let us walk in the light of the Lord.

fresh_translation: For he let go his people, house of Israel, because their land was filled as from the beginning with divinations, as the land of foreigners, and many foreign sons were born to them.
brenton_translation: For he has forsaken his people the house of Israel, because their land is filled as at the beginning with divinations, as the land of the Philistines, and many strange children were born to them.

fresh_translation: Their land was filled with silver and gold, and there was no number of their treasures, and the land was filled with horses, and there was no number of their chariots.
brenton_translation: For their land is filled with silver and gold, and there was no number of their treasures; their land also is filled with horses, and there was no number of their chariots.

fresh_translation: Their land was filled with abominations, works of their hands, and they bowed to what their fingers made.
brenton_translation: And the land is filled with abominations, even the works of their hands; and they have worshipped the works which their fingers made.

fresh_translation: Man bent down, and male was humbled, and I will certainly not let them go.
brenton_translation: And the mean man bowed down, and the great man was humbled: and I will not pardon them.

fresh_translation: And now enter the rocks and hide in the earth from the face of the fear of the Lord and from the glory of his strength when he rises to shatter the earth.
brenton_translation: Now therefore enter ye into the rocks, and hide yourselves in the earth, for fear of the Lord, and by reason of the glory of his might, when he shall arise to strike terribly the earth.

fresh_translation: For the eyes of the Lord are high, but man is low, and the height of men will be humbled, and the Lord alone will be exalted in that day.
brenton_translation: For the eyes of the Lord are high, but man is low; and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low, and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.

fresh_translation: For the day of the Lord of hosts is upon every insolent and proud one, and upon every high and lofty thing, and they will be humbled.
brenton_translation: For the day of the Lord of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and haughty, and upon every one that is high and towering, and they shall be brought down;

fresh_translation: And upon every cedar of Lebanon, high and lofty, and upon every oak tree of Bashan.
brenton_translation: and upon every cedar of Libanus, of them that are high and towering, and upon every oak of Basan,

fresh_translation: And upon every mountain and every high hill.
brenton_translation: and upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill,

fresh_translation: And upon every high tower and every high wall.
brenton_translation: and upon every high tower, and upon every high wall,

fresh_translation: And upon every ship of the sea and upon every sight of beauty of ships.
brenton_translation: and upon every ship of the sea, and upon every display of fine ships.

fresh_translation: Every man will be humbled and the height of men will fall, and the Lord alone will be exalted in that day.
brenton_translation: And every man shall be brought low, and the pride of men shall fall: and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.

fresh_translation: All handmade things they will utterly hide.
brenton_translation: And they shall hide all idols made with hands,

fresh_translation: Carrying them into the caves and into the fissures of the rocks and into the hollows of the earth from the face of the fear of the Lord and from the glory of his strength when he rises to shatter the earth.
brenton_translation: having carried them into the caves, and into the clefts of the rocks, and into the caverns of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and by reason of the glory of his might, when he shall arise to strike terribly the earth.

fresh_translation: For in that day man will throw out his silver and gold abominations, which they made to bow to vanities and night-creatures.
brenton_translation: For in that day a man shall cast forth his silver and gold abominations, which they made in order to worship vanities and bats;

fresh_translation: To enter the hollows of solid rock and the fissures of rocks from the face of the fear of the Lord and from the glory of his strength when he rises to shatter the earth.
brenton_translation: to enter into the caverns of the solid rock, and into the clefts of the rocks, for fear of the Lord, and by reason of the glory of his might, when he shall arise to strike terribly the earth.

fresh_translation: Look now, the Master, the Lord of hosts, will take from Judah and Jerusalem a strong man and a strong woman, strength of bread and strength of water,
brenton_translation: Behold now, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, will take away from Jerusalem and from Judea the mighty man and mighty woman, the strength of bread, and the strength of water,

fresh_translation: a giant and a strong man and a man of war, and a judge and a prophet and a diviner and an elder,
brenton_translation: the great and mighty man, the warrior and the judge, and the prophet, and the counsellor, and the elder,

fresh_translation: and a captain of fifty and a wonderful counselor and a wise craftsman and an understanding listener.
brenton_translation: the captain of fifty also, and the honourable counsellor, and the wise artificer, and the intelligent hearer.

fresh_translation: I will appoint youths their rulers, and mockers will lord over them.
brenton_translation: And I will make youths their princes, and mockers shall have dominion over them.

fresh_translation: The people will fall together, man against man and man against his neighbor; a child will strike against an elder, the dishonorable one against the honorable.
brenton_translation: And the people shall fall, man upon man, and every man upon his neighbour: the child shall insult the elder man, and the base the honourable.

fresh_translation: Because a man will seize his brother or one of his father's household, saying, You have clothing, become our leader, and let my food be under you.
brenton_translation: For a man shall lay hold of his brother, as one of his father's household, saying, Thou hast raiment, be thou our ruler, and let my meat be under thee.

fresh_translation: He will answer and say in that day, I will not be your leader, for in my house there is neither bread nor clothing; I will not be the leader of this people.
brenton_translation: And he shall answer in that day, and say, I will not be thy ruler; for I have no bread in my house, nor raiment: I will not be the ruler of this people.

fresh_translation: Because Jerusalem is abandoned and Judah has fallen, and their tongues with lawlessness speak things against the Lord, disobeying, because now their glory was humbled.
brenton_translation: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judea has fallen, and their tongues have spoken with iniquity, disobedient as they are towards the Lord.

fresh_translation: The shame of their face stood against them, and their sin they announced as Sodom and made it plain. Woe to their soul, because they planned evil counsel against themselves.
brenton_translation: Wherefore now their glory has been brought low, and the shame of their countenance has withstood them, and they have proclaimed their sin as Sodom, and made it manifest.

fresh_translation: Saying, Let us bind the righteous one, because he is inconvenient to us; therefore they will eat the produce of their works.
brenton_translation: Woe to their soul, for they have devised an evil counsel against themselves, saying against themselves, Let us bind the just, for he is burdensome to us: therefore shall they eat the fruits of their works.

fresh_translation: Woe to the lawless one; evil will happen to him according to the works of his hands.
brenton_translation: Woe to the transgressor! evils shall happen to him according to the works of his hands.

fresh_translation: My people, your exactors glean you, and those collecting dues lord over you. My people, those calling you blessed lead you astray and trouble the path of your feet.
brenton_translation: O my people, your exactors strip you, and extortioners rule over you: O my people, they that pronounce you blessed lead you astray, and pervert the path of your feet.

fresh_translation: But now the Lord will stand for judgment and stand to judge his people.
brenton_translation: But now the Lord will stand up for judgment, and will enter into judgment with his people.

fresh_translation: The Lord himself will come into judgment with the elders of his people and with their rulers: But you, why did you burn my vineyard, and the spoil of the poor in your houses?
brenton_translation: The Lord himself shall enter into judgment with the elders of the people, and with their rulers: but why have ye set my vineyard on fire, and why is the spoil of the poor in your houses?

fresh_translation: Why do you wrong my people and shame the face of the poor?
brenton_translation: Why do ye wrong my people, and shame the face of the poor?

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Because the daughters of Zion were lifted high and walked with a high neck and with winks of eyes and in the walking of feet, dragging tunics together and playing together with feet,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Because the daughters of Sion are haughty, and have walked with an outstretched neck, and with winking of the eyes, and motion of the feet, at the same time drawing their garments in trains, and at the same time sporting with their feet:

fresh_translation: God will humble the ruling daughters of Zion, and the Lord will uncover their form.
brenton_translation: therefore the Lord will humble the chief daughters of Sion, and the Lord will expose their form in that day;

fresh_translation: In that day the Lord will take away the glory of their clothing and their ornaments and braids and hair-nets and crescent-moons,
brenton_translation: and the Lord will take away the glory of their raiment, the curls and the fringes, and the crescents,

fresh_translation: and the hangings and the ornament of their face,
brenton_translation: and the chains, and the ornaments of their faces,

fresh_translation: and the arrangement of the ornament of glory and bracelets and armlets and headdress and wrist-bands and rings and earrings,
brenton_translation: and the array of glorious ornaments, and the armlets, and the bracelets, and the wreathed work, and the finger-rings, and the ornaments for the right hand, and the ear-rings,

fresh_translation: and purple garments and garments bordered in purple,
brenton_translation: and the garments with scarlet borders, and the garments with purple grounds,

fresh_translation: and robes for the house and transparent Laconian cloths,
brenton_translation: and the shawls to be worn in the house, and the Spartan transparent dresses,

fresh_translation: and fine linen and blue and scarlet and linen woven together with gold and blue, and reclining veils.
brenton_translation: and those made of fine linen, and the purple ones, and the scarlet ones, and the fine linen, interwoven with gold and purple, and the light coverings for couches.

fresh_translation: It will be, instead of a sweet smell there will be dust, and instead of a belt you will bind with rope, and instead of the golden ornament of the head you will have baldness because of your works, and instead of a tunic bordered in purple you will gird yourself with sackcloth.
brenton_translation: And there shall be instead of a sweet smell, dust; and instead of a girdle, thou shalt gird thyself with a rope; and instead of a golden ornament for the head, thou shalt have baldness on account of thy works; and instead of a tunic with a scarlet ground, thou shalt gird thyself with sackcloth.

fresh_translation: Your most beautiful son whom you love will fall by sword, and your mighty men will fall by sword.
brenton_translation: And thy most beautiful son whom thou lovest shall fall by the sword; and your mighty men shall fall by the sword, and shall be brought low.

fresh_translation: The cases of your ornament will be humbled and mourn, and you will be left alone and dashed to the ground.
brenton_translation: And the stores of your ornaments shall mourn, and thou shalt be left alone, and shalt be levelled with the ground.

fresh_translation: Seven women will seize one man, saying, We will eat our bread and wear our clothes; only let your name be called upon us; take away our reproach.
brenton_translation: And seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own raiment: only let thy name be called upon us, and take away our reproach.

fresh_translation: In that day God will shine forth in counsel with glory upon the earth, to lift up and glorify the remnant of Israel.
brenton_translation: And in that day God shall shine gloriously in counsel on the earth, to exalt and glorify the remnant of Israel.

fresh_translation: It shall be that the one left in Zion and the one left in Jerusalem will be called holy, all who are written for life in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And it shall be, that the remnant left in Sion, and the remnant left in Jerusalem, even all that are appointed to life in Jerusalem, shall be called holy.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord will wash the filth of the sons and daughters of Zion and cleanse the blood from their midst by the spirit of judgment and the spirit of burning.
brenton_translation: For the Lord shall wash away the filth of the sons and daughters of Sion, and shall purge out the blood from the midst of them, with the spirit of judgment, and the spirit of burning.

fresh_translation: He will come, and over every place of Mount Zion and all around her, a cloud will overshadow by day, like smoke, and like light of burning fire by night. Over all the glory it will be covered.
brenton_translation: And he shall come, and it shall be with regard to every place of mount Sion, yea, all the region round about it shall a cloud overshadow by day, and there shall be as it were the smoke and light of fire burning by night: and upon all the glory shall be a defence.

fresh_translation: And it will be for shade from the heat and for shelter and hiding from harshness and rain.
brenton_translation: And it shall be for a shadow from the heat, and as a shelter and a hiding-place from inclemency of weather and from rain.

fresh_translation: Now I will sing to my beloved a song of my beloved concerning my vineyard. A vineyard came to my beloved on a hilltop in a fertile place.
brenton_translation: Now I will sing to my beloved a song of my beloved concerning my vineyard.

fresh_translation: I put a fence around it and staked it and planted a chosen vine and built a tower in the midst of it and dug a wine-vat in it, and I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.
brenton_translation: And I made a hedge round it, and dug a trench, and planted a choice vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and dug a place for the wine-vat in it: and I waited for it to bring forth grapes, and it brought forth thorns.

fresh_translation: And now, man of Judah and dwellers in Jerusalem, judge between me and my vineyard.
brenton_translation: And now, ye dwellers in Jerusalem, and every man of Juda, judge between me and my vineyard.

fresh_translation: What shall I still do to my vineyard that I did not do to it? Because I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.
brenton_translation: What shall I do any more to my vineyard, that I have not done to it? Whereas I expected it to bring forth grapes, but it has brought forth thorns.

fresh_translation: And now I will announce to you what I will do to my vineyard: I will remove its fence and it will be for plundering, and I will pull down its wall and it will be for trampling.
brenton_translation: And now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away its hedge, and it shall be for a spoil; and I will pull down its walls, and it shall be left to be trodden down.

fresh_translation: And I will leave my vineyard, and it shall certainly not be pruned nor dug, and thorns will come up upon it as upon wasteland, and I will command the clouds not to send rain on it.
brenton_translation: And I will forsake my vineyard; and it shall not be pruned, nor dug, and thorns shall come up upon it as on barren land; and I will command the clouds to rain no rain upon it.

fresh_translation: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the man of Judah is a beloved new planting. I waited for judgment, but it produced lawlessness, and not righteousness but a cry.
brenton_translation: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Juda his beloved plant: I expected it to bring forth judgment, and it brought forth iniquity; and not righteousness, but a cry.

fresh_translation: Woe to those joining house to house and bringing field near to field, to take something away from the neighbor; will you not dwell alone on the land?
brenton_translation: Woe to them that join house to house, and add field to field, that they may take away something of their neighbour's: will ye dwell alone upon the land?

fresh_translation: For these things were heard in the ears of the Lord of hosts: if many houses shall become, they will be desolate, great and beautiful, and there will not be the ones dwelling in them.
brenton_translation: For these things have reached the ears of the Lord of hosts: for though many houses should be built, many and fair houses shall be desolate, and there shall be no inhabitants in them.

fresh_translation: For ten yokes of oxen working will produce one jar, and one sowing six artabas will produce three measures.
brenton_translation: For where ten yoke of oxen plough the land shall yield one jar-full, and he that sows six homers shall produce three measures.

fresh_translation: Woe to those rising early and pursuing strong drink, those remaining till late, for the wine will burn them together.
brenton_translation: Woe to them that rise up in the morning, and follow strong drink; who wait at it till the evening: for the wine shall inflame them.

fresh_translation: For with lyre and psaltery and drums and flutes they drink wine, but the works of the Lord they do not look on, and the works of his hands they do not understand.
brenton_translation: For they drink wine with harp, and psaltery, and drums, and pipes: but they regard not the works of the Lord, and consider not the works of his hands.

fresh_translation: Therefore my people became captive because they did not know the Lord, and a multitude became dead from famine and thirst of water.
brenton_translation: Therefore my people have been taken captive, because they know not the Lord: and there has been a multitude of dead bodies, because of hunger and of thirst for water.

fresh_translation: And Hades widened its soul and opened its mouth without ceasing, and her glorious ones and great ones and rich ones and her plague-struck ones will go down.
brenton_translation: Therefore hell has enlarged its desire and opened its mouth without ceasing: and her glorious and great, and her rich and her pestilent men shall go down into it.

fresh_translation: And a man will be humbled and a male will be dishonored, and the lofty eyes will be humbled.
brenton_translation: And the mean man shall be brought low, and the great man shall be disgraced, and the lofty eyes shall be brought low.

fresh_translation: And the Lord of hosts will be exalted in judgment, and the Holy God will be glorified in righteousness.
brenton_translation: But the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and the holy God shall be glorified in righteousness.

fresh_translation: And the plundered ones will be grazed as bulls, and lambs will eat the deserted places of those taken away.
brenton_translation: And they that were spoiled shall be fed as bulls, and lambs shall feed on the waste places of them that are taken away.

fresh_translation: Woe to those drawing sins with a long rope and lawlessness as with the strap of a heifer's yoke,
brenton_translation: Woe to them that draw sins to them as with a long rope, and iniquities as with a thong of the heifer's yoke:

fresh_translation: those saying, Let what he will do come quickly and draw near, that we may see; and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel come, that we may know.
brenton_translation: who say, Let him speedily hasten what he will do, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel come, that we may know it.

fresh_translation: Woe to those saying evil is good and good is evil, those putting darkness as light and light as darkness, those putting bitter as sweet and sweet as bitter.
brenton_translation: Woe to them that call evil good, and good evil; who make darkness light, and light darkness; who make bitter sweet, and sweet bitter.

fresh_translation: Woe to those understanding in themselves and knowledgeable before themselves.
brenton_translation: Woe to them that are wise in their own conceit, and knowing in their own sight.

fresh_translation: Woe to your mighty men, drinkers of wine, and rulers mixing strong drink,
brenton_translation: Woe to the strong ones of you that drink wine, and the mighty ones that mingle strong drink:

fresh_translation: those justifying the ungodly for gifts and taking away the right of the righteous.
brenton_translation: who justify the ungodly for rewards, and take away the righteousness of the righteous.

fresh_translation: Therefore as stubble will be burned under a coal of fire and be consumed under a loose flame, their root will be as down and their blossom will go up as dust, because they did not want the law of the Lord of hosts but provoked the oracle of the Holy One of Israel.
brenton_translation: Therefore as stubble shall be burnt by a coal of fire, and shall be consumed by a violent flame, their root shall be as chaff, and their flower shall go up as dust: for they rejected the law of the Lord of hosts, and insulted the word of the Holy One of Israel.

fresh_translation: And the Lord of hosts was enraged in anger against his people, and he laid his hand on them and struck them and the mountains were provoked, and their corpses became as dung in the midst of the road. In all these his anger did not turn away, but his hand is still high.
brenton_translation: Therefore the Lord of hosts was greatly angered against his people, and he reached forth his hand upon them, and smote them: and the mountains were troubled, and their carcases were as dung in the midst of the way: yet for all this his anger has not been turned away, but his hand is yet raised.

fresh_translation: Therefore he will raise a signal among the nations far off and whistle to them from the end of the earth, and look, swiftly lightly they come.
brenton_translation: Therefore shall he lift up a signal to the nations that are afar, and shall hiss for them from the end of the earth; and, behold, they are coming very quickly.

fresh_translation: They will neither hunger nor grow weary nor grow drowsy nor sleep, nor loosen their belts from their waist, nor will the straps of their sandals break.
brenton_translation: They shall not hunger nor be weary, neither shall they slumber nor sleep; neither shall they loose their girdles from their loins, neither shall their shoe-latchets be broken.

fresh_translation: Whose arrows are sharp and their bows bent; the feet of their horses were reckoned as solid rock, the wheels of their chariots as a storm.
brenton_translation: Whose arrows are sharp, and their bows bent; their horses' hoofs are counted as solid rock: their chariot-wheels are as a storm.

fresh_translation: They will rush as lions and stand by as a lion's whelp, and will seize and roar as a beast and cast out, and there will not be one rescuing them.
brenton_translation: They rage as lions, and draw nigh as a lion's whelps: and he shall seize, and roar as a wild beast, and he shall cast them forth, and there shall be none to deliver them.

fresh_translation: And it will roar because of them in that day as the sound of a surging sea, and they will look to the land, and look, hard darkness is in their distress.
brenton_translation: And he shall roar on account of them in that day, as the sound of the swelling sea; and they shall look to the land, and, behold, there shall be thick darkness in their perplexity.

fresh_translation: And it happened in the year King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a high and lifted throne, and the house was full of his glory.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the year in which king Ozias died, that I saw the Lord sitting on a high and exalted throne, and the house was full of his glory.

fresh_translation: And seraphim stood around him; six wings to one and six wings to one; with two they covered the face, and with two they covered the feet, and with two they flew.
brenton_translation: And seraphs stood round about him: each one had six wings: and with two they covered their face, and with two they covered their feet, and with two they flew.

fresh_translation: And one cried to another and said, Holy, holy, holy, the Lord of hosts; the whole earth is full of his glory.
brenton_translation: And one cried to the other, and they said, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

fresh_translation: And the lintel was raised from the voice with which they cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
brenton_translation: And the lintel shook at the voice they uttered, and the house was filled with smoke.

fresh_translation: And I said, O wretched me, because I am pierced to heart, because being a man and having unclean lips and dwelling in the midst of the people having unclean lips, I saw the King, the Lord of hosts, with my eyes.
brenton_translation: And I said, Woe is me, for I am pricked to the heart; for being a man, and having unclean lips, I dwell in the midst of a people having unclean lips; and I have seen with mine eyes the King, the Lord of hosts.

fresh_translation: And one of the seraphim was sent to me, and in his hand he had a coal which he took with the tongs from the altar.
brenton_translation: And there was sent to me one of the seraphs, and he had in his hand a coal, which he had taken off the altar with the tongs:

fresh_translation: And he touched my mouth and said, Behold, this touched your lips, and it will take away your lawlessness and cleanse your sins.
brenton_translation: and he touched my mouth, and said, Behold, this has touched thy lips, and will take away thine iniquities, and will purge off thy sins.

fresh_translation: And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go to this people? And I said, Behold, I am here; send me.
brenton_translation: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go to this people? And I said, Behold, I am here, send me. And he said, Go, and say to this people,

fresh_translation: And he said, Go and say to this people: hearing you will hear and certainly not understand, and looking you will look and certainly not see.
brenton_translation: Ye shall hear indeed, but ye shall not understand; and ye shall see indeed, but ye shall not perceive.

fresh_translation: For the heart of this people grew fat, and with their ears they heard heavily, and their eyes they closed, lest they see with the eyes and hear with the ears and understand with the heart and turn, and I heal them.
brenton_translation: For the heart of this people has become gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

fresh_translation: And I said, Until when, Lord? And he said, Until the cities are made desolate from not being inhabited, and the houses from not having men, and the land will be left desolate.
brenton_translation: And I said, How long, O Lord? And he said, Until the cities be deserted by reason of their not being inhabited, and the houses by reason of there being no men, and the land shall be left desolate.

fresh_translation: And after these things God will send men far away, and those left behind will multiply on the earth.
brenton_translation: And after this God shall remove the men far off, and they that are left upon the land shall be multiplied.

fresh_translation: And yet upon it still is the tenth, and again it will be for plundering, like a terebinth and like an oak whenever it falls from its casing.
brenton_translation: And yet there shall be a tenth upon it, and again it shall be for a spoil, as a turpentine tree, and as an acorn when it falls out of its husk.

fresh_translation: And it happened in the days of Ahaz son of Jotham son of Uzziah king of Judah, Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel went up against Jerusalem to war against it, and they were not able to besiege it.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the days of Achaz the son of Joatham, the son of Ozias, king of Juda, there came up Rasin king of Aram, and Phakee son of Romelias, king of Israel, against Jerusalem to war against it, but they could not take it.

fresh_translation: And it was reported to the house of David, saying, Aram agreed with Ephraim, and his soul and the soul of his people were stirred as when a tree in the forest is shaken by wind.
brenton_translation: And a message was brought to the house of David, saying, Aram has conspired with Ephraim. And his soul was amazed, and the soul of his people, as in a wood a tree is moved by the wind.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to Isaiah, Go out to meet Ahaz, you and Shear-jashub your son, to the pool of the upper road of the fuller's field.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to Esaias, Go forth to meet Achaz, thou, and thy son Jasub who is left, to the pool of the upper way of the fuller's field.

fresh_translation: And you will say to him, Take care to be quiet and do not fear, nor let your soul weaken from these two pieces of smoking firebrands, for whenever the anger of my wrath comes, again I will heal.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say to him, Take care to be quiet, and fear not, neither let thy soul be disheartened because of these two smoking firebrands: for when my fierce anger is over, I will heal again.

fresh_translation: And the son of Aram and the son of Remaliah, because they counseled evil counsel about you, saying,
brenton_translation: And as for the son of Aram, and the son of Romelias, forasmuch as they have devised an evil counsel, saying,

fresh_translation: We will go up into Judah and by speaking with them turn them toward us, and we will make the son of Tabeel king of it.
brenton_translation: We will go up against Judea, and having conferred with them we will turn them away to our side, and we will make the son of Tabeel king of it;

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord of hosts: This counsel will certainly not remain, nor shall it be.
brenton_translation: thus saith the Lord of hosts, This counsel shall not abide, nor come to pass.

fresh_translation: But the head of Aram is Damascus; and yet within sixty-five years the kingdom of Ephraim will cease from being a people.
brenton_translation: But the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus, Rasim; and yet within sixty and five years the kingdom of Ephraim shall cease from being a people.

fresh_translation: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah. If you do not believe, neither will you understand.
brenton_translation: And the head of Ephraim is Somoron, and the head of Somoron the son of Romelias: but if ye believe not, neither will ye at all understand.

fresh_translation: And the Lord added again to speak to Ahaz, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Lord again spoke to Achaz, saying,

fresh_translation: Ask for yourself a sign from the Lord your God, in depth or in height.
brenton_translation: Ask for thyself a sign of the Lord thy God, in the depth or in the height.

fresh_translation: And Ahaz said, I will certainly not ask, nor certainly will I test the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Achaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he said, Hear now, house of David. Is it a small thing for you to furnish struggle to men, and how do you furnish struggle to the Lord?
brenton_translation: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; is it a little thing for you to contend with men? and how do ye contend against the Lord?

fresh_translation: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: Behold, the virgin will have a child in the womb and bear a son, and you will call his name Immanuel.
brenton_translation: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; behold, a virgin shall conceive in the womb, and shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name Emmanuel.

fresh_translation: Butter and honey he will eat; before he knows or chooses evil, he will choose the good.
brenton_translation: Butter and honey shall he eat, before he knows either to prefer evil, or choose the good.

fresh_translation: Because before the child knows good or evil, he rejects evil to choose the good, and the land which you fear from the face of the two kings will be forsaken.
brenton_translation: For before the child shall know good or evil, he refuses evil, to choose the good; and the land shall be forsaken which thou art afraid of because of the two kings.

fresh_translation: But God will bring upon you and upon your people and upon the house of your father days not yet come since the day Ephraim was taken away from Judah: the king of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: But God shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon the house of thy father, days which have never come, from the day that Ephraim took away from Juda the king of the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day, the Lord will whistle for the flies that rule part of the river of Egypt and for the bee that is in the land of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in that day that the Lord shall hiss for the flies, which insect shall rule over a part of the river of Egypt, and for the bee which is in the land of the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: And they will all come and rest in the ravines of the land and the holes of the rocks and the caves and every cleft and every tree.
brenton_translation: And they all shall enter into the clefts of the land, and into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves, and into every ravine.

fresh_translation: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor, the great and drunken one, which is beyond the river, by the king of the Assyrians, the head and the hairs of the feet, and the beard he will remove.
brenton_translation: In that day the Lord shall shave with the hired razor of the king of Assyria beyond the river the head, and the hairs of the feet, and will remove the beard.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day, a man will nourish a heifer of cattle and two sheep.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall rear a heifer, and two sheep.

fresh_translation: And it will be, from the abundance of milk, everyone left on the land will eat butter and honey.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass from their drinking an abundance of milk, that every one that is left on the land shall eat butter and honey.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day every place where there are a thousand vines for a thousand shekels will become a wasteland and a thorn.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, for every place where there shall be a thousand vines at a thousand shekels, they shall become barren land and thorns.

fresh_translation: With an arrow and bow they will enter there, because the whole land will be a wasteland and thorn.
brenton_translation: Men shall enter thither with arrow and bow; for all the land shall be barren ground and thorns.

fresh_translation: And every mountain being plowed will be plowed, and fear will certainly not come there, for from the wasteland and thorn it will be for the grazing of sheep and the trampling of ox.
brenton_translation: And every mountain shall be certainly ploughed: there shall no fear come thither: for there shall be from among the barren ground and thorns that whereon cattle shall feed and oxen shall tread.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Take for yourself a new large scroll and write on it with a human stylus: Swiftly spoil, quickly plunder, for it is near.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Take to thyself a volume of a great new book, and write in it with a man's pen concerning the making a rapid plunder of spoils; for it is near at hand.

fresh_translation: And make for me faithful human witnesses, Uriah and Zechariah son of Berechiah.
brenton_translation: And make me witnesses of faithful men, Urias, and Zacharias the son of Barachias.

fresh_translation: And I approached the prophetess, and she conceived and bore a son, and the Lord said to me, Call his name, Swiftly Spoil, Quickly Plunder.
brenton_translation: And I went in to the prophetess; and she conceived, and bore a son. And the Lord said to me, Call his name, Spoil quickly, plunder speedily.

fresh_translation: Because before the child knows to call father or mother, he will take the power of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria before the king of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: For before the child shall know how to call his father or his mother, one shall take the power of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria before the king of the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: And the Lord added to speak to me still,
brenton_translation: And the Lord spoke to me yet again, saying,

fresh_translation: Because this people did not want the water of Siloam going quietly, but wanted to have Rezin and the son of Remaliah as king over you,
brenton_translation: Because this people chooses not the water of Siloam that goes softly, but wills to have Rassin, and the son of Romelias to be king over you;

fresh_translation: because of this behold the Lord brings up upon you the water of the river, strong and abundant, the king of the Assyrians and his glory, and it will go up over all your valleys and walk over all your walls.
brenton_translation: therefore, behold, the Lord brings up upon you the water of the river, strong and abundant, even the king of the Assyrians, and his glory: and he shall come up over every valley of yours, and shall walk over every wall of yours:

fresh_translation: And it will take away from Judah a man who can lift his head or be able to accomplish anything, and his camp will be so as to fill the width of your land, God-with-us.
brenton_translation: and he shall take away from Juda every man who shall be able to lift up his head, and every one able to accomplish anything; and his camp shall fill the breadth of thy land, O God with us.

fresh_translation: Know, nations, and be defeated; hear, to the end of the earth. Having grown strong, be defeated. If again you grow strong, again you will be defeated.
brenton_translation: Know, ye Gentiles, and be conquered; hearken ye, even to the extremity of the earth: be conquered, after ye have strengthened yourselves; for even if ye should again strengthen yourselves, ye shall again be conquered.

fresh_translation: And whatever counsel you counsel, the Lord will scatter; and whatever word you speak will certainly not remain for you, because with us is the Lord God.
brenton_translation: And whatsoever counsel ye shall take, the Lord shall bring it to nought; and whatsoever word ye shall speak, it shall not stand among you: for God is with us.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord with a strong hand; they disobey in the walking of the way of this people, saying,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, With a strong hand they revolt from the course of the way of this people, saying,

fresh_translation: Never say hard whatever this people says is hard. The fear of it you certainly shall not fear, nor certainly be troubled.
brenton_translation: Let them not say, It is hard, for whatsoever this people says, is hard: but fear not ye their fear, neither be dismayed.

fresh_translation: Sanctify the Lord himself, and he himself will be your fear.
brenton_translation: Sanctify ye the Lord himself; and he shall be thy fear.

fresh_translation: And if you are trusting in him, he will be for you into holiness, and not as a stumbling stone will you meet him, nor as a rock of falling; but the house of Jacob is in a snare and in a hollow, sitting in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And if thou shalt trust in him, he shall be to thee for a sanctuary; and ye shall not come against him as against a stumbling-stone, neither as against the falling of a rock: but the houses of Jacob are in a snare, and the dwellers in Jerusalem in a pit.

fresh_translation: Because of this many among them will be weak and fall and be crushed, and they will draw near and be captured while men are in safety.
brenton_translation: Therefore many among them shall be weak, and fall, and be crushed; and they shall draw nigh, and men shall be taken securely.

fresh_translation: Then those sealing the law so as not to learn will be clear.
brenton_translation: Then shall those who seal themselves that they may not learn the law be made manifest.

fresh_translation: And he will say, I will wait for God who turned his face from the house of Jacob, and I will trust in him.
brenton_translation: And one shall say, I will wait for God, who has turned away his face from the house of Jacob, and I will trust in him.

fresh_translation: Behold, I and the children whom God gave me, and they will be for signs and wonders in the house of Israel from the Lord of hosts who dwells on Mount Zion.
brenton_translation: Behold I and the children which God has given me: and they shall be for signs and wonders in the house of Israel from the Lord of hosts, who dwells in mount Sion.

fresh_translation: And if they say to you, Seek those from the earth who call and ventriloquists who speak emptiness, who speak from the belly, does not a nation seek to its God? Why do they seek the dead ones concerning the living ones?
brenton_translation: And if they should say to you, Seek those who have in them a divining spirit, and them that speak out of the earth, them that speak vain words, who speak out of their belly: shall not a nation diligently seek to their God? why do they seek to the dead concerning the living?

fresh_translation: For he gave the law for help, so that they may say, not according to this word, concerning which there is no gift to give.
brenton_translation: For he has given the law for a help, that they should not speak according to this word, concerning which there are no gifts to give for it.

fresh_translation: And hard famine will come upon you, and it will be, whenever you hunger, you will be distressed, and you will speak evil of the ruler and ancestral things and will look upward to heaven.
brenton_translation: And famine shall come sorely upon you, and it shall come to pass, that when ye shall be hungry, ye shall be grieved, and ye shall speak ill of the prince and your fathers' ordinances: and they shall look up to heaven above,

fresh_translation: And down to the earth they will look, and look, affliction and tightness and darkness, narrow distress and darkness so as not to see.
brenton_translation: and they shall look on the earth below, and behold severe distress, and darkness, affliction, and anguish, and darkness so that one cannot see; and he that is in anguish shall not be distressed only for a time.

fresh_translation: And one being in distress will not be without escape until time. This first he does quickly: the land of Zebulun, the land of Naphtali, the way of the sea, and the rest who dwell by the coast and beyond Jordan, Galilee of nations, the regions of Judah.
brenton_translation: Drink this first. Act quickly, O land of Zabulon, land of Nephthalim, and the rest inhabiting the sea-coast, and the land beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: The people walking in darkness, see a great light; you dwelling in the land and the shadow of death, a light will shine on you.
brenton_translation: O people walking in darkness, behold a great light: ye that dwell in the region and shadow of death, a light shall shine upon you.

fresh_translation: Most of the people whom you brought down, in your gladness they will rejoice before you as those rejoicing in harvest and as those dividing spoils.
brenton_translation: The multitude of the people which thou hast brought down in thy joy, they shall even rejoice before thee as they that rejoice in harvest, and as they that divide the spoil.

fresh_translation: Because the yoke lying on them and the rod on their neck, for the rod of those exacting the Lord scattered as on the day of Midian.
brenton_translation: Because the yoke that was laid upon them has been taken away, and the rod that was on their neck: for he has broken the rod of the exactors, as in the day of Madiam.

fresh_translation: Because every garment gathered by deceit and a garment from confiscation they will repay, and they will wish it had become burned with fire.
brenton_translation: For they shall compensate for every garment that has been acquired by deceit, and all raiment with restitution; and they shall be willing, even if they were burnt with fire.

fresh_translation: Because a child was born to us, a son was given to us, whose rule became upon his shoulder, and his name is called Angel of Great Counsel, for I will bring peace upon rulers, peace and health to him.
brenton_translation: For a child is born to us, and a son is given to us, whose government is upon his shoulder: and his name is called the Messenger of great counsel: for I will bring peace upon the princes, and health to him.

fresh_translation: Great is his rule, and his peace has no boundary, upon the throne of David and his kingdom, to make it prosper and uphold it in righteousness and judgment from now and forever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will do these things.
brenton_translation: His government shall be great, and of his peace there is no end: it shall be upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to establish it, and to support it with judgment and with righteousness, from henceforth and for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts shall perform this.

fresh_translation: The Lord sent death upon Jacob, and it came upon Israel.
brenton_translation: The Lord has sent death upon Jacob, and it has come upon Israel.

fresh_translation: And all the people of Ephraim and the dwellers in Samaria will know, in insolence and a lofty heart saying,
brenton_translation: And all the people of Ephraim, and they that dwelt in Samaria shall know, who say in their pride and lofty heart,

fresh_translation: Bricks have fallen, but come, let us hew stones, and cut down sycamores and cedars, and build a tower for ourselves.
brenton_translation: The bricks are fallen down, but come, let us hew stones, and cut down sycamores and cedars, and let us build for ourselves a tower.

fresh_translation: And God will dash down those rising on Mount Zion against them, and their enemies he will scatter.
brenton_translation: And God shall dash down them that rise up against him on mount Sion, and shall scatter his enemies;

fresh_translation: Syria from the east of the sun and Greeks from the west of the sun, devouring Israel with a whole mouth. In all these his anger did not turn away, but his hand is still high.
brenton_translation: even Syria from the rising of the sun, and the Greeks from the setting of the sun, who devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but still his hand is exalted.

fresh_translation: And the people did not turn until it was struck, and the Lord they did not seek.
brenton_translation: But the people turned not until they were smitten, and they sought not the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord took away from Israel the head and tail, great and small, in one day.
brenton_translation: So the Lord took away from Israel the head and tail, great and small, in one day:

fresh_translation: An elder and those admiring faces are the head, and a prophet teaching lawless things is the tail.
brenton_translation: the old man, and them that respect persons, this is the head; and the prophet teaching unlawful things, he is the tail.

fresh_translation: And those blessing this people will mislead, and they mislead so as to swallow them.
brenton_translation: And they that pronounce this people blessed shall mislead them; and they mislead them that they may devour them.

fresh_translation: Because of this God will not rejoice over their young men, and their orphans and widows he will not pity, because all are lawless and evil, and every mouth speaks unjust things. In all these his anger did not turn away, but his hand is still high.
brenton_translation: Therefore the Lord shall not take pleasure in their young men, neither shall he have pity on their orphans or on their widows: for they are all transgressors and wicked, and every mouth speaks unjustly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is yet exalted.

fresh_translation: And lawlessness will burn as a fire, and dry grass will be eaten by fire, and it will burn in the thickets of the forest and consume everything around the hills.
brenton_translation: And iniquity shall burn as fire, and shall be devoured by fire as dry grass: and it shall burn in the thickets of the wood, and shall devour all that is round about the hills.

fresh_translation: By the wrath of the anger of the Lord the whole land has been burned together, and the people will be as ones burned by fire; a man will not pity his brother.
brenton_translation: The whole earth is set on fire because of the fierce anger of the Lord, and the people shall be as men burnt by fire: no man shall pity his brother.

fresh_translation: He will turn aside to the right because he will hunger, and he will eat from the left and certainly not be filled; each man eating the flesh of his own arm.
brenton_translation: But one shall turn aside to the right hand, for he shall be hungry; and shall eat on the left, and a man shall by no means be satisfied with eating the flesh of his own arm.

fresh_translation: For Manasseh will eat Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh, because together they will besiege Judah. In all these his anger did not turn away, but his hand is still high.
brenton_translation: For Manasses shall eat the flesh of Ephraim, and Ephraim the flesh of Manasses; for they shall besiege Juda together. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is yet exalted.

fresh_translation: Woe to those writing evil things, for writing they write evil,
brenton_translation: Woe to them that write wickedness; for when they write they do write wickedness,

fresh_translation: turning aside the judgment of the poor, stealing the right of the needy of my people, so that a widow becomes for them plunder and an orphan spoil.
brenton_translation: perverting the cause of the poor, violently wresting the judgment of the needy ones of my people, that the widow may be a prey to them, and the orphan a spoil.

fresh_translation: And what will they do in the day of visitation? For affliction will come to you from far off, and to whom will you flee to be helped, and where will you leave your glory?
brenton_translation: And what will they do in the day of visitation? for affliction shall come to you from afar: and to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory,

fresh_translation: So as not to fall into captivity? In all these his anger did not turn away, but his hand is still high.
brenton_translation: that ye may not fall into captivity?

fresh_translation: Woe to the Assyrians; the rod of my anger, and wrath is in their hands.
brenton_translation: Woe to the Assyrians; the rod of my wrath, and anger are in their hands.

fresh_translation: I will send my wrath against a lawless nation, and I will command against my people to make spoil and plunder and trample the cities and make them dust.
brenton_translation: I will send my wrath against a sinful nation, and I will charge my people to take plunder and spoil, and to trample the cities, and to make them dust.

fresh_translation: But he did not think thus, and in his soul he did not reckon thus; but his mind will cast off, to destroy nations not a few.
brenton_translation: But he meant not thus, neither did he devise thus in his soul: but his mind shall change, and that to destroy nations not a few.

fresh_translation: And if they say to him, You alone are the ruler?
brenton_translation: And if they should say to him, Thou alone art ruler;

fresh_translation: And he will say, Did I not take the region above Babylon and Calno where the tower was built, and take Arabia and Damascus and Samaria?
brenton_translation: then shall he say, Have I not taken the country above Babylon and Chalanes, where the tower was built? and have I not taken Arabia, and Damascus, and Samaria?
