fresh_translation: As I took these into my hand, so I will take all the realms. Howl, carved things in Jerusalem and in Samaria.
brenton_translation: As I have taken them, I will also take all the kingdoms: howl, ye idols in Jerusalem, and in Samaria.

fresh_translation: For as I did to Samaria and to her handmade things, so I will do to Jerusalem and her idols.
brenton_translation: For as I did to Samaria and her idols, so will I do also to Jerusalem and her idols.

fresh_translation: And it will be, when the Lord finishes doing all things on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, he will bring upon the great mind of the ruler of the Assyrians and upon the loftiness of the glory of his eyes.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord shall have finished doing all things on mount Sion and Jerusalem, that I will visit upon the proud heart, even upon the ruler of the Assyrians, and upon the boastful haughtiness of his eyes.

fresh_translation: For he said, By strength I will do it, and by the wisdom of understanding. I will remove boundaries of nations and plunder their strength, and shake inhabited cities.
brenton_translation: For he said, I will act in strength, and in the wisdom of my understanding I will remove the boundaries of nations, and will spoil their strength.

fresh_translation: And the whole world I will seize with the hand as a nest, and as eggs left behind I will take, and there is none who will escape me or speak against me.
brenton_translation: And I will shake the inhabited cities: and I will take with my hand all the world as a nest: and I will even take them as eggs that have been left; and there is none that shall escape me, or contradict me.

fresh_translation: Will an axe be glorified without the one chopping with it, or a saw be lifted up without the one pulling it? Likewise if someone lifts a rod or wood.
brenton_translation: Shall the axe glorify itself without him that hews with it? or shall the saw lift up itself without him that uses it, as if one should lift a rod or staff? but it shall not be so;

fresh_translation: And not thus, but the Lord of hosts will send dishonor into your honor, and under your glory a burning fire will be burned.
brenton_translation: but the Lord of hosts shall send dishonour upon thine honour, and burning fire shall be kindled upon thy glory.

fresh_translation: And the light of Israel will be for a fire, and it will sanctify him in a burning fire, and it will devour the forest as grass in that day.
brenton_translation: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and he shall sanctify him with burning fire, and it shall devour the wood as grass.

fresh_translation: Mountains and hills and forests will be extinguished, and it will be devoured from soul to flesh, and the fugitive will be as one fleeing from a burning flame.
brenton_translation: In that day the mountains shall be consumed, and the hills, and the forests, and fire shall devour both soul and body: and he that flees shall be as one fleeing from burning flame.

fresh_translation: And those left from them will be a number, and a child will write them.
brenton_translation: And they that are left of them shall be a small number, and a child shall write them.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day, the remnant of Israel will no longer continue, and those saved of Jacob will no longer keep trusting in those who wronged them, but they will be trusting in God, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel shall no more join themselves with, and the saved of Jacob shall no more trust in, them that injured them; but they shall trust in the Holy God of Israel, in truth.

fresh_translation: And the remnant of Jacob will be upon mighty God.
brenton_translation: And the remnant of Jacob shall trust on the mighty God.

fresh_translation: And even if the people Israel become as the sand of the sea, the remnant of them will be saved, for a word finishing and cutting short in righteousness.
brenton_translation: And though the people of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant of them shall be saved.

fresh_translation: Because God will make a cut-short word in the whole inhabited world.
brenton_translation: He will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because the Lord will make a short work in all the world.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts, Do not fear, my people dwelling in Zion, from the Assyrians, because with a rod he will strike you, for I bring a stripe upon you to see the way of Egypt.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, Be not afraid, my people who dwell in Sion, of the Assyrians, because he shall smite thee with a rod: for I am bringing a stroke upon thee, that thou mayest see the way of Egypt.

fresh_translation: For still a little, and the wrath will cease, but my anger will be upon their counsel.
brenton_translation: For yet a little while, and the indignation shall cease: but my wrath shall be against their council.

fresh_translation: And God will stir against them according to the blow of Midian in the place of affliction, and his anger in the way by sea, in the way toward Egypt.
brenton_translation: And God will stir up enemies against them, according to the stroke of Madiam in the place of affliction: and his wrath shall be by the way of the sea, even to the way that leads to Egypt.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day his fear will be removed from you and his yoke from your shoulder, and the yoke will be destroyed from your shoulders.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his yoke shall be taken away from thy shoulder, and his fear from thee, and the yoke shall be destroyed from off your shoulders.

fresh_translation: For he will come to the city Aiath and pass to Megiddo and at Michmash he will place his gear.
brenton_translation: For he shall arrive at the city of Angai, and shall pass on to Maggedo, and shall lay up his stores in Machmas.

fresh_translation: He will pass a ravine and come to Aiath; fear will seize Ramah; the city of Saul will flee.
brenton_translation: And he shall pass by the valley, and shall arrive at Angai: fear shall seize upon Rama, the city of Saul.

fresh_translation: The daughter of Gallim will hear; Laish will hear; Anathoth.
brenton_translation: The daughter of Gallim shall flee; Laisa shall hear; one shall hear in Anathoth.

fresh_translation: Madmena staggered, and the dwellers of Gebim, comfort yourselves.
brenton_translation: Madebena also is amazed, and the inhabitants of Gibbir.

fresh_translation: Today on the road to remain, with the hand he calls to the mountain, the daughter of Zion, and the hills in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Exhort ye them to-day to remain in the way: exhort ye beckoning with the hand the mountain, the daughter of Sion, even ye hills that are in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: For look, the Master, the Lord of hosts, shakes the glorious ones with might, and the lofty in insolence will be crushed, and the high ones will be humbled.
brenton_translation: Behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, will mightily confound the glorious ones; and the haughty in pride shall be crushed, and the lofty shall be brought low:

fresh_translation: And the high ones will fall by a sword, and Lebanon with the high ones will fall.
brenton_translation: and the lofty ones shall fall by the sword, and Libanus shall fall with his lofty ones.

fresh_translation: And a rod will come out from the root of Jesse, and a flower from the root will go up.
brenton_translation: And there shall come forth a rod out of the root of Jesse, and a blossom shall come up from his root:

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of God will rest upon him, a spirit of wisdom and understanding, a spirit of counsel and strength, a spirit of knowledge and piety.
brenton_translation: and the Spirit of God shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and strength, the spirit of knowledge and godliness shall fill him;

fresh_translation: The spirit of fear of God will fill him; not according to glory will he judge, nor according to speech will he reprove.
brenton_translation: the spirit of the fear of God. He shall not judge according to appearance, nor reprove according to report:

fresh_translation: But he will judge the humble in judgment and reprove the humble of the earth, and strike the earth with the word of his mouth, and by spirit through lips he will kill the ungodly.
brenton_translation: but he shall judge the cause of the lowly, and shall reprove the lowly of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the word of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he destroy the ungodly one.

fresh_translation: And righteousness will be girded about his loins and truth wrapped round his sides.
brenton_translation: And he shall have his loins girt with righteousness, and his sides clothed with truth.

fresh_translation: And a wolf will graze together with a lamb, and a leopard will rest together with a kid, and a calf and a bull and a lion together will graze, and a little child will lead them.
brenton_translation: And the wolf shall feed with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the young calf and bull and lion shall feed together; and a little child shall lead them.

fresh_translation: And an ox and a bear will graze together, and together their young will be, and a lion and an ox together will eat straw.
brenton_translation: And the ox and bear shall feed together; and their young shall be together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

fresh_translation: And an infant child will lay his hand over a hole of asps and over a bed of offspring of asps.
brenton_translation: And an infant shall put his hand on the holes of asps, and on the nest of young asps.

fresh_translation: And they will certainly not do evil nor be able to destroy anyone upon my holy mountain, because the whole world was filled to know the Lord, as much water covers the seas.
brenton_translation: And they shall not hurt, nor shall they at all be able to destroy any one on my holy mountain: for the whole world is filled with the knowledge of the Lord, as much water covers the seas.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day, the root of Jesse and the one rising to rule nations; on him nations will hope, and his rest will be honor.
brenton_translation: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall arise to rule over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust, and his rest shall be glorious.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day, the Lord will add to show his hand, to be zealous for the remnant left of his people which might be left from the Assyrians and Egypt and Babylon and Ethiopia and from the Elamites and from the east of the sun and from Arabia.
brenton_translation: And it shall be in that day, that the Lord shall again shew his hand, to be zealous for the remnant that is left of the people, which shall be left by the Assyrians, and that from Egypt, and from the country of Babylon, and from Ethiopia, and from the Elamites, and from the rising of the sun, and out of Arabia.

fresh_translation: And he will raise a sign to the nations and gather the lost of Israel, and the dispersed of Judah he will gather from the four wings of the earth.
brenton_translation: And he shall lift up a standard for the nations, and he shall gather the lost ones of Israel, and he shall gather the dispersed of Juda from the four corners of the earth.

fresh_translation: And the zeal of Ephraim will be removed and the enemies of Judah will perish; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah and Judah will not oppress Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And the envy of Ephraim shall be taken away, and the enemies of Juda shall perish: Ephraim shall not envy Juda, and Juda shall not afflict Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And they will fly in ships of foreigners; the sea together they will plunder, and the easterners and Edom, and upon Moab first they will lay hands, and the sons of Ammon will obey first.
brenton_translation: And they shall fly in the ships of the Philistines: they shall at the same time spoil the sea, and them that come from the east, and Idumea: and they shall lay their hands on Moab first; but the children of Ammon shall first obey them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will make the sea of Egypt desolate and lay his hand upon the river with a violent spirit and strike seven ravines, so as to pass through it in sandals.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall make desolate the sea of Egypt; and he shall lay his hand on the river with a strong wind, and he shall smite the seven channels, so that men shall pass through it dry-shod.

fresh_translation: And there will be a passage for my people left in Egypt, and it will be for Israel as the day when he came out from the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And there shall be a passage for my people that is left in Egypt: and it shall be to Israel as the day when he came forth out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And you will say in that day, I will bless you, Lord, because you were angry with me and turned your wrath away and pitied me.
brenton_translation: And in that day thou shalt say, I will bless thee, O Lord; for thou wast angry with me, but thou hast turned aside thy wrath, and hast pitied me.

fresh_translation: Behold, my God is my savior. I will trust in the Lord and be saved in him, and I will not fear, because the Lord is my glory and my praise, and he became salvation to me.
brenton_translation: Behold, my God is my Saviour; I will trust in him, and not be afraid: for the Lord is my glory and my praise, and is become my salvation.

fresh_translation: And you will draw water with gladness from the springs of salvation.
brenton_translation: Draw ye therefore water with joy out of the wells of salvation.

fresh_translation: And you will say in that day, sing a hymn to the Lord, cry his name, announce among the nations his glorious things, remember that his name was exalted.
brenton_translation: And in that day thou shalt say, Sing to the Lord, call aloud upon his name, proclaim his glorious deeds among the Gentiles; make mention that his name is exalted.

fresh_translation: Sing a hymn to the name of the Lord, because he did high things; announce these in all the earth.
brenton_translation: Sing praise to the name of the Lord; for he has done great things: declare this in all the earth.

fresh_translation: Exult and rejoice, the dwellers of Zion, because the Holy One of Israel was exalted in her midst.
brenton_translation: Exalt and rejoice, ye that dwell in Sion: for the Holy One of Israel is exalted in the midst of her.

fresh_translation: The vision which Isaiah son of Amoz saw against Babylon.
brenton_translation: The Vision which Esaias son of Amos saw against Babylon.

fresh_translation: Lift a signal on a plain mountain, raise the voice to them, do not fear, encourage with the hand, open, rulers.
brenton_translation: Lift up a standard on the mountain of the plain, exalt the voice to them, beckon with the hand, open the gates, ye rulers.

fresh_translation: I command, and I bring them; they are sanctified, and I bring them. Giants come to fill my wrath, rejoicing together and insulting.
brenton_translation: I give command, and I bring them: giants are coming to fulfil my wrath, rejoicing at the same time and insulting.

fresh_translation: The voice of many nations on the mountains, like many nations; the voice of kings and nations gathered together. The Lord of hosts has commanded a warlike nation
brenton_translation: A voice of many nations on the mountains, even like to that of many nations; a voice of kings and nations gathered together: the Lord of hosts has given command to a war-like nation,

fresh_translation: to come from a far land, from the edge of the foundation of heaven, the Lord and his warriors, to destroy the whole inhabited world.
brenton_translation: to come from a land afar off, from the utmost foundation of heaven; the Lord and his warriors are coming to destroy all the world.

fresh_translation: Howl, for the day of the Lord is near, and crushing from God will come.
brenton_translation: Howl ye, for the day of the Lord is near, and destruction from God shall arrive.

fresh_translation: Because of this every hand will grow weak and every soul of man will lose courage.
brenton_translation: Therefore every hand shall become powerless, and every soul of man shall be dismayed.

fresh_translation: And envoys will be troubled, and pains will seize them as a woman giving birth, and they will be confounded one at another, and will be amazed, and their faces will change as a flame.
brenton_translation: The elders shall be troubled, and pangs shall seize them, as of a woman in travail: and they shall mourn one to another, and shall be amazed, and shall change their countenance as a flame.

fresh_translation: For look, the day of the Lord comes, incurable, of fury and anger, to make the whole inhabited world desolate and destroy the sinners out of it.
brenton_translation: For behold! the day of the Lord is coming which cannot be escaped, a day of wrath and anger, to make the world desolate, and to destroy sinners out of it.

fresh_translation: For the stars of heaven and Orion and all the ornament of heaven will not give the light, and the sun rising will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light.
brenton_translation: For the stars of heaven, and Orion, and all the host of heaven, shall not give their light; and it shall be dark at sunrise, and the moon shall not give her light.

fresh_translation: And I will command evils upon the whole inhabited world and their sins upon the ungodly, and I will destroy the insolence of the lawless and humble the insolence of the proud.
brenton_translation: And I will command evils for the whole world, and will visit their sins on the ungodly: and I will destroy the pride of transgressors, and will bring low the pride of the haughty.

fresh_translation: And those left behind will be more precious than untried gold, and a man will be more precious than a stone from Ophir.
brenton_translation: And they that are left shall be more precious than gold tried in the fire; and a man shall be more precious than the stone that is in Suphir.

fresh_translation: For the heaven will be enraged, and the earth will be shaken from its foundations, because of the wrath of the anger of the Lord of hosts on the day when his anger comes.
brenton_translation: For the heaven shall be enraged, and the earth shall be shaken from her foundation, because of the fierce anger of the Lord of hosts, in the day in which his wrath shall come on.

fresh_translation: And those left will be as a fleeing gazelle and as a wandering sheep, and there will be no one gathering, so that a man turns back to his people and a man pursues to his land.
brenton_translation: And they that are left shall be as a fleeing fawn, and as a stray sheep, and there shall be none to gather them: so that a man shall turn back to his people, and a man shall flee to his own land.

fresh_translation: For whoever is caught will be defeated, and those gathered together will fall by a sword.
brenton_translation: For whosoever shall be taken shall be overcome; and they that are gathered together shall fall by the sword.

fresh_translation: And their children before them they will dash down, and their houses they will plunder, and their women they will have.
brenton_translation: And they shall dash their children before their eyes; and they shall spoil their houses, and shall take their wives.

fresh_translation: Look, I stir up the Medes against you, who do not value silver nor have need of gold.
brenton_translation: Behold, I will stir up against you the Medes, who do not regard silver, neither have they need of gold.

fresh_translation: Their bows will crush the young men, and your children they will certainly not pity, nor will their eyes spare the children.
brenton_translation: They shall break the bows of the young men; and they shall have no mercy on your children; nor shall their eyes spare thy children.

fresh_translation: And Babylon, called glorious by the king of Chaldeans, will be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
brenton_translation: And Babylon, which is called glorious by the king of the Chaldeans, shall be as when God overthrew Sodoma and Gomorrha.

fresh_translation: It will not be inhabited forever, nor shall they enter into it for many generations, nor shall the Arabs pass through it, nor the shepherds rest in it.
brenton_translation: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall any enter into it for many generations: neither shall the Arabians pass through it; nor shall shepherds at all rest in it.

fresh_translation: And the beasts will rest there, and the houses will be filled with sound, and the sirens will rest there and demons will dance there.
brenton_translation: But wild beasts shall rest there; and the houses shall be filled with howling; and monsters shall rest there, and devils shall dance there,

fresh_translation: And donkey-centaurs will dwell there, and hedgehogs will make nests in their houses. Quickly it comes and will not delay.
brenton_translation: and satyrs shall dwell there; and hedgehogs shall make their nests in their houses. It will come soon, and will not tarry.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will have mercy on Jacob and will still choose Israel, and they will rest upon their land, and a resident alien will be added to them and added to the house of Jacob.
brenton_translation: And the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and they shall rest on their land: and the stranger shall be added to them, yea, shall be added to the house of Jacob.

fresh_translation: And nations will take them and bring them into their place, and they will inherit and multiply on the land of God as male slaves and female slaves, and they will capture those who captured them and rule those who ruled them.
brenton_translation: And the Gentiles shall take them, and bring them into their place: and they shall inherit them, and they shall be multiplied upon the land for servants and handmaidens: and they that took them captives shall become captives to them; and they that had lordship over them shall be under their rule.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day God will give you rest from your pain and your anger and your hard service with which you served them.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow and vexation, and from thy hard servitude wherein thou didst serve them.

fresh_translation: And you will take up this lament over the king of Babylon and say in that day: How the exactor has rested, and how the zealot has rested.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take up this lamentation against the king of Babylon,

fresh_translation: God shattered the yoke of sinners, the yoke of rulers,
brenton_translation: The Lord has broken the yoke of sinners, the yoke of princes.

fresh_translation: striking a nation in wrath with an incurable blow, striking a nation with a stroke of anger from which he did not spare.
brenton_translation: Having smitten a nation in wrath, with an incurable plague, smiting a nation with a wrathful plague, which spared them not, he rested in quiet.

fresh_translation: All the earth rested confidently; it cries out with gladness.
brenton_translation: All the earth cries aloud with joy:

fresh_translation: And the trees of Lebanon rejoiced over you, and the cedar of Lebanon: Since you have fallen asleep, the one cutting us down did not come up.
brenton_translation: the trees also of Libanus rejoice against thee, and the cedar of Libanus, saying, From the time that thou hast been laid low, no one has come up to cut us down.

fresh_translation: Hades below was embittered to meet you; all the giants who ruled the earth were raised up for you, who roused from their thrones all the kings of nations.
brenton_translation: Hell from beneath is provoked to meet thee: all the great ones that have ruled over the earth have risen up together against thee, they that have raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

fresh_translation: All will answer and say to you, You too were taken as we were; among us you were reckoned.
brenton_translation: All shall answer and say to thee, Thou also hast been taken, even as we; and thou art numbered amongst us.

fresh_translation: And your glory came down into Hades, your much gladness; decay they will spread under you, and a worm is your covering.
brenton_translation: Thy glory has come down to Hades, and thy great mirth: under thee they shall spread corruption, and the worm shall be thy covering.

fresh_translation: How the morning-star fell from heaven, the one rising in the morning; the one sent out toward all nations was crushed to the earth.
brenton_translation: How has Lucifer, that rose in the morning, fallen from heaven! He that sent orders to all the nations is crushed to the earth.

fresh_translation: And you said in your mind, I will go up into heaven, above the stars of heaven I will place my throne; I will sit on a high mountain, on the high mountains toward the north.
brenton_translation: But thou saidst in thine heart, I will go up to heaven, I will set my throne above the stars of heaven: I will sit on a lofty mount, on the lofty mountains toward the north:

fresh_translation: I will go up above the clouds; I will be like the Most High.
brenton_translation: I will go up above the clouds; I will be like the Most High.

fresh_translation: But now you will go down into Hades and into the foundations of the earth.
brenton_translation: But now thou shalt go down to hell, even to the foundations of the earth.

fresh_translation: Those seeing you will marvel over you and say, This man provoking the earth, shaking kings,
brenton_translation: They that see thee shall wonder at thee, and say, This is the man that troubled the earth, that made kings to shake;

fresh_translation: placing the whole inhabited world desolate and pulling down the cities, did not release those in captivity.
brenton_translation: that made the whole world desolate, and destroyed its cities; he loosed not those who were in captivity.

fresh_translation: All the kings of nations slept in honor, each man in his own house.
brenton_translation: All the kings of the nations lie in honour, every man in his house.

fresh_translation: But you will be cast on the mountains as a loathed corpse with many dead pierced by swords, going down into Hades, as a garment soaked in blood will not be clean.
brenton_translation: But thou shalt be cast forth on the mountains, as a loathed carcase, with many dead who have been pierced with swords, going down to the grave.

fresh_translation: So neither will you be clean, because you destroyed my land and killed my people; an evil seed will certainly not remain forever.
brenton_translation: As a garment defiled with blood shall not be pure, so neither shalt thou be pure; because thou hast destroyed my land, and hast slain my people: thou shalt not endure for ever,—thou an evil seed.

fresh_translation: Prepare your children to be slaughtered for the sins of your father, so that they do not rise up and inherit the land and fill the land with cities.
brenton_translation: Prepare thy children to be slain for the sins of their father; that they arise not, and inherit the earth, nor fill the earth with wars.

fresh_translation: And I will rise against them, says the Lord of hosts, and I will destroy from them their name and remnant and seed, thus says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will destroy their name, and remnant, and seed: thus saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And I will make Babylon desolate for hedgehogs to dwell and it will be for nothing, and I will make it a muddy pit for destruction.
brenton_translation: And I will make the region of Babylon desert, so that hedgehogs shall dwell there, and it shall come to nothing: and I will make it a pit of clay for destruction.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord of hosts: As I have spoken, so it will be, and as I have counseled, so it remains,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, As I have said, so it shall be: and as I have purposed, so the matter shall remain:

fresh_translation: to destroy the Assyrians from my land, and from my mountains, and they will be for trampling, and their yoke will be removed from them and their glory removed from the shoulders.
brenton_translation: even to destroy the Assyrians upon my land, and upon my mountains: and they shall be for trampling; and their yoke shall be taken away from them, and their glory shall be taken away from their shoulders.

fresh_translation: This counsel which the Lord has counseled over the whole inhabited world, and this uplifted hand over all nations of the inhabited world.
brenton_translation: This is the purpose which the Lord has purposed upon the whole earth: and this the hand that is uplifted against all the nations.

fresh_translation: For what the Holy God has counseled, who will scatter? And the uplifted hand, who will turn back?
brenton_translation: For what the Holy God has purposed, who shall frustrate? and who shall turn back his uplifted hand?

fresh_translation: In the year King Ahaz died this word came.
brenton_translation: In the year in which king Achaz died this word came.

fresh_translation: Do not rejoice, all you foreigners; for the yoke of the one striking you was broken, for from the seed of snakes offspring of asps will come out, and their offspring will come out as flying serpents.
brenton_translation: Rejoice not, all ye Philistines, because the yoke of him that smote you is broken: for out of the seed of the serpent shall come forth the young of asps, and their young shall come forth flying serpents.

fresh_translation: And the poor will be grazed through him, and poor men will rest in peace, but he will kill your seed with famine, and your remnant he will kill.
brenton_translation: And the poor shall be fed by him, and poor men shall rest in peace: but he shall destroy thy seed with hunger, and shall destroy thy remnant.

fresh_translation: Howl, the gates of cities; let the cities cry out, all foreigners disturbed, because smoke from the north comes, and there is no one to be.
brenton_translation: Howl, ye gates of cities; let the cities be troubled and cry, even all the Philistines: for smoke is coming from the north, and there is no possibility of living.

fresh_translation: And what will the kings of nations answer? That the Lord founded Zion, and through him the humble of the people will be saved.
brenton_translation: And what shall the kings of the nations answer? That the Lord has founded Sion, and by him the poor of the people shall be saved.

fresh_translation: The word against the Moabite land. By night the Moabite land is destroyed; by night the wall of the Moabite land is destroyed.
brenton_translation: The Word against the Land of Moab.

fresh_translation: Grieve over yourselves, for Dibon is destroyed, where your altar is. There you will go up to weep over Nebo of Moab. Howl; on every head is baldness, all arms are cut.
brenton_translation: Grieve for yourselves; for even Debon, where your altar is, shall be destroyed: thither shall ye go up to weep, over Nabau of the land of Moab: howl ye: baldness shall be on every head, and all arms shall be wounded.

fresh_translation: In her streets gird yourselves with sackcloths and lament on her housetops, and in her lanes all howl with weeping.
brenton_translation: Gird yourselves with sackcloth in her streets: and lament upon her roofs, and in her streets, and in her ways; howl all of you with weeping.

fresh_translation: Because Heshbon cried out and Elealeh, as far as Jahaz their voice was heard; therefore the loins of Moab cry out; her soul will know.
brenton_translation: For Esebon and Eleale have cried: their voice was heard to Jassa: therefore the loins of the region of Moab cry aloud; her soul shall know.

fresh_translation: The heart of Moab cries within her, as far as Zoar, for a heifer is three years old. Upon the ascent of Luhith they will go up to you weeping; on the way of Horonaim they cry out, destruction and earthquake.
brenton_translation: The heart of the region of Moab cries within her to Segor; for it is as a heifer of three years old: and on the ascent of Luith they shall go up to thee weeping by the way of Aroniim: she cries, Destruction, and trembling.

fresh_translation: The water of Nimrim will be desolate, and its grass will fail, for green grass will not exist.
brenton_translation: The water of Nemerim shall be desolate, and the grass thereof shall fail: for there shall be no green grass.

fresh_translation: Will it thus be saved? For I will bring upon the valley of Arabs, and they will take it.
brenton_translation: Shall Moab even thus be delivered? for I will bring the Arabians upon the valley, and they shall take it.

fresh_translation: For a cry joined the border of Moabite land, its howl as far as the well of Elim.
brenton_translation: For the cry has reached the border of the region of Moab, even of Agalim; and her howling has gone as far as the well of Ælim.

fresh_translation: The water of Rimmon will be filled with blood, for I will bring Arabs upon Rimmon, and I will take the seed of Moab and Ariel and the remnant of Admah.
brenton_translation: And the water of Dimon shall be filled with blood: for I will bring Arabians upon Dimon, and I will take away the seed of Moab, and Ariel, and the remnant of Adama.

fresh_translation: I will send as reptiles upon the land. Is not the rock a desert, the mountain of Zion?
brenton_translation: I will send as it were reptiles on the land: is not the mount of the daughter of Sion a desolate rock?

fresh_translation: For you will be as a flying bird, a chick taken away, daughters of Moab, and then lambs.
brenton_translation: For thou shalt be as a young bird taken away from a bird that has flown: even thou shalt be so, daughter of Moab: and then do thou, O Arnon,

fresh_translation: Counsel more; make a shelter of mourning for her always in noonday darkness. The fugitives are driven out; do not be taken away.
brenton_translation: take farther counsel, and continually make thou a shelter from grief: they flee in darkness at mid-day; they are amazed; be not thou led captive.

fresh_translation: The fugitives of Moab will dwell with you; they will be a shelter to you from the face of a pursuer, because your alliance was removed and the ruler perished, the one trampling on the earth.
brenton_translation: The fugitives of Moab shall sojourn with thee; they shall be to you a shelter from the face of the pursuer: for thine alliance has been taken away, and the oppressing ruler has perished from off the earth.

fresh_translation: And a throne will be set right with mercy, and one will sit upon it with truth in the tent of David, judging and seeking judgment and hastening righteousness.
brenton_translation: And a throne shall be established with mercy; and one shall sit upon it with truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and earnestly seeking judgments, and hasting righteousness.

fresh_translation: We heard the insolence of Moab, very insolent, his pride was dried up; not thus your oracle.
brenton_translation: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud. I have cut off his pride: thy prophecy shall not be thus, no not thus.

fresh_translation: Not thus will Moab howl; for in the Moabite land all will howl. For the dwellers of Deseth you will meditate, and you will not be ashamed.
brenton_translation: Moab shall howl; for all shall howl in the land of Moab: but thou shalt care for them that dwell in Seth, and thou shalt not be ashamed.

fresh_translation: The fields of Heshbon will mourn, the vine of Shebam. Swallowing the nations, you trampled its vines as far as Jaazer; do not join yourselves, wander in the wilderness. Those sent were abandoned, for they crossed the wilderness.
brenton_translation: The plains of Esebon shall mourn, the vine of Sebama: swallowing up the nations, trample ye her vines, even to Jazer: ye shall not come together; wander ye in the desert: they that were sent are deserted, for they have gone over to the sea.

fresh_translation: Because of this I will weep as the weeping of Jaazer for the vine of Shebam. Your trees Heshbon and Elealeh cast down, because over your harvest and your vintage I will trample, and all things will fall.
brenton_translation: Therefore will I weep as with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sebama; Esebon and Eleale have cast down thy trees; for I will trample on thy harvest and on thy vintages, and all thy plants shall fall.

fresh_translation: And gladness and rejoicing will be lifted from your vineyards, and in your vineyards they will certainly not rejoice, and they will certainly not tread wine into vats, for it has ceased.
brenton_translation: And gladness and rejoicing shall be taken away from the vineyards; and they shall not rejoice at all in thy vineyards; and they shall not at all tread wine into the vats; for the vintage has ceased.

fresh_translation: Because of this my inward parts for Moab will sound like a lyre, and my insides like a wall which you renewed.
brenton_translation: Therefore my belly shall sound as a harp for Moab, and thou hast repaired my inward parts as a wall.

fresh_translation: And it will be, when you are shamed, because Moab toiled upon the altars and enters into her handmade things to pray, he certainly will not be able to rescue himself.
brenton_translation: And it shall be to thy shame, (for Moab is wearied at the altars,) that he shall go in to the idols thereof to pray, but they shall not be at all able to deliver him.

fresh_translation: This word which the Lord spoke against Moab whenever he spoke.
brenton_translation: This is the word which the Lord spoke against Moab, when he spoke.

fresh_translation: And now I say: in three years, years of a hired worker, the glory of Moab will be dishonored in all the much wealth, and a remnant will be few and not honored.
brenton_translation: And now I say, In three years, of the years of an hireling, the glory of Moab shall be dishonoured with all his great wealth; and he shall be left few in number, and not honoured.

fresh_translation: The word against Damascus: Behold, Damascus will be removed from cities and will be for falling.
brenton_translation: The Word against Damascus.

fresh_translation: It is left forever as a bed of flocks and a resting place, and there will not be one pursuing.
brenton_translation: abandoned for ever, to be a fold and resting-place for flocks, and there shall be none to go after them.

fresh_translation: And there will no longer be a fortress for Ephraim to flee into, and no longer a kingdom in Damascus, and the remnant of the Syrians will perish. For you are no better than the sons of Israel and their glory, thus says the Lord of hosts.
brenton_translation: And she shall no longer be a strong place for Ephraim to flee to, and there shall no longer be a kingdom in Damascus, or a remnant of Syrians; for thou art no better than the children of Israel, even than their glory; thus saith the Lord of hosts.

fresh_translation: It will be in that day, a fading of the glory of Jacob, and the fat things of his glory will be shaken.
brenton_translation: There shall be in that day a failure of the glory of Jacob, and the riches of his glory shall be shaken.

fresh_translation: And it will be as if someone gathers a standing harvest and reaps seed of ears of grain with his arm, and it will be as if someone gathers an ear in a firm ravine.
brenton_translation: And it shall be as if one should gather standing corn, and reap the grain of the ears; and it shall be as if one should gather ears in a rich valley;

fresh_translation: And stubble will be left in it, or as berries of an olive tree, two or three on a high tip, or four or five on their branches will be left, thus says the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: and as if there should be left stubble therein, or as it were the berries of an olive tree, two or three on the topmost bough, or as if four or five should be left on their branches; thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: In that day the man will be trusting in the one who made him, and his eyes will look to the Holy One of Israel.
brenton_translation: In that day a man shall trust in him that made him, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

fresh_translation: And they certainly will not be trusting in altars, nor in the works of their hands which their fingers made, and they will not see their trees nor their abominations.
brenton_translation: And they shall not at all trust in their altars, nor in the works of their hands, which their fingers made; and they shall not look to the trees, nor to their abominations.

fresh_translation: In that day your cities will be abandoned as the Amorites and the Hivites abandoned from the face of the sons of Israel, and they will be desolate.
brenton_translation: In that day thy cities shall be deserted, as the Amorites and the Evæans deserted theirs, because of the children of Israel; and they shall be desolate.

fresh_translation: Because you abandoned God your savior and did not remember the Lord your helper. Therefore you will plant a faithless planting and faithless seed.
brenton_translation: Because thou hast forsaken God thy Saviour, and hast not been mindful of the Lord thy helper; therefore shalt thou plant a false plant, and a false seed.

fresh_translation: And on the day when you plant, you will go astray, and in the morning if you sow, it will blossom for a harvest; on the day he gives lot, and as a father of man gives lot to your sons.
brenton_translation: In the day wherein thou shalt plant thou shalt be deceived; but if thou sow in the morning, the seed shall spring up for a crop in the day wherein thou shalt obtain an inheritance, and as a man's father, thou shalt obtain an inheritance for thy sons.

fresh_translation: Woe, a multitude of many nations; as the sea surges, so you will be troubled, and a rush of many nations will sound as water.
brenton_translation: Woe to the multitude of many nations, as the swelling sea, so shall ye be confounded; and the force of many nations shall sound like water;

fresh_translation: As much water, so are many nations; as the force of much water rushing down, he will scare him away and chase him far, as dust of chaff of threshers before wind and as wheel-dust carried by a storm.
brenton_translation: many nations like much water, as when much water rushes violently: and they shall drive him away, and pursue him afar, as the dust of chaff when men winnow before the wind, and as a storm whirling the dust of the wheel.

fresh_translation: Toward evening there will be grief; before morning and it will not be. This is the portion of those plundering you and the inheritance of those inheriting you.
brenton_translation: Toward evening, and there shall be grief; before the morning, and he shall not be. This is the portion of them that spoiled you, and the inheritance to them that robbed you of your inheritance.

fresh_translation: Woe, land of winged ships beyond the rivers of Ethiopia,
brenton_translation: Woe to you, ye wings of the land of ships, beyond the rivers of Ethiopia.

fresh_translation: sending hostages by sea and papyrus letters on the water. For light messengers will go to a lofty and strange nation, a difficult people. What is theirs beyond? A nation without hope and trampled, whose land the rivers now divide.
brenton_translation: He sends messengers by the sea, and paper letters on the water: for swift messengers shall go to a lofty nation, and to a strange and harsh people. Who is beyond it? a nation not looked for, and trodden down.

fresh_translation: All as an inhabited land will inhabit; their land will be inhabited as a signal lifted from a mountain, and as a trumpet's voice it will be heard.
brenton_translation: Now all the rivers of the land shall be inhabited as an inhabited country; their land shall be as when a signal is raised from a mountain; it shall be audible as the sound of a trumpet.

fresh_translation: Because thus the Lord said to me: Safety will be in my city as the light of noonday heat and as a cloud of dew in the day of harvest.
brenton_translation: For thus said the Lord to me, There shall be security in my city, as the light of noonday heat, and it shall be as a cloud of dew in the day of harvest.

fresh_translation: Before the harvest, when a blossom is finished and a sour grape blossoms into a budding flower, he will remove the little clusters with sickles, and he will remove and cut down the branches.
brenton_translation: Before the reaping time, when the flower has been completely formed, and the unripe grape has put forth its flower and blossomed, then shall he take away the little clusters with pruning-hooks, and shall take away the small branches, and cut them off;

fresh_translation: And he will leave them together to the birds of heaven and the beasts of the earth, and the birds of heaven will gather on them and all the beasts of the earth will come upon him.
brenton_translation: and he shall leave them together to the birds of the sky, and to the wild beasts of the earth: and the fowls of the sky shall be gathered upon them, and all the beasts of the land shall come upon him.

fresh_translation: At that time gifts will be brought to the Lord of hosts from a people afflicted and plucked, and from a great people from now and forever, a nation hoping and trampled, which is in the region of the river of its land, to the place where the name of the Lord of hosts was invoked, Mount Zion.
brenton_translation: In that time shall presents be brought to the Lord of hosts from a people afflicted and peeled, and from a people great from henceforth and for ever; a nation hoping and yet trodden down, which is in a part of a river of his land, to the place where is the name of the Lord of hosts, the mount Sion.

fresh_translation: A vision of Egypt: Behold, the Lord sits on a swift cloud and will come into Egypt, and the handmade things of Egypt will be shaken from before him and their heart will be defeated within them.
brenton_translation: The Vision of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And the Egyptians will rise against Egyptians, and a man will war with his brother and a man with his neighbor, city against city and law against law.
brenton_translation: And the Egyptians shall be stirred up against the Egyptians: and a man shall fight against his brother, and a man against his neighbour, city against city, and law against law.

fresh_translation: And the spirit of the Egyptians will be troubled within them, and I will scatter their counsel, and they will ask their gods and their carved images and those speaking from the earth and the ventriloquists.
brenton_translation: And the spirit of the Egyptians shall be troubled within them; and I will frustrate their counsel: and they shall enquire of their gods and their images, and them that speak out of the earth, and them that have in them a divining spirit.

fresh_translation: And I will hand over Egypt into the hands of harsh lords, and harsh kings will rule them, thus says the Lord of hosts.
brenton_translation: And I will deliver Egypt into the hands of men, of cruel lords; and cruel kings shall rule over them: thus saith the Lord of hosts.

fresh_translation: And the Egyptians will drink water from the sea, and the river will fail and dry up.
brenton_translation: And the Egyptians shall drink the water that is by the sea, but the river shall fail, and be dried up.

fresh_translation: And the rivers will fail, and the channels of the river, and every collection of water will dry up, and every marsh of reed and papyrus.
brenton_translation: And the streams shall fail, and the canals of the river; and every reservoir of water shall be dried up, in every marsh also of reed and papyrus.

fresh_translation: And the green rush, all around the river, and everything sown by the river will dry up, wind-blasted.
brenton_translation: And all the green herbage round about the river, and everything sown by the side of the river, shall be blasted with the wind and dried up.

fresh_translation: And the fishermen will groan, and all casting a hook into the river will groan, and those throwing drag-nets and casting nets will mourn.
brenton_translation: And the fishermen shall groan, and all that cast a hook into the river shall groan; they also that cast nets, and the anglers shall mourn.

fresh_translation: And shame will seize those working the split flax and those working the fine linen.
brenton_translation: And shame shall come upon them that work fine flax, and them that make fine linen.

fresh_translation: And those weaving them will be in pain, and all making beer will grieve and pain their souls.
brenton_translation: And they that work at them shall be in pain, and all that make beer shall be grieved, and be pained in their souls.

fresh_translation: And the princes of Zoan will be fools, the wise counselors of the king; their counsel will be made foolish. How will you say to the king, We are sons of wise men, sons of ancient kings?
brenton_translation: And the princes of Tanis shall be fools: as for the king's wise counsellors, their counsel shall be turned into folly: how will ye say to the king, We are sons of wise men, sons of ancient kings?

fresh_translation: Where now are your wise men? Let them announce to you and tell what the Lord of hosts has counseled against Egypt.
brenton_translation: Where are now thy wise men? and let them declare to thee, and say, What has the Lord of hosts purposed upon Egypt?

fresh_translation: The princes of Zoan failed, and the princes of Memphis were exalted, and they will lead Egypt astray by tribes.
brenton_translation: The princes of Tanis have failed, and the princes of Memphis are lifted up with pride, and they shall cause Egypt to wander by tribes.

fresh_translation: For the Lord mixed in them a spirit of wandering, and they led Egypt astray in all their works, as a drunk man and a vomiting man wander together.
brenton_translation: For the Lord has prepared for them a spirit of error, and they have caused Egypt to err in all their works, as one staggers who is drunken and vomits also.

fresh_translation: And there will not be for the Egyptians a work which head and tail, beginning and end, will do.
brenton_translation: And there shall be no work to the Egyptians, which shall make head or tail, or beginning or end.

fresh_translation: In that day the Egyptians will be as women, in fear and trembling from the face of the hand of the Lord of hosts which he himself lays upon them.
brenton_translation: But in that day the Egyptians shall be as women, in fear and in trembling because of the hand of the Lord of hosts, which he shall bring upon them.

fresh_translation: And the land of the Jews will be a terror to the Egyptians; whoever names it to them, they will fear because of the counsel which the Lord has counseled against it.
brenton_translation: And the land of the Jews shall be for a terror to the Egyptians: whosoever shall name it to them, they shall fear, because of the counsel which the Lord of hosts has purposed concerning it.

fresh_translation: In that day there will be five cities in Egypt speaking the language of Canaan and swearing by the name of the Lord; one city will be called the City of Righteousness.
brenton_translation: In that day there shall be five cities in Egypt speaking the language of Chanaan, and swearing by the name of the Lord of hosts; one city shall be called the city of Asedec.

fresh_translation: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the land of the Egyptians and a pillar to the Lord by its border.
brenton_translation: In that day there shall be an altar to the Lord in the land of the Egyptians, and a pillar to the Lord by its border.

fresh_translation: And it will be for a sign forever to the Lord in the land of Egypt, because they will cry to the Lord because of those afflicting them, and the Lord will send them a man who will save them; by judging he will save them.
brenton_translation: And it shall be for a sign to the Lord for ever in the land of Egypt: for they shall presently cry to the Lord by reason of them that afflict them, and he shall send them a man who shall save them; he shall judge and save them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will be known to the Egyptians, and the Egyptians will know the Lord in that day, and they will make sacrifices and vow vows to the Lord and pay them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall be known to the Egyptians, and the Egyptians shall know the Lord in that day; and they shall offer sacrifices, and shall vow vows to the Lord, and pay them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord will strike the Egyptians with a great blow and heal them; he will heal, and they will turn to the Lord, and he will hear them and heal them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall smite the Egyptians with a stroke, and shall completely heal them: and they shall return to the Lord, and he shall hear them, and thoroughly heal them.

fresh_translation: In that day there will be a way from Egypt to the Assyrians, and the Assyrians will enter Egypt and the Egyptians will go to the Assyrians, and the Egyptians will serve the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: In that day there shall be a way from Egypt to the Assyrians, and the Assyrians shall enter into Egypt, and the Egyptians shall go to the Assyrians, and the Egyptians shall serve the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: In that day Israel will be third among the Assyrians and the Egyptians, blessed in the land
brenton_translation: In that day shall Israel be third with the Egyptians and the Assyrians, blessed in the land which the Lord of hosts has blessed,

fresh_translation: which the Lord of hosts blessed, saying, Blessed is my people in Egypt, and among the Assyrians, and my inheritance, Israel.
brenton_translation: saying, Blessed be my people that is in Egypt, and that is among the Assyrians, and Israel mine inheritance.

fresh_translation: In the year Tartan entered into Ashdod, when he was sent by Sargon king of the Assyrians, and he warred against Ashdod and captured it,
brenton_translation: In the year when Tanathan came to Azotus, when he was sent by Arna king of the Assyrians, and warred against Azotus, and took it;

fresh_translation: then the Lord spoke to Isaiah, saying, Go and take the sackcloth off your waist and loosen the sandals from your feet. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
brenton_translation: then the Lord spoke to Esaias the son of Amos, saying, Go and take the sackcloth off thy loins, and loose thy sandals from off thy feet, and do thus, going naked and barefoot.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said, As Isaiah my servant has walked naked and barefoot for three years, so signs and wonders will be to the Egyptians and Ethiopians.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said, As my servant Esaias has walked naked and barefoot three years, there shall be three years for signs and wonders to the Egyptians and Ethiopians;

fresh_translation: Because thus the king of the Assyrians will lead the captivity of Egypt and Ethiopians, young men and elders, naked and barefoot, with the shame of Egypt uncovered.
brenton_translation: for thus shall the king of the Assyrians lead the captivity of Egypt and the Ethiopians, young men and old, naked and barefoot, having the shame of Egypt exposed.

fresh_translation: And the Egyptians will be ashamed, defeated because of the Ethiopians on whom they were trusting; for the Egyptians were their glory.
brenton_translation: And the Egyptians being defeated shall be ashamed of the Ethiopians, in whom they had trusted; for they were their glory.

fresh_translation: And the dwellers in this island will say, Look, we were trusting to flee to them for help, who were not able to be saved from the king of the Assyrians; and how shall we be saved?
brenton_translation: And they that dwell in this island shall say in that day, Behold, we trusted to flee to them for help, who could not save themselves from the king of the Assyrians: and how shall we be saved?

fresh_translation: The vision of the wilderness: as a storm through a wilderness would pass through, coming from a fearful land.
brenton_translation: The Vision of the Desert.

fresh_translation: A hard vision was reported to me: a lawless one acts lawlessly, and an outlaw acts as an outlaw. Against me the Elamites and the envoys of the Persians come upon me. Now I will groan and comfort myself.
brenton_translation: so a fearful and a grievous vision was declared to me: he that is treacherous deals treacherously, the transgressor transgresses. The Elamites are upon me, and the ambassadors of the Persians come against me: now will I groan and comfort myself.

fresh_translation: Because of this my loins were filled with weakness, and pains seized me as one giving birth. I did wrong not to hear; I hurried not to see.
brenton_translation: Therefore are my loins filled with feebleness, and pangs have seized me as a travailing woman: I dealt wrongfully that I might not hear; I hasted that I might not see.

fresh_translation: My heart wanders and lawlessness baptizes me; my soul has stood into fear.
brenton_translation: My heart wanders, and transgression overwhelms me; my soul is occupied with fear.

fresh_translation: Prepare the table; drink, eat. Rise up, rulers; prepare the shields.
brenton_translation: Prepare the table, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and prepare your shields.

fresh_translation: Because thus the Lord said to me: Having gone, set a watchman for yourself, and what you see, report.
brenton_translation: For thus said the Lord to me, Go and station a watchman for thyself, and declare whatever thou shalt see.

fresh_translation: And I saw riders, two horsemen, a rider of a donkey and a rider of a camel. Listen with great listening.
brenton_translation: And I saw two mounted horsemen, and a rider on an ass, and a rider on a camel.

fresh_translation: And call Uriah to the lookout of the Lord. And he said, I stood continually by day, and on the camp I stood the whole night.
brenton_translation: Hearken with great attention, and call thou Urias to the watch-tower: the Lord has spoken. I stood continually during the day, and I stood in the camp all the night:

fresh_translation: And look, he comes, a rider of a pair. And answering he said, Babylon has fallen, and all her carved images and handmade things have been shattered to the ground.
brenton_translation: and, behold, he comes riding in a chariot and pair: and he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all her images and her idols have been crushed to the ground.

fresh_translation: Hear, you left behind and you being pained; hear what the Lord of hosts, God of Israel, announced to us.
brenton_translation: Hear, ye that are left, and ye that are in pain, hear what things I have heard of the Lord of hosts which the God of Israel has declared to us.

fresh_translation: The vision of Edom: To me one calls from Seir, Guard the ramparts.
brenton_translation: The Vision of Idumea.

fresh_translation: I guard the morning and the night. If you seek, seek, and dwell with me.
brenton_translation: I watch in the morning and the night: if thou wouldest enquire, enquire, and dwell by me.

fresh_translation: In the forest at evening you will sleep, on the road, Dedan.
brenton_translation: Thou mayest lodge in the forest in the evening, or in the way of Dædan.

fresh_translation: Bring water to the thirsty one; you dwelling in the land of Tema, meet the fugitives with bread,
brenton_translation: Ye that dwell in the country of Thæman, bring water to meet him that is thirsty;

fresh_translation: because of the multitude of fugitives and the multitude of wanderers and the multitude of sword and the multitude of stretched bows and the multitude of fallen in the war.
brenton_translation: meet the fugitives with bread, because of the multitude of the slain, and because of the multitude of them that lose their way, and because of the multitude of swords, and because of the multitude of bent bows, and because of the multitude of them that have fallen in war.

fresh_translation: Because thus the Lord said to me: Yet one year, as a year of a hired worker, the glory of the sons of Kedar will fail.
brenton_translation: For thus said the Lord to me, Yet a year, as the year of an hireling, and the glory of the sons of Kedar shall fail:

fresh_translation: And the remnant of arrows of the mighty sons of Kedar will be few, because the Lord God of Israel spoke.
brenton_translation: and the remnant of the strong bows of the sons of Kedar shall be small: for the Lord God of Israel has spoken it.

fresh_translation: The word of the valley of Zion: What happened to you now that all of you went up to the housetops?
brenton_translation: The Word of the Valley of Sion.

fresh_translation: The city is full of shouting, vanity; your wounded are not wounded by sword, nor are your dead from war.
brenton_translation: The city is filled with shouting men: thy slain are not slain with swords, nor are thy dead those who have died in battle.

fresh_translation: All your rulers have fled, and those captured are harshly bound, and mighty ones among you have fled far off.
brenton_translation: All thy princes have fled, and thy captives are tightly bound, and the mighty men in thee have fled far away.

fresh_translation: Because of this I said, Leave me; I will weep bitterly. Do not insist to comfort me over the crushing of the daughter of my kin.
brenton_translation: Therefore I said, Let me alone, I will weep bitterly; labour not to comfort me for the breach of the daughter of my people.

fresh_translation: Because there is a day of trouble and destruction and trampling and wandering from the Lord of hosts in the valley of Zion; they wander from small to great, they wander on the mountains.
brenton_translation: For it is a day of trouble, and of destruction, and of treading down, and there is perplexity sent from the Lord of hosts: they wander in the valley of Sion; they wander from the least to the greatest on the mountains.

fresh_translation: And the Elamites took quivers, riders, men on horses, and a gathering of battle-line.
brenton_translation: And the Elamites took their quivers, and there were men mounted on horses, and there was a gathering for battle.

fresh_translation: And your choice valleys will be filled with chariots, and the horsemen will shut your gates.
brenton_translation: And it shall be that thy choice valleys shall be filled with chariots, and horsemen shall block up thy gates.

fresh_translation: And they will uncover the gates of Judah, and in that day they will look to the choice houses of the city.
brenton_translation: And they shall uncover the gates of Juda, and they shall look in that day on the choice houses of the city.

fresh_translation: And they will uncover the hidden things of the houses of the citadel of David, and saw that they are many, and that they turned the water of the old pool into the city.
brenton_translation: And they shall uncover the secret places of the houses of the citadel of David: and they saw that they were many, and that one had turned the water of the old pool into the city;

fresh_translation: And that they pulled down the houses of Jerusalem into a fortification for the wall of the city.
brenton_translation: and that they had pulled down the houses of Jerusalem, to fortify the wall of the city.

fresh_translation: And you made water for yourselves between the two walls inside the old pool, and you did not look to the one who made it from the beginning, and the one who built it you did not see.
brenton_translation: And ye procured to yourselves water between the two walls within the ancient pool: but ye looked not to him that made it from the beginning, and regarded not him that created it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord of hosts called in that day for weeping and mourning and shaving and girding of sackcloth.
brenton_translation: And the Lord, the Lord of hosts, called in that day for weeping, and lamentation, and baldness, and for girding with sackcloth:

fresh_translation: But they made gladness and rejoicing, slaughtering calves and sacrificing sheep, so as to eat meat and drink wine, saying, Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.
brenton_translation: but they engaged in joy and gladness, slaying calves, and killing sheep, so as to eat flesh, and drink wine; saying, Let us eat and drink; for to-morrow we die.

fresh_translation: And these things are uncovered in the ears of the Lord of hosts: this sin will certainly not be forgiven you until you die.
brenton_translation: And these things are revealed in the ears of the Lord of hosts: for this sin shall not be forgiven you, until ye die.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Go into the chamber to Shebna the steward and say to him,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Go into the chamber, to Somnas the treasurer, and say to him, Why art thou here?

fresh_translation: What do you have here, and what is here to you, that you cut out for yourself here a tomb and made for yourself a memorial in a high place and carved for yourself a dwelling in a rock?
brenton_translation: and what hast thou to do here, that thou hast here hewn thyself a sepulchre, and madest thyself a sepulchre on high, and hast graven for thyself a dwelling in the rock?

fresh_translation: Look now, the Lord of hosts will throw out and pulverize a man and remove your robe.
brenton_translation: Behold now, the Lord of hosts casts forth and will utterly destroy such a man, and will take away thy robe and thy glorious crown,

fresh_translation: And your glorious crown, and he will throw you into a great and immeasurable land, and there you will die, and he will make your beautiful chariot into dishonor and your ruler's house into trampling.
brenton_translation: and will cast thee into a great and unmeasured land, and there thou shalt die: and he will bring thy fair chariot to shame, and the house of thy prince to be trodden down.

fresh_translation: And you will be removed from your stewardship and from your station.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt be removed from thy stewardship, and from thy place.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day, I will call my servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Chelcias:

fresh_translation: And I will clothe him with your robe and give your crown to him, and your authority and your stewardship I will give into his hands, and he will be as a father to the dwellers in Jerusalem and the dwellers in Judah.
brenton_translation: and I will put on him thy robe, and I will grant him thy crown with power, and I will give thy stewardship into his hands: and he shall be as a father to them that dwell in Jerusalem, and to them that dwell in Juda.

fresh_translation: And I will give the glory of David to him, and he will rule, and there will not be one contradicting.
brenton_translation: And I will give him the glory of David; and he shall rule, and there shall be none to speak against him: and I will give him the key of the house of David upon his shoulder; and he shall open, and there shall be none to shut; and he shall shut, and there shall be none to open.

fresh_translation: And I will set him as a ruler in a trustworthy place, and he will be for a throne of glory of the house of his father.
brenton_translation: And I will make him a ruler in a sure place, and he shall be for a glorious throne of his father's house.

fresh_translation: And every glorious one in the house of his father will be trusting on him, from small to great, and they will be hanging from him.
brenton_translation: And every one that is glorious in the house of his father shall trust in him, from the least to the greatest; and they shall depend upon him in that day.

fresh_translation: In that day, thus says the Lord of hosts, the man supported in a trustworthy place will be shaken, and he will fall, and the glory upon him will be removed, because the Lord spoke.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, The man that is fastened in the sure place shall be removed and be taken away, and shall fall; and the glory that is upon him shall be utterly destroyed: for the Lord has spoken it.

fresh_translation: The vision of Tyre: Howl, ships of Carthage, because it was destroyed and they no longer come from the land of Kittim; it was led captive.
brenton_translation: The Word concerning Tyre.

fresh_translation: To what have the dwellers on the island become like, traders of Phoenicia crossing the sea?
brenton_translation: To whom are the dwellers in the island become like, the merchants of Phœnice, passing over the sea

fresh_translation: In much water, the seed of traders as a harvest brought in, the traders of nations.
brenton_translation: in great waters, a generation of merchants? as when the harvest is gathered in, so are these traders with the nations.

fresh_translation: Be ashamed, Sidon, said the sea. And the strength of the sea said, I did not travail nor bear, nor nourish young men, nor raise virgins.
brenton_translation: Be ashamed, O Sidon: the sea has said, yea, the strength of the sea has said, I have not travailed, nor brought forth, nor have I brought up young men, nor reared virgins.

fresh_translation: And whenever it becomes heard in Egypt, a pain will seize them concerning Tyre.
brenton_translation: Moreover when it shall be heard in Egypt, sorrow shall seize them for Tyre.

fresh_translation: Go away to Carthage; howl, you dwellers on this island.
brenton_translation: Depart ye to Carthage; howl, ye that dwell in this island.

fresh_translation: Was this your insolence from the beginning before it was handed over?
brenton_translation: Was not this your pride from the beginning, before she was given up?

fresh_translation: Who planned these things against Tyre? Is she not lesser, or does she not prevail? Her merchants are glorious, rulers of the earth.
brenton_translation: Who has devised this counsel against Tyre? Is she inferior? or has she no strength? her merchants were the glorious princes of the earth.

fresh_translation: The Lord of hosts counseled to paralyze all the insolence of glorious ones and dishonor every glorious thing on the earth.
brenton_translation: The Lord of hosts has purposed to bring down all the pride of the glorious ones, and to disgrace every glorious thing on the earth.

fresh_translation: Work your land, for a ship no longer comes from Carthage.
brenton_translation: Till thy land; for ships no more come out of Carthage.

fresh_translation: And your hand, the one provoking kings, no longer has strength over the sea. The Lord of hosts commanded concerning Canaan to destroy her strength.
brenton_translation: And thy hand prevails no more by sea, which troubled kings: the Lord of hosts has given a command concerning Chanaan, to destroy the strength thereof.

fresh_translation: And they will say, You will no longer continue to act insolently and do wrong, daughter of Sidon; and if you go to Kittim, even there a rest will not be to you.
brenton_translation: And men shall say, Ye shall no longer at all continue to insult and injure the daughter of Sidon: and if thou depart to the Citians, neither there shalt thou have rest.

fresh_translation: And into the land of the Chaldeans, and this has been desolated by the Assyrians; even there a rest will not be to you, because its wall has fallen.
brenton_translation: And if thou depart to the land of the Chaldeans, this also is laid waste by the Assyrians, for her wall is fallen.

fresh_translation: Howl, ships of Carthage, because your stronghold was destroyed.
brenton_translation: Howl, ye ships of Carthage: for your strong hold is destroyed.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day, Tyre will be left seventy years, as the time of the king, as the time of a man. And after seventy years Tyre will be as the song of a prostitute.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be left seventy years, as the time of a king, as the time of a man: and it shall come to pass after seventy years, that Tyre shall be as the song of a harlot.

fresh_translation: Take a lyre, wander the cities, forgotten prostitute; play the lyre well, sing much, so that the memory of you may happen.
brenton_translation: Take a harp, go about, O city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; play well on the harp, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

fresh_translation: And it will be after seventy years, God will make a visitation on Tyre, and again she will be restored to the ancient state and will be a marketplace for all the kingdoms of the inhabited world.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass after the seventy years, that God will visit Tyre, and she shall be again restored to her primitive state, and she shall be a mart for all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: And her trade and wage will be holy to the Lord; it will not be gathered for them, but all her trade for those dwelling before the Lord, to eat and drink and be filled, into a token, a memorial before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And her trade and her gain shall be holiness to the Lord: it shall not be gathered for them, but for those that dwell before the Lord, even all her trade, to eat and drink and be filled, and for a covenant and a memorial before the Lord.

fresh_translation: Behold, the Lord destroys the inhabited world and will make it desolate and uncover its face and scatter those dwelling in it.
brenton_translation: Behold, the Lord is about to lay waste the world, and will make it desolate, and will lay bare the surface of it, and scatter them that dwell therein.

fresh_translation: And the people will be as the priest, and the servant as the master, and the maid as the mistress; the buyer will be as the seller, the lender as the borrower, and the debtor as the one to whom debt is owed.
brenton_translation: And the people shall be as the priest, and the servant as the lord, and the maid as the mistress; the buyer shall be as the seller, the lender as the borrower, and the debtor as his creditor.

fresh_translation: The land will be ruined with ruin and plundered with plunder, for the mouth of the Lord spoke these things.
brenton_translation: The earth shall be completely laid waste, and the earth shall be utterly spoiled: for the mouth of the Lord has spoken these things.

fresh_translation: The land mourned and the inhabited world was destroyed; the high ones of the earth mourned.
brenton_translation: The earth mourns, and the world is ruined, the lofty ones of the earth are mourning.

fresh_translation: And the land acted lawlessly because of those dwelling in it, because they transgressed the law and changed the ordinances, the everlasting covenant.
brenton_translation: And she has sinned by reason of her inhabitants; because they have transgressed the law, and changed the ordinances, even the everlasting covenant.

fresh_translation: Because of this a curse will eat the land, because those dwelling in it sinned; because of this the dwellers in the land will be poor and a few men will be left.
brenton_translation: Therefore a curse shall consume the earth, because the inhabitants thereof have sinned: therefore the dwellers in the earth shall be poor, and few men shall be left.

fresh_translation: The wine will mourn, the vine will mourn, all rejoicing in soul will groan.
brenton_translation: The wine shall mourn, the vine shall mourn, all the merry-hearted shall sigh.

fresh_translation: The gladness of drums ceased, insolence and the wealth of the ungodly ceased, the voice of the lyre ceased.
brenton_translation: The mirth of timbrels has ceased, the sound of the harp has ceased.

fresh_translation: They were put to shame; they did not drink wine; strong drink became bitter to the drinkers.
brenton_translation: They are ashamed, they have not drunk wine; strong drink has become bitter to them that drink it.

fresh_translation: Every city was made desolate; they will shut a house so as not to enter.
brenton_translation: All the city has become desolate: one shall shut his house so that none shall enter.

fresh_translation: Howl concerning the wine everywhere; all gladness of the land ceased.
brenton_translation: There is a howling for the wine everywhere; all the mirth of the land has ceased, all the mirth of the land has departed.

fresh_translation: And cities will be left desolate, and abandoned houses will perish.
brenton_translation: And cities shall be left desolate, and houses being left shall fall to ruin.

fresh_translation: All these will be in the land in the midst of the nations, as whenever one gleans an olive tree, thus they will glean them, and when the vintage ceases.
brenton_translation: All this shall be in the land in the midst of the nations, as if one should strip an olive tree, so shall they strip them; but when the vintage is done,

fresh_translation: These will cry out with a voice, and those left on the land will rejoice together in the glory of the Lord; the water of the sea will be troubled.
brenton_translation: these shall cry aloud; and they that are left on the land shall rejoice together in the glory of the Lord: the water of the sea shall be troubled.

fresh_translation: Because of this the glory of the Lord will be in the islands of the sea; the name of the Lord will be glorious, O Lord, the God of Israel.
brenton_translation: Therefore shall the glory of the Lord be in the isles of the sea; the name of the Lord shall be glorious.

fresh_translation: From the wings of the earth we heard wonders, hope to the godly one. And they will say, Woe to those rejecting, those rejecting the law.
brenton_translation: O Lord God of Israel, from the ends of the earth we have heard wonderful things, and there is hope to the godly: but they shall say, Woe to the despisers, that despise the law.

fresh_translation: Fear and pit and snare are upon you, dwellers on the earth.
brenton_translation: Fear, and a pit, and a snare, are upon you that dwell on the earth.

fresh_translation: And it will be, the one fleeing the fear will fall into the pit, and the one coming up from the pit will be caught by the snare, because windows from heaven were opened and the foundations of the earth will be shaken.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, that he that flees from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that comes up out of the pit shall be caught by the snare: for windows have been opened in heaven, and the foundations of the earth shall be shaken,

fresh_translation: With turmoil the earth will be troubled and with perplexity the earth will be perplexed.
brenton_translation: the earth shall be utterly confounded, and the earth shall be completely perplexed.
