brenton_translation: So Rabsaces returned, and found the king of the Assyrians besieging Lobna: for he had heard that he had departed from Lachis.

fresh_translation: Tirhakah king of the Ethiopians went out to besiege him. And hearing, he turned back and sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
brenton_translation: And Tharaca king of the Ethiopians went forth to attack him. And when he heard it, he turned aside, and sent messengers to Ezekias, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus you will say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let your God, on whom you trust, deceive you, saying, Jerusalem certainly will not be handed into the hands of the king of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: Thus shall ye say to Ezekias king of Judea, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: Did you not hear what the kings of the Assyrians did to the whole earth, how they destroyed it?
brenton_translation: Hast thou not heard what the kings of the Assyrians have done, how they have destroyed the whole earth? and shalt thou be delivered?

fresh_translation: Did the gods of the nations rescue them, whom my fathers destroyed, Gozan and Haran and Rezeph which are in the land of Theemath?
brenton_translation: Have the gods of the nations which my fathers destroyed delivered them, both Gozan, and Charrhan, and Rapheth, which are in the land of Theemath?

fresh_translation: Where are the kings of Hamath and Arpad and the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, Ivvah?
brenton_translation: Where are the kings of Emath? and where is the king of Arphath? and where is the king of the city of Eppharuaim, and of Anagugana?

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah took the book from the messengers and opened it before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias received the letter from the messengers, and read it, and went up to the house of the Lord, and opened it before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord, saying,
brenton_translation: And Ezekias prayed to the Lord, saying,

fresh_translation: Lord of hosts, God of Israel, the one sitting upon the cherubim, you alone are God of every kingdom of the inhabited world; you made heaven and earth.
brenton_translation: O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, who sittest upon the cherubs, thou alone art the God of every kingdom of the world: thou hast made heaven and earth.

fresh_translation: Hear, Lord; look, Lord; and see the words which Sennacherib sent to reproach the living God.
brenton_translation: Incline thine ear, O Lord, hearken, O Lord; open thine eyes, O Lord, look, O Lord: and behold the words of Sennacherim, which he has sent to reproach the living God.

fresh_translation: For truly the kings of the Assyrians made the whole inhabited world and their land desolate
brenton_translation: For of a truth, Lord, the kings of the Assyrians have laid waste the whole world, and the countries thereof,

fresh_translation: and threw their idols into the fire, for they were not gods but works of the hands of men, wood and stones, and they destroyed them.
brenton_translation: and have cast their idols into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone; and they have cast them away.

fresh_translation: But you, Lord our God, save us from their hand so that every kingdom of the earth may know that you alone are God.
brenton_translation: But now, O Lord our God, deliver us from his hands, that every kingdom of the earth may know that thou art God alone.

fresh_translation: And Isaiah son of Amoz was sent to Hezekiah and said to him, Thus says the Lord God of Israel: I heard what you prayed to me concerning Sennacherib king of the Assyrians.
brenton_translation: And Esaias the son of Amos was sent to Ezekias, and said to him, Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, I have heard thy prayer to me concerning Sennacherim king of the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: This is the word which God spoke concerning him: The virgin daughter Zion despised you and mocked you; at you the daughter Jerusalem shook her head.
brenton_translation: This is the word which God has spoken concerning him; The virgin daughter of Sion has despised thee, and mocked thee; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at thee.

fresh_translation: Whom did you reproach and provoke? Against whom did you raise your voice and did not lift your eyes to height? Against the Holy One of Israel.
brenton_translation: Whom hast thou reproached and provoked? and against whom hast thou lifted up thy voice? and hast thou not lifted up thine eyes on high against the Holy One of Israel?

fresh_translation: Because through envoys you reproached the Lord. For you said, In the multitude of my chariots I went up into the height of mountains and into the far parts of Lebanon, and I cut down the height of its cedar and the beauty of cypress and entered the height of a region of the forest.
brenton_translation: For thou hast reproached the Lord by messengers; for thou hast said, With the multitude of chariots have I ascended to the height of mountains, and to the sides of Libanus; and I have cropped the height of his cedars and the beauty of his cypresses; and I entered into the height of the forest region:

fresh_translation: And I set a bridge and made the waters desolate and every gathering of waters.
brenton_translation: and I have made a bridge, and dried up the waters, and every pool of water.

fresh_translation: Did you not hear long ago what I did? From ancient days I arranged them. But now I displayed it to lay the nations waste in strongholds and the dwellers in fortified cities.
brenton_translation: Hast thou not heard of these things which I did of old? I appointed them from ancient times; but now have I manifested my purpose of desolating nations in their strong holds, and them that dwell in strong cities.

fresh_translation: I let go the hands and they dried up and became as dry grass upon housetops and as field-grass.
brenton_translation: I weakened their hands, and they withered; and they became as dry grass on the house-tops, and as grass.

fresh_translation: And now your resting and your going out and your coming in I know.
brenton_translation: But now I know thy rest, and thy going out, and thy coming in.

fresh_translation: And your anger, with which you raged, and your bitterness came up to me, and I will put a hook into your nose and a bridle on your lips and turn you back by the way in which you came.
brenton_translation: And thy wrath wherewith thou hast been enraged, and thy rancour has come up to me; therefore I will put a hook in thy nose, and a bit in thy lips, and will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

fresh_translation: And this is the sign to you: Eat this year what you sowed, and in the second year the remnant, and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
brenton_translation: And this shall be a sign to thee, Eat this year what thou hast sown; and the second year that which is left: and the third year sow, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

fresh_translation: And those left in Judah will put forth a root down and make seed upward.
brenton_translation: And they that are left in Judea shall take root downward, and bear fruit upward:

fresh_translation: Because from Jerusalem the ones left will go out and the ones being saved from Mount Zion. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will do these things.
brenton_translation: for out of Jerusalem there shall be a remnant, and the saved ones out of mount Sion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall perform this.

fresh_translation: Because of this thus says the Lord concerning the king of the Assyrians: He certainly will not enter this city, nor certainly cast an arrow on it, nor certainly bring a shield against it, nor certainly circle a palisade around it.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of the Assyrians, He shall not enter into this city, nor cast a weapon against it, nor bring a shield against it, nor make a rampart round it.

fresh_translation: But by the way he came, by it he will turn back, thus says the Lord.
brenton_translation: But by the way by which he came, by it shall he return, and shall not enter into this city: thus saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: I will shield over this city to save it for my sake and for David my servant.
brenton_translation: I will protect this city to save it for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

fresh_translation: And the angel of the Lord went out and killed from the camp of the Assyrians one hundred eighty-five thousand, and rising early in the morning they found all the bodies dead.
brenton_translation: And the angel of the Lord went forth, and slew out of the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand: and they arose in the morning and found all these bodies dead.

fresh_translation: And the king of the Assyrians turned back and departed and dwelt in Nineveh.
brenton_translation: And Sennacherim king of the Assyrians turned and departed, and dwelt in Nineve.

fresh_translation: And while he was bowing in the house of Nisroch his ancestral god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with swords, but they escaped into Armenia, and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place.
brenton_translation: And while he was worshipping Nasarach his country's god in the house, Adramelech and Sarasar his sons smote him with swords; and they escaped into Armenia: and Asordan his son reigned in his stead.

fresh_translation: And it happened at that time Hezekiah grew weak unto death, and Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet came to him and said to him, Thus says the Lord: Arrange concerning your house, for you die and will not live.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass at that time, that Ezekias was sick even to death. And Esaias the prophet the son of Amos came to him, and said to him, Thus saith the Lord, Give orders concerning thy house: for thou shalt die, and not live.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall and prayed to the Lord,
brenton_translation: And Ezekias turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the Lord, saying,

fresh_translation: saying, Remember, Lord, how I walked before you with truth in a true heart, and I did the pleasing things before you. And Hezekiah wept with great weeping.
brenton_translation: Remember, O Lord, how I have walked before thee in truth, with a true heart, and have done that which was pleasing in thy sight. And Ezekias wept bitterly.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Esaias, saying, Go, and say to Ezekias,

fresh_translation: Go and say to Hezekiah, Thus says the Lord God of David your father: I heard the voice of your prayer and saw your tears. Behold, I add fifteen years to your time,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, and seen thy tears: behold, I will add to thy time fifteen years.

fresh_translation: and from the hand of the king of the Assyrians I will save you and shield over this city.
brenton_translation: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians: and I will defend this city.

fresh_translation: And this is the sign to you from the Lord that God will do this word:
brenton_translation: And this shall be a sign to thee from the Lord, that God will do this thing;

fresh_translation: I will turn back the shadow of the stair-steps by which the sun went down, the ten steps of the house of your father; I will turn back the sun the ten steps. And the sun went up the ten steps by which the shadow had gone down.
brenton_translation: behold, I will turn back the shadow of the degrees of the dial by which ten degrees on the house of thy father the sun has gone down—I will turn back the sun the ten degrees; so the sun went back the ten degrees by which the shadow had gone down.

fresh_translation: A prayer of Hezekiah king of Judah when he grew weak and rose from his weakness.
brenton_translation: The Prayer of Ezekias king of Judea, when he had been sick, and was recovered from his sickness.

fresh_translation: I said, In the height of my days, in the gates of Hades I will leave the remaining years.
brenton_translation: I said in the end of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I shall part with the remainder of my years.

fresh_translation: I said, I will certainly no longer see the salvation of God on the earth; I will certainly no longer see a man.
brenton_translation: I said, I shall no more at all see the salvation of God in the land of the living: I shall no more at all see the salvation of Israel on the earth: I shall no more at all see man.

fresh_translation: From my kin I left the remnant of my life; it went out and departed from me as one striking a tent. My spirit by me became as a weaver's web coming near to cut off; in that day I was handed over.
brenton_translation: My life has failed from among my kindred: I have parted with the remainder of my life: it has gone forth and departed from me, as one that having pitched a tent takes it down again: my breath was with me as a weaver's web, when she that weaves draws nigh to cut off the thread.

fresh_translation: Until morning, as a lion, thus he crushed my bones. For from the day until the night I was handed over.
brenton_translation: In that day I was given up as to a lion until the morning: so has he broken all my bones: for I was so given up from day even to night.

fresh_translation: As a swallow thus I will cry, and as a dove thus I will meditate, for my eyes failed from looking into the height of heaven, toward the Lord who delivered me.
brenton_translation: As a swallow, so will I cry, and as a dove, so do I mourn: for mine eyes have failed with looking to the height of heaven to the Lord, who has delivered me,

fresh_translation: And he took away the pain of my soul.
brenton_translation: and removed the sorrow of my soul.

fresh_translation: Lord, for concerning this it was announced to you, and you roused my breath, and having comforted, I lived.
brenton_translation: Yea, O Lord, for it was told thee concerning this; and thou hast revived my breath; and I am comforted, and live.

fresh_translation: For you chose my soul so it might not perish, and you threw all my sins behind me.
brenton_translation: For thou hast chosen my soul, that it should not perish: and thou hast cast all my sins behind me.

fresh_translation: For those in Hades will not praise you, nor will the dead bless you, nor will those in Hades hope in your mercy.
brenton_translation: For they that are in the grave shall not praise thee, neither shall the dead bless thee, neither shall they that are in Hades hope for thy mercy.

fresh_translation: The living ones will bless you, as also I; for from today I will make children who will announce your righteousness.
brenton_translation: The living shall bless thee, as I also do: for from this day shall I beget children, who shall declare thy righteousness,

fresh_translation: Lord of my salvation, and I will not stop blessing you with a psaltery all the days of my life before the house of God.
brenton_translation: O God of my salvation; and I will not cease blessing thee with the psaltery all the days of my life before the house of God.

fresh_translation: And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Take a cake of figs and rub and apply as poultice, and you will be healthy.
brenton_translation: Now Esaias had said to Ezekias; Take a cake of figs, and mash them, and apply them as a plaister, and thou shalt be well.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah said, This is the sign that I will go up into the house of the Lord God.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias said, This is a sign to Ezekias, that I shall go up to the house of God.

fresh_translation: At that time Merodach son of Laadan, king of Babylon, sent letters and envoys and gifts to Hezekiah, for he heard that he grew weak unto death and rose.
brenton_translation: At that time Marodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, the king of Babylonia, sent letters and ambassadors and gifts to Ezekias: for he had heard that he had been sick even to death, and was recovered.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah rejoiced greatly over them and showed them the house of perfumes and myrrh and incenses and ointment and silver and gold and all the houses of the vessels of the treasury and all that was in his treasures, and there was nothing that Hezekiah did not show in his house.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias was glad of their coming, and he shewed them the house of his spices, and of silver, and gold, and myrrh, and incense, and ointment, and all the houses of his treasures, and all that he had in his stores: and there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, which Ezekias did not shew.

fresh_translation: And Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, What do these men say, and from where did they come to you? And Hezekiah said, From a far land they came to me, from Babylon.
brenton_translation: And Esaias the prophet came to king Ezekias, and said to him, What say these men? and whence came they to thee? and Ezekias said, They are come to me from a land afar off, from Babylon.

fresh_translation: And Isaiah said, What did they see in your house? And Hezekiah said, They saw all the things in my house, and there is nothing in my house which they did not see, and also the things in my treasures.
brenton_translation: And Esaias said, What have they seen in thine house? and Ezekias said, They have seen everything in my house; and there is nothing in my house which they have not seen: yea, also the possessions in my treasuries.

fresh_translation: And Isaiah said to him, Hear the word of the Lord of hosts.
brenton_translation: And Esaias said to him, Hear the word of the Lord of hosts:

fresh_translation: Behold, the days are coming, says the Lord, and they will take all the things in your house and whatever your fathers gathered until this day into Babylon, and they certainly will not leave anything, but God said,
brenton_translation: Behold, the days come, when they shall take all the things that are in thine house, and all that thy fathers have gathered until this day, shall go to Babylon; and they shall not leave anything at all: and God hath said,

fresh_translation: and from your children whom you begot they will take and make eunuchs in the house of the king of the Babylonians.
brenton_translation: that they shall take also of thy children whom thou shalt beget; and they shall make them eunuchs in the house of the king of the Babylonians.

fresh_translation: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, The word of the Lord which he spoke is good. Let there be peace and righteousness in my days.
brenton_translation: And Ezekias said to Esaias, Good is the word of the Lord, which he hath spoken: let there, I pray, be peace and righteousness in my days.

fresh_translation: Comfort, comfort my people, says God.
brenton_translation: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith God.

fresh_translation: Priests, speak to the heart of Jerusalem; comfort her, because her humiliation is filled, her sin is loosed, because she received from the hand of the Lord double her sins.
brenton_translation: Speak, ye priests, to the heart of Jerusalem; comfort her, for her humiliation is accomplished, her sin is put away: for she has received of the Lord's hand double the amount of her sins.

fresh_translation: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare the way of the Lord, make straight the paths of our God.
brenton_translation: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight the paths of our God.

fresh_translation: Every ravine will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be humbled, and all the crooked things will become straight, and the rough things into plains.
brenton_translation: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low: and all the crooked ways shall become straight, and the rough places plains.

fresh_translation: And the glory of the Lord will be seen, and all flesh will see the salvation of God, because the Lord spoke.
brenton_translation: And the glory of the Lord shall appear, and all flesh shall see the salvation of God: for the Lord has spoken it.

fresh_translation: The voice of one saying, Cry out. And I said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the glory of man is as a flower of grass.
brenton_translation: The voice of one saying, Cry; and I said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass.

fresh_translation: The grass dried up and the flower fell,
brenton_translation: The grass withers, and the flower fades:

fresh_translation: but the word of our God remains forever.
brenton_translation: but the word of our God abides for ever.

fresh_translation: Go up on a high mountain, the one bringing good news to Zion. Lift your voice with strength, the one bringing good news to Jerusalem. Lift up, do not fear; say to the cities of Judah, Behold your God.
brenton_translation: O thou that bringest glad tidings to Zion, go up on the high mountain; lift up thy voice with strength, thou that bringest glad tidings to Jerusalem; lift it up, fear not; say unto the cities of Juda, Behold your God!

fresh_translation: Behold, the Lord comes with strength, and his arm with lordship; behold, his wage is with him and his work before him.
brenton_translation: Behold the Lord! The Lord is coming with strength, and his arm is with power: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

fresh_translation: As a shepherd he will shepherd his flock, and with his arm gather lambs and comfort those carrying in the womb.
brenton_translation: He shall tend his flock as a shepherd, and he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and shall soothe them that are with young.

fresh_translation: Who measured the water with his hand and heaven with a span, and who set all the earth with a handful? Who set the mountains with a scale and the glens with a balance?
brenton_translation: Who has measured the water in his hand, and the heaven with a span, and all the earth in a handful? Who has weighed the mountains in scales, and the forests in a balance?

fresh_translation: Who knew the mind of the Lord, and who became his counselor, who instructs him?
brenton_translation: Who has known the mind of the Lord? and who has been his counsellor, to instruct him?

fresh_translation: Or with whom did he take counsel and who instructed him? Or who showed him judgment? Or who showed him the way of understanding?
brenton_translation: Or with whom has he taken counsel, and he has instructed him? or who has taught him judgment, or who has taught him the way of understanding;

fresh_translation: If all the nations were reckoned as a drop from a bucket and as the tilt of scales, then as spit they will be reckoned.
brenton_translation: since all the nations are counted as a drop from a bucket, and as the turning of a balance, and shall be counted as spittle?

fresh_translation: Lebanon is not enough for burning, and all the four-footed animals are not enough for a whole burnt offering.
brenton_translation: And Libanus is not enough to burn, nor all beasts enough for a whole-burnt offering:

fresh_translation: And all the nations are as nothing and were reckoned into nothing.
brenton_translation: and all the nations are as nothing, and counted as nothing.

fresh_translation: To whom did you liken the Lord, and to what likeness did you liken him?
brenton_translation: To whom have ye compared the Lord? and with what likeness have ye compared him?

fresh_translation: Did not a craftsman make an image, or a goldsmith having melted gold gilded it and construct a likeness?
brenton_translation: Has not the artificer made an image, or the goldsmith having melted gold, gilt it over, and made it a similitude?

fresh_translation: For incorrupt wood is chosen; a craftsman wisely seeks how to set his image so it not be shaken.
brenton_translation: For the artificer chooses out a wood that will not rot, and will wisely enquire how he shall set up his image, and that so that it should not be moved.

fresh_translation: Will you not know? Will you not hear? Was it not announced to you from the beginning? Did you not know the foundations of the earth?
brenton_translation: Will ye not know? will ye not hear? has it not been told you of old? Have ye not known the foundations of the earth?

fresh_translation: The one holding the circuit of the earth, and those dwelling in it as locusts, the one setting heaven as a vault and stretching it as a tent to dwell in,
brenton_translation: It is he that comprehends the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants in it are as grasshoppers; he that set up the heaven as a chamber, and stretched it out as a tent to dwell in:

fresh_translation: the one giving rulers to rule into nothing, and made the earth as nothing.
brenton_translation: he that appoints princes to rule as nothing, and has made the earth as nothing.

fresh_translation: For they certainly will not sow, nor plant, nor their root certainly take root in the earth; he breathed upon them and they dried up, and a storm will take them up as brushwood.
brenton_translation: For they shall not plant, neither shall they sow, neither shall their root be fixed in the ground: he has blown upon them, and they are withered, and a storm shall carry them away like sticks.

fresh_translation: Now then to whom did you liken me, that I shall be exalted, said the Holy One.
brenton_translation: Now then to whom have ye compared me, that I may be exalted? saith the Holy One.

fresh_translation: Lift your eyes on high and see who showed all these, the one bringing out his array by number; he will call all by name. From much glory and strength of power nothing escaped you.
brenton_translation: Lift up your eyes on high, and see, who has displayed all these things? even he that brings forth his host by number: he shall call them all by name by means of his great glory, and by the power of his might: nothing has escaped thee.

fresh_translation: So do not say, Jacob, and what did you speak, Israel? My way was hidden from God, and my God took away judgment and departed.
brenton_translation: For say not thou, O Jacob, and why hast thou spoken, Israel, saying, My way is hid from God, and my God has taken away my judgment, and has departed?

fresh_translation: And now did you not know? Did you not hear? The eternal God, the God who prepared the ends of the earth, will not hunger nor grow weary, nor is there finding out of his wisdom.
brenton_translation: And now, hast thou not known? hast thou not heard? the eternal God, the God that formed the ends of the earth, shall not hunger, nor be weary, and there is no searching of his understanding.

fresh_translation: Giving strength to the hungry ones and grief to those not pained.
brenton_translation: He gives strength to the hungry, and sorrow to them that are not suffering.

fresh_translation: For the young men will hunger and grow weary, and the chosen youths will be weak.
brenton_translation: For the young men shall hunger, and the youths shall be weary, and the choice men shall be powerless:

fresh_translation: But those enduring for God will change strength, they will grow wings like eagles, they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not hunger.
brenton_translation: but they that wait on God shall renew their strength; they shall put forth new feathers like eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; they shall walk, and not hunger.

fresh_translation: Renew yourselves to me, islands, for the rulers will change strength. Let them come near and speak together; then let them announce judgment.
brenton_translation: Hold a feast to me, ye islands: for the princes shall renew their strength: let them draw nigh and speak together: then let them declare judgment.

fresh_translation: Who raised righteousness from the east? He called it to his feet and it will go. He will give nations before him and astonish kings and give their swords into the earth and their bows as driven brushwood.
brenton_translation: Who raised up righteousness from the east, and called it to his feet, so that it should go? shall appoint it an adversary of Gentiles, and shall dismay kings, and bury their swords in the earth, and cast forth their bows and arrows as sticks?

fresh_translation: And he will pursue them and pass through in peace, the way of his feet.
brenton_translation: And he shall pursue them; the way of his feet shall proceed in peace.

fresh_translation: Who worked and did these things? He called it from the generations of beginning. I am God, first, and in the things coming I am.
brenton_translation: Who has wrought and done these things? he has called it who called it from the generations of old; I God, the first and to all futurity, I AM.

fresh_translation: The nations saw and feared; the ends of the earth drew near and came together.
brenton_translation: The nations saw, and feared; the ends of the earth drew nigh, and came together,

fresh_translation: Each one judging for his neighbor and saying to his brother, Help.
brenton_translation: every one judging for his neighbour and that to assist his brother: and one will say,

fresh_translation: A craftsman strengthened, and a bronze-smith striking with a hammer while driving. At one time he says, The joint is good; they strengthened them with nails and they will not be moved.
brenton_translation: The artificer has become strong, and the coppersmith that smites with the hammer, and forges also: sometimes he will say, It is a piece well joined: they have fastened them with nails; they will fix them, and they shall not be moved.

fresh_translation: But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I chose, the seed of Abraham whom I loved,
brenton_translation: But thou, Israel, art my servant Jacob, and he whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraam, whom I have loved:

fresh_translation: whom I took hold from the edges of the earth and called from its watchpoints, and I said to you, You are my servant; I chose you and did not abandon you.
brenton_translation: whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and from the high places of it I have called thee, and said to thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and I have not forsaken thee.

fresh_translation: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not wander, for I am your God, the one strengthening you and helping you, and I secured you by my right righteous hand.
brenton_translation: Fear not; for I am with thee: wander not; for I am thy God, who have strengthened thee; and I have helped thee, and have established thee with my just right hand.

fresh_translation: Behold, all those opposing you will be ashamed and put to shame, for they will be as not existing, and all your adversaries will perish.
brenton_translation: Behold, all thine adversaries shall be ashamed and confounded; for they shall be as if they were not: and all thine opponents shall perish.

fresh_translation: You will seek them and certainly not find the men who rage against you, for the ones fighting against you will be as not existing and will not be.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt seek them, and thou shalt not find the men who shall insolently rage against thee: for they shall be as if they were not, and they that war against thee shall not be.

fresh_translation: For I am your God, the one holding your right hand, saying to you, Do not fear.
brenton_translation: For I am thy God, who holdeth thy right hand, who saith to thee,

fresh_translation: Jacob, little one; Israel, I helped you, says God, one redeeming you, Israel.
brenton_translation: Fear not, Jacob, and thou Israel few in number; I have helped thee, saith thy God, he that redeems thee, O Israel.

fresh_translation: Behold, I made you as new threshing wheels of a wagon, saw-toothed, and you will thresh the mountains and make the hills fine and make them as dust.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have made thee as new saw-shaped threshing wheels of a waggon; and thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat the hills to powder, and make them as chaff:

fresh_translation: And you will winnow them, and a wind will take them and a storm scatter them. But you will rejoice in the holy things of Israel, and they will exult.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt winnow them, and the wind shall carry them away, and a tempest shall scatter them: but thou shalt rejoice in the holy ones of Israel.

fresh_translation: For the poor and the needy will seek water, and there will be none; their tongue dried up from thirst. I, the Lord God, will hear; the God of Israel, I will not abandon them.
brenton_translation: And the poor and the needy shall exult; for when they shall seek water, and there shall be none, and their tongue is parched with thirst, I the Lord God, I the God of Israel will hear, and will not forsake them:

fresh_translation: But I will open rivers on the mountains and make springs in the midst of plains. I will make the wilderness into marshes and the thirsty land into aqueducts.
brenton_translation: but I will open rivers on the mountains, and fountains in the midst of plains: I will make the desert pools of water, and a thirsty land watercourses.

fresh_translation: I will put a cedar and a box tree and a myrtle and a cypress and a white poplar in the dry land,
brenton_translation: I will plant in the dry land the cedar and box, the myrtle and cypress, and white poplar:

fresh_translation: so that they may see and know and understand and know together that the hand of the Lord did all these things and the Holy One of Israel displayed them.
brenton_translation: that they may see, and know, and perceive, and understand together, that the hand of the Lord has wrought these works, and the Holy One of Israel has displayed them.

fresh_translation: Your judgment draws near, says the Lord God; your counsels drew near, says the king of Jacob.
brenton_translation: Your judgment draws nigh, saith the Lord God; your counsels have drawn nigh, saith the King of Jacob.

fresh_translation: Let them come near and announce to you what will happen, or what the former things were; speak, and we will set our mind and know what the last things are, and tell us the things coming.
brenton_translation: Let them draw nigh, and declare to you what things shall come to pass; or tell us what things were of old, and we will apply our understanding, and we shall know what are the last and the future things:

fresh_translation: Tell us the things coming at the end, and we will know that you are gods; do good and do evil, and we will marvel and see together.
brenton_translation: tell us, declare ye to us the things that are coming on at the last time, and we shall know that ye are gods: do good, and do evil, and we shall wonder, and see at the same time

fresh_translation: Because from where are you, and from where is your work? They chose you from the land as an abomination.
brenton_translation: whence ye are, and whence is your work: they have chosen you an abomination out of the earth.

fresh_translation: But I raised one from the north and one from the east of the sun; they will be called by my name. Let the rulers come, and as potter's clay and as a potter treading the clay, thus you will be trampled.
brenton_translation: But I have raised up him that comes from the north, and him that comes from the rising of the sun: they shall be called by my name: let the princes come, and as potter's clay, and as a potter treading clay, so shall ye be trodden down.

fresh_translation: For who will announce the things from the beginning so that we may know, and the things before, and we will say they are true? There is no one foretelling, nor one hearing your words.
brenton_translation: For who will declare the things from the beginning, that we may know also the former things, and we will say that they are true? there is no one that speaks beforehand, nor any one that hears your words.

fresh_translation: I will give a beginning to Zion and comfort Jerusalem for the way.
brenton_translation: I will give dominion to Sion, and will comfort Jerusalem by the way.

fresh_translation: For from the nations, behold, no one, and from their idols there was not one announcing; and if I ask them from where they are, they certainly will not answer me.
brenton_translation: For from among the nations, behold, there was no one; and of their idols there was none to declare anything: and if I should ask them, Whence are ye? they could not answer me.

fresh_translation: For the ones making you and the ones leading you astray are vain.
brenton_translation: For these are your makers, as ye think, and they that cause you to err in vain.

fresh_translation: Jacob my servant, I will help him; Israel my chosen one, my soul accepted him. I gave my Spirit upon him; he will bring judgment to the nations.
brenton_translation: Jacob is my servant, I will help him: Israel is my chosen, my soul has accepted him; I have put my Spirit upon him; he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: He will not cry out nor raise up, nor will his voice be heard outside.
brenton_translation: He shall not cry, nor lift up his voice, nor shall his voice be heard without.

fresh_translation: A crushed reed he will not break, and smoking flax he will not quench, but in truth he will bring judgment.
brenton_translation: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench; but he shall bring forth judgment to truth.

fresh_translation: He will shine out and will not be broken until he sets judgment upon the earth, and the nations will hope in his name.
brenton_translation: He shall shine out, and shall not be discouraged, until he have set judgment on the earth: and in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord God, the one making heaven and stretching it, the one establishing the earth and the things in it, and giving breath to the people on it and spirit to those walking on it.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord God, who made the heaven, and established it; who settled the earth, and the things in it, and gives breath to the people on it, and spirit to them that tread on it:

fresh_translation: I, the Lord God, called you in righteousness and will hold your hand and strengthen you, and I gave you into a covenant of a race, into a light of nations,
brenton_translation: I the Lord God have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will strengthen thee: and I have given thee for the covenant of a race, for a light of the Gentiles;

fresh_translation: to open the eyes of the blind, bring bound ones out of bonds and those sitting in darkness out of a prison house.
brenton_translation: to open the eyes of the blind, to bring the bound and them that sit in darkness out of bonds and the prison-house.

fresh_translation: I, the Lord God, this is my name. My glory I will not give to another, nor my virtues to the carved things.
brenton_translation: I am the Lord God: that is my name: I will not give my glory to another, nor my praises to graven images.

fresh_translation: Behold, the former things came, and the new things which I announce; before they spring up, they were made clear to you.
brenton_translation: Behold, the ancient things have come to pass, and so will the new things which I tell you: yea, before I tell them they are made known to you.

fresh_translation: Sing to the Lord a new hymn, his beginning; glorify his name from the end of the earth, those going down into the sea and sailing it, the islands and those dwelling in them.
brenton_translation: Sing a new hymn to the Lord: ye who are his dominion, glorify his name from the end of the earth: ye that go down to the sea, and sail upon it; the islands, and they that dwell in them.

fresh_translation: Rejoice, the wilderness and its villages, the camps and the dwellers in Kedar. The dwellers of the rock will rejoice; from the tops of the mountains they will cry out.
brenton_translation: Rejoice, thou wilderness, and the villages thereof, the hamlets, and the dwellers in Kedar: the inhabitants of the rock shall rejoice, they shall shout from the top of the mountains.

fresh_translation: They will give glory to God, and in the islands announce his virtues.
brenton_translation: They shall give glory to God, and shall proclaim his praises in the islands.

fresh_translation: The Lord God of powers will go out and crush war, stir up zeal and shout against his enemies with strength.
brenton_translation: The Lord God of hosts shall go forth, and crush the war: he shall stir up jealousy, and shall shout mightily against his enemies.

fresh_translation: I was silent; will I also always be silent and endure? I held firm. As a woman giving birth I will be amazed and dry up together.
brenton_translation: I have been silent: shall I also always be silent and forbear? I have endured like a travailing woman: I will now amaze and wither at once.

fresh_translation: And I will make rivers into islands and dry up marshes.
brenton_translation: I will make desolate mountains and hills, and will dry up all their grass; and I will make the rivers islands, and dry up the pools.

fresh_translation: And I will lead the blind in a way they did not know, and I will make paths for them that they did not know how to tread. I will make the darkness for them into light and the crooked things into straight things. These words I will do and not abandon them.
brenton_translation: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not, and I will cause them to tread paths which they have not known: I will turn darkness into light for them, and crooked things into straight. These things will I do, and will not forsake them.

fresh_translation: But they turned backward. Be ashamed with shame, the ones trusting in the carved things, the ones saying to the molten images, You are our gods.
brenton_translation: But they are turned back: be ye utterly ashamed that trust in graven images, who say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.

fresh_translation: The deaf ones, hear; the blind ones, look up to see.
brenton_translation: Hear, ye deaf, and look up, ye blind, to see.

fresh_translation: And who is blind except my servants, and deaf except the ones ruling them? And the servants of God were blinded.
brenton_translation: And who is blind, but my servants? and deaf, but they that rule over them? yea, the servants of God have been made blind.

fresh_translation: You saw many times and did not keep watch; the ears were opened and you did not hear.
brenton_translation: Ye have often seen, and have not taken heed; your ears have been opened, and ye have not heard.

fresh_translation: The Lord God wanted him to be justified and to magnify praise, and I saw.
brenton_translation: The Lord God has taken counsel that he might be justified, and might magnify his praise.

fresh_translation: And the people became plundered and pillaged, for the snare was in the storerooms everywhere and in houses together where they hid them. They became for plunder, and there was no one rescuing, spoil and no one saying, Give back.
brenton_translation: And I beheld, and the people were spoiled and plundered: for there is a snare in the secret chambers everywhere, and in the houses also, where they have hidden them: they became a spoil, and there was no one that delivered the prey, and there was none who said, Restore.

fresh_translation: Who among you will give ear to these things, will hear for the things coming?
brenton_translation: Who is there among you that will give ear to these things? hearken ye to the things which are coming to pass.

fresh_translation: Who gave Jacob for plunder and Israel to the ones spoiling him? Was it not God against whom they sinned, and they did not want to walk in his ways nor hear his law?
brenton_translation: For what did he give Jacob up to spoil, and Israel to them that plundered him? Did not God do it against whom they sinned? and they would not walk in his ways, nor hearken to his law.

fresh_translation: And he brought upon them the anger of his wrath and war prevailed over them, and the ones burning them around, each of them did not know nor set it on his soul.
brenton_translation: So he brought upon them the fury of his wrath; and the war, and those that burnt round about them, prevailed against them; yet no one of them knew it, neither did they lay it to heart.

fresh_translation: And now thus says the Lord God, the one making you, Jacob, the one forming you, Israel: Do not fear, because I redeemed you; I called you by your name; you are mine.
brenton_translation: And now thus saith the Lord God that made thee, O Jacob, and formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

fresh_translation: And if you pass through water, I am with you, and rivers will not flood you, and if you pass through fire, you certainly will not be burned; a flame will not burn you.
brenton_translation: And if thou pass through water, I am with thee; and the rivers shall not overflow thee: and if thou go through fire, thou shalt not be burned; the flame shall not burn thee.

fresh_translation: Because I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, the one saving you. I made Egypt and Ethiopia and Syene your exchange.
brenton_translation: For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, that saves thee: I have made Egypt and Ethiopia thy ransom, and given Soene for thee.

fresh_translation: Since you became precious before me, you were glorified and I loved you, and I will give many men for you and rulers over your head.
brenton_translation: Since thou becamest precious in my sight, thou hast become glorious, and I have loved thee: and I will give men for thee, and princes for thy life.

fresh_translation: Do not fear, because I am with you. From the east I will bring your seed, and from the west I will gather you.
brenton_translation: Fear not; for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and will gather thee from the west.

fresh_translation: I will say to the north, Bring, and to the south, Do not hinder; bring my sons from a far land and my daughters from the ends of the earth,
brenton_translation: I will say to the north, Bring; and to the south, Keep not back; bring my sons from the land afar off, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;

fresh_translation: all as many as are called by my name, for in my glory I prepared him and formed and made him.
brenton_translation: even all who are called by my name: for I have prepared him for my glory, and I have formed him, and have made him:

fresh_translation: And I brought out a blind people, and eyes exist yet equally blind, and deaf ones having ears.
brenton_translation: and I have brought forth the blind people; for their eyes are alike blind, and they that have ears are deaf.

fresh_translation: All the nations were gathered together, and rulers will gather. Who among them announces these things, or who from the things from the beginning will announce to you? Let them bring their witnesses and be justified and say true things.
brenton_translation: All the nations are gathered together, and princes shall be gathered out of them: who will declare these things? or who will declare to you things from the beginning? let them bring forth their witnesses, and be justified; and let them hear, and declare the truth.

fresh_translation: Become witnesses to me, and I witness, says the Lord God, and the servant whom I chose, so that you may know and believe and understand that I am. Before me no other god came to be, and after me there will not be.
brenton_translation: Be ye my witnesses, and I too am a witness, saith the Lord God, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know, and believe, and understand that I am he: before me there was no other God, and after me there shall be none.

fresh_translation: I am God, and apart from me there is no one saving.
brenton_translation: I am God; and beside me there is no Saviour.

fresh_translation: I announced and saved; I reproached, and there was no foreigner among you. You are my witnesses, and I am a witness, says the Lord God.
brenton_translation: I have declared, and have saved; I have reproached, and there was no strange god among you: ye are my witnesses, and I am the Lord God,

fresh_translation: Still from the beginning, and there is no one rescuing from my hands. I will do, and who will turn it back?
brenton_translation: even from the beginning; and there is none that can deliver out of my hands: I will work, and who shall turn it back?

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord God, the one redeeming you, the Holy One of Israel: Because of you I will send into Babylon and stir up all the fugitives, and the Chaldeans will be bound in ships.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord God that redeems you, the Holy One of Israel; For your sakes I will send to Babylon, and I will stir up all that flee, and the Chaldeans shall be bound in ships.

fresh_translation: I am the Lord God, your Holy One, the one showing Israel your king.
brenton_translation: I am the Lord God, your Holy One, who have appointed for Israel your king.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord, the one giving a way in the sea and a path in strong water,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty water;

fresh_translation: the one bringing out chariots and horse and a strong crowd. But they slept and will not rise; they were quenched as extinguished flax.
brenton_translation: who brought forth chariots and horse, and a mighty multitude: but they have lain down, and shall not rise: they are extinct, as quenched flax.

fresh_translation: Do not remember the former things and do not consider the ancient things.
brenton_translation: Remember ye not the former things, and consider not the ancient things.

fresh_translation: Behold, I make the new things which now will spring up, and you will know them, and I will make in the wilderness a way and in the dry land rivers.
brenton_translation: Behold, I will do new things, which shall presently spring forth, and ye shall know them: and I will make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the dry land.

fresh_translation: The beasts of the field, sirens and daughters of ostriches, will bless me, because I gave water in the wilderness and rivers in the dry land to give drink to my chosen race,
brenton_translation: The beasts of the field shall bless me, the owls and young ostriches; for I have given water in the wilderness, and rivers in the dry land, to give drink to my chosen race,

fresh_translation: my people whom I acquired to recount my virtues.
brenton_translation: even my people whom I have preserved to tell forth my praises.

fresh_translation: Not now did I call you, Jacob, nor did I make you weary, Israel.
brenton_translation: I have not now called thee, O Jacob; neither have I made thee weary, O Israel.

fresh_translation: You did not bring me sheep of your burnt offering, nor glorify me in your sacrifices, nor make me toil with frankincense.
brenton_translation: Thou hast not brought me the sheep of thy whole-burnt-offering; neither hast thou glorified me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with sacrifices, neither have I wearied thee with frankincense.

fresh_translation: Nor did you buy me incense with silver, nor did I desire the fat of your sacrifices, but in your sins and injustices I stood before you.
brenton_translation: Neither hast thou purchased for me victims for silver, neither have I desired the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou didst stand before me in thy sins, and in thine iniquities.

fresh_translation: I am, I am, the one wiping out your lawlessnesses, and certainly I will not remember.
brenton_translation: I, even I, am he that blots out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and thy sins; and I will not remember them.

fresh_translation: But you remember, and let us judge together; speak you your lawlessnesses first, so that you may be justified.
brenton_translation: But do thou remember, and let us plead together: do thou first confess thy transgressions, that thou mayest be justified.

fresh_translation: Your first fathers and their rulers acted lawlessly against me.
brenton_translation: Your fathers first, and your princes have transgressed against me.

fresh_translation: And the rulers defiled my holy things, and I gave Jacob to destruction and Israel to reproach.
brenton_translation: And the princes have defiled my sanctuaries: so I gave Jacob to enemies to destroy, and Israel to reproach.

fresh_translation: Now hear, my servant Jacob, and Israel whom I chose.
brenton_translation: But now hear, Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord God, the one making you and the one forming you from the womb: You will still be helped. Do not fear, my servant Jacob, beloved Israel whom I chose.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord God that made thee, and he that formed thee from the womb; Thou shalt yet be helped: fear not, my servant Jacob; and beloved Israel, whom I have chosen.

fresh_translation: Because I will give water in thirst to the ones going in dry land; I will put my Spirit on your seed and my blessings on your children.
brenton_translation: For I will give water to the thirsty that walk in a dry land: I will put my Spirit upon thy seed, and my blessings upon thy children:

fresh_translation: And they will spring up like grass among waters, and like a willow by flowing water.
brenton_translation: and they shall spring up as grass between brooks, and as willows on the banks of running water.

fresh_translation: This one will say, I belong to God; and this one will cry out in the name of Jacob; and another will write, I belong to God, in the name of Israel.
brenton_translation: One shall say, I am God's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall write with his hand, I am God's, and shall call himself by the name of Israel.

fresh_translation: Thus says God, the king of Israel, the one rescuing him, God of hosts: I am first, and I am after these things; besides me no god exists.
brenton_translation: Thus saith God the King of Israel, and the God of hosts that delivered him; I am the first, and I am hereafter: beside me there is no God.

fresh_translation: Who is like me? Let him stand, call out, and prepare it before me, from the time I made humankind for the age; and the things coming before they come, let them declare to you.
brenton_translation: Who is like me? let him stand, and call, and declare, and prepare for me from the time that I made man for ever; and let them tell you the things that are coming before they arrive.

fresh_translation: Do not hide yourselves. Have you not heard from the beginning? I told you. You are my witnesses whether there is a god besides me; there were none then.
brenton_translation: Hide not yourselves, nor go astray: have ye not heard from the beginning, and have not I told you? ye are witnesses if there is a God beside me.

fresh_translation: The ones shaping and carving are all vain, making their cherished things, which will not profit them; instead they will be put to shame.
brenton_translation: But they that framed false gods did not then hearken; and they that graved images are all vain, performing their own desires, which shall not profit them, but they shall be ashamed

fresh_translation: All the ones who shape a god and carve useless things.
brenton_translation: that form a god, and all that grave worthless things:

fresh_translation: And all from whom they came were dried up, and mute from among men. Let them all gather and stand together; let them together be shamed and disgraced.
brenton_translation: and all by whom they were made are withered: yea, let all the deaf be gathered from among men, and let them stand together; and let them be ashamed and confounded together:

fresh_translation: For a craftsman sharpened iron, worked it with an axe, pierced it with a drill, worked it with the strength of his arm; then he will hunger and grow weak, and by not drinking water, become faint.
brenton_translation: For the artificer sharpens the iron; he fashions the idol with an axe, and fixes it with an awl, and fashions it with the strength of his arm: and he will be hungry and weak, and will drink no water.

fresh_translation: A carpenter set wood by measure and shaped it by a line. He made it as the form of a man and as the beauty of a human, to set it in a house.
brenton_translation: The artificer having chosen a piece of wood, marks it out with a rule, and fits it with glue, and makes it as the form of a man, and as the beauty of a man, to set it up in the house.

fresh_translation: One cut wood from the forest, which the Lord planted, and rain made it grow.
brenton_translation: He cuts wood out of the forest, which the Lord planted, even a pine tree, and the rain made it grow,

fresh_translation: So it might be for humans as fuel; taking from it he warmed himself, and burning it they baked breads; with what remained they worked gods and worshiped them.
brenton_translation: that it might be for men to burn: and having taken part of it he warms himself; yea, they burn part of it, and bake loaves thereon; and of the rest they make for themselves gods, and they worship them.

fresh_translation: Half of it they burned in a fire, and baking breads on it, and roasting meat on it, he ate and was filled; and being warmed he said, Pleasant to me, because I am warmed and saw a fire.
brenton_translation: Half thereof he burns in the fire, and with half of it he bakes loaves on the coals; and having roasted flesh on it he eats, and is satisfied, and having warmed himself he says, I am comfortable, for I have warmed myself, and have seen the fire.

fresh_translation: But the remainder he made into a carved god and worships it and prays, saying, Deliver me, because you are my god.
brenton_translation: And the rest he makes a graven god, and worships, and prays, saying, Deliver me; for thou art my God.

fresh_translation: They did not know how to understand, because they were darkened from seeing with their eyes and from perceiving with their heart.
brenton_translation: They have no understanding to perceive; for they have been blinded so that they should not see with their eyes, nor perceive with their heart.

fresh_translation: And he did not consider in his heart, nor reckon in his soul, nor know with understanding that he burned half of it in fire and baked breads on its coals and roasted meat and ate, and its remainder he made into an abomination and they worship it.
brenton_translation: And one has not considered in his mind, nor known in his understanding, that he has burnt up half of it in the fire, and baked loaves on the coals thereof and has roasted and eaten flesh, and of the rest of it he has made an abomination, and they worship it.

fresh_translation: Know that their heart is ash; they wander, and no one can rescue his soul. See, will you not say, A lie is in my right hand?
brenton_translation: Know thou that their heart is ashes, and they err, and no one is able to deliver his soul: see, ye will not say, There is a lie in my right hand.

fresh_translation: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, because you are my servant. I formed you my servant, and you, Israel, do not forget me.
brenton_translation: Remember these things, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant; I have formed thee to be my servant: and do thou, Israel, not forget me.

fresh_translation: For see, I wiped away your lawless deeds like a cloud and your sins like gloom. Turn to me, and I will redeem you.
brenton_translation: For behold, I have blotted out as a cloud thy transgressions, and thy sin as darkness: turn to me, and I will redeem thee.

fresh_translation: Be glad, heavens, because God showed mercy to Israel. Trumpet, foundations of the earth. Cry out, mountains, with gladness, the hills and all the trees in them, because God redeemed Jacob, and Israel will be glorified.
brenton_translation: Rejoice, ye heavens; for God has had mercy upon Israel: sound the trumpet, ye foundations of the earth: ye mountains, shout with joy, ye hills, and all the trees therein: for God has redeemed Jacob, and Israel shall be glorified.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord, the one redeeming you and the one forming you from the womb: I am the Lord, the one completing all things. I stretched out heaven alone and founded the earth. Who else?
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord that redeems thee, and who formed thee from the womb, I am the Lord that performs all things: I stretched out the heaven alone, and established the earth.

fresh_translation: He will scatter signs of ventriloquists and divinations from the heart, turning wise men backward and making their counsel foolish,
brenton_translation: Who else will frustrate the tokens of those that have divining spirits, and prophecies from the heart of man? turning the wise back, and making their counsel foolishness;

fresh_translation: He establishes the words of his servant and makes true the counsel of his messengers, the one saying, Jerusalem, You will be inhabited, and to the cities of Judah, You will be built, and her desolate places will spring up.
brenton_translation: and confirming the word of his servant, and verifying the counsel of his messengers: who says to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Idumea, Ye shall be built, and her desert places shall spring forth.

fresh_translation: the one saying to the deep, Be made desolate, and I will dry up your rivers.
brenton_translation: Who says to the deep, Thou shalt be dried up, and I will dry up the rivers.

fresh_translation: the one saying to Cyrus, Think rightly, and he will do all my will, the one saying, Jerusalem, You will be built, and I will lay the foundation of my holy house.
brenton_translation: Who bids Cyrus be wise, and he shall perform all my will: who says to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built, and I will lay the foundation of my holy house.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord God to Cyrus, my anointed, whose right hand I grasped, to make nations obey before him. I will tear apart the strength of kings, open doors before him, and cities will not be shut.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord God to my anointed Cyrus, whose right hand I have held, that nations might be obedient before him; and I will break through the strength of kings; I will open doors before him, and cities shall not be closed.

fresh_translation: I will go before you and level mountains; I will crush bronze doors and break iron bars.
brenton_translation: I will go before thee, and will level mountains: I will break to pieces brazen doors, and will burst iron bars.

fresh_translation: And I will give you treasures of darkness; hidden unseen treasures I will open for you, so you may know that I am the Lord God, the one calling your name, the God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, I will open to thee hidden, unseen treasures, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord thy God, that call thee by name, am the God of Israel.

fresh_translation: For the sake of Jacob my servant and Israel my chosen, I will call you by your name and accept you; but you did not know me.
brenton_translation: For the sake of my servant Jacob, and Israel mine elect, I will call thee by thy name, and accept thee: but thou hast not known me.

fresh_translation: Because I am the Lord God, and there is no other; there is no god besides me, and you did not know me.
brenton_translation: For I am the Lord God, and there is no other God beside me; I strengthened thee, and thou hast not known me.

fresh_translation: so that those from the rising of the sun and those from the west may know that none exists besides me. I am the Lord God, and there is no other.
brenton_translation: That they that come from the east and they that come from the west may know that there is no God but me. I am the Lord God, and there is none beside.

fresh_translation: I am the one preparing light and making darkness, making peace and creating evils; I am the Lord God, the one doing all these things.
brenton_translation: I am he that prepared light, and formed darkness; who make peace, and create evil; I am the Lord God, that does all these things.

fresh_translation: Let the heaven above rejoice, and let the clouds rain righteousness. Let the earth sprout mercy, and let righteousness spring up together. I am the Lord who created you.
brenton_translation: Let the heaven rejoice from above, and let the clouds rain righteousness: let the earth bring forth, and blossom with mercy, and bring forth righteousness likewise: I am the Lord that created thee.

fresh_translation: What better thing did I make than clay of a potter? Will the plowman plow the whole earth all day? Will the clay say to the potter, What are you doing, since you do not work, nor do you have hands?
brenton_translation: What excellent thing have I prepared as clay of the potter? Will the ploughman plough the earth all day? shall the clay say to the potter, What art thou doing that thou dost not work, nor hast hands? shall the thing formed answer him that formed it?

fresh_translation: The one saying to the father, What will you beget? and to the mother, What are you laboring to bear?
brenton_translation: As though one should say to his father, What wilt thou beget me? and to his mother, What art thou bringing forth?

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, the one making the things coming: Ask me concerning my sons and my daughters, and command me concerning the works of my hands.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, who has formed the things that are to come, Enquire of me concerning my sons, and concerning the works of my hands command me.

fresh_translation: I made the earth and humankind on it. I fixed heaven with my hand; I commanded all the stars.
brenton_translation: I have made the earth, and man upon it: I with my hand have established the heaven; I have given commandment to all the stars.

fresh_translation: I raised him up with righteousness as king, and all his ways are straight. He will build my city and turn back the captivity of my people, not with ransoms nor with gifts, says the Lord of hosts.
brenton_translation: I have raised him up to be a king with righteousness, and all his ways are right: he shall build my city, and shall turn the captivity of my people, not for ransoms, nor for rewards, saith the Lord of hosts.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Egypt labored, and the trade of Ethiopians, and the Sabeans, tall men, will pass over to you and be your slaves, and behind you they will follow, bound with fetters, and they will worship you and make supplication to you, because God is in you; and they will say, No god exists besides you.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Egypt has laboured for thee; and the merchandise of the Ethiopians, and the Sabeans, men of stature, shall pass over to thee, and shall be thy servants; and they shall follow after thee bound in fetters, and shall pass over to thee, and shall do obeisance to thee, and make supplication to thee: because God is in thee; and there is no God beside thee, O Lord.

fresh_translation: For you are God, and we did not know it, the God of Israel, Savior.
brenton_translation: For thou art God, yet we knew it not, the God of Israel, the Saviour.

fresh_translation: All those opposing him will be shamed and disgraced, and they will go in shame. Renew yourselves toward me, islands.
brenton_translation: All that are opposed to him shall be ashamed and confounded, and shall walk in shame: ye isles, keep a feast to me.

fresh_translation: Israel is saved by the Lord with everlasting salvation; they will not be ashamed nor disgraced forever.
brenton_translation: Israel is saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation: they shall not be ashamed nor confounded for evermore.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord, the one making heaven: this God, the one bringing the earth to view and making it, he himself marked it out. He did not make it empty, but to be inhabited. I am, and there is no other.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord that made the heaven, this God that created the earth, and made it; he marked it out, he made it not in vain, but formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord, and there is none beside.

fresh_translation: Not in secret have I spoken, nor in a dark place of the earth. I did not say to the seed of Jacob, Seek me in vain. I am, I am the Lord, speaking righteousness and declaring truth.
brenton_translation: I have not spoken in secret, nor in a dark place of the earth: I said not to the seed of Jacob, Seek vanity: I, even I, am the Lord, speaking righteousness, and proclaiming truth.

fresh_translation: Gather yourselves and come; take counsel together, those being saved from the nations. They did not know, those carrying the wood of their carved image and praying as to gods who do not save.
brenton_translation: Assemble yourselves and come; take counsel together, ye that escape of the nations: they that set up wood, even their graven image, have no knowledge, nor they who pray to gods that do not save.

fresh_translation: If they declare, let them come near, so they may know together. Who made these things heard from the beginning? Then it was declared to you. I am God, and there is no other besides me; righteous and Savior, there is none apart from me.
brenton_translation: If they will declare, let them draw nigh, that they may know together, who has caused these things to be heard from the beginning: then was it told you. I am God, and there is not another beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none but me.

fresh_translation: Turn to me and be saved, those from the end of the earth. I am God, and there is no other.
brenton_translation: Turn ye to me, and ye shall be saved, ye that come from the end of the earth: I am God, and there is none other.

fresh_translation: By myself I swear: surely righteousness will go out from my mouth; my words will not turn back, because to me every knee will bend and every tongue will confess to God.
brenton_translation: By myself I swear, righteousness shall surely proceed out of my mouth; my words shall not be frustrated; that to me every knee shall bend, and every tongue shall swear by God,

fresh_translation: saying, Righteousness and glory will come to him, and all those separating themselves will be shamed.
brenton_translation: saying, Righteousness and glory shall come to him: and all that remove them from their borders shall be ashamed.

fresh_translation: From the Lord all the seed of the sons of Israel will be justified, and in God they will be glorified.
brenton_translation: By the Lord shall they be justified, and in God shall all the seed of the children of Israel be glorified.

fresh_translation: Bel fell; Dagon was shattered. Their carved images came to belong to wild animals and cattle. Carry them, bound, like a burden for a weary one.
brenton_translation: Bel has fallen, Nabo is broken to pieces, their graven images are gone to the wild beasts and the cattle: ye take them packed up as a burden to the weary, exhausted, hungry, and at the same time helpless man;

fresh_translation: and for a hungry and exhausted one, one without strength. Together they will not be able to be saved from war, but they themselves were led away captive.
brenton_translation: who will not be able to save themselves from war, but they themselves are led away captive.

fresh_translation: Hear me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of Israel, the ones being carried from the womb and being instructed from childhood.
brenton_translation: Hear me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of Israel, who are borne by me from the womb, and taught by me from infancy, even to old age:

fresh_translation: Until old age I am, and until you grow old I am. I bear with you; I made, and I will sustain; I will take up and save you.
brenton_translation: I am he; and until ye shall have grown old, I am he: I bear you, I have made, and I will relieve, I will take up and save you.

fresh_translation: To whom have you compared me? Look. Devise it, you who wander.
brenton_translation: To whom have ye compared me? see, consider, ye that go astray.

fresh_translation: Those pouring out gold from a purse and silver in a balance, they set it by weight, and hiring a goldsmith, they made things made by hands, and bending down they worship them.
brenton_translation: They that furnish gold out of a purse, and silver by weight, will weigh it in a scale, and they hire a goldsmith and make idols, and bow down, and worship them.

fresh_translation: They lift it on their shoulders and go. But if they set it in its place, it remains; it will certainly not move, and whoever cries out to it, it will certainly not hear; it will certainly not save him from evils.
brenton_translation: They bear it upon the shoulder, and go; and if they put it upon its place, it remains, it cannot move: and whosoever shall cry to it, it cannot hear; it cannot save him from trouble.

fresh_translation: Remember these things and groan. Repent, you who have been led astray; turn back in the heart.
brenton_translation: Remember ye these things, and groan: repent, ye that have gone astray, return in your heart;

fresh_translation: And remember the former things from the age, because I am God, and there is no other besides me.
brenton_translation: and remember the former things that were of old: for I am God, and there is none other beside me,

fresh_translation: Declaring beforehand the last things before they come to be, and at once they were completed. And I said, All my counsel will stand, and all the things I have planned I will do.
brenton_translation: telling beforehand the latter events before they come to pass, and they are accomplished together: and I said, All my counsel shall stand, and I will do all things that I have planned:

fresh_translation: Calling a bird from the east and from a far land the things concerning which I have planned. I spoke and brought it; I created and made it; I brought him and prospered his way.
brenton_translation: calling a bird from the east, and from a land afar off, for the things which I have planned: I have spoken, and brought him; I have created and made him; I have brought him, and prospered his way.

fresh_translation: Hear me, you who have lost the heart, you who are far from righteousness.
brenton_translation: Hearken to me, ye senseless ones, that are far from righteousness:

fresh_translation: I brought near my righteousness and the salvation that is from me. I will not delay. I have given salvation in Zion to Israel for glory.
brenton_translation: I have brought near my righteousness, and I will not be slow with the salvation that is from me: I have given salvation in Sion to Israel for glory.

fresh_translation: Come down. Sit upon the ground, virgin daughter of Babylon. Enter into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans, because no longer will you be called tender and delicate.
brenton_translation: Come down, sit on the ground, O virgin daughter of Babylon: sit on the ground, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and luxurious.

fresh_translation: Take a millstone. Grind flour. Uncover your veil; uncover your gray hairs; draw up your legs; cross rivers.
brenton_translation: Take a millstone, grind meal: remove thy veil, uncover thy white hairs, make bare the leg, pass through the rivers.

fresh_translation: Your shame will be uncovered; your reproaches will be seen. From you I will take justice; I will no longer hand you over to people.
brenton_translation: Thy shame shall be uncovered, thy reproaches shall be brought to light: I will exact of thee due vengeance, I will no longer deliver thee to men.

fresh_translation: The one who rescued you said: the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
brenton_translation: Thy deliverer is the Lord of hosts, the Holy One of Israel is his name.

fresh_translation: Sit pierced through. Enter into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans, because no longer will you be called strength of a kingdom.
brenton_translation: Sit thou down pierced with woe, go into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: thou shalt no more be called the strength of a kingdom.

fresh_translation: I was provoked against my people. You defiled my inheritance. I gave them into your hand, but you gave them no mercy; upon the elder you made the yoke very heavy.
brenton_translation: I have been provoked with my people; thou hast defiled mine inheritance: I gave them into thy hand, but thou didst not extend mercy to them: thou madest the yoke of the aged man very heavy,

fresh_translation: And you said, Forever I will be ruler. You did not consider these things in your heart, nor remember the last things.
brenton_translation: and saidst, I shall be a princess for ever: thou didst not perceive these things in thine heart, nor didst thou remember the latter end.

fresh_translation: Now hear these things, delicate one, the one sitting secure, the one saying in her heart, I am, and there is no other. I will not sit as a widow, nor know childlessness.
brenton_translation: But now hear these words, thou luxurious one, who art the one that sits at ease, that is secure, that says in her heart, I am, and there is not another; I shall not sit a widow, neither shall I know bereavement.

fresh_translation: But now these two things will come upon you suddenly in one day: widowhood and childlessness. They will come upon you suddenly in your sorcery, in the great strength of your spells, exceedingly.
brenton_translation: But now these two things shall come upon thee suddenly in one day, the loss of children and widowhood shall come suddenly upon thee, for thy sorcery, for the strength of thine enchantments,

fresh_translation: In the hope of your evil, for you said, I am, and there is no other. Know that the understanding of these things and your prostitution will be shame to you, and you said in your heart, I am, and there is no other.
brenton_translation: for thy trusting in wickedness: for thou saidst, I am, and there is not another: know thou, the understanding of these things and thy harlotry shall be thy shame; for thou saidst in thy heart, I am, and there is not another.

fresh_translation: And ruin will come upon you, and you will certainly not know the pit, and you will fall into it. Misery will come upon you, and you will not be able to become clean. Sudden ruin will come upon you, and you will certainly not know it.
brenton_translation: And destruction shall come upon thee, and thou shalt not be aware; there shall be a pit, and thou shalt fall into it: and grief shall come upon thee, and thou shalt not be able to be clear; and destruction shall come suddenly upon thee, and thou shalt not know.

fresh_translation: Stand now in your spells and in your much sorcery, which you learned from your youth, if you will be able to be helped.
brenton_translation: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the abundance of thy sorcery, which thou hast learned from thy youth; if thou canst be profited.
