fresh_translation: You have grown weary in your counsels. Let the astrologers of heaven stand and save you, those seeing the stars; let them announce to you what is about to come upon you.
brenton_translation: Thou art wearied in thy counsels. Let now the astrologers of the heaven stand and deliver thee, let them that see the stars tell thee what is about to come upon thee.

fresh_translation: See, all will be burned like brushwood in fire, and they will certainly not rescue their soul from flame, because you have coals of fire; sit upon them.
brenton_translation: Behold, they all shall be burnt up as sticks in the fire; neither shall they at all deliver their life from the flame. Because thou hast coals of fire, sit thou upon them;

fresh_translation: These will be your help. You labored in your trafficking from youth. Each man wandered by himself, but for you there will be no salvation.
brenton_translation: these shall be thy help. Thou hast wearied thyself with traffic from thy youth: every man has wandered to his own home, but thou shalt have no deliverance.

fresh_translation: Hear these things, house of Jacob, those called by the name Israel and those who came out from Judah, those swearing by the name of the Lord God of Israel, making mention not with truth nor with righteousness.
brenton_translation: Hear these words, ye house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and have come forth out of Juda, who swear by the name of the Lord God of Israel, making mention of it, but not with truth, nor with righteousness;

fresh_translation: and those holding fast to the name of the holy city and leaning on the God of Israel; the Lord of hosts is his name.
brenton_translation: maintaining also the name of the holy city, and staying themselves on the God of Israel: the Lord of hosts is his name. The former things I have already declared;

fresh_translation: The former things I declared even then, and from my mouth they went out and became heard. Suddenly I did them, and they came.
brenton_translation: and they have proceeded out of my mouth, and it became well known; I wrought suddenly, and the events came to pass.

fresh_translation: I know that you are hard, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your forehead is bronze.
brenton_translation: I know that thou art stubborn, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy forehead brazen.

fresh_translation: And I declared to you of old; before it came upon you, I made it heard to you, lest you say, My idols did them, and lest you say, My carved and cast things commanded me.
brenton_translation: And I told thee of old what should be before it came upon thee; I made it known to thee, lest thou shouldest say, My idols have done it for me; and shouldest say, My graven and molten images have commanded me.

fresh_translation: You heard all things, and you did not know. But I also made new things heard to you from now on, the things that are about to come to be, and you did not say.
brenton_translation: Ye have heard all this, but ye have not known: yet I have made known to thee the new things from henceforth, which are coming to pass, and thou saidst not,

fresh_translation: Now they come to be and not long ago, and in former days you did not hear them, lest you say, Yes, I know them.
brenton_translation: Now they come to pass, and not formerly: and thou heardest not of them in former days: say not thou, Yea, I know them.

fresh_translation: You neither knew nor understood, nor from the beginning did I open your ears, for I knew that in rejecting you would reject, and lawless from the womb you would be called.
brenton_translation: Thou hast neither known, nor understood, neither from the beginning have I opened thine ears: for I knew that thou wouldest surely deal treacherously, and wouldest be called a transgressor even from the womb.

fresh_translation: For the sake of my name I will show you my wrath, and my glorious things I will bring upon you, so that I do not destroy you.
brenton_translation: For mine own sake will I shew thee my wrath, and will bring before thee my glorious acts, that I may not utterly destroy thee.

fresh_translation: See, I have sold you, not for silver, but I rescued you from a furnace of poverty.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have sold thee, but not for silver; but I have rescued thee from the furnace of affliction.

fresh_translation: For my own sake I will do this for you, because my name is being profaned, and my glory I will not give to another.
brenton_translation: For mine own sake I will do this for thee, because my name is profaned; and I will not give my glory to another.

fresh_translation: Hear me, Jacob, and Israel whom I call. I am first, and I am forever.
brenton_translation: Hear me, O Jacob, and Israel whom I call; I am the first, and I endure for ever.

fresh_translation: My hand founded the earth, and my right hand fixed heaven. I will call them, and they will stand together.
brenton_translation: My hand also has founded the earth, and my right hand has fixed the sky: I will call them, and they shall stand together.

fresh_translation: And all will be gathered and will hear. Who declared these things to them? Loving you, I did your will against Babylon, to remove the seed of the Chaldeans.
brenton_translation: And all shall be gathered, and shall hear: who has told them these things? Out of love to thee I have fulfilled thy desire on Babylon, to abolish the seed of the Chaldeans.

fresh_translation: I spoke, I called, I brought him, and I prospered his way.
brenton_translation: I have spoken, I have called, I have brought him, and made his way prosperous.

fresh_translation: Come near to me and hear these things. Not from the beginning did I speak in secret, nor in a dark place of the earth. When it came to be, I was there. And now the Lord has sent me, and his Spirit.
brenton_translation: Draw nigh to me, and hear ye these words; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning: when it took place, there was I, and now the Lord, even the Lord, and his Spirit, hath sent me.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord, the one rescuing you, the Holy One of Israel: I am your God. I have shown you to find the way in which you will walk.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord that delivered thee, the Holy One of Israel; I am thy God, I have shewn thee how thou shouldest find the way wherein thou shouldest walk.

fresh_translation: And if you had heard my commandments, your peace would have become like a river and your righteousness like a wave of the sea.
brenton_translation: And if thou hadst hearkened to my commandments, then would thy peace have been like a river, and thy righteousness as a wave of the sea.

fresh_translation: And your seed would have become like the sand, and the offspring of your womb like the dust of the earth. Even now you would certainly not be destroyed, nor would your name perish before me.
brenton_translation: Thy seed also would have been as the sand, and the offspring of thy belly as the dust of the ground: neither now shalt thou by any means be utterly destroyed, neither shall thy name perish before me.

fresh_translation: Go out from Babylon, fleeing from the Chaldeans. Declare a voice of gladness, and let this be heard. Proclaim it to the end of the earth. Say, The Lord rescued his servant Jacob.
brenton_translation: Go forth of Babylon, thou that fleest from the Chaldeans: utter aloud a voice of joy, and let this be made known, proclaim it to the end of the earth; say ye, The Lord hath delivered his servant Jacob.

fresh_translation: And if they thirst, through a wilderness he will lead them; he will bring out water for them from a rock. A rock will be split, and water will flow, and my people will drink.
brenton_translation: And if they shall thirst, he shall lead them through the desert; he shall bring forth water to them out of the rock: the rock shall be cloven, and the water shall flow forth, and my people shall drink.

fresh_translation: There is no rejoicing for the ungodly, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: There is no joy, saith the Lord, to the ungodly.

fresh_translation: Hear me, islands, and pay attention, nations. Through much time it will stand, says the Lord. From my mother's womb he called my name.
brenton_translation: Hearken to me, ye islands; and attend, ye Gentiles; after a long time it shall come to pass, saith the Lord: from my mother's womb he has called my name:

fresh_translation: And he made my mouth like a sharp sword and hid me under the shelter of his hand. He made me like a chosen arrow and covered me in his quiver.
brenton_translation: and he has made my mouth as a sharp sword, and he has hid me under the shadow of his hand; he has made me as a choice shaft, and he has hid me in his quiver;

fresh_translation: And he said to me, You are my servant, Israel, and in you I will be glorified.
brenton_translation: and said to me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, and in thee I will be glorified.

fresh_translation: But I said, In vain I labored, and for emptiness and for nothing I gave my strength. Therefore my judgment is with the Lord, and my toil is before my God.
brenton_translation: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have given my strength for vanity and for nothing: therefore is my judgment with the Lord, and my labour before my God.

fresh_translation: And now thus says the Lord, the one forming me from the womb as servant to himself, to gather Jacob and Israel to him. I will be gathered and glorified before the Lord, and my God will be my strength.
brenton_translation: And now, thus saith the Lord that formed me from the womb to be his own servant, to gather Jacob to him and Israel. I shall be gathered and glorified before the Lord, and my God shall be my strength.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, It is a great thing for you to be called my servant, to establish the tribes of Jacob and turn back the dispersion of Israel. See, I have set you as a covenant of a race, as a light of nations, for you to be for salvation as far as the end of the earth.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, It is a great thing for thee to be called my servant, to establish the tribes of Jacob, and to recover the dispersion of Israel: behold, I have given thee for the covenant of a race, for a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation to the end of the earth.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord, the one rescuing you, the God of Israel: Sanctify the one despising his soul, the one abhorred by the nations, the servant of rulers. Kings will see him and rise; rulers also will worship him, because of the Lord, because the Holy One of Israel is faithful, and he chose you.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord that delivered thee, the God of Israel, Sanctify him that despises his life, him that is abhorred by the nations that are the servants of princes: kings shall behold him, and princes shall arise, and shall worship him, for the Lord's sake: for the Holy One of Israel is faithful, and I have chosen thee.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: In an acceptable time I heard you, and in a day of salvation I helped you, and I gave you as a covenant of nations, to establish the earth and inherit a deserted inheritance.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I succoured thee: and I have formed thee, and given thee for a covenant of the nations, to establish the earth, and to cause to inherit the desert heritages:

fresh_translation: saying to those in bonds, Come out, and to those in the darkness, Be revealed. On all their ways they will be pastured, and on all their paths will be their grazing.
brenton_translation: saying to them that are in bonds, Go forth; and bidding them that are in darkness shew themselves. They shall be fed in all the ways, and in all the paths shall be their pasture.

fresh_translation: They will not hunger nor thirst, nor will burning heat strike them, nor the sun, but the one having mercy on them will comfort them and lead them by springs of waters.
brenton_translation: They shall not hunger, neither shall they thirst; neither shall the heat nor the sun smite them; but he that has mercy on them shall comfort them, and by fountains of waters shall he lead them.

fresh_translation: And I will make every mountain into a road and every path into pasture for them.
brenton_translation: And I will make every mountain a way, and every path a pasture to them.

fresh_translation: See, these come from far away; these from the north, and these from the sea; and others from the land of the Persians.
brenton_translation: Behold, these shall come from far: and these from the north and the west, and others from the land of the Persians.

fresh_translation: Rejoice, heavens, and let the earth exult. Let the mountains break out in gladness, and the hills in righteousness, because God had mercy on his people and comforted the humble ones of his people.
brenton_translation: Rejoice, ye heavens; and let the earth be glad: let the mountains break forth with joy; for the Lord has had mercy on his people, and has comforted the lowly ones of his people.

fresh_translation: But Zion said, The Lord abandoned me, and the Lord forgot me.
brenton_translation: But Sion said, The Lord has forsaken me, and, The Lord has forgotten me.

fresh_translation: Will a woman forget her child, so as not to have mercy on the offspring of her womb? But even if a woman forgets these, I will not forget you, said the Lord.
brenton_translation: Will a woman forget her child, so as not to have compassion upon the offspring of her womb? but if a woman should even forget these, yet I will not forget thee, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: See, on my hands I have drawn your walls, and you are always before me.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have painted thy walls on my hands, and thou art continually before me.

fresh_translation: And quickly you will be built by those by whom you were torn down, and those making you desolate will go out from you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt soon be built by those by whom thou wert destroyed, and they that made thee desolate shall go forth of thee.

fresh_translation: Lift your eyes around and see. See, all have been gathered and have come to you. As I live, says the Lord, you will clothe yourself with them all and put them on as an ornament of a bride.
brenton_translation: Lift up thine eyes round about, and look on them all; behold, they are gathered together, and are come to thee. As I live, saith the Lord, thou shalt clothe thyself with them all as with an ornament, and put them on as a bride her attire.

fresh_translation: Because your desolate places and ruined and fallen places will now be made too narrow because of those dwelling there, and those swallowing you will be far from you.
brenton_translation: For thy desert and marred and ruined places shall now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that devoured thee shall be removed far from thee.

fresh_translation: For your sons whom you lost will say in your ears, The place is too narrow for me; make room for me so that I may dwell.
brenton_translation: For thy sons whom thou hast lost shall say in thine ears, The place is too narrow for me: make room for me that I may dwell.

fresh_translation: And you will say in your heart, Who bore these for me? But I was childless and a widow; who raised these for me? But I was left alone; where were these for me?
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say in thine heart, Who has begotten me these? whereas I was childless, and a widow; but who has brought up these for me? and I was left alone; but whence came these to me?

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: See, I lift my hand to the nations and raise my signal to the islands, and they will bring your sons in the bosom, and your daughters they will carry upon shoulders.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, even the Lord, Behold, I lift up mine hand to the nations, and I will lift up my signal to the islands: and they shall bring thy sons in their bosom, and shall bear thy daughters on their shoulders.

fresh_translation: And kings will be your foster fathers and rulers your nurses. With their faces to the ground they will worship you and lick the dust of your feet, and you will know that I am the Lord, and you will not be ashamed.
brenton_translation: And kings shall be thy nursing-fathers, and their princesses thy nurses, they shall bow down to thee on the face of the earth, and shall lick the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord, and they that wait on me shall not be ashamed.

fresh_translation: Will anyone take spoils from a giant? And if someone takes captive unjustly, will he be saved?
brenton_translation: Will any one take spoils from a giant? and if one should take a man captive unjustly, shall he be delivered?

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: If anyone takes captive a giant, he will take spoils; but one taking from a strong one will be saved. I will judge your judgment, and I will rescue your sons.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, If one should take a giant captive, he shall take spoils, and he who takes them from a mighty man shall be delivered: for I will plead thy cause, and I will deliver thy children.

fresh_translation: And those afflicting you will eat their own flesh and drink their blood like new wine and be drunk. And all flesh will know that I am the Lord, the one rescuing you and upholding the strength of Jacob.
brenton_translation: And they that afflicted thee shall eat their own flesh; and they shall drink their own blood as new wine, and shall be drunken: and all flesh shall perceive that I am the Lord that delivers thee, and that upholds the strength of Jacob.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: What is the book of divorce of your mother, with which I sent her away? Or to which creditor have I sold you? See, by your sins you were sold, and by your lawless deeds I sent away your mother.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Of what kind is your mother's bill of divorcement, by which I put her away? or to which debtor have I sold you? Behold, ye are sold for your sins, and for your iniquities have I put your mother away.

fresh_translation: Why was there no man when I came? I called, and there was no one obeying. Is my hand not strong enough to rescue, or am I not strong enough to deliver? See, by my threat I will desolate the sea and make rivers deserts; their fish will dry up because there is no water and will die in thirst.
brenton_translation: Why did I come, and there was no man? why did I call, and there was none to hearken? Is not my hand strong to redeem? or can I not deliver? behold, by my rebuke I will dry up the sea, and make rivers a wilderness; and their fish shall be dried up because there is no water, and shall die for thirst.

fresh_translation: And I will clothe heaven with darkness and make its covering like sackcloth.
brenton_translation: I will clothe the sky with darkness, and will make its covering as sackcloth.

fresh_translation: The Lord gives me a tongue of instruction, to know in season when it is necessary to speak a word. He set it for me in the morning; he added an ear for me to hear.
brenton_translation: The Lord even God gives me the tongue of instruction, to know when it is fit to speak a word: he has appointed for me early, he has given me an ear to hear:

fresh_translation: And the instruction of the Lord opens my ears, and I do not disobey nor speak against.
brenton_translation: and the instruction of the Lord, even the Lord, opens mine ears, and I do not disobey, nor dispute.

fresh_translation: I have given my back to whips and my cheeks to slaps. My face I did not turn away from the shame of spit.
brenton_translation: I gave my back to scourges, and my cheeks to blows; and I turned not away my face from the shame of spitting:

fresh_translation: And the Lord became my helper. Therefore I was not ashamed, but I set my face like a solid rock and knew that I certainly would not be shamed.
brenton_translation: but the Lord God became my helper; therefore I was not ashamed, but I set my face as a solid rock; and I know that I shall never be ashamed,

fresh_translation: Because the one justifying me comes near. Who is contending with me? Let him stand against me together. And who is contending with me? Let him come near me.
brenton_translation: for he that has justified me draws near; who is he that pleads with me? let him stand up against me at the same time: yea, who is he that pleads with me? let him draw nigh to me.

fresh_translation: See, the Lord helps me. Who will harm me? See, all of you will grow old like a garment, and a moth will devour you.
brenton_translation: Behold, the Lord, the Lord, will help me; who will hurt me? behold, all ye shall wax old as a garment, and a moth shall devour you.

fresh_translation: Who among you fears the Lord? Let him hear the voice of his servant. You who walk in darkness and have no light, trust in the name of the Lord and lean on God.
brenton_translation: Who is among you that fears the Lord? let him hearken to the voice of his servant: ye that walk in darkness, and have no light, trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon God.

fresh_translation: See, all of you kindle fire and strengthen a flame. Walk by the light of your fire and by the flame that you kindled. Because of me these things came to you; in grief you will lie down.
brenton_translation: Behold, ye all kindle a fire, and feed a flame: walk in the light of your fire, and in the flame which ye have kindled. This has happened to you for my sake; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

fresh_translation: Hear me, you who pursue righteousness and seek the Lord. Look to the solid rock that you cut and to the pit of the cistern that you dug.
brenton_translation: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, and seek the Lord: look to the solid rock, which ye have hewn, and to the hole of the pit which ye have dug.

fresh_translation: Look to Abraham your father and to Sarah who labored with you, because he was one, and I called him and blessed him and loved him and multiplied him.
brenton_translation: Look to Abraam your father, and to Sarrha that bore you: for he was alone when I called him, and blessed him, and loved him, and multiplied him.

fresh_translation: And now I will comfort you, Zion, and have comforted all her desolate places, and I will make her desolate places like the paradise of the Lord. They will find gladness and exultation in her, thanksgiving and a sound of praise.
brenton_translation: And now I will comfort thee, O Sion: and I have comforted all her desert places; and I will make her desert places as a garden, and her western places as the garden of the Lord; they shall find in her gladness and exultation, thanksgiving and the voice of praise.

fresh_translation: Hear me, hear me, my people, and you kings, give ear to me, because law will go out from me and my judgment as a light of nations.
brenton_translation: Hear me, hear me, my people; and ye kings, hearken to me: for a law shall proceed from me, and my judgment shall be for a light of the nations.

fresh_translation: My righteousness draws near quickly, my salvation will go out like light, and nations will hope in my arm. Islands wait for me and hope in my arm.
brenton_translation: My righteousness speedily draws nigh, and my salvation shall go forth as light, and on mine arm shall the Gentiles trust: the isles shall wait for me, and on mine arm shall they trust.

fresh_translation: Lift your eyes to heaven and look at the earth below, because heaven was fixed like smoke and the earth will grow old like a garment, and those dwelling on the earth will die like these things. But my salvation will be forever and my righteousness will certainly not fail.
brenton_translation: Lift up your eyes to the sky, and look on the earth beneath: for the sky was darkened like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and the inhabitants shall die in like manner: but my righteousness shall not fail.

fresh_translation: Hear me, you who know judgment, my people, in whose heart is my law. Do not fear the reproach of men and do not be defeated by their contempt.
brenton_translation: Hear me, ye that know judgment, the people in whose heart is my law: fear not the reproach of men, and be not overcome by their contempt.

fresh_translation: For like a garment it will be eaten by time, and like wool it will be eaten by a moth. But my righteousness will be forever and my salvation will be to the generations of generations.
brenton_translation: For as a garment will be devoured by time, and as wool will be devoured by a moth, so shall they be consumed; but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation for all generations.

fresh_translation: Awake, awake, Jerusalem, and put on the strength of your arm. Awake as in the beginning of days, as a generation of old. Are you not
brenton_translation: Awake, awake, O Jerusalem, and put on the strength of thine arm; awake as in the early time, as the ancient generation.

fresh_translation: the one desolating the sea, the water, the abundance of the abyss, the one making the depths of the sea a way of passage for the rescued?
brenton_translation: Art thou not it that dried the sea, the water, even the abundance of the deep; that made the depths of the sea a way of passage for the delivered and redeemed?

fresh_translation: For those redeemed by the Lord will return and come to Zion with gladness, and everlasting exultation will be upon their head. Exultation and praise and gladness will overtake them. Pain and grief and groaning have fled.
brenton_translation: for by the help of the Lord they shall return, and come to Sion with joy and everlasting exultation, for praise and joy shall come upon their head: pain, and grief, and groaning, have fled away.

fresh_translation: I am, I am the one comforting you. Know whom you dreaded, whom you feared: mortal man and a son of man, who dried up like grass.
brenton_translation: I, even I, am he that comforts thee: consider who thou art, that thou wast afraid of mortal man, and of the son of man, who are withered as grass.

fresh_translation: And you forgot the God who made you, who made heaven and founded the earth, and you feared always, all the days, the face of the wrath of the one afflicting you, because he planned to remove you. And now where is the wrath of the one afflicting you?
brenton_translation: And thou hast forgotten God who made thee, who made the sky and founded the earth; and thou wert continually afraid because of the wrath of him that afflicted thee: for whereas he counselled to take thee away, yet now where is the wrath of him that afflicted thee?

fresh_translation: For when you are being saved you will not stand still nor delay.
brenton_translation: For in thy deliverance he shall not halt, nor tarry;

fresh_translation: Because I am your God, the one stirring the sea and making its waves roar. The Lord of hosts is my name.
brenton_translation: for I am thy God, that troubles the sea, and causes the waves thereof to roar: the Lord of hosts is my name.

fresh_translation: I will put my words into your mouth, and under the shadow of my hand I will shelter you, by which I set heaven and founded the earth, and will say to Zion, You are my people.
brenton_translation: I will put my words into thy mouth, and I will shelter thee under the shadow of mine hand, with which I fixed the sky, and founded the earth: and the Lord shall say to Sion, Thou art my people.

fresh_translation: Awake, awake. Rise, Jerusalem, you who drank the cup of wrath from the hand of the Lord, because the cup of falling, the bowl of wrath, you drank and drained.
brenton_translation: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, that hast drunk at the hand of the Lord the cup of his fury: for thou hast drunk out and drained the cup of calamity, the cup of wrath:

fresh_translation: And there was no one to comfort you from among all your children whom you bore, and no one to take your hand from among all your sons whom you raised.
brenton_translation: and there was none to comfort thee of all the children whom thou borest; and there was none to take hold of thine hand, not even of all the children whom thou hast reared.

fresh_translation: These two things are set against you. Who will grieve with you? Ruin and crushing, famine and sword. Who will comfort you?
brenton_translation: Wherefore these things are against thee; who shall sympathise with thee in thy grief? downfall, and destruction, famine, and sword: who shall comfort thee?

fresh_translation: Your sons are in distress, sleeping at the edge of every street, like a half-boiled beet, full of the wrath of the Lord, weakened by the Lord God.
brenton_translation: Thy sons are the perplexed ones, that sleep at the top of every street as a half-boiled beet; they that are full of the anger of the Lord, caused to faint by the Lord God.

fresh_translation: Therefore hear this, humbled one and drunken one, not from wine.
brenton_translation: Therefore hear, thou afflicted one, and drunken, but not with wine;

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord God, the one judging his people: See, I have taken from your hand the cup of falling, the bowl of wrath, and you will no longer drink it.
brenton_translation: thus saith the Lord God that judges his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of calamity, the cup of my wrath; and thou shalt not drink it any more.

fresh_translation: And I will put it into the hands of those who wronged you and humbled you, who said to your soul, Bend down so we may pass by. And you made your back level with the ground for those passing by outside.
brenton_translation: And I will give it into the hands of them that injured thee, and them that afflicted thee; who said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may pass over: and thou didst level thy body with the ground to them passing by without.

fresh_translation: Awake, awake, Zion. Put on your strength, Zion, and put on your glory, Jerusalem, the holy city, because the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer pass through you.
brenton_translation: Awake, awake, Sion; put on thy strength, O Sion; and do thou put on thy glory, Jerusalem the holy city: there shall no more pass through thee the uncircumcised and unclean.

fresh_translation: Shake off the dust and rise. Sit, Jerusalem. Strip off the bond of your neck, captive daughter of Zion.
brenton_translation: Shake off the dust and arise; sit down, Jerusalem: put off the band of thy neck, captive daughter of Sion.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord: You were sold for nothing, and not with silver will you be redeemed.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, Ye have been sold for nought; and ye shall not be ransomed with silver.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: My people first went down to Egypt to dwell there, and to the Assyrians they were led by force.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, My people went down before to Egypt to sojourn there; and were carried away forcibly to the Assyrians.

fresh_translation: And now why are you here? says the Lord, because my people were taken for nothing. Be amazed and howl, says the Lord. Because of you continually my name is blasphemed among the nations.
brenton_translation: And now why are ye here? Thus saith the Lord, Because my people was taken for nothing, wonder ye and howl. Thus saith the Lord, On account of you my name is continually blasphemed among the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: Therefore my people will know my name in that day, because I am he, the one speaking; I am present.
brenton_translation: Therefore shall my people know my name in that day, for I am he that speaks: I am present,

fresh_translation: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of one bringing good news, a report of peace, of one bringing good things as good news, because I will make your salvation heard, saying to Zion, Your God will reign.
brenton_translation: as a season of beauty upon the mountains, as the feet of one preaching glad tidings of peace, as one preaching good news: for I will publish thy salvation, saying, O Sion, thy God shall reign.

fresh_translation: Because the voice of your watchmen was lifted up, and with one voice together they will rejoice, because eye to eye they will see when the Lord shows mercy to Zion.
brenton_translation: For the voice of them that guard thee is exalted, and with the voice together they shall rejoice: for eyes shall look to eyes, when the Lord shall have mercy upon Sion.

fresh_translation: Let the desolate places of Jerusalem break out together in gladness, because the Lord had mercy on her and rescued Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Let the waste places of Jerusalem break forth in joy together, because the Lord has had mercy upon her, and has delivered Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: The Lord will uncover his holy arm before all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation from God.
brenton_translation: And the Lord shall reveal his holy arm in the sight of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation that comes from our God.

fresh_translation: Depart, depart. Go out from there, and touch nothing unclean. Go out from the midst of her. Be set apart, you who carry the vessels of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Depart ye, depart, go out from thence, and touch not the unclean thing; go ye out from the midst of her; separate yourselves, ye that bear the vessels of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because not with turmoil will you go out, nor will you go in flight, for the Lord will go before you, and the Lord God of Israel will gather you.
brenton_translation: For ye shall not go forth with tumult, neither go by flight: for the Lord shall go first in advance of you; and the God of Israel shall be he that brings up your rear.

fresh_translation: See, my servant will understand and be exalted and glorified very greatly.
brenton_translation: Behold, my servant shall understand, and be exalted, and glorified exceedingly.

fresh_translation: Just as many will be astonished at you, so your appearance will be without glory before men, and your glory will be without honor before people.
brenton_translation: As many shall be amazed at thee, so shall thy face be without glory from men, and thy glory shall not be honoured by the sons of men.

fresh_translation: So many nations will marvel at him, and kings will shut their mouth, because those to whom nothing was told concerning him will see, and those who did not hear will understand.
brenton_translation: Thus shall many nations wonder at him; and kings shall keep their mouths shut: for they to whom no report was brought concerning him, shall see; and they who have not heard, shall consider.

fresh_translation: O Lord, who believed our report? And to whom was the arm of the Lord revealed?
brenton_translation: O Lord, who has believed our report? and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

fresh_translation: We announced before him like a child, like a root in a thirsty land. There is no form to him nor glory, and we saw him, and he had no form nor beauty.
brenton_translation: We brought a report as of a child before him; he is as a root in a thirsty land: he has no form nor comeliness; and we saw him, but he had no form nor beauty.

fresh_translation: But his form was dishonored, failing beyond all men: a man in a wound and knowing how to bear sickness, because his face has turned away; he was dishonored and not counted.
brenton_translation: But his form was ignoble, and inferior to that of the children of men; he was a man in suffering, and acquainted with the bearing of sickness, for his face is turned from us: he was dishonoured, and not esteemed.

fresh_translation: This one bears our sins and suffers pain for us, and we counted him to be in pain and in wound and in affliction.
brenton_translation: He bears our sins, and is pained for us: yet we accounted him to be in trouble, and in suffering, and in affliction.

fresh_translation: But he was wounded because of our lawless deeds and weakened because of our sins. The discipline of our peace was upon him; by his bruise we were healed.
brenton_translation: But he was wounded on account of our sins, and was bruised because of our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and by his bruises we were healed.

fresh_translation: All we like sheep wandered. Each man wandered in his own way, and the Lord gave him over for our sins.
brenton_translation: All we as sheep have gone astray; every one has gone astray in his way; and the Lord gave him up for our sins.

fresh_translation: And he, because he was afflicted, does not open his mouth. As a sheep was led to slaughter and as a lamb is silent before the one shearing it, so he does not open his mouth.
brenton_translation: And he, because of his affliction, opens not his mouth: he was led as a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is dumb, so he opens not his mouth.

fresh_translation: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away. Who will tell his generation? Because his life is taken from the earth; because of the lawless deeds of my people he was led to death.
brenton_translation: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken away from the earth: because of the iniquities of my people he was led to death.

fresh_translation: And I will give wicked ones for his burial and rich ones for his death, because he did no lawlessness, nor was deceit found in his mouth.
brenton_translation: And I will give the wicked for his burial, and the rich for his death; for he practised no iniquity, nor craft with his mouth.

fresh_translation: And the Lord desires to cleanse him from the wound. If you give concerning sin, your soul will see long-lived seed, and the Lord desires to take away
brenton_translation: The Lord also is pleased to purge him from his stroke. If ye can give an offering for sin, your soul shall see a long-lived seed:

fresh_translation: from the pain of his soul, to show him light and form with understanding, to justify a righteous one serving many well, and he himself will bear their sins.
brenton_translation: the Lord also is pleased to take away from the travail of his soul, to shew him light, and to form him with understanding; to justify the just one who serves many well; and he shall bear their sins.

fresh_translation: Therefore he will inherit many and divide spoils of the strong, because his soul was given over to death and he was counted among lawless ones, and he bore sins of many and was given over because of their sins.
brenton_translation: Therefore he shall inherit many, and he shall divide the spoils of the mighty; because his soul was delivered to death: and he was numbered among the transgressors; and he bore the sins of many, and was delivered because of their iniquities.

fresh_translation: Rejoice, barren one who does not bear. Break out and cry, you who are not in labor, because the children of the desolate one are more than those of the one having a husband, for the Lord has said.
brenton_translation: Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that dost not travail: for more are the children of the desolate than of her that has a husband: for the Lord has said,

fresh_translation: Enlarge the place of your tent, and fix your curtains. Do not spare. Lengthen your cords and strengthen your pegs.
brenton_translation: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and of thy curtains: fix the pins, spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy pins;

fresh_translation: Still to the right and to the left spread out, and your seed will inherit nations and inhabit desolate cities.
brenton_translation: spread forth thy tent yet to the right and the left: for thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and thou shalt make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

fresh_translation: Do not fear, because you were put to shame; do not be disgraced, because you were reproached, because you will forget everlasting shame and no longer remember the reproach of your widowhood.
brenton_translation: Fear not, because thou hast been put to shame, neither be confounded, because thou wast reproached: for thou shalt forget thy former shame, and shalt no more at all remember the reproach of thy widowhood.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord is the one making you; the Lord of hosts is his name, and the one rescuing you, the God of Israel, will be called the God of all the earth.
brenton_translation: For it is the Lord that made thee; the Lord of hosts is his name: and he that delivered thee, he is the God of Israel, and shall be called so by the whole earth.

fresh_translation: The Lord has not called you as a woman forsaken and fainthearted, nor as a woman hated from youth, said your God.
brenton_translation: The Lord has not called thee as a deserted and faint-hearted woman, nor as a woman hated from her youth, saith thy God.

fresh_translation: For a small time I left you, and with great mercy I will have mercy on you.
brenton_translation: For a little while I left thee: but with great mercy will I have compassion upon thee.

fresh_translation: In a little wrath I turned my face from you, and with everlasting mercy I will have mercy on you, said the Lord, the one rescuing you.
brenton_translation: In a little wrath I turned away my face from thee; but with everlasting mercy will I have compassion upon thee, saith the Lord that delivers thee.

fresh_translation: This is to me like the water in Noah's time, just as I swore to him at that time not to be angry with the earth. So neither will I be angry with you anymore nor threaten you.
brenton_translation: From the time of the water of Noe this is my purpose: as I sware to him at that time, saying of the earth, I will no more be wroth with thee, neither when thou art threatened,

fresh_translation: Mountains may be moved and your hills shaken, but my mercy for you will not fail, and the covenant of your peace will not be moved, says the Lord, being gracious to you.
brenton_translation: shall the mountains depart, nor shall thy hills be removed: so neither shall my mercy fail thee, nor shall the covenant of thy peace be at all removed: for the Lord who is gracious to thee has spoken it.

fresh_translation: Afflicted and unstable one, you were not comforted. See, I prepare your stone as carbuncle and your foundations with sapphire.
brenton_translation: Afflicted and outcast thou hast not been comforted: behold, I will prepare carbuncle for thy stones, and sapphire for thy foundations;

fresh_translation: And I will make your battlements jasper and your gates stones of crystal and your enclosure chosen stones.
brenton_translation: and I will make thy buttresses jasper, and thy gates crystal, and thy border precious stones.

fresh_translation: And all your sons will be taught by God, and your children will be in much peace.
brenton_translation: And I will cause all thy sons to be taught of God, and thy children to be in great peace.

fresh_translation: And in righteousness you will be built. Keep far from injustice and you will not fear, and terror will not come near you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt be built in righteousness: abstain from injustice, and thou shalt not fear; and trembling shall not come nigh thee.

fresh_translation: See, strangers will come to you through me and will flee for refuge to you.
brenton_translation: Behold, strangers shall come to thee by me, and shall sojourn with thee, and shall run to thee for refuge.

fresh_translation: See, I create you, not as a smith blowing coals and bringing out a vessel for work; but I created you, not for destruction to ruin.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have created thee, not as the coppersmith blowing coals, and bringing out a vessel fit for work; but I have created thee, not for ruin, that I should destroy thee.

fresh_translation: Every harmful weapon against you I will not prosper, and every voice that rises against you in judgment you will defeat them all. But those guilty against you will be in it. This is the inheritance for those serving the Lord, and you will be righteous to me, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: I will not suffer any weapon formed against thee to prosper; and every voice that shall rise up against thee for judgment, thou shalt vanquish them all; and thine adversaries shall be condemned thereby. There is an inheritance to them that serve the Lord, and ye shall be righteous before me, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: You who thirst, go to water. And as many as do not have silver, go, buy, and drink wine and fat without silver and price.
brenton_translation: Ye that thirst, go to the water, and all that have no money, go and buy; and eat and drink wine and fat without money or price.

fresh_translation: Why do you spend silver and your labor for what does not satisfy? Hear me and eat good things, and your soul will delight in good things.
brenton_translation: Wherefore do ye value at the price of money, and give your labour for that which will not satisfy? hearken to me, and ye shall eat that which is good, and your soul shall feast itself on good things.

fresh_translation: Pay attention with your ears and follow my ways. Hear me, and your soul will live in good things, and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, the faithful holy things of David.
brenton_translation: Give heed with your ears, and follow my ways: hearken to me, and your soul shall live in prosperity; and I will make with you an everlasting covenant, the sure mercies of David.

fresh_translation: See, I have given him as a witness among nations, a ruler and commander to nations.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have made him a testimony among the Gentiles, a prince and commander to the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: Nations that did not know you will call upon you, and peoples that do not understand you will flee for refuge to you, because of your God, the Holy One of Israel, because he glorified you.
brenton_translation: Nations which know thee not, shall call upon thee, and peoples which are not acquainted with thee, shall flee to thee for refuge, for the sake of the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified thee.

fresh_translation: Seek God, and when you find him, call upon him when he draws near to you.
brenton_translation: Seek ye the Lord, and when ye find him, call upon him; and when he shall draw nigh to you,

fresh_translation: Let the ungodly man leave his ways and the lawless man his counsels, and let him turn to the Lord, and he will receive mercy, because he will abundantly forgive your sins.
brenton_translation: let the ungodly leave his ways, and the transgressor his counsels: and let him return to the Lord, and he shall find mercy; for he shall abundantly pardon your sins.

fresh_translation: For my counsels are not like your counsels, nor are my ways like your ways, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: For my counsels are not as your counsels, nor are my ways as your ways, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: But as heaven is far from the earth, so my way is far from your ways and your thoughts from my mind.
brenton_translation: But as the heaven is distant from the earth, so is my way distant from your ways, and your thoughts from my mind.

fresh_translation: For as rain or snow comes down from heaven and will not return until it drenches the earth and brings forth and sprouts and gives seed to the sower and bread for food,
brenton_translation: For as rain shall come down, or snow, from heaven, and shall not return until it have saturated the earth, and it bring forth, and bud, and give seed to the sower, and bread for food:

fresh_translation: so will my word be, whatever goes out from my mouth: it will not return until all I desired is accomplished, and I will prosper your ways and my commandments.
brenton_translation: so shall my word be, whatever shall proceed out of my mouth, it shall by no means turn back, until all the things which I willed shall have been accomplished; and I will make thy ways prosperous, and will effect my commands.

fresh_translation: For in gladness you will go out and in joy you will be taught. For the mountains and hills will leap, awaiting you with joy, and all the trees of the field will clap with branches.
brenton_translation: For ye shall go forth with joy, and shall be taught with gladness: for the mountains and the hills shall exult to welcome you with joy, and all the trees of the field shall applaud with their branches.

fresh_translation: And instead of stubble a cypress will come up, and instead of nettle a myrtle will come up, and the Lord will be for a name and for an everlasting sign and will not fail.
brenton_translation: And instead of the bramble shall come up the cypress, and instead of the nettle shall come up the myrtle: and the Lord shall be for a name, and for an everlasting sign, and shall not fail.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Keep judgment. Do righteousness, because my salvation has drawn near to come and my mercy to be revealed.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my mercy to be revealed.

fresh_translation: Blessed is the man doing these things and the person holding them fast, keeping the Sabbaths and not profaning them, and keeping his hands from doing wrongdoing.
brenton_translation: Blessed is the man that does these things, and the man that holds by them, and keeps the sabbaths from profaning them, and keeps his hands from doing unrighteousness.

fresh_translation: Let not the foreigner joined to the Lord say, The Lord will surely separate me from his people. And let not the eunuch say, I am a dry tree.
brenton_translation: Let not the stranger who attaches himself to the Lord, say, Surely the Lord will separate me from his people: and let not the eunuch say, I am a dry tree.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord to the eunuchs: As many as keep my Sabbaths and choose what I want and hold fast my covenant,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord to the eunuchs, as many as shall keep my sabbaths, and choose the things which I take pleasure in, and take hold of my covenant;

fresh_translation: I will give them in my house and within my wall a notable place, better than sons and daughters. I will give them an everlasting name and it will not fail.
brenton_translation: I will give to them in my house and within my walls an honourable place, better than sons and daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, and it shall not fail.

fresh_translation: And to the foreigners joined to the Lord to serve him and to love the name of the Lord, so as to be his male and female servants, and all those keeping my Sabbaths and not profaning them and holding fast my covenant,
brenton_translation: And I will give it to the strangers that attach themselves to the Lord, to serve him, and to love the name of the Lord, to be to him servants and handmaids; and as for all that keep my sabbaths from profaning them, and that take hold of my covenant;

fresh_translation: I will bring them to my holy mountain and gladden them in the house of my prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and sacrifices will be acceptable on my altar, for my house will be called a house of prayer for all nations.
brenton_translation: I will bring them to my holy mountain, and gladden them in my house of prayer: their whole-burnt-offerings and their sacrifices shall be acceptable upon mine altar; for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations,

fresh_translation: The Lord who gathers the scattered ones of Israel says, I will gather an assembly to him.
brenton_translation: saith the Lord that gathers the dispersed of Israel; for I will gather to him a congregation.

fresh_translation: All the wild beasts, come, eat; all the beasts of the forest.
brenton_translation: All ye beasts of the field, come, devour, all ye beasts of the forest.

fresh_translation: See that all have been blinded; they did not know how to understand. All are mute dogs, unable to bark, dreaming of a bed, loving to sleep.
brenton_translation: See how they are all blinded: they have not known; they are dumb dogs that will not bark; dreaming of rest, loving to slumber.

fresh_translation: And the dogs are shameless in soul, not knowing fullness, and they are evil, not knowing understanding. All have followed their own ways, each according to his own.
brenton_translation: Yea, they are insatiable dogs, that know not what it is to be filled, and they are wicked, having no understanding: all have followed their own ways, each according to his own will.

fresh_translation: See how a righteous man perished and no one takes it to heart, and righteous men are taken away and no one understands, because from the face of injustice a righteous man is taken away.
brenton_translation: See how the just man has perished, and no one lays it to heart: and righteous men are taken away, and no one considers: for the righteous has been removed out of the way of injustice.

fresh_translation: His burial will be in peace; he has been taken from the midst.
brenton_translation: His burial shall be in peace: he has been removed out of the way.

fresh_translation: But you, come here, lawless sons, seed of adulterers and a prostitute.
brenton_translation: But draw ye near hither, ye lawless children, the seed of adulterers and the harlot.

fresh_translation: In whom did you delight yourselves? Against whom did you open your mouth and let loose your tongue? Are you not children of destruction, lawless seed,
brenton_translation: Wherein have ye been rioting? and against whom have ye opened your mouth, and against whom have ye loosed your tongue? are ye not children of perdition? a lawless seed?

fresh_translation: calling upon idols under leafy trees, slaughtering your children in ravines between rocks?
brenton_translation: who call upon idols under the leafy trees, slaying your children in the valleys among the rocks?

fresh_translation: That is your portion. This is your lot. To them you poured drink offerings; to them you brought sacrifices. Shall I not be angry over these things?
brenton_translation: That is thy portion, this is thy lot: and to them hast thou poured forth drink-offerings, and to these hast thou offered meat-offerings. Shall I not therefore be angry for these things?

fresh_translation: On a high and lofty mountain, there is your bed; there you brought up sacrifices.
brenton_translation: On a lofty and high mountain, there is thy bed, and thither thou carriedst up thy meat-offerings:

fresh_translation: And behind the doorposts of your door you set your memorials. You thought that if you departed from me you would have something more. You loved those sleeping with you.
brenton_translation: and behind the posts of thy door thou didst place thy memorials. Didst thou think that if thou shouldest depart from me, thou wouldest gain? thou hast loved those that lay with thee;

fresh_translation: And you multiplied your prostitution with them and made many far from you, and sent messengers beyond your borders and turned away and were humbled as far as Hades.
brenton_translation: and thou hast multiplied thy whoredom with them, and thou hast increased the number of them that are far from thee, and hast sent ambassadors beyond thy borders, and hast been debased even to hell.

fresh_translation: In your many ways you labored and did not say, I will stop. Because you kept strengthening yourself, therefore you did not plead with me.
brenton_translation: Thou hast wearied thyself with thy many ways; yet thou saidst not, I will cease to strengthen myself: for thou hast done these things; therefore thou hast not supplicated me.

fresh_translation: Whom did you respect and fear and lie to me, and not remember me, nor take me into your mind or heart? And I, seeing you, overlooked it, and you did not fear me.
brenton_translation: Through dread of whom hast thou feared, and lied against me, and hast not remembered, nor considered me, nor regarded me, yea, though when I see thee I pass thee by, yet thou hast not feared me.

fresh_translation: But I will declare my righteousness and your evils, which will not profit you.
brenton_translation: And I will declare thy righteousness, and thy sins, which shall not profit thee.

fresh_translation: When you cry out, let them deliver you in your distress; for wind will take all these and storm will carry them away. But those holding fast to me will possess land and inherit my holy mountain.
brenton_translation: When thou criest out, let them deliver thee in thine affliction: for all these the wind shall take, and the tempest shall carry them away: but they that cleave to me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain.

fresh_translation: And they will say, Clear the roads before him and remove obstacles from the way of my people.
brenton_translation: And they shall say, Clear the ways before him, and take up the stumbling-blocks out of the way of my people.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord Most High, the one dwelling in the heights forever: Holy among holy ones is his name, the Lord Most High, resting among holy ones and giving patience to the fainthearted and giving life to those crushed in heart.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Most High, who dwells on high for ever, Holy in the holies, is his name, the Most High resting in the holies, and giving patience to the faint-hearted, and giving life to the broken-hearted:

fresh_translation: Not forever will I avenge you, nor will I be angry with you always, for spirit from me will go out, and I made every breath.
brenton_translation: I will not take vengeance on you for ever, neither will I be always angry with you: for my Spirit shall go forth from me, and I have created all breath.

fresh_translation: Because of sin I grieved him for a little while and struck him and turned my face away from him, and he was grieved and went gloomy in his ways.
brenton_translation: On account of sin for a little while I grieved him, and smote him, and turned away my face from him; and he was grieved, and he went on sorrowful in his ways.

fresh_translation: I have seen his ways and healed him and comforted him and gave him true comfort.
brenton_translation: I have seen his ways, and healed him, and comforted him, and given him true comfort;

fresh_translation: Peace upon peace to those far and to those near, and the Lord said, I will heal them.
brenton_translation: peace upon peace to them that are far off, and to them that are nigh: and the Lord has said, I will heal them.

fresh_translation: But unrighteous ones will thus be shaken and will not be able to rest.
brenton_translation: But the unrighteous shall be tossed as troubled waves, and shall not be able to rest.

fresh_translation: There is no rejoicing for the ungodly, said the Lord God.
brenton_translation: There is no joy to the ungodly, said God.

fresh_translation: Cry out with strength and do not spare. Lift your voice like a trumpet and announce to my people their sins and to the house of Jacob their lawless deeds.
brenton_translation: Cry aloud, and spare not; lift up thy voice as with a trumpet, and declare to my people their sins, and to the house of Jacob their iniquities.

fresh_translation: They seek me day after day and want to know my ways, as a people that has done righteousness and not forsaken the judgment of their God. They ask me now for righteous judgment and desire to draw near to God.
brenton_translation: They seek me day by day, and desire to know my ways, as a people that had done righteousness, and had not forsaken the judgment of their God: they now ask of me righteous judgment, and desire to draw nigh to God,

fresh_translation: saying, Why did we fast and you did not see? We humbled our souls and you did not know. For in the days of your fasts you find your own desires and goad all those under your hands.
brenton_translation: saying, Why have we fasted, and thou regardest not? why have we afflicted our souls, and thou didst not know it?

fresh_translation: If you fast for judgments and fights and strike the humble one with fists, why do you fast to me as today, so that your voice may be heard in a cry?
brenton_translation: If ye fast for quarrels and strifes, and smite the lowly with your fists, wherefore do ye fast to me as ye do this day, so that your voice may be heard in crying?

fresh_translation: I did not choose such a fast, nor a day for a man to humble his soul, nor if you bend your neck like a ring and spread sackcloth and ashes. You will not call such a fast acceptable.
brenton_translation: I have not chosen this fast, nor such a day for a man to afflict his soul; neither though thou shouldest bend down thy neck as a ring, and spread under thee sackcloth and ashes, neither thus shall ye call a fast acceptable.

fresh_translation: Is this not the fast I chose, says the Lord? Loose every bond of injustice, untie knots of violent agreements, send broken ones away in release, and tear up every unjust writing.
brenton_translation: I have not chosen such a fast, saith the Lord; but do thou loose every burden of iniquity, do thou untie the knots of hard bargains, set the bruised free, and cancel every unjust account.

fresh_translation: Break your bread for the hungry one and bring the poor homeless into your house. If you see a naked one, clothe him. And do not overlook those from your own seed.
brenton_translation: Break thy bread to the hungry, and lead the unsheltered poor to thy house: if thou seest one naked, clothe him, and thou shalt not disregard the relations of thine own seed.

fresh_translation: Then your light will burst forth early and your healings quickly rise, and your righteousness will go before you and the glory of God will surround you.
brenton_translation: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thy health shall speedily spring forth: and thy righteousness shall go before thee, and the glory of God shall compass thee.

fresh_translation: Then you will cry, and God will hear you. While you are still speaking he will say, See, I am here. If you remove from yourself a bond and pointing of the hand and word of grumbling,
brenton_translation: Then shalt thou cry, and God shall hearken to thee; while thou art yet speaking he will say, Behold, I am here. If thou remove from thee the band, and the stretching forth of the hands, and murmuring speech;

fresh_translation: and give bread from your soul to the hungry one and fill the humbled soul, then your light will rise in darkness and your darkness as midday.
brenton_translation: and if thou give bread to the hungry from thy heart, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light spring up in darkness, and thy darkness shall be as noon-day:

fresh_translation: And your God will be with you always, and you will be filled as your soul desires, and your bones will grow fat, and you will be like a well-watered garden and like a spring whose water does not fail, and your bones like grass will spring up and grow fat, and they will inherit generations of generations.
brenton_translation: and thy God shall be with thee continually, and thou shalt be satisfied according as thy soul desires; and thy bones shall be made fat, and shall be as a well-watered garden, and as a fountain from which the water has not failed.

fresh_translation: And your everlasting desolations will be built, and your foundations will be everlasting to the generations of generations. And you will be called builder of fences, and you will stop the paths between.
brenton_translation: And thy old waste desert places shall be built up, and thy foundations shall last through all generations; and thou shalt be called a repairer of breaches, and thou shalt cause thy paths between to be in peace.

fresh_translation: If you turn your foot from the Sabbaths, not doing your wishes on the holy day, and call the Sabbaths delightful, holy to your God, you will not lift your foot for work nor speak a word in anger from your mouth.
brenton_translation: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, so as not to do thy pleasure on the holy days, and shalt call the sabbaths delightful, holy to God; if thou shalt not lift up thy foot to work, nor speak a word in anger out of thy mouth,

fresh_translation: And you will be confident in the Lord, and he will bring you up on the good things of the earth and feed you with the inheritance of Jacob your father, for the mouth of the Lord spoke these things.
brenton_translation: then shalt thou trust on the Lord; and he shall bring thee up to the good places of the land, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the Lord has spoken this.

fresh_translation: Surely the hand of the Lord is not too weak to save, nor his ear made heavy so as not to hear.
brenton_translation: Has the hand of the Lord no power to save? or has he made his ear heavy, so that he should not hear?

fresh_translation: But your sins stand between you and God, and because of your sins he turned his face away from you so as not to have mercy.
brenton_translation: Nay, your iniquities separate between you and God, and because of your sins has he turned away his face from you, so as not to have mercy upon you.

fresh_translation: For your hands are polluted with blood and your fingers with sins. Your lips spoke lawlessness and your tongue studies injustice.
brenton_translation: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with sins; your lips also have spoken iniquity, and your tongue meditates unrighteousness.

fresh_translation: No one speaks righteous things, nor is there true judgment. They trust in vanities and speak empty things, because they conceive pain and bear lawlessness.
brenton_translation: None speaks justly, neither is there true judgment: they trust in vanities, and speak empty words; for they conceive trouble, and bring forth iniquity.

fresh_translation: They hatch eggs of asps and weave spider's web, and the one who is about to eat their eggs, breaking one, finds a viper in it.
brenton_translation: They have hatched asps' eggs, and weave a spider's web: and he that is going to eat of their eggs, having crushed an addled egg, has found also in it a basilisk.

fresh_translation: Their web will not become a garment, nor will they clothe themselves from their works, for their works are works of lawlessness.
brenton_translation: Their web shall not become a garment, nor shall they at all clothe themselves with their works; for their works are works of iniquity.

fresh_translation: Their feet run to evil, quick to pour out blood, and their thoughts are thoughts of fools. Crushing and misery are in their ways.
brenton_translation: And their feet run to wickedness, swift to shed blood; their thoughts also are thoughts of murder; destruction and misery are in their ways;

fresh_translation: They do not know the way of peace, and there is no judgment in their ways, for their paths are twisted, which they travel, and they do not know peace.
brenton_translation: and the way of peace they know not, neither is there judgment in their ways; for their paths by which they go are crooked, and they know not peace.

fresh_translation: Therefore judgment withdrew from them, and righteousness will not overtake them. Though they waited for light, darkness came to them. While waiting for dawn, they walked in gloom.
brenton_translation: Therefore has judgment departed from them, and righteousness shall not overtake them: while they waited for light, darkness came upon them; while they waited for brightness, they walked in perplexity.

fresh_translation: They will grope for a wall like blind men and as having no eyes they will grope, and they will fall at noon as at midnight. As dying men they will groan.
brenton_translation: They shall feel for the wall as blind men, and shall feel for it as if they had no eyes: and they shall feel at noon-day as at midnight; they shall groan as dying men.

fresh_translation: Like a bear and like a dove together they will go. We waited for judgment, and there is none; salvation stood far from us.
brenton_translation: They shall proceed together as a bear and as a dove: we have waited for judgment, and there is no salvation, it is gone far from us.

fresh_translation: For our lawlessness is great before you, and our sins stood against us. Our lawless deeds are in us, and our injustices we know:
brenton_translation: For our iniquity is great before thee, and our sins have risen up against us: for our iniquities are in us, and we know our unrighteous deeds.

fresh_translation: we acted ungodly and lied and turned away from behind our God. We spoke unjust things and disobeyed. We conceived and studied from our heart unjust words.
brenton_translation: We have sinned, and dealt falsely, and revolted from our God: we have spoken unrighteous words, and have been disobedient; we have conceived and uttered from our heart unrighteous words.

fresh_translation: And we turned judgment backward and righteousness stood far off, because truth was consumed in their ways and they could not pass by straight paths.
brenton_translation: And we have turned judgment back, and righteousness has departed afar off: for truth is consumed in their ways, and they could not pass by a straight path.

fresh_translation: And truth was taken away and they moved the mind away from understanding. And the Lord saw, and it did not please him, because there was no judgment.
brenton_translation: And truth has been taken away, and they have turned aside their mind from understanding.

fresh_translation: And he saw, and there was no man, and he understood, and there was no one to help. So he defended them with his arm and established himself with mercy.
brenton_translation: And he looked, and there was no man, and he observed, and there was none to help: so he defended them with his arm, and stablished them with his mercy.

fresh_translation: And he put on righteousness as a breastplate and placed a helmet of salvation on his head and put on a garment of vengeance as a cloak.
brenton_translation: And he put on righteousness as a breast-plate, and placed the helmet of salvation on his head; and he clothed himself with the garment of vengeance, and with his cloak,

fresh_translation: as one who will give repayment: reproach to the opponents.
brenton_translation: as one about to render a recompence, even reproach to his adversaries.

fresh_translation: And those from the west will fear the name of the Lord, and those from the sunrise the glorious name. For wrath from the Lord will come like a violent river, coming with fury.
brenton_translation: So shall they of the west fear the name of the Lord, and they that come from the rising of the sun his glorious name: for the wrath of the Lord shall come as a mighty river, it shall come with fury.

fresh_translation: And the rescuer will come for the sake of Zion and turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
brenton_translation: And the deliverer shall come for Sion's sake, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

fresh_translation: And this covenant from me with them, said the Lord: My Spirit which is on you and the words I put in your mouth will not fail from your mouth nor from the mouth of your seed, said the Lord, from now and forever.
brenton_translation: And this shall be my covenant with them, said the Lord; My Spirit which is upon thee, and the words which I have put in thy mouth, shall never fail from thy mouth, nor from the mouth of thy seed, for the Lord has spoken it, henceforth and for ever.

fresh_translation: Shine, shine, Jerusalem, for your light has come and the glory of the Lord has risen on you.
brenton_translation: Be enlightened, be enlightened, O Jerusalem, for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.

fresh_translation: See, darkness and gloom will cover the earth over nations; but on you the Lord will appear and his glory will be seen on you.
brenton_translation: Behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and there shall be gross darkness on the nations: but the Lord shall appear upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

fresh_translation: And kings will walk by your light and nations by your brightness.
brenton_translation: And kings shall walk in thy light, and nations in thy brightness.

fresh_translation: Lift your eyes around and see. Your children have been gathered; see, all your sons have come from far away and your daughters will be carried on shoulders.
brenton_translation: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold thy children gathered: all thy sons have come from far, and thy daughters shall be borne on men's shoulders.

fresh_translation: Then you will see and fear and your heart will be amazed, because the wealth of the sea and of nations and peoples will turn to you and come to you.
brenton_translation: Then shalt thou see, and fear, and be amazed in thine heart; for the wealth of the sea shall come round to thee, and of nations and peoples; and herds of camels shall come to thee,

fresh_translation: Herds of camels will cover you, camels of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come, carrying gold and frankincense, and proclaiming the salvation of the Lord.
brenton_translation: and the camels of Madiam and Gæpha shall cover thee: all from Saba shall come bearing gold, and shall bring frankincense, and they shall publish the salvation of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And all the sheep of Kedar will be gathered to you and rams of Nebaioth will come to you and be brought up acceptable on my altar, and my house of prayer will be glorified.
brenton_translation: And all the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered, and the rams of Nabæoth shall come; and acceptable sacrifices shall be offered on my altar, and my house of prayer shall be glorified.

fresh_translation: Who are these flying like clouds and like doves with young?
brenton_translation: Who are these that fly as clouds, and as doves with young ones to me?

fresh_translation: Islands waited for me and ships of Tarshish first, to bring your children from far away, and their silver and gold with them, because of the holy name of the Lord and because the Holy One of Israel is glorified.
brenton_translation: The isles have waited for me, and the ships of Tharsis among the first, to bring thy children from afar, and their silver and their gold with them, and that for the sake of the holy name of the Lord, and because the Holy One of Israel is glorified.

fresh_translation: Foreigners will build your walls and their kings will stand beside you, because in my wrath I struck you and in mercy I loved you.
brenton_translation: And strangers shall build thy walls, and their kings shall wait upon thee: for by reason of my wrath I smote thee, and by reason of mercy I loved thee.

fresh_translation: Your gates will be opened continually; day and night they will not be shut, to bring to you the strength of nations and kings being led.
brenton_translation: And thy gates shall be opened continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; to bring in to thee the power of the Gentiles, and their kings as captives.

fresh_translation: For nations and kings that will not serve you will perish, and nations will be made utterly desolate.
brenton_translation: For the nations and the kings which will not serve thee shall perish; and those nations shall be made utterly desolate.

fresh_translation: The glory of Lebanon will come to you with cypress and pine and cedar together, to glorify my holy place.
brenton_translation: And the glory of Libanus shall come to thee, with the cypress, and pine, and cedar together, to glorify my holy place.

fresh_translation: Sons of those who humbled you and provoked you will come to you in fear, and you will be called the city of the Lord, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
brenton_translation: And the sons of them that afflicted thee, and of them that provoked thee, shall come to thee in fear; and thou shalt be called Sion, the city of the Holy One of Israel.

fresh_translation: Because you became forsaken and hated and there was none to help, I will make you everlasting exultation, joy of generation to generation.
brenton_translation: Because thou hast become desolate and hated, and there was no helper, therefore I will make thee a perpetual gladness, a joy of many generations.

fresh_translation: You will suck milk of nations and eat wealth of kings, and you will know that I, the Lord, am the one saving you and delivering you, the God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt eat the wealth of kings: and shalt know that I am the Lord that saves thee and delivers thee, the Holy One of Israel.

fresh_translation: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, and instead of iron I will bring you silver, and instead of wood bronze, and instead of stones iron. And I will give your rulers in peace and your overseers in righteousness.
brenton_translation: And for brass I will bring thee gold, and for iron I will bring thee silver, and instead of wood I will bring thee brass, and instead of stones, iron; and I will make thy princes peaceable, and thine overseers righteous.

fresh_translation: Injustice will no longer be heard in your land, nor crushing nor misery in your borders, but your walls will be called Salvation and your gates Carved Work.
brenton_translation: And injustice shall no more be heard in thy land, nor destruction nor misery in thy coasts; but thy walls shall be called Salvation, and thy gates Sculptured Work.

fresh_translation: The sun will not be for you light by day, nor will the rising of the moon light your night, but the Lord will be everlasting light for you and God your glory.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt no more have the sun for a light by day, nor shall the rising of the moon lighten thy night; but the Lord shall be thine everlasting light, and God thy glory.

fresh_translation: Your sun will not set and your moon will not fail, for the Lord will be everlasting light for you and the days of your mourning will be fulfilled.
brenton_translation: For the sun shall no more set, nor shall the moon be eclipsed; for the Lord shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be completed.

fresh_translation: All your people will be righteous, and forever they will inherit the land, keeping the plant, the work of his hands, for glory.
brenton_translation: Thy people also shall be all righteous; they shall inherit the land for ever, preserving that which they have planted, even the works of their hands, for glory.

fresh_translation: The least one will become thousands and the smallest a great nation. I, the Lord, in due time will gather them.
brenton_translation: The little one shall become thousands, and the least a great nation; I the Lord will gather them in due time.

fresh_translation: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he anointed me to bring good news to the poor. He sent me to heal those crushed in heart, proclaim release to captives and recovery of sight to the blind.
brenton_translation: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me; he has sent me to preach glad tidings to the poor, to heal the broken in heart, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and recovery of sight to the blind;
