fresh_translation: to call the acceptable year of the Lord and the day of repayment, to comfort all those mourning.
brenton_translation: to declare the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of recompence; to comfort all that mourn;

fresh_translation: to give to those mourning Zion glory instead of ashes, oil of gladness to those mourning, a garment of glory instead of a spirit of weariness, and they will be called generations of righteousness, planting of the Lord for glory.
brenton_translation: that there should be given to them that mourn in Sion glory instead of ashes, the oil of joy to the mourners, the garment of glory for the spirit of heaviness: and they shall be called generations of righteousness, the planting of the Lord for glory.

fresh_translation: And they will build everlasting desolations, raise up places formerly deserted, and renew desolate cities, desolated through generations.
brenton_translation: And they shall build the old waste places, they shall raise up those that were before made desolate, and shall renew the desert cities, even those that had been desolate for many generations.

fresh_translation: Foreigners will come, shepherding your sheep, and aliens plowmen and vine-dressers.
brenton_translation: And strangers shall come and feed thy flocks, and aliens shall be thy ploughmen and vine-dressers.

fresh_translation: But you will be called priests of the Lord, ministers of God. You will eat the strength of nations and be marveled at in their wealth.
brenton_translation: But ye shall be called priests of the Lord, the ministers of God: ye shall eat the strength of nations, and shall be admired because of their wealth.

fresh_translation: So they will inherit the land for a second time and everlasting joy will be above their head.
brenton_translation: Thus shall they inherit the land a second time, and everlasting joy shall be upon their head.

fresh_translation: For I am the Lord loving righteousness and hating robberies from injustice, and I will give their toil to righteous ones and make an everlasting covenant with them.
brenton_translation: For I am the Lord who love righteousness, and hate robberies of injustice; and I will give their labour to the just, and will make an everlasting covenant with them.

fresh_translation: Their seed will be known among nations and their offspring in the midst of peoples. Everyone seeing them will know them, because these are seed blessed by God.
brenton_translation: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring in the midst of peoples: every one that sees them shall take notice of them, that they are a seed blessed of God;

fresh_translation: They will rejoice with joy in the Lord; let my soul exult in the Lord, for he clothed me with a garment of salvation and a tunic of gladness. As a bridegroom he put a turban on me, and as a bride he adorned me with ornament.
brenton_translation: and they shall greatly rejoice in the Lord.

fresh_translation: And as earth increases its flower and as a garden its seeds, so the Lord will make righteousness and exultation spring up before all nations.
brenton_translation: And as the earth putting forth her flowers, and as a garden its seed; so shall the Lord, even the Lord, cause righteousness to spring forth, and exultation before all nations.

fresh_translation: For Zion I will not be silent, and for Jerusalem I will not relent until my righteousness goes out like light and my salvation burns like a torch.
brenton_translation: For Sion's sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as light, and my salvation burn as a torch.

fresh_translation: Nations will see your righteousness and kings your glory, and you will be called by your new name, which the Lord will name.
brenton_translation: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and kings thy glory: and one shall call thee by a new name, which the Lord shall name.

fresh_translation: You will be a crown of beauty in the hand of the Lord and a diadem of kingship in the hand of your God.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt be a crown of beauty in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

fresh_translation: No longer will you be called Forsaken, and your land will no longer be called Desolate, for you will be called My Desire, and your land Inhabited.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt no more be called Forsaken; and thy land shall no more be called Desert: for thou shalt be called My Pleasure, and thy land Inhabited: for the Lord has taken pleasure in thee, and thy land shall be inhabited.

fresh_translation: And as a young man lives with a virgin, so your sons will dwell with you, and as a bridegroom rejoices over a bride, so the Lord will rejoice over you.
brenton_translation: And as a young man lives with a virgin, so shall thy sons dwell in thee: and it shall come to pass that as a bridegroom will rejoice over a bride, so will the Lord rejoice over thee.

fresh_translation: On your walls, Jerusalem, I appointed watchmen all day and all night; continually they will not be silent, remembering the Lord.
brenton_translation: And on thy walls, O Jerusalem, have I set watchmen all day and all night, who shall never cease making mention of the Lord.

fresh_translation: For there is no one like you when he restores and makes Jerusalem a boast upon the earth.
brenton_translation: For there is none like you, when he shall have established, and made Jerusalem a praise on the earth.

fresh_translation: The Lord swore by his right hand and by the strength of his arm: Surely I will no longer give your grain and your foods to your enemies, and sons of foreigners will no longer drink your wine for which you labored—
brenton_translation: For the Lord has sworn by his glory, and by the might of his arm, I will no more give thy corn and thy provisions to thine enemies; nor shall strangers any more drink thy wine, for which thou hast laboured.

fresh_translation: rather those who gather them will eat them and praise the Lord, and those who gather them will drink them in my holy courts.
brenton_translation: But they that have gathered them shall eat them, and they shall praise the Lord; and they that have gathered the grapes shall drink thereof in my holy courts.

fresh_translation: Go through my gates and make a road for my people, and scatter the stones from the road. Lift a standard for the nations.
brenton_translation: Go through my gates, and make a way for my people; and cast the stones out of the way; lift up a standard for the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: For behold, the Lord made this heard to the end of the earth: Say to the daughter of Zion, Behold, your Savior comes, holding his wage and his work before his face.
brenton_translation: For behold, the Lord has proclaimed to the end of the earth, say ye to the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy Saviour has come to thee, having his reward and his work before his face.

fresh_translation: And he will call them Holy People, Redeemed by the Lord. But you will be called Sought Out, a City Not Forsaken.
brenton_translation: And one shall call them the holy people, the redeemed of the Lord: and thou shalt be called a city sought out, and not forsaken.

fresh_translation: Who is this coming from Edom, with redness of garments from Bozrah, so beautiful in his robe, with force and strength? I speak righteousness and a judgment of salvation.
brenton_translation: Who is this that is come from Edom, with red garments from Bosor? thus fair in his apparel, with mighty strength? I speak of righteousness and saving judgment.

fresh_translation: Why are your garments red and your clothes like those from a trodden winepress?
brenton_translation: Wherefore are thy garments red, and thy raiment as if fresh from a trodden wine-press?

fresh_translation: I am full of what was trampled, and from the nations no man was with me; I trampled them in wrath and crushed them like earth and brought their blood down to the earth.
brenton_translation: I am full of trodden grape, and of the nations there is not a man with me; and I trampled them in my fury, and dashed them to pieces as earth, and brought down their blood to the earth.

fresh_translation: For the day of repayment came upon them, and the year of redemption is present.
brenton_translation: For the day of recompence has come upon them, and the year of redemption is at hand.

fresh_translation: I looked and there was no helper; I considered and no one was taking hold. So my arm rescued them and my wrath came upon them.
brenton_translation: And I looked, and there was no helper; and I observed, and none upheld: therefore my arm delivered them, and mine anger drew nigh.

fresh_translation: And I trampled them in my anger and brought their blood down to the earth.
brenton_translation: And I trampled them in mine anger, and brought down their blood to the earth.

fresh_translation: I remembered the mercy of the Lord, the virtues of the Lord in all things by which the Lord repays us—the Lord is a good judge to the house of Israel. He brings upon us according to his mercy and according to the abundance of his righteousness.
brenton_translation: I remembered the mercy of the Lord, the praises of the Lord in all things wherein he recompenses us. The Lord is a good judge to the house of Israel; he deals with us according to his mercy, and according to the abundance of his righteousness.

fresh_translation: And he said, Are they not my people, children who will certainly not reject? And he became salvation to them.
brenton_translation: And he said, Is it not my people? the children surely will not be rebellious: and he became to them deliverance

fresh_translation: In all their affliction, no elder nor angel, but the Lord himself saved them. Because he loved them and spared them, he redeemed them and took them up and lifted them all the days of old.
brenton_translation: out of all their affliction: not an ambassador, nor a messenger, but himself saved them, because he loved them and spared them: he himself redeemed them, and took them up, and lifted them up all the days of old.

fresh_translation: But they disobeyed and provoked his Holy Spirit, and he turned to them as an enemy and himself fought them.
brenton_translation: But they disobeyed, and provoked his Holy Spirit: so he turned to be an enemy, he himself contended against them.

fresh_translation: And he remembered the days of old, the one who brought up from the land the shepherd of the sheep. Where is the one who placed the Holy Spirit in them,
brenton_translation: Then he remembered the ancient days, saying, Where is he that brought up from the sea the shepherd of the sheep? where is he that put his Holy Spirit in them?

fresh_translation: the one who led Moses by the right hand? The arm of his glory strengthened the water before him, to make an everlasting name for himself.
brenton_translation: who led Moses with his right hand, the arm of his glory? he forced the water to separate from before him, to make himself an everlasting name.

fresh_translation: He led them through the abyss like a horse through a wilderness, and they did not tire.
brenton_translation: He led them through the deep, as a horse through the wilderness, and they fainted not,

fresh_translation: And like cattle through a plain, the Spirit from the Lord came down and guided them. So you led your people to make for yourself a name of glory.
brenton_translation: and as cattle through a plain: the Spirit came down from the Lord, and guided them: thus thou leddest thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

fresh_translation: Turn back from heaven and look from your holy and glorious house. Where is your zeal and strength? Where is the multitude of your mercy and compassions, because you held back from us?
brenton_translation: Turn from heaven, and look from thy holy habitation and from thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength? where is the abundance of thy mercy and of thy compassions, that thou hast withholden thyself from us?

fresh_translation: For you are our father, because Abraham did not know us and Israel did not acknowledge us; but you, Lord, our father, rescue us. From the beginning your name is upon us.
brenton_translation: For thou art our Father; for though Abraham knew us not, and Israel did not acknowledge us, yet do thou, O Lord, our Father, deliver us: thy name has been upon us from the beginning.

fresh_translation: Why did you make us wander, Lord, from your way? You hardened our hearts so as not to fear you. Turn back for the sake of your servants, the tribes of your inheritance.
brenton_translation: Why hast thou caused us to err, O Lord, from thy way? and hast hardened our hearts, that we should not fear thee? Return for thy servants' sake, for the sake of the tribes of thine inheritance,

fresh_translation: So we may inherit a little of your holy mountain. Our opponents trampled your sanctuary.
brenton_translation: that we may inherit a small part of thy holy mountain.

fresh_translation: We became as from the beginning when you did not rule us nor was your name called on us. If you open heaven, trembling will seize the mountains from you, and they will melt.
brenton_translation: We are become as at the beginning, when thou didst not rule over us, and thy name was not called upon us.

fresh_translation: As wax melts from fire, and fire will burn the opponents, and the name of the Lord will be evident among the opponents; from your face nations will be shaken.
brenton_translation: as wax melts before the fire; and fire shall burn up the enemies, and thy name shall be manifest among the adversaries: at thy presence the nations shall be troubled,

fresh_translation: When you do glorious things, trembling will seize the mountains from you.
brenton_translation: whenever thou shalt work gloriously; trembling from thee shall take hold upon the mountains.

fresh_translation: From the age we have not heard, nor have our eyes seen God besides you and your works which you will do for those waiting for mercy.
brenton_translation: From of old we have not heard, neither have our eyes seen a God beside thee, and thy works which thou wilt perform to them that wait for mercy.

fresh_translation: For he will meet those who do righteousness, and they will remember your ways. Behold, you were angry and we sinned; because of this we wandered.
brenton_translation: For these blessings shall happen to them that work righteousness, and they shall remember thy ways: behold, thou wast angry and we have sinned; therefore we have erred,

fresh_translation: And all of us became as unclean, and all our righteousness as a cloth of menstruation, and we fell away as leaves. Because of our lawless deeds, thus a wind will carry us away.
brenton_translation: and we are all become as unclean, and all our righteousness as a filthy rag: and we have fallen as leaves because of our iniquities; thus the wind shall carry us away.

fresh_translation: And there is no one calling on your name and no one remembering to take hold of you, because you turned your face away from us and gave us over because of our sins.
brenton_translation: And there is none that calls upon thy name, or that remembers to take hold on thee: for thou hast turned thy face away from us, and hast delivered us up because of our sins.

fresh_translation: And now, Lord, you are our father; but we are clay, all of us the work of your hands.
brenton_translation: And now, O Lord, thou art our Father, and we are clay, all of us the work of thine hands.

fresh_translation: Do not be very angry with us, and do not remember our sins in season. And now look, because we are all your people.
brenton_translation: Be not very wroth with us, and remember not our sins for ever; but now look on us, for we are all thy people.

fresh_translation: Your holy city became desolate. Zion became like a desert; Jerusalem became a curse.
brenton_translation: The city of thy holiness has become desolate, Sion has become as a wilderness, Jerusalem a curse.

fresh_translation: Our holy house and our glory, which our fathers blessed, was burned with fire, and all glorious things fell.
brenton_translation: The house, our sanctuary, and the glory which our fathers blessed, has been burnt with fire: and all our glorious things have gone to ruin.

fresh_translation: And over all these things you held back, Lord, and kept silent and humbled us greatly.
brenton_translation: And for all these things thou, O Lord, hast withholden thyself, and been silent, and hast brought us very low.

fresh_translation: I became manifest to those not seeking me; I was found by those not asking after me. I said, Behold, I am here, to a nation not calling my name.
brenton_translation: I became manifest to them that asked not for me; I was found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold, I am here, to a nation, who called not on my name.

fresh_translation: I stretched out my hands all day to a disobedient and contradicting people, who did not walk in a true way but after their sins.
brenton_translation: I have stretched forth my hands all day to a disobedient and gainsaying people, to them that walked in a way that was not good, but after their sins.

fresh_translation: This is the people who provoke me continually to my face, sacrificing in the gardens and burning incense on the bricks to demons that do not exist.
brenton_translation: This is the people that provokes me continually in my presence; they offer sacrifices in gardens, and burn incense on bricks to devils, which exist not.

fresh_translation: And among the tombs and in the caves they sleep because of dreams, eating pig flesh and broth of polluted sacrifices; all their vessels are polluted.
brenton_translation: They lie down to sleep in the tombs and in the caves for the sake of dreams, even they that eat swine's flesh, and the broth of their sacrifices: all their vessels are defiled:

fresh_translation: saying, Keep far from me; do not come near me, because I am clean. This is smoke of my wrath; a fire burns in it all the days.
brenton_translation: who say, Depart from me, draw not nigh to me, for I am pure.

fresh_translation: Behold, it is written before me. I will not keep silent until I repay into their bosom
brenton_translation: Behold, it is written before me: I will not be silent until I have recompensed into their bosom,

fresh_translation: their sins and the sins of their fathers, says the Lord, who burned incense on the mountains and reproached me on the hills. I will repay their works into their bosom.
brenton_translation: their sins and the sins of their fathers, saith the Lord, who have burnt incense on the mountains, and reproached me on the hills: I will recompense their works into their bosom.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: As a grape is found in the cluster and they say, Do not destroy it, because the blessing of the Lord is in it, so I will do for the sake of the one serving me. For his sake I will not destroy them all.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, As a grape-stone shall be found in the cluster, and they shall say, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for the sake of him that serves me, for his sake I will not destroy them all.

fresh_translation: And I will bring out the seed from Jacob and from Judah, and it will inherit my holy mountain, and my chosen will inherit it and my servants will dwell there.
brenton_translation: And I will lead forth the seed that came of Jacob and of Juda, and they shall inherit my holy mountain: and mine elect and my servants shall inherit it, and shall dwell there.

fresh_translation: And in the forest there will be folds for flocks and the valley of Achor as a resting place for herds, for my people who sought me.
brenton_translation: And there shall be in the forest folds of flocks, and the valley of Achor shall be for a resting-place of herds for my people, who have sought me.

fresh_translation: But you who abandon me and forget my holy mountain and prepare a table for the demon and fill mixed drink for Fortune,
brenton_translation: But ye are they that have left me, and forget my holy mountain, and prepare a table for the devil, and fill up the drink-offering to Fortune.

fresh_translation: I will hand you over to the sword. All of you will fall by slaughter, because I called you and you did not obey; I spoke and you refused, and you did evil before me and chose what I did not desire.
brenton_translation: I will deliver you up to the sword, ye shall all fall by slaughter: for I called you, and ye hearkened not; I spoke, and ye refused to hear; and ye did evil in my sight, and chose the things wherein I delighted not.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, those who serve me will eat, but you will hunger. Behold, those who serve me will drink, but you will thirst. Behold, those who serve me will rejoice, but you will be shamed.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall hunger: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall thirst: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:

fresh_translation: Behold, those who serve me will exult in gladness, but you will cry out from the pain of your heart and howl from crushing of spirit.
brenton_translation: behold, my servants shall exult with joy, but ye shall cry for the sorrow of your heart, and shall howl for the vexation of your spirit.

fresh_translation: For you will leave your name for fullness to my chosen; the Lord will kill you, but to those who serve him a new name will be called,
brenton_translation: For ye shall leave your name for a loathing to my chosen, and the Lord shall destroy you: but my servants shall be called by a new name,

fresh_translation: by which one blessed on the earth will bless the true God, and those swearing on the earth will swear by the true God, because they will forget their former affliction and it will not come up on their heart.
brenton_translation: which shall be blessed on the earth; for they shall bless the true God: and they that swear upon the earth shall swear by the true God; for they shall forget the former affliction, and it shall not come into their mind.

fresh_translation: For there will be a new heaven and a new earth, and former things will not be remembered nor come up upon their heart.
brenton_translation: For there shall be a new heaven and a new earth: and they shall not at all remember the former, neither shall they at all come into their mind.

fresh_translation: But they will find gladness and exultation in it, because behold, I make Jerusalem an exultation and my people gladness.
brenton_translation: But they shall find in her joy and exultation; for, behold, I make Jerusalem a rejoicing, and my people a joy.

fresh_translation: And I will exult over Jerusalem and be glad over my people, and a voice of weeping and a voice of crying will no longer be heard in her.
brenton_translation: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and will be glad in my people: and there shall no more be heard in her the voice of weeping, or the voice of crying.

fresh_translation: And there will no longer be an untimely child there nor an old man who does not fill his time, for the young one will be one hundred years old, but the sinner dying at one hundred years will be accursed.
brenton_translation: Neither shall there be there any more a child that dies untimely, or an old man who shall not complete his time: for the youth shall be a hundred years old, and the sinner who dies at a hundred years shall also be accursed:

fresh_translation: They will build houses and dwell in them, and plant vineyards and eat their produce.
brenton_translation: and they shall build houses, and themselves shall dwell in them; and they shall plant vineyards, and themselves shall eat the fruit thereof.

fresh_translation: They will not build and others dwell, nor plant and others eat, for the days of my people will be like the days of the tree of life, and the works of their labors will grow old.
brenton_translation: They shall by no means build, and others inhabit; and they shall by no means plant, and others eat: for as the days of the tree of life shall be the days of my people, they shall long enjoy the fruits of their labours.

fresh_translation: My chosen will not labor in vain nor bear children for a curse, because seed blessed by God is with them and their offspring with them.
brenton_translation: My chosen shall not toil in vain, neither shall they beget children to be cursed; for they are a seed blessed of God, and their offspring with them.

fresh_translation: And before they cry out, I will hear them. While they are still speaking, I will say, What is it?
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will hearken to them; while they are yet speaking, I will say, What is it?

fresh_translation: Then wolves and lambs will graze together, and a lion like an ox will eat straw, and a serpent will eat earth like bread. They will not do injustice nor destroy on my holy mountain, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Then wolves and lambs shall feed together, and the lion shall eat chaff like the ox, and the serpent earth as bread. They shall not injure nor destroy in my holy mountain, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Heaven is my throne, and the earth is the footstool of my feet. What house will you build for me, or what is the place of my rest?
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: what kind of a house will ye build me? and of what kind is to be the place of my rest?

fresh_translation: For all these things my hand made, and all these things are mine, says the Lord. And upon whom will I look, except upon the humble and quiet one and the one trembling at my words?
brenton_translation: For all these things are mine, saith the Lord: and to whom will I have respect, but to the humble and meek, and the man that trembles at my words?

fresh_translation: But the lawless one sacrificing a calf to me is like one killing a dog; the one offering fine flour is like pig's blood; the one giving frankincense for a memorial is like a blasphemer. These also chose their own ways, and their soul desired their abominations.
brenton_translation: But the transgressor that sacrifices a calf to me, is as he that kills a dog; and he that offers fine flour, as one that offers swine's blood; he that gives frankincense for a memorial, is as a blasphemer.

fresh_translation: So I will choose their mockeries and repay their sins to them, because I called them and they did not obey me. I spoke and they did not hear, and they did evil before me and chose what I did not desire.
brenton_translation: I also will choose their mockeries, and will recompense their sins upon them; because I called them, and they did not hearken to me; I spoke, and they heard not: and they did evil before me, and chose the things wherein I delighted not.

fresh_translation: Hear the word of the Lord, you who tremble at his word: Say, Our brothers, to those who hate us and abhor us, Let the name of the Lord be glorified and be seen in their gladness; but they will be shamed.
brenton_translation: Hear the words of the Lord, ye that tremble at his word; speak ye, our brethren, to them that hate you and abominate you, that the name of the Lord may be glorified, and may appear their joy; but they shall be ashamed.

fresh_translation: The voice of a cry from the city, a voice from the temple, the voice of the Lord repaying recompense to those opposing him.
brenton_translation: A voice of a cry from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the Lord rendering recompence to his adversaries.

fresh_translation: Before the one in labor gave birth, before the pain of birth-pangs came, she escaped and bore a male.
brenton_translation: Before she that travailed brought forth, before the travail-pain came on, she escaped it and brought forth a male.

fresh_translation: Who heard such a thing, and who saw thus? Did the earth labor in one day, or was a nation born at once? Because Zion labored and bore her children.
brenton_translation: Who has heard such a thing? and who has seen after this manner? Has the earth travailed in one day? or has even a nation been born at once, that Sion has travailed, and brought forth her children?

fresh_translation: But I gave this expectation and you did not remember me, said the Lord. See, did I make the one bearing and then make her barren? said God.
brenton_translation: But I have raised this expectation, yet thou hast not remembered me, saith the Lord: behold, have not I made the bearing and barren woman? saith thy God.

fresh_translation: Be glad, Jerusalem, and celebrate in her, all who love her. Rejoice with joy, all who mourn over her,
brenton_translation: Rejoice, O Jerusalem, and all ye that love her hold in her a general assembly: rejoice greatly with her, all that now mourn over her:

fresh_translation: so that you may nurse and be filled from the breast of her comfort, so that after nursing you may delight from the entrance of her glory.
brenton_translation: that ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breast of her consolation; that ye may milk out, and delight yourselves with the influx of her glory.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord: Behold, I turn to them like a river of peace and like a torrent flooding the glory of nations. Their children will be carried on shoulders and comforted on knees.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I turn toward them as a river of peace, and as a torrent bringing upon them in a flood the glory of the Gentiles: their children shall be borne upon the shoulders, and comforted on the knees.

fresh_translation: As when a mother comforts someone, so I also will comfort you, and in Jerusalem you will be comforted.
brenton_translation: As if his mother should comfort one, so will I also comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And you will see and your heart will rejoice and your bones will spring up like grass, and the hand of the Lord will be known to those revering him, and he will threaten the disobedient ones.
brenton_translation: And ye shall see, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall thrive like grass: and the hand of the Lord shall be known to them that fear him, and he shall threaten the disobedient.

fresh_translation: For behold, the Lord will come as fire and his chariots like a storm, to render vengeance in wrath and rebuke in a flame of fire.
brenton_translation: For, behold, the Lord will come as fire, and his chariots as a storm, to render his vengeance with wrath, and his rebuke with a flame of fire.

fresh_translation: For by the fire of the Lord all the earth will be judged, and by his sword all flesh; many will be wounded by the Lord.
brenton_translation: For with the fire of the Lord all the earth shall be judged, and all flesh with his sword: many shall be slain by the Lord.

fresh_translation: Those purifying and cleansing themselves in the gardens and in the porches, eating pig flesh and abominations and the mouse, together they will be consumed, said the Lord.
brenton_translation: They that sanctify themselves and purify themselves in the gardens, and eat swine's flesh in the porches, and the abominations, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And I know their works and their thought. I am coming to gather all nations and tongues, and they will come and see my glory.
brenton_translation: And I know their works and their imagination. I am going to gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

fresh_translation: And I will leave signs on them and send from them saved ones to nations—to Tarshish and Pul and Lud and Meshech and Tubal and to Greece and to distant islands, who have not heard my name nor seen my glory—and they will declare my glory among nations.
brenton_translation: And I will leave a sign upon them, and I will send forth them that have escaped of them to the nations, to Tharsis, and Phud, and Lud, and Mosoch, and to Thobel, and to Greece, and to the isles afar off, to those who have not heard my name, nor seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: And they will bring your brothers from all nations as a gift to the Lord, with horses and chariots, in litters, mules, and with parasols, into the holy city Jerusalem, says the Lord, as the sons of Israel bring me their sacrifices with psalms into the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they shall bring your brethren out of all nations for a gift to the Lord with horses, and chariots, in litters drawn by mules with awnings, to the holy city Jerusalem, said the Lord, as though the children of Israel should bring their sacrifices to me with psalms into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And from them I will take for myself priests and Levites, said the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will take of them priests and Levites, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: For as the new heaven and the new earth which I make remain before me, says the Lord, so your seed and your name will stand.
brenton_translation: For as the new heaven and the new earth, which I make, remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name continue.

fresh_translation: And it will be from month to month and Sabbath to Sabbath; all flesh will come before me to worship in Jerusalem, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass from month to month, and from sabbath to sabbath, that all flesh shall come to worship before me in Jerusalem, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they will go out and see the limbs of the men who transgressed against me, for their worm will not end and their fire will not be quenched, and they will be a spectacle to all flesh.
brenton_translation: And they shall go forth, and see the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, and their fire shall not be quenched; and they shall be a spectacle to all flesh.

fresh_translation: The word of God that came upon Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, from the priests, who dwelt in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
brenton_translation: The word of God which came to Jeremias the son of Chelcias, of the priests, who dwelt in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

fresh_translation: to whom the word of God came in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign,
brenton_translation: accordingly as the word of God came to him in the days of Josias son of Amos king of Juda, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

fresh_translation: and it came in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the captivity of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
brenton_translation: And it was in the days of Joakim son of Josias king of Juda, until the eleventh year of Sedekias king of Juda, even until the captivity of Jerusalem in the fifth month.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to him, saying,

fresh_translation: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you came out from the womb I sanctified you; I set you as a prophet to nations.
brenton_translation: Before I formed thee in the belly, I knew thee; and before thou camest forth from the womb, I sanctified thee; I appointed thee a prophet to the nations.

fresh_translation: And I said, O Master Lord, behold, I do not know how to speak, because I am too young.
brenton_translation: And I said, O Lord, thou that art supreme Lord, behold, I know not how to speak, for I am a child.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Do not say, I am too young, because to all to whom I send you, you will go, and all whatever I command you, you will speak.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all to whomsoever I shall send thee, and according to all the words that I shall command thee, thou shalt speak.

fresh_translation: Do not fear before their face, because I am with you to deliver you, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Be not afraid before them: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord stretched out his hand toward me and touched my mouth, and the Lord said to me, Behold, I have given my words into your mouth.
brenton_translation: And the Lord stretched forth his hand to me, and touched my mouth: and the Lord said to me, Behold, I have put my words into thy mouth.

fresh_translation: Behold, I have set you today over nations and kingdoms, to root up and dig down and destroy and rebuild and plant.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have appointed thee this day over nations and over kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to rebuild, and to plant.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said, A staff of almond wood.
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, What seest thou? And I said, A rod of an almond tree.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, You have seen well, because I have watched over my words to perform them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Thou hast well seen: for I have watched over my words to perform them.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? And I said, A boiling cauldron, and its face from the face of the north.
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, A caldron on the fire; and the face of it is toward the north.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, From the face of the north evils will be kindled against all those dwelling in the land.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, From the north shall flame forth evils upon all the inhabitants of the land.

fresh_translation: Because behold, I call all the kingdoms from the north of the earth, says the Lord, and they will come, and each will place his throne at the entrances of the gates of Jerusalem and against all her surrounding walls and against all the cities of Judah.
brenton_translation: For, behold, I call together all the kingdoms of the earth from the north, saith the Lord; and they shall come, and shall set each one his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls round about her, and against all the cities of Juda.

fresh_translation: And I will speak judgment with them concerning all their wickedness, because they abandoned me and sacrificed to foreign gods and worshiped the works of their hands.
brenton_translation: And I will speak to them in judgment, concerning all their iniquity, forasmuch as they have forsaken me, and sacrificed to strange gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

fresh_translation: And you, gird your waist and rise and say to them all whatever I command you. Do not fear before them nor be terrified before them, because I am with you to deliver you, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And do thou gird up thy loins, and stand up, and speak all the words that I shall command thee: be not afraid of their face, neither be thou alarmed before them; for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Behold, I have made you this day as a fortified city and as a strong bronze wall against all the kings of Judah and its rulers and the people of the land.
brenton_translation: Behold, I have made thee this day as a strong city, and as a brazen wall, strong against all the kings of Juda, and the princes thereof, and the people of the land.

fresh_translation: And they will fight against you and will certainly not prevail against you, because I am with you to deliver you, said the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall by no means prevail against thee; because I am with thee, to deliver thee, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he said, Thus says the Lord: I remembered the mercy of your youth and the love of your completion, when you followed the Holy One of Israel, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he said, Thus saith the Lord, I remember the kindness of thy youth, and the love of thine espousals, in following the Holy One of Israel, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Israel was holy to the Lord, the firstfruits of his produce. All who eat him will be guilty; evils will come upon them, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Israel was the holy people to the Lord, and the first-fruits of his increase: all that devoured him shall offend; evils shall come upon them, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Hear the word of the Lord, house of Jacob and every family of the house of Israel.
brenton_translation: Hear the word of the Lord, O house of Jacob, and every family of the house of Israel.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: What fault did your fathers find in me, that they withdrew far from me and went after worthless things and became worthless?
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, What trespass have your fathers found in me, that they have revolted far from me, and gone after vanities, and become vain?

fresh_translation: And they did not say, Where is the Lord who brought us up from the land of Egypt, who guided us in the wilderness, in an unbounded and untrodden land, in a waterless and fruitless land, in a land through which no one traveled and no son of man dwelt there?
brenton_translation: And they said not, Where is the Lord, who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who guided us in the wilderness, in an untried and trackless land, in a land which no man at all went through, and no man dwelt there?

fresh_translation: And I brought you into Carmel, for you to eat its fruits and its good things. And you entered and defiled my land and made my inheritance an abomination.
brenton_translation: And I brought you to Carmel, that ye should eat the fruits thereof, and the good thereof; and ye went in, and defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.

fresh_translation: The priests did not say, Where is the Lord? Those holding the law did not know me, the shepherds acted ungodly toward me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and went after useless things.
brenton_translation: The priests said not, Where is the Lord? and they that held by the law knew me not: the shepherds also sinned against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and went after that which profited not.

fresh_translation: Therefore I will still enter judgment with you, says the Lord, and with the sons of your sons I will enter judgment.
brenton_translation: Therefore I will yet plead with you, and will plead with your children's children.

fresh_translation: For pass over to the islands of Kittim and see, and send to Kedar, and consider carefully, and see whether such things have happened.
brenton_translation: For go to the isles of the Chettians, and see; and send to Kedar, and observe accurately, and see if such things have been done;

fresh_translation: Will nations change their gods, though those are not gods? Yet my people exchanged its glory for that from which they will not profit.
brenton_translation: if the nations will change their gods, though they are not gods: but my people have changed their glory, for that from which they shall not be profited.

fresh_translation: The heaven was astonished at this and shuddered very greatly, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: The heaven is amazed at this, and is very exceedingly horror-struck, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because my people did two evils: they abandoned me, a fountain of living water, and dug for themselves broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
brenton_translation: For my people has committed two faults, and evil ones: they have forsaken me, the fountain of water of life, and hewn out for themselves broken cisterns, which will not be able to hold water.

fresh_translation: Is Israel a slave, or is he homeborn? Why has he become plunder?
brenton_translation: Is Israel a servant, or a home-born slave? why has he become a spoil?

fresh_translation: Lions roared against him and gave their voice, those who made his land a desert, and his cities were torn down so that they are not inhabited.
brenton_translation: The lions roared upon him, and uttered their voice, which have made his land a wilderness: and his cities are broken down, that they should not be inhabited.

fresh_translation: And sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes knew you and mocked you.
brenton_translation: Also the children of Memphis and Taphnas have known thee, and mocked thee.

fresh_translation: Did not your abandoning me do these things to you? says the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Has not thy forsaking me brought these things upon thee? saith the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: And now what have you to do with the way of Egypt, to drink the water of Gihon? And what have you to do with the way of the Assyrians, to drink the water of rivers?
brenton_translation: And now what hast thou to do with the way of Egypt, to drink the water of Geon? and what hast thou to do with the way of the Assyrians, to drink the water of rivers?

fresh_translation: Your apostasy will discipline you and your evil will expose you. Know and see that your abandoning me is bitter to you, says the Lord your God, and I did not take pleasure in you, says the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: Thine apostasy shall correct thee, and thy wickedness shall reprove thee: know then, and see, that thy forsaking me has been bitter to thee, saith the Lord thy God; and I have taken no pleasure in thee, saith the Lord thy God.

fresh_translation: Because from of old you broke your yoke and tore your bonds and said, I will not serve. Rather, on every high hill and under every shady tree, there I will spread myself out in my prostitution.
brenton_translation: For of old thou hast broken thy yoke, and plucked asunder thy bands; and thou hast said, I will not serve thee, but will go upon every high hill, and under every shady tree, there will I indulge in my fornication.

fresh_translation: But I planted you as a fruitful vine, wholly true. How did you turn into bitterness, the foreign vine?
brenton_translation: Yet I planted thee a fruitful vine, entirely of the right sort: how art thou a strange vine turned to bitterness!

fresh_translation: If you wash with niter and multiply soap for yourself, you are stained by your injustices before me, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Though thou shouldest wash thyself with nitre, and multiply to thyself soap, still thou art stained by thine iniquities before me, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: How will you say, I was not defiled and I did not go after Baal? See your ways in the burial ground and know what you did. At evening her voice wailed in her ways.
brenton_translation: How wilt thou say, I am not polluted, and have not gone after Baal? behold thy ways in the burial-ground, and know what thou hast done: her voice has howled in the evening:

fresh_translation: She spread out over waters of the wilderness; in the desires of her soul she was wind-borne, given over. Who will turn her back? All seeking her will not grow weary; in her humiliation they will find her.
brenton_translation: she has extended her ways over the waters of the desert; she was hurried along by the lusts of her soul; she is given up to them, who will turn her back? none that seek her shall be weary; at the time of her humiliation they shall find her.

fresh_translation: Turn your foot from a rough way and your throat from thirst. But she said, I will be strong, because she loved foreigners and went after them.
brenton_translation: Withdraw thy foot from a rough way, and thy throat from thirst: but she said, I will strengthen myself: for she loved strangers, and went after them.

fresh_translation: As the shame of a thief when caught, so the sons of Israel will be shamed, they and their kings and their rulers and their priests and their prophets.
brenton_translation: As is the shame of a thief when he is caught, so shall the children of Israel be ashamed; they, and their kings, and their princes, and their priests, and their prophets.

fresh_translation: To a tree they said, You are my father, and to a stone, You birthed me. And they turned their backs to me and not their faces, and at the time of their evils they will say, Rise and save us.
brenton_translation: They said to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast begotten me: and they have turned their backs to me, and not their faces: yet in the time of their afflictions they will say, Arise, and save us.

fresh_translation: And where are your gods that you made for yourself? Let them rise, if they will save you at the time of your affliction, because according to the number of your cities were your gods, Judah, and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem they sacrificed to Baal.
brenton_translation: And where are thy gods, which thou madest for thyself? will they arise and save in the time of thine affliction? for according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Juda; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem they sacrificed to Baal.

fresh_translation: Why do you all speak against me? You all acted ungodly and lawlessly toward me, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Wherefore do ye speak unto me? ye all have been ungodly, and ye all have transgressed against me, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: In vain I struck your children; they did not accept correction. A sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion, and you did not fear.
brenton_translation: In vain have I smitten your children; ye have not received correction: a sword has devoured your prophets as a destroying lion; yet ye feared not.

fresh_translation: Hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord: Did I become a wilderness to Israel or a land laid waste? Why did my people say, We will not be ruled and will not come to you any longer?
brenton_translation: Hear ye the word of the Lord: thus saith the Lord, Have I been a wilderness or a dry land to Israel? wherefore has my people said, We will not be ruled over, and will not come to thee any more?

fresh_translation: Will a bride forget her ornament, or a virgin her breast-band? But my people forgot me for days without number.
brenton_translation: Will a bride forget her ornaments, or a virgin her girdle? but my people has forgotten me days without number.

fresh_translation: Why do you still make your ways beautiful to seek love? Not so; but you also did evil, defiling your ways.
brenton_translation: What fair device wilt thou yet employ in thy ways, so as to seek love? it shall not be so; moreover thou hast done wickedly in corrupting thy ways;

fresh_translation: And in your hands were found bloods of innocent souls. I did not find them in tunnels, but under every oak.
brenton_translation: and in thine hands has been found the blood of innocent souls; I have not found them in holes, but on every oak.

fresh_translation: And you said, I am innocent; let his wrath be turned from me. Behold, I enter judgment with you in your saying, I did not sin.
brenton_translation: Yet thou saidst, I am innocent: only let his wrath be turned away from me.

fresh_translation: Why did you greatly despise repeating your ways? From Egypt you will be put to shame just as you were put to shame by Assyria.
brenton_translation: For thou hast been so exceedingly contemptuous as to repeat thy ways; but thou shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assur.

fresh_translation: Because also from there you will go out with your hands upon your head, because the Lord rejected your hope and you will not prosper by it.
brenton_translation: For thou shalt go forth thence also with thine hands upon thine head; for the Lord has rejected thine hope, and thou shalt not prosper in it.

fresh_translation: If a husband sends away his wife, and she departs from him and becomes another man's, will she by returning return to him again? Will not that woman be utterly defiled? Yet you prostituted yourself with many shepherds and kept returning to me, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: If a man put away his wife, and she depart from him, and become another man's, shall she return to him any more at all? shall not that woman be utterly defiled? yet thou hast gone a-whoring with many shepherds, and hast returned to me, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Lift your eyes straight ahead and see where you were not defiled. By the roads you sat for them like a crow in desolation, and you defiled the land with your prostitutions and your evils.
brenton_translation: Lift up thine eyes to look straight forward, and see where thou hast not been utterly defiled. Thou hast sat for them by the wayside as a deserted crow, and hast defiled the land with thy fornications and thy wickedness.

fresh_translation: And you had many shepherds as a stumbling-block for yourself. The face of a prostitute became yours; you became shameless toward all.
brenton_translation: And thou didst retain many shepherds for a stumbling-block to thyself: thou hadst a whore's face, thou didst become shameless toward all.

fresh_translation: Did you not call me house and father and leader of your virginity?
brenton_translation: Hast thou not called me as it were a home, and the father and guide of thy virgin-time?

fresh_translation: Will he remain forever or be kept for hostility? Behold, you spoke and did these evil things and prevailed.
brenton_translation: Will God's anger continue for ever, or be preserved to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done these bad things, and hadst power to do them.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me in the days of King Josiah, Did you see what the dwelling of Israel did to me? They went on every high mountain and under every leafy tree and prostituted themselves there.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me in the days of Josias the king, Hast thou seen what things the house of Israel has done to me? they have gone on every high mountain, and under every shady tree, and have committed fornication there.

fresh_translation: And I said after she did all these prostitutions, Return to me. And she did not return. And faithless Judah saw her faithlessness.
brenton_translation: And I said after she had committed all these acts of fornication, Turn again to me. Yet she returned not. And faithless Juda saw her faithlessness.

fresh_translation: And I saw that concerning all the things in which the dwelling of Israel was caught, with which she committed adultery, I sent her away and gave her a bill of divorce into her hands. Yet faithless Judah did not fear, but she also went and prostituted herself.
brenton_translation: And I saw that (for all the sins of which she was convicted, wherein the house of Israel committed adultery, and I put her away, and gave into her hands a bill of divorcement,) yet faithless Juda feared not, but went and herself also committed fornication.

fresh_translation: And her prostitution became as nothing, and she committed adultery with the wood and the stone.
brenton_translation: And her fornication was nothing accounted of; and she committed adultery with wood and stone.

fresh_translation: And in all these things faithless Judah did not return to me with all her heart, but in falsehood.
brenton_translation: And for all these things faithless Juda turned not to me with all her heart, but falsely.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Israel justified her own soul more than faithless Judah.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Israel has justified himself more than faithless Juda.

fresh_translation: Go and read these words toward the north and say, Return to me, dwelling of Israel, says the Lord, and I will not set my face against you, because I am merciful, says the Lord, and I will not be angry with you forever.
brenton_translation: Go and read these words toward the north, and thou shalt say, Return to me, O house of Israel, saith the Lord; and I will not set my face against you: for I am merciful, saith the Lord, and I will not be angry with you for ever.

fresh_translation: Only know your injustice, that you acted ungodly against the Lord your God and poured out your ways to foreigners under every leafy tree, and you did not obey my voice, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless, know thine iniquity, that thou hast sinned against the Lord thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to strangers under every shady tree, but thou didst not hearken to my voice, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Return, sons who have turned away, says the Lord, because I will rule over you and take you, one from a city and two from a family, and bring you into Zion.
brenton_translation: Turn, ye children that have revolted, saith the Lord; for I will rule over you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you in to Sion:

fresh_translation: And I will give you shepherds according to my heart, and they will shepherd you with knowledge.
brenton_translation: and I will give you shepherds after my heart, and they shall certainly tend you with knowledge.

fresh_translation: And it will be, if you multiply and increase on the earth in those days, says the Lord, they will no longer say, the ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel. It will not come up in the heart, nor be named nor visited, nor be made again.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass that when ye are multiplied and increased upon the land, saith the Lord, in those days they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel: it shall not come to mind; it shall not be named; neither shall it be visited; nor shall this be done any more.

fresh_translation: In those days and at that time they will call Jerusalem the throne of the Lord, and all nations will gather to it, and they will no longer walk after the thoughts of their evil heart.
brenton_translation: In those days and at that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the Lord; and all the nations shall be gathered to it: and they shall not walk any more after the imaginations of their evil heart.

fresh_translation: In those days the house of Judah will come together with the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north and from all regions to the land that I caused their fathers to inherit.
brenton_translation: In those days the house of Juda shall come together to the house of Israel, and they shall come, together, from the land of the north, and from all the countries, to the land, which I caused their fathers to inherit.

fresh_translation: And I said, So be it, Lord, that I will appoint you among children and give you a chosen land, an inheritance of God Almighty of nations. And I said, You will call me Father, and from me you will not turn away.
brenton_translation: And I said, So be it, Lord, for thou saidst, I will set thee among children, and will give thee a choice land, the inheritance of the Almighty God of the Gentiles: and I said, Ye shall call me Father; and ye shall not turn away from me.

fresh_translation: But as a woman acts faithlessly toward the one living with her, so the house of Israel acted faithlessly toward me, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: But as a wife acts treacherously against her husband, so has the house of Israel dealt treacherously against me, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: A voice was heard from lips: weeping and supplication of sons of Israel, because they did wrong in their ways and forgot their Holy God.
brenton_translation: A voice from the lips was heard, even of weeping and supplication of the children of Israel: for they have dealt unrighteously in their ways, they have forgotten God their Holy One.

fresh_translation: Return, returning sons, and I will heal your fractures. Behold, we will be your servants, because you are the Lord our God.
brenton_translation: Turn, ye children that are given to turning, and I will heal your bruises.

fresh_translation: Truly the hills and the might of the mountains were for falsehood, but through the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.
brenton_translation: Truly the hills and the strength of the mountains were a lying refuge: but by the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.

fresh_translation: And shame consumed the labors of our fathers from our youth, their sheep and their calves and their sons and their daughters.
brenton_translation: But shame has consumed the labours of our fathers from our youth; their sheep and their calves, and their sons and their daughters.

fresh_translation: We lay down in our shame, and our dishonor covered us, because we sinned before our God, we and our fathers, from our youth until this day, and did not obey the voice of the Lord our God.
brenton_translation: We have lain down in our shame, and our disgrace has covered us: because we and our fathers have sinned before our God, from our youth until this day; and we have not hearkened to the voice of the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: If Israel returns, says the Lord, he will return to me. If he removes his abominations from his mouth and is reverent before my face,
brenton_translation: If Israel will return to me, saith the Lord, he shall return: and if he will remove his abominations out of his mouth, and fear before me, and swear,

fresh_translation: and one swears, As the Lord lives, with truth and in judgment and in righteousness, then nations will bless in him, and in him they will praise God in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: The Lord lives, with truth, in judgment and righteousness, then shall nations bless by him, and by him they shall praise God in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord to the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: Break up fresh ground for yourselves and do not sow among thorns.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord to the men of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Break up fresh ground for yourselves, and sow not among thorns.

fresh_translation: Be circumcised to your God and circumcise your hardness of heart, men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, lest my wrath go out like fire and burn, and there be no one to quench it because of the evil of your practices.
brenton_translation: Circumcise yourselves to your God, and circumcise your hardness of heart, ye men of Juda, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my wrath go forth as fire, and burn, and there be none to quench it, because of the evil of your devices.

fresh_translation: Declare in Judah and let it be heard in Jerusalem. Say, Sound a trumpet upon the land, and cry out greatly, saying, Gather together and let us enter fortified cities.
brenton_translation: Declare ye in Juda, and let it be heard in Jerusalem: say ye, Sound the trumpet in the land; cry ye aloud: say ye, Gather yourselves together, and let us enter into the fortified cities.

fresh_translation: Take flight to Zion. Hurry, do not stand, because I am bringing evils from the north and a great crushing.
brenton_translation: Gather up your wares and flee to Sion: hasten, stay not: for I will bring evils from the north, and great destruction.

fresh_translation: A lion came up from his lair; a destroyer of nations rose and went out from his place to make the land a desolation, and cities will be demolished so as not to be inhabited.
brenton_translation: The lion is gone up from his lair, he has roused himself to the destruction of the nations, and has gone forth out of his place, to make the land desolate; and the cities shall be destroyed, so as to be without inhabitant.

fresh_translation: For these things gird yourselves with sackcloth and beat yourselves and howl, because the anger of the Lord has not turned away from you.
brenton_translation: For these things gird yourselves with sackclothes, and lament, and howl: for the anger of the Lord is not turned away from you.

fresh_translation: And it will be in that day, says the Lord, the heart of the king will perish and the heart of the rulers, and the priests will be amazed and the prophets will wonder.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be amazed, and the prophets shall wonder.

fresh_translation: And I said, Ah, Master Lord, surely you deceived this people and Jerusalem by deception, saying, Peace will be to you. And behold, the sword touched even to their soul.
brenton_translation: And I said, O sovereign Lord, verily thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, There shall be peace; whereas behold, the sword has reached even to their soul.

fresh_translation: At that time they will say to this people and to Jerusalem: A spirit of wandering in the wilderness is the way of the daughter of my people, not for cleansing nor for holiness.
brenton_translation: At that time they shall say to this people and to Jerusalem, There is a spirit of error in the wilderness: the way of the daughter of my people is not to purity, nor to holiness.

fresh_translation: A spirit of fullness will come to me. But now I myself speak judgments to them.
brenton_translation: But a spirit of full vengeance shall come upon me; and now I declare my judgments against them.

fresh_translation: Behold, like a cloud he will come up, and his chariots like a storm; his horses are lighter than eagles. Woe to us, because we are made miserable.
brenton_translation: Behold, he shall come up as a cloud, and his chariots as a tempest: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are in misery.

fresh_translation: Wash your heart from wickedness, Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will the thoughts of your labors remain in you?
brenton_translation: Cleanse thine heart from wickedness, O Jerusalem, that thou mayest be saved: how long will thy grievous thoughts be within thee?

fresh_translation: Because a voice of one declaring will come from Dan, and pain will be heard from the mountain of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: For a voice of one publishing from Dan shall come, and trouble out of mount Ephraim shall be heard of.

fresh_translation: Remind the nations. Behold, they have come. Declare in Jerusalem: Crowds are coming from a far land, and they gave their voice against the cities of Judah.
brenton_translation: Remind ye the nations; behold, they are come: proclaim it in Jerusalem, that bands are approaching from a land afar off, and have uttered their voice against the cities of Juda.

fresh_translation: Like keepers of a field they became against her all around, because you neglected me, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: As keepers of a field, they have surrounded her; because thou, saith the Lord, hast neglected me.

fresh_translation: Your ways and your practices did these things to you. This is your evil, because it is bitter, because it touched your heart.
brenton_translation: Thy ways and thy devices have brought these things upon thee; this is thy wickedness, for it is bitter, for it has reached to thy heart.

fresh_translation: My belly, my belly, I am in pain, and the feelings of my heart rage. My soul writhes. My heart is torn. I will not be silent, because my soul heard the voice of a trumpet, a cry of war.
brenton_translation: I am pained in my bowels, my bowels, and the sensitive powers of my heart; my soul is in great commotion, my heart is torn: I will not be silent, for my soul has heard the sound of a trumpet, the cry of war, and of distress: it calls on destruction;

fresh_translation: Affliction calls crushing, because the whole land has been afflicted. Suddenly my tent was afflicted; my skins were torn apart.
brenton_translation: for all the land is distressed: suddenly my tabernacle is distressed, my curtains have been rent asunder.

fresh_translation: How long will I see fugitives and hear the sound of trumpets?
brenton_translation: How long shall I see fugitives, and hear the sound of the trumpet?

fresh_translation: Because the leaders of my people did not know me. They are foolish sons and without understanding, wise to do evil, but they did not know how to do good.
brenton_translation: For the princes of my people have not known me, they are foolish and unwise children: they are wise to do evil, but how to do good they have not known.

fresh_translation: I looked upon the earth, and behold, nothing, and to heaven, and its lights were not.
brenton_translation: I looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was not; and to the sky, and there was no light in it.

fresh_translation: I saw the mountains, and they were trembling, and all the hills were shaken.
brenton_translation: I beheld the mountains, and they trembled, and I saw all the hills in commotion.

fresh_translation: I looked, and behold, there was no human, and all the birds of heaven were terrified.
brenton_translation: I looked, and, behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky were scared.

fresh_translation: I looked, and behold, Carmel was a desert, and all the cities were burned with fire. From the face of the Lord and from the face of the anger of his wrath they vanished.
brenton_translation: I saw, and, behold, Carmel was desert, and all the cities were burnt with fire at the presence of the Lord, and at the presence of his fierce anger they were utterly destroyed.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: The whole land will be a desolation, yet I will not make a full end.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, The whole land shall be desolate; but I will not make a full end.

fresh_translation: For these things let the earth mourn and heaven above be dark, because I spoke and will not change my mind; I set it in motion and will not turn back from it.
brenton_translation: For these things let the earth mourn, and let the sky be dark above: for I have spoken, and I will not repent; I have purposed, and I will not turn back from it.

fresh_translation: From the sound of a horseman and a bent bow every region withdrew. They entered the caves and hid in the groves and climbed the rocks. Every city was abandoned; no human dwells in them.
brenton_translation: The whole land has recoiled from the noise of the horseman and the bent bow; they have gone into the caves, and have hidden themselves in the groves, and have gone up upon the rocks: every city was abandoned, no man dwelt in them.

fresh_translation: And you, what will you do? If you dress in scarlet and adorn yourself with gold ornaments and paint your eyes with antimony, your beautifying is in vain. Lovers rejected you; they seek your soul.
brenton_translation: And what wilt thou do? Though thou clothe thyself with scarlet, and adorn thyself with golden ornaments; though thou adorn thine eyes with stibium, thy beauty will be in vain: thy lovers have rejected thee, they seek thy life.

fresh_translation: Because I heard a voice as of a woman in labor, your groaning as of one giving birth for the first time. The voice of the daughter of Zion will grow weak and let down her hands: Woe to me, because my soul fails because of slain ones.
brenton_translation: For I have heard thy groaning as the voice of a woman in travail, as of her that brings forth her first child; the voice of the daughter of Zion shall fail through weakness, and she shall lose the strength of her hands, saying, Woe is me! for my soul faints because of the slain.

fresh_translation: Run about in the streets of Jerusalem and see and know and seek in her broad places whether you find a man doing judgment and seeking faithfulness, and I will be gracious to them, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Run ye about in the streets of Jerusalem, and see, and know, and seek in her broad places, if ye can find one, if there is any one that does judgment, and seeks faithfulness; and I will pardon them, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: They say, As the Lord lives. Because of this, do they not swear by lies?
brenton_translation: The Lord lives, they say; do they not therefore swear falsely?

fresh_translation: Lord, are not your eyes for faithfulness? You struck them, and they were not pained. You finished them, and they did not want to receive discipline. They made their faces harder than rock and did not want to turn back.
brenton_translation: O Lord, thine eyes are upon faithfulness: thou hast scourged them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them; but they would not receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; and they would not return.

fresh_translation: And I said, Perhaps they are poor, because they were not able, because they did not know the way of the Lord and the judgment of God.
brenton_translation: Then I said, It may be they are poor; for they are weak, for they know not the way of the Lord, or the judgment of God.

fresh_translation: I will go to the great men and speak with them, because they knew the way of the Lord and the judgment of God. And behold, together they broke a yoke and tore bonds.
brenton_translation: I will go to the rich men, and will speak to them; for they have known the way of the Lord, and the judgment of God: but, behold, with one consent they have broken the yoke, they have burst the bonds.

fresh_translation: Therefore a lion from the forest struck them, and a wolf up to houses destroyed them, and a leopard kept watch over their cities. All those going out from them will be hunted, because they multiplied their ungodliness and grew strong in their turnings away.
brenton_translation: Therefore has a lion out of the forest smitten them, and a wolf has destroyed them even to their houses, and a leopard has watched against their cities: all that go forth from them shall be hunted: for they have multiplied their ungodliness, they have strengthened themselves in their revoltings.

fresh_translation: For which of these shall I be gracious to you? Your sons abandoned me and swore by the things that are not gods. And I fed them, and they committed adultery, and they lodged in prostitutes' houses.
brenton_translation: In what way shall I forgive thee for these things? Thy sons have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: and I fed them to the full, and they committed adultery, and lodged in harlots' houses.

fresh_translation: They became lustful horses; each one neighed after the wife of his neighbor.
brenton_translation: They became as wanton horses: they neighed each one after his neighbour's wife.

fresh_translation: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Shall not my soul avenge on such a nation?
brenton_translation: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the Lord: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this.

fresh_translation: Go up on her battlements and tear down, but do not make a full end. Leave her supports, because they are the Lord's.
brenton_translation: Go up upon her battlements, and break them down; but make not a full end: leave her buttresses; for they are the Lord's.

fresh_translation: Because the house of Israel and the house of Judah acted faithlessly toward me with faithlessness, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: For the house of Israel have indeed dealt treacherously against me, saith the Lord: the house of Juda also

fresh_translation: They lied to their Lord and said, These things are not; evils will not come upon us, and sword and famine we will not see.
brenton_translation: have lied to their Lord, and they have said, These things are not so; no evils shall come upon us; and we shall not see sword or famine.

fresh_translation: Our prophets were wind, and the word of the Lord was not in them. So it will be to them.
brenton_translation: Our prophets became wind, and the word of the Lord was not in them.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord Almighty: Because you spoke this word, behold, I have made my words in your mouth fire and this people as wood, and it will devour them.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord Almighty, Because ye have spoken this word, behold, I have made my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

fresh_translation: Behold, I bring on you a nation from far away, house of Israel, says the Lord, a nation whose language's voice you will not hear.
brenton_translation: Behold, I will bring upon you a nation from far, O house of Israel, saith the Lord; a nation the sound of whose language one shall not understand.

fresh_translation: All are mighty men.
brenton_translation: They are all mighty men:

fresh_translation: And they will eat your harvest and your breads, and they will eat your sons and your daughters, and they will eat your sheep and your calves, and they will eat your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive groves, and thresh your fortified cities in which you trust by sword.
brenton_translation: and they shall devour your harvest, and your bread; and shall devour your sons, and your daughters; and they shall devour your sheep, and your calves, and devour your vineyards, and your fig-plantations, and your olive yards: and they shall utterly destroy your strong cities, wherein ye trusted, with the sword.

fresh_translation: And it will be in those days, says the Lord your God, I will not make a full end of you.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass in those days, saith the Lord thy God, that I will not utterly destroy you.

fresh_translation: And it will be when you say, For what reason did the Lord our God do all these things to us? you will say to them, Because you served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve foreigners in a land not yours.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore has the Lord our God done all these things to us? that thou shalt say to them, Because ye served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.

fresh_translation: Declare these things to the house of Jacob and let it be heard in Judah.
brenton_translation: Proclaim these things to the house of Jacob, and let them be heard in the house of Juda.

fresh_translation: Hear now these things, foolish and heartless people: they have eyes and do not see, ears and do not hear.
brenton_translation: Hear ye now these things, O foolish and senseless people; who have eyes, and see not; and have ears, and hear not:

fresh_translation: Will you not fear me? says the Lord. Will you not tremble before my face? I set sand as a boundary for the sea, an everlasting command, and it will not pass it. It will be disturbed and not be able, and its waves will roar and not pass it.
brenton_translation: will ye not be afraid of me? saith the Lord; and will ye not fear before me, who have set the sand for a bound to the sea, as a perpetual ordinance, and it shall not pass it: yea, it shall rage, but not prevail; and its waves shall roar, but not pass over it.

fresh_translation: But for this people there came a disobedient and rebellious heart, and they turned aside and went away.
brenton_translation: But this people has a disobedient and rebellious heart; and they have turned aside and gone back:

fresh_translation: And they did not say in their heart, Let us now fear the Lord our God, the one giving us early and late rain in due season, the fullness of the appointed harvest, and he kept it for us.
