brenton_translation: and they have not said in their heart, Let us fear now the Lord our God, who gives us the early and latter rain, according to the season of the fulfilment of the ordinance of harvest, and has preserved it for us.

fresh_translation: Your lawless deeds turned these things away, and your sins removed good things from you.
brenton_translation: Your transgressions have turned away these things, and your sins have removed good things from you.

fresh_translation: Because among my people ungodly men were found, and they set traps to destroy men, and they captured them.
brenton_translation: For among my people were found ungodly men; and they have set snares to destroy men, and have caught them.

fresh_translation: As a snare set up full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit. Because of this they grew great and rich.
brenton_translation: As a snare which has been set is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore have they grown great, and become rich:

fresh_translation: And they passed over judgment. They did not judge the cause of an orphan, and the cause of a widow they did not judge.
brenton_translation: and they have transgressed the rule of judgment; they have not judged the cause of the orphan, nor have they judged the cause of the widow.

fresh_translation: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Shall not my soul avenge on such a nation?
brenton_translation: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the Lord: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

fresh_translation: Astonishment and horrors came upon the earth:
brenton_translation: Shocking and horrible deeds have been done on the land;

fresh_translation: Prophets prophesy unjust things, and priests clapped their hands, and my people loved it so. And what will you do afterward?
brenton_translation: the prophets utter unrighteous prophecies, and the priests have clapped their hands: and my people has loved to have it thus: and what will ye do for the future?

fresh_translation: Strengthen yourselves, sons of Benjamin, from the midst of Jerusalem, and in Tekoa sound a trumpet, and over Beth-haccherem lift a signal, because evils have leaned out from the north and great crushing is coming.
brenton_translation: Strengthen yourselves, ye children of Benjamin, to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and sound an alarm with the trumpet in Thecue, and set up a signal over Bæthacharma: for evil threatens from the north, and a great destruction is coming.

fresh_translation: Your height will be taken away, O daughter of Zion.
brenton_translation: And thy pride, O daughter of Sion, shall be taken away.

fresh_translation: Shepherds and their flocks will come to her, and they will pitch tents against her all around, and each will shepherd by his own hand.
brenton_translation: The shepherds and their flocks shall come to her; and they shall pitch their tents against her round about, and shall feed their flocks each with his hand.

fresh_translation: Prepare against her for war. Rise, and let us go up against her at noon. Woe to us, because the day has declined, because the shadows of evening fail.
brenton_translation: Prepare yourselves for war against her; rise up, and let us go up against her at noon. Woe to us! for the day has gone down, for the shadows of the day fail.

fresh_translation: Rise, and let us go up in the night and destroy her foundations.
brenton_translation: Rise, and let us go up against her by night, and destroy her foundations.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord: Cut down her trees, pour out strength against Jerusalem. O false city, all oppression is in her.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, Hew down her trees, array a numerous force against Jerusalem. O false city; there is all oppression in her.

fresh_translation: As a cistern cools its water, so her evil cools. Ungodliness and misery will be heard in her; before her face continually are pain and scourge.
brenton_translation: As a cistern cools water, so her wickedness cools her, ungodliness and misery shall be heard in her, as continually before her.

fresh_translation: Be disciplined, Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from you, lest I make you a pathless land that will not be inhabited.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt be chastened, O Jerusalem, with pain and the scourge, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee a desert land, which shall not be inhabited.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord: Glean, glean as a vine the remnants of Israel. Return like a grape-gatherer to his basket.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, Glean, glean thoroughly as a vine the remnant of Israel: turn back your hands as a grape-gatherer to his basket.

fresh_translation: To whom shall I speak and testify, and he will hear? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised and they cannot hear. Behold, the word of the Lord became a reproach to them. They will not want to hear it.
brenton_translation: To whom shall I speak, and testify, that he may hearken? behold, thine ears are uncircumcised, and they shall not be able to hear: behold, the word of the Lord is become to them a reproach, they will not at all desire it.

fresh_translation: And I was filled with my wrath and held it back, and I did not finish them. I will pour it on infants outside and on a gathering of young men together, because a man and a woman will be taken, an elder together with one full of days.
brenton_translation: And I allowed my wrath to come to the full, yet I kept it in, and did not utterly destroy them: I will pour it out on the children without, and on the assembly of young men together: for man and woman shall be taken together, the old man with him that is full of days.

fresh_translation: And their houses will be turned over to others, their fields and their wives together, because I will stretch out my hand upon those inhabiting this land, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And their houses shall be turned to others, with their fields and their wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of this land, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because from their small one even to their great one, all together completed lawless things; from priest even to false prophet, all practiced lies.
brenton_translation: For from the least of them even to the greatest they have all committed iniquity; from the priest even to the false prophet they have all wrought falsely.

fresh_translation: And they healed crushing of my people by treating it lightly and saying, Peace, peace, and where is peace?
brenton_translation: And they healed the breach of my people imperfectly, making light of it, and saying, Peace, peace: and where is peace?

fresh_translation: They were ashamed because they failed, yet not even as ashamed were they ashamed, and they did not know their dishonor. Therefore they will fall in their falling, and in the time of their visitation they will perish, said the Lord.
brenton_translation: They were ashamed because they failed; yet they were not ashamed as those who are truly ashamed, and they knew not their own disgrace: therefore shall they utterly fall when they do fall, and in the time of visitation shall they perish, said the Lord.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Stand on the roads and see and ask for the everlasting paths of the Lord, and see what the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find cleansing for your souls. And they said, We will not walk.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths of the Lord; and see what is the good way, and walk in it, and ye shall find purification for your souls. But they said, We will not walk in them.

fresh_translation: I set watchmen over you: Hear the sound of a trumpet. And they said, We will not hear.
brenton_translation: I have set watchmen over you, saying, Hear ye the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hear it.

fresh_translation: Therefore the nations heard, and those shepherding their flocks.
brenton_translation: Therefore have the nations heard, and they that feed their flocks.

fresh_translation: Hear, O earth. Behold, I bring on this people evils, the fruit of their turning away, because they paid no attention to my words and rejected my law.
brenton_translation: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evils upon this people, even the fruit of their rebellions; for they have not heeded my words, and they have rejected my law.

fresh_translation: Why do you bring me frankincense from Sheba and cinnamon from a far land? Your whole burnt offerings are not acceptable and your sacrifices did not please me.
brenton_translation: Wherefore do ye bring me frankincense from Saba, and cinnamon from a land afar off? your whole-burnt-offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices have not been pleasant to me.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I give this people weakness, and fathers and sons together will be weakened by it; a neighbor and his near one will perish.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring weakness upon this people, and the fathers and sons shall be weak together; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Behold, a people comes from the north, and a nation will be stirred from the end of the earth.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, a people comes from the north, and nations shall be stirred up from the end of the earth.

fresh_translation: They will grasp bow and javelin. He is harsh and will not show mercy. His voice is like a waving sea. On horses and chariots he will line up like fire for war against you, O daughter of Zion.
brenton_translation: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; the people is fierce, and will have no mercy; their voice is as the roaring sea; they shall array themselves for war against thee as fire on horses and chariots, O daughter of Sion.

fresh_translation: We heard their report; our hands were paralyzed. Affliction seized us, birth-pangs as of a woman giving birth.
brenton_translation: We have heard the report of them: our hands are weakened: anguish has seized us, the pangs as of a woman in travail.

fresh_translation: Do not go out into the field, and on the roads do not walk, because the sword of enemies lives all around.
brenton_translation: Go not forth into the field, and walk not in the ways; for the sword of the enemy lingers round about.

fresh_translation: O daughter of my people, gird sackcloth, roll in ashes, make for yourself mourning for a beloved one, bitter lament, because suddenly misery will come upon you.
brenton_translation: O daughter of my people, gird thyself with sackcloth: sprinkle thyself with ashes; make for thyself pitiable lamentation, as the mourning for a beloved son: for misery will come suddenly upon you.

fresh_translation: I have given you as a tester among tested peoples, and you will know me when I test their way.
brenton_translation: I have caused thee to be tried among tried nations, and thou shalt know me when I have tried their way.

fresh_translation: All are disobedient, walking crookedly; bronze and iron, all are corrupted.
brenton_translation: They are all disobedient, walking perversely: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupted.

fresh_translation: Bellows failed from fire, lead failed; the silversmith works silver in vain, their evil was not melted.
brenton_translation: The bellows have failed from the fire, the lead has failed: the silversmith works at his trade in vain; their wickedness is not consumed.

fresh_translation: Call them rejected silver, because the Lord rejected them.
brenton_translation: Call ye them reprobate silver, because the Lord has rejected them.

fresh_translation: Hear the word of the Lord, all Judah.
brenton_translation: Hear ye the word of the Lord, all Judea.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Correct your ways and your practices, and I will settle you in this place.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Correct your ways and your devices, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

fresh_translation: Do not trust in yourselves on false words that will surely not profit you, saying, Temple of the Lord, temple of the Lord it is.
brenton_translation: Trust not in yourselves with lying words, for they shall not profit you at all, saying, It is the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because if by correcting you truly correct your ways and your practices, and by doing you do judgment between a man and his neighbor,
brenton_translation: For if ye thoroughly correct your ways and your practices, and do indeed execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;

fresh_translation: and do not oppress a sojourner and an orphan and a widow, and do not pour out innocent blood in this place, and do not walk after foreign gods to your harm,
brenton_translation: and oppress not the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, and go not after strange gods to your hurt:

fresh_translation: then I will settle you in this place, in the land I gave to your fathers from age to age.
brenton_translation: then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land which I gave to your fathers of old and for ever.

fresh_translation: But if you trust in false words, from which you will not profit,
brenton_translation: But whereas ye have trusted in lying words, whereby ye shall not be profited;

fresh_translation: and murder and commit adultery and steal and swear unrighteously and burn incense to Baal and walk after foreign gods whom you do not know, for your harm,
brenton_translation: and ye murder, and commit adultery, and steal, and swear falsely, and burn incense to Baal, and are gone after strange gods whom ye know not,

fresh_translation: and you came and stood before me in the house over which my name has been called and said, We have held back from doing all these abominations—
brenton_translation: so that it is evil with you; yet have ye come, and stood before me in the house, whereon my name is called, and ye have said, We have refrained from doing all these abominations.

fresh_translation: Has my house over which my name has been called become a den of robbers there before you? And I, behold, have seen, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Is my house, whereon my name is called, a den of robbers in your eyes? And, behold, I have seen it, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: For go to my place in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell before, and see what I did to it because of the evil of my people Israel.
brenton_translation: For go ye to my place which is in Selo, where I caused my name to dwell before, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel.

fresh_translation: And now because you did all these works and I spoke to you and you did not hear me, and I called you and you did not answer,
brenton_translation: And now, because ye have done all these deeds, and I spoke to you, but ye hearkened not to me; and I called you, but ye answered not;

fresh_translation: I will do to this house over which my name has been called, on which you trust, and to the place I gave to you and to your fathers, just as I did to Shiloh.
brenton_translation: therefore I also will do to the house whereon my name is called, wherein ye trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Selo.

fresh_translation: And I will cast you out from my face, just as I cast out your brothers, all the seed of Ephraim.
brenton_translation: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I cast away your brethren, all the seed of Ephraim.

fresh_translation: And you, do not pray concerning this people, and do not ask that they be shown mercy, and do not vow, and do not come to me concerning them, because I will not hear.
brenton_translation: Therefore pray not thou for this people, and intercede not for them to be pitied, yea, pray not, and approach me not for them: for I will not hearken unto thee.

fresh_translation: Do you not see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
brenton_translation: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Juda, and in the streets of Jerusalem?

fresh_translation: Their sons gather wood, and their fathers kindle fire, and their women knead dough to make cakes for the host of heaven, and they poured drink offerings to foreign gods so as to provoke me.
brenton_translation: Their children gather wood, and their fathers kindle a fire, and their women knead dough, to make cakes to the host of heaven; and they have poured out drink-offerings to strange gods, that they might provoke me to anger.

fresh_translation: Do they provoke me? says the Lord. Is it not themselves, so that their faces may be ashamed?
brenton_translation: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the Lord: do they not provoke themselves, that their faces may be ashamed?

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, my anger and wrath are poured out on this place and on men and on cattle and on every tree of their field and on all the produce of the earth, and it will burn and not be quenched.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, my anger and wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and upon the men, and upon the cattle, and upon every tree of their field, and upon the fruits of the land; and it shall burn, and not be quenched.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Gather your whole burnt offerings with your sacrifices and eat flesh.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Gather your whole-burnt-offerings with your meat-offerings, and eat flesh.

fresh_translation: Because I did not speak to your fathers and did not command them on the day I brought them up from the land of Egypt concerning whole burnt offerings and sacrifice.
brenton_translation: For I spoke not to your fathers, and commanded them not in the day wherein I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, concerning whole-burnt-offerings and sacrifice:

fresh_translation: But this word I commanded them, saying, Hear my voice and I will be to you as God and you will be to me as people, and walk in all my ways that I command you, so that it may be well for you.
brenton_translation: but I commanded them this thing, saying, Hear ye my voice, and I will be to you a God, and ye shall be to me a people: and walk ye in all my ways, which I shall command you, that it may be well with you.

fresh_translation: And they did not hear me and did not incline their ear, but walked in the thoughts of their evil heart and became backward and not forward.
brenton_translation: But they hearkened not to me, and their ear gave no heed, but they walked in the imaginations of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward;

fresh_translation: From the day their fathers came out from the land of Egypt until this day, I sent to you all my servants the prophets; day by day and early morning I sent.
brenton_translation: from the day that their fathers went forth out of the land of Egypt, even until this day. And I sent to you all my servants, the prophets, by day and early in the morning: yea, I sent them,

fresh_translation: And they did not hear me and did not incline their ear and hardened their neck more than their fathers.
brenton_translation: but they hearkened not to me, and their ear gave no heed; and they made their neck harder than their fathers.

fresh_translation: And you will say to them this word: This is the nation that did not hear the voice of the Lord and did not receive discipline. Faithfulness perished from their mouth.
brenton_translation: Therefore thou shalt speak this word to them;

fresh_translation: Faithfulness perished from their mouth.
brenton_translation: This is the nation which has not hearkened to the voice of the Lord, nor received correction: truth has failed from their mouth.

fresh_translation: Shear your head and cast it away, and raise lament upon lips, because the Lord rejected and thrust away the generation doing these things.
brenton_translation: Cut off thine hair, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on thy lips; for the Lord has reprobated and rejected the generation that does these things.

fresh_translation: Because the sons of Judah did evil before me, says the Lord. They set their abominations in the house over which my name has been called, to defile it.
brenton_translation: For the children of Juda have wrought evil before me, saith the Lord; they have set their abominations in the house on which my name is called, to defile it.

fresh_translation: And they built the altar of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I did not command them, nor did I conceive it in my heart.
brenton_translation: And they have built the altar of Tapheth, which is in the valley of the son of Ennom, to burn their sons and their daughters with fire; which I did not command them to do, neither did I design it in my heart.

fresh_translation: Therefore behold, days come, says the Lord, and they will no longer say the altar of Topheth and the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of the slaughtered, and they will bury in Topheth because no place remains.
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when they shall no more say, The altar of Tapheth, and the valley of the son of Ennom, but, The valley of the slain; and they shall bury in Tapheth, for want of room.

fresh_translation: And the dead bodies of this people will be for food to the birds of heaven and the beasts of the earth, and none will frighten them away.
brenton_translation: And the dead bodies of this people shall be for food to the birds of the sky, and to the wild beasts of the earth; and there shall be none to drive them away.

fresh_translation: And I will make cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of rejoicing and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, because the whole land will become desolation.
brenton_translation: And I will destroy out of the cities of Juda, and the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of them that make merry, and the voice of them that rejoice, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride; for the whole land shall become a desolation.

fresh_translation: At that time, says the Lord, they will bring out the bones of the kings of Judah and the bones of their rulers and the bones of priests and the bones of prophets and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem from their tombs.
brenton_translation: At that time, saith the Lord, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Juda, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves;

fresh_translation: And they will spread them out toward the sun and the moon and all the stars and all the host of heaven, which they loved and served and went after and held fast and worshiped. They will not be mourned nor buried, and they will be an example upon the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: and they shall spread them out to the sun, and the moon, and to all the stars, and to all the host of heaven, which they have loved, and which they have served, and after which they have walked, and to which they have held, and which they have worshipped; they shall not be mourned for, neither shall they be buried; but they shall be for an example on the face of the earth,

fresh_translation: Because they chose death rather than life, for all the remnant left from that generation in every place where I drive them out.
brenton_translation: because they chose death rather than life, even to all the remnant that are left of that family, in every place whither I shall drive them out.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord: Will one falling not rise? Or one turning away not turn back?
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, Shall not he that falls arise? or he that turns away, shall he not turn back again?

fresh_translation: Why did this people of mine turn away with a shameless turning away? They held fast in their own choice and did not want to return.
brenton_translation: Wherefore has this my people turned away with a shameless revolting, and strengthened themselves in their wilfulness, and refused to return?

fresh_translation: Give ear now and hear: They will not speak thus. There is no one repenting from his evil, saying, What have I done? The one running from his course ceased, like a sweating horse in its neighing.
brenton_translation: Hearken, I pray you, and hear: will they not speak thus, There is no man that repents of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? the runner has failed from his course, as a tired horse in his neighing.

fresh_translation: And the stork in heaven knew its season; the turtledove and swallow of the field and sparrows kept the times of their comings. But my people did not know the judgments of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Yea, the stork in the heaven knows her time, also the turtle-dove and wild swallow; the sparrows observe the times of their coming in; but this my people knows not the judgments of the Lord.

fresh_translation: How will you say, We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us? In vain the false reed of scribes came to be.
brenton_translation: How will ye say, We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us? In vain have the scribes used a false pen.

fresh_translation: The wise men were ashamed and terrified and caught, because they rejected the word of the Lord. What wisdom is in them?
brenton_translation: The wise men are ashamed, and alarmed, and taken; because they have rejected the word of the Lord; what wisdom is there in them?

fresh_translation: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to heirs.
brenton_translation: Therefore will I give their wives to others, and their fields to new inheritors; and they shall gather their fruits, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And they will gather their produce, says the Lord. There is no grape on the vines, and no figs on the fig trees, and leaves have fallen.
brenton_translation: There are no grapes on the vines, and there are no figs on the fig-trees, and the leaves have fallen off.

fresh_translation: Why do we sit? Gather and let us enter fortified cities and be cast away, because God cast us away and gave us water of gall to drink, because we sinned against him.
brenton_translation: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the strong cities, and let us be cast out there: for God has cast us out, and made us drink water of gall, because we have sinned before him.

fresh_translation: We gathered for peace and there were no good things, for the time of healing and behold, haste.
brenton_translation: We assembled for peace, but there was no prosperity; for a time of healing, but behold anxiety.

fresh_translation: From Dan we will hear the sound of the swiftness of his horses. From the sound of neighing of his cavalry all the land shook, and he will come and devour the land and its fullness, the city and those dwelling in it.
brenton_translation: We shall hear the neighing of his swift horses out of Dan: the whole land quaked at the sound of the neighing of his horses; and he shall come, and devour the land and the fulness of it; the city, and them that dwell in it.

fresh_translation: Because behold, I send against you deadly serpents for which there is no charming, and they will bite you.
brenton_translation: For, behold, I send forth against you deadly serpents, which cannot be charmed, and they shall bite you

fresh_translation: Incurable things with pain; your heart is in distress.
brenton_translation: mortally with the pain of your distressed heart.

fresh_translation: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a far land: Is the Lord not in Zion? Is her king not there? Why did they provoke me with their carved images and foreign vanities?
brenton_translation: Behold, there is a sound of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land afar off: Is not the Lord in Sion? is there not a king there? because they have provoked me with their graven images, and with strange vanities.

fresh_translation: Summer passed, harvest ended, and we were not saved.
brenton_translation: The summer is gone, the harvest is past, and we are not saved.

fresh_translation: Over the crushing of the daughter of my people I was darkened. Distress seized me, pangs as of a woman giving birth.
brenton_translation: For the breach of the daughter of my people I have been saddened: in my perplexity pangs have seized upon me as of a woman in travail.

fresh_translation: Is there no resin in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why did healing of the daughter of my people not rise?
brenton_translation: And is there no balm in Galaad, or is there no physician there? why has not the healing of the daughter of my people taken place?

fresh_translation: Who will give my head water and my eyes a spring of tears? And I will weep for this people day and night, for the wounded ones of the daughter of my people.
brenton_translation: Who will give water to my head, and a fountain of tears to my eyes? then would I weep for this my people day and night, even for the slain of the daughter of my people.

fresh_translation: Who will give me a last lodging-place in the wilderness, that I may leave my people and go away from them? Because all commit adultery, a company of faithless ones.
brenton_translation: Who would give me a most distant lodge in the wilderness, that I might leave my people, and depart from them? for they all commit adultery, an assembly of treacherous men.

fresh_translation: And they bent their tongue like a bow: falsehood, and not faithfulness, grew strong on the land, because from evils to evils they went out, and me they did not know.
brenton_translation: And they have bent their tongue like a bow: falsehood and not faithfulness has prevailed upon the earth; for they have gone on from evil to evil, and have not known me, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Each guard yourselves from your neighbor, and do not trust in your brothers, because every brother will trip by the heel, and every friend will walk deceitfully.
brenton_translation: Beware ye each of his neighbour, and trust ye not in your brethren: for every one will surely supplant, and every friend will walk craftily.

fresh_translation: Each will mock his friend; they will certainly not speak truth. Their tongue has learned to speak lies. They did wrong and did not cease from turning back.
brenton_translation: Every one will mock his friend; they will not speak truth: their tongue has learned to speak falsehoods; they have committed iniquity, they ceased not, so as to return.

fresh_translation: Usury upon usury, deceit upon deceit; they did not want to know me.
brenton_translation: There is usury upon usury, and deceit upon deceit: they would not know me, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will refine them and test them, because what shall I do before the evil of the daughter of my people?
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will try them with fire, and prove them; for I will do thus because of the wickedness of the daughter of my people.

fresh_translation: Their tongue is a wounding arrow; words of their mouth are deceitful. To his neighbor he speaks peaceful things, but within himself he holds enmity.
brenton_translation: Their tongue is a wounding arrow; the words of their mouth are deceitful: one speaks peaceably to his neighbour, but in himself retains enmity.

fresh_translation: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Shall not my soul take vengeance on such a people?
brenton_translation: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the Lord: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a people as this?

fresh_translation: Take up mourning over the mountains and lament over the paths of the wilderness, because they failed so that there are no men, and they did not hear the sound of life; from the birds of heaven even to cattle, they were startled and went away.
brenton_translation: Take up a lamentation for the mountains, and a mournful dirge for the paths of the wilderness, for they are desolate for want of men; they heard not the sound of life from the birds of the sky, nor the cattle: they were amazed, they are gone.

fresh_translation: And I will give Jerusalem into exile and a dwelling-place of dragons, and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, so as not to be inhabited.
brenton_translation: And I will remove the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and make it a dwelling-place of dragons; and I will utterly waste the cities of Juda, so that they shall not be inhabited.

fresh_translation: Who is the wise man? Let him understand this. And to whom the word from the mouth of the Lord came, let him declare to you: Why did the land perish, burned like a wilderness, so as not to be passed through?
brenton_translation: Who is the wise man, that he may understand this? and he that has the word of the mouth of the Lord addressed to him, let him tell you wherefore the land has been destroyed, has been ravaged by fire like a desert, so that no one passes through it.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me: Because they abandoned my law which I gave before them and did not hear my voice,
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Because they have forsaken my law, which I set before them, and have not hearkened to my voice;

fresh_translation: but went after the things pleasing to their evil heart and after idols which their fathers taught them,
brenton_translation: but went after the lusts of their evil heart, and after the idols which their fathers taught them to worship:

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord God of Israel: Behold, I will feed them with hardships and give them water of gall to drink.
brenton_translation: therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Behold, I will feed them with trouble and will cause them to drink water of gall:

fresh_translation: And I will scatter them among nations which neither they nor their fathers knew, and I will send sword after them until I consume them by it.
brenton_translation: and I will scatter them among the nations, to them whom neither they nor their fathers knew; and I will send a sword upon them, until I have consumed them with it.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Call the mourning women and let them come, and send to the wise women and let them speak,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Call ye the mourning women, and let them come; and send to the wise women, and let them utter their voice;

fresh_translation: and let them take up lament over you, and let your eyes bring down tears and your eyelids flow with water.
brenton_translation: and let them take up a lamentation for you, and let your eyes pour down tears, and your eyelids drop water.

fresh_translation: Because the voice of lament was heard in Zion: How we were made miserable! We were greatly ashamed, because we abandoned the land and threw away our tents.
brenton_translation: For a voice of lamentation has been heard in Sion, How are we become wretched! we are greatly ashamed, for we have forsaken the land, and have abandoned our tabernacles!

fresh_translation: Hear now, women, the word of God, and let your ears receive words from his mouth. Teach your daughters lament and each woman her neighbor mourning.
brenton_translation: Hear now, ye women, the word of God, and let your ears receive the words of his mouth, and teach your daughters lamentation, and every woman her neighbour a dirge.

fresh_translation: Because death came up through your windows, entered your land, to destroy infants outside and young men from the broad places.
brenton_translation: For death has come up through your windows, it has entered into our land, to destroy the infants without, and the young men from the streets.

fresh_translation: And the dead bodies of men will be an example upon the face of the field of your land, and like grass behind the reaper, and none will gather.
brenton_translation: And the carcases of the men shall be for an example on the face of the field of your land, like grass after the mower, and there shall be none to gather them.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, and let not the strong man boast in his strength, and let not the rich man boast in his riches,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, and let not the strong man boast in his strength, and let not the rich man boast in his wealth;

fresh_translation: but in this let the one boasting boast: to understand and know that I am the Lord, doing mercy and judgment and righteousness on the earth, because in these is my will, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: but let him that boasts boast in this, the understanding and knowing that I am the Lord that exercise mercy, and judgment, and righteousness, upon the earth; for in these things is my pleasure, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Behold, days come, says the Lord, and I will visit all circumcised in their foreskin:
brenton_translation: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will visit upon all the circumcised their uncircumcision;

fresh_translation: upon Egypt and upon Judah and upon Edom and upon the sons of Ammon and upon the sons of Moab and upon all those who clip the hair around the face, those dwelling in the wilderness, because all nations are uncircumcised in flesh and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in their hearts.
brenton_translation: on Egypt, and on Idumea, and on Edom, and on the children of Ammon, and on the children of Moab, and on every one that shaves his face round about, even them that dwell in the wilderness; for all the Gentiles are uncircumcised in flesh, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in their hearts.

fresh_translation: Hear the word of the Lord which he spoke concerning you, house of Israel.
brenton_translation: Hear ye the word of the Lord, which he has spoken to you, O house of Israel.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Do not learn according to the ways of the nations, and do not fear the signs of heaven, because they fear them before their faces.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Learn ye not the ways of the heathen, and be not alarmed at the signs of the sky; for they are alarmed at them, falling on their faces.

fresh_translation: Because the customs of nations are vain. It is a tree cut out of the forest, work of a carpenter and a casting.
brenton_translation: For the customs of the nations are vain; it is a tree cut out of the forest, the work of the carpenter, or a molten image.

fresh_translation: They are adorned with silver and gold. With hammers and nails they fastened them and they will not move.
brenton_translation: They are beautified with silver and gold, they fix them with hammers and nails;

fresh_translation: Carried, they will be carried, because they will not step. Do not fear them, because they surely will not do evil, and there is no good in them.
brenton_translation: they will set them up that they may not move; it is wrought silver, they will not walk,

fresh_translation: There is beaten silver; they will not walk. Refined silver will come from Tarshish, gold from Uphaz, handwork of goldsmiths, works of craftsmen. They will clothe them in blue and purple.
brenton_translation: it is forged silver brought from Tharsis, gold will come from Mophaz, and the work of goldsmiths: they are all the works of craftsmen, they will clothe themselves with blue and scarlet.

fresh_translation: Thus you will say to them: The gods who did not make heaven and earth, let them perish from the earth and from under this heaven.
brenton_translation: Thus shall ye say to them, Let the gods which have not made heaven and earth perish from off the earth, and from under this sky.

fresh_translation: The Lord is the one making the earth by his strength, the one setting upright the inhabited world by his wisdom, and by his understanding stretched out heaven.
brenton_translation: It is the Lord that made the earth by his strength, who set up the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding stretched out the sky,

fresh_translation: And there is abundance of water in heaven, and he brought up clouds from the end of the earth, made lightning for rain, and brought out light from his treasuries.
brenton_translation: and set abundance of waters in the sky, and brought up clouds from the ends of the earth; he made lightnings for the rain, and brought forth light out of his treasures.

fresh_translation: Every man was made foolish apart from knowledge. Every goldsmith was ashamed over his carved things, because they cast lies; there is no breath in them.
brenton_translation: Every man is deprived of knowledge, every goldsmith is confounded because of his graven images; for he has cast false gods, there is no breath in them.

fresh_translation: They are vanities, works made a mockery. In the time of their visitation they will perish.
brenton_translation: They are vain works, wrought in mockery; in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

fresh_translation: Not like these is the portion of Jacob, because the one shaping all things, he is his inheritance. The Lord is his name.
brenton_translation: Such is not the portion of Jacob; for he that formed all things, he is his inheritance; the Lord is his name.

fresh_translation: Gather your substance from outside, you dwelling among chosen places.
brenton_translation: He has gathered thy substance from without that lodged in choice vessels.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord: Behold, I sling out the inhabitants of this land in affliction, so that your wound may be found.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will overthrow the inhabitants of this land with affliction, that thy plague may be discovered.

fresh_translation: Woe over your crushing; your wound is painful. And I said, Truly this is my blow, and it seized me.
brenton_translation: Alas for thy ruin! thy plague is grievous: and I said, Surely this is thy wound, and it has overtaken thee.

fresh_translation: My tent was made miserable and perished, and all my skins were torn apart. My sons and my sheep are not. There is no longer a place for my tent, a place for my skins.
brenton_translation: Thy tabernacle is in a ruinous state, it has perished; and all thy curtains have been torn asunder: my children and my cattle are no more: there is no more any place for my tabernacle, nor place for my curtains.

fresh_translation: Because the shepherds acted foolishly and did not seek the Lord. Therefore the whole pasture did not understand, and they were scattered.
brenton_translation: For the shepherds have become foolish, and have not sought the Lord; therefore the whole pasture has failed, and the sheep have been scattered.

fresh_translation: The voice of report, behold, comes, and great shaking from the land of the north, to make the cities of Judah a desolation and a lodging-place of sparrows.
brenton_translation: Behold, there comes a sound of a noise, and a great earthquake from the land of the north, to make the cities of Juda a desolation, and a resting-place for ostriches.

fresh_translation: I know, Lord, that the way of man is not his own, nor will a man walk and direct his path.
brenton_translation: I know, O Lord, that man's way is not his own; neither shall a man go, and direct his going.

fresh_translation: Discipline us, Lord, but in judgment and not in wrath, lest you make us few.
brenton_translation: Chasten us, O Lord, but with judgment; and not in wrath, lest thou make us few.

fresh_translation: Pour out your wrath on the nations not knowing you and on families who did not call upon your name, because they devoured Jacob and consumed him and made his pasture desolate.
brenton_translation: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that have not known thee, and upon the families that have not called upon thy name: for they have devoured Jacob, and consumed him, and have made his pasture desolate.

fresh_translation: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying,
brenton_translation: The word that came to Jeremias from the Lord, saying,

fresh_translation: Hear the words of this covenant and speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
brenton_translation: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and thou shalt speak to the men of Juda, and to the dwellers in Jerusalem;

fresh_translation: and you will say to them, Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Cursed is the man who will not hear the words of this covenant,
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Cursed is the man, who shall not hearken to the words of this covenant,

fresh_translation: which I commanded your fathers on the day I brought them up from the land of Egypt, from an iron furnace, saying, Hear my voice and do all whatever I command you, and you will be my people and I will be your God,
brenton_translation: which I commanded your fathers, in the day wherein I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, Hearken to my voice, and do all things that I shall command you; so shall ye be to me a people, and I will be to you a God;

fresh_translation: so that I may establish my oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. And I answered and said, So be it, Lord.
brenton_translation: that I may confirm mine oath, which I sware to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then I answered and said, So be it, O Lord.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Read these words in the cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, saying, Hear the words of this covenant and do them.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Read these words in the cities of Juda, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.

fresh_translation: And they did not do them.
brenton_translation: But they did them not.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, A conspiracy was found among the men of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Juda, and among the dwellers in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: They turned back to the injustices of their former fathers, who did not want to hear my words, and behold, they walk after foreign gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah broke my covenant which I made with their fathers.
brenton_translation: They are turned aside to the iniquities of their fathers that were of old, who would not hearken to my words: and, behold, they go after strange gods, to serve them: and the house of Israel and the house of Juda have broken my covenant, which I made with their fathers.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I bring on this people evils from which they will not be able to go out, and they will cry to me and I will not hear them.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I bring evils upon this people, out of which they shall not be able to come forth; and they shall presently cry to me, but I will not hearken to them.

fresh_translation: And the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to whom they burn incense; they surely will not save them in the time of their evils.
brenton_translation: And the cities of Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem shall go, and cry to the gods to whom they burn incense; which shall not deliver them in the time of their troubles.

fresh_translation: Because according to the number of your cities were your gods, Judah, and according to the number of streets of Jerusalem you set up altars to burn incense to Baal.
brenton_translation: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Juda; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to burn incense to Baal.

fresh_translation: And you, do not pray concerning this people and do not ask concerning them in supplication and prayer, because I will not hear when they call upon me in the time of their affliction.
brenton_translation: And thou, pray not for this people, and intercede not for them in supplication and prayer: for I will not hear in the day in which they call upon me, in the day of their affliction.

fresh_translation: Why has my beloved done abomination in my house? Will vows and holy flesh remove your evils from you, or will you escape by these?
brenton_translation: Why has my beloved wrought abomination in my house? will prayers and holy offerings take away thy wickedness from thee, or shalt thou escape by these things?

fresh_translation: A beautiful olive tree, fair in appearance, the Lord called your name. At the sound of its pruning, fire was kindled on it. Great affliction came on you; its branches were made useless.
brenton_translation: The Lord called thy name a fair olive tree, of a goodly shade in appearance, at the noise of its being lopped, fire was kindled against it; great is the affliction coming upon thee: her branches are become good for nothing.

fresh_translation: And the Lord who planted you spoke evils against you because of the evil of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, because they did for themselves things to provoke me by their burning incense to Baal.
brenton_translation: And the Lord that planted thee has pronounced evils against thee, because of the iniquity of the house of Israel and the house of Juda, whatsoever they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger by burning incense to Baal.

fresh_translation: Lord, make it known to me and I will know; then I saw their practices.
brenton_translation: O Lord, teach me, and I shall know: then I saw their practices.

fresh_translation: And I was like an innocent lamb led to be sacrificed. I did not know they reasoned an evil thought against me, saying, Come and let us cast wood into his bread and wipe him out from the land of the living, and his name shall no longer be remembered.
brenton_translation: But I as an innocent lamb led to the slaughter, knew not: against me they devised an evil device, saying, Come and let us put wood into his bread, and let us utterly destroy him from off the land of the living, and let his name not be remembered any more.

fresh_translation: Lord, judging righteous things, testing kidneys and heart, let me see your vengeance from them, because to you I revealed my case.
brenton_translation: O Lord, that judgest righteously, trying the reins and hearts, let me see thy vengeance taken upon them, for to thee I have declared my cause.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord against the men of Anathoth who seek my life, saying, You shall not prophesy in the name of the Lord, or else you will die in our hands.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the men of Anathoth, that seek my life, that say, Thou shalt not prophesy at all in the name of the Lord, but if thou dost, thou shalt die by our hands:

fresh_translation: Behold, I will visit upon them. Their young men will die by the sword, and their sons and daughters will die by famine.
brenton_translation: behold, I will visit them: their young men shall die by the sword; and their sons and their daughters shall die of famine:

fresh_translation: And no remnant of them will exist, because I will bring evils upon the inhabitants of Anathoth in the year of their visitation.
brenton_translation: and there shall be no remnant left of them; for I will bring evil upon the dwellers in Anathoth, in the year of their visitation.

fresh_translation: You are righteous, Lord, because I will make my defense to you; yet I will speak judgments to you: Why does the way of the ungodly prosper? All who act faithlessly with faithless acts flourished.
brenton_translation: Righteous art thou, O Lord, that I may make my defence to thee, yea, I will speak to thee of judgments. Why is it that the way of ungodly men prospers? that all that deal very treacherously are flourishing?

fresh_translation: You planted them and they took root. They bore children and made fruit. You are near in their mouth and far from their kidneys.
brenton_translation: Thou hast planted them, and they have taken root; they have begotten children, and become fruitful; thou art near to their mouth, and far from their reins.

fresh_translation: And you, Lord, know me. You tested my heart before you. Set them apart for the day of their slaughter.
brenton_translation: But thou, Lord, knowest me; thou hast proved my heart before thee; purify them for the day of their slaughter.

fresh_translation: How long will the land mourn and every grass of the field dry up? Because of the evil of those dwelling in it, cattle and birds vanished, because they said, God will not see our ways.
brenton_translation: How long shall the land mourn, and the grass of the field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell in it? the beasts and birds are utterly destroyed; because the people said, God shall not see our ways.

fresh_translation: Your feet run and wear you out; how will you prepare to mount horses? And in the land of peace you trusted; how will you do in the thicket of the Jordan?
brenton_translation: Thy feet run, and they cause thee to faint; how wilt thou prepare to ride upon horses? and thou hast been confident in the land of thy peace? how wilt thou do in the roaring of Jordan?

fresh_translation: Because even your brothers and the house of your father, they also dealt faithlessly with you, and they cried out after you from behind. Do not believe them when they speak good things to you.
brenton_translation: For even thy brethren and the house of thy father, even these have dealt treacherously with thee; and they have cried out, they are gathered together in pursuit of thee; trust not thou in them, though they shall speak fair words to thee.

fresh_translation: I have abandoned my house, left my inheritance, given the beloved of my soul into the hands of her enemies.
brenton_translation: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given my beloved one into the hands of her enemies.

fresh_translation: My inheritance became to me like a lion in the forest; it gave its voice against me; therefore I hated it.
brenton_translation: My inheritance has become to me as a lion in a forest; she has uttered her voice against me; therefore have I hated her.

fresh_translation: Is my inheritance a hyena's cave to me, a cave around her? Go, gather all the beasts of the field, and let them come to devour her.
brenton_translation: Is not my inheritance to me a hyæna's cave, or a cave round about her? Go ye, gather together all the wild beasts of the field, and let them come to devour her.

fresh_translation: Many shepherds ruined my vineyard, defiled my portion, gave my desirable portion into a pathless desert.
brenton_translation: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard, they have defiled my portion, they have made my desirable portion a trackless wilderness;

fresh_translation: It was made into destruction; for me in destruction the whole land was made desolate, because no one lays it to heart.
brenton_translation: it is made a complete ruin: for my sake the whole land has been utterly ruined, because there is none that lays the matter to heart.

fresh_translation: Over every opening in the wilderness came destroyers, because the sword of the Lord will devour from one end of the earth to the other end; there is no peace for any flesh.
brenton_translation: The ravagers are come to every passage in the wilderness: for the sword of the Lord will devour from one end of the land to the other: no flesh has any peace.

fresh_translation: You sowed wheat and reaped thorns. Their allotments will not profit them. Be ashamed of your boastings, because of reproach before the Lord.
brenton_translation: Sow wheat, and reap thorns; their portions shall not profit them: be ashamed of your boasting, because of reproach before the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord concerning all evil neighbors touching my inheritance which I portioned to my people Israel: Behold, I pull them away from their land and cast Judah out from their midst.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord concerning all the evil neighbours that touch mine inheritance, which I have divided to my people Israel; Behold, I will draw them away from their land, and I will cast out Juda from the midst of them.

fresh_translation: And it will be after I cast them out, I will return and have mercy on them and settle each in his inheritance and each in his land.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, after I have cast them out, that I will return, and have mercy upon them, and will cause them to dwell every one in his inheritance, and every one in his land.

fresh_translation: And it will be if in learning they learn the way of my people, to swear by my name, As the Lord lives, just as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built in the midst of my people.
brenton_translation: And it shall be, if they will indeed learn the way of my people, to swear by my name, saying, The Lord lives; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall that nation be built in the midst of my people.

fresh_translation: But if they do not return, then I will uproot that nation with uprooting and destruction.
brenton_translation: But if they will not return, then will I cut off that nation with utter ruin and destruction.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Go and buy for yourself a linen belt and put it around your waist, and it shall not pass through water.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Go and procure for thyself a linen girdle, and put it about thy loins, and let it not be put in water.

fresh_translation: And I bought the belt according to the word of the Lord and put it around my waist.
brenton_translation: So I procured the girdle according to the word of the Lord, and put it about my loins.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Take the belt around your waist and rise and go to the Euphrates and hide it there in the hole of the rock.
brenton_translation: Take the girdle that is upon thy loins, and arise, and go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.

fresh_translation: And I went and hid it by the Euphrates, just as the Lord commanded me.
brenton_translation: So I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.

fresh_translation: And it happened after many days, and the Lord said to me, Rise, go to the Euphrates and take from there the belt which I commanded you to hide there.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after many days, that the Lord said to me, Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take thence the girdle, which I commanded thee to hide there.

fresh_translation: And I went to the Euphrates River and dug and took the belt from the place where I buried it there, and behold, it was ruined, fit for nothing.
brenton_translation: So I went to the river Euphrates, and dug, and took the girdle out of the place where I had buried it: and, behold, it was rotten, utterly good for nothing.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thus saith the Lord,

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: So I ruin the pride of Judah and the pride of Jerusalem,
brenton_translation: Thus will I mar the pride of Juda, and the pride of Jerusalem;

fresh_translation: this great pride of those not wanting to hear my words and going after foreign gods to serve them and worship them. And they will become like this belt which is fit for nothing.
brenton_translation: even this great pride of the men that will not hearken to my words, and have gone after strange gods, to serve them, and to worship them: and they shall be as this girdle, which can be used for nothing.

fresh_translation: Because just as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so I made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to me, to become to me a notable people and praise and glory, and they did not hear me.
brenton_translation: For as a girdle cleaves about the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave to myself the house of Israel, and the whole house of Juda; that they might be to me a famous people, and a praise, and a glory: but they did not hearken to me.

fresh_translation: And you will say to this people, Every wineskin will be filled with wine. And it will be if they say to you, Do we not know that every wineskin will be filled with wine?
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say to this people, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and it shall come to pass, if they shall say to thee, Shall we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine? that thou shalt say to them,

fresh_translation: And you will say to them, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I fill the inhabitants of this land and their kings, the sons of David seated upon his throne, and the priests and the prophets and Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with drunkenness.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will fill the inhabitants of this land, and their kings the sons of David that sit upon their throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and Juda and all the dwellers in Jerusalem, with strong drink.

fresh_translation: And I will scatter them, a man and his brother and their fathers and their sons together. I will not pity, says the Lord, and I will not spare and I will not show mercy from their destruction.
brenton_translation: And I will scatter them a man and his brother, and their fathers and their sons together: I will not have compassion, saith the Lord, and I will not spare, neither will I pity to save them from destruction.

fresh_translation: Hear and give ear and do not exalt yourselves, because the Lord spoke.
brenton_translation: Hear ye, and give ear, and be not proud: for the Lord has spoken.

fresh_translation: Give glory to the Lord your God before he brings darkness, and before your feet stumble on dark mountains, and you wait for light and there is the shadow of death, and they will be set into darkness.
brenton_translation: Give glory to the Lord your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and ye shall wait for light, and behold the shadow of death, and they shall be brought into darkness.

fresh_translation: And if you do not hear, your soul will weep secretly because of pride, and your eyes will bring down tears because the flock of the Lord was crushed.
brenton_translation: But if ye will not hearken, your soul shall weep in secret because of pride, and your eyes shall pour down tears, because the Lord's flock is sorely bruised.

fresh_translation: Say to the king and to the rulers, Be humbled and sit down, because the crown of your glory fell from your head.
brenton_translation: Say ye to the king and the princes, Humble yourselves, and sit down; for your crown of glory is removed from your head.

fresh_translation: The cities toward the south were shut, and there was no one opening. Judah was carried away, a complete exile.
brenton_translation: The cities toward the south were shut, and there was none to open them: Juda is removed into captivity, they have suffered a complete removal.

fresh_translation: Lift up your eyes, Jerusalem, and see those coming from the north. Where is the flock given to you, the sheep of your glory?
brenton_translation: Lift up thine eyes, O Jerusalem, and behold them that come from the north; where is the flock that was given thee, the sheep of thy glory?

fresh_translation: What will you say when they visit you, and you taught them lessons against yourself for rule? Will birth-pangs not seize you like a woman giving birth?
brenton_translation: What wilt thou say when they shall visit thee, for thou didst teach them lessons for rule against thyself; shall not pangs seize thee as a woman in travail?

fresh_translation: And if you say in your heart, Why did these things meet me? Because of the multitude of your injustice your hind parts were uncovered, your heels exposed as an example.
brenton_translation: And if thou shouldest say in thine heart, Wherefore have these things happened to me? Because of the abundance of thine iniquity have thy skirts been discovered, that thine heels might be exposed.

fresh_translation: If an Ethiopian can change his skin and a leopard her spots, then you also will be able to do good, having learned evil things.
brenton_translation: If the Ethiopian shall change his skin, or the leopardess her spots, then shall ye be able to do good, having learnt evil.

fresh_translation: And I scattered them like brushwood carried by the wind into the wilderness.
brenton_translation: So I scattered them as sticks carried by the wind into the wilderness.

fresh_translation: This is your lot and the portion of your disobeying me, says the Lord, because you forgot me and hoped in lies.
brenton_translation: Thus is thy lot, and the reward of your disobedience to me, saith the Lord; as thou didst forget me, and trust in lies,

fresh_translation: And I also will uncover your back parts over your face, and your dishonor will be seen.
brenton_translation: I also will expose thy skirts upon thy face, and thy shame shall be seen;

fresh_translation: Your adultery and your neighing and alienation of your prostitution on the hills and in the fields--I saw your abominations. Woe to you, Jerusalem, because you were not cleansed after me. How much longer?
brenton_translation: thine adultery also, and thy neighing, and the looseness of thy fornication: on the hills and in the fields I have seen thine abominations. Woe to thee, O Jerusalem, for thou hast not been purified so as to follow me; how long yet shall it be?

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.
brenton_translation: And the Word of the Lord came to Jeremias concerning the Drought.

fresh_translation: Judah mourned, and her gates were emptied and darkened upon the earth, and the cry of Jerusalem went up.
brenton_translation: Judea has mourned, and her gates are emptied, and are darkened upon the earth; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

fresh_translation: And her nobles sent their younger ones for water. They came to the wells and found no water and returned their vessels empty.
brenton_translation: And her nobles have sent their little ones to the water: they came to the wells, and found no water: and brought back their vessels empty.

fresh_translation: And the works of the earth failed because there was no rain. Farmers were ashamed; they covered their heads.
brenton_translation: And the labours of the land failed, because there was no rain: the husbandmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

fresh_translation: And does in the field gave birth and abandoned them because there was no grass.
brenton_translation: And hinds calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.

fresh_translation: Wild donkeys stood on hilltops and drew in wind. Their eyes failed because there was no grass because of the injustice of the people.
brenton_translation: The wild asses stood by the forests, and snuffed up the wind; their eyes failed, because there was no grass.

fresh_translation: If our sins stood against us, Lord, do for us for your sake, because many are our sins before you, because against you we sinned.
brenton_translation: Our sins have risen up against us: O Lord, do thou for us for thine own sake; for our sins are many before thee; for we have sinned against thee.

fresh_translation: Hope of Israel, Lord, you save in the time of evils; why did you become like a resident alien upon the land and like a native one turning aside into lodging?
brenton_translation: O Lord, thou art the hope of Israel, and deliverest us in time of troubles; why art thou become as a sojourner upon the land, or as one born in the land, yet turning aside for a resting-place?

fresh_translation: Do not be like a sleeping man or like a man unable to save. And you are among us, Lord, and your name is called upon us; do not forget us.
brenton_translation: Wilt thou be as a man asleep, or as a strong man that cannot save? yet thou art among us, O Lord, and thy name is called upon us; forget us not.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord to this people: They loved to move their feet and did not spare, and God took no pleasure in them. Now he will remember their injustices.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord to this people, They have loved to wander, and they have not spared, therefore God has not prospered them; now will he remember their iniquity.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Do not pray concerning this people for good things.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Pray not for this people for their good:

fresh_translation: Because if they fast, I will not hear their supplication, and if they offer whole burnt offerings and sacrifices, I will not take pleasure in them, because by the sword and by famine and by death I will consume them.
brenton_translation: for though they fast, I will not hear their supplication; and though they offer whole-burnt-offerings and sacrifices, I will take no pleasure in them: for I will consume them with sword, and with famine, and with pestilence.

fresh_translation: And I said, O Lord, behold, their prophets prophesy and say, You will not see the sword nor will there be famine among you, because I will give truth and peace on the land and in this place.
brenton_translation: And I said, O ever living Lord! behold, their prophets prophesy, and say, Ye shall not see a sword, nor shall famine be among you; for I will give truth and peace on the land, and in this place.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name. I did not send them and did not command them and did not speak to them. False visions and divinations and omens and choices of their own hearts they prophesy to you.
brenton_translation: Then the Lord said to me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, and I commanded them not, and I spoke not to them: for they prophesy to you false visions, and divinations, and auguries, and devices of their own heart.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the prophets prophesying lies in my name whom I did not send, those saying, The sword and famine will not be on this land: By diseased death they will die and by famine the prophets will be finished.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that prophesy lies in my name, and I sent them not, who say, Sword and famine shall not be upon this land; they shall die by a grievous death, and the prophets shall be consumed by famine.

fresh_translation: And the people to whom they prophesy will lie thrown in the streets of Jerusalem from the face of the sword and the famine, and there will be no one burying them and their wives and their sons and their daughters, and I will pour out on them their evils.
brenton_translation: And the people to whom they prophesy, they also shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem, because of the sword and famine; and there shall be none to bury them: their wives also, and their sons, and their daughters shall die thus; and I will pour out their wickedness upon them.

fresh_translation: And you will say to them this word: Let your eyes bring down tears day and night and let them not cease, because the daughter of my people was crushed with crushing, a very grievous wound.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt speak this word to them; Let your eyes shed tears day and night, and let them not cease: for the daughter of my people has been sorely bruised, and her plague is very grievous.

fresh_translation: If I go out into the field, behold, wounded by the sword, and if I enter the city, behold, pain from famine, because priest and prophet went into the land which they did not know.
brenton_translation: If I go forth into the plain, then behold the slain by the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold the distress of famine! for priest and prophet have gone to a land which they knew not.

fresh_translation: Did you utterly reject Judah, and did your soul depart from Zion? Why did you strike us and there is no healing for us? We waited for peace and there were no good things, for the time of healing and behold, disturbance.
brenton_translation: Hast thou utterly rejected Juda? and has thy soul departed from Sion? wherefore hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we waited for peace, but there was no prosperity; for a time of healing, and behold trouble!

fresh_translation: We know, Lord, our sins and the injustices of our fathers, because we sinned against you.
brenton_translation: We know, O Lord, our sins, and the iniquities of our fathers: for we have sinned before thee.

fresh_translation: Cease for your name's sake; do not destroy the throne of your glory. Remember; do not break your covenant with us.
brenton_translation: Refrain for thy name's sake, destroy not the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

fresh_translation: Is there among the idols of the nations one who gives rain? Or will heaven give its fullness? Are you not he? And we will wait for you, because you made all these things.
brenton_translation: Is there any one among the idols of the Gentiles that can give rain? and will the sky yield his fulness at their bidding? Art not thou he? we will even wait on thee, O Lord: for thou hast made all these things.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, If Moses and Samuel should stand before my face, my soul would not be toward them. Send out this people and let them go out.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before my face, my soul could not be toward them: dismiss this people, and let them go forth.

fresh_translation: And it will be if they say to you, Where will we go out? Then you will say to them, Thus says the Lord: Those for death, to death; and those for the sword, to the sword; and those for famine, to famine; and those for captivity, to captivity.
brenton_translation: And it shall be, if they say to thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord; As many as are for death, to death; and as many as are for famine, to famine; and as many as are for the sword, to the sword; and as many as are for captivity, to captivity.

fresh_translation: And I will avenge on them with four kinds, says the Lord: the sword for slaughter and the dogs for tearing and the beasts of the earth and the birds of heaven for food and ruin.
brenton_translation: And I will punish them with four kinds of death, saith the Lord, the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the wild beasts of the earth, and the birds of the sky to devour and destroy.

fresh_translation: And I will hand them over to troubles for all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah, because of all he did in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And I will deliver them up for distress to all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasses son of Ezekias king of Juda, for all that he did in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: Who will spare you, Jerusalem? And who will be timid over you? Or who will turn back for your peace?
brenton_translation: Who will spare thee, O Jerusalem? and who will fear for thee? or who will turn back to ask for thy welfare?

fresh_translation: You turned away from me, says the Lord; backward you will go. And I will stretch out my hand and destroy you, and I will no longer let them rest.
brenton_translation: Thou hast turned away from me, saith the Lord, thou wilt go back: therefore I will stretch out my hand, and will destroy thee, and will no more spare them.

fresh_translation: And I will scatter them in dispersion in the gates of my people. They were made childless; they destroyed my people because of their evils.
brenton_translation: And I will completely scatter them; in the gates of my people they are bereaved of children: they have destroyed my people because of their iniquities.

fresh_translation: Their widows multiplied beyond the sand of the sea. I brought against the mother of a young man, misery at noon. I cast on her sudden terror and haste.
brenton_translation: Their widows have been multiplied more than the sand of the sea: I have brought young men against the mother, even distress at noon-day: I have suddenly cast upon her trembling and anxiety.

fresh_translation: She who bore seven was emptied; her soul grew faint. Her sun set while it was still the middle of the day. She was ashamed and reproached. Their remnant I will give to the sword before their enemies.
brenton_translation: She that bore seven is spent; her soul has fainted under trouble; her sun is gone down while it is yet noon; she is ashamed and disgraced: I will give the remnant of them to the sword before their enemies.

fresh_translation: Woe to me, mother, that you bore me, a man being judged and contending with the whole land. I neither profited nor did anyone profit me. My strength failed among those cursing me.
brenton_translation: Woe is me, my mother! thou hast born me as some man of strife, and at variance with the whole earth; I have not helped others, nor has any one helped me; my strength has failed among them that curse me.

fresh_translation: Let it be, Master, as you straighten their way. Did I not stand before you in the time of their evils and in the time of their affliction for good things toward the enemy?
brenton_translation: Be it so, Lord, in their prosperity; surely I stood before thee in the time of their calamities, and in the time of their affliction, for their good against the enemy.

fresh_translation: Will iron and bronze armor be known?
brenton_translation: Will iron be known? whereas thy strength is a brazen covering.

fresh_translation: Your strength and your treasures I will give for plunder, as payment for all your sins and throughout all your borders.
brenton_translation: Yea, I will give thy treasures for a spoil as a recompence, because of all thy sins, and that in all thy borders.

fresh_translation: And I will enslave you to your enemies round about in a land you did not know, because fire has been kindled from my wrath; upon you it will burn.
brenton_translation: And I will enslave thee to thine enemies round about, in a land which thou hast not known; for a fire has been kindled out of my wrath; it shall burn upon you.

fresh_translation: Lord, remember me and visit me and vindicate me from those who persecute me. In your long-suffering know that I took reproach for your sake.
brenton_translation: O Lord, remember me, and visit me, and vindicate me before them that persecute me; do not bear long with them; know how I have met with reproach for thy sake, from those who set at nought thy words;
