fresh_translation: By those rejecting your words, consume them. And your word will be to me joy and gladness of my heart, because your name is called upon me, O Lord Almighty.
brenton_translation: consume them; and thy word shall be to me for the joy and gladness of my heart: for thy name has been called upon me, O Lord Almighty.

fresh_translation: I did not sit in their gathering as they played, but I feared before your hand. I sat alone, because I was filled with bitterness.
brenton_translation: I have not sat in the assembly of them as they mocked, but I feared because of thy power: I sat alone, for I was filled with bitterness.

fresh_translation: Why do those grieving me prevail over me? My wound is severe; from where will I be healed? It became to me like false water, having no faithfulness.
brenton_translation: Why do they that grieve me prevail against me? my wound is severe; whence shall I be healed? it is indeed become to me as deceitful water, that has no faithfulness.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: If you return, I will restore you and you will stand before my face. And if you bring out precious from the worthless, you will be as my mouth. They will return to you, but you will not return to them.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, If thou wilt return, then will I restore thee, and thou shalt stand before my face: and if thou wilt bring forth the precious from the worthless, thou shalt be as my mouth: and they shall return to thee; but thou shalt not return to them.

fresh_translation: And I will make you for this people as a fortified bronze wall, and they will fight against you and surely not prevail against you, because I am with you to save you
brenton_translation: And I will make thee to this people as a strong brazen wall; and they shall fight against thee, but they shall by no means prevail against thee;

fresh_translation: and to deliver you from the hand of evil ones, and I will redeem you from the hand of pestilent men.
brenton_translation: for I am with thee to save thee, and to deliver thee out of the hand of wicked men; and I will ransom thee out of the hand of pestilent men.

fresh_translation: And you, do not take a wife, says the Lord God of Israel.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt not take a wife, saith the Lord God of Israel:

fresh_translation: And no son or daughter will be born to you in this place.
brenton_translation: and there shall be no son born to thee, nor daughter in this place.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord concerning the sons and concerning the daughters born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them and their fathers who fathered them in this land:
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that have born them, and concerning their fathers that have begotten them in this land;

fresh_translation: By diseased death they will die. They will not be mourned and not buried. They will be as an example upon the face of the earth. By the sword they will fall and by famine be finished, and they will be food for the beasts of the earth and birds of heaven.
brenton_translation: They shall die of grievous death; they shall not be lamented, nor buried; they shall be for an example on the face of the earth; and they shall be for the wild beasts of the land, and for the birds of the sky: they shall fall by the sword, and shall be consumed with famine.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Do not enter into their drinking feast, and do not go to cut yourself and do not mourn them, because I have removed my peace from this people.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Enter not into their mourning feast, and go not to lament, and mourn not for them: for I have removed my peace from this people.

fresh_translation: They will not cut themselves for them, nor make gashes, nor shave themselves.
brenton_translation: They shall not bewail them, nor make cuttings for them, and they shall not shave themselves for them:

fresh_translation: And bread will surely not be broken in their mourning for comfort over a dead one, and he will not be given a cup for comfort over his father and mother.
brenton_translation: and there shall be no bread broken in mourning for them for consolation over the dead: they shall not give one to drink a cup for consolation over his father or his mother.

fresh_translation: Into the house of drinking you will not enter to sit with them to eat and drink.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt not enter into the banquet-house, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord God of Israel: Behold, I destroy from this place before your eyes and in your days the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of a bridegroom and the voice of a bride.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel; Behold, I will make to cease out of this place before your eyes, and in your days, the voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.

fresh_translation: And it will be when you announce to this people all these words and they say to you, Why did the Lord speak on us all these evils? What is our injustice, and what is our sin which we sinned against the Lord our God?
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt report to this people all these words, and they shall say to thee, Wherefore has the Lord pronounced against us all these evils? what is our unrighteousness? and what is our sin which we have sinned before the Lord our God?

fresh_translation: Then you will say to them, Because your fathers abandoned me, says the Lord, and went after foreign gods and served them and worshiped them, and me they abandoned, and they did not keep my law.
brenton_translation: Then thou shalt say to them, Because your fathers forsook me, saith the Lord, and went after strange gods and served them, and worshipped them, and forsook me, and kept not my law;

fresh_translation: And you acted more evilly than your fathers, and behold, you each walk after the pleasures of your evil heart, so as not to obey me.
brenton_translation: (and ye sinned worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the lusts of your own evil heart, so as not to hearken to me);

fresh_translation: And I will cast you away from this land into a land which you and your fathers did not know, and there you will serve other gods who will not give you mercy.
brenton_translation: therefore I will cast you off from this good land into a land which neither ye nor your fathers have known; and ye shall serve there other gods, who shall have no mercy upon you.

fresh_translation: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say, As the Lord lives who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt,
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when they shall no more say, The Lord lives, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

fresh_translation: but, As the Lord lives who brought up the house of Israel from the land of the north and from all regions where they were driven there, and I will restore them to their land which I gave to their fathers.
brenton_translation: but, The Lord lives, who brought up the house of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries whither they were thrust out: and I will restore them to their own land, which I gave to their fathers.

fresh_translation: Behold, I send many fishers, says the Lord, and they will fish them, and after these I will send many hunters, and they will hunt them on every mountain and hill and from clefts of the rocks.
brenton_translation: Behold, I will send many fishers, saith the Lord, and they shall fish them; and afterward I will send many hunters, and they shall hunt them upon every mountain, and upon every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

fresh_translation: Because my eyes are on all their ways, and their injustices were not hidden from before my eyes.
brenton_translation: For mine eyes are upon all their ways; and their iniquities have not been hidden from mine eyes.

fresh_translation: And I will repay their injustices and their sins double, by which they profaned my land with corpses of their abominations and by their lawless deeds in which they offended my inheritance.
brenton_translation: And I will recompense their mischiefs doubly, and their sins, whereby they have profaned my land with the carcases of their abominations, and with their iniquities, whereby they have trespassed against mine inheritance.

fresh_translation: Lord, my strength and my help and my refuge in the day of evils, to you the nations will come from the end of the earth and say, Our fathers truly possessed lies, idols, and there is no profit in them.
brenton_translation: O Lord, thou art my strength, and mine help, and my refuge in days of evil: to thee the Gentiles shall come from the end of the earth, and shall say, How vain were the idols which our fathers procured to themselves, and there is no help in them.

fresh_translation: Will a man make gods for himself, and these are not gods?
brenton_translation: Will a man make gods for himself, whereas these are no gods?

fresh_translation: Therefore behold, I will show them my hand at this time and make my power known to them, and they will know that my name is the Lord.
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, I will at this time manifest my hand to them, and will make known to them my power; and they shall know that my name is the Lord.

fresh_translation: Cursed is the man who has hope in man and will make flesh the support of his arm upon him, and whose heart departs from the Lord.
brenton_translation: Cursed is the man who trusts in man, and will lean his arm of flesh upon him, while his heart departs from the Lord.

fresh_translation: And he will be like the tamarisk in the wilderness and will not see when good things come, and he will dwell in barren places and in the wilderness, in a salty land which is not inhabited.
brenton_translation: And he shall be as the wild tamarisk in the desert: he shall not see when good comes; but he shall dwell in barren places, and in the wilderness, in a salt land which is not inhabited.

fresh_translation: And blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, and the Lord will be his hope.
brenton_translation: But blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord shall be.

fresh_translation: And he will be like a flourishing tree by waters and will cast its roots toward moisture, and it will not fear when heat comes, and on it will be woodland shoots. In the year of drought it will not fear and will not cease making fruit.
brenton_translation: And he shall be as a thriving tree by the waters, and he shall cast forth his root toward a moist place: he shall not fear when heat comes, and there shall be upon him shady branches: he shall not fear in a year of drought, and he shall not fail to bear fruit.

fresh_translation: Deep is the heart beyond all things, and it is man; and who will know him?
brenton_translation: The heart is deep beyond all things, and it is the man, and who can know him?

fresh_translation: I, the Lord, search hearts and test kidneys, to give to each according to his ways and according to the fruits of his practices.
brenton_translation: I the Lord try the hearts, and prove the reins, to give to every one according to his ways, and according to the fruits of his devices.

fresh_translation: A partridge cried out, gathering what she did not bear. One making his wealth not with judgment, in the middle of his days they will leave him, and at his end he will be a fool.
brenton_translation: The partridge utters her voice, she gathers eggs which she did not lay; so is a man gaining his wealth unjustly; in the midst of his days his riches shall leave him, and at his latter end he will be a fool.

fresh_translation: An exalted throne of glory is our sanctuary.
brenton_translation: An exalted throne of glory is our sanctuary.

fresh_translation: Hope of Israel, Lord, let all who abandon you be ashamed. Let those departing be written upon the earth, because they abandoned the fountain of life, the Lord.
brenton_translation: O Lord, the hope of Israel, let all that have left thee be ashamed, let them that have revolted be written on the earth, because they have forsaken the fountain of life, the Lord.

fresh_translation: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved, because you are my boasting.
brenton_translation: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved; for thou art my boast.

fresh_translation: Behold, they say to me, Where is the word of the Lord? Let it come.
brenton_translation: Behold, they say to me, Where is the word of the Lord? let it come.

fresh_translation: But I did not grow weary following after you, and a day of man I did not desire. You know what goes out through my lips; it is before your face.
brenton_translation: But I have not been weary of following thee, nor have I desired the day of man; thou knowest; the words that proceed out of my lips are before thy face.

fresh_translation: Do not become alienation to me, sparing me in an evil day.
brenton_translation: Be not to me a stranger, but spare me in the evil day.

fresh_translation: Let those persecuting me be ashamed, and let me not be ashamed. Let them be terrified, and let me not be terrified. Bring on them an evil day; crush them with double crushing.
brenton_translation: Let them that persecute me be ashamed, but let me not be ashamed: let them be alarmed, but let me not be alarmed: bring upon them the evil day, crush them with double destruction.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Go and stand in the gates of the sons of your people, in which the kings of Judah enter and go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; Go and stand in the gates of the children of thy people, by which the kings of Juda enter, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem:

fresh_translation: and say to them, Hear the word of the Lord, kings of Judah and all Judah and all Jerusalem, entering in these gates.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say to them, Hear the word of the Lord, ye kings of Juda, and all Judea, and all Jerusalem, all who go in at these gates:

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Guard your souls and do not carry burdens on the day of Sabbaths and do not go out by the gates of Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: thus saith the Lord; Take heed to your souls, and take up no burdens on the sabbath-day, and go not forth through the gates of Jerusalem;

fresh_translation: And do not bring burdens out of your houses on the day of Sabbaths, and do no work. Sanctify the day of Sabbaths, just as I commanded your fathers, and they did not hear and did not incline their ear.
brenton_translation: and carry forth no burdens out of your houses on the sabbath-day, and ye shall do no work: sanctify the sabbath-day, as I commanded your fathers.

fresh_translation: And they hardened their neck more than their fathers, not to hear me and not to receive discipline.
brenton_translation: But they hearkened not, and inclined not their ear, but stiffened their neck more than their fathers did, so as not to hear me, and not to receive correction.

fresh_translation: And it will be if in hearing you hear me, says the Lord, not bringing burdens through the gates of this city on the day of Sabbaths and sanctifying the day of Sabbaths, so as not to do any work,
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, if ye will hearken to me, saith the Lord, to carry in no burdens through the gates of this city on the sabbath-day, and to sanctify the sabbath-day, so as to do no work upon it,

fresh_translation: then kings and rulers seated on the throne of David will enter through the gates of this city and mounted on their chariots and on their horses, they and their rulers, men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.
brenton_translation: that there shall enter through the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on the throne of David, and riding on their chariots and horses, they, and their princes, the men of Juda, and the dwellers in Jerusalem: and this city shall be inhabited for ever.

fresh_translation: And they will come from the cities of Judah and from around Jerusalem and from the land of Benjamin and from the lowland and from the mountain and from the south, bringing whole burnt offerings and sacrifice and incense and grain offering and frankincense, bringing praise into the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And men shall come out of the cities of Juda, and from round about Jerusalem, and out of the land of Benjamin, and out of the plain country, and from the hill country, and from the south country, bringing whole-burnt-offerings, and sacrifices, and incense, and manna, and frankincense, bringing praise to the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it will be if you do not hear me, to sanctify the day of Sabbaths, not to carry burdens and not to enter by the gates of Jerusalem on the day of Sabbaths, then I will kindle fire in her gates and it will devour the streets of Jerusalem and will not be quenched.
brenton_translation: But it shall come to pass, if ye will not hearken to me to sanctify the sabbath-day, to bear no burdens, nor go in with them by the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath-day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the streets of Jerusalem, and shall not be quenched.

fresh_translation: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying,
brenton_translation: The word that came from the Lord to

fresh_translation: Rise and go down into the house of the potter, and there you will hear my words.
brenton_translation: Jeremias, saying, Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there thou shalt hear my words.

fresh_translation: And I went down into the house of the potter, and behold, he was doing work upon the stones.
brenton_translation: So I went down to the potter's house, and behold, he was making a vessel on the stones.

fresh_translation: And the vessel which he was making fell apart in his hands, and again he made it another vessel, just as it pleased him to make.
brenton_translation: And the vessel which he was making with his hands fell: so he made it again another vessel, as it seemed good to him to make it.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Will I not be able to make you as this potter does, house of Israel? Behold, as the clay of the potter, you are in my hands.
brenton_translation: Shall I not be able, O house of Israel, to do to you as this potter? behold, as the clay of the potter are ye in my hands.

fresh_translation: At one moment I will speak concerning a nation or concerning a kingdom, to root them up and destroy.
brenton_translation: If I shall pronounce a decree upon a nation, or upon a kingdom, to cut them off, and to destroy them;

fresh_translation: And if that nation turns from all its evils, then I will repent concerning the evils which I planned to do to them.
brenton_translation: and that nation turn from all their sins, then will I repent of the evils which I purposed to do to them.

fresh_translation: And at another moment I will speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, that it be built and planted.
brenton_translation: And if I shall pronounce a decree upon a nation and kingdom, to rebuild and to plant it;

fresh_translation: And if they do evil before me, not hearing my voice, then I will repent concerning the good things which I spoke to do for them.
brenton_translation: and they do evil before me, so as not to hearken to my voice, then will I repent of the good which I spoke of, to do it to them.

fresh_translation: And now speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: Behold, I am forming evils against you and planning a plan against you. Let each turn from his evil way, and you will make your practices better.
brenton_translation: And now say to the men of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Behold, I prepare evils against you, and devise a device against you: let every one turn now from his evil way, and amend your practices.

fresh_translation: And they said, We will be strong, because after our turnings away we will go, and each will do the pleasures of his own evil heart.
brenton_translation: And they said, We will quit ourselves like men, for we will pursue our perverse ways, and we will perform each the lusts of his evil heart.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Ask now among the nations: who heard such fearful things which virgin Israel did exceedingly?
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Enquire now among the nations, who has heard such very horrible things as the virgin of Israel has done?

fresh_translation: Will breasts fail from rock, or snow from Lebanon? Will water carried violently by wind turn aside?
brenton_translation: Will fertilising streams fail to flow from a rock, or snow fail from Libanus? will water violently impelled by the wind turn aside?

fresh_translation: Because my people forgot me. In vain they burned incense, and they will be weakened in their ways, everlasting tracks, to step on paths having no road for walking,
brenton_translation: For my people have forgotten me, they have offered incense in vain, and they fail in their ways, leaving the ancient tracks, to enter upon impassable paths;

fresh_translation: to set their land for destruction and everlasting hissing. All who pass through it will be astonished and shake their heads.
brenton_translation: to make their land a desolation, and a perpetual hissing; all that go through it shall be amazed, and shall shake their heads.

fresh_translation: Like a burning wind I will scatter them before the face of their enemies. I will show them the day of their destruction.
brenton_translation: I will scatter them before their enemies like an east wind; I will shew them the day of their destruction.

fresh_translation: And they said, Come, let us think a thought against Jeremiah, because law will not perish from a priest, and counsel from a wise man, and word from a prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue and hear all his words.
brenton_translation: Then they said, Come, and let us devise a device against Jeremias; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and we will hear all his words.

fresh_translation: Hear me, Lord, and hear the voice of my plea.
brenton_translation: Hear me, O Lord, and hear the voice of my pleading.

fresh_translation: Is evil repaid in place of good? Because they spoke words against my soul and hid their punishment for me. Remember my standing before your face to speak good things for them, to turn your wrath away from them.
brenton_translation: Forasmuch as evil is rewarded for good; for they have spoken words against my soul, and they have hidden the punishment they meant for me; remember that I stood before thy face, to speak good for them, to turn away thy wrath from them.

fresh_translation: Therefore give their sons to famine and gather them into the hands of a sword. Let their wives become childless and widows, and let their men become killed by death, and their young men fallen by sword in war.
brenton_translation: Therefore do thou deliver their sons to famine, and gather them to the power of the sword: let their women be childless and widows; and let their men be cut off by death, and their young men fall by the sword in war.

fresh_translation: Let a cry come in their houses, because you will bring robbers on them suddenly, because they laid a word for my capture and hid snares against me.
brenton_translation: Let there be a cry in their houses: thou shalt bring upon them robbers suddenly: for they have formed a plan to take me, and have hidden snares for me.

fresh_translation: And you, Lord, knew all their counsel against me for death. Do not acquit their injustices, and do not wipe away their sins from before your face. Let their weakness be before you; in the time of your wrath, do in them.
brenton_translation: And thou, Lord, knowest all their deadly counsel against me: account not their iniquities guiltless, and blot not out their sins from before thee: let their weakness come before thee; deal with them in the time of thy wrath.

fresh_translation: Then the Lord said to me, Go and buy a shaped earthen jar and bring some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests,
brenton_translation: Then said the Lord to me, Go and get an earthen bottle, the work of the potter, and thou shalt bring some of the elders of the people, and of the priests;

fresh_translation: and you will go out to the burial place of the sons of their children, which is by the entrances of the Gate of Potsherd, and there read all the words which I speak to you,
brenton_translation: and thou shalt go forth to the burial-place of the sons of their children, which is at the entrance of the gate of Charsith; and do thou read there all these words which I shall speak to thee:

fresh_translation: and say to them, Hear the word of the Lord, kings of Judah and men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and those entering these gates. Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Behold, I bring evils on this place so that both ears of everyone hearing them will ring.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say to them,

fresh_translation: Because they abandoned me and estranged this place and burned incense in it to foreign gods whom they and their fathers and kings of Judah did not know, and they filled this place with innocent bloods,
brenton_translation: Because they forsook me, and profaned this place, and burnt incense in it to strange gods, which they and their fathers knew not; and the kings of Juda have filled this place with innocent blood,

fresh_translation: and built high places to Baal to burn their sons in fire, which I did not command, nor speak, nor conceive in my heart.
brenton_translation: and built high places for Baal, to burn their children in the fire, which things I commanded not, neither did I design them in my heart:

fresh_translation: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and this place will no longer be called Falling Away and burial place of the son of Hinnom, but burial place of slaughter.
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when this place shall no more be called, The fall and burial-place of the son of Ennom, but, The burial-place of slaughter.

fresh_translation: And I will slaughter the counsel of Judah and the counsel of Jerusalem in this place, and I will cast them down by the sword before their enemies and in the hands of those seeking their souls, and I will give their dead bodies for food to the birds of heaven and the beasts of the earth.
brenton_translation: And I will destroy the counsel of Juda and the counsel of Jerusalem in this place; and I will cast them down with the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and I will give their dead bodies for food to the birds of the sky and to the wild beasts of the earth.

fresh_translation: And I will set this city for destruction and hissing. Everyone passing by it will look gloomy and hiss over every plague of it.
brenton_translation: And I will bring this city to desolation and make it a hissing; every one that passes by it shall scowl, and hiss because of all her plague.

fresh_translation: And they will eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and each will eat the flesh of his neighbor in the siege and in the straitness with which their enemies will besiege them.
brenton_translation: And they shall eat the flesh of their sons, and the flesh of their daughters; and they shall eat every one the flesh of his neighbour in the blockade, and in the siege wherewith their enemies shall besiege them.

fresh_translation: And you will crush the jar before the eyes of the men going out with you,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt break the bottle in the sight of the men that go forth with thee,

fresh_translation: and say, Thus says the Lord: So I will crush this people and this city just as an earthen vessel is crushed which can no longer be healed.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord, Thus will I break in pieces this people, and this city, even as an earthen vessel is broken in pieces which cannot be mended again.

fresh_translation: Thus I will do, says the Lord, to this place and to those dwelling in it, to make this city like the fallen place.
brenton_translation: Thus will I do, saith the Lord, to this place, and to the inhabitants of it, that this city may be given up, as one that is falling to ruin.

fresh_translation: And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be as the place of falling away of uncleannesses, in all the houses in which they burned incense on their roofs to all the army of heaven and poured drink offerings to foreign gods.
brenton_translation: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Juda shall be as a ruinous place, because of their uncleannesses in all the houses, wherein they burnt incense upon their roofs to all the host of heaven, and poured drink-offerings to strange gods.

fresh_translation: And Jeremiah came from the place of falling away where the Lord sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the house of the Lord and said to all the people,
brenton_translation: And Jeremias came from the place of the Fall, whither the Lord had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the Lord's house; and said to all the people, Thus saith the Lord;

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I bring on this city and on all her cities and on her villages all the evils which I spoke against her, because they hardened their neck so as not to hear my words.
brenton_translation: Behold, I bring upon this city, and upon all the cities belonging to it, and upon the villages of it, all the evils which I have spoken against it, because they have hardened their neck, that they might not hearken to my commands.

fresh_translation: And Pashhur son of Immer, the priest, who was appointed ruler of the house of the Lord, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
brenton_translation: Now Paschor the son of Emmer, the priest, who also had been appointed chief of the house of the Lord, heard Jeremias prophesying these words.

fresh_translation: And he struck him and threw him into the stocks, which were at the gate of the appointed upper house, which was in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And he smote him, and cast him into the dungeon which was by the gate of the upper house that was set apart, which was by the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Pashhur brought Jeremiah out from the stocks, and Jeremiah said to him, The Lord did not call your name Pashhur, but Exile.
brenton_translation: And Paschor brought Jeremias out of the dungeon: and Jeremias said to him, The Lord has not called thy name Paschor, but Exile.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord: Behold, I give you into exile with all your friends, and they will fall by the sword of their enemies and your eyes will see, and I will give you and all Judah into the hands of the king of Babylon, and they will carry them away and cut them down with swords.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will give thee up to captivity with all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall see it: and I will give thee and all Juda into the hands of the king of Babylon, and they shall carry them captives, and cut them in pieces with swords.

fresh_translation: And I will give all the strength of this city and all its toils and all the treasures of the king of Judah into the hands of his enemies, and they will carry them into Babylon.
brenton_translation: And I will give all the strength of this city, and all the labours of it, and all the treasures of the king of Juda, into the hands of his enemies, and they shall bring them to Babylon.

fresh_translation: And you and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity, and in Babylon you will die, and there you will be buried, you and all your friends to whom you prophesied lies.
brenton_translation: And thou and all the dwellers in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt die in Babylon, and there thou and all thy friends shall be buried, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.

fresh_translation: You deceived me, Lord, and I was deceived. You overpowered me and prevailed. I became a laughingstock all day. I was continually mocked.
brenton_translation: Thou hast deceived me, O Lord, and I have been deceived: thou hast been strong, and hast prevailed: I am become a laughing-stock, I am continually mocked every day.

fresh_translation: Because with my bitter word I will laugh. Lawlessness and misery I will call out, because the word of the Lord became to me for reproach and for mockery all my days.
brenton_translation: For I will laugh with my bitter speech, I will call upon rebellion and misery: for the word of the Lord is become a reproach to me and a mockery all my days.

fresh_translation: And I said, I will not name the name of the Lord and I will not speak any longer in his name. And it became like a burning fire flaming in my bones, and I am weakened from every side and cannot bear it.
brenton_translation: Then I said, I will by no means name the name of the Lord, and I will no more at all speak in his name. But it was as burning fire flaming in my bones, and I am utterly weakened on all sides, and cannot bear up.

fresh_translation: Because I heard the blame of many gathering around: Assemble, and let us assemble against him. All men who are his friends, watch his thought, if he will be deceived, and we will prevail against him and take our vengeance from him.
brenton_translation: For I have heard the reproach of many gathering round, saying, Conspire ye, and let us conspire together against him, even all his friends: watch his intentions, if perhaps he shall be deceived, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall be avenged on him.

fresh_translation: And the Lord is with me like a mighty warrior. Because of this they persecuted me and could not prevail. They were greatly ashamed, because they did not understand. Their eternal dishonors will not be forgotten.
brenton_translation: But the Lord was with me as a mighty man of war: therefore they persecuted me, but could not perceive anything against me; they were greatly confounded, for they perceived not their disgrace, which shall never be forgotten.

fresh_translation: Lord, testing righteous things and understanding kidneys and hearts, let me see from you vengeance on them, because to you I revealed my defense.
brenton_translation: O Lord, that provest just deeds, understanding the reins and hearts, let me see thy vengeance upon them: for to thee I have revealed my cause.

fresh_translation: Sing to the Lord. Praise him, because he rescued the soul of a poor man from the hand of evildoers.
brenton_translation: Sing ye to the Lord, sing praise to him: for he has rescued the soul of the poor from the hand of evil-doers.

fresh_translation: Cursed be the day in which I was born. Let not the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.
brenton_translation: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: the day wherein my mother brought me forth, let it not be blessed.

fresh_translation: Cursed be the man who brought good news to my father, saying, A male was born to you, rejoicing with joy.
brenton_translation: Cursed be the man who brought the glad tidings to my father, saying, A male child is born to thee.

fresh_translation: Let that man be like the cities which the Lord overthrew in anger and did not relent. Let him hear a cry in the morning and a battle-shout at midday,
brenton_translation: Let that man rejoice as the cities which the Lord overthrew in wrath, and repented not: let him hear crying in the morning, and loud lamentation at noon;

fresh_translation: because he did not kill me in the womb of my mother, and my mother became my tomb and her womb a womb of eternal conception.
brenton_translation: because he slew me not in the womb, and my mother became not my tomb, and her womb always great with me.

fresh_translation: Why was this? I came out from the womb to see toils and pains, and my days passed in shame.
brenton_translation: Why is it that I came forth of the womb to see troubles and distresses, and my days are spent in shame?

fresh_translation: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Melchiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
brenton_translation: The Word that came from the Lord to Jeremias, when King Sedekias sent to him Paschor the Son of Melchias, and Sophonias Son of Basæas, the Priest, saying,

fresh_translation: Ask the Lord concerning us, because the king of Babylon has risen against us, if the Lord will act according to all his wonders and depart from us.
brenton_translation: Enquire of the Lord for us; for the king of Babylon has risen up against us; if the Lord will do according to all his wonderful works, and the king shall depart from us.

fresh_translation: And Jeremiah said to them, Thus you will say to Zedekiah king of Judah,
brenton_translation: And Jeremias said to them, Thus shall ye say to Sedekias king of Juda,

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I turn back the weapons of war with which you fight against the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the wall, into the midst of this city.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war wherewith ye fight against the Chaldeans that have besieged you from outside the wall, and I will gather them into the midst of this city.

fresh_translation: And I myself will fight you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, with wrath and anger and great provocation.
brenton_translation: And I will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, with wrath and great anger.

fresh_translation: And I will strike all who dwell in this city, men and cattle, with great death, and they will die.
brenton_translation: And I will smite all the dwellers in this city, both men and cattle, with grievous pestilence: and they shall die.

fresh_translation: And after these things, thus says the Lord, I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his servants and the people left in this city from death and from famine and from sword into the hands of their enemies seeking their lives, and they will cut them down with the edge of a sword. I will not spare them and I will not pity them.
brenton_translation: And after this, thus saith the Lord; I will give Sedekias king of Juda, and his servants, and the people that is left in this city from the pestilence, and from the famine, and from the sword, into the hands of their enemies, that seek their lives: and they shall cut them in pieces with the edge of the sword: I will not spare them, and I will not have compassion upon them.

fresh_translation: And to this people you will say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I have given before your face the way of life and the way of death.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say to this people, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I have set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

fresh_translation: The one dwelling in this city will die by sword and by famine, but the one going out to join the Chaldeans besieging you will live, and his soul will be for spoil and he will live.
brenton_translation: He that remains in this city shall die by the sword, and by famine: but he that goes forth to advance to the Chaldeans that have besieged you, shall live, and his life shall be to him for a spoil, and he shall live.

fresh_translation: Because I have set my face against this city for evils and not for good. It will be handed over into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.
brenton_translation: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good: it shall be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall consume it with fire.

fresh_translation: House of the king of Judah, hear the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: O house of the king of Juda, hear ye the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: House of David, thus says the Lord: Judge judgment in the morning, and set right, and rescue the plundered one from the hand of one wronging him, so that my wrath not blaze like fire and burn, and there not be one quenching it.
brenton_translation: O house of David, thus saith the Lord; Judge judgment in the morning, and act rightly, and rescue the spoiled one from the hand of him that wrongs him, lest mine anger be kindled like fire, and it burn, and there be none to quench it.

fresh_translation: Behold, I am against you, the one dwelling in the valley of Sor, the plain one, those saying, Who will terrify us, and who will enter into our dwelling?
brenton_translation: Behold, I am against thee that dwellest in the valley of Sor; in the plain country, even against them that say, Who shall alarm us? or who shall enter into our habitation?

fresh_translation: And I will kindle fire in her forest, and it will devour all around her.
brenton_translation: And I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Go and go down into the house of the king of Judah, and there you will speak this word,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; Go thou, and go down to the house of the king of Juda, and thou shalt speak there this word,

fresh_translation: and say, Hear the word of the Lord, king of Judah seated on the throne of David, you and your house and your people and those entering by these gates.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say,

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Practice judgment and righteousness, and rescue the plundered one from the hand of the one wronging him; do not oppress the resident alien, orphan, or widow; do not act impiously, and do not pour out innocent blood in this place.
brenton_translation: thus saith the Lord; Execute ye judgment and justice, and rescue the spoiled out of the hand of him that wrongs him: and oppress not the stranger, and orphan, and widow, and sin not, and shed no innocent blood in this place.

fresh_translation: Because if in doing you do this word, kings seated on the throne of David will enter through the gates of this house and mounted on chariots and horses, they and their servants and their people.
brenton_translation: For if ye will indeed perform this word, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, and riding on chariots and horses, they, and their servants, and their people.

fresh_translation: But if you will not do these words, by myself I swore, says the Lord, that this house will become a desolation.
brenton_translation: But if ye will not perform these words, by myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, that this house shall be brought to desolation.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord against the house of the king of Judah: Gilead, you are to me, the head of Lebanon. I will surely set you as a wilderness, cities not to be inhabited.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord concerning the house of the king of Juda; Thou art Galaad to me, and the head of Libanus: yet surely I will make thee a desert, even cities that shall not be inhabited:

fresh_translation: And I will bring against you a destroying man and his axe, and they will cut down your choice cedars and throw them into the fire.
brenton_translation: and I will bring upon thee a destroying man, and his axe: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

fresh_translation: And nations will pass through this city, and each will say to his neighbor, Why did the Lord do thus to this great city?
brenton_translation: And nations shall pass through this city, and each shall say to his neighbour, Why has the Lord done thus to this great city?

fresh_translation: And they will say, Because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord their God and bowed to foreign gods and served them.
brenton_translation: And they shall say, Because they forsook the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshipped strange gods, and served them.

fresh_translation: Do not weep for the dead one and do not lament him. Weep with weeping for the one going out, because he will not return again and will not see the land of his homeland.
brenton_translation: Weep not for the dead, nor lament for him: weep bitterly for him that goes away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native land.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord concerning Shallum son of Josiah, reigning instead of Josiah his father, who went out from this place: He will not return there any longer.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord concerning Sellem the son of Josias, who reigns in the place of Josias his father, who has gone forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:

fresh_translation: But in the place where I carried him away, there he will die, and this land he will not see again.
brenton_translation: but in that place whither I have carried him captive, there shall he die, and shall see this land no more.

fresh_translation: Woe to the one building his house not with righteousness and his upper rooms not in judgment, with his neighbor working for nothing, and he will never pay him his wages.
brenton_translation: He that builds his house not with justice, and his upper chambers not with judgment, who works by means of his neighbour for nothing, and will by no means give him his reward.

fresh_translation: You built for yourself a well-proportioned house, airy upper rooms opened with windows and paneled with cedar and painted with red pigment.
brenton_translation: Thou hast built for thyself a well-proportioned house, airy chambers, fitted with windows, and wainscoted with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

fresh_translation: Will you reign because you are inflamed against Ahaz your father? Will they not eat and will they not drink? It was better for you to do judgment and good righteousness.
brenton_translation: Shalt thou reign, because thou art provoked with thy father Achaz? they shall not eat, and they shall not drink: it is better for thee to execute judgment and justice.

fresh_translation: They did not know; they did not judge the case of the lowly nor the case of the poor. Is not this the same as not knowing me? says the Lord.
brenton_translation: They understood not, they judged not the cause of the afflicted, nor the cause of the poor: is not this thy not knowing me? saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Behold, your eyes and your heart are not good, but only for your greed and for pouring out innocent blood and for doing injustice and murder.
brenton_translation: Behold, thine eyes are not good, nor thine heart, but they go after thy covetousness, and after the innocent blood to shed it, and after acts of injustice and slaughter, to commit them.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: Woe for this man. They will not lament him, saying, Ah brother, and they will not weep for him, saying, Alas, Lord.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning Joakim son of Josias, king of Juda, even concerning this man; they shall not bewail him, saying, Ah brother! neither shall they at all weep for him, saying, Alas Lord.

fresh_translation: With the burial of a donkey he will be buried, dragged away and thrown beyond the gate of Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass; he shall be dragged roughly along and cast outside the gate of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: Go up to Lebanon and cry out, and in Bashan give your voice, and cry beyond the sea, because all your lovers were shattered.
brenton_translation: Go up to Libanus, and cry; and utter thy voice to Basan, and cry aloud to the extremity of the sea: for all thy lovers are destroyed.

fresh_translation: I spoke to you in your falling away, and you said, I will not hear. This was your way from your youth: you did not hear my voice.
brenton_translation: I spoke to thee on occasion of thy trespass, but thou saidst, I will not hearken. This has been thy way from thy youth, thou hast not hearkened to my voice.

fresh_translation: Wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go out into captivity, because then you will be ashamed and dishonored by all those loving you.
brenton_translation: The wind shall tend all thy shepherds, and thy lovers shall go into captivity; for then shalt thou be ashamed and disgraced because of all thy lovers.

fresh_translation: You who dwell in Lebanon, nesting in the cedars, you will groan when birth-pains come on you, like one giving birth.
brenton_translation: O thou that dwellest in Libanus, making thy nest in the cedars, thou shalt groan heavily, when pangs as of a travailing woman are come upon thee.

fresh_translation: As I live, says the Lord, if Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah should become a signet on my right hand, from there I will tear you away.
brenton_translation: As I live, saith the Lord, though Jechonias son of Joakim king of Juda were indeed the seal upon my right hand, thence would I pluck thee;

fresh_translation: And I will hand you over into the hands of those seeking your life, before whose face you are afraid, into the hands of the Chaldeans.
brenton_translation: and I will deliver thee into the hands of them that seek thy life, before whom thou art afraid, into the hands of the Chaldeans.

fresh_translation: And I will throw you and your mother who bore you into a land where you were not born, and there you will die.
brenton_translation: And I will cast forth thee, and thy mother that bore thee, into a land where thou wast not born; and there ye shall die.

fresh_translation: But to the land which they long for with their souls, they will never return.
brenton_translation: But they shall by no means return to the land which they long for in their souls.

fresh_translation: Was Jeconiah dishonored like a vessel of no use? Because he was thrown out and cast into a land which he did not know.
brenton_translation: Jechonias is dishonoured as a good-for-nothing vessel; for he is thrown out and cast forth into a land which he knew not.

fresh_translation: Earth, earth, hear the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Land, land, hear the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Write this man as rejected, because no man from his seed will grow up to sit on the throne of David and rule any longer in Judah.
brenton_translation: Write ye this man an outcast: for there shall none of his seed at all grow up to sit on the throne of David, or as a prince yet in Juda.

fresh_translation: Woe to the shepherds who scatter and destroy the sheep of my pasture.
brenton_translation: Woe to the shepherds that destroy and scatter the sheep of their pasture!

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord against those shepherding my people: You scattered my sheep and drove them out and did not attend to them. Behold, I punish you according to your evil practices.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord against them that tend my people; Ye have scattered my sheep, and driven them out, and ye have not visited them: behold, I will take vengeance upon you according to your evil practices.

fresh_translation: And I will gather the remnant of my people from every land where I drove them, and I will restore them to their pasture, and they will increase and multiply.
brenton_translation: And I will gather in the remnant of my people in every land, whither I have driven them out, and will set them in their pasture; and they shall increase and be multiplied.

fresh_translation: And I will raise up for them shepherds who will shepherd them, and they will not fear any longer and will not be terrified, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will raise up shepherds to them, who shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be alarmed, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will raise up for David a righteous dawning, and a king will reign and understand and do judgment and righteousness upon the earth.
brenton_translation: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will raise up to David a righteous branch, and a king shall reign and understand, and shall execute judgment and righteousness on the earth.

fresh_translation: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell in confidence, and this is his name which the Lord will call him: The Lord Is Righteous.
brenton_translation: In his days both Juda shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell securely: and this is his name, which the Lord shall call him, Josedec among the prophets.

fresh_translation: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say, As the Lord lives, who brought up the house of Israel from the land of Egypt,
but, As the Lord lives, who gathered all the seed of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands where he drove them and restored them to their land.

Concerning the prophets, my heart was crushed within me. All my bones were shaken. I became like a broken man and like a man overcome by wine, before the face of the Lord and before the face of the splendor of his glory.
brenton_translation: My heart is broken within me; all my bones are shaken: I am become as a broken-down man, and as a man overcome with wine, because of the Lord, and because of the excellence of his glory.

fresh_translation: Because of these things the land mourned. The pastures of the wilderness dried up, and their way became evil, and their strength was not right.
brenton_translation: For because of these things the land mourns; the pastures of the wilderness are dried up; and their course is become evil, and so also their strength.

fresh_translation: Because priest and prophet were defiled, and in my house I saw their evils.
brenton_translation: For priest and prophet are defiled; and I have seen their iniquities in my house.

fresh_translation: Therefore let their way become for them a slippery place in gloom, and they will stumble and fall in it, because I will bring evils on them in the year of their visitation, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Therefore let their way be to them slippery and dark: and they shall be tripped up and fall in it: for I will bring evils upon them, in the year of their visitation.

fresh_translation: And in the prophets of Samaria I saw lawless things. They prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.
brenton_translation: And in the prophets of Samaria I have seen lawless deeds; they prophesied by Baal, and led my people Israel astray.

fresh_translation: And in the prophets of Jerusalem I saw horrible things: committing adultery and walking in lies and strengthening the hands of evildoers, so that each one would not turn back from his evil way. They all became to me like Sodom, and those dwelling in it like Gomorrah.
brenton_translation: Also in the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen horrible things: as they committed adultery, and walked in lies, and strengthened the hands of many, that they should not return each from his evil way: they are all become to me as Sodoma, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrha.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I feed them pain and give them bitter water to drink, because from the prophets of Jerusalem pollution went out into all the land.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will feed them with pain, and give them bitter water to drink: for from the prophets of Jerusalem has defilement gone forth into all the land.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Do not hear the words of prophets, because they make vain things for themselves. They speak a vision from their own heart and not from the mouth of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord Almighty, Hearken not to the words of the prophets: for they frame a vain vision for themselves; they speak from their own heart, and not from the mouth of the Lord.

fresh_translation: They say to those rejecting the word of the Lord, Peace will be to you, and to all those walking after their own desires, to everyone walking in the wandering of his heart, they said, Evils will not come upon you.
brenton_translation: They say to them that reject the word of the Lord, There shall be peace to you; and to all that walk after their own lusts, and to every one that walks in the error of his heart, they have said, No evil shall come upon thee.

fresh_translation: Because who stood in the Lord's standing-place and saw his word? Who gave ear and heard?
brenton_translation: For who has stood in the counsel of the Lord, and seen his word? who has hearkened, and heard?

fresh_translation: Behold, a shaking from the Lord, and wrath goes out into a whirling turmoil. It will come upon the ungodly.
brenton_translation: Behold, there is an earthquake from the Lord, and anger proceeds to a convulsion, it shall come violently upon the ungodly.

fresh_translation: And the anger of the Lord will not turn back until he does it and until he raises it up from the undertaking of his heart. At the last of days they will understand these things.
brenton_translation: And the Lord's wrath shall return no more, until he have accomplished it, and until he have established it, according to the purpose of his heart: at the end of the days they shall understand it.

fresh_translation: I did not send the prophets, and they ran. I did not speak to them, and they prophesied.
brenton_translation: I sent not the prophets, yet they ran: neither spoke I to them, yet they prophesied.

fresh_translation: And if they had stood in my standing-place and heard my words, they would have turned my people away from their evil practices.
brenton_translation: But if they had stood in my counsel, and if they had hearkened to my words, then would they have turned my people from their evil practices.

fresh_translation: Am I a God near at hand, says the Lord, and not a God from far away?
brenton_translation: I am a God nigh at hand, saith the Lord, and not a God afar off.

fresh_translation: If a man hides himself in hidden places, will I not see him? Do I not fill heaven and earth? says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Shall any one hide himself in secret places, and I not see him? Do I not fill heaven and earth? saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: I heard what the prophets say, those prophesying lies in my name, saying, I dreamed a dream.
brenton_translation: I have heard what the prophets say, what they prophesy in my name, saying falsely, I have seen a night vision.

fresh_translation: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets prophesying lies and prophesying the desires of their own heart?
brenton_translation: How long shall these things be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies, when they prophesy the purposes of their own heart?

fresh_translation: They plan to make my law forgotten by their dreams which each recounts to his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot my name in Baal.
brenton_translation: who devise that men may forget my law by their dreams, which they have told every one to his neighbour, as their fathers forgot my name in the worship of Baal.

fresh_translation: The prophet in whom the dream is, let him recount his dream, and the one with whom my word is, let him recount my word in truth. What is straw compared to wheat? So are my words, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell his dream; and he in whom is my word spoken to him, let him tell my word truly: what is the chaff to the corn? so are my words, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Are not my words like flaming fire, says the Lord, and like a hammer breaking rock?
brenton_translation: Behold, are not my words as fire? saith the Lord; and as an axe cutting the rock?

fresh_translation: Therefore behold, I am against the prophets, says the Lord God, those stealing my words, each from his neighbor.
brenton_translation: Behold, I am therefore against the prophets, saith the Lord God, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.

fresh_translation: Behold, I am against the prophets throwing out prophecies of the tongue and dozing their own drowsiness.
brenton_translation: Behold, I am against the prophets that put forth prophecies of mere words, and slumber their sleep.

fresh_translation: Behold, I am against the prophets prophesying lying dreams, and they recounted them and led my people astray in their lies and in their wanderings. And I did not send them and did not command them, and they will not benefit this people with any benefit.
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets that prophesy false dreams, and have not told them truly, and have caused my people to err by their lies, and by their errors; yet I sent them not, and commanded them not; therefore, they shall not profit this people at all.

fresh_translation: And if this people or priest or prophet asks you, saying, What is the burden of the Lord? then you will say to them, You are the burden, and I will dash you down, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And if this people, or the priest, or the prophet, should ask, What is the burden of the Lord? then thou shalt say to them, Ye are the burden, and I will dash you down, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the prophet and the priest and the people, whoever says, Burden of the Lord, I will punish that man and his house.
brenton_translation: As for the prophet, and the priests, and the people, who shall say, The burden of the Lord, I will even take vengeance on that man, and on his house.

fresh_translation: Because thus each will say to his neighbor and each to his brother, What did the Lord answer, and what did the Lord speak?
brenton_translation: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What has the Lord answered? and, what has the Lord said?

fresh_translation: And do not name Burden of the Lord any longer, because the burden will be each man's own word.
brenton_translation: And do ye name no more the burden of the Lord; for his own word shall be a man's burden.

fresh_translation: And why did the Lord our God speak?
brenton_translation: But wherefore, say ye, has the Lord our God spoken?

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord God: Because you said this word, Burden of the Lord, though I sent to you saying, You shall not say, Burden of the Lord,
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord our God; Because ye have spoken this word, The burden of the Lord, and I sent to you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the Lord;

fresh_translation: therefore behold, I will take and dash you and the city which I gave to you and to your fathers.
brenton_translation: therefore, behold, I will seize, and dash down you and the city which I gave to you and your fathers.

fresh_translation: And I will put upon you eternal reproach and eternal dishonor which will not be forgotten.
brenton_translation: And I will bring upon you an everlasting reproach, and everlasting disgrace, which shall not be forgotten.

fresh_translation: The Lord showed me two baskets of figs set before the face of the temple of the Lord, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon carried away Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and the rulers and the craftsmen and the prisoners and the rich men from Jerusalem and brought them to Babylon.
brenton_translation: The Lord shewed me two baskets of figs, lying in front of the temple of the Lord, after Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had carried captive Jechonias son of Joakim king of Juda, and the princes, and the artificers, and the prisoners, and the rich men out of Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

fresh_translation: One basket held very good figs, like the first-ripe figs, and the other basket held very bad figs, which will not be eaten because of their badness.
brenton_translation: The one basket was full of very good figs, as the early figs; and the other basket was full of very bad figs, which could not be eaten, for their badness.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs: the good ones are very good, and the bad ones are very bad, which will not be eaten because of their badness.
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, What seest thou, Jeremias? and I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the bad, very bad, which cannot be eaten, for their badness.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord God of Israel: As these good figs, so I will recognize the exiles of Judah whom I sent away from this place into the land of the Chaldeans for good.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; As these good figs, so will I acknowledge the Jews that have been carried away captive, whom I have sent forth out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for good.

fresh_translation: And I will set my eyes on them for good and restore them to this land for good, and I will rebuild them and certainly not tear them down, and I will plant them and certainly not pull them up.
brenton_translation: And I will fix mine eyes upon them for good, and I will restore them into this land for good: and I will build them up, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

fresh_translation: And I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the Lord, and they will be to me for a people and I will be to them for God, because they will turn back to me with all their heart.
brenton_translation: And I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the Lord: and they shall be to me a people, and I will be to them a God: for they shall turn to me with all their heart.

fresh_translation: And like the bad figs, which will not be eaten because of their badness, thus says the Lord, so I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah and his nobles and the remnant of Jerusalem left in this land and those dwelling in Egypt.
brenton_translation: And as the bad figs, which cannot be eaten, for their badness; thus saith the Lord, So will I deliver Sedekias king of Juda, and his nobles, and the remnant of Jerusalem, them that are left in this land, and the dwellers in Egypt.

fresh_translation: And I will give them for dispersion into all the kingdoms of the earth, and they will be for a reproach and for a proverb and for hatred and for a curse in every place where I drove them.
brenton_translation: And I will cause them to be dispersed into all the kingdoms of the earth, and they shall be for a reproach, and a proverb, and an object of hatred, and a curse, in every place whither I have driven them out.

fresh_translation: And I will send upon them famine and death and sword until they are gone from the land which I gave them.
brenton_translation: And I will send against them famine, and pestilence, and the sword, until they are consumed from off the land which I gave them.

fresh_translation: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah,
brenton_translation: The Word that came to Jeremias concerning all the people of Juda in the fourth year of Joakim, son of Josias, king of Juda;

fresh_translation: which he spoke to all the people of Judah and to those dwelling in Jerusalem, saying,
brenton_translation: which he spoke to all the people of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,

fresh_translation: In the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah and until this day, twenty-three years, I spoke to you, rising early and speaking.
brenton_translation: In the thirteenth year of Josias, son of Amos, king of Juda, even until this day for three and twenty years, I have both spoken to you, rising early and speaking,

fresh_translation: And I sent to you my servants the prophets, rising early and sending, and you did not listen and did not pay attention with your ears,
brenton_translation: and I sent to you my servants the prophets, sending them early; (but ye hearkened not, and listened not with your ears;) saying,

fresh_translation: saying, Let each one turn back from his evil way and from your evil practices, and you will dwell upon the land which I gave to you and to your fathers from age to age.
brenton_translation: Turn ye every one from his evil way, and from your evil practices, and ye shall dwell in the land which I gave to you and your fathers, of old and for ever.

fresh_translation: Do not go after foreign gods, to serve them and bow down to them, so that you do not provoke me by the works of your hands, to harm you.
brenton_translation: Go ye not after strange gods, to serve them, and to worship them, that ye provoke me not by the works of your hands, to do you hurt.

fresh_translation: And you did not hear me.
brenton_translation: But ye hearkened not to me.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you did not believe my words,
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Since ye believed not my words,

fresh_translation: behold, I send and will take the family from the north and bring them upon this land and upon those dwelling in it and upon all the nations around it, and I will make them desolate and give them for disappearance and for hissing and for eternal reproach.
brenton_translation: behold, I will send and take a family from the north, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants of it, and against all the nations round about it, and I will make them utterly waste, and make them a desolation, and a hissing, and an everlasting reproach.

fresh_translation: And I will destroy from them the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of a bridegroom and the voice of a bride, the smell of perfume and the light of a lamp.
brenton_translation: And I will destroy from among them the voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the scent of ointment, and the light of a candle.

fresh_translation: And all the land will be for disappearance, and they will serve among the nations seventy years.
brenton_translation: And all the land shall be a desolation; and they shall serve among the Gentiles seventy years.

fresh_translation: And when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will punish that nation, says the Lord, and I will set them for eternal disappearance.
brenton_translation: And when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will take vengeance on that nation, and will make them a perpetual desolation.

fresh_translation: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I spoke against it, all the things written in this book.
brenton_translation: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have spoken against it, even all things that are written in this book.

fresh_translation: The things which Jeremiah prophesied against the nations, against Elam.
brenton_translation: The Prophecies of Jeremias against the Nations of Ælam.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Let the bow of Elam be shattered, the beginning of their power.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, The bow of Ælam is broken, even the chief of their power.

fresh_translation: And I will bring upon Elam four winds from the four ends of heaven and will scatter them in all these winds, and there will not be a nation where the outcasts of Elam will not come.
brenton_translation: And I will bring upon Ælam the four winds from the four corners of heaven, and I will disperse them toward all these winds; and there shall be no nation to which they shall not come—even the outcasts of Ælam.

fresh_translation: And I will terrify them before their enemies seeking their lives, and I will bring evils upon them according to the anger of my wrath, and I will send my sword after them until I consume them.
brenton_translation: And I will put them in fear before their enemies that seek their life; and I will bring evils upon them according to my great anger; and I will send forth my sword after them, until I have utterly destroyed them.

fresh_translation: And I will set my throne in Elam and send away from there the king and nobles.
brenton_translation: And I will set my throne in Ælam, and will send forth thence king and rulers.

fresh_translation: And it will be at the last of days: I will turn back the captivity of Elam, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: But it shall come to pass at the end of days, that I will turn the captivity of Ælam, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: At the beginning of the reign of King Zedekiah, this word came concerning Elam.
brenton_translation: In the beginning of the reign of king Sedekias, there came this word concerning Ælam.

fresh_translation: Concerning Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates at Carchemish, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim king of Judah.
brenton_translation: For Egypt, against the Power of Pharao Nechao King of Egypt, who was by the river Euphrates in Charmis, whom Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Joakim king of Juda.

fresh_translation: Take up weapons and shields, and draw near for war.
brenton_translation: Take up arms and spears, and draw nigh to battle;

fresh_translation: Harness the horses; mount up, riders, and stand in your helmets. Advance the spears and put on your breastplates.
brenton_translation: and harness the horses: mount, ye horsemen, and stand ready in your helmets; advance the spears, and put on your breast-plates.

fresh_translation: Why are they terrified and withdrawing backward? Because their mighty ones will be cut down. They fled in flight and did not turn back, hemmed in all around, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Why do they fear, and turn back? even because their mighty men shall be slain: they have utterly fled, and being hemmed in they have not rallied, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Let the swift one not flee, and let the mighty one not save himself. Toward the north, by the Euphrates, they weakened and fell.
brenton_translation: Let not the swift flee, and let not the mighty man escape to the north: the forces at Euphrates are become feeble, and they have fallen.

fresh_translation: Who is this who will rise like a river, and whose waters surge like rivers?
brenton_translation: Who is this that shall come up as a river, and as rivers roll their waves?

fresh_translation: The waters of Egypt will rise like a river, and he said, I will go up and cover the earth and destroy those dwelling in it.
brenton_translation: The waters of Egypt shall come up like a river: and he said, I will go up, and will cover the earth, and will destroy the dwellers in it.

fresh_translation: Mount the horses. Prepare the chariots. Go out, warriors, Ethiopians and Libyans armed with weapons, and Lydians, go up, bend the bow.
brenton_translation: Mount ye the horses, prepare the chariots; go forth, ye warriors of the Ethiopians, and Libyans armed with shields; and mount, ye Lydians, bend the bow.

fresh_translation: And that day belongs to the Lord our God, a day of vengeance to avenge his enemies, and the sword of the Lord will devour and be filled and become drunk with their blood, because a sacrifice belongs to the Lord of hosts from the land of the north by the river Euphrates.
brenton_translation: And that day shall be to the Lord our God a day of vengeance, to take vengeance on his enemies: and the sword of the Lord shall devour, and be glutted, and be drunken with their blood: for the Lord has a sacrifice from the land of the north at the river Euphrates.

fresh_translation: Go up to Gilead and take resin, virgin daughter of Egypt. In vain you multiplied your healings. There is no benefit for you.
brenton_translation: Go up to Galaad, and take balm for the virgin daughter of Egypt: in vain hast thou multiplied thy medicines; there is no help in thee.

fresh_translation: The nations heard your voice, and the earth was filled with your cry, because warrior weakened against warrior. Together both fell.
brenton_translation: The nations have heard thy voice, and the land has been filled with thy cry: for the warriors have fainted fighting one against another, and both are fallen together.

fresh_translation: The things which the Lord spoke by the hand of Jeremiah, for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to come to strike the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: The Words which the Lord spoke by Jeremias, concerning the coming of the king of Babylon to smite the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: Announce in Migdol and proclaim in Memphis. Say, Stand ready and prepare, because the sword devoured your smilax.
brenton_translation: Proclaim it at Magdol, and declare it at Memphis: say ye, Stand up, and prepare; for the sword has devoured thy yew-tree.

fresh_translation: Why did Apis, your chosen calf, flee? He did not remain, because the Lord weakened him.
brenton_translation: Wherefore has Apis fled from thee? thy choice calf has not remained; for the Lord has utterly weakened him.

fresh_translation: And your multitude weakened and fell, and each said to his neighbor, Let us rise and return to our people and to our homeland from the face of a Greek sword.
brenton_translation: And thy multitude has fainted and fallen; and each one said to his neighbour, Let us arise, and return into our country to our people, from the Grecian sword.

fresh_translation: Call the name of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt: Saon-esbi-emoed.
brenton_translation: Call ye the name of Pharao Nechao king of Egypt, Saon esbeie moed.

fresh_translation: As I live, says the Lord God, as Tabor among the mountains and as Carmel by the sea, so he will come.
brenton_translation: As I live, saith the Lord God, he shall come as Itabyrion among the mountains, and as Carmel that is on the sea.

fresh_translation: Make for yourself gear for exile, you dwelling daughter of Egypt, because Memphis will become a disappearance and will be called Woe, because there are no inhabitants in her.
brenton_translation: O daughter of Egypt dwelling at home, prepare thee stuff for removing: for Memphis shall be utterly desolate, and shall be called Woe, because there are no inhabitants in it.

fresh_translation: Egypt is a beautified heifer; a cutting off from the north has come upon her.
brenton_translation: Egypt is a fair heifer, but destruction from the north is come upon her.

fresh_translation: And her hired men in her are like fattened calves raised in her, because they too turned back and fled together. They did not stand, because the day of their destruction came upon them and the time of their vengeance.
