brenton_translation: Also her hired soldiers in the midst of her are as fatted calves fed in her; for they also have turned, and fled with one accord: they stood not, for the day of destruction was come upon them, and the time of their retribution.

fresh_translation: Her voice will hiss like a serpent's, because they will go in sand, and with axes they will come upon her like woodcutters.
brenton_translation: Their voice is as that of a hissing serpent, for they go upon the sand; they shall come upon Egypt with axes, as men that cut wood.

fresh_translation: They will cut down her forest, says the Lord God, because it certainly will not be estimated. They are more numerous than locusts, and there is no number for them.
brenton_translation: They shall cut down her forest, saith the Lord, for their number cannot at all be conjectured, for it exceeds the locust in multitude, and they are innumerable.

fresh_translation: The daughter of Egypt was put to shame. She was handed into the hands of the people from the north.
brenton_translation: The daughter of Egypt is confounded; she is delivered into the hands of a people from the north.

fresh_translation: Behold, I punish Amon her son, upon Pharaoh and upon those trusting in him.
brenton_translation: Behold, I will avenge Ammon her son upon Pharao, and upon them that trust in him.

fresh_translation: But do not fear, my servant Jacob, and do not be terrified, Israel, because behold, I save you from far away, and your seed from the land of their captivity, and Jacob will return and be quiet and sleep, and there will not be one harassing him.
brenton_translation: But fear not thou, my servant Jacob, neither be thou alarmed, Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be at ease, and sleep, and there shall be no one to trouble him.

fresh_translation: Do not fear, my servant Jacob, says the Lord, because I am with you. Because I will make an end in every nation where I drove you, but you I will certainly not make fail, and I will discipline you in judgment, and by acquitting I will not acquit you.
brenton_translation: Fear not thou, my servant Jacob, saith the Lord; for I am with thee: she that was without fear and in luxury, has been delivered up: for I will make a full end of every nation among whom I have thrust thee forth; but I will not cause thee to fail: yet will I chastise thee in the way of judgment, and will not hold thee entirely guiltless.

fresh_translation: The word of the Lord which he spoke concerning Babylon.
brenton_translation: The Word of the Lord which He spoke against Babylon.

fresh_translation: Announce among the nations and make it heard, and do not hide it. Say, Babylon was taken. Bel was put to shame. Merodach was handed over, the fearless and delicate one.
brenton_translation: Proclaim ye among the Gentiles, and cause the tidings to be heard, and suppress them not: say ye, Babylon is taken, Belus is confounded; the fearless, the luxurious Mærodach is delivered up.

fresh_translation: Because a nation came up upon her from the north. This one will make her land a disappearance, and there will be none dwelling in her, from man even to cattle.
brenton_translation: For a nation has come up against her from the north, he shall utterly ravage her land, and there shall be none to dwell in it, neither man nor beast.

fresh_translation: In those days and in that time, the sons of Israel will come, they and the sons of Judah together. Walking and weeping, they will go seeking the Lord their God.
brenton_translation: In those days, and at that time, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Juda together; they shall proceed, weeping as they go, seeking the Lord their God.

fresh_translation: They will ask the way to Zion, because there they will set their faces, and they will come and flee for refuge to the Lord their God, because the everlasting covenant will not be forgotten.
brenton_translation: They shall ask the way till they come to Sion, for that way shall they set their face; and they shall come and flee for refuge to the Lord their God; for the everlasting covenant shall not be forgotten.

fresh_translation: My people became lost sheep. Their shepherds drove them away upon the mountains. They led them astray from mountain to hill. They went away and forgot their resting-place.
brenton_translation: My people have been lost sheep: their shepherds thrust them out, they caused them to wander on the mountains: they went from mountain to hill, they forgot their resting-place.

fresh_translation: All finding them consumed them, and their enemies said, Let us not leave them guiltless, because they sinned against the Lord, the pasture of righteousness, the one who gathered their fathers.
brenton_translation: All that found them consumed them: their enemies said, Let us not leave them alone, because they have sinned against the Lord: he that gathered their fathers had a pasture of righteousness.

fresh_translation: Separate yourselves from the midst of Babylon, and go out from the land of the Chaldeans, and become like dragons before flocks.
brenton_translation: Flee ye out of the midst of Babylon, and from the land of the Chaldeans, and go forth, and be as serpents before sleep.

fresh_translation: Because behold, I raise up against Babylon gatherings of nations from the land of the north, and they will array against her. From there she will be taken, like an arrow of wise warrior that will not return empty.
brenton_translation: For, behold, I stir up against Babylon the gatherings of nations out of the land of the north; and they shall set themselves in array against her: thence shall she be taken, as the dart of an expert warrior shall not return empty.

fresh_translation: And Chaldea will become plunder. All plundering her will be filled.
brenton_translation: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied.

fresh_translation: Because you rejoiced and boasted while plundering my inheritance, because you leaped like little cattle in grass and gored like bulls.
brenton_translation: Because ye rejoiced, and boasted, while plundering mine heritage; because ye exulted as calves in the grass, and pushed with the horn as bulls.

fresh_translation: Your mother was greatly ashamed, mother of your good things, last of nations, a wilderness.
brenton_translation: Your mother is greatly ashamed; your mother that bore you for prosperity is confounded: she is the last of the nations, desolate,

fresh_translation: From the anger of the Lord she will not be inhabited, and all will become a disappearance. Everyone passing through Babylon will darken and hiss over all her plague.
brenton_translation: by reason of the Lord's anger: it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be all a desolation; and every one that passes through Babylon shall scowl, and they shall hiss at all her plague.

fresh_translation: Array yourselves against Babylon all around, all stretching the bow. Shoot at her. Do not spare your arrows.
brenton_translation: Set yourselves in array against Babylon round about, all ye that bend the bow; shoot at her, spare not your arrows,

fresh_translation: Raise a shout against her. Her hands were weakened. Her battlements fell, and her wall was torn down, because it is vengeance from God. Avenge against her. As she did, do to her.
brenton_translation: and prevail against her: her hands are weakened, her bulwarks are fallen, and her wall is broken down: for it is vengeance from God: take vengeance upon her; as she has done, do to her.

fresh_translation: Destroy seed from Babylon and one holding the sickle in the time of harvest. From the face of a Greek sword each will turn to his people, and each will flee into his land.
brenton_translation: Utterly destroy seed out of Babylon, and him that holds a sickle in time of harvest: for fear of the Grecian sword, they shall return every one to his people, and every one shall flee to his own land.

fresh_translation: Israel is a wandering sheep. Lions drove him out. First the king of Assyria devoured him, and later the king of Babylon broke his bones.
brenton_translation: Israel is a wandering sheep; the lions have driven him out: the king of Assyria first devoured him, and afterward this king of Babylon has gnawed his bones.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I punish the king of Babylon and his land just as I punished the king of Assyria.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will take vengeance on the king of Babylon, and upon his land, as I took vengeance on the king of Assyria.

fresh_translation: And I will restore Israel to his pasture, and he will graze on Carmel and on the hill-country of Ephraim and on Gilead, and his soul will be filled.
brenton_translation: And I will restore Israel to his pasture, and he shall feed on Carmel and on mount Ephraim and in Galaad, and his soul shall be satisfied.

fresh_translation: In those days and in that time they will seek the injustice of Israel and it will not exist, and the sins of Judah and they will certainly not be found, because I will be merciful to the remnant upon the land, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: In those days, and at that time, they shall seek for the iniquity of Israel, and there shall be none; and for the sins of Juda, and they shall not be found: for I will be merciful to them that are left

fresh_translation: Go up bitterly against her and against those dwelling on her. Avenge with the sword and make her disappear, says the Lord, and do according to all I command you.
brenton_translation: on the land, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: The sound of war and great crushing in the land of the Chaldeans.
brenton_translation: A sound of war, and great destruction in the land of the Chaldeans!

fresh_translation: How the hammer of all the earth was broken and shattered. How Babylon became a disappearance among the nations.
brenton_translation: How is the hammer of the whole earth broken and crushed! How is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

fresh_translation: They will set a trap for you, and you will be taken, O Babylon, and you will not know. You were found and taken, because you stood against the Lord.
brenton_translation: They shall come upon thee, and thou shalt not know it, Babylon, that thou wilt even be taken captive: thou art found and taken, because thou didst resist the Lord.

fresh_translation: The Lord opened his treasury and brought out the vessels of his wrath, because work belongs to the Lord God in the land of the Chaldeans.
brenton_translation: The Lord has opened his treasury, and brought forth the weapons of his anger: for the Lord God has a work in the land of the Chaldeans.

fresh_translation: Because her times have come. Open her storehouses. Search her like a cave and utterly destroy her. Let no remnant of her come to be.
brenton_translation: For her times are come: open ye her storehouses: search her as a cave, and utterly destroy her: let there be no remnant of her.

fresh_translation: Dry up all her fruits and let them go down to slaughter. Woe to them, because their day has come and the time of their vengeance.
brenton_translation: Dry ye up all her fruits, and let them go down to the slaughter: woe to them! for their day is come, and the time of their retribution.

fresh_translation: The voice of those fleeing and escaping from the land of Babylon, to announce in Zion vengeance from the Lord our God.
brenton_translation: A voice of men fleeing and escaping from the land of Babylon, to declare to Sion the vengeance that comes from the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: Command many against Babylon, everyone stretching the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let there not be one escaping from her. Pay back to her according to her works. According to all she did, do to her, because she stood against the Lord, the Holy God of Israel.
brenton_translation: Summon many against Babylon, even every one that bends the bow: camp against her round about; let no one of her people escape: render to her according to her works; according to all that she has done, do to her: for she has resisted the Lord, the Holy God of Israel.

fresh_translation: Therefore her young men will fall in her squares, and all her men of war will be cast down, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her warriors shall be cast down, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Behold, I am against you, the arrogant one, says the Lord, because your day has come and the time of your vengeance.
brenton_translation: Behold, I am against thee the haughty one, saith the Lord: for thy day is come, and the time of thy retribution.

fresh_translation: And your arrogance will weaken and fall, and there will not be one raising her up. And I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will devour all around her.
brenton_translation: And thy pride shall fail, and fall, and there shall be no one to set it up again: and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it shall devour all things round about her.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: The sons of Israel and the sons of Judah together are oppressed, and all taking them captive oppressed them, because they were not willing to send them away.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; The children of Israel and the children of Juda have been oppressed: all they that have taken them captive have oppressed them together; for they would not let them go.

fresh_translation: But the one redeeming them is strong. The Lord Almighty is his name. He will judge judgment against his adversaries so that he may lift up the land and provoke those dwelling in Babylon.
brenton_translation: But their Redeemer is strong; the Lord Almighty is his name: he will enter into judgment with his adversaries, that he may destroy the earth;

fresh_translation: A sword upon the Chaldeans and upon those dwelling in Babylon and upon her nobles and upon her wise men.
brenton_translation: and he will sharpen a sword against the Chaldeans, and against the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her nobles and upon her wise men;

fresh_translation: A sword upon her warriors, and they will be paralyzed.
brenton_translation: a sword upon her warriors, and they shall be weakened: a sword upon their horses, and upon their chariots:

fresh_translation: A sword upon their horses and upon their chariots, a sword upon her mixed people in her midst, and they will become like women. A sword upon her treasures, and they will be scattered.
brenton_translation: a sword upon their warriors, and upon the mixed people in the midst of her; and they shall be as women: a sword upon the treasures, and they shall be scattered upon her water,

fresh_translation: Upon her water they trusted, and they will be put to shame, because it is a land of carved images, and in islands they boasted.
brenton_translation: and they shall be ashamed: for it is a land of graven images; and in the islands, where they boasted.

fresh_translation: Therefore phantoms will dwell in the islands, and daughters of sirens will dwell in her. She will certainly no longer be inhabited forever.
brenton_translation: Therefore shall idols dwell in the islands, and the young of monsters shall dwell in it: it shall not be inhabited any more for ever.

fresh_translation: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and those neighboring them, says the Lord, no man will dwell there and no son of man will sojourn there.
brenton_translation: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities bordering upon them, saith the Lord: no man shall dwell there, and no son of man shall sojourn there.

fresh_translation: Behold, a people comes from the north, and a great nation and many kings will be roused from the end of the earth.
brenton_translation: Behold, a people comes from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be stirred up from the end of the earth; holding bow and dagger:

fresh_translation: Holding bow and short-sword, he is cruel and certainly will not show mercy. Their voice will sound like the sea. Upon horses they will ride, prepared like fire for war against you, daughter of Babylon.
brenton_translation: the people is fierce, and will have no mercy: their voices shall sound as the sea, they shall ride upon horses, prepared for war, like fire, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

fresh_translation: The king of Babylon heard their report, and his hands were weakened. Distress seized him, birth-pains like one giving birth.
brenton_translation: The king of Babylon heard the sound of them, and his hands were enfeebled: anguish overcame him, pangs as of a woman in travail.

fresh_translation: Behold, like a lion he will go up from the Jordan into Ethan place, because quickly I will drive them from her, and every young man I will appoint over her. Because who is like me, and who will oppose me, and who is this shepherd who will stand before my face?
brenton_translation: Behold, he shall come up as a lion from Jordan to Gæthan; for I will speedily drive them from her, and I will set all the youths against her: for who is like me? and who will resist me? and who is this shepherd who will stand before me?

fresh_translation: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord which he counseled against Babylon and his thoughts which he thought against those dwelling in Chaldea: Unless the lambs of their sheep are destroyed, unless pasture is made a disappearance from them.
brenton_translation: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, which he has taken against Babylon; and his devices, which he has devised upon the Chaldeans inhabiting it: surely lambs of their flock shall be destroyed: surely pasture shall be cut off from them.

fresh_translation: Because from the sound of Babylon's capture the earth will be shaken and a cry will be heard among the nations.
brenton_translation: For at the sound of the taking of Babylon the earth shall quake, and a cry shall be heard among the nations.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I raise against Babylon and against those dwelling in Chaldea a hot destroying wind.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I stir up against Babylon, and against the Chaldeans dwelling therein, a deadly burning wind.

fresh_translation: And I will send revilers into Babylon, and they will revile her and ruin her land. Woe upon Babylon all around in the day of her affliction.
brenton_translation: And I will send forth against Babylon spoilers, and they shall spoil her, and shall ravage her land. Woe to Babylon round about her in the day of her affliction.

fresh_translation: Against her let the one stretching his bow stretch it, and let the one who has armor gird himself, and do not spare her young men, and destroy all her power.
brenton_translation: Let the archer bend his bow, and him that has armour put it on: and spare ye not her young men, but destroy ye all her host.

fresh_translation: And slain ones will fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and stabbed ones outside her.
brenton_translation: And slain men shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and men pierced through shall fall without it.

fresh_translation: Because Israel and Judah were not widowed from their God, from the Lord Almighty, because their land was filled with injustice from the Holy One of Israel.
brenton_translation: For Israel and Juda have not been forsaken of their God, of the Lord Almighty; whereas their land was filled with iniquity against the holy things of Israel.

fresh_translation: Flee from the midst of Babylon and let each save his soul, and do not be cast away in her injustice, because the time of her vengeance is from the Lord. He repays repayment to her.
brenton_translation: Flee ye out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every one his soul: and be not overthrown in her iniquity; for it is the time of her retribution from the Lord; he is rendering to her a recompence.

fresh_translation: Babylon was a golden cup in the hand of the Lord, making all the earth drunk. Nations drank from her wine. Because of this they were shaken.
brenton_translation: Babylon has been a golden cup in the Lord's hand, causing all the earth to be drunken: the nations have drunk of her wine; therefore they were shaken.

fresh_translation: And suddenly Babylon fell and was shattered. Lament her. Take resin for her ruin, if perhaps she will be healed.
brenton_translation: And Babylon is fallen suddenly, and is broken to pieces: lament for her; take balm for her deadly wound, if by any means she may be healed.

fresh_translation: We healed Babylon and she was not healed. Let us abandon her, and let each go away into his own land, because her judgment drew near to heaven and rose as far as the stars.
brenton_translation: We tried to heal Babylon, but she was not healed: let us forsake her, and depart every one to his own country: for her judgment has reached to the heaven, it has mounted up to the stars.

fresh_translation: The Lord brought out his judgment. Come, and let us announce in Zion the works of the Lord our God.
brenton_translation: The Lord has brought forth his judgment: come, and let us declare in Sion the works of the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: Prepare arrows. Fill quivers. The Lord stirred the spirit of the king of Medes, because his wrath is against Babylon, to destroy her, because it is vengeance of the Lord, it is vengeance of his people.
brenton_translation: Prepare the arrows; fill the quivers: the Lord has stirred up the spirit of the king of the Medes: for his wrath is against Babylon, to destroy it utterly; for it is the Lord's vengeance, it is the vengeance of his people.

fresh_translation: Upon the walls of Babylon raise a signal. Set quivers. Stir up guards. Prepare weapons, because the Lord undertook and will do what he spoke against those dwelling in Babylon.
brenton_translation: Lift up a standard on the walls of Babylon, prepare the quivers, rouse the guards, prepare the weapons: for the Lord has taken the work in hand, and will execute what he has spoken against the inhabitants of Babylon,

fresh_translation: O you dwelling upon many waters and upon an abundance of treasures, your end has come, truly into your inward parts.
brenton_translation: dwelling on many waters, and amidst the abundance of her treasures; thine end is come verily into thy bowels.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord swore by his arm: I will fill you with men like locusts, and those coming down will shout over you.
brenton_translation: For the Lord has sworn by his arm, saying, I will fill thee with men as with locusts; and they that come down shall cry against thee.

fresh_translation: He made the earth in his strength, preparing the world in his wisdom. In his understanding he stretched out heaven.
brenton_translation: The Lord made the earth by his power, preparing the world by his wisdom, by his understanding he stretched out the heaven.

fresh_translation: At his voice he set the sound of waters in heaven and brought up clouds from the end of the earth. He made lightnings for rain and brought out light from his treasuries.
brenton_translation: At his voice he makes a sound of water in the heaven, and brings up clouds from the extremity of the earth; he makes lightnings for rain, and brings light out of his treasures.

fresh_translation: Every man became foolish from knowledge. Every goldsmith was put to shame by his carved images, because what they cast were lies and there is no breath in them.
brenton_translation: Every man has completely lost understanding; every goldsmith is confounded because of his graven images: for they have cast false gods, there is no breath in them.

fresh_translation: They are vain works, mocked things. In the time of their visitation they will perish.
brenton_translation: They are vain works, objects of scorn; in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

fresh_translation: Not such is the portion for Jacob, because the one forming all things, he is his inheritance. The Lord is his name.
brenton_translation: Not such is Jacob's portion; for he that formed all things, he is his inheritance; the Lord is his name.

fresh_translation: You are my war-vessels, and with you I will scatter nations, and from you I will remove kings.
brenton_translation: Thou scatterest for me the weapons of war: and I will scatter nations by thee, and will destroy kings by means of thee.

fresh_translation: And with you I will scatter horse and its rider, and with you I will scatter chariots and their riders.
brenton_translation: And by thee I will scatter the horse and his rider; and by thee I will scatter chariots and them that ride in them.

fresh_translation: And with you I will scatter young man and virgin, and with you I will scatter man and woman.
brenton_translation: And by thee I will scatter youth and maid; and by thee I will scatter man and woman.

fresh_translation: And with you I will scatter shepherd and his flock, and with you I will scatter farmer and his farm, and with you I will scatter your rulers and generals.
brenton_translation: And by thee I will scatter the shepherd and his flock; and by thee I will scatter the husbandman and his husbandry; and by thee I will scatter leaders and the captains.

fresh_translation: And I will repay Babylon and all the Chaldeans dwelling there for all their evils which they did against Zion before your eyes, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will recompense to Babylon and to all the Chaldeans that dwell there all their mischiefs that they have done to Sion before your eyes, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Behold, I am against you, corrupt mountain, the one destroying all the earth, and I will stretch out my hand upon you and roll you down from the rocks and give you as a mountain set on fire.
brenton_translation: Behold, I am against thee, the ruined mountain, that destroys the whole earth; and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will roll thee down upon the rocks, and will make thee as a burnt mountain.

fresh_translation: And they will certainly not take from you a stone for a corner or a stone for a foundation, because you will be a disappearance forever, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they shall not take from thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for a foundation: for thou shalt be a desolation for ever, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Raise a signal upon the earth. Sound a trumpet among the nations. Sanctify nations against her. Command against her the kingdoms of Ararat and Ashkenaz. Set missile-stations against her. Bring up a horse against her like a swarm of locusts.
brenton_translation: Lift up a standard in the land, sound the trumpet among the nations, consecrate the nations against her, raise up kings against her by me, and that for the people of Achanaz; set against her engines of war; bring up against her horses as a multitude of locusts.

fresh_translation: Sanctify nations against her, the king of Medes and the leaders of all his land and all his generals.
brenton_translation: Bring up nations against her, even the king of the Medes and of the whole earth, his rulers, and all his captains.

fresh_translation: The earth shook and was in pain, because the plan of the Lord rose against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a disappearance and not inhabited.
brenton_translation: The earth has quaked and been troubled, because the purpose of the Lord has risen up against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, and uninhabitable.

fresh_translation: The warrior of Babylon failed from fighting. They will sit there in enclosure. Their power was broken. They became like women. Her dwellings were burned with fire. Her bars were shattered.
brenton_translation: The warrior of Babylon has failed to fight; they shall sit there in the siege; their power is broken; they are become like women; her tabernacles have been set on fire; her bars are broken.

fresh_translation: Runner will run to meet runner, and announcer to meet announcer, to announce to the king of Babylon that his city was taken.
brenton_translation: One shall rush, running to meet another runner, and one shall go with tidings to meet another with tidings, to bring tidings to the king of Babylon, that his city is taken.

fresh_translation: From the end of its crossings they were seized, and their gathering-places were burned with fire, and their men of war go out.
brenton_translation: At the end of his passages they were taken, and his cisterns they have burnt with fire, and his warriors are going forth.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord, the house of the king of Babylon is like a ripe threshing-floor. Yet a little while, and her harvest will come.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord, The houses of the king of Babylon shall be threshed as a floor in the season; yet a little while, and her harvest shall come.

fresh_translation: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon devoured me, portioned me, took me as a delicate vessel, swallowed me like a dragon, filled his belly from my luxury, and drove me out.
brenton_translation: He has devoured me, he has torn me asunder, airy darkness has come upon me; Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon has swallowed me up, as a dragon has he filled his belly with my delicacies.

fresh_translation: My labors and my hardships are upon Babylon, says the one dwelling in Zion, and my blood upon those dwelling in Chaldea, says Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: My troubles and my distresses have driven me out into Babylon, shall she that dwells in Sion say; and my blood shall be upon the Chaldeans dwelling there, shall Jerusalem say.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I judge your case and will avenge your vengeance, and I will desolate her sea and dry up her spring.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will judge thine adversary, and I will execute vengeance for thee; and I will waste her sea, and dry up her fountain.

fresh_translation: And Babylon will become a disappearance and will not be inhabited.
brenton_translation: And Babylon shall be a desolation, and shall not be inhabited.

fresh_translation: Together they were roused like lions and like lion cubs.
brenton_translation: For they rose up together as lions, and as lions' whelps.

fresh_translation: In their heat I will give them drink and make them drunk so that they become numb and sleep an eternal sleep and certainly not wake up, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: In their heat I will give them a draught, and make them drunk, that they may be stupified, and sleep an everlasting sleep, and not awake, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: I will bring them down like lambs to slaughter and like rams with goats.
brenton_translation: And bring thou them down as lambs to the slaughter, and rams with kids.

fresh_translation: How the praise of all the earth was taken and hunted down. How Babylon became a disappearance among the nations.
brenton_translation: How has the boast of all the earth been taken and caught in a snare! how has Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

fresh_translation: The sea rose over Babylon. With the sound of its waves she was covered.
brenton_translation: The sea has come up upon Babylon with the sound of its waves, and she is covered.

fresh_translation: Her cities became a waterless and impassable land. No one will dwell in her, and no son of man will lodge in her.
brenton_translation: Her cities are become like a dry and trackless land; not so much as one man shall dwell in it, neither shall a son of man lodge in it.

fresh_translation: And I will punish Babylon and bring out from her mouth what she swallowed, and nations will certainly no longer be gathered to her.
brenton_translation: And I will take vengeance on Babylon, and bring forth out of her mouth what she has swallowed down, and the nations shall no more be gathered to her:

fresh_translation: And in Babylon the slain ones of all the earth will fall.
brenton_translation: and in Babylon the slain men of all the earth shall fall.

fresh_translation: You who are being saved from the land, go and do not stand still. You far-off ones, remember the Lord, and let Jerusalem rise upon your heart.
brenton_translation: Go forth of the land, ye that escape, and stay not; ye that are afar off, remember the Lord, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

fresh_translation: We were ashamed because we heard our reproach. Dishonor covered our face. Foreigners entered into our holy places, into the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: We are ashamed, because we have heard our reproach; disgrace has covered our face; aliens are come into our sanctuary, even into the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will punish her carved images, and in all her land slain ones will fall.
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will take vengeance upon her graven images: and slain men shall fall in all her land.

fresh_translation: Because if Babylon goes up like heaven, and if she fortifies the height of her strength, destroyers of her will come from me, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: For though Babylon should go up as the heaven, and though she should strengthen her walls with her power, from me shall come they that shall destroy her, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: The voice of a cry in Babylon and great crushing in the land of the Chaldeans.
brenton_translation: A sound of a cry in Babylon, and great destruction in the land of the Chaldeans:

fresh_translation: Because the Lord destroyed Babylon and destroyed from her the great voice sounding like many waters. He gave her voice for destruction.
brenton_translation: for the Lord has utterly destroyed Babylon, and cut off from her the great voice sounding as many waters: he has consigned her voice to destruction.

fresh_translation: Because affliction came upon Babylon. Her warriors were taken. Their bow was terrified, because God repays them. The Lord repays her repayment.
brenton_translation: For distress has come upon Babylon, her warriors are taken, their bows are useless: for God recompenses them.

fresh_translation: And he will make her rulers drunk with drunkenness and her wise men and her generals, says the King, the Lord Almighty is his name.
brenton_translation: The Lord recompenses, and will make her leaders and her wise men and her captains completely drunk, saith the King, the Lord Almighty is his name.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: The wall of Babylon, broadened out, being dug down, will be torn down, and her high gates will be burned with fire, and peoples will not labor for emptiness, and nations at their beginning will fail.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, The wall of Babylon was made broad, but it shall be completely broken down, and her high gates shall be burnt with fire; and the peoples shall not labour in vain, nor the nations fail in their rule.

fresh_translation: The word which the Lord commanded Jeremiah the prophet to tell Seraiah son of Neriah son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign, and Seraiah was ruler of gifts.
brenton_translation: The Word which the Lord commanded the Prophet Jeremias to say to Saræas son of Nerias, son of Maasæas, when he went from Sedekias king of Juda to Babylon, in the fourth year of his reign. And Saræas was over the bounties.

fresh_translation: And Jeremiah wrote in one scroll all the evils which will come upon Babylon, all these words written against Babylon.
brenton_translation: And Jeremias wrote in a book all the evils which should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.

fresh_translation: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When you come into Babylon and see and read all these words,
brenton_translation: And Jeremias said to Saræas, When thou art come to Babylon, and shalt see and read all these words;

fresh_translation: then you will say, Lord, Lord, you spoke against this place, to destroy it and for there not to be in it one dwelling, from man to cattle, because it will be a disappearance forever.
brenton_translation: then thou shalt say, O Lord God, thou hast spoken against this place, to destroy it, and that there should be none to dwell in it, neither man nor beast; for it shall be a desolation for ever.

fresh_translation: And it will be when you finish reading this scroll, you will tie a stone upon it and throw it into the midst of the Euphrates,
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt cease from reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone upon it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates;

fresh_translation: and you will say, Thus Babylon will sink and will certainly not rise from the face of evils which I bring upon her.
brenton_translation: and shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and not rise, because of the evils which I bring upon it.

fresh_translation: Against the foreigners.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord against the Philistines;

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Behold, waters rise from the north, and they will become a flooding torrent and cover the land and its fullness, the city and those dwelling in it, and men will cry out and all those dwelling in the land will howl.
brenton_translation: Behold, waters come up from the north, and shall become a sweeping torrent, and it shall sweep away the land, and its fulness; the city, and them that dwell in it: and men shall cry and all that dwell in the land shall howl,

fresh_translation: At the sound of his rush, at the hooves of his feet and at the shaking of his chariots, the sound of his wheels, fathers did not turn back toward their sons because of the slackening of their hands.
brenton_translation: at the sound of his rushing, at the sound of his hoofs, and at the rattling of his chariots, at the noise of his wheels: the fathers turned not to their children because of the weakness of their hands,

fresh_translation: In the day that is coming to destroy all the foreigners, and I will wipe out Tyre and Sidon and all the remnant of their help, because the Lord will destroy the remnant of the islands.
brenton_translation: in the day that is coming to destroy all the Philistines: and I will utterly destroy Tyre and Sidon, and all the rest of their allies: for the Lord will destroy the remaining inhabitants of the islands.

fresh_translation: Baldness has come upon Gaza. Ashkelon was cast away, and the remnant of Enakim. How long will you keep cutting yourself?
brenton_translation: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ascalon is cast away, and the remnant of the Enakim.

fresh_translation: Sword of the Lord, how long will you not rest? Return into your sheath. Rest and be lifted up.
brenton_translation: How long wilt thou smite, O sword of the Lord? how long will it be ere thou art quiet? return into thy sheath, rest, and be removed.

fresh_translation: How will it rest? The Lord commanded it against Ashkelon and against the seacoasts, against the remnant, to be stirred up.
brenton_translation: How shall it be quiet, whereas the Lord has given it a commission against Ascalon, and against the regions on the sea-coast, to awake against the remaining countries!

fresh_translation: To Edom thus says the Lord: Is there no wisdom any longer in Teman? Counsel has perished from the prudent. Their wisdom went away.
brenton_translation: Concerning Idumea, thus saith the Lord; There is no longer wisdom in Thæman, counsel has perished from the wise ones, their wisdom is gone,

fresh_translation: Their place was deceived. Go deep into dwelling, you dwelling in Dedan, because I made hard things against him. I brought them on him in the time when I visited him.
brenton_translation: their place has been deceived. Dig deep for a dwelling, ye that inhabit Dædam, for he has wrought grievously: I brought trouble upon him in the time at which I visited him.

fresh_translation: Because grape-gatherers came to you, they will not leave gleanings to you. Like thieves in the night, they will lay their hand on them.
brenton_translation: For grape-gatherers are come, who shall not leave thee a remnant; as thieves by night, they shall lay their hand upon thy possessions.

fresh_translation: Because I stripped Esau bare. I uncovered their hidden things. They will certainly not be able to hide. They were destroyed by the hand of his brother and his neighbor, and he is no more.
brenton_translation: For I have stripped Esau, I have uncovered their secret places; they shall have no power to hide themselves, they have perished each by the hand of his brother, my neighbour, and it is impossible

fresh_translation: Leave your orphan behind so that he may live, and I will keep him alive, and widows trusted in me.
brenton_translation: for thy fatherless one to be left to live, but I shall live, and the widows trust in me.

fresh_translation: Because thus said the Lord: Those for whom it was not law to drink the cup drank, and you, by acquitting, will certainly not be acquitted, because drinking you will drink.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord; They who were not appointed to drink the cup have drunk it; and thou shalt by no means be cleared:

fresh_translation: Because by myself I swore, says the Lord, that you will become trackless waste and reproach and curse in the midst of her, and all her cities will become deserts forever.
brenton_translation: for by myself I have sworn, saith the Lord, that thou shalt be in the midst of her an impassable land, and a reproach, and a curse; and all her cities shall be desert for ever.

fresh_translation: I heard a report from the Lord, and he sent messengers to nations: Gather yourselves and come against her. Rise for war.
brenton_translation: I have heard a report from the Lord, and he has sent messengers to the nations, saying, Assemble yourselves, and come against her; rise ye up to war.

fresh_translation: I made you small among nations, despised among men.
brenton_translation: I have made thee small among the nations, utterly contemptible among men.

fresh_translation: Your plaything deceived you, the insolence of your heart, dwelling in holes of rocks, holding strength of high hill. Because he raised his nest like an eagle, from there I will bring you down.
brenton_translation: Thine insolence has risen up against thee, the fierceness of thine heart has burst the holes of the rocks, it has seized upon the strength of a lofty hill; for as an eagle he set his nest on high: thence will I bring thee down.

fresh_translation: And Edom will become trackless waste. Everyone passing by her will hiss.
brenton_translation: And Idumea shall be a desert: every one that passes by shall hiss at it.

fresh_translation: As Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring places were overthrown, says the Lord Almighty, so no man will sit there and no son of man will dwell there.
brenton_translation: As Sodom was overthrown and Gomorrha and they that sojourned in her, saith the Lord Almighty, no man shall dwell there, nor shall any son of man inhabit there.

fresh_translation: Behold, like a lion he will go up from the midst of the Jordan into Ethan place, because quickly I will drive them from her, and appoint young men over her. Because who is like me, and who will oppose me, and who is this shepherd who will stand before my face?
brenton_translation: Behold, he shall come up as a lion out of the midst of Jordan to the place of Ætham: for I will speedily drive them from it, and do ye set the young men against her: for who is like me? and who will withstand me? and who is this shepherd, who shall confront me?

fresh_translation: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord which he counseled against Edom and his thought which he thought against those dwelling in Teman: Unless the least ones of the flock are consumed, unless their resting-place is made desolate upon her.
brenton_translation: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, which he has framed against Idumea; and his device, which he has devised against the inhabitants of Thæman: surely the least of the sheep shall be swept off; surely their dwelling shall be made desolate for them.

fresh_translation: Because from the sound of their fall, earth was shaken, and your cry was heard in the sea.
brenton_translation: For at the sound of their fall the earth was scared, and the cry of the sea was not heard.

fresh_translation: Behold, like an eagle he will appear and stretch his wings over her strongholds, and the heart of the mighty men of Edom in that day will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
brenton_translation: Behold, he shall look upon her as an eagle, and spread forth his wings over her strongholds; and the heart of the mighty men of Idumea shall be in that day as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

fresh_translation: To the sons of Ammon thus said the Lord: Are there no sons in Israel, or is there no heir for them? Why did Milcom inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
brenton_translation: Concerning the sons of Ammon thus saith the Lord, Are there no sons in Israel? or have they no one to succeed them? wherefore has Melchol inherited Galaad, and why shall their people dwell in their cities?

fresh_translation: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will sound in Rabbah tumults of wars, and they will become trackless waste and destruction, and her altars will be burned with fire, and Israel will inherit his dominion.
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will cause to be heard in Rabbath a tumult of wars; and they shall become a waste and ruined place, and her altars shall be burned with fire; then shall Israel succeed to his dominion.

fresh_translation: Howl, Heshbon, because Ai was destroyed. Cry out, daughters of Rabbah. Gird on sackcloth and mourn and cut yourselves for Milcom, because he will go in exile, his priests and his rulers together.
brenton_translation: Howl, O Esebon, for Gai has perished; cry, ye daughters of Rabbath, gird yourselves with sackclothes, and lament; for Melchol shall go into banishment, his priests and his princes together.

fresh_translation: Why do you rejoice in the plains of Enakim, daughter of insolence, trusting in her treasures, saying, Who will enter against me?
brenton_translation: Why do ye exult in the plains of the Enakim, thou haughty daughter, that trustest in thy treasures, that sayest, Who shall come in to me?

fresh_translation: Behold, I bring fear upon you, says the Lord, from all around you, and you will each be scattered before his face, and there will not be one gathering.
brenton_translation: Behold, I will bring terror upon thee, saith the Lord, from all the country round about thee; and ye shall be scattered every one right before him, and there is none to gather you.

fresh_translation: To Kedar, royal court, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck, thus said the Lord: Rise and go up against Kedar and fill yourselves with the sons of the east.
brenton_translation: Concerning Kedar the Queen of the Palace, whom Nabuchodonosor King of Babylon smote, thus saith the Lord;

fresh_translation: They will take their tents and their sheep, their garments and all their vessels, and their camels they will take for themselves, and call destruction all around upon them.
brenton_translation: They shall take their tents and their sheep, they shall take for themselves their garments, and all their baggage and their camels; and summon ye destruction against them from every side.

fresh_translation: Flee greatly. Go deep into dwelling, you dwelling in the court, because the king of Babylon planned a plan against you and devised a thought against you.
brenton_translation: Flee ye, dig very deep for a dwelling-place, ye that dwell in the palace; for the king of Babylon has framed a counsel, and devised a device against you.

fresh_translation: Rise and go up against a nation at ease, dwelling in refreshment, for whom there are no doors, no bars, no bolts. They dwell alone.
brenton_translation: Rise up, and go up against a nation settled and dwelling at ease, who have no doors, nor bolts, nor bars, who dwell alone.

fresh_translation: And their camels will become plunder and the multitude of their cattle destruction, and I will winnow them to every wind, those clipped around the face, and from every side I will bring their downfall, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And their camels shall be a spoil, and the multitude of their cattle shall be destroyed: and I will scatter them as chaff with every wind, having their hair cut about their foreheads, I will bring on their overthrow from all sides, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the court will become a dwelling-place of sparrows and trackless waste forever. No man will sit there, and no son of man will dwell there.
brenton_translation: And the palace shall be a resting-place for ostriches, and desolate for ever: no man shall abide there, and no son of man shall dwell there.

fresh_translation: To Damascus: Hamath and Arpad were put to shame, because they heard an evil report. They were confounded and troubled, and they certainly are not able to rest.
brenton_translation: Concerning Damascus. Emath is brought to shame, and Arphath: for they have heard an evil report: they are amazed, they are angry, they shall be utterly unable to rest.

fresh_translation: Damascus melted away. She turned to flight. Terror seized her.
brenton_translation: Damascus is utterly weakened, she is put to flight; trembling has seized upon her.

fresh_translation: How was my city not abandoned, the town they loved?
brenton_translation: How has she not left my city, they have loved the village?

fresh_translation: Therefore your young men will fall in your squares, and all your men of war will fall, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Therefore shall the young men fall in thy streets, and all thy warriors shall fall, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And I will kindle fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour streets of Ben-Hadad.
brenton_translation: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall devour the streets of the son of Ader.

fresh_translation: To Moab thus said the Lord: Woe to Nebo, because it was destroyed. Kiriathaim was taken. Amath was put to shame and defeated.
brenton_translation: Thus has the Lord said concerning Moab, Woe to Nabau! for it has perished: Cariathaim is taken: Amath and Agath are put to shame.

fresh_translation: There is no longer healing for Moab, nor boasting in Heshbon. They planned evils against her: We cut her off from a nation. Stop, a stopping-place. Behind you the sword will go.
brenton_translation: There is no longer any healing for Moab, nor glorying in Esebon: he has devised evils against her: we have cut her off from being a nation, and she shall be completely still: after thee shall go a sword;

fresh_translation: Because the voice of criers from Horonaim: destruction and great crushing.
brenton_translation: for there is a voice of men crying out of Oronaim, destruction and great ruin.

fresh_translation: Moab was crushed. Announce it in Zoar.
brenton_translation: Moab is ruined, proclaim it to Zogora:

fresh_translation: Because on the ascent of Aloth one will go up with weeping, weeping. On the road of Horonaim they heard a cry of crushing.
brenton_translation: for Aloth is filled with weeping: one shall go up weeping by the way of Oronaim; ye have heard a cry of destruction.

fresh_translation: Flee and save your souls, and you will be like a wild donkey in the desert.
brenton_translation: Flee ye, and save your lives, and ye shall be as a wild ass in the desert.

fresh_translation: Because you trusted in your strongholds, you too will be taken, and Chemosh will go out into exile, his priests and his rulers together.
brenton_translation: Since thou hast trusted in thy strong-hold, therefore thou shalt be taken: and Chamos shall go forth into captivity, and his priests, and his princes together.

fresh_translation: And destruction will come upon every city, and no city will be saved, and the valley will perish and the plain will be destroyed, just as the Lord said.
brenton_translation: And destruction shall come upon every city, it shall by no means escape; the valley also shall perish, and the plain country shall be completely destroyed, as the Lord has said.

fresh_translation: Give signs to Moab, because in flight she will fly out, and all her cities will become trackless waste. From where will there be one dwelling in her?
brenton_translation: Set marks upon Moab, for she shall be touched with a plague-spot, and all her cities shall become desolate; whence shall there be an inhabitant for her?

fresh_translation: Cursed is the one doing the works of the Lord negligently, withholding his sword from blood.
brenton_translation: Cursed is the man that does the works of the Lord carelessly, keeping back his sword from blood.

fresh_translation: Moab was at rest from childhood and was confident in his glory. He was not poured from vessel to vessel, and into exile he did not go. Because of this his taste stood in him and his smell did not leave.
brenton_translation: Moab has been at ease from a child, and trusted in his glory; he has not poured out his liquor from vessel to vessel, and has not gone into banishment, therefore his taste remained in him, and his smell departed not.

fresh_translation: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will send him tippers, and they will tip him, and they will thin his vessels and break his horns.
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, his days come, saith the Lord, when I shall send upon him bad leaders, and they shall lead him astray, and they shall utterly break in pieces his possessions, and shall cut his horns asunder.

fresh_translation: And Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their hope, trusting in them.
brenton_translation: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chamos, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bæthel their hope, having trusted in them.

fresh_translation: How will you say, We are strong and mighty men for wars?
brenton_translation: How will ye say, We are strong, and men strong for war?

fresh_translation: Moab was destroyed, his city, and his chosen young men went down to slaughter.
brenton_translation: Moab is ruined, even his city, and his choice young men have gone down to slaughter.

fresh_translation: Near is the day of Moab to come, and his evil is very swift.
brenton_translation: The day of Moab is near at hand, and his iniquity moves swiftly to vengeance.

fresh_translation: Shake for him, all around him, all knowing his name. Say, How the glorious staff was broken, the rod of greatness.
brenton_translation: Shake the head at him, all ye that are round about him; all of you utter his name; say ye, How is the glorious staff broken to pieces, the rod of magnificence!

fresh_translation: Come down from glory and sit in dampness, you dwelling in Dibon, worn out, because the destroyer of Moab came up against you. He destroyed your stronghold.
brenton_translation: Come down from thy glory, and sit down in a damp place: Dæbon shall be broken, because Moab is destroyed: there has gone up against thee one to ravage thy strong-hold.

fresh_translation: Stand by the road and watch, you dwelling in Aroer, and ask the one fleeing and being saved, and say, What happened?
brenton_translation: Stand by the way, and look, thou that dwellest in Arer; and ask him that is fleeing, and him that escapes, and say, What has happened?

fresh_translation: Moab was put to shame because he was broken. Howl and cry. Announce in Arnon that Moab was destroyed.
brenton_translation: Moab is put to shame, because he is broken: howl and cry; proclaim in Arnon, that Moab has perished.

fresh_translation: And judgment comes upon the land of Mishor, upon Holon and upon Jahazah and upon Mephaath,
brenton_translation: And judgment is coming against the land of Misor, upon Chelon, and Rephas, and Mophas,

fresh_translation: and upon Dibon and Nebo and upon Beth-diblathaim,
brenton_translation: and upon Dæbon, and upon Nabau, and upon the house of Dæthlathaim,

fresh_translation: and upon Kiriathaim and upon Beth-gamul and upon Beth-meon,
brenton_translation: and upon Cariathaim, and upon the house of Gæmol, and upon the house of Maon,

fresh_translation: and upon Kerioth and upon Bozrah and upon all cities of Moab, far and near.
brenton_translation: and upon Carioth, and upon Bosor, and upon all the cities of Moab, far and near.

fresh_translation: The horn of Moab was broken, and his arm was shattered.
brenton_translation: The horn of Moab is broken, and his arm is crushed.

fresh_translation: Make him drunk, because he magnified himself against the Lord, and Moab will clap with his hand, and he too will become a laughingstock.
brenton_translation: Make ye him drunk; for he has magnified himself against the Lord: and Moab shall clap with his hand, and shall be also himself a laughing-stock.

fresh_translation: And if Israel was not for mockery to you, was he found among your thefts, because you were fighting against him?
brenton_translation: For surely Israel was to thee a laughing-stock, and was found among thy thefts, because thou didst fight against him.

fresh_translation: They left the cities and dwelt in rocks, those dwelling in Moab. They became like doves nesting in rocks at the mouth of pit.
brenton_translation: The inhabitants of Moab have left the cities, and dwelt in rocks; they have become as doves nestling in rocks, at the mouth of a cave.

fresh_translation: I heard the pride of Moab. He was very proud, his insult and his arrogance, and his heart was raised high.
brenton_translation: And I have heard of the pride of Moab, he has greatly heightened his pride and his haughtiness, and his heart has been lifted up.

fresh_translation: But I knew his works. Was it not enough for him? Did he not do thus?
brenton_translation: But I know his works: is it not enough for him? has he not done thus?

fresh_translation: Therefore over Moab howl everywhere. Cry over the men of Kir-heres of drought.
brenton_translation: Therefore howl ye for Moab on all sides; cry out against the shorn men in a gloomy place. I will weep for thee,

fresh_translation: Like the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed through the sea. They touched Jazer. Destruction fell upon your fruit and upon your vintage.
brenton_translation: O vine of Aserema, as with the weeping of Jazer: thy branches are gone over the sea, they reached the cities of Jazer: destruction has come upon thy fruits, and upon thy grape-gatherers.

fresh_translation: Joy and gladness were utterly swept from the land of Moab, and though wine was in your presses, in the morning they did not tread it, nor in the evening did they raise the cry of joy.
brenton_translation: Joy and gladness have been utterly swept off the land of Moab: and though there was wine in thy presses, in the morning they trod it not, neither in the evening did they raise the cry of joy.

fresh_translation: From the cry of Heshbon as far as Elealeh their cities gave their voice, from Zoar as far as Horonaim and Aglath-salisia, because the waters of Nimrim will become a burning.
brenton_translation: From the cry of Esebon even to Ætam their cities uttered their voice, from Zogor to Oronaim, and their tidings as a heifer of three years old, for the water also of Nebrin shall be dried up.

fresh_translation: And I will destroy from Moab, says the Lord, the one going up upon the altar and burning incense to his gods.
brenton_translation: And I will destroy Moab, saith the Lord, as he comes up to the altar, and burns incense to his gods.

fresh_translation: Therefore my heart for Moab will sound like flutes, and my heart over the men of Kir-heres will sound like a flute, because what he prepared perished from man.
brenton_translation: Therefore the heart of Moab shall sound as pipes, my heart shall sound as a pipe for the shorn men; forasmuch as what every man has gained has perished from him.

fresh_translation: Every head in every place will be shaved, and every beard will be shaved, and all hands will beat, and upon every waist will be sackcloth.
brenton_translation: They shall all have their heads shaved in every place, and every beard shall be shaved; and all hands shall beat the breasts, and on all loins shall be sackcloth.

fresh_translation: And upon all roofs of Moab and in her squares, because I shattered Moab, says the Lord, like a vessel for which there is no use.
brenton_translation: And on all the housetops of Moab, and in his streets shall be mourning: for I have broken him, saith the Lord, as a vessel, which is useless.

fresh_translation: How he changed! How Moab turned his back! He was ashamed and became a laughingstock and a vexation to all around him.
brenton_translation: How has he changed! how has Moab turned his back! Moab is put to shame, and become a laughing-stock, and an object of anger to all that are round about him.

fresh_translation: Because thus said the Lord:
brenton_translation: For thus said the Lord;

fresh_translation: Kerioth was taken and strongholds were seized.
brenton_translation: Carioth is taken, and the strong-holds have been taken together.

fresh_translation: And Moab will perish from being a multitude, because against the Lord he magnified himself.
brenton_translation: And Moab shall perish from being a multitude, because he has magnified himself against the Lord.

fresh_translation: A snare and fear and pit are upon you, one dwelling in Moab.
brenton_translation: A snare, and fear, and the pit, are upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab.

fresh_translation: One fleeing from the face of fear will fall into the pit, and one coming up from the pit will be caught in the snare, because I will bring these things upon Moab in the year of her visitation.
brenton_translation: He that flees from the terror shall fall into the pit, and he that comes up out of the pit shall even be taken in the snare: for I will bring these things upon Moab in the year of their visitation.

fresh_translation: What Jeremiah prophesied against all nations.
Thus said the Lord God of Israel: Take this cup of unmixed wine from my hand, and you will make all nations drink, to whom I send you.
brenton_translation: Thus said the Lord God of Israel; Take the cup of this unmixed wine from mine hand, and thou shalt cause all the nations to drink, to whom I send thee.

fresh_translation: And they will drink and vomit and go mad from the face of the sword which I send among them.
brenton_translation: And they shall drink, and vomit, and be mad, because of the sword which I send among them.

fresh_translation: And I took the cup from the hand of the Lord and made the nations drink, to whom the Lord sent me against them:
brenton_translation: So I took the cup out of the Lord's hand, and caused the nations to whom the Lord sent me to drink:

fresh_translation: Jerusalem and the cities of Judah and kings of Judah and its rulers, to set them for desolation and for trackless waste and for hissing,
brenton_translation: Jerusalem, and the cities of Juda, and the kings of Juda, and his princes, to make them a desert place, a desolation, and a hissing;

fresh_translation: and Pharaoh king of Egypt and his servants and his nobles and all his people,
brenton_translation: and Pharao king of Egypt, and his servants, and his nobles, and all his people;

fresh_translation: and all his mixed peoples and all kings of the Philistines: Ashkelon and Gaza and Ekron and the remnant of Ashdod,
brenton_translation: and all the mingled people, and all the kings of the Philistines, and Ascalon, and Gaza, and Accaron, and the remnant of Azotus,

fresh_translation: and Edom and Moab and the sons of Ammon,
brenton_translation: and Idumea, and the land of Moab, and the children of Ammon,

fresh_translation: and all kings of Tyre and kings of Sidon and kings beyond the sea,
brenton_translation: and the kings of Tyre, and the kings of Sidon, and the kings in the country beyond the sea,

fresh_translation: and Dedan and Teman and Rosh and every one shaved around his face,
brenton_translation: and Dædan, and Thæman, and Ros, and every one that is shaved round about the face,

fresh_translation: and all mixed peoples dwelling in the wilderness,
brenton_translation: and all the mingled people lodging in the wilderness,

fresh_translation: and all kings of Elam and all kings of the Persians,
brenton_translation: and all the kings of Ælam, and all the kings of the Persians,

fresh_translation: and all kings from the east, far and near, each toward his brother, and all kingdoms upon the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: and all the kings from the north, the far and the near, each one with his brother, and all the kingdoms which are on the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: And you will say to them, Thus said the Lord Almighty: Drink and get drunk and vomit and fall and not rise from the face of the sword which I send among you.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say to them, Thus said the Lord Almighty; Drink ye, be ye drunken; and ye shall vomit, and shall fall, and shall in nowise rise, because of the sword which I send among you.

fresh_translation: And it will be, when they do not want to receive the cup from your hand to drink, then you will say, Thus said the Lord: Drinking you will drink.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, when they refuse to take the cup out of thine hand, to drink it, that thou shalt say, Thus said the Lord; Ye shall surely drink.

fresh_translation: Because in the city upon which my name was called, I begin to do evil, and you will certainly not be cleansed, because I call a sword upon those dwelling on the earth.
brenton_translation: For I am beginning to afflict the city whereon my name is called, and ye shall by no means be held guiltless: for I am calling a sword upon all that dwell upon the earth.

fresh_translation: And you will prophesy against them these words and say: The Lord from on high will utter, and from his holy place he will give his voice. He will utter a word against his place, and shouting like grape-treaders, they will answer against those dwelling on the earth.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt prophesy against them these words, and shalt say, The Lord shall speak from on high, from his sanctuary he will utter his voice; he will pronounce a declaration on his place; and these shall answer like men gathering grapes: and destruction is coming on them that dwell on the earth,

fresh_translation: Destruction comes upon a part of the earth, because judgment belongs to the Lord among the nations. He himself enters judgment with all flesh, but the ungodly were given to the sword, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: even upon the extreme part of the earth; for the Lord has a controversy with the nations, he is pleading with all flesh, and the ungodly are given to the sword, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: Behold, evils come from nation upon nation, and great storm goes out from the ends of the earth.
brenton_translation: Thus said the Lord; Behold, evils are proceeding from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind goes forth from the end of the earth.

fresh_translation: And slain by the Lord in the day of the Lord will be from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They will never be buried. They will be like dung upon the face of the earth.
brenton_translation: And the slain of the Lord shall be in the day of the Lord from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth: they shall not be buried; they shall be as dung on the face of the earth.

fresh_translation: Howl, shepherds, and cry out, and beat yourselves, rams of the sheep, because your days were filled up for slaughter, and you will fall like choice rams.
brenton_translation: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and lament, ye rams of the flock: for your days have been completed for slaughter, and ye shall fall as the choice rams.

fresh_translation: And flight will perish from shepherds and salvation from rams of the sheep.
brenton_translation: And flight shall perish from the shepherds, and safety from the rams of the flock.

fresh_translation: A voice of the cry of shepherds and a howl of sheep and rams, because the Lord destroyed their pastures.
brenton_translation: A voice of the crying of the shepherds, and a moaning of the sheep and the rams: for the Lord has destroyed their pastures.

fresh_translation: And the remnants of peace will cease from the face of my burning anger.
brenton_translation: And the peaceable abodes that remain shall be destroyed before the fierceness of my anger.

fresh_translation: He abandoned his lodging like a lion, because their land became trackless waste from the face of the great sword.
brenton_translation: He has forsaken his lair, as a lion: for their land is become desolate before the great sword.

fresh_translation: At the beginning of King Jehoiakim son of Josiah this word came from the Lord.
brenton_translation: In the beginning of the Reign of King Joakim Son of Josias there came this Word from the Lord.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: Stand in the court of the house of the Lord and declare to all Judeans and to all those coming to worship in the house of the Lord all the words which I ordered you to declare to them. Do not leave out a word.
brenton_translation: Thus said the Lord; Stand in the court of the Lord's house, and thou shalt declare to all the Jews, and to all that come to worship in the house of the Lord, all the words which I commanded thee to speak to them; abate not one word.

fresh_translation: Perhaps they will hear and each turn from his evil way, and I will relent from the evils which I plan to do to them because of their evil practices.
brenton_translation: Peradventure they will hear, and turn every one from his evil way: then I will cease from the evils which I purpose to do to them, because of their evil practices.

fresh_translation: And you will say, Thus said the Lord: If you do not listen to me, to walk in my statutes which I gave before your face,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say, Thus said the Lord; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my statutes which I set before you,

fresh_translation: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you early, and I sent, and you did not listen to me,
brenton_translation: to hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I send to you early in the morning; yea, I sent them, but ye hearkened not to me;

fresh_translation: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and this city I will give for a curse to all nations of all the earth.
brenton_translation: then will I make this house as Selo, and I will make this city a curse to all the nations of all the earth.

fresh_translation: And the priests and the false prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the priests, and the false prophets, and all the people heard Jeremias speaking these words in the house of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it happened when Jeremiah ceased speaking all that the Lord ordered him to speak to all the people, the priests and the false prophets and all the people seized him, saying, You will surely die.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when Jeremias had ceased speaking all that the Lord had ordered him to speak to all the people, that the priests and the false prophets and all the people took him, saying,

fresh_translation: Because you prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, Like Shiloh this house will be, and this city will be made desolate, without dwellers. And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt surely die, because thou hast prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, This house shall be as Selo, and this city shall be made quite destitute of inhabitants.

fresh_translation: And the rulers of Judah heard this word and went up from the house of the king into the house of the Lord and sat in the entrance of the new gate of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And the princes of Juda heard this word, and they went up out of the house of the king to the house of the Lord, and sat in the entrance of the new gate.

fresh_translation: And the priests and the false prophets said to the rulers and to all the people, A judgment of death for this man, because he prophesied against this city as you heard in your ears.
brenton_translation: Then the priests and the false prophets said to the princes and to all the people, The judgment of death is due to this man; because he has prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.

fresh_translation: And Jeremiah said to the rulers and to all the people, saying, The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all these words which you heard.
brenton_translation: Then Jeremias spoke to the princes, and to all the people, saying, The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city, all the words which ye have heard.

fresh_translation: And now make your ways and your works better and hear the voice of the Lord, and the Lord will relent from the evils which he spoke against you.
brenton_translation: And now amend your ways and your works, and hearken to the voice of the Lord; and the Lord shall cease from the evils which he has pronounced against you.

fresh_translation: And behold, I am in your hands. Do to me as is beneficial and as seems better to you.
brenton_translation: And behold, I am in your hands; do to me as is expedient, and as it is best for you.

fresh_translation: Only know for certain that if you kill me, you place innocent blood upon yourselves and upon this city and upon those dwelling in it, because in truth the Lord sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.
brenton_translation: But know for a certainty, that if ye slay me, ye bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon them that dwell in it; for in truth the Lord has sent me to you to speak in your ears all these words.

fresh_translation: And the rulers and all the people said to the priests and to the false prophets, There is no judgment of death for this man, because in the name of the Lord our God he spoke to us.
brenton_translation: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the false prophets; Judgment of death is not due to this man; for he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God.

fresh_translation: And men from the elders of the land stood up and said to all the assembly of the people,
brenton_translation: And there rose up men of the elders of the land, and said to all the assembly of the people,

fresh_translation: Micah the Morasthite was in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and said to all the people of Judah, Thus said the Lord: Zion will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become trackless waste, and the mountain of the house will become a grove of the forest.
brenton_translation: Michæas the Morathite lived in the days of Ezekias king of Juda, and said to all the people of Juda, Thus saith the Lord; Sion shall be ploughed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become a desolation, and the mountain of the house shall be a thicket of trees.

fresh_translation: Did Hezekiah and all Judah truly kill him? Was it not because they feared the Lord and sought the face of the Lord, and the Lord relented from the evils which he spoke against them? And we have done great evils against our souls.
brenton_translation: Did Ezekias and all Juda in any way slay him? Was it not that they feared the Lord, and they made supplication before the Lord, and the Lord ceased from the evils which he had pronounced against them? whereas we have wrought great evil against our own souls.

fresh_translation: And there was a man prophesying in the name of the Lord, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim, and he prophesied concerning this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
brenton_translation: And there was another man prophesying in the name of the Lord, Urias the son of Samæas of Cariathiarim; and he prophesied concerning this land according to all the words of Jeremias.

fresh_translation: And King Jehoiakim and all the rulers heard all his words, and they sought to kill him, and Uriah heard and entered Egypt.
brenton_translation: And king Joakim and all the princes heard all his words, and sought to slay him; and Urias heard it and went into Egypt.

fresh_translation: And the king sent men into Egypt,
brenton_translation: And the king sent men into Egypt;

fresh_translation: and they brought him out from there and led him to the king, and he struck him with the sword and threw him into the tomb of the sons of his people.
brenton_translation: and they brought him thence, and brought him in to the king; and he smote him with the sword, and cast him into the sepulchre of the children of his people.

fresh_translation: But the hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so as not to hand him into the hands of the people, so they would not kill him.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless the hand of Achicam son of Saphan was with Jeremias, to prevent his being delivered into the hands of the people, or being killed.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: Make bonds and yokes and put them around your neck.
brenton_translation: Thus said the Lord; Make to thyself bonds and yokes, and put them about thy neck,

fresh_translation: And you will send them to the king of Edom and to the king of Moab and to the king of the sons of Ammon and to the king of Tyre and to the king of Sidon by the hand of their messengers who come to meet Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt send them to the king of Idumea, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the children of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hands of their messengers that come to meet them at Jerusalem to Sedekias king of Juda.

fresh_translation: And you will command them to say to their lords, Thus said the Lord God of Israel. Thus you will say to your lords:
brenton_translation: And thou shalt commission them to say to their lords, Thus said the Lord God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to your lords;

fresh_translation: I made the earth in my great strength and in my high arm, and I will give it to whomever seems right in my eyes.
brenton_translation: I have made the earth by my great power, and with my high arm, and I will give it to whomsoever it shall seem good in mine eyes.

fresh_translation: I gave the land to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, to serve him, and the beasts of the field to work for him.
brenton_translation: I gave the earth to Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon to serve him, and the wild beasts of the field to labour for him.

fresh_translation: And the nation and the kingdom, as many as do not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, with sword and famine I will visit them, said the Lord, until they fail by his hand.
brenton_translation: And the nation and kingdom, all that shall not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, with sword and famine will I visit them, saith the Lord, until they are consumed by his hand.
