fresh_translation: And do not listen to your false prophets and those divining to you and those dreaming to you and your omens and your sorceries, those saying, You will not serve the king of Babylon.
brenton_translation: And hearken ye not to your false prophets, nor to them that divine to you, nor to them that foretel events by dreams to you, nor to your auguries, nor your sorcerers, that say, Ye shall by no means work for the king of Babylon:

fresh_translation: Because they prophesy lies to you, to remove you far from your land.
brenton_translation: for they prophesy lies to you, to remove you far from your land.

fresh_translation: And the nation that puts its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, I will leave upon its land, and it will work for him and dwell in it.
brenton_translation: But the nation which shall put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, I will even leave it upon its land, and it shall serve him, and dwell in it.

fresh_translation: And to Zedekiah king of Judah I spoke according to all these words, saying, Submit your neck,
brenton_translation: I spoke also to Sedekias king of Juda according to all these words, saying, Put your neck into the yoke,

fresh_translation: and serve the king of Babylon, because they prophesy unjust things to you.
brenton_translation: and serve the king of Babylon. For they prophesy unrighteous words to you,

fresh_translation: Because I did not send them, says the Lord, and they prophesy in my name unjustly, to destroy you, and you will perish, you and your prophets who prophesy lies to you unjustly.
brenton_translation: for I sent them not, saith the Lord; and they prophesy in my name unjustly, that I might destroy you, and ye should perish, and your prophets, who unrighteously prophesy lies to you.

fresh_translation: To you and to all this people and to the priests I spoke, saying, Thus said the Lord: Do not listen to the words of the prophets prophesying to you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the house of the Lord will return from Babylon, because they prophesy unjust things to you. I did not send them.
brenton_translation: I spoke to you, and to all this people, and to the priests, saying, Thus said the Lord; Hearken not to the words of the prophets that prophesy to you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the Lord's house shall return from Babylon: for they prophesy to you unrighteous words. I sent them not.

fresh_translation: If they are prophets and if the word of the Lord is in them, let them meet me.
brenton_translation: If they are prophets, and if the word of the Lord is in them, let them meet me, for thus has the Lord said.

fresh_translation: Because thus said the Lord, even concerning the remaining vessels
brenton_translation: And as for the remaining vessels,

fresh_translation: which the king of Babylon did not take when he carried away Jeconiah from Jerusalem,
brenton_translation: which the king of Babylon took not, when he carried Jechonias prisoner out of Jerusalem,

fresh_translation: into Babylon they will enter, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: they shall go into Babylon, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it happened in the fourth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fifth month, Hananiah son of Azor, the false prophet from Gibeon, said to me in the house of the Lord before the eyes of the priests and all the people, saying,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Sedekias king of Juda, in the fifth month, that Ananias the false prophet, the son of Azor, from Gabaon, spoke to me in the house of the Lord, in the sight of the priests and all the people, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

fresh_translation: Still two full years, and I will restore into this place the vessels of the house of the Lord,
brenton_translation: Yet two full years, and I will return into this place the vessels of the house of the Lord,

fresh_translation: and Jeconiah and the exile of Judah, because I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
brenton_translation: and Jechonias, and the captivity of Juda: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

fresh_translation: And Jeremiah said to Hananiah before the eyes of all the people and before the eyes of the priests standing in the house of the Lord,
brenton_translation: Then Jeremias spoke to Ananias in the sight of all the people, and in the sight of the priests that stood in the house of the Lord,

fresh_translation: and Jeremiah said, Truly, may the Lord do so. May the Lord establish your word which you prophesy, to return the vessels of the house of the Lord and all the exile from Babylon into this place.
brenton_translation: and Jeremias said, May the Lord indeed do thus; may he confirm thy word which thou dost prophesy, to return the vessels of the house of the Lord, and all the captivity, out of Babylon to this place.

fresh_translation: Only hear the word of the Lord which I speak into your ears and into the ears of all the people.
brenton_translation: Nevertheless hear ye the word of the Lord which I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people.

fresh_translation: The prophets who were before me and before you from ancient time prophesied against much land and against great kingdoms concerning war.
brenton_translation: The prophets that were before me and before you of old, also prophesied over much country, and against great kingdoms, concerning war.

fresh_translation: The prophet prophesying for peace, when his word comes, they will know the prophet whom the Lord sent in faithfulness.
brenton_translation: As for the prophet that has prophesied for peace, when the word has come to pass, they shall know the prophet whom the Lord has sent them in truth.

fresh_translation: And Hananiah took before the eyes of all the people the yokes from Jeremiah's neck and broke them.
brenton_translation: Then Ananias took the yokes from the neck of Jeremias in the sight of all the people, and broke them to pieces.

fresh_translation: And Hananiah said before the eyes of all the people, saying, Thus said the Lord: Thus I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon from the necks of all nations. And Jeremiah went on his way.
brenton_translation: And Ananias spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus said the Lord; Thus will I break the yoke of the king of Babylon from the necks of all the nations. And Jeremias went his way.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah after Hananiah broke the yokes from his neck, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremias, after that Ananias had broken the yokes off his neck, saying,

fresh_translation: Go and say to Hananiah, Thus said the Lord: You broke wooden yokes, and I will make iron yokes in their place.
brenton_translation: Go and speak to Ananias, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but I will make instead of them yokes of iron.

fresh_translation: Because thus said the Lord: I have set an iron yoke upon the neck of all nations, to serve the king of Babylon.
brenton_translation: For thus said the Lord, I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all the nations, that they may serve the king of Babylon.

fresh_translation: And Jeremiah said to Hananiah, The Lord did not send you, and you made this people trust in an unjust thing.
brenton_translation: And Jeremias said to Ananias, The Lord has not sent thee; and thou hast caused this people to trust in unrighteousness.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus said the Lord: Behold, I send you away from the face of the earth. In this year you will die.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus said the Lord: Behold, I will cast thee off from the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die.

fresh_translation: And he died in the seventh month.
brenton_translation: So he died in the seventh month.

fresh_translation: And these are the words of the scroll which Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to the elders of exile and to the priests and to the false prophets, a letter into Babylon to the exile and to all the people,
brenton_translation: And these are the words of the book which Jeremias sent from Jerusalem to the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, and to the false prophets, even an epistle to Babylon for the captivity, and to all the people;

fresh_translation: after Jeconiah the king and the queen and the eunuchs and every freeman and prisoner and craftsman went out from Jerusalem,
brenton_translation: (after the departure of Jechonias the king and the queen, and the eunuchs, and every freeman, and bondman, and artificer, out of Jerusalem;)

fresh_translation: by the hand of Eleasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Babylon in Babylon, saying,
brenton_translation: by the hand of Eleasan son of Saphan, and Gamarias son of Chelcias, (whom Sedekias king of Juda sent to the king of Babylon to Babylon) saying,

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord God of Israel concerning the exile which I exiled from Jerusalem:
brenton_translation: Thus said the Lord God of Israel concerning the captivity which I caused to be carried away from Jerusalem;

fresh_translation: Build houses and dwell, and plant gardens and eat their fruits.
brenton_translation: Build ye houses, and inhabit them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruits thereof;

fresh_translation: And take wives and beget sons and daughters, and take wives for your sons and give your daughters to husbands, and multiply and do not become few.
brenton_translation: and take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, and be multiplied, and be not diminished.

fresh_translation: And seek the peace of the land into which I exiled you there, and pray concerning it to the Lord, because in its peace there will be peace for you.
brenton_translation: And seek the peace of the land into which I have carried you captive, and ye shall pray to the Lord for the people: for in its peace ye shall have peace.

fresh_translation: Because thus said the Lord: Do not let the false prophets among you persuade you, and do not let your diviners persuade you, and do not listen to your dreams which you yourselves dream,
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord; Let not the false prophets that are among you persuade you, and let not your diviners persuade you, and hearken not to your dreams which ye dream.

fresh_translation: because they prophesy unjustly to you in my name, and I did not send them.
brenton_translation: For they prophesy to you unrighteous words in my name; and I sent them not.

fresh_translation: Because thus said the Lord: When seventy years are about to be completed for Babylon, I will visit you and establish my words upon you, to restore your people into this place.
brenton_translation: For thus said the Lord; When seventy years shall be on the point of being accomplished at Babylon, I will visit you, and will confirm my words to you, to bring back your people to this place.

fresh_translation: And I plan for you a plan of peace and not evils, to give you these things.
brenton_translation: And I will devise for you a device of peace, and not evil, to bestow upon you these good things.

fresh_translation: And pray to me, and I will hear you.
brenton_translation: And do ye pray to me, and I will hearken to you: and do ye earnestly seek me, and ye shall find me;

fresh_translation: And seek me, and you will find me, because you will seek me with all your heart.
brenton_translation: for ye shall seek me with your whole heart.

fresh_translation: And I will appear to you.
brenton_translation: And I will appear to you:

fresh_translation: Because you said, The Lord appointed prophets for us in Babylon.
brenton_translation: whereas ye said, The Lord has appointed for us prophets in Babylon:

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord concerning Ahab and concerning Zedekiah: Behold, I give them into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will strike them before your eyes.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord concerning Achiab, and concerning Sedekias; Behold, I will deliver them into the hands of the king of Babylon; and he shall smite them in your sight.

fresh_translation: And from them they will take a curse in all the exile of Judah in Babylon, saying, May the Lord make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in fire,
brenton_translation: And they shall make of them a curse in all the captivity of Juda in Babylon, saying, The Lord do to thee as he did to Sedekias, and as he did to Achiab, whom the king of Babylon fried in the fire;

fresh_translation: because they did lawlessness in Israel and committed adultery with the wives of their fellow citizens and spoke a word in my name which I did not command them, and I am witness, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: because of the iniquity which they wrought in Israel, and because they committed adultery with the wives of their fellow-citizens, and spoke a word in my name, which I did not command them to speak, and I am witness, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And to Shemaiah the Nehelamite you will say,
brenton_translation: And to Samæas the Ælamite thou shalt say,

fresh_translation: I did not send you in my name. And to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest he said,
brenton_translation: I sent thee not in my name: and to Sophonias the priest the son of Maasæas say thou,

fresh_translation: The Lord made you priest in place of Joiada the priest, to become overseer in the house of the Lord over every man prophesying and every madman, and you will put him into confinement and into stocks.
brenton_translation: The Lord has made thee priest in the place of Jodae the priest, to be ruler in the house of the Lord over every prophet, and to every madman, and thou shalt put them in prison, and into the dungeon.

fresh_translation: And now why did you revile Jeremiah from Anathoth, the one prophesying to you?
brenton_translation: And now wherefore have ye reviled together Jeremias of Anathoth, who prophesied to you?

fresh_translation: Was it not because of this that he sent to you into Babylon, saying, It is long. Build houses and dwell, and plant gardens and eat their fruit?
brenton_translation: Did he not send for this purpose? for in the course of this month he sent to you to Babylon, saying, It is far off: build ye houses, and inhabit them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

fresh_translation: And Zephaniah read the scroll into the ears of Jeremiah.
brenton_translation: And Sophonias read the book in the ears of Jeremias.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
brenton_translation: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremias, saying,

fresh_translation: Send to the exile, saying, Thus said the Lord concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah prophesied to you and I did not send him, and he made you trust in unjust things,
brenton_translation: Send to the captivity, saying, Thus saith the Lord concerning Samæas the Ælamite, Since Samæas has prophesied to you, and I sent him not, and he has made you to trust in iniquity,

fresh_translation: therefore thus said the Lord: Behold, I will visit Shemaiah and his seed, and there will not be a man from them in your midst to see the good things which I will do for you. They will not see.
brenton_translation: therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will visit Samæas, and his family: and there shall not be a man of them in the midst of you to see the good which I will do to you: they shall not see it.

fresh_translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
brenton_translation: The Word that came to Jeremias from the Lord, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord God of Israel, saying, Write in a scroll all the words which I declared to you,
brenton_translation: Thus speaks the Lord God of Israel, saying,

fresh_translation: because behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will restore the exile of my people Israel and Judah, says the Lord, and I will restore them into the land which I gave to their fathers, and they will take possession of it.
brenton_translation: For, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will bring back the captivity of my people Israel and Juda, said the Lord: and I will bring them back to the land which I gave to their fathers, and they shall be lords of it.

fresh_translation: And these are the words which the Lord spoke concerning Israel and Judah.
brenton_translation: And these are the Words which the Lord spoke concerning Israel and Juda:

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: A voice of fear you will hear: fear, and there is no peace.
brenton_translation: Thus said the Lord: Ye shall hear a sound of fear, there is fear, and there is not peace.

fresh_translation: Ask and see whether a male gives birth. Why, from fear, does every man hold his loins? Because I saw every man with his hands upon his loins; faces were turned to jaundice.
brenton_translation: Enquire, and see if a male has born a child? and ask concerning the fear, wherein they shall hold their loins, and look for safety: for I have seen every man, and his hands are on his loins; their faces are turned to paleness.

fresh_translation: For that day became great, and there is none like it, and it is a narrow time for Jacob, and from this he will be saved.
brenton_translation: For that day is great, and there is not such another; and it is a time of straitness to Jacob; but he shall be saved out of it.

fresh_translation: In that day, said the Lord, I will break the yoke from their neck and tear apart their bonds, and they will no longer serve foreigners.
brenton_translation: In that day, said the Lord, I will break the yoke off their neck, and will burst their bonds, and they shall no longer serve strangers:

fresh_translation: And they will serve the Lord their God, and I will raise up David their king for them.
brenton_translation: but they shall serve the Lord their God; and I will raise up to them David their king.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: Your fracture rose up painfully; your wound is painful.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; I have brought on thee destruction; thy stroke is painful.

fresh_translation: There is none judging your case for the painful thing. You were treated, but there is no benefit for you.
brenton_translation: There is none to judge thy cause: thou hast been painfully treated for healing, there is no help for thee.

fresh_translation: All your friends forgot you. They will never ask for you, because with the wound of an enemy I struck you, a stern discipline. Because of all your injustice, your sins were multiplied.
brenton_translation: All thy friends have forgotten thee; they shall not ask about thee at all, for I have smitten thee with the stroke of an enemy, even severe correction: thy sins have abounded above all thine iniquity.

fresh_translation: Therefore all those eating you will be eaten, and all your enemies will eat their own flesh. Because your injustices multiplied, your sins multiplied, they did these things to you, and those carrying you off will become a carrying off, and all those plundering you I will give for plunder.
brenton_translation: Therefore all that devour thee shall be eaten, and all thine enemies shall eat all their own flesh. Thy sins have abounded beyond the multitude of thine iniquities, therefore they have done these things to thee. And they that spoil thee shall become a spoil, and I will give up to be plundered all that have plundered thee.

fresh_translation: Because I will bring up your healing. From a painful wound I will heal you, says the Lord, because they called you Scattered: It is your prey, because there is no seeker for her.
brenton_translation: For I will bring about thy healing, I will heal thee of thy grievous wound, saith the Lord; for thou art called Dispersed: she is your prey, for no one seeks after her.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: Behold, I will restore the exile of Jacob, and his captivity I will pity, and the city will be built on its height, and the temple will sit according to its judgment.
brenton_translation: Thus said the Lord; Behold, I will turn the captivity of Jacob, and will have pity upon his prisoners; and the city shall be built upon her hill, and the people shall settle after their manner.

fresh_translation: And from them singers and a voice of those playing will come out, and I will multiply them and they will not be diminished.
brenton_translation: And there shall go forth from them singers, even the sound of men making merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not at all be diminished.

fresh_translation: And their sons will enter as before, and their testimonies before my face will be set upright, and I will visit those afflicting them.
brenton_translation: And their sons shall go in as before, and their testimonies shall be established before me, and I will visit them that afflict them.

fresh_translation: And their mighty ones will be over them, and their ruler will come out from them, and I will gather them and they will return to me. Because who is this who gave his heart to return to me? says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And their mighty ones shall be over them, and their prince shall proceed of themselves; and I will gather them, and they shall return to me: for who is this that has set his heart to return to me? saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because the wrath of the Lord went out furious. Turning wrath will come upon the ungodly.
brenton_translation: For the wrathful anger of the Lord has gone forth, even a whirlwind of anger has gone forth: it shall come upon the ungodly.

fresh_translation: The wrath of the anger of the Lord will not turn back until he does and until he establishes the undertaking of his heart. At the last of days you will know these things.
brenton_translation: The fierce anger of the Lord shall not return, until he shall execute it, and until he shall establish the purpose of his heart: in the latter days ye shall know these things.

fresh_translation: In that time the Lord said, I will be God to the family of Israel, and they will be a people to me.
brenton_translation: At that time, saith the Lord, I will be a God to the family of Israel, and they shall be to me a people.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: I found warmth in the wilderness with those destroyed by the sword. Go, and do not destroy Israel.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, I found him warm in the wilderness with them that were slain with the sword: go ye and destroy not Israel.

fresh_translation: The Lord appeared to him from far away: With eternal love I loved you, therefore I drew you into compassion.
brenton_translation: The Lord appeared to him from afar, saying, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore have I drawn thee in compassion.

fresh_translation: Still I will build you and you will be built, virgin Israel. Still you will take your tambourine and go out with the assembly of those playing.
brenton_translation: For I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt yet take thy timbrel, and go forth with the party of them that make merry.

fresh_translation: Still plant vineyards in the mountains of Samaria. Plant and praise.
brenton_translation: For ye have planted vineyards on the mountains of Samaria: plant ye, and praise.

fresh_translation: Because there is a day of calling of defenders in the mountains of Ephraim: Rise and go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.
brenton_translation: For it is a day when those that plead on the mountains of Ephraim shall call, saying, Arise ye, and go up to Sion to the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: Because thus said the Lord to Jacob: Rejoice and neigh over the head of nations. Make it heard and praise. Say, The Lord saved his people, the remnant of Israel.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord to Jacob; Rejoice ye, and exult over the head of the nations: make proclamation, and praise ye: say, The Lord has delivered his people, the remnant of Israel.

fresh_translation: Behold, I bring them from the north and gather them from the ends of the earth at the feast of Passover, and they will beget a great crowd and return here.
brenton_translation: Behold, I bring them from the north, and will gather them from the end of the earth to the feast of the passover: and the people shall beget a great multitude, and they shall return hither.

fresh_translation: With weeping they went out, and with comfort I will lead them, lodging them by channels of waters, in a straight way, and they will not wander in it, because I became a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
brenton_translation: They went forth with weeping, and I will bring them back with consolation, causing them to lodge by the channels of waters in a straight way, and they shall not err in it: for I am become a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my first-born.

fresh_translation: Hear the word of the Lord, nations, and announce to islands far away. Say, The one who winnowed Israel will gather him and guard him like a shepherd his flock.
brenton_translation: Hear the words of the Lord, ye nations, and proclaim them to the islands afar off; say, He that scattered Israel will also gather him, and keep him as one that feeds his flock.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord ransomed Jacob, delivered him from the hand of those stronger than he.
brenton_translation: For the Lord has ransomed Jacob, he has rescued him out of the hand of them that were stronger than he.

fresh_translation: And they will come and rejoice on Mount Zion, and come upon the good things of the Lord, upon the land of grain and wine and fruits and cattle and sheep. And their soul will be like a fruitful tree, and they will hunger no longer.
brenton_translation: And they shall come, and shall rejoice in the mount of Sion, and shall come to the good things of the Lord, even to a land of corn, and wine, and fruits, and cattle, and sheep: and their soul shall be as a fruitful tree; and they shall hunger no more.

fresh_translation: Then virgins will rejoice in the gathering of young men, and elders will rejoice, and I will turn their mourning into joy and make them glad.
brenton_translation: Then shall the virgins rejoice in the assembly of youth, and the old men shall rejoice; and I will turn their mourning into joy, and will make them merry.

fresh_translation: I will magnify and make drunk the soul of the priests, sons of Levi, and my people will be filled with my good things.
brenton_translation: I will expand and cheer with wine the soul of the priests the sons of Levi, and my people shall be satisfied with my good things: thus saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: A voice was heard in Ramah, lament and weeping and mourning, Rachel weeping for her sons. She was not willing to stop, because they are not.
brenton_translation: A voice was heard in Rama, of lamentation, and of weeping, and wailing; Rachel would not cease weeping for her children, because they are not.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: Let your voice cease from weeping and your eyes from your tears, because there is a wage for your works, and they will return from the land of enemies.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; Let thy voice cease from weeping, and thine eyes from thy tears: for there is a reward for thy works; and they shall return from the land of thine enemies.

fresh_translation: There is permanence for your children.
brenton_translation: There shall be an abiding home for thy children.

fresh_translation: Hearing, I heard Ephraim lamenting: You disciplined me and I was disciplined, like a calf not taught. Turn me back and I will return, because you are the Lord my God.
brenton_translation: I have heard the sound of Ephraim lamenting, and saying, Thou hast chastened me, and I was chastened; I as a calf was not willingly taught: turn thou me, and I shall turn; for thou art the Lord my God.

fresh_translation: Because after my captivity I repented, and after I came to know, I groaned in the day of shame and showed you that I received reproach from my youth.
brenton_translation: For after my captivity I repented; and after I knew, I groaned for the day of shame, and shewed thee that I bore reproach from my youth.

fresh_translation: Ephraim is a beloved son to me, a cherished child, because in return for my words in him I will surely remember him. Therefore I hastened over him; with mercy I will have mercy on him, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Ephraim is a beloved son, a pleasing child to me: for because my words are in him, I will surely remember him: therefore I made haste to help him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Set up for yourself, Zion. Make correction. Give your heart to the shoulders, to the road on which you went. Turn back, virgin Israel. Turn back to your cities, mourning.
brenton_translation: Prepare thyself, O Sion; execute vengeance; look to thy ways: return, O virgin of Israel, by the way by which thou wentest, return mourning to thy cities.

fresh_translation: How long will you turn back, dishonored daughter? Because the Lord created salvation for a new planting. Men will go about in salvation.
brenton_translation: How long, O disgraced daughter, wilt thou turn away? for the Lord has created safety for a new plantation: men shall go about in safety.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: Still they will speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities when I restore its captivity: Blessed is the Lord upon the righteous mountain, his holy one.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord; They shall yet speak this word in the land of Juda, and in the cities thereof, when I shall turn his captivity; blessed be the Lord on his righteous holy mountain!

fresh_translation: And dwellers in the cities of Judah and in all its land together with the farmer, and one will be lifted in a flock.
brenton_translation: And there shall be dwellers in the cities of Juda, and in all his land, together with the husbandman, and the shepherd shall go forth with the flock.

fresh_translation: Because I made every thirsty soul drunk and filled every hungry soul.
brenton_translation: For I have saturated every thirsting soul, and filled every hungry soul.

fresh_translation: Therefore I woke up and saw, and my sleep became sweet to me.
brenton_translation: Therefore I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet to me.

fresh_translation: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will sow Israel and Judah with seed of man and seed of cattle.
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Juda with the seed of man, and the seed of beast.

fresh_translation: And it will be, just as I watched over them to tear down and to do evil, so I will watch over them to build and to plant, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, that as I watched over them, to pull down, and to afflict, so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: In those days they will no longer say, The fathers ate a sour grape, and the teeth of the children were set on edge.
brenton_translation: In those days they shall certainly not say, The fathers ate a sour grape, and the children's teeth were set on edge.

fresh_translation: But each will die in his own sin, and the teeth of the one eating the sour grape will be set on edge.
brenton_translation: But every one shall die in his own sin; and the teeth of him that eats the sour grape shall be set on edge.

fresh_translation: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will make with the house of Israel and the house of Judah a new covenant,
brenton_translation: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Juda:

fresh_translation: not according to the covenant which I made with their fathers on the day when I took their hand to bring them out from the land of Egypt, because they did not remain in my covenant and I neglected them, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: not according to the covenant which I made with their fathers in the day when I took hold of their hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; for they abode not in my covenant, and I disregarded them, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because this is the covenant which I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord: Giving, I will give my laws into their mind, and upon their hearts I will write them, and I will be God to them, and they will be a people to me.
brenton_translation: For this is my covenant which I will make with the house of Israel; after those days, saith the Lord, I will surely put my laws into their mind, and write them on their hearts; and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people.

fresh_translation: And they will certainly not teach each his fellow citizen and each his brother, saying, Know the Lord, because all will know me from their little one to their great one, because I will be merciful to their injustices and I will no longer remember their sins.
brenton_translation: And they shall not at all teach every one his fellow citizen, and every one his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least of them to the greatest of them: for I will be merciful to their iniquities, and their sins I will remember no more.

fresh_translation: If heaven is lifted up high, says the Lord, and if the foundation of the earth is humbled below, I also will not reject the seed of Israel, says the Lord, concerning all they did.
brenton_translation: Though the sky should be raised to a greater height, saith the Lord, and though the ground of the earth should be sunk lower beneath, yet I will not cast off the family of Israel, saith the Lord, for all that they have done.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord, who gave the sun for the light of day, the moon and stars for the light of night, and a roar in the sea, and its waves roared, the Lord Almighty is his name.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, who gives the sun for a light by day, the moon and the stars for a light by night, and makes a roaring in the sea, so that the waves thereof roar; the Lord Almighty is his name:

fresh_translation: If these laws cease from before my face, says the Lord, then the seed of Israel will cease from being a nation before my face all the days.
brenton_translation: if these ordinances cease from before me, saith the Lord, then shall the family of Israel cease to be a nation before me for ever.

fresh_translation: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and the city will be built to the Lord from the tower of Hanameel to the corner gate.
brenton_translation: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when the city shall be built to the Lord from the tower of Anameel to the gate of the corner.

fresh_translation: And its measuring-line will go out opposite them as far as the hills of Gareb and will be encircled round about with chosen stones.
brenton_translation: And the measurement of it shall proceed in front of them as far as the hills of Gareb, and it shall be compassed with a circular wall of choice stones.

fresh_translation: And all Asaeremoth as far as the valley of Kidron, as far as the corner of the horse gate toward the east, will be a holy thing to the Lord, and it will never fail or be torn down forever.
brenton_translation: And all the Asaremoth even to Nachal Kedron, as far as the corner of the horse-gate eastward, shall be holiness to the Lord; and it shall not fail any more, and shall not be destroyed for ever.

fresh_translation: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah in the tenth year of the reign of Zedekiah; this was the eighteenth year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
brenton_translation: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremias in the tenth year of king Sedekias, this is the eighteenth year of king Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon.

fresh_translation: And the force of the king of Babylon fenced against Jerusalem, and Jeremiah was guarded in the court of the prison, which is in the house of the king.
brenton_translation: And the host of the king of Babylon had made a rampart against Jerusalem: and Jeremias was kept in the court of the prison, which is in the king's house;

fresh_translation: In which King Zedekiah shut him up, saying, Why do you prophesy, saying, Thus said the Lord: Behold, I give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will take it.
brenton_translation: in which king Sedekias had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;

fresh_translation: And Zedekiah will certainly not be saved from the hand of the Chaldeans, because in handing over he will be handed into the hands of the king of Babylon, and his mouth will speak to his mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes.
brenton_translation: and Sedekias shall by no means be delivered out of the hand of the Chaldeans, for he shall certainly be given up into the hands of the king of Babylon, and his mouth shall speak to his mouth, and his eyes shall look upon his eyes;

fresh_translation: And Zedekiah will enter Babylon, and there he will sit.
brenton_translation: and Sedekias shall go into Babylon, and dwell there?

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
brenton_translation: And the Word of the Lord came to Jeremias, saying,

fresh_translation: Behold, Hanameel son of Shallum, your father's brother, comes to you, saying, Buy for yourself my field in Anathoth, because the right belongs to you to receive it for possession.
brenton_translation: Behold, Anameel the son of Salom thy father's brother is coming to thee, saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for thou hast the right to take it as a purchase.

fresh_translation: And Hanameel son of Shallum, my father's brother, came to me into the court of the prison and said to me, Buy my field in the land of Benjamin, in Anathoth, because the right belongs to you to buy, and you are elder. And I knew that it is the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: So Anameel the son of Salom my father's brother came to me into the court of the prison, and said, Buy thee my field that is in the land of Benjamin, in Anathoth: for thou hast a right to buy it, and thou art the elder. So I knew that it was the word of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And I bought the field of Hanameel, son of my father's brother, and weighed out to him seventeen shekels of silver.
brenton_translation: And I bought the field of Anameel the son of my father's brother, and I weighed him seventeen shekels of silver.

fresh_translation: And I wrote in a scroll and sealed it and called witnesses and weighed the silver in a balance.
brenton_translation: And I wrote it in a book, and sealed it, and took the testimony of witnesses, and weighed the money in the balance.

fresh_translation: And I took the scroll of purchase, sealed and read.
brenton_translation: And I took the book of the purchase that was sealed;

fresh_translation: And I gave it to Baruch son of Neriah son of Maaseiah before the eyes of Hanameel son of my father's brother and before the eyes of those standing and writing in the scroll of purchase and before the eyes of the Judeans in the court of the prison.
brenton_translation: and I gave it to Baruch son of Nerias, son of Maasæas, in the sight of Anameel my father's brother's son, and in the sight of the men that stood by and wrote in the book of the purchase, and in the sight of the Jews that were in the court of the prison.

fresh_translation: And I commanded Baruch before their eyes, saying,
brenton_translation: And I charged Baruch in their presence, saying, Thus saith the Lord Almighty;

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord Almighty: Take this scroll of purchase and the scroll that was read and put it into an earthen vessel, so that it may remain many days.
brenton_translation: Take this book of the purchase, and the book that has been read; and thou shalt put it into an earthen vessel, that it may remain many days.

fresh_translation: Because thus said the Lord: Still fields and houses and vineyards will be bought in this land.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord; There shall yet be bought fields and houses and vineyards in this land.

fresh_translation: And I prayed to the Lord after my giving the scroll of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, saying,
brenton_translation: And I prayed to the Lord after I had given the book of the purchase to Baruch the son of Nerias, saying,

fresh_translation: Ah Lord, you made heaven and earth with your great strength and your high and lifted arm, and nothing will be hidden from you,
brenton_translation: O ever living Lord! thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power, and with thy high and lofty arm: nothing can be hidden from thee.

fresh_translation: doing mercy to thousands and repaying the sins of fathers into the bosom of their children after them, the great and mighty God,
brenton_translation: Granting mercy to thousands, and recompensing the sins of the fathers into the bosoms of their children after them: the great, the strong God;

fresh_translation: the Lord of great counsel and mighty in works, the great God, the Almighty and great in name, the Lord. Your eyes are upon the ways of the sons of men, to give to each according to his way,
brenton_translation: the Lord of great counsel, and mighty in deeds, the great Almighty God, and Lord of great name: thine eyes are upon the ways of the children of men, to give to every one according to his way:

fresh_translation: who made signs and wonders in the land of Egypt until this day, and in Israel and among earth-born people, and made a name for yourself as this day.
brenton_translation: who hast wrought signs and wonders in the land of Egypt even to this day, and in Israel, and among the inhabitants of the earth; and thou didst make for thyself a name, as at this day;

fresh_translation: And you brought your people Israel out from the land of Egypt with signs and with wonders and with a strong hand and with a high arm and with great visions.
brenton_translation: and thou didst bring out thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, with a mighty hand, and with a high arm, and with great sights;

fresh_translation: And you gave them this land which you swore to their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.
brenton_translation: and thou gavest them this land, which thou didst swear to give to their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey;

fresh_translation: And they entered and took it, and they did not hear your voice, and in your ordinances they did not walk. All that you commanded them they did not do, and you made all these evils happen to them.
brenton_translation: and they went in, and took it; but they hearkened not to thy voice, and walked not in thine ordinances; they did none of the things which thou didst command them, and they caused all these calamities to happen to them.

fresh_translation: Behold, a crowd comes to this city to seize it, and the city was given into the hands of the Chaldeans fighting against it, from the face of the sword and famine. As you spoke, so it happened.
brenton_translation: Behold, a multitude is come against the city to take it; and the city is given into the hands of the Chaldeans that fight against it, by the power of the sword, and the famine: as thou hast spoken, so has it happened.

fresh_translation: And you say to me, Buy a field for yourself with silver, and I wrote a scroll and sealed it and brought witnesses, and the city was given into the hands of the Chaldeans.
brenton_translation: And thou sayest to me, Buy thee the field for money; and I wrote a book, and sealed it, and took the testimony of witnesses: and the city is given into the hands of the Chaldeans.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: I am the Lord, God of all flesh. Will anything be hidden from me?
brenton_translation: I am the Lord, the God of all flesh: shall anything be hidden from me!

fresh_translation: Therefore thus said the Lord God of Israel: This city in being given over will be handed into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will take it.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel; This city shall certainly be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it:

fresh_translation: And the Chaldeans fighting against this city will come and burn this city with fire and burn the houses in which they burned incense on their roofs to Baal and poured libations to other gods to provoke me.
brenton_translation: and the Chaldeans shall come to war against this city, and they shall burn this city with fire, and shall burn down the houses wherein they burnt incense on the roofs thereof to Baal, and poured drink-offerings to other gods, to provoke me.

fresh_translation: Because the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah alone were doing evil before my eyes from their youth.
brenton_translation: For the children of Israel and the children of Juda alone did evil in my sight from their youth.

fresh_translation: Because this city has been for my anger and for my wrath from the day they built it even until this day, to remove it from before my face,
brenton_translation: For this city was obnoxious to my anger and my wrath, from the day that they built it even to this day; that I should remove it from my presence,

fresh_translation: because of all the evils of the sons of Israel and Judah which they did to provoke me, they and their kings and their rulers and their priests and their prophets, men of Judah and dwellers of Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: because of all the wickedness of the children of Israel and Juda, which they wrought to provoke me, they and their kings, and their princes, and their priests, and their prophets, the men of Juda, and the dwellers in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And they turned to me back and not face, and I taught them rising early and teaching, and they did not listen so as to receive discipline.
brenton_translation: And they turned the back to me, and not the face: whereas I taught them early in the morning, but they hearkened no more to receive instruction.

fresh_translation: And they set their defilements in the house on which my name was called, by their uncleannesses.
brenton_translation: And they set their pollutions in the house, on which my name was called, by their uncleannesses.

fresh_translation: And they built altars to Baal in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to offer up their sons and daughters to King Moloch, which I did not command them and it did not rise on my heart, to do this abomination, to make Judah sin.
brenton_translation: And they built to Baal the altars that are in the valley of the son of Ennom, to offer their sons and their daughters to king Moloch; which things I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind that they should do this abomination, to cause Juda to sin.

fresh_translation: And now thus said the Lord God of Israel concerning this city which you say will be handed into the hands of the king of Babylon by sword and famine and by sending away:
brenton_translation: And now thus has the Lord God of Israel said concerning this city, of which thou sayest, It shall be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by famine, and banishment.

fresh_translation: Behold, I gather them from all lands where I scattered them in my anger and in my wrath and in great provocation, and I will restore them to this place and settle them in confidence.
brenton_translation: Behold, I will gather them out of every land, where I have scattered them in my anger, and my wrath, and great fury; and I will bring them back into this place, and will cause them to dwell safely:

fresh_translation: And they will be a people to me, and I will be God to them.
brenton_translation: and they shall be to me a people, and I will be to them a God.

fresh_translation: And I will give them another way and another heart, to fear me all the days, for good to them and to their children after them.
brenton_translation: And I will give them another way, and another heart, to fear me continually, and that for good to them and their children after them.

fresh_translation: And I will make with them an everlasting covenant, which I will certainly not turn away from behind them, and my fear I will give into their heart, so that they will not depart from me.
brenton_translation: And I will make with them an everlasting covenant, which I will by no means turn away from them, and I will put my fear into their heart, that they may not depart from me.

fresh_translation: And I will visit them to do good to them and plant them in this land in faithfulness and with all heart and with all soul.
brenton_translation: And I will visit them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land in faithfulness, and with all my heart, and with all my soul.

fresh_translation: Because thus said the Lord: As I brought upon this people all these great evils, so I will bring upon them all the good things which I spoke upon them.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord; As I have brought upon this people all these great evils, so will I bring upon them all the good things which I pronounced upon them.

fresh_translation: And fields will still be bought in the land which you say is trackless waste, without men and cattle, and they were handed into the hands of the Chaldeans.
brenton_translation: And there shall yet be fields bought in the land, of which thou sayest, It shall be destitute of man and beast; and they are delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans.

fresh_translation: And they will buy fields with silver and write a scroll and seal it and bring witnesses in the land of Benjamin and around Jerusalem and in the cities of Judah and in the cities of the hill country and in the cities of the lowland and in the cities of Negeb, because I will restore their exiles.
brenton_translation: And they shall buy fields for money, and thou shalt write a book, and seal it, and shalt take the testimony of witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and round about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Juda, and in the cities of the mountain, and in the cities of the plain, and in the cities of the south: for I will turn their captivity.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah a second time, while he was still bound in the court of the prison, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremias the second time, when he was yet bound in the court of the prison, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord, who makes earth and forms it to set it upright; the Lord is his name:
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, who made the earth and formed it, to establish it; the Lord is his name;

fresh_translation: Cry to me, and I will answer you and announce to you great and mighty things which you did not know.
brenton_translation: Cry to me, and I will answer thee, and I will declare to thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

fresh_translation: Because thus said the Lord God of Israel concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the king of Judah, which were torn down into trenches and defenses,
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the king of Juda, which have been pulled down for mounds and fortifications,

fresh_translation: to fight against the Chaldeans and to fill it with dead men whom I struck in my anger and wrath, and I turned away my face from them because of all their evils.
brenton_translation: to fight against the Chaldeans, and to fill it with the corpses of men, whom I smote in mine anger and my wrath, and turned away my face from them, for all their wickedness:

fresh_translation: Behold, I bring up healing and remedy for her, and I will reveal to them a hearing; and I will heal her and make peace and faithfulness for them.
brenton_translation: Behold, I bring upon her healing and cure, and I will show myself to them, and will heal her, and make both peace and security.

fresh_translation: And I will restore the exile of Judah and the exile of Israel and build them as before.
brenton_translation: And I will turn the captivity of Juda, and the captivity of Israel, and will build them, even as before.

fresh_translation: And I will cleanse them from all their injustices with which they sinned against me, and I will no longer remember the sins with which they sinned against me and departed from me.
brenton_translation: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned against me, and will not remember their sins, whereby they have sinned against me, and revolted from me.

fresh_translation: And it will be for joy and for praise and for greatness to every people of the earth who hear all the good things which I will do. And they will fear and be embittered concerning all the good things and concerning all the peace which I will make for them.
brenton_translation: And it shall be for joy and praise, and for glory to all the people of the earth, who shall hear all the good that I will do: and they shall fear and be provoked for all the good things and for all the peace which I will bring upon them.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: Still it will be heard in this place, which you say is desolate from men and cattle, in the cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, laid waste because there is no man and no cattle,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; There shall yet be heard in this place, of which ye say, It is destitute of men and cattle, in the cities of Juda, and in the streets of Jerusalem, the places that have been made desolate for want of men and cattle,

fresh_translation: The voice of gladness and the voice of joy, the voice of bridegroom and the voice of bride, the voice of those saying, Give thanks to the Lord Almighty, because the Lord is good, because his mercy is forever. And they will bring gifts into the house of the Lord, because I will restore all exile of that land as before, said the Lord.
brenton_translation: the voice of gladness, and the voice of joy, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of men saying, Give thanks to the Lord Almighty: for the Lord is good; for his mercy endures for ever: and they shall bring gifts into the house of the Lord; for I will turn all the captivity of that land as before, said the Lord.

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord of hosts: There will still be in this place, this desolate one because there is no man and cattle, and in all its cities, dwellings of shepherds laying sheep down.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; There shall yet be in this place, that is desert for want of man and beast, in all the cities thereof, resting-places for shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

fresh_translation: In the cities of the hill country and in the cities of the lowland and in the cities of Negeb and in the land of Benjamin and around Jerusalem and in the cities of Judah, sheep will still pass under the hand of one counting, said the Lord.
brenton_translation: In the cities of the hill country, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the cities round about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Juda, flocks shall yet pass under the hand of him that numbers them, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: [Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.]
[In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.]
[In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.]
[For thus says the LORD; David shall never lack a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;]
[Neither shall the priests the Levites lack a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle food offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.]
[And the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, saying,]
[Thus says the LORD; If all of you can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;]
[Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.]
[As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.]
[Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,]

[Consider you not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD has chosen, he has even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.]
[Thus says the LORD; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;]

[Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.]

The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his camp and all the land under his rule were fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah, saying,
brenton_translation: The word that came to Jeremias from the Lord (now Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the country of his dominion, were warring against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Juda,) saying,

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and say to him, Thus said the Lord: This city, in being handed over, will be handed into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will seize it and burn it with fire.
brenton_translation: Thus has the Lord said; Go to Sedekias king of Juda, and thou shalt say to him, Thus has the Lord said, This city shall certainly be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it, and shall burn it with fire:

fresh_translation: And you will certainly not be saved from his hand, because in being seized you will be seized and into his hands you will be given; your eyes will see his eyes, and his mouth will speak with your mouth, and you will enter Babylon.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt certainly be taken, and shalt be given into his hands; and thine eyes shall see his eyes, and thou shalt enter into Babylon.

fresh_translation: But hear the word of the Lord, Zedekiah king of Judah. Thus says the Lord:
brenton_translation: But hear the word of the Lord, O Sedekias king of Juda; Thus saith the Lord,

fresh_translation: In peace you will die, and as they lamented your fathers, the kings who ruled before you, they will lament you also, and saying, Ah, lord, they will beat themselves for you, because I have spoken a word, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt die in peace: and as they wept for thy fathers that reigned before thee, they shall weep also for thee, saying, Ah lord! and they shall lament for thee down to the grave: for I have spoken the word, said the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Jeremiah spoke all these words to King Zedekiah in Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And Jeremias spoke to king Sedekias all these words in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And the force of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and against the cities of Judah, against Lachish and against Azekah, because these fortified cities were left among the cities of Judah.
brenton_translation: And the host of the king of Babylon warred against Jerusalem, and against the cities of Juda, and against Lachis, and against Azeca: for these strong cities were left among the cities of Juda.

fresh_translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord after King Zedekiah completed a covenant with the people to proclaim release,
brenton_translation: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremias, after king Sedekias had concluded a covenant with the people, to proclaim a release;

fresh_translation: to send out each one his male servant and each one his female servant, the Hebrew man and the Hebrew woman, free, so that no man from Judah would be enslaved.
brenton_translation: that every one should set at liberty his servant, and every one his handmaid, the Hebrew man and Hebrew woman, that no man of Juda should be a bondman.

fresh_translation: And all the nobles and all the people who entered the covenant to send out each one his male servant and each one his female servant turned back,
brenton_translation: Then all the nobles, and all the people who had entered into the covenant, engaging to set free every one his man-servant, and every one his maid, turned,

fresh_translation: and they forced them into male servants and female servants.
brenton_translation: and gave them over to be men-servants and maid-servants.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremias, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus said the Lord God of Israel: I made a covenant with your fathers on the day when I brought them out from the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day wherein I took them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying,

fresh_translation: When six years are fulfilled, you shall send out your Hebrew brother who is sold to you, and he shall work for you six years, and you shall send him out free. But they did not hear me and did not incline their ear.
brenton_translation: When six years are accomplished, thou shalt set free thy brother the Hebrew, who shall be sold to thee: for he shall serve thee six years, and then thou shalt let him go free: but they hearkened not to me, and inclined not their ear.

fresh_translation: And today you turned to do what is right before my eyes, to proclaim release each to his neighbor, and you completed a covenant before my face in the house on which my name has been called.
brenton_translation: And this day they turned to do that which was right in my sight, to proclaim every one the release of his neighbour; and they had concluded a covenant before me, in the house whereon my name is called.

fresh_translation: And you turned back and profaned my name by bringing back each one his male servant and each one his female servant whom you had sent out free according to their own desire, to be for you male servants and female servants.
brenton_translation: But ye turned and profaned my name, to bring back every one his servant, and every one his handmaid, whom ye had sent forth free and at their own disposal, to be to you men-servants and maid-servants.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus said the Lord: You did not hear me to proclaim release, each to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim release to you, to sword and to death and to famine, and I will give you for dispersion to all kingdoms of the earth.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus said the Lord; Ye have not hearkened to me, to proclaim a release every one to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a release to you, to the sword, and to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will give you up to dispersion among all the kingdoms of the earth.

fresh_translation: And I will give the men who passed over my covenant, those who did not uphold my covenant which they made before my face, the calf which they prepared to perform it with,
brenton_translation: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, who have not kept my covenant, which they made before me, the calf which they prepared to sacrifice with it,

fresh_translation: namely the rulers of Judah and the mighty men and the priests and the people,
brenton_translation: the princes of Juda, and the men in power, and the priests, and the people;

fresh_translation: and I will give them to their enemies, and their dead bodies will be food for the birds of heaven and for the beasts of the earth.
brenton_translation: I will even give them to their enemies, and their carcases shall be food for the birds of the sky and for the wild beasts of the earth.

fresh_translation: And Zedekiah king of Judah and their rulers I will give into the hands of their enemies, and the force of the king of Babylon will come upon those fleeing from them.
brenton_translation: And I will give Sedekias king of Judea, and their princes, into the hands of their enemies, and the host of the king of Babylon shall come upon them that run away from them.

fresh_translation: Behold, I command, says the Lord, and I will return them to this land. They will fight against it and take it and burn it with fire, and the cities of Judah I will give as desolate, without dwellers.
brenton_translation: Behold, I will give command, saith the Lord, and will bring them back to this land; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire, and the cities of Juda; and I will make them desolate without inhabitants.

fresh_translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim king of Judah, saying,
brenton_translation: The Word that came to Jeremias from the Lord in the days of Joakim, king of Juda, saying,

fresh_translation: Go to the house of the Rechabites and bring them into the house of the Lord, into one of the courts, and give them wine to drink.
brenton_translation: Go to the house of the Archabin, and thou shalt bring them to the house of the Lord, into one of the courts, and give them wine to drink.

fresh_translation: And I brought out Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah son of Habaziniah and his brothers and his sons and all the house of the Rechabites,
brenton_translation: So I brought forth Jechonias the son of Jeremin the son of Chabasin, and his brethren, and his sons, and all the family of the Archabin;

fresh_translation: and I brought them into the house of the Lord, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan son of Gedaliah, a man of God, which is near the house of the rulers, above the house of Maaseiah son of Shallum, keeper of the court.
brenton_translation: and I brought them into the house of the Lord, into the chamber of the sons of Joanan, the son of Ananias, the son of Godolias, a man of God, who dwells near the house of the princes that are over the house of Maasæas the son of Selom, who kept the court.

fresh_translation: And I set before them a jar of wine and cups and said, Drink wine.
brenton_translation: And I set before them a jar of wine, and cups, and I said, Drink ye wine.

fresh_translation: And they said, We will certainly not drink wine, because Jonadab son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, You and your sons shall certainly not drink wine forever.
brenton_translation: But they said, We will on no account drink wine, for our father Jonadab the son of Rechab commanded us, saying, Ye shall on no account drink wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:

fresh_translation: And you shall not build a house, and you shall not sow seed, and no vineyard shall be yours, because you shall dwell in tents all your days, so that you may live many days upon the land on which you sojourn.
brenton_translation: nor shall ye at all build houses, nor sow any seed, nor shall ye have a vineyard: for ye shall dwell in tents all your days; that ye may live many days upon the land, in which ye sojourn.

fresh_translation: And we listened to the voice of Jonadab our father, so as not to drink wine all our days, we and our wives and our sons and our daughters,
brenton_translation: And we hearkened to the voice of Jonadab our father, so as to drink no wine all our days, we, and our wives, and our sons, and our daughters;

fresh_translation: and so as not to build houses to dwell in, and there has not come to be for us vineyard or field or seed.
brenton_translation: and so as to build no houses to dwell in: and we have had no vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

fresh_translation: And we dwelt in tents and listened and did according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
brenton_translation: but we have dwelt in tents, and have hearkened, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

fresh_translation: And it happened when Nebuchadnezzar came up against the land, we said, Come, and let us enter Jerusalem from before the force of the Chaldeans and from before the force of the Assyrians, and we dwelt there.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when Nabuchodonosor came up against the land, that we said we would come in; and we entered into Jerusalem, for fear of the host of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the host of the Assyrians: and we dwelt there.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Go and say to the men of Judah and to those dwelling in Jerusalem, Will you not receive discipline, to listen to my words?
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Go, and say to the men of Juda, and to them that dwell in Jerusalem, Will ye not receive correction to hearken to my words?

fresh_translation: The sons of Jonadab son of Rechab upheld the word which he commanded his children, not to drink wine, and they did not drink. But I spoke to you, rising early and speaking, and you did not hear.
brenton_translation: The sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have kept the word which he commanded his children, that they should drink no wine; and they have not drunk it: but I spoke to you early, and ye hearkened not.

fresh_translation: And I sent to you my servants the prophets, saying, Let each one turn back from his evil way and amend your practices, and do not go after other gods to serve them, and you will dwell upon the land which I gave to you and to your fathers. But you did not incline your ears and did not hear.
brenton_translation: And I sent to you my servants the prophets, saying, Turn ye every one from his evil way, and amend your practices, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell upon the land which I gave to you and to your fathers: but ye inclined not your ears, and hearkened not.

fresh_translation: And the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab kept the command of their father, but this people did not hear me.
brenton_translation: But the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have kept the command of their father; but this people has not hearkened to me.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus said the Lord: Behold, I bring upon Judah and upon those dwelling in Jerusalem all the evils which I spoke against them.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will bring upon Juda and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evils which I pronounced against them.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus said the Lord: Because the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab listened to the command of their father, doing just as their father commanded them,
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Since the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have hearkened to the command of their father, to do as their father commanded them:

fresh_translation: a man from the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab will certainly not fail to stand before my face all the days of the earth.
brenton_translation: there shall never be wanting a man of the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab to stand before my face while the earth remains.

fresh_translation: And in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: In the fourth Year of Joakim son of Josias king of Juda, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Take for yourself a scroll-sheet and write on it all the words which I declared to you concerning Jerusalem and Judah and all the nations, from the day when I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah king of Judah, even until this day.
brenton_translation: Take thee a roll of a book, and write upon it all the words which I spoke to thee against Jerusalem, and against Juda, and against all the nations, from the day when I spoke to thee, from the days of Josias king of Juda, even to this day.

fresh_translation: Perhaps the house of Judah will hear all the evils which I plan to do to them, so that they may turn back from their evil way, and I will be merciful concerning their injustices and their sins.
brenton_translation: Perhaps the house of Juda will hear all the evils which I purpose to do to them; that they may turn from their evil way; and so I will be merciful to their iniquities and their sins.

fresh_translation: And Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord which he had declared to him, into a scroll-sheet.
brenton_translation: So Jeremias called Baruch the son of Nerias: and he wrote from the mouth of Jeremias all the words of the Lord, which he had spoken to him, on a roll of a book.

fresh_translation: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am kept under guard. I cannot enter the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Jeremias commanded Baruch, saying, I am in prison; I cannot enter into the house of the Lord:

fresh_translation: And you will read from this sheet into the ears of the people in the house of the Lord on the day of fasting, and in the ears of all Judah coming from their cities you will read to them.
brenton_translation: so thou shalt read in this roll in the ears of the people in the house of the Lord, on the fast day; and in the ears of all Juda that come out of their cities, thou shalt read to them.

fresh_translation: Perhaps their plea for mercy will fall before the face of the Lord, and they will turn back from their evil way, because great is the anger and the wrath of the Lord which he spoke against this people.
brenton_translation: Peradventure their supplication will come before the Lord, and they will turn from their evil way: for great is the wrath and the anger of the Lord, which he has pronounced against this people.

fresh_translation: And Baruch did according to all that Jeremiah commanded him, to read in the scroll the words of the Lord in the house of the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Baruch did according to all that Jeremias commanded him—reading in the book the words of the Lord in the Lord's house.

fresh_translation: And it happened in the eighth year of King Jehoiakim, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and the house of Judah proclaimed fast before the Lord.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the eighth year of king Joakim, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem, and the house of Juda, proclaimed a fast before the Lord.

fresh_translation: And Baruch read in the scroll the words of Jeremiah in the house of the Lord, in the house of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court, in the entrance of the new gate of the house of the Lord, in the ears of all the people.
brenton_translation: And Baruch read in the book the words of Jeremias in the house of the Lord, in the house of Gamarias son of Saphan the scribe, in the upper court, in the entrance of the new gate of the house of the Lord, and in the ears of all the people.

fresh_translation: And Micaiah son of Gemariah son of Shaphan heard all the words of the Lord from the scroll,
brenton_translation: And Michæas the son of Gamarias the son of Saphan heard all the words of the Lord, out of the book.

fresh_translation: and he went down to the house of the king, to the house of the scribe, and behold, all the rulers were sitting there: Elishama the scribe and Delaiah son of Shelemiah and Elnathan son of Achbor and Gemariah son of Shaphan and Zedekiah son of Hananiah and all the rulers.
brenton_translation: And he went down to the king's house, into the house of the scribe: and, behold, there were sitting there all the princes, Elisama the scribe, and Dalæas the son of Selemias, and Jonathan the son of Acchobor, and Gamarias the son of Saphan, and Sedekias the son of Ananias, and all the princes.

fresh_translation: And Micaiah announced to them all the words which he heard while Baruch read into the ears of the people.
brenton_translation: And Michæas reported to them all the words which he had heard Baruch reading in the ears of the people.

fresh_translation: And all the rulers sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah son of Shelemiah son of Chusi to Baruch son of Neriah, saying, The sheet in which you are reading in the ears of the people, take it in your hand and come. And Baruch took the sheet and went down to them.
brenton_translation: And all the princes sent to Baruch son of Nerias Judin the son of Nathanias, the son of Selemias, the son of Chusi, saying, Take in thine hand the roll in which thou readest in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch took the roll, and went down to them.

fresh_translation: And they said to him, Read it again into our ears. And Baruch read.
brenton_translation: And they said to him, Read it again in our ears. And Baruch read it.

fresh_translation: And it happened when they heard all the words, each took counsel with his neighbor and said, We must surely announce to the king all these words.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, that they took counsel each with his neighbour, and said, Let us by all means tell the king all these words.

fresh_translation: And they asked Baruch, saying, From where did you write all these words?
brenton_translation: And they asked Baruch, saying, Where didst thou write all these words?

fresh_translation: And Baruch said, Jeremiah announced all these words to me from his mouth, and I wrote them in a scroll.
brenton_translation: And Baruch said, Jeremias told me from his own mouth all these words, and I wrote them in a book.

fresh_translation: And they said to Baruch, Go hide, you and Jeremiah. Let no man know where you are.
brenton_translation: And they said to Baruch, Go, and hide, thou and Jeremias; let no man know where ye are.

fresh_translation: And they entered to the king, into the court, and they gave the sheet for safekeeping in the house of Elishama, and they announced to the king all the words.
brenton_translation: And they went in to the king into the court, and gave the roll to one to keep in the house of Elisama; and they told the king all these words.

fresh_translation: And the king sent Jehudi to take the scroll-sheet, and he took it from the house of Elishama and read it into the ears of the king and into the ears of all the rulers standing around the king.
