brenton_translation: Beth. In the day of his wrath the Lord has overwhelmed her as in the sea, and not spared: he has brought down in his fury all the beautiful things of Jacob; he has brought down to the ground the strong-holds of the daughter of Juda: he has profaned her king and her princes.

fresh_translation: He broke, in the anger of his wrath, every horn of Israel. He turned back his right hand from the face of the enemy, and he kindled in Jacob like a flame of fire that devoured all around.
brenton_translation: Gimel. He has broken in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he has turned back his right hand from the face of the enemy, and has kindled a flame in Jacob as fire, and it has devoured all things round about.

fresh_translation: He bent his bow like an enemy; he fixed his right hand like an adversary and killed all the desirable things of my eyes. In the tent of daughter Zion he poured out his wrath like fire.
brenton_translation: Daleth. He has bent his bow as an opposing enemy: he has strengthened his right hand as an adversary, and has destroyed all the desirable things of my eyes in the tabernacle of the daughter of Sion: he has poured forth his anger as fire.

fresh_translation: The Lord became like an enemy. He submerged Israel. He submerged all her palaces. He destroyed his strongholds and multiplied humiliation and humbling for daughter Judah.
brenton_translation: He. The Lord is become as an enemy: he has overwhelmed Israel as in the sea, he has overwhelmed her palaces: he has destroyed his strong-holds, and has multiplied the afflicted and humbled ones to the daughter of Juda.

fresh_translation: He scattered his tent like a vine. He destroyed his feast. The Lord forgot feast and sabbath which he made in Zion, and in the outburst of his anger he provoked king and priest and ruler.
brenton_translation: Vau. And he has scattered his tabernacle as a vine, he has marred his feast: the Lord has forgotten the feast and the sabbath which he appointed in Sion, and in the fury of his wrath has vexed the king, and priest, and prince.

fresh_translation: The Lord cast off his altar, shook off his sanctuary, and broke the wall of her palaces by the hand of the enemy. They gave voice in the house of the Lord as on a feast day.
brenton_translation: Zain. The Lord has rejected his altar, he has cast off his sanctuary, he has broken by the hand of the enemy the wall of her palaces; they have uttered their voice in the house of the Lord as on a feast day.

fresh_translation: And the Lord turned to destroy the wall of daughter Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not turn back his hand from trampling. Rampart and wall mourned together; they weakened as one.
brenton_translation: Heth. And he has turned to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he has stretched out the measuring line, he has not turned back his hand from afflicting her: therefore the bulwark mourned, and the wall was weakened with it.

fresh_translation: Her gates sank into the ground. He destroyed and broke her bars. Her king and her rulers are among the nations. There is no law, and even her prophets did not see a vision from the Lord.
brenton_translation: Teth. Her gates are sunk into the ground: he has destroyed and broken to pieces her bars, and her king and her prince among the Gentiles: there is no law, nay, her prophets have seen no vision from the Lord.

fresh_translation: The elders of daughter Zion sat on the ground and kept silent. They raised dust on their heads and girded themselves with sackcloth. The chief virgins in Jerusalem brought themselves down to the ground.
brenton_translation: Jod. The elders of the daughter of Sion have sat upon the ground, they have kept silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloths: they have brought down to the ground the chief virgins in Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: My eyes failed with tears. My heart was troubled. My glory poured out on the earth over the crushing of the daughter of my people, when infant and suckling failed in the streets of the city.
brenton_translation: Chaph. Mine eyes have failed with tears, my heart is troubled, my glory is cast down to the ground, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; while the infant and suckling swoon in the streets of the city.

fresh_translation: To their mothers they said, Where are grain and wine? as they failed like wounded ones in the streets of the city, as their souls poured out into the bosom of their mothers.
brenton_translation: Lamed. They said to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? while they fainted like wounded men in the streets of the city, while their souls were poured out into their mother's bosom.

fresh_translation: What shall I testify to you, or what shall I compare to you, daughter Jerusalem? Who will save and comfort you, virgin daughter Zion? For the cup of your crushing became great; who will heal you?
brenton_translation: Mem. What shall I testify to thee, or what shall I compare to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? who shall save and comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Sion? for the cup of thy destruction is enlarged: who shall heal thee?

fresh_translation: Your prophets saw for you vain and foolish things, and they did not uncover your injustice to turn back your captivity, but they saw for you vain burdens and expulsions.
brenton_translation: Nun. Thy prophets have seen for thee vanities and folly: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn back thy captivity; but they have seen for thee vain burdens, and worthless visions.

fresh_translation: All who pass along the road clapped hands over you. They hissed and shook their heads over daughter Jerusalem: Is this the city they called the crown of glory, joy of all the earth?
brenton_translation: Samech. All that go by the way have clapped their hands at thee; they have hissed and shaken their head at the daughter of Jerusalem. Is this the city, they say, the crown of joy of all the earth?

fresh_translation: All your enemies opened their mouth over you. They hissed and gnashed teeth. They said, We swallowed her up. Yet this is the day we expected; we found it; we saw it.
brenton_translation: Ain. All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they have hissed and gnashed their teeth, and said, We have swallowed her up: moreover this is the day which we looked for; we have found it, we have seen it.

fresh_translation: The Lord did what he intended. He fulfilled his words which he commanded from ancient days. He pulled down and did not spare. He made the enemy rejoice over you. He raised the horn of the one afflicting you.
brenton_translation: Phe. The Lord has done that which he purposed; he has accomplished his word, even the things which he commanded from the ancient days: he has thrown down, and has not spared: and he has caused the enemy to rejoice over thee, he has exalted the horn of him that afflicted thee.

fresh_translation: Their heart cried to the Lord. Walls of Zion, bring down tears like torrents day and night. Give yourself no relief. Let your eye not be silent.
brenton_translation: Tsade. Their heart cried to the Lord, Ye walls of Sion, pour down tears like torrents day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eyes cease.

fresh_translation: Rise, cry out in the night, at the beginnings of your watch. Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift your hands to him for the life of your little ones, those failing from famine at the head of every street.
brenton_translation: Koph. Arise, rejoice in the night at the beginning of thy watch: pour out thy heart as water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands to him for the life of thine infants, who faint for hunger at the top of all the streets.

fresh_translation: See, Lord, and look: against whom have you gleaned thus? Will women eat the fruit of their womb? The cook made a gleaning. Will nursing infants be killed? Will you kill priest and prophet in the sanctuary of the Lord?
brenton_translation: Rhechs. Behold, O Lord, and see for whom thou hast gathered thus. Shall the women eat the fruit of their womb? the cook has made a gathering: shall the infants sucking at the breasts be slain? wilt thou slay the priest and prophet in the sanctuary of the Lord?

fresh_translation: Young boy and elder lay down in the street. My virgins and my young men went into captivity. By sword and famine you killed. In the day of your anger you butchered; you did not spare.
brenton_translation: Chsen. The child and old man have lain down in the street: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity: thou hast slain them with the sword and with famine; in the day of thy wrath thou hast mangled them, thou hast not spared.

fresh_translation: You called my sojourners around as on a feast day, and in the day of the Lord's anger there was no one saved and left, though I had strengthened and multiplied all my enemies.
brenton_translation: Thau. He has called my sojourners round about to a solemn day, and there was not in the day of the wrath of the Lord any one that escaped or was left; whereas I have strengthened and multiplied all mine enemies.

fresh_translation: I am the man seeing poverty by the rod of his wrath upon me.
brenton_translation: Aleph. I am the man that sees poverty, through the rod of his wrath upon me.

fresh_translation: He took me and led me into darkness, and not light.
brenton_translation: He has taken me, and led me away into darkness, and not into light.

fresh_translation: Only against me he turned his hand all day.
brenton_translation: Nay, against me has he turned his hand all the day.

fresh_translation: He made my flesh and my skin old; he shattered my bones.
brenton_translation: He has made old my flesh and my skin; he has broken my bones.

fresh_translation: He built against me and surrounded my head, and he brought toil upon me.
brenton_translation: Beth. He has built against me, and compassed my head, and brought travail upon me.

fresh_translation: In dark places he seated me like the dead of long ago.
brenton_translation: He has set me in dark places, as them that have long been dead.

fresh_translation: He built against me, and I will not go out. He made my bronze chain heavy.
brenton_translation: He has builded against me, and I cannot come forth: he has made my brazen chain heavy.

fresh_translation: Even when I cry out and shout, he fenced off my prayer.
brenton_translation: Gimel. Yea, though I cry and shout, he shuts out my prayer.

fresh_translation: He built up my ways, blocked my paths, and troubled me.
brenton_translation: Daleth. He has built up my ways, he has hedged my paths;

fresh_translation: He was a bear lying in wait for me, a lion in hidden places.
brenton_translation: he has troubled me, as a she-bear lying in wait: he is to me as a lion in secret places.

fresh_translation: He pursued me when I had turned aside and stopped me; he made me desolate.
brenton_translation: He pursued me after I departed, and brought me to a stand: he has utterly ruined me.

fresh_translation: He bent his bow and set me as a target for an arrow.
brenton_translation: He. He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

fresh_translation: He brought into my kidneys the arrows of his quiver.
brenton_translation: He has caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

fresh_translation: I became a laughingstock to all my people, their song all day.
brenton_translation: I became a laughing-stock to all my people; and their song all the day.

fresh_translation: He filled me with bitterness; he made me drunk with gall.
brenton_translation: Vau. He has filled me with bitterness, he has drenched me with gall.

fresh_translation: And he dashed out my teeth with gravel. He fed me ashes.
brenton_translation: And he has dashed out my teeth with gravel, he has fed me with ashes.

fresh_translation: And he thrust my soul away from peace; I forgot good things.
brenton_translation: He has also removed my soul from peace: I forgot prosperity.

fresh_translation: And I said, My victory and my hope from the Lord have perished.
brenton_translation: Therefore my success has perished, and my hope from the Lord.

fresh_translation: I remembered, because of my poverty and because of my persecution, my bitterness and my gall.
brenton_translation: Zain. I remembered by reason of my poverty, and because of persecution my bitterness and gall shall be remembered;

fresh_translation: My soul will remember and meditate within me.
brenton_translation: and my soul shall meditate with me.

fresh_translation: This I will set in my heart; therefore I endure.
brenton_translation: This will I lay up in my heart, therefore will I endure.

fresh_translation: The Lord is good to those waiting for him, good to the soul that seeks him.
brenton_translation: Teth. The Lord is good to them that wait for him: the soul which shall seek him

fresh_translation: And one waits and keeps quiet for the salvation of the Lord.
brenton_translation: is good, and shall wait for, and quietly expect salvation of the Lord.

fresh_translation: It is good for a man when he bears a yoke in his youth.
brenton_translation: Teth. It is good for a man when he bears a yoke in his youth.

fresh_translation: He will sit alone and be silent, because he took it upon himself.
brenton_translation: He will sit alone, and be silent, because he has borne it upon him.

fresh_translation: He will give his cheek to one striking him. He will be filled with reproaches.
brenton_translation: Jod. He will give his cheek to him that smites him: he will be filled full with reproaches.

fresh_translation: Because the Lord will not cast off forever.
brenton_translation: For the Lord will not reject for ever.

fresh_translation: Because the one who humbled will have compassion according to the multitude of his mercy.
brenton_translation: Chaph. For he that has brought down will pity, and that according to the abundance of his mercy.

fresh_translation: Because he did not answer from his heart when he humbled sons of man.
brenton_translation: He has not answered in anger from his heart, though he has brought low the children of a man.

fresh_translation: To humble under his feet all prisoners of the earth,
brenton_translation: Lamed. To bring down under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

fresh_translation: to turn aside the judgment of a man before the face of the Most High,
brenton_translation: to turn aside the judgment of a man before the face of the Most High,

fresh_translation: to condemn a man in his judging, the Lord did not say.
brenton_translation: to condemn a man unjustly in his judgment, the Lord has not given commandment.

fresh_translation: Who thus spoke and it happened, if the Lord did not command?
brenton_translation: Who has thus spoken, and it has come to pass? the Lord has not commanded it.

fresh_translation: Will not evils and good come out from the mouth of the Most High?
brenton_translation: Out of the mouth of the Most High there shall not come forth evil and good.

fresh_translation: Why will a living man complain, a man about his sin?
brenton_translation: Mem. Why should a living man complain, a man concerning his sin?

fresh_translation: Our way was searched out and examined; let us turn back to the Lord.
brenton_translation: Nun. Our way has been searched out and examined, and we will turn to the Lord.

fresh_translation: Let us lift our hearts with our hands to the Most High in heaven.
brenton_translation: Let us lift up our hearts with our hands to the lofty One in heaven.

fresh_translation: We sinned; we acted ungodly, and you were not propitiated.
brenton_translation: We have sinned, we have transgressed; and thou hast not pardoned.

fresh_translation: You covered us in wrath and drove us away. You killed; you did not spare.
brenton_translation: Samech. Thou hast visited us in wrath, and driven us away: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

fresh_translation: You covered yourself with a cloud because of prayer.
brenton_translation: Thou hast veiled thyself with a cloud because of prayer, that I might be blind,

fresh_translation: To close my eyes and be thrust away, you placed us in the midst of the peoples.
brenton_translation: and be cast off. Ain. Thou hast set us alone in the midst of the nations.

fresh_translation: All our enemies opened their mouth against us.
brenton_translation: All our enemies have opened their mouth against us.

fresh_translation: Fear and anger came upon us, upheaval and crushing.
brenton_translation: Fear and wrath are come upon us, suspense and destruction.

fresh_translation: My eye will bring down streams of waters over the crushing of the daughter of my people.
brenton_translation: Mine eye shall pour down torrents of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

fresh_translation: My eye was consumed, and I will not be silent, so that there be no relief,
brenton_translation: Phe. Mine eye is drowned with tears, and I will not be silent, so that there shall be no rest,

fresh_translation: until the Lord looks down and sees from heaven.
brenton_translation: until the Lord look down, and behold from heaven.

fresh_translation: My eye preys upon my soul because of all the daughters of the city.
brenton_translation: Mine eye shall prey upon my soul, because of all the daughters of the city.

fresh_translation: Hunting, they hunted me like a sparrow, my enemies without cause.
brenton_translation: Tsade. The fowlers chased me as a sparrow, all mine enemies destroyed my life in a pit without cause,

fresh_translation: They killed my life in a pit and put a stone upon me.
brenton_translation: and laid a stone upon me.

fresh_translation: Water overflowed over my head. I said, I am thrust away.
brenton_translation: Water flowed over my head: I said, I am cut off.

fresh_translation: I called on your name, Lord, from the lowest pit.
brenton_translation: Koph. I called upon thy name, O Lord, out of the lowest dungeon.

fresh_translation: You heard my voice. Do not hide your ears from my petition.
brenton_translation: Thou heardest my voice: close not thine ears to my supplication.

fresh_translation: You came near for my help on the day when I called you. You said to me, Do not fear.
brenton_translation: Thou drewest nigh to my help: in the day wherein I called upon thee thou saidst to me, Fear not.

fresh_translation: You pleaded, Lord, the cases of my soul. You redeemed my life.
brenton_translation: Rechs. O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

fresh_translation: You saw, Lord, my troubles. You judged my case.
brenton_translation: Thou hast seen, O Lord, my troubles: thou hast judged my cause.

fresh_translation: You saw all their vengeance, all their reasonings against me.
brenton_translation: Thou hast seen all their vengeance, thou hast looked on all their devices against me.

fresh_translation: You heard their reproach, all their reasonings against me.
brenton_translation: Chsen. Thou hast heard their reproach and all their devices against me;

fresh_translation: The lips of those rising against me and their meditations are against me all day.
brenton_translation: the lips of them that rose up against me, and their plots against me all the day;

fresh_translation: Their sitting and their rising, look upon their eyes.
brenton_translation: their sitting down and their rising up: look thou upon their eyes.

fresh_translation: You will repay them recompense, Lord, according to the works of their hands.
brenton_translation: Thou wilt render them a recompence, O Lord, according to the works of their hands.

fresh_translation: You will give them a shield of heart, your toil to them.
brenton_translation: Thau. Thou wilt give them as a covering, the grief of my heart.

fresh_translation: You will pursue them in anger and consume them from under heaven, Lord.
brenton_translation: Thou wilt persecute them in anger, and wilt consume them from under the heaven, O Lord.

fresh_translation: How gold was dimmed; good silver changed. Holy stones were poured out at the head of every street.
brenton_translation: Aleph. How will the gold be tarnished, and the fine silver changed! the sacred stones have been poured forth at the top of all the streets.

fresh_translation: The sons of Zion, the precious ones raised up in gold, how they were reckoned as earthen vessels, works of a potter's hands.
brenton_translation: Beth. The precious sons of Zion, who were equalled in value with gold, how are they counted as earthen vessels, the works of the hands of the potter!

fresh_translation: Even dragons drew out breasts and suckled their cubs. The daughters of my people became incurable like a sparrow in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: Gimel. Nay, serpents have drawn out the breasts, they give suck to their young, the daughters of my people are incurably cruel, as an ostrich in a desert.

fresh_translation: The tongue of a nursing child clung to his throat from thirst. Little ones asked for bread. There is no one breaking it for them.
brenton_translation: Daleth. The tongue of the sucking child cleaves to the roof of its mouth for thirst: the little children ask for bread, and there is none to break it to them.

fresh_translation: Those eating delicacies were made desolate in the streets. Those nourished on scarlet embraced dung-heaps.
brenton_translation: He. They that feed on dainties are desolate in the streets: they that used to be nursed in scarlet have clothed themselves with dung.

fresh_translation: And the lawlessness of the daughter of my people grew beyond the lawlessness of Sodom, the overthrown one, as if suddenly, and no hands labored in her.
brenton_translation: Vau. And the iniquity of the daughter of my people has been increased beyond the iniquities of Sodoma, the city that was overthrown very suddenly, and none laboured against her with their hands.

fresh_translation: Her Nazirites were purer than snow, brighter than milk; their appearance was redder than sapphire stones.
brenton_translation: Zain. Her Nazarites were made purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were purified as with fire, their polishing was superior to sapphire stone.

fresh_translation: Their appearance darkened more than soot. They were not recognized in the streets. Their skin stuck to their bones; they dried up and became like wood.
brenton_translation: Heth. Their countenance is become blacker than smoke; they are not known in the streets: their skin has cleaved to their bones; they are withered, they are become as a stick.

fresh_translation: Better were those wounded by the sword than those wounded by famine. They went pierced from lack of the produce of fields.
brenton_translation: Teth. The slain with the sword were better than they that were slain with hunger: they have departed, pierced through from want of the fruits of the field.

fresh_translation: The hands of compassionate women cooked their children. They became food for them in the crushing of the daughter of my people.
brenton_translation: Jod. The hands of tender-hearted women have sodden their own children: they became meat for them in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

fresh_translation: The Lord completed his wrath, poured out the anger of his wrath, and kindled a fire in Zion, and it devoured her foundations.
brenton_translation: Chaph. The Lord has accomplished his wrath; he has poured out his fierce anger, and has kindled a fire in Sion, and it has devoured her foundations.

fresh_translation: The kings of the earth did not believe, all dwellers of the world, that an enemy and oppressor would enter through the gates of Jerusalem,
brenton_translation: Lamed. The kings of the earth, even all that dwell in the world, believed not that an enemy and oppressor would enter through the gates of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: because of the sins of her prophets, the injustices of her priests, those pouring out righteous blood in her midst.
brenton_translation: Mem. For the sins of her prophets, and iniquities of her priests, who shed righteous blood in the midst of her,

fresh_translation: Her watchmen staggered in the streets; they were polluted with blood. In their inability, they touched their garments.
brenton_translation: Nun. her watchmen staggered in the streets, they were defiled with blood in their weakness, they touched their raiment with it.

fresh_translation: Depart from the unclean ones; call to them, Depart, depart, do not touch, because they were kindled. And indeed they staggered. They said among the nations, They will no longer sojourn.
brenton_translation: Samech. Depart ye from the unclean ones: call ye them: depart, depart, touch them not: for they are on fire, yea, they stagger: say ye among the nations, They shall no more sojourn there.

fresh_translation: The face of the Lord is their portion. He will no longer look on them. They did not receive the faces of priests; elders they did not pity.
brenton_translation: Ain. The presence of the Lord was their portion; but he will not again look upon them: they regarded not the person of the priests, they pitied not the prophets.

fresh_translation: While we were still alive, our eyes failed for our vain help. While watching, we watched for a nation not saving.
brenton_translation: Phe. While we yet lived our eyes failed, while we looked in vain for our help. Tsade. We looked to a nation that could not save.

fresh_translation: We hunted our little ones so they would not walk in our streets. Our time drew near; our days were fulfilled; our time is present.
brenton_translation: We have hunted for our little ones, that they should not walk in our streets. Koph. Our time has drawn nigh, our days are fulfilled, our time is come.

fresh_translation: Our pursuers became swifter than eagles of heaven. On the mountains they blazed. In the wilderness they lay in wait for us.
brenton_translation: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky, they flew on the mountains, in the wilderness they laid wait for us.

fresh_translation: The breath of our face, the anointed of the Lord, was seized in their destructions, of whom we said, In his shadow we will live among the nations.
brenton_translation: Rechs. The breath of our nostrils, our anointed Lord, was taken in their destructive snares, of whom we said, In his shadow we shall live among the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: Rejoice and be glad, daughter Edom dwelling on the land. Yet the cup of the Lord will also pass to you, and you will be drunk and pour out.
brenton_translation: Chsen. Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Idumea, that dwellest in the land: yet the cup of the Lord shall pass through to thee: thou shalt be drunken, and pour forth.

fresh_translation: Your lawlessness came to an end, daughter Zion. He will no longer exile you. He visited your lawlessnesses, daughter Edom; he uncovered your ungodlinesses.
brenton_translation: Thau. O daughter of Sion, thine iniquity has come to an end; he shall no more carry thee captive: he has visited thine iniquities, O daughter of Edom; he has discovered thy sins.

fresh_translation: Remember, Lord, what happened to us. Look and see our reproach.
brenton_translation: Remember, O Lord, what has happened to us: behold, and look on our reproach.

fresh_translation: Our inheritance was turned over to strangers, our houses to foreigners.
brenton_translation: Our inheritance has been turned away to aliens, our houses to strangers:

fresh_translation: We became orphans; there is no father. Our mothers are like widows.
brenton_translation: we are become orphans, we have no father, our mothers are as widows.

fresh_translation: From our days, our wood came by exchange.
brenton_translation: We have drunk our water for money; our wood is sold to us for a burden on our neck:

fresh_translation: Upon our neck we were pursued. We labored; we did not rest.
brenton_translation: we have been persecuted, we have laboured, we have had no rest.

fresh_translation: Egypt gave a hand to Assyria for their fullness.
brenton_translation: Egypt gave the hand to us, Assur to their own satisfaction.

fresh_translation: Our fathers sinned and are not; we bore their lawless deeds.
brenton_translation: Our fathers sinned, and are not: we have borne their iniquities.

fresh_translation: Slaves ruled over us. There is no one redeeming us from their hand.
brenton_translation: Servants have ruled over us: there is none to ransom us out of their hand.

fresh_translation: With our lives we bring our bread from the face of the sword of the wilderness.
brenton_translation: We shall bring in our bread with danger of our lives, because of the sword of the wilderness.

fresh_translation: Our skin was shriveled like an oven, contracted before the storms of famine.
brenton_translation: Our skin is blackened like an oven; they are convulsed, because of the storms of famine.

fresh_translation: They humbled women in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.
brenton_translation: They humbled the women in Sion, the virgins in the cities of Juda.

fresh_translation: Rulers were hung by their hands. Elders were not honored.
brenton_translation: Princes were hanged up by their hands: the elders were not honoured.

fresh_translation: Chosen ones took up weeping, and young men weakened under wood.
brenton_translation: The chosen men lifted up the voice in weeping, and the youths fainted under the wood.

fresh_translation: Elders ceased from the gate. Chosen ones ceased from their songs.
brenton_translation: And the elders ceased from the gate, the chosen men ceased from their music.

fresh_translation: The joy of our heart ceased. Our dance turned into mourning.
brenton_translation: The joy of our heart has ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

fresh_translation: The crown of our head fell. Woe now to us, because we sinned.
brenton_translation: The crown has fallen from our head: yea, woe to us! for we have sinned.

fresh_translation: Because of this our heart became pained; because of this our eyes darkened,
brenton_translation: For this has grief come; our heart is sorrowful: for this our eyes are darkened.

fresh_translation: over Mount Zion, because it was ruined. Foxes passed through it.
brenton_translation: Over the mountain of Sion, because it is made desolate, foxes have walked therein.

fresh_translation: But you, Lord, will dwell forever; your throne is to generation and generation.
brenton_translation: But thou, O Lord, shalt dwell for ever; thy throne shall endure to generation and generation.

fresh_translation: Why will you forget us utterly and leave us for the length of days?
brenton_translation: Wherefore wilt thou utterly forget us, and abandon us a long time?

fresh_translation: Turn us back, Lord, to you, and we will return; renew our days as before,
brenton_translation: Turn us, O Lord, to thee, and we shall be turned; and renew our days as before.

fresh_translation: because in thrusting away you thrust us away. You were very angry against us.
brenton_translation: For thou hast indeed rejected us; thou hast been very wroth against us.

fresh_translation: And it happened in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth of the month, and I was in the midst of captivity by the river Chebar, and the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.
brenton_translation: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, that I was in the midst of the captivity by the river of Chobar; and the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

fresh_translation: On the fifth of the month, this was the fifth year of the captivity of King Joakim,
brenton_translation: On the fifth day of the month; this was the fifth year of the captivity of king Joakim.

fresh_translation: and the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel son of Buzi the priest in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar, and the hand of the Lord came upon me.
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to Jezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans, by the river of Chobar; and the hand of the Lord was upon me.

fresh_translation: And I saw, and behold, a lifting wind came from the north, and a great cloud was in it, and brightness around it, and flashing fire; and in its midst was like the appearance of electrum in the midst of the fire, and brightness was in it.
brenton_translation: And I looked, and, behold, a sweeping wind came from the north, and a great cloud on it, and there was brightness round about it, and gleaming fire, and in the midst of it as it were the appearance of amber in the midst of the fire, and brightness in it.

fresh_translation: And in the midst was something like the likeness of four living beings, and this was their appearance: likeness of a man upon them.
brenton_translation: And in the midst as it were the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; the likeness of a man was upon them.

fresh_translation: And there were four faces to each one and four wings to each one.
brenton_translation: And each one had four faces, and each one had four wings.

fresh_translation: And their legs were straight, and their feet were winged, with sparks like flashing bronze, and their wings were light.
brenton_translation: And their legs were straight; and their feet were winged, and there were sparks, like gleaming brass, and their wings were light.

fresh_translation: And the hand of man was beneath their wings on their four sides, and the faces of the four.
brenton_translation: And the hand of a man was under their wings on their four sides.

fresh_translation: They did not turn when walking; each went straight before its face.
brenton_translation: And the faces of them four turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

fresh_translation: And the likeness of their faces: a face of a man, and a face of a lion on the right for the four, and a face of a calf on the left for the four, and a face of an eagle for the four.
brenton_translation: And the likeness of their faces was the face of a man, and the face of a lion on the right to the four; and the face of a calf on the left to the four; and the face of an eagle to the four.

fresh_translation: And their wings were stretched upward; for the four, two were joined to one another and two covered over their bodies.
brenton_translation: And the four had their wings spread out above; each one had two joined to one another, and two covered their bodies.

fresh_translation: And each went straight before its face. Wherever the spirit was going, they went and did not turn.
brenton_translation: And each one went straight forward: wherever the spirit was going they went, and turned not back.

fresh_translation: And in the midst of the living beings was an appearance like burning coals of fire, like the sight of lamps turning among the living beings, and brightness of fire, and from the fire lightning went out.
brenton_translation: And in the midst of the living creatures there was an appearance as of burning coals of fire, as an appearance of lamps turning among the living creatures; and the brightness of fire, and out of the fire came forth lightning.

fresh_translation: And I saw, and behold, one wheel on the earth adjoining the living beings, for the four.
brenton_translation: And I looked, and, behold, the four had each one wheel on the ground near the living creatures.

fresh_translation: And the appearance of the wheels was like the appearance of Tarshish, and one likeness was in the four, and their work was as a wheel within a wheel.
brenton_translation: And the appearance of the wheels was as the appearance of beryl: and the four had one likeness: and their work was as it were a wheel in a wheel.

fresh_translation: They went upon their four sides; they did not turn while going.
brenton_translation: They went on their four sides: they turned not as they went;

fresh_translation: And indeed their backs: there was height to them, and I saw them, and their backs were full of eyes around, for the four.
brenton_translation: neither did their backs turn: and they were high: and I beheld them, and the backs of them four were full of eyes round about.

fresh_translation: And when the living beings went, the wheels adjoining them went, and when the living beings were lifted from the earth, the wheels were lifted.
brenton_translation: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures lifted themselves off the earth, the wheels were lifted off.

fresh_translation: Wherever the cloud was, there the spirit went. The living beings went, and the wheels were lifted with them, because the spirit of life was in the wheels.
brenton_translation: Wherever the cloud happened to be, there was the spirit ready to go: the wheels went and were lifted up with them; because the spirit of life was in the wheels.

fresh_translation: When they went, these went; when they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted from the earth, the wheels were lifted with them, because the spirit of life was in the wheels.
brenton_translation: When those went, the wheels went; and when those stood, the wheels stood; and when those lifted themselves off the earth, they were lifted off with them: for the spirit of life was in the wheels.

fresh_translation: And the likeness over the head of the living beings was like a firmament, as the appearance of crystal stretched over their wings above.
brenton_translation: And the likeness over the heads of the living creatures was as a firmament, as the appearance of crystal, spread out over their wings above.

fresh_translation: And under the firmament their wings were stretched, winging one to the other, each with two joined, covering their bodies.
brenton_translation: And their wings were spread out under the firmament, reaching one to the other; two wings to each, covering their bodies.

fresh_translation: And I heard the sound of their wings when they went, like the sound of much water, and when they stood, their wings rested.
brenton_translation: And I heard the sound of their wings when they went, as the sound of much water: and when they stood, their wings were let down.

fresh_translation: And behold, a voice came from above the firmament that was over their head.
brenton_translation: And lo! a voice from above the firmament

fresh_translation: Like the appearance of a sapphire stone, likeness of a throne upon it, and upon the likeness of the throne, a likeness as the appearance of a man above.
brenton_translation: that was over their head, there was as the appearance of a sapphire stone, and the likeness of a throne upon it: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as an appearance of a man above.

fresh_translation: And I saw like the sight of electrum from the sight of loins and upward, and from the sight of loins and downward I saw like the appearance of fire and his brightness around.
brenton_translation: And I saw as it were the resemblance of amber from the appearance of the loins and upwards, and from the appearance of the loins and under I saw an appearance of fire, and the brightness thereof round about.

fresh_translation: Like the appearance of a bow when it is in a cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of brightness around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord, and I saw and fell on my face and heard a voice speaking.
brenton_translation: As the appearance of the bow when it is in the cloud in days of rain, so was the form of the brightness round about.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, stand upon your feet and I will speak to you.
brenton_translation: This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And I saw and fell upon my face, and heard the voice of one speaking: and he said to me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak to thee.

fresh_translation: And spirit came upon me and took me up and lifted me and set me on my feet, and I heard him speaking to me.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit came upon me, and took me up, and raised me, and set me on my feet: and I heard him speaking to me.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, I send you to the house of Israel, those provoking me, who provoked me, they and their fathers until this present day.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, I send thee forth to the house of Israel, them that provoke me; who have provoked me, they and their fathers, to this day.

fresh_translation: And you will say to them, Thus says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Whether perhaps they hear or are afraid, because it is a provoking house, they will know that you are a prophet in the midst of them.
brenton_translation: Whether then indeed they shall hear or fear, (for it is a provoking house,) yet they shall know that thou art a prophet in the midst of them.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, do not fear them nor be dismayed before their face, because they will rage and gather around against you, and you dwell in the midst of scorpions. Do not fear their words, and do not be dismayed before their face, because it is a provoking house.
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, fear them not, nor be dismayed at their face; (for they will madden and will rise up against thee round about, and thou dwellest in the midst of scorpions): be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their countenance, for it is a provoking house.

fresh_translation: And you will speak my words to them, whether perhaps they hear or are afraid, because it is a provoking house.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt speak my words to them, whether they will hear or fear: for it is a provoking house.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, hear the one speaking to you. Do not become provoking like the provoking house. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, hear him that speaks to thee; be not thou provoking, as the provoking house: open thy mouth, and eat what I give thee.

fresh_translation: And I saw, and behold, a hand stretched out to me, and in it was a scroll of a book.
brenton_translation: And I looked, and behold, a hand stretched out to me, and in it a volume of a book.

fresh_translation: And he unrolled it before me, and on it were writings on back and front, and written on it were lament and song and woe.
brenton_translation: And he unrolled it before me: and in it the front and the back were written upon: and there was written in it Lamentation, and mournful song, and woe.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, eat this scroll, and go and speak to the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, eat this volume, and go and speak to the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And I opened my mouth, and he fed me the scroll.
brenton_translation: So he opened my mouth, and caused me to eat the volume.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, your mouth will eat, and your belly will be filled with this scroll given to you. And I ate it, and it became in my mouth like sweet honey.
brenton_translation: thy mouth shall eat, and thy belly shall be filled with this volume that is given to thee. So I ate it; and it was in my mouth as sweet honey.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, go, enter to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, go thy way, and go in to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.

fresh_translation: For you are not being sent to a deep-lipped and heavy-tongued people, but to the house of Israel,
brenton_translation: For thou art not sent to a people of hard speech, but to the house of Israel;

fresh_translation: nor to many peoples foreign-speaking or foreign-tongued, nor heavy in tongue, whose words you would not understand. If I had sent you to such people, they would have listened to you.
brenton_translation: neither to many nations of other speech and other tongues, nor of harsh language, whose words thou wouldest not understand: although if I had sent thee to such, they would have hearkened to thee.

fresh_translation: But the house of Israel will not want to listen to you, because they do not want to listen to me, because all the house of Israel are contentious and hard-hearted.
brenton_translation: But the house of Israel will not be willing to hearken to thee; for they will not hearken to me: for all the house of Israel are stubborn and hard-hearted.

fresh_translation: And behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and I will strengthen your strife against their strife.
brenton_translation: And, behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and I will strengthen thy power against their power.

fresh_translation: And it will always be stronger than rock. Do not fear them, nor be dismayed before their face, because it is a provoking house.
brenton_translation: And it shall be continually stronger than a rock: be not afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their faces, because it is a provoking house.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, take into your heart all the words that I have spoken with you, and hear with your ears.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, receive into thine heart all the words that I have spoken to thee, and hear them with thine ears.

fresh_translation: And go, enter into the captivity, to the sons of your people, and speak to them and say to them, Thus says the Lord, whether perhaps they hear, whether perhaps they yield.
brenton_translation: And go thy way, go in to the captivity, to the children of thy people, and thou shalt speak to them, and say to them, Thus saith the Lord; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

fresh_translation: And spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of great shaking: Blessed be the glory of the Lord from his place.
brenton_translation: Then the Spirit took me up, and I heard behind me the voice as of a great earthquake, saying, Blessed be the glory of the Lord from his place.

fresh_translation: And I perceived the sound of wings of living beings beating one against another, and the sound of the wheels next to them, and the sound of the shaking.
brenton_translation: And I perceived the sound of the wings of the living creatures clapping one to the other, and the sound of the wheels was near them, and the sound of the earthquake.

fresh_translation: And spirit lifted me and took me up, and I went in the rush of my spirit, and the hand of the Lord became strong upon me.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit lifted me, and took me up, and I went in the impulse of my spirit; and the hand of the Lord was mighty upon me.

fresh_translation: And I entered into the captivity, borne aloft, and went around those dwelling by the river Chebar, those who were there, and sat there seven days, staying in the midst of them.
brenton_translation: Then I passed through the air and came into the captivity, and went round to them that dwelt by the river of Chobar who were there; and I sat there seven days, conversant in the midst of them.

fresh_translation: And it happened after the seven days, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And after the seven days the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Son of man,

fresh_translation: Son of man, I have given you as a watchman to the house of Israel, and you will hear a word from my mouth and warn them from me.
brenton_translation: I have made thee a watchman to the house of Israel; and thou shalt hear a word of my mouth, and shalt threaten them from me.

fresh_translation: When I say to the lawless one, By death you will be put to death, and you do not warn him nor speak to warn the lawless one to turn from his ways so that he may live, that lawless one will die in his injustice, and his blood I will seek from your hand.
brenton_translation: When I say to the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou hast not warned him, to give warning to the wicked, to turn from his ways, that he should live; that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

fresh_translation: And you, if you warn the lawless one and he does not turn from his lawlessness and from his way, that lawless one will die in his injustice, and you will rescue your soul.
brenton_translation: But if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, and from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity, and thou shalt deliver thy soul.

fresh_translation: And when a righteous one turns from his righteousnesses and commits a trespass, and I set torment before his face, he will die because you did not warn him, and in his sins he will die because his righteous deeds that he did will not be remembered, and his blood I will seek from your hand.
brenton_translation: And when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits a trespass, and I shall bring punishment before him, he shall die, because thou didst not warn him: he shall even die in his sins, because his righteousness shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

fresh_translation: But if you warn the righteous one not to sin and he does not sin, the righteous one will surely live because you warned him, and you will rescue your own soul.
brenton_translation: But if thou warn the righteous not to sin, and he sin not, the righteous shall surely live, because thou hast warned him; and thou shalt deliver thine own soul.

fresh_translation: And the hand of the Lord came upon me and said to me, Rise and go out into the plain, and there it will be spoken to you.
brenton_translation: And the hand of the Lord came upon me; and he said to me, Arise, and go forth into the plain, and there shalt thou be spoken to.

fresh_translation: And I rose and went out into the plain, and behold, there the glory of the Lord stood, just as the vision and as the glory that I had seen by the river Chebar, and I fell on my face.
brenton_translation: And I arose, and went forth to the plain: and, behold, the glory of the Lord stood there, according to the vision, and according to the glory of the Lord, which I saw by the river of Chobar: and I fell on my face.

fresh_translation: And spirit came upon me and set me on my feet and spoke to me and said to me, Enter and shut yourself in the midst of your house.
brenton_translation: Then the Spirit came upon me, and set me on my feet, and spoke to me, and said to me, Go in, and shut thyself up in the midst of thine house.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, behold, bonds have been given upon you, and they will bind you with them, and you will not go out from the midst of them.
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, behold, bonds are prepared for thee, and they shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not come forth of the midst of them.

fresh_translation: And I will bind your tongue, and you will be made mute, and you will not be to them a man who rebukes, because it is a provoking house.
brenton_translation: Also I will bind thy tongue, and thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: because it is a provoking house.

fresh_translation: And when I speak to you, I will open your mouth, and you will say to them, Thus says the Lord. The one who hears, let him hear; and the one who disobeys, let him disobey, because it is a provoking house.
brenton_translation: But when I speak to thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord, He that hears, let him hear; and he that is disobedient, let him be disobedient: because it is a provoking house.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, take for yourself a brick and set it before your face and draw on it a city, Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, take thee a brick, and thou shalt set it before thy face, and shalt portray on it the city, even Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: And set a siege against it and build defenses against it, and cast a siege mound around it, and set camps against it, and place siege engines around it.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt besiege it, and build works against it, and throw up a mound round about it, and pitch camps against it, and set up engines round about.

fresh_translation: And you, take for yourself an iron pan and set it as an iron wall between you and the city, and prepare your face against it, and it will be under siege and you will shut it in. This is a sign for the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: And take thou to thyself an iron pan, and thou shalt set it for an iron wall between thee and the city: and thou shalt set thy face against it, and it shall be in a siege, and thou shalt besiege it. This is a sign to the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: And you will lie on your left side and set the injustices of the house of Israel upon it. According to the number of the days, one hundred fifty, during which you lie on it, you will bear their injustices.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt lie upon thy left side, and lay the iniquities of the house of Israel upon it, according to the number of the hundred and fifty days during which thou shalt lie upon it: and thou shalt bear their iniquities.

fresh_translation: And I have given you their two injustices for the number of days, one hundred ninety days, and you will bear the injustices of the house of Israel.
brenton_translation: For I have appointed thee their iniquities for a number of days, for a hundred and ninety days: so thou shalt bear the iniquities of the house of Israel.

fresh_translation: And you will finish all these things and lie on your right side and bear the injustices of the house of Judah forty days. I have set for you a day for a year.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt accomplish this, and then shalt lie on thy right side, and shalt bear the iniquities of the house of Juda forty days: I have appointed thee a day for a year.

fresh_translation: And toward the siege of Jerusalem you will prepare your face, and you will strengthen your arm, and you will prophesy against it.
brenton_translation: So thou shalt set thy face to the siege of Jerusalem, and shalt strengthen thine arm, and shalt prophesy against it.

fresh_translation: And I, behold, have given bonds upon you, and you will not turn from one side to the other until the days of your siege are completed.
brenton_translation: And, behold, I have prepared bonds for thee, and thou mayest not turn from thy one side to the other, until the days of thy siege shall be accomplished.

fresh_translation: And you, take for yourself wheat and barley and beans and lentils and millet and spelt and put them into an earthen vessel and make them for yourself into loaves, and according to the number of the days during which you sleep on your side, one hundred ninety days, you will eat them.
brenton_translation: Take thou also to thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and bread-corn; and thou shalt cast them into one earthen vessel, and shalt make them into loaves for thyself; and thou shalt eat them a hundred and ninety days, according to the number of the days during which thou sleepest on thy side.

fresh_translation: And your food which you will eat will be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you will eat them.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt eat thy food by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat them.

fresh_translation: And you will drink water by measure, one-sixth of a hin. From time to time you will drink.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt drink water by measure, even from time to time thou shalt drink the sixth part of a hin.

fresh_translation: And you will eat them as a barley cake. With human-dung fuel you will bake them before their eyes.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt eat them as a barley cake: thou shalt bake them before their eyes in man's dung.

fresh_translation: And you will say, Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Thus the sons of Israel will eat unclean things among the nations.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel; Thus shall the children of Israel eat unclean things among the Gentiles.

fresh_translation: And I said, No indeed, Lord God of Israel. Behold, my soul has not been defiled with uncleanness, and I have not eaten what died of itself or was torn by beasts from my birth until now, nor has any stale flesh entered into my mouth.
brenton_translation: Then I said, Not so, Lord God of Israel: surely my soul has not been defiled with uncleanness; nor have I eaten that which died of itself or was torn of beasts from my birth until now; neither has any corrupt flesh entered into my mouth.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Behold, I have given you cow dung instead of human dung, and you will make your loaves upon it.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Behold, I have given thee dung of oxen instead of man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy loaves upon it.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, behold, I break the support of bread in Jerusalem, and they will eat bread by weight and in want, and they will drink water by measure and in ruin,
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, behold, I break the support of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight and in want; and shall drink water by measure, and in a state of ruin:

fresh_translation: so that they may be in want of bread and water, and a man and his brother will be brought to ruin and melt away in their injustices.
brenton_translation: that they may want bread and water; and a man and his brother shall be brought to ruin, and they shall pine away in their iniquities.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, take for yourself a sharp sword, like a barber's razor. Acquire it for yourself and bring it over your head and over your beard, and you will take scales for weighing and divide the hairs.
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, take thee a sword sharper than a barber's razor; thou shalt procure it for thyself, and shalt bring it upon thine head, and upon thy beard: and thou shalt take a pair of scales, and shalt separate the hair.

fresh_translation: A quarter you will burn with fire in the midst of the city according to the completion of days of the siege. And you will take a quarter and burn it in the midst of her, and a quarter you will cut with a sword around her, and a quarter you will scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword behind them.
brenton_translation: A fourth part thou shalt burn in the fire in the midst of the city, at the fulfilment of the days of the siege: and thou shalt take a fourth part, and burn it up in the midst of it: and a fourth part thou shalt cut with a sword round about it: and a fourth part thou shalt scatter to the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.

fresh_translation: And you will take from there a few in number and wrap them in your cloak.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take thence a few in number, and shalt wrap them in the fold of thy garment.

fresh_translation: And from these you will take again and throw them into the midst of the fire and burn them with fire. From it fire will go out, and you will say to all the house of Israel,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt take of these again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them up with fire: from thence shall come forth fire; and thou shalt say to the whole house of Israel,

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: This is Jerusalem. I have set her and the lands around her in the midst of the nations.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; This is Jerusalem: I have set her and the countries round about her in the midst of the nations.

fresh_translation: And you will declare my ordinances to the lawless one from the nations and my statutes to the lands around her, because they rejected my ordinances and did not walk in my statutes.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt declare mine ordinances to the lawless one from out of the nations; and my statutes to the sinful one of the countries round about her: because they have rejected mine ordinances, and have not walked in my statutes.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because your occasion for sin was from the nations around you, and you did not walk in my statutes or do my ordinances, and you did not even do according to the ordinances of the nations around you.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Because your occasion for sin has been taken from the nations round about you, and ye have not walked in my statutes, nor kept mine ordinances, nay, ye have not even done according to the ordinances of the nations round about you; therefore thus saith the Lord;

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, and I will do judgment in your midst before the nations.
brenton_translation: Behold, I am against thee, and I will execute judgment in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.

fresh_translation: And I will do among you things that I have not done, and things like these I will not do again, because of all your abominations.
brenton_translation: And I will do in thee things which I have not done, and the like of which I will not do again, for all thine abominations.

fresh_translation: Therefore fathers will eat children in your midst and children will eat fathers, and I will execute judgments in you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.
brenton_translation: Therefore the fathers shall eat their children in the midst of thee, and children shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and I will scatter all that are left of thee to every wind.

fresh_translation: Therefore as I live, says the Lord, because you defiled my holy things with all your abominations, I also will reject you. My eye will not spare, and I will not have mercy.
brenton_translation: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord; surely, because thou hast defiled my holy things with all thine abominations, I also will reject thee; mine eye shall not spare, and I will have no mercy.

fresh_translation: A quarter of you will be consumed in death, and a quarter of you will be finished in famine in your midst, and a quarter of you I will scatter to every wind, and a quarter of you will fall by sword around you, and I will draw out a sword behind them.
brenton_translation: A fourth part of thee shall be cut off by pestilence, and a fourth part of thee shall be consumed in the midst of thee with famine: and as for another fourth part of thee, I will scatter them to every wind; and a fourth part of thee shall fall by the sword round about thee, and I will draw out a sword after them.

fresh_translation: And my wrath and my anger will be completed upon them, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken in my zeal when I complete my anger upon them.
brenton_translation: And my wrath and mine anger shall be accomplished upon them: and thou shalt know that I the Lord have spoken in my jealousy, when I have accomplished mine anger upon them.

fresh_translation: And I will make you a wilderness, and your daughters around you, before everyone passing through.
brenton_translation: And I will make thee desolate, and thy daughters round about thee, in the sight of every one that passes through.

fresh_translation: And you will be groaned over and miserable among the nations around you when I execute judgments in you in vengeance of my wrath. I, the Lord, have spoken.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt be mourned over and miserable among the nations round about thee, when I have executed judgments in thee in the vengeance of my wrath. I the Lord have spoken.

fresh_translation: When I send my arrows of famine upon them and they will be for destruction, and I will break your support of bread,
brenton_translation: And when I have sent against them shafts of famine, then they shall be consumed, and I will break the strength of thy bread.

fresh_translation: and I will send upon you famine and evil beasts and take vengeance on you, and death and blood will pass through upon you, and I will bring a sword upon you all around. I, the Lord, have spoken.
brenton_translation: So I will send forth against thee famine and evil beasts, and I will take vengeance upon thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through upon thee; and I will bring a sword upon thee round about. I the Lord have spoken.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them,
brenton_translation: Son of man, set thy face against the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them;

fresh_translation: and say, Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord to the mountains and to the hills and to the ravines and to the valleys: Behold, I bring a sword upon you, and your high places will be destroyed.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say,

fresh_translation: And your altars will be crushed and your shrines will be broken down, and I will cast down your slain before your idols.
brenton_translation: And your altars shall be broken to pieces, and your consecrated plats; and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

fresh_translation: And I will scatter your bones around your altars.
brenton_translation: And I will scatter your bones round about your altars,

fresh_translation: In all your dwelling places the cities will be laid waste and the high places will disappear, so that your altars may be destroyed and your idols crushed and your shrines removed.
brenton_translation: and in all your habitations: the cities shall be made desolate, and the high places utterly laid waste; that your altars may be destroyed, and your idols be broken to pieces, and your consecrated plats be abolished.

fresh_translation: And the slain will fall in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And slain men shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: When there are survivors from you from the sword among the nations, and when you are scattered in the lands,
brenton_translation: When there are some of you escaping from the sword among the Gentiles, and when ye are scattered in the countries;

fresh_translation: then those of you who are rescued will remember me among the nations where they were taken captive, because I swore against their heart whoring away from me and against their eyes whoring after their practices, and they will beat their faces over all their abominations.
brenton_translation: then they of you that escape among the nations whither they were carried captive shall remember me; (I have sworn an oath against their heart that goes a-whoring from me, and their eyes that go a-whoring after their practices;) and they shall mourn over themselves for all their abominations.

fresh_translation: And they will know that I, the Lord, have spoken.
brenton_translation: And they shall know that I the Lord have spoken.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Clap with your hand and stamp with your foot and say, Alas, alas, over all the abominations of the house of Israel. By sword and by death and by famine they will fall.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; Clap with thy hand, and stamp with thy foot and say, Aha, aha! for all the abominations of the house of Israel: they shall fall by the sword, and by pestilence, and by famine.

fresh_translation: The one near will fall by sword, and the one far off will die by death, and the one hemmed in will be finished by famine, and I will complete my anger upon them.
brenton_translation: He that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that is far off shall die by the pestilence; and he that is in the siege shall be consumed with famine: and I will accomplish mine anger upon them.

fresh_translation: And you will know that I am the Lord when your slain are in the midst of your idols, around your altars, on every high hill and under every shady tree, where they offered a fragrant smell to all their idols.
brenton_translation: Then ye shall know that I am the Lord, when your slain are in the midst of your idols round about your altars, on every high hill, and under every shady tree, where they offered a sweet savour to all their idols.

fresh_translation: And I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land into desolation and ruin, from the wilderness to Diblath, in all their dwelling places, and they will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will stretch out my hand against them, and I will make the land desolate and ruined from the wilderness of Deblatha, in all their habitations: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Also, thou, son of man, say,

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, say, Thus says the Lord to the land of Israel: The end has come; the end has come upon the four wings of the land.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord;

fresh_translation: The end has come.
brenton_translation: The end is come

fresh_translation: Upon you who dwell in the land, the time has come; the day has drawn near, not with tumults nor with birth pains.
brenton_translation: on thee, the inhabitant of the land: the time is come, the day has drawn nigh, not with tumult, nor with pangs.

fresh_translation: Now from nearby I will pour out my wrath upon you and complete my anger in you, and I will judge you according to your ways and bring all your abominations upon you.
brenton_translation: Now I will pour out mine anger upon thee near at hand, and I will accomplish my wrath on thee: and I will judge thee for thy ways, and recompense upon thee all thine abominations.

fresh_translation: My eye will not spare, nor will I show mercy, because I will bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord, the one who strikes.
brenton_translation: Mine eye shall not spare, nor will I have any mercy: for I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord that smite thee.

fresh_translation: Now the end comes toward you, and I will send it upon you, and I will take vengeance on you according to your ways and bring all your abominations upon you.
brenton_translation: Now the end is come to thee, and I will send judgment upon thee: and I will take vengeance on thy ways, and will recompense all thine abominations upon thee.

fresh_translation: My eye will not spare you, nor will I show mercy, because I will bring your way upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: Mine eye shall not spare, nor will I have any mercy: for I will recompense thy way upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: For thus says the Lord.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, the end is come.

fresh_translation: Behold, the end has come. Behold, the day of the Lord. Though the rod has blossomed, insolence has sprung up.
brenton_translation: Behold, the day of the Lord! although the rod has blossomed,

fresh_translation: And it will shatter the staff of the lawless one, not with tumult nor with haste.
brenton_translation: pride has sprung up, and will break the staff of the wicked one, and that not with tumult, nor with haste.

fresh_translation: The time has come; behold, the day. Let the buyer not rejoice, and let the seller not mourn.
brenton_translation: The time is come, behold the day: let not the buyer rejoice, and let not the seller mourn.

fresh_translation: For the buyer will never return to the seller, and no one, with the eye of his life, will hold firm.
brenton_translation: For the buyer shall never again return to the seller, neither shall a man cleave with the eye of hope to his life.

fresh_translation: Sound the trumpet and judge everything.
brenton_translation: Sound ye the trumpet, and pass sentence on all together.

fresh_translation: War with sword outside, and famine and death inside. The one in the field will die by sword, but famine and death will finish those in the city.
brenton_translation: There shall be war with the sword without, and famine and pestilence within: he that is in the field shall die by the sword; and famine and pestilence shall destroy them that are in the city.

fresh_translation: And those rescued from them will be saved and be on the mountains. I will kill all of them, each in his injustices.
brenton_translation: But they that escape of them shall be delivered, and shall be upon the mountains: and I will slay all the rest, every one for his iniquities.

fresh_translation: All hands will grow weak, and all thighs will be defiled with wetness.
brenton_translation: All hands shall be completely weakened, and all thighs shall be defiled with moisture.

fresh_translation: And they will gird themselves with sackcloth, and dismay will cover them, and shame will be upon every face, and baldness upon every head.
brenton_translation: And they shall gird themselves with sackcloth, and amazement shall cover them; and shame shall be upon them, even upon every face, and baldness upon every head.

fresh_translation: Their silver will be thrown in the streets and their gold will be despised. Their souls will not be filled, and their bellies will not be satisfied, because it became a torment of their injustices.
brenton_translation: Their silver shall be cast forth in the streets, and their gold shall be despised: their souls shall not be satisfied, and their bellies shall not be filled: for it was the punishment of their iniquities.

fresh_translation: Their chosen ornaments they set for pride, and images of their abominations they made from them; because of this I gave them over to uncleanness.
brenton_translation: As for their choice ornaments, they employed them for pride, and they made of them images of their abominations: therefore have I made them uncleanness to them.

fresh_translation: And I will hand them over into the hands of strangers to plunder them, and to the pests of the earth for spoil, and they will profane them.
brenton_translation: And I will deliver them into the hands of strangers to make them a prey, and to the pests of the earth for a spoil; and they shall profane them.

fresh_translation: And I will turn my face away from them, and they will defile my visitation, and they will enter them unguarded and profane them.
brenton_translation: And I will turn away my face from them, and they shall defile my charge, and shall go in to them unguardedly, and profane them.

fresh_translation: And they will make confusion, because the land is full of peoples and the city is full of lawlessness.
brenton_translation: And they shall work uncleanness: because the land is full of strange nations, and the city is full of iniquity.

fresh_translation: And I will turn away the arrogance of their strength, and their holy things will be defiled.
brenton_translation: And I will turn back the boasting of their strength; and their holy things shall be defiled.

fresh_translation: Propitiation will come, and one will seek peace, and it will not be.
brenton_translation: And though propitiation shall come, and one shall seek peace, yet there shall be none.

fresh_translation: Woe upon woe will be, and message upon message will be, and a vision will be sought from a prophet, and law will perish from a priest and counsel from elders.
brenton_translation: There shall be woe upon woe, and there shall be message upon message; and a vision shall be sought from a prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

fresh_translation: A ruler will clothe himself with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land will be paralyzed. According to their ways I will deal with them, and by their judgments I will take vengeance on them, and they will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: The prince shall clothe himself with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be made feeble: I will do to them according to their ways, and according to their judgments will I punish them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And it happened in the sixth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth of the month, I was sitting in the house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, and the hand of the Lord came upon me.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth day of the month, I was sitting in the house, and the elders of Juda were sitting before me: and the hand of the Lord came upon me.

fresh_translation: And I saw, and behold, the likeness of a man: from his loins and downward, there was fire, and from his loins upward, like the appearance of electrum.
brenton_translation: And I looked, and, behold, the likeness of a man: from his loins and downwards there was fire, and from his loins upwards there was as the appearance of amber.

fresh_translation: And he stretched out the likeness of a hand and took me by the top of my head, and a spirit lifted me between the earth and heaven and brought me to Jerusalem in the vision of God, to the forecourt of the inner gate facing north, where the pillar of the Possessor was.
brenton_translation: And he stretched forth the likeness of a hand, and took me up by the crown of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between the earth and sky, and brought me to Jerusalem in a vision of God, to the porch of the gate that looks to the north, where was the pillar of the Purchaser.

fresh_translation: And behold, there was the glory of the Lord God of Israel, according to the vision I saw in the plain.
brenton_translation: And, behold, the glory of the Lord God of Israel was there, according to the vision which I saw in the plain.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, lift your eyes toward the north. And I lifted my eyes toward the north, and behold, from the north, toward the gate that faces east.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes toward the north, and, behold, I looked from the north toward the eastern gate.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what these are doing? Great lawless deeds they do here, so that I should withdraw from my holy things, and still you will see greater lawless deeds.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, hast thou seen what these do? They commit great abominations here so that I should keep away from my sanctuary: and thou shalt see yet greater iniquities.

fresh_translation: And he brought me to the forecourt of the court.
brenton_translation: And he brought me to the porch of the court.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, dig. And I dug, and behold, one door.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, dig: so I dug, and behold a door.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Enter and see the lawless deeds that these do here.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Go in, and behold the iniquities which they practise here.
