fresh_translation: And I entered and saw, and behold, vain abominations and all idols of the house of Israel engraved on it all around.
brenton_translation: So I went in and looked; and beheld vain abominations, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed upon them round about.

fresh_translation: And seventy men from the elders of the house of Israel stood before them, and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was in the midst of them, and each had his censer in his hand, and the vapor of the incense was going up.
brenton_translation: And seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel, and Jechonias the son of Saphan stood in their presence in the midst of them, and each one held his censer in his hand; and the smoke of the incense went up.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do, each in his hidden chamber? For they said, The Lord does not see; the Lord has abandoned the land.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Thou hast seen, son of man, what the elders of the house of Israel do, each one of them in their secret chamber: because they have said, The Lord sees not; The Lord has forsaken the earth.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, You will still see greater lawless deeds that these do.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Thou shalt see yet greater iniquities which these do.

fresh_translation: And he brought me to the forecourt of the gate of the house of the Lord that faces north, and behold, women were sitting there lamenting Tammuz.
brenton_translation: And he brought me in to the porch of the house of the Lord that looks to the north; and, behold, there were women sitting there lamenting for Thammuz.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen? You will still see practices greater than these.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, thou hast seen; but thou shalt yet see evil practices greater than these.

fresh_translation: And he brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord, and behold, at the forecourt of the temple of the Lord, between the porch and the altar, about twenty men had their backs toward the temple of the Lord and their faces opposite, and these were bowing to the sun.
brenton_translation: And he brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord, and at the entrance of the temple of the Lord, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty men, with their back parts toward the temple of the Lord, and their faces turned the opposite way; and these were worshipping the sun.

fresh_translation: And he said to me, Have you seen, son of man? Is it a small thing for the house of Judah to do the lawless deeds they have done here? For they filled the land with lawlessness, and behold, they are like mockers.
brenton_translation: And he said to me, Son of man, thou hast seen this. Is it a little thing to the house of Juda to practise the iniquities which they have practised here? for they have filled the land with iniquity: and, behold, these are as scorners.

fresh_translation: And I also will deal with them in wrath. My eye will not spare, nor will I have mercy.
brenton_translation: Therefore will I deal with them in wrath: mine eye shall not spare, nor will I have any mercy.

fresh_translation: And he cried into my ears with a loud voice, saying, The vengeance of the city has drawn near, and each had the instruments of destruction in his hand.
brenton_translation: And he cried in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, The judgment of the city has drawn nigh; and each had the weapons of destruction in his hand.

fresh_translation: And behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate that faces north, and each one's axe was in his hand, and one man was in the midst of them, clothed in a full-length robe, with a sapphire belt on his loins; and they entered and stood beside the bronze altar.
brenton_translation: And, behold, six men came from the way of the high gate that looks toward the north, and each one's axe was in his hand; and there was one man in the midst of them clothed with a long robe down to the feet, and a sapphire girdle was on his loins: and they came in and stood near the brazen altar.

fresh_translation: And the glory of God of Israel went up from the cherubim that was upon them to the forecourt of the house, and he called the man clothed in the full-length robe, who had the belt upon his loins.
brenton_translation: And the glory of the God of Israel, that was upon them, went up from the cherubs to the porch of the house.

fresh_translation: And he said to him, Pass through the midst of Jerusalem and put the mark on the foreheads of the men who groan and grieve over all the lawless deeds being done in her midst.
brenton_translation: and said to him, Go through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that groan and that grieve for all the iniquities that are done in the midst of them.

fresh_translation: And to these he said in my hearing, Go after him into the city and strike. Let not your eyes spare, and do not show mercy.
brenton_translation: And he said to the first in my hearing, Go after him into the city, and smite: and let not your eyes spare, and have no mercy.

fresh_translation: Kill old man and young man and virgin and infants and women for wiping out, but do not come near anyone on whom the mark is, and begin from my holy things. And they began from the elder men who were inside the house.
brenton_translation: Slay utterly old man and youth, and virgin, and infants, and women: but go ye not nigh any on whom is the mark: begin at my sanctuary.

fresh_translation: And he said to them, Defile the house and fill the ways with the dead. Go out and strike.
brenton_translation: And he said to them, Defile the house, and go out and fill the ways with dead bodies, and smite.

fresh_translation: And it happened while they were striking that I fell on my face and cried out and said, Alas, Lord, do you wipe out the remnant of Israel when you pour out your wrath upon Jerusalem?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass as they were smiting, that I fell upon my face, and cried out, and said, Alas, O Lord! wilt thou destroy the remnant of Israel, in pouring out thy wrath upon Jerusalem?

fresh_translation: And he said to me, The injustice of the house of Israel and Judah has grown very, very great, because the land has been filled with many peoples and the city has been filled with injustice and uncleanness, because they said, The Lord has abandoned the land; the Lord does not look upon it.
brenton_translation: Then said he to me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Juda is become very exceedingly great: for the land is filled with many nations, and the city is filled with iniquity and uncleanness: because they have said, The Lord has forsaken the earth, The Lord looks not upon it.

fresh_translation: And my eye will not spare, nor will I show mercy. I have put their ways on their heads.
brenton_translation: Therefore mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have any mercy: I have recompensed their ways upon their heads.

fresh_translation: And behold, the man clothed in the full-length robe, with the belt around his loins, answered, saying, I have done just as you commanded me.
brenton_translation: And, behold, the man clothed with the long robe, and girt with the girdle about his loins, answered and said, I have done as thou didst command me.

fresh_translation: And I saw, and behold, above the firmament over the heads of the cherubim, like a sapphire stone, there was the likeness of a throne upon them.
brenton_translation: Then I looked, and, behold, over the firmament that was above the head of the cherubs there was a likeness of a throne over them, as a sapphire stone.

fresh_translation: And he said to the man clothed in the robe, Enter into the midst of the wheels beneath the cherubim and fill your hands with coals of fire from the midst of the cherubim and scatter them over the city. And he entered before me.
brenton_translation: And he said to the man clothed with the long robe, Go in between the wheels that are under the cherubs, and fill thine hands with coals of fire from between the cherubs, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.

fresh_translation: And the cherubim stood on the right of the house when the man went in, and the cloud filled the inner court.
brenton_translation: And the cherubs stood on the right hand of the house, as the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

fresh_translation: And the glory of the Lord went up from the cherubim to the forecourt of the house, and the cloud filled the house, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Then the glory of the Lord departed from the cherubs to the porch of the house; and the cloud filled the house, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the sound of wings of cherubim was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty speaking.
brenton_translation: And the sound of the cherubs' wings was heard as far as the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God speaking.

fresh_translation: And it happened when he commanded the man clothed in the holy robe, saying, Take fire from the midst of the wheels, from the midst of the cherubim, and he went in and stood beside the wheels.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, when he gave a charge to the man clothed with the sacred robe, saying, Take fire from between the wheels from between the cherubs, that he went in, and stood near the wheels.

fresh_translation: And he stretched out his hand into the midst of the fire that was in the midst of the cherubim and took it and gave it into the hands of the one clothed in the holy robe, and he took it and went out.
brenton_translation: And he stretched forth his hand into the midst of the fire that was between the cherubs, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of the man clothed with the sacred robe: and he took it, and went out.

fresh_translation: And I saw on the cherubim the likeness of human hands beneath their wings.
brenton_translation: And I saw the cherubs having the likeness of men's hands under their wings.

fresh_translation: And I saw, and behold, four wheels stood beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and the appearance of the wheels was like the appearance of a carbuncle stone.
brenton_translation: And I saw, and behold, four wheels stood by the cherubs, one wheel by each cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the appearance of a carbuncle stone.

fresh_translation: And their appearance had one likeness in the four, like a wheel within a wheel.
brenton_translation: And as for their appearance, there was one likeness to the four, as if there should be a wheel in the midst of a wheel.

fresh_translation: When they went, they went on their four sides; they did not turn when they went, because to whatever place the one head looked, they went, and they did not turn when they went.
brenton_translation: When they went, they went on their four sides; they turned not when they went, for whichever way the first head looked, they went; and they turned not as they went.

fresh_translation: And their backs and their hands and their wings and the wheels were full of eyes all around the four wheels.
brenton_translation: And their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about the four wheels.

fresh_translation: And as for these wheels, they were called Whirling, as I heard.
brenton_translation: And these wheels were called Gelgel in my hearing.

fresh_translation: And the cherubim were lifted up. This was the living creature I saw by the river Chebar.
brenton_translation: And the cherubs were the same living creature which I saw by the river of Chobar.

fresh_translation: And when the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them, and when the cherubim lifted their wings to rise from the earth, their wheels did not turn.
brenton_translation: And when the cherubs went, the wheels went, and they were close to them: and when the cherubs lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, their wheels turned not.

fresh_translation: When they stood, these stood, and when they were lifted up, these were lifted with them, because the spirit of life was in them.
brenton_translation: When they stood, the wheels stood; and when they mounted up, the wheels mounted up with them: because the spirit of life was in them.

fresh_translation: And the glory of the Lord went out from the house and settled on the cherubim.
brenton_translation: Then the glory of the Lord departed from the house, and went up on the cherubs.

fresh_translation: And the cherubim lifted their wings and were raised from the earth before me as they went out, and the wheels were beside them, and they stood at the forecourt of the opposite gate of the house of the Lord, and the glory of God of Israel was above them.
brenton_translation: And the cherubs lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went forth, the wheels were also beside them, and they stood at the entrance of the front gate of the house of the Lord; and the glory of the God of Israel was upon them above.

fresh_translation: This is the living creature I saw beneath God of Israel by the river Chebar, and I knew that they are cherubim.
brenton_translation: This is the living creature which I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chobar; and I knew that they were cherubs.

fresh_translation: Four faces belonged to each one, and eight wings to each one, and the likeness of human hands was beneath their wings.
brenton_translation: Each one had four faces, and each one had eight wings; and under their wings was the likeness of men's hands.

fresh_translation: And the likeness of their faces: these are the faces I saw beneath the glory of God of Israel by the river Chebar, and each went straight before its face.
brenton_translation: And as for the likeness of their faces, these are the same faces which I saw under the glory of the God of Israel by the river of Chobar: and they went each straight forward.

fresh_translation: And a spirit took me up and brought me to the opposite gate of the house of the Lord that faces east, and behold, at the forecourt of the gate were about twenty-five men. And I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
brenton_translation: Moreover the Spirit took me up, and brought me to the front gate of the house of the Lord, that looks eastward: and behold at the entrance of the gate were about five and twenty men; and I saw in the midst of them Jechonias the son of Ezer, and Phaltias the son of Banæas, the leaders of the people.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Son of man, these are the men thinking vain things and counseling evil counsel in this city,
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me, Son of man, these are the men that devise vanities, and take evil counsel in this city:

fresh_translation: those saying, Have not the houses recently been built? This is the cooking pot, and we are the meat.
brenton_translation: who say, Have not the houses been newly built? This is the caldron, and we are the flesh.

fresh_translation: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man.
brenton_translation: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, son of man.

fresh_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me and said to me, Say, Thus says the Lord: Thus you said, house of Israel, and the plans of your spirit I know.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and said to me, say;

fresh_translation: You multiplied your dead in this city and filled its streets with slain.
brenton_translation: Ye have multiplied your dead in this city, and ye have filled your ways with slain men.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Your dead, whom you struck in its midst, these are the meat and this is the cooking pot, but I will bring you out from its midst.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Your dead whom ye have smitten in the midst of it, these are the flesh, and thiscity is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.

fresh_translation: You fear the sword, and a sword I will bring upon you, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Ye fear the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And I will bring you out from its midst and hand you over into the hands of strangers, and I will execute judgments among you.
brenton_translation: And I will bring you forth out of the midst of it, and will deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

fresh_translation: By a sword you will fall. On the borders of Israel I will judge you, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you on the mountains of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: This will not be the cooking pot for you, and you will certainly not become meat in its midst. On the borders of Israel I will judge you,
and you will know that I am the Lord.
And it happened, while I prophesied, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died, and I fell on my face and cried out with a loud voice and said, Alas, alas, Lord, are you bringing the remnant of Israel to an end?
brenton_translation: And it came to pass, while I was prophesying, that Phaltias the son of Banæas died. And I fell upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Alas, alas, O Lord! wilt thou utterly destroy the remnant of Israel?

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, your brothers and the men of your captivity and all the house of Israel have come to the full, to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem said, Keep far from the Lord; to us the land was given for inheritance.
brenton_translation: Son of man, thy brethren, and the men of thy captivity, and all the house of Israel are come to the full, to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem said, Keep ye far away from the Lord: the land is given to us for an inheritance.

fresh_translation: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: Though I thrust them away among the nations and scatter them into all the earth, yet I will be to them as a little sanctuary in the lands into which they enter.
brenton_translation: Therefore say thou,

fresh_translation: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: I will welcome them from the nations and gather them from the lands where I scattered them, and I will give them the land of Israel.
brenton_translation: Therefore say thou, Thus saith the Lord; I will also take them from the heathen, and gather them out of the lands wherein I have scattered them, and will give them the land of Israel.

fresh_translation: And they will enter there and remove all its abominations and all its lawless deeds from it.
brenton_translation: And they shall enter in there, and shall remove all the abominations of it, and all its iniquities from it.

fresh_translation: And I will give them another heart, and I will give a new spirit within them, and I will pull out the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
brenton_translation: And I will give them another heart, and will put a new spirit within them; and will extract the heart of stone from their flesh, and give them a heart of flesh:

fresh_translation: so that they may walk in my ordinances and keep my judgments and do them, and they will be to me for a people and I will be to them for God.
brenton_translation: that they may walk in my commandments, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be to me a people, and I will be to them a God.

fresh_translation: But as for the heart set on their abominations and their lawless deeds, as their heart went after them, I have put their ways on their heads, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And as for the heart set upon their abominations and their iniquities, as their heart went after them, I have recompensed their ways on their heads, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the cherubim lifted their wings, and the wheels were beside them, and the glory of God of Israel was above them.
brenton_translation: Then the cherubs lifted up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

fresh_translation: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city and stood upon the mountain opposite the city.
brenton_translation: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city, and stood on the mountain which was in front of the city.

fresh_translation: And a spirit took me up and brought me to the land of the Chaldeans, to the captivity, in a vision, in the Spirit of God, and I came up from the vision that I saw.
brenton_translation: And the Spirit took me up, and brought me to the land of the Chaldeans, to the captivity, in a vision by the Spirit of God: and I went up after the vision which I saw.

fresh_translation: And I spoke to the captivity all the words of the Lord that he showed me.
brenton_translation: And I spoke to the captivity all the words of the Lord which he had shewed me.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, you dwell in the midst of their injustices, those who have eyes to see and do not see, and ears to hear and do not hear, because it is a provoking house.
brenton_translation: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of the iniquities of those, who have eyes to see, and see not; and have ears to hear, and hear not: because it is a provoking house.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, make for yourself baggage for captivity by day before them, and you will go into captivity from your place to another place before them, so that they may see, because it is a provoking house.
brenton_translation: Thou therefore, son of man, prepare thyself baggage for going into captivity by day in their sight; and thou shalt be led into captivity from thy place into another place in their sight; that they may see that it is a provoking house.

fresh_translation: And you will bring out your baggage, like baggage for captivity, by day in their sight, and you will go out in the evening, as a captive goes out.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt carry forth thy baggage, baggage for captivity, by day before their eyes: and thou shalt go forth at even, as a captive goes forth, in their sight.

fresh_translation: In their sight dig for yourself through the wall, and you will go out through it.
brenton_translation: Dig for thyself into the wall of the house, and thou shalt pass through it in their sight:

fresh_translation: In their sight you will be lifted on shoulders and go out hidden. You will cover your face so that you do not see the land, because I have given you as a wonder to the house of Israel.
brenton_translation: thou shalt be lifted up on men's shoulders, and shalt go forth in secret: thou shalt cover thy face, and shalt not see the ground: because I have made thee a sign to the house of Israel.

fresh_translation: And I did so, according to everything he commanded me, and I brought out baggage like baggage for captivity by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall for myself, and hidden I went out; I was lifted on shoulders in their sight.
brenton_translation: And I did thus according to all that he commanded me; and I carried forth my baggage for captivity by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall for myself, and went out secretly; I was taken up on men's shoulders before them.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me in the morning, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me in the morning, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, did not the house of Israel, the provoking house, say to you, What are you doing?
brenton_translation: Son of man, have not the house of Israel, the provoking house, said to thee, What doest thou?

fresh_translation: Say to them, Thus says the Lord God concerning the ruler and the leader in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel who are in their midst.
brenton_translation: Say to them,

fresh_translation: Say, I perform wonders in her midst. As I have done, so it will be to them; into exile and captivity they will go.
brenton_translation: say, I am performing signs: as I have done, so shall it be to him: they shall go into banishment and captivity.

fresh_translation: And the ruler in their midst will be lifted on shoulders and will go out hidden. Through the wall he will dig to go out through it. He will cover his face so that he is not seen by any eye, and he will not see the land.
brenton_translation: And the prince in the midst of them shall be borne upon shoulders, and shall go forth in secret through the wall, and shall dig so that he may go forth thereby: he shall cover his face, that he may not be seen by any eye, and he himself shall not see the ground.

fresh_translation: And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in my enclosure, and I will bring him to Babylon, to the land of the Chaldeans, and yet he will not see it, and there he will die.
brenton_translation: And I will spread out my net upon him, and he shall be caught in my toils: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; but he shall not see it, though he shall die there.

fresh_translation: And all those around him, his helpers and all those supporting him, I will scatter to every wind, and I will draw out a sword behind them.
brenton_translation: And I will scatter to every wind all his assistants round about him, and all that help him; and I will draw out a sword after them.

fresh_translation: And they will know that I am the Lord, when I scatter them among the nations and disperse them in the lands.
brenton_translation: And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have scattered them among the nations; and I will disperse them in the countries.

fresh_translation: And I will leave from them a few men in number, from sword and famine and death, so that they may recount all their lawless deeds among the nations where they entered, and they will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will leave of them a few men in number spared from the sword, and from famine, and from pestilence; that they may declare all their iniquities among the nations whither they have gone; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, you will eat your bread with pain, and you will drink your water with torment and distress.
brenton_translation: Son of man, eat thy bread with sorrow, and drink thy water with torment and affliction.

fresh_translation: And you will say to the people of the land, Thus says the Lord to those dwelling in Jerusalem upon the land of Israel: They will eat their bread with scarcity and drink their water with desolation, so that the land may be desolated with its fullness, because of the impiety of all those dwelling in it.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say to the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord to the inhabitants of Jerusalem on the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread in scarcity, and shall drink their water in desolation, that the land may be desolate with all that it contains: for all that dwell in it are ungodly.

fresh_translation: And their inhabited cities will be laid waste, and the land will become a desolation, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And their inhabited cities shall be laid utterly waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, what is this proverb among you on the land of Israel, saying, The days are far off; the vision has perished?
brenton_translation: Son of man, what is your parable on the land of Israel, that ye say, The days are long, the vision has perished?

fresh_translation: Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord: I will turn away this proverb, and the house of Israel will no longer speak this proverb. But speak to them, The days have drawn near, and the word of every vision.
brenton_translation: Therefore say to them,

fresh_translation: For there will no longer be any false vision and any flattering diviner in the midst of the sons of Israel.
brenton_translation: For there shall no more be any false vision, nor any one prophesying flatteries in the midst of the children of Israel.

fresh_translation: Because I am the Lord. I will speak my words; I will speak and do them, and I will delay no longer, because in your days, provoking house, I will speak the word and do it, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: For I the Lord will speak my words; I will speak and perform them, and will no more delay, for in your days, O provoking house, I will speak the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, behold, the provoking house of Israel says, The vision that this one sees is for many days, and for distant times this one prophesies.
brenton_translation: Son of man, behold, the provoking house of Israel boldly say, The vision which this man sees is for many days, and he prophesies for times afar off.

fresh_translation: Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord: None of my words will be delayed any longer. Whatever word I speak, I will speak and do, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Therefore say to them,

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel, and you will prophesy and say to them, Hear the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel, and thou shalt prophesy, and shalt say to them, Hear ye the word of the Lord:

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Woe to those prophesying from their own heart and seeing nothing at all.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Woe to them that prophesy out of their own heart, and who see nothing at all.

fresh_translation: Your prophets, Israel, are like foxes in the deserts.
brenton_translation: Thy prophets, O Israel, are like foxes in the deserts.

fresh_translation: They did not stand in firmness and gathered flocks against the house of Israel. Those speaking did not rise in the day of the Lord.
brenton_translation: They have not continued steadfast, and they have gathered flocks against the house of Israel, they that say,

fresh_translation: Seeing false things and divining vain things, those saying, The Lord says, though the Lord did not send them, and they began to establish a word.
brenton_translation: In the day of the Lord, have not stood, seeing false visions, prophesying vanities, who say, The Lord saith, and the Lord has not sent them, and they began to try to confirm the word.

fresh_translation: Did you not see a false vision and speak vain divinations?
brenton_translation: Have ye not seen a false vision? and spoken vain prophecies?

fresh_translation: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: Because your words are false and your divinations vain, therefore behold, I am against you, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And therefore say,

fresh_translation: And I will stretch out my hand against the prophets seeing false things and those uttering vanities. In the instruction of my people they will not be, nor will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, nor will they enter into the land of Israel, and they will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will stretch forth my hand against the prophets that see false visions, and those that utter vanities: they shall not partake of the instruction of my people, neither shall they be written in the roll of the house of Israel, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because they led my people astray, saying, Peace, peace, and there was no peace, and one builds a wall, and they plaster it; it will fall.
brenton_translation: Because they have caused my people to err, saying, Peace; and there is no peace; and one builds a wall, and they plaster it,—it shall fall.

fresh_translation: Say to those plastering it, It will fall, and there will be flooding rain, and I will give hailstones against their bindings, and they will fall, and there will be a storming wind, and it will be broken.
brenton_translation: Say to them that plaster it, It shall fall; and there shall be a flooding rain; and I will send great stones upon their joinings, and they shall fall; and there shall be a sweeping wind, and it shall be broken.

fresh_translation: And behold, the wall has fallen, and will they not say to you, Where is your plaster that you plastered?
brenton_translation: And lo! the wall has fallen; and will they not say to you, Where is your plaster wherewith ye plastered it?

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will burst forth a storming blast with wrath, and flooding rain will come in my anger, and hailstones in wrath I will bring for complete destruction.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; I will even cause to burst forth a sweeping blast with fury, and there shall be a flooding rain in my wrath; and in my fury I will bring on great stones for complete destruction.

fresh_translation: And I will tear down the wall that you plastered, and it will fall, and I will lay it on the ground, and its foundations will be uncovered, and it will fall, and you will be finished with reproofs, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will break down the wall which ye have plastered, and it shall fall; and I will lay it on the ground, and its foundations shall be discovered, and it shall fall; and ye shall be consumed with rebukes: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And I will complete my wrath against the wall and against those plastering it, and it will fall, and I will say to you, The wall is not, nor are those plastering it,
brenton_translation: And I will accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that plaster it; it shall fall: and I said to you, The wall is not, nor they that plaster it,

fresh_translation: the prophets of Israel prophesying concerning Jerusalem and seeing peace for her, though there is no peace, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: even the prophets of Israel, who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own heart, and prophesy against them,
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, set thy face firmly against the daughters of thy people, that prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them.

fresh_translation: and say, Thus says the Lord: Woe to those stitching cushions on every elbow of the hand and making veils over every head of every stature, to twist souls. The souls of my people were twisted, and they kept souls alive for themselves.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord, Woe to the women that sew pillows under every elbow, and make kerchiefs on the head of every stature to pervert souls! The souls of my people are perverted, and they have saved souls alive.

fresh_translation: And they profaned me before my people for a handful of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill souls that should not die and to keep souls alive that should not live, when you utter vain utterances to a people listening.
brenton_translation: And they have dishonoured me before my people for a handful of barley, and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls which should not die, and to save alive the souls which should not live, while ye speak to a people hearing vain speeches.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against your cushions on which you twist souls there, and I will tear them from your arms and send away the souls that you twist, their souls into scattering.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I am against your pillows, whereby ye there confound souls, and I will tear them away from your arms, and will set at liberty their souls which ye pervert to scatter them.

fresh_translation: And I will tear your veils and rescue my people from your hand, and they will no longer be in your hands for twisting, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will tear your kerchiefs, and will rescue my people out of your hand, and they shall no longer be in your hands to be confounded; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because you twisted the heart of a righteous one unjustly, and I did not twist him, and because you strengthened the hands of a lawless one so that he not turn at all from his evil way and live,
brenton_translation: Because ye have perverted the heart of the righteous, whereas I perverted him not, and that in order to strengthen the hands of the wicked, that he should not at all turn from his evil way and live:

fresh_translation: therefore you will never see false things, and you will never divine divinations again, and I will rescue my people from your hand, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: therefore ye shall not see false visions, and ye shall no more utter prophecies: but I will deliver my people out of your hand; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And men from the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
brenton_translation: And there came to me men of the people of Israel, of the elders, and sat before me.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, these men set their thoughts upon their hearts and placed punishment of their injustices before their face. Shall I indeed answer them?
brenton_translation: Son of man, these men have conceived their devices in their hearts, and have set before their faces the punishment of their iniquities: shall I indeed answer them?

fresh_translation: Therefore speak to them and say to them, Thus says the Lord: Any man, any man from the house of Israel, who sets his thoughts upon his heart and places punishment of his injustice before his face and comes to the prophet, I, the Lord, will answer him in the things wherein his mind is entangled,
brenton_translation: Therefore speak to them, and thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord; Any man of the house of Israel, who shall conceive his devices in his heart, and shall set the punishment of his iniquity before his face, and shall come to the prophet; I the Lord will answer him according to the things in which his mind is entangled,

fresh_translation: so as to turn aside the house of Israel according to their hearts that are alienated from me in their thoughts.
brenton_translation: that he should turn aside the house of Israel, according to their hearts that are estranged from me in their thoughts.

fresh_translation: Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God: Turn back and turn away from your practices and from all your impieties, and turn your faces back.
brenton_translation: Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God, Be converted, and turn from your evil practices, and from all your sins, and turn your faces back again.

fresh_translation: Because any man, any man from the house of Israel and from the newcomers sojourning in Israel, who becomes alienated from me and sets his thoughts upon his heart and places punishment of his injustice before his face and comes to the prophet to inquire of him in me, I, the Lord, will answer him in that wherein he is entangled within himself.
brenton_translation: For any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, who shall separate himself from me, and conceive his imaginations in his heart, and set before his face the punishment of his iniquity, and come to the prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the Lord will answer him, according to the things wherein he is entangled.

fresh_translation: And I will set my face against that man and make him a desolation and a ruin, and I will remove him from the midst of my people, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him desolate and ruined, and will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if a prophet is led astray and speaks, I, the Lord, have led that prophet astray, and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
brenton_translation: And if a prophet should cause to err and should speak, I the Lord have caused that prophet to err, and will stretch out my hand upon him, and will utterly destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

fresh_translation: And they will bear their injustice; like the offense of the one inquiring, so the offense of the prophet will be,
brenton_translation: And they shall bear their iniquity according to the trespass of him that asks; and it shall be in like manner to the prophet according to the trespass:

fresh_translation: so that the house of Israel may no longer wander from me, and so that they may no longer be defiled in all their trespasses, and they will be to me for a people and I will be to them for God, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, and that they may no more defile themselves with any of their transgressions: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, if a land sins against me by committing offense, and I stretch out my hand against it and break its support of bread and send famine upon it and remove from it man and cattle,
brenton_translation: Son of man, if a land shall sin against me by committing a trespass, then will I stretch out my hand upon it, and will break its staff of bread, and will send forth famine upon it, and cut off from it man and beast.

fresh_translation: and if these three men are in its midst, Noah and Daniel and Job, they themselves will be saved by their righteousness, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And though these three men should be in the midst of it, Noe, and Daniel, and Job, they alone should be delivered by their righteousness, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if I bring evil beasts upon the land and punish it, and it becomes a desolation and there is no passerby because of the beasts,
brenton_translation: If again I bring evil beasts upon the land, and take vengeance upon it, and it be ruined, and there be no one to pass through for fear of the wild beasts:

fresh_translation: and these three men are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters will be saved; only they themselves will be saved, but the land will become a ruin.
brenton_translation: and if these three men should be in the midst of it, as I live, saith the Lord, neither sons nor daughters shall be saved, but these only shall be saved, and the land shall be destroyed.

fresh_translation: Or if I bring a sword upon that land and say, Let a sword pass through the land, and I remove from it man and cattle,
brenton_translation: Or again if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Let the sword go through the land; and I cut off from them man and beast:

fresh_translation: and these three men are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, they will never rescue sons or daughters; only they themselves will be saved.
brenton_translation: though these three men were in the midst of it, as I live, saith the Lord, they shall not deliver sons or daughters, but they only shall be saved themselves.

fresh_translation: Or if I send death upon that land and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to destroy from it man and cattle,
brenton_translation: Or if again I send pestilence upon that land, and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to destroy from off it man and beast:

fresh_translation: and Noah and Daniel and Job are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters will be left behind; they themselves will rescue their own souls by their righteousness.
brenton_translation: and should Noe, and Daniel, and Job, be in the midst of it, as I live, saith the Lord, there shall be left them neither sons nor daughters; only they by their righteousness shall deliver their souls.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Even if I send my four evil punishments, sword and famine and evil beasts and death, upon Jerusalem, to destroy from it man and cattle,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, And if I even send upon Jerusalem my four sore judgments, sword, and famine, and evil beasts, and pestilence, to destroy from out of it man and beast;

fresh_translation: yet behold, survivors are left in it, its rescued ones, who bring out sons and daughters from it. Behold, they come out to you, and you will see their ways and their thoughts, and you will regret the evils that I brought upon Jerusalem, all the evils that I brought upon her.
brenton_translation: yet, behold, there shall be men left in it, the escaped thereof, who shall lead forth of it sons and daughters: behold, they shall go forth to you, and ye shall see their ways and their thoughts: and ye shall mourn over the evils which I have brought upon Jerusalem, even all the evils which I have brought upon it.

fresh_translation: And they will comfort you, because you will see their ways and their thoughts, and you will know that I have not done in vain all that I did in her, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And they shall comfort you, because ye shall see their ways and their thoughts: and ye shall know that I have not done in vain all that I have done in it, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, what might become of the wood of the vine, from all the wood of the branches that are among the trees of the forest?
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man—of all the wood of the branches that are among the trees of the forest, what shall be made of the wood of the vine?

fresh_translation: Will wood be taken from it to make something for work? Will a peg be taken from it to hang any vessel on it?
brenton_translation: Will they take wood of it to make it fit for work? will they take of it a peg to hang any vessel upon it?

fresh_translation: It is only given to the fire for consuming; the fire consumes the yearly pruning from it, and it fails completely. Will it be useful for any work?
brenton_translation: It is only given to the fire to be consumed; the fire consumes that which is yearly pruned of it, and it is utterly gone. Will it be useful for any work?

fresh_translation: Not even while it is still whole will it be useful for any work; much less if fire consumes it completely, will it still be useful for work?
brenton_translation: Not even while it is yet whole will it be useful for any work: if the fire shall have utterly consumed it, will it still be fit for work?

fresh_translation: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: As the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I gave to the fire for consuming, so I have given the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Therefore say,

fresh_translation: And I will set my face against them. From the fire they will go out, and fire will consume them, and they will know that I am the Lord when I set my face against them.
brenton_translation: And I will set my face against them; they shall go forth of the fire, and yet fire shall devour them; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have set my face against them.

fresh_translation: And I will make the land a desolation, because they committed an offense, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will give up the land to ruin, because they have utterly transgressed, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, bear witness to Jerusalem concerning her lawless deeds,
brenton_translation: Son of man, testify to Jerusalem of her iniquities;

fresh_translation: and say, Thus says the Lord to Jerusalem: Your root and your birth are from the land of Canaan; your father was Amorite and your mother Hittite.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say,

fresh_translation: And as for your birth, on the day you were born they did not bind your breasts, and you were not washed in water, nor salted with salt, nor wrapped in swaddling-cloths.
brenton_translation: And as for thy birth in the day wherein thou wast born, thou didst not bind thy breasts, and thou wast not washed in water, neither wast thou salted with salt, neither wast thou swathed in swaddling-bands.

fresh_translation: Nor did my eye spare you, to do one of all these things for you, to feel anything for you, and you were thrown on the face of the plain, because of the crookedness of your soul, on the day you were born.
brenton_translation: Nor did mine eye pity thee, to do for thee one of all these things, to feel at all for thee; but thou wast cast out on the face of the field, because of the deformity of thy person, in the day wherein thou wast born.

fresh_translation: And I passed by you and saw you mixed in your blood, and I said to you, From your blood, life.
brenton_translation: And I passed by to thee, and saw thee polluted in thy blood; and I said to thee, Let there be life out of thy blood:

fresh_translation: Increase; I made you like the growth of the field, and you multiplied and grew great and entered into the cities of cities. Your breasts were raised and your hair sprang up, but you were naked and unseemly.
brenton_translation: increase; I have made thee as the springing grass of the field. So thou didst increase and grow, and didst enter into great cities: thy breasts were set, and thy hair grew, whereas thou wast naked and bare.

fresh_translation: And I passed by you and saw you, and behold, your time, a time of resting. And I spread my wings over you and covered your nakedness and swore to you and entered into covenant with you, says the Lord, and you became mine.
brenton_translation: And I passed by thee and saw thee, and, behold, it was thy time and a time of resting; and I spread my wings over thee, and covered thy shame, and sware to thee: and I entered into covenant with thee, saith the Lord, and thou becamest mine.

fresh_translation: And I washed you with water and washed away your blood from you and anointed you with oil.
brenton_translation: And I washed thee in water, and washed thy blood from thee, and anointed thee with oil.

fresh_translation: And I clothed you with embroidered things and shod you with hyacinth and girded you with fine linen and wrapped you with hair-woven cloth.
brenton_translation: And I clothed thee with embroidered garments, and clothed thee beneath with purple, and girded thee with fine linen, and clothed thee with silk,

fresh_translation: And I adorned you with jewelry and put bracelets on your hands and a necklace around your neck.
brenton_translation: and decked thee also with ornaments, and put bracelets on thine hands, and a necklace on thy neck.

fresh_translation: And I put a nose-ring on your nostril and rings on your ears and a crown of boasting on your head.
brenton_translation: And I put a pendant on thy nostril, and rings in thine ears, and a crown of glory on thine head.

fresh_translation: And you were adorned with gold and silver, and your garments were fine linen and hair-woven and embroidered. You ate fine flour and oil and honey, and you became exceedingly beautiful.
brenton_translation: So thou wast adorned with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and variegated work: thou didst eat fine flour, and oil, and honey, and didst become extremely beautiful.

fresh_translation: And your name went out among the nations because of your beauty, because it was completed in splendor, in the beauty that I set upon you, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thy name went forth among the nations for thy beauty: because it was perfected with elegance, and in the comeliness which I put upon thee, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you trusted in your beauty and whored because of your name and poured out your whoring on every passerby, which should not be.
brenton_translation: Thou didst trust in thy beauty, and didst go a-whoring because of thy renown, and didst pour out thy fornication on every passer by.

fresh_translation: And you took from your garments and made for yourself stitched idols and whored on them, and you shall never enter, nor shall it happen.
brenton_translation: And thou didst take of thy garments, and madest to thyself idols of needlework, and didst go a-whoring after them; therefore thou shalt never come in, nor shall the like take place.

fresh_translation: And you took vessels of your boasting from my gold and my silver, from what I gave you, and made for yourself male images and whored with them.
brenton_translation: And thou tookest thy fair ornaments of my gold and of my silver, of what I gave thee, and thou madest to thyself male images, and thou didst commit whoredom with them.

fresh_translation: And you took your embroidered garment and clothed them, and my oil and my incense you set before them.
brenton_translation: And thou didst take thy variegated apparel and didst clothe them, and thou didst set before them mine oil and mine incense.

fresh_translation: And my breads that I gave you, fine flour and oil and honey with which I fed you, you set before them for fragrant smell, and it happened, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And thou tookest my bread which I gave thee, (yea I fed thee with fine flour and oil and honey) and didst set them before them for a sweet-smelling savour: yea, it was so, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you took your sons and your daughters whom you bore and sacrificed them to them for destruction. You whored as if it were a small thing.
brenton_translation: And thou tookest thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou borest, and didst sacrifice these to them to be destroyed. Thou didst go a-whoring as if that were little,

fresh_translation: And you slaughtered your children and gave them up as you made expiation with them.
brenton_translation: and didst slay thy children, and gavest them up in offering them to them for an expiation.

fresh_translation: This was beyond all your whoring, and you did not remember the days of your infancy, when you were naked and unseemly and lived while mixed in your blood.
brenton_translation: This is beyond all thy fornication, and thou didst not remember thine infancy, when thou wast naked and bare, and didst live though defiled in thy blood.

fresh_translation: And it happened after all your evils, says the Lord,
brenton_translation: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, saith the Lord,

fresh_translation: that you built for yourself a house of prostitution and made for yourself a display-place in every square.
brenton_translation: that thou didst build thyself a house of fornication, and didst make thyself a public place in every street;

fresh_translation: And at the head of every road you built your brothels and ruined your beauty and spread your legs to every passerby and multiplied your whoring.
brenton_translation: and on the head of every way thou didst set up thy fornications, and didst defile thy beauty, and didst open thy feet to every passer by, and didst multiply thy fornication.

fresh_translation: And you whored with the sons of Egypt, your neighbors, great of flesh, and you whored in many ways to provoke me.
brenton_translation: And thou didst go a-whoring after the children of Egypt thy neighbours, great of flesh; and didst go a-whoring often to provoke me to anger.

fresh_translation: And if I stretch out my hand against you and remove your statutes and hand you over to the souls of those hating you, daughters of foreigners, who turned you aside from your way in which you acted impiously,
brenton_translation: And if I stretch out my hand against thee, then will I abolish thy statutes, and deliver thee up to the wills of them that hate thee, even to the daughters of the Philistines that turned thee aside from the way wherein thou sinnedst.

fresh_translation: then you whored with daughters of Assyria, and not even thus were you satisfied, and you whored, and still were not filled.
brenton_translation: And thou didst go a-whoring to the daughters of Assur, and not even thus wast thou satisfied; yea, thou didst go a-whoring, and wast not satisfied.

fresh_translation: And you multiplied your covenants toward the land of the Chaldeans, and not even with these were you satisfied.
brenton_translation: And thou didst multiply thy covenants with the land of the Chaldeans; and not even with these wast thou satisfied.

fresh_translation: What shall I do with your daughter, says the Lord, when you do all these works of a prostitute woman, and you whored threefold?
brenton_translation: Why should I make a covenant with thy daughter, saith the Lord, while thou doest all these things, the works of a harlot? and thou hast gone a-whoring in a threefold degree with thy daughters.

fresh_translation: Among your daughters you built your brothel at the head of every road and made your base in every square, and you became like a prostitute gathering wages.
brenton_translation: Thou hast built a house of harlotry in every top of a way, and hast set up thine high place in every street; and thou didst become as a harlot gathering hires.

fresh_translation: The adulterous woman is like you, taking wages from her husband.
brenton_translation: An adulteress resembles thee, taking rewards of her husband.

fresh_translation: She gave wages to all those who prostituted her, but you gave wages to all your lovers and loaded them down to come to you from all around in your whoring.
brenton_translation: She has even given rewards to all that went a-whoring after her, and thou hast given rewards to all thy lovers, yea, thou didst load them with rewards, that they should come to thee from every side for thy fornication.

fresh_translation: And in you there came to be perversity beyond the women in your whoring: they whored with you when you gave wages, and wages were not given to you, and perverse things came to be in you.
brenton_translation: And there has happened in thee perverseness in thy fornication beyond other women, and they have committed fornication with thee, in that thou givest hires over and above, and hires were not given to thee; and thus perverseness happened in thee.

fresh_translation: Therefore, whore, hear the word of the Lord.
brenton_translation: Therefore, harlot, hear the word of the Lord:

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Because you poured out your bronze, and your shame will be uncovered in your whoring toward your lovers and toward all the thoughts of your lawless deeds and in the blood of your children whom you gave to them,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord, Because thou hast poured forth thy money, therefore thy shame shall be discovered in thy harlotry with thy lovers, and with regard to all the imaginations of thine iniquities, and for the blood of thy children which thou hast given to them.

fresh_translation: therefore behold, I gather all your lovers with whom you mixed, and all whom you loved, with all whom you hated, and I will gather them against you from all around and uncover your evils before them, and they will see all your shame.
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, I will gather all thy lovers with whom thou hast consorted, and all whom thou hast loved, with all whom thou didst hate; and I will gather them against thee round about, and will expose thy wickedness to them, and they shall see all thy shame.

fresh_translation: And I will avenge you with the vengeance of adulteress and one shedding blood, and I will set you in the blood of wrath and jealousy.
brenton_translation: And I will be avenged on thee with the vengeance of an adulteress, and I will bring upon thee blood of fury and jealousy.

fresh_translation: And I will hand you over into their hands, and they will tear down your brothel and pull down your base and strip you of your garment and take vessels of your boasting and leave you naked and unseemly.
brenton_translation: And I will deliver thee into their hands, and they shall break down thy house of harlotry, and destroy thine high place; and they shall strip thee of thy garments, and shall take thy proud ornaments, and leave thee naked and bare.

fresh_translation: And they will bring crowds against you and stone you with stones and butcher you with their swords.
brenton_translation: And they shall bring multitudes upon thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and pierce thee with their swords.

fresh_translation: And they will burn your houses with fire and do vengeance on you before many women, and I will turn you from your whoring, and you will give wages no longer.
brenton_translation: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and shall execute vengeance on thee in the sight of many women: and I will turn thee back from harlotry, and I will no more give thee rewards.

fresh_translation: And I will let my wrath rest on you and my jealousy will depart from you, and I will rest and no longer be troubled.
brenton_translation: So will I slacken my fury against thee, and my jealousy shall be removed from thee, and I will rest, and be no more careful for thee.

fresh_translation: Because you did not remember the day of your infancy and grieved me in all these things, behold, I also have put your ways on your head, says the Lord, and so you did impiety on top of all your lawless deeds.
brenton_translation: Because thou didst not remember thine infancy, and thou didst grieve me in all these things; therefore, behold, I have recompensed thy ways upon thine head, saith the Lord: for thus hast thou wrought ungodliness above all thine other iniquities.

fresh_translation: These are all the things they spoke against you in a proverb, saying, Like mother, like daughter.
brenton_translation: These are all the things they have spoken against thee in a proverb, saying,

fresh_translation: You are daughter of your mother, who rejected her husband and her children, and sister of your sisters, who rejected their husbands and their children. Your mother was Hittite, and your father was Amorite.
brenton_translation: As is the mother, so is thy mother's daughter: thou art she that has rejected her husband and her children; and the sisters of thy sisters have rejected their husbands and their children: your mother was a Chettite, and your father an Amorite.

fresh_translation: Your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters dwelling on your left, and your younger sister dwelling on your right is Sodom and her daughters.
brenton_translation: Your elder sister who dwells on thy left hand is Samaria, she and her daughters: and thy younger sister, that dwells on thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

fresh_translation: And not in their ways did you walk, nor did you act according to their lawless deeds. It was a small thing, and you surpassed them in all your ways.
brenton_translation: Yet notwithstanding thou hast not walked in their ways, neither hast thou done according to their iniquities within a little, but thou hast exceeded them in all thy ways.

fresh_translation: As I live, says the Lord, Sodom your sister and her daughters did not do as you and your daughters did.
brenton_translation: As I live, saith the Lord, this Sodom and her daughters have not done as thou and thy daughters have done.

fresh_translation: Except this was the lawlessness of Sodom your sister: pride, fullness of bread, and abundance of wine belonged to her and her daughters, and they did not support the hand of the poor and needy.
brenton_translation: Moreover this was the sin of thy sister Sodom, pride: she and her daughters lived in pleasure, in fulness of bread and in abundance: this belonged to her and her daughters, and they helped not the hand of the poor and needy.

fresh_translation: And they were boasting and did lawless things before me, and I removed them as I saw.
brenton_translation: And they boasted, and wrought iniquities before me: so I cut them off as I saw fit.

fresh_translation: And Samaria did not sin according to half of your sins, and you multiplied your lawless deeds beyond them and justified your sisters by all your lawless deeds that you did.
brenton_translation: Also Samaria has not sinned according to half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine iniquities beyond them, and thou hast justified thy sisters in all thine iniquities which thou hast committed.

fresh_translation: And you bear your torment, because you corrupted your sisters with your sins by which you acted more lawlessly than they, and you justified them beyond yourself. And you, be ashamed and receive your dishonor in justifying your sisters.
brenton_translation: Thou therefore bear thy punishment, for that thou hast corrupted thy sisters by thy sins which thou hast committed beyond them; and thou hast made them appear more righteous than thyself: thou therefore be ashamed, and bear thy dishonour, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

fresh_translation: And I will turn back their turning back, the turning back of Sodom and her daughters, and I will turn back the turning back of Samaria and her daughters, and I will turn back your turning back in their midst,
brenton_translation: And I will turn their captivity, even the captivity of Sodom and her daughters; and I will turn the captivity of Samaria and her daughters; and I will turn thy captivity in the midst of them:

fresh_translation: so that you bear your torment and be dishonored for everything you did in provoking me.
brenton_translation: that thou mayest bear thy punishment, and be dishonoured for all that thou hast done in provoking me to anger.

fresh_translation: And your sister Sodom and her daughters will be restored as they were from the beginning, and Samaria and her daughters will be restored as they were from the beginning, and you and your daughters will be restored as you were from the beginning.
brenton_translation: And thy sister Sodom and her daughters shall be restored as they were at the beginning, and thou and thy daughters shall be restored as ye were at the beginning.

fresh_translation: And Sodom your sister was not mentioned in your mouth in the days of your pride,
brenton_translation: And surely thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the days of thy pride:

fresh_translation: before your evils were uncovered, as now you are a reproach of the daughters of Syria and of all those around her, daughters of foreigners encircling you around,
brenton_translation: before thy wickedness was discovered, even now thou art the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all that are round about her, even of the daughters of the Philistines that compass thee round about.

fresh_translation: your impieties and your lawless deeds, you yourself have borne them, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: As for thine ungodliness and thine iniquities, thou hast borne them, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: I will act in you as you acted, as you dishonored these things by transgressing my covenant.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; I will even do to thee as thou hast done, as thou hast dealt shamefully in these things to transgress my covenant.

fresh_translation: And I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your infancy and raise up for you an everlasting covenant.
brenton_translation: And I will remember my covenant made with thee in the days of thine infancy, and I will establish to thee an everlasting covenant.

fresh_translation: And you will remember your way and be utterly dishonored when you receive your older sisters with your younger ones, and I will give them to you for building, and not from your covenant.
brenton_translation: Then thou shalt remember thy way, and shalt be utterly dishonoured when thou receivest thine elder sisters with thy younger ones: and I will give them to thee for building up, but not by thy covenant.

fresh_translation: And I will raise my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the Lord,
brenton_translation: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord:

fresh_translation: so that you remember and be ashamed and no longer have it in you to open your mouth because of your dishonor, when I make propitiation for you according to all that you did, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: that thou mayest remember, and be ashamed, and mayest no more be able to open thy mouth for thy shame, when I am reconciled to thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, tell a tale and speak a parable to the house of Israel,
brenton_translation: Son of man, relate a tale, and speak a parable to the house of Israel:

fresh_translation: and say, Thus says the Lord: The great eagle, large-winged, long in spread, full of claws, having power to enter Lebanon, came and took the choice things of the cedar.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord;

fresh_translation: He clipped off the tips of its tenderness and brought them into the land of Canaan; in a fortified city he set them.
brenton_translation: he cropped off the ends of the tender twigs, and brought them into the land of Chanaan; he laid them up in a walled city.

fresh_translation: And he took from the seed of the land and put it in the open field, a plant by much water; under watch he set it.
brenton_translation: And he took of the seed of the land, and sowed it in a field planted by much water; he set it in a conspicuous place.

fresh_translation: And it sprang up and became a vine, weak and small in size, with its branches appearing upon it and its roots beneath it, and it became a vine and made shoots and sent out its tendril-growth.
brenton_translation: And it sprang up, and became a weak and little vine, so that the branches thereof appeared upon it, and its roots were under it: and it became a vine, and put forth shoots, and sent forth its tendrils.

fresh_translation: And there was another great eagle, large-winged and many-clawed, and behold, this vine was entwined toward him, and its roots toward him, and its branches it sent out toward him so that he might water it with the clod of its planting.
brenton_translation: And there was another great eagle, with great wings and many claws: and, behold, this vine bent itself round toward him, and her roots were turned towards him, and she sent forth her branches towards him, that he might water her together with the growth of her plantation.

fresh_translation: In a good field by much water it fattens, to make shoots and bear fruit, to become a great vine.
brenton_translation: She thrives in a fair field by much water, to produce shoots and bear fruit, that she might become a great vine.

fresh_translation: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: Will it prosper? Will not its tender roots and its fruit rot, and all its first sproutings dry up? Not with great arm, nor with many people, to pull it from its roots.
brenton_translation: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord; Shall it prosper? shall not the roots of her tender stem and her fruit be blighted? yea, all her early shoots shall be dried up, and that not by a mighty arm, nor by many people, to tear her up from her roots.

fresh_translation: And behold, it fattens. Will it prosper? Will it not dry in drought as soon as the scorching wind touches it? With the clod of its growth it will dry up.
brenton_translation: And, behold, it thrives: shall it prosper? shall it not wither as soon as the east wind touches it? it shall be withered together with the growth of its shoots.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, now say to the provoking house, Do you not understand what these things were? Say, When the king of Babylon comes against Jerusalem and takes its king and its rulers and brings them to himself in Babylon,
brenton_translation: Son of man, say now to the provoking house, Know ye not what these things were? say to them, Whenever the king of Babylon shall come against Jerusalem, then he shall take her king and her princes, and shall take them home to Babylon.

fresh_translation: then he will take from the seed of the kingdom and make a covenant with him and bring him under a curse, and he will take the leaders of the land,
brenton_translation: And he shall take of the seed royal, and shall make a covenant with him, and shall bind him with an oath: and he shall take the princes of the land:

fresh_translation: that the kingdom may become weak, not lifting itself up at all, but keeping his covenant and standing by it.
brenton_translation: that it may become a weak kingdom, so as never to lift itself up, that he may keep his covenant, and establish it.

fresh_translation: But he will rebel against him by sending his own messengers into Egypt, so that it might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will the one acting as an adversary and transgressing the covenant be saved?
brenton_translation: And if he shall revolt from him, to send his messengers into Egypt, that they may give him horses and much people; shall he prosper? shall he that acts as an adversary be preserved? and shall he that transgresses the covenant be preserved?

fresh_translation: As I live, says the Lord, surely in the place of the king who made him king, who dishonored my oath and who transgressed my covenant with him, in the midst of Babylon he will die.
brenton_translation: As I live, saith the Lord, verily in the same place where the king is that made him king, who dishonoured my oath, and who broke my covenant, shall he die with him in the midst of Babylon.

fresh_translation: And Pharaoh will not make war for him with great force nor with a great crowd, by casting up a trench and building missile-stations, to cut off lives.
brenton_translation: And Pharao shall make war upon him not with a large force or great multitude, in throwing up a mound, and in building of forts, to cut off souls.

fresh_translation: And he dishonored an oath by transgressing a covenant, and behold, he gave his hand and did all these things. He will not be saved.
brenton_translation: Whereas he has profaned the oath so as to break the covenant, when, behold, I engaged his hand, and he has done all these things to him, he shall not escape.

fresh_translation: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: As I live, surely my covenant that he transgressed and my oath that he dishonored, I will put them on his head.
brenton_translation: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord; As I live, surely mine oath which he has profaned, and my covenant which he has transgressed, I will even recompense it upon his head.

fresh_translation: And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in its enclosure.
brenton_translation: And I will spread a net upon him, and he shall be caught in its snare.

fresh_translation: In all his battle line they will fall by sword, and those left I will scatter to every wind, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken.
brenton_translation: In every battle of his they shall fall by the sword, and I will scatter his remnant to every wind: and ye shall know that I the Lord have spoken it.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord: I myself will take from the choice things of the cedar, from the top of their heart I will clip off and plant it upon a high mountain and hang it there.
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord; I will even take of the choice branches of the cedar from the top thereof, I will crop off their hearts, and I will plant it on a high mountain:

fresh_translation: On a high mountain of Israel I will plant it, and it will bring forth a shoot and make fruit and become a great cedar, and every beast and every bird will rest beneath it; in its shade its branches will be restored.
brenton_translation: and I will hang it on a lofty mountain of Israel: yea, I will plant it, and it shall put forth shoots, and shall bear fruit, and it shall be a great cedar: and every bird shall rest beneath it, even every fowl shall rest under its shadow: its branches shall be restored.

fresh_translation: And all the trees of the field will know that I am the Lord, humbling the high tree and exalting the low tree and drying the green tree and making the dry tree flourish. I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it.
brenton_translation: And all the trees of the field shall know that I am the Lord that bring low the high tree, and exalt the low tree, and wither the green tree, and cause the dry tree to flourish: I the Lord have spoken, and will do it.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, what is this proverb for you among the sons of Israel, saying, The fathers ate an unripe grape, and the teeth of the children were set on edge?
brenton_translation: Son of man, what mean ye by this parable among the children of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten unripe grapes, and the children's teeth have been set on edge?

fresh_translation: As I live, says the Lord, this proverb will no longer be spoken in Israel.
brenton_translation: As I live, saith the Lord, surely this parable shall no more be spoken in Israel.

fresh_translation: Because all the souls are mine. As the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son, they are mine. The soul that sins, it will die.
brenton_translation: For all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son, they are mine: the soul that sins, it shall die.

fresh_translation: And the man who is righteous, who does judgment and righteousness,
brenton_translation: But the man who shall be just, who executes judgment and righteousness,

fresh_translation: will not eat on the mountains and will not lift his eyes to the thoughts of the house of Israel, and will not defile the wife of his neighbor, and will not approach a woman in her monthly flow.
