brenton_translation: who shall not eat upon the mountains, and shall not at all lift up his eyes to the devices of the house of Israel, and shall not defile his neighbour's wife, and shall not draw nigh to her that is removed,

fresh_translation: And he will not oppress a man; he will return the pledge of a debtor and will not seize plunder; he will give his bread to the hungry one and clothe the naked one.
brenton_translation: and shall not oppress any man, but shall return the pledge of the debtor, and shall be guilty of no plunder, shall give his bread to the hungry, and clothe the naked;

fresh_translation: And he will not give his money on interest, nor take excess, and he will turn his hand away from injustice; he will do righteous judgment between a man and his neighbor.
brenton_translation: and shall not lend his money upon usury, and shall not receive usurious increase, and shall turn back his hand from injustice, shall execute righteous judgment between a man and his neighbour,

fresh_translation: And he has walked in my ordinances and kept my judgments to do them. This one is righteous; living he will live, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: and has walked in my commandments and kept mine ordinances, to do them; he is righteous, he shall surely live, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if he fathers a violent son, shedding blood and committing sins,
brenton_translation: And if he beget a mischievous son, shedding blood and committing sins,

fresh_translation: who did not walk in the way of his righteous father, but also ate on the mountains and defiled the wife of his neighbor,
brenton_translation: who has not walked in the way of his righteous father, but has even eaten upon the mountains, and has defiled his neighbour's wife,

fresh_translation: and oppressed the poor and needy and seized plunder and did not return the pledge, and set his eyes on the idols and did lawlessness,
brenton_translation: and has oppressed the poor and needy, and has committed robbery, and not restored a pledge, and has set his eyes upon idols, has wrought iniquities,

fresh_translation: and gave with interest and took excess. Will this one live? He will not live. He did all these lawless deeds; by death he will be put to death. His blood will be upon him.
brenton_translation: has lent upon usury, and taken usurious increase; he shall by no means live: he has wrought all these iniquities; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

fresh_translation: And if he fathers a son and he sees all the sins of his father that he did and fears and does not do according to them,
brenton_translation: And if he beget a son, and the son see all his father's sins which he has wrought, and fear, and not do according to them,

fresh_translation: he has not eaten on the mountains and has not set his eyes on the thoughts of the house of Israel and has not defiled the wife of his neighbor,
brenton_translation: and if he has not eaten on the mountains, and has not set his eyes on the devices of the house of Israel, and has not defiled his neighbour's wife,

fresh_translation: and has not oppressed a man and has not taken a pledge and has not seized plunder; he gave his bread to the hungry one and clothed the naked one,
brenton_translation: and has not oppressed a man, and has not retained the pledge, nor committed robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has clothed the naked,

fresh_translation: and turned his hand away from injustice; he did not take interest or excess, and did righteousness and walked in my ordinances. This one will not die in the injustices of his father; living he will live.
brenton_translation: and has turned back his hand from unrighteousness, has not received interest or usurious increase, has wrought righteousness, and walked in mine ordinances; he shall not die for the iniquities of his father, he shall surely live.

fresh_translation: But his father, if he oppressed with oppression and seized plunder and did contrary things in the midst of my people, he will die in his injustice.
brenton_translation: But if his father grievously afflict, or plunder, he has wrought enmity in the midst of my people, and shall die in his iniquity.

fresh_translation: And you will say, Why has the son not borne the injustice of his father? Because the son did righteousness and mercy and kept all my ordinances and did them; living he will live.
brenton_translation: But ye will say, Why has not the son borne the iniquity of the father? Because the son has wrought judgment and mercy, has kept all my statutes, and done them, he shall surely live.

fresh_translation: And the soul sinning will die, but a son will not bear the injustice of his father, nor will a father bear the injustice of his son. The righteousness of a righteous one will be upon him, and the lawlessness of a lawless one will be upon him.
brenton_translation: But the soul that sins shall die: and the son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, nor shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the iniquity of the transgressor shall be upon him.

fresh_translation: And if the lawless one turns from all his lawless deeds that he did and keeps all my commandments and does righteousness and mercy, living he will live; he will not die.
brenton_translation: And if the transgressor turn away from all his iniquities which he has committed, and keep all my commandments, and do justice and mercy, he shall surely live, and shall by no means die.

fresh_translation: None of all his trespasses that he did will be remembered; in his righteousness that he did he will live.
brenton_translation: None of his trespasses which he has committed shall be remembered: in his righteousness which he has done he shall live.

fresh_translation: Do I at all desire the death of the lawless one, says the Lord, rather than that he turn from the evil way and live?
brenton_translation: Shall I at all desire the death of the sinner, saith the Lord, as I desire that he should turn from his evil way, and live?

fresh_translation: But when a righteous one turns from his righteousness and does injustice, according to all the lawless deeds that the lawless one did, none of his righteous deeds that he did will be remembered. In his trespass by which he trespassed and in his sins by which he sinned, in them he will die.
brenton_translation: But when the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, according to all the transgressions which the transgressor has wrought, none of his righteousness which he has wrought shall be at all remembered: in his trespass wherein he has trespassed, and in his sins wherein he has sinned, in them shall he die.

fresh_translation: And you said, The way of the Lord is not straight. Hear now, all the house of Israel: Is my way not straight? Is it not your way that is not straight?
brenton_translation: Yet ye have said, The way of the Lord is not straight. Hear now, all the house of Israel; will not my way be straight? Is your way straight?

fresh_translation: When the righteous one turns from his righteousness and does trespass and dies, in the trespass that he did, in it he will die.
brenton_translation: When the righteous turns away from his righteousness and commits a trespass, and dies in the trespass which he has committed, he shall even die in it.

fresh_translation: And when the lawless one turns from the lawlessness that he committed and does judgment and righteousness, this one has preserved his soul.
brenton_translation: And when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and shall do judgment and justice, he has kept his soul,

fresh_translation: And he turned away from all his impieties that he did; living he will live; he will not die.
brenton_translation: and has turned away from all his ungodliness which he has committed: he shall surely live, he shall not die.

fresh_translation: And the house of Israel says, The way of the Lord is not right. Is my way not right, house of Israel? Is it not your way that is not right?
brenton_translation: Yet the house of Israel say, The way of the Lord is not right. Is not my way right, O house of Israel? is not your way wrong?

fresh_translation: I will judge each one of you according to his way, house of Israel, says the Lord. Turn back and turn away from all your impieties, and they will not become to you a punishment of injustice.
brenton_translation: I will judge you, O house of Israel, saith the Lord, each one according to his way: be converted, and turn from all your ungodliness, and it shall not become to you the punishment of iniquity.

fresh_translation: Throw away from yourselves all your impieties by which you acted impiously against me, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. And why are you dying, house of Israel?
brenton_translation: Cast away from yourselves all your ungodliness wherein ye have sinned against me; and make to yourselves a new heart and a new spirit: for why should ye die, O house of Israel?

fresh_translation: Because I do not want the death of the one dying, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: For I desire not the death of him that dies, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you, take lamentation for the ruler of Israel,
brenton_translation: Moreover do thou take up a lamentation for the prince of Israel,

fresh_translation: and say, What was your mother? A lioness among lions she became; in the midst of lions she multiplied her cubs.
brenton_translation: and say, Why is thy mother become a whelp in the midst of lions? in the midst of lions she has multiplied her whelps.

fresh_translation: And one of her cubs leapt up; he became a lion and learned to seize plunder; he ate men.
brenton_translation: And one of her whelps sprang forth; he became a lion, and learned to take prey, he devoured men.

fresh_translation: And nations heard about him; in their corruption he was caught, and they brought him with a bridle into the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: And the nations heard a report of him; he was caught in their pit, and they brought him into the land of Egypt in chains.

fresh_translation: And she saw that he was driven from her and her expectation perished, and she took another from her cubs and appointed him as a lion.
brenton_translation: And she saw that he was driven away from her, and her hope of him perished, and she took another of her whelps; she made him a lion.

fresh_translation: And he prowled in the midst of lions; he became a lion and learned to seize plunder; he ate men.
brenton_translation: And he went up and down in the midst of lions, he became a lion, and learned to take prey, he devoured men.

fresh_translation: And he prowled in his daring and laid waste their cities and desolated the land and its fullness by the sound of his roar.
brenton_translation: And he prowled in his boldness and laid waste their cities, and made the land desolate, and the fulness of it, by the voice of his roaring.

fresh_translation: And nations from countries around set themselves against him and spread their nets over him; in their corruption he was caught.
brenton_translation: Then the nations set upon him from the countries round about, and they spread their nets upon him: he was taken in their pit.

fresh_translation: And they put him in a bridle and in a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon and led him into prison, so that his voice might no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.
brenton_translation: And they put him in chains and in a cage, and he came to the king of Babylon; and he cast him into prison, that his voice should not be heard on the mountains of Israel.

fresh_translation: Your mother was like a vine, like a blossom on a pomegranate, planted by water; her fruit and her shoot came from much water.
brenton_translation: Thy mother was as a vine and as a blossom on a pomegranate tree, planted by water: her fruit and her shoots abounded by reason of much water.

fresh_translation: And she had a rod of strength for a tribe of rulers, and she was exalted in her size in the midst of stems, and she saw her size in the multitude of her branches.
brenton_translation: And she became a rod for a tribe of princes, and was elevated in her bulk in the midst of other trees, and she saw her bulk in the multitude of her branches.

fresh_translation: And she was broken in wrath and cast onto the ground, and the scorching wind dried her chosen things; her rod of strength was avenged and dried up; fire consumed her.
brenton_translation: But she was broken down in wrath, she was cast upon the ground, and the east wind dried up her choice branches: vengeance came upon them, and the rod of her strength was withered; fire consumed it.

fresh_translation: And now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a waterless land.
brenton_translation: And now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a dry land.

fresh_translation: And fire went out from a rod of her chosen ones and devoured her, and there was no rod of strength in her, a tribe for a parable of lamentation. It is lamentation and will be for lamentation.
brenton_translation: And fire is gone out of a rod of her choice boughs, and has devoured her; and there was no rod of strength in her. Her race is become a parable of lamentation, and it shall be for a lamentation.

fresh_translation: And it happened in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, men from the elders of the house of Israel came to inquire of the Lord and sat before me.
brenton_translation: And it came to pass in the seventh year, on the fifteenth day of the month, there came men of the elders of the house of Israel to enquire of the Lord, and they sat before me.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, Thus says the Lord: Is it to inquire of me that you come? As I live, I will not answer you, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: Son of man, speak to the elders of the house of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, I will not be enquired of by you, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Will I avenge them with vengeance, son of man? Bear witness to them concerning the lawless deeds of their fathers.
brenton_translation: Shall I utterly take vengeance on them, son of man? testify to them of the iniquities of their fathers:

fresh_translation: And say to them, Thus says the Lord: From the day I chose the house of Israel and made myself known to the seed of the house of Jacob and was known to them in the land of Egypt and took hold of them with my hand, saying, I am the Lord your God,
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord;

fresh_translation: on that day I took hold of them with my hand to bring them out from the land of Egypt into the land that I prepared for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, a honeycomb beyond every land.
brenton_translation: in that day I helped them with my hand, to bring them out of the land of Egypt into the land which I prepared for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, it is abundant beyond every land.

fresh_translation: And I said to them, Let each one cast away the abominations of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the practices of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: And I said to them, Let every one cast away the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the devices of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And they rebelled against me and did not want to listen to me. They did not cast away the abominations of their eyes, and they did not leave behind the practices of Egypt, and I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to complete my anger in them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: But they revolted from me, and would not hearken to me: they cast not away the abominations of their eyes, and forsook not the devices of Egypt: then I said that I would pour out my wrath upon them, to accomplish my wrath upon them in the midst of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And I acted so that my name might not at all be profaned before the nations among whom they were, among whom I was made known to them before them, to bring them out from the land of Egypt.
brenton_translation: But I wrought so that my name should not be at all profaned in the sight of the Gentiles, in the midst of whom they are, among whom I was made known to them in their sight, to bring them out of the land of Egypt.

fresh_translation: And I brought them out from the land of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.
brenton_translation: And I brought them into the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And I gave them my ordinances, and my judgments I made known to them, which if a man does them, he will live in them.
brenton_translation: And I gave them my commandments, and made known to them mine ordinances, all which if a man shall do, he shall even live in them.

fresh_translation: And my Sabbaths I gave them, to be a sign between me and them, so that they might know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
brenton_translation: And I gave them my sabbaths, that they should be for a sign between me and them, that they should know that I am the Lord that sanctify them.

fresh_translation: And I said to the house of Israel in the wilderness, Walk in my ordinances, yet they did not walk, and they rejected my judgments, which if a man does them, he will live in them, and they greatly profaned my Sabbaths, and I said I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness to consume them.
brenton_translation: And I said to the house of Israel in the wilderness, Walk ye in my commandments: but they walked not in them, and they rejected mine ordinances, which if a man shall do, he shall even live in them; and they grievously profaned my sabbaths: and I said that I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

fresh_translation: And I acted so that my name might not at all be profaned before the nations from whom I brought them out before their eyes.
brenton_translation: But I wrought so that my name should not be at all profaned before the Gentiles, before whose eyes I brought them out.

fresh_translation: And I lifted my hand against them in the wilderness, not at all to bring them into the land that I gave them, a land flowing with milk and honey, a honeycomb beyond every land,
brenton_translation: But I lifted up my hand against them in the wilderness once for all, that I would not bring them into the land which I gave them, a land flowing with milk and honey, it is sweeter than all lands:

fresh_translation: because they rejected my judgments and did not walk in my ordinances and profaned my Sabbaths, and they went after the thoughts of their hearts.
brenton_translation: because they rejected mine ordinances, and walked not in my commandments, but profaned my sabbaths, and went after the imaginations of their hearts.

fresh_translation: And my eye spared them so as not to wipe them out, and I did not make a full end of them in the wilderness.
brenton_translation: Yet mine eyes spared them, so as not to destroy them utterly, and I did not make an end of them in the wilderness.

fresh_translation: And I said to their children in the wilderness, Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, and do not keep their judgments, and do not mix yourselves with their practices, and do not defile yourselves.
brenton_translation: And I said to their children in the wilderness, Walk not ye in the customs of your fathers, and keep not their ordinances, and have no fellowship with their practices, nor defile yourselves with them.

fresh_translation: I am the Lord your God. Walk in my ordinances, and keep my judgments and do them,
brenton_translation: I am the Lord your God; walk in my commandments, and keep mine ordinances, and do them;

fresh_translation: and sanctify my Sabbaths, and let them be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am the Lord your God.
brenton_translation: and hallow my sabbaths, and let them be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the Lord your God.

fresh_translation: And their children provoked me. They did not walk in my ordinances, and they did not keep my judgments to do them, which if a man does them, he will live in them, and they profaned my Sabbaths, and I said I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness to complete my anger upon them.
brenton_translation: But they provoked me, and their children walked not in my commandments, and they took no heed to mine ordinances to do them, which if a man shall do, he shall even live in them, and they profaned my sabbaths: then I said that I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness, to accomplish mine anger upon them.

fresh_translation: And I acted so that my name might not at all be profaned before the nations from whom I brought them out before their eyes.
brenton_translation: But I wrought so that my name might not be at all profaned before the Gentiles; and I brought them out in their sight.

fresh_translation: And I lifted my hand against them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and disperse them in the lands,
brenton_translation: I lifted up my hand against them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the Gentiles, and disperse them in the countries;

fresh_translation: because they did not do my judgments and rejected my ordinances and profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after the thoughts of their fathers.
brenton_translation: because they kept not mine ordinances, and rejected my commandments, and profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes went after the imaginations of their fathers.

fresh_translation: And I also gave them ordinances that were not good and judgments in which they will not live.
brenton_translation: So I gave them commandments that were not good, and ordinances in which they should not live.

fresh_translation: And I defiled them with their gifts, when I caused every opener of the womb to pass through, so that I might destroy them.
brenton_translation: And I will defile them by their own decrees, when I pass through upon every one that opens the womb, that I may destroy them.

fresh_translation: Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, Thus says the Lord: Thus far your fathers provoked me in their trespasses by which they trespassed against me.
brenton_translation: Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord: Hitherto have your fathers provoked me in their trespasses in which they transgressed against me.

fresh_translation: And I brought them into the land about which I lifted my hand to give it to them, and they saw every high hill and every shady tree and there they sacrificed to their gods and set there a fragrant smell and poured out there their drink offerings.
brenton_translation: Whereas I brought them into the land concerning which I lifted up mine hand to give it them; and they looked upon every high hill, and every shady tree, and they sacrificed there to their gods, and offered there a sweet-smelling savour, and there they poured out their drink-offerings.

fresh_translation: And I said to them, What is Bamah, that you enter there? And its name was called Bamah until this day.
brenton_translation: And I said to them, What is Abama, that ye go in thither? and they called its name Abama, until this day.

fresh_translation: Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord: Are you defiling yourselves in the lawless deeds of your fathers, and after their abominations are you whoring?
brenton_translation: Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord, Do ye pollute yourselves with the iniquities of your fathers, and do ye go a-whoring after their abominations,

fresh_translation: And in the firstfruits of your gifts, in your separations, you are defiling yourselves in all your thoughts until this day, and shall I answer you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord, I will not answer you. And as for this that rises upon your spirit,
brenton_translation: and do ye pollute yourselves with the first-fruits of your gifts, in the offerings wherewith ye pollute yourselves in all your imaginations, until this day; and shall I answer you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord, I will not answer you, neither shall this thing come upon your spirit.

fresh_translation: it will not be in the way that you say, We will be like the nations and like the tribes of the earth, serving wood and stone.
brenton_translation: And it shall not be as ye say, We will be as the nations, and as the tribes of the earth, to worship stocks and stones.

fresh_translation: Therefore as I live, says the Lord, with a strong hand and an uplifted arm and wrath poured out I will reign over you.
brenton_translation: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord, I will reign over you with a strong hand, and with a high arm, and with outpoured wrath:

fresh_translation: And I will bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the lands where you were scattered, with a strong hand and an uplifted arm and wrath poured out.
brenton_translation: I will bring you out from the nations, and will take you out of the lands wherein ye were dispersed, with a strong hand, and with a high arm, and with outpoured wrath.

fresh_translation: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples and judge with you there face to face.
brenton_translation: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, and will plead with you there face to face.

fresh_translation: As I judged with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: As I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I judge you, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And I will bring you under my rod and bring you in by number.
brenton_translation: And I will cause you to pass under my rod, and I will bring you in by number.

fresh_translation: And I will pick out from you the impious ones and the rebels, because I will bring them out from their sojourning, but into the land of Israel they will not enter, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will separate from among you the ungodly and the revolters; for I will lead them forth out of their place of sojourning, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the Lord, even the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you, house of Israel, thus says the Lord God: Each one, remove his practices, and after these things, if you do not listen to me, you will no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and with your practices.
brenton_translation: And as to you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord, even the Lord; Put away each one his evil practices, and hereafter if ye hearken to me, then shall ye no more profane my holy name by your gifts and by devices.

fresh_translation: Because on my holy mountain, on a high mountain, says the Lord God, there all the house of Israel, to the end, will serve me, and there I will receive you, and there I will visit your firstfruits and the firstfruits of your separations in all your holy things.
brenton_translation: For upon my holy mountain, on the high mountain, saith the Lord, even the Lord, there shall all the house of Israel serve me for ever: and there will I accept you, and there will I have respect to your first-fruits, and the first-fruits of your offerings, in all your holy things.

fresh_translation: In a fragrant aroma I will receive you, when I bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the lands in which you were scattered, and I will be sanctified in you before the eyes of the peoples.
brenton_translation: I will accept you with a sweet-smelling savour, when I bring you out from the nations, and take you out of the countries wherein ye have been dispersed; and I will be sanctified among you in the sight of the nations.

fresh_translation: And you will know that I am the Lord when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the land concerning which I lifted my hand to give it to your fathers.
brenton_translation: And ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I have brought you into the land of Israel, into the land concerning which I lifted up my hand to give it to your fathers.

fresh_translation: And there you will remember your ways and your practices by which you defiled yourselves, and you will strike your faces over all your evils.
brenton_translation: And ye shall there remember your ways, and your devices wherewith ye defiled yourselves; and ye shall bewail yourselves for all your wickedness.

fresh_translation: And you will know that I am the Lord when I act thus toward you, so that my name may not be profaned, not according to your evil ways and not according to your corrupt practices, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: And ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I have done thus to you, that my name may not be profaned in your evil ways, and in your corrupt devices, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, set your face toward Teman and look toward Darom and prophesy against the leading forest of Negeb.
brenton_translation: Son of man, set thy face against Thæman, and look toward Darom, and prophesy against the chief forest of Nageb,

fresh_translation: And say to the forest of Negeb, Hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I kindle fire in you, and it will devour in you every green tree and every dry tree. The kindled flame will not be quenched, and every face from the east to the north will be burned in it.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say to the forest of Nageb, Hear the word of the Lord; thus saith the Lord, even the Lord; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour in thee every green tree, and every dry tree: the flame that is kindled shall not be quenched, and every face shall be scorched with it from the south to the north.

fresh_translation: And all flesh will know that I, the Lord, kindled it, and it will not be quenched.
brenton_translation: And all flesh shall know that I the Lord have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.

fresh_translation: And I said, By no means, Lord, Lord. They say to me, Is this not a parable being spoken?
brenton_translation: And I said, Not so, O Lord God! they say to me, Is not this that is spoken a parable?

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Therefore prophesy, son of man, and set your face toward Jerusalem and look toward their holy places, and you will prophesy against the land of Israel.
brenton_translation: Therefore prophesy, son of man, set thy face steadfastly toward Jerusalem, and look toward their holy places, and thou shalt prophesy against the land of Israel,

fresh_translation: And you will say to the land of Israel, Behold, I am against you, and I will draw my dagger from its sheath and destroy from you the unjust and the lawless.
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I am against thee, and I will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and I will destroy out of thee the transgressor and unrighteous.

fresh_translation: Because I will destroy from you the unjust and the lawless, so my dagger will go out from its sheath against all flesh from the east to the north.
brenton_translation: Because I will destroy out of thee the unrighteous and the transgressor, therefore so shall my sword come forth out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

fresh_translation: And all flesh will know that I, the Lord, have drawn my dagger from its sheath, and it will not turn back anymore.
brenton_translation: and all flesh shall know that I the Lord have drawn forth my sword out of its sheath: it shall not return any more.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, groan with breaking of your loins, and with pains you will groan before their eyes.
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, groan with the breaking of thy loins; thou shalt even groan heavily in their sight.

fresh_translation: And it will be, if they say to you, Why do you groan? then you will say, Because of the report, for it is coming, and every heart will be broken, and all hands will be paralyzed, and all flesh and every spirit will faint, and all thighs will be defiled with wetness. Behold, it is coming and will happen, says the Lord God.
brenton_translation: And it shall come to pass, if they shall say to thee, Wherefore dost thou groan? that thou shalt say, For the report; because it comes: and every heart shall break, and all hands shall become feeble, and all flesh and every spirit shall faint, and all thighs shall be defiled with moisture: behold, it comes, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord: Say, Sword, sword, be sharpened and be enraged.
brenton_translation: Son of man, prophesy, and thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord; Say, Sword, sword, be sharpened and rage,

fresh_translation: So that you may slaughter victims, be sharpened; so that you may become ready for gleaming, ready for paralysis. Slaughter; despise; push away every tree.
brenton_translation: that thou mayest slay victims; be sharpened that thou mayest be bright, ready for slaughter, slay, set at nought, despise every tree.

fresh_translation: And he gave it ready for his hand to seize. The sword has been honed; it is ready to be given into the hand of one piercing through.
brenton_translation: And he made it ready for his hand to hold: the sword is sharpened, it is ready to put into the hand of the slayer.

fresh_translation: Cry out and howl, son of man, because it came among my people; it came among all the leaders of Israel. They will sojourn under sword; it came among my people. Therefore clap upon your hand.
brenton_translation: Cry out and howl, son of man: for this sword is come upon my people, this sword is come upon all the princes of Israel: they shall be as strangers: judgment with the sword is come upon my people: therefore clap thine hands, for sentence has been passed:

fresh_translation: Because it has been justified. And what if a tribe has been rejected? It will not be, says the Lord God.
brenton_translation: and what if even the tribe be rejected? it shall not be, saith the Lord God.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, prophesy and strike hand upon hand and double the sword; the third sword is a sword of wounded ones, a great sword of wounded ones, and it will throw them into panic.
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, prophesy, and clap thine hands, and take a second sword: the third sword is the sword of the slain, the great sword of the slain: and thou shalt strike them with amazement, lest the heart should faint

fresh_translation: So that the heart may be crushed and the weak ones may be multiplied, at all their gates they have been handed over to slaughter by sword. It has been well made for slaughter; it has been well made for gleaming.
brenton_translation: and the weak ones be multiplied at every gate—they are given up to the slaughter of the sword: it is well fitted for slaughter, it is well fitted for glittering.

fresh_translation: Pass through. Be sharpened on the right and on the left, wherever your face is raised.
brenton_translation: And do thou go on, sharpen thyself on the right and on the left whithersoever thy face may set itself.

fresh_translation: And I too will clap my hand to my hand and let my wrath rest. I, the Lord, have spoken.
brenton_translation: And I also will clap my hands, and let loose my fury: I the Lord have spoken it.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, appoint for yourself two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to enter. From one land the two will come out, and a hand will be at the beginning of the road, at the beginning of the city's road.
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may enter in: the two shall go forth of one country; and there shall be a force at the top of the way of the city, thou shalt set it at the top of the way,

fresh_translation: You will appoint a road for the sword to enter upon Rabbah of the sons of Ammon and upon Judah and upon Jerusalem in her midst.
brenton_translation: that the sword may enter in upon Rabbath of the children of Ammon, and upon Judea, and upon Jerusalem in the midst thereof.

fresh_translation: Because the king of Babylon will stand on the ancient road, at the beginning of the two roads, to divine divination, to shake a rod, and inquire by the carved things and inspect a liver. On his right
brenton_translation: For the king of Babylon shall stand on the old way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination, to make bright the arrow, and to enquire of the graven images, and to examine the victims.

fresh_translation: the oracle came against Jerusalem, to cast up a trench, to open mouth with a shout, to raise a voice with a cry, to cast up a trench against her gates and heap up earth and build missile-stations.
brenton_translation: On his right was the divination against Jerusalem, to cast a mound, to open the mouth in shouting, to lift up the voice with crying, to cast a mound against her gates, to cast up a heap, and to build forts.

fresh_translation: And he will be to them like one divining divination before them, and he himself reminding them of his injustices, to be remembered.
brenton_translation: And he was to them as one using divination before them, and he himself recounting his iniquities, that they might be borne in mind.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you brought your injustices to remembrance, when your impieties were uncovered, so that your sins were seen in all your impieties and in your practices, because you were remembered in these things, in them you will be captured.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Because ye have caused your iniquities to be remembered, in the discovery of your wickedness, so that your sins should be seen, in all your wickedness and in your evil practices; because ye have caused remembrance of them, in these shall ye be taken.

fresh_translation: And you, profane, lawless leader of Israel, whose day has come, an end in a time of injustice,
brenton_translation: And thou profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day, even an end, is come in a season of iniquity, thus saith the Lord;

fresh_translation: thus says the Lord: Remove the turban and put on the crown. This will not be like this. You humbled the high and exalted the low.
brenton_translation: Thou hast taken off the mitre and put on the crown, it shall not have such another after it: thou hast abased that which was high, and exalted that which was low.

fresh_translation: Injustice, injustice, I will make it. Even this will not be until one comes whose right it is, and I will give it to him.
brenton_translation: Injustice, injustice, injustice, will I make it: woe to it: such shall it be until he comes to whom it belongs; and I will deliver it to him.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord concerning the sons of Ammon and concerning their reproach. And you will say, Sword, sword, drawn for slaughter and drawn for complete destruction. Rise up so that you may flash,
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, prophesy, and thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord, concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach; and thou shalt say, O sword, sword, drawn for slaughter, and drawn for destruction, awake, that thou mayest gleam.

fresh_translation: while in your vain vision and your false divination, to hand you over upon the necks of wounded lawless ones whose day has come, an end in a time of injustice.
brenton_translation: While thou art seeing vain visions, and while thou art prophesying falsehoods, to bring thyself upon the necks of ungodly transgressors, the day is come, even an end, in a season of iniquity.

fresh_translation: Turn back. Do not lodge in this place where you were born; in your own land, I will judge you.
brenton_translation: Turn, rest not in this place wherein thou wert born: in thine own land will I judge thee.

fresh_translation: And I will pour out my wrath upon you; in the fire of my wrath I will blow upon you and hand you over into the hands of barbarous men devising destruction.
brenton_translation: And I will pour out my wrath upon thee, I will blow upon thee with the fire of my wrath, and I will deliver thee into the hands of barbarians skilled in working destruction.

fresh_translation: In fire you will be food; your blood will be in the midst of your land. There will be no remembrance of you, because I, the Lord, have spoken.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt be fuel for fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of thy land; there shall be no remembrance at all of thee: for I the Lord have spoken it.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, will you judge the city of bloods? Then show her all her lawless deeds,
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, declare thou to her all her iniquities.

fresh_translation: and say, Thus says the Lord God: O city pouring out bloods in her midst, so that her time may come, and making thoughts against herself so as to defile herself,
brenton_translation: And thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord God: O city that sheds blood in the midst of her, so that her time should come, and that forms devices against herself, to defile herself;

fresh_translation: in their bloods that you poured out you have trespassed, and in your thoughts that you made you were defiled; you brought your days near and brought on the time of your years. Because of this I have given you for reproach to nations and for mockery to all lands,
brenton_translation: in their blood which thou hast shed, thou hast transgressed; and in thy devices which thou hast formed, thou hast polluted thyself; and thou hast brought nigh thy days, and hast brought on the time of thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach to the Gentiles, and a mockery to all the countries,

fresh_translation: those near you and those far from you. They will mock you, unclean one, well-known and abundant in lawless deeds.
brenton_translation: to those near thee, and to those far distant from thee; and they shall mock thee, thou that art notoriously unclean, and abundant in iniquities.

fresh_translation: Behold, the leaders of the house of Israel, each with his relatives, were mixed together in you so as to pour out blood.
brenton_translation: Behold, the princes of the house of Israel have conspired in thee each one with his kindred, that they might shed blood.

fresh_translation: Father and mother they reviled in you, and toward the sojourner they behaved unjustly. In you they oppressed orphan and widow.
brenton_translation: In thee they have reviled father and mother; and in thee they have behaved unjustly toward the stranger: they have oppressed the orphan and widow.

fresh_translation: And my holy things they despised, and my Sabbaths they profaned in you.
brenton_translation: And they have set at nought my holy things, and in thee they have profaned my sabbaths.

fresh_translation: Robber men were in you so as to pour out blood in you, and on mountains they ate in you; they did impious things in your midst.
brenton_translation: There are robbers in thee, to shed blood in thee; and in thee they have eaten upon the mountains: they have wrought ungodliness in the midst of thee.

fresh_translation: A father's shame they uncovered in you, and one set apart in uncleanness they humbled in you.
brenton_translation: In thee they have uncovered the father's shame; and in thee they have humbled her that was set apart for uncleanness.

fresh_translation: Each one acted lawlessly with the wife of his neighbor, and each one defiled his daughter-in-law in impiety, and each one humbled his sister, daughter of his father, in you.
brenton_translation: They have dealt unlawfully each one with his neighbour's wife; and each one in ungodliness has defiled his daughter-in-law: and in thee they have humbled each one his sister, the daughter of his father.

fresh_translation: Gifts they took in you so as to pour out blood; interest and excess they took in you, and you brought your evil to completion by oppression. But me you forgot, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: In thee they have received gifts to shed blood; they have received in thee interest and usurious increase; and by oppression thou hast brought thy wickedness to the full, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: And if I strike my hand to my hand over what you completed, what you did, and over your bloods that have come to be in your midst,
brenton_translation: And if I shall smite my hand at thine iniquities which thou hast accomplished, which thou hast wrought, and at thy blood that has been shed in the midst of thee,

fresh_translation: will your heart stand? Will your hands be strong in the days when I act in you? I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it.
brenton_translation: shall thy heart endure? shall thine hands be strong in the days which I bring upon thee? I the Lord have spoken, and will do it.

fresh_translation: And I will scatter you among nations and disperse you through lands, and your uncleanness will cease from you.
brenton_translation: And I will scatter thee among the nations, and disperse thee in the countries, and thy uncleanness shall be removed out of thee.

fresh_translation: And I will allot inheritances in you before the eyes of nations, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will give heritages in thee in the sight of the nations, and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, behold, the house of Israel has become mixed to me, all of them with bronze and iron and tin and lead in the midst of silver; it is mixed.
brenton_translation: Son of man, behold, the house of Israel are all become to me as it were mixed with brass, and iron, and tin, and lead; they are mixed up in the midst of silver.

fresh_translation: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: Because you all became one mixture, therefore I receive you into the midst of Jerusalem.
brenton_translation: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord God; Because ye have become one mixture, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

fresh_translation: As silver and bronze and iron and tin and lead are received into the midst of a furnace, to blow fire into it so as to be melted, so I will receive you in my wrath and gather and melt you.
brenton_translation: As silver, and brass, and iron, and tin, and lead, are gathered into the midst of the furnace, to blow fire into it, that they may be melted: so will I take you in my wrath, and I will gather and melt you.

fresh_translation: And I will blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in her midst.
brenton_translation: And I will blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

fresh_translation: As silver is melted in the midst of a furnace, so you will be melted in her midst, and you will know that I, the Lord, poured out my wrath upon you.
brenton_translation: As silver is melted in the midst of a furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the Lord have poured out my wrath upon you.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, say to her, You are a land not rained on, nor did rain come upon you in the day of wrath.
brenton_translation: Son of man, say to her, Thou art the land that is not rained upon, neither has rain come upon thee in the day of wrath:

fresh_translation: Whose rulers in her midst are like roaring lions seizing plunder, eating souls in oppression, taking payments in injustice, and your widows were multiplied in your midst.
brenton_translation: whose princes in the midst of her are as roaring lions seizing prey, devouring souls by oppression, and taking bribes; and thy widows are multiplied in the midst of thee.

fresh_translation: And her priests rejected my law and profaned my holy things; between the holy and the profane they did not distinguish, and between the unclean and the clean they did not distinguish, and from my Sabbaths they covered their eyes, and I was profaned in their midst.
brenton_translation: Her priests also have set at nought my law, and profaned my holy things: they have not distinguished between the holy and profane, nor have they distinguished between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I was profaned in the midst of them.

fresh_translation: Her rulers in her midst are like wolves seizing plunder, to pour out blood, so that greedily they may gain greed.
brenton_translation: Her princes in the midst of her are as wolves ravening to shed blood, that they may get dishonest gain.

fresh_translation: And her prophets who smear them over will fall, seeing vain things, divining falsehoods, saying, Thus says the Lord, and the Lord has not spoken.
brenton_translation: And her prophets that daub them shall fall, that see vanities, that prophesy falsehoods, saying, Thus saith the Lord, when the Lord has not spoken.

fresh_translation: The people of the land were oppressing with injustice and plundering plunder, oppressing the poor and needy, and not behaving toward the sojourner with judgment.
brenton_translation: That sorely oppress the people of the land with injustice, and commit robbery; oppressing the poor and needy, and not dealing justly with the stranger.

fresh_translation: And I sought from them a man walking uprightly and standing wholly before me in the time of the land, so as not to wipe it out completely, and I did not find one.
brenton_translation: And I sought from among them a man behaving uprightly, and standing before me perfectly in the time of wrath, so that I should not utterly destroy her: but I found him not.

fresh_translation: And I poured out my wrath upon her; in the fire of my wrath, to complete, I have put their ways on their heads, says the Lord God.
brenton_translation: So I have poured out my wrath upon her in the fury of mine anger, to accomplish it. I have recompensed their ways on their own heads, saith the Lord God.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother.
brenton_translation: Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother:

fresh_translation: And they whored in Egypt, in their youth. There their breasts fell, there they were deflowered.
brenton_translation: and they went a-whoring in Egypt in their youth: there their breasts fell, there they lost their virginity.

fresh_translation: And their names were Oola the elder and Ooliba her sister, and they became mine and bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria was Oola and Jerusalem Ooliba.
brenton_translation: And their names were Oola the elder, and Ooliba her sister: and they were mine, and bore sons and daughters: and as for their names, Samaria was Oola, and Jerusalem was Ooliba.

fresh_translation: And Oola whored away from me and set herself on her lovers, on Assyrians near her,
brenton_translation: And Oola went a-whoring from me, and doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians that were her neighbours,

fresh_translation: clothed in blue, leaders and generals, choice young men all, horsemen mounted on horses.
brenton_translation: clothed with purple, princes and captains; they were young men and choice, all horsemen riding on horses.

fresh_translation: And she gave her whoring to them, all choice sons of Assyria, and with all on whom she set herself, with all her thoughts, she was defiled.
brenton_translation: And she bestowed her fornication upon them; all were choice sons of the Assyrians: and on whomsoever she doted herself, with them she defiled herself in all their devices.

fresh_translation: And her whoring from Egypt she did not leave, because they lay with her in her youth, and they also deflowered her and poured out their whoring upon her.
brenton_translation: And she forsook not her fornication with the Egyptians: for in her youth they committed fornication with her, and they deflowered her, and poured out their fornication upon her.

fresh_translation: Because of this I gave her into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of sons of Assyria on whom she set herself.
brenton_translation: Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the children of the Assyrians, on whom she doted.

fresh_translation: They uncovered her shame; they took her sons and daughters, and her they killed with sword. And she became a byword among women, and they carried out acts of vengeance against her among the daughters.
brenton_translation: They uncovered her shame: they took her sons and daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became a byword among women; and they wrought vengeance in her for the sake of the daughters.

fresh_translation: And her sister Ooliba saw and corrupted her desire beyond hers and her whoring beyond her sister's whoring.
brenton_translation: And her sister Ooliba saw it, and she indulged in her fondness more corruptly than she, and in her fornication more than the fornication of her sister.

fresh_translation: She set herself on sons of Assyria, leaders and generals near her, clothed in fine-bordered garments, horsemen riding on horses, choice young men all.
brenton_translation: She doted upon the sons of the Assyrians, princes and captains, her neighbours, clothed with fine linen, horsemen riding on horses; they were all choice young men.

fresh_translation: And I saw that they were defiled; one way belonged to them both.
brenton_translation: And I saw that they were defiled, that the two had one way.

fresh_translation: And she added to her whoring, and saw men painted on a wall, images of Chaldeans drawn with stylus,
brenton_translation: And she increased her fornication, and she saw men painted on the wall, likenesses of the Chaldeans painted with a pencil,

fresh_translation: girded with embroidered work on their loins and dyed tiaras on their heads, all with princely appearance, likeness of sons of Chaldea, their native land.
brenton_translation: having variegated girdles on their loins, having also richly dyed attire upon their heads; all had a princely appearance, the likeness of the children of the Chaldeans, of their native land.

fresh_translation: And she set herself on them at the sight of her eyes and sent messengers to them into the land of Chaldeans.
brenton_translation: And she doted upon them as soon as she saw them, and sent forth messengers to them into the land of the Chaldeans.

fresh_translation: And sons of Babylon came to her into a lodging bed and defiled her in her whoring, and she was defiled by them, and her soul turned away from them.
brenton_translation: And the sons of Babylon came to her, into the bed of rest, and they defiled her in her fornication, and she was defiled by them, and her soul was alienated from them.

fresh_translation: And she uncovered her whoring and uncovered her shame, and my soul turned away from her, as my soul turned away from her sister.
brenton_translation: And she exposed her fornication, and exposed her shame: and my soul was alienated from her, even as my soul was alienated from her sister.

fresh_translation: And you multiplied your whoring so as to remember the days of your youth in which you whored in Egypt.
brenton_translation: And thou didst multiply thy fornication, so as to call to remembrance the days of thy youth, wherein thou didst commit whoredom in Egypt,

fresh_translation: And you longed for Chaldeans, whose flesh was like that of donkeys and whose genitals were genitals of horses.
brenton_translation: and thou didst dote upon the Chaldeans, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and their members as the members of horses.

fresh_translation: And you revisited the lawlessness of your youth, what you did in Egypt, in your lodging, where your youthful breasts were.
brenton_translation: And thou didst look upon the iniquity of thy youth, the things which thou wroughtest in Egypt in thy lodging, where were the breasts of thy youth.

fresh_translation: Therefore, Ooliba, thus says the Lord: Behold, I stir up your lovers against you, those from whom your soul turned away, and I will bring them upon you from all around,
brenton_translation: Therefore, Ooliba, thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will stir up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy soul is alienated, and I will bring them upon thee round about,

fresh_translation: sons of Babylon and all Chaldeans, Phakoud and Sue and Kue, and all sons of Assyria with them, choice young men, governors and generals, all nobles and men of name, riding on horses.
brenton_translation: the children of Babylon, and all the Chaldeans, Phacuc, and Sue, and Hychue, and all the sons of the Assyrians with them; choice young men, governors and captains, all princes and renowned, riding on horses.

fresh_translation: And all will come against you from the north, chariots and wheels with a crowd of peoples; shields and bucklers, and they will set a guard against you all around. And I will set judgment before them, and they will take vengeance on you by their judgments.
brenton_translation: And they all shall come upon thee from the north, chariots and wheels, with a multitude of nations, shields and targets; and the enemy shall set a watch against thee round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall take vengeance on thee with their judgments.

fresh_translation: And I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in a fury of wrath. Your nose and your ears they will remove, and your remnant they will cast down by sword. They will take your sons and daughters, and fire will devour your remnant.
brenton_translation: And I will bring upon thee my jealousy, and they shall deal with thee in great wrath: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and shall cast down thy remnant with the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy remnant fire shall devour.

fresh_translation: And they will strip you of your garments and take vessels of your boasting.
brenton_translation: And they shall strip thee of thy raiment, and take away thine ornaments.

fresh_translation: And I will turn your impieties away from you, and your whoring from the land of Egypt; and you will not lift your eyes to them, and Egypt you will remember no more.
brenton_translation: So I will turn back thine ungodliness from thee, and thy fornication from the land of Egypt: and thou shalt not lift up thine eyes upon them, and shalt no more remember Egypt.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord God: Behold, I hand you over into the hands of those you hate, from whom your soul turned away,
brenton_translation: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hands of those whom thou hatest, from whom thy soul is alienated.

fresh_translation: and they will deal with you in hatred and take all your labors and your toils, and you will be naked and disgraced, and the shame of your whoring, your impiety, and your whoring will be uncovered.
brenton_translation: And they shall deal with thee in hatred, and shall take all the fruits of thy labours and thy toils, and thou shalt be naked and bare: and the shame of thy fornication shall be exposed: and thy ungodliness and thy fornication

fresh_translation: These things were done to you because you whored after nations and were defiled in their thoughts.
brenton_translation: brought this upon thee, in that thou wentest a-whoring after the nations, and didst defile thyself with their devices.

fresh_translation: You walked in the way of your sister, and I will put her cup in your hands.
brenton_translation: Thou didst walk in the way of thy sister; and I will put her cup into thine hands.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: You will drink the cup of your sister, deep and broad, overflowing so as to make an end.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; Drink thy sister's cup, deep and large, and full, to cause complete drunkenness.

fresh_translation: You will be filled with drunkenness and collapse, a cup of desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
brenton_translation: And thou shalt be thoroughly weakened; and the cup of destruction, the cup of thy sister Samaria,

fresh_translation: And you will drink it, and her feasts and her new moons I will turn away, because I have spoken, says the Lord.
brenton_translation: drink thou it, and I will take away her feasts and her new moons: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you forgot me and cast me behind your body, you also receive your impiety and your whoring.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore receive thou the reward of thine ungodliness and thy fornication.

fresh_translation: And the Lord said to me, Son of man, will you not judge Oola and Ooliba and announce to them their lawless deeds?
brenton_translation: And the Lord said to me; Son of man, wilt thou not judge Oola and Ooliba? and declare to them their iniquities?

fresh_translation: Because they committed adultery, and blood was in their hands. With their thoughts they committed adultery, and their children whom they bore to me they passed through fire for them.
brenton_translation: For they have committed adultery, and blood was in their hands, they committed adultery with their devices, and they passed through the fire to them their children which they bore to me.

fresh_translation: Even these things they did to me: my holy things they defiled and my Sabbaths they profaned.
brenton_translation: So long too as they did these things to me, they defiled my sanctuary, and profaned my sabbaths.

fresh_translation: And when they slaughtered their children to their idols, they entered into my holy places to profane them, and so they acted in the midst of my house.
brenton_translation: And when they sacrificed their children to their idols, they also went into my sanctuary to profane it: and whereas they did thus in the midst of my house;

fresh_translation: And they sent messengers to men coming from far away, and as soon as they came you washed and painted your eyes with stibium and adorned yourself with ornament.
brenton_translation: and whereas they did thus to the men that came from afar, to whom they sent messengers, and as soon as they came, immediately thou didst wash thyself, and didst paint thine eyes and adorn thyself with ornaments,

fresh_translation: And you sat on a spread bed, and an adorned table was before her, and my incense and my oil were enjoyed among them.
brenton_translation: and satest on a prepared bed, and before it there was a table set out, and as for mine incense and mine oil, they rejoiced in them,

fresh_translation: And they struck up the sound of harmony, and to men from the multitude of the people coming from the wilderness they put bracelets on their hands and a crown of boasting on their heads.
brenton_translation: and they raised a sound of music, and that with men coming from the wilderness out of a multitude of men, and they put bracelets on their hands, and a crown of glory on their heads;

fresh_translation: And I said, Are they not committing adultery in these things? Works of a prostitute, and she whored.
brenton_translation: Therefore I said, Do they not commit adultery with these? and has she also gone a-whoring after the manner of a harlot?

fresh_translation: And they went in to her as they go in to a prostitute woman; so they went in to Oola and to Ooliba, to do lawlessness.
brenton_translation: And they went in to her, as men go in to a harlot; so they went in to Oola and to Ooliba to work iniquity.

fresh_translation: And righteous men, they will take vengeance on them with the vengeance of adulteress and vengeance of blood, because they are adulteresses and blood is in their hands.
brenton_translation: And they are just men, and shall take vengeance on them with the judgment of an adulteress and the judgment of blood: for they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord God: Bring up a crowd against them and give among them turmoil and plundering.
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord God, Bring up a multitude upon them, and send trouble and plunder into the midst of them.

fresh_translation: And stone them with stones of crowds and pierce them with their swords. Their sons and their daughters they will kill, and their houses they will burn with fire.
brenton_translation: And stone them with the stones of a multitude, and pierce them with their swords: they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and shall burn up their houses.

fresh_translation: And I will turn impiety away from the land, and all women will be disciplined and will not act according to their impieties.
brenton_translation: And I will remove ungodliness out of the land, and all the women shall be instructed, and shall not do according to their ungodliness.

fresh_translation: And your impiety will be given upon you, and the sins of your thoughts you will receive, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And your ungodliness shall be recompensed upon you, and ye shall bear the guilt of your devices: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, write for yourself this day, from this day on which the king of Babylon pressed hard against Jerusalem, from this very day.
brenton_translation: Son of man, write for thyself daily from this day, on which the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem, even from this day.

fresh_translation: And speak a parable against the provoking house, and say to them, Thus says the Lord: Set on the cooking pot and pour water into it,
brenton_translation: And speak a parable to the provoking house, and thou shalt say to them,

fresh_translation: and put into it the pieces, every good piece, leg and shoulder, stripped from the bones.
brenton_translation: and put the pieces into it, every prime piece, the leg and shoulder taken off from the bones,

fresh_translation: taken from choice livestock, and kindle the bones under them. It boiled, boiled, and its bones were cooked in its midst.
brenton_translation: which are taken from choice cattle, and burn the bones under them: her bones are boiled and cooked in the midst of her.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: O city of bloods, a pot in which there is rust, and its rust did not go out from it. Piece by piece it was brought out; no lot fell on it.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord; O bloody city, the caldron in which there is scum, and the scum has not gone out of, she has brought it forth piece by piece, no lot has fallen upon it.

fresh_translation: Because her blood is in her midst. Upon bare rock I placed it; I did not pour it on the ground so as to cover it with earth.
brenton_translation: For her blood is in the midst of her; I have set it upon a smooth rock: I have not poured it out upon the earth, so that the earth should cover it;

fresh_translation: So that wrath might rise for vengeance, to take vengeance, I gave her blood upon bare rock, so that it should not be covered.
brenton_translation: that my wrath should come up for complete vengeance to be taken: I set her blood upon a smooth rock, so as not to cover it.

fresh_translation: Therefore thus says the Lord: I too will enlarge the pile.
brenton_translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, I will also make the firebrand great,

fresh_translation: And I will multiply the wood and kindle the fire so that the flesh may melt and the broth be diminished.
brenton_translation: and I will multiply the wood, and kindle the fire, that the flesh may be consumed, and the liquor boiled away;

fresh_translation: And set it upon the coals so that its bronze may burn and become hot and its uncleanness may melt within it and its rust may disappear.
brenton_translation: and that it may stand upon the coals, that her brass may be thoroughly heated, and be melted in the midst of her filthiness, and her scum may be consumed,

fresh_translation: And her abundant rust will not go out from her; her rust will be put to shame.
brenton_translation: and her abundant scum may not come forth of her.

fresh_translation: Because you were defiling yourself, what if you are not cleansed any longer until I fill up my wrath?
brenton_translation: Her scum shall become shameful, because thou didst defile thyself: and what if thou shalt be purged no more until I have accomplished my wrath?

fresh_translation: I, the Lord, have spoken, and it will come, and I will act. I will not delay, nor will I show mercy. According to your ways and according to your thoughts I judge you, says the Lord. Therefore I judge you according to your bloods and according to your thoughts; I judge you, the unclean one, notorious and abundant in provoking.
brenton_translation: I the Lord have spoken; and it shall come, and I will do it; I will not delay, neither will I have any mercy: I will judge thee, saith the Lord, according to thy ways, and according to thy devices: therefore will I judge thee according to thy bloodshed, and according to thy devices will I judge thee, thou unclean, notorious, and abundantly provoking one.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, behold, I take from you the desire of your eyes by an ordered stroke. You must not mourn, nor must you weep.
brenton_translation: Son of man, behold I take from thee the desire of thine eyes by violence: thou shalt not lament, neither shalt thou weep.

fresh_translation: The groaning of blood of your loins is mourning; it will not be. Your hair will not be braided on you, and your sandals will be on your feet. You will not be comforted by their lips, and bread of men you will not eat.
brenton_translation: Thou shalt groan for blood, and have mourning upon thy loins; thy hair shall not be braided upon thee, and thy sandals shall be on thy feet; thou shalt in no wise be comforted by their lips, and thou shalt not eat the bread of men.

fresh_translation: And I spoke to the people in the morning as it was commanded me, and my wife died in the evening, and I did in the morning as it was ordered me.
brenton_translation: And I spoke to the people in the morning, as he commanded me in the evening, and I did in the morning as it was commanded me.

fresh_translation: And the people said to me, Will you not tell us what these things are that you are doing?
brenton_translation: And the people said to me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are that thou doest?

fresh_translation: And I said to them, The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: Then I said to them, The word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I profane my holy things, the boasting of your strength, the desire of your eyes and what your souls spare, and your sons and your daughters whom you left behind will fall by sword.
brenton_translation: Say to the house of Israel,

fresh_translation: And you will do as I did. You will not be comforted by their mouth, and bread of men you will not eat.
brenton_translation: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not be comforted at their mouth, and ye shall not eat the bread of men.

fresh_translation: And your hair will be on your head and your sandals on your feet. You will neither mourn nor weep, and you will melt away in your injustices, and each of you will comfort his brother.
brenton_translation: And your hair shall be upon your head, and your shoes on your feet: neither shall ye at all lament or weep; but ye shall pine away in your iniquities, and shall comfort every one his brother.

fresh_translation: And Ezekiel will be for you a sign; according to all that he did you will do when these things come, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And Jezekiel shall be for a sign to you: according to all that I have done shall ye do, when these things shall come; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And you, son of man, will it not be on the day when I take from them their strength, the exaltation of their boasting, the desire of their eyes and the exaltation of their soul, their sons and their daughters,
brenton_translation: And thou, son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take their strength from them, the pride of their boasting, the desires of their eyes, and the pride of their soul, their sons and their daughters,

fresh_translation: on that day the one escaping will come to you to announce it in your ears?
brenton_translation: that in that day he that escapes shall come to thee, to tell it thee in thine ears?

fresh_translation: On that day your mouth will be opened to the one escaping, and you will speak and no longer be mute, and you will be to them as a sign, and they will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: In that day thy mouth shall be opened to him that escapes; thou shalt speak, and shalt be no longer dumb: and thou shalt be for a sign to them, and they shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
brenton_translation: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

fresh_translation: Son of man, set your face toward the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,
brenton_translation: Son of man, set thy face steadfastly against the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them;

fresh_translation: and say to the sons of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord: Because you rejoiced over my holy things that they were profaned, and over the land of Israel that it was destroyed, and over the house of Judah that they went into captivity,
brenton_translation: and thou shalt say to the children of Ammon,

fresh_translation: therefore behold, I give you to the sons of the east for inheritance, and they will camp with their equipment in you and pitch their tents in you. They will eat your fruits, and they will drink your richness.
brenton_translation: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of Kedem for an inheritance, and they shall lodge in thee with their stuff, and they shall pitch their tents in thee: they shall eat thy fruits, and they shall drink thy milk.

fresh_translation: And I will give the city of Ammon for a pasture for camels and the sons of Ammon for a pasture for sheep, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will give up the city of Ammon for camels' pastures, and the children of Ammon for a pasture of sheep: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: Because thus says the Lord: Because you clapped your hand and stamped your foot and rejoiced with all your soul over the land of Israel,
brenton_translation: For thus saith the Lord; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with thy foot, and heartily rejoiced against the land of Israel;

fresh_translation: therefore I stretch out my hand against you and give you for plunder among the nations and destroy you from the peoples and make you perish from the lands with destruction, and you will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: therefore I will stretch out my hand against thee, and I will make thee a spoil to the nations; and I will utterly destroy thee from among the peoples, and I will completely cut thee off from out of the countries: and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Because Moab said, Behold, the house of Israel and Judah is like all the nations,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; Because Moab has said, Behold, are not the house of Israel and Juda like all the other nations?

fresh_translation: therefore behold, I weaken the shoulder of Moab from its frontier cities, the choice land: Beth-Asimouth above the spring of the city by the sea,
brenton_translation: Therefore, behold, I will weaken the shoulder of Moab from his frontier cities, even the choice land, the house of Bethasimuth above the fountain of the city, by the sea-side.

fresh_translation: to the sons of the east, against the sons of Ammon, I have given them for inheritance, so that no remembrance of the sons of Ammon may come to be.
brenton_translation: I have given him the children of Kedem in addition to the children of Ammon for an inheritance, that there may be no remembrance of the children of Ammon.

fresh_translation: And against Moab I will do vengeance, and they will know that I am the Lord.
brenton_translation: And I will execute vengeance on Moab; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

fresh_translation: Thus says the Lord: Because Edom acted in taking vengeance with vengeance against the house of Judah, and they remembered wrongs and exacted a claim,
brenton_translation: Thus saith the Lord; Because of what the Idumeans have done in taking vengeance on the house of Juda, and because they have remembered injuries, and have exacted full recompence;

fresh_translation: therefore thus says the Lord: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and destroy from it man and cattle and make it a wilderness, and from Teman the pursued will fall by sword.
brenton_translation: therefore thus saith the Lord; I will also stretch out my hand upon Idumea, and will utterly destroy out of it man and beast; and will make it desolate; and they that are pursued out of Thæman shall fall by the sword.

fresh_translation: And I will place my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will act in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath, and they will know my vengeance, says the Lord.
